English: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
Kiswahili: “Mawimbi ya mauti yalinizunguka, mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinilemea.
Ekegusii: Emerindo y'amakweri konya yang'etananire, chiooro chi'obobe chikandetera obwoba.

English: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
Kiswahili: Binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza kwa paa na kwa ayala wa shambani: Msichochee wala kuamsha mapenzi hata yatakapotaka yenyewe. Shairi La Pili Mpendwa
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi ne chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani, gose koboichania, goika bobe Engaki yaye yaikeranire. Ogoteera Gwa Kabere (Omoriakari)

English: At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of Hosts— from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people widely feared, from a powerful nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers— to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo matoleo yataletwa kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote kutoka kwa taifa la watu warefu wenye ngozi nyororo, kutoka kwa taifa linaloogopwa mbali na karibu, kutoka taifa gomvi lenye lugha ngeni, ambalo nchi yao imegawanywa kwa mito, matoleo yataletwa katika Mlima Sayuni, mahali pa Jina la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene bw’Emeganda narenterwe ebiegwa nabaanto abwo bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, abwo bairokire nabaanto bare ang’e na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende nigo gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo nigo ere ne chindooche chinyinge. Ebiegwa ebio nigo biraarentwe ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase erieta ri’Omonene rimenyete.

English: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikaliitia jina la Bwana: “Ee Bwana, niokoe!”
Ekegusii: Erio nkarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, ’ngasaba, “Aye Omonene, nagosoroire ontoorie omoyo one.”

English: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, Ana alikuja akaanza kusifu, akimshukuru Mungu na kusema habari za huyo mtoto kwa watu wote waliokuwa wakitarajia ukombozi wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agateebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang'ana igoro y'Omwana oria.

English: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Harada na kupiga kambi huko Makelothi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Harada, bakageenda bagaika Makeloti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
Kiswahili: Wakampiga kwa fimbo ya mwanzi tena na tena kichwani na kumtemea mate. Wakapiga magoti mbele yake, wakamsujudia kwa kumdhihaki.
Ekegusii: Bakamoaka omotwe negetonto, bakamotwera amate, bakabeka amaru inse, bakamosasiima.

English: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes.” The Levites Numbered
Kiswahili: Kila urithi utagawanywa kwa kura miongoni mwa makundi makubwa na madogo.”
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna obomera boragwere abanto ba kera egesaku, ekenene gose egeke, nabo baranyore omwando obo.

English: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
Kiswahili: ninachukia kusanyiko la watenda mabaya na ninakataa kuketi pamoja na waovu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ngechete gosanga nabaanto bagokora amabe, na tingwancha goikaransa amo nabaanto abakayayu.

English: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Wenye haki watafurahi waonapo wakilipizwa kisasi, watakapochovya nyayo zao katika damu ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nagoke ekero egesiomba kegoakanwa, natiringe amanyinga ’abaanto abanyabibe.

English: On the fourth day Elizur son of Shedeur, the leader of the Reubenites, drew near.
Kiswahili: Siku ya nne Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri, kiongozi wa kabila la Reubeni, alileta sadaka yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kane Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

English: Then he restored the altar of the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings and thank offerings on it, and he told Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha akarudisha madhabahu ya Bwana na kutolea juu yake dhabihu za sadaka za amani pamoja na sadaka za shukrani, naye akawaamuru Yuda wamtumikie Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia naende egesasiimero ki’Omonene gekaba ekeyia, erio akaruera aroro ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, na ebi’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono; agachiika Abayuda bakorere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na hapo mtakapoingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria mokoorokera, erio kamogosoa aroro, namorore emori y'etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyendetere.

English: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeshuhudiwa kwamba: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
Ekegusii: Naki obereirwe kirori ng'a. “Aye n'Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng'ana buna Melkizedeki.”

English: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwingine wingu lilikuwepo kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi tu, na lilipoinuka asubuhi, nao waliondoka. Ikiwa ni mchana au usiku, wakati wowote wingu lilipoinuka, waliondoka.
Ekegusii: Chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria korwa mogoroba goika mambia rioka. Ekero kende gionsi riire riarenge koimokerera igoro, abanto nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo rwabo. Onye riarenge kobeera agwo omobaso na obotuko goika ekero riarenge koimokerera igoro naende, abanto nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo ekero ekio.

English: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife's hand, and his two daughters' hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
Kiswahili: Alipositasita, wale watu wakamshika mkono wake na mikono ya mke wake na binti zake wawili na kuwaongoza salama nje ya mji, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa na huruma kwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero abeete ogoteebana, abanto abwo bakamobwata okoboko, bakabwata na mokaye na abaiseke baye, ekiagera Omonene amororerete amaabera, akamosokia isiko y'omochie.

English: And Saul waited seven days for the time appointed by Samuel, but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and the troops began to desert Saul.
Kiswahili: Akangoja kwa siku saba, muda uliowekwa na Samweli; lakini Samweli hakuja Gilgali, nao watu wa Sauli wakaanza kutawanyika.
Ekegusii: Saulo akaganya Samweli amatuko atano na abere, buna Samweli konya amotebirie, na ekiagera Samweli ateebaanete Abanto bagaachaka goserebekana na gotiga Saulo.

English: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
Kiswahili: “Bwana, mhurumie mwanangu. Yeye ana kifafa na anateseka sana. Mara kwa mara huanguka kwenye moto au kwenye maji.
Ekegusii: “Omonene, ororere omomura one amaabera, ekiagera nare nendurume, nigo achandegete mono. Inaki ere, kero kende nigo akogwa ase omorero ime, na kero kende ase amaache ime.

English: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
Kiswahili: Kina, Dimona, Adada,
Ekegusii: Na Kina, na Dimona, na Adada,

English: Jonah, however, got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish. So he paid the fare and went aboard to sail for Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. The Great Storm (Acts 27:13–26)
Kiswahili: Lakini Yona alimkimbia Bwana na kuelekea Tarshishi. Alishuka mpaka Yafa, ambapo alikuta meli iliyokuwa imepangwa kuelekea bandari ile. Baada ya kulipa nauli, akapanda melini na kuelekea Tarshishi ili kumkimbia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende Yona akaimoka, agatama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene. Agatirimboka gochia Yopa, na agwo akanyora emeeri ekogenda Tarisisi. Erio agaakana chitaabu chi’orogendo, agasoa ime, akagenda amo nabaanto bande gotama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene.

English: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
Kiswahili: wale ambao meno yao ni panga na ambao mataya yao yamewekwa visu kuwaangamiza maskini katika nchi, na wahitaji kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Abanto 'mbare babwate amaino anga emioro, ne chintakunero chi'amaino abo nigo chinga emeyio; barabwo nigo bakoria na gosiria abataka bare ase ense; nigo bakoura abaremeire bare ase abanto.

English: Even so, who will pity him who goes to a sinner, and is associated with him in his sins?
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ni nani atakayemhurumia anayemwendea mwenye dhambi, na akashirikishwa naye katika dhambi zake?
Ekegusii: Ase igo, monto taiyo oramorore amaabera.

English: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametukuka juu ya mataifa yote, utukufu wake juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi, na obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine igoro chionsi.

English: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba Kristo, kwa sababu alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, hawezi kufa tena; mauti haina tena mamlaka juu yake.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng'a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakuure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogaambera naende.

English: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
Kiswahili: Ahimothi akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Sofai, Sofai akamzaa Nahathi,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Ahimoti: Elikana omomura oye, na Sofai omomura oye, na Nahati omomura oye,

English: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
Kiswahili: Fikiri jinsi ambavyo umewafundisha watu wengi, jinsi ambavyo umeitia nguvu mikono iliyokuwa dhaifu.
Ekegusii: Rora, aye kworokereirie abanto abange, na amaboko atabwate chinguru kwayakong'irie.

English: Bacchides was in the right wing. The phalanx advanced on the two parts, and they blew with their trumpets.
Kiswahili: Bacchides alikuwa upande wa kulia. Kikosi cha phalanx kilisonga mbele pande mbili, nao wakapiga tarumbeta zao.
Ekegusii: Bakide omonyene akeroberia ase okoboko gwokorio. Abasikari bagochiera amagoro bagachaaka gosuka motwe barabwo bagiteire korwa chinsemo ibere na baria bariinete chibaarasi. Ebituureri bi'eseegi biakabugigwa na abasikari ba Yuda nabarabwo bakabugia ebituureri biabo.

English: The affliction of an hour causes delights to be forgotten. In the end, a man's deeds are revealed.
Kiswahili: Taabu ya saa moja husababisha furaha kusahaulika. Mwishowe, matendo ya mtu hufichuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebinto bitari buya, abanto nigo bakweba, mbari korengereria ng'a chingaki nchireo chinkong'u, n'engaki y'emechando onde taiyo okoinyora amagenderero.

English: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu, chagueni watu saba miongoni mwenu, watu wenye sifa njema, waliojawa na Roho Mtakatifu na hekima, ambao tunaweza kuwakabidhi kazi hii,
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, chora abanto batano na babere korwa ase egati yaino, abamanyekanete ng'a nabaya, baichire n'Omoika na obong'aini, erinde tobabeeke ase emeremo eye.

English: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.
Kiswahili: Watawajibika kwenu na watafanya kazi zote za Hema, lakini kamwe wasisogelee vifaa vya patakatifu au madhabahu, la sivyo wao na ninyi mtakufa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo 'nabagokorere, naende bakore emeremo yonsi ase Eema eria, korende tibaabaisa goika ang'e ase ebikorero ebichenu bi'Aase Aachenu, gose tibaika ang'e ase egesasiimero. Baise gokora igo, aye amo nabarabwo igo morakwe.

English: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “Yahweh says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.'” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
Kiswahili: naye akasema mbele ya watu wote, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Vivi hivi ndivyo nitakavyoivunja nira ya Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli kutoka kwenye shingo za mataifa katika muda huu wa miaka miwili.' ” Alipofanya hivi, nabii Yeremia akaondoka zake.
Ekegusii: Hanania agakwana ase abanto bategererete, agateeba: “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Emiaka ebere etaraika nabo ndabune rikorogoto ria Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, rirue ase amagoti 'ebisaku bionsi.” Korende Yeremia omobani akarua agwo, akagenda.

English: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya nafasi ya juu aliyompa baba yako, kabila zote za watu, mataifa na watu wa kila lugha walimhofu na kumwogopa. Wale ambao mfalme alitaka kuwaua, aliwaua; wale aliotaka kuwaacha hai, aliwaacha hai; wale aliotaka kuwapandisha cheo, aliwapandisha; aliotaka kuwashusha, aliwashusha.
Ekegusii: na ase engencho y'obonene obwo amoete, abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b'emenwa ao ao, bakaba bagotengechigwa na koiroka ase obosio bwaye. Omonto onde bwensi ere aganetie goita, nigo arenge komoita, na oyo aganetie gotiga abe moyo, nigo arenge komotiga oba moyo; na oyo aganetie gokinia abe omonene, nigo arenge komokinia, na oyo aganetie gokeyia, nigo arenge komokeyia.

English: He says: “I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing Your praises in the assembly.”
Kiswahili: Yeye husema, “Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu; mbele ya kusanyiko nitaimba sifa zako.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia Nyasae, “Nindarie erieta riao ase abaminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie ase ogoteera.”

English: Meanwhile, the servants of the king of Aram said to him, “Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they prevailed over us. Instead, we should fight them on the plains; surely then we will prevail.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, maafisa wa mfalme wa Aramu wakamshauri, wakamwambia, “Miungu yao ni miungu ya vilimani. Ndiyo sababu walikuwa na nguvu sana kutuzidi. Lakini kama tukipigana nao katika nchi tambarare, hakika tutawashinda.
Ekegusii: Abasomba b’omorwoti bw’Abasiiria bakamoteebia: “Chinyasae chiabo nigo chire chinyasae chi’ebitunwa, na ase ayio nigo chiaba ne chinguru gotobua; korende togende torwane nabaanto abwo ase ense omweya, ekeene, goika tobe ne chinguru kobabua.

English: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will not be inquired of by you!
Kiswahili: Mnapotoa matoleo yenu, yaani, wana wenu kafara katika moto, mnaendelea kujinajisi na sanamu zenu zote hadi siku hii ya leo. Je, niulizwe neno na ninyi, ee nyumba ya Israeli? Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, mimi sitaulizwa neno na ninyi.
Ekegusii: Nonya ngoika reero iga, ekero mokorua ebiegwa biaino, na gosamba abana baino babe ebing'wanso, nigo mogwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasiima emegwekano yaino yonsi. Naende inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ninyanchete momborie amang'ana? Ekeene buna inche inde moyo, tingwancha momborie. Ninche Omonene Nyasae nateebire ayio.

English: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don't you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akalipigia kelele jeshi na Abneri mwana wa Neri, akisema, “Je, Abneri, hutanijibu?” Abneri akajibu, “Nani wewe umwitaye mfalme?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria abarwani abwo b'esegi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, akabora: “Abineri, tori goitaba?” Abineri akairaneria: “Naye ng'o okorangeria omorwoti?”

English: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza taa zake saba, na pia mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, pamoja na masinia, zote kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chitaaya chiaye isano na ibere, na ebiinachi, ne chindogio chiaye chi’echitaabu chichenire.

English: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
Kiswahili: Wanaomcha Mungu wameondolewa kutoka nchi; hakuna mtu mnyofu hata mmoja aliyebaki. Watu wote wanavizia kumwaga damu, kila mmoja anamwinda ndugu yake kwa wavu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamoirogete Nyasae basirire korwa ase ense, na oyore nenkoro endonge tari ase egati y’abanto. Bonsi nigo bakoboera abanto baitere amanyinga abo. Kera omonto nigo akobwata, oyomwabo noboreba.

English: In that day Tobit remembered the money which he had left in trust with Gabael in Rages of Media,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo Tobiti alikumbuka pesa alizokuwa amemwachia Gabaeli katika Rages of Media,
Ekegusii: Rituko erio erio, Tobiti akainyora chitaabu chiaye echio atigerete Gabaeli aria Rege ase ense ya Media,

English: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don't do even so to him:
Kiswahili: Mungu na amshughulikie Abneri, tena kwa ukali, ikiwa sitafanya kwa ajili ya Daudi kile Bwana alichomwahidi kwa kiapo,
Ekegusii: Nyasae ang'e egesusuro ekenene onye tingoikeraneria Daudi ay'Omonene amorierete eira amokorere:

English: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaweka askari walinzi katika ufalme wa Waaramu huko Dameski. Basi Waaramu wakawa watumwa wa Daudi, na kumlipa ushuru. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kote alipokwenda.
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abasikari ase egati y'Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.

English: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,
Kiswahili: Beth-Suri, Soko, Adulamu,
Ekegusii: na Beti‐Suri, na Soko, na Adulamu,

English: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
Kiswahili: “Au tena, mtu awezaje kuingia katika nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu? Akishamfunga, ndipo hakika anaweza kuteka nyara mali zake.
Ekegusii: Gose inaki omonto aranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani omonto oria omonyene chinguru? Erio magega anyare gosakora enyomba yaye.

English: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one cake of unleavened bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and he placed them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
Kiswahili: Kisha kutoka kwenye kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichokuwa mbele za Bwana, akachukua andazi moja, na jingine lililotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba; akaviweka hivi vyote juu ya mafungu ya mafuta ya mnyama, na juu ya lile paja la kulia.
Ekegusii: Naende korwa ase egetonga keria kiareenge agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene akarusia omogati oyomo otabeekiri memera, ne rindasi erimo, na omogati oyomo omoo, erio akabibeeka igoro ase ebitinya ebio na ekenama ekio kia borio.

English: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
Kiswahili: lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato kwa Bwana Mungu wako. Siku hiyo hutafanya kazi yoyote, wewe, wala mwanao au binti yako, wala mtumishi wako wa kiume au wa kike, wala wanyama wako, wala mgeni aliye ndani ya malango yako.
Ekegusii: korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nerituko ri'Esabato, riatananetwe na Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye, gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose chitugo chiao, gose omomenyi ore ase omochie oo.

English: Your descendants would have been as countless as the sand, and your offspring as numerous as its grains; their name would never be cut off or eliminated from My presence.”
Kiswahili: Wazao wako wangekuwa kama mchanga, watoto wako kama chembe zake zisizohesabika; kamwe jina lao lisingefutiliwa mbali, wala kuangamizwa kutoka mbele zangu.”
Ekegusii: Oroiboro rwao nigo rware gocha koba oronge buna omokenye, na ororeeria rwao robuche robe oronge buna chinche chi’omokenye. Amarieta abo tarenge gocha korusigwa, gose gosirigwa, korwa ase obosio bwane.”

English: You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mlimkataa huyo Mtakatifu na Mwenye Haki mkaomba mpewe yule muuaji.
Ekegusii: Korende mokamwanga oria Omochenu, Omonyene Oboronge, na mokaboria moegwe omoiti.

English: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona Maria akilia na wale Wayahudi waliokuja pamoja naye pia wakilia, Yesu alisikia uchungu moyoni, akafadhaika sana.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia komoorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.

English: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
Kiswahili: au zungumzeni na dunia, nayo itawafundisha, au acheni samaki wa baharini wawape taarifa.
Ekegusii: gose kwana ne riroba, ndikworokererie, ne chinswe chia nyancha, nchikoraarerie.

English: Therefore, the wrath of the LORD has fallen upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has made them an object of terror, horror, and mockery, as you can see with your own eyes.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hasira ya Bwana ikashuka juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu, naye akawa amewafanya kitu cha kutisha, cha kushangaza na kitu cha kufanyia mzaha kama mnavyoona kwa macho yenu wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene egacha igoro ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu. Omonene akabakora bakaba ebiorokererio bi’og okuurera, na aya abakorerete abeire ay’ogoichania na ay’okoondokia abanto. Aya moyaroche namaiso aino.

English: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kerubi mmoja kwenye mwisho mmoja, na kerubi mwingine kwenye mwisho mwingine; akawatengeneza kuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kifuniko katika miisho hiyo miwili.
Ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo, akayekora ekaba egento ekemo n'Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

English: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
Kiswahili: Nimemiminwa kama maji, mifupa yangu yote imetoka katika viungo vyake. Moyo wangu umegeuka kuwa nta, umeyeyuka ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Nabeire buna amaache aiteirwe 'nse; amauga onsi ay'omobere one atengokire na achoga‐chogire; enkoro yane yabeire buna obochoe, yanyititokire ime yane.

English: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,
Kiswahili: Kila mara viumbe hao wanne wenye uhai wanapomtukuza, kumheshimu na kumshukuru yeye aketiye kwenye kile kiti cha enzi, tena aishiye milele na milele,
Ekegusii: Na engaki ende yonsi ching’iti chiria chire moyo chikomotogia ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene, na komoa ogosika, na komoakera ng’a mbuya mono, ere oyore moyo goika kare na kare,

English: Men gathered together to them, acclaiming them.
Kiswahili: Wanaume walikusanyika pamoja kwao, wakiwasifu.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge kobekana amo ase ebiombe ase okobairaneria mbuya mono.

English: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless Yahweh your God!” All the assembly blessed Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before Yahweh and the king.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote, “Mhimidini Bwana Mungu wenu.” Hivyo wote wakamhimidi Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao. Wakasujudu na kuanguka kifudifudi mbele za Bwana na mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia omosangererekano bwonsi, “Togia Omonene, Nyasae oino!” Na omosangererekano bwonsi ogatogia Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, na agwo abanto baria bagatureka emetwe yabo, bagasasiima Omonene naende bakaorokia amasikani ase omorwoti.

English: Then someone came into Persia bringing him news that the armies which went against the land of Judah had been put to flight,
Kiswahili: Kisha mtu mmoja akaja Uajemi akimletea habari kwamba majeshi yaliyokwenda kupigana na nchi ya Yuda yameshindwa.
Ekegusii: Agwo Perisi, omorwoti Antioko akarenterwa amang'ana buna abarwani esegi abwo atomete Yudea babaiurwe;

English: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,'
Kiswahili: Ninapofikiri kwamba kitanda changu kitanifariji, nacho kiti changu cha fahari kitapunguza malalamiko yangu,
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorengereria ng'a oborere bwane mbonyare kondemia, na ebirengererio biane mbinyare gonkeaneria obororo bwane,

English: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Samweli alipokuwa akikua, na hakuacha hata moja ya maneno yake lianguke chini.
Ekegusii: Samweli akamenta gokiina; Omonene akaba nere, erinde tatiga ring'ana riaye nonya nerimo ritaikeranetigwe.

English: The king removed the signet ring he had recovered from Haman and presented it to Mordecai. And Esther appointed Mordecai over the estate of Haman.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akaivua pete yake ya muhuri, ambayo alikuwa amemnyangʼanya Hamani, akampa Mordekai, naye Esta akamweka Mordekai juu ya shamba la Hamani.
Ekegusii: Bono omorwoti akarusia ebonyi eria arusetie ase Hamani, akayea Moredekai, na Esiteri akabeeka Moredekai atenenere enyomba eria yarenge eya Hamani.

English: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.
Kiswahili: watu wote wakakusanyika kama mtu mmoja kwenye uwanja mbele ya Lango la Maji. Wakamwambia Ezra mwandishi alete Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mose, ambacho Bwana aliamuru kwa ajili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bonsi bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagasangererekana ase eraaro agwo bosio bw'Egeita ki'Amache, bagateebia Ezra, oria orenge omworokia bw'amachiiko, arente Egetabu ki'Amachiko, a Musa, ayio Omonene aruete ase Abaisraeli.

English: The Jews had light and gladness
Kiswahili: Wayahudi walikuwa na nuru na furaha
Ekegusii: Yabeire bo ase baria bare n'okobua, nigo bakwegena abasani babo nagwancha kobwatia omonguso obo, nigo benyorire bagosanga nabarobwo ase egesusuro egetindi,

English: Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
Kiswahili: Kweli haipatikani popote, na yeyote aepukaye uovu huwa mawindo. Bwana alitazama naye akachukizwa kwamba hapakuwepo haki.
Ekegusii: Ekeene kiaborire, na oyo ogotiga obobe nere ogwoswa oirwa. Omonene okwebeeka ang’e gotooria abanto baye Omonene ororire ng’a ekeene tikeri gokorwa, na amang’ana ayio amogechirie mono.

English: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn't come again.
Kiswahili: Alikumbuka kwamba wao walikuwa nyama tu, upepo upitao ambao haurudi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ainyorete ng'a barabwo Mwanyabaanto bagosira, nigo banga buna embeo egoeta na tekoirana.

English: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
Kiswahili: Alipolifungua hilo Shimo, moshi ukapanda kutoka humo kama moshi wa tanuru kubwa sana. Jua na anga vikatiwa giza na ule moshi uliotoka katika hilo Shimo.
Ekegusii: Na igo ekaigora ekeronga ki'eora eria, na erioki rigasoka korwa ase ekeronga keria buna erioki ri'eriko rinene, na erioba na omoika bikabekwa omosunte nerioki riria riarwete ase ekeronga keria.

English: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” Yahweh said, “Judah first.”
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakapanda Betheli na kumuuliza Mungu, “Ni nani miongoni mwetu atakayetangulia mbele yetu ili kupigana na Wabenyamini?” Bwana akawajibu, “Yuda ndiye atakayetangulia.”
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka, bakageenda Beteli kobooria ogoseemia korwa ase Nyasae, bakabooria, “Mbarabi ase tore barabe ab'eritang'ani gochia korwania Ababenjamini?” Omonene akairaneria, “Abayuda 'nababe ab'eritang'ani”.

English: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
Kiswahili: Wewe, Ee Bwana unatawala milele, kiti chako cha enzi chadumu kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo oragaambe kare na kare, ekerogo kiao ki'obogaambi nigo kerabeo ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: while the land belonged to a mighty man, and a man of honor lived on it.
Kiswahili: ingawa ulikuwa mtu mwenye uwezo ukimiliki nchi: mtu uliyeheshimiwa, ukiishi ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto obwate okobua nigo akoira ense yaba eyaye, na oyio oeirwe ogosikwa nere okoyemenya.

English: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, inuka uihukumu nchi, kwa kuwa mataifa yote ni urithi wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekiina, ekiagera abanto b'ebisaku bionsi nabao.

English: Yahweh's hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Nguvu za Bwana zikamjia Eliya, naye akajikaza viuno, akakimbia mbele ya Ahabu njia yote hadi maingilio ya Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw'Omonene gokaba amo n'Elija, ere agesiba ekenema norokini rwaye, akaminyoka agatang'ana bosio bw'Ahabu goika akagenda ase omochie o Yesireeli.

English: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mipiko itabakia daima katika hizo pete za hilo Sanduku; haitaondolewa.
Ekegusii: Emiaro eyio goika ebe ime ase chibonyi echio, terusigwao.

English: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don't murmur among yourselves.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kunungʼunikiana ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Timwemurunganerania inwe ase inwe.

English: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
Kiswahili: Yule Mfilisti aliposogea karibu ili kumshambulia, Daudi akaenda mbio kuelekea safu ya vita kukutana naye.
Ekegusii: Omofilisti oria agaachaka kogenda goikera Daudi ang'e, erio Daudi akaminyoka bwango gochia ase abarwani koumerana n'Omofilisti oria.

English: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don't hear the voice of the taskmaster.
Kiswahili: Wafungwa nao hufurahia utulivu wao, hawasikii tena sauti ya kukemea ya kiongozi wa watumwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasibwa baikire aroro, nigo bakoba bagotimoka amo, tibari koigwa amariogi y'abarendi babo bakobabetereria nobotindi.

English: But because he couldn't pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alikuwa hawezi kulipa deni hilo, bwana wake akaamuru kwamba auzwe, yeye, mkewe, watoto wake na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, ili lile deni lipate kulipwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero asinyetwe goakana, omonene oye agachiika aoonigwe, ere na mokaye, na abana baye, na ebi abwate bionsi, na esiira eria eakanwe.

English: Then Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim, and the whole army of Sisera fell by the sword; not a single man was left. Jael Kills Sisera
Kiswahili: Lakini Baraka akafuata magari pamoja na jeshi mpaka Haroshethi-Hagoyimu. Jeshi lote la Sisera likaanguka kwa upanga, wala hakuna hata mtu mmoja aliyesalia.
Ekegusii: Baraki akabwatia chigari n’omoganda bw’abarwani b’esegi goika Haroseti, omochie bw’ebisaku, n’omoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani b’esegi o Sisera ogaitwa, monto onde taiyo nonya n’oyomo ominchoretie.

English: When Jacob came in from the field that evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, “You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night. Issachar, Zebulun, and Dinah
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo alipokuja kutoka shambani jioni ile, Lea akaenda kumlaki, akamwambia, “Lazima ukutane nami kimwili. Nimekukodisha kwa tunguja za mwanangu.” Kwa hiyo akakutana naye kimwili usiku ule.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo areenge koirana korwa mogondo mogoroba, Lea akagenda komoorotota, akamoteebia: “Reero goika oraare mwane, nakogorire namasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one.” Ase obotuko Yakobo akaba nere.

English: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi mnajionyesha kuwa wenye haki mbele za wanadamu, lakini Mungu anaijua mioyo yenu. Kwa maana vile vitu ambavyo wanadamu wanavithamini sana, kwa Mungu ni machukizo.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe nabaanto mogwetogia ng'a nigo more abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende Nyasae omanyire chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ekeimokererete igoro ase Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae nigo akegechete.

English: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
Kiswahili: walikuwa watu 8,580.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge abanto chilifu isano isato na amagana atano, na merongo etano netato (8,580).

English: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake watu wa Shekemu wakatoka wakaenda mashambani, Abimeleki akaambiwa juu ya jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bagasoka ase egetii aarabu, n'Abimeleki agateebigwa amang'ana ayio.

English: But afterwards, they also saw a new kind of birds, when, led on by desire, they asked for luxurious dainties;
Kiswahili: Lakini baadaye, waliona pia aina mpya ya ndege, wakati, wakiongozwa na tamaa, waliomba vyakula vitamu vya kifahari;
Ekegusii: Omoerio bakarora chinyoni chingeni.

English: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
Kiswahili: Haimpasi mwanaume kufunika kichwa chake kwa kuwa yeye ni mfano wa Mungu na utukufu wa Mungu, lakini mwanamke ni utukufu wa mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Naki tegwenereti omosacha gotuba omotwe oye, ekiagera nomogwekano bw’obonene bwa Nyasae; korende omokungu nobonene bw’omosaacha.

English: So Saul went to Naioth in Ramah. But the Spirit of God came upon even Saul, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Sauli akaenda Nayothi huko Rama. Lakini Roho wa Mungu akaja juu yake hata yeye, akawa anatembea huku anatoa unabii hadi akafika Nayothi.
Ekegusii: Ase igo akagenda gochia Nayoti agwo Rama. Korende Omoika o Nyasae ogaika nonya niigoro yaye, na ere akaba okobana kagendererete nchera goika Nayoti agwo Rama.

English: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
Kiswahili: Hesabuni uvumilivu wa Bwana kuwa ni wokovu, kama vile ndugu yetu mpenzi Paulo alivyowaandikia kwa hekima ile aliyopewa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Na bara okoremereria kw'Omonene oito ng'a nogotooreka. Naboigo noyominto omwanchwa, Paulo, abarikerete koreng'ana nobong'aini aetwe.

English: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”
Kiswahili: Naomi akamwambia, “Tazama, mwenzako anarejea kwa watu wake na kwa miungu yake. Rudi pamoja naye.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo Naomi agateebia Rutu, “Naama! Oripa, moka momura omwabo omosacha oo, oiranire ase abanto baye, na ase enyasae yaye. Naye irana, mogende komo!”

English: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
Kiswahili: Kila siku alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni. Lakini viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa watu walikuwa wakitafuta njia ili kumuua.
Ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria kera rituko ase Hekalu. Abakuani abanene, na aborokia b'amariiko, na abanene b'abaanto bakarigia komoita;

English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
Kiswahili: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na hazina iliyofichwa shambani, ambayo mtu mmoja alipoiona akaificha tena. Kisha katika furaha yake, akaenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akalinunua lile shamba.”
Ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine neniibo yabisire ase omogondo, eye omonto anyorete, akayebisa; erio ase omogooko oye akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akagora omogondo oria.

English: at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said to them, “The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities in which to live, together with pasturelands for our livestock.”
Kiswahili: huko Shilo katika Kanaani na kuwaambia, “ Bwana aliamuru kupitia Mose kuwa mtupe miji ya kuishi yenye sehemu za malisho kwa mifugo yetu.”
Ekegusii: bagakwana nabarabwo agwo Silo, bakabateebia, “Omonene nigo achigete goetera ase Musa ng’a toegwe emechie ase tokomenya, amo namarisio, ase chitugo chiaito chirarisie.”

English: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
Kiswahili: Nitakusifu kwa moyo mnyofu ninapojifunza sheria zako za haki.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe neorokereirie okogaamba kwao kw’oboronge, rirorio nimbe nkona‐kogotogia nenkoro endonge.

English: They also brought the fat portions from the ox and the ram—the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver—
Kiswahili: Lakini sehemu zile za mafuta ya yule maksai na kondoo dume, yaani mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yaliyofunika tumbo, ya figo na yaliyofunika ini,
Ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eeri eyio, na omokera bw’emingichi n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, ne chinyigo, n’ebitinya bie riini,

English: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni. Hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kukaa kwenye nafasi za heshima katika karamu.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abanchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro, na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega,

English: It will pour into Judah, swirling and sweeping over it, reaching up to the neck; its spreading streams will cover your entire land, O Immanuel!
Kiswahili: na kufika hadi Yuda, yakizunguka kwa kasi juu yake, yakipita katikati na yakifika hadi shingoni. Mabawa yake yaliyokunjuliwa yatafunika upana wa nchi yako, Ee Imanueli!”
Ekegusii: Aro naminyoke ne chinguru igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, aichore, agenderere gochia bosio aike ase rigoti.” Ee, aye Imanueli, amaache ayio nigo ararambore chimbaaba chiaye atube obogare bw’ense yao.

English: Tell the rebellious house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I have had enough of all your abominations, O house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Iambie nyumba ya kuasi ya Israeli, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Matendo yenu ya machukizo yatosha, ee nyumba ya Israeli!
Ekegusii: “Oteebie abanto b’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli, abwo bare abasaria, ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Inwe Abaisraeli, tiga ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia goisanere agwo.

English: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh's breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
Kiswahili: Majani hunyauka na maua huanguka, kwa sababu pumzi ya Bwana huyapuliza. Hakika wanadamu ni majani.
Ekegusii: Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, ekero Omonene abiuteire omoika oye; naboigo na Mwanyabaanto banga buna obonyansi.

English: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo ahadi ambayo makabila yetu kumi na mawili yanatarajia kuiona ikitimizwa wanapomtumikia Mungu kwa bidii usiku na mchana. Ee mfalme, ninashtakiwa na Wayahudi kwa ajili ya tumaini hili.
Ekegusii: eira eyio eyio ebisaku biaito ikomi na bibere biasemeretie koyeikera, kobiragenderere komosasiima Nyasae obotuko na omobaso. Aye omorwoti! Ase engencho y'ogosemeria okwo nasoereirwe n'Abayahudi.

English: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
Kiswahili: Bibi arusi ni wa bwana arusi. Lakini rafiki yake bwana arusi anayesimama karibu naye na kusikiliza kutoka kwake, hufurahi sana aisikiapo sauti ya bwana arusi. Kwa sababu hii furaha yangu imekamilika.
Ekegusii: Oyore nomoriakari nere omonywomi, korende omong’wansi oye nigo agotenena na komoigwa, ogookera eriogi ri’omonywomi; naboigo omogooko one oikeranire bono.”

English: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
Kiswahili: uzito wa dhahabu safi kwa ajili ya nyuma, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia na vikombe, masinia; uzito wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya kila bakuli la dhahabu; uzito wa fedha kwa ajili ya kila bakuli la fedha;
Ekegusii: Akamotebereria igoro ye chigami, ne chisani, na ebitaabo biroisigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire na igoro ye chibakuri chi'echitaabu, na echie chifeta, na oborito bwa kera eyemo;

English: Tell it to your children; let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.
Kiswahili: Waelezeni watoto wenu, na watoto wenu wawaambie watoto wao, na watoto wao kwa kizazi kitakachofuata.
Ekegusii: Yateebie abana baino amang’ana aya, na abana baino bayateebie abana babo, na abana babo bayateebie ekegori kende.

English: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
Kiswahili: Yule mdogo akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nipe urithi wangu.’ Hivyo akawagawia wanawe mali yake.
Ekegusii: Oria omoke agateebia ise: Tata, ing’a ensemo y’enibo entungetie. Ise akabaatanera ebinto biaye.

English: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke ambaye ni mjane kweli kweli, yaani, yeye aliyebaki peke yake huweka tumaini lake kwa Mungu naye hudumu katika maombi usiku na mchana akimwomba Mungu ili amsaidie.
Ekegusii: Oyore omotaakanwa bori, na otigire bweka, oyo nigo amosemeretie Nyasae, na kogeenderera ase okoboria na ogosaba obotuko na omobaso.

English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mushi: Mahli, Ederi na Yeremothi; wote walikuwa watatu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba batato: Mali, na Ederi, na Yeremoti.

English: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
Kiswahili: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa mahalathi leanothi. Utenzi wa Hemani Mwezrahi. Ee Bwana, Mungu uniokoaye, nimelia mbele zako usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora; okworokereria kwa Hamani Omoezara) Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw'ogotooreka kwane, omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera asore ng'a onkonye.

English: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows. Confessing Christ (Matthew 10:32–33)
Kiswahili: Naam, hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa. Hivyo msiogope, kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.
Ekegusii: Nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe chionsi. Timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.

English: So they set it aside until morning as Moses had commanded, and it did not smell or contain any maggots.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakavihifadhi mpaka asubuhi, kama Mose alivyoagiza, na havikunuka wala kuwa na mabuu.
Ekegusii: Na buna Musa abachigete bakagacha endagera eria yatigarete goika rituko ria kabere; ero tiyagunda etioke, gose tiyasogwa namakonde.

English: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
Kiswahili: “Vitu vyote ni halali kwangu”: lakini si vitu vyote vyenye faida. “Vitu vyote ni halali kwangu”: lakini sitatawaliwa na kitu chochote.
Ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tingwancha koba omosomba o gento kende gionsi.

English: so that as long as the heavens are above the earth, your days and those of your children may be multiplied in the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba siku zenu na siku za watoto wenu zipate kuwa nyingi katika nchi ile Bwana aliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu, kama zilivyo nyingi siku za mbingu juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Erio nario inwe amo n’abana baino moramenye amatuko amaange ase ense eri’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee ebe eyabo. Nigo moragenderere komenyao ase engaki koreng’ana buna igoro egendererete koba igoro y’ense.

English: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Danieli akastawi wakati wa utawala wa Dario, na utawala wa Koreshi Mwajemi.
Ekegusii: Bono Danieli oyio agasesenigwa akanyora okobua ase engaki y'okogamba kwa Dario na ey'ogwa Koresi Omoayemi.

English: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.
Kiswahili: Hivyo walitawanyika kwa sababu hapakuwepo mchungaji, nao walipotawanyika, wakawa chakula cha wanyama wa mwitu wote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio chiaserebekanire gochia aande onsi, ekiagera chitabwati omorisia, chiabeire endagera ye ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, ee chiaserebekanire.

English: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yoshua akaondoka Libna kwenda Lakishi akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote; wakajipanga dhidi yake na kuushambulia.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaimoka amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Libuna, bakagenda Lakisi, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.

English: and said to them, “Cross over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of Israel,
Kiswahili: naye akawaambia, “Mtangulie mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana Mungu wenu, mwende katikati ya Mto Yordani. Kila mmoja wenu atainua jiwe begani mwake, kufuatana na hesabu ya makabila ya Waisraeli,
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Eta mogende bosio bw’Esanduki y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, goika gati‐gati ya Yorodani. Kera oyomo oino aimokie rigena erimo, aribeke ireko riaye, erimo ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli.

English: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you. Hagar and Sarah (Genesis 21:9–21)
Kiswahili: Natamani kama ningekuwa pamoja nanyi sasa, pengine ningebadilisha sauti yangu. Kwa maana nina wasiwasi kwa ajili yenu. Mfano Wa Hagari Na Sara
Ekegusii: Ee, anga nancha koba amo nainwe bono, na koonchora eriogi riane, ekiagera timanyeti inki ngokora ase more. Abana babere abamura

English: He shall tend the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD continually. The Showbread (Exodus 25:23–30; Exodus 37:10–16)
Kiswahili: Taa zilizo juu ya kinara cha dhahabu safi mbele za Bwana lazima zihudumiwe daima.
Ekegusii: Aroni arende chitaaya echio chire ase ekebekerero gi’echitaaya gi’etaabu echenire, erinde chigenderere gwoka botaambe ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae

English: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants' blood is being poured out.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wenu?” Mbele ya macho yetu, dhihirisha kati ya mataifa kwamba unalipiza kisasi damu iliyomwagwa ya watumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b'ebisaku bakoboria, “Ng'ai Nyasae oyio obo are?” Ase amasio aito tiga abanto b'ebisaku bamanye buna okorusia egesiomba ase engencho y'ogoiterwa kw'amanyinga 'abasomba bao.

English: After some time, David’s son Amnon fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of David’s son Absalom.
Kiswahili: Ikawa baada ya hayo, Amnoni mwana wa Daudi akampenda Tamari, umbu lake Absalomu mwana wa Daudi, ambaye alikuwa mzuri wa sura.
Ekegusii: Bono Abisalomu, mosinto o Daudi, nareenge nomoiseke omwabo ore korokwa Tamari. Tamari nigo arenge omonyakieni mono. Omomura onde o Daudi ore korokwa Amunoni akaba omwanchete Tamari.

English: For by fire and by His sword, the LORD will execute judgment on all flesh, and many will be slain by the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa moto na kwa upanga wake Bwana atatekeleza hukumu juu ya watu wote, nao wengi watakuwa ni wale waliouawa na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nanachere abanto ekiina na kobaa egesusuro ki’ogosaambwa nomorero na goitwa nemioro, na abwo baraitwe n’Omonene nigo barabe abange.

English: Then Hiram king of Tyre wrote a letter in reply to Solomon: “Because the LORD loves His people, He has set you over them as king.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akamjibu Solomoni kwa barua: “Kwa sababu Bwana anawapenda watu wake, amekufanya wewe kuwa mfalme wao.”
Ekegusii: Huramu, omorwoti o Turo, akairaneria ase riruube atomete ase Sulemani, rigoteeba: “Ekiagera Omonene anchete abanto baye, okobekire aye koba omorwoti igoro ase bare,”

English: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana alisimama upande wangu akanitia nguvu, ili kupitia kwangu lile Neno lihubiriwe kwa ukamilifu, watu wote Mataifa wapate kulisikia. Mimi niliokolewa kutoka kinywa cha simba.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatenena amo nainche, akambeeka chinguru, erinde goetera ase 'nde okoraria kwe ring'ana goikeranigwe goika abanto bonsi b'Ebisaku bakoigwe. Na inche nigo natooretigwe korwa ase omonwa bw'endo.

English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won't be harmed by the second death.
Kiswahili: “Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie yale ambayo Roho ayaambia makanisa. Yeye ashindaye hatadhuriwa kamwe na mauti ya pili.
Ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring'ana eri Omoika ogoteebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue takonyora obororo bw'amakweri a kabere nonya ng'ake.

English: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenyezi ni nguvu yangu; huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya ayala, huniwezesha kupita juu ya vilima. Kwa kiongozi wa uimbaji. Kwa vinanda vyangu vya nyuzi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oyore Omonene, nere chinguru chiane; nigo agokora amagoro aane abe amaango buna ay’ensune, nigo agontaaria ase ebitunwa biane igoro. Ase omoteria. Ogoteera kogoterwa ase okobugigwa kw’amakano aane.

English: You are to speak to him and put the words in his mouth. I will help both of you to speak, and I will teach you what to do.
Kiswahili: Utazungumza naye na kuweka maneno kinywani mwake. Nitawasaidia ninyi wawili kusema, nami nitawafundisha jambo la kufanya.
Ekegusii: Aye nokwane nere, omoteebie aya agochia gokwana. Inche nimbae inwe babere amang’ana mogochia gokwana, boigo nimbaorokererie aya mogochi gokora.

English: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
Kiswahili: Kama nyumba pekee ninayoitarajia ni kaburi, kama nikikitandika kitanda changu gizani,
Ekegusii: Nonya inde nogosemeria, aase abakuure nao obomenyo bwane, nindambore oborere bwane ase omosunte ime.

English: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Aliwaongoza wana wa Israeli kutoka Misri, baada ya kufanya ishara na maajabu mengi huko Misri, katika Bahari ya Shamu, na katika jangwa kwa muda wa miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nere obarusetie korwa aroro magega gakorire amakumia na ebikone ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Enyancha Embariri, naende ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
Kiswahili: Huyasheheneza mawingu kwa maji, naye husambaza umeme wake wa radi kupitia hayo.
Ekegusii: Nigo agoichoria amare amarito namaache, amare nigo agosiarera chinkoba chiaye.

English: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won't fail.”
Kiswahili: Utazikungʼutakungʼuta kama joho, nazo zitachakaa kama vazi. Lakini wewe hubadiliki, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.”
Ekegusii: nobiringe buna egetambaa gi'okwambara, na birobio nabionchoke buna chianga. Korende aye naye oria oria ore buna kwarenge, na obogima bwao tibokoba nomoerio.”

English: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
Kiswahili: Mara wale waliokuwa wanataka kumhoji wakajiondoa haraka, naye yule jemadari akaingiwa na hofu alipotambua ya kuwa amemfunga Paulo, ambaye ni raia wa Rumi, kwa minyororo.
Ekegusii: Erio baria barenge ang'e komoboria bakaimoka, bakamotiga bwango, na oria omotang'ani omonene akoboa ekero aigwa ng'a n'Omorumi are, na konya omosibire.

English: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Lakini mara alipoazimu kufanya jambo hili, malaika wa Bwana akamtokea katika ndoto na kusema, “Yosefu mwana wa Daudi, usiogope kumchukua Maria awe mke wako, kwa maana mimba aliyo nayo ni kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero arenge orengereretie aya, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamochiera ase chindoto akamoteebia. “Aye Yusufu, korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi, toiroka koira Mariamu abe mokao, ekiagera nigo abeire morito ase okobua kw’Omoika Omochenu.

English: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
Kiswahili: Mara baada ya kupandwa, mara baada ya kutiwa ardhini, mara baada ya kutoa mizizi yao ardhini, ndipo huwapulizia nao wakanyauka, nao upepo wa kisulisuli huwapeperusha kama makapi.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo banga buna ebimeri bisimekire masomberera, bitaireti emeri inse. Omonene nigo akobaguseria embeo, boma, na omoubera noro obairurukia buna okoirurukia obonyansi obwomo.

English: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.
Kiswahili: Lolote Sauli alilomtuma Daudi kufanya, alitenda kwa hekima, hata Sauli akampa cheo cha juu katika jeshi. Jambo hili likawapendeza watu wote, hata maafisa wa Sauli pia.
Ekegusii: Aande onsi ase Saulo areenge gotoma Daudi, Daudi nigo areenge konyora obobui. Ase ayio Saulo akamobeka akaba omotang'ani bw'abarwani. Daudi igo anyorete ogwancherwa kw'Abaanto bonsi na okw'abasomba ba Saulo.

English: But when the elders had told their tale, the servants were greatly ashamed; for there was never such a report made of Susanna.
Kiswahili: Lakini wazee walipokwisha kusimulia hadithi yao, watumishi wakaona aibu sana; kwa maana hakukuwahi kuripotiwa habari kama hiyo kuhusu Susana.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi baria bagateba omogano obo na ekero abasomba baria baigwete omogano oyio bagasoka mono, ekiagera mangana anga buna aya tanya kobera Susana rinde.

English: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Neco king of Egypt marched up to fight at Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out to confront him.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya yote, Yosia alipomaliza kulitengeneza vizuri Hekalu, Neko mfalme wa Misri, akapanda ili kupigana huko Karkemishi katika Mto Frati, naye Yosia akatoka kwenda kupigana naye.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio onsi, ekero Yosia konya aroisirie Hekalu, Neko, omorwoti o Misiri, agatiira kogenda korwana esegi agwo Karikemisi ase orooche rw’Eufarati, na Yosia akagenda korwana nere.

English: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
Kiswahili: Sheba akapita katika makabila yote ya Israeli hadi Abel-Beth-Maaka na kupitia eneo lote la Waberi ambao walijikusanya pamoja na kumfuata.
Ekegusii: Seba agaeta egati ye chingongo chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, agaika omochie o Abeli Beti‐Maaka, na Ababeri bonsi bagasangererekana amo, bakamotunyana.

English: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.
Kiswahili: Huipinga mipango ya wenye hila, ili mikono yao isifikie ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agosaria emeroberio y’abang’ainereria, erinde emeremo bagokora namaboko abo tegoikerana buna baganetie.

English: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaomba, “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, nipatie ushindi leo, uonyeshe huruma kwa bwana wangu Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Ere agasaba, agateeba: “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw'omonene one Aburaamu, nagosabire, onsesenie ase amang'ana aane a reero, okorere omonene one Aburaamu obwanchani.

English: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli, wanawe watatu, mbeba silaha wake na watu wake wote wakafa pamoja siku ile ile.
Ekegusii: Nabo Saulo, na abamura baye batato, na omobogoria ebirwanero, amo n'baanto baye bonsi, baitetwe ase rituko erio erimo.

English: He took his life in his hands when he struck down the Philistine, and the LORD worked a great salvation for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced, so why would you sin against innocent blood by killing David for no reason?”
Kiswahili: Alihatarisha maisha yake alipomuua yule Mfilisti. Bwana akajipatia ushindi mkubwa kwa ajili ya Israeli wote, nawe uliuona na ukafurahi. Kwa nini basi utende mabaya kwa mtu asiye na hatia kama Daudi kwa kumuua bila sababu?”
Ekegusii: Ere taboraarete obogima bwaye, ekero aitete Omofilisti oria, n’Omonene akanyorera Abaisraeli obobui obonene mono. Aye nkwaroche amang’ana ayio, na okagoka ase ayio. Nase ki rende orakore ebibe na goitera amanyinga yomonto otari na komocha, ase ogoita Daudi?”

English: The foreigners who had escaped came and told Lysias all the things that had happened.
Kiswahili: Wageni waliotoroka walikuja na kumwambia Lisia mambo yote yaliyotokea.
Ekegusii: Abarwani baria be esegi be ebisaku binde abwo baminchoretie bakamochiera Lisia na komomanyia onsi aria akorekanete.

English: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza, “Unakwenda wapi?” Akanijibu, “Kupima Yerusalemu, kupata urefu na upana wake.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkamoboria, “Ng'ai okogenda?” Ere akairaneria aganteebia, “Yerusalemu ngochia korenga, erinde imanye obogare bwaye, na obotambe bwaye.”

English: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, pokea sifa za hiari za kinywa changu, nifundishe sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, anchera ogosaba kwane kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende onyorokererie aya gwachiikire.

English: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima mzitii sheria zangu, na mwe waangalifu kuzifuata amri zangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Moigwere amachiiko aane, na mokore aya nkobachika. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
Kiswahili: “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na mtakapokuwa mnaingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, Genda goika agachie karia mokoorokera; kamwasoire ime, inamorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyesibore moyendetere.

English: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi yake na mapema, Yakobo akalichukua lile jiwe aliloliweka chini ya kichwa chake, akalisimamisha kama nguzo na kumimina mafuta juu yake.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka mambia chuni, akaimokia rigena riria atoorerete omotwe rogoro, akaritenenia buna esiiro koba ekeinyorio, akaumora amaguta igoro yaye.

English: Not one of them was left, except Mattathias the son of Absalom, and Judas the son of Chalphi, captains of the forces.
Kiswahili: Hakusalia hata mmoja wao, isipokuwa Matathia mwana wa Absalomu, na Yuda mwana wa Chalfi, maakida wa majeshi.
Ekegusii: Abarwani be esegi ba Yonathani bakaonchoka gotama. Tatigara onde bwensi otataiga abanene babere: Matathia mosinto bwa Abisalomu na Yuda mosinto o Kalifi abateneneri be esegi.

English: Behold, all you Israelites, give your advice and verdict here and now.”
Kiswahili: Sasa, ninyi Waisraeli wote, semeni na mtoe uamuzi wenu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli mwensi, karue amang’ana aino ay’ogoseemia igoro ase aya akorekanire!”

English: On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem, so that the weakest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo, Bwana atawakinga wale waishio Yerusalemu, ili kwamba aliye dhaifu kupita wote miongoni mwao awe kama Daudi, nayo nyumba ya Daudi itakuwa kama Mungu, kama Malaika wa Bwana akiwatangulia.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene nakengere abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, erinde oyore omworo mono ase egati yabo abe buna Daudi, na abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi babe buna Nyasae, ee, buna omomalaika bw’Omonene oyo obatang’aine.

English: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
Kiswahili: Huyafungia maji kwenye mawingu yake, hata hivyo mawingu hayapasuki kwa uzito wake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aochoganetie amaache amo, akayaboerania amare amanetu ime; na amare ayio tari gotandoka.

English: “Tell Aaron and his sons that this is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD; it is most holy.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi: Sadaka ya dhambi itachinjiwa mbele za Bwana mahali sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: “Moe Aroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe: Agwo ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa gekonyeenyerwa nao agwo eki’ebibe keranyenyerwe, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekeng’wanso ekio negechenu mono.

English: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
Kiswahili: Refaya mwana wa Huri, mtawala wa nusu ya wilaya ya Yerusalemu, alikarabati sehemu iliyofuatia.
Ekegusii: Oyo obwatetie abwo koagacha, n'Refaya, mosinto o Huri, omogambi bw'ekeng'ese ki'orogongo rore rwa Yerusalemu.

English: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
Kiswahili: Chakula kilichopatikana kwa hila ni kitamu kwa mwanadamu, bali huishia na kinywa kilichojaa changarawe.
Ekegusii: Endagera ekonyorwa ase enchera y'obong'ainereria, nigo ekoba enyansu ase omonto, korende magega yaye omonwa bw'omonto oyio nigo ogoichorwa n'omokenye.

English: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
Kiswahili: Bali wewe, Ee Bwana, utatukuzwa milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.

English: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakashangaa, wakisema, “Ni mtu wa namna gani huyu? Hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii!”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateeba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”

English: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Mose, mtumishi wa Bwana, na Waisraeli wakawashinda. Naye Mose mtumishi wa Bwana akawapa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase nchi ya hao wafalme ili iwe milki yao.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo konya babuirwe na Musa omosomba bw'Omonene amo n'Abaisraeli. Musa, omosomba bw'Omonene, konya oeire Abareubeni na Abagadi, amo nekeng'ese ki'egesaku kia Manase, ense eria ebe eyabo.

English: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the LORD of Hosts. The Book of Remembrance
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mataifa yote yatawaita mliobarikiwa, kwa maana nchi yenu itakuwa ya kupendeza sana,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi inabaabaroke abasesenirie, ekiagera ense yaino n’ebe y’okogokia. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.” Eira ya Nyasae y’amaabera

English: “We will restore it,” they replied, “and will require nothing more from them. We will do as you say.” So I summoned the priests and required of the nobles and officials an oath that they would do what they had promised.
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Tutawarudishia na hatutataka kitu chochote zaidi kutoka kwao. Tutafanya kama ulivyosema.” Kisha nikawaita makuhani na kuwafanya wakuu na maafisa kuapa kufanya kile walichoahidi.
Ekegusii: Erio abatang’ani abwo bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Goika toiranie ebinto ebio, gose titoboria ebitoki korwa ase bare; ntokore buna gwateebire.” Agwo nkarangeria abakuani batianie abatang’ani abwo barie eira ng’a bakore buna bateebetigwe.

English: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.'”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akigusa kitu kilicho najisi, iwe ni uchafu wa mwanadamu, au mnyama najisi, au kitu chochote kilicho najisi, kitu cha kuchukiza, kisha akala nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.' ”
Ekegusii: “Naende omonto karakune egento getachenegeti, gokeraabe egetachenegeti kere ase omonto, gose ase eng'iti, gose okogechia konde gwonsi, na arie enyama y'ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”

English: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Bwana anapendezwa nasi, atatuongoza kuingia katika nchi ile, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, naye atatupa nchi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Onye Omonene okogokigwa naintwe, na gotoyea toyeire, ense eria n'entenenku ere namabeere naamooke.

English: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawayajui mawazo ya Bwana; hawauelewi mpango wake, yeye awakusanyaye kama miganda kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibamanyeti ebirengererio bi’Omonene, gose tibamanyeti omooroberio oye ng’a obasangereirie amo buna emesaima ere ase ekeooreri gi’okoorera.

English: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
Kiswahili: Yeye aizuiaye fimbo yake hampendi mwanawe, bali yeye ampendaye huwa mwangalifu kumwadibisha.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oy'omwanchete tari goteebana komoorongeyia.

English: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo toleo maalum mtakalotoa: moja ya sita ya efa kutoka kila homeri ya ngano na moja ya sita ya efa kutoka kila homeri ya shayiri.
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorua moraarente: Ebimunu bibere korwa ase ebitonga ikomi bi'engano, na ebimunu bibere korwa ase ebitonga ikomi bi'esairi.

English: Then Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia watu, “Kwa vile nimewanunua ninyi pamoja na nchi yenu leo kuwa mali ya Farao, hapa kuna mbegu kwa ajili yenu ili mweze kuziotesha.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abanto: “Igwa! Reero nabagorire inwe amo namaremo aino, mobe enibo ya Farao. Bwata chimbusuro chiaino echi, chiire mochisimeke ase emegondo.

English: Later, the LORD said to Moses,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
Kiswahili: Sasa ni saa ya hukumu kwa ajili ya ulimwengu huu, sasa mkuu wa ulimwengu huu atatupwa nje.
Ekegusii: Bono ekiina gi’ense eye nkere; bono omogambi bw’ense eye natugutwe isiko.

English: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
Kiswahili: kutoka Mto Shihori ulioko mashariki mwa Misri, kuelekea kaskazini kwenye eneo la Ekroni, ambayo yote ilihesabika kama ya Wakanaani (maeneo yale matano ya watawala wa Kifilisti, ambayo ni Gaza, Ashdodi, Ashkeloni, Gathi na Ekroni: ndiyo nchi ya Waavi);
Ekegusii: (Ense yonsi gochakeera orooche rwa Sihori, moocha ya Misiri, goikera orobebe rw'Ekironi aria sugusu nigo ebarire ng'a ney'Abakanaani. Abagaambi batano b'Abafilisti nigo bamenyete Gasa, na Asidodi, na Asikeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.) Naende nero ense y'Abaavi,

English: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Alikufanyia nini? Aliyafumbuaje macho yako?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso?”

English: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh's wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.
Kiswahili: Lakini waliwadhihaki wajumbe wa Bwana wakayadharau maneno yake na kuwacheka manabii wake mpaka ghadhabu ya Bwana ikawa kubwa dhidi ya watu wake na hakukuwa na namna ya kuituliza.
Ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera gochecheria abatomwa ba Nyasae, bagachaya amang'ana aye, na bagachecheria ababani baye. Ase igo endamwamu y'Omonene ekaba enene igoro ase abanto baye, na gotooreka tikwanyorekana ase bare.

English: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
Kiswahili: Umenikunjakunja, nalo limekuwa ushahidi; nako kukonda kwangu kumeongezeka sana na kushuhudia dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ere okorire omobere one obeire nemenia, na eyio yambereire kirori; oboreu bwane bwaorokeire ase obosio bwane kombera kirori.

English: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ufunuo huu unasubiri wakati uliokubalika; unazungumzia mambo ya mwisho, na kamwe hautakosea. Iwapo utakawia, wewe usubiri; kwa hakika utakuja na hautachelewa.
Ekegusii: Okorora okwo nigo koganyete engaki yaye eike. Nigo gokoayerera goikerane, tigokomocha goikerana. Nonya gokororekana ng’a gwatebanire, ekeene goika goikerane, tikogoteebana.

English: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
Kiswahili: Msemo huu ni wa kweli na unaostahili kukubalika, usemao kwamba: Kristo Yesu alikuja ulimwenguni kuokoa wenye dhambi, ambao mimi ndiye niliye mbaya kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, rigwenerete gwancherwa kegima, ng’a Kristo Yeso nigo achete ase ense gotooria abanyene ebibe, na ase abwo inche noyo bw’eritang’ani.

English: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamimina maji kwenye sinia na kuanza kuwanawisha wanafunzi wake miguu na kuikausha kwa kile kitambaa alichokuwa amejifunga kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka amaache ase esani, agachaaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.

English: Again He asked, “To what can I compare the kingdom of God?
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza tena, “Nitaufananisha Ufalme wa Mungu na nini?
Ekegusii: Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng’ania oborwoti bwa Nyasae?

English: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
Kiswahili: Simoni amekwisha kutueleza jinsi Mungu, kwa mara ya kwanza alivyoonyesha kuhusika kwa kujichagulia watu kutoka watu wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Simioni otworokirie buna Nyasae ritang’ani acheire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde achore abanto korwa ase bare babogorie erieta riaye.

English: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into Yahweh's house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akainuka kutoka pale sakafuni. Baada ya kuoga, akajipaka mafuta na kubadilisha nguo zake kisha akaenda ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana, akaabudu. Baada ya hapo akaenda nyumbani kwake kwa kutaka kwake, wakamwandalia chakula, naye akala.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaimoka korwa inse agesibia, ageaka amaguta, akaonchoreria chianga chiaye; agasoa ase enyomba y'Omonene agasasiima. Erio akairana bwoye, agasaba endagera, akaegwa akaria.

English: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
Kiswahili: Wenye hekima hurithi heshima, bali huwaaibisha wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abang'aini 'mbanyore omwando bw'obonene, korende abariri 'mbabogorie obosooku.

English: The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to Ephraim.
Kiswahili: (Nchi ya Tapua ilikuwa mali ya Manase, lakini Tapua yenyewe iliyo mpakani mwa nchi ya Manase ilikuwa ya Waefraimu.)
Ekegusii: (Ense ya Tapua neya Manase yarenge, korende omochie o Tapua, ase orobebe rwa Manase, okaegwa Efraimu.)

English: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher, including these cities and their villages. Naphtali’s Inheritance
Kiswahili: Miji hii pamoja na vijiji vyake ilikuwa ndio urithi wa kabila la Asheri, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Naftali
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Orogongo rw’egesaku kia Nafutali

English: Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli na Muumba wake: Kuhusu mambo yatakayokuja, je, unaniuliza habari za watoto wangu, au kunipa amri kuhusu kazi za mikono yangu?
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli na Omotongi obo, agoteeba: “Mborie inche igoro y'amang'ana agochia koba; ntige inyechandere abana baane, ekiagera abwo nemeremo y'amaboko aane.

English: So Abner told him, “Turn to your right or to your left, seize one of the young men, and take his equipment for yourself.” But Asahel would not stop chasing him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abneri akamwambia, “Geuka upande wa kulia au kushoto. Mchukue mmoja wa vijana wa kiume na umvue silaha zake.” Lakini Asaheli hakuacha kumfukuza.
Ekegusii: Abineri akamoteebia, “Gobera gochia ensemo ende, eya borio gose eya bomosi, obwatie omomura oyomo bw’abwo, oire ebirwanero biaye.” Korende Asaeli tancha koonchoka amotige.

English: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
Kiswahili: Wanatamani mashamba na kuyakamata, pia nyumba na kuzichukua. Wanamlaghai mwanaume nyumba yake, mwanadamu mwenzake urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero barabwo batagete emegondo baurereria; ekero batagete chinyomba bachiira rioka. Eamate teiyo gose enibo bire n'oborendi.

English: Then Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD, and there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, since the bronze altar he had made could not contain all these offerings.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akaweka wakfu sehemu ya katikati ya ua uliokuwa mbele ya Hekalu la Bwana na hapo akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na mafuta ya sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba aliyokuwa ametengeneza haikutosha kuweka sadaka hizo zote za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na za mafuta.
Ekegusii: Sulemani agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasiimero gi’etai keria Sulemani aroisetie tikiarenge konyara goisana ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ebitinya.

English: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Lakini pamoja na hili, wakati watakuwa katika nchi ya adui zao, sitawakataa wala kuwachukia kiasi cha kuwaharibu kabisa na kuvunja agano langu nao. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo ase engaki eyio ekero bagendererete komenya ase ense eria y'ababisa babo, inche tinkobaanga gose kobatiga, na tinkobaseria. Tingotiga okobwatana kwane kw'ogotianania nakorete nabarabwo, ekiagera ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.

English: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
Kiswahili: Nitatuma moto juu ya nyumba ya Hazaeli ambao utateketeza ngome za Ben-Hadadi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase enyomba ya Hasaeli; oro nosambe osirie kegima chinyomba chinkong’u chia Beni‐Hadadi.

English: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikishaota, hukua ikawa mmea mkubwa kuliko yote ya bustanini, ikawa na matawi makubwa hata ndege wa angani wanaweza kujenga viota kwenye matawi yake.”
