Ekegusii: korende koyasimekirwe, yakiina, yaba enene kobua emete yonsi y’amato, yaba ne chinsagia chinene; goika chinyoni chia igoro chinyare gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.”

English: But Jesus took her by the hand and called out, “Child, get up!”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamshika yule binti mkono na kuita, “Binti, amka!”
Ekegusii: Korende ere akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateeba, “Omwana, imoka!”

English: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
Kiswahili: Basi kuweni watendaji wa Neno wala msiwe wasikiaji tu, huku mkijidanganya nafsi zenu.
Ekegusii: Timweng’aina inwe abanyene ase okoigwa ring’ana riaye rioka, korende ribeeke ase ebikorwa.

English: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
Kiswahili: Ni yule aendaye pasipo mawaa, atendaye yaliyo haki, asemaye kweli toka moyoni mwake,
Ekegusii: Nomonto oria orogendo rwaye rore oroikeranu, oria ogokora kwaye kore okuya, na amang'ana agokwana korwa ase enkoro yaye nay'ekeene,

English: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
Kiswahili: Nilikwenda kwa sababu nilikuwa nimefunuliwa na Mungu, ili nikawaeleze kwa faragha wale walioonekana kuwa viongozi, ile Injili ninayoihubiri kwa watu wa Mataifa. Nilifanya hivyo kwa kuhofia kwamba nisije nikawa nilikuwa ninakimbia au nilikimbia bure.
Ekegusii: Na inche ngatiira ekiagera namaanoreretwe na Nyasae buna ngende; ase obobisi nkabateebia abarai enchiri eria nkorandia ase abanto b'Ebisaku. Inche tinarigetie emeremo yane emekoro gose emeyia ebe bosa.

English: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
Kiswahili: Usitumainie vya udhalimu wala usijivune kwa vitu vya wizi; ingawa utajiri wako utaongezeka, usiviwekee moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria obourereria, timobaisa koba nogosemeria kwa bosa ase ebinto bi’oboibi. Onye obotenenku bwaino bwabeire obonge, timobaisa kobosemeria.

English: Above all this ask the Most High that he may direct your way in truth.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote haya mwombe Aliye Juu Zaidi apate kukuongoza katika kweli.
Ekegusii: Ase onsi, omosabe Omonene erio ayerae enchera yao ase ekeene.

English: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
Kiswahili: Pia Kristo hakujitwalia utukufu yeye mwenyewe wa kuwa Kuhani Mkuu, bali Mungu alimwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo na Kristo, ere teimokereretie igoro ere omonyene koba Omokuani Omonene, korende nigo abegetwe nere oyomotebetie, “Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.”

English: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
Kiswahili: mara kwenye barabara za mji, mara kwenye viwanja vikubwa, kwenye kila pembe huvizia.)
Ekegusii: Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chiinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.

English: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man's bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamimina nafaka kutoka kwenye magunia yao, ndani ya gunia la kila mtu kulikuwa na mfuko wa fedha! Wakati wao na baba yao walipoona mifuko ya fedha, wakaogopa.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chitaabu chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise barooche chisaro chi'echitaabu chiabo, bakaondoka.

English: She makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchants.
Kiswahili: Hutengeneza mavazi ya kitani na kuyauza, naye huwauzia wafanyabiashara mishipi.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akoroisia chianga chi’egatani engiya, ochioonia; naende nigo akoroisia chinkini, ochiooneria abaonchoreria bande.

English: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
Kiswahili: Salmoni akamzaa Boazi, na mama yake Boazi alikuwa Rahabu, Boazi akamzaa Obedi, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Ruthu, Obedi akamzaa Yese,
Ekegusii: na Salimoni akaibora Boazi ase Rahabu, na Boazi akaibora Obedi ase Rutu, na Obedi akaibora Yese,

English: In the thirty-seventh year of the reign of Joash over Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa utawala wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi alianza kutawala Israeli huko Samaria, naye akatawala miaka kumi na sita.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na kabere, bw’okogaamba kwa Yoashi, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi, agachaaka kogaambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria, na akagaamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo.

English: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
Kiswahili: unapandwa mwili wa asili, unafufuliwa mwili wa kiroho. Kama kuna mwili wa asili, basi kuna mwili wa kiroho pia.
Ekegusii: Omobere o Mwanyabaanto osimekwa, korende omobere bw'omoika obokigwa. Onye omobere o Mwanyabaanto oreo, naboigo noyo bw'omoika noreo.

Ekegusii: Na Musa nigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae buna omokoreri, erinde abe kirori ase amang’ana arache gokwanwa,

English: And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
Kiswahili: Malaika wa tatu akawafuata hao wawili akisema kwa sauti kubwa, “Kama mtu yeyote anamwabudu huyo mnyama na sanamu yake na kutiwa chapa yake kwenye kipaji chake cha uso au kwenye mkono wake,
Ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde, oyo o gatato, akabatunyana, ogoteeba neriogi rinene, “Omonto karasasiime eng’iti eria na omogwekano oye, na kobekwa ekemanyererio ase obosio bwaye igoro, gose ase okoboko kwaye,

English: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya koo za Wakohathi walipewa kama nchi yao miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Efraimu.

English: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakutuita ili tupate ghadhabu bali tupate wokovu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae tatoragerete endamwamu, korende agatoragera tonyore ogotooreka goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo,

English: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced. Men of renown have been delivered into other men's hands.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wengi hodari wameaibishwa sana. Watu mashuhuri wametiwa mikononi mwa watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria abanene-abanene baagoranirwe kegima, abanene abange babekirwe chinchera gati-gati y'abanto bande.

English: A wise man will instruct his own people. The fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.
Kiswahili: Mwenye hekima atawafundisha watu wake mwenyewe, na matunda ya ufahamu wake ni ya kuaminika.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong'aini nanyaare kobaseemia abanto baye, na ayakobwatekana nobomanyi bwaye abe amaikeranu.

English: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has spilled blood.’
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akaniambia, ‘Wewe hutajenga nyumba kwa Jina langu, kwa sababu wewe umepigana vita na umemwaga damu.’
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agankania, aganteebia: Aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera kwarwanire chiseegi na gwaiteire amanyinga ’abaanto.

English: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
Kiswahili: Kama angekuwa duniani, hangekuwa kuhani, kwa sababu tayari wapo watu watoao sadaka kama ilivyoelekezwa na sheria.
Ekegusii: Onye nabeete ase ense, anga tabeti Omokuani, ekiagera mbareo abare korua ebiegwa buna amachiiko achigete.

English: As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
Kiswahili: Mnaona ya kwamba mtu huhesabiwa haki kwa yale anayotenda wala si kwa imani peke yake.
Ekegusii: Mwarorire ng’a Mwanyabaanto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase ogokora, gose tari ase okwegena gwoka.

English: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. For you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
Kiswahili: Nayajua matendo yako. Tazama, nimeweka mbele yako mlango uliofunguliwa, wala hakuna awezaye kuufunga. Ninajua kwamba una nguvu kidogo lakini umelishika neno langu wala hukulikana Jina langu.
Ekegusii: “Namanyire ogokora kwao. Rora, nakoeire egesieri keigoire ase obosio bwao, gose onde tari oranyare kogesieka. Nigo ore ne chinguru chinke, na aye norendete ring’ana riane, gose tokaneti erieta riane.

English: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wakuu waliotokana na Esau, kwa majina, kufuatana na koo zao na nchi zao: Timna, Alva, Yethethi,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta 'abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rwa Esau, gotunyana chiamate chiabo, na aase bamenyete nigo are namarieta abo: Omogambi Timuna, na omogambi Aliva, na omogambi Yeteti,

English: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote yatamtumikia yeye, pamoja na mwanawe na mwana wa mwanawe, hadi wakati wa nchi yake utakapowadia, kisha mataifa mengi na wafalme wenye nguvu nyingi watamshinda.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabimokorere, naende bikorere omwana oye omomura, na omochokoro oye omomura, nabigenderere gokora boigo goika ekero engaki y'okogwa gw'ense yaye eraike; magega y'ayio ense yaye nebe ensomba ekorere ebisaku ebinge na abarwoti abanene bare ne chinguru.

English: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Kiswahili: Kabla hawajaita, nitajibu, nao wakiwa katika kunena, nitasikia.
Ekegusii: Nebe ng'a ekero batarandangeria nimbairanerie, na ekero barabe bagenderere gokwana nimbaigwe.

English: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing Beth-horon on the south and came out at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the western side.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kilima kinachotazamana na Beth-Horoni upande wa kusini mpaka ule ukazunguka kusini kufuatia upande wa magharibi, na ukatokezea Kiriath-Baali (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu), mji wa watu wa Yuda. Huu ndio uliokuwa upande wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera na rokaonchoka gochia Irianyi, bosongo y’egetunwa keria kerochie Beti‐Horoni, rogaika Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), omochie bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Oro nigo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo.

English: But if anyone doesn't provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu hawatunzi wale wa jamaa yake, hasa wale wa nyumbani mwake mwenyewe, ameikana imani, tena ni mbaya kuliko yeye asiyeamini.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto takoreenda abare abamwabo, mono baria be enyomba yaye, okaanire okwegena, naende nomobe kobua oy'otegeneti.

English: So he also died pure, putting his whole trust in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo pia alikufa akiwa safi, akiweka tumaini lake lote kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omomura oria agakwa kare nogosemeria okonene ase Nyasae.

English: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?'
Kiswahili: Je, unataka kuniua kama ulivyomuua yule Mmisri jana?'
Ekegusii: Inee! Norigetie kong'ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria igoro?

English: I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana, wala hakuna mwingine, zaidi yangu hakuna Mungu. Nitakutia nguvu, ingawa wewe hujanitambua,
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, onde tari; Nyasae onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Nigo nakoboyirie chinguru nonya aye tomanyeti inche.

English: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and Yahweh his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.
Kiswahili: Solomoni mwana wa Daudi alijiimarisha kwenye milango yote! Katika ufalme wake, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wake alikuwa pamoja naye, naye akamfanya mkuu mno.
Ekegusii: Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, akanyora chinguru ase oborwoti bwaye, n'Omonene, Nyasae oye, nigo arenge amo nere, na akamokora akaba omonene mono.

English: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
Kiswahili: wanyama wa mwituni na mifugo yote, viumbe vidogo na ndege warukao,
Ekegusii: nainwe ching’iti chi’orosana na echitugire chionsi, nainwe echikwagura amo ne chinyoni chionsi!

English: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,
Kiswahili: kengewa mwekundu, kengewa mweusi, mwewe wa aina yoyote,
Ekegusii: amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;

English: Judas fell, and the rest fled.
Kiswahili: Yuda akaanguka, na wengine wakakimbia.
Ekegusii: Omoerio Yuda omonyene agaitwa erio abanto baye bonsi bagatama.

English: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
Kiswahili: Lakini uchague watu wenye uwezo miongoni mwa watu wote, watu wanaomwogopa Mungu, watu waaminifu wanaochukia mali ya dhuluma, uwateuwe wawe maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.
Ekegusii: Korende ochore abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, abegenwa, abatakorigia riaaki, abaranyare koba abaraai b'abaanto b'emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

English: When all were now waiting for the decision of the issue, and the enemy had already joined battle, and the army had been set in array, and the elephants brought back to a convenient post, and the cavalry deployed on the flanks,
Kiswahili: Wakati wote walikuwa wakisubiri uamuzi wa suala hilo, na adui alikuwa tayari amejiunga na vita, na jeshi lilikuwa limepangwa, na tembo walirudishwa kwenye kituo kilicho karibu, na wapanda farasi wakiwa wamepangwa pembeni,
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo nigo aganyete korora buna ningo omobui bw'esegi eyio. Abarwani esegi b'ababisa nigo bagendererete gosuka motwe bakobwatesigwa n'abarini chibarasi abwo barenge kera ensemo y'okoboko kwabo, n'echinchogu chiabo nigo chiabekire ase chinsemo chiria chengencho mono.

English: Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees,
Kiswahili: Ole wao wawekao sheria zisizo za haki, kwa wale watoao amri za kuonea,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakobeeka amachiiko atari ayaboronge, na abariki abakona‐koriika amang’ana ay’ogokorera abande bobe.

English: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Mose alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na Aroni alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na mitatu walipozungumza na Farao.
Ekegusii: Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Aroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83).

English: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu na uzao wake milele, kama alivyowaahidi baba zetu.”
Ekegusii: buna atebeetie chisokoro chiaito, Aburaamu na oroiboro rwaye, goika kare na kare.”

English: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
Kiswahili: Wakachukizwa naye. Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nabii hakosi heshima, isipokuwa katika nchi yake na nyumbani kwake.”
Ekegusii: Bakagechigwa asare. Korende Yeso akabateebia, “Omobani takoborwa ogosikwa otatiga ase abanto baye na ime ase ense yaye.”

English: Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Samsoni akasema, “Kwa taya la punda malundo juu ya malundo. Kwa taya la punda nimeua watu 1,000.”
Ekegusii: Erio Samusoni agakwana. “Ase riuga ri'orosea rw'etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri'orosea rw'etigere nababeekire inse ebinge chiebitondo.”

English: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went away.
Kiswahili: Wakawaua Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe kwa upanga kisha wakamchukua Dina kutoka nyumba ya Shekemu na kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Bagaita Hamori amo na Sekemu momura oye nemeyio ya birende, bakarusia Dina omwabo mwa Sekemu, bakagenda nere.

English: So now, our God, the great and mighty and awesome God who keeps His gracious covenant, do not view lightly all the hardship that has come upon us, and upon our kings and leaders, our priests and prophets, our ancestors and all Your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa, Ee Mungu wetu, uliye mkuu, mwenye nguvu na Mungu wa kuogofya, mwenye kushika agano lake la upendo, usiache taabu hizi zote zionekane kuwa kitu kidogo mbele za macho yako, taabu hizi zilizotupata, juu ya wafalme wetu na viongozi, juu ya makuhani wetu na manabii, juu ya baba zetu na watu wako wote, tangu siku za wafalme wa Ashuru hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Na bono, aye Nyasae oito, nigo ore omonene, na omobui, na oyo bw’okoirokia. Nigo orendete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, na obwanchani bwao boria bogendererete botambe. Tobara buna negento egesinini obokong’u obo bwonsi bwatonyorire. Korwa ase engaki eria abarwoti b’Abaasuri batogamberete goika reero, twabeire togochandeka intwe na abarwoti baito, na abanene baito, na abakuani baito, na ababani baito, ne chisokoro chiaito; ee, abanto bao bonsi.

English: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.
Kiswahili: Kilichosazwa na kundi la tunutu nzige wakubwa wamekula, kilichosazwa na nzige wakubwa parare wamekula, kilichosazwa na parare madumadu wamekula.
Ekegusii: Ogosongerera ase obonge gw'echingige, chiagwereire ebimeri, biria chinyanchaba chiatigaretie, chingige chikayeria, na eye chingige chiatigaretie, ebisase bikayeria, na eye ebisase biatigaretie, chingeeti chikayeria.

English: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing, He said to His disciples,
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakastaajabia uweza mkuu wa Mungu. Wakati bado watu walikuwa wanastaajabia hayo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya Yesu, yeye akawaambia wanafunzi wake:
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Obobani bwa kabere bwa Yeso igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 17:22-23; Mar 9:30-32) Korende ekero bonsi babete nogokumia ase amang’ana onsi akorete, agateebia aborokigwa baye,

English: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Daudi akawashinda Wafilisti na kuwatiisha, naye akautwaa Metheg-Amma kutoka mikononi mwa Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafirisiti, akababua, akabua nomochie obo omonene akayobeeka inse y’obogaambi bwaye.

English: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites—a head taller than any of the people.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na mwana aliyeitwa Sauli, kijana anayevutia sana, hakuwepo aliyelingana naye miongoni mwa Waisraeli, alikuwa mrefu kuliko wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Saulo. Ere nigo areenge omonyakieni mono. Momura onde tareenge ase egati y’Abaisraeli obwate ekieni ekiya komobua. Ere nigo aetanetie Abanto bande bonsi ase obotaambe bw’omotwe korwa ase amareko gochia igoro.

English: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kishion, Daberath,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Isakari walipewa, Kishioni, Daberathi,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kisioni, na Daberati,

English: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako ataweka laana hizi zote juu ya adui zako ambao wanakuchukia na kukutesa.
Ekegusii: Omonene oino nabeeke okoragereria okwo gwonsi igoro y'ababisa baino, na igoro ya baria baabageechete na kobachaanda.

English: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us, and they took us to stay at the home of Mnason the Cypriot, an early disciple. Paul’s Arrival at Jerusalem
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi kutoka Kaisaria wakafuatana nasi na kutupeleka nyumbani kwa Mnasoni, ambaye tungekaa kwake. Yeye alikuwa mtu wa Kipro, mmoja wa wanafunzi wa zamani. Kukamatwa Kwa Paulo, Na Safari Yake Kwenda Rumi (21:17–28:31) Paulo Awasili Yerusalemu
Ekegusii: Abande baborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.

English: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni afadhali kupata mateso kwa ajili ya kutenda mema, kama kuteseka huko ndiyo mapenzi ya Mungu, kuliko kuteseka kwa kutenda maovu.
Ekegusii: Naki mbuya gochandwa ase ogokora amaya kobua gochandwa ase ogokora amabe, onye gokoba ogwancha kwa Nyasae.

English: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.”
Kiswahili: na kupitia uzao wako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa, kwa sababu umenitii.”
Ekegusii: na ase ororeeria rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe, ekiagera kwanyigwereire.”

English: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”
Kiswahili: Kama yeyote akimpa hata kikombe cha maji baridi mmoja wa hawa wadogo kwa kuwa ni mwanafunzi wangu, amin, nawaambia, hataikosa thawabu yake.”
Ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi oramoe oyomo obo bw’aba abake egekombe kiamaache amakendu ekiagera are omworokigwa one, nekeene nabatebirie: Takoyesiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.”

English: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mazoezi ya mwili yana faida kwa sehemu, lakini utauwa una faida katika mambo yote, yaani, unayo ahadi ya uzima wa sasa na ya ule ujao.
Ekegusii: Inaki okwenaria kw’omobere nokonyora ogoke, korende okwenaria gwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nokonyora ase amang’ana onsi, ekiagera nkore neira ase obogima bwa bono, na ase boria bogochia‐gocha.

English: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn't Yahweh bring us up from Egypt?' But now Yahweh has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
Kiswahili: Gideoni akajibu, “Ee Bwana wangu, kama Bwana yu pamoja nasi, mbona mambo haya yote yametutokea? Yako wapi basi yale matendo yake makuu baba zetu waliyotusimulia juu yake waliposema, ‘Je, Bwana hakutupandisha kutoka Misri?' Lakini sasa Bwana ametuacha na kututia katika mkono wa Midiani.”
Ekegusii: Gidioni agakwana nere, agateeba, “Aye Omonene one, onye Omonene ore amo naintwe, nase ki rende aya onsi atonyorire? Naende ng'ai ogokora kwaye gwe chinguru kore koria chisokoro chiaito chiatoteebetie ng'a Omonene nere otorusetie Misiri? Na b'Omonene otwangire na gotobeeka ase amaboko y'Abamidiani.”

English: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all; the second to Gedaliah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
Kiswahili: Kura ya kwanza, ambayo ilikuwa kwa ajili ya Asafu, ilimwangukia Yosefu, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12 Ya pili ikamwangukia Gedalia, // yeye na wanawe pamoja na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y’Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: So David told him, “Look, tomorrow is the New Moon, and I am supposed to dine with the king. Instead, let me go and hide in the field until the third evening from now.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akamwambia, “Angalia, kesho ni sikukuu ya Mwezi Mwandamo, nami inanipasa kula chakula pamoja na mfalme; lakini niache niende kujificha shambani mpaka kesho kutwa.
Ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Yonathani, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, nigo embetereretie ng’a ng’ikaranse koragera amo nomorwoti, korende ing’a ribaga ngende kwebisa agwo ase omogondo goika ankio ende mogoroba.

English: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn't find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
Kiswahili: Mwenye mzaha huitafuta hekima na haipati, bali maarifa huja kwa urahisi kwa anayepambanua.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omochecheria narigia obong'aini takobonyora, korende chiseemi nigo chikonyorekana bwango ase omonto ore omong'aini.

English: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;
Kiswahili: ukakatiza kusini mwa Akrabimu, ukaendelea hadi Sini ukaenda hadi kusini mwa Kadesh-Barnea. Tena ukapitia Hesroni ukapanda hadi Adari na ukapinda hadi Karka.
Ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Irianyi y'egetunwa ki'Ebiuge, na goetera Sini gochia Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea, naende rogaeta Hezironi, rogatiira gochia Adari, rokaonchoka rogaika Karika,

English: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.
Kiswahili: “Pinde za mashujaa zimevunjika, lakini wale wanaojikwaa wamevikwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Amata yabaanto chituoni abunekire, korende abakogochwa babeekirwe chinguru.

English: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza madhabahu kwa mbao za mshita kwa ajili ya kufukizia uvumba.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa.

English: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Salmona, wakapiga kambi huko Punoni.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Salimona, bakageenda bagaika Punoni, bagatoora aroro.

English: “Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense before you.”
Kiswahili: “Ndugu zangu na baba zangu, sikilizeni utetezi wangu.”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abaminto, na abatata, ntegerera aya ngwekengera omonyene ase more bono.”

English: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.
Kiswahili: Umbo lako ni kama la mtende, nayo matiti yako kama vishada vya matunda.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okinete buna omokendo, ne chimbeere chiao nigo chire buna ebisago bi'amasabibu.

English: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don't let us die for this man's life, and don't lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamlilia Bwana, “Ee Bwana, tafadhali usituue kwa kuondoa uhai wa mtu huyu. Usituhesabie hatia kwa kuutoa uhai wa mtu asiyekuwa na hatia, kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umefanya kama ilivyokupendeza.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakarera ase Omonene, bagateeba, “Aye Omonene, totoa egesusuro ki'ogokwa ase engencho y'ogosiria obogima bw'omonto oyo. Ekiagera aye Omonene gwakorire buna bwanchete.”

English: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, andaa robo ya hini ya divai kwa sadaka ya kinywaji.
Ekegusii: n'edivai egetuba ekemo kebe okoruegwa gw'ekenyugwa, amo na kera emanwa y'eng'ondi; onye nekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa gose ekeng'wanso kende gionsi.

English: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
Kiswahili: Adui zako watavikwa aibu, nazo hema za waovu hazitakuwepo tena.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abakogechete mbarenterwe obosooku, na obomenyo bw'abakori amabe tibokogenderera kobao.”

English: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, nao wakaanza kufanya shauri la kumuua Yesu wakiwa na Maherode.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Abafarisai baria bagasoka, bakagamba amo n'Abaherodiani buna barakore baite Yeso.

English: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest. She has roared against Me; therefore I hate her.
Kiswahili: Urithi wangu umekuwa kwangu kama simba wa msituni. Huningurumia mimi, kwa hiyo ninamchukia.
Ekegusii: Abanto bare omwando one babeire buna endo ere ase rinani. Baakire amariogi abo mamincha yane. Ase engencho eyio nabagechire.

English: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasikia idadi ya wale waliotiwa muhuri: yaani 144,000 kutoka makabila yote ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa omobaro obo abwo babekirwe ekemanyererio. Nigo barenge abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ene na inye (144,000) korwa ase kera egesaku kia basinto ba Israeli.

English: Moreover, the LORD will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day—yes, even today!
Kiswahili: “ Bwana atajiinulia mwenyewe mfalme juu ya Israeli ambaye ataikatilia mbali jamaa ya Yeroboamu. Siku ndiyo hii! Nini? Naam, hata sasa hivi.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene nechorere omorwoti oragaambere Abaisraeli, na omorwoti oyio nasirie kegima enyomba ya Yeroboamu, na ayio nakoreke korwa bono.

English: Be careful that no one lures you with riches; do not let a large bribe lead you astray.
Kiswahili: Uwe mwangalifu ili yeyote asikushawishi kwa utajiri; usipotoshwe kwa fungu kubwa la rushwa.
Ekegusii: Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw’embooria bogosirie.

English: but these you may not eat: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
Kiswahili: Lakini wafuatao msiwale: tai, furukombe, kipungu,
Ekegusii: Timoria chinyoni echi: ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;

English: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, watu hawa wameweka sanamu katika mioyo yao na kuweka vitu viovu vya kukwaza mbele ya macho yao. Je, kweli niwaruhusu waniulize jambo lolote?
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto aba baeire emegwekano bagosasiima ribaga koba ase chinkoro chiabo, na emegwekano eyio yabeire ekegocha gekobaraa gochia gokora ebibe. Inee! Ninyanche abanto banga buna abwo baborie amang'ana korwa asende?

English: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Ahabu akaondoka ili kula na kunywa. Lakini Eliya akapanda kileleni mwa Karmeli, akasujudu na akaweka kichwa chake katikati ya magoti yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Ahabu akaimoka, akaria na akanywa, korende Elija agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro, agatugama inse akaumama, akabeeka obosio bwaye gati‐gati y'amaru aye.

English: The priest is to sacrifice them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atavitoa dhabihu, mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi na huyo mwingine kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii atafanya upatanisho mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya huyo mtu kwa sababu ya kutokwa usaha kwake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arue erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y’okorua kwaye kw’amaache anga buna chimengere.

English: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
Kiswahili: Kabla hawajaenda kulala, watu wote kutoka kila sehemu ya mji wa Sodoma, vijana kwa wazee, waliizunguka nyumba.
Ekegusii: Ritang'ani batarachia korara, abanto bonsi b'omochie oria o Sodomu, abamura na abagaaka, bagacha bagaetanana enyomba,

English: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh's glory, as the waters cover the sea.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa dunia itajazwa na maarifa ya utukufu wa Bwana, kama maji yaifunikavyo bahari.
Ekegusii: Ense neichorigwe nokomanya kw'obonene o Omonene buna chinyancha chiichire namaache.

English: The bottom floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits, and the third floor seven cubits. He also placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple, so that nothing would be inserted into its walls.
Kiswahili: Ghorofa ya chini kabisa ilikuwa na upana wa dhiraa tano, ya kati ilikuwa dhiraa sita na ya tatu ilikuwa dhiraa saba. Kuzunguka ukuta wa nje wa Hekalu akapunguza ukuta pande zote ili boriti zisishikane kwenye kuta za Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Obogare bw’ebinyomba bia inse nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na ebie rirongo ria kabere amaboko atano na rimo, na ebie rirongo ria gatato amaboko atano na abere. Nigo akorete ebitambokero bikabwatana nenyasi ye Hekalu ase kera rirongo, erinde emeriibo egosiira kera rirongo etoorere ase ebitambokero ebio, etari gosoigwa ase enyasi.

English: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!'
Kiswahili: Katika mji huo alikuwako mjane mmoja ambaye alikuwa akija kwake mara kwa mara akimwomba, ‘Tafadhali nipatie haki kati yangu na adui yangu.'
Ekegusii: Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteeba: Ngambera boronge ase omosiira one.

English: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters, and they subsided, and all was calm.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, Bwana, tunaangamia!” Yeye akaamka, akaukemea ule upepo na yale mawimbi; dhoruba ikakoma, nako kukawa shwari.
Ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakaboora, “Omonene Nyasae, ngosira tore!” Erio ere akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amaache, na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.

English: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
Kiswahili: “Mungu hufanya haya yote kwa mwanadamu; mara mbili hata mara tatu,
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang'ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,

English: You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.
Kiswahili: Umelikuza taifa, na kuzidisha furaha yao, wanafurahia mbele zako, kama watu wanavyofurahia wakati wa mavuno, kama watu wafurahivyo wagawanyapo nyara.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogooko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.

English: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hajatokea mtu aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana Mbatizaji. Lakini aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie inwe ng'a ase baria baiboire nomokuungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana Omobatisi; korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa igoro nomonene komobua.

English: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna kiongozi yeyote au mmoja wa Mafarisayo ambaye amemwamini?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ase abanene baito omwegenire, gose ase Abafarisai?

English: At the end of three years, two of Shimei's slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya miaka mitatu, watumwa wawili wa Shimei wakatoroka kwenda kwa Akishi mwana wa Maaka, mfalme wa Gathi, naye Shimei akaambiwa, “Watumwa wako wako Gathi.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekaba ase omoerio bw'omwaka o gatato abasomba babere ba Simei bagatama, bakagenda ase Akisi, mosinto o Maaka, omorwoti o Gati. Simei agateebigwa ng'a abasomba baye nao bakare agwo Gati.

English: When they sin against You—for there is no one who does not sin—and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to his own land, whether far or near,
Kiswahili: “Watakapotenda dhambi dhidi yako, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote ambaye hatendi dhambi, nawe ukachukizwa nao na kuwakabidhi kwa adui, ambaye atawachukua utumwani katika nchi yake mwenyewe, mbali au karibu;
Ekegusii: “Omonto tari otagokora ebibe. Ase ayio baise kogokorera ebibe, na aye korabe nendamwamu ase bare na kobabeeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo baboose na kobaira ase ense y’ababisa ere aare gose ang’e, obaigwe.

English: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo dunia yote ilikuwa na lugha moja na msemo mmoja.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ense engima nigo baarenge nomonwa oyomo na amang’ana abwekaine.

English: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
Kiswahili: Waliomba, naye akawaletea kware, akawashibisha kwa mkate wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ekero baboretie eki bakoria, ere agatoma chinkware, boigo akabaigotia nendagera korwa igoro.

English: Why are you fighting?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unapigana?
Ekegusii: Nase ki mokorwana?

English: As one who grasps at a shadow and follows after the wind, so is he who sets his mind on dreams.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu anayeshika kivuli na kufuata upepo, ndivyo alivyo mtu anayeweka mawazo yake katika ndoto.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwegena chindoto nabo anga omonto okomonyokia omorengari gose embeo erio ayebwate.

English: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:
Kiswahili: “Waamuru Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia nchi ya Kanaani, nchi ambayo itagawanywa kwenu kama urithi itakuwa na mipaka ifuatayo:
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachiike: Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kaanani, eyio nero ense erabe omwando oino, chimbebe chiaye nigo chirabe iga:

English: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo ulimi ni kiungo kidogo sana katika mwili, lakini hujivuna majivuno makuu. Fikirini jinsi moto mdogo unavyoweza kuteketeza msitu mkubwa!
Ekegusii: Naboigo na oromeme nekiimo egeke, na rororwo nigo rokweenenia ase amang'ana amanene. Rigereria buna ensase enke egosamba rinani rinene mono.

English: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said that an angel had spoken to Him.
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliokuwa mahali pale uliisikia nao ukasema, “Hiyo ni sauti ya radi,” wengine wakasema, “Malaika ameongea naye.”
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto abateneine ang’e bakaigwa, bakaboora ng’a kwabeire okogukura; abande bakaboora, “Nomomalaika ogokwana nere.”

English: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Esau (yaani Edomu).
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw'ororeeria rwa Esau, nere Edomu.

English: He added glory to Aaron, and gave him a heritage. He divided to him the first fruits of the increase, and prepared bread of first fruits in abundance.
Kiswahili: Alimwongezea Haruni utukufu, na kumpa urithi. Alimgawia malimbuko ya mavuno, na kuandaa mkate wa malimbuko kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Erio akamomentera Aroni esiko yaye, na komoa omwano oye ere omonyene: oboronge igoro ase okorwegwa kwogotongora.

English: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Mimi ninakaribia kwenda njia ya dunia yote. Hivyo uwe hodari, jionyeshe kuwa mwanaume,
Ekegusii: “Inche nabeire ang'e kogenda enchera eria abanto bonsi b'ense bakogenda. Obe omokong'u, bweorokie erinde obe omonto oteneine boronge.

English: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
Kiswahili: Umeniondolea marafiki na wapendwa wangu; giza limekuwa ndilo rafiki yangu wa karibu kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.

English: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
Kiswahili: Lakini ulinzi wa Farao utakuwa kwa aibu yenu, kivuli cha Misri kitawaletea fedheha.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio chinguru chia Farao nchionchoke chibe obosooku bwaino; na obotamero bwaino ase ekiriri kia Misiri mbobarentere ogochaywa.

English: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akakusanya wafanyakazi 30,000 kutoka Israeli yote.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agakora omooroberio bw’abaanto chilifu emerongo etato (30,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, akababeeka bakore emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.

English: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamfungua yule mwana-punda, wenyewe wakawauliza, “Mbona mnamfungua huyo mwana-punda?”
Ekegusii: Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y’etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”

English: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
Kiswahili: Geuza macho yangu kutoka kwenye mambo yasiyofaa, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Oyaonchore amaiso aane tarigereria amang’ana atagwenereti; ing’a obogima oboyia ’mbwatie chinchera chiao.

English: but glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.
Kiswahili: bali utukufu, heshima na amani kwa ajili ya kila mmoja atendaye mema, kwa Myahudi kwanza, kisha kwa mtu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: korende obonene na ogosika, na omorembe nigo bire ase kera oyomo oyogokora amaya, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.

English: “Yahweh God, don't turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu, usimkatae
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, torusia obosio bwao korwa ase omoakwa amaguta oo! Inyora obwanchani bwao botari koera ase omosomba oo Daudi.”

English: Along both banks of the river, fruit trees of all kinds will grow. Their leaves will not wither, and their fruit will not fail. Each month they will bear fruit, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will be used for food and their leaves for healing.” The Borders of the Land
Kiswahili: Miti ya matunda ya kila aina itaota kwenye kingo zote mbili za mto huu. Majani yake hayatanyauka wala haitaacha kuwa na matunda katika matawi yake. Kila mwezi kutakuwa na matunda, kwa sababu maji yatokayo patakatifu yanaitiririkia. Matunda yake yatakuwa chakula na majani yake yatakuwa dawa.” Mipaka Mipya Ya Nchi
Ekegusii: Ase chingegu chi’orooche orwo chinsemo chionsi ibere emete y’ebisaku ao ao ekwama amatunda akoriegwa nemereo. Amato y’emete eyio tagosusana, gose emete eyio tekomocha kwama amatunda. Kera omotienyi nigo erame amatunda amayia, ekiagera amaache agocha ase emete eyio nigo arabe akorua ase Hekalu. Ase ayio amatunda ’emete eyio nabe endagera, na amato abo nabe eriogo rikogwenia abanto.” Chimbebe chi’ense y’Abaisraeli

English: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Filologo, Yulia, Nerea na dada yake, na Olimpa na watakatifu wote walio pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Fililogo, Yuli, Nereu na mosubati omwabo, Olimpa na abachenu bonsi abare amo n'abarabwo.

English: They worked the Israelites ruthlessly
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo wakawatumikisha kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri bakaba abatindi ase Abaisraeli na kobabetereria gokora emeremo emekong’u

English: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mlimani, makutano makubwa ya watu yakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, emeganda emenge ekamotunyana.

English: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
Kiswahili: katika safu ya nne ilikuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Vito hivyo vilitiwa kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

English: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Je, umemwangalia huyo mtumishi wangu Ayubu? Hakuna mtu mwingine duniani aliye kama yeye, asiye na hatia, ni mnyofu, mwenye kumcha Mungu, na kuepukana na uovu.”
Ekegusii: Agw'Omonene akabooria Saitani, “Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa, na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe.”

English: His tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.
Kiswahili: Mkia wake hutikisika kama mwerezi; mishipa ya mapaja yake imesukwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekemincha kiaye nigo kere egekong’u pa buna omocharake, na emekia y’amariagati aye nigo esisekaine amo.

English: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
Kiswahili: Amebarikiwa mtu ambaye siku zote humcha Bwana, bali yeye afanyaye moyo wake kuwa mgumu huangukia kwenye taabu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene botambe, korende oyo okong'etie enkoro yaye nanyore emechando eramosirie.

English: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked.
Kiswahili: Katika mji wa Listra, alikuwako kiwete, ambaye alikuwa amelemaa tangu kuzaliwa na hakuwa ametembea kamwe.
Ekegusii: Agwo Listra narengeo omonto oyomo ekerema. Ere nigo arenge rigata korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye, tana kogenda nonya ng'ake.

English: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mmoja wa wanyama aliyekufa ataangukia ndani ya chungu, kila kilichomo katika chungu hicho kitakuwa najisi, nawe ni lazima uvunje chungu hicho.
Ekegusii: Onye eyemo ye ching'iti echio ekogwera enyongo, gose gento kende keroisirie korwa ase amaroba, ekere ime yaye nakebe egetachenegeti, na egento ekio goika giatwe.

English: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.
Kiswahili: Nitazilaza maiti za Waisraeli mbele ya sanamu zao, nami nitatawanya mifupa yenu kuzunguka madhabahu yenu.
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke emebere ekwete y'Abaisraeli bosio bw'emegwekano yabo bagosasiima, na amauga aino nin'yasiarere chinsemo chionsi chiebisasimero biaino.

English: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
Kiswahili: Patakuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kwa jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli, kila kimoja kichorwe kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.
Ekegusii: Amagena ayio nigo arabe ikomi na abere, abe namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli. Amarieta ayio amang’erwe buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio. Kera rigena ribe nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.

English: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, will visit them and restore them.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa mali ya mabaki ya nyumba ya Yuda, hapo watapata malisho. Wakati wa jioni watajilaza chini katika nyumba za Ashkeloni. Bwana Mungu wao atawatunza, naye atawarudishia wafungwa wao.
Ekegusii: Ense eyio nebe egetari ki'abatigari b'Abayuda, nao barabe bakorisia chitugo chiabo na korara ase chinyomba chire agwo Asikeloni chingaki chia mogoroba. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabainyore, abarusie ase obosibwa bwabo.

English: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkana mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: korende oyorankaane ase Mwanyabaanto, nere nakaanwe ase abamalaika ba Nyasae.

English: Now Israel’s eyesight was poor because of old age; he could hardly see. Joseph brought his sons to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
Kiswahili: Basi macho ya Israeli yalikuwa hayaoni vizuri kwa sababu ya uzee, naye aliona kwa shida. Kwa hiyo Yosefu akawaleta wanawe karibu na baba yake, Israeli akawabusu na akawakumbatia.
Ekegusii: Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y’obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabaagata na kobaboania.

English: Very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you and vent My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
Kiswahili: Ninakaribia kumwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yenu na kumaliza hasira yangu dhidi yenu, nitawahukumu sawasawa na matendo yenu na kuwalipiza kwa ajili ya desturi zenu zote za machukizo.
Ekegusii: “Bono yatigaire engaki enke, inche ng’umore okogechigwa kwane na goikerania endamwamu y’ane igoro ase more. Nimbanachere ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwaino, nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’okogechia kwaino gwonsi.

English: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
Kiswahili: wala wasitoe muda wao kwa hadithi za kubuniwa na orodha za majina ya vizazi visivyo na mwisho, ambazo huchochea mabishano badala ya mpango wa Mungu utokanao na imani.
Ekegusii: gose tibategerera emegano ao ao, gose ebinimboria bie chisokoro bitakoera. Ayio onsi nigo akorenta okoamererania, gose tari goikerania emeroberio ya Nyasae eyio emanyekanete ase okwegena.

English: Hear this, O elders; and give ear, all who dwell in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers?
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni hili, enyi wazee; sikilizeni, ninyi nyote mnaoishi katika nchi. Je, jambo kama hili lilishawahi kutokea katika siku zenu au katika siku za babu zenu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ya Yuda, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang’ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?

English: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
Kiswahili: Ni Sabato ya mapumziko, na lazima mfunge; ni agizo la kudumu.
Ekegusii: Rituko erio naribe richenu mono ase more, rituko ri'ogotimoka, na inwe namweng'ate. Oyio nomoroberio ochiikirwe oragenderere botaambe.

English: For Antiochus, on the pretense that he would marry her, came into the place, he and his friends who were with him, that they might take a large part of the treasures as a dowry.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Antioko, kwa kisingizio kwamba angemwoa, aliingia mahali hapo, yeye na marafiki zake waliokuwa pamoja naye, ili waweze kuchukua sehemu kubwa ya hazina kama mahari.
Ekegusii: Antioko konya osoire ase Hekalu amo na bake bab'amasemia baye ng'a achie konywoma enyasae eria ekuungu, korende okogania kwaye okonene n'okogenda kwenyorera enibo eria yagachire aria Hekalu.

English: On the seventh day the child died. But David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Look, while the child was alive, we spoke to him, and he would not listen to us. So how can we tell him the child is dead? He may even harm himself.”
Kiswahili: Kunako siku ya saba yule mtoto akafa. Watumishi wa Daudi wakaogopa kumwambia kuwa mtoto amekufa, kwa maana walifikiri, “Wakati mtoto alipokuwa angali hai, tulizungumza na Daudi lakini hakutusikiliza. Tutawezaje kumwambia kwamba mtoto amekufa? Anaweza kufanya kitu cha kujidhuru.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omwana oria agakwa. Abasomba ba Daudi bakoboa komoteebia ng’a omwana okuure, inaki nigo bateebete, “Ekero omwana arenge moyo, togachia gokwana nere, korende tanchete gotoigwa. Inaki rende toranyare komoteebia ng’a omwana okuure? Nigo arabaise gwekorera bobe.”

English: This lad is nice
Kiswahili: Kijana huyu ni mzuri
Ekegusii: Omoisia oyo nomuya

English: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn't accept what we say.
Kiswahili: Nililiandikia kanisa, lakini Deotrefe, yeye apendaye kujifanya wa kwanza, hakubali mamlaka yetu.
Ekegusii: Nabarikerete abekanisa amang'ana, korende Dioterefe, oyobwanchete koba oyo bw'eritang'ani ase bare, tatwancheti.

English: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him; but Mary stayed at home.
Kiswahili: Martha aliposikia kwamba Yesu anakuja, alitoka kwenda kumlaki, ila Maria alibaki nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Nabo Martha agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are, akagenda komoorotota, korende Mariamu nigo aikaransete nyomba ime.

English: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa Herode mfalme wa Uyahudi, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja jina lake Zekaria, ambaye alikuwa wa ukoo wa kikuhani wa Abiya. Elizabeti mkewe alikuwa pia mzao wa Aroni.
Ekegusii: Ekero Herode arenge omorwoti o Boyahudi, narenge Omokuani oyomo, erieta riaye Zakaria, oyo orongebw'ororeria rwa Abiya. Mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Elisabeti oyio orenge omoiseke bw'ororeria rw' Omokuani Aroni.

English: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, saying, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwita mzaliwa wake wa kwanza Manase, akisema, “Ni kwa sababu Mungu amenifanya nisahau taabu zangu zote pamoja na jamaa yote ya nyumba ya baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu Akaaroka omwana oria omotangi Manase, agateeba: “Nyasae ogerire inyebe obokong’u bwonsi na abanto b’enka ya tata”

English: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
Kiswahili: Sasa, Bwana angalia vitisho vyao na utuwezeshe sisi watumishi wako kulinena neno lako kwa ujasiri mkuu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bono, aye Omonene, rora ogotianerwa okwo kwabeire, erio aye otwanchere, intwe abasomba bao tokwane ring'ana riao n'oboremu bwonsi.

English: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
Kiswahili: Wakati mnapokwenda, hubirini mkisema, ‘Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.’
Ekegusii: Na inwe ase okogenda kwaino, randia, moteebe: Oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.

English: allies in an impious fellowship, and murderers of their own helpless babes, it was your counsel to destroy by the hands of our fathers;
Kiswahili: washirika katika ushirika usio na adabu, na wauaji wa watoto wao wasiojiweza, ilikuwa ni shauri lako kuwaangamiza kwa mikono ya baba zetu;
Ekegusii: na goita abana abwo batare na nguru chi'ogwetanga korwa ase bare. Ase ogwancha kwao abanto abwo bagasirigwa n'abagaaka baito;

English: Then the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likaja kupitia kwa nabii Hagai:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rikaboria:

English: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,
Kiswahili: “Wakati njaa au tauni vikija juu ya nchi, au koga au kawa, nzige au panzi, au wakati adui atakapowazingira katika mji wao wowote, maafa ya namna yoyote au ugonjwa wowote unaoweza kuwajia,
Ekegusii: “Kerabe enchara erache ase ense, gose oborwaire obobe bogoita, gose oborwaire bw'enyagetabo ase chindagera, gose obw'ogochirigisia, gose chingige, gose amakonde, gose ababisa bakoboera ase omochie onde bwonsi ase emechie yabo, gose obobe bonde bwonsi, gose oborwaire bonde bwonsi,

English: For their worshipers either make merry to madness, or prophesy lies, or live unrighteously, or lightly commit perjury.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana waabudu wao hufurahia wazimu, au hutabiri uongo, au huishi maisha yasiyo ya haki, au huapa uongo kwa upole.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagosasiima emegwekano eyio nigo baborirwe obongaini, gose nigo bakobana oborimo, gose bamenya obogima obobe na gotiana oborimo batari korengereria.

English: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews' way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
Kiswahili: Basi ilikuwepo mitungi sita ya kuhifadhia maji iliyotengenezwa kwa mawe kwa ajili ya kujitakasa kwa desturi ya Kiyahudi; kila mtungi ungeweza kuchukua vipipa viwili au vitatu.
Ekegusii: Nchiarenge aroro chinsiongo isano nemo chi'amagena, chiabekire aroro ase engencho y'ogwesiberia kw'Abayahudi; kera eyemo nigo yarenge ekerengo gie chigalani emerongo ebere gose etato.

English: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
Kiswahili: Abimeleki akaja kwenye ule mnara na kuushambulia, lakini alipokaribia kwenye ingilio la mnara ili kuuchoma kwa moto,
Ekegusii: Abimeleki agacha koumokera omoorobiri oyio, agaika ang'e n'egesieri kiaye ayosambe n'omorero,

English: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
Kiswahili: Atai akamzaa Nathani, Nathani akamzaa Zabadi,
Ekegusii: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,

English: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Kiswahili: Toa sadaka za shukrani kwa Mungu, timiza nadhiri zako kwake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana,
Ekegusii: Aye omoruere Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende ikerania ase Oyore Igoro Mono chiira kwamorierete.

English: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
Kiswahili: Nilitahiriwa siku ya nane, mimi ni Mwisraeli wa kabila la Benyamini, Mwebrania wa Waebrania. Kwa habari ya sheria, ni Farisayo,
Ekegusii: ekiagera narogete ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, naende noyomo bw’Abaisraeli inde, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini, Omoiberania oiboretwe n’Abaiberania, na ase ogotunyana amachiiko n’Omofarisai inde.

English: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; everyone follows behind him, and those before him are without number.
Kiswahili: Udongo ulio bondeni ni mtamu kwake; watu wote watamfuata, nao umati wa watu usiohesabika umemtangulia.
Ekegusii: Amaroba erigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa magega, na omobaro bw’abamotang’anerete tori kobareka.

English: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtumishi wa Mungu na mtume wa Yesu Kristo kwa ajili ya imani ya wateule wa Mungu na kuijua kweli iletayo utauwa:
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo nomosomba o Nyasae, na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo. Inche nigo narangeretigwe naboigo gotomwa ogokonya okwegena kw’abachoore ba Nyasae, erinde baike ase ayare ay’ekeene, ayio akworokererigwa ase okwegena gwaito,

English: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
Kiswahili: “Angalieni maua jinsi yameavyo: Hayafanyi kazi wala hayafumi. Lakini nawaambia, hata Solomoni katika fahari yake yote hakuvikwa vizuri kama mojawapo ya hayo maua.
Ekegusii: Rigereria ebisicha buna bigokina; tibiri gokora emeremo gose gwesisa, korende nabateebirie, nonya n'Sulemani ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki'ebi.

English: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akamwapia Sauli. Kisha Sauli akarudi zake nyumbani, lakini Daudi na watu wake wakapanda kwenda ngomeni.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agatiana buna igo. Erio Saulo akagenda bwoye, na Daudi na Abanto baye bakagenda komenya ase amakuruma y'egetare.

English: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”
Kiswahili: Wewe na wafuasi wako wote mmekusanyika pamoja kinyume cha Bwana. Aroni ni nani kwamba ninyi mnungʼunike dhidi yake?”
Ekegusii: Aroni ninki aisaine inwe mwamwemurunganirie mamincha yaye? Ase ayio, mwerende, aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia. Igo mwasangererekanire mamincha y'Omonene.”

English: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.
Kiswahili: Jicho lako ni taa ya mwili wako. Kama jicho lako ni zima, mwili wako wote pia umejaa nuru. Lakini kama jicho ni bovu, mwili wako wote pia umejaa giza.
Ekegusii: Etaaya y’omobere oo neriiso riao; ekero eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire noborabu; korende ekero eriiso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire nomosunte.

English: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.
Kiswahili: Badala ya aibu yao watu wangu watapokea sehemu maradufu, na badala ya fedheha watafurahia katika urithi wao; hivyo watarithi sehemu maradufu katika nchi yao, nayo furaha ya milele itakuwa yao.
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri'obosooku bwaino monyore egetari ara kabere, na abwo bachayetwe mbanyore omogooko ase ebitari biabo; na igo barabwo mbanyore ebitari ara kabere agwo ase ense yabo, mbabe nomogooko o kare na kare.

English: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akajibu, “Kwa nini mnalia na kunivunja moyo? Mimi niko tayari si kufungwa tu, bali hata kufa huko Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya jina la Bwana Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo akairaneria: “Inki eke mogokora, mokorera na kong’ita omoyo? Nigo inde ang’e, tari ase ogosibwa gwoka, korende nonya nogoitwa ase Yerusalemu ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.”

English: The word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno lililomjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana, baada ya Mfalme Sedekia kufanya agano na watu wote huko Yerusalemu ili kutangaza uhuru kwa watumwa.
Ekegusii: Ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia magega Zedekia omorwoti gakoorire gokora okobwatana nabaanto bonsi ba Yerusalemu ng'a obosibore borarigwe ase egati yabo.

English: and said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Samweli, “Usiache kumlilia Bwana, Mungu wetu, kwa ajili yetu, ili apate kutuokoa na mikono ya Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: bagateebia Samweli, “Tobaisa gotiga kogenderera gotosabera ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, ng’a atotoorie korwa ase amaboko y’Abafilisti.”

English: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: anaweza akahudumu katika jina la Bwana Mungu wake kama Walawi wenzake wote wanaohudumu hapo mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere na'be ogokora emeremo ase erieta ri'Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Abalawi bande bamwabo bagotenena gokora emeremo ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: “Won't I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
Kiswahili: “Katika siku hiyo,” asema Bwana, “je, sitaangamiza watu wenye hekima wa Edomu, watu wenye ufahamu katika milima ya Esau?
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko erio ninsirie abanto abang'aini ba Edomu, naende ninsirie okomanya gwonsi korwa ase Egetunwa gia Esau.

English: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Mchungaji mwema huutoa uhai wake kwa ajili ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omorisia omuya; omorisia omuya nigo akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho ye ching’ondi.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man's pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz';
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Chukua gombo kubwa, uandike juu yake kwa kalamu ya kawaida jina: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bazi.
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Imokia ebao enene ekorikwa, orike amariko aya Mwanyabaanto baranyare gosoma buya, orike: Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.”

English: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa sheria walikataa mpango wa Mungu kwao kwa kutokubali kubatizwa na Yohana.)
Ekegusii: korende Abafarisai na abanto b'amachiiko bagakana omooroberio o Nyasae ase bare abanyene, ekiagera tibaabatisetwe na Yohana.)

English: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Yerusalemu ilivyotwaliwa: Katika mwaka wa tisa wa utawala wa Mfalme Sedekia wa Yuda, katika mwezi wa kumi, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli akiwa na jeshi lake lote alifanya vita dhidi ya Yerusalemu na akauzunguka mji.
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o ikomi, omwaka o kianda bw'okogamba gwa Zedekia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, amo nabarwani baye bonsi b'esegi, bagacha bakaboera Yerusalemu.

English: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
Kiswahili: “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Mwana wa Adamu atatiwa mikononi mwa viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria. Nao watamhukumu kifo
Ekegusii: Kobare inchera, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore gochia Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naruugwe ase amaboko y'abakuani abanene na aborokia b'amariiko, na barabwo 'nabamonachere ekiina ki'ogokwa,

English: When this was done, a flame was kindled; but when the light from the altar shone back, it went out.
Kiswahili: Wakati hili lilipofanyika, mwali wa moto uliwaka; lakini mwanga kutoka madhabahuni ulipoangaza tena, ulizimika.
Ekegusii: erio omorero ogoka rimo rioka, korende okarimigwa n'erioki ri'omorero oria oronge ase emesa y'egesasiimero.

English: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
Kiswahili: Mauti na uzima viko katika uwezo wa ulimi, nao waupendao watakula matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Amakweri na obogima nigo bire ase chinguru chi'oromeme, na abwo banchete korokorera emeremo 'mbanyore okwama kwaye.

English: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwingine hufa katika uchungu wa nafsi, akiwa hajafurahia kamwe jambo lolote zuri.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde igo agokwa ore nobororo bw'omoyo oye, atana konyora amaya nonya ng'ake.

English: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa yote, akamtuma mwanawe kwao, akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.’
Ekegusii: Omoerio oye agatoma omwana oye ase bare, ogoteeba: Inabasike omwana one.

English: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Mithka na kupiga kambi huko Hashmona.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Mitika, bakageenda bagaika Hasimona, bagatoora aroro.

English: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
Kiswahili: Shimei Mramathi alikuwa msimamizi wa mashamba ya mizabibu. Zabdi Mshifmi alikuwa msimamizi wa zabibu, utengenezaji na uhifadhi wa divai katika mapipa makubwa.
Ekegusii: Simei Omoramati agatenenera emegondo y'emesabibu, na Sabidi Omosifumi agatenenera edivai ase yare kogachwa.

English: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
Kiswahili: Watu wa nusu ya kabila la Manase, waliotajwa kwa majina ili waje kumweka Daudi kuwa mfalme, watu 18,000.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'egesaku ekeng'ese kia Manase: chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000), baria batoretwe amarieta abo bache kobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.

English: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
Kiswahili: Lakini wengi walio wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho, na walio wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Korende abange abare ab'eritang'ani inababe abamagega, na abamagega inababe ab'eritang'ani.

English: And corresponding to the doors of the chambers that were facing south, there was a door in front of the walkway that was parallel to the wall extending eastward.
Kiswahili: ndivyo ilivyokuwa milango ya vyumba vya upande wa kusini. Kulikuwa na ingilio kuanzia mwanzo wa njia ambao ulikuwa sambamba na ukuta wa pili uliokuwa upande wa mashariki, ambako ndiko kwa kuingia vyumbani.
Ekegusii: Ebisieri biabo nigo biarenge buna ebi’ebinyomba bia Irianyi. Egesieri nkiarenge ase omochakano bw’aase aria arenge goeterwa, engencho yaye aase arenge ensemo ya moocha ang’e norwaki ase omonto aranyare goetera.

English: They covered the face of all the land until it was black, and they consumed all the plants on the ground and all the fruit on the trees that the hail had left behind. Nothing green was left on any tree or plant in all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wakafunika ardhi yote mpaka ardhi ikawa nyeusi. Wakatafuna kile chote kilichokuwa kimebakizwa na ile mvua ya mawe, kila kitu kiotacho mashambani pamoja na matunda kwenye miti. Hakuna kitu chochote cha kijani kilichosalia katika miti au mmea katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Chingige echio chigatuba ense eria yonsi goika ekamwama ti, chikaria ebimeri bionsi pi ase ense eria, na amatunda onsi y’emete, ebio bionsi bitasaretigwe nembura y’amagena. Tigiatigarete kemeri kende gionsi ekebese gose amato y’emete ase ense ya Misiri engima.

English: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
Kiswahili: Unapopeleka Roho wako, wanaumbwa, nawe huufanya upya uso wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogotoma omoika oo, nigo bigotongwa, naende gwakora ense yaba enyia.

English: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Enendeni ulimwenguni kote, mkaihubiri Injili kwa kila kiumbe.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Genda ase ense yonsi, morandie enchiri ase kera egetongwa.

English: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kile kilichokuwa kinafifia kilikuja kwa utukufu, je, si zaidi utukufu wa kile kinachodumu?
Ekegusii: Ekiagera onye boria bwaetete bwarenge nobonene bwaye, boria boreo botambe mbore nobonene kobua mono.

English: Next he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.
Kiswahili: Kisha akanileta mpaka ukumbi wa ndani kwa kupitia lango la kusini, naye akapima lango la kusini, ambalo lilikuwa na vipimo sawa na yale mengine.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime goetera ase oboagacho bware geita ase ensemo ya Irianyi, akaborengia, naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.

English: So Joshua arose early the next morning and had Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema Yoshua akawaamuru Israeli kuja mbele kabila kwa kabila; na Yuda akatwaliwa.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akaimoka mambia chuni, akarangeria Abaisraeli bache bosio, egesaku ase egesaku, na obomera bokagwera egesaku kia Yuda.

English: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoabu na vikosi vyake wakasonga mbele kupigana na Waaramu, nao Waaramu wakakimbia mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka bagaika ang’e n’Abasiiria ase okorwana esegi, na Abasiiria baria bagatama korwa asare.

English: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wenyewe ndio barua yetu iliyoandikwa katika mioyo yetu, inayojulikana na kusomwa na kila mtu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene neriruube riaito ririikire ase chinkoro chiaito, rimanyekanete na gosomwa nabaanto bonsi.

English: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari wa askari walinzi akawachukua kama wafungwa Seraya kuhani mkuu, kuhani Sefania aliyefuata kwa cheo, na mabawabu watatu.
Ekegusii: Omoteneneri oria bw'abarendi akaira Seraya, Omokuani omonene, na Sefania, Omokuani o kabere, na abarendi b'egesieri batato.

English: and He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Mwanadamu, hapa ni mahali pa kiti changu cha enzi na mahali pa kuweka nyayo za miguu yangu. Hapa ndipo nitakapoishi miongoni mwa Waisraeli milele. Kamwe nyumba ya Israeli hawatalinajisi tena Jina langu takatifu, yaani, wao wala wafalme wao, kwa ukahaba wao na kwa sanamu zao zisizokuwa na uhai za wafalme wao katika mahali pao pa juu pa kuabudia miungu.
Ekegusii: aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, aase aiga nao ekerogo kiane ki’obonene kere, naende nao amagoro ane agotacha. Aiga nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Na Abaisraeli gose abarwoti babo tibakogenderera gokora erieta riane richenu ribe eritachenegeti, goetera ase obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasiima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abarwoti babo, na aase abo aimokererete igoro.

English: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
Kiswahili: Akawachukua hao viongozi wa mji na kuwafundisha watu wa Sukothi somo kwa kuwaadhibu kwa miiba na michongoma ya nyikani.
Ekegusii: Akaimokia amagwa y'orosana na amageri akabaaria abagaaka b'omochie oria.

English: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Aroni akafanya hivyo; akaziweka zile taa ili zielekee mbele kwenye kinara cha taa, kama vile Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Aroni agakora bo, akabeeka ekebekerero gi’echitaaya echio, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio bw’ekebeekerero ekio, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Matthew 8:14–17; Luke 4:38–41)
Kiswahili: Sifa zake zikaanza kuenea haraka katika eneo lote la karibu na Galilaya. Yesu Amponya Mama Mkwe Wa Simoni (Mathayo 8:14-15; Luka 4:38-39)
Ekegusii: Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense ya Galili. Yeso okogwenia abanto abange (Mat 8:14-17; Luk 4:38-41)

English: And the LORD also delivered that city and its king into the hand of Israel, and Joshua put all the people to the sword, leaving no survivors. And he did to the king of Libnah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
Kiswahili: Bwana pia akautia huo mji wa Libna pamoja na mfalme wake mikononi mwa Israeli. Yoshua akaangamiza ule mji na kila mtu aliyekuwa ndani yake kwa upanga. Hakubakiza huko mtu yeyote. Akamfanyia mfalme wa Libna kama alivyokuwa amemfanyia mfalme wa Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabeeka omochie oyio amo nomorwoti oye ase amakobo ’Abaisraeli. Bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi pi b’omochie oyio; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Naende agakora omorwoti bw’aroro buna akorete omorwoti o Yeriko.

English: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don't be troubled, for his life is in him.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akashuka chini, akajitupa juu yake na kumkumbatia, akasema, “Msishtuke, uzima wake bado umo ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora: “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”

English: But you have mercy on all men, because you have power to do all things, and you overlook the sins of men to the end that they may repent.
Kiswahili: Lakini unawahurumia watu wote, kwa sababu una uwezo wa kufanya mambo yote, na unapuuza dhambi za wanadamu ili wapate kutubu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye n'omonyamaabera ase bonsi ekiagera aye n'omobui o bionsi; aye tori korigereria ebibe b'abaanto bao, nigo okobaa chingaki erio baangame.

English: Now present yourselves, so that I may confront you before the LORD with all the righteous acts He has done for you and your fathers.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, simameni hapa, kwa sababu nitakabiliana nanyi kwa ushahidi mbele za Bwana wa matendo yote ya haki yaliyofanywa na Bwana kwenu na kwa baba zenu.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono tenena, mokire‐kiri, erinde mbasoere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase okobainyoria ogokora gwonsi okoronge, okw’Omonene abakorerete inwe ne chisokoro chiaino.

English: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
Kiswahili: kusudi awakomboe wale waliokuwa chini ya sheria, ili tupate kupokea zile haki kamili za kufanywa watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: erinde ababoorie baria barenge inse y'amachiiko, erinde tonyare gokorwa koba abana baye.

English: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
Kiswahili: Ninataka uape kwa Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu na Mungu wa nchi, kwamba hutamtwalia mwanangu mke kutoka binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi miongoni mwao,
Ekegusii: na inche ninkoboorie otiane ase Omonene Nyasae o igoro na ense, ng'a tokorigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b'Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase egati yabo.

English: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn't listen.”'”
Kiswahili: Nitamwadhibu yeye, watoto wake na watumishi wake kwa ajili ya uovu wao. Nitaleta juu yao na wote waishio Yerusalemu na watu wa Yuda kila maafa niliyoyasema dhidi yao, kwa sababu hawajasikiliza.' ”
Ekegusii: Ere amo nororeria rwaye na abasomba baye nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y'ebibe biabo. Nindete igoro ase bare, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Abayuda, amabe onsi aria nakwanete ng'a nimbayarentere, nonya nabo bakaanga koigwera.”

English: He also had narrow windows framed high in the temple. The Chambers
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza madirisha membamba yenye vidirisha vidogo vya juu katika Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia ase enyomba eria ebibao bi’emete; ebibao ebio tibiareenge koigorwa.

English: But the boy didn't know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
Kiswahili: (Mvulana hakujua chochote juu ya hayo yote; Yonathani na Daudi tu ndio waliojua.)
Ekegusii: Omwana oria tamanyete ng'a ninki engencho y'amang'ana ayio, korende Yonathani na Daudi mbayamanyete.

English: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
