Kiswahili: Mwambie hekima, “Wewe ni dada yangu,” uite ufahamu jamaa yako;
Ekegusii: Teebia obong'aini, “Aye naye mosubati ominto”, na obomanyi oboroke omosani oo momanyaine,

English: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won't be desolate.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini tuangamie mbele ya macho yako, sisi pamoja na nchi yetu? Utununue sisi pamoja na ardhi yetu ili kubadilishana kwa chakula. Nasi pamoja na nchi yetu tutakuwa watumwa wa Farao. Tupe sisi mbegu ili tuweze kuishi wala tusife, nchi yetu isije ikawa ukiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”

English: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akageuka, akawaona wakimfuata akawauliza, “Mnataka nini?” Wakamwambia, “Rabi,” (maana yake Mwalimu), “Unaishi wapi?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamoteebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”

English: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn't know that disaster was close to them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu 10,000 bora waliochaguliwa katika Israeli wote, wakaja kuishambulia Gibea. Vita vilikuwa vikali sana, hata Wabenyamini hawakutambua kuwa maangamizi yalikuwa karibu nao kwa kiasi hicho.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto chilifu ikomi, abaachooretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bakageenda korwania omochie o Gibea, na esegi eria ekaba entindi. Ababenjamini tibamanyete ng'a ogosirigwa kwabo konya gwaikire ang'e.

English: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”
Kiswahili: Mtawala huyo atathibitisha agano na watu wengi kwa juma moja. Katikati ya juma hilo atakomesha dhabihu na sadaka. Mahali pa dhabihu katika Hekalu atasimamisha chukizo la uharibifu, hadi mwisho ulioamriwa utakapomiminwa juu yake yeye aletaye uharibifu.”
Ekegusii: Ere nakore okobwatana ogokong'u kw'ogotianania nabaanto abange ase echuma eyemo; na ase egati‐gati y'echuma eyio nakoore ebing'wanso na okoruegwa gwonsi tibiruegwa naende. Oyokorenta obobe bw'okogechia nigo araache okoiruruka gosiria. Ayio nigo aragenderere goika egesusuro ki'ogosirigwa achiikeretwe korwa kare geikeranigwe.

English: If you say, “Behold, we didn't know this,” doesn't he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn't he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?
Kiswahili: Kama mkisema, “Lakini hatukujua lolote kuhusu hili,” je, yule apimaye mioyo halitambui hili? Je, yule awalindaye maisha yenu halijui hili? Je, hatamlipa kila mtu kulingana na aliyotenda?
Ekegusii: Oise goteeba, “Intwe titwamanyete amang'ana aya”, Inee, oyio okorenga chinkoro tamanyeti ayio? Oyio origereretie omoyo oo nigo amanyete ayio, na nigo araakane kera omonto buna ogokora kwaye kore.

English: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakienda, wakakutana na mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.
Ekegusii: Kobagosoka korwa ase omochie, bakarora omonto oyomo, Omokurene, okorokwa Simioni; erio abasikari bakabetereria omonto oyio abogorerie Yeso omosalaba.

English: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wametawaliwa na Mfalme Kedorlaoma kwa miaka kumi na miwili, lakini mwaka wa kumi na tatu waliasi.
Ekegusii: Konya bamokoreire Kedorilaoma emeremo ase engaki y'emiaka ikomi na ebere, korende omwaka o ikomi na gatato bakaenena, tibamokorera naende.

English: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
Kiswahili: Nao watatoka nje, wale waliotenda mema watafufuka wapate uzima na wale waliotenda maovu, watafufuka wahukumiwe. Shuhuda Kuhusu Yesu
Ekegusii: na barabwo inabasoke, baria abaare gokora amaya ase okobokigwa kw’obogima, na baria abaare gokora amabe ase okobokigwa gw’ekiina. Oborori igoro ya Yeso

English: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight.
Kiswahili: Yehoyakini alikuwa na miaka kumi na minane alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu miezi mitatu na siku kumi. Akafanya yaliyo maovu machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Yehoyakini nigo arenge nemiaka etano na etato ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emetienyi etato na amatuko ikomi, agwo Yerusalemu. Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: Don't listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?
Kiswahili: Msiwasikilize. Mtumikieni mfalme wa Babeli, nanyi mtaishi. Kwa nini mji huu uwe magofu?
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kobaigwera; inwe korera omorwoti o Babiloni, nario morabe moyo. Nase ki omochie oyo orasarigwe obe amaturi?

English: Ask now, and see: Can a male give birth? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor and every face turned pale?
Kiswahili: Ulizeni na mkaone: Je, mwanaume aweza kuzaa watoto? Kwa nini basi ninaona kila mwanaume mwenye nguvu ameweka mikono yake tumboni kama mwanamke aliye na utungu wa kuzaa, kila uso ukigeuka rangi kabisa?
Ekegusii: Boria momanye; Inee, omosacha nabe morito aibore omwana? Nase ki rende narorire kera omosacha abwatete enda namaboko aye buna omokungu okobina aibore? Nase ki kera omonto aonchokire obosio bwaye?

English: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
Kiswahili: Kupakana na sehemu hii, Yedaya mwana wa Harumafu alikarabati sehemu iliyokuwa mkabala na nyumba yake, naye Hatushi mwana wa Hashabnea akakarabati sehemu iliyofuatia.
Ekegusii: Oyo obwatetie abwo koagacha, n'Yedaya, mosinto o Harumafu: ere akaagacha orwaki rwarochie mwaye. Oyomobwatetie koagacha, nere Hatusi, mosinto o Hasabineya.

English: An outer wall in front of the chambers was fifty cubits long and ran parallel to the chambers and the outer court.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na ukuta wa nje uliokuwa sambamba na vile vyumba na ukumbi wa nje, ulitokeza urefu wa dhiraa hamsini.
Ekegusii: Orwaki ndwarenge mbarabare y’ebinyomba biria rwarochie gochia ase eraaro ya isiko. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano.

English: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba sheria ni ya kiroho, lakini mimi ni wa kimwili nikiwa nimeuzwa kwenye utumwa wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng'a amachiiko nay'Omoika, korende inche n'omonto bw'engencho y'ebibe; nigo naonetigwe inse ase obosomba bw'ebibe.

English: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Herode akawaita wale wataalamu wa nyota kwa siri na kutaka kujua kutoka kwao uhakika kamili wa wakati ile nyota ilionekana.
Ekegusii: Erio Herode akarangeria abageni baria barwete moocha agatwara okoumerana kwa bobisi nabarabwo, erio akamanya korwa ase bare kegima chingaki eng'enang'eni eria yarorekanete.

English: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu huu utakuwa ni wakati wa adhabu ili kutimiza yote yaliyoandikwa.
Ekegusii: ekiagera aya namatuko egesiomba, onsi ayarigetwe anyare goikerana.

English: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
Kiswahili: Hata kitandani mwake hupanga hila mbaya, hujitia katika njia ya dhambi na hakatai lililo baya.
Ekegusii: Ekero araire borere bwaye nigo agokora emeroberio y’amabe, na kobwatia chinchera chitari chingiya, tari kwanga obobe bonde bwonsi. Obuya bwa Nyasae

English: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ni uzima kwa wale wanaoyapata na afya kwa mwili wote wa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.

English: So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Kiswahili: Mungu akasikia kilio chao cha huzuni, akakumbuka Agano alilofanya na Abrahamu pamoja na Isaki na Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa ekerero kiabo, na akainyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, okwo akorete na Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo;

English: had taken possession of the country, having made away with Antiochus and his guardian Lysias.
Kiswahili: alikuwa amechukua nchi, akimkimbia Antioko na mlezi wake Lisia.
Ekegusii: na goita omorwoti Antioko amo na Lisia oyio orenge omorendi oye erio akaira ense eyio.

English: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu wewe, ee mnara wa ulinzi wa kundi, ee ngome ya Binti Sayuni, milki ya awali itarudishwa kwako, ufalme utakuja kwa Binti Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: “Naye Omorobiri bw'oborendi, aye ekegoro ki'omochie o Sayoni, obogambi bwao obokoro mbokoiranere, ee, obogambi bw'omochie o Yerusalemu.”

English: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn't argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
Kiswahili: Akaondoka huko, akachimba kisima kingine, wala hakuna yeyote aliyekigombania. Akakiita Rehobothi, akisema, “Sasa Bwana ametufanyia nafasi, nasi tutastawi katika nchi.”
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda akarema akanyora entuboka ende; eyio ero tibayiomanera. Ase ayio akayeroka Rehoboti, akabora: “Naki Omonene otoeire ense engare, na toragenderere komenteka ase ense eye.”

English: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, msiruhusu dhambi itawale ndani ya miili yenu, ipatikanayo na kufa, ili kuwafanya mzitii tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Bono timotiga ebibe bigaambe ime ase emebere yaino ey’ekonyorekana n’amakweri, na timobaisa koigwera okogania kwabo okobe.

English: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
Kiswahili: Alinileta nje mahali penye nafasi tele, akaniokoa kwa kuwa alipendezwa nami.
Ekegusii: Akang’ira aase areenge aagare, agantooria, ekiagera namogoogetie.

English: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakashangaa, hata wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Haya ni mambo gani? Ni mafundisho mapya, tena yenye mamlaka! Anaamuru hata pepo wachafu, nao wanamtii!”
Ekegusii: Bagaichana bonsi, goika bakaborania, bakobora, “Inki eke? Nokworokereria okoyia! Omonto oyo nigo abwate okobua kw’ogochika nonya nebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio bikomoigwera.”

English: The girl burst out singing: "I am not called the talking bag. My name is Kaamungei! Oh! My mother, whom I love, Oh! My father, whom I love, Oh! My calabash, which I use to drink milk!"
Kiswahili: Msichana akaanza kuimba kwa sauti, "Mimi kamwe si mfuko, Mifuko haiongei, Naitwa Kaamungei, Lo! Mama nimpendaye, Lo! Baba nimpendaye, Kata nanywea maziwa."
Ekegusii: The girl burst out singing: Tindi korokwa omobuko ogokwana; Erieta riane no’Kaamungei Obe! Mama ominto oria inyan inyanchete. Obe! Tata oria inyanchete. Obe! gaki egesanda keria kiane inkonywera amabere!

English: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote atakayemlaani baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraragererie ise gose ng'ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.”

English: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children; make yourselves as bald as an eagle, for they will go from you into exile.
Kiswahili: Nyoeni nywele zenu katika kuomboleza kwa ajili ya watoto wenu mnaowafurahia; jifanyieni upara kama tai, kwa kuwa watawaacha na kwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey’echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.

English: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
Kiswahili: Nimeyafuta makosa yako kama wingu, dhambi zako kama ukungu wa asubuhi. Nirudie mimi, kwa kuwa nimekukomboa wewe.”
Ekegusii: Natinyirie ogosaria kwaino buna ngotinyia riire, na ebibe biaino buna ngotinyia ritaturi. Ing’iranere, ekiagera nababooririe.”

English: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wale ambao hawakujitia unajisi kwa wanawake, kwa kuwa wao ni bikira. Wao humfuata Mwana-Kondoo kila aendako. Hawa wamekombolewa kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu wakawa malimbuko kwa Mungu na kwa Mwana-Kondoo.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo batesoetie ase ogotacheneka nabakuungu, ekiagera barabwo nabekuungi, naende bagotunyana Emanwa y'Eng'ondi kera aase ase akogenda. Aba nababooretigwe korwa ase Mwanyabaanto buna ogotongorwa ase Nyasae na ase Emanwa y'Eng'ondi,

English: Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:
Kiswahili: “Kwa mambo matatu nchi hutetemeka, naam, kwa mambo manne haiwezi kuvumilia:
Ekegusii: Nare amang’ana atato akonyegeria ense, ee, nare ane etanyaare koyaremereria, naro aya:

English: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
Kiswahili: Tikiko, aliye ndugu mpendwa na mtumishi mwaminifu katika Bwana, atawaambia kila kitu, ili pia mpate kujua hali yangu na kile ninachofanya sasa.
Ekegusii: Erinde monyaare komanya buna inche inde, naende ninki ngokora, Tukiko, oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa ase Omonene, nabateebie amang’ana onsi.

English: Send him to labor, that he not be idle, for idleness teaches much mischief.
Kiswahili: Mpeleke kazini, ili asiwe mvivu, kwani uvivu hufundisha madhara mengi.
Ekegusii: Moe emeremo erio ere tabaisa koba omworo, ekiagera obworo nigo bokomoa omonto obobe obonge.

English: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”
Kiswahili: Walipoyasikia maneno hayo yote, wakatazamana wao kwa wao kwa woga na kumwambia Baruku, “Lazima tutoe taarifa ya maneno haya yote kwa mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baigwete amang'ana ayio, bakaonchoka bakarigererania bare nobwoba, bagateebia Baruku, “Goika toteebie omorwoti amang'ana aya.”

English: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
Kiswahili: Aliigawanya bahari akawapitisha, alifanya maji yasimame imara kama ukuta.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aatananete amaache ’enyancha, akaambokeria chisokoro chiabo aroro, agakora amaache ayio agatenena buna orwaki.

English: “Look,” said Absalom, “I sent for you and said, ‘Come here. I want to send you to the king to ask: Why have I come back from Geshur? It would be better for me if I were still there.’ So now, let me see the king’s face, and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”
Kiswahili: Absalomu akamwambia Yoabu, “Tazama, nilikutumia ujumbe na kusema, ‘Njoo ili niweze kukutuma kwa mfalme kuuliza, “Kwa nini nimekuja kutoka Geshuri? Ingekuwa bora zaidi kwangu kama ningebaki huko!” ’ Sasa basi, nataka kuuona uso wa mfalme, na ikiwa nina hatia ya jambo lolote, basi na aniue.”
Ekegusii: Abisalomu akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, ’ngatoma abanto ase ore ng’a oche ogeende ase omorwoti, omoteebie amang’ana ane. Inki rende narwerete Gesuri? Nanga mbuya nare komenya aroro goika reero iga. Bono ninganetie korora omorwoti. Onye obobe bore ase ’nde ang’ite.”

English: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.
Kiswahili: Watu wataoneana wao kwa wao: mtu dhidi ya mtu, na jirani dhidi ya jirani yake. Kijana atainuka dhidi ya mzee, mtu mnyonge dhidi ya mtu mwenye heshima.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbachandane, kera omonto nabe ogochanda oyonde, na kera omonto nabe ogochanda omogisangio oye; omwana omoke naenenere omonto omogotu, na omonto otaroochi nchera nachaye omonto osikire.

English: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
Kiswahili: Yuda aliposhambulia, Bwana akawatia Wakanaani na Waperizi mikononi mwao, nao wakawaua watu 10,000 huko Bezeki.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayuda bakageenda korwana esegi, n'Omonene akababeeka Abakaanani n'Abaperisi ase amaboko abo; Abayuda bagaita abanto chiribu ikomi agwo Bezeki.

English: In the spring, at the time when kings march out to war, Joab led out the army and ravaged the land of the Ammonites. He came to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. And Joab attacked Rabbah and demolished it.
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni mwa mwaka mpya, wakati ambapo wafalme huenda vitani, Yoabu aliliongoza jeshi. Aliangamiza nchi ya Waamoni, na akaenda Raba na kuuzingira, lakini Daudi alibaki Yerusalemu. Yoabu akashambulia Raba na kuuacha ukiwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’ogosimeka ekero abarwoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Yoabu agatang’ana abarwani b’esegi, agasaria ense y’Abaamoni, akagenda koboera omochie o Raba, korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu. Yoabu akarwania Raba, akayobua akayosaria.

English: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Kiswahili: Huyo atapokea baraka kutoka kwa Bwana, na hukumu ya haki kutoka kwa Mungu Mwokozi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nonyore ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene; boigo nanyore oboronge korwa ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaye.

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema iwe nanyi na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae tata oito na Omonene Yeso Kristo abae obuya na omorembe.

English: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life.
Kiswahili: Mkimbiaji hodari hatanusurika, wenye nguvu wataishiwa nguvu zao, na shujaa hataweza kuokoa maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio abanto bamanyete kominyoka chimbero, mbasinywe gotama, na abwo bare ne chinguru, mbaborwe chinguru, na abarwani esegi bare chituoni, tibagotooria obogima bwabo.

English: “As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa upande wangu, hili ndilo Agano langu na wewe: Wewe utakuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.
Ekegusii: “Rora, okobwatana kwane nabwatanire naye nakwo oko: Aye nobe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.

English: It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,' and no longer call me ‘my master.'
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile,” asema Bwana, “utaniita mimi ‘Mume wangu'; hutaniita tena mimi ‘Bwana wangu.'
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio nondoke omosacha oo, gose tokogenderera kondoka Baali yao.

English: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
Kiswahili: Umetuacha tutafunwe kama kondoo na umetutawanya katika mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye kwarure ribaga toriegwe buna ching'ondi chikoriegwa, gwatosiareire gochia ase abanto b'ebisaku.

English: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
Kiswahili: Akawachagua kumi na wawili, ambao aliwaita mitume, ili wapate kuwa pamoja naye, na awatume kwenda kuhubiri
Ekegusii: Agachoora ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa erio banyare koba amo nere, erinde abatome bagende korandia,

English: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
Kiswahili: Wakamwita Barnaba Zeu na Paulo wakamwita Herme kwa kuwa ndiye alikuwa msemaji mkuu.
Ekegusii: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.

English: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akafanya ua kuizunguka Maskani ya Mungu na madhabahu, pia akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la huo ua. Hivyo Mose akaikamilisha kazi.
Ekegusii: Agatenenia orosenge rw'eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasiimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi'egesoero ki'eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi.

English: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka za amani juu yake, mkizila na kufurahia mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: morue na ebing'wanso bi'omorembe, mobiriereo na mogooke ase obosio bw'Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
Kiswahili: Kila kitolewacho kilicho chema na kilicho kamili, hutoka juu, na hushuka kutoka kwa Baba wa mianga, ambaye kwake hakuna kubadilika, wala kivuli cha kugeukageuka.
Ekegusii: Kera ekerugwa ekiya, na kera ekeegwa geikeranete nigo gekorwa ase Ise bw'emebaso. Asare koonchoka tikoiyo, gose ekiriri kende gekooncha‐onchoka.

English: Jesus answered, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Katika maisha haya watu huoa na kuolewa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abana b’ense eye nigo bakonyuoma na konyuomwa;

English: For He carries out His decree against me, and He has many such plans.
Kiswahili: Hutimiliza maagizo yake dhidi yangu, na bado anayo mipango mingi kama hiyo ambayo ameiweka akiba.
Ekegusii: Aya achiikire igoro yane, goika ayaikeranie, na amange buna ayio nigo agachire ase ebirengererio biaye.

English: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akasema, “Hutaweza kuuona uso wangu, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuniona akaishi.”
Ekegusii: Naende akamokania, akamoteebia, “Tokonyara korora obosio bwane, ekiagera Mwanyabaanto aise kondora, takonyara koba moyo.”

English: They crouch down and bring forth their young; they deliver their newborn.
Kiswahili: Wao hujiinamisha na kuzaa watoto wao; utungu wa kuzaa unakoma.
Ekegusii: Nigo chigwekumba chiabiara chimanwa chiabo, na ekero chiabiarire, obororo bw’okobina bwasira.

English: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
Kiswahili: Linda maisha yangu, kwa maana nimejiweka kwako, wewe ni Mungu wangu, mwokoe mtumishi wako anayekutumaini.
Ekegusii: Orende omoyo one, ekiagera nigo nkoirogete; aye Nyasae one, intoorie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera nigo ngosemeretie.

English: A cobra is a snake feared by all
Kiswahili: Cobra ni nyoka anayeogopwa na wote
Ekegusii: Rirubi N'engiti eoboirwe na bonsi

English: And Jehoiakim rested with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Yehoyakimu akalala pamoja na baba zake. Naye Yehoyakini mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Yehoyakimu akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete na Yehoyakini, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu ameweka mioyoni mwao kutimiza kusudi lake kwa kukubali kumpa yule mnyama mamlaka yao ya utawala mpaka maneno ya Mungu yatakapotimia.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae obekire ase chinkoro chiabo okogania kw'ogokora ogwancha kwaye ase okoba nokorengereria okomo, na koa eng'iti eria oborwoti bwabo, goika amang'ana a Nyasae aikeranigwe.

English: If indeed the land of your inheritance is unclean, then cross over to the land of the LORD’s possession, where the LORD’s tabernacle stands, and take possession of it among us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building for yourselves an altar other than the altar of the LORD our God.
Kiswahili: Kama nchi mnayomiliki imenajisika, vukeni mje katika nchi ya Bwana, mahali Maskani ya Bwana ilipo, nanyi mkajitwalie sehemu miongoni mwetu, lakini msije mkaasi dhidi ya Bwana wala dhidi yetu sisi kwa kujijengea madhabahu, zaidi ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Onye morooche ng’a ense eye mwaeirwe ebe eyaino tegwenereti mogosasimerao, imoka mwamboke gochia ase ense y’Omonene, ase obomenyo bwaye boteneine, moegwe chingongo chiaino agwo ase egati yaito. Timobaisa kwanga koigwera Omonene, gose kwanga gotoigwera intwe ase okweagachera egesasiimero kiaino ekeao goetania eki’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don't know me,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Huweka tayari ndimi zao kama upinde, ili kurusha uongo; wamekuwa na nguvu katika nchi lakini si katika ukweli. Wanatoka dhambi moja hadi nyingine, hawanitambui mimi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagokumba chimeme chiabo buna amata; oborimo nigo bomentete koba obonge kobua ekeene ase ense yabo. Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Nigo bagendererete komenta ebibe ase ebibe binde, gose tibamanyeti inche.”

English: For the blood she shed is still within her; she poured it out on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground to cover it with dust.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa kuwa damu aliyoimwaga ipo katikati yake: huyo mwanamke aliimwaga juu ya mwamba ulio wazi; hakuimwaga kwenye ardhi, ambako vumbi lingeifunika.
Ekegusii: Amanyinga y’ abanto b’omochie oyio oiterete nigo agendererete kobeera imeo. Tayaumorete ase riroba riyatube na koyabisa, korende nigo ayaumorete igoro ase egetare.

English: And on the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour Jezebel, and there will be no one to bury her.’” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Yezebeli, mbwa watamla kwenye kiwanja huko Yezreeli, wala hakuna mtu atakayemzika.’ ” Kisha akafungua mlango na kukimbia.
Ekegusii: Chisese nachiriere Yesebeli ase oboremo agwo Yesireeli, na monto onde takomotindeka.” Erio akaigora egesieri agatama.

English: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa wote wametenda dhambi na kupungukiwa na utukufu wa Mungu,
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe, na baremeirwe n'obonene bwa Nyasae;

English: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kumi na moja kwa mwezi wa kumi na moja alikuwa Benaya Mpirathoni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw'ororeria rw'Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw'ekeombe ki'omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;
Kiswahili: na kama nimeinua mkono wangu dhidi ya yatima, nikijua kuwa nina ushawishi mahakamani,
Ekegusii: Onye nakorerete entakana bobe ekiagera namanyete ng'a ekegambero agwo ase egeita ngenkonye,

English: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Mark 1:29–34; Luke 4:38–41)
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule jemadari, “Nenda na iwe kwako sawasawa na imani yako.” Naye yule mtumishi akapona saa ile ile. Yesu Aponya Wengi (Marko 1:29-34; Luka 4:38-41)
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, “Genda bwoo, nabe ase ore koreng’ana nokwegena kwao.” Omosomba oria akagwenigwa ase ekero keria. Yeso okogwenia Abanto abange (Mar 1:29-34; Luk 4:38-41)

English: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
Kiswahili: Masuke yale membamba yakameza yale masuke saba yenye afya na yaliyojaa. Basi Farao akaamka kutoka usingizini, kumbe ilikuwa ndoto.
Ekegusii: Agwo ebigara ebio ebireu bitano na bibere bikaria biria binde ebinene ebinoru. Farao akaboka, akanyora ng'a nigo are koroota.

English: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.
Kiswahili: Tena yule aliyeonekana kama mwanadamu akanigusa na kunitia nguvu.
Ekegusii: Naende oria ogwekaine Mwanyabaanto agankuna, na akambeka chinguru,

English: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.
Kiswahili: Uliona kuwa moyo wake ni mwaminifu kwako, nawe ukafanya Agano naye kuwapa wazao wake nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wayebusi na Wagirgashi. Umetimiza ahadi yako kwa sababu wewe ni mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Okamorora ng'a nigo arenge nenkoro y'obwegenwa ase obosio bwao, erio ogakora okobwatana kw'ogotianania amo nere ng'a noe ororeria rwaye ense y'Abakanaani, ey'Abahiti na Abaamori, ey'Abaperisi, na Abayebusi, na Abagirigasi, na bono gwaikeranirie ring'ana gwakwanete, ekiagera aye nomonyene oboronge.

English: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.
Ekegusii: Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chi’echitaabu, bagachibeeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.

English: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni mfano mwingine: Kulikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye shamba ambaye alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akajenga ukuta kulizunguka, akatengeneza shinikizo ndani yake na akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akalikodisha hilo shamba la mizabibu kwa wakulima fulani, naye akaondoka, akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.
Ekegusii: “Tegerera omobayeeno onde. Narenge omonto omonyene omochie; ere akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akayoetananeria orobago, agakuunya ime aroro egeteera akomitera amasabibu, akaagaacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo.

English: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and in the marketplace with those he met each day.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akahojiana kwenye sinagogi na Wayahudi pamoja na Wayunani waliomcha Mungu, na pia sokoni kila siku na watu aliopatana nao huko.
Ekegusii: Nabo ase esinagogi agakwana n’Abayahudi na abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, na kera rituko ase echiiro nabaria abaare gocha aroro.

English: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ. The Escape from Damascus
Kiswahili: Sauli akazidi kuwa hodari na kuwashangaza Wayahudi walioishi Dameski kwa kuthibitisha kuwa Yesu ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende Saulo akagenderera komenteka koba ne chinguru, agatantania Abayahudi abamenyete Damesiki, ase okoorokia ekeene ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

English: Keep the king’s command, I say, because of your oath before God.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, Tii amri ya mfalme, kwa sababu uliapa mbele za Mungu.

Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yakobo, ekero arenge ang'e nogokwa, agasesenia kera oyomo bw'abana ba Yusufu, agasasiima bwesiirerete enyimbo yaye.

English: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile Yakobo akawaondoa beberu wote waliokuwa na mistari au madoadoa na mbuzi wake wote waliokuwa na mistari au madoadoa (wote waliokuwa na alama nyeupe juu yao) na wana-kondoo weusi wote, akawaweka chini ya uangalizi wa wanawe.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Labani akarusia chigoree chiimarera ne chinkororo, ne chimbori chiaberi, echiare nyankanga ne chire nyankororo, na kera eyare nebimoa ebirabu ase omobere oye, na kera eng'ondi eyare emwamu. Echio chionsi agachia abana baye abamura bachirende.

English: On that same day the LORD said to Moses,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo hiyo Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio eri’Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty. Solomon’s Labor Force
Kiswahili: Bwana akampa Solomoni hekima, kama alivyomwahidi. Palikuwepo na uhusiano wa amani kati ya Hiramu na Solomoni, na wote wawili wakafanya mkataba.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani obong’aini buna amorierete eira. Omorembe okaba ase egati ya Hiramu na Sulemani, na aba babere bagakora okobwatana gw’okoigwana.

English: He doesn't believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
Kiswahili: Hukata tamaa kuokoka gizani; amewekwa kwa ajili ya upanga.
Ekegusii: Ere tari koba nogosemeria ng'a gose narue ase omosunte naende, ekiagera omoro nigo omoganetie.

English: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
Kiswahili: ili mtu yeyote asifadhaishwe na mateso haya. Mnajua vyema kwamba tumewekewa hayo mateso.
Ekegusii: erio tatigerigwa nemechando eye. Naki inwe abanyene 'momanyete ng'a ase ayio nero torageire.

English: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Zimri akaingia, akampiga na kumuua katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa utawala wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda. Kisha Zimri akaingia mahali pake kuwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Simuri agasoa nyomba, akamoaka, akamoiyeria inse na komoita. Ayio igo akorete ase omwaka bw'emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw'okogaamba gw'Asa, omorwoti bw'Abayuda. Magega y'ayio Simuri akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: So the king asked, “Is there anyone left of Saul’s family to whom I can show the kindness of God?” Ziba answered, “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Je, hakuna yeyote ambaye amebaki wa nyumba ya Sauli ninayeweza kumwonyesha wema wa Mungu?” Siba akamjibu mfalme, “Bado yupo mwana wa Yonathani, yeye ni kiwete miguu yote.”
Ekegusii: Naende omorwoti akamobooria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera obuya bwa Nyasae?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Ee, nareo omonto oyomo, mosinto o Yonathani, ore ekerema.”

English: the beginning, end, and middle of times; the alternations of the solstices and the changes of seasons;
Kiswahili: mwanzo, mwisho, na katikati ya nyakati; mabadiliko ya solstices na mabadiliko ya majira;
Ekegusii: Omochakano bwe chingaki, omoerio oye, na gati gati yaye, ogonchoreria gwechingaki n'ebiro,

English: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him. Some of them asked, “What is this babbler trying to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign gods.” They said this because Paul was proclaiming the good news of Jesus and the resurrection.
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya Waepikureo na Wastoiko wenye falsafa wakakutana naye. Baadhi yao wakasema, “Je, huyu mpayukaji anajaribu kusema nini?” Wengine wakasema, “Inaonekana anasema habari za miungu ya kigeni.” Walisema haya kwa sababu Paulo alikuwa anahubiri habari njema kuhusu Yesu na ufufuo wa wafu.
Ekegusii: Abande abanyasemi b’Abaepikurio na Abastoiki bakaamererania nere. Abande bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nomonyamang’ana mange, inki arigetie goteeba?” Na abande: “Ororekanire ng’a nigo are buna omorandia bw’amang’ana e chinyasae chingeni”, ekiagera nigo arenge korandia amang’ana a Yeso na okobokigwa kw’abakuure.

English: perseverance, character; and character, hope.
Kiswahili: nayo saburi huleta uthabiti wa moyo, na uthabiti wa moyo huleta tumaini,
Ekegusii: na oboremereria nigo bokorenta oboremu bw’omoyo, na oboremu bw’omoyo nigo bokorenta ogosemeria.

English: And among the other Israelites, from the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa Waisraeli wengine: Kutoka wazao wa Paroshi: Ramia, Izia, Malkiya, Miyamini, Eleazari, Malkiya na Benaya.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande: abeamate ya Parosi: Ramia na Isia, Malikia na Miyamini, Eleazari na Malikia na Benaya;

English: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wakomboe Israeli, katika shida zao zote!
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.

English: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king's tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.
Kiswahili: Bado kukawa na wengine waliokuwa wakisema, “Ilitubidi tukope fedha ili kulipa kodi ya mfalme kwa ajili ya mashamba yetu na mashamba yetu ya mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Na abande bagateeba, “Twasabire chitaabu singo igoro y'amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y'emesabibu, ase ogoakana ebango ase omorwoti.

English: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
Kiswahili: Apandaye kwa mwili, katika mwili wake atavuna uharibifu, lakini yeye apandaye katika Roho, katika Roho atavuna uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyogosimeka ase chingencho chiaye chi'ebibe nache kogesa ogosareka korwa ase chingencho chiaye chi'ebibe, korende ere oyogosimeka ase Omoika nache kogesa obogima bwa kare na kare korwa ase Omoika.

English: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wake, watiini waume zenu, kama inavyostahili katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, buna egwenerete ase Omonene.

English: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya koo za Wakohathi walipewa kama nchi yao miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi'Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw'egesaku gi'Efraimu.

English: And they found written in the Law, which the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month.
Kiswahili: Wakakuta imeandikwa katika ile Sheria, ambayo Bwana aliiamuru kupitia kwa Mose, kwamba Waisraeli walipaswa kukaa katika vibanda wakati wa sikukuu ya mwezi wa saba,
Ekegusii: Bakanyora amang’ana ariikire ase amachiiko ayio Omonene aruete ase Abaisraeli goetera ase Musa, ng’a Abaisraeli goika bamenye ase ebigutu ase Rituko Rinene ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere,

English: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akawaita Bezaleli na Oholiabu na kila mtu mwenye ustadi ambaye Bwana alikuwa amempa uwezo na mwenye kupenda kuja na kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Besaleli amo na Oholiabu na abaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene aeire obong’aini, abaasugetigwe ase chinkoro chiabo, bache, bachake emeremo eria.

English: But Naomi replied, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb to become your husbands?
Kiswahili: Lakini Naomi akasema, “Rudini nyumbani, binti zangu. Kwa nini mnifuate? Je, mimi nitaweza tena kuwa na wana wengine ambao wataweza kuwaoa ninyi?
Ekegusii: Korende Naomi akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Abana baane, irana mogende seino! Nase ki moganetie kogenda amo nainche? Inee! Ninyare naende korwa ase enda yane koibora abana bagochia kobanyuoma?

English: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre. Every head was made bald and every shoulder made raw. But he and his army received no wages from Tyre for the labor they expended on it.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli aliongoza jeshi lake kufanya kazi ngumu dhidi ya Tiro; kila kichwa kilipata upaa na kila bega likachunika. Lakini yeye na jeshi lake hawakupata malipo yoyote kutokana na muda wote aliongoza hiyo vita dhidi ya Tiro.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, agatiga abarwani baye b’esegi bagokora emeremo agwo ase omochie o Turo. Kera omotwe ogasunyoka etukia, na kera rireko rikaniaroka. Korende nonya naboigo, ere na abarwani baye b’esegi, tibaakaneretwe ng’eria ende yonsi ase ogokorera Turo emeremo.

English: when as his blood was now well near spent, he drew forth his bowels through the wound, and taking them in both his hands he shook them at the crowds. Calling upon him who is Lord of life and spirit to restore him these again, he died like this.
Kiswahili: damu yake ilipokuwa karibu kuisha, alitoa matumbo yake kupitia jeraha, na kuyashika mikono yake yote miwili akawatikisa makutano. Akimwita yeye aliye Bwana wa uzima na roho amrudishie haya tena, akafa hivi.
Ekegusii: Agwo konya amanyinga aerire korwa ase omobere oye, agatandora enda yaye akarusia amara akarutera abanto baria, erio agasaba Omonene bw'obogima amoiranerie amara aye, erio agakwa.

English: and a large supply of rations for every man, and a huge amount of gold and silver out of the king's house.
Kiswahili: na ugavi mkubwa wa chakula kwa kila mtu, na kiasi kikubwa cha dhahabu na fedha kutoka ikulu ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Akamoa kera omorwani endagera eisane akoria amo n'ebinto ebinge bi'etaabu nechifeta korwa ase ebigachero bi'omorwoti.

English: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don't go empty to your mother-in-law.'”
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Amenipa shayiri vipimo sita akisema, ‘Usiende kwa mama mkwe wako mikono mitupu.' ”
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Boazi nigo anteebia ng'a tinkonyara koirana gocha asore namaboko amasa. Ase igo ong'a esairi eye ebitita bitano na ekemo.”

English: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo niliona ni muhimu niwahimize hawa ndugu watangulie kuja huko kwenu kabla yangu, wafanye mipango ya hayo matoleo ya ukarimu mliyokuwa mmeahidi, ili yawe tayari kama matoleo ya hiari wala si kama ya kutozwa kwa nguvu. Kupanda Kwa Ukarimu
Ekegusii: Nabo narorire ng’a ningwenerete ntebie abaminto aba bantang’ane gocha ase more, na koroisia bwango ekeegwa kiaino keria mwarierete eira y’okorua korwa kare, erinde kenyare koba ang’e, buna ekeegwa, gose tari buna egento gekorugwa ase obong’iti. Okorua kw’ebiegwa ebinge, na ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase Kristo

English: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ninyi mmekuwa wakaidi kuliko mataifa yanayowazunguka na hamkufuata amri zangu wala kuzishika sheria zangu. Wala hamkuweza hata kuzifuata kawaida za mataifa yanayowazunguka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Inwe mwabeire abebura‐buria kobua ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine, gose timobwateti emeroberio y'ane echiikire, gose timorendeti amachiiko ane, na timobwateti nonya namachiiko y'ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine.”

English: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.
Kiswahili: Baba yao alikuwa amewapa zawadi nyingi za fedha na dhahabu na vitu vya thamani, pamoja na miji yenye ngome huko Yuda, bali ufalme akampa Yehoramu kwa sababu alikuwa mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Ise akabaa ebiegwa ebinene, chifeta ne chitaabu, ne chinibo chie rigori rinene, amo nemechie y'Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki; korende akaa Yehoramu oborwoti, ekiagera nere orenge omomura omotangi.

English: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
Kiswahili: Waweza kupitisha kamba puani mwake, au kutoboa taya lake kwa kulabu?
Ekegusii: Nonyare gosoyia engori ime ase chimioro chiaye, gose kobochora orosea rwaye nendobio?

English: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
Kiswahili: Yese akawazaa Eliabu mwanawe wa kwanza; wa pili Abinadabu, wa tatu Shimea,
Ekegusii: Yese akaibora Eliabu, omwana oye omomura omotangi, na Abinadabu oyo o kabere, na Simea oyo o gatato,

English: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, ‘Isn't he a speaker of parables?'”
Kiswahili: Ndipo niliposema, “Aa, Bwana Mwenyezi! Wao hunisema, ‘Huyu si huzungumza mafumbo tu?' ”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Ayee, Omonene! Abanto aba nigo bagokwana igoro y'ane baboria: Inee! Omonto oyo tari gokwana ase emebayeno?”

English: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
Kiswahili: Bali macho ya waovu hayataona, wokovu utawaepuka; tarajio lao litakuwa ni hangaiko la mtu anayekata roho.”
Ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbabe bakouna‐una ase omosunte, tibakorora omobaso. Tibagotooreka nonya ng'ake; ogosemeria kwabo ngosire pi.”

English: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nina matumaini haya, ninajua kwamba nitaendelea kuwepo na kuwa pamoja nanyi nyote, ili mpate kukua na kuwa na furaha katika imani.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inde nobomaene ase aya, namanyire ng’a nintigare na kogenderera amo nainwe mwensi, na inwe momenteke na kogoka ase okwegena,

English: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili yao akakumbuka agano lake, na kutokana na upendo wake mkuu akapooza hasira yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yaabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.

English: So he asked the officials of Pharaoh who were in custody with him in his master’s house, “Why are your faces so downcast today?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawauliza maafisa hao wa Farao waliokuwa chini ya ulinzi pamoja naye nyumbani mwa bwana wake, akasema, “Mbona nyuso zenu zimejaa huzuni leo?”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, akabooria abateneneri abwo ba Farao, abaarenge amo nere ase egesibo ase enyomba y’omonene oye, akabora: “Naki moichaanete iga reero?”

English: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
Kiswahili: Basi Dina, binti wa Yakobo aliyezaliwa na Lea, akatoka nje kuwatembelea wanawake wa nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Bono Dina, omoiseke o Lea, oyio Lea aiborerete Yakobo, akagenda kororana nabaiseke b’ense eria.

English: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara tupu nikiyalinganisha na faida kubwa ipitayo kiasi cha kumjua Kristo Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili yake nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nikiyahesabu kuwa kama mavi ili nimpate Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng’a abeire bosa ase engencho y’obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,

English: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
Kiswahili: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Bwana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abanto aba bonsi abakori amabe tibari nokomanya? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari korangeri’Omonene abakoonye.

English: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu yeyote aliye hai aweza kulalamika wakati anapoadhibiwa kwa ajili ya dhambi zake?
Ekegusii: Nase ki rende Mwanyabaanto ore moyo akwemurunganeria? Nase ki akwemurungania ekero akonyora egesusuro ase engencho y'ebibe biaye.

English: before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
Kiswahili: nayo mavumbi kurudi ardhini yalikotoka, na roho kurudi kwa Mungu aliyeitoa.
Ekegusii: Erio orotu ndoirane, ase riroba buna rwarenge, na omoika oirane gochia ase Nyasae oria oyoruete.

English: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea. About midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.
Kiswahili: Usiku wa kumi na nne ulipofika, tulikuwa bado tunasukumwa na upepo katika Bahari ya Adria. Ilipokuwa yapata usiku wa manane, mabaharia wakahisi kwamba walikuwa wanakaribia nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Goika obotuko bwa ikomi na kane bogachia goika tokairwa gochia aria na aria ase enyancha y’Adiria. Botuko gati abagendia b’emeeri bagakaga ng’a baikire ang’e ase ense enyomo.

English: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”
Kiswahili: Hata alipokuwa anasema, Yonathani mwana wa kuhani Abiathari akafika. Adoniya akasema, “Ingia ndani. Mtu mstahiki kama wewe ni lazima alete habari njema.”
Ekegusii: Ekero agendererete gokwana, rora, Yonathani, mosinto bw'Abiatari Omokuani, agacha agwo. Adonia akamoteebia: “Inchuo aiga ime, ekiagera aye nomonto omuya, okorenta amang'ana amaya.”

English: Then the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah instructed him, “Behold now, with one accord the words of the prophets are favorable to the king. So please let your words be like theirs, and speak favorably.”
Kiswahili: Mjumbe aliyekuwa amekwenda kumwita Mikaya akamwambia, “Tazama, manabii wote kama mtu mmoja wanatabiri ushindi kwa mfalme. Neno lako na likubaliane na lao, nawe unene mema kuhusu mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria otometwe gochia korangeria Mikaya akagenda akamoteebia, “Rora, amang’ana ’ababani bande nigo are ayamo, akoria eira y’egesio ekiya ase omorwoti; tiga ring’ana riao ribe erimo namang’ana abo; naye boigo okwane amang’ana okoria eira y’egesio ekiya ase omorwoti.”

English: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well is a righteous man who gives way to the wicked.
Kiswahili: Kama vile chemchemi iliyotibuliwa matope au kisima kilichotiwa taka ndivyo alivyo mtu mwenye haki akishiriki na waovu.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge okorua ribaga ase omokori amabe nigo anga buna orooche rore netintira na buna ensoko yasarekire.

English: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, tulia tena, kwa kuwa Bwana amekuwa mwema kwako.
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, irana ase n’obotoereru bwao, ekiagera Omonene ogokoreire amaya amange.

English: Now Adonijah and all his guests were finishing their feast when they heard the sound of the ram’s horn. “Why is the city in such a loud uproar?” asked Joab.
Kiswahili: Adoniya pamoja na wageni wote waliokuwa pamoja naye wakasikia sauti hiyo walipokuwa wakimalizia karamu yao. Waliposikia sauti ya tarumbeta, Yoabu akauliza, “Nini maana ya makelele yote haya katika mji?”
Ekegusii: Adonia na abageni bonsi baria baarenge amo nere, ekero bakoorire omoyega obo, bakaigwa amariogi aria. Na ekero Yoabu ayaigwete amo nebiroria, akabooria: “Ninki engencho y’amariogi aya amanene are ase omochie?”

English: In that case, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
Kiswahili: Lakini, kwa kweli si mimi tena nitendaye lile nisilotaka bali ni ile dhambi ikaayo ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono tari inche nkoyakora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.

English: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. Yahweh loved him;
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akamfariji Bathsheba mkewe, akaingia kwake akakutana naye kimwili. Akazaa mwana, wakamwita jina lake Solomoni. Bwana alimpenda Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaba okoremia Batiseba mok'aye; akaba nere, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia, na Daudi akamoroka Sulemani. Na Omonene akaba bwanchete omwana oria,

English: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let's go over to the other side.”
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo ilipokaribia jioni, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake, “Tuvukeni twende mpaka ngʼambo.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria, rigachia koba mogoroba, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng'umbu.”

English: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
Kiswahili: wala msisimamishe jiwe la kuabudu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu anavichukia vitu hivi.
Ekegusii: Naende timobaisa gotenenia esiiro ende yonsi y’ogosasiimwa, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nageechete ebinto buna ebio.

English: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;
Kiswahili: hivyo moyo wangu kushawishiwa kwa siri, au kubusu mkono wangu kwa kuviheshimu,
Ekegusii: goika enkoro yane ekaebererigwa bobisi ase okobisasiima, gose tinanyunyuntete okoboko kwane ase okobisika.

English: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
Kiswahili: Naijua dhiki yako na umaskini wako, lakini wewe ni tajiri! Nayajua masingizio ya wale wasemao kuwa ni Wayahudi lakini sio, bali wao ni sinagogi la Shetani.
Ekegusii: Namanyire emechando yao, na obotaka bwao (korende nomonda ore). Namanyire buna ogokwanwa bobe nabwo bagoteeba ng’a n’Abayahudi bare, ko tibari bo, korende barabwo n’ekeombe gia ya Saitani.

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, I will bring down upon his head My oath that he despised and My covenant that he broke.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Hakika kama niishivyo, nitaleta juu ya kichwa chake kiapo changu, alichokidharau na Agano langu lile alilolivunja.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteeba: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ekiagera achaayete eira eria atianete asende, na agasaria okobwatana kw’ane kw’ogotianania, nimoakane ogokora kwaye komoiranere.

English: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakuita urudi kana kwamba ulikuwa mke aliyeachwa na kuhuzunishwa rohoni; kama mke aliyeolewa bado angali kijana na kukataliwa,” asema Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oo nigo agoteeba iga: “Inche Omonene nakorangeirie aye ore buna omokungu bwangetwe, oichaanete ase omoyo oye, ee, nakorangeirie aye ore buna omokungu oseretigwe ekero arenge omoriakari.

English: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!'
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, toa unabii na useme: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Ombolezeni ninyi na mseme, “Ole wa siku ile!”
Ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, bana oteebe ng'a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Eumie, morere: Obee! Naki rituko eri rire?

English: Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
Kiswahili: Kuweni imara na moyo wa ushujaa. Msiogope wala msifadhaike kwa sababu yao, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu anakwenda pamoja nanyi; kamwe hatawaacha wala hatawatupa ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Motenene bokong'u, mobe abaremu, timobaisa kobairoka gose koboboa, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nagende amo nainwe, takobatiga mobugwe, gose takobatuguta.”

English: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu; wengi ni adui kwangu bila sababu, wale wanaotafuta kuniangamiza. Ninalazimishwa kurudisha kitu ambacho sikuiba.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bangechete bosa ’ngencho ende etaiyo; nigo bare abange kobua etukia ere ase omotwe one. Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane, baganetie gosiria obogima bwane, nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge. Nigo n’akanete ebi ntaibete.

English: Then Jacob declared, “O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, the LORD who told me, ‘Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,’
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akaomba, “Ee Mungu wa baba yangu Abrahamu, Mungu wa baba yangu Isaki, Ee Bwana, ambaye uliniambia, ‘Rudi katika nchi yako na jamaa yako, nami nitakufanya ustawi,’
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agasaba, akabora: “Aye Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka tata, aye Omonene, gwanteebetie ng’a: Oirane gochia seino, na eamate yao, na inche ningokorere amaya.

English: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda wakamtwaa Uzia, aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita, nao wakamfanya mfalme mahali pa Amazia baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Usia arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo, Abayuda bonsi bakamobeka akaba omorwoti ribaga ri’Amasia ise.

English: But Jeremiah answered, “You are to tell Zedekiah that
Kiswahili: Lakini Yeremia akawajibu, “Mwambieni Sedekia,
Ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akabairaneria, “Teebia Zedekia

English: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
Kiswahili: Shaharaimu aliwazaa wana katika nchi ya Moabu baada ya kuwapa talaka wake zake wawili yaani, Hushimu na Baara.
Ekegusii: Saharaimu akaibora abana abamura ase ense ya Moabu ekero konya aseririe Husimu na Baara, abakungu baye.

English: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath. The LORD Alone Is God
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu ni Mungu mwenye huruma, hatawaacha au kuwaangamiza wala kusahau Agano alilofanya na baba zenu, alilowathibitishia kwa kiapo. Bwana Ndiye Mungu
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, takobatiga, ekiagera ere n’oyo bw’amaabera. Takobasiria, gose takweba okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino.

English: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
Kiswahili: Timotheo, mtendakazi mwenzangu anawasalimu. Vivyo hivyo Lukio, Yasoni, na Sosipatro, ndugu zangu.
Ekegusii: Timotheo, omokori emeremo amo nainche, obakwanirie; naboigo Lukio, na Yasoni, na Sosipateri, abaamate bane, baabakwanirie.

English: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Efraimu, mashujaa hodari 20,800, watu waliokuwa maarufu katika koo zao.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaefraimu: chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana atano na atato (20,800), abanto chituoni ase esegi bamanyekanete ase chiamate chiabo.

English: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
Kiswahili: Basi, nyenyekeeni chini ya mkono wa Mungu ulio hodari, ili awakweze kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekeyie inse y'okoboko kwa Nyasae okore nokobua, erinde ere abaimokererie igoro ase ekero kiaye.

English: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
Kiswahili: Absalomu akaendelea na tabia hii mbele ya Waisraeli wote waliomjia mfalme kumwomba awape haki; kwa hiyo Absalomu akaiba mioyo ya watu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Abisalomu akorerete Abaisraeli bonsi abwo bareenge gocha ase omorwoti ase okogaamberwa ebiina biabo. Ase enchera eyio Abisalomu akang'usa Abaisraeli bonsi bakamwancha.

English: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.
Kiswahili: pia Bwana Mungu wako atakapowatia mkononi mwako na ukawashinda, basi ni lazima uwaangamize wote kabisa. Usifanye agano nao, wala usiwahurumie.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue, goika mobaite na kobasiria kegima, timobaisa gokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, gose kobarorera amaabera.

English: All things that are of the earth will go back to the earth; so the ungodly will go from a curse to perdition.
Kiswahili: Vitu vyote vilivyo duniani vitarudi duniani; vivyo hivyo wasiomcha Mungu watatoka laana hadi kuangamia.
Ekegusii: Kende gionsi gekorwa ase orotu, kerokio nigo gekoirana gochi ase orotu, ababe nigo bagochaakera okoragererigwa na gokorera obosiru.

English: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nafsi yangu imejaa taabu, na maisha yangu yanakaribia kaburi.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oichire nemechando, na obogima bwane bwaikire ang'e kogenda aase abakuure.

English: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Wakati utafika ambapo mtatamani kuiona moja ya siku ya Mwana wa Adamu, lakini hamtaiona.
Ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri'amatuko y'Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, korende timokorirora.

English: See the strength of his loins and the power in the muscles of his belly.
Kiswahili: Tazama basi nguvu alizo nazo kwenye viuno vyake, uwezo alio nao kwenye misuli ya tumbo lake!
Ekegusii: Rora, chinguru chiaye nigo chire ase ekeneema kiaye, na okobua kwaye nigo kore ase chinyama chi’enda yaye.

English: It is HIV/AIDS that has killed them.
Kiswahili: Ni VVU/UKIMWI uliowaua.
Ekegusii: Enyamoreo Nero yabaita

English: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no'), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaendelea kusema, “Tafadhali mwombe Mfalme Solomoni, anipatie Abishagi, Mshunami, awe mke wangu; hatakukatalia wewe.”
Ekegusii: Adonia agakwana: “Nagosabire, genda oboorie omorwoti Sulemani ang'e Abisagi, Omosunemu oria, abe mokaane. Nimanyete ng'a takogokania.”

English: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon—all that he did, as well as his wisdom—are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?
Kiswahili: Kwa habari za matukio mengine ya utawala wa Solomoni, yote aliyoyafanya na hekima aliyoionyesha, je hayakuandikwa yote katika kitabu cha matendo cha Solomoni?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Sulemani, na aya onsi akorete, na obong’aini bwaye bwonsi nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora gwa Sulemani.

English: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
Kiswahili: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamealikwa arusini pia.
Ekegusii: Yeso nere konya orangeriigwe amo naborokigwa baye ase enyangi.

English: They will all respond to you, saying, “You too have become weak, as we are; you have become like us!”
Kiswahili: Wote wataitikia, watakuambia, “Wewe pia umekuwa dhaifu, kama sisi tulivyo; wewe umekuwa kama sisi.”
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi mbakwane, bagoteebie: Bono naye kwaurirwe chinguru buna intwe, gwatogwekanire.

English: Rescue those being led away to death, and restrain those stumbling toward the slaughter.
Kiswahili: Okoa wale wanaoongozwa kwenye kifo; wazuie wote wanaojikokota kuelekea machinjoni.
Ekegusii: Tooria abwo bakoirwa gochia gokwa; irania abwo bakoirwa gochia goitwa.

English: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh's voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.
Kiswahili: Lakini Samweli akajibu: “Je, Bwana anafurahia sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu kama vile kuitii sauti ya Bwana? Kutii ni bora zaidi kuliko dhabihu, nako kusikia ni bora kuliko mafuta ya kondoo dume.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamoteebia: “Inee! Igo okorengereria ng'a Omonene nagokerete ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa na ebing'wanso binde kobua okomoigwera? Naama! Okoigwera nokuya kobua ebing'wanso, na ogotegerera nokuya kobua ebitinya bie chimingichi.

English: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don't labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nilisema, “Geukia mbali nami, niache nilie kwa uchungu. Usijaribu kunifariji juu ya maangamizi ya watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche ngateeba: “Tobaisa kondigereria, ntige ndere nobororo ing'iyerie amariga; tobaisa gwechanda kondemia ase engencho y'ogosarigwa kw'omochie bw'abaanto baane.”

English: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
Kiswahili: Tangu nyakati za zamani hakuna yeyote aliyesikia, hakuna sikio lililotambua, hakuna jicho lililomwona Mungu mwingine ila wewe, anayetenda mambo kwa ajili ya wale wamngojeao.
Ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a kare onde tana koigwa nogoto kwaye, gose korora neriso riaye, Nyasae onga buna aye ogokorera abwo bagosemeretie amaya.

English: During his lifetime, Absalom had set up for himself a pillar in the King’s Valley, for he had said, “I have no son to preserve the memory of my name.” So he gave the pillar his name, and to this day it is called Absalom’s Monument. David Mourns for Absalom
Kiswahili: Wakati wa uhai wa Absalomu alikuwa amechukua nguzo na kuisimamisha katika Bonde la Mfalme, kwa maana alifikiri, “Sina mwana atakayeendeleza kumbukumbu ya jina langu.” Akaita nguzo hiyo kwa jina lake mwenyewe. Nayo inaitwa Mnara wa Ukumbusho wa Absalomu mpaka leo. Daudi Aomboleza Kifo Cha Absalomu
Ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu arenge moyo konya bweagaacheire egento buna esiiro, agakebeeka agwo ase Ense Omweya y’Omorwoti gekaba ekeinyorio ki’erieta riaye; akarengereria ng’a tari na monyamwando. Akayeroka ase erieta riaye omonyene; na goika reero iga nigo ekorokwa Ekeinyorio ki’Abisalomu. Daudi ogoteebigwa igoro y’ogokwa kw’Abisalomu

English: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.
Kiswahili: Ndani yake ilionekana damu ya manabii na ya watakatifu na wote waliouawa duniani.”
Ekegusii: Ime y’omochie oria akanyorekanao amanyinga y’ababani, na ay’abachenu, na aya baria bonsi abaitetwe ase ense.”

English: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.
Kiswahili: Niliona watu wa Kushani katika dhiki, na makazi ya Midiani katika maumivu makali.
Ekegusii: Nkarora chinyomba chire Kusani chichandegete, ne chieema chi’ense ya Midiani chikanyegerigwa.

English: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
Kiswahili: Nimjie Bwana na kitu gani na kusujudu mbele za Mungu aliyetukuka? Je, nije mbele zake na sadaka za kuteketezwa, nije na ndama za mwaka mmoja?
Ekegusii: “Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung'ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?

English: as well as the thresholds and the beveled windows and the galleries all around with their three levels opposite the threshold, were overlaid with wood on all sides. They were paneled from the ground to the windows, and the windows were covered.
Kiswahili: pamoja na vizingiti, madirisha membamba na vyumba vyote vitatu, kila kimoja pamoja na kizingiti vilifunikwa kwa mbao. Sakafu, ukuta mpaka kwenye madirisha na madirisha yenyewe vilifunikwa kwa mbao.
Ekegusii: Boigo omonto oria akarengia emeriibo ya inse y’ebisieri, na ebibao biasiekeire ebioma, na ebisona bi’amarongo atato bi’enyomba, na emeriibo y’ebisieri igoro yatubire ne chibao, na obotambe korwa inse goika ase ebibao. Ebibao ebio nigo biarenge bitubire.

English: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ungamianeni dhambi zenu ninyi kwa ninyi na kuombeana ili mpate kuponywa. Maombi ya mwenye haki yana nguvu tena yanafaa sana.
Ekegusii: Orokerania ebibe biaino inwe ase inwe, na gosaberana, monyore okogwenigwa. Ogosaba kw’omonyene oboronge nigo kore nengencho enene mono gokorasabwe nomokia.

English: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
Kiswahili: Yosefu na Maria walipokuwa wamekamilisha mambo yote yaliyotakiwa na Sheria ya Bwana, walirudi mjini kwao Nazareti huko Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia gokoora goikerania onsi koreng'ana namachiiko Omonene, bakairana Galili goika omochie obo Nazareti.

English: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel from that morning until the appointed time, and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akatuma tauni katika Israeli kuanzia asubuhi mpaka mwisho wa muda ulioamriwa, wakafa watu 70,000 kuanzia Dani hadi Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe, na borobwo bogaita abanto korwa mambia goika engaki yaragetwe; abanto chilifu emerongo etan’ebere (70,000) bagakwa korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.

English: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakajibu: “Sisi tutafuata njia kuu; tena ikiwa sisi au mifugo yetu tutakunywa tone la maji yenu, tutalilipia. Sisi tunataka tu kupita kwa miguu, wala si kitu kingine chochote.”
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoteebia, “Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, na gatoranywe amaache ao, intwe gose chitugo chiaito, rirorio 'natoakane amaache ayio. Toe ribaga toete rioka namagoro, titokogania gento kende goetania ekio.”

English: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
Kiswahili: Navyo vile viungo tunavyoviona havina heshima, ndivyo tunavipa heshima maalum. Vile viungo vya mwili ambavyo havina uzuri, tunavipa heshima ya pekee;
Ekegusii: Na ebiimo biria bi’omobere bigokagerwa ng’a tibiri nogosika twabieire ogosika kobua; na ebiimo biaito bitari nobuya, nigo tokobiboyia buya kobua,

English: Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
Kiswahili: Je, haiwapasi kuniogopa mimi?” asema Bwana. “Je, haiwapasi kutetemeka mbele zangu? Niliufanya mchanga kuwa mpaka wa bahari, kizuizi cha milele ambacho haiwezi kupita. Mawimbi yanaweza kuumuka, lakini hayawezi kuupita; yanaweza kunguruma, lakini hayawezi kuuvuka.
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timokonyiroka inche Omonene? Timokoiguswa ase obosio bwane? Nigo nabegete omokenye okaba orobebe rw’enyancha, egetango kia botambe enyancha etanyare gotamboka. Nonya nemerindo ekorotwoma, tekonyara korotagora. Nonya ekoimokerera igoro, tekonyara goeta orobebe roria.

English: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wakaja wakamletea Yesu mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amebebwa na watu wanne.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagaacha; bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata obogoirie nabaanto bane.

English: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
Kiswahili: Basi matendo ya mwili ni dhahiri nayo ni haya: Uasherati, uchafu, ufisadi,
Ekegusii: Ogokora gwe chingencho chi'ebibe nigo kore maiso marore na korokwo nobotomani, eubi, obonyaka,

English: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines. They will strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
Kiswahili: Kisha nitakutia mikononi mwa wapenzi wako, nao watabomoa majukwaa yako na kuharibu mahali pako pa fahari pa ibada ya miungu. Watakuvua nguo zako na kuchukua vito vyako vya thamani na kukuacha uchi na bila kitu.
Ekegusii: Ninkobeke ase amaboko ’abanchi bao; barabwo mbatagore ebinyomba biria kweagacherete bi’emegwekano ogosasiima amo nase ao aimokererete igoro. Naende mbakorusie chianga chiao, na baire ebinto biao ebiya bi’ogwechabera, bagotige kore getirianda otabegeti eanga.

English: Cry aloud, O Daughter of Gallim! Listen, O Laishah! O wretched Anathoth!
Kiswahili: Piga kelele, ee Binti Galimu! Sikiliza, ee Laisha! Maskini Anathothi!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Galimu, rera neriogi rinene! Inwe aba Laisa, tegerera moigwe! Obee! Inwe ab’Anatoti abaremerwa!

English: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
Kiswahili: Ndipo hekalu la Mungu lililoko mbinguni likafunguliwa, na sanduku la agano lake likaonekana humo ndani. Kukatokea mianga ya umeme wa radi, ngurumo, sauti za radi, tetemeko la nchi na mvua kubwa ya mawe.
Ekegusii: Erio Hekalu ya Nyasae ere igoro ekaigorwa, na Esanduki y’okobwatana kwaye ekarorekana ase Hekalu yaye ime. Aroro bikaba okomesa, na okogukura, ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na embura y’amagena enyinge mono egatwa.

English: If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath,
Kiswahili: Kama lilikuwa kusudi la Mungu, naye akaiondoa Roho yake na pumzi yake,
Ekegusii: Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw’obogima,

English: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Androniko na Yunia, jamaa zangu ambao wamekuwa gerezani pamoja nami. Wao ni maarufu miongoni mwa mitume, nao walikuwa katika Kristo kabla yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Androniko na Yunia, abaamate baane, abasibetwe ano nainche, abatomwa bagwatorwa ng’a nabaya; barabwo nigo bantang’anerete koba ime ase Kristo.

English: He who blasphemes Yahweh's name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
Kiswahili: yeyote atakayekufuru Jina la Bwana ni lazima auawe. Kusanyiko lote litampiga kwa mawe. Iwe ni mgeni au mzawa, atakapolikufuru Jina la Bwana, ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oraraame erieta ri'Omonene goika aitwe akwe; omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena. Karabe omomenyi gose omobiare, oyokorama Erieta ri'Omonene goika aitwe akwe.

English: And the charge inscribed against Him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Kiswahili: Tangazo likaandikwa la mashtaka dhidi yake lenye maneno haya: “ Mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
Ekegusii: Na amariiko y’ogosoerwa kwaye nigo ariikire igoro, “OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

English: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
Kiswahili: Sasa wamejua ya kuwa vyote ulivyonipa vimetoka kwako,
Ekegusii: Bono bamanyire ng’a onsi aya kwang’ete nigo akorwa ase ore.

English: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.
Kiswahili: Tamari akamwambia, “Hapana! Kunifukuza itakuwa vibaya zaidi kuliko yale uliyonitendea.” Lakini Amnoni akakataa kumsikiliza.
Ekegusii: Tamari akamoiraneria, “Yaya taibo, oyominto. Bono ogoseria oko ogonseria nigo kore okobe kobua amang'ana aya gwankoreire.” Korende Amunoni akaanga gotegerera amang'ana aye.

English: Although Ahaz had taken a portion from the house of the LORD, from the royal palace, and from the princes and had presented it to the king of Assyria, it did not help him.
Kiswahili: Ahazi akachukua baadhi ya vitu kutoka Hekalu la Bwana, jumba la kifalme na kutoka kwa wakuu wake na kumpa mfalme wa Ashuru kama ushuru, lakini hilo halikumsaidia.
Ekegusii: Ahasi akaurereria enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’omorwoti, na ey’abanene barenge nere, akaa omorwoti bw’Abaasuri ebango, korende ayio tamokonyete. Ebibe bi’Ahasi

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit, but he walked in them.
Kiswahili: Alifanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, na hakuacha dhambi yoyote kati ya zile za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati ambazo alikuwa amesababisha Israeli kuzitenda, bali aliendelea kuzitenda.
Ekegusii: Nere agakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, teatananete korwa ase ekemo ki’ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, korende akagenderera kobikora.

English: and gave their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with zeal for you, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid. O God, O my God, hear me also who am a widow.
Kiswahili: Ukawatoa wake zao kuwa mateka, na binti zao kuwa mateka, na nyara zao zote kugawanywa miongoni mwa watoto wako wapendwa; waliokuonea wivu, na kuchukia uchafu wa damu yao, na kukuita msaada. Ee Mungu, Ee Mungu wangu, nisikilize mimi pia, mimi mjane.
Ekegusii: Aye okabatiga abakungu baaabo bagooswa na ebisakore biabo bikairwa na absomba bao bakogogetie, engencho yaye, Abaisraeli abwo berwete gokora ogwancha kwao. Abamura bamwabo Dina bakabea ase ogochecherigwa gwa Dina mosubati omwabo. Nabo ekero bagosabete aye okabaa obokoonyi. Aye Nyasae, Nyasae one, onyigwe inche omokungu omoboraka;

English: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
Kiswahili: Baada ya miaka mitatu Waashuru wakautwaa. Kwa hiyo Samaria ulitekwa katika mwaka wa sita wa utawala wa Mfalme Hezekia, ambao ulikuwa mwaka wa tisa wa utawala wa Hoshea mfalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Na ase omoerio bw'omwaka o gatato Abaasuri bakayobua, bakayoira. Ase omwaka o gatano na rimo bw'okogaamba kwa Hezekia, noro omwaka o kianda bw'okogaamba kwa Hosea, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, Samaria okairwa.

English: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
Kiswahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutamka hekima, nao ulimi wake huzungumza lililo haki.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonto omooronge nigo agokwana amang’ana yobong’aini, na oromeme rwaye nigo rogosokia ay’ekeene.

English: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo aliwapa kile walichoomba, lakini akatuma juu yao ugonjwa wa kudhoofisha.
Ekegusii: Ere akabaa egento baboretie baegwe, korende akabatomera oborwaire bw’okobareyia.

English: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
Kiswahili: Bwana anatukumbuka na atatubariki: ataibariki nyumba ya Israeli, ataibariki nyumba ya Aroni,
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire ogotoinyora, natosesenie; nasesenie Abaisraeli, nasesenie ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni.
