English: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn't be comforted, because they are no more.”
Kiswahili: “Sauti ilisikika huko Rama, maombolezo na kilio kikubwa, Raheli akilia kwa ajili ya wanawe, akikataa kufarijiwa, kwa sababu hawako tena.”
Ekegusii: Magega Herode gakuure, omomalaika bw'Omonene akamoorokera Yusufu aria Misiri ase chindoto, akamoteebia,

English: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya majeshi wapanda farasi ilikuwa 200,000,000. Nilisikia idadi yao.
Ekegusii: Na omobaro bw’emeganda y’abariinete chibarasi nigo orenge chimilion amagana abere. Nkaigwa ng’a omobaro obo nigo orenge buna iga.

English: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
Kiswahili: Nitampanda katika nchi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe; nami nitaonyesha pendo langu kwake yule ambaye nilimwita, ‘Si mpenzi wangu. ’ Nitawaambia wale walioitwa, ‘Sio watu wangu,’ ‘Ninyi ni watu wangu’; nao watasema, ‘Wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nimosimeke Yesireeli ase ense eye abe oyone. Nimororere amaabera oyio otaroreretwe amaabera, ninteebie abwo batarenge abanto baane: Bono inwe nabaanto baane, na barabwo mbateebe: Aye naye Nyasae oito.”

English: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God's house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
Kiswahili: Katika Walawi, Ahiya alikuwa mwangalizi wa hazina za nyumba ya Mungu na mwangalizi wa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.
Ekegusii: Ahiya oyomo bw'Abalawi nere otenenerete chikungo chi'enyomba ya Nyasae, naende nere orendete ebiatananetwe bikaba ebichenu.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Pigeni makofi, enyi mataifa yote, mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera 'omogooko neriogi rinene!

English: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akafurahi mno, naye akatoa amri Danieli atolewe kutoka kwa lile tundu. Danieli alipotolewa kutoka kwa lile tundu, hakukutwa na jeraha lolote, kwa sababu alikuwa amemtumaini Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaba nomogooko omonene mono, agachiika ng'a Danieli arusigwe ase engoro eria. Ase ayio Danieli akarusigwa aroro na tanyorekanete oarire aande onsi ase omobere oye, ekiagera nigo amosemeretie Nyasae oye.

English: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu aapaye kwa madhabahu, huapa kwa hayo madhabahu na vitu vyote vilivyo juu yake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasiimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.

English: You are the daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and children. You are the sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni binti halisi wa mama yako, ambaye alimchukia kabisa mume wake na watoto wake, tena wewe ni dada halisi wa dada zako, waliowachukia kabisa waume zao na watoto wao. Mama yako alikuwa Mhiti na baba yako alikuwa Mwamori.
Ekegusii: Aye omosubati nigo onga nyoko, oria bwangete omosacha oye, na abana baye; naende nigo onga basubati bamino, abwo bangete abasacha babo, na abana babo. Nyoko nigo arenge Omohiti na iso n’Omoamiori orenge.

English: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
Kiswahili: Kumbuka jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita haraka. Ni kwa ubatili kiasi gani umemuumba mwanadamu!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng'e, nigo gwatongete Mwanyabaanto bonsi bakwe igo.

English: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn't know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
Kiswahili: Yule mkuu wa meza akayaonja yale maji ambayo yalikuwa yamebadilika kuwa divai. Hakujua divai hiyo ilikotoka ingawa wale watumishi waliochota yale maji wao walifahamu. Basi akamwita bwana arusi kando
Ekegusii: Omonene bw'omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw'omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,

English: The king commanded that they take off Jonathan's garments and clothe him in purple, and they did so.
Kiswahili: Mfalme aliamuru wamvue Yonathani mavazi yake na kumvika nguo ya zambarau, nao wakafanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Ere Alekisanda agachiika Yonathani aaborigwe chianga chiaye na koboyigwa chianga chi'oborwoti chiimonyinga. Ayio agakoreka boigo.

English: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!
Kiswahili: “Njooni, ninyi nyote wenye kiu, njooni kwenye maji; nanyi ambao hamna fedha, njooni, nunueni na mle! Njooni, nunueni divai na maziwa bila fedha na bila gharama.
Ekegusii: “Naama! Inwe mwensi abamore nerang’o, inchwo monywe amaache! Inwe aba motabwati chitaabu, inchwo mogore endagera morie! Inchuo mogore edivai na amabeere motari goakana chitaabu, gose korua kende.

English: the Arodite clan from Arod, and the Arelite clan from Areli.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Arodi, ukoo wa Waarodi; kutoka kwa Areli, ukoo wa Waareli.
Ekegusii: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.

English: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama hata baada ya haya bado hamtanisikiliza lakini mkaendelea kuweka uadui nami,
Ekegusii: “Komoraabe mwanyorire emechando eye yonsi, na mogenderere kwanga konyigwera na koba mamincha yane,

English: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mlio mbali sana, sikieni lile nililofanya; ninyi mlio karibu, tambueni uweza wangu!
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang’e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

English: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
Kiswahili: Nazidi kumwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa utukufu, awajalieni ninyi roho ya hekima na ya ufunuo, ili mpate kumjua zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a Nyasae Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata Obonene, abae omoika bw’obong’aini na bw’okomaanorerwa, erinde momomanye;

English: The priests entered in, and stood before the altar and the temple; and they wept, and said,
Kiswahili: Makuhani wakaingia, wakasimama mbele ya madhabahu na hekalu; wakalia, wakasema,
Ekegusii: Abakuani baria bakairana gochia ime ye Hekalu na gotenena bosio bw'egesasiimero bakarera bagoteeba:

English: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.
Kiswahili: “Anapokimbilia mojawapo ya hii miji mikubwa atasimama kwenye maingilio ya lango la mji mkuu na kueleza wazee wa mji kuhusu shauri lake. Kisha watampokea katika mji wao na kumpa mahali pa kuishi nao.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria omoiti, ekero aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio goika agende atenene ase egeita ki’omochie oyio, akwane amang’ana aye nabatang’ani b’omochie oria. Barabwo bamosoyie ase omochie bamoe aase akomenya ase egati yabo.

English: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko lote la Waisraeli likakusanyika huko Shilo na kusimamisha Hema la Kukutania. Nchi ikawa chini ya utawala wao,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babuete ense eria, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, na agwo bagatenenia Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
Kiswahili: Huwainua juu wanyonge, nao wale waombolezao huinuliwa wakawa salama.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, na abwo bachandegete bakorera, nigo akobabeka ase oborendi obuya.

English: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya shukrani. Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kw'ogoaka ng'a mbuya mono) Inwe abanto b'ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!

English: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don't do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, ninao binti wawili ambao kamwe hawajakutana kimwili na mwanaume. Acha niwatoe nje kwenu, nanyi mnaweza kuwafanyia lolote mnalotaka. Lakini msiwafanyie chochote watu hawa, kwa sababu wako kwenye ulinzi chini ya dari langu.”
Ekegusii: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing'ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y'oborendi bwane.”

English: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya umati mkubwa wa watu, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waweke tayari mashua ndogo kwa ajili yake, ili kuwazuia watu kumsonga.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.

English: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
Kiswahili: Kama mguu wako ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa kiwete, kuliko kuwa na miguu miwili lakini ukaingia jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba n'amagoro abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu ase omorero o kare na kare

English: A wise man will be filled with blessing. All those who see him will call him happy.
Kiswahili: Mwenye hekima atajazwa baraka, na wote wamwonao watamwita mwenye furaha.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong'aini natogigwe ase obonge, na bonsi abarabe bakomorora inabamoroke omonyagesio.

English: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
Kiswahili: “Mungu alimleta kutoka Misri; yeye ana nguvu kama nyati. Anayararua mataifa yaliyo adui zake, na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; huwachoma kwa mishale yake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi'eng'era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y'emebere y'ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.

English: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yakobo akaenda Misri ambako yeye na baba zetu walifia.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatirimboka, agaika Misiri; ere agakwera aroro, ere omonyene ne chisokoro chiaito.

English: But now, behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, did not know it.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa Adoniya amekuwa mfalme, nawe, bwana wangu mfalme huna habari kuhusu jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Na bono rora, Adonia bweeire oborwoti, na aye omonene one omorwoti, tomanyeti amang’ana ayio.

English: The LORD of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawabariki, akisema, “Baraka iwe kwa Misri watu wangu, kwa Ashuru kazi ya mikono yangu, na kwa Israeli urithi wangu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasesenie, ateebe: “Imosesenirie inwe Abamisiri, abamore abanto baane, nainwe Abaasuri, abamore emeremo y’amaboko aane, nainwe Abaisraeli, abamore omwando one.”

English: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
Kiswahili: Muda ambao Daudi alikuwa mfalme juu ya nyumba ya Yuda huko Hebroni ilikuwa miaka saba na miezi sita.
Ekegusii: Ere akabagaambera Abayuda agwo Heburoni ase engaki y'emiaka etan'ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo.

English: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila fahali, andaa sadaka ya nafaka sehemu tatu za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa;
Ekegusii: Naende morue okoruegwa kw’endagera obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo na kera eeri ensae morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

English: Now therefore, do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man. You know what you ought to do to him to bring his gray head down to Sheol in blood.” David’s Reign and Death (1 Chronicles 29:26–30)
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa, usidhani kwamba hana hatia. Wewe ni mtu wa hekima, utajua la kumtendea. Zishushe mvi zake kaburini kwa damu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, tobaisa komobara ng’a tari na komocha, ekiagera aye nomonto omong’aini; nomanye aye omonyene eki ogwenerete gokora asare, tomotiga agende aase abakuure ore ne chimbuche, ase engencho y’okomocha kwaye kw’ogoitera amanyinga omoite akwe.” Ogokwa kwa Daudi

English: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hata Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.”
Ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y'abange.”

English: “Bear with me a little longer, and I will show you that there is more to be said on God’s behalf.
Kiswahili: “Nivumilie kidogo zaidi nami nitakuonyesha kwamba yako mengi zaidi ya kusemwa kwa ajili ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana ribaga ria Nyasae.

English: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Lakini waganga wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa siri ya uganga wao, nao pia wakafanya vyura kuja juu ya nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.

English: After him, Nathan rose up to prophesy in the days of David.
Kiswahili: Baada yake, Nathani aliinuka kutoa unabii katika siku za Daudi.
Ekegusii: Erio boigo akabwatia Nathani; oyio orenge omobani ase amatuko y'omorwoti Daudi.

English: So Anansi did that, and he tied the snake to the stick with his vine to keep him straight. When he was all tied up, Anansi took the snake up to heaven.
Kiswahili: Anansi alifanya hivyo. Kisha akamfunga yule nyoka kwenye kijiti kile kwa kutumia kamba ili kumnyoosha sawasawa. Baada ya kumfunga huyo nyoka vizuri, alimbeba hadi juu mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Igo anansi agakora igo nagosiba eng'iti eria nomogoye oria erinde eng'iti eria enyare koramboka kabisa ase egete keria. Ekero akorete gosiba eng'iti eria nemegoye eria, anansi akayebogoria akayeira mbaka igoro onyasae.

English: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
Kiswahili: Ninazama kwenye vilindi vya matope, pasipo mahali pa kukanyaga, Nimefika kwenye maji makuu, mafuriko yamenigharikisha.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngendererete korimera endiba y’etintira ime, aase tari ase ngotacha n’amagoro. Narimeire ase amaache ase endiba entambe, na emerindo yantubire.

English: He did what was right in the reforming of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.
Kiswahili: Alifanya yaliyo mema katika kuwarekebisha watu, na akaondoa machukizo ya uovu.
Ekegusii: Yosia nigo araetwe buya buna akoraa abanto erio akarusia obobisa bwonsi obwo bwarenge bwabo bw'obobe.

English: And now you are beautiful in your countenance, and wise in your words. If you will do as you have spoken, your God will be my God, and you will dwell in the palace of King Nebuchadnezzar, and will be renowned through the whole earth.”
Kiswahili: Na sasa wewe ni mzuri katika uso wako, na mwenye busara katika maneno yako. Ukifanya kama ulivyosema, Mungu wako atakuwa Mungu wangu, nawe utakaa katika jumba la mfalme Nebukadreza, nawe utajulikana duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omonyakieni naende ogokwana n'obong'aini. Oinse gokora buna kwarire eira, Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one. Aye nomenye ase enyomba y'oborwoti ya Nebukadinesaro naye nobe omokungu bwesiko ase ense engima.”

English: Then the people went out and plundered the camp of the Arameans. It was then that a seah of fine flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley sold for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wakatoka na kuteka nyara kambi ya Waaramu. Kwa hiyo kipimo cha unga mzuri kikauzwa kwa shekeli, na vipimo viwili vya shayiri kwa shekeli, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Samaria bakagenda bagasakora egetwori ki’Abasiiria. Ase ayio obosie obonuke bw’engano ebitita bibere bokaoonigwa ase esekeli eyemo, na obw’esairi ebitita bine ase esekeli eyemo, buna Omonene ateebete.

English: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
Kiswahili: Bahari iliwekwa juu ya mafahali kumi na wawili, watatu wakielekea kaskazini, watatu wakielekea magharibi, watatu wakielekea kusini na watatu wakielekea mashariki. Bahari iliwekwa juu yao na sehemu zao za nyuma zilielekeana.
Ekegusii: Egetuba keria giaterekereretwe igoro y'emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere. Chiombe isato chikarigereria gochia sugusu, na isato gochia bosongo, na isato gochia Irianyi, na isato gochia moocha; chinsemo chiabo chia magega chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati inse y'egetuba keria.

English: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
Kiswahili: basi jueni kuwa Mungu amenitendea yaliyo mabaya, naye amekokota wavu wake kunizunguka.
Ekegusii: rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya ase ’nde, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.

English: Wine is as good as life to men, if you drink it in moderation. What life is there to a man who is without wine? It has been created to make men glad.
Kiswahili: Mvinyo ni mzuri kama uhai kwa wanadamu, ukinywa kwa kiasi. Kuna uhai gani kwa mtu asiye na divai? Imeumbwa ili kuwafurahisha wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Edivai nigo enga obogima oboyia ekero omonto akoyenywa ase ekerengo. Obogima ninki edivai etaiyo? Aro nigo aroisirie agokie abanto.

English: A fool's lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
Kiswahili: Midomo ya mpumbavu humletea ugomvi na kinywa chake hualika kipigo.
Ekegusii: Chinkwana chi'omoriri nigo chikorenta eriomana, na omonwa oye nigo okorangeria ogoakwa.

English: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
Kiswahili: Utawaleta Walawi mbele za Bwana, na Waisraeli wataweka mikono yao juu ya Walawi.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwarentire Abalawi ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Abaisraeli goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe yabo.

English: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
Kiswahili: Maskini huepukwa hata na majirani zao, bali matajiri wana marafiki wengi.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.

English: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.
Kiswahili: Yeye na aielekeze mioyo yetu kwake, ili tutembee katika njia zake zote na kuzishika amri na maagizo na masharti aliyowapa baba zetu.
Ekegusii: korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiiko aye na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na onsi aya achiigete chisokoro chiaito.

English: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hasira ya mwanadamu haitendi haki ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto teri gokora ayare boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
Kiswahili: Alifanya hivyo ili kuonyesha haki yake wakati huu, ili yeye awe mwenye haki na mwenye kumhesabia haki yule anayemwamini Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng'a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.

English: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn't you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?
Kiswahili: Je, tutavunja maagizo yako tena na kuoana na watu ambao hufanya mambo ya machukizo? Je, hutakuwa na hasira ya kutosha juu yetu na kutuangamiza, bila kutuachia mabaki wala atakayenusurika?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ntosarie naende amachiiko ao na tonyuomerane nabaanto aba bagokora okogechia oko? Inee! Igo aye tokoba nendamwamu ase tore na otosirie kegima, erinde abatigari tibanyorekana, gose monto onde atooreke?

English: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:
Kiswahili: Wewe huonyesha upendo kwa maelfu, lakini huleta adhabu kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba mapajani mwa watoto wao baada yao. Ee Mungu mkuu na mwenye uweza, ambaye jina lako ni Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote,
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okoorokia obwanchani bwao bwa botambe ase abanto chilifu chinyinge, korende nigo okorua egesusuro ase abana ase engencho y'okomocha kw'abaise. Aye Nyasae ore Omonene bw'echinguru, erieta riao nario Omonene bw'Emeganda.

English: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
Kiswahili: Ngozi yangu imekuwa nyeusi nayo inachunika; mifupa yangu inaungua kwa homa.
Ekegusii: Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.

English: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli akawaambia watumishi wake, “Nitafutieni mwanamke mwaguzi ili nimwendee, nipate kuuliza kwake.” Watumishi wake wakamwambia, “Yuko mwanamke mmoja huko Endori.”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia abasomba baye: “Indigerie omokungu okoboria amang'ana korwa ase emeika y'abanto bakuure, nimochiere, ndigie ogosemigwa korwa asare.” Abasomba baye bakamoiraneria: “Naama! Agwo Eni‐Dori omokungu buna oyio nareo.”

English: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
Kiswahili: Lazima aweze kuisimamia nyumba yake mwenyewe vizuri na kuhakikisha kwamba watoto wake wanamtii na kuwa na heshima kwa kila njia.
Ekegusii: Naende nemogwenerete abe omonto omanyete kogambera enyomba yaye omonyene buya, na kworokereria abana baye baigwere ase ogosika gwonsi,

English: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.
Kiswahili: Upana wa ua wa Hekalu upande wa mashariki, pamoja na upande wa mbele wa Hekalu ulikuwa dhiraa mia moja.
Ekegusii: Obogare bwa bosio bwe Hekalu ensemo ya moocha, amo neraaro nigo bwarenge obw'ekerengo ki'amaboko rigana erimo.

English: And the LORD said to Moses, “The man must surely be put to death. The whole congregation is to stone him outside the camp.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Huyo mtu ni lazima afe. Kusanyiko lote lazima limpige mawe nje ya kambi.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”

English: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
Kiswahili: Ambaye humpa chakula kila kiumbe. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorua endagera oa ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini, mwezi wa nne, siku ya tano ya mwezi, wakati nilipokuwa miongoni mwa hao waliokuwa uhamishoni kando ya Mto Kebari, mbingu zilifunguka nami nikaona maono ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o kane, omwaka bw’emerongo etato, ekero inche Ezekieli namenyete ang’e norooche rwa Kebari amo nabooswa bande, igoro ekamaanoka, nkarora amaroro akorwa ase Nyasae.

English: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
Kiswahili: Hekima humfanya yeye aliye nayo kuwa na uwezo zaidi kuliko watawala kumi katika mji.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini nigo bogokora abare abang'aini koba ne chinguru chibuete echi'abagaambi ikomi bare ase omochie oyomo.

English: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utafahamu lipi lililo kweli na haki na sawa: yaani kila njia nzuri.
Ekegusii: Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayaare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chiinchera chionsi chire chingiya,

English: So the Levitical property and the city property will lie in the center of the area belonging to the prince—the area between the borders of Judah and Benjamin. The Portions for the Remaining Tribes
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo milki ya Walawi na milki ya mji vitakuwa katikati ya eneo lile ambalo ni mali ya mkuu anayetawala. Eneo la mkuu anayetawala litakuwa kati ya mpaka wa Yuda na mpaka wa Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Chingongo chi’omogaambi nigo chirabebekane norw’Abalawi na orw’omochie, naende chibe ase egati y’orw’Abayuda na orw’Ababenjamini. Ense yaterwe ebisaku binde

English: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil, first for the Jew, then for the Greek;
Kiswahili: Kutakuwa na taabu na dhiki kwa kila mmoja atendaye maovu, Myahudi kwanza na mtu wa Mataifa pia,
Ekegusii: Emechando na obororo inabibe igoro ase kera oyomo bw’abana ba Mwanyabaanto oyogokora amabe, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo;

English: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana atakuwa tumaini lako na kuepusha mguu wako kunaswa katika mtego.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabe ogosemeria kwao, ere narende okogoro kwao tikobaisa kobwatwa ase omotego.

English: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Yarmuthi na En-Ganimu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne
Ekegusii: na Yarimuti na Eni‐Ganimu, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akaondoka Beer-Sheba nao wana wa Israeli wakamchukua baba yao Yakobo na watoto wao na wake zao katika magari ya kukokotwa yale Farao aliyokuwa amempelekea kumsafirisha.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba, akagenda. Basinto ba Israeli bakabogoria Yakobo ise, amo nabana babo abake, na abakungu babo ase chigari chiria Farao abatomerete chibabogorie.

English: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and petition, and may You uphold their cause. May You forgive Your people who sinned against You.
Kiswahili: basi kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako, usikie dua yao na maombi yao na kuitetea haki yao. Uwasamehe watu wako, waliotenda dhambi dhidi yako.
Ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa aase agwo igoro, ase obomenyo bwao bore, ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, obae oboronge bwabo na bwabere abanto bao abakorire ebibe asore.

English: The man whom the demons had left begged to go with Jesus. But He sent him away, saying,
Kiswahili: Yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu akamsihi Yesu afuatane naye, lakini Yesu akamuaga, akamwambia:
Ekegusii: Na omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha akamosorora abe amo nere, korende Yeso akamokania, akabora,

English: But bring those enemies of mine who didn't want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.'”
Kiswahili: Lakini wale adui zangu ambao hawakutaka mimi niwe mfalme juu yao. Waleteni hapa mkawaue mbele yangu.' ”
Ekegusii: Korende baria ababisa baane batarigeti mbagambere, barente aiga, mobaite ase obosio bwane.”

English: One day, while Job’s sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
Kiswahili: Siku moja watoto wa Ayubu walipokuwa wakifanya karamu wakila na kunywa divai katika nyumba ya ndugu yao mkubwa,
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero abana b’Ayubu, abamura na abaiseke, babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene,

English: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
Kiswahili: “Efraimu, ninawezaje kukuacha? Ee Israeli, ninawezaje kukutoa? Nitawezaje kukutendea kama Adma? Nitawezaje kukufanya kama Seboimu? Moyo wangu umegeuka ndani yangu, huruma zangu zote zimeamshwa.
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ndakore mbatige? Inwe Abaisraeli, naki ndakore mbatige morue asende? Naki ndakore mbatige buna natigete Adima? Naki ndakore mbakorere buna nakorerete Seboimu? Enkoro yane nigo egwoka, na amaabera aane onsi abokire ime yane.

English: “I have made my peace offerings; today I have paid my vows.
Kiswahili: “Nina sadaka za amani nyumbani; leo nimetimiza nadhiri zangu.
Ekegusii: “Nariete eira korua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe; rituko ria reero nayeikeranirie.

English: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies will be unclean, and any furniture on which he sits will be unclean.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kitanda chochote atakacholalia mtu mwenye kutokwa na usaha kitakuwa najisi, na chochote atakachokalia kitakuwa najisi.
Ekegusii: Ebirarero bionsi araararere, gose araikaransere, nigo biraabe ebitachenegeti.

English: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, nimemchagua Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda,
Ekegusii: “Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

English: (for when Gentiles who don't have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
Kiswahili: (Naam, wakati wa watu wa Mataifa, ambao hawana sheria, wanapofanya kwa asili mambo yatakiwayo na sheria, wao ni sheria kwa nafsi zao wenyewe, hata ingawa hawana sheria.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'Ebisaku batari namachiiko, ekero bagokora buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere aya amachiiko are korigia, nonya abwo tibari namachiiko, babeire amachiiko boka abanyene.

English: The portico was twenty cubits wide and twelve cubits deep, and ten steps led up to it. There were columns by the side pillars, one on each side.
Kiswahili: Baraza ilikuwa na dhiraa ishirini kwenda juu na dhiraa kumi na mbili kuanzia mbele hadi nyuma. Kulikuwa na ngazi kumi za kupandia huko, pia kulikuwa na nguzo kwa kila upande wa miimo.
Ekegusii: Obogare bw’egesona ekio nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia ime obw’amaboko ikomi na rimo. Nkiarengeo ekeriinero kiare koriinerwa gochiao. Ase kera ensemo bosio bw’emetobwa eria, chisiiro nchiarengeo.

English: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
Kiswahili: Kwa unyenyekevu wote na upole, mkiwa wavumilivu, mkichukuliana kwa upendo.
Ekegusii: ase obokanyeku bwonsi na obwororo, na ase oboremereria mokobogorerania ase obwanchani.

English: Don't speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
Kiswahili: Ndugu, msineneane mabaya ninyi kwa ninyi. Mtu yeyote anayesema mabaya dhidi ya ndugu yake au kumhukumu anasema dhidi ya sheria na kuihukumu. Unapoihukumu sheria, basi huishiki sheria bali umekuwa hakimu wa kuihukumu hiyo sheria.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, timong'achana. Oyokong'acha oyomwabo, gose komogambia nigo akong'acha amachiiko na koyagambia, korende onye gokogambia amachiiko, rirorio tori omokori amachiiko, korende omogambia amachiiko.

English: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote watakusanyika mbele zake, naye atawatenga kama mchungaji anavyotenga kondoo na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererie ase obosio bwaye; ere naatanane abanto buna omorisia agwatanana ching’ondi ne chimbori.

English: He marched out and came with a great army, and sent letters secretly to all his allies who were in Judea, that they should seize Jonathan and those who were with him; but they couldn't, because their plan was known to them.
Kiswahili: Alitoka nje na kuja na jeshi kubwa, akatuma barua kwa siri kwa washirika wake wote waliokuwa Yudea, kwamba wamkamate Yonathani na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye; lakini hawakuweza, kwa sababu mpango wao ulikuwa umejulikana kwao.
Ekegusii: Bakide akaimokia na abarwani esegi baye abange kegima na kibariikera amarube abobisi abasani baye bonsi bareenge ase ense ya Yudea, okobaboria bamobwate Yonathani na abanto baye. Korende barabwo tibanyaara goikerania ayio ase engencho omoroberio obo omanyekanete mapema.

English: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Milima italeta mafanikio kwa watu, vilima tunda la haki.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa na ebigoro mbirentere abanto omorembe goetera ase oboronge.

English: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akamjibu na kumwambia yule mtu, “Mama yangu ni nani, nao ndugu zangu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Korende akairaneria oria omotebetie, akabora, “Baba nere ng'o? Na bamura baminto mbarabi?”

English: If she doesn't go as you direct, cut her away from your flesh.
Kiswahili: Kama hataenda kama ulivyoelekeza, kata mbali na mwili wako.
Ekegusii: Onye ere tagokora buna okomoteebia, moserie arue asore.

English: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
Kiswahili: Uturehemu, Ee Bwana, uturehemu, kwa maana tumevumilia dharau nyingi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otororere amaabera, koranche otororere amaabera, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa mono goetania.

English: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
Kiswahili: Lakini mhitaji hatasahaulika siku zote, wala matumaini ya walioonewa hayatapotea.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaremerwa tibakwebwa kogenderera botambe, na ogosemeria kw’abagokorerwa bobe tikogosira nonya ng’ake.

English: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninategemea upendo wako usiokoma; moyo wangu unashangilia katika wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Ninsemerie obwanchani bwao botari koera, enkoro yane negokere ogotooreka gokorwa asore.

English: Then the woman said to her husband, “Behold, now I know that the one who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia mumewe, “Ninajua kwamba huyu mtu ambaye anakuja kwetu mara kwa mara ni mtu mtakatifu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria agateebia omosacha oye: “Narorire ng’a omonto oyo ogoeta aa botambe nomonto omochenu o Nyasae.

English: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni mwa mwaka mpya, wakati ambapo wafalme huenda vitani, Yoabu aliliongoza jeshi. Aliangamiza nchi ya Waamoni, na akaenda Raba na kuuzingira, lakini Daudi alibaki Yerusalemu. Yoabu akashambulia Raba na kuuacha ukiwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y'ogosimeka ekero abarwoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Yoabu agatang'ana abarwani b'esegi, agasaria ense y'Abaamoni, akagenda koboera omochie o Raba, korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu. Yoabu akarwania Raba, akayobua akayosaria.

English: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipofika kando ya bahari, aliona makutano makubwa ya watu, akawahurumia na akawaponya wagonjwa wao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikire engegu, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amaabera, akagwenia abarwaire babo.

English: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Humta, Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), na Siori; miji tisa pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Humuta, na Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), na Sihori, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

English: And when Saul numbered them at Bezek, there were 300,000 Israelites and 30,000 men of Judah.
Kiswahili: Sauli alipowakusanya huko Bezeki, watu wa Israeli walikuwa 300,000 na watu wa Yuda 30,000.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo abarete Abaisraeli agwo Bezeki, nigo baarenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), na Abayuda chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

English: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
Kiswahili: Ndipo “ ‘wataiambia milima, “Tuangukieni!” na vilima, “Tufunikeni!” ’
Ekegusii: Erio nabachaake goteebia ebitunwa: Togwere, na ebigoro: Totube.

English: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
Kiswahili: Paulo alikuwa ameamua tusipitie Efeso ili asitumie muda mwingi huko sehemu za Asia, kwa sababu alikuwa anatamani kama ikiwezekana kufika Yerusalemu kabla ya siku ya Pentekoste.
Ekegusii: Naki Paulo nigo arengereretie goeta Efeso mbarabare, tabaisa goteebana ase Asia, ekiagera nigo are koayerera kogenda Yerusalemu rituko ria Pentekosti, keranyarekane.

English: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
Kiswahili: Usiwe mwenye hekima machoni pako mwenyewe; mche Bwana ukajiepushe na uovu.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gwekora omong’aini ase okorora kwao omonyene; omoiroke Omonene na bweatanane korwa ase amabe.

English: From the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Bani: Maadai, Amramu, Ueli,
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Bani: Maadai na Amuramu, Ueli

English: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
Kiswahili: Yesu akamkuta mwana-punda akampanda, kama ilivyoandikwa,
Ekegusii: Yeso akanyora emori y’etigere, akayeriina, buna yarigetwe,

English: Now let this gift your servant has brought to my lord be given to the young men who follow you.
Kiswahili: Nayo zawadi hii ambayo mtumishi wako amemletea bwana wangu, wapewe watu wanaofuatana nawe.
Ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one, ebiegwa ebi inche omosomba oo nakorenteire, tiga biegwe abanto aba bakogotunyana aye omonene one.

English: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaagiza kwa ukali wasimweleze mtu yeyote jambo hilo, naye akawaambia wampe yule msichana chakula.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabakuurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachiika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.

English: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Sisi tunayo sheria na kutokana na sheria hiyo, hana budi kufa kwa sababu yeye alijiita Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Intwe ntore nogochika, naende ase ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.
Kiswahili: Simba aliua mawindo ya kutosha watoto wake, alinyonga mawindo kwa ajili ya mwenzi wake, akijaza makao yake kwa alivyoua na mapango yake kwa mawindo.
Ekegusii: Endo nigo yare goita keria egotwara naende yakebutorana ebisamunye yaereria eyamwabo amo n'echimanwa chiaye; nigo yarenge goichoria engoro yaye n'echinyama chibutoranire.

English: She added, “Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”
Kiswahili: Akaongeza kusema, “Nani angemwambia Abrahamu kuwa Sara angenyonyesha watoto? Tena nimemzalia mwana katika uzee wake.” Hagari Na Ishmaeli Wafukuzwa
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba: “Ning’o nanga ore komoteebia Aburaamu ng’a Sara nagonkie abana? Na bono namoiboreire omwana ase obogotu bwaye.”

English: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Loti akajichagulia bonde lote la Yordani, akaelekea upande wa mashariki. Watu hao wawili wakatengana:
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Loti agechorera bweka ense omweya yonsi ya Yorodani. Barabwo bagatananekana. Igo Loti akamanora kogenda gochia moocha.

English: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
Kiswahili: Mifereji itanuka; vijito vya Misri vitapungua na kukauka. Mafunjo na nyasi vitanyauka,
Ekegusii: Chindooche chigochiao nigo chiragunde chitioke, na amaache 'emetaro agwo Misiri nakee aere; ebitonto na amauncho mbiome.

English: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ndiye huo ufufuo na uzima. Yeye aniaminiye mimi, hata akifa atakuwa anaishi
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche ninche okobokigwa na obogima; oyonyegenire inche, naisa gokwa, nabe moyo.

English: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja nao, nayo idadi kubwa ya watu wakaamini na kumgeukia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw'Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nabarabwo; abanto abange bakamwege n'Omonene, na komoonchokera.

English: For from garments comes a moth, and from a woman comes a woman's wickedness.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nondo hutoka katika mavazi, na uovu wa mwanamke hutoka kwa mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera esukubi nigo egosoka korwa ime yechianga, na obobe bw'omokuungu nigo bokorwa ase omokungu.

English: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili ya kusimamisha ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya maskani.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, agachitenenia.

English: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanadamu huzaliwa ili kutaabika, kwa hakika kama cheche za moto zirukavyo kuelekea juu.
Ekegusii: korende Mwanyabaanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.

English: This is the land that remains: All the territory of the Philistines and the Geshurites,
Kiswahili: “Nchi iliyosalia ni hii: maeneo yote ya Wafilisti na Wageshuri:
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiatigaire nachio echi: Chinsemo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, na ense yonsi y’Abagesuri.

English: They cast out before them the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, the Shechemite, and all the Girgashites, and they lived in that country many days.
Kiswahili: Wakawafukuza mbele yao Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wayebusi, Washekemu, na Wagirgashi wote; wakakaa katika nchi hiyo siku nyingi.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaseria Abakaanani, Abaperisi, Abayebusi Abashekenu na Abagirigasi, naboigo bakamenye orogongo orwo ase engaki entambe.

English: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Maandiko husema, “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka,” tena, “Mfanyakazi anastahili mshahara wake.”
Ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Tobaisa kobekera entang'ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endaagera”, na “Omokori emeremo nagwenerete koegwa eng'eria yaye.”

English: we, having heard that the Jews do not consent to our father's purpose to turn them to the customs of the Greeks, but choose rather their own way of living, and make request that the customs of their law be allowed to them—
Kiswahili: Sisi, tukiwa tumesikia kwamba Wayahudi hawakubaliani na kusudi la baba yetu la kuwageuza kufuata desturi za Wayunani, bali tunachagua njia yao wenyewe ya kuishi, na kuomba waruhusiwe kufuata desturi za sheria yao—
Ekegusii: Namanyire buna Abayahudi tibarigeti komenya na kobwatia chingencho chi'ekegiriki buna tata arigeti, korende nigo baganetie komenya na kobwatia chingencho chiabo, na basabire gotigwa bamenye igo.

English: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule Mlawi, mume wa yule mwanamke aliyeuawa, akasema, “Mimi na suria wangu tulifika Gibea ya Benyamini ili tulale huko.
Ekegusii: Omolawi oria, omosacha bw'omokuungu oria oitetwe moeneno, akairaneria, agateeba, “Nigo nachete Gibea, omochie, bw'Ababenjamini, inche na omokungu one o sere‐sere, erinde toraare aroro agwo ase obotuko.

English: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites. Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel, as I have commanded you.
Kiswahili: “Na kuhusu wakaaji wote katika maeneo ya milima, kuanzia Lebanoni hadi Misrefoth-Maimu, pamoja na eneo lote la Wasidoni, mimi mwenyewe nitawafukuza watoke mbele ya Waisraeli. Hakikisha umegawa nchi hii kwa Israeli kuwa urithi, kama nilivyokuagiza,
Ekegusii: Abasidoni abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa egati y’egetunwa kia Lebanoni na omochie o Misirefoti‐Maimu, inche omonyene nimbaserie barue bosio bw’Abaisraeli. Aye goika bwatananere Abaisraeli ense eyio ebe omwando obo, ase okoyeakera obomera, buna nagochigeete.

English: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
Kiswahili: Paulo alipotaka kujitetea, Galio akawaambia Wayahudi, “Kama ninyi Wayahudi mlikuwa mkilalamika kuhusu makosa makubwa ya uhalifu ingekuwa haki kwangu kuwasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo achia korigia komaanora omonwa oye, Galio agateebia Abayahudi: “Inwe Abayahudi, onye ring'ana ri'okorega gose okong'ainereria okobe ndiakoregete, rirorio anga naremereria nainwe,

English: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
Kiswahili: Juu ya mlima huu ataharibu sitara ihifadhiyo mataifa yote, kile kifuniko kifunikacho mataifa yote,
Ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene nasarie na korusia egietubo getubete abanto bonsi, ee, egietubo ekio keramboire igoro y'ebisaku bionsi.

English: But when the men of that place asked about his wife, he said, “She is my sister.” For he was afraid to say, “She is my wife,” since he thought to himself, “The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is so beautiful.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa mahali pale walipomuuliza habari za mke wake, akasema, “Huyu ni dada yangu,” kwa sababu aliogopa kusema, “Huyu ni mke wangu.” Alifikiri, “Watu wa mahali pale wataweza kumuua kwa sababu ya Rebeka, kwa kuwa alikuwa mzuri wa sura.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’aase aria baamoboretie amang’ana igoro ya mokaye, akabateebia: “Oyo ’mosubati ominto.” Naki nigo oboete goteeba ng’a ere ’mokaye, akarengereria ng’a abanto b’aase aria mbaabaise komoita ase engencho ya Rebeka, ekiagera ere areenge omonyakieni.

English: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Bwana, ndugu yangu anikosee mara ngapi nami nimsamehe? Je, hata mara saba?”
Ekegusii: Erio Petero agacha, akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ara karenga oyominto arankorere bobe, na inche ’mwabere? Ngoika chintunda isano na ibere gose?”

English: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atatia sehemu ya hiyo damu juu ya pembe za madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba wenye harufu nzuri iliyoko mbele za Bwana katika Hema la Kukutania. Damu iliyobaki ya huyo fahali ataimwaga chini ya hayo madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Magega y'ayio Omokuani oria agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye ching'unchara ere ase chikoona chi'egesasiimero ase n'ekoroso egosaamberwa, kere ime ase Eema y'Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, na amanyinga 'eeri eria agotigara ayaumore inse agwo ase egesasiimero gi'ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa kere ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: He made the veil of blue, purple, and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim woven into it.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, zambarau na nyekundu, na za kitani safi, na kutarizi makerubi juu yake.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia etoto y’egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, akayeroisia ebe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba. Chisiiro ibere chi’etai (1 Abar 7:15-22)

English: He who loves money is never satisfied by money, and he who loves wealth is never satisfied by income. This too is futile.
Kiswahili: Yeyote apendaye fedha kamwe hatosheki na fedha; yeyote apendaye utajiri kamwe hatosheki na kipato chake. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete chitaabu, tagoisaneka nachirochio; gose oyobwanchete obotenenku, tagoisaneka nebitoki biaye. Ayio boigo mbosa.

English: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
Kiswahili: Kila siku, Hekaluni na nyumba kwa nyumba, hawakuacha kufundisha na kuhubiri habari njema kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na kera rituko, ase Hekalu ime na ase chinyomba chiabo tibatigete kworokereria na korandia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso, oyio ore Kristo.

English: Then he set up an Asherah pole. Thus Ahab did more to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel before him.
Kiswahili: Pia Ahabu akatengeneza nguzo ya Ashera na kufanya mengi ili kumkasirisha Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kuliko walivyofanya wafalme wote wa Israeli waliomtangulia.
Ekegusii: Ahabu akaroisia omote bw’Asera, enyasae enkuungu; agakora bobe mono goetania abarwoti bonsi baria bamotang’anerete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, goika akaba nendamwamu.

English: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.'
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu asioze kamwe, alitamka maneno haya: “ ‘Nitakupa wewe baraka takatifu zilizo za hakika nilizomwahidi Daudi.'
Ekegusii: Naende ng'a nigo amobogetie korwa ase abakuure, erinde tanyara koirana naende ase ogosareka, okwanire iga, Nimbae ogosesenigwa ogochenu na ogw'ekeene, koria narierete Daudi eira.

English: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!' or, ‘There!' don't believe it.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo kama mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristo huyu hapa!' Au, ‘Kristo yuko kule,' msisadiki.
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio omonto karabateebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Ooria! Timwancha.

English: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Kuweni na nia ile ile aliyokuwa nayo Kristo Yesu:
Ekegusii: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

English: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God of his fathers.
Kiswahili: Hadi leo Edomu wameasi dhidi ya Yuda. Libna pia wakaasi wakati huo huo kwa sababu Yehoramu alikuwa amemwacha Bwana, Mungu wa baba zake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaedomu bagasaria bakaanga kogamberwa n'Abayuda; naboigo ere goika reero iga. Ase engaki eria abanto b'omochie o Libuna boigo bagasaria, bakaanga kogamberwa na Yehoramu, ekiagera ere atigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye.

English: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites and went to Hebron to tell David all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Pia Abneri mwenyewe akazungumza na kabila la Benyamini. Kisha akaenda mpaka Hebroni kumwambia Daudi kila kitu ambacho Israeli na nyumba yote ya Benyamini walichotaka kufanya.
Ekegusii: Abineri agakwana n’abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini boigo. Erio akageenda Heburoni, agateebia Daudi amang’ana ayio Abaisraeli na Ababenjamini bonsi banchete gokora ase are.

English: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die, but God will surely visit you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Mimi ninakaribia kufa. Lakini kwa hakika Mungu atawasaidia na kuwachukueni kutoka nchi hii na kuwapeleka katika nchi aliyomwahidi kwa kiapo Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo: “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”

English: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Miji yote hii kumi pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho ilipewa koo za Wakohathi zilizobaki.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate echio chi'Abakohati nigo baetwe emechie eyio ikomi, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: For we don't have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hapa hatuna mji udumuo, bali tunautafuta ule ujao.
Ekegusii: ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.

English: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals. He rose early in the morning, and taking the two stone tablets in his hands, he went up Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akachonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, naye akapanda juu ya Mlima Sinai asubuhi na mapema, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza, akachukua vile vibao viwili vya mawe mikononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaacha chibao ibere chi’amagena chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, akaimoka mambia chuni, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikiire, obogoretie chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena koboko kwaye.

English: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’obomenyo.

English: A king who judges the poor with fairness— his throne will be established forever.
Kiswahili: Kama mfalme akiwaamua maskini kwa haki, kiti chake cha enzi kitakuwa thabiti siku zote.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti okogambera abataka ase oboronge, obogambi bwaye ’mbogeenderere gotenena bokong’u.

English: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
Kiswahili: Lakini unadhoofisha hata uchaji wa Mungu na kuzuia ibada mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.

English: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
Kiswahili: Kisha nitawapeni wachungaji wanipendezao moyo wangu, ambao watawaongoza kwa maarifa na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Nimbae inwe abarisia abaya, abarangokie ase enkoro yane, abarabaragerie bare nobong'ani na okomanya.

English: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaambia, “Kwa nini mmefanya mambo kama haya? Nimesikia kutoka kwa watu wote juu ya haya matendo yenu maovu.
Ekegusii: Erio akabateebia: “Nase ki mogokora amang'ana buna ayio? Abanto bonsi banteebirie amabe aino mogokora.

English: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Sijui wala sielewi unalosema.” Naye akaondoka kuelekea kwenye njia ya kuingilia.
Ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.

English: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akasema, “Yesu, unikumbuke utakapokuja katika Ufalme wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong'inyore ekero ogocha ase oborwoti bwao!”

English: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame— she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.
Kiswahili: Kisha adui yangu ataliona naye atafunikwa na aibu, yule aliyeniambia, “Yu wapi Bwana Mungu wako?” Macho yangu yataona kuanguka kwake, hata sasa atakanyagwa chini ya mguu kama tope barabarani.
Ekegusii: Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.

English: King Alexander met him, and he gave him his daughter Cleopatra, and celebrated her wedding at Ptolemais with great pomp, as kings do.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Aleksanda alimlaki, akampa binti yake Kleopatra, na akasherehekea harusi yake huko Tolemai kwa fahari kubwa, kama wafalme wanavyofanya.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Alekisanda akaumerana nabarabwo, nere Tolemai akamonywomeria Alekisanda omoiseke oye Kileopatura. Enyangi egachengerwa agwo Tolemai ase omogooko kobwatekana nobonene amo nechingeencho chia abarwoti.

English: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
Kiswahili: kwa habari ya juhudi, nilikuwa nalitesa kanisa, kuhusu haki ipatikanayo kwa sheria, mimi nilikuwa sina hatia.
Ekegusii: Nkaba nomokia bw’ogochanda ekanisa, na ase amang’ana ’oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko tinarenge na komocha.

English: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
Kiswahili: Ongoza hatua zangu kulingana na neno lako, usiache dhambi yoyote initawale.
Ekegusii: Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao, totiga obobe bongambere.

English: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kisha kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, Mnadhiri ni lazima anyoe nywele zake ambazo alikuwa ameziweka wakfu. Atazichukua hizo nywele na kuziweka ndani ya moto ulio chini ya dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano, Omwerwa oria akigite etukia y'omotwe oye ere ekemanyererio ng'a neatananete ase Omonene. Erio aire etukia yaye, ayerute ase omorero oria ore inse y'ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe.

English: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.
Kiswahili: Lakini siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “nitakapotuma watu wamiminao kutoka kwenye magudulia, nao watamimina; wataacha magudulia yake yakiwa matupu na kuvunja mitungi yake.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, bono amatuko ngocha are, ndatome abaumori baabaumore, erinde ebibekerero ebio bitigare bibe bosa, erio biatwe.

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno lililomjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ring'ana rigacha ase Yeremia korwa ase Omonene, rikamoteebia

English: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, mambo yote yaliyo ya kweli, yoyote yaliyo na sifa njema, yoyote yaliyo ya haki, yoyote yaliyo safi, yoyote ya kupendeza, yoyote yenye staha, ukiwepo uzuri wowote, pakiwepo chochote kinachostahili kusifiwa, tafakarini mambo hayo.
Ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, onsi ayare ay'ekeene, onsi ayare ay'ogosika, onsi ayare ay'oboronge, onsi ayare ay'oborabu, onsi ayagwenerete gwanchwa, onsi ayagokwanwa buya; koborabeo obuya bonde bwonsi, gose ogotogigwa, aya onsi yarengererie.

English: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
Kiswahili: Je, hekima haitani? Je, ufahamu hapazi sauti?
Ekegusii: Inee! Obong’aini tibori korangeria? Okomanya tikori goaka eriogi rinene?

English: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu ulionekana mzuri kwa Absalomu na kwa wazee wote wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ogoseemia okwo gokagwenera Abisalomu na abagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli.

English: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a day of sacred assembly. You must not do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD. Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:14–28; Numbers 28:16–25; Deuteronomy 16:1–8)
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kuna siku sita mnazoweza kufanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato ya kupumzika, siku ya kusanyiko takatifu. Hamtafanya kazi yoyote. Popote mnapoishi, ni Sabato kwa Bwana. Pasaka Na Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu (Hesabu 28:16-25)
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mokore emeremo yaino, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka, rituko ri’omosangererekano bwatananirwe ase ogosasiima. Timobaisa gokora meremo ende yonsi. Erio nerituko ri’Esabato ri’Omonene, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
Kiswahili: Wale wote waichukiao Sayuni na warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bageechete Sayoni, taga basookigwe na koiranigwa magega.

English: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
Kiswahili: Aliwanyeshea nyama kama mavumbi, ndege warukao kama mchanga wa pwani.
Ekegusii: Erio akabarentera chinyama chinyinge buna orotu, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase enyancha;

English: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.
Kiswahili: Tazama, nimemfanya kuwa shahidi wa mataifa, kiongozi na jemadari wa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Rora, nigo namobegete abe kirori one ase abanto, naende abe omoraai na omochiki igoro ase abanto.

English: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye amekuwa akiiba, asiibe tena, lakini lazima ajishughulishe, afanye kitu kifaacho kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na kitu cha kuwagawia wahitaji.
Ekegusii: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.

English: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume katika familia ya kuhani aweza kula nyama hiyo; ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ore ase chinka chi'abakuani arie chinyama echio echire chinchenu mono.

English: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
Kiswahili: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Utajificha milele? Ghadhabu yako itawaka kama moto hata lini?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?

English: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamsukumia Aleksanda mbele na baadhi ya watu kwenye ule umati wakampa maelekezo. Akawaashiria kwa mkono ili watulie aweze kujitetea mbele ya watu.
Ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Alekisanda, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso 'abaanto. Alekisanda akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.

English: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Ehudi, waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za wale walioishi huko Geba na ambao walihamishiwa Manahathi:
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ehudi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, echio chiamenyete Geba. Barabwo bagooswa, bakairwa ase ense ya Manahati.

English: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, so that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the LORD shed by the hand of Jezebel.
Kiswahili: Inakupasa uiangamize nyumba ya bwana wako Ahabu, nami nitalipiza kisasi cha damu ya watumishi wangu manabii na damu ya watumishi wote wa Bwana iliyomwagwa na Yezebeli.
Ekegusii: Naye oraite osirie abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu, omonene oo, erinde inche nyeruserie egesiomba ase Yesebeli, ekiagera ere aiterete amanyinga ’abasomba baane ababani, na ay’abasomba baane bonsi, inche Omonene.

English: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wazee na watu wenye cheo walioishi katika mji wa Nabothi wakafanya kama Yezebeli alivyoelekeza katika barua aliyowaandikia.
Ekegusii: Na abanto b'omochie, na abagaaka, na abanene b'omochie oyio, bagakora buna Yesebeli abateebeetie. Buna koreng'ana ariikire ase amarube aria atomete ase bare,

English: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
Kiswahili: Ingawa mimi ni mdogo kuliko aliye mdogo kabisa miongoni mwa watakatifu wote, nilipewa neema hii: ili niwahubirie watu wa Mataifa kuhusu utajiri usiopimika ulio ndani ya Kristo,
Ekegusii: Inche inde omoke kobua abachenu bonsi; nonya nabo ’nkaegwa obuya bw’okoranderia abanto b’Ebisaku obonda bwa Kristo, obo botari korengeka.

English: but Hannah did not go. “After the boy is weaned,” she said to her husband, “I will take him to appear before the LORD and to stay there permanently.”
Kiswahili: Hana hakwenda. Alimwambia mume wake, “Baada ya mtoto kuachishwa kunyonya, nitamchukua na kumpeleka mbele za Bwana, naye ataishi huko wakati wote.”
Ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eyio Ana tagendeteo, agateebia omosacha oye, “Ninganye goika ’ntache omwana, erio nario ndamoire imoorokie ase obosio bw’Omonene, erinde imotige amenye aroro botaambe.”

English: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.
Kiswahili: Kisha kutoka kwenye kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichokuwa mbele za Bwana, akachukua andazi moja, na jingine lililotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba; akaviweka hivi vyote juu ya mafungu ya mafuta ya mnyama, na juu ya lile paja la kulia.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko Aroni, na ay'abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: You didn't choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
Kiswahili: Si ninyi mlionichagua, bali mimi ndiye niliyewachagua ninyi na kuwaweka mwende mkazae matunda, na matunda yenu yapate kudumu. Ili nalo lolote mtakalomwomba Baba katika Jina langu, awape ninyi.
Ekegusii: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae.

English: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
Kiswahili: jua halitakudhuru mchana, wala mwezi wakati wa usiku.
Ekegusii: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

English: and brought them into the way of Sinai Kadesh-Barnea and they cast out all that lived in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: akawapeleka katika njia ya Sinai Kadesh-Barnea, nao wakawafukuza wote waliokaa jangwani.
Ekegusii: akabaraa goika ase egetunwa gia Sinai na Kadeshi-Barinea. Magega kobabaseririe abamenyi b'ense eyio ye erooro;

English: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
Kiswahili: Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, dada yako Sodoma pamoja na binti zake, kamwe hawakufanya yale ambayo wewe na binti zako mmefanya.
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, Sodomu, mosubati omino, na abaiseke baye, tibarakora buna aye gwakorire amo nabaiseke bao.

English: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
Kiswahili: Iwapo sadaka yako ya nafaka imeandaliwa kwenye kikaango, itakuwa ni ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, bila chachu.
Ekegusii: “Onye okoruegwa kwao kw'endagera n'emegati esaambeire orogio, ebe eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke amo namaguta, korende ebe etabeekiri memera.

English: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana amemchagua Yakobo kuwa wake mwenyewe, Israeli kuwa mali yake ya thamani.
Ekegusii: Omonene bwechooreire Yakobo, bwechooreire Abaisraeli koba aba aye bori.

English: For those who have kept the things that are holy in holiness will be made holy. Those who have been taught them will find what to say in defense.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wale walioyatunza mambo yaliyo matakatifu katika utakatifu watatakaswa. Wale waliofundishwa watapata la kusema katika kujitetea.
Ekegusii: Baria batenererete amang'ana y'obochenu mbancherwe koba abachenu. Boigo na baria begerigwe ayio mbanyore enchera yokwerwanerera engaki y'ekina.

English: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu ambaye atamwinda mnyama au ndege anayeruhusiwa kuliwa ni lazima aimwage damu na kuifunika kwa udongo,
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraite eng'iti y'orosana, gose enyoni eyancheire koriegwa, goika aitere amanyinga aye inse, erio ayatube amaroba.

English: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Jihadharini msije mkabeba mzigo siku ya Sabato, wala kuingiza mzigo kupitia malango ya Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Onye moganetie gotooria obogima bwaino, mwerende, timobaisa kobogoria egurube ende yonsi ase rituko ri'Esabato, gose koyesoyia ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase rituko erio.

English: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.
Kiswahili: Piteni, piteni katika malango! Tengenezeni njia kwa ajili ya watu. Jengeni, jengeni njia kuu! Ondoeni mawe. Inueni bendera kwa ajili ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Eta, eta, mosoere ase ebiita, moroiserie abanto enchera; ticha enchera eyio eimokerere igoro, rusia amagena korwa aroro; tenenia ekemanyererio abanto bakerore.

English: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent's food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mbwa mwitu na mwana-kondoo watalisha pamoja, naye simba atakula nyasi kama maksai, lakini mavumbi yatakuwa chakula cha nyoka. Hawatadhuru wala kuharibu katika mlima wangu mtakatifu wote,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Esese y'orosana na emaanwa y'eng'ondi nchibe chikoriseria amo, endo nebe ekorisia obonyansi buna eng'ombe, na orotu ndobe endagera y'eng'iti engenda inse. Ogokora bobe na ogosiria konde gwonsi tikogokorwa ase egetunwa kiane egechenu. Nab'Omonene atebiire.”

English: In the Most Holy Place he made two cherubim of sculptured work, and he overlaid them with gold.
Kiswahili: Katika sehemu ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu akafanyiza jozi moja ya makerubi ya kuchongwa na kuyafunika kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Ime y’Aase Achenu Mono akaroisia emegwekano ebere y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, akayeooma ne chitaabu.

English: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
Kiswahili: Naye Hiramu akawatuma watu wake; mabaharia walioijua bahari, kuhudumu katika hizo meli pamoja na watu wa Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Hiramu agatoma abanto baye baria bamanyete emeremo ye chinyancha, bagasang'ana nabaanto ba Sulemani.

English: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.” Jesus Anointed at Bethany (Mark 14:3–9; Luke 7:36–50; John 12:1–8)
Kiswahili: Lakini wakasema, “Isiwe wakati wa Sikukuu, kusitokee ghasia miongoni mwa watu.” Yesu Anapakwa Mafuta Huko Bethania (Marko 14:3-9; Yohana 12:1-8)
Ekegusii: Korende bakaboora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa goocha koba rirorooche ase abanto.” Yeso ogoakwa amaguta agwo Bethania (Mar 14:3-9; Yoh 12:1-8)

English: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo Bwana akafanya Agano na Abramu, na kumwambia, “Nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii, kuanzia Kijito cha Misri hadi mto ule mkubwa, Frati,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko eri’Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Aburamu, agateeba: “Ororeeria rwao naroire ense eye gochakera ase orooche orwo oronene rokorokwa Eufarati,

English: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
Kiswahili: Wazee wameondoka langoni la mji, vijana wameacha kuimba nyimbo zao.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka tibari goikaransa geita ki'omochie, na abamura batigire kobugia amakano abo.

English: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
Kiswahili: Wenye majivuno wananichimbia mashimo, kinyume na sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu batabwateti amachiiko ao nigo bankuunyeire emetaro.

English: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband's authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa umepotoka wakati ukiwa umeolewa na mume wako na umejinajisi mwenyewe kwa kukutana kimwili na mwanaume mwingine asiyekuwa mumeo”;
Ekegusii: Korende onye gwatomanire nomonto omoao ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, na gwekorire omosaria,

English: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that Yahweh's hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba watu wapate kuona na kujua, wapate kufikiri na kuelewa, kwamba mkono wa Bwana umetenda hili, kwamba yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli ndiye alilifanya.”
Ekegusii: ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbaarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng'a nokoboko kw'Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.”

English: “The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet as a man. A man's heart was given to it.
Kiswahili: “Mnyama wa kwanza alifanana na simba, naye alikuwa na mabawa kama ya tai. Nikatazama mpaka mabawa yake yalipongʼolewa, naye akainuliwa katika nchi, akasimama kwa miguu miwili kama mwanadamu, naye akapewa moyo wa binadamu.
Ekegusii: Eng'iti entang'ani nigo yagwekaine endo, korende yabwate chimbaaba buna echi'ekeongo. Buna nabeete ndigereretie, chimbaaba chiaye nigo chiasimoire, ero ekaimokererigwa igoro korwa ase riroba, egatenenigwa namagoro abere buna omonto, ekaegwa enkoro ya Mwanyabaanto.

English: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wako itampasa angoje mpaka lini? Ni lini utawaadhibu washtaki wangu?
Ekegusii: Ngoika ririri inche omosomba oo ’ndagenderere koremereria? Ndiriri oranache ekiina ase abachaandi baane?

English: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi yalivyo makuu matendo yako, tazama jinsi yalivyo ya kina mawazo yako!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, emeremo yao nigo ere emenene mono, na ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebia ime mono.

English: O my people, crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel. The Burden against Edom (Isaiah 34:5–17)
Kiswahili: Ee watu wangu, mliopondwa kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, ninawaambia kile nilichokisikia kutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, kutoka kwa Mungu wa Israeli. Unabii Dhidi Ya Edomu
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, aba mwaoorirwe ase ekeooreri buna obori na koirurwa, amang’ana naigure korwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, naro nkobaraareria. Obobani igoro ya Edomu

English: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
Kiswahili: “Wakati Efraimu alipoona ugonjwa wake, naye Yuda vidonda vyake, ndipo Efraimu alipogeukia Ashuru, na kuomba msaada kwa mfalme mkuu. Lakini hawezi kukuponya, wala hawezi kukuponya vidonda vyako.
Ekegusii: “Abaefraimu mbaroche oborwaire bwabo, n'Abayuda bakarora amagumba abo. Ase ayio Abaefraimu bakagenda ase Abaasuri, bakarangeria omorwoti Yarebu bakagania ogokoonywa korwa ase are. Korende omorwoti oyio takonyara kobagwenia korwa ase oborwaire bwaino, gose amagumba aino,

English: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
Kiswahili: nawapa utajiri wale wanipendao na kuzijaza hazina zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoa abwo banyanchete obotenenku na goichoria chikungo chiabo.

English: See that you, since you have been scourged from heaven, proclaim to all men the sovereign majesty of God.” When they had spoken these words, they vanished out of sight.
Kiswahili: Angalieni kwamba, kwa kuwa mmepigwa mijeledi kutoka mbinguni, mtangazie watu wote ukuu wa Mungu. Walipokwisha kusema maneno haya, wakatoweka.
Ekegusii: Inyora buna Omonene nere okoa egesusuro. Bono aye genda bwoo otebie kera omonto igoro y'echinguru chia Nyasae.” Ekero bakorete gokwana ayio bagasira.

English: Then Nebuchadnezzar, furious with rage, summoned Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. So these men were brought before the king,
Kiswahili: Mfalme Nebukadneza, akiwa amekasirika na mwenye ghadhabu kali, akawaita Shadraki, Meshaki na Abednego. Hivyo watu hawa wakaletwa mbele ya mfalme,
