Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Nebukadinesaro akaba nekeririanda egetindi, agachiika ng’a Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, barentwe ase are, na abamura baria batato bakarentwa ase obosio bwaye.

English: She anticipates those who desire her, making herself known.
Kiswahili: Anawatarajia wale wanaomtamani, akijitambulisha.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini nigo bogotanga kweorokia ase baria babotagete.

English: For this is what the LORD says: “Your injury is incurable; your wound is grievous.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “ ‘Kidonda chako hakina dawa, jeraha lako haliponyeki.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Ogochandeka kwaino tigokogwenigwa, amaote aino abeire amabe mono.

English: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
Kiswahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote na mnaweza kuwasaidia wakati wowote mnaotaka. Lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
Ekegusii: Inaki amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, na kero kende gionsi mwanchete, namonyare kobakorera amaya, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.

English: Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”
Kiswahili: “Basi na ijulikane kwenu kwamba, huu wokovu wa Mungu umepelekwa kwa watu wa Mataifa, nao watasikiliza.” [
Ekegusii: Naki amanyekane ase more ng’a ogotooreka oko kwa Nyasae kwairirwe ase abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarabwo nabaigwe.

English: On the next day, we who were Paul's companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata tukaondoka, tukafika Kaisaria. Huko tukaenda nyumbani kwa mwinjilisti mmoja jina lake Filipo, aliyekuwa mmoja wa wale Saba, tukakaa kwake.
Ekegusii: Mambia yaye tokaimoka tokagenda Kaisaria, togasoa enyomba ya Filipo, omorandia bw'enchiri. Nere orenge oyomo bwa baria batano na babere; tokamenya bwoye.

English: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
Kiswahili: Anakomesha vita hata miisho ya dunia, anakata upinde na kuvunjavunja mkuki, anateketeza ngao kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Otangire chiseegi ase ense engima, obunire amata, osenyentire amatimo, osambire chigari nomorero.

English: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
Kiswahili: Maria akafadhaishwa sana na maneno haya, akajiuliza moyoni, “Salamu hii ni ya namna gani?”
Ekegusii: Mariamu agaichana mono ase ring'ana eri, erio ere akebooria, “Ngokwania ki oko?”

English: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
Kiswahili: Hasar-Shuali, Bala, Esemu,
Ekegusii: na Hasari‐Suali, na Bala, na Esemu,

English: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
Kiswahili: lakini ninakuomba kwa upendo, mimi Paulo, mzee na pia sasa nikiwa mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu,
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obwanchani bwane ase ore, nanchire kobua kogosorora, buna inche Paulo inde omotomwa, naende inde omosibwa o Kristo Yeso.

English: After this, Joshua struck down and killed the kings, and he hung their bodies on five trees and left them there until evening.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawapiga na kuwaua wale wafalme na kuwatundika juu ya miti mitano, nao wakaachwa wakiningʼinia juu ya ile miti hadi jioni.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua agaita abarwoti baria, akabatonga ase emete etano; agwo bagasung’unana goika mogoroba.

English: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
Kiswahili: Watu wa kabila la wa Simeoni wapatao mia tano, wakiongozwa na Pelatia, Nearia, Refaya na Uzieli wana wa Ishi, wakavamia nchi ya vilima ya Seiri.
Ekegusii: Na abanto amagana atano (500) b'egesaku gia Simioni, bakagenda goika egetunwa gia Edomu, bakaba nabaraai babo: Pelatia na Nearia, Refaya na Usieli, basinto ba Ishi.

English: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Katika siku ile mwerezi uliposhushwa chini kaburini nilizifunika chemchemi zenye maji mengi kwa maombolezo: Nilivizuia vijito vyake na wingi wa maji yake nikauzuia. Kwa sababu yake niliivika Lebanoni huzuni, nayo miti yote ya shambani ikanyauka.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ase rituko erio omote oria ogendete aase abakuure ngachiika ebirero birerwe; nigo natubete chindiba ase engencho yaye, ngatanga chindooche chiaye, nkaochania amaache amanene. Nigo nachiigete egetunwa kia Lebanoni keyobokerie amagombo, na emete yonsi y'orosana egasusana ase engencho yaye.

English: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
Kiswahili: Mungu akaruhusu roho mbaya kati ya Abimeleki na watu wa Shekemu, nao watu wa Shekemu wakamtendea Abimeleki kwa hila.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatoma omoika omobe ase ogwatanan'Abimeleki n'abanto ba Sekemu, n'abanto aba bagakorera Abimeleki obong'ainereria.

English: Therefore calamity will come upon him suddenly; in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo maafa yatamkumba ghafula; ataangamizwa mara, pasipo msaada.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio emechando nemoochere mobosokano; nigo arasirigwe mobasokano atanyaare gotoorigwa.

English: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
Kiswahili: Hapo tukapata meli iliyokuwa inavuka kwenda Foinike tukapanda tukasafiri nayo.
Ekegusii: Tokanyoora emeeri eyeranyaare kwamboka goika Foiniki, tokariina emeeri eria, tokagenda.

English: The gods cower; they crouch together, unable to relieve the burden; but they themselves go into captivity.
Kiswahili: Vinyago pamoja na wale wanaovibeba wanainama chini; hiyo miungu haiwezi kuwaokoa watu, wote wanakwenda utumwani pamoja.
Ekegusii: Chinyasae echio nigo chiekumbete gochia inse amo, tichikonyara gotooria chigurube chiria, echio chinyene nigo chigwoswa chiairwa ase obosomba.

English: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
Kiswahili: kisha akawatuma waende wakahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kuponya wagonjwa.
Ekegusii: Akabatoma korandia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na kogwenia abarwaire.

English: when their faces are blackened through the smoke that comes out of the temple.
Kiswahili: nyuso zao zikiwa nyeusi kutokana na moshi unaotoka hekaluni.
Ekegusii: Ebitabaramato, n'ebiongo boigo n'echinyoni chinde nigo chikoiruruka igoro y'echinyasae echio, nonya n'ebimoni nigo bigochinkaransera.

English: He spoke this message quite frankly, and Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
Kiswahili: Aliyasema haya waziwazi, ndipo Petro akamchukua kando na akaanza kumkemea.
Ekegusii: Agakwana amang’ana aya maiso marore. Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania.

English: you will sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased, and how his fury has ended!
Kiswahili: utaichukua dhihaka hii dhidi ya mfalme wa Babeli: Tazama jinsi mtesi alivyofikia mwisho! Tazama jinsi ghadhabu yake kali ilivyokoma!
Ekegusii: erio mokwane amang’ana aya y’ogochecheria omorwoti o Babiloni, moteebe: “Naki omochandi oria akirigwe! Obotindi bw’ogochandwa gwaito bwaerire!

English: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
Kiswahili: Wakati waovu wanapostawi, pia dhambi vivyo hivyo, lakini wenye haki wataliona anguko lao.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakomentekana, ogosaria nigo gokomentekana, korende abanyene oboronge 'mbarore okogwa kw'abwo.

English: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini Sihoni hakumruhusu Israeli apite katika nchi yake. Alilikutanisha jeshi lake lote, wakaondoka kwenda jangwani ili kupigana na Israeli. Alipofika huko Yahazi, akapigana na Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Sihoni akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye b'esegi, akageenda agaika Yahasi ase erooro, na agwo akarwania Abaisraeli.

English: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
Kiswahili: Lakini hapa pana watu wengi na ni wakati wa mvua, hivyo hatuwezi kusimama nje. Hata hivyo, shauri hili haliwezi kumalizika kwa siku moja au mbili, kwa sababu tumefanya dhambi kubwa katika jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nabange mono, na engaki eye ney’embura enyinge, titokonyara kogenderera gotenena aa isiko ase eraaro. Emeremo eye teri eye rituko erimo, gose ey’amatuko abere, ekiagera twamochire mono ase ring’ana eri.

English: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
Kiswahili: Shamba ambalo Abrahamu alilinunua kwa Wahiti. Hapo ndipo Abrahamu alipozikwa pamoja na mkewe Sara.
Ekegusii: ase oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Abahiti. Agwo nao Aburaamu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye nere atindegetwe.

English: And Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a log. And when he cast it into the waters, they were sweetened. There the LORD made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there He tested them,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akamlilia Bwana, naye Bwana akamwonyesha kipande cha mti. Akakitupa ndani ya maji, nayo maji yakawa matamu. Huko Bwana akawapa amri na sheria na huko akawajaribu.
Ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, n’Omonene akamworokia ekeng’ese kio omote. Omote oyio Musa akayoruta amaache ime, na amaache aria akaba amaansu. Agw’Omonene akabeekera abanto amaachiko akobaraa, na agwo akaba okobateema.

English: No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?”
Kiswahili: Hapa nyumbani hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko mimi. Bwana wangu hakunizuilia kitu chochote isipokuwa wewe, kwa kuwa wewe ni mke wake. Nitawezaje basi kufanya uovu huu na kutenda dhambi dhidi ya Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Onde tari ase enyomba yaye oeire okobua otatiga inche, gose tantangeti gento kende gionsi otatiga aye bweka, ekiagera aye mokaye ore. Naki rende ndanyare gokora ebibe ebinene buna ebi, imomochere Nyasae?”

English: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Samweli akachukua jiwe na kulisimamisha kati ya Mispa na Sheni. Akaliita Ebenezeri, akisema, “Hata sasa Bwana ametusaidia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia gati ya Misipa na Seni, akariroka Ebeni‐Eseri, akabora: “Omonene otokonyire twaikire aiga.”

English: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
Kiswahili: Kila kahaba hupokea malipo, lakini wewe hutoa zawadi kwa wapenzi wako wote, ukiwahonga ili waje kwako kutoka kila mahali kwa ajili ya ukahaba wako.
Ekegusii: Abasacha nigo bakorwa chitaabu baa abakungu abatayayi, korende aye nigo okorua echiao kwaa abanchi bao ase okobaebereria bache korwa chinsemo chionsi bakore obonyaka naye.

English: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakazungumza na watu kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani kutokea Yeriko, wakasema,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakwana n'abanto baria ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, akabateebia,

English: When the scribes and chief priests realized that Jesus had spoken this parable against them, they sought to arrest Him that very hour. But they were afraid of the people.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa makuhani wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata mara moja, kwa sababu walifahamu kwamba amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao. Lakini waliwaogopa watu. Kumlipa Kaisari Kodi (Mathayo 22:15-22; Marko 12:13-17)
Ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo akobayeena, korende bakairoka abanto. Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mat 22:15-22; Mar 12:13-17)

English: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
Kiswahili: Nao watatoka nje, wale waliotenda mema watafufuka wapate uzima na wale waliotenda maovu, watafufuka wahukumiwe.
Ekegusii: na barabwo inabasoke, baria abaare gokora amaya ase okobokigwa kw'obogima, na baria abaare gokora amabe ase okobokigwa gw'ekiina.

English: “Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.”
Kiswahili: “Vikubali vitu hivi kutoka kwao, ili viweze kutumika katika kazi kwenye Hema la Kukutania. Wapatie Walawi kama kazi ya kila mtu itakavyohitaji.”
Ekegusii: “Ancha oire ebiegwa ebio korwa ase bare, erinde bikorerwe emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Obie Abalawi, kera omonto anyore buna emeremo yaye ere.”

English: Finishing the service at the altars, that he might arrange the offering of the Most High, the Almighty,
Kiswahili: Akimaliza ibada kwenye madhabahu, ili aweze kupanga sadaka ya Aliye Juu Zaidi, Mwenyezi,
Ekegusii: Ekero akorire emeremo yobokoreri ase egesasiimero, koroberia ebing'wanso bi'Omonene, Omobui,

English: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
Kiswahili: “Tulieni, mjue ya kwamba mimi ndimi Mungu; nitatukuzwa katikati ya mataifa, nitatukuzwa katika dunia.”
Ekegusii: “Toerera, momanye ng'a ninche Nyasae; inche inde omonene ase abanto b'ebisaku, omonene ase ense.”

English: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men's labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
Kiswahili: Wala hatuvuki mipaka kwa kujisifu kwetu kwa ajili ya kazi iliyofanywa na watu wengine. Tumaini letu ni kwamba imani yenu inavyozidi kukua, eneo letu la utendaji miongoni mwenu litapanuka zaidi,
Ekegusii: Titori gwetogia kobua ekerengo ase emeremo y'abanto bande; korende ogosemeria gwaito nigo kore ng'a koreng'ana buna okwegena kwaino gokomenteka, na emeremo yaito ase more ementeke.

English: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: “Simika Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Ase rituko rie ritang'ani, omotienyi bw'eritang'ani, otenenie obomenyo, Eema eria y'Omosangererekano.

English: And you must raise an army like the one you have lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight the Israelites on the plain, where we will surely prevail.” And the king approved their plan and acted accordingly. Another War with Ben-hadad
Kiswahili: Ni lazima pia uandae jeshi jingine kama lile ulilopoteza, farasi kwa farasi, gari la vita kwa gari la vita, ili tuweze kupigana na Israeli katika nchi tambarare. Kisha kwa hakika tutakuwa na nguvu kuliko wao.” Akakubaliana nao naye akashughulika ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Naende roberia abarwani b’esegi bang’ana buna abwo baitwa, ne chibarasi ne chigari ching’ana buna echio chiasirigwa, erio tobarwanie ase ense omweya; ekeene, goika tobe ne chinguru kobabua.” Omorwoti agancha amang’ana abo, naende agakora buna bamoteebetie.

English: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
Kiswahili: Ninyi wanafiki! Isaya alikuwa sawa alipotabiri juu yenu kwamba:
Ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Mbuya Isaya abanete igoro ase more, ekero ateebete:

English: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, He has brought all this disaster upon them.’”
Kiswahili: Watu watajibu, ‘Ni kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, aliyewatoa Misri, nao wamekumbatia miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia, ndiyo sababu ameyaleta maafa haya yote juu yao.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio nairanerigwe: Nekiagera batigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Nigo babwatanete ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasiima na gochikorera; ayio naro agerire Omonene arentire amabe aya onsi igoro ase bare.”

English: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
Kiswahili: Ombeni mambo haya yasitokee wakati wa baridi.
Ekegusii: Saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo,

English: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
Kiswahili: Naye Hadadi pia akafa. Wakuu wa Edomu walikuwa: Timna, Alva, Yethethi,
Ekegusii: Na Hadadi agakwa. Abagaambi b'Abaedomu nabwo aba: Timuna na Alifa, na Yeteti,

English: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa siku saba mtamletea Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kwenye siku hiyo ya saba mtafanya kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.' ”
Ekegusii: korende namorue okoruegwa kw'endagera kogosaambwa n'omorero ase Omonene ase engaki y'amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko.”

English: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mimi ni huru, wala si mtumwa wa mtu yeyote, nimejifanya kuwa mtumwa wa kila mtu, ili niweze kuwavuta wengi kadri iwezekanavyo.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya inde nobosibore korwa ase abanto bonsi, nekorire omosomba o bonsi, erinde ndete abanto abange kobua.

English: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
Kiswahili: Tamari alipoambiwa, “Baba mkwe wako yuko njiani kwenda Timna kukata kondoo wake manyoya,”
Ekegusii: Ekero Tamari ateebetigwe ng'a ise biara 'nkogenda akare Timuna konacha ching'ondi chiaye amarionya,

English: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
Kiswahili: Saa iyo hiyo, kukatokea tetemeko kubwa la nchi na sehemu ya kumi ya mji ikaanguka. Watu elfu saba wakauawa katika tetemeko hilo, nao walionusurika wakaogopa sana, wakamtukuza Mungu wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Na ase ensa eria ekaba omotengecho omonene bw'ense, na ensemo ya ikomi y'omochie ekagwa. Abanto chilifu isano na ibere bagaitwa ase omotengecho oria, na abwo batigarete bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatogia obonene bwa Nyasae ore igoro.

English: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
Kiswahili: Nitasimama katika zamu yangu, na kujiweka mwenyewe juu ya maboma; nitatazama nione atakaloniambia, na ni jibu gani nitakalotoa kuhusu lalamiko hili.
Ekegusii: Inche nintenene korenda, ee, nintenene igoro ase omoorobiri bw'ogotengera, ndore ay'Omonene aranteebie, na buna ndairanerie igoro y'okorera kwane.

English: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili yangu, nami nitakifanya imara kiti cha ufalme wake milele.
Ekegusii: Oyio nere orang’agachere enyomba; nainche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kebeo kogenderera botambe.

English: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
Kiswahili: apate kujiletea Kanisa tukufu lisilo na doa wala kunyanzi au waa lolote, bali takatifu na lisilo na hatia.
Ekegusii: erinde anyare kwenyorera ekanisa y'obonene, etari na kemoa gose omonia, gose rinde rionsi buna aya, korende ebe enchenu etari na kemoa.

English: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ndipo wale wanaoishi katika miji ya Israeli watakapotoka na kutumia hizo silaha kuwashia moto na kuziteketeza, yaani, kigao na ngao, pinde na mishale, rungu za vita na mikuki. Kwa miaka saba watavitumia kama kuni.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abamenyete ase emechie y'Abaisraeli mbagende basangererie ebirwanero; chinguba, ne ching'aya, na amata, ne chinsara, ne chisimisi, na amatimo, babikore chinko bagoutera omorero ase engaki y'emiaka etan'ebere.

English: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
Kiswahili: kutoka Simeoni, ni Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.

English: After this, King Ahasuerus highly honored Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Bugaean. He exalted him and set his seat above all his friends.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, Mfalme Ahasuero alimheshimu sana Hamani mwana wa Hammedatha, Mbugae, akamtukuza na kumweka kiti chake juu ya marafiki zake wote.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki enkeigo, amang'ana ayio, omorwoti Ahaswero agakiinia Hamani, mosinto bwa Hamedata Omoagagi, akamoa obonene kobua abanene bande bonsi abarenge amo nere.

English: So Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaondoka mle kwenye sinagogi, akaenda nyumbani kwa mtu mmoja jina lake Tito Yusto, aliyekuwa mcha Mungu. Nyumba yake ilikuwa karibu na sinagogi.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, agasoa enyomba y’omonto ore korokwa Tito Yusto, omosasiimi Nyasae. Mwaye nigo yasinyaine nesinagogi.

English: Don't say, “It is he that caused me to err;” for he has no need of a sinful man.
Kiswahili: Usiseme, “Yeye ndiye aliyenikosesha,” kwa maana hana haja na mtu mwenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba ng'a Nyasae nere ogerire, ekiagera ere taganetie ogokoonya kwomonyabibe.

English: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek Yahweh's word, and will not find it.
Kiswahili: Wanaume watayumbayumba kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutangatanga kutoka kaskazini mpaka mashariki, wakitafuta neno la Bwana, lakini hawatalipata.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbatayaye korwa ase enyancha goika ase enyancha ende, na korwa sugusu goika moocha; mbaminyoke gochia aaria na aaria, babe bakorigia ring'ana ri'Omonene, korende tibakorinyora.

English: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
Kiswahili: Je, mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu amepatwa na taabu? Basi inampasa aombe. Je, kuna yeyote mwenye furaha? Basi na aimbe nyimbo za kusifu.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karanyorekane nemechando, tiga asabe. Onde omo oino, onye ore nomoyo bw'ogosasoka, tiga atogie ase ogoteera.

English: Ephraim will have one portion bordering the territory of Manasseh from east to west.
Kiswahili: “Efraimu atakuwa na sehemu moja, itapakana na nchi ya Manase kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Efraimu keegwe orogongo rw’aye robebekane norwa Manase korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
Kiswahili: Vijiji vilivyoizunguka vilikuwa Etamu, Aini, Rimoni, Tokeni na Ashani; jumla miji mitano:
Ekegusii: Na emechie yabo emeke nigo yarenge Etamu na Aini, Rimoni na Tokeni, na Asani; yonsi netano.

English: He said to the king, “Don't let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
Kiswahili: na kumwambia, “Bwana wangu na asinihesabie hatia. Usikumbuke jinsi mtumishi wako alivyofanya kosa siku ile bwana wangu mfalme alipoondoka Yerusalemu. Mfalme aliondoe moyoni mwake.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Omonene one, tombarera obobe, gose toinyora aria nagokorerete ase rituko riria kwaruete Yerusalemu.

English: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
Kiswahili: bali utakwenda katika nchi yangu na jamaa zangu umpatie Isaki mwanangu mke.”
Ekegusii: Korende ogende ase ense yane na ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one Isaka omokungu korwa aroro abe mokaye.”

English: Send her from the holy heavens, and ask her to come from the throne of your glory, that being present with me she may work, and I may learn what pleases you well.
Kiswahili: Mtume kutoka mbinguni takatifu, na umuombe aje kutoka kwenye kiti cha enzi cha utukufu wako, ili awepo nami afanye kazi, nami nipate kujua yanayokupendeza.
Ekegusii: Toma obongaini korwa agwo igoro ase achenu korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki'amaabera egechenu erio obongaini obwo bomenye amo nainche na gokora emeremo amo nainche erio inyare kwegera aria agokogokia.

English: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
Kiswahili: je, hamjawabagua na kuwa mahakimu mioyoni mwenu mkihukumu kwa mawazo yenu maovu?
Ekegusii: Inee, timokoreti ogwatananeka ase egati yaino inwe abanyene, na mwabeire abagaambi, more nebirengererio ebibe?

English: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.
Kiswahili: Pia mbele ya kiti cha enzi palikuwa na kile kilichoonekana kama bahari ya kioo, iliyokuwa angavu kama bilauri. Katikati, kukizunguka kile kiti cha enzi, kulikuwa na viumbe wanne wenye uhai, wakiwa wamejawa na macho mbele na nyuma.
Ekegusii: Na bosio bw’ekerogo keria ki’obonene nigo arenge aase buna enyancha egwekaine ekerore gekomeka‐meka. Agwo gati‐gati goetanana ekerogo keria ki’obonene nchiarengeo ching’iti inye chire moyo, chiichire amaiso bosio na magega.

English: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need. Honoring Elders
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mwanamke yeyote aaminiye ana wajane katika jamaa yake, inampasa awasaidie wala si kuwaacha wakililemea kanisa, ili kanisa liweze kuwasaidia wale ambao ni wajane kweli kweli. Wazee Wa Kanisa
Ekegusii: Onye omosacha gose omokungu, oyobwegenete, ore nabatakaanwa bamwabo, tiga abakoonye, ekanisa terarerigwa, erinde ebakonye baria bare abatakanwa bori.

English: Benaiah came to Yahweh's Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!'” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Benaya akaingia kwenye hema la Bwana na kumwambia Yoabu, “Mfalme anasema, ‘Toka nje!' ” Lakini akajibu, “La! Nitafia hapa hapa.” Benaya akamwarifu mfalme, “Hivi ndivyo Yoabu alivyonijibu.”
Ekegusii: Benaya akagenda ase Eema y'Omonene, agateebia Yoabu, “Omorwoti ogochikiire osoke isiko.” Korende Yoabu agakana, “Yaya, aa nao ngokwera.” Benaya akagenda ase omorwoti, akamoteebia amang'ana Yoabu ateebete.

English: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God's house.
Kiswahili: Yehieli, Azazia, Nahathi, Asaheli, Yeremothi, Yozabadi, Elieli, Ismakia, Mahathi na Benaya walikuwa waangalizi chini ya Konania na Shimei ndugu yake, waliokuwa wamewekwa na Mfalme Hezekia na Azaria, afisa msimamizi wa Hekalu la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yehieli na Asasia, Nahati na Asaeli, Yerimoti na Yosabadi, Elieli na Isimakia, Mahati na Benaya, abwo nabwo barenge abakoonyi ba Konania na Simei, momura omwabo. Nigo bachoretwe na Hezekia omorwoti na Asaria oyo otenenerete enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Then Balak sent other princes, more numerous and more distinguished than the first messengers.
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaki akatuma wakuu wengine, wengi zaidi na wanaoheshimiwa zaidi kuliko wale wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Naende Balaki agatoma abanene bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani, naende ababwate amasikani amanene kobua abwo.

English: This is the book of God's commandments and the law that endures forever. All those who hold it fast will live, but those who leave it will die.
Kiswahili: Hiki ndicho kitabu cha amri za Mungu na sheria idumuyo milele. Wote watakaokishika wataishi, lakini wale watakaokiacha watakufa.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini n'egetabu ki'amachiiko a Nyasae, borobwo n'erichiiko riria riramenye kare na kare. Baria bonsi bakobwaterera obong'aini mbamenye, korende baria barabotige mbakue.

English: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
Kiswahili: Akasubu pete za shaba za kushikilia ile mipiko kwa ajili ya zile pembe nne za huo wavu wa shaba.
Ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye, agachibeka ase chikoona inye chi’egechungi ekio gi’etai, ase emiaro egosoigwa.

English: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.
Kiswahili: “Namwona yeye, lakini si sasa; namtazama yeye, lakini si karibu. Nyota itatoka kwa Yakobo, fimbo ya ufalme itainuka kutoka kwa Israeli. Atawaponda Wamoabu vipaji vya nyuso na mafuvu yote ya wana wa Shethi.
Ekegusii: Namororire, korende tari bono; namorigereirie, korende tari ang’e. Eng’enang’eni neoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo, na enyimbo y’obogambi neoroke korwa ase Abaisraeli. Nesenyente chintakunero chi’emetwe y’Abamoabu, neiyerie abanto b’ororeeria rwa Seti.

English: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
Kiswahili: Mungu ni mwenye haki: yeye atawalipa mateso wale wawatesao ninyi
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae ororire boronge kobaakana emechando baria bakobachanda inwe,

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Sasa nakuweka uwe msimamizi wa nchi yote ya Misri.”
Ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Rora nakobekire aye igoro y'ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

English: A seal is good where an evil wife is. Where there are many hands, lock things up.
Kiswahili: Muhuri ni mzuri pale ambapo mke mwovu yupo. Pale ambapo kuna mikono mingi, funga vitu.
Ekegusii: Onye omokungu oo tari omwegeenwa, aye omobise amang'ana ao, na ase abanto abange aye osiekere ebinto biao.

English: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akaunyoosha mkono wake kuelekea angani, na giza nene likafunika pote katika nchi ya Misri kwa muda wa siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia okoboko kwaye gochia igoro, na omosunte ekerima okaba ase ense ya Misiri engaki y'amatuko atato.

English: But you shall go forth, and take all their coasts for me first. If they will yield themselves to you, then you must reserve them for me until the day of their reproof.
Kiswahili: Lakini utatoka, na kuchukua mipaka yao yote kwa ajili yangu kwanza. Ikiwa watajisalimisha kwako, basi lazima uniwekee akiba hadi siku ya kukemewa kwao.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Holofene nagochiikire gontang'anera gosakora chinsinyo echio chionsi inche omonyene ntaraika. Keraabe beruure asore, nigo aye orababwate goika inche omonyene inche kobaa egesusuro.

English: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ninyi wafalme, kuweni na hekima; mwonyeke, enyi watawala wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarwoti, mobe abang'aini, inwe abagaambi b'ense, igwera ogokuurerwa oko:

English: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
Kiswahili: Kwa nguvu zake aliisukasuka bahari; kwa hekima yake alimkata Rahabu vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: Ere ase okobua kwaye nigo agoturubania enyancha, na ase chisemi chiaye akanachana Rahabu, eng’iti enene y’enyancha.

English: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”
Kiswahili: Na akupe wewe na uzao wako baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu, upate kumiliki nchi unayoishi sasa kama mgeni, nchi ambayo Mungu alimpa Abrahamu.”
Ekegusii: Ere nakoe ogosesenigwa kwa Aburaamu, aye amo na ororeeria rwao, erinde onyare koira ense eye ore omomenyi bono, eye Nyasae aete Aburaamu!”

English: So David’s men said to him, “This is the day about which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do with him as you wish.’” Then David crept up secretly and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Daudi wakasema, “Hii ndiyo siku aliyonena Bwana akikuambia, ‘Nitamtia adui yako mikononi mwako ili wewe umtendee utakavyo.’ ” Basi Daudi akanyemelea bila kuonekana na kukata upindo wa joho la Sauli.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Daudi bakamoteebia: “Rituko eri ndiri’Omonene agoteebetie ng’a nabeeke omobisa oo ase okoboko kwao, naye omokore buna oranche.” Erio Daudi agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, akabutora omokoba bw’eganchwa ya Saulo bobisi.

English: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?' The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.'
Kiswahili: “Nikauliza, ‘Nifanye nini Bwana?' “Naye Bwana akaniambia, ‘Inuka uingie Dameski, huko utaambiwa yote yakupasayo kufanya.'
Ekegusii: Nkaboria: Ninki ndakore Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Imoka ogende goika Damesiki, agwo noteebigwe onsi aya gwachiikirwe oyakore.

English: for on these days the Jews obtained rest from their enemies; and in that month, which was Adar, in which a change was made for them from mourning to joy, and from sorrow to a holiday, to spend the whole of it in good days of feasting and gladness, sending portions to their friends and to the poor.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana siku hizo Wayahudi walipata raha kutokana na adui zao; na katika mwezi huo, ambao ulikuwa Adari, ambapo mabadiliko yalifanyika kwa ajili yao kutoka maombolezo hadi furaha, na kutoka huzuni hadi sikukuu, ili kutumia yote kwa sikukuu njema za karamu na furaha, wakiwapelekea rafiki zao na maskini sehemu.
Ekegusii: Modekai akariika amang'ana ayio, na agatoma amarube ase Abayahudi bonsi abarenge ang'e na aare ase chingongo chionsi chi'oborwoti bw'Ahaswero,

English: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo sasa, Baba, unitukuze mbele zako kwa ule utukufu niliokuwa nao pamoja na wewe kabla ulimwengu haujakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, ase obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang'ani ense etaratongwa.

English: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
Kiswahili: “Tubuni, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.”
Ekegusii: “Onchoka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang'e!”

English: This was Yahweh's word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo neno la Bwana lililonenwa kwa Yehu likatimia, kwamba, “Wazao wako wataketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli hadi kizazi cha nne.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio eira eri'Omonene arierete Yehu ng'a abana baye goika ekiaare gia kane mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo ki'oborwoti kw'Abaisraeli egaikeranigwa.

English: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren't satisfied.
Kiswahili: Ulifanya ukahaba na Waashuru pia, kwa kuwa hukuridhika, hata baada ya hayo, ukawa bado hukutosheleka.
Ekegusii: “Naende ngwakorete obonyaka n'Abaasuri, ekiagera tigwaisanegete, ee, ngwakorete obotaayayi nabarabwo, nonya naboigo tigwaisanegete.

English: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
Kiswahili: Lakini mjane mmoja maskini akaja na kuweka sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba zenye thamani ya senti mbili.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agacha, oyorenge omoboraka na omotaka, akabeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai, rigori ri’ekeng’ese ki’ebesa eyemo.

English: They took him alive, and decreed that both he and those who reigned after him should give them a great tribute, and should give hostages, and a parcel of land from the best of their provinces:
Kiswahili: Wakamkamata akiwa hai, wakaamuru kwamba yeye na wale waliotawala baada yake wawape kodi kubwa, na kuwapa mateka, na sehemu ya ardhi kutoka katika majimbo yao bora;
Ekegusii: Bakamobwata Antioko ore moyo, bakamobetereria ere amo na abarwoti abwo bamobwatisetie korwa ebango enene, koira abooswa sobo, boigo korwa na koira ensemo ere engiya ye chingongo chiabo.

English: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima pia uandae jeshi jingine kama lile ulilopoteza, farasi kwa farasi, gari la vita kwa gari la vita, ili tuweze kupigana na Israeli katika nchi tambarare. Kisha kwa hakika tutakuwa na nguvu kuliko wao.” Akakubaliana nao naye akashughulika ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Naende roberia abarwani b'esegi bang'ana buna abwo baitwa, ne chibarasi ne chigari ching'ana buna echio chiasirigwa, erio tobarwanie ase ense omweya; ekeene, goika tobe ne chinguru kobabua.” Omorwoti agancha amang'ana abo, naende agakora buna bamoteebetie.

English: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, weka mlinzi kinywani mwangu, weka ulinzi mlangoni mwa midomo yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, beeka omorendi ase omonwa one, abe okorenda ebikoba biane.

English: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana kutoka duniani, ninyi viumbe vikubwa vya baharini na vilindi vyote vya bahari,
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene korwa ase ense, nainwe ebitongwa bie chinyancha ne chindiba chionsi!

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
Kiswahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, aliyetubariki sisi kwa baraka zote za rohoni, katika ulimwengu wa roho ndani ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, atogigwe, ere oyotosesenetie ase Kristo nogosesenigwa gwonsi kw'omoika aase aaria igoro,

English: The fruit of a tree discloses its cultivation, so is the utterance of the thought of a person's heart.
Kiswahili: Matunda ya mti hufichua kilimo chake, ndivyo ilivyo kauli ya mawazo ya moyo wa mtu.
Ekegusii: Buna okwama kw'amatunda gokoorokia buna omote orendire, naboigo amang'ana akorwa ase omonto akomororekania.

English: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn't receive him.
Kiswahili: Alikuja kwa walio wake, lakini wao hawakumpokea.
Ekegusii: Agaacha ase abaye, na barabwo abaare abaye tibamwancha.

English: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
Kiswahili: Kapu lako na vyombo vyako vya kukandia vitabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: “Nesesenigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo ney’ebituba biaino mogoseera obosie.

English: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.
Kiswahili: Mierezi katika bustani ya Mungu haikuweza kushindana nao, wala misunobari haikuweza kulingana na vitawi vyake, wala miaramoni haikulinganishwa na matawi yake, wala hakukuwa na mti katika bustani ya Mungu wa kulinganisha na uzuri wake.
Ekegusii: Emecharake ende ey'omogondo o Nyasae tiyayoetanetie, gose emebunduki tiyarenge ne chinsagia buna echiaye; na emeuru tiyarenge nebisagia buna ebiaye. Ee, omote onde bw'omogondo o Nyasae torenge omosiani buna oro.

English: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu anakuja na hatakaa kimya, moto uteketezao unamtangulia, akiwa amezungukwa na tufani kali.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oito ngocha are, tagokirakiri; omorero okoria nigo otang'aine bosio bwaye, omwaga omotindi nigo omoetanaine.

English: let's draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
Kiswahili: sisi na tumkaribie Mungu kwa moyo mnyofu kwa imani timilifu, mioyo yetu ikiwa imenyunyizwa damu ya Kristo na kuwa safi kutokana na dhamiri mbaya nayo miili yetu ikiwa imeoshwa kwa maji safi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, toike ang'e ne chinkoro chire nekeene, tobe nobomaene oboikeranu ase okwegena, ne chinkoro chiaito chianyororokerigwe oborabu, tichigotogambia, twasibiigwe ase emebere yaito namaache amaya.

English: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened calves near the stone of Zoheleth, which is next to En-rogel. He invited all his royal brothers and all the men of Judah who were servants of the king.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Adoniya akatoa dhabihu ya kondoo, ngʼombe na ndama walionona kwenye Jiwe la Zohelethi karibu na En-Rogeli. Akawaalika ndugu zake wote, wana wa mfalme na wanaume wote wa Yuda waliokuwa maafisa wa mfalme,
Ekegusii: Adonia akanyenya ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, chikaba ekeng’wanso agwo ang’e n’Egetare gie Ching’iti kere ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, akarangeria abamura bamwabo bonsi, abwo abamura b’omorwoti, na abanto bonsi abanene b’obogaambi bwa Yuda.

English: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king's house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja wakati wa jioni Daudi aliinuka kitandani mwake na kutembeatembea juu ya paa la jumba lake la kifalme. Kutokea kule kwenye paa, akamwona mwanamke akioga. Mwanamke huyo alikuwa mzuri sana wa sura,
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase rituko erimo chinsa chia mogoroba, Daudi akaimoka korwa borere bwaye, akariina kerama igoro, ase enyomba yaye y'oborwoti. Ekero areenge gotaarao, akarora omokungu ogwesibia, na omokungu oyio nigo arenge omonyakieni mono.

English: and do not give the devil a foothold.
Kiswahili: wala msimpe ibilisi nafasi.
Ekegusii: gose timoa Saitani ribaga.

English: He said to them, “Do you know Tobit our brother?” They said, “We know him.” Then he said to them, “Is he in good health?”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, "Je, mnamjua Tobiti ndugu yetu?" Wakasema, "Tunamjua." Kisha akawauliza, "Je, yuko salama?"
Ekegusii: Edina akababoria Inee 'momanyete momura ominto Tobiti? Barabwo bakairaneria “Ee ntomomanyete mono.” Erio ere akababoria “Inee? Mbuya are?”

English: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema wewe ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine husema ni Eliya, na bado wengine husema kwamba ni mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.”
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; abande Elija, na abande ng’a oyomo ase ababani abakoro obokire.”

English: For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajisifu, “Tumefanya agano na mauti, tumefanya mapatano na kuzimu. Wakati pigo lifurikalo litakapopita, haliwezi kutugusa sisi, kwa kuwa tumefanya uongo kuwa kimbilio letu na miungu ya uongo kuwa mahali petu pa kujificha.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba, “Intwe twakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namakweri, na twabwatanire nase abakuure; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache tegotoika ang’e, ekiagera twakorire oborimo bwabeire obotamero bwaito, na obong’ainereria bwabeire egekengero giaito.”

English: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi huo itakuwa sikukuu; kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri'omotienyi oyio nario Rituko Rinene. Ase amatuko atan'abere morie emagaati etabekiri memera.

English: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
Kiswahili: Bwana akautia Lakishi mikononi mwa Israeli, Yoshua akauteka siku ya pili. Yoshua akauangamiza mji na kila kilichokuwa ndani yake kwa upanga, kama tu vile alivyokuwa ameufanyia mji wa Libna.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene akabeeka Lakisi ase amaboko 'Abaisraeli, erio bakayobwata rituko ria kabere, bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi b'omochie, buna bakorete agwo Libuna.

English: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke, akijua kilichomtokea, akaja, akaanguka miguuni pake akitetemeka kwa hofu, akamweleza ukweli wote.
Ekegusii: Na omokungu oria agasogwa nomoondoko na okoiguswa, akamanya eriamonyorire, agacha akamogwera, akamoorokeria ekeene gionsi.

English: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kumi na moja kwa mwezi wa kumi na moja alikuwa Benaya Mpirathoni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God's sight.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, kujipamba kwenu kuwe katika utu wenu wa moyoni, yaani uzuri usioharibika wa roho ya upole na utulivu, ambayo ni ya thamani sana machoni pa Mungu.
Ekegusii: korende kobe ogw'enkoro y'omonto o ime otari kororekana, ogwechabera okwo gotari gosareka, ase omoika bw'obwororo na obokanyeku. Oko nakwo kore kwe rigori rinene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker; whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished.
Kiswahili: Yeye anaye mdhihaki maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wake; yeyote afurahiaye maafa hataepuka kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochecheria omotaka nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oye, na oyokogookera emechando yanyorire abande, takomocha konyora egesusuro.

English: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit. The Purpose of the Law (Romans 7:1–6)
Kiswahili: Alitukomboa ili kwamba baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu ipate kuwafikia watu wa Mataifa kwa njia ya Kristo Yesu, ili kwa imani tupate kupokea ile ahadi ya Roho. Sheria Na Ahadi
Ekegusii: Igo ogosesenigwa okwo Aburaamu anyorete goikera abanto b’Ebisaku goetera ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyare konyora Omoika ase enchera y’okwegena, buna twarieretwe eira. Ogochika n’echiira

English: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
Kiswahili: Wazee na watu mashuhuri ndio vichwa, nao manabii wanaofundisha uongo ndio mkia.
Ekegusii: Omogaka bw'amasikani nere omotwe, na omobani okworokereria oborimo nere ekemincha.

English: Do I say this from a human perspective? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
Kiswahili: Je, nasema mambo haya katika mtazamo wa kibinadamu tu? Je, sheria haisemi vivyo hivyo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ngokwana aya buna Mwanyabaanto? Gose amachiiko tari goteeba boigo?

English: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
Kiswahili: Sifa zake zikaanza kuenea haraka katika eneo lote la karibu na Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi'ense ya Galili.

English: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
Kiswahili: Bwana ndiye Mungu, naye ametuangazia nuru yake. Mkiwa na matawi mkononi, unganeni kwenye maandamano ya sikukuu hadi kwenye pembe za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae, ere otorabeirie ensaakia. Bogoria chinsagia chi’emete, mochaake rituko rinene, moroobere gochia ase egesasiimero kere n’emegwekano ye ching’unchara!

English: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. But do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, ninao binti wawili ambao kamwe hawajakutana kimwili na mwanaume. Acha niwatoe nje kwenu, nanyi mnaweza kuwafanyia lolote mnalotaka. Lakini msiwafanyie chochote watu hawa, kwa sababu wako kwenye ulinzi chini ya dari langu.”
Ekegusii: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing’ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y’oborendi bwane.”

English: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Libomoeni hili Hekalu, nami nitalijenga tena kwa siku tatu!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tagora Hekalu eye, na inche ase amatuko atato ninyetenenie.”

English: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, amuru uwezo wako, Ee Mungu tuonyeshe nguvu zako, kama ulivyofanya hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia okobua kwao; ee Nyasae, ayio gwatokoreire, genderera koyabeka chinguru.

English: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.
Kiswahili: na ni lazima atubu dhambi aliyoifanya. Ni lazima atoe malipo kamili kwa ajili ya kosa lake, aongeze sehemu ya tano juu ya malipo hayo na kutoa yote kwa mtu aliyemkosea.
Ekegusii: omonto oyio goika aorokie ebibe biria. Boigo airanie ase omonto oria aurete rigori ri’eniibo eyio amourete, naende amente eyemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.

English: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban's flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn't put them into Laban's flock.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akawatenga wadogo wa kundi peke yao, lakini akazielekeza nyuso za hao waliobaki kwenye wale wenye mistari na weusi waliokuwa mali ya Labani. Hivyo akatenga makundi yake mwenyewe, na wala hakuwachanganya na wanyama wa Labani.
Ekegusii: Na Yakobo agaatanana ching'ondi chimingichi, ne ching'ondi chiaberi agachisang'anania ne chimingichi chie riicho ria Labani echiareenge namagwari, na echiare chimwamu. Naboigo akenyorera amaicho aye ere omonyene, ayio atabegete amo naya Labani.

English: “My silver has been returned!” he said to his brothers. “It is here in my sack.” Their hearts sank, and trembling, they turned to one another and said, “What is this that God has done to us?”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia ndugu zake, “Fedha yangu imerudishwa. Iko ndani ya gunia langu.” Mioyo yao ikazimia, na kila mmoja akamgeukia mwenzake wakitetemeka, wakaulizana, “Ni nini hiki Mungu alichotufanyia?”
Ekegusii: agateebia abamwabo: “Ayee! Chibesa chiane nigo chiairanetigwe, rigereria, nao chire aa egunia yane ime!” Chinkoro chiabo chikagoyaana, bakarigererania na koiguswa, bagateeba: “Inki eke Nyasae atokoreire iga?”

English: Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,
Kiswahili: Naye Hezekia akamwomba Bwana akisema:
Ekegusii: Hezekia agasaba Omonene, agateeba,

English: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,
Kiswahili: Wote wapigao makasia wataacha meli zao, mabaharia wote na wanamaji wote watasimama pwani.
Ekegusii: “Abanto bonsi abagoata amaache n'emegango mbatige chimeeri chiabo; abagokora emeremo ase chimeeri amo nabagendia, mbagende ase engegu, bateneneo.

English: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu wanyama, ndege, kila kiumbe hai kiendacho ndani ya maji, na kila kiumbe kiendacho juu ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika gotenenerete ching'iti ne chinyoni, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegoetanana ase amaache ime, na ebitongwa ebisinini bigoetanana ase ense,

English: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana neema ya Mungu ambayo inawaokoa wanadamu wote imefunuliwa.
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae oorokriie obuya bwaye ase ogotooreka ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi.

English: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa kwa viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria. Wao watamhukumu kifo na kumtia mikononi mwa watu wa Mataifa,
Ekegusii: akabora, “Rigereria, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nabekwe ase amaboko y'abakuani abanene na aborokia b'amariiko. Abwo nabamogambie, na bamobeke ase amaboko abanto b'Ebisaku,

English: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
Kiswahili: Jana usiku, malaika wa Mungu yule ambaye mimi ni wake na ambaye ninamwabudu alisimama karibu nami,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obotuko obo bwa reero omomalaika o Nyasae, oria inche inde omonto oye, naende nere ngosasiima,

English: All the people were exceedingly amazed, and bowed themselves, and worshiped God, and said with one accord, “Blessed are you, O our God, who have this day humiliated the enemies of your people.”
Kiswahili: Watu wote walishangaa sana, wakainama, wakamsujudia Mungu, na kusema kwa pamoja, “Ubarikiwe, Ee Mungu wetu, ambaye leo umewaaibisha maadui wa watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ase omochie akabwatwa nomoichano. Bagatugama ase okomosasiima Nyasae ase ogosaba bakoboora, “Otogiwe aye Nyasae oito goika kwababuire ababisa ba abanto bao.”

English: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
Kiswahili: Kama dubu aviziaye, kama simba mafichoni,
Ekegusii: Nigo amboerete buna edubu, enyang’au entindi, ekoboera, na buna endo eboerete eite.

English: He said to Jonathan, “Why have you put all these people to so much trouble, seeing there is no war between us?
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Yonathani, “Kwa nini umewatia watu hawa wote katika taabu kubwa, huku hakuna vita kati yetu?”
Ekegusii: Erio akamobooria Yonathani: “Ninki gekogera kwabachaandete abasikari aba abange iga naye nomanyete buna intwe titobwati esegi ase egati yaito?

English: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
Kiswahili: Wote wakala na kushiba. Baadaye wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu saba.
Ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere biichire.

English: Bind them always upon your heart; tie them around your neck.
Kiswahili: Yafunge katika moyo wako daima, yakaze kuizunguka shingo yako.
Ekegusii: Yasibe, ageenderere kobeera ase enkoro yao botambe, naende oyasibe ase rigoti ria’o.

English: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God's Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
Kiswahili: “Sheria na Manabii vilihubiriwa mpaka kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji. Tangu wakati huo habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu zinahubiriwa, na kila mmoja hujiingiza kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: “Amachiiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang'ana amaya ay'oborwoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.

English: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
Kiswahili: tukiwa kama wenye huzuni, lakini siku zote tukifurahi; tukionekana maskini, lakini tukitajirisha wengi; tukiwa kama wasio na kitu, lakini tuna vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: twaichanigwe, korende amatuko onsi nigo tore nomogooko; tore abataka, korende twabatenenkirie abange, titori na gento, nonya nabo ntore n’ebinto bionsi. Okorigia obwanchani bw’abaonchogete

English: For you have authority over life and death, and you lead down to the gates of Hades, and lead up again.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana una mamlaka juu ya uzima na kifo, na unaongoza chini hadi milango ya kuzimu, na unaongoza juu tena.
Ekegusii: Aye nobwate okobua igoro y'obogima n'ogokwa; aye nigo ogotirimbokia abanto goika ogokwa naende kwabairania.

English: But bring your youngest brother back to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini mleteni huyo ndugu yenu mdogo kwangu, ndipo nitajua kuwa ninyi sio wapelelezi, ila ni watu waaminifu. Kisha nitamrudisha ndugu yenu, nanyi mtaweza kufanya biashara katika nchi hii.’ ”
Ekegusii: Genda mondetere oyio omino omoke, erio nario ndamanye ng’a timori chirooti, korende nabaanto abaronge. Erio nimbairanerie oyomino, na inwe inamonyore ribaga mobe mokoonchoreria ase ense eye.”

English: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die. The Birth and Adoption of Moses (Exodus 2:1–10; Hebrews 11:23–29)
Kiswahili: Huyu mfalme akawatendea watu wetu hila na kuwatesa baba zetu kwa kuwalazimisha wawatupe watoto wao wachanga ili wafe.
Ekegusii: Oyio agakorera egesaku giaito obong’ainereria, na agakorera chisokoro chiaito amabe, na barabwo bagachiikwa ng’a batugute abana babo ebing’werere, erinde tibaaba moyo.

English: And I saw a wall surrounding the temple area. Now the length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits (each measuring a cubit and a handbreadth), and he measured the wall to be one rod thick and one rod high.
Kiswahili: Nikaona ukuta uliozunguka eneo lote la Hekalu. Ule ufito wa kupimia uliokuwa mkononi mwa yule mtu ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ndefu sita, yaani, dhiraa ndefu ni sawa na dhiraa na nyanda nne, akapima ule ukuta. Ukuta huo ulikuwa na unene wa dhiraa ndefu sita na kimo cha dhiraa ndefu sita.
Ekegusii: Nkarora orwaki rwaetanaine eraaro y’enyomba eria chinsemo chionsi. Emoti yarenge ase okoboko kw’omonto oria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko atano na rimo, na kera ekerengo gi’okoboko gekamentwa eki’egesanyi ekemo. Omonto oria akarengia orwaki. Obogare bwaye bokaba emoti eyemo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro emoti eyemo.

English: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
Kiswahili: Na atoe shavu lake kwa yule ampigaye, na ajazwe na aibu.
Ekegusii: Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka, na oyio aisaneke noborami.

English: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, goika ogokwa; ikaransa aiga, morende.”

English: We have brought Yahweh's offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tumeleta kama sadaka kwa Bwana vyombo vya dhahabu kila mmoja wetu alivyopata, yaani vikuku, bangili, pete za muhuri, vipuli na mikufu, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yetu mbele za Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio twarentire ebinto bie chitaabu bi'ogwechabera: ebitange bi'amaboko, na ebigera, ne chibonyi, na ebigera bi'amato, ne chisonoi. Ebinto ebio twasakorete kera oyomo oito, na bono twabirentire, twabirure ase Omonene, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase tore ase obosio bwaye.”

English: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kwa kuwa u vuguvugu, si baridi wala moto, nitakutapika utoke kinywani mwangu.
Ekegusii: Nabo, ekiagera ore igatwa, otari morero gose omokendu, ningotwe buna amate korwa ase omonwa one.

English: But will God indeed dwell with man upon the earth? Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kweli, je, Mungu atafanya makao duniani na wanadamu? Mbingu, hata mbingu zilizo juu sana, haziwezi kukutosha wewe. Sembuse Hekalu hili nililojenga!
Ekegusii: “Korende, Inee, nekeene ng’a aye Nyasae nonyare komenya amo na Mwanyabaanto aiga ase ense? Rora igoro, na igoro aare mono, takogoisana komenya; naki rende enyomba eye nakoagacheire eragoisane?

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Kwa sababu unafikiri una hekima, mwenye hekima kama mungu,
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ekiagera aye kwarengereirie ng’a nigo ore omong’aini buna Nyasae,

English: For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nitasamehe uovu wao, wala sitazikumbuka dhambi zao tena!”
Ekegusii: Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”

English: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
Kiswahili: Mbingu zilizo juu sana ni mali ya Bwana, lakini dunia amempa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igoro yonsi na aase aye ere Omonene ore igoro, korende ense ero oyeire Mwanyabaanto.

English: Then the LORD said to him, “Go back by the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you arrive, you are to anoint Hazael as king over Aram.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Rudi kwa njia uliyoijia, uende kwenye Jangwa la Dameski. Wakati utakapofika huko, mtie Hazaeli mafuta awe mfalme wa Aramu
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Irana, ogende enchera yao goika ase erooro ya Damesiki; na ekero oraike aroro, oake Hasaeli amaguta, omobeke abe omorwoti igoro y’Abasiiria.

English: Each man is to take his censer, place incense in it, and present it before the LORD—250 censers. You and Aaron are to present your censers as well.”
Kiswahili: Kila mtu atachukua chetezo chake na kuweka uvumba ndani yake, vyetezo 250 kwa jumla, na kukileta mbele za Bwana. Wewe na Aroni mtaleta vyetezo vyenu pia.”
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino aimokie orogio rw’aye rw’omorero, na arobekere ubani na kororenta ase obosio bw’Omonene. Chindogio chionsi nigo chirabe amagana abere, na merongo etano; naye orente orwao, na Aroni nere arente orwaye.’

English: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”'”
Kiswahili: Nitamweka juu ya nyumba yangu na ufalme wangu milele; kiti chake cha enzi nitakifanya imara milele.' ”
Ekegusii: Korende nimokore agenderere kobeerao botambe ase enyomba yane, na ase oborwoti bwane, na obogambi bwaye bokong'igwe kobao botari nomoerio.”

English: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Nethaneli mwana wa Suari.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.

English: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
Kiswahili: Isaki akawauliza, “Mbona mmekuja kwangu na ninyi mlinichukia na kunifukuza?”
Ekegusii: Na Isaka akababooria: “Inki mwacha korigia aa bwone, na ekero nare nainwe nigo mongechete, naende mwanseretie korwa seino?”

English: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Ethni, mwana wa Zera, mwana wa Adaya,
Ekegusii: bw'Etini, o Zera, bw'Adaya,

English: Jonathan, and Simon his brother, and all who were with him, knew it; and they fled into the wilderness of Tekoah, and encamped by the water of the pool of Asphar.
Kiswahili: Yonathani, na Simoni nduguye, na wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, walijua hilo; wakakimbia mpaka nyikani mwa Tekoa, wakapiga kambi karibu na maji ya bwawa la Asfari.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Yonathani amanya emeroberio eyio, agatama gochia ase erooro ya Tekoa, ere amo na momura omwabo, Simioni amo na abanto baabo. Agwo bakabeeka ekambi ange neritibo ria Asifari.

English: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus' mother was there.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu kulikuwa na arusi katika mji wa Kana ya Galilaya, naye mama yake Yesu alikuwepo pale.
Ekegusii: Naende rituko ria gatato 'yarenge enyangi agwo Kana ya Galili, na ng'ina Yeso nao arenge.

English: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
Kiswahili: Kwa namna hii twaweza kulijua pendo la Mungu: Kwa sababu Yesu Kristo aliutoa uhai wake kwa ajili yetu. Nasi imetupasa kuutoa uhai kwa ajili ya hao ndugu.
Ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y’abaminto.

English: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
Kiswahili: Kisha akapima ukuta wa Hekalu, nao ulikuwa na unene wa dhiraa sita, na kila chumba cha pembeni kuzunguka Hekalu kilikuwa na upana wa dhiraa nne.
Ekegusii: Naende akarengia enyasi ye Hekalu; obonetu bwaye nigo bwarenge obw'amaboko atano na rimo, na obogare bw'ebinyomba biaetanaine Hekalu nigo bwarenge obw'amaboko ane.

English: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your goodness, as He delighted in that of your fathers,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana Mungu wako atakapokufanikisha sana katika kazi zote za mikono yako na katika uzao wa tumbo lako, wadogo wa mifugo yako na mazao ya nchi yako. Bwana atakufurahia tena na kukufanikisha, kama alivyowafurahia baba zako,
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, nabasesenie mono ase emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora n’amaboko aino, nasesenie oroiboro rwaino romentekane, ’namente ne chiombe chiaino na okwama kwaino kwe riroba. Na buna Omonene agoogete ase ogosesenia chisokoro chiaino, naboigo aragooke ase okobasesenia inwe,

English: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.
Kiswahili: Kila mahali mtakapoweka mguu wenu patakuwa penu: Nchi yenu itaenea kutoka jangwa la Lebanoni, na kutoka mto wa Frati hadi bahari ya magharibi
Ekegusii: Aase ande onsi morataare n'amagoro aino nabe aaino. Orogongo rwaino nigo rorachaakere ase erooro ya Irianyi na roikere Lebanoni, ensemo ya sugusu, naende rochaakere orooche rwa Eufarati ensemo ya moocha na roikere Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.

English: Then she called out, “Samson, the Philistines are here!” When Samson awoke from his sleep, he thought, “I will escape as I did before and shake myself free.” But he did not know that the LORD had departed from him.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akamwita, “Samsoni, hao Wafilisti wanakujia!” Akaamka toka usingizini akasema, “Nitatoka nje kama hapo awali, nitawakungʼutia mbali na kuwa huru.” Lakini hakujua kuwa Bwana amemwacha.
Ekegusii: Erio akarangeria, “Samusoni! Abafirisiti aba bachire gokobwata!” Samusoni akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akarengereria ng’a “Bono ninyesibore buna botambe, ’ngende,” ekiagera tamanyete ng’a Omonene omotigire.

English: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
Kiswahili: Pia ulichukua vito vizuri nilivyokupa, vito vilivyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu yangu na fedha yangu, ukajitengenezea navyo sanamu za kiume na ukafanya ukahaba nazo.
Ekegusii: Naende okaimokia ebinto biao ebiya bie chitaabu na ebie chifeta nakoete, erio okeroiseria emegwekano yogosasiima enga abasacha, erio ogakora obonyaka n'ero.

English: and lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of stallions.
Kiswahili: Huko aliwatamani wapenzi wake, ambao viungo vyao vya uzazi ni kama vya punda, na kile kiwatokacho ni kama kiwatokacho farasi.
Ekegusii: Ere akaba nokogania okobe ase abatomani baria baare nokogania kw’omobere buna chitigere chire, naende bagasokia oroiboro buna chibarasi chigosokia orwabo.

English: Do not be like your fathers and brothers who were unfaithful to the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that He made them an object of horror, as you can see.
Kiswahili: Msiwe kama baba zenu na ndugu zenu, ambao hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, hivyo akawafanya kitu cha kushangaza kama mnavyoona.
Ekegusii: Timoba buna chisokoro chiaino na buna abanto bamino batarenge abegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, goika akabasiria buna morooche bono.

English: A man who is accustomed to abusive language won't be corrected all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Mwanaume aliyezoea lugha ya matusi hatarekebishwa siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto onarete amang'ana amagundo ituko ndiri arabe n'amasikani ase obogima bwaye bwensi.

English: “The God of the Hebrews has met with us,” they answered. “Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God, or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakasema, “Mungu wa Waebrania amekutana nasi. Sasa turuhusu tuwe na safari ya siku tatu ya jangwani ili tukamtolee Bwana Mungu wetu dhabihu, la sivyo aweza kutupiga sisi kwa tauni au kwa upanga.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakamoteebia, “Nyasae bw’Abaiberania natoorokera. Koranche, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde tomoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso, tabaisa gocha gotoita namarwaire gose nemioro.”

English: that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, as He has promised.
Kiswahili: Ametangaza kwamba atawaweka juu kuliko mataifa mengine aliyoyafanya katika sifa, kuwa fahari na heshima, na kwamba mtakuwa taifa takatifu kwa Bwana Mungu wenu, kama alivyoahidi.
Ekegusii: N’abakore mobe abanene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi biria atongete; n’abakore momanyekane ase ogotogigwa okuya na ogosikwa, nainwe ’namobe abanto bare abachenu ase Omonene Nyasae oino, buna ere ateebire.”

English: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:
Kiswahili: Kisha Masadukayo, wale wasemao kuwa hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu,
Ekegusii: Na Abasadukai bagachiera Yeso, baria bakoboora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamobooria,

English: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo watakaponiita lakini sitawajibu; watanitafuta lakini hawatanipata.
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo ’mbandangerie, korende tinkobaigwa; ’mbandigie, korende tibakonyora inche.

English: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja akashangaa na kumtukuza Mungu. Wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, wakasema, “Leo tumeona mambo ya ajabu.”
Ekegusii: Ogokumia gokabwata bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae; bagaichorwa nokoiroka, bakaboora, “Twarorire amakumia reero.”

English: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
Kiswahili: nikifurahi katika dunia yake yote nami nikiwafurahia wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nagokerete ense yaye emenyire nabaanto, na nkaba nsasokerete Mwanyabaanto.

English: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites, saying, “What do you have against me that you have come to fight against my land?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yefta akatuma wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Waamoni akisema, “Una nini juu yetu, hata umekuja kushambulia nchi yetu?”
Ekegusii: Erio Yefta agatoma abanto ase omorwoti bw’Abaamoni komoboria, “’Ndiomana ki obwate ase ’nde? Nase ki gwachire korwania ense yane?”

English: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
Kiswahili: Wana wa Sayuni wenye thamani, ambao mwanzo uzito wa thamani yao ulikuwa wa dhahabu, sasa wanaangaliwa kama vyungu vya udongo, kazi ya mikono ya mfinyanzi!
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Sayoni abare nengencho enene, abwo bareng’anirie ne chitaabu chingiya, naki yabeire ng’a bareng’anigwe ne chinyongo chi’amaroba, echire emeremo y’amaboko ’abakori chinyongo?

English: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika mwingine akaja kutoka hekaluni naye akamwita kwa sauti kubwa yule aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya lile wingu akasema, “Chukua mundu wako ukavune kwa kuwa wakati wa mavuno umewadia, kwa maana mavuno ya dunia yamekomaa.”
Ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasooka korwa ase Hekalu akarera neriogi rinene, agateebia oyoikaransete igoro ase riire riria, “Soyia omoyio oo mogondo, ogese, ekiagera engaki y'okogesa yaikire, ne rigesa riomire mono.”

English: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia Wagadi na Wareubeni, “Je, watu wa nchi yenu watakwenda vitani wakati ninyi mmeketi hapa?
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’abanto ba Gadi na abareubeni, akabora, “Inee! Abanto bamino nigo bakogeenda korwana esegi, nainwe mobe motigarete aase aa?

English: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
Kiswahili: ili waweze kuwafundisha wanawake vijana kuwa na kiasi, wawapende waume zao na kuwapenda watoto wao,
Ekegusii: erinde borokererie abakungu abake banche abasacha babo, na abana babo.

English: My beloved is mine and I am his; he pastures his flock among the lilies.
Kiswahili: Mpenzi wangu ni wangu, nami ni wake, yeye hujilisha katikati ya yungiyungi.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere noyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.

English: And there the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.”
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yangu huko, naye akaniambia, “Simama uende mpaka sehemu tambarare, nami nitasema nawe huko.”
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo okoboko kw’Omonene gokambeka chinguru, ere aganteebia, “Imoka, ogende ase ense omweya, na aroro aaria inche ninkwane naye.”

English: Jonathan learned that there was an ambush behind him. They surrounded his army, and shot their arrows at the people, from morning until evening;
Kiswahili: Yonathani akagundua kwamba kulikuwa na watu wanaomvizia nyuma yake, nao wakazunguka jeshi lake, wakawapiga mishale watu, tangu asubuhi hadi jioni;
Ekegusii: Goika agwo konye Yonathani tamanyete buna otegeirwe. Ekaba mobasokano abarwani baye be esegi bakaonchokanwa. Erio chinsara chi'ababisa chikabatonyera korwa igoro buna embura korwa mambia goika mogoroba.

English: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the aged, gather the children, even those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her chamber.
Kiswahili: Wakusanyeni watu, wekeni wakfu kusanyiko; waleteni pamoja wazee, wakusanyeni watoto, wale wanyonyao maziwa. Bwana arusi na atoke chumbani mwake na bibi arusi naye atoke katika chumba chake.
Ekegusii: Sangereria abanto amo, ochene omosangererekano oyio; sangereria abagaaka, sangereria nabana, nonya nabakogonka. Tiga nonya mbaria banyuomanire bwango iga basoke korwa mwabo,

English: Now a certain old prophet was living in Bethel, and his sons came and told him all the deeds that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words that the man had spoken to the king.
Kiswahili: Basi kulikuwepo na nabii fulani mzee aliyekuwa anaishi Betheli, ambaye wanawe walikuja kumwambia yote ambayo mtu wa Mungu alikuwa ameyafanya pale siku ile. Pia wakamwambia baba yao yale aliyomwambia mfalme.
Ekegusii: Narenge omobani omogotu oyomo omenyete agwo Beteli. Abana baye abamura bagacha, bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi omonto oria o Nyasae akorete ase rituko riria agwo Beteli, bakamoteebia na amang’ana akwanete nomorwoti.

English: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
Kiswahili: Uzao wa tumbo lako utalaaniwa, mazao ya ardhi yako, ndama wa makundi yako ya ngʼombe na wana-kondoo wa makundi yako.
Ekegusii: “Ndoragererigwe oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino amo n'okwama kwaino kwe riroba, na okobiara gwe'chiombe chiaino, na ogwe'ching'ondi ne'chimbori chiaino.

English: To the Levites who taught all Israel and were holy to the LORD, Josiah said: “Put the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel. It is not to be carried around on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and His people Israel.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia Walawi, waliowafundisha Waisraeli wote na waliokuwa wamejiweka wakfu kwa ajili ya kazi ya Bwana, “Liwekeni hilo Sanduku takatifu katika Hekalu lile alilojenga Solomoni mwana wa Daudi mfalme wa Israeli. Halipaswi kubebwa huku na huko mabegani mwenu. Sasa mtumikieni Bwana Mungu wenu na watu wake Israeli.
Ekegusii: Agatebereria Abalawi baria barenge aborokia b’Abaisraeli, naende baatananetwe ase Omonene, akabora, “Beka Esanduki eyio enchenu ase enyomba eyio Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, aagachete. Korwa bono timogwenereti koyebogoria igoro ase amareko aino. Bono mokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino, mobakorere na abanto baye Abaisraeli.

English: “Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured me; he has crushed me. He has set me aside like an empty vessel; he has swallowed me like a monster; he filled his belly with my delicacies and vomited me out.
Kiswahili: “Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli ametula, ametufanya tuchangayikiwe, ametufanya tuwe gudulia tupu. Kama nyoka ametumeza na kujaza tumbo lake kwa vyakula vyetu vizuri, kisha akatutapika.
Ekegusii: “Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, ondiire, onsegenyire; ontigire inde bosa buna ekebekerero getabwati gento. Omerire inche buna enchoka ekomera egento. Oichoirie enda yaye n’ebinto biane ebiya, ontigire inde bosa.

English: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu mwenye haki, uchunguzaye mawazo na mioyo, komesha ghasia za waovu na ufanye wenye haki waishi kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Tiga ebibe bi’abakori amabe biere, korende omonto omooronge omotenenie bokong’u. Aye Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo okorenga chinkoro na emioyo.

English: ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, with no iniquity in me.
Kiswahili: ‘Mimi ni safi na sina dhambi; mimi ni safi na sina hatia.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba iga: Inche nigo nchenegete, tindi nogosaria konde, na bibe tibiri ime yane.
