English: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, Abrahamu akachukua chakula na kiriba cha maji, akampa Hagari. Akaviweka mabegani mwa Hagari, akamwondoa pamoja na kijana. Hagari akashika njia, akatangatanga katika jangwa la Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akaimokia omogati na ebirandi biroiseirie amasankwa, bire n'amaache, akabiaa Hagari, akamobibekera mareko. Akamorentera na omwana, akamoteebia agende amo nere. Akagenda, akana‐koong'anya ase erooro ya Beeri‐Seba.

English: Don't reject me in my old age. Don't forsake me when my strength fails.
Kiswahili: Usinitupe wakati wa uzee, wala usiniache nguvu zangu zinapopungua.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, tontiga ekero chinguru chirabe chiang'ereire.

English: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.
Kiswahili: Nao wakampa divai iliyochanganywa na manemane, lakini hakuinywa.
Ekegusii: Bakamoa edivai yochoganirie na manemane anywe, ko tancha konywa.

English: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Uza, Pasea, Besai,
Ekegusii: Usa, na Pasea, na Besai;

English: But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
Kiswahili: Lakini nikauzuia mkono wangu na kwa ajili ya Jina langu nikafanya kile ambacho kingelifanya Jina langu lisitiwe unajisi machoni mwa mataifa ambao mbele yao nilikuwa nimewatoa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende tinakorete bo, ekiagera nigo narendete erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti ase amasio y’ abanto b’ebisaku abwo ase narusetie Abaisraeli korwa.

English: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
Kiswahili: Utakuwa kama alalaye katikati ya bahari, alalaye juu ya kamba ya merikebu.
Ekegusii: Nigo or'abe buna omonto oraire ase egati‐gati y'enyancha, gose buna omonto ore ase omote omotambe igoro okoirwa esiororia.

English: One said to another, “If we all do as our kindred have done, and don't fight against the Gentiles for our lives and our ordinances, they will quickly destroy us from off the earth.”
Kiswahili: Mmoja aliambiana, “Kama sote tukifanya kama jamaa zetu walivyofanya, na tusipigane na Mataifa kwa ajili ya maisha yetu na kanuni zetu, watatuangamiza haraka kutoka duniani.”
Ekegusii: Erio kera omonto agateebia oyomwabo, “Tomochanie tokore buna abaaminto baakorete na totige titwerwanerera korwa ase ababisa baito ase okoegerera obogima bwaito, ase obwango barabwo nigo bagochia gotosiria korwa ase oboiko bw'ense.”

English: Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo anaweza kuwaokoa kabisa wale wanaomjia Mungu kupitia kwake, kwa sababu yeye adumu daima kuomba kwa ajili yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nare nokobua gw’okobatooria kegima abwo bagocha ase Nyasae goetera asare, ekiagera nigo are moyo botambe ase okobasabera.

English: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
Kiswahili: Ndani yake jengo lote limeshikamanishwa pamoja na kusimamishwa ili kuwa Hekalu takatifu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase are ere oboagacho bwonsi bwabwataniigwe amo, na gokiina, bobe Hekalu Enchenu ase Omonene.

English: Then Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long will you waver between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow Him. But if Baal is God, follow him.” But the people did not answer a word.
Kiswahili: Eliya akasimama mbele ya watu na kusema, “Mtasitasita katika mawazo mawili hadi lini? Ikiwa Bwana ndiye Mungu, mfuateni yeye; lakini ikiwa Baali ni Mungu, basi mfuateni yeye.” Lakini watu hawakusema kitu.
Ekegusii: Elija agaika abanto bonsi ang’e, agakwana: “Ngoika ririri mogochia koba ne chitang’utang’u more nebirengererio bire ara kabere? Onye Omonene nere Nyasae, momobwatie, korende onye Baali, mobwatie ere.” Abanto bagakira kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo.

English: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawaheshimu kazi za Bwana, na yale ambayo mikono yake imetenda, atawabomoa na kamwe hatawajenga tena.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng’a ogokora kw’Omonene, gose emeremo y’amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.

English: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa ajili ya Jina langu nikafanya kile ambacho kitalifanya Jina langu lisitiwe unajisi machoni mwa mataifa ambao mbele yao nilikuwa nimewatoa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ayio nakorete nigo nayakorete ase okorenda erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti ase amasio y’ abanto b’ebisaku, abwo ase narusetie Abaisraeli korwa.

English: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him, ‘Curse David,' who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?'”
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme akamwambia, “Mna nini nami, enyi wana wa Seruya? Ikiwa analaani kwa sababu Bwana amemwambia, ‘Mlaani Daudi,' nani awezaye kuuliza, ‘Kwa nini unafanya hivi?' ”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akabora, “Inki inde nainwe abamura b'omokuungu Seruya? Onye okoragereria, ekiagera Omonene amoteebirie ng'a andagererie inche Daudi, ning'o oranyaare komoboria; Ninki kiagera ogokora iga?”

English: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwili hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na Roho, naye Roho hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na mwili. Roho na mwili hupingana na kwa sababu hiyo hamwezi kufanya mnayotaka.
Ekegusii: Naki okogania gwe chingencho chi'ebibe nigo gokoamererania n'Omoika na okogania kw'Omoika nigo gokoamererania ne chingencho chi'ebibe; naki ebi iga bikorwana goika timokonyara gokora ayamorigetie gokora.

English: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa taji la utukufu, taji zuri la maua kwa mabaki ya watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe egutwa y’obonene, na ekiore ki’obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

English: Once upon a time there was a female giant. As she was walking near the lake one day, she found three little girls. She asked them, "Who among you is loved by both parents?"
Kiswahili: Hapo zamani za kale paliondokea jitu la kike. Lilipokuwa likitembea kandokando mwa ziwa liliwaona wasichana watatu. Likawauliza, “Ni nani kati yenu anayependwa na wazazi wote wawili?”
Ekegusii: Kare kare richini rikungu ndiarenge ororo. Korigotara rikanyora abaiseke abake nchera. Rikababoria, “Ning’o gati yaino bwanchire na’baibori baye bonsi?”

English: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.
Kiswahili: kwa nguvu za ishara na miujiza, kwa uweza wa Roho wa Mungu, hivyo kuanzia Yerusalemu hadi maeneo yote ya kandokando yake mpaka Iliriko, nimekwisha kuihubiri Injili ya Kristo kwa ukamilifu.
Ekegusii: ase chinguru chi’ebikone na amakumia, ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Naikire korandia enchiri ya Kristo ase Yerusalemu ne chinsemo chionsi chietanaine goika Iluriko.

English: His father-in-law, the girl’s father, persuaded him to stay, so he remained with him three days, eating, drinking, and lodging there.
Kiswahili: Baba mkwe wake, yaani, baba yake yule msichana, akamzuia ili akae, hivyo akakaa na huyo baba mkwe wake kwa siku tatu, wakila, wakinywa na kulala huko.
Ekegusii: Ise biara akamobooria abeere aroro; erio akaba amo nere amatuko atato, bakaria na konywa, bakarara aroro.

English: Your wealth and your treasures I will give up as plunder, without charge for all your sins within all your borders.
Kiswahili: Utajiri wako na hazina zako nitavitoa kuwa nyara, bila gharama, kwa sababu ya dhambi zako zote katika nchi yako yote.
Ekegusii: “Obotenenku ne chinibo chiaino nimbirue bibe ebisakorwa, tibigoakanwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe ebinge ase ense yaino yonsi.

English: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
Kiswahili: Umati wa watu ulipokuwa unazidi kuongezeka, Yesu akaendelea kusema, “Hiki ni kizazi kiovu. Kinatafuta ishara, lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ya Yona.
Ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yamentekanete, agachaaka gokwana, “Ekegori eke nekegori ekebe, gekorigia egekone buna ekemanyererio, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki'omobani Yona.

English: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Kiswahili: Fungulia ukali wa ghadhabu yako, mtafute kila mwenye kiburi umshushe,
Ekegusii: Siara ekeririanda gi'okogechigwa kwao, erio origererie kera omonto ore omoenenu, omokeyie.

English: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
Kiswahili: Akawarudia ndugu zake na kusema, “Kijana hayuko mle! Nielekee wapi sasa?”
Ekegusii: akeonchora gochia ase abamwabo, akabateebia: “Omwana timonyoreti ase engoro. Ng'ai rende nkogenda?”

English: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.
Kiswahili: Sikukuu ya Vibanda ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
Ekegusii: Naende rituko rinene ri’Ebigutu ri’Abayahudi nigo riarenge ang’e.

English: until he has rendered to every man according to his deeds, and repaid the works of men according to their plans, until he has judged the cause of his people, and he will make them rejoice in his mercy.
Kiswahili: mpaka atakapomlipa kila mtu kulingana na matendo yake, na kuwalipa wanadamu kulingana na mipango yao, hadi atakapowahukumu watu wake, na kuwafurahisha katika rehema zake.
Ekegusii: ase okomosoera ere oria omorenteire emechaando yaye.

English: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
Kiswahili: Ee dunia, tetemeka mbele za Bwana, mbele za Mungu wa Yakobo,
Ekegusii: Aye ense, tengecha ase obosio Omonene, ee, ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: Then Elisha said, “Get some flour.” He threw it into the pot and said, “Pour it out for the people to eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot. Feeding a Hundred Men (Matthew 15:29–39; Mark 8:1–10)
Kiswahili: Elisha akasema, “Leteni unga.” Akauweka ndani ya chungu na kusema, “Wagawie watu ili wale.” Wala hapakuwa na kitu chochote chenye madhara ndani ya chungu. Watu Mia Wanalishwa
Ekegusii: Elisha agateeba: “Renta obosie!” Erio akabobeeka ase enyongo ime, agateeba: “Bekera abanto endagera eye barie.” Bono egento gi’okorenta amabe tikiarenge ase enyongo eria ime.

English: and if it does evil in My sight and does not listen to My voice, then I will relent of the good I had intended for it.
Kiswahili: ikiwa utafanya maovu mbele zangu na hukunitii, ndipo nitakapoghairi makusudio yangu mema niliyokuwa nimeyakusudia.
Ekegusii: na abanto abwo kobarakore ebibe ase obosio bwane bange konyigwera, inche ning’onchoke, ntige amaya aria narengereretie kobakorera.

English: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!” The Greatest Commandment (Deuteronomy 6:1–19; Matthew 22:34–40)
Kiswahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai. Kwa hiyo mmekosea kabisa.” Amri Iliyo Kuu (Mathayo 22:34-40; Luka 10:25-28)
Ekegusii: Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende bw’abare moyo; ase ayio nigo mogosira mono.” Ogochika okonene (Mat 22:34-40)

English: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa wema wa radhi yako uifanye Sayuni istawi, ukazijenge upya kuta za Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene okorere Sayoni amaya ase amaabera ao; oagache chindwaki chia Yerusalemu.

English: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don't spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
Kiswahili: “Panua mahali pa hema lako, tandaza mapazia ya hema lako uyaeneze mbali, wala usiyazuie; ongeza urefu wa kamba zako, imarisha vigingi vyako.
Ekegusii: “Gareyia aase okobeeka eema yao; orambore ebitambaa bi'eema yao. Tobaisa gotiga korambora chingori na gokong'ia ebirochi!

English: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Nitaipanda Israeli katika nchi yao wenyewe, hawatangʼolewa tena kutoka nchi ambayo nimewapa,” asema Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Nimbairanie mbabeeke bamenye ase ense yabo, tibagotegorwa korwa ase ense eyio nabaete.” Nabo Omonene, Nyasae oino, ateebire.

English: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.'
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu unaghadhibika dhidi yangu, na ufidhuli wako umefika masikioni mwangu, nitaweka ndoana yangu puani mwako na hatamu yangu kinywani mwako, nami nitakufanya urudi kwa njia ile uliyoijia.'
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio ase 'nde, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime na ekeokio kiane ki'ogokoraa ase omonwa oo; ninkoiranie ogende ase enchera eria gwacherete.

English: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
Kiswahili: Kondoo wangu huisikia sauti yangu nami nawajua, nao hunifuata,
Ekegusii: Ching’ondi chiane nigo chikoigwa eriogi riane, na inche ninchimanyete, na chirochio nigo chigontunyana;

English: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete nne za dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza hiyo, na uzifungie kwenye pembe nne, pale penye miguu yake minne.
Ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi'echitaabu ase emesa eria, ochibeeke ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye,

English: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa hamsini utakuwa yubile kwenu, msipande wala msivune kile kiotacho chenyewe, au kuvuna zabibu zisizohudumiwa.
Ekegusii: Omwaka oyo bw’emerongo etano nobe oyio bw’Omochengo ase more. Ase omwaka oyio timobusura kende, gose kogesa echiemeretie korwa ase chimbusuro chiagwete inse, gose timosangereria amasabibu korwa emesabibu etacheeretwe.

English: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
Kiswahili: Nao wakaanza kumshtaki wakisema: “Tumemwona huyu mtu akipotosha taifa letu, akiwazuia watu wasilipe kodi kwa Kaisari na kujiita kuwa yeye ni Kristo, mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Bagachaaka komosoera, bakobora, “Twanyorire omonto oyo oonchoire ense yaito, otokanirie titoa Kaisari ebango, okobora ng’a ere omonyene nere Kristo omorwoti.”

English: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia: “Jihadharini mtu yeyote asiwadanganye.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachaaka kobateebia, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang'aina,

English: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.
Kiswahili: Kwa uchungu na hasira, mfalme wa Israeli akaenda kwenye jumba lake la kifalme huko Samaria.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli akagenda bwoye ore nomoichano na obororo bw'endamwamu, agaika Samaria.

English: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
Kiswahili: Malaika wangu atatangulia mbele yako na kukuleta katika nchi ya Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nami nitawafutilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Naki omomalaika one nagotang'ane akoire na kogoikia ase ense y'Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abakanaani, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, na inche nimbasirie.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth', nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom', but ‘The valley of Slaughter'.
Kiswahili: Hivyo jihadharini, siku zinakuja, asema Bwana, wakati watu hawatapaita tena mahali hapa Tofethi ama Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, bali Bonde la Machinjo.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire, “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, aase aria atarokwe Tofeti, gose Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, korende nigo rirarokwe Rikura ri'Okonyenyera.

English: As the troops were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs, and with tambourines and other instruments.
Kiswahili: Watu walipokuwa wanarudi nyumbani baada ya Daudi kumuua yule Mfilisti, wanawake wakaja kutoka pande zote za miji ya Israeli kumlaki Mfalme Sauli kwa kuimba na kucheza, kwa nyimbo za furaha na kwa matari na zeze.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Daudi are koirana, ekero aitire Omofilisti oria, na abarwani b’esegi bakoirana boigo, abakungu bagaacha korwa ase emechie yonsi bakana‐goteera na gotenga bare nomogooko, bakobugia chikonu ne chinchigiri.

English: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
Kiswahili: Watawatenga na masinagogi. Naam, saa yaja ambayo mtu yeyote atakayewaua atadhani kwa kufanya hivyo anamtumikia Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabaabaserie korwa ase chisinagogi; nabo engaki neche ekero onde bwensi arabaite akage ng'a okoreire Nyasae emeremo.

English: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndivyo zilivyokuwa nyuso zao. Mabawa yao yalikunjuliwa kuelekea juu, kila mmoja alikuwa na mabawa mawili ambayo kila moja liligusa bawa la mwenzake kila upande na mabawa mengine mawili yakifunika mwili wake.
Ekegusii: Amasio abo nabo arenge igo. Chimbaaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire gochia igoro; chimbaaba ibere chia kera ekemo chigakunana nechi'ekende, na ibere chinde chia kera ekemo chigatuba emebere yabo.

English: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.
Kiswahili: Wataanguka waliouawa katika Babeli, wakiwa na majeraha ya kutisha barabarani zake.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo mbaitwe ase ense y'Abakalidayo, babe bakwete ase chinchera chi'emechie yabo.

English: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwenye dhambi? Kama nawaambia yaliyo kweli, mbona hamniamini?
Ekegusii: Ning'o ase egati yaino okong'orokia ng'a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene, naki inwe motakonyegena?

English: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwaje katika Sheria? Kwani unasoma nini humo?”
Ekegusii: Ere akamobooria, “Ase amachiiko inki keriikire? Naki ogosoma?”

English: the Shemidaite clan from Shemida, and the Hepherite clan from Hepher.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Shemida, ukoo wa Washemida; kutoka kwa Heferi, ukoo wa Waheferi.
Ekegusii: na Abasemida, abarwete ase Semida, na Abaheferi, abarwete ase Heferi.

English: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
Kiswahili: Aache uovu, atende mema, aitafute amani na kuifuatilia.
Ekegusii: Otige amabe, okore amaya; origie omorembe na koyobwata mono.

English: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.
Kiswahili: Akaviweka hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe, na kuviinua mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko Aroni, na ay’abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
Kiswahili: Kisha tukageuka tukakwea kufuata njia iliyoelekea Bashani, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani akaondoka na jeshi lake lote kupigana na sisi huko Edrei.
Ekegusii: “Magega y’ayio tokaonchoka, togatiira gochia sugusu gochia ase orogongo rwa Basani. Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, amo n’abanto baye bonsi, bagaacha gotorwania esegi agwo ase omochie o Edirei.

English: Don't look around in the streets of the city. Don't wander in its deserted places.
Kiswahili: Usiangalie huku na huko katika mitaa ya mji, Usitangatanga katika maeneo yake yaliyoachwa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Tokona komagaga chichiro goeta gose konakoombogana ebinucha-nuchi ime aye bweka.

English: but because there was no opposing the king, he watched his time to execute this purpose by strategy.
Kiswahili: lakini kwa sababu hakukuwa na mpinzani mfalme, aliangalia wakati wake wa kutekeleza kusudi hili kwa mkakati.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho atatagete kobuna ogochika kw'omorwoti, agachaaka korigia enchera y'okobwata Yuda.

English: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yeriko wakajenga sehemu zilizopakana nao, naye Zakuri mwana wa Imri akajenga karibu nao.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yeriko bakamobwatia, bakaagacha ensemo ende; na oyobwatetie abanto aba, n'Sakuri, mosinto o Imuri.

English: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you should lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
Kiswahili: “Baba yako aliweka nira nzito juu yetu, lakini sasa tupunguzie kazi za kikatili na nira nzito aliyoweka juu yetu, nasi tutakutumikia.”
Ekegusii: “Iso igo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe natogokorere.”

English: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their leaders gave him a staff—one for each of the leaders of their tribes, twelve staffs in all. And Aaron’s staff was among them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akasema na Waisraeli, nao viongozi wao wakampa fimbo kumi na mbili, fimbo moja kwa ajili ya kila kabila la baba zao, nayo fimbo ya Aroni ikiwa miongoni mwa hizo.
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Abaisraeli, akabateebia amang’ana ayio, na abaraai bonsi be chiamate chia kera egesaku bakamoa chinyimbo chiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, na enyimbo ya Aroni nigo yarenge ase egati ye chinyimbo chiria.

English: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
Kiswahili: Ninyi amueni. Je, nije kwenu na fimbo, au nije kwa upendo na kwa roho ya upole?
Ekegusii: Naki morigetie? Inchiche ase more nenyimbo gose nobwanchani ase omoika bw'obwororo?

English: Paul replied, “I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.
Kiswahili: Paulo akasema, “Mimi sasa nimesimama mbele ya mahakama ya Kaisari, ambako ndiko ninakostahili kushtakiwa. Kama vile wewe mwenyewe ujuavyo vyema kabisa sijawatendea Wayahudi kosa lolote.
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agateeba: “Inche nigo nteneine aiga bosio bw’ekegambero gia Kaisari, ase ngwenerete kogamberigwa; timochereti Abayahudi ring’ana buna aye omanyete buya.

English: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
Kiswahili: kwamba uzao wake utaendelea milele, na kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu mbele zangu kama jua;
Ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki'obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.

English: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.” Take Up Your Cross (Mark 8:34–38; Luke 9:23–27)
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akageuka na kumwambia Petro, “Rudi nyuma yangu, Shetani! Wewe ni kikwazo kwangu. Moyo wako hauwazi yaliyo ya Mungu, bali ya wanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akeonchora, agateebia Petero, “Irana magega y’ane, Saitani! Aye nigo origetie koba egetango ase inde, ekiagera ebirengererio biao tibiri ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mar 8:34; 9:1; Luk 9:23-27)

English: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.'”
Kiswahili: Yule mnyama wa kumi hatachaguliwa kwa kigezo cha uzuri au ubaya, naye haruhusiwi kubadiliwa. Ikiwa atabadiliwa, basi mnyama yule wa kwanza na huyo aliyebadiliwa wote watahesabiwa kuwa watakatifu, na haiwezekani kuwakomboa.' ”
Ekegusii: Omonyene eng'iti eria takoriga — rigereria, onye ere engiya gose embe, na takoyeonchoreria. Onye omonto okoonchoreria ching'iti echio, erio chionsi ibere nchibe chinchenu, tichikoboorigwa.”

English: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is a brawler, and whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Kiswahili: Mvinyo ni mdhihaki na kileo ni mgomvi; yeyote apotoshwaye navyo hana hekima.
Ekegusii: Edivai nigo ekorenta echeche, ekenyugwa egetindi nigo gekorenta eriomana; na onde bwensi otari gokianga nigo akoborwa obong’aini.

English: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
Kiswahili: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu zifunge kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na uzishikamanishe na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.
Ekegusii: Chinsinyo chinde chi'ebichanga biria bibere ochisiberanie nebikonde biria bibere, naende obibwateranie bionsi ase ebitwanga bi'amareko bire bosio ase egesibao ki'obokuani.

English: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother along with Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu Mwenyezi awajalieni rehema mbele ya huyo mtu ili apate kumwachia yule ndugu yenu na Benyamini mweze kurudi pamoja. Kwangu mimi kama nikufiwa nimefiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae Omobui abae ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyio, erio abasiborere oria omino onde, erinde moirane nere amo na Benjamini. Onye inche ekongwenera nsirerwe nabana baane, tiga abe bo.”

English: His bones are tubes of bronze; his limbs are rods of iron.
Kiswahili: Mifupa yake ni bomba za shaba, maungo yake ni kama fito za chuma.
Ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo are amakong’u buna emebirangwa eroisirie korwa ase etai; ee, amauga ’omobere oye nigo anga buna emeriibo y’ebioma.

English: Those who had fallen by the sword plus those who were burned were about eight thousand men.
Kiswahili: Wale walioanguka kwa upanga pamoja na wale walioteketezwa walikuwa kama watu elfu nane.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio, abanto goika 8,000 bagaitwa goetera ase omoro gose omorero.

English: This is what the LORD says: “As the new wine is found in a cluster of grapes, and men say, ‘Do not destroy it, for it contains a blessing,’ so I will act on behalf of My servants; I will not destroy them all.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kama vile divai mpya ingali bado inapatikana katika kishada cha zabibu, nao watu husema, ‘Usikiharibu, kwa kuwa bado kuna kitu kizuri ndani yake,’ hivyo ndivyo nitakavyofanya kwa ajili ya watumishi wangu; sitawaangamiza wote.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Buna koreng’ana edivai ekonyorekana korwa ase egesago ki’omosabibu, na abanto bateeba: Timogesaria, ekiagera ogosesenigwa nkore ime yaye, naboigo ndakore ase engencho y’abasomba baane, tingoita na gosiria abanto abwo bonsi.

English: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.
Kiswahili: Wakaenda mashambani mwao kuvuna zabibu na kuzisindika hizo zabibu, wakafanya sikukuu katika hekalu la mungu wao. Wakati wakila na kunywa, wakamlaani Abimeleki.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakageenda ase emegondo y'emesabibu, bagatora amasabibu, bakayamita, bakaroisia edivai na gokora omoyega omonene. Bagasoa ase enyomba y'enyasae yabo, bakaria na konywa, erio bakaragereria Abimeleki.

English: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakawatoa hao wafalme watano nje ya pango: wafalme wa Yerusalemu, Hebroni, Yarmuthi, Lakishi na Egloni.
Ekegusii: Aya agakoreka. Bakarusia abarwoti baria batano korwa ase rikuruma: omorwoti o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yerimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw'Egiloni, bakabarenta ase Yoshua.

English: A large number of the people—many from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun—had not purified themselves, yet they ate the Passover, contrary to what was written. But Hezekiah interceded for them, saying, “May the LORD, who is good, provide atonement for everyone
Kiswahili: Ingawa watu wengi miongoni mwa wale waliotoka Efraimu, Manase, Isakari na Zabuloni walikuwa hawajajitakasa, hata hivyo walikula Pasaka kinyume na ilivyoandikwa. Lakini Hezekia akawaombea, akisema, “ Bwana, ambaye ni mwema na amsamehe kila mmoja
Ekegusii: Abanto abange korwa ase Abaefraimu, na Abamanase, na Abaisakaru, na Abasabuloni, konya tibarechena; korende nonya naboigo, bakaria chinyama chi’eching’ondi chi’Epasaka buna ogochika gotarenge goteeba. Hezekia konya obasabeire, ogoteeba, Omonene, ase obuya bwao ororere kera oyomo amaabera,

English: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
Kiswahili: Naye Labani akamtoa Zilpa, mtumishi wake wa kike, kuwa mtumishi wa Lea, binti yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Labani akarua omosomba oye omoiseke okorokwa Silpa, abe omokoreri o Lea, omwana oye.

English: Yahweh will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa mtu yeyote atendaye jambo hili, Bwana na amkatilie mbali kutoka hema za Yakobo, hata kama huwa anamletea Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote sadaka.
Ekegusii: Omonene nasirie korwa ase chinyomba chia Yakobo onde bwensi ogokora amang'ana ayio karabe Omwarimu gose omworokigwa, nonya noyokorenta ekeng'wanso ase Omonene bw'Emeganda.

English: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Vumilia taabu pamoja nasi kama askari mwema wa Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naye oremererie emechando buna omorwani omuya o Kristo Yeso.

English: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
Kiswahili: Nanyoosha mikono yangu kwako, nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu kama ardhi kame.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorambora amaboko aane goocha asore, omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, buna riroba rirang’ete embura.

English: the priest shall go outside the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days.
Kiswahili: kuhani atatoka na kufunga mlango wa nyumba hiyo kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: erio Omokuani asoke korwa ase enyomba eyio, na ayesieke ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nitawezaje kuvumilia kuona maafa yakiwapata watu wangu? Nitawezaje kuvumilia kuona maangamizi ya jamaa yangu?”
Ekegusii: Naki ndakore ndemererie ndore amabe ayio akobacheera abaminto? Gose naki ndakore ndemererie ndore abanto b'egesaku kiane bagosirigwa.”

English: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, umemwonyesha mtumishi wako ukuu wako na mkono wako wenye uweza. Kwa kuwa ni mungu yupi aliye mbinguni au duniani anayeweza kufanya kazi na matendo makuu kama ufanyayo wewe?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bono kwanyorokirie inche, omosomba oo, omochakano bwoka bw’obonene bwao, n’okoboko kwao gwechinguru. Enyasae ende teri, igoro gose ase ense, eranyaare gokora emeremo emenene na eyechinguru buna ey’ogokora aye.

English: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God's Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.
Kiswahili: Lakini umati wa watu ukafahamu alikokwenda, ukamfuata. Akawakaribisha na kunena nao kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu na kuwaponya wale wote waliokuwa wanahitaji uponyaji.
Ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora, ekamotunyana, na ere akabaroisia, agakwana nabarabwo amang'ana 'oborwoti bwa Nyasae, akagwenia abarenge nokogania gw'okogwenigwa.

English: Then I will give you shepherds after My own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nitawapeni wachungaji wanipendezao moyo wangu, ambao watawaongoza kwa maarifa na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Nimbae inwe abarisia abaya, abarangokie ase enkoro yane, abarabaragerie bare nobong’ani na okomanya.

English: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Watoto na wake zetu, makundi ya mbuzi na kondoo, na makundi ya ngʼombe zetu, watabaki hapa katika miji ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Abana baito na abakungu barabwo tiga batigare amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaito aiga ase emechie ya Gileadi.

English: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where he found a disciple named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman and a Greek father.
Kiswahili: Paulo akafika Derbe na kisha Listra, ambako kulikuwa na mwanafunzi mmoja jina lake Timotheo, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Myahudi aliyeamini, lakini baba yake alikuwa Myunani.
Ekegusii: Agaika Deribe na Listra, ase omworokigwa oyomo amenyete, erieta riaye Timotheo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omoyahudi, korende ise n’Omogiriki orenge.

English: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
Kiswahili: Uyalinde maisha yangu na uniokoe, usiniache niaibike, kwa maana nimekukimbilia wewe.
Ekegusii: Renda omoyo one na ontoorie; naye ngotamera tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe.

English: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
Kiswahili: Aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke, akawabariki. Walipokwisha kuumbwa, akawaita “mwanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabatonga omosacha na omokungu, akabasesenia, akabaroka Mwanyabaanto.

English: Abimelech replied, “I do not know who has done this. You did not tell me, so I have not heard about it until today.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Abimeleki akasema, “Sijui ni nani ambaye amefanya hili. Hukuniambia, leo tu ndipo ninasikia habari zake.”
Ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Inche timanyeti ning’o okorete ring’ana erio, gose tikwana gonteebia; nonya nokoigwa, tinana koyaigwa otatiga reero rioka.”

English: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
Kiswahili: la sivyo watanirarua kama simba na kunichana vipande vipande, asiwepo wa kuniokoa.
Ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo barantaborane bare buna chindo, 'mbankurure gochia aase omonto onde otache gontooria.

English: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Solomoni akasema, “Bwana alisema kwamba ataishi katika giza nene;
Ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akabora, “Omonene obekire erioba igoro, korende oteebire ng'a narigetie komenya ase omosunte ekerima.

English: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,' and so they settled a matter.
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akaendelea kusema, “Zamani za kale walikuwa wakisema, ‘Wakaulize ushauri huko Abeli,' hivyo kulimaliza lile shauri.
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Agwo kare abanto nigo banarete goteeba: Geenda Abeli, omochie oyio, erinde onyore ogoseemigwa; ayio naro arenge gokoora amang'ana abo.

English: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Tiro, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu ameuza jumuiya nzima ya mateka kwa Edomu, na kutokujali mapatano ya undugu,
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’ abanto ba Turo ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima ase ense ya Edomu, tibainyorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’obomwabo.

English: For the wisdom of the Lord is great. He is mighty in power, and sees all things.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hekima ya Bwana ni kuu, Yeye ni mkuu katika uweza, na huona mambo yote.
Ekegusii: Chisemi chia Nyasae n'echinene kegima; ere nigo abwate chinguru chi'obomanyi bwa kera egento.

English: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness'?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyemwelekeza katika njia zake, au kumwambia, ‘Wewe umetenda yasiyo sawa'?
Ekegusii: Ning'o ochikeire Nyasae enchera yaye? Gose ning'o oranyare komoteebia: Aye gwakorire bobe?

English: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu alipoiangamiza miji ya tambarare alimkumbuka Abrahamu, akamtoa Loti kutoka kwenye lile janga lililoharibu miji ile ambamo Loti alikuwa ameishi.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Nyasae asaretie emechie eyio y'ense eraire, akaba okoinyora Aburaamu, akarusia Loti ase ogosarigwa koria, ekero asambete emechie eyio ase Loti amenyete.

English: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya kufukiza uvumba pamoja na mipiko yake, mafuta ya upako na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri; pazia la mlangoni mahali pa kuingilia ndani ya maskani;
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa amo nemiaro yaye, na amaguta akweakwa, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya, na ebitambaa bigosungwa ase egesoero ki'Obomenyo obwo;

English: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter and the glory of kings to search it out.
Kiswahili: Ni Utukufu wa Mungu kuficha jambo, bali ni utukufu wa wafalme kuchunguza jambo.
Ekegusii: Nigo bore obonene bwa Nyasae kobisa amang’ana; korende na obonene bw’abarwoti gokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio.

English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
Kiswahili: Wasalimu Prisila na Akila, na wote wa nyumbani kwa Onesiforo.
Ekegusii: Nkw'anerie Priska na Akwila, na abanto b'enyomba y'Onesiforo.

English: So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says: “Do men fall and not get up again? Does one turn away and not return?
Kiswahili: “Waambie, ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “ ‘Je, watu wanapoanguka hawainuki? Je, mtu anapopotea harudi?
Ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, okwane nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Ekero abanto bakogwa, inee, tibari koimoka naende? Onye omonto oonchokire na otigire enchera, tari koonchoka oirana?

English: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mkikataa kutahiriwa, tutamchukua ndugu yetu na kuondoka.”
Ekegusii: Korende motancheti mwarokigwe, rirorio nigo torarusie omoiseke oito aa, togende nere.”

English: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu atawatuma malaika zake, nao watakusanya kutoka Ufalme wake kila kitu kinachosababisha dhambi na watenda maovu wote.
Ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto natome abamalaika baye, na barabwo nabasangererie na kobarusia korwa ase oborwoti bwaye abakogera abande bagochwe, na abagokora ebibe bonsi,

English: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.
Kiswahili: Naye akajibu, “Nimekubali. Na iwe kama mnavyosema.” Kwa hiyo akaagana nao, nao wakaondoka. Yeye akaifunga ile kamba nyekundu dirishani.
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Abe buna mwateeba.” Akabatiga bakagenda. Erio agasiba engori eria embariri ase ekebao keria.

English: “When those who came from the king blasphemed, your angel went out, and struck among them one hundred eighty-five thousand.
Kiswahili: "Wale waliotoka kwa mfalme walipokufuru, malaika wako alitoka, akawapiga watu mia moja na themanini na tano elfu miongoni mwao."
Ekegusii: “Omonene, ekero abanto baria batometwe bakoraamete, omomalaika oo nigo abaitete Abaashuru 185,000.

English: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, mtumishi wa mtu wa Mungu alipoamka na kutoka nje, jeshi, pamoja na farasi na magari ya vita, likawa limeuzunguka mji. Mtumishi wake akasema, “Ole wetu, bwana wangu! Tutafanya nini?”
Ekegusii: Ekero omosomba bw'omonto oria o Nyasae abogeete mambia chuni, agasoka isiko, akarora omoganda oria bw'abasikari, amo ne chigari ne chibarasi, agateeba: “Obee, omonene one! Ninki togokora?”

English: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akamjibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu aliye hai.”
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae ore moyo.”

English: He both saw and measured her. He rained down skill and knowledge of understanding, and exalted the honor of those who hold her fast.
Kiswahili: Alimwona na kumpima. Alimnyeshea ujuzi na maarifa ya ufahamu, na akainua heshima ya wale wanaomshikilia.
Ekegusii: Okomwancha Nyasae nigo enga buna okobekerwa engobo y'echisemi, n'echisemi nigo akorenta omorembe amo n'obogima obuya bw'omobere.

English: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
Kiswahili: Elisha akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Je, ni nini kinachoweza kufanyika kwa ajili yake?” Gehazi akasema, “Hakika, hana mwana, na mume wake ni mzee.”
Ekegusii: Elisha akabooria: “Ngento ki omokungu oyo agwenerete akorerwe?” Gehasi akairaneria: “Naremeire egento ekemo, tabwati omwana, na omosacha oye ogotire.”

English: And all who were distressed or indebted or discontented rallied around him, and he became their leader. About four hundred men were with him.
Kiswahili: Wale wote waliokuwa katika dhiki au waliokuwa na madeni au wale ambao hawakuridhika wakamkusanyikia Daudi, naye akawa kiongozi wao. Watu wapatao 400 walikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Abanto bachandegete, na abwo babwate chisira, na abwo bataisanegete nobogima bwabo, bakamochiera, nere akaba omotang’ani obo. Abanto abasacha abaarenge amo nere nigo baarenge koreng’ana amagana ane.

English: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn't please Isaac, his father.
Kiswahili: Esau akatambua jinsi ambavyo baba yake Isaki anavyowachukia binti za Wakanaani.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero Esau arooche ng'a Isaka ise tancheti abaiseke abwo b'Abakaanani,

English: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
Kiswahili: Abiezeri kutoka Anathothi; Mebunai, Mhushathi;
Ekegusii: Abieseri korwa Anatoti, na Mebunai korwa Husa;

English: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, atop the burning wood on the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watapanga vile vipande vya nyama, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya huyo mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Naende abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, babeeke ebitari biria, amo nomotwe n’ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasiimero.

English: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
Kiswahili: Basi Yohana alivaa mavazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa singa za ngamia, akiwa na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake. Chakula chake kilikuwa nzige na asali ya mwitu.
Ekegusii: Ere Yohana nigo arenge kobeeka chianga chiaroiseirie amarionya y’engamia na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenama kiaye, na endagera yaye nigo yarenge chingige na obooke bw’orosana.

English: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mwapotoka kwa sababu hamjui Maandiko wala uweza wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwasirire inwe, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae.

English: He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
Kiswahili: Yeye amwibiaye baba yake na kumfukuza mama yake ni mwana aletaye aibu na fedheha.
Ekegusii: Omwana ore omotindi ase ise na ogoseria ng’ina, nigo akorenta obosooku na ogochaaya.

English: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
Kiswahili: Angalia basi, kwa maana Bwana amekuchagua wewe ili ujenge Hekalu kuwa mahali patakatifu. Uwe hodari ukafanye kazi hiyo.”
Ekegusii: Bono bwerende, ekiagera Omonene ogochorire oagache enyomba ebe Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu. Obe omokong'u na okore ayio.”

English: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
Kiswahili: Sasa kilio cha Waisraeli kimenifikia, nami nimeona jinsi Wamisri wanavyowatesa.
Ekegusii: Nainde bono ekerero ki’Abaisraeli giaikire ase ’nde, naende narorire ogochandwa koria Abamisiri bakobachanda,

English: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa akiingia ndani, Kornelio alikuja kumlaki, akaanguka miguuni pake kwa heshima.
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia gosoa omochie, Kornelio agasoka komoorotota, akagwa inse ase amagoro aye, akamosasiima.

English: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent, and discerning when he holds his tongue.
Kiswahili: Hata mtu mpumbavu hudhaniwa kuwa na hekima kama akinyamaza, na mwenye ufahamu kama akiuzuia ulimi wake.
Ekegusii: Nonya nomonto omoriri, ekero agokira, nigo akobarwa ng’a nomong’aini are. Ekero akomumeka omonwa oye nigo akorokwa omong’aini.

English: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yehu akawaandikia barua ya pili, akisema, “Ikiwa ninyi mko upande wangu na mtanitii mimi, twaeni vichwa vya wana wa bwana wenu, na mnijie huku Yezreeli kesho wakati kama huu.” Wakati huo wana sabini wa mfalme walikuwa wakiishi pamoja na viongozi wa mji wa Samaria, waliokuwa wakiwalea.
Ekegusii: Naende akabarikera riruube eria kabere, akabateebia: “Onye more ase ensemo yane, naende onye more ang'e konyigwera, butora emetwe y'abana b'omonene oino, na ankio, engaki buna eye mochiche ase 'nde aiga Yesireeli.” Abana b'omorwoti emerongo etano na ebere, nao bamenyete amo nabaanto abanene b'omochie, baria batenenerete.

English: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, macho yetu yalichoka, kwa kutazamia bure msaada; tuliangalia kutoka minara yetu kwa taifa lisiloweza kutuokoa.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aito arosire ase okorigereria, na okoganya bosa ng’a natokonywe; korwa ase ebitengero biaito, nigo twaganyete egesaku getanyare gototooria.

English: Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am cleansed from my sin”?
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kusema, “Nimeuweka moyo wangu safi; mimi ni safi na sina dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyaare goteeba, “Nasibekire ase enkoro y’ane; nachenekire korwa ase ebibe biane”?

English: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Kiswahili: Lakini niliwapa Wareubeni na Wagadi eneo kuanzia Gileadi hadi Bonde la Arnoni (katikati ya bonde ulikuwa ndio mpaka), kuelekea mpaka Mto Yaboki, ambao ndio mpaka wa Waamoni.
Ekegusii: na abanto b'egesaku kia Rubeni na ab'egesaku kia Gadi 'nkabaa orogongo gochakera Gileadi goikera orooche rw'Arinoni. Egati‐gati y'orooche orwo ekaba orobebe rwabo rw'enseemo ya Irianyi, na orooche rwa Yaboki rokaba orobebe rwabo sugusu, orwarenge orobebe rw'Abaamoni.

English: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo, Leteni watu wengi wenye makelele dhidi yao na uwaache wapate hofu na watekwe nyara.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Nimbarentere omoganda bw' abanto obakorere bobe na kobasakora.

English: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wakafunika ardhi yote mpaka ardhi ikawa nyeusi. Wakatafuna kile chote kilichokuwa kimebakizwa na ile mvua ya mawe, kila kitu kiotacho mashambani pamoja na matunda kwenye miti. Hakuna kitu chochote cha kijani kilichosalia katika miti au mmea katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Chingige echio chigatuba ense eria yonsi goika ekamwama ti, chikaria ebimeri bionsi pi ase ense eria, na amatunda onsi y'emete, ebio bionsi bitasaretigwe nembura y'amagena. Tigiatigarete kemeri kende gionsi ekebese gose amato y'emete ase ense ya Misiri engima.

English: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Kiswahili: Mfuate haki na haki peke yake, ili mweze kuishi na kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa.
Ekegusii: Oboronge nabwo bwoka moraabe mokobwatia, erio nario moraabe moyo, na koira ense eri'Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.

English: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!
Kiswahili: Ole wako, ee nchi ambayo mfalme wako alikuwa mtumwa na ambayo wakuu wako hufanya karamu asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwao, aye ense, ekero omorwoti oo are omwana, na abagaambi bao bakobeera ase emeyega y'okwegokia ase chingaki chia mambia.

English: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan son of Gideoni.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Abidani mwana wa Gideoni.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.

English: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.
Kiswahili: “Gadi atashambuliwa ghafula na kundi la washambuliaji, lakini yeye atawageukia na kuwashinda kabisa.
Ekegusii: “Gadi namigwe nemeganda y’abauri, korende nere nabamige korwa magega.

English: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.
Kiswahili: Walipogeuka na kukimbia kuelekea nyikani hata kufikia mwamba wa Rimoni, Waisraeli wakawaua watu 5,000 wakiwa njiani. Wakawafuata kwa kasi mpaka Gidomu huko wakawaua watu wengine 2,000.
Ekegusii: Abatigarete bakeonchora, bagatama gochia erooro ase egetare kia Rimoni. Abanto chilifu isano bagaitwa ekero baare ase enchera gotama. Abaisraeli bakabwatia abatigarete naende goika Gidomi, n'abanto chilifu ibere bagaitwa.

English: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.
Kiswahili: “Angalieni, nitawafanya wadogo miongoni mwa mataifa, mtadharauliwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteebia egesaku kia Edomu “Rora, ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, obe kogochaywa mono na bonsi.

English: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
Kiswahili: Penueli akamzaa Gedori, naye Ezeri akamzaa Husha. Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrathi, na baba yake Bethlehemu.
Ekegusii: Penueli nigo arenge ise Abagedori, na Eseri ise Abahusa. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omotangi o Efarata, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu.

English: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,
Kiswahili: Solomoni alikuwa na wachukuzi wa mizigo 70,000 na wachonga mawe 80,000 huko vilimani,
Ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) abaarenge kobogoria chigurube, na abanto chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) abaarenge kobaacha amagena agwo ase ebitunwa.

English: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.
Kiswahili: wale ambao aliwaambia, “Hapa ni mahali pa kupumzika, waliochoka na wapumzike,” na, “Hapa ni mahali pa mapumziko,” lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo atebeetie abanto abwo: “Aiga nase agotimokerwa, tiga abwo barosire batimokere aiga, erinde banyore chinguru naende.” Korende abanto abwo tibaigwerete.

English: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, sikilizeni: Je, Mungu hakuwachagua wale walio maskini machoni pa ulimwengu kuwa matajiri katika imani na kuurithi Ufalme aliowaahidi wale wampendao?
Ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, tegerera! Inee! Nyasae tachorete abataka b’ense eye babe abanda ase okwegena, naende babe abanyamwando b’oborwoti obo abarierete eira, abwo bamwanchete?

English: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
Kiswahili: Jueni kila mahali anapojificha mrudi na kunipa taarifa kamili. Kisha nitakwenda pamoja nanyi; kama atakuwa katika eneo hilo, nitamsaka miongoni mwa koo zote za Yuda.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio genda momanyererie buya aase onsi obwebiso bore, erio moirane ase 'nde monteebie amaene, nainche ngende amo nainwe. Onye ore ase orogongo orwo, nimorigie ase egati ye chilifu chionsi chi'Abayuda.”

English: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
Kiswahili: Akamfungua yule mtu aliyekuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa kuhusika katika uasi dhidi ya serikali na mauaji. Akamkabidhi Yesu mikononi mwao, wamfanyie watakavyo.
Ekegusii: Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso ase bare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge.

English: After many days, Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nyingi Bwana akaniambia, “Nenda sasa Frati ukauchukue ule mkanda niliokuambia uufiche huko.”
Ekegusii: Magega y'amatuko amange gaetire Omonene aganteebia, “Imoka ogende goika Eufarati, orusie orokini roria nagochigeete ng'a orobise aroro, ororente aa.”

English: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
Kiswahili: Fedha yao wala dhahabu yao hazitaweza kuwaokoa katika siku hiyo ya ghadhabu ya Bwana. Katika moto wa wivu wake dunia yote itateketezwa, kwa maana ataleta mwisho wa wote wanaoishi katika dunia ghafula.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu y’Omonene chifeta chiabo ne chitaabu chiabo tibikonyara kobatooria. Ense yonsi nesambwe esirigwe nomorero bwe risemi riaye. Mobosokano narente omoerio bw’okoondokia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.

English: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
Kiswahili: Kornelio akajibu, “Siku nne zilizopita, nilikuwa nyumbani nikisali saa kama hii, saa tisa alasiri. Ghafula mtu aliyevaa nguo zilizongʼaa akasimama mbele yangu,
Ekegusii: Kornelio akamoiraneria: “Reero nerituko ria kane, korwa ekero narenge gosaba nyomba mwane chinsa buna echi, chinsa kianda. Ani! Omonto nateneine bosio bwane obekeire chianga chikomeka‐meka.

English: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akimwambia, “Mafuta ya mnyama na yachomwe kwanza, ndipo uchukue chochote unachotaka,” mtumishi angalijibu, “Hapana, nipe sasa, kama huwezi nitaichukua kwa nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria oreenge goteebia omosomba oria, “Tiga tosaambe enyama enoru ritang'ani, erio magega omanye koira enyama ende yonsi oganetie,” nere igo areenge goteeba, “Yaya, taibo, goika oyeeng'e bono iga. Onye tokong'a enyama eyio, rirorio nigo nkoyerusia ne chinguru, 'nyeire.”

English: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nanyi mnasema: ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’
Ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ochire, okoria na konywa, na inwe mogoteeba: Rora, nomonto omoribobe, ogotinda edivai, omosani bw’ababarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe!

English: For these things' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya mambo haya, ghadhabu ya Mungu inakuja.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yayio endamwamu ya Nyasae nebachere abanto batarikomoigwera.

English: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
Kiswahili: Ndugu aliyechukizwa ni mgumu kuridhika kuliko mji uliozungushiwa ngome, nayo mabishano ni kama malango ya ngome yenye makomeo.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere aakong'u koirania ase obosani omonto omocheirwe, kobua koirania omochie omokong'u, na eriomana nigo ringa buna emekorogoto y'ebiita bi'orwaki orokong'u.

English: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them, and they asked, “Is this Naomi?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hao wanawake wawili wakaondoka, wakafika Bethlehemu. Walipofika Bethlehemu, mji mzima ulitaharuki, wanawake wakashangaa, wakasema, “Huyu aweza kuwa ni Naomi?”
Ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo babere bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, goika bagaika Bethlehemu. Ekero baigete aroro, abanto bonsi b'omochie bakaeegaeega ase engencho yabo, na abakungu bakaboorania, bagoteeba, “Inee! Oyo Naomi?”

English: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into David's city until he had finished building his own house, Yahweh's house, and the wall around Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akafanya urafiki na Mfalme Farao wa Misri na kumwoa binti yake. Akamleta huyo binti katika Mji wa Daudi mpaka alipomaliza kujenga jumba lake la kifalme na Hekalu la Bwana, pamoja na ukuta kuzunguka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Sulemani agakora oboamate na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Akanyuoma omoiseke o Farao, akamorenta ase Omochie o Daudi akamenya aroro goika ekero akoorete koagacha enyomba yaye omonyene amo nenyomba y'Omonene ne chindwaki chiaetanaine Yerusalemu.

English: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
Kiswahili: Gileadi ni yangu na Manase ni yangu; Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.
Ekegusii: Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi'ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y'obogambi.

English: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
Kiswahili: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.

English: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
Kiswahili: Yeye amdhaminiye mgeni hakika atateseka, bali yeyote akataaye kuunga mkono dhamana ni salama.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwerua koba intenenera ase omonto omoao nigo agwesoyia ase emechando, korende oyo okwanga koba intenenera nigo erendete buya.

English: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
Kiswahili: wakati aliiwekea bahari mpaka wake ili maji yasivunje agizo lake, na wakati aliweka misingi ya dunia.
Ekegusii: na ekero abeekerete chinyancha chimbebe, amaache tabaisa goetania ogochika kwaye; na ekero abeegete amaroso y'ense nao narenge.

English: “Alas,” said the king of Israel, “for the LORD has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab!”
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Israeli akamaka, “Nini! Je, Bwana ametuita sisi wafalme watatu ili tu kututia mikononi mwa Moabu?”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli agateeba, “Obobe nobwaito! Omonene otorangeirie intwe abarwoti batato atobeke ase amaboko Abamoabu.”

English: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ninyi mwashuhudia na mnathibitisha kile baba zenu walichofanya. Wao waliwaua manabii, nanyi mnawajengea makaburi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo inwe mwabeire abarori na gwanchera ogokora gwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera nabwo baabaitete, na inwe mokoagacha chimbeera chiabo.

English: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
Kiswahili: Shemu ambaye ni ndugu mkubwa wa Yafethi, kwake kulizaliwa wana pia. Shemu alikuwa baba wa wana wote wa Eberi.
Ekegusii: Shemu, oyorenge sokoro y'abana b'Eberi, naende oyio neere orenge omomura omonene omwabo Yafeti, akaiborerwa abana.

English: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Mimi ninacho chakula ambacho ninyi hamkifahamu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”

English: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
Kiswahili: Wote hawana akili, tena ni wapumbavu, wanafundishwa na sanamu za miti zisizofaa lolote.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi tibamanyeti gento, nabariri bare. Naki ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano eyio nemete bosa.

English: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings. The Breastpiece (Exodus 39:8–21)
Kiswahili: na mikufu miwili ya dhahabu safi iliyosokotwa kama kamba, na uifunge mikufu hiyo kwenye vijalizo. Kifuko Cha Kifuani (Kutoka 39:8-21)
Ekegusii: na okore ebichanga bibere bie chitaabu chichenire, bisisire buna engori, bibwatanigwe nebikonde biria. Egesembe ki’obokuani (Okong’ 39:8-21)

English: Now when Jonathan heard the words of Apollonius, he was moved in his mind, and he chose ten thousand men, and went out from Jerusalem; and Simon his brother met him to help him.
Kiswahili: Yonathani aliposikia maneno ya Apolonio, aliingiwa na wasiwasi moyoni mwake, akachagua watu elfu kumi, akatoka Yerusalemu; na Simoni nduguye akamkuta ili amsaidie.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yonathani anyoorete amang'ana ayio korwa ase Apolonio, akabea mono. Agachoora abasikari 10,000 korwa Yerusalemu na Simioni momura omwabo nere akarenta abasikari bande. Ebiombe ebio

English: For they sought out all manner of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.
Kiswahili: Kwani walitafuta kila aina ya uovu, hadi kisasi kilipowajia.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera barabwo bateemete gokora kera engencho yobobe goika Omonene akabaakania egesiomba.

English: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
Kiswahili: Kura ya kwanza, ambayo ilikuwa kwa ajili ya Asafu, ilimwangukia Yosefu, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12 Ya pili ikamwangukia Gedalia, yeye na wanawe pamoja na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obomera obotang'ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y'Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi akaviweka vifaa hivi wakfu kwa Bwana kama vile alivyokuwa amefanya kwa fedha na dhahabu aliyokuwa ameitwaa katika mataifa yote haya: Edomu na Moabu, Waamoni, Wafilisti na Waamaleki.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebio boigo Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chifeta ne chitaabu biria asakorete korwa ase ebisaku binde bionsi, korwa ase Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafirisiti, na Abaameleki.

English: They see false visions and speak lying divinations. They claim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ when the LORD did not send them; yet they wait for the fulfillment of their message.
Kiswahili: Maono yao ni ya uongo na ubashiri wao ni wa udanganyifu. Wao husema, “ Bwana amesema,” wakati Bwana hakuwatuma, bado wakitarajia maneno yao kutimizwa.
Ekegusii: Amaroro abo nay’obong’ainereria, na oboringoria bwabo nobw’oborimo. Barabwo nigo bagoteeba iga: Omonene oteebire bo. Korende Omonene tabatometi. Nonya naboigo, nigo basemeretie ng’a Omonene naikeranie amang’ana abo baabanire.

English: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka miwili sasa imekuwepo njaa katika nchi, pia kwa miaka mitano ijayo hapatakuwepo kulima wala kuvuna.
Ekegusii: Omwaka oyo noyo o kabere enchara ere ase ense, naende netigarete emiaka etano abanto batareme gose kogesa.

English: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakienda mji kwa mji, wakawa wanawapa maamuzi yaliyotolewa na mitume na wazee huko Yerusalemu ili wayafuate.
Ekegusii: Nabo, ekero barenge goeta egati y'emechie eria, bakabaa amachiiko aria achiigetwe nabatomwa n'abagaaka abarenge Yerusalemu, erinde bayabwate.

English: Isn't their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.'
Kiswahili: Je, kamba za hema yao hazikungʼolewa, hivyo hufa bila hekima?'
Ekegusii: Bionsi ebi'abaanto abwo basemeretie nigo bigosira kegima. Nigo bagokwa bataraikera komanya obong'aini bonde bwonsi.

English: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, kama mkiwa na imani wala msiwe na shaka, si kwamba mtaweza kufanya tu yale yaliyofanyika kwa huu mtini, bali hata mkiuambia huu mlima, ‘Ngʼoka, ukatupwe baharini,’ litafanyika.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene nabateebirie; Komorabe nokwegena motabeti na tangutangu chinde, tari erio ri’omoko rioka morakore, korende ’namoteebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime, na rikoreke.

English: So men of all nations came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
Kiswahili: Watu wa mataifa yote wakaja kusikiliza hekima ya Solomoni, waliotumwa na wafalme wote wa ulimwengu, waliokuwa wamesikia juu ya hekima yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakarwa ase chinse chionsi, bagacha koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani, na abarwoti bonsi b’ense bagatoma abanto bagachia komoigwa.

English: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
Kiswahili: Roho yao itokapo hurudi mavumbini, siku hiyo hiyo mipango yao yote hukoma.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoika orure ase omonto, ere nigo akoirana ase amaroba, ase arwete. Ase rituko erio erio emeroberio yaye nigo egosira.

English: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
Kiswahili: Sivyo walivyo waovu! Wao ni kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibari bo, korende nigo banga buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.

English: The Israelites also mobilized, gathered supplies, and marched out to meet them. The Israelites camped before them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Waisraeli kukusanywa na kupewa mahitaji, walikwenda kukabiliana nao. Waisraeli wakapiga kambi mkabala nao kama makundi mawili madogo ya mbuzi, wakati Waaramu walienea katika nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaroberigwa na koariganerigwa chindagera, bakagenda korwania Abasiiria. Abaisraeli bagatoora korigererania n’Abasiiria, bakarorekana buna amaicho abere amake e chimbori, korende Abasiiria bagaichora aase aria.

English: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
Kiswahili: “Ugonjwa mbaya sana umempata, kamwe hatainuka tena kitandani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Noborwaire boramoite bwamonyorire, takoboka naende korwa ase araire”.

English: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wakaja kumsihi Daudi ale chochote kulipokuwa kungali bado mchana; lakini Daudi akaapa, akisema, “Mungu na anishughulikie, tena kwa ukali, kama nikionja mkate au kitu kingine chochote kabla ya jua kutua!”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagaacha koebereria Daudi arie endagera, korende Daudi agatiana, ogoteeba, “Nyasae ang'e egesusuru bono na kogenderera onye 'nkoria endagera erioba ritaragwa.”

English: for you are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? Are you not walking in the way of man?
Kiswahili: Ninyi bado ni watu wa mwilini. Kwa kuwa bado kuna wivu na magombano miongoni mwenu, je, ninyi si watu wa mwilini? Je, si mwaendelea kama watu wa kawaida?
Ekegusii: ekiagera nonya mbono nigo more abanto b’engencho y’ebibe. Naki onye more ne ribero na eriomana ase egati yaino, Inee, timori abanto b’engencho y’ebibe, naende nigo mogendererete buna banto bande bonsi?

English: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.'”
Kiswahili: Nimeweka maneno yangu kinywani mwako na kukufunika kwa uvuli wa mkono wangu: Mimi niliyeweka mbingu mahali pake, niliyeweka misingi ya dunia, niwaambiaye Sayuni, ‘Ninyi ni watu wangu.' ”
Ekegusii: Nabekire amang'ana aane ase omonwa oo, naende nakobisire ase ekiriri gi'okoboko kwane. Nindambore igoro mbeeke oboroso bw'ense, ninteebie abanto ba Sayoni: Inwe nabaanto baane.”

English: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone. All Scripture Is God-Breathed (Hebrews 4:12–16)
Kiswahili: Lakini hawataendelea sana, kwa sababu upumbavu wao utakuwa dhahiri kwa watu wote, kama ulivyokuwa dhahiri upumbavu wa hao watu wawili. Paulo Amwagiza Timotheo
Ekegusii: korende tibakogeenderera mono, ekiagera oboriri bwabo naboorokigwe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi, buna yabeete ase baria babere. Ogochika kw’omoerio

English: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.
Kiswahili: Maana wale Mungu aliowajua tangu mwanzo, pia aliwachagua tangu mwanzo, wapate kufanana na mfano wa Mwanawe, ili yeye awe mzaliwa wa kwanza miongoni mwa ndugu wengi.
Ekegusii: Inaki baria amanyete korwa kare akabachoora korwa kare, bareng’anigwe n’omogwekano bw’Omwana oye, erinde ere abe omotangi bw’abamwabo abange.

English: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
Kiswahili: Hasar-Shuali, Bala, Esemu,
Ekegusii: na Hasari‐Suali, na Bala, na Esemu,

English: Gold and silver will make the foot stand sure, and counsel is esteemed better than both.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu na fedha vitaimarisha mguu, na ushauri unathaminiwa kuliko vyote viwili.
Ekegusii: Etaabu nechifeta nigo bikomokong'ia omonto, korende amorokererio amaya nigo abuete ebio bibere.

English: But I will take ten tribes of the kingdom from the hand of his son and give them to you.
Kiswahili: Nitauondoa ufalme kutoka mikononi mwa mwanawe na kukupa wewe makabila kumi.
Ekegusii: Nindusie oborwoti korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oye; aye noegwe ebisaku ikomi,

English: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayekubali mafundisho hustawi, tena amebarikiwa yeye anayemtumaini Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera Ring'ana nanyore amaya, na oyo okomosemeri'Omonene nasesenirie.

English: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
Kiswahili: Atakapokuwa amelijaza tumbo lake, Mungu ataionyesha ghadhabu kali dhidi yake, na kumnyeshea mapigo juu yake.
Ekegusii: Nebe ng'a ekero aisire koigota, Nyasae namotomere ekeririanda gi'okogechigwa kwaye; egesusuro ekio nigo keramochere ekero agendererete koragera.

English: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watu wa maeneo hayo wenyewe wanaeleza jinsi mlivyotupokea na jinsi mlivyomgeukia Mungu mkaacha sanamu, ili kumtumikia Mungu aliye hai na wa kweli
Ekegusii: Naki barabwo abanyene baorokirie amang'ana igoro yaito, buna twasoete ase egati yaino, na buna inwe mwaonchokerete Nyasae korwa ase emegwekano y'ogosasimwa, erinde mokorere Nyasae ore moyo, oyo bw'ekeene,

English: so that you may nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you may drink deeply and delight yourselves in her glorious abundance.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mtanyonya na kutosheka katika faraja ya matiti yake; mtakunywa sana, na kuufurahia wingi wa mafuriko ya ustawi wake.”
Ekegusii: Bono gonka na moisaneke namabeere aye, monyore okoremigwa ase egekuba kiaye; ee, gonka mono na mogokere obonge bw’obonene bwaye!”

English: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
Kiswahili: Amkeni, enyi walevi, mlie! Pigeni yowe enyi wanywaji wote wa mvinyo, pigeni yowe kwa sababu ya mvinyo mpya, kwa kuwa mmenyangʼanywa kutoka midomoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamwatindire nebinyugwa ebiroro, boka morere! Inwe mwensi aba mokonywa edivai, bokia amagombo, ase engencho amasabibu onsi y'okoroisia edivai enyia, asarigwe.

English: Then he stretched himself out over the child three times and cried out to the LORD, “O LORD my God, please let this boy’s life return to him!”
Kiswahili: Kisha akajinyoosha juu ya kijana mara tatu na kumlilia Bwana, akisema, “Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, nakuomba roho ya huyu kijana imrudie!”
Ekegusii: Erio akaramamera omwana oria ara gatato, naende akarera ase Omonene, “Aye Omonene Nyasae one, tiga obomoyo bw’omwana oyo bomoiranere naende.”

English: over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron was Zadok;
Kiswahili: kwa Walawi: Hashabia mwana wa Kemueli; kwa Aroni: Sadoki;
Ekegusii: Hasabia, mosinto o Kemueli, ase Abalawi; Zadoki ase abanto ba Aroni;

English: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Daudi na watu wake wakapiga yowe mpaka wakaishiwa na nguvu za kulia.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto baria baarenge komo bagaaka amariogi abo, bakarera mono goika chinguru chikabaerera.

English: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Tazameni, mtakapokuwa mkiingia mjini, mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni mpaka kwenye nyumba atakayoingia.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rora, ekero mwasoire omochie, namoumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotunyane goika enyomba agosoa,

English: Don't say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
Kiswahili: Usimwambie jirani yako, “Njoo baadaye, nitakupa kesho”: wakati wewe unacho kitu kile karibu nawe.
Ekegusii: Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komoteebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”

English: “The three districts that have been added to Judea from the country of Samaria, let them be annexed to Judea, that they may be reckoned to be under one ruler, that they may not obey any other authority than the high priest's.
Kiswahili: "Wilaya tatu ambazo zimeongezwa Yudea kutoka nchi ya Samaria, na ziunganishwe na Yudea, ili zihesabiwe kuwa chini ya mtawala mmoja, ili zisitii mamlaka nyingine yoyote isipokuwa ya kuhani mkuu."
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiria isato chi'ense ya Samaria chibwatanetigwe na Yudea, inachibarwe koba ensemo ya Yudea na kobekwa inse yobobui bw'Omokuani omonene.

English: He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.
Kiswahili: Kamwe asiingie mahali palipo maiti ndani. Kamwe asijitie unajisi, hata kwa ajili ya baba yake au mama yake,
Ekegusii: Tabaisa gosoa enyomba ase abanto babekire omobere bw’omonto okuure gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka, naba ise gose ng’ina.

English: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
Kiswahili: Ninazitii sheria zako, kwa sababu ninazipenda mno.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo obwatete oborori bwao, nigo ’mbwanchete mono.

English: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: lakini watu wa kijiji kile hawakumkaribisha kwa sababu alikuwa anakwenda zake Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'omochie oria tibamoroisia, ekiagera arenge kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
Kiswahili: Basi Mungu alikuwa amemfanya huyo mkuu wa maafisa kuonyesha upendeleo na huruma kwa Danieli,
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaa Danieli ogwancherwa na obuya ase obosio bw'omoteneneri oria omonene.

English: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
Kiswahili: pamoja na wenzao waliofanya kazi hekaluni: watu 822. Adaya mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Pelalia, mwana wa Amsi, mwana wa Zekaria, mwana wa Pashuri, mwana wa Malkiya,
Ekegusii: na abamwabo abarenge gokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, bonsi nabaanto amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ebere, na babere (822); Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu, o Pelalia, bw'Amusi, o Zakaria; o Pasuri, o Malikia,

English: Now the lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon. They rejoiced and said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hands.”
Kiswahili: Basi viongozi wa Wafilisti wakakusanyika pamoja ili kutoa kafara kwa mungu wao Dagoni na kufanya karamu, wakisema, “Mungu wetu amemtia adui yetu Samsoni mikononi mwetu.”
