Ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’Afilisti bagasangererekana koruera Dagoni, enyasae yabo, ekeng’wanso ekenene, na gochenga, bagoteeba, “Enyasae yaito yabeekire omobisa oito Samusoni ase amaboko aito.”

English: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Koo za Wakohathi zilikuwa ni: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

English: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wakaldayo waliunda vikosi vitatu vya uvamizi na kuwaangukia ngamia wako na kuwachukua wakaondoka nao. Wakawaua watumishi kwa upanga, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abakalidayo nigo bachicha bare ebiombe bitato, baumokera chingamia, bachiira, naende baita abasomba bande nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

English: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
Kiswahili: Nanyi sasa mnajua kinachomzuia, ili apate kudhihirishwa wakati wake utakapowadia.
Ekegusii: Na bono, erimotangete morimanyete, erio ekero engaki yaye eraike anyare koorokigwa.

English: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
Kiswahili: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo, kobagosooka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.

English: They spend their days in prosperity and go down to Sheol in peace.
Kiswahili: Huitumia miaka yao katika mafanikio nao hushuka kaburini kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakogenderera kwegokia nobotenenku bwabo; bakwa bagenda aase abakuure bare nomorembe.

English: And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.
Kiswahili: Nyimbo za wapiga vinubi na waimbaji, wapiga filimbi na wapiga tarumbeta kamwe hazitasikika tena ndani yako. Ndani yako kamwe hataonekana tena fundi mwenye ujuzi wa aina yoyote. Wala sauti ya jiwe la kusagia kamwe haitasikika tena.
Ekegusii: Amariogi ’abakobugia amakano na ebiroria, na ebitureeri, takoigugwa nonya nomooroisia o gento kende gionsi takororekana ime ase ore naende nonya ng’ake; nonya neriogi ri’orogena rogosia tirikoigugwa ime ase ore naende nonya ng’ake; ime ase ore naende nonya ng’ake;

English: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
Kiswahili: Solomoni alitawala Israeli yote miaka arobaini, akiwa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Sulemani akagamba agwo Yerusalemu igoro y'Abaisraeli bonsi ase emiaka emerongo ene.

English: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akasisitiza zaidi, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Korende Petero ere akamenta gokwana mono, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng'ake.” Na bonsi bagateeba boigo.

English: Then King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed their heads and worshiped.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Hezekia na maafisa wake wakawaamuru Walawi kumsifu Bwana kwa maneno ya Daudi na ya Asafu mwonaji. Hivyo wakaimba sifa kwa furaha nao wakainamisha vichwa vyao na kuabudu.
Ekegusii: Hezekia omorwoti amo nabagaambi b’oborwoti bagachika Abalawi batere amatera ay’ogotogia Omonene ase amang’ana a Daudi na ay’Asafu omoorori. Barabwo bagatera, bakaba bagotogia nomogooko, bagekumba na gosasiima.

English: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.
Kiswahili: Ulikuwa na ukuta mkubwa, mrefu wenye malango kumi na mawili, pakiwa na malaika kumi na wawili kwenye hayo malango. Kwenye malango hayo yaliandikwa majina ya yale makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omochie oyio nigo orenge norwaki oronene, orotambe, ore nebiita ikomi na bibere. Ase ebiita biria mbarengeo abamalaika ikomi na babere, na amarieta ’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli ariikire aroro.

English: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa Yehoramu, Edomu waliasi dhidi ya Yuda na kujiwekea mfalme wao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ay'okogaamba kwa Yehoramu, Abaedomu bagasaria, bakaanga koigwera Abayuda, bakebekera omorwoti.

English: So that day Jacob blessed them and said: “By you shall Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’” So he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Akawabarikia siku ile na kusema, “Kwa jina lenu Israeli watatamka baraka hii: ‘Mungu na awafanye kama Efraimu na Manase.’ ” Kwa hiyo akamtanguliza Efraimu mbele ya Manase.
Ekegusii: Rituko erio akabasesenia, akabora, “Ekero ogosesenigwa kogokwanwa ase Abaisraeli, abanto baatore amarieta aino na goteeba: Nyasae abakore mobe buna Efraimu na Manase.” Agwo agwo agatang’ania Efraimu ase obosio bwa Manase.

English: He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving. “Let us flee from the Israelites,” said the Egyptians, “for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!”
Kiswahili: Mungu akayaondoa magurudumu ya magari yao, kwa hivyo wakayaendesha kwa shida. Nao Wamisri wakasema, “Tuachane na Waisraeli! Bwana anawapigania dhidi ya Misri.” Wafuatiaji Wazama
Ekegusii: Omonene akagokora amagoro e chigari chiabo, goika bagasinywa kogenda bosio. Erio Abamisiri bagateeba, “Tiga totame korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera Omonene nkobarwanera are mamincha yaito intwe Abamisiri.”

English: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
Kiswahili: Lakini taarifa kutoka mashariki na kaskazini zitamshtua, naye ataondoka kwa ghadhabu nyingi ili kuangamiza na kuharibu kabisa wengi.
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ararwe moocha na sugusu namoichanie, erio asoke ore nekeririanda ekenene aite abanto abange abasirie kegima.

English: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake toka miisho ya dunia, ninyi mshukao chini baharini, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, enyi visiwa na wote wakaao ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi'ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo n'ebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang'e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!

English: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
Kiswahili: Herode na askari wake wakamdhihaki Yesu na kumfanyia mzaha. Wakamvika vazi zuri sana, wakamrudisha kwa Pilato.
Ekegusii: Herode na abarwani baye bakamochaya, bakamosekereria, bakamobekera chianga chingiya mono, akamoirania ase Pilato.

English: May He incline our hearts to Himself, to walk in all His ways and to keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances He commanded our fathers.
Kiswahili: Yeye na aielekeze mioyo yetu kwake, ili tutembee katika njia zake zote na kuzishika amri na maagizo na masharti aliyowapa baba zetu.
Ekegusii: korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiiko aye na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na onsi aya achiigete chisokoro chiaito.

English: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni jambo la sifa kama mtu akivumilia anapoteswa kwa uonevu kwa ajili ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki aya namaya mono omonto karaaremererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.

English: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you on that day.” God Grants the Request
Kiswahili: Siku ile itakapowadia, mtalia kwa kutaka msaada kutokana na mfalme mliyemchagua, naye Bwana hatawajibu.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio inamobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y’omorwoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”

English: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
Kiswahili: Basi Solomoni akajenga Hekalu na kulikamilisha, akiliweka paa za boriti na mbao za mierezi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Sulemani akaagacha Hekalu, akayekoora. Akaroisia risang'ina ri'enyomba ne chibao chi'emecharake.

English: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense. The Censers Reserved for Holy Use
Kiswahili: Moto ukaja kutoka kwa Bwana, ukawateketeza wale watu 250 waliokuwa wakifukiza uvumba.
Ekegusii: Erio omorero okarua ase Omonene, ogasamba abanto baria amagana abere, na merongo etano, abwo konya barentire ubani. Chindogio chi’omorero

English: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Kiswahili: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.
Ekegusii: Bogoria eanga y'omonto bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto onde, ira biria abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y'omonto otamanyekaneti.

English: However, when they relayed all that Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipokwisha kumweleza kila kitu ambacho Yosefu alikuwa amewaambia, na alipoona magari ya kukokotwa Yosefu aliyokuwa amempelekea ya kumchukua aende Misri, roho ya baba yao Yakobo ikahuishwa.
Ekegusii: Korende bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi Yusufu abateebetie. Ere agachia korora chigari chiria Yusufu amotomerete chigocha komoimokia, omoyo oye okaba nobogima oboyia.

English: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.
Kiswahili: Walisema, “Geukeni sasa, kila mmoja wenu kutoka njia yake mbaya na matendo yake maovu, ndipo mtaweza kukaa katika nchi ambayo Bwana aliwapa ninyi na baba zenu milele.
Ekegusii: Abwo babeire bakobateebia, “Kera oyomo oino aonchoke atige chinchera chiaye chi'ebibe na ogokora kwaye okobe, erio nario moramenye ase ense eye Omonene aete chisokoro chiaino kare, nainwe obayeeire ebe eyaino kogenderera botambe.

English: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
Kiswahili: Hapo mwanzo Mungu aliumba mbingu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Agwo omochakano Nyasae agatonga igoro na ense,

English: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
Kiswahili: Matendo yako na yaonekane kwa watumishi wako, utukufu wako kwa watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Tworokie intwe, abasomba bao, ogokora kwao, na abana baito oborokie obonene bwao.

English: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
Kiswahili: Mungu yuko katikati yake, hautaanguka, Mungu atausaidia asubuhi na mapema.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amenyete imeo, tokonyegerigwa, ere nayokonye kobogokia mambia.

English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
Kiswahili: Kisha waambie Waisraeli: ‘Chukueni mbuzi dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na ndama na mwana-kondoo, wote wawili wawe wa umri wa mwaka mmoja, na wasio na dosari, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa,
Ekegusii: Naende oteebie Abaisraeli ng'a bachore egoree ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na emori amo nemaanwa y'eng'ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa,

English: When Jacob woke up, he thought, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
Kiswahili: Yakobo alipoamka kutoka usingizini, akawaza, “Hakika Bwana yuko mahali hapa, wala mimi sikujua.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akabora: “Amaene, Omonene nao are aase aa, na inche tinamanyete.”

English: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
Kiswahili: Uliandaa shamba kwa ajili yake, mizizi ikawa imara, ukajaza nchi.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwayoraberetie aase na koaroisia, noro ogakina okaira emeri inse, okaranda ase ense eyio engima.

English: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
Kiswahili: Hata wale waliotahiriwa wenyewe hawaitii sheria, lakini wanataka ninyi mtahiriwe ili wapate kujivuna kwa habari ya miili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya mbarabwo abanyene abaarogete tibabwateti amachiiko, korende mbarigetie inwe mwarokigwe, erinde banyare gwetogeria emebere yaino.

English: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
Kiswahili: Ondoa takataka kwenye madini ya fedha, nako ndani yake kutatokea chombo cha mfua fedha.
Ekegusii: Rusia amabiria korwa ase efeta, na omoturi 'nanyore efeta akoroiseria egekorero ekiya.

English: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
Kiswahili: Ndugu, tunawaagiza katika Jina la Bwana Yesu Kristo, jitengeni na kila ndugu ambaye ni mvivu na ambaye haishi kufuatana na maagizo tuliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Bono baminto, twabachikiire ase erieta ri'Omonene Yeso Kristo, mweatanane korwa ase oyomino oyore omworo, oyotabwateti chingencho echio mweorokereretie korwa ase tore.

English: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya mikate ya Wonyesho, kwa ajili ya sadaka za kawaida za nafaka na sadaka za kuteketezwa, kwa ajili ya sadaka za siku za Sabato, Sikukuu za Mwandamo wa Mwezi na sikukuu nyingine zilizoamriwa, kwa ajili ya sadaka takatifu, kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Israeli, na kwa ajili ya kazi zote za nyumba ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: “Chibesa echio chiraruegwe ase engencho y'emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na okoruegwa kw'endagera kwa botambe, na ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa kia botambe, na ebie Chisabato, na Emetienyi Emeyia, na Amatuko Amanene achiikire, na ebing'wanso ebichenu, na ebing'wanso bi'ebibe bigokora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y'emeremo yonsi y'enyomba ya Nyasae oito.

English: The sun, when it appears, bringing tidings as it rises, is a marvelous instrument, the work of the Most High.
Kiswahili: Jua, linapoonekana, likileta habari linapochomoza, ni chombo cha ajabu, kazi ya Aliye Juu Zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba rikooroka, rirorio nigo rikoraria okomesa kwaye. Ekio negento kiogokumia ere Omonene atongete.

English: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
Kiswahili: Lakini Maandiko yamefanya vitu vyote vifungwe chini ya nguvu ya dhambi, ili yale yaliyoahidiwa kwa njia ya imani katika Yesu Kristo yapate kupewa wale wanaoamini.
Ekegusii: Korende amariiko asiekeire bonsi inse y’okobua kw’ebibe, erinde abegenire baegwe ayio ariereretwe eira ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso o Kristo.

English: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.
Kiswahili: Nitawaangamiza waishio katika mji huu, watu na wanyama, nao watauawa kwa tauni ya kutisha.
Ekegusii: Ning'ite abanto abamenyete ase omochie oyio, ng'ite ne ching'iti chireo. Oborwaire bogoita mboite Mwanyabaanto ne ching'iti.”

English: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter.
Kiswahili: Sasa tuma watu waende Yafa wakamwite mtu mmoja jina lake Simoni aitwaye Petro.
Ekegusii: Gaki, bono toma abanto Yopa barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.

English: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoingia Hekaluni, viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu wakamjia alipokuwa anafundisha na kusema, “Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Na ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka hayo?”
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Hekalu ime na kworokereria, agachierwa nabakuani abanene na etureti y'abanto, bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokora amang'ana aya? Ning'o okoete okobua oko?”

English: In addition to this, he undertook to assign one hundred fifty more, if it might be allowed him through the king's authority to set him up a gymnasium and a body of youths to be trained in it, and to register the inhabitants of Jerusalem as citizens of Antioch.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, aliahidi kuwapa watu mia moja na hamsini zaidi, ikiwa angeweza kuruhusiwa kupitia mamlaka ya mfalme kumjengea ukumbi wa mazoezi na kundi la vijana wa kufunzwa humo, na kuwaandikisha wakazi wa Yerusalemu kama raia wa Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Kero kende Yasoni nigo aete omorwoti chitaabu chiria erio agachee egetii ase abasae bakwegere gokora chigosorio, na echinde ase engencho yokorika abanto ba Yerusalemu koba abantiokia.

English: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
Kiswahili: Nami nikamwona malaika amesimama ndani kwenye jua, akaita ndege wote warukao angani kwa sauti kuu, “Njooni, kusanyikeni kwa ajili ya karamu kubwa ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika oteneine ase erioba ime, okorera ase eriogi rinene, ogoteebia chinyoni chiare koiruruka ase igoro gati, “Inchuo mosangererekane ase omoyega omonene o Nyasae.

English: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninajua kwamba hamna upendo wa Mungu mioyoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende nabamanyire inwe ng’a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasae ime yaino.

English: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.'
Kiswahili: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.'
Ekegusii: Akabora: Yaya, tata Aburaamu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakuure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.

English: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mishale yako imenichoma, na mkono wako umenishukia.
Ekegusii: Kwandasire emegwe yao yasoeire ime yane, kwanyiyeirie inse nokoboko kwao.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likamjia Samweli kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase Samweli, rikamoteebia,

English: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the Desert of Shur. For three days they walked in the desert without finding water.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaongoza Israeli kutoka Bahari ya Shamu na kuingia katika Jangwa la Shuri. Kwa siku tatu walisafiri jangwani bila kupata maji.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Bagataara ase engaki y’amatuko atato ase erooro, na tibanyora maache.

English: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
Kiswahili: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong'u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

English: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa kweli wajane wengine wamepotoka ili kumfuata Shetani.
Ekegusii: Inaki abaande bairanire magega, na gotunyana Saitani.

English: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mti wa uzima kwa wale wanaomkumbatia; wale wamshikao watabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bore omote bw'obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong'u nasesenirie.

English: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwao wamo wale wajiingizao katika nyumba za watu na kuwachukua mateka wanawake wajinga, waliolemewa na dhambi zao na kuyumbishwa na aina zote za tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase egati yabo mbareo abagwesoyia ase chinyomba chi'abaanto gosakora abakungu aboro, abare ne chigurube chi'ebibe, na koraagwa nokogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao.

English: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
Kiswahili: Ni yule mwenye mikono safi na moyo mweupe, yule ambaye hakuinulia sanamu nafsi yake au kuapa kwa kitu cha uongo.
Ekegusii: Nomonto oria obwate amaboko atari na komocha, na enkoro echenegete, noria otari gosasiima chinyasae chi’oborimo, gose gotiana ase obong’ainereria.

English: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale wakulima walimkamata yule mtumishi, wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

English: O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, hata lini hasira yako itawaka na kufoka moshi dhidi ya maombi ya watu wako?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe gokogechigwa nogosaba kw’abaanto bao?

English: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana niliyewapandisha mtoke Misri ili niwe Mungu wenu. Kwa hiyo kuweni watakatifu kwa sababu Mimi ni mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri imbe Nyasae oino. Ase ayio, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde.”

English: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu na kaka zake wote na kizazi kile chote walikufa,
Ekegusii: Korende Yusufu, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria bagakwera Misiri.

English: If only this people were under my authority, I would remove Abimelech; I would say to him, ‘Muster your army and come out!’” The Fall of Shechem
Kiswahili: Laiti watu hawa wangekuwa chini ya amri yangu! Basi mimi ningemwondoa huyo Abimeleki. Ningemwambia Abimeleki, ‘Ondoa jeshi lako lote.’ ”
Ekegusii: Onye abanto aba ’nkoba barenge ase oborendi bwane, anga ’narusia Abimeleki. Nigo nare komoteebia: Menta abarwani bao b’esegi, erio ochiche korwana!”

English: Hadad and his men set out from Midian and went to Paran. They took men from Paran with them and went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Midiani wakaenda Parani. Basi wakichukua pamoja nao wanaume kutoka Parani, wakaenda Misri, kwa Farao mfalme wa Misri, ambaye alimpa Hadadi nyumba, ardhi na akampatia chakula.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabaanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.

English: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
Kiswahili: Ingawa alipokuwa akiishi alijihesabu kuwa heri, na wanadamu wanakusifu unapofanikiwa,
Ekegusii: Nonya omonto oyio ekero are moyo, ogweteba ng'a nigo asesenirie, ee, nonya ogotogigwa ekero ekoreire amaya,

English: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
Kiswahili: matawi yake yatatanda. Fahari yake itakuwa kama mti wa mzeituni, harufu yake nzuri kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni.
Ekegusii: Ebisabo biabo mbirande, na obwari bwabo nabobe buna obw'emezeituni, ne rimisu riabo ndiesiarere buna eri'emete ya Lebanoni.

English: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Alipofika na kuona madhihirisho ya neema ya Mungu, akafurahi na kuwatia moyo waendelee kuwa waaminifu kwa Bwana kwa mioyo yao yote.
Ekegusii: Ere, ekero achia goika na korora buna obuya bwa Nyasae bwakorire, akagoka, agasorora bonsi babe abegenwa ase Omonene ase okogania gwe chinkoro.

English: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
Kiswahili: Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

English: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh's anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
Kiswahili: Kama mkilivunja agano la Bwana Mungu wenu, ambalo aliwaamuru ninyi, mkaenda na kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia, hasira ya Bwana itawaka dhidi yenu, nanyi mtaangamia kutoka nchi nzuri aliyowapa ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Onye mogosaria okobwatana kw'Omonene, Nyasae oino, okwo abachigete, naende mogokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasiima, erio endamwamu yaye inayoke igoro yaino, nainwe bwango mosire korwa ase ense eye engiya abaeire.”

English: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
Kiswahili: Basi Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Njoo, nikupeleke mahali pengine. Huenda itampendeza Mungu kukuruhusu unilaanie hao watu kutoka mahali hapo.”
Ekegusii: Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono inchwo 'nkoire aase ande aao. Aande gose Nyasae nanche obandagererie korwa aroro.”

English: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
Kiswahili: Nanyi, mkiisha kuwekwa huru mbali na dhambi, mmekuwa watumwa wa haki.
Ekegusii: na ekero mwasiboretwe korwa ase ebibe mogakorwa koba abasomba b’oboronge.

English: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
Kiswahili: Bwana na auongeze upendo wenu na kuuzidisha kati yenu na kwa wengine wote, kama vile tulivyo na upendo mwingi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene abakore momenteke na gokiina ase ogwanchana inwe ase inwe, na ase ogwancha abanto bonsi, buna intwe tobanchete inwe.

English: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.
Kiswahili: Pembe hiyo ikaendelea kukua hadi kufikia jeshi la mbinguni, nayo ikalitupa baadhi ya jeshi la vitu vya angani hapa chini duniani, na kulikanyaga.
Ekegusii: Orogunchara orwo rogakiina mono, rogaika ase emeganda ya igoro, rokaiyeria emeganda ende ne ching'enang'eni gocha inse aa, rogachitiringerao.

English: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
Kiswahili: Ashirikianaye na watenda mabaya na kuchangamana na watu waovu.
Ekegusii: Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.

English: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
Kiswahili: Akamchagua Daudi mtumishi wake na kumtoa kwenye mazizi ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching'ondi.

English: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
Kiswahili: Naye alipokwisha kusema haya, akawavuvia, akawaambia, “Pokeeni Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akabautera omoika, akabateebia, “Nyora Omoika Omochenu.

English: and Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard of this, he pursued David there.
Kiswahili: Sauli na watu wake wakaanza msako, naye Daudi alipoelezwa hili, akateremka mpaka mwambani na kukaa katika Jangwa la Maoni. Sauli aliposikia hili, akaenda katika Jangwa la Maoni akimfuata Daudi.
Ekegusii: Saulo na’baanto baye bakagenda korigia Daudi, korende Daudi agateebigwa amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio akagenda ase egetare kiareenge ase erooro ya Maoni, akabeerao. Ekero Saulo aigwete ng’a Daudi ogendire agwo akamobwatia gochiao.

English: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wenu, ndugu, ninyi kamwe msichoke katika kutenda mema.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, timorosa gokora amaya.

English: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani kwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma. Wakati alipokuwa ameketi mezani akila chakula cha jioni, mwanamke mmoja aliingia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa. Akaivunja hiyo chupa, akamiminia hayo manukato kichwani mwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase endagera, omokungu agacha orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta agotioka buya, aye rigori rinene, agaata echuba eria, akamonyororokeria omotwe oye.

English: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
Kiswahili: Akachagua kupata mateso pamoja na watu wa Mungu kuliko kujifurahisha kwa anasa za dhambi kwa kitambo kidogo tu.
Ekegusii: agachoora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabaanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.

English: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Hesabu ya waume wote wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja au zaidi waliohesabiwa walikuwa 6,200.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na magana abere (6,200).

English: saying, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!” So he had him ride in his chariot.
Kiswahili: Yehu akasema, “Twende pamoja ukaone wivu wangu kwa ajili ya Bwana.” Hivyo wakasafiri pamoja kwenye gari lake.
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia: “Inchuo amo nainche, orore risemi riane na omokia one ase Omonene!” Erio bakagenda komo ase egari ya Yehu.

English: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Lea aliposema, “Jinsi gani nilivyo na furaha! Wanawake wataniita furaha.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Asheri.
Ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Inche ninde nomogooko omonene, naki abakungu nabandoke Oyore n'omogooko.” Ase igo, akamoroka Aseri.

English: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa huko Antiokia kwa muda, wakaagwa kwa amani na wale ndugu ili waende kwa wale waliowatuma.
Ekegusii: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai 'nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete.

English: For when they heard that through their own punishments the others benefited, they recognized the Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana waliposikia kwamba kupitia adhabu zao wenyewe wengine walifaidika, walimtambua Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigwete buna egesusuro kiao nigo giakonyete abanto bao, bagateeba buna aye Omonene naye gwakorete ayio onsi.

English: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels' necks.
Kiswahili: Uzito wa pete za dhahabu alizoomba zilifikia shekeli 1,700, bila kuhesabu mapambo mengine, pete za masikio na mavazi ya zambarau yaliyovaliwa na wafalme wa Midiani, au mikufu iliyokuwa kwenye shingo za ngamia zao.
Ekegusii: Oborito bw'e'bigera biria asabeete aegwe nigo bwarenge koreng'ana chikiiro emerongo ebere. Amo n'ebio akaira chisonoi, n'ebigera, ne chianga chimonyinga, ebinto abarwoti b'Abamidiani barenge kobeeka, amo ne chisonoi chiria chiarenge ase amagoti ye'chingamia chiabo.

English: Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mimi sitaaibishwa ninapozingatia amri zako zote.
Ekegusii: Rirorio tingosookigwa ekero 'ndabe 'ndigereretie amachiiko ao onsi.

English: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa habari yako wewe, mtende wema mtumishi wako, kwa sababu mmeingia kwenye agano pamoja naye mbele za Bwana. Kama nina hatia, basi niue wewe mwenyewe! Kwa nini unikabidhi kwa baba yako?”
Ekegusii: Gaki onkorere inche, omosomba oo, amaya, ekiagera gwakorire okobwatana kw'ogotianania amo nainche ase obosio bw'Omonene. Korende onye okomocha kore ase 'nde, rirorio aye omonyene ong'ite. Nase ki okong'ira ase iso, erinde ere ang'ite?”

English: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo kuhusu nyumba katika mji huu na majumba ya kifalme ya Yuda yaliyobomolewa ili yatumiwe dhidi ya kule kuzungukwa na jeshi na upanga
Ekegusii: Naende aya naro inche Omonene bw'Abaisraeli ngoteeba igoro ye chinyomba chi'omochie oyo, na igoro ye chinyomba chi'abarwoti b'Abayuda, chiria chiatagoretwe nabwo baagachete chindwaki chi'ogwekengera, naende bakorwana esegi:

English: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
Kiswahili: Maneno yako yamewategemeza wale waliojikwaa; umeyatia nguvu magoti yaliyokuwa dhaifu.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong'irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.

English: But David said to Michal, “I was dancing before the LORD, who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s people Israel. I will celebrate before the LORD,
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia Mikali, “Nilifanya hivyo mbele za Bwana ambaye alinichagua mimi badala ya baba yako au mwingine yeyote kutoka nyumba yake wakati aliponiweka niwe mtawala juu ya Israeli, watu wa Bwana. Kwa hiyo nitacheza mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Mikali, “Nigo narenge gotenga na kogooka ase obosio bw’Omonene, oyo onchorete inche ribaga ria iso, na enyomba yaye yonsi, ’nkaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, goika ’ngenderere gochenga ase Omonene.

English: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don't wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”
Kiswahili: Onyesheni ishara ili kwenda Sayuni! Kimbilieni usalama pasipo kuchelewa! Kwa kuwa ninaleta maafa kutoka kaskazini, maangamizi ya kutisha.”
Ekegusii: Imokia ekemanyererio kiorokie enchera egochia Sayoni; tama motooreke, timobaisa goteebana, ekiagera nkorenta nde obobe na ogosaria okonene korwa sugusu.”

English: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika hapo kushuhudia tukio hili walipoyaona hayo, wakapigapiga vifua vyao kwa huzuni na kwenda zao.
Ekegusii: Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.

English: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanywa kuwa maskini sana na Wamidiani, hata Israeli wakamlilia Bwana kuomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bagakorwa koba abataka mono ase engencho y'Abamidiani; erio bakarera ase Omonene ng'a abakoonye.

English: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
Kiswahili: Je, kama mtu akifa, aweza kuishi tena? Siku zote za kazi zangu ngumu nitangojea kufanywa upya kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto gakuure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.

English: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Haya yalikuwa majina ya wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

English: The Commander of the LORD’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa jeshi la Bwana akajibu, “Vua viatu vyako, kwa maana mahali hapa unaposimama ni patakatifu.” Naye Yoshua akafanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria bw’omoganda okorwana esegi y’Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.” Na Yoshua agakora bo.

English: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries: ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!’
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasema kuhusu yule aliyechakazwa na uzinzi, ‘Basi wamtumie kama kahaba, kwa kuwa ndivyo alivyo.’
Ekegusii: Erio nkeboria: Inee! Abanto aba abanyaka nigo bagochia gokora obonyaka nomokuungu oyo okorire obonyaka ase engaki entambe?

English: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. The Israelites kept the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day they held an assembly, according to the ordinance.
Kiswahili: Siku baada ya siku, kuanzia siku ya kwanza hadi ya mwisho, Ezra alisoma kutoka kwenye kile Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mungu. Wakaiadhimisha sikukuu ile kwa siku saba, nayo siku ya nane, kufuatana na maagizo, kulikuwa na kusanyiko maalum.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko, korwa erie ritang’ani goikera eri’omoerio, Ezra akaba okobasomera Korea ase Egetabu keria kiarikire amachiiko a Nyasae. Abanto bakagenderera korenda Amatuko aria Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaba nomosangererekano omonene bw’ogosasiima, buna yachikiire.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.'”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Nyoosha mkono wako ukiwa na ile fimbo yako juu ya vijito, mifereji na madimbwi, fanya vyura waje juu ya nchi ya Misri.' ”
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

English: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
Kiswahili: ndipo alipoitazama hekima na kuikadiria thamani yake, akaithibitisha na kuihakikisha.
Ekegusii: nario aroche obong'aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.

English: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote aletapo sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana kutoka kundi la ngʼombe au mbuzi ili kutimiza nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya hiari, lazima sadaka hiyo isiwe na dosari au waa ili ikubalike.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe ase 'nde, ase engencho y'eira ariete, gose eki'ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching'ondi, goika ebe eng'iti eng'ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.

English: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds. until it comes near, he will not be comforted. He won't depart until the Most High visits and he judges righteously and executes judgment.
Kiswahili: Sala ya mnyenyekevu hupenya mawingu; hata ikakaribia, hatafarijika. Hataondoka mpaka Aliye Juu ajitokeze, naye ahukumu kwa haki na kutekeleza hukumu.
Ekegusii: Ere tari gosiereria amasabo yechintakana, gose amasabo yomoboraka ekero akomotebia omogano oye.

English: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Elioenai walikuwa: Hodavia, Eliashibu, Pelaya, Akubu, Yohanani, Delaya na Anani; jumla yao wote saba.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b'Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere (7).

English: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya watoto waliozaliwa kwake huko: Shamua, Shobabu, Nathani, Solomoni,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani,

English: If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word; he must do everything he has promised.
Kiswahili: Mwanaume awekapo nadhiri kwa Bwana, au anapoapa kujifunga kwa ahadi, kamwe asitangue neno lake, bali ni lazima afanye kila kitu alichosema.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoria eira ase Omonene, gose agotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete, tagosaria eira eria yaye. Goika akore na goikerania buna akwanete.

English: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.'”
Kiswahili: Wakumbuke watumishi wako Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, ambao uliwaapia kwa nafsi yako mwenyewe: ‘Nitawafanya uzao wako kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nami nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii yote ambayo niliwaahidia, nayo itakuwa urithi wao milele.' ”
Ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabateebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching'enang'eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng'a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”

English: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo wanaume pia wakiacha matumizi ya asili ya wanawake wakawakiana tamaa wao kwa wao. Wanaume wakafanyiana matendo ya aibu na wanaume wengine nao wakapata katika maisha yao adhabu iliyowastahili kwa ajili ya upotovu wao.
Ekegusii: Na abasacha boigo bagatiga okomenyana nabakungu kwa boronge, bagasambwa ase okorigania abasacha ase abasacha, bagakora ogokora kw'obosooku, bakanyora abanyene ogoakanwa kwa boronge kw'ogosaria kwabo.

English: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
Kiswahili: Wakati maneno ni mengi, dhambi haikosekani, lakini yeye ambaye huzuia ulimi wake ni mwenye busara.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokwana amang'ana amaange tari komocha korenta ogosaria, korende oyo orendete omonwa oye nigo are omong'aini.

English: For being ignorant of God's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn't subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawakuijua haki itokayo kwa Mungu, wakatafuta kuweka haki yao wenyewe, hawakujitia chini ya haki ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki kobar'abe tibamanyeti oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae, naende bakorigia goikerania oboronge bwabo abanyene, igo tibebegeti inse ase oboronge bwa Nyasae.

English: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
Kiswahili: ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, naam, kila kiogeleacho katika njia za bahari.
Ekegusii: ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi’enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.

English: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Basi, sasa nenda. Ninakutuma kwa Farao ili kuwatoa watu wangu Waisraeli kutoka Misri.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ’ngogotoma inde ogende ase Farao orusie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri.”

English: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;
Kiswahili: Samsoni akawaambia, “Niwape kitendawili, mkiweza kunipa jibu katika muda wa siku hizi saba za karamu, nitawapa mavazi thelathini ya kitani na mavazi mengine mivao thelathini.
Ekegusii: Samusoni akabateebia, “Tiga mbateebie omobayeeno, na inwe monteebie engencho yaye. Moise gonteebia engencho yaye ase engaki y'amatuko atan'abere ay'omoyega oyo, nigo ndabae chianga chi'egatani, ne chianga chinde chi'omoyega emerongo etato.

English: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn't forsake your precepts.
Kiswahili: Walikaribia kabisa kunifuta kutoka uso wa dunia, lakini sijaacha mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Barabwo babeire ang'e gonsiria aiga ase ense, nonya naboigo, tintigeti amachiiko ao.

English: When the people of the land bring merchandise or any kind of grain to sell on the Sabbath day, we will not buy from them on a Sabbath or holy day. Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow, and will cancel every debt.
Kiswahili: “Wakati mataifa jirani waletapo bidhaa zao au nafaka kuuza siku ya Sabato, hatutazinunua kutoka kwao siku ya Sabato, wala siku nyingine yoyote takatifu. Kila mwaka wa saba, tutaacha kuilima ardhi na tutafuta madeni yote.
Ekegusii: Onye abanto b’ense eye bakorenta ebinto gose chindagera gotooneria rituko ri’Esabato, titokobigora ase Esabato gose ase rituko rinde richenu. Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere ntotige emegondo yaito etimoke teremwa, ne chisira titochiboria chiakanwe.

English: Don't avoid those who weep, and mourn with those who mourn.
Kiswahili: Usiwaepuke wale wanaolia, na uomboleze pamoja na wale wanaoomboleza.
Ekegusii: Tobaa omogongo baria bakwereirwe, korende obwatane nabarabwo ase ogwechanda kwabo.

English: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and those who survive will be scattered to every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.’
Kiswahili: Askari wake wote wanaotoroka wataanguka kwa upanga, nao watakaonusurika watatawanyika katika pande zote za dunia. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi Bwana nimesema. Hatimaye Israeli Kutukuzwa
Ekegusii: Abarwani baye b’esegi abaratame ’mbakenywe nemioro, na abatigari mbasiarerwe gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense. Erio nario moramanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire.” Eira ya Nyasae y’ogosemeria

English: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Kiswahili: Israeli na washangilie katika Muumba wao, watu wa Sayuni na wafurahi katika Mfalme wao.
Ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omorwoti obo!

English: Please, please, God of my father, and God of the inheritance of Israel, Lord of the heavens and of the earth, Creator of the waters, King of all your creation, hear my prayer.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali, tafadhali, Mungu wa baba yangu, na Mungu wa urithi wa Israeli, Bwana wa mbingu na dunia, Muumba wa maji, Mfalme wa viumbe vyako vyote, sikia maombi yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, o Sokoro yane Simioni, aye Abaisraeli basemeretie, Nyasae o igoro na ense, aye Omorwoti bw'ebitongwa bionsi, na omotongi bwa amaache, nagosabire oigwe ogosaba kwane.

English: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”
Kiswahili: Yoabu akaambiwa, “Mfalme analia na kumwombolezea Absalomu.”
Ekegusii: Yoabu agateebigwa ng'a omorwoti Daudi 'nkorera are na kweumia ase engencho y'Abisalomu.

English: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.' This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
Kiswahili: Moto ulienea kuanzia katika mmojawapo ya matawi yake makubwa na kuteketeza matunda yake. Hakuna tawi lenye nguvu lililobaki juu yake lifaalo kuwa fimbo ya enzi ya mtawala.' Hili ndilo ombolezo, na litumike kama ombolezo.”
Ekegusii: Omorero okarua ase chinsagia chiaye, okagenderera gosamba amasabibu aye, totigaretie orosagia rwaisanete koba enyimbo y'omogaambi. “Oko nakwo ogoteera gw'okobokia amagombo koragenderere goterwa ase okobokia amagombo.”

English: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
Kiswahili: Adui mwovu anawavuta wote kwa ndoana, anawakamata katika wavu wake, anawakusanya katika juya lake; kwa hiyo anashangilia na anafurahi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobabwata nebigobanio biabo baabakurura nekeonga kiabo na kobasangereria ase ekeonga kiabo bakorubera; erio bagoka na gochenga.

English: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akaondoka Makeda akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote mpaka mji wa Libna na kuushambulia.
Ekegusii: Magega y'ayio Yoshua amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Makeda, bakagenda korwania Libuna.

English: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.
Kiswahili: Mara tu alipofariki Gideoni, Waisraeli wakarudia hali ya uovu na kufanya uasherati kwa kuabudu Mabaali. Wakamsimamisha Baal-Berithi kuwa mungu wao na
Ekegusii: Magega y'ogokwa kwa Gidioni, Abaisraeli bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, na bagasasiima chinyasae chiria Baali. Bagachoora Baali‐Beriti ekaba enyasae yabo,

English: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;' to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.
Kiswahili: Macho yako na yafumbuke kuelekea Hekalu hili usiku na mchana, mahali hapa ambapo ulisema, ‘Jina langu litakuwako humo,' ili kwamba upate kusikia maombi ambayo mtumishi wako ataomba kuelekea mahali hapa.
Ekegusii: Tiga amaiso ao arigererie enyomba eye obotuko na omobaso aase aiga aye gwateebete igoro yaye: Erieta riane naribeere aroro. Ase ayio oigwe ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, ngosaba ndigereretie aase aiga.

English: Then her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the man who noticed you.” So she told her mother-in-law where she had worked. “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,” she said.
Kiswahili: Basi mkwewe akamuuliza, “Je, umeokota wapi leo? Umefanya kazi wapi? Abarikiwe mtu yule aliyekujali.” Ndipo Ruthu akamwambia mama mkwe wake juu ya yule ambaye yeye alikuwa amefanyia kazi katika shamba lake. Akasema, “Yule mtu niliyefanyia kazi kwake leo, anaitwa Boazi.”
Ekegusii: Naomi akamobooria, “Ng’ai kware gochora ebigara reero? Nase omogondo o ng’o kware gokora emeremo? Asesenigwe omonto oyio ogwechandera kogokonya!” Rutu agateebia Naomi ng’a nigo arenge gokora emeremo ase omogondo bw’omonto ore korokwa Boazi.

English: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
Kiswahili: Uutenge mbali nami udanganyifu na uongo; usinipe umaskini wala utajiri, bali unipe chakula cha kunitosha kila siku.
Ekegusii: Orusie korwa ase 'nde ayare abosa na oborimo. Tobaisa kong'a obotaka gose obotenenku, korende ong'e endagera engwenerete.

English: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
Kiswahili: Mbuga za majani za jangwani umezineemesha; vilima vimevikwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Amarisia e chirooro nigo agotonya boigo, na ebigoro nigo bieboetie omogooko.

English: He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”
Kiswahili: Akauliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Akajibu, “Ni mimi Ruthu, mjakazi wako. Uitande nguo yako juu yangu, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe jamaa wa karibu wa kutukomboa.”
Ekegusii: Boazi akamobooria, “Naye ng'o?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ninche Rutu omosomba oo, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonyamwando o tata biara. Ase igo koranche nywome.”

English: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakatuma watu kumwita Yeroboamu, yeye na kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakamwendea Rehoboamu na kumwambia,
Ekegusii: Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu, na ere amo nomosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagateebia Rehoboamu,

English: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
Kiswahili: lolote tuombalo, twalipokea kutoka kwake, kwa sababu tumezitii amri zake na kutenda yale yanayompendeza.
Ekegusii: na rinde rionsi togosaba nigo tokorinyora korwa asare, ekiagera ntobwatete amachiiko aye, naende igo tokoyakora ayakomogwenera.

English: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, mzidi kuwa hodari katika Bwana na katika uweza wa nguvu zake.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, motenene bokong'u ase Omonene, na ase chinguru chi'okobua kwaye.

English: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akaamka asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, akamtayarisha punda wake. Akawachukua watumishi wake wawili pamoja na Isaki mwanawe. Baada ya kuchanja kuni za kutosha kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akaondoka kuelekea mahali Mungu alipokuwa amemwambia.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akabeeka ebinto ase etigere yaye, akairana abamura babere amo nere, na Isaka omwana oye. Agaatia chinko agochia gosambera ekeng'wanso, akaimoka, akagenda gochia aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae.

English: and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall tear down their altars.’ Yet you have not obeyed My voice. What is this you have done?
Kiswahili: Nanyi msifanye agano na watu wa nchi hii, bali mtazibomoa madhabahu yao.’ Lakini ninyi hamkunitii mimi. Kwa nini mmefanya jambo hili?
Ekegusii: Boigo, nainwe timokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’ababiare b’ense eye. Inwe goika mobitaagore ebisasimero biabo, mobiiyerie inse. Korende timonyigwereti. Bono ninki eke mwakorire?

English: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
Kiswahili: Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Yeyote aongozaye mashambulizi dhidi ya Wayebusi, atakuwa jemadari mkuu.” Yoabu mwana wa Seruya akawa wa kwanza kukwea, naye akawa mkuu.
Ekegusii: Daudi konya oteebire, ng'a “Monto onde bwensi orabe oyo bw'eritang'ani goita abanto ba Yebusi, ere oyio nabe omochiki omonene bw'abarwani.” Yoabu, omomura bw'omokuungu Seruya, akaba oyo bw'eritang'ani kogenda aroro; ase ayio ere akaba omochiki.

English: therefore I am against you and against your rivers. I will turn the land of Egypt into a ruin, a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Syene, and as far as the border of Cush.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo mimi ni kinyume nawe na kinyume na vijito vyako, nami nitaifanya nchi ya Misri kuwa magofu na ukiwa isiyolimwa wala kukaliwa na watu kuanzia Migdoli hadi Aswani, hata kufikia mpakani wa Ethiopia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, na mamincha ye chindooche chiao. Ninsarie ense ya Misiri kegima ebe bosa korwa Migidoli goika Siwen ase orobebe rw’Ethiopia.

English: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Ara 652
Ekegusii: aba orwa Ara, amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano, na babere (652);

English: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn't discipline?
Kiswahili: Vumilieni taabu kwa ajili ya kufunzwa adabu. Mungu anawatendea ninyi kama watoto wake, kwa maana ni mtoto yupi asiyeadibishwa na mzazi wake?
Ekegusii: Ekero mokorongeigwa moremererie Nyasae nigo akobakorera buna abana baye. Naki, mwana ki otari korongeigwa na ise?

English: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
Kiswahili: “Watagawiwa nchi kama urithi kwa kulingana na hesabu ya majina.
Ekegusii: Aatananere abanto aba chingongo chibe emiando yabo. Ochiatanane kobwatekana nomobaro bw' abanto.

English: Then Yahweh's word came to Isaiah, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia Isaya, kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Isaya, rikamoteebia,

English: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wakati wangu bado haujawadia, lakini wakati wenu upo siku zote.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero kiane tikeraika, korende ekero kiaino botambe nkereo.

English: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own, but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.” The Adultery Test
Kiswahili: Kila kitu cha mtu kilichowekwa wakfu ni chake mwenyewe, lakini kile atoacho kwa kuhani kitakuwa cha kuhani.’ ” Jaribio Kwa Ajili Ya Mke Asiye Mwaminifu
Ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi omonto araatanane koba ebichenu nigo birabe ebi’Omokuani oyio okobiegwa.” Abakungu Bagokagerwa Nabasaacha Babo Ng’a Tibari Abegenwa

English: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
Kiswahili: Wagershoni walipokea miji ifuatayo pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho: Katika nusu ya kabila la Manase: walipewa Golani katika Bashani na pia Ashtarothi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abagerisomu bakaegwa Golani agwo Basani, na Asitaroti, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
Kiswahili: Pia chukua sehemu ya damu iliyo juu ya madhabahu na sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, umnyunyizie Aroni na mavazi yake, pia wanawe na mavazi yao. Ndipo Aroni na wanawe pamoja na mavazi yao watakuwa wamewekwa wakfu.
Ekegusii: Orusie amanyinga make ayare ase egesasiimero, na amaguta ayio akweakwa, onyororokerie Aroni ne chianga chiaye, na abamura baye, ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo Aroni na abamura baye baatananwe ase emeremo emechenu, amo ne chianga chiabo.

English: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
Kiswahili: Kenani alikuwa mwana wa Enoshi, Enoshi alikuwa mwana wa Sethi, Sethi alikuwa mwana wa Adamu, Adamu alikuwa mwana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: o Enosu, o Seti, o Adamu, o Nyasae.

English: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya kama Mose alivyowaelekeza, nao wakawaomba Wamisri wawapatie vitu vya fedha, dhahabu na nguo.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire buna Musa abateebeetie; konya basabire korwa ase Abamisiri ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitaabu amo ne chianga.

English: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani kuvukia Yeriko,
Ekegusii: Ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang’e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kusini mpaka ulianzia kwenye viunga vya Kiriath-Yearimu kwa upande wa magharibi, nao ukatokeza kwenye chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ensinyo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, rokagenderera gochia ensemo ya bosongo, rogaika ase chinsoko chia Nefitoa.

English: I have seen all the things that are done under the sun, and have found them all to be futile, a pursuit of the wind.
Kiswahili: Nimeshaona mambo yote yanayotendeka chini ya jua, hayo yote ni ubatili, hii ni kukimbiza upepo.
Ekegusii: Narigereirie kera egento kegokorwa inse y’erioba, narorire ng’a bionsi nigo bire bosa; nigo enga buna okominyokia embeo.

English: “And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
Kiswahili: Nami nitachagua baadhi yao pia wawe makuhani na Walawi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire: “Nimbeeke abande b’abwo babe abakuani na Abalawi.”

English: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
Kiswahili: Haya yote mwisho wake ni kuharibika yanapotumiwa, kwa sababu msingi wake ni katika maagizo na mafundisho ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: koreng'ana buna Mwanyabaanto bakoyanyora ase amachiiko na amorokererio abo? (Amang'ana ayio onsi nigo agosareka ekero agokorerwa.)

English: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night.”
Kiswahili: Nililala lakini moyo wangu ulikuwa macho. Sikiliza! Mpenzi wangu anabisha: “Nifungulie, dada yangu, mpenzi wangu, hua wangu, asiye na hitilafu. Kichwa changu kimeloa umande, na nywele zangu manyunyu ya usiku.”
Ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge indaire, korende enkoro yane nigo yategesetie. Igwa! Omwanchi one oyio ogokongonta egesieri ogontura. (Omonyuomi) Moiseke ominto, omwanchi one, riruma riane na omoikeranu one, inyigorere! Inyigorere, ekiagera omotwe one otoorire riime, na etukia yane yanyiire nembura ya botuko.

English: Additionally, Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, officers of the Levites, donated to the Levites 5,000 Passover offerings and 500 bulls.
Kiswahili: Konania na nduguze wawili, Shemaya na Nethaneli, pamoja na Hashabia, Yeieli na Yozabadi waliokuwa viongozi wa Walawi, nao pia wakawapa Walawi wana-kondoo na wana-mbuzi 5,000 na mafahali 500, kwa ajili ya sadaka za Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Konania, amo na Semaya na Netaneli, abamura bamwabo, na Hasabia, na Yeieli, na Yosabadi, abanene b’Abalawi, bakaa Abalawi chimanwa chi’eching’ondi, na echie chimbori, chilifu isano (5,000), chibe ebing’wanso bi’Epasaka, ne chiombe amagana atano (500).

English: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
Kiswahili: Mungu aliwatoa kutoka Misri; wao wana nguvu za nyati.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri; barabwo nigo babwate chinguru buna echi'eng'era.

English: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.
Kiswahili: Inawezekana mimi nikawa si mnenaji hodari, lakini ni hodari katika elimu. Jambo hili tumelifanya liwe dhahiri kwenu kwa njia zote.
Ekegusii: Nonya timanyeti gokwana buya, korende obong’aini nimbwate, na ase kera enchera twaorokirie amang’ana onsi ase more.

English: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
Kiswahili: Nimeandika kwa ajili yao mambo mengi kuhusu sheria yangu, lakini wameziangalia kama kitu cha kigeni.
Ekegusii: Nonya nare korika amachiiko aane ase bare ara chilifu ikomi, tibaare koyancha, korende bayabarire koba egento ekegeni ase bare.

English: And there at Gilgal Joshua set up the twelve stones they had taken from the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Naye Yoshua akayasimamisha huko Gilgali yale mawe kumi na mawili ambayo walikuwa wameyachukua katikati ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Agwo Giligali Yoshua akabeeka amo amagena aria ikomi na abere arusetigwe Yorodani.

English: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.
Kiswahili: Mfalme aliporudi kutoka Dameski na kuona hayo madhabahu, akayasogelea na kutoa sadaka juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti achete korwa Damesiki agakerora egesasiimero, akageika ang’e, akarua ekeng’wanso igoro yaye.

English: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na moja, mwezi wa kwanza, siku ya saba, neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o ikomi nomo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yothamu, pamoja na vita vyake vyote na vitu vingine alivyofanya, vimeandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ande onsi Yotamu akorete, ne chiseegi chiaye chionsi, ne chinchera chi'obogima bwaye, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'Abarwoti b'Abaisraeli na ab'Abayuda.

English: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kwa mara nyingine tena wazee wanaume kwa wanawake walioshiba umri wataketi katika barabara za Yerusalemu, kila mmoja akiwa na mkongojo wake mkononi kwa sababu ya umri wake.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Abagaaka na abang’ina nabanyorekane ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu naende, kera oyomo nabe nenyimbo yaye agwesiirera, ekiagera babeire abagotu mono.

English: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD
Kiswahili: Makuhani walipoondoka katika Mahali Patakatifu, wingu likajaza Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakuani baarenge gosoka korwa ase Aase Aachenu, riire rigaichora enyomba y’Omonene,

English: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Bwana na akupe hekima na ufahamu wakati atakuweka juu ya Israeli, ili uweze kuishika sheria ya Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene akoe obong'aini na okomanya, erio ekero orabe gokogambera Abaisraeli obwate amachiiko a Omonene, Nyasae oo.

English: Judas heard how they had made for themselves a senate house, and day by day, three hundred twenty men sat in council, consulting always for the people, to the end they might be well governed,
Kiswahili: Yuda alisikia jinsi walivyojijengea nyumba ya seneti, na siku baada ya siku, watu mia tatu na ishirini walikaa barazani, wakishauriana na watu kila mara, ili waweze kutawaliwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baroisetie egeikaranso kiabagaaka 320 abwo barenge goikaransa na goetia amang'ana yogokinigwa kwabo.

English: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya hivi kwa sababu wameniacha mimi na kuabudu Ashtorethi mungu mke wa Wasidoni, Kemoshi mungu wa Wamoabu, na Moleki mungu wa Waamoni, nao hawakwenda katika njia zangu ili kufanya yaliyo sawa machoni pangu, wala kushika amri na sheria zangu kama Daudi, babaye Solomoni, alivyofanya.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo arakoreke, ekiagera bantigire na basasimire Asitaroti, enyasae enkuungu y'Abasidoni, na Kemosi, enyasae y'Abamoabu, na Milikomu, enyasae y'Abaamoni, gose tibabwateti chinchera chiane na tibakorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bwane ase okorenda emeroberio yane echiikire na amachiiko aane, buna Daudi ise akorete.

English: Woe to you Pharisees! You love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu Mafarisayo, kwa sababu ninyi mnapenda kukalia viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, Abafarisai! Ekiagera mwanchete goikaransa ebirogo bia bosio ase chisinagogi, na gokwanigwa namasikani ase chichiiro.

English: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
Kiswahili: Pigeni baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume wakati wa Mwandamo wa Mwezi, na wakati wa mwezi mpevu, katika siku ya Sikukuu yetu;
Ekegusii: Mobugie egetureeri ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekero oorokire omogima, ase ogosika rituko riaito ri’omoyega richikiire.

English: If he fails in understanding, have patience with him. Don't dishonor him in your full strength.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa atashindwa kuelewa, mvumilie. Usimwaibishe kwa nguvu zako zote.
Ekegusii: Nonya nekero chisemi chi'amoereire, omoremererie; gose tomosiereria ase engencho ore n'echinguru n'obuya bw'omobere.

English: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh's angel pursuing them.
Kiswahili: Njia yao na iwe giza na ya utelezi, malaika wa Bwana akiwafuatilia.
Ekegusii: Omosunte na oboterere bibe ase enchera bagoetera, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobabwata abasirie.

English: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
Kiswahili: akawapa nchi za mataifa, wakawa warithi wa mali wengine walikuwa wameitaabikia:
Ekegusii: Akabaa chinse chi’abaanto b’ebisaku chikaba echiabo, akabaa n’ebinto abanto abwo konya bechandeire.

English: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.
Kiswahili: Watu wote katika sinagogi waliposikia maneno haya, wakakasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Bagachia koigwa aya, bonsi ase esinagogi bagaichorwa nendamwamu.

English: Then all the men of his city will stone him to death. So you must purge the evil from among you, and all Israel will hear and be afraid. Cursed Is Anyone Hung on a Tree
Kiswahili: Kisha wanaume wote wa mjini mwake watampiga kwa mawe mpaka afe. Ndivyo imewapasa kuondoa maovu kati yenu. Israeli yote itasikia hili na kuogopa. Sheria Mbalimbali
Ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bamoake amagena goika akwe. Ase enchera eyio morusie obobe borue ase egati yaino. Abaisraeli bonsi kobaraigwe ayio, mbairoke. Amachiiko ande ao ao

English: They were exceedingly afraid at his approach, and were troubled for Jerusalem and for the temple of the Lord their God;
Kiswahili: Waliogopa sana kwa sababu ya kukaribia kwake, na wakafadhaika kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu na kwa ajili ya hekalu la Bwana Mungu wao;
Ekegusii: Bakabwatwa nekeondoko amo n'obwoba obonge ase engencho ye'Hekalu y'Omonene Nyasae obo n'omochie o Yerusalemu.

English: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn't you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
Kiswahili: Basi nikaendelea kusema, “Mnachokifanya si sawa. Je, haikuwapasa kutembea katika hofu ya Mungu wetu ili tuepukane na shutuma za adui zetu wasioamini?
Ekegusii: Erio naende nkabateebia, “Amang'ana aya mogokora tari amaya. Inee! Tebagwenereti momoiroke Nyasae oito ase orogendo rwaino, erio nario abanto b'ebisaku, ababisa baito, batabe nengencho y'ogotochaya?

English: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea; all the depths of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
Kiswahili: Watapita katika bahari ya mateso; bahari iliyochafuka itatulizwa na vilindi vyote vya Mto Naili vitakauka. Kiburi cha Ashuru kitashushwa, nayo fimbo ya utawala ya Misri itatoweka.
Ekegusii: Ekero baraete ase egati y’enyancha y’emechando, inche Omonene ning’ake emerindo yaye, ne chindiba chionsi chi’orooche rwa Naeli nchikame; na igo oboenenu bw’Abaasuri mbotiringerwe inse, na enyimbo y’obogambi ya Misiri nesirigwe.

English: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya amani ataleta sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yote ya mnyama yafunikayo sehemu za ndani, ama yanayoungana na hizo sehemu za ndani,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase eng'iti y'ekeng'wanso ekio ki'omorembe arusie ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi'enda, n'ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere n'ebitinya bichitubete; n'ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa n'omorero ase 'nde inche Omonene.

English: My brother took coffee before going to work.
Kiswahili: Ndugu yangu alikunywa kahawa kabla ya kwenda kazini.
Ekegusii: Momura ominto nanyua ekagwa ataragenda emeremo.

English: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki na anipige: ni jambo la huruma; na anikemee: ni mafuta kichwani mwangu. Kichwa changu hakitalikataa. Hata hivyo, maombi yangu daima ni kinyume cha watenda mabaya,
Ekegusii: Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.

English: And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man:
Kiswahili: Hakika damu ya uhai wenu nitaidai. Nitaidai kutoka kwa kila mnyama. Kutoka kwa kila mwanadamu pia nitaidai kwa ajili ya uhai wa mtu mwenzake.
Ekegusii: Amaene, amanyinga y’obogima bwaino ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe; korwa ase kera eng’iti ninyaganie, na korwa ase kera omonto oyogoita oyomwabo ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe obogima bw’omonto oyio.

English: He who shows mercy will lend to his neighbor. He who strengthens him with his hand keeps the commandments.
Kiswahili: Mwenye huruma atamkopesha jirani yake, na yeye amtiaye nguvu kwa mkono wake huzishika amri.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n'amaabera nigo akoa oyomwabo singo; gokoonya omwamate oo okwo nakwo oikerania ebirage.

English: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it's because you have no bread? Don't you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?
Kiswahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akawauliza: “Mbona mnajadiliana kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate? Je, bado hamtambui wala hamwelewi? Je, mbona mioyo yenu ni migumu kiasi hicho?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabateebia, “Inaki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timokomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong'u goika bono?

English: And from the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Nebo: Yeieli, Matithia, Zabadi, Zebina, Yadai, Yoeli na Benaya.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Nebo: Yeieli na Matitia, Sabadi na Sebiina, Yadai na Yoel, na Benaya.

English: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: dunia ilitikisika, mbingu zikanyesha mvua, mbele za Mungu, Yule wa Sinai, mbele za Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: ense nigo yatengechete, embura egatwa korwa igoro, na aye Nyasae nao kwarenge. Nonya negetunwa gia Sinai nigo giatengechete, ekero aye Nyasae kwarengeo; aye ore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu lile shamba likaitwa Shamba la Damu hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omogondo oyo nigo okorokwa Omogondo bw'Amanyinga goika reero.

English: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa kwamba Abrahamu alikuwa na wana wawili, mmoja wa mwanamke mtumwa na wa pili wa mwanamke huru.
Ekegusii: Naki neriikire, ng'a Aburaamu nigo arenge nabana babere abamura, oyomo bw'omokuungu omosomba, na oyomo bw'omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.

English: They cast him into the lion's den, where he was six days.
Kiswahili: Wakamtupa kwenye tundu la simba, ambapo alikaa kwa siku sita.
Ekegusii: Ime ase engoro eyio nchiarengeo chindo isano naibere echi chiarenge korgerigwa abanto babera amo ne ching'ondi ibere ase kera rituko; ekaba tichiaegwa endagera eyio ase amatuko ayio Danieli arenge ase engoro eria erio chimotandorane na komoria

English: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Akawatoa watu waliokuwa humo, akawaweka wafanye kazi kwa misumeno, sululu za chuma na mashoka. Daudi akafanya hivi kwa miji yote ya Waamoni. Kisha Daudi na jeshi lake lote wakarudi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Naende akabasokia abanto barenge ase omochie ime, akababetereria gokora emeremo ne chinseke, na amakombe 'ebioma, na ebisire. Naboigo Daudi akorete abanto b'emechie yonsi y'Abaamoni. Erio akairana Yerusalemu amo nabaanto baye.

English: But when he was already present there with his guards near the treasury, the Sovereign of spirits and of all authority caused a great manifestation, so that all who had presumed to come with him, stricken with dismay at the power of God, fainted in terror.
Kiswahili: Lakini alipokuwa tayari amekuwepo pale pamoja na walinzi wake karibu na hazina, Mfalme wa roho na mamlaka yote alisababisha udhihirisho mkubwa, hivi kwamba wote waliodhania kuja naye, wakiwa wameshikwa na fadhaa kwa nguvu ya Mungu, walizimia kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Korende ere amo n'abarendi baye baigete ase ekegancha gi'Hekalu, Omonene bw'emeika yonsi n'okobua gwonsi agakora egento ki'ogokumia erio kera oyomo oyosoete ase Hekalu ime amo na Heliodoro agasogwa n'obwoba nakoererwa chinguru.

English: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don't invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
Kiswahili: “Uzingatie kutenda kila kitu nilichokuambia. Usiombe kwa majina ya miungu mingine, wala usiyaruhusu kusikika kinywani mwako.
Ekegusii: “Motegerere mono onsi aya nabateebirie na moyabwate. Timwatora amarieta ye chinyasae chinde; ayio taigugwa korwa ase emenwa yaino.”

English: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “Bwana, niko tayari kwenda pamoja nawe gerezani na hata kifoni.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omonene nigo inde ang’e kogenda amo naye echela, nonya nase ogokwa.”

English: were alternating carved cherubim and palm trees. Each cherub had two faces:
Kiswahili: kulinakshiwa makerubi na miti ya mitende. Miti ya mitende ilikuwa kati ya kerubi na kerubi. Kila kerubi alikuwa na nyuso mbili:
Ekegusii: Emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba na ey’emekendo in’yarengeo. Ase kera egati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, omokendo norengeo, na kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba nigo arenge namasio abere;
