English: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote anayesema kwa lugha, hasemi na wanadamu bali anasema na Mungu. Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote anayemwelewa, kwani anasema mambo ya siri kwa roho.
Ekegusii: Naki oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, tari gokwana nabaanto, korende na Nyasae, ekiagera onde tari okomoigwa, korende nigo agokwana amang’ana abobisi ase Omoika.

English: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
Kiswahili: Nimekusudia moyoni mwangu kuyafuata maagizo yako mpaka mwisho.
Ekegusii: Narure enkoro yane erende amachiiko ao, botambe goika omoerio.

English: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili wampe sehemu ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu. Lakini wale wakulima wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde bamoe ensemo yaye y’amatunda y’emesabibu. Abaremi bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

English: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
Kiswahili: Je, ni lazima kundi langu wajilishe kwa yale mliyoyakanyaga na kunywa maji mliyoyachafua kwa miguu yenu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ching’ondi chiane nigo chirabe chikorisia obonyansi mwatiringire namagoro aino, naende chinywe amaache ayio mwaturubanirie namagoro aino?

English: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Siku zake za utakaso kwa ajili ya mwana au binti zitakapotimia, mwanamke huyo atamletea kuhani kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mwana-kondoo mwenye umri wa mwaka mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na kinda la njiwa au hua kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: “Ekero amatuko 'omokuungu oyio ay'ogochenwa aerire, karabe nomwana omoisia aiboire, gose egesagane, omokungu oyio arente eng'ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa, ne riige rie riruma, gose riruma, ribe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Abirente ase Omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: And when the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done was evil in the sight of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda wa maombolezo kwisha, Daudi akamtaka aletwe nyumbani kwake, naye akawa mkewe, na akamzalia mwana. Lakini jambo alilokuwa amefanya Daudi lilimchukiza Bwana.
Ekegusii: na ekero omokungu oria akoorire korera Daudi agatoma omonto komwoyia. Batiseba akaba moga Daudi, na magega y’ayio akamoiborera omwana omoisia. Korende amang’ana ayio Daudi akorete akagechia Omonene.

English: A man takes joy in a fitting reply— and how good is a timely word!
Kiswahili: Mtu hupata furaha katika kutoa jibu linalofaa: je, ni zuri namna gani neno lililotoka kwa wakati wake!
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogookera okoiraneria okuya gokorua ase omonwa oye, ne ring’ana rigokwanwa ase engaki egwenerete, nigo rire rigiya mono.

English: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
Kiswahili: Katika siku Bwana atakapokuondolea mateso, udhia na utumwa wa kikatili,
Ekegusii: Nebe ekero Omonene abaeire ogotimoka korwa ase emechando yaino, na obokong'u, na emeremo emekong'u mwarenge gokorigwa,

English: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.
Kiswahili: Shikeni amri zangu na kuzifuata. Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwafanyaye ninyi watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Mobwate amachiiko aane na koyakora; inche ninche Omonene, nkobachena.

English: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria six months.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na nane wa utawala wa Azaria mfalme wa Yuda, Zekaria mwana wa Yeroboamu akawa mfalme wa Israeli katika Samaria, naye akatawala miezi sita.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na etano na etato bw’okogaamba gw’Asaria omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Zakaria, mosinto o Yeroboamu, akagaambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo.

English: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.
Kiswahili: Akawapeleka Lebanoni kwa zamu za watu 10,000 kwa mwezi, hivyo walikaa Lebanoni kwa mwezi mmoja na miezi miwili nyumbani. Adoniramu ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa shokoa.
Ekegusii: Agaatanana abanto aba ase ebiombe bitato, kera ekeombe gekaba abanto chilifu ikomi. Kera ekeombe gekaba kegokora emeremo agwo Lebanoni ase omotienyi oyomo na kobeera inka ase emetienyi ebere. Adoniramu akabeekwa gotenenera emeremo eyio yagwenerete gokorwa.

English: Now Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers at Shechem and said to them and to all the clan of his mother,
Kiswahili: Siku moja Abimeleki mwana wa Yerub-Baali akaenda kwa ndugu ya mama yake huko Shekemu na kuwaambia yeye na ukoo wote wa mama yake,
Ekegusii: Abimeleki, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, akageenda Sekemu, ase abaang’inarome, na ase abanto bonsi b’eamate ya ise ng’ina, akabateebia

English: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe, kwa haki yako uniokoe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!

English: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.
Kiswahili: Wakalihifadhi jambo hilo wao wenyewe, lakini wakawa wanajiuliza, “Huku kufufuka kwa wafu maana yake nini?”
Ekegusii: Bakabwata ring’ana riria, bakaboorania barabwo ase barabwo, ng’a okoboka korwa ase abakuure, engencho yaye ninki.

English: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
Kiswahili: mahali ambapo utapinda, na kuunganika na Kijito cha Misri na kumalizikia kwenye Bahari ya Kati.
Ekegusii: na korwa agwo Asimoni rogenderere kobwatia orooche rw'orobebe rwa Misiri, roike Enyancha Enene.

English: Then King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest, “Offer on the great altar the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, and the king’s burnt offering and grain offering, as well as the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings of all the people of the land. Sprinkle on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar to seek guidance.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Ahazi akatoa amri zifuatazo kwa Uria kuhani: “Juu ya hayo madhabahu kubwa mapya, toa sadaka ya asubuhi ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya jioni ya nafaka, sadaka ya mfalme ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya watu wote wa nchi, pamoja na sadaka yao ya nafaka na sadaka yao ya kinywaji. Unyunyize juu ya hayo madhabahu damu yote ya sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu. Lakini mimi nitatumia hayo madhabahu ya zamani ya shaba kwa ajili ya kutafuta uongozi.”
Ekegusii: Ahasi omorwoti agachiika Uria Omokuani, akamoteebia: “Igoro ase egesasiimero keria ekenene asambere ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa kia mambia, na okoruegwa kw’endagera kwa mogoroba, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ki’omorwoti, na okoruegwa kwaye kw’endagera, amo nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bi’abaanto bonsi b’ense eye, na okoruegwa kwabo kw’endagera amo nokw’ebinyugwa. Naende onyororokerie amanyinga onsi ay’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ay’ebing’wanso binde igoro yaye. Korende egesasiimero keria gi’etai ogentigere indore inki ndagekorere.”

English: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, tangu sasa mtu yeyote asinitaabishe, kwa maana nachukua katika mwili wangu chapa zake Yesu.
Ekegusii: Korwa bono monto onde tanchanda; naki nabogoirie ekemanyererio kia Yeso ase omobere one.

English: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”
Kiswahili: Mwingine aliitwa Eliezeri, kwa kuwa alisema, “Mungu wa baba yangu alikuwa msaada wangu, akaniokoa kutoka upanga wa Farao.”
Ekegusii: Boigo akaroka omwana oye okabere Eliezeri agateeba, “Nyasae o tata obeire omokonyi one, agantooria korwa ase ogoita gwa Farao”.

English: It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.” And they scolded her.
Kiswahili: Mafuta haya yangeweza kuuzwa kwa zaidi ya dinari 300, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.” Wakamkemea vikali huyo mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa chidinari amagana atato na kobua, abataka baegwe.” Bakamwemurunganeria omokungu oria mono.

English: They forcibly circumcised the boys who were uncircumcised, as many as they found in the coasts of Israel.
Kiswahili: Walitahiri wavulana ambao hawakuwa wametahiriwa kwa nguvu, kama wengi waliowapata katika mipaka ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: na kobaarokia ne chinguru abamura bonsi bare konyoora bataarokiri ime ya Israeli.

English: He entered into it on the twenty-third day of the second month, in the one hundred seventy-first year, with praise and palm branches, with harps, with cymbals, and with stringed instruments, with hymns, and with songs, because a great enemy had been destroyed out of Israel.
Kiswahili: Aliingia humo siku ya ishirini na tatu ya mwezi wa pili, katika mwaka wa mia moja na sabini na moja, akiwa na sifa na matawi ya mitende, na vinubi, na matoazi, na vinanda, na nyimbo, kwa sababu adui mkuu alikuwa ameangamizwa katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riemerongo ebere nagatato na ase omotienyi o kabere omwaka bwe rigana erimo na merongo eta'nebere noyomo (171), okaba omoyega omonene bwokoiraneria mbuya mono ase omochie o Yerusalemu ekiagera okwoboyia gwokoondokia kwaruusetigwe aroro. Simioni na abanto baye bagasoa ime yeburi eria bakobugia ebinubi, ebita na amakano boigo chitebe bagoteera chingeero chi'ogotogia na koiraneria mbuya mono barabwo babogoretie amato yemekendo.

English: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Sanbalati Mhoroni na Tobia afisa Mwamoni waliposikia juu ya jambo hili, waliudhika sana kwamba amekuja mtu kuinua ustawi wa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Sanibalati korwa Beti-Horoni, na Tobia, omonene bw'orogongo rw'Abaamoni, baigwete ng'a omonto gete ochire gokorera Abaisraeli amaya, bakagechigwa bakaba nekeririanda ekenene mono.

English: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yadai walikuwa: Regemu, Yothamu, Geshani, Peleti, Efa na Shaafu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yahadai nabwo aba: Regemu na Yotamu, Gesani na Peleti, Efa na Saafu.

English: When those who were in the tents heard, they were amazed at what happened.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa kwenye mahema waliposikia, walishangaa kilichotokea.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria barenge ase ebitwori baigwa ayabeete bakoboa,

English: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu sasa, hadi siku hii ya leo, hamkuwaacha ndugu zenu, bali ninyi mmetimiza ile kazi Bwana Mungu wenu aliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aya amange timwatigete Abaisraeli bamino goika reero iga. Mwarendire mono na koigwera ay'Omonene, Nyasae oino abachigete mokore.

English: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people. The Golden Calf (Exodus 32:1–35; Acts 7:39–43)
Kiswahili: Basi mjue, si kwa sababu ya haki yenu Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa nchi hii nzuri kuimiliki, kwa kuwa ninyi ni taifa lenye shingo ngumu. Ndama Ya Dhahabu
Ekegusii: Ase ayio mobe n’obomaene ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, tari gochia kobaa ense eria engiya ekiagera more abanyene oboronge. Taibo! Inwe nigo more abanto abanyabigoti bikong’u.”

English: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
Kiswahili: Juu ya kinara chenyewe vitakuwepo vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.
Ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria ribe nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha.

English: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
Kiswahili: Nikodemo akamuuliza, “Mambo haya yanawezekanaje?”
Ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki aranyare koba aya?”

English: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
Kiswahili: Maria akafadhaishwa sana na maneno haya, akajiuliza moyoni, “Salamu hii ni ya namna gani?”
Ekegusii: Mariamu agaichana mono ase ring’ana eri, erio ere akebooria, “Ngokwania ki oko?”

English: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa maombi ya Daudi mwana wa Yese.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omoerio bw’ogosaba gwa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.

English: His heart was lifted up, and he planned to make himself master of the country, and he made deceitful plans against Simon and his sons, to do away with them.
Kiswahili: Moyo wake uliinuka, akapanga kujifanya mtawala wa nchi, na akapanga mipango ya udanganyifu dhidi ya Simoni na wanawe, ili kuwaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Korende ere nigo arenge nobote obonene, akarigia koira oborai bw'ense. Ere agakoraobobisi bw'okomoita Simioni na momura oye.

English: And while they didn't sin before their God, they prospered, because God who hates iniquity was with them.
Kiswahili: Na ingawa hawakufanya dhambi mbele za Mungu wao, walifanikiwa, kwa sababu Mungu anayechukia uovu alikuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Kera ekero barabwo batakorete ebibe ase Nyasae obo, bakaba bagokiina ekiagera Nyasae obo nigo ageechete ebibe. 5:17 rora Abal 28:1-68

English: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
Kiswahili: Basi wakawaita watawala wote wa Wafilisti pamoja na kusema, “Liondoeni Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli na lirudishwe mahali pake, la sivyo litatuua sisi na watu wetu.” Kwa kuwa kifo kilikuwa kimeujaza mji hofu; kwani mkono wa Mungu ulikuwa mzito sana juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma Abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b'Abafilisti, bakaboora: “Rusia aiga Esanduki eye ya Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, moyeiranie gochia aase aye, teebaisa gotoita intwe amo nabana baito.” Obwoba bw'amakweri konya bwasoire ase omochie bwonsi, ekiagera okoboko kw'Omonene nigo kwareenge okorito mono aroro.

English: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
Kiswahili: Kwa jambo hili, wakararua nguo zao. Ndipo wote wakapakiza mizigo yao juu ya punda zao na kurudi mjini.
Ekegusii: Erio bonsi bagatandora chianga chiabo; kera omonto akabeekera etigere yaye egurube, bakairana gochia ase omochie.

English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hebroni: Yeria alikuwa mkuu, Amaria wa pili, Yahazieli wa tatu, na Yekameamu wa nne.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria omotangi, na Amaria oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu oyo o kane;

English: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
Kiswahili: nao wakamvuta juu kwa kamba na kumtoa katika kisima. Yeremia akakaa katika ua wa walinzi. Sedekia Amhoji Yeremia Tena
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakang’usa Yeremia ne chingori chiria korwa ase engoro eria, bakamorusiao. Na Yeremia akagenderera kobeera ase egoora y’abarendi. Zedekia okoboria Yeremia amosemie

English: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? Jehoiachin Reigns in Judah (2 Chronicles 36:9–10)
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yehoyakimu na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoyakimu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abayuda.

English: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be beaten back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Yoshua na Israeli wote wakaruhusu kurudishwa nyuma mbele yao, na kuelekea jangwani.
Ekegusii: Yoshua amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bagekora buna babuirwe, bagatama gochia erooro.

English: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu ashukuriwe, yeye ambaye siku zote hutufanya tuandamane kwa ushindi tukiwa ndani ya Kristo. Naye kupitia kwetu hueneza kila mahali harufu nzuri ya kumjua yeye.
Ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ere oyogotoraa ase okobua okonene botambe ase Kristo, naende oyogosokia rimisu rigiya goetera ase tore, erinde bamomanye kera aase.

English: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.
Kiswahili: Wajapopelekwa uhamishoni na adui zao, huko nako nitaamuru upanga uwaue. Nitawakazia macho yangu kwa mabaya wala si kwa mazuri.”
Ekegusii: Nabaisa koirwa ase obosomba nababisa babo, aroro agwo ninchike emioro ebaite. Nimbaonchorere amaiso ane mbakorere ayare amabe na tari ayare amaya.”

English: You shall not have two differing weights in your bag, one heavy and one light.

English: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mioyo ya watu hawa imekuwa migumu; hawasikii kwa masikio yao, na wamefumba macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, na kugeuka nami nikawaponya.’
Ekegusii: Naki chinkoro chi’abaanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo, gose baigwe namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.

English: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his sword into his opponent’s side, and they all fell together. So this place, which is in Gibeon, is called Helkath-hazzurim.
Kiswahili: Kisha kila mtu akakamatana na mpinzani wake kichwani na kuchomana kwa upanga, nao wakaanguka chini pamoja. Kwa hiyo mahali pale katika Gibeoni pakaitwa Helkath-Hasurimu.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo akabwata omotwe bw’oyo riare koamererania, na komobeta omoyio ase riikere; bonsi bakagwa inse bagakwa. Ase ayio, aase aria a Gibeoni akarokwa Helikati‐Hasurimu.

English: And the Lord delivered into his hand Jehoiakim king of Judah, along with some of the articles from the house of God. He carried these off to the land of Shinar, to the house of his god, where he put them in the treasury of his god.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamtia Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda mkononi mwa Nebukadneza, pamoja na baadhi ya vyombo kutoka Hekalu la Mungu. Hivi akavichukua hadi kwenye hekalu la mungu wake huko Shinari, naye akaviweka nyumbani ya hazina ya mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabeeka Yehoyakimu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro. Boigo akaa Nebukadinesaro ribaga aire ebikorero binde bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, na ere akabiira ase ense ya Shinari, ase enyomba y’enyasae yaye, akabibeka ase ekungo y’enyomba eria.

English: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
Kiswahili: Yule adui aliyepanda magugu ni ibilisi. Mavuno ni mwisho wa dunia, nao wavunaji ni malaika.
Ekegusii: Omobisa oria oyasimegete nere Saitani; rigesa nomoerio bw'ense, na abaraache kogesa nabamalaika.

English: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Akabaura chinse chiabo chikaba omwando bw' abanto baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”
Kiswahili: Hakika, kama niishivyo,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, “hakika Moabu itakuwa kama Sodoma, Waamoni kama Gomora: mahali pa magugu na mashimo ya chumvi, nchi ya ukiwa milele. Mabaki ya watu wangu watawateka nyara; mabaki ya taifa langu watarithi nchi yao.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteeba iga: “Ekeene, buna inde moyo, ense ya Moabu nebe buna Sodomu, na ense y’Abaamoni nebe buna Gomora, ense ere namasa ne chingoro chire nomonyoo, aase agwo nabe agendererete gosareka botambe. Abatigari b’abaanto baane mbasakore abanto abwo, na abatooregete b’egesaku kiane mbaboose baabakore babe abasomba babo.”

English: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakupiga kwa majipu ya Misri na kwa vidonda vitokavyo usaha na kuwashwa, ambako huwezi kuponywa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabarentere inwe amagumba buna aria arenterete Abamisiri, nabarentere n'amasisa, na okweagia, amarwaire ayio atanyaare kogwenigwa.

English: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
Kiswahili: Mimi namjua kwa kuwa nimetoka kwake, naye ndiye alinituma.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche nimomanyete, ekiagera naruete asare, nere ontomire.”

English: When the letter came to them, they took the king's sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Hiyo barua ilipowafikia, watu hawa wakawachukua wale wana sabini wa mfalme na kuwachinja wote. Wakaweka vichwa vyao ndani ya makapu na kumpelekea Yehu huko Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero riruube riria riabaikerete, bakaimokia abana b'omorwoti emerongo etano na ebere, bakabaita nemioro. Erio bakabeeka emetwe yabo ebitonga ime, bakayetoma gochia ase Yehu agwo Yesireeli.

English: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
Kiswahili: Wageni watayachunga makundi yenu, wageni watafanya kazi katika mashamba yenu, na kutunza mashamba yenu ya mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi mbabe bakobariseria amaicho aino, na abanto b'ebisaku ebiaao mbabe bakobaremera emegondo yaino na kobarendera emesabibu yaino.

English: At this time the Arameans had gone out in bands and had taken a young girl from the land of Israel, and she was serving Naaman’s wife.
Kiswahili: Siku hizo vikosi kutoka Aramu vilikuwa vimekwenda na vikawa vimemteka msichana kutoka Israeli, naye akamtumikia mkewe Naamani.
Ekegusii: Engaki eyemo, ekero Abasiiria bagendete gosakora, bagoosa omoiseke omoke korwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli, na ere akaba ogokorera moka Naamani emeremo.

English: “For our God is a consuming fire.”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa “Mungu wetu ni moto ulao.”
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae oito nomorero okoria na gosiria.

English: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
Kiswahili: Wekeni nadhiri kwa Bwana Mungu wenu na kuzitimiza; nchi zote za jirani na walete zawadi kwa Yule astahiliye kuogopwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe karie chiira ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, na mochiikeranie. Abanto bonsi bamoetanaine, tiga bamorentere ebiegwa, ere oria ogwenerete koirokwa.

English: “I have pardoned them as you requested,” the LORD replied.
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Nimewasamehe kama ulivyoomba.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba, “Nabaabeire koreng’ana buna gwansabire.

English: the LORD is the God of Hosts— the LORD is His name of renown.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Bwana ndilo jina lake!
Ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae bw’Emeganda. Omonene nario erieta riaye.

English: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.
Kiswahili: Waliwajibika kutunza Sanduku la Agano, meza, kinara cha taa, madhabahu, na vile vyombo vya mahali patakatifu vinavyotumika kuhudumu, pazia, na kila kitu kinachohusika na matumizi yake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kwogotianania, n’emesa, n’ekebeekerero gie chitaaya, na ebisasimero, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Obomenyo boria, biria abakuani bagokorera emeremo, amo negetambaa getubete Aase Aachenu Mono. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

English: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akaingia ndani ya lile wingu alivyokuwa akipanda mlimani. Naye akakaa huko mlimani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Musa agasoa riire ime, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akabeera aroro ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.

English: the stands; the basins on the stands;
Kiswahili: vishikio pamoja na masinia yake;
Ekegusii: Boigo akaroisia ebibekerero bi’ebituba amo nebituba biaterekereireo,

English: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
Kiswahili: Mitume walipokuwa wamekusanyika pamoja, wakamuuliza Yesu, “Bwana, je, huu ndio wakati wa kuwarudishia Israeli ufalme?”
Ekegusii: Erio ekero basangererekanete amo, bakamobooria: “Omonene, ekero eke nakio okoiraneria Abaisraeli oborwoti bwabo?”

English: “Go in peace,” said the king. So Absalom got up and went to Hebron.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamwambia, “Enenda kwa amani.” Hivyo akaenda Hebroni.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoteebia, “Geenda nomorembe.” Ase igo Abisalomu akaimoka, akageenda Heburoni.

English: For on that day, every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold that your own hands have sinfully made.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa katika siku ile kila mmoja wenu atazikataa sanamu za fedha na za dhahabu zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono yenu yenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Engaki ngocha ere kera omonto aratugute emegwekano yaye agosasiima eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu, eyio mwaroisetie namaboko aino, na igo mogakora ebibe.

English: And all the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “We did this because the king is our relative. Why does this anger you? Have we ever eaten at the king’s expense or received anything for ourselves?”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wa Yuda wakawajibu watu wa Israeli, “Tulifanya hivi kwa sababu mfalme ni jamaa yetu wa karibu. Kwa nini mnakasirikia jambo hili? Je, tumekula kitu chochote cha mfalme? Je, tumejichukulia kitu chochote kwa ajili yetu wenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Abayuda bonsi bakairaneria Abaisraeli, “Nigo twakorete igo, ekiagera omorwoti nigo are bw’eamate yaito. Nase ki rende mokobeea ase amang’ana ayio? Inee! Twarire gento kende ki’omorwoti? Gose otoeire keegwa kende?”

English: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
Kiswahili: “Je, Mungu hayuko katika mbingu za juu? Juu kuliko nyota zilizo juu sana!
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae tari aaria igoro mono? Rigereria ching’enang’eni chia igoro buna chire aare mono!

English: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
Kiswahili: Hezro Mkarmeli, Naarai mwana wa Ezbai,
Ekegusii: Hesero korwa Karimeli, na Naara, mosinto bw’Esibai;

English: “Where is He?” they asked. “I do not know,” he answered. The Pharisees Investigate the Healing
Kiswahili: Wale wakamuuliza, “Yeye huyo mtu yuko wapi?” Akawajibu, “Sijui.” Mafarisayo Wachunguza Kuponywa Kwa Kipofu
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai are oyio?” Akabora, “Timanyeti.”

English: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wale walio kando ya njia ambako neno lilipandwa. Walisikiapo neno, Shetani huja mara na kulinyakua lile neno lililopandwa ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo bare buna embusuro eyio ekogwa enchera ensemo; na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa ring’ana, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.

English: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword, use it as a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, sasa chukua upanga mkali na uutumie kama wembe wa kinyozi ili kunyolea nywele za kichwa chako na ndevu zako. Kisha uchukue mizani ya kupimia ukazigawanye nywele hizo.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imokia omoyio o birende omwoge, bwekigite etukia y’omotwe oo, ne chinderu chiao; erio orente ekerengero orengere etukia eyio na oyiatanane.

English: A stone was brought and placed over the mouth of the den, and the king sealed it with his own signet ring and with the rings of his nobles, so that nothing concerning Daniel could be changed.
Kiswahili: Jiwe likaletwa na kuwekwa kwenye mdomo wa tundu, naye mfalme akalitia muhuri kwa pete yake mwenyewe pamoja na kwa pete za wakuu wake, ili hali ya Danieli isiweze kubadilishwa.
Ekegusii: Rigena rikarentwa rigakuneka ase omonwa bw’engoro eria, erio omorwoti akabeeka ekemanyererio kiaye omonyene amo nebi’abanene b’oborwoti bwaye, erinde amang’ana ande onsi Danieli akoreretwe taonchorwa.

English: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but they didn't make known to me its interpretation.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wachawi, na wachawi, na Wakaldayo, na wanajimu wakaingia; nami nikawasimulia ndoto hiyo; lakini hawakunijulisha tafsiri yake.
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorora narooche ekero naraire borere bw'ane: “Nkarora omote omonene orenge omotambe mono oteneine ase egati‐gati y'ense.

English: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
Kiswahili: Magurudumu manne yalikuwa chini ya papi, na vyuma vya katikati vya kuzungushia magurudumu hayo vilikuwa vimeunganishwa kwenye kitako. Kipenyo cha kila gurudumu kilikuwa dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aye ane nigo abegetwe inse ye chinsingo chiaye, ne rinyongo riaye nigo ribwateranirie nekebekerero. Obotambe bwa kera okogoro nigo bwarenge obw'okoboko okomo na ekeng'ese.

English: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo koo za wana wa Noa, kufuatana na vizazi vyao, katika mataifa yao. Kutokana na hawa mataifa yalienea duniani kote baada ya gharika.
Ekegusii: Echio nachio chiamate chi'abana ba Nuhu, koreng'ana na ororeeria rwabo ase ebisaku biabo; na korwa ase bare ebisaku bigesiarera ase ense yonsi magega y'etoigo.

English: I have hated many things, but nothing like him. The Lord will hate him.
Kiswahili: Nimechukia vitu vingi, lakini hakuna kitu kama yeye. Bwana atamchukia.
Ekegusii: Ase obogima bwane bwonsi ningeechete amang'ana amange korende inche tingecheti ing'ana rinde rionsi buna ingeechete omonto onga buna oyio, Omonene boigo nigo amogeechete.

English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie yale ambayo Roho ayaambia makanisa.
Ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogoteebia chikanisa.

English: After the anguish of His soul, He will see the light of life and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many, and He will bear their iniquities.
Kiswahili: Baada ya maumivu ya nafsi yake, ataona nuru ya uzima na kuridhika; kwa maarifa yake, mtumishi wangu mwenye haki atawafanya wengi kuwa wenye haki, naye atayachukua maovu yao.
Ekegusii: Ere narore okwama kw’emechando y’omoyo oye na goisaneka; ase obong’aini bwaye omosomba one omonyene oboronge nakore abanto abange babe abanyene oboronge, ekiagera nabogorie ebibe biabo.

English: A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Mtu anayekata tamaa angetazamia moyo wa kujitoa wa rafiki zake, hata kama akiacha uchaji wa Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Oyotakororera omosani oye amaabera oyio, rirorio otigire koiroka Omobui.

English: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wake walisema hivi kwa sababu waliwaogopa Wayahudi kwani walikuwa wamekubaliana kuwa mtu yeyote atakayemkiri Yesu kuwa ndiye Kristo atafukuzwa kutoka sinagogi.
Ekegusii: Abaibori baye nigo bakwanete aya ase okoiroka Abayahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi konya babwatanire, ng’a monto onde bwensi oramoorokie ng’a nere Kristo aserigwe korwa ase esinagogi.

English: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,' isn't that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar'?”
Kiswahili: Nawe kama ukiniambia, “Tunamtumainia Bwana Mungu wetu”: je, siyo yeye ambaye Hezekia aliondoa mahali pake pa juu pa kuabudia miungu na madhabahu zake, akiwaambia Yuda na Yerusalemu, “Ni lazima mwabudu mbele ya madhabahu haya”?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe nigo mogonteebia ng'a nigo mosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oino? Tari ere oria aase aye aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa amo nebisasimero biaye Hezekia atagoire, agateebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu: Mobe mogosasiima bosio bw'egesasiimero eke!

English: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wanakutazama, toboa ukuta utolee mizigo yako hapo.
Ekegusii: Obochore ekebao ase enyasi ekero abanto abwo bakorooche, erio obogorie ebinto biao oetereo.

English: Then the woman, seeing that she could not escape notice, came trembling and fell down before Him. In the presence of all the people, she explained why she had touched Him and how she had immediately been healed.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alipofahamu ya kuwa hawezi kuendelea kujificha, alikuja akitetemeka, akaanguka miguuni mwa Yesu. Akaeleza mbele ya watu wote kwa nini alimgusa na jinsi alivyoponywa mara.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria ekero achia korora ng’a tabisekaneti, agacha okoiguswa, akamogwera, na ase amasio ’abaanto bonsi akamworokia engencho yagera omokuna, naende buna agwenetigwe ara rimo.

English: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule malaika akauzungusha mundu wake duniani na kukusanya zabibu za dunia na kuzitupa kwenye shinikizo kubwa la ghadhabu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akabutora, agasangereria amasabibu ’emesabibu y’ense, na akayaruta ase ekemitero ekenene ki’endamwamu ya Nyasae.

English: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo migawanyo ya wana wa Aroni: Aroni alikuwa na wana wanne: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebiombe bi’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.

English: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
Kiswahili: Waimbaji walikuwa chini ya amri za mfalme, ambazo pia ziliratibu shughuli zao za kila siku.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo aruete ogochika igoro ase abanto b'eamate eyio, buna barenge gokora emeremo y'amatera agwo ase Hekalu, buna yaganeirie rituko ase rituko.

English: Then Moses asked God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is His name?’ What should I tell them?”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Mungu, “Ikiwa nitawaendea Waisraeli na kuwaambia, ‘Mungu wa baba zenu amenituma kwenu,’ nao wakiniuliza, ‘Jina lake ni nani?’ Nitawaambia nini?”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Nyasae, “Kondaimoke kogenda ase Abaisraeli na kobateebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino ontomire inche ase more, barabwo baramboria: Erieta riaye, nere ng’o? Inki ndabateebie?”

English: Khayanga carried her special Gourd everywhere. With her Gourd, Khayanga felt her parents presence and protection.
Kiswahili: Khayanga alikibeba Kibuyu chake cha kipekee kila alipokwenda. Kilimlinda alipokwenda mtoni kuchota maji. Kwa sababu ya Kibuyu chake, Khayanga alihisi kwamba wazazi wake walikuwa naye na walimlinda.
Ekegusii: Korwa rituko erio, Khayanga akabogoria ekerandi keria kera ase arenge kogenda. Agakebeka ase arenge korara, akaba gakoboka nakio na kweyaka amaguta kageikaranserete. Baka ekaba buna kera ekero atagakebogoirie nigo arenge kogechiwa sana. Ekiagera kera ekero agakeboigirie, nigo giakamoinyorie ise na ng'ina yagera oigwa buya.

English: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakiwachunga hao nguruwe wakakimbia wakaingia mjini, wakaeleza yote kuhusu yale yaliyowatokea wale waliokuwa wamepagawa na pepo wachafu.
Ekegusii: Na abarisia b'echimbeche chiria bagatama, bakagenda omochie bakararia amang'ana onsi ayakoregete ase baria babwatire nebirecha.

English: Yahweh sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamtuma Nathani kwa Daudi. Alipofika kwake akamwambia, “Katika mji mmoja kulikuwepo na watu wawili, mmoja alikuwa tajiri na mwingine alikuwa maskini.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agatoma Nathani ase Daudi. Nathani akageenda ase are, akamoteebia, “Abanto babere 'mbaamenyete ase omochie gete, oyomo obo nigo arenge omonda, na oria onde omotaka.

English: Then the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yakobo, “Rudi katika nchi ya baba zako na kwa watu wako, nami nitakuwa pamoja nawe.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiao, ase eamate yao, na inche nimbe amo naye.”

English: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia Yerusalemu na kwenda Hekaluni. Akaangalia kila kitu kilichokuwamo, lakini kwa kuwa ilishakuwa jioni, akaenda zake Bethania pamoja na wale kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yerusalemu agaika ase Hekalu ime; akarigereria buya chinsemo chionsi kera egento. Korende ase engencho nigo kiarenge ekero kia mogoroba, agasoka, akagenda Bethania amo na baria ikomi na babere.

English: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima aichome hiyo nguo, ikiwa ni ya sufu ama kitani iliyofumwa ama kusokotwa, ama chombo chochote cha ngozi chenye maambukizo, kwa kuwa ni upele unaoangamiza; chombo chote ni lazima kichomwe moto.
Ekegusii: Ase igo egento ekio gesambwe n'omorero, gokeraabe eanga, gose egetambaa kende gionsi, keroisirie korwa ase amarionya, gose korwa ase egatani, gose gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere noborwaire obwo ime yaye. Obwo noborwaire obobe bwa ukoma; ebinto ebio goika bisambwe n'omorero.

English: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.
Kiswahili: Wote tunanguruma kama dubu; tunalia kwa maombolezo kama hua. Tunatafuta haki, kumbe hakuna kabisa; tunatafuta wokovu, lakini uko mbali.
Ekegusii: Intwe twensi nigo tokwamuma buna chidubu, na tweumia buna amaruma; nigo toganetie ay'oboronge, korende tibori aande; nigo toganetie ogotooreka, korende nigo kore aare naintwe.

English: He will suck cobra venom. The viper's tongue will kill him.
Kiswahili: Atanyonya sumu za majoka; meno ya nyoka mwenye sumu kali yatamuua.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nanyunyunte obosongo bw'eng'iti nomonwa, na obosongo bokorwa ase oromeme rw'eng'iti eria mbomoite.

English: Strength resides in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
Kiswahili: Nguvu hukaa katika shingo yake; utisho hutangulia mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.

English: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it, nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu wala mawe maangavu haviwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi hubadilishwa na vito vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Chitaabu na ebirore ebiya tibikoreng’anigwa naborobwo, gose tibokoonchorerigwa n’ebinto bi’ogwechabera, biroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

English: When Jehu came to Samaria, he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there, until he had destroyed them, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah. Jehu Kills the Priests of Baal
Kiswahili: Yehu alipofika Samaria, akawaua wale wote waliokuwa wamesalia wa jamaa ya Ahabu, akawaangamiza, sawasawa na neno la Bwana alilosema kupitia Eliya. Watumishi Wa Baali Wauawa
Ekegusii: Na ekero aigete Samaria, agaita abanto bonsi batigarete ase enyomba y’Ahabu agwo Samaria, goika akabasiria kegima, buna Omonene ateebete goetera ase Elija. Abasasimi ba Baali bagoitwa

English: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
Kiswahili: Mkutanikapo pamoja si chakula cha Bwana mnachokula,
Ekegusii: Ekero mogosangererekana amo, timori koria endagera y’Omonene;

English: Then Jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaamuru wawaketishe watu makundi makundi kwenye majani,
Ekegusii: Yeso akabachiika aborokigwa baye baabaikaransie bonsi, ebiombe, ebiombe, ase obonyansi obobese.

English: When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”
Kiswahili: Mungu alipomfufua Yesu Mwanawe, alimtuma kwenu kwanza, ili awabariki kwa kumgeuza kila mmoja wenu kutoka njia yake mbaya.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae abogetie Omosomba oye, akamotoma ase more ritang’ani, erinde abasesenie ase ogwatanana kera oyomo oino korwa ase obobe bwaye.”

English: Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
Kiswahili: Ondoa mkono wako uwe mbali nami, nawe uache kuniogofya kwa hofu zako kuu.
Ekegusii: Rusia okoboko kwao korwa ase ’nde, na okogosa kwao tikogenderera konyoboyia.

English: Wisdom is the focus of the discerning, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Mtu wa ufahamu huitazama hekima, lakini macho ya mpumbavu huhangaika hadi kwenye miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Botambe omonto omong’aini nigo akorora ay’obong’aini amoetanaine, korende omonto omoriri nigo akomaga-maga gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, naye huyo wakamuua. Akawatuma wengine wengi; baadhi yao wakawapiga, na wengine wakawaua.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria naende agatoma omosomba onde naende, na oyio bakamoita agakwa. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita bagakwa.

English: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwenye wivu na Mungu mlipiza kisasi; Bwana hulipiza kisasi na amejaa ghadhabu. Bwana hulipiza kisasi juu ya watesi wake, naye anadumisha ghadhabu yake dhidi ya adui zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae tari gwanchereria abamereria; nigo akobaa egesusuro abwo bakomoengereia. Ase ekeririanda kiaye nabairanerie eri bagwenerete.

English: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
Kiswahili: Atawaweka kondoo upande wake wa kuume, na mbuzi upande wake wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Ching’ondi nachibeeke ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, korende chimbori ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

English: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli amekataa lile lililo jema, adui atamfuatia.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bangire amang'ana are amaya, ase ayio ababisa mbaababwatie.

English: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo Daudi akamuuliza Bwana, “Je, niende kuwashambulia Wafilisti? Je, utawatia mikononi mwangu?” Bwana akamjibu, “Nenda, kwa maana hakika nitawatia Wafilisti mikononi mwako.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabori'Omonene, “Inee! Ndageenda korwania Abafirisiti, nobabeeke ase amaboko ane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee geenda, nimbabeeke ase amaboko ao.”

English: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa wamemkamata Yesu wakampeleka kwa Kayafa, kuhani mkuu, mahali ambapo walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee walikuwa wamekusanyika.
Ekegusii: Baria babwatete Yeso bakamoira ase enyomba ya Kayafa Omokuani omonene, aase aborokia b'amariiko na abagaaka basangererekanete.

English: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
Kiswahili: Kwa kanisa la Mungu lililoko Korintho, kwa wale waliotakaswa katika Kristo Yesu na walioitwa kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na wale wote ambao kila mahali wanaliitia Jina la Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu, aliye Bwana wao na wetu pia:
Ekegusii: nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto, inwe abamwachenirwe ase Kristo Yeso, abamwarangerigwe koba abachenu amo na bonsi abakorangeria erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo kera aase, nere Omonene obo na oyoito.

English: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
Kiswahili: Nitatuma njaa kali dhidi yao maradhi mabaya, yateketezayo na tauni ya kufisha; nitawapelekea meno makali ya wanyama mwitu, na sumu ya nyoka wale watambaao mavumbini.
Ekegusii: ’Nabakwe ase engencho y’enchara ne riberera rikorura, ’nabariegwe namarwaire amabe agoita. Nimbatomere ching’iti chi’orosana chire n’amaino amooge chibarwanie, ne ching’iti chingeenda inse chire n’obosongo, chibarome.

English: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
Kiswahili: Yesu ameonekana anastahili heshima kubwa kuliko Mose, kama vile mjenzi wa nyumba alivyo wa heshima kubwa kuliko nyumba yenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki Yeso nigo abarirwe ng'a nemogwenerete abe nobonene mono kobua Musa, buna omoagachi enyomba are nogosikwa kobua enyomba enyene.

English: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent are stirred against the godless.
Kiswahili: Watu wanyofu wanatishwa na hili; watu wasio na hatia wanasimama dhidi ya wasiomcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaronge bakumirie amang’ana aya, ee, omonto otari na komocha oimokire gokorera bobe oria otamoirogeti Nyasae.

English: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been most pleasant to me.
Kiswahili: Kwa jambo hili niliamka na kuangalia pande zote. Usingizi wangu ulikuwa mtamu kwangu.
Ekegusii: (Aroro agwo nkaboka korwa ase chitoro, nkarigereria, ne chitoro chiane nigo chiarenge chingiya ase ’nde.)

English: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili ya wafalme na wale wote wenye mamlaka, ili tupate kuishi kwa amani na utulivu, katika uchaji wote wa Mungu na utakatifu.
Ekegusii: ase engencho y'abarwoti, na bonsi abaeire okobua, erinde tonyaare koba nobogima bw'oboitongo na obw'omorembe, na ase amang'ana onsi koba ne chingeencho chi'obonyasae, na echi'ogosikana.

English: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
Kiswahili: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.

English: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!
Kiswahili: Ole wenu mnaoongeza nyumba baada ya nyumba na kuunganisha mashamba baada ya mashamba hadi hakuna nafasi iliyobaki, nanyi mnaishi peke yenu katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakwementera enyomba ase enyomba, naende bementera oboremo ase oboremo, goika bakoora aase onsi, erinde ng'a barabwo boka bamenye ase ense eyio engima.

English: But if what I don't desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
Kiswahili: Basi kama ninatenda lile nisilotaka kutenda, ni kwamba ninakubali kuwa sheria ni njema.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ngokora aya ntancheti, rirorio nanchire ng'a amachiiko n'amaya.

English: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. You have praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don't see, or hear, or know; and you have not glorified the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, umejiinua dhidi ya Bwana wa mbingu. Uliletewa vikombe vya Hekalu lake, nawe na wakuu wako, wake zako na masuria wako mlivitumia kwa kunywea mvinyo. Ukaisifu miungu ya fedha na dhahabu, ya shaba, chuma, miti na mawe, miungu ambayo haiwezi kuona, au kusikia wala kufahamu. Lakini hukumheshimu Mungu ambaye anaushikilia uhai wako na njia zako zote mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: korende kweimokereirie igoro mamincha y'Omonene ore igoro. Ebikorero bi'enyomba yaye biarentirwe ase obosio bwao; aye amo nabaanto b'oborwoti bwao, na abakungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere, babinywereire edivai. Aye kwabeire kogotogia chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na emete na amagena, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose chitamanyeti gento, korende Nyasae oria obomoyo bwao bore ase okoboko kwaye, ne chinchera chiao chionsi chire ase okobua kwaye, tomotogeti.

English: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mavuno ni mengi, lakini watendakazi ni wachache. Kwa hiyo mwombeni Bwana wa mavuno, ili apeleke watendakazi katika shamba lake la mavuno.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake; gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.

English: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Wakati dunia yote inashangilia nitakufanya ukiwa.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Ense yonsi negoke ekero ndagosarie obe bosa.

English: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.
Kiswahili: Kiasi cha watu 40,000 waliojiandaa kwa vita walivuka mbele za Bwana hadi nchi tambarare za Yeriko kwa ajili ya vita.
Ekegusii: Abanto koreng'ana chilifu emerongo ene babogoretie ebirwanero, baare ang'e korwana esegi, bagaetera ebirubo ebiomo ang'e na Yeriko, ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.” The First Disciples (Mark 1:16–20; Luke 5:1–11; John 1:35–42)
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo, Yesu alianza kuhubiri akisema: “Tubuni, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.” Yesu Awaita Wanafunzi Wake Wa Kwanza (Marko 1:16-20; Luka 5:1-11)
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba, “Onchoka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e. ” Yeso okorangeria aborokigwa baye b’eritang’ani (Mar 1:16-20; Luk 5:1-11)

English: Hear therefore Yahweh's word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi nyote mlio uhamishoni, niliowapeleka Babeli kutoka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi narusetie Yerusalemu nkabaira Babiloni ase obosomba, tegerera moigwe ring'ana ri'Omonene!

English: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah's letters came to them.
Kiswahili: Pia katika siku hizo wakuu wa Yuda walikuwa wakituma barua nyingi kwa Tobia, nayo majibu yaliyotoka kwa Tobia yaliendelea kuwajia.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio onsi abasike b'Abayuda nigo bagendererete konagotoma amarube amange ase Tobia, nere nabo agendererete kona-gotoma ayande ase okobairaneria.

English: One cliff stood to the north toward Michmash, and the other to the south toward Geba.
Kiswahili: Jabali moja lilisimama kaskazini kuelekea Mikmashi na jingine upande wa kusini kuelekea Geba.
Ekegusii: Egetare ekemo nigo giachongororogete ensemo ya sugusu kororia Mikimasi, na ekende ensemo ya Irianyi kororia Geba.

English: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme na Israeli wote pamoja naye wakatoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti na abanto bonsi amo nere bakarua ekeng'wanso ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: Exceedingly great wrath came upon Israel.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu kubwa sana ikawajia Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase endamwamu ya Nyasae Abaisraeli bagachandeka mono.

English: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Bakbuki, Hakufa, Harhuri,
Ekegusii: Bakibuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;

English: You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
Kiswahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako na kushika masharti yake, amri zake, sheria zake na maagizo yake siku zote.
Ekegusii: “Ase igo bono mwanche Omonene Nyasae oino, botambe mobwate aya achiikire, n’emeroberio yaye echiikire, n’amachiiko aye onsi.

English: The wisdom of the scribe comes by the opportunity of leisure. He who has little business can become wise.
Kiswahili: Hekima ya mwandishi huja kwa fursa ya kupumzika. Yeye ambaye hana shughuli nyingi anaweza kuwa na hekima.
Ekegusii: Ebiro nigo bikomoa omosomi chingaki chikonyoora obong'aini, omonto obwate emeremo emeke nabo aranyare konyoora obong'aini.

English: At last they filled the army with terror and alarm, and departed with good success.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye walilijaza jeshi hofu na wasiwasi, na wakaondoka kwa mafanikio makubwa.
Ekegusii: Omoerio oye abanto bonsi barenge ase eema eria bagaichorwa n'obwoba, Yuda n'abanto baye bakarwa oo n'obobui.

English: there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from among men.
Kiswahili: wale ambao meno yao ni panga na ambao mataya yao yamewekwa visu kuwaangamiza maskini katika nchi, na wahitaji kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare babwate amaino anga emioro, ne chintakunero chi’amaino abo nigo chinga emeyio; barabwo nigo bakoria na gosiria abataka bare ase ense; nigo bakoura abaremeire bare ase abanto.

English: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.
Kiswahili: Basi mfalme alikuwa amemweka yule afisa ambaye mfalme alikuwa anauegemea mkono wake awe msimamizi wa lango. Nao watu wakamkanyaga walipoingia langoni, naye akafa, kama vile mtu wa Mungu alivyokuwa ametangulia kusema wakati mfalme alipofika nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Bono omorwoti konya ochorire omotang'ani oria bw'abasikari, ere omonyene egenete, abe omorendi bw'egeita. Abanto bakamotindachera agwo ase egeita goika agakwa, buna omonto oria o Nyasae ateebete ekero omorwoti achete asare.

English: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
Kiswahili: Niambieni kiasi cha mahari na zawadi nitakayoileta, hata iwe kubwa kiasi gani, nami nitawalipa chochote mtakachodai. Nipeni tu huyu msichana awe mke wangu.”
Ekegusii: Mboorie enibo ende yonsi na ebiegwa boigo, nimbae buna moraganie, kogicha mong'e omoiseke oyo abe mokane.”

English: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
Kiswahili: Nitegee sikio lako, uje uniokoe haraka; uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, ngome imara ya kuniokoa.
Ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe amang'ana aane, obe omwango gontooria. Kabe egetare kiane ngotamera, na eburi yane enkong'u, na ontoorie!

English: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
Kiswahili: Nilipoangalia ndani yake kwa karibu niliona wanyama wenye miguu minne wa nchini, wanyama wa mwitu, watambaao na ndege wa angani.
Ekegusii: Ngakerigereria mono, nkarora ching'iti chire n'amagoro ane, ne ching'iti chi'orosana, amo n'echikwagura, n'chinyoni chia igoro.

English: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
Kiswahili: Wasioe wanawake wajane wala walioachika, inawapasa kuoa wanawake bikira wenye heshima wa Israeli au wajane wa makuhani.
Ekegusii: Ere takonyuoma omokungu omotakaanwa, gose oyotiganire nomosacha oye, korende nanyare konyuoma omoiseke omwekungi bw'ororeria rw'Abaisraeli, gose nabo aranyare konyuoma omokungu omoborakabw'Omokuani.

English: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost. Paul’s Farewell to the Ephesians
Kiswahili: Paulo alikuwa ameamua tusipitie Efeso ili asitumie muda mwingi huko sehemu za Asia, kwa sababu alikuwa anatamani kama ikiwezekana kufika Yerusalemu kabla ya siku ya Pentekoste.
Ekegusii: Naki Paulo nigo arengereretie goeta Efeso mbarabare, tabaisa goteebana ase Asia, ekiagera nigo are koayerera kogenda Yerusalemu rituko ria Pentekosti, keranyarekane. Paulo ogoakera abagaaka ba Efeso ng’a batigare buya

English: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
Kiswahili: Wale walinzi wakajibu, “Kamwe hajanena mtu yeyote kama yeye anenavyo.”
Ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairaneria, “Tana gokwana monto onde bwensi buna oyo agokwana!”

English: And when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.’
Kiswahili: Kisha, utakapokwenda kwenye ukoo wangu, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu hata kama wakikataa kukupa huyo binti, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu.’
Ekegusii: erio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eyio nakoboririe otiane. Ekero oraike ase eamate yane, onye tibagokoa omoiseke oyio, aye rirorio nobe gwasiboirwe korwa ase ogotiana kwao.”

English: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the great storm continued to batter us, we abandoned all hope of being saved.
Kiswahili: Kulipokuwa hakuna kuonekana kwa jua wala nyota kwa siku nyingi, nayo dhoruba ikiwa inaendelea kuwa kali, hatimaye tulikata kabisa tamaa ya kuokoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba ne ching’enang’eni bitarorekanete ase amatuko amange, na omwaga omonene mono ogatotuba, tokerusia moyo ase ogotooreka.

English: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Dishani walikuwa: Usi na Arani.
Ekegusii: Na basinto ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani.

English: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.
Kiswahili: Yuda ikashindwa na Israeli, na kila mtu akakimbilia nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakabugwa n'Abaisraeli, bagatama, kera omonto gochia ase enka yaye.

English: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
Kiswahili: Utuonyeshe upendo wako usiokoma, Ee Bwana, utupe wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otoorokerie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na otoe ogotooreka kwao.

English: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
Kiswahili: Udongo huifanya iote kuwa mche, halafu suke, kisha nafaka kamili kwenye suke.
Ekegusii: Inaki ense nigo ekwama enyene, ritang'ani rinyansi, naende ekegara, erio enyeke ase ekegara.

English: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu yako imepita juu yangu; hofu zako zimeniangamiza.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu yao entindi yantubire kegima, amaakwa ao ansiririe.

English: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
Kiswahili: Watu waliposikia maneno haya yakawachoma mioyo yao, wakawauliza Petro na wale mitume wengine, “Ndugu zetu tufanye nini?”
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bagasambwa ase chinkoro chiabo, bakabooria Petero na abatomwa bande: “Abaminto, inki torakore?”

English: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,
Kiswahili: Pigeni matiti yenu kwa ajili ya mashamba mazuri, kwa ajili ya mizabibu iliyozaa vizuri
Ekegusii: Moake‐ake ebikuba biaino, ekiagera emegondo yaino emiya, na emesabibu yaino ekwama mono, yasarigwe,

English: This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, saw. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me the interpretation, because none of the wise men of my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you are able, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.” Daniel Interprets the Second Dream
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo ndoto niliyoipata mimi, Mfalme Nebukadneza. Sasa Belteshaza, niambie maana yake, kwa maana hakuna hata mmoja wa wenye hekima katika ufalme wangu anayeweza kunifasiria. Bali wewe waweza, kwa sababu roho ya miungu mitakatifu imo ndani yako.” Danieli Anafasiri Ndoto
Ekegusii: “Echio nachio chindoto inche Nebukadinesaro omorwoti narota. Aye Beli‐Tesasari, nteebie engencho yaye, ekiagera abanto abang’aini bonsi bare ase oborwoti bwane basinyirwe gonteebia engencho yaye, korende aye nonyare, ekiagera omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao.” Danieli okoorokia engencho ye chindoto chiria

English: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamefifia, yakitazamia wokovu wako, na kuitazamia ahadi yako ya kweli.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ogotooreka gokorwa asore, amo nogoikeranigwa kw’eira yao y’oboronge.

English: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
Kiswahili: “Basi andika mambo uliyoyaona, yaliyopo na yale yatakayotukia baada ya haya.
Ekegusii: Bono riika amang’ana aya kwarorire, ayareo, na ayarache koba magega y’ayio.

English: Bordering the territory of Judah, from east to west, will be the portion you are to set apart. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and the length of a tribal portion from east to west. In the center will be the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: “Kupakana na nchi ya Yuda kuanzia mashariki mpaka magharibi itakuwa ndiyo sehemu utakayoitoa ili kuwa toleo maalum. Itakuwa na upana wa dhiraa 25,000 na urefu wake kuanzia mashariki mpaka magharibi utakuwa ule ule wa sehemu moja ya kabila, mahali patakatifu patakuwa katikati ya eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: Orogongo robebekaine norwa Yuda korwa moocha goika bosongo, nigo roratigwe robe aase mokoruera okoruegwa ogochenu. Obogare bwaye nigo borabe obwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obotambe bwaye nigo borabe buna obwa kera egesaku korwa moocha goika bosongo. Gati‐gati y’orogongo orwo aase aachenu nao arabe.

English: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh's word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn't it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”
Kiswahili: Hezekia akamjibu Isaya, “Neno la Bwana ulilosema ni jema.” Kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Lakini si patakuwa na amani na usalama wakati wa uhai wangu?”
Ekegusii: Hezekia agateebia Isaya: “Ring'ana ri'Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya”. Nigo arengereretie ng'a onye rioka omorembe na oborendi obuya biare gochia konyorekana ase obogima bwaye.

English: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David's head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.
Kiswahili: Akachukua taji kutoka kwa kichwa cha mfalme wao, lililokuwa na uzito wa talanta moja ya dhahabu, nayo ilizungushiwa vito vya thamani. Ikawekwa juu ya kichwa cha Daudi. Alichukua nyara nyingi kutoka mjini huo.
Ekegusii: Erio akarusia eguutwa y'etaabu korwa ase omotwe bw'omorwoti bw'aroro. Oborito bw'eguutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng'ana chikiiro emerongo etato na inye naende nigo yachabeire amagena ye rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabeekerwa Daudi ase omotwe oye igoro. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi'omochie oria:

English: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.” The Lord of the Sabbath (1 Samuel 21:1–7; Matthew 12:1–8; Luke 6:1–5)
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, ile divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo hiyo divai itamwagika na viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya.” Bwana Wa Sabato (Mathayo 12:1-8; Luka 6:1-5)
Ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria nebiate ebirandi, edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia.” Riborio igoro y’okorenda Esabato (Mat 12:1-8; Luk 6:1-5)

English: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
Kiswahili: Wakatoa pepo wachafu wengi, wakawapaka wagonjwa wengi mafuta na kuwaponya.
Ekegusii: Bagaseria ebirecha ebinge, bagaaka abanto abange amaguta, abwo barenge abarwaire, bakabagwenia.

English: Eat it within your gates; both the ceremonially unclean and clean may eat it as they would a gazelle or a deer.
Kiswahili: Itawapasa kumla ninyi wenyewe katika miji yenu. Wote wasio safi na walio safi kwa desturi za kiibada mwaweza kula kama vile mnavyokula paa au kulungu.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chie ching’iti buna echio mochiriere agwo ase emechie yaino. Abanto bonsi onye bare abatachenegeti, gose bachenegete, ’nabachirie. Nabo morachirie buna mokoria chinyama chie chingabi gose echie chinsune.

English: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye kile kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichoko mbele za Bwana, chukua mkate, andazi lililokandwa kwa mafuta na mkate mdogo mwembamba.
Ekegusii: Orusie omogati oyomo, ne rindasi erimo riroisirie namaguta, na omogati oyomo omoo, ebio bitabekiri memera, bire ase egetonga ime, bibekire ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.” The Truth Will Set You Free (2 John 1:4–6)
Kiswahili: Yeye aliyenituma yu pamoja nami, hajaniacha, kwa kuwa siku zote nafanya mapenzi yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ere oyontomete nigo are amo nainche, tantigeti inche bweka, ekiagera botambe nigo ngokora ayakomogwenera.”

English: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana yuko katika Hekalu lake takatifu; dunia yote na inyamaze mbele yake.”
Ekegusii: “Korende Omonene nao are ase Hekalu yaye Enchenu; tiga ense yonsi ekire‐kiri ase obosio bwaye.”

English: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she gave her servant Zilpah to Jacob as a wife.
Kiswahili: Lea alipoona kuwa amekoma kuzaa watoto, alimchukua mtumishi wake wa kike Zilpa, naye akampa Yakobo awe mke wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Lea achia korora ng’a Bilia okoorire koibora abana, akaimokia Silpa, omosomba oye omoiseke, akamomoa Yakobo, abe mokaye.

English: Ozias said to her, “Blessed are you, daughter, in the sight of the Most High God, above all the women upon the earth; and blessed is the Lord God, who created the heavens and the earth, who directed you to cut off the head of the prince of our enemies.
Kiswahili: Uzia akamwambia, "Umebarikiwa, binti, mbele za Mungu Aliye Juu Zaidi, kuliko wanawake wote duniani; na abarikiwe Bwana Mungu, aliyeumba mbingu na dunia, aliyekuelekeza umkate kichwa mkuu wa adui zetu."
Ekegusii: Erio Uzia agateeba, “Aye Yuditi omosubati one, Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono ogosesenirie kobua abakungu bonsi ase ense engima. Inaki toranyaare komotogia Omonene oyo otongete igoro na ense! Ere nigo akoraete goika nonya nekero kwarenge koyonacha omotwe bw'omobisa oito omonene. 13:18 rora Abag 5:24; Luka 1:28,42

English: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.
Kiswahili: Lakini wameambiwa habari zako kwamba unafundisha Wayahudi wote waishio miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa kumkataa Mose, na kwamba unawaambia wasiwatahiri watoto wao wala kufuata desturi zetu.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo mbateebetigwe ng'a kworokereirie Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete ase egati y'abanto b'Ebisaku ng'a batige Musa, gokobakania tibarokia abana babo, gose tibabwatia chingencho chiaito.

English: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
Kiswahili: Watasimulia utukufu wa ufalme wako na kusema juu ya ukuu wako,
Ekegusii: Mbabe bakoraria obonene bw’oborwoti bwao, naende babe bagokwana igoro y’okobua kwao,

English: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
Kiswahili: “Walio fahari yako, ee Israeli, wameuawa juu ya mahali pako palipoinuka. Jinsi wenye nguvu walivyoanguka!
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, obonene bwaino bwasireire igoro ase ebigoro biaino! Chituoni chi'eseegi chiaitirwe.

English: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
Kiswahili: Hukumu yangu na itoke kwako, macho yako na yaone yale yaliyo haki.
Ekegusii: Aye omonyene onachere ekiina gi’okong’a oboronge, amaiso ao nigo akorora ayare ay’ekeene.

English: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu wapendwa, fahamuni jambo hili: Kila mtu awe mwepesi wa kusikiliza, lakini asiwe mwepesi wa kusema wala wa kukasirika.
Ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, momanye ring’ana eri: Kera omonto abe omwango ase okoigwa, korende abe bwe ng’ora ase ogokwana, na bwe ng’ora ase okoba nendamwamu,

English: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, nitakuimbia wimbo mpya, kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi nitakuimbia,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ningoterere ogoteera okoyia, ninkobugerie obokano bore ne chinge ikomi.

English: And He was given dominion, glory, and kingship, that the people of every nation and language should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed. Daniel’s Visions Interpreted
Kiswahili: Akapewa mamlaka, utukufu na ufalme wenye nguvu; nao watu wa kabila zote, mataifa, na watu wa kila lugha wakamwabudu. Utawala wake ni utawala wa milele ambao hautapita, nao ufalme wake ni ule ambao kamwe hautaangamizwa. Tafsiri Ya Ndoto
Ekegusii: Ere oyio akaegwa okobua gw’okogaamba, na obonene, na oborwoti, erinde abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bamokorere. Obogaambi bwaye nobwa kare na kare, tibokoera, na oborwoti bwaye tibokobugwa. Engencho y’amaroro ekoorokigwa

English: Now it was reported to King David, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God.” So David went and had the ark of God brought up from the house of Obed-edom into the City of David with rejoicing.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mfalme Daudi akaambiwa, “ Bwana ameibariki nyumba ya Obed-Edomu pamoja na kila alicho nacho, kwa sababu ya Sanduku la Mungu.” Basi Daudi akateremka na kulipandisha Sanduku la Mungu kutoka nyumba ya Obed-Edomu hadi Mji wa Daudi kwa shangwe.
Ekegusii: Daudi agateebigwa ng’a, ase engencho y’Esanduki eria y’Omonene osesenirie abanto b’enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, amo nebiinto bionsi abwate. Erio akageenda akoyia Esanduki eria korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, akayerenta ase omochie oye ore n’omochengo omonene.

English: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
Kiswahili: Mapazia ya hema yatakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa moja zaidi pande zote, sehemu itakayobaki itaningʼinia pande zote za Hema ili kuifunika.
Ekegusii: Ekerengo gi'okoboko okomo kie rirondia keringwe, getube Obomenyo ase kera rikere riaye.

English: How great are his signs! How mighty are his wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. His dominion is from generation to generation.
Kiswahili: Ishara zake ni kuu aje, na maajabu yake yana nguvu aje! Ufalme wake ni ufalme wa milele; enzi yake hudumu kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: “Inaki ebimanyererio biaye bire ebinene, na amakumia aye are nokobua okonene! Oborwoti bwaye nigo bore obwa kare na kare, na obogambi bwaye nigo bogendererete ekiaare ase ekiaare.

English: Birds will return to their own kind, so truth will return to those who practice it.
Kiswahili: Ndege watarudi katika aina yao, kwa hivyo ukweli utarudi kwa wale wanaoufanya.
Ekegusii: Kera enyoni nigo egotunyana chinyoni chi'omogwekano oye, naboigo nekeene kegotunyana baria bakogeikerania.

English: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
Kiswahili: Tunalo tumaini hili kama nanga ya roho iliyo imara na thabiti. Tumaini hili huingia katika sehemu takatifu iliyopo nyuma ya pazia,
Ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo tore nakorokwo buna ekeroochi ki'omoyo, okore ne chinguru, na gotari koonchoka, kogosoa aase are ime moino y'etoto.

English: The crowds gave their undivided attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.
Kiswahili: Watu walipomsikia Filipo na kuona ishara na miujiza aliyofanya, wakasikiliza kwa bidii yale aliyosema.
Ekegusii: Emeganda yonsi ase omoyo oyomo bagategerera amang’ana onsi Filipo are gokwana, ekero bamoigwete na korora ebikone ebiarenge gokora.

English: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
Kiswahili: Hadadi, Tema, Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema.
Ekegusii: na Hadadi, na Tema, na Yeturi, na Nafisi, na Kedema.

English: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?'”
Kiswahili: Yuko wapi mfalme wa Hamathi, mfalme wa Arpadi, mfalme wa mji wa Sefarvaimu, au wa Hena au wa Iva?”
Ekegusii: Ng'ai omorwoti o Hamati are, gose omorwoti bw'Aripadi, na oyo bw'omochie o Sefariwaimu, na oyo o Hena, na oyo o Iwa?”

English: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
Kiswahili: kabla hajaumba dunia wala mashamba yake au vumbi lolote la dunia.
Ekegusii: ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.

English: All you who fear the Lord, wait for his mercy. Don't turn aside, lest you fall.
Kiswahili: Ninyi nyote mnaomcha Bwana, ngojeni rehema zake. Msigeuke kando, msije mkaanguka.
Ekegusii: Inwe baria momwegenete Omonene ganya amaabera aye, timoonchoka korwa asare erio morabaise kogwa.

English: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unanifanya nitazame dhuluma? Kwa nini unavumilia makosa? Uharibifu na udhalimu viko mbele yangu; kuna mabishano na mapambano kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Naki gwantigire narorire amabe buna aya? Naki ondigereretie ing’etananire nemechando? Ogosirigwa na ogokorerwa bobe nigo bire ase obosio bwane; amariomana na ogotaigwana nigo bireo.

English: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
Kiswahili: Lakini tunamwomba Mungu msije mkatenda kosa lolote, si ili sisi tuonekane kuwa tumeshinda hilo jaribio, bali ili ninyi mtende lililo haki, hata kama tutaonekana kuwa tumeshindwa.
Ekegusii: Korende twasabire Nyasae, timokora rinde rire riibe, tari ng'a intwe tororekane twancheirwe, korende inwe mokore erire rigiya, natoisa koba intwe buna abangirwe.

English: There is danger not only that our business will fall into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited and her majesty deposed—she who is worshiped by all the province of Asia and the whole world.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kuna hatari si kwa kazi yetu kudharauliwa tu, bali pia hata hekalu la mungu mke Artemi, aliye mkuu, anayeabudiwa Asia yote na ulimwengu wote, litakuwa limepokonywa fahari yake ya kiungu.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ere aakong’u ase tore, tari ng’a nemeremo yaito yoka erachaywe, korende nonya ne Hekalu y’Aritemi, enyasae enkuungu ere enene, nigo erabarwe ng’a teri gento. Naende enyasae eria, egosasimwa n’abanto b’Asia yonsi na ab’ense yonsi nigo eraurwe obonene bwaye.”

English: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
Kiswahili: Basi haya yakiisha kusamehewa, hakuna tena dhabihu yoyote inayotolewa kwa ajili ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Gaki, okorusigwa kw'ebibe gokorabeo, rirorio ekerugwa ase engencho y'ebibe tigekobao naende.

English: She said, “My request and my petition is:
Kiswahili: Alisema, "Ombi langu na ombi langu ni:
Ekegusii: Akaimokia enyimbo yaye y'obogambi eyio yaroisirie n'amagena ya maabera agatorera Esiteri ase ebigoti biaye, akamoagata okomoteebia: kwana naiche, Esiteri akamoteebia “Inyiborie!” nigo okororekana buna oyomo bw'Abamalaika ba Nyasae. Enkoro yane nigo yaichorwa, n'omoichano bw'echinguru chiao. Nigo ore oyo bw'okororekana kw'ogokumia. Nyasae one Omobui, enkoro yao nigo eichire n'obuya.

English: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hili moyo wangu unatetemeka, nao unaruka kutoka mahali pake.
Ekegusii: “Ayio nigo akogera enkoro yane yaiguswa, yatuma gocha ase omoyo.

English: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
Kiswahili: Bali waovu watakatiliwa mbali kutoka nchi, nao wasio waaminifu watangʼolewa kutoka humo.
Ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe ’mbaitwe barue ase ense, na abasaria ’mbasirigwe kegima.

English: and be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.
Kiswahili: Mwe waangalifu msiwapuuze Walawi kwa muda wote mnaoishi katika nchi yenu.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiga gokonya Abalawi ase chingaki chionsi moragenderere komenya ase ense yaino.
