English: transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
Kiswahili: Uasi na udanganyifu dhidi ya Bwana, kumgeuzia Mungu wetu kisogo, tukichochea udhalimu na maasi, tukinena uongo ambao mioyo yetu imeuhifadhi.
Ekegusii: Twasaririe na komokan'Omonene, twairanire magega, twatigire komobwatia Nyasae oito; nigo togokwana amang'ana ay'ogokorera abande bobe, na ay'ogotaigwera; nigo togokwana amang'ana 'obong'ainereria akorwa ase chinkoro chiaito.

English: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Unapoandaa fahali mchanga kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, kwa ajili ya nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Ekero okorua eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi, onye nase ogoikerania eira kwariete, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene,

English: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people. Then I will let your people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Mose na Aroni na kusema, “Mwombeni Bwana awaondoe vyura kutoka kwangu na kwa watu wangu, nami nitawaachia watu wenu waende kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Mosabe Omonene arusie ebioto korwa ase ense na korwa ase abanto baane, na inche ning’ee abanto baye ribaga bagende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

English: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Nijulishe mafundisho ya mausia yako, nami nitatafakari maajabu yako.
Ekegusii: Inyorokererie, erinde imanye chinchera chi'amachiiko ao, nimbe 'nkona koiranerera ogokora kwao kw'ogokumia.

English: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
Kiswahili: Wakatoa dhabihu kwa pepo, ambao si Mungu: miungu wasiyoijua, miungu iliyojitokeza siku za karibuni, miungu ambayo baba zenu hawakuiogopa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua ebing’wanso ase ebirecha bitari Nyasae: bagasasiima chinyasae batamanyete agwo ritang’ani, chinyasae chinyia chiasoete magega, echio chisokoro chiaino chitairogete.

English: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.'
Kiswahili: “Mwenye shamba alikuwa bado na mmoja wa kumtuma, mwanawe aliyempenda. Hatimaye akamtuma akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.'
Ekegusii: Narenge nomwana oyomo konya ataratoma, omwanchwa oye; oyo nere akamotoma ase bare magega, okobora: Inabasike omwana one.

English: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaambia mara nyingi kabla, nami sasa nasema tena hata kwa machozi, watu wengi wanaishi kama adui wa msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b’omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang’ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobateebia aya ase amariga.

English: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa kwa siku kadhaa, akateremka nabii mmoja kutoka Uyahudi jina lake Agabo.
Ekegusii: Gatwamenyire aroro amatuko atai make, omobani oyomo, erieta riaye Agabo, agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi.

English: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
Kiswahili: Amenijaza kwa majani machungu na kunishibisha kwa nyongo.
Ekegusii: Ong’ichoirie nobororo, ong’eire ekenyugwa ekeroro nanyure.

English: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye ufahamu. Kamwe Mungu hatendi uovu, Mwenyezi hafanyi kosa.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abanto abamore nokomanya, inyigwa! Nyasae tabaisa gokagerwa ng'a nakore amabe. Inee! Ere Omonguru nakore ebibe?

English: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son, because he is your offspring.”
Kiswahili: Nitamfanya huyu mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike kuwa taifa pia, kwa sababu naye ni uzao wako.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo, omwana bw’omokuungu oyo omosomba nimokore abe egesaku ekenene, ekiagera nere oyio nomwana oo.”

English: Then the men were even more afraid and said to him, “What have you done?” The men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them. Jonah Cast into the Sea
Kiswahili: Hili liliwaogopesha nao wakamuuliza, “Umefanya nini?” (Walijua alikuwa anamkimbia Bwana, kwa sababu alishawaambia hivyo.)
Ekegusii: Erio Jona akabateebia ng’a nigo are gotama korwa ase Omonene Nyasae. Ekero baigwete ayio, abanto baria bakairoka mono, bakamobooria, “Mang’ana ki aya gwakorire?”.

English: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.
Kiswahili: lakini kibarua yeyote au msafiri haruhusiwi kula.
Ekegusii: Omogeni omenyete ase more, gose omonto orikire tibayeria Epasaka eyio.

English: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, pakawa na tetemeko kubwa la ardhi, kwa sababu malaika wa Bwana alishuka kutoka mbinguni, akaenda penye kaburi, akalivingirisha lile jiwe na kulikalia.
Ekegusii: Na rora, norengeo omotengecho omonene, ekiagera omomalaika bw’Omonene aigete korwa igoro, agachia agatigeria rigena riria, akariikaransera.

English: The rich man had a great number of sheep and cattle,
Kiswahili: Yule mtu tajiri alikuwa na idadi kubwa sana ya kondoo na ngʼombe,
Ekegusii: Oria omonda nigo abwate ching’ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono.

English: To that place you are to bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and heave offerings, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, as well as the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
Kiswahili: hapo ndipo mtakapoleta sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na dhabihu, zaka zenu na changizo zenu, kile ulichoweka nadhiri kutoa, sadaka zenu za hiari na malimbuko ya makundi yenu ya ngʼombe pamoja na mbuzi na kondoo.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao moraarente ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, na ensemo yaino ya ikomi, na okoruegwa mokorenta, na ebi mwarierete Omonene eira komoruera, na okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, ne’bitangi biaino bi’echiombe, ne’ching’ondi, ne’chimbori.

English: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven't I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”
Kiswahili: Angalia shamba wanaume wanamovuna, ufuate nyuma yao. Nimewaamuru wanaume hawa wasikuguse. Wakati wowote ukiona kiu, nenda kwenye mitungi ukanywe maji waliyoyateka wanaume hawa.”
Ekegusii: Origererie orore ase bakogesa obabwatie korwa magega! Nakanirie abanto baane tibakogochanda. Gokorang'a, ogende ase chinsiongo echio baichoirie amaache, otaae onywe!”

English: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Wagershoni walikuwa wawili: Ladani na Shimei.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Ladani na Simei.

English: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
Kiswahili: Akamchagua Daudi mtumishi wake na kumtoa kwenye mazizi ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching’ondi.

English: In visions of God He took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose southern slope was a structure that resembled a city.
Kiswahili: Nikiwa katika maono ya Mungu alinichukua mpaka nchi ya Israeli, naye akaniweka kwenye mlima mrefu sana, ambako upande wa kusini kulikuwepo baadhi ya majengo ambayo yalionekana kama mji.
Ekegusii: Erio ase okorora naetwe na Nyasae, ere akang’ira gochia ase ense y’Abaisraeli, akambeka igoro ase egetunwa egetambe mono. Aroro agwo ’nkarora egento kenga oboagacho bw’omochie ore ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: But when Israel came up out of Egypt, they traveled through the wilderness to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipopanda kutoka Misri, Israeli walipitia katika jangwa hadi Bahari ya Shamu na wakafika Kadeshi.
Ekegusii: korende ekero barwete Misiri nigo baetete ase egati y’erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri, bagaika Kadeshi.

English: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
Kiswahili: Bali ninyi, ndugu, hampo gizani hata siku ile iwakute ghafula kama mwizi.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, timori ase omosunte, goika rituko riria riche kobanyoora mobosokano buna omoibi,

English: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Imeri: Hanani na Zebadia.
Ekegusii: Abeamate ya Imeri: Hanani na Sebadia;

English: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor. As a result, they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Basi Wamisri wakaweka wasimamizi wa kuwasimamia na kuwatesa Waisraeli kwa kazi ngumu, nao wakajenga miji ya Pithomu na Ramesesi ya kuweka akiba ya Farao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamisiri bakabeeka abateneneri abatindi igoro ase Abaisraeli barenge erio baabachande nemeremo emekong’u mono yobosomba. Agwo Abaisraeli bakaagachera Farao emechie y’okogaacha chinibo, nero Pitoni na Ramesesi.

English: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to Yahweh's word which he commanded Joshua.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli wakajichukulia mifugo na nyara za mji huu, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Yoshua.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira chitugo na ebinto binde basakorete bikaba ebiabo, buna Omonene atebeetie Yoshua.

English: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Agripa, je, unaamini manabii? Najua kuwa unaamini.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Agripa, Inee, mbwegenete ababani? Namanyire ng’a nobegenete.”

English: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.
Kiswahili: Hasira yake imewaka juu yangu; amenihesabu kuwa miongoni mwa adui zake.
Ekegusii: Obeire nekeririanda ekenene ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.

English: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Purchase us and our land in exchange for food. Then we, along with our land, will be slaves to Pharaoh. Give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini tuangamie mbele ya macho yako, sisi pamoja na nchi yetu? Utununue sisi pamoja na ardhi yetu ili kubadilishana kwa chakula. Nasi pamoja na nchi yetu tutakuwa watumwa wa Farao. Tupe sisi mbegu ili tuweze kuishi wala tusife, nchi yetu isije ikawa ukiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”

English: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
Kiswahili: Jengeni miji kwa ajili ya wanawake na watoto wenu, na mazizi kwa ajili ya mbuzi na kondoo zenu, lakini fanyeni yale mliyoahidi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha emechie ase abana baino baramenye na ameri ase ching’ondi chiaino, erio mokore buna mwariire chiira chiaino.”

English: she called her household servants. “Look,” she said, “this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us. He came to me so he could sleep with me, but I screamed as loud as I could.
Kiswahili: akawaita watumishi wake wa nyumbani, akawaambia, “Tazameni! Huyu Mwebrania ameletwa hapa kutudhihaki! Aliingia hapa ndani ili akutane nami kimwili, lakini nikapiga kelele.
Ekegusii: akarangeria abanto ba nyomba mwaye, akabateebia: “Rigereria, omosacha one otorenteire omonto oyo Omoiberania ase egati yaito atokorere echeche; nigo acha ase ’nde ng’a araare nainche, na inche nakuura neriogi rinene.

English: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
Kiswahili: kwa aliye mtakatifu unajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu, lakini kwa aliyepotoka unajionyesha kuwa mkaidi.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu, nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.

English: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya makundi yako ya wajeuri kuanguka kwa panga za watu mashujaa, taifa katili kuliko mataifa yote. Watakivunjavunja kiburi cha Misri, nayo makundi yake yote ya wajeuri yatashindwa.
Ekegusii: Nindete abarwani chituoni, abare abatindi goetania ebisaku bionsi, abwo mbaite emeganda yao nemioro. Barabwo mbasirie obonene bwa Misiri bobe bosa, na emeganda yaye yonsi nesirigwe.

English: For when lawless men had supposed that they held a holy nation in their power, they, prisoners of darkness, and bound in the fetters of a long night, kept close beneath their roofs, lay exiled from the eternal providence.
Kiswahili: Kwani wakati watu wasio na sheria walipodhani kwamba wana taifa takatifu katika mamlaka yao, wao, wafungwa wa giza, na wamefungwa kwa pingu za usiku mrefu, wamewekwa karibu chini ya paa zao, walilala uhamishoni kutoka kwa maongozi ya milele.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero abanto ababe bakagete buna bairire ense yao ebe inse y'okobua kwabo, barabwo abanyene nigo basibetwe ase obotuko bware n'omosunte omonene, nigo batigarete ase chinyomba chiabo ase batare n'oborendi bwao bwa botambe.

English: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.
Kiswahili: na kubadili utukufu wa Mungu aishiye milele kwa sanamu zilizofanywa zifanane na mwanadamu ambaye hufa, na mfano wa ndege, wanyama na viumbe vitambaavyo.
Ekegusii: Bakaonchoreria obonene bwa Nyasae, oyotari n’ogosareka, ase omogwekano bw’ekieni kia Mwanyabaanto oyore nogosareka, na oyobwechinyoni, na bwe ching’iti chire n’amagoro ane, na bwe ching’iti chikwagura.

English: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
Kiswahili: nilikumbuka nilivyoimba nyimbo usiku. Moyo wangu ulitafakari na roho yangu ikauliza:
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko obogima nigo nkoinyora amatera aane: nigo nkoba nkorengereria ase enkoro yane ime, neriga‐rigia na kweboria:

English: “‘Don't defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Msijitie unajisi kwa njia yoyote katika hizi, kwa sababu hivi ndivyo mataifa nitakayoyafukuza mbele yenu yalivyojitia unajisi.
Ekegusii: “Inwe timobaisa gwekora abatachenegeti ase ogokora buna okwo. Ase enchera eyio abanto b'ebisaku mbesoetie ase ogotacheneka, na bono inche Omonene nkobaseria inde baabatigere inwe ense eyio.

English: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
Kiswahili: Kama watasikiliza au hawatasikiliza, kwa kuwa wao ni nyumba ya kuasi, watajua nabii amekuwa miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Kobaraigwe, gose bange koigwa (ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera), mbamanye ng’a omobani obeire ase egati yabo.

English: Every living creature loves its own kind, and every man loves his neighbor.
Kiswahili: Kila kiumbe hai hupenda aina yake, na kila mtu humpenda jirani yake.
Ekegusii: Kera egetongwa nigo kegwancha egetongwa kende gekebwekaine, naboigo Mwanyabaanto nigo agwancha Mwanyabaanto omwabo.

English: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.
Kiswahili: “Nitawateremsha kama wana-kondoo waendao machinjoni, kama kondoo dume na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Nimbarente banyenywe buna chimanwa chi'eching'ondi, ne chimingichi amo ne chigoree chikonyenywa.”

English: They were a wall around us, both day and night, the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.
Kiswahili: Usiku na mchana walikuwa ukuta wakituzunguka wakati wote tulipokuwa tukichunga kondoo zetu karibu nao.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki yonsi twareenge amo nabarabwo korisia ching’ondi, barabwo nigo baarenge ase tore buna orwaki, omobaso na obotuko.

English: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi waliposikia haya, wakaanguka chini kifudifudi, wakajawa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bakagwa inse maumama, bakabwatwa nomoondoko omonene.

English: When they had set themselves in array, it came to pass that a few of the Jews fell.
Kiswahili: Walipojipanga, ikawa kwamba Wayahudi wachache walianguka.
Ekegusii: Ase esegi eyio Abayahudi bake bagakwa.

English: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;
Kiswahili: Kamwe msitoe dhabihu ya Pasaka katika mji wowote ambao Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa,
Ekegusii: “Timoruera ekeng'wanso gi'Epasaka ase emechie ende yaino, eyi'Omonene Nyasae oino agochia kobaa.

English: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.'”
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye sadaka za amani za Waisraeli, mimi Mungu nimepokea kidari kile kilichoinuliwa pamoja na lile paja lililotolewa, nami nimevitoa kwa kuhani Aroni na wanawe kuwa fungu lao la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli.' ”
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe gekoruegwa n'Abaisraeli narusirie ritaana rigosungusigwa amo nekenama kia borio, nabieire Aroni Omokuani na abamura baye. Ebio nabio Abaisraeli barabe bakoa abakuani, bibe ebitari biabo botaambe.

English: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
Kiswahili: Huzifanya chemchemi zimwage maji mabondeni, hutiririka kati ya milima.
Ekegusii: Nigo ogotubokia chinsoko ase amagoko, amaache aba agoeta ase egati y’ebitunwa.

English: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won't deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won't be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.
Kiswahili: Hakika wako kama mabua makavu; moto utawateketeza. Hawawezi hata kujiokoa wao wenyewe kutokana na nguvu za mwali wa moto. Hapa hakuna makaa ya kumtia mtu yeyote joto; hapa hakuna moto wa kuota.
Ekegusii: “Rora, abanto abwo nigo banga amasakwe, omorero nigo okoyasamba ayia aera, tari konyara gwetooria korwa ase chinguru chi'omorero. Amasakwe ayio takoyia abe omorero bw'amakara, omonto araikaranseo aywote.

English: I will fill the souls of the priests abundantly, and will fill My people with My goodness,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: Nitawashibisha makuhani kwa wingi, nao watu wangu watajazwa kwa ukarimu wangu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninyigotie na goisanekia abakuani n’ebinto ebinoru; abanto baane mbaisaneke nobuya bwane. Nab’Omonene atebiire.” Amaabera a Nyasae ase Abaisraeli

English: “When you divide the land by lot as an inheritance, you are to set aside a portion for the LORD, a holy portion of the land 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide. This entire tract of land will be holy.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mtakapogawa nchi kuwa urithi, mtaitoa sehemu ya nchi kwa Bwana kuwa eneo takatifu, urefu wake dhiraa 25,000, upana wake dhiraa 20,000 eneo hili lote litakuwa takatifu.
Ekegusii: “Ekero morabe mogoaka obomera ase ogwatera abanto ense yaino ebe emiando yabo, mwatananere n’Omonene emonga yaye ebe enchenu. Obotambe bw’emonga eyio nigo borabe obw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare bwaye chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Emonga eyio engima nigo erabe enchenu.

English: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
Kiswahili: Mke mwenye sifa nzuri, ni nani awezaye kumpata? Yeye ni wa thamani sana kuliko marijani.
Ekegusii: Ning'o oranyaare konyora omokungu omuya? Omokungu omuya nigo are n'engeencho enene kobua amagena ye rigori rinene.

English: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, Tatenai, mtawala wa Ngʼambo ya Mto Frati na Shethar-Bozenai pamoja na ninyi, maafisa wenzao wa jimbo hilo kaeni mbali na mahali hapo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Dario akarika riruube iga. “Bono aye Tatenai, omogabana bw'orogongo rore bosongo y'orooche rw'Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abagabana bande abwo mokogamba komo agwo ase orogongo rore bosongo y'orooche roria, inwe beera aare kegima.

English: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
Kiswahili: Sifa za Mungu na ziwe vinywani mwao na upanga ukatao kuwili mikononi mwao,
Ekegusii: Tiga ogotogigwa okonene kwa Nyasae kobe ase emenwa yaabo, na ase amaboko abo babogorie emeyio ya birende ere nobwoge chinsemo ibere,

English: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ilitupasa tuwe na Kuhani Mkuu wa namna hii, yaani, aliye mtakatifu, asiye na lawama, asiye na dosari, aliyetengwa na wenye dhambi na kuinuliwa juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n'Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.

English: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son. He must die, because he has torn down Baal’s altar and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa mji wakamwambia Yoashi, “Mlete mwanao hapa. Ni lazima afe, kwa sababu amebomoa madhabahu ya Baali na kukatakata nguzo ya Ashera iliyokuwa karibu nayo.”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’omochie oria bagateebia Yoashi, “Morente omomura oyio oo aiga, ere goika aitwe, ekiagera otagoire egesasiimero gia Baali, na otagoire omote oria bw’Asera orenge ensemo yaye.”

English: So the total wingspan of these cherubim was twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main room. The Veil and Pillars (1 Kings 7:13–22)
Kiswahili: Mabawa ya makerubi hawa yalitanda dhiraa ishirini. Walisimama kwa miguu yao, nyuso zao zikielekea ukumbi mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bw’echimbaba ibere bw’ebitongwa biria bibwate chimbaba nigo bwarenge bw’chimita 4.5 nigo chiateneine chirigereranetie n’amasio y’ebitongwa ebio bibwate chimbaba arigereretie eero.

English: How great is the mercy of the Lord, and his forgiveness to those who turn to him!
Kiswahili: Rehema za Bwana ni kuu sana, na msamaha wake kwa wale wanaomgeukia!
Ekegusii: Naki amaabera a Nyasae akare amanene, naende naki okwabera kwaye okonene ase baria bakomoiranera.

English: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.”
Kiswahili: Njooni, tushuke tuvuruge lugha yao ili wasielewane wao kwa wao.”
Ekegusii: Eta togende toike inse ase bare, tobatantanie ase omonbwa obo tibaigwana ase chinkwana chiao barabwo ase barabwo.”

English: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakapiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, wakaziba masikio yao, wakamrukia kwa nia moja.
Ekegusii: Korende bagaaka egeturi ase eriogi rinene, bagakuneka amato abo, bakamorindokera bonsi amo,

English: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.” “I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.” So he went and lay down.
Kiswahili: Naye akakimbia kwa Eli na kumwambia, “Mimi hapa, kwa kuwa umeniita.” Lakini Eli akasema, “Sikukuita; rudi ukalale.” Hivyo akaenda kulala.
Ekegusii: Erio akaminyoka gochia ase Eli, akamoteebia, “Nao inde aa! Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Korende Eli akamoiraneria, “Inche tinkorangereti, genda oraare.” Erio Samweli akairana gochia korara.

English: Don't let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
Kiswahili: Uwe mwangalifu ili yeyote asikushawishi kwa utajiri; usipotoshwe kwa fungu kubwa la rushwa.
Ekegusii: Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw'embooria bogosirie.

English: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
Kiswahili: Yohana akawajibu, “Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kupata kitu chochote isipokuwa kile tu alichopewa kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omonto takonyara konyora ring'ana rinde rionsi otatiga aegwe korwa igoro.

English: For they will bring sudden destruction. Who knows what ruin they can bring? Further Sayings of the Wise
Kiswahili: kwa maana hao wawili watatuma maangamizi ya ghafula juu yao, naye ni nani ajuaye maafa wawezayo kuleta? Misemo Zaidi Ya Wenye Hekima
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo baranyore emechando ya mobosokano, na ning’o oranyaare komanya ogosirigwa kwabo? Amang’ana ande y’obong’aini

English: Then God said to Noah,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa,
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu,

English: the priest must come and inspect it. If the mildew has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew; the house is unclean.
Kiswahili: kuhani atakwenda kuikagua, na kama upele umeenea ndani ya nyumba, basi ni upele uharibuo; nyumba hiyo ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Omokuani agende ayerenge naende. Onye egetamase keria giesiareire ase enyomba eria, obwo noukoma, yabeire eyetachenegeti.

English: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, mashemasi nao wawe watu wanaostahili heshima, wasiwe wenye kauli mbili au wenye kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo, wala wanaotamani faida isiyo halali.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakoonyi b’ekanisa babe abanto bateneneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, batari nemenwa ebere, abanto batari konywa edivai enyinge, abanto batari gwancha okonyora kw’oborianania.

English: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”
Kiswahili: yeye asema: “Je, ni jambo dogo sana wewe kuwa mtumishi wangu ili kurejeza makabila ya Yakobo, na kuwarudisha wale Waisraeli niliowahifadhi? Pia nitakufanya uwe nuru kwa ajili ya watu wa Mataifa, ili upate kuleta wokovu wangu hata miisho ya dunia.”
Ekegusii: Nigo agoteeba iga: “Ayio tagoisana asore obe omosomba one ase okoiraneria ab'ebisaku bia Yakobo amaya abo, na koirania abatigari b'Abaisraeli boka. Boigo ningokore obe omobaso bw'abaanto b'ebisaku; erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende goike ase chinsinyo chi'ense.”

English: So he changed his behavior before them and feigned madness in their hands; he scratched on the doors of the gate and let his saliva run down his beard.
Kiswahili: Basi akajifanya mwendawazimu mbele yao; naye alipokuwa mikononi mwao, alitenda kama kichaa, akikwaruza kwa kutia alama juu ya milango ya lango na kuachia udelele kutiririka kwenye ndevu zake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo akaonchora okoba gwe chingencho chiaye ase amasio abo, agekora buna ebarimo na kona‐koara ebisieri biabo; na agatiga amate akana‐konyororoka korwa monwa, agaitekera chinderu chiaye.

English: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
Kiswahili: Naungama uovu wangu, ninataabishwa na dhambi yangu.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo nkoorokia ogosaria kwane, neitirie ase engencho y’ebibe biane.

English: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
Kiswahili: Lakini itokeapo nyama mbichi kwenye ngozi yake, atakuwa najisi.
Ekegusii: Korende onye enyama embariri yachakire gokina imeo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.

English: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
Kiswahili: Furahini pamoja na wenye kufurahi, lieni pamoja na wale waliao.
Ekegusii: Goka amo nabwo bakogoka; rera amo nabwo bakorera.

English: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
Kiswahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Hizi zote nimezishika. Je, bado nimepungukiwa na nini?”
Ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoteebia, “Ayio onsi nayabwatire; ing’ana ki rimochete?”

English: A spirit came out, stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.' “Yahweh said to him, ‘How?'
Kiswahili: Mwishoni, roho akajitokeza, akasimama mbele za Bwana na kusema, ‘Nitamshawishi.' “Bwana akauliza, ‘Kwa njia gani?'
Ekegusii: Erio omoika ogaacha ogatenena bosio bw'Omonene ogateba: Ninche ndamoebererie. Omonene akaboria omoika oria: Nase enchera ere naki oramoebererie?

English: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu atakuja katika utukufu wa Baba yake pamoja na malaika zake, naye ndipo atakapomlipa kila mtu kwa kadiri ya matendo yake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naoroke nabamalaika baye ore nobonene bwa Ise, na ekero ekio ng’ae kera omonto koreng’ana buna are gokora.

English: I have heard that the spirit of the gods is in you, and that you have insight, intelligence, and extraordinary wisdom.
Kiswahili: Nimesikia kwamba roho ya miungu iko ndani yako, na kwamba una ufahamu, akili na hekima ya pekee.
Ekegusii: Naigure igoro yao ng’a omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao, naende ng’a oborabu, na okomanya, na obong’aini obuya mono, nigo bikonyorekana ime yao

English: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don't let her be slain in Yahweh's house.”
Kiswahili: Kuhani Yehoyada akawaagiza majemadari wa vikosi vya mamia, waliokuwa viongozi wa jeshi, “Mleteni nje kati ya safu, na mkamuue kwa upanga yeyote anayemfuata.” Kwa kuwa kuhani alikuwa amesema, “Hatauawa ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Yehoyada Omokuani agachiika abatang'ani b'abasikari amagana, akabateebia, “Mosokie isiko, momobeke ase egati y'abarendi, na momoite n'omoro onde bwensi okomotunyana.” Omokuani tanchete omokungu oria aiterwe ime ase enyomba y'Omonene.

English: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akaamuru wavisubu katika kalibu ya udongo wa mfinyanzi katika uwanda wa Yordani ulio kati ya Sukothi na Sarethani.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omorwoti akabibomba korwa ase etai enyititoire, ime ase esike ebombire agwo egati ya Sukoti na Saretani ase Riranya ria Yorodani.

English: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Daudi akamkimbia Sauli na kwenda kwa Akishi mfalme wa Gathi.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Daudi akarua agwo, agatama korwa ase Saulo, akagenda ase Akisi, omorwoti o Gati,

English: So he said to the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought Him and He has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akawaambia Yuda, “Tuijenge hii miji na tuizungushie kuta, pamoja na minara, malango na makomeo. Nchi bado ni yetu, kwa sababu tumemtafuta Bwana Mungu wetu, tulimtafuta naye ametupa raha kila upande.” Hivyo wakajenga na wakafanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Agateebia Abayuda, “Inchuo toagache emechie eye toyeetananie chindwaki amo nemerobiri, na ebiita bire nemekorogoto. Ense eye nigo egendererete koba eyaito, ekiagera twarigirie Omonene, Nyasae oito; intwe twamorigirie, na ere otoeire omorembe ase chinsemo chiaito chionsi.” Ase ayio bakaagacha na bagasesenigwa.

English: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
Kiswahili: Nuru ya mwenye haki hungʼaa sana, bali taa ya mwovu itazimwa.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka n’omogooko, korende etaya y’abakori amabe nigo enga ekebeya gekorima.

English: But Israel has rejected good; an enemy will pursue him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli amekataa lile lililo jema, adui atamfuatia.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bangire amang’ana are amaya, ase ayio ababisa mbaababwatie.

English: The slaughter of our kindred, the captivity of the land, and the desolation of our inheritance, he will bring on our heads among the Gentiles, wherever we will be in bondage. We will be an offense and a reproach to those who take us for a possession.
Kiswahili: Kuuawa kwa jamaa zetu, utumwa wa nchi, na ukiwa wa urithi wetu, ataleta juu ya vichwa vyetu miongoni mwa Mataifa, popote tutakapokuwa utumwani. Tutakuwa kosa na aibu kwa wale wanaotuchukua kuwa milki yetu.
Ekegusii: Ogoitwa kwa abaminto, okoirwa gwe ense yaito na ogosirigwa kwobotenenku bwaito nigo birabarwe igoro yaito intwe abanyene ime ase egati yebisaku ebio togochia gokorera obosomba. Boigo abanene baito abayia inabatochaaye buna intwe negesaku ekebe kere nemeroberio emebe.

English: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Siku moja, alipokuwa akiabudu katika hekalu la mungu wake Nisroki, wanawe Adrameleki na Shareza wakamuua kwa upanga, nao wakakimbilia nchi ya Ararati. Naye Esar-Hadoni mwanawe akawa mfalme badala yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gosasiima ime ase enyomba ya Nisiroki, enyasae yaye, Adarameleki na Sareseri, abamura baye, bakamoita nemioro, erio bagatama gochia ase ense y'Ararati. Ezra‐Hadoni, omomura oye, akaba omorwoti ribaga riaye.

English: But Yahweh's angel didn't appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh's angel.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana hakumtokea tena Manoa na mkewe. Ndipo Manoa akatambua kuwa huyo alikuwa malaika wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero keria omomalaika oria taoroka ase Manoa naende, gose ase omorugi oye, Erio Manoa akamanya ng'a oria nigo arenge omomalaika bw'Omonene.

English: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke Yahweh to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
Kiswahili: Kama alivyokuwa amefanya huko Betheli, Yosia akabomoa na kunajisi mahali pa kuabudia miungu kwenye mahali pa juu ambapo wafalme wa Israeli walikuwa wamejenga ndani ya miji ya Samaria, ambayo ilikuwa imemghadhibisha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Yosia agatagora ne chinyomba chionsi chi'aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, echiarenge ase emechie ya Samaria, chiria abarwoti b'Abaisraeli baagachete bakagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu. Agachikora buna akorete agwo Beteli.

English: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.” Jesus’ Authority Challenged (Mark 11:27–33; Luke 20:1–8)
Kiswahili: Yoyote mtakayoyaomba mkisali na mkiamini, mtayapokea.” Wahoji Kuhusu Mamlaka Ya Yesu (Marko 11:27-33; Luka 20:1-8)
Ekegusii: Kende gionsi moraborie ase ogosaba, komoregeene namokenyore.” Riborio igoro y’okobua kwa Yeso (Mar 11:27-33; Luk 20:1-8)

English: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
Kiswahili: hivyo umaskini utakuja juu yako kama mnyangʼanyi, na kupungukiwa kutakujia kama mtu mwenye silaha.
Ekegusii: goika obotaka bogochere buna omouri, na oboremerwa kogochere buna omorwani esegi.

English: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
Kiswahili: Ingawa hekalu hili linavutia sasa, wote watakaolipita watashangaa na kudhihaki wakisema, ‘Kwa nini Bwana amefanya kitu kama hiki katika nchi hii na kwa Hekalu hili?’
Ekegusii: Enyomba eye nebe rituuri riatagokire, na kera omonto ogoeta aase agwo naichanigwe na gokumia, na ekero monto onde akoboria: Nase ki Omonene akorire ayaiga ase ense eye na ase enyomba eye?

English: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
Kiswahili: La sivyo, akiisha kuweka msingi, naye akiwa hana uwezo wa kuikamilisha, wote waionao wataanza kumdhihaki,
Ekegusii: Aise gosinywa gokoora oboagacho boria kabekire oboroso, abanto bonsi bachake komosekerera,

English: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, hesabuni kuwa ni furaha tupu mnapopatwa na majaribu mbalimbali,
Ekegusii: Abaminto, bara ng’a nomogooko bwoka komorasoe ase amateemwa are ao ao,

English: yet I and my sons and my kindred will walk in the covenant of our fathers.
Kiswahili: lakini mimi na wanangu na jamaa zangu tutatembea katika agano la baba zetu.
Ekegusii: inche na abana baane amo na bamura baminto nigo toragenderere gotunyana okobwatana ogochenu intwe twakorete n'Omonene oito.

English: The world can't hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
Kiswahili: Ulimwengu hauwezi kuwachukia ninyi, lakini unanichukia mimi kwa sababu ninawashuhudia kwamba matendo yao ni maovu.
Ekegusii: Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe, korende nigo engechete inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeorokia ng'a emeremo yaye nemebe.

English: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atazamaye upepo hatapanda, yeyote aangaliaye mawingu hatavuna.
Ekegusii: Omonto okona‐korigereria komanya igoro y’embeo tagosimeka, na oyo okona‐korigereria amare buna are takogesa.

English: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
Kiswahili: Pepeto lake liko mkononi, tayari kusafisha sakafu yake ya kupuria na kuikusanya ngano ghalani, lakini makapi atayateketeza kwa moto usiozimika.”
Ekegusii: Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”

English: Then he must bring to the priest his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock.
Kiswahili: Kisha kama adhabu lazima amletee kuhani, yaani kwa Bwana, kama sadaka yake ya hatia, kondoo dume asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani kamili kutoka kundi lake.
Ekegusii: Erio andeetere inche Omonene emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye; ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye rie ching’ondi, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye; naye oyekorere rigori, na omonto oria ayeirere Omokuani.

English: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don't abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”
Kiswahili: Nao Wagibeoni wakatuma ujumbe kwa Yoshua kwenye kambi ya Gilgali na kumwambia, “Usiwatelekeze watumishi wako. Panda haraka uje kwetu kutuokoa! Tusaidie, kwa sababu wafalme wote wa Waamori wakaao kwenye nchi ya vilima wameunganisha majeshi yao pamoja dhidi yetu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abagibeoni bagatoma abanto ase Yoshua agwo Giligali ase atoorete komoteebia, “Tototiga intwe abasomba bao! Ayerera, otiire gocha aa, otokonye na gototooria, ekiagera abarwoti bonsi b'Abaamori, abwo bamenyete ase ense y'ebitunwa, basangererekanire gotorwania.”

English: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
Kiswahili: Makiri akatwaa mke kutoka miongoni mwa Wahupimu na Washupimu. Jina la dada yake aliitwa Maaka. Mwana wa pili wa Makiri aliitwa Selofehadi, ambaye alikuwa na wasichana tu.
Ekegusii: Makiri akanywomeria Hupimu omokungu, boigo akanywomeria Supimu omokungu. Omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Maaka. Omwana omomura o kabere o Manase nigo arenge korokwa Selofehadi. Selofehadi nigo abwate abana abaiseke boka.

English: and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
Kiswahili: nayo makao yake huko bara yataangamizwa kwa upanga. Ndipo watakapojua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’emechie yaye emeke ere ase engegu mbakenywe nemioro. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

English: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
Kiswahili: Mabaki watarudi, mabaki wa Yakobo watamrudia Mungu Mwenye Nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abatigari, abwo bare b'ororeeria rwa Yakobo, mbamoiranere Nyasae Omobui.

English: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
Kiswahili: Ikimbieni zinaa. Dhambi zingine zote atendazo mtu ziko nje ya mwili wake, lakini yeye aziniye hutenda dhambi ndani ya mwili wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Tama obotomani! Kera ebibe binde bigokorwa na Mwanyabaanto nigo bire isiko y’omobere; korende ere oyogokora obotomani igo okorire ebibe ase omobere oye omonyene.

English: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
Kiswahili: Lakini hapakuwa na yeyote mbinguni wala duniani au chini ya dunia aliyeweza kukifungua hicho kitabu wala hata kutazama ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Na onde tarenge igoro, gose ase ense, gose inse y'ense oyogwenerete koigora egetabu, gose koyerigereria.

English: They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
Kiswahili: Hawataona njaa wala kuona kiu, wala hari ya jangwani au jua halitawapiga. Yeye mwenye huruma juu yao atawaonyesha njia, na kuwaongoza kando ya chemchemi za maji.
Ekegusii: Tibakoba nenchara, gose erang’o, eguru‐gura na omobaso tibikobasamba, ekiagera Omonene oria obaroreire amaabera nabaraae, nabatang’ane gochia ase chinsoko chi’amaache.

English: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
Kiswahili: Akasubu pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etaabu enyititoire, agachibeeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.

English: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
Kiswahili: Watakuwa watu wangu, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.

English: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while'? We don't know what he is saying.”
Kiswahili: Wakaendelea kuulizana, “Ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Kitambo kidogo'? Hatuelewi hilo analosema.”
Ekegusii: Nabo bagateeba, “Ing'ana ki eri agoteeba, ng'a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”

English: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn't find him.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakasisitiza, mpaka akaona aibu kuwakatalia. Hivyo akasema, “Watumeni.” Nao wakawatuma watu hamsini, wakamtafuta kwa siku tatu, lakini hawakumpata.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bagendererete komobooria, ere akarosa, agateeba: “Batome rende.” Barabwo bagatoma abanto emerongo etano, bagachia komorigia ase engaki y'amatuko atato, tibamonyora.

English: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaagana na makutano, akaingia nyumbani. Wanafunzi wake wakamjia wakamwambia, “Tueleze maana ya ule mfano wa magugu shambani.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw'amabanchore a mogondo.”

English: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Ni mtu gani huyo aliyekuambia uchukue mkeka wako uende?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Oria ogoteebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”

English: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inazimia kwa kutamani wokovu wako, lakini nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one oganyoire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao, nigo 'nsemeretie ring'ana riao.

English: And the priest is to examine the mildew and isolate the contaminated fabric for seven days.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atachunguza upele huo na kukitenga kifaa hicho kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Omokuani areenge egento kere na ukoma, erio akebeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
Kiswahili: Unijibu basi, kama unaweza; jiandae kunikabili mimi.
Ekegusii: Bono ing'iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang'ana ao ang'e, otenene bokong'u!

English: A man who looks to the table of another, his life is not to be considered a life. He will pollute his soul with another person's food, but a wise and well-instructed person will beware of that.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayetazama meza ya mtu mwingine, maisha yake hayapaswi kuchukuliwa kama maisha. Atachafua roho yake kwa chakula cha mtu mwingine, lakini mtu mwenye busara na elimu atajihadhari na hilo.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto akomosemeria oyonde amoe endagera, ere nigo akomenya obogima botagwenereti Mwanyabaanto. Ogosemeria endagera y'omonto onde nokwea obosooku; omonto oorokereirie naende omong'aini, ere nigo akobwebachera obogima bonga buna obwo.

English: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh's house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God's house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
Kiswahili: Akampa vielelezo vya yote Roho alikuwa ameviweka moyoni mwake kwa ajili ya kumbi za Hekalu la Bwana na vyumba vyote vilivyolizunguka, kwa ajili ya hazina za Hekalu la Mungu na kwa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.
Ekegusii: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw'ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y'okoagacha chiraaro chi'enyomba y'Omonene, na obw'ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi'enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi'ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.

English: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
Kiswahili: Hunifumbulia vinywa vyao wakisema, “Aha! Aha! Kwa macho yetu wenyewe tumeliona.”
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateeba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”

English: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
Kiswahili: Mpaka huo ukageukia nyuma kuelekea Rama na kwenda hadi kwenye mji wenye ngome wa Tiro, ukageuka kuelekea Hosa na kutokeza baharini katika eneo la Akzibu,
Ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia Rama, rogaika omochie omonene o Turo, oyogiteire chindwaki, rokaonchoka gochia Hosa, na rokanucha Enyancha Enene. Naende orogongo orwo rokabwaterania engegu y'ensemo y'Akisibu,

English: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God's house, cut the vessels of God's house in pieces, and shut up the doors of Yahweh's house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Ahazi akakusanya pamoja vyombo vya nyumba ya Mungu na kuvivunja vipande vipande. Akafunga milango ya Hekalu la Bwana na kusimamisha madhabahu katika kila njia panda ya barabara za Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ahasi agasangereria ebikorero bi'enyomba ya Nyasae, akabinachana ebing'ese, erio agasieka ebisieri bi'enyomba y'Omonene, akayeroiseria ebisasimero aase ande onsi agwo Yerusalemu.

English: But if He should say, ‘I do not delight in you,’ then here I am; let Him do to me whatever seems good to Him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama yeye atasema, ‘Mimi sipendezwi nawe,’ basi mimi niko tayari; yeye na anifanye chochote aonacho chema kwake.”
Ekegusii: Korende karanteebie ng’a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya ase are.”

English: who is not partial to princes and does not favor rich over poor? For they are all the work of His hands.
Kiswahili: yeye asiyependelea wakuu, wala haonyeshi upendeleo kwa matajiri kuliko maskini, kwa kuwa wote ni kazi ya mikono yake?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagaambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.

English: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
Kiswahili: Nimedhihirisha, kuokoa na kutangaza: Mimi, wala si mungu mgeni katikati yenu. Ninyi ni mashahidi wangu,” asema Bwana, “kwamba Mimi ndimi Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo narentete ogotooreka, nkabarareria ayio, nainwe mokayaigwa, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge ase egati yaino; inwe nigo more birori baane ng’a inche ninche Nyasae.” Naboigo Omonene atebiire.

English: A faithful wife gives joy to her husband. He will fulfill his years in peace.
Kiswahili: Mke mwaminifu humfurahisha mumewe, naye atatimiza miaka yake kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Omokungu omwegenwa nigo are omogooko ase omosacha oye; omosacha oyio nigo aramenye nomorembe emiaka yaye yonsi.

English: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn't recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja, nao hawakumtambua, bali walimtendea kila kitu walichotaka. Vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu pia atateswa mikononi mwao.”
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng'a Elija oikire gocha; na barabwo tibamomanyete, korende bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie. Naboigo n'Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachie konyora emechando ase amaboko abo.”

English: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti kuu mbinguni, ikisema: “Sasa wokovu na uweza na Ufalme wa Mungu wetu umekuja na mamlaka ya Kristo wake. Kwa kuwa ametupwa chini mshtaki wa ndugu zetu, anayewashtaki mbele za Mungu usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene igoro rigoteeba, “Bono ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito gwachire amo ne chinguru na oborwoti bwaye, na okobua gwa Kristo oye, ekiagera omosoeri bw’abaminto orutirwe inse, ere oyorenge kobasoera ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito omobaso na obotuko.

English: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Kiswahili: Ameukumbuka upendo wake na uaminifu wake kwa nyumba ya Israeli; miisho yote ya dunia imeuona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.

English: Meanwhile, those in the ambush came out of the city against them, and the men of Ai were trapped between the Israelite forces on both sides. So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.
Kiswahili: Wale waviziaji nao pia wakatoka nje ya mji dhidi yao, hivi kwamba wakashikiwa katikati, Waisraeli wakiwa pande zote mbili. Israeli wakawaua, bila kuwaachia yeyote aliyenusurika wala aliyetoroka.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli abarenge ase omochie ime bagatirimboka gochiao. Ase igo abanto ba Ai bagaetananwa kegima n’Abaisraeli, na bonsi bagaitwa. Onde tatigarete otooregete,

English: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
Kiswahili: Wakamwita Barnaba Zeu na Paulo wakamwita Herme kwa kuwa ndiye alikuwa msemaji mkuu.
Ekegusii: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.

English: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;
Kiswahili: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye sehemu yenye mawe ni mtu yule ambaye hulisikia neno na mara hulipokea kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase egetare nere oria okoigwa ring'ana, erio kegima oribwata nomogooko,

English: Therefore a lion from the forest will strike them down, a wolf from the desert will ravage them. A leopard will lie in wait near their cities, and everyone who ventures out will be torn to pieces. For their rebellious acts are many, and their unfaithful deeds are numerous.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo simba kutoka mwituni atawashambulia, mbwa mwitu kutoka jangwani atawaangamiza, chui atawavizia karibu na miji yao, ili kumrarua vipande vipande yeyote atakayethubutu kutoka nje, kwa maana maasi yao ni makubwa, na kukengeuka kwao kumekuwa ni kwingi.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio endo nerue rinani ebaite; esese y’orosana nerue erooro ebasirie; engo nebaboere ase emechie yabo. Kera omonto ogosoka korwa aroro natandoranwe, ekiagera ogosaria kwabo nokonge, na okogwa kwabo kw’ogontiga nokonene.

English: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
Kiswahili: Ninaikabidhi roho yangu mikononi mwako, unikomboe Ee Bwana, uliye Mungu wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.

English: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
Kiswahili: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng'ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

English: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don't bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
Kiswahili: Utakapokuja kwa Waamoni, msiwasumbue wala kuwachokoza kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa ardhi yoyote iliyo ya Waamoni kuwa milki yenu. Nimeitoa kama milki ya wazao wa Loti.”
Ekegusii: Ekero moraike ang'e n'ense y'Abaamoni, abanto b'ororeeria rwa Loti, timobaisa kobachegia gose kobarwania esegi, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe nonya n'enseemo eyemo y'orogongo orwo nabaeire barabwo.”

English: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn't concealed from my eyes.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yanaziona njia zao zote, hazikufichika kwangu, wala dhambi yao haikusitirika.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo aroche chinchera chiabo chionsi. Tibakonyara kwebisa korwa ase 'nde. Nigo ndoche ebibe biabo.

English: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!' and tell the south, ‘Don't hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
Kiswahili: Nitaiambia kaskazini, ‘Watoe!' nayo kusini, ‘Usiwazuie.' Walete wana wangu kutoka mbali, na binti zangu kutoka miisho ya dunia:
Ekegusii: Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia Irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi'ense.

English: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.
Kiswahili: Mashujaa wa Babeli wameacha kupigana, wamebaki katika ngome zao. Nguvu zao zimekwisha, wamekuwa kama wanawake. Makazi yake yameteketezwa kwa moto, makomeo ya malango yake yamevunjika.
Ekegusii: Abarwani chituoni ba Babiloni batigire korwana esegi. Nigo bagendererete kobeera ase chiburi ime, ekiagera tibari ne chinguru, babeire buna abakungu. Chinyomba chia Babiloni chiasambirwe, na emekorogoto yabo y'ebiita yabunirwe.

English: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
Kiswahili: Sifa apewe Bwana, Mungu Mwokozi wetu, ambaye siku kwa siku hutuchukulia mizigo yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.

English: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.
Kiswahili: Ilipauliwa kwa mierezi juu ya boriti zile zilizolala juu ya nguzo arobaini na tano, kumi na tano kwa kila safu.
Ekegusii: Enyomba nigo yareenge nekerama ki’emecharake igoro y’emiamba yabegetwe ase chisiiro chiria emerongo ene na isano, ikomi na isano ase kera orwaro.

English: In all the things that you have brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, Jerusalem, you have executed true judgments. For according to truth and justice you have brought all these things upon us because of our sins.
Kiswahili: Katika mambo yote uliyotuletea sisi, na juu ya mji mtakatifu wa baba zetu, Yerusalemu, umetekeleza hukumu za kweli. Kwa maana kwa mujibu wa kweli na haki umetuletea mambo haya yote kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu.
Ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete eri riarenge rironge ekeene kwaretete emechando ase Yerusalemu, omochie omochenu bw'echisokoro chiaito. Egesusuro ekio nigo giatobwenerete ase engencho y'ebibe biaito.

English: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions
Kiswahili: “Je, utamwindia simba jike mawindo, na kuwashibisha simba wenye njaa
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,

English: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Gadi; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 40,500.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi'egesaku kia Gadi. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifi emerongo ene, na amagana atano (40,500).

English: Pray to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail. I will let you go; you do not need to stay any longer.”
Kiswahili: Mwombeni Bwana, kwa kuwa tumepata ngurumo na mvua za mawe za kututosha. Nitawaachia mwondoke; hamtahitaji kungoja zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”

English: They set up the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD—both the morning and evening burnt offerings—even though they feared the people of the land.
Kiswahili: Ingawa waliwaogopa watu waliowazunguka, walijenga madhabahu juu ya ule msingi wake, wakamtolea Bwana dhabihu za sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto juu yake za asubuhi na za jioni.
Ekegusii: Bakaagacha egesasiimero keria aase aye, erinde bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa mambia na morogoba, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto bamenyete ase ense eria.

English: For before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife and remove and discard the branches.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kabla ya mavuno, wakati wa kuchanua ukishapita na maua yakawa zabibu zinazoiva, atayakata machipukizi kwa mundu wa kupogolea matawi, naye atakata na kuyaondoa matawi yaliyopanuka.
Ekegusii: Ekero chindagera chiakoorire gosicha ne rigesa ritaraika, na amasabibu achakire kwama, Omonene nasose chinsagia nomoyio enkuro, na ebisebo bigokina abirusieo.

English: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
Kiswahili: Lakini Sauli alikuwa amemwoza Mikali binti yake, aliyekuwa mkewe Daudi, kwa Palti mwana wa Laishi, kutoka Galimu.
Ekegusii: Saulo konya orure Mikali, omosubati oye, oyorenge moga Daudi, ase Paliti, mosinto o Laisi bw’omochie o Galimu.

English: Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaandika barua kwa jina la Ahabu akaweka muhuri wake juu ya hizo barua, akazipeleka kwa wazee na kwa watu wenye cheo walioishi katika mji pamoja na Nabothi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omokungu oria akarika amarube, akabeeka erieta ri’Ahabu na ekemanyererio kiaye ase amarube ayio, akayatoma gochia ase abagaaka, na ase abanene baria bamenyete amo na Naboti ase omochie oye.

English: He will scourge us for our iniquities, and will again show mercy, and will gather us out of all the nations among whom you are all scattered.
Kiswahili: Atatupiga kwa ajili ya maovu yetu, na kutuonyesha rehema tena, na kutukusanya kutoka katika mataifa yote ambayo nyote mmetawanyika kati yao.
Ekegusii: Nonya gakobaa egesusuro ase engencho y'obobe bwaino, nabarorere amaabera inwe mwensi; nabasangererie korwa ase kera egesaku korwa kera ase mwasiareretwe.

English: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa watakataa kufanya mapatano ya amani na wakiwaingiza katika vita, basi mtauzunguka mji huo kwa vita.
Ekegusii: Korende onye bakwanga kwerua abanyene ase more, korende baabarwanie esegi, rirorio moire omochie obo na komenyao.

English: There were three rows of high windows facing one another in three tiers.
Kiswahili: Madirisha yake yaliwekwa juu kwa safu tatu, yakielekeana.
Ekegusii: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.

English: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury, and great wrath.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitapigana dhidi yenu kwa mkono wangu ulionyooshwa na mkono wa nguvu, kwa hasira na ghadhabu kali na ukali mwingi.
Ekegusii: Inche omonyene mbarwanie inwe nokoboko kwane kore ne chinguru, imbe nendamwamu, na obotindi, na okogechigwa okonene.

English: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord Yahweh says,' when Yahweh has not spoken.
Kiswahili: Manabii wake wanapaka chokaa matendo haya kwa maono ya uongo na utabiri wa udanganyifu. Wanasema, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo,' wakati Bwana hajasema.
Ekegusii: Abaabani babo baabaakire echooka etochoganiri buya; nigo bakobarorera amaroro y'oborimo na kobaringoreria oborimo, bateeba: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba, n'Omonene takwaneti bo.

English: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
Kiswahili: Ninatafakari maagizo yako na kuziangalia njia zako.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’amachiiko ao, naende ’mbe ’nkorigereria chinchera chiao chionsi.

English: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?'
Kiswahili: Kiburi cha moyo wako kimekudanganya, wewe unayeishi katika majabali ya miamba na kufanya makao yako juu, wewe unayejiambia mwenyewe, ‘Ni nani awezaye kunishusha chini?'
Ekegusii: Oboenenu bw'enkoro yao bwakong'ainire, aye omenyete ime y'emienya y'ebitare; agwo ase omenyete aimokererete igoro. Nigo ogokwana ase enkoro yao ime, gweteeba: Ning'o orang'iyerie gochia inse?”

English: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtumwa amekimbilia kwako, usimrudishe kwa bwana wake.
Ekegusii: “Onye omosomba otamire korwa ase omonene oye, ochire ase more, timobaisa komoirania gochia ase omonene oye naende.

English: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
Kiswahili: nchi izaayo ikawa ya chumvi isiyofaa, kwa sababu ya uovu wa wale walioishi humo.
Ekegusii: Akaonchora n'ense ere entobu ekaba ekerubo ki'omonyo, ase engencho y'obobe bw' abanto bamenyeteo.

English: On the seventh day, when the king’s heart was merry with wine, he ordered the seven eunuchs who served him—Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas—
Kiswahili: Siku ya saba, wakati Mfalme Ahasuero alikuwa amesisimka roho yake kwa mvinyo, aliamuru matowashi saba waliokuwa wakimhudumia, yaani, Mehumani, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethari na Karkasi,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omoyega oyio, omorwoti kanyure edivai akaba nomosasoko ase enkoro yaye. Ase ayio akarangeria Mehumani na Bisita, Haribona na Bigita, Abagita na Setari, na Karikasi, abakoreri baye batano na babere abagombaetigwe, abwo barenge komokorera ere ase enyomba yaye,

English: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia kila kiumbe mbinguni na duniani, chini ya nchi na baharini na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake vikiimba: “Sifa na heshima na utukufu na uweza ni vyake yeye aketiye juu ya hicho kiti cha enzi na kwa Mwana-Kondoo, milele na milele!”
Ekegusii: Naende nkaigwa kera egetongwa ekere igoro, na ekere ase ense, na inse y’ense, na igoro y’enyancha na imeo, kegoteeba, “Asare ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene, na ase Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ogotogigwa, na ogosikwa, na obonene, na okobua goika kare na kare!”

English: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
Kiswahili: Hofu, shimo na mtego vinakungojea, ewe mtu ukaaye duniani.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase ense, obwoba, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete.

English: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
Kiswahili: Majirani zake na wale wote waliokuwa wamemwona hapo awali akiombaomba wakaanza kuuliza, “Je, huyu si yule aliyekuwa akiketi akiombaomba?”
Ekegusii: Nabo abagisangio baye, na baria bamorooche ekero arenge omosabereri bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo tari ere oria orenge oikaransete gosaberera?”

English: Take the garment of him who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
Kiswahili: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.
Ekegusii: Ira eanga y’omonto oyo bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omoao, ira ebi abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.

English: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!'
Kiswahili: “Hapo mbele yangu kulikuwa na mnyama wa pili, ambaye alionekana kama dubu. Upande wake mmoja ulikuwa umeinuka, na alikuwa na mbavu tatu katika kinywa chake kati ya meno yake. Akaambiwa, ‘Amka, ule nyama mpaka ushibe!'
Ekegusii: “Naende nkarora eng'iti ya kabere yagwekaine edubu ekaimokerera igoro na kogunkwaria rikere riaye erimo; nigo yabwate chimbaru isato ase omonwa oye, gati‐gati y'amaino aye. Eng'iti eria egateebigwa: Imoka, orie chinyama chinyinge!

English: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.” Word of Jerusalem’s Fall
Kiswahili: Lakini, ee nyumba ya Israeli, unasema, ‘Njia ya Bwana si sawa.’ Lakini nitamhukumu kila mmoja wenu sawasawa na njia zake mwenyewe.” Anguko La Yerusalemu Laelezewa
Ekegusii: Korende inwe Abaisraeli nigo mogendererete goteeba: Chinchera chia Omonene tichiri echi’ekeene. Ninachere kera omonto ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwaye. Amang’ana igoro y’okogwa kwa Yerusalemu

English: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.
Kiswahili: Kama kondoo, wamewekewa kwenda kaburini, nacho kifo kitawala. Wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi, maumbile yao yataozea kaburini, mbali na majumba yao makubwa ya fahari.
Ekegusii: Buna riicho rie ching’ondi nigo bakoirwa gochia aase abakuure amakweri naro arabe omorisia obo. Abwo bare abaronge mbaabagambere kobogokiamoka, na ebieni biabo mbisirere agwo aase abakuure aase are obomenyo bwabo.

English: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufanya mapatano naye, atatenda kwa udanganyifu, na akitumia watu wachache tu ataingia madarakani.
Ekegusii: Nyuma okobwatana kogwakorirwe nere, nakore obong'ainereria, anyore okobua nonya obwate abanto abake boka.

English: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side. The Curtain for the Entrance (Exodus 36:37–38)
Kiswahili: Weka meza nje ya pazia upande wa kaskazini wa Hema, kisha weka kinara cha taa upande wa kusini wa Hema.
Ekegusii: Obeke emesa isiko y’etoto ensemo ya sugusu, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya ensemo ya Irianyi, ase Obomenyo ime.

English: “You will indeed drink My cup,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa kweli kikombe changu mtakinywea, lakini kuketi upande wangu wa kuume au wa kushoto si langu mimi kuwapa. Nafasi hizo ni za wale ambao wameandaliwa na Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Egekombe ’nkonywera inche, namokenywere, korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio ney’okobee, tindi nokobua gw’okobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire na Tata one nabwo barariegwe.” Obonene bw’ekeene (Mar 10:41-45)

English: The people asked me, “Won't you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wakaniuliza, “Je, jambo hili unalofanya linamaanisha nini kwetu?”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bakamboria, “Nonyare gototeebia engencho y'amang'ana aya, na eyagera gwakora iga?”

English: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
Kiswahili: Huifunga mioyo yao iliyo migumu, vinywa vyao hunena kwa majivuno.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bare ne chinkoro chitari namaabera nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.

English: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.
Kiswahili: Zera Mkushi akatoka kupigana dhidi yao akiwa na jeshi la watu maelfu ya maelfu na magari ya vita 300, nao wakaja mpaka Maresha.
Ekegusii: Sera Omoetiopia amo nabarwani baye b'esegi emilioni eyemo (1,000,000) abarenge ne chigari amagana atato bagacha kobarwania esegi, bagaika Maresa.

English: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
Kiswahili: Jihadharini na mbwa, wale watenda maovu, jihadharini na wale wajikatao miili yao, wasemao ili kuokoka ni lazima kutahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Mwerende korwa ase chisese, mwerende na korwa ase abwo bagokora amabe, mwerende nabwo bakwenachanacha!

English: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Paulo kuona maono haya, tulijiandaa kwa haraka kuondoka kwenda Makedonia tukiwa tumesadiki kuwa Mungu alikuwa ametuita kuhubiri habari njema huko.
Ekegusii: Magega y'okorora koria, erio bwango kegima tokarigia kogenda Makedonia, ekiagera twaroche ekeene ng'a Nyasae otorangeirie tobaranderie enchiri.

English: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God's Mountain.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akaondoka na Yoshua mtumishi wake, naye Mose akapanda juu kwenye mlima wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nomosomba oye Yoshua, erio ere agatiira gochia egetunwa kia Nyasae.

English: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
Kiswahili: Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Yeyote aongozaye mashambulizi dhidi ya Wayebusi, atakuwa jemadari mkuu.” Yoabu mwana wa Seruya akawa wa kwanza kukwea, naye akawa mkuu.
Ekegusii: Daudi konya oteebire, ng’a “Monto onde bwensi orabe oyo bw’eritang’ani goita abanto ba Yebusi, ere oyio nabe omochiki omonene bw’abarwani.” Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani kogenda aroro; ase ayio ere akaba omochiki.

English: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God rested on my tent,
Kiswahili: Natamani siku zile nilizokuwa katika ustawi wangu, wakati urafiki wa Mungu wa ndani ulipoibariki nyumba yangu,
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria nakinete inde ne chinguru, na obosani bwa Nyasae bwagendererete kobeera ase obomenyo bwane.

English: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
Kiswahili: “mimi huzipinga ishara za manabii wa uongo, na kuwatia upumbavu waaguzi, niyapinduaye maarifa ya wenye hekima, na kuyafanya kuwa upuzi,
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ngosaria ebimanyererio bi'ababani b'oborimo na gokora abaringoria baba chiosi. Nigo nkoirania magega obong'aini bw'abang'aini na gokora okomanya kwabo kwaba oboriri.

English: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
Kiswahili: lakini alilichagua kabila la Yuda, Mlima Sayuni, ambao aliupenda.
Ekegusii: korende agachora abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, na egetunwa gia Sayoni ekio anchete.

English: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”
Kiswahili: Siku utakayoondoka kuvuka Bonde la Kidroni, uwe na hakika utakufa; damu yako itakuwa juu ya kichwa chako mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero kende gionsi orasoke korwa aroro, bwamboke akarooche ga Kidironi, omanye ng'a goika okwe; okomocha kw'ogoiterwa kw'amanyinga ao nigo korabe okwao.”

English: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akarudi kwa Bwana na kumwambia, “Lo! Hawa watu wamefanya dhambi kubwa namna gani! Wamejitengenezea miungu ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Abanto aba bakorire ebibe ebinene mono, bekoreire enyasae y'etaabu.

English: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
Kiswahili: Wale wanawake waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja na Yesu wakimfuata kutoka Galilaya wakamfuata Yosefu, wakaliona kaburi na jinsi mwili wa Yesu ulivyolazwa.
Ekegusii: Abakungu abaachete amo nere korwa Galili, nigo batunyanete korwa magega, bakarigereria oboina na buna omobere oye bwareretigwe.

English: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can't.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama nikisema, “Sitamtaja wala kusema tena kwa jina lake,” neno lake linawaka ndani ya moyo wangu kama moto, moto uliofungwa ndani ya mifupa yangu. Nimechoka sana kwa kulizuia ndani mwangu; kweli, siwezi kujizuia.
Ekegusii: Ekero nateebete: “Bono tinkoinyora Omonene, gose gokwana ase erieta riaye nonya ng'ake,” rirorio rikaba ase enkoro yane na ase amauga aane buna omorero ogosamba osiekeireo. Nkarosa mono korikiria ime ase 'nde, tinanyarete gwetanga tindisokia.

English: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted,
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii Hiramu akampa Solomoni miti yote ya mierezi na magogo ya misunobari kama alivyohitaji,
Ekegusii: Hiramu akaa Sulemani emete, emecharake na emetarakwa buna Sulemani aganetie.

English: The poor man is hated even by his neighbor, but many are those who love the rich.
Kiswahili: Maskini huepukwa hata na majirani zao, bali matajiri wana marafiki wengi.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.

English: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa kipindi chote cha kujitenga kwake yeye ni wakfu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe omochenu aase Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete.

English: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
Kiswahili: kutoka Asheri, ni Pagieli mwana wa Okrani;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi'Aseri, Pagieli, mosinto bw'Okirani.

English: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
Kiswahili: Basi walikuwepo Yerusalemu Wayahudi wanaomcha Mungu kutoka kila taifa chini ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Mbamenyete Yerusalemu Abayahudi abasigete Nyasae, abanto korwa ase kera egesaku inse y'erioba.

English: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,
Kiswahili: Paulo alipoitwa aingie ndani, Tertulo akaanza kutoa mashtaka akisema, “Mtukufu Feliksi, kwa muda mrefu tumefurahia amani na matengenezo mengi mazuri yamefanywa kwa ajili ya watu hawa kwa sababu ya upeo wako wa kuona mambo ya mbele.
Ekegusii: Ekero Teritulo achia korangerigwa, agachaaka komosoera, agateeba: “Aye, omosike Feliki, ase okogamba kwao twanyorire omorembe omonge, na ase okorigereria kwao gwakoreire egesaku giaito ebinto ebinge ebiya,

English: From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
Kiswahili: Kutoka uzao wa Bebai: Yehohanani, Hanania, Zabai na Athlai.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Bebai; Yehohanani na Hanania, Sabai na Atilai;

English: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error, he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu yeyote amekula sadaka takatifu kwa makosa, lazima atoe malipo ya sadaka hiyo kwa kuhani na kuongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani ya sadaka hiyo.
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani oraarie ebinto biria ebichenu ase ogotamanya, goika airanie egento egechenu ase Omokuani, buna keria airete, na ameente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.

English: Once upon a time there was a poor man and his wife. They had only one child, a girl. The child's name was Nonkungu. Her parents loved Nonkungu very much.
Kiswahili: Paliishi mtu maskini na mkewe. Walikuwa na binti yao mrembo aliyeitwa Nonkungu.
Ekegusii: Abwo kare Omosacha oyomo narengeoo amo na mokaye. Nigo babwate omwana oyomo bweka omoiseke nerieta riaye nigo arenge korokwa Nonkungu. Nonkungu nigo arenge omuya ekieni naende abwate enkoro engiya.

English: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”
Kiswahili: waambieni wale wenye mioyo ya hofu, “Kuweni hodari, msiogope; tazama, Mungu wenu atakuja, pamoja na malipo ya Mungu, atakuja na kuwaokoa ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Teebia abanto abwo babwate chinkoro chinyoba: “Mobe abaremu, timwoboa! Naama! Nyasae oino nache korusia egesiomba. Rora, Nyasae nache kobaruseria egesiomba. Ere nache kobatooria.”

English: Doesn't the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
Kiswahili: Je, sikio haliyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang'ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?

English: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini au mtakunywa nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini. Je, maisha si zaidi ya chakula, na mwili zaidi ya mavazi?
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio nabateebirie ng’a timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie, gose eki moranywe, gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke. Inee! Obogima tibori obonene kobua endagera? Na omobere tori omonene kobua chianga?

English: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu alimfanya yeye asiyekuwa na dhambi kuwa dhambi kwa ajili yetu, ili sisi tupate kufanywa haki ya Mungu kwake yeye.
Ekegusii: Nyasae omokorire ere, oyotamanyeti ebibe, koba ebibe ase engencho yaito, erio asare intwe tobe noboronge ase Nyasae.

English: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
Kiswahili: maana aliiwekea misingi yake baharini na kuifanya imara juu ya maji.
Ekegusii: Nigo abegete oboroso bwaye igoro ase chinyancha, akabokong'ia igoro ase chindooche.

English: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.” Meaningless Idols
Kiswahili: ili kwamba watu wapate kuona na kujua, wapate kufikiri na kuelewa, kwamba mkono wa Bwana umetenda hili, kwamba yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli ndiye alilifanya.”
