Ekegusii: ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbaarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng’a nokoboko kw’Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.” Omonene okoamererania ne chinyasae chi’oborimo

English: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
Kiswahili: Debora, nabii mwanamke, mkewe Lapidothi, ndiye alikuwa anaamua Israeli wakati ule.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omobani Debora, moka Lapidoti, nigo arenge omogambi bw’Abaisraeli.

English: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
Kiswahili: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vitakuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yanayotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang'ani robe nemegwekano etato y'ebisicha binga buna ebi'omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo robe nemegwekano etato y'ebisicha binga buna ebi'omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chibe boigo.

English: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
Kiswahili: Dunia inapepesuka kama mlevi, inayumbayumba kama kibanda kwenye upepo; imelemewa sana na mzigo wa hatia ya uasi wake na ikianguka kamwe haitainuka tena.
Ekegusii: Ense yatindire buna oyotindire amarwa; nigo ekorunda‐rundigwa buna oborunda‐rundia bw'omote. Ogosaria kwaye kwayeritoereire, negwe, tekonyara koboka naende.

English: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?
Kiswahili: Hili nalo ni baya la kusikitisha: Kama vile mtu ajavyo, vivyo hivyo huondoka, naye anapata faida gani, maadamu hutaabika kwa ajili ya upepo?
Ekegusii: Obo boigo nobobe bw'obororo; onye okorua ase ense ogenda buna achete, mbitoki ki abwate ase ogwechanda gokora emeremo emekong'u y'okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa?

English: Then all the people turned them toward him, and said, “What do these words that you have spoken mean?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wote wakamgeukia, wakasema, "Maneno haya uliyosema yanamaanisha nini?"
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo agaonchokera Daniel akamoboria, “Inki eke ogokwana?”

English: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”
Kiswahili: Nawe umpe mwanangu Solomoni kujitolea kwako kwa moyo wote ili kuzishika amri zako, masharti yako, maagizo yako na kufanya kila kitu ili kujenga Hekalu hili la fahari ambalo kwa ajili yake nimetoa.”
Ekegusii: Oe Sulemani, omwana one, enkoro yeruete asore, erinde arende amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao, na emeroberio yao echiikire, akore aya onsi na aagache enyomba eria y'obonene nabeire nkobeeka ebinto bionsi ang'e ase okoyeagacha.”

English: “For both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in My house I have found their wickedness,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Nabii na kuhani wote si wacha Mungu; hata hekaluni mwangu ninaona uovu wao,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Abaabani na abakuani tibamoirogeti Nyasae. Nonya nase enyomba yane obobe bwabo bwarorekanire.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”
Kiswahili: nuru kwa ajili ya ufunuo kwa watu wa Mataifa na kwa ajili ya utukufu kwa watu wako Israeli.”
Ekegusii: omobaso okomorekera abanto b’Ebisaku, na obonene bw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli.”

English: He pulled down the altars that the kings of Judah had set up on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars that Manasseh had set up in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD. The king pulverized them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.
Kiswahili: Alizivunja madhabahu ambazo wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wamezijenga kwenye paa la ghorofa ya Ahazi, pia madhabahu alizokuwa amezijenga Manase katika nyua mbili za Hekalu la Bwana. Akaziondoa huko, akazivunja vipande vipande, na kutupa hicho kifusi katika Bonde la Kidroni.
Ekegusii: Agatagora na akaiyeria inse ebisasimero biarenge igoro ase ekerama ang’e nakanyomba ka igoro k’Ahasi, biria abarwoti b’Abayuda baagachete, na biria Manase aagachete ase chiraaro ibere chi’enyomba y’Omonene. Akabinachana ebing’ese, erio akaruta orotu rwabo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.

English: ‘Curse Meroz,’ says the angel of the LORD. ‘Bitterly curse her inhabitants; for they did not come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akasema, ‘Merozi alaaniwe. Walaaniwe watu wake kwa uchungu, kwa kuwa hawakuja kumsaidia Bwana, kumsaidia Bwana dhidi ya hao wenye nguvu.’
Ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene nigo agoteeba, Ragereria Merosi, ragereria abanto bamenyeteo, ekiagera tibaachete gokony’Omonene, komokonya korwania abare ne chinguru.

English: fell on their faces to the ground, blew with the solemn trumpets, and cried toward heaven.
Kiswahili: walianguka kifudifudi chini, wakapiga tarumbeta nzito, na kupiga kelele kuelekea mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Bakagwa inse maumama. Ekero rirandi riabugetigwe buna ekeinyorio, kera oyomo akamoreera Omonene.

English: Are my days not few? Withdraw from me, that I may have a little comfort,
Kiswahili: Je, siku zangu chache si zimekaribia kuisha? Niachie ili niweze kupata muda mfupi wa kufurahi
Ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko y’obogima bwane tari amake? Intige, imbe n’obotoereru ase engaki eye enke,

English: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri, zikaota vizuri na kukua, zikatoa mazao, moja mara thelathini, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara mia moja.”
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama endagera, chikamera na gokina, na kwama; echinde emerongo etato, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, naende echinde rigana.”

English: The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for common use by the city, for houses, and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it
Kiswahili: “Eneo linalobaki lenye upana wa dhiraa 5,000 na urefu wa dhiraa 25,000, litakuwa kwa ajili ya matumizi ya kawaida ya mji, kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa nyumba na malisho. Mji utakuwa katikati yake
Ekegusii: Orogongo roratigare rore nobogare bwe chimoti chilifu isano (5,000), na obotambe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), nigo rorabe orw’ abanto bande bonsi, baraagache emechie yabo aroro, naende robe orw’oborisia. Agwo nao omochie omonene oraagachwe gati‐gati.

English: Don't be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Usiwaogope, kwa maana niko pamoja nawe nikuokoe,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobairoka, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye kogokonya. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: “Angalieni, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu, atakayeiandaa njia mbele yangu. Ndipo ghafula Bwana mnayemtafuta atakuja hekaluni mwake. Mjumbe wa Agano, ambaye mnamwonea shauku, atakuja,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw'Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora, nintome omotomwa one andoiserie enchera, n'Omonene oyio mokorigia nache mobosokano ase Hekalu yaye; nere omotomwa bw'okobwatana kw'ogotianania oyio moganetie. Ee, ngocha are.”

English: When Jesus saw their faith, He said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, akamwambia yule mgonjwa, “Rafiki, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamoteebia, “Mosani, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: The elders of Israel will listen to what you say, and you must go with them to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.’
Kiswahili: “Wazee wa Israeli watakusikiliza. Kisha wewe na wazee mtakwenda kwa mfalme wa Misri na kumwambia, ‘ Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania ametutokea. Turuhusu twende safari ya siku tatu huko jangwani kutoa dhabihu kwa Bwana Mungu wetu.’
Ekegusii: “Na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli inabaigwe amang’ana ao. Erio mogende, aye na abagaaka ba Abaisraeli, ase omorwoti o Misiri, momoteebie: Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, natoorokera; na bono twanchere togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erio toruere Omonene oito, ekeng’wanso.

English: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakakusanya majeshi yao yote huko Afeki, nao Waisraeli wakapiga kambi karibu na chemchemi iliyoko Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagasangereria abarwani babo bonsi b'esegi agwo Afeki, na Abaisraeli bagatoora ang'e nensoko yareenge agwo Yesireeli.

English: At that time the LORD said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule Bwana aliniambia, “Chonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza uje kwangu juu mlimani. Pia utengeneze Sanduku la mbao.
Ekegusii: “Erio naende Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia: Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani. Oroisie n’Esanduki ye’chibao chi’emete. Erio otiire goocha aa ase ’nde egetunwa igoro.

English: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini.
Ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ase aya nabateebirie, timochandeka igoro y'obogima bwaino, eki morarie; gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke.

English: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
Kiswahili: nchi ambayo chakula hakitapungua na hamtakosa chochote; nchi ambayo miamba yake ni chuma na mnaweza kuchimba shaba kutoka kwenye vilima.
Ekegusii: Ase ense eyio inamorie endagera enyinge etari kobaerera; aroro timokoremerwa gento kende gionsi. Amagena areo nigo are n’ebioma, naende ’namoremere chitaai korwa ase ebitunwa biaye.

English: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo fanya lile tunalokuambia. Tunao watu wanne hapa ambao wameweka nadhiri.
Ekegusii: Gaki kora ring'ana eri toragoteebie. Mbare aiga ase tore abanto baane abariete eira gete.

English: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don't do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo iambie nyumba ya Israeli, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Si kwa ajili yako, ee nyumba ya Israeli, kwamba ninafanya mambo haya, bali ni kwa ajili ya Jina langu takatifu, ambalo mmelitia unajisi miongoni mwa mataifa mliyoyaendea.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, teebia Abaisraeli ng'a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Inwe Abaisraeli, tingokora ayio ase engencho yaino, korende nase engencho y'erieta riane richenu, erio mwakorire koba eritachenegeti ase egati y'ebisaku ebio ase mwagendete.

English: And from that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return to his father’s house.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia siku ile Sauli akamchukua Daudi naye hakumruhusu kurudi nyumbani kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Korwa rituko riria Saulo akaa Daudi ribaga komenya asare, gose tamotigete airane gochia nka o ise.

English: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote, dumuni katika upendo kwa maana upendo husitiri wingi wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Kobua ase onsi mobe nomokia ase ogwanchana, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bogotuba obonge bw'ebibe.

English: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
Kiswahili: “Enyi Waisraeli, sikilizeni maneno haya nisemayo: Yesu wa Nazareti alikuwa mtu aliyethibitishwa kwenu na Mungu kwa miujiza, maajabu na ishara, ambayo Mungu alitenda miongoni mwenu kupitia kwake, kama ninyi wenyewe mjuavyo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, igwa amang’ana aya, Yeso o Nazareti, omonto o orogetigwe ase more na Nyasae ase ogokora gwe chinguru, na amakumia, na ebikone ebi Nyasae akorete nere egati yaino, buna inwe abanyene momanyete,

English: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father's house, and give me a true sign;
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, tafadhali niapieni kwa Bwana, kwamba mtaitendea hisani jamaa ya baba yangu, kwa kuwa mimi nimewatendea hisani. Nipeni ishara ya uaminifu
Ekegusii: Bono nabasabire, mondiere eira na gotiana ase obosio bw'Omonene ng'a, buna nabakoreire inwe amaya, nainwe mokorere abanto b'enyomba ya tata amaya, na mong'e ekemanyererio kio'bwegenwa.

English: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Simoni akajibu, “Niombeeni kwa Bwana, ili hayo mliyosema lolote yasinitukie.”
Ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria: “Insabera inwe ase Omonene, ng’a amang’ana aya mwakwanire tabaisa gocha konyora nonya nerimo riabo.”

English: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
Kiswahili: Jihadharini msimsahau Bwana Mungu wenu, mkashindwa kushika maagizo yake, sheria na amri zake ambazo ninawapa leo.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene Nyasae oino. Timobaisa gotiga kobwata amachiiko aye, na emeroberio yaye yonsi echiikire, aya ’nkobaa ase rituko ria reero.

English: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu hali akijua kuwa mambo yote yamemalizika, alisema ili kutimiza Maandiko, “Naona kiu.”
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso, kamanyete ng’a onsi aikire gokorwa, erinde ririiko riikeranigwe, akabora, “Ninde nerang’o.”

English: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, ikiwa sisi ni watoto, basi tu warithi, warithi wa Mungu, warithio pamoja na Kristo, naam, tukiteswa pamoja naye tupate pia kutukuzwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Onye tore abana, naboigo tore abanyamwando, abanyamwando ba Nyasae, abaraire omwando amo na Kristo, gatorachandwe amo nere, erinde tonyore obonene amo nere.

English: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
Kiswahili: Azaria akamzaa Helesi, Helesi akamzaa Eleasa,
Ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Helesi, na Helesi akaibora Eleasa;

English: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
Kiswahili: Paulo, Silvano na Timotheo: Kwa kanisa la Wathesalonike, ninyi mlio ndani ya Mungu Baba yetu na ndani ya Bwana Yesu Kristo: Neema iwe kwenu na amani. Shukrani Kwa Ajili Ya Imani Ya Wathesalonike
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo amo na Silivano na Timotheo nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa y’Abatesaloniki, abamore ase Nyasae Tata na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe. Okwegena kw’Abatesaloniki na ekiorokererio kiabo ekiya

English: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wajane wao kuwa wengi kuliko mchanga wa bahari. Wakati wa adhuhuri nitamleta mharabu dhidi ya mama wa vijana wao waume; kwa ghafula nitaleta juu yao maumivu makuu na hofu kuu.
Ekegusii: Abakungu ababoraka batigaire abange mono kobua omokenye o nyancha; narentire abaiti baitire abamura mobaso gati na batigire abang'ina bare bosa; narentire obororo na omoondoko gocha igoro ase bare mobosokano.

English: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
Kiswahili: juu ya Lango la Efraimu, Lango la Yeshana, Lango la Samaki, Mnara wa Hananeli, na Mnara wa Mia, mpaka kwenye Lango la Kondoo. Walipofika kwenye Lango la Ulinzi wakasimama.
Ekegusii: Naende togaetera Egeita gi’Efraimu, na Egeita Egekoro, na Egeita gie Chinswe, na Omorobiri o Hananeli, na Omorobiri bwe Rigana, goika ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi. Togakoorera orogendo rwaito agwo ase Egeita ki’Abarendi.

English: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ataleta sadaka kwa mikono yake mwenyewe iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto; ataleta mafuta ya huyo mnyama pamoja na kidari, naye atainua hicho kidari mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
Ekegusii: Arente namaboko aye omonyene ekeng'wanso kiaye kegosaambwa n'omorero ase 'nde inche Omonene; arente ebitinya amo ne ritaana, ne ritaana erio risungusigwe ribe ekeng'wanso kegosungusigwa ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.

English: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the produce of the land, you are to celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days. There shall be complete rest on the first day and also on the eighth day.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi kuanzia siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, baada ya kuvuna mazao yote ya nchi, mtaadhimisha sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba; siku ya kwanza ni mapumziko, pia siku ya nane ni mapumziko.
Ekegusii: “Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ekero mwakoorire rigesa ri’emegondo yaino, namorende Amatuko Amanene atano na abere ase Omonene. Rituko rie ritang’ani naribe rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, naboigo nase rituko ria gatano na gatato.

English: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Weka mkono wako ndani ya joho lako.” Basi Mose akaweka mkono wake ndani ya joho lake, naye alipoutoa, ulikuwa na ukoma, mweupe kama theluji.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Soyia okoboko kwao eanga yao ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora boigo; na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng'a kwabeire okorabu se ase buna okwo omorwaire bwa ukoma.

English: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD comprehend fully.
Kiswahili: Watu wabaya hawaelewi haki, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana wanaielewa kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibamanyeti ayare amaronge, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene nigo bayamanyete onsi.

English: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati wowote mtu anapomgeukia Bwana, utaji unaondolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omonto akoonchokera Omonene egietubo keria nigo gekorusigwa.

English: “Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem. Look now and take note; search her squares. If you can find a single person, anyone who acts justly, anyone who seeks the truth, then I will forgive the city.
Kiswahili: “Pandeni na kushuka katika mitaa ya Yerusalemu, tazameni pande zote na mtafakari, tafuteni katika viwanja vyake. Kama mtaweza kumpata hata mtu mmoja tu atendaye kwa uaminifu na kutafuta kweli, nitausamehe mji huu.
Ekegusii: Minyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, morigererie na komanya. Moriga‐rigie ase chichiiro morore gose monyore omonto oyomo ogokora oboronge na korigia ekeene, erinde inche Omonene inyare kwabera omochie oyo.

English: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh's cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizi tatu, Farao atakutoa gerezani na kukuweka tena kwenye nafasi yako, nawe utaweka kikombe cha Farao mikononi mwake, kama vile ulivyokuwa unafanya ulipokuwa mnyweshaji wake.
Ekegusii: Magega y'amatuko atato Farao nakorusie aiga, akoe ogosika, akoiranie ase emeremo yao, na aye nobe gokomoa egekombe koboko kwaye, buna kware komoa agwo ritang'ani, ekero kwareenge omoteneneri bw'ebinyugwa biaye.

English: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaokula kutoka kwenye ruzuku za mfalme watajaribu kumwangamiza; jeshi lake litafagiliwa mbali, nao wengi watakufa vitani.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakoria endagera amo nere mbamosirie, na abarwani baye b'esegi mbaserebekane, na abange mbaitwe bakwe.

English: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the youths, a young man lacking judgment,
Kiswahili: Niliona miongoni mwa wajinga, nikagundua miongoni mwa wanaume vijana, kijana asiye na akili.
Ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto batamanyeti amaange, ’nkarora omomura ore ase egati y’abamura bande otabwati chiseemi.

English: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.
Kiswahili: Ukuta huo ulijengwa kwa yaspi hali mji wenyewe ulijengwa kwa dhahabu safi, ikingʼaa kama kioo.
Ekegusii: Na orwaki rwaye nigo rwaagachire namagena a yasipi, na omochie omonyene nigo orenge bw’etaabu engiya, endabu buna ekerore ekerabu.

English: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akaivua pete yake ya muhuri kutoka kidoleni mwake na kuivalisha katika kidole cha Yosefu. Akamvika majoho mazuri ya kitani safi na mkufu wa dhahabu shingoni mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarusia ebonyi yaye ere nekemanyererio korwa ase ekiara kiaye, akamoyebeekera Yusufu kiara kiaye, akamobekera na eanga engiya y'egatani, akamobekera ne chisonoi chi'etaabu igoti riaye.

English: As for the eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it.
Kiswahili: “Jicho lile limdhihakilo baba, lile linalodharau kumtii mama, litangʼolewa na kunguru wa bondeni, litaliwa na tai.
Ekegusii: Eriso ri’omonto ogochecheria ise na gochaaya ng’ina ndirusigwe nebigonkoru bie rigoko na ririegwe namage ye chinsoti.

English: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
Kiswahili: “Ole wake yeye awapaye jirani zake kileo, akiimimina kutoka kwenye kiriba cha mvinyo mpaka wamelewa, ili apate kutazama miili yao iliyo uchi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobw'omonto oria okoa omonto onde ekenyugwa giochoganirie nobosongo kiamotindia, erinde anyare korigereria obogetirianda bwaye.

English: And there was war between the houses of Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of Abijam’s life.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu wakati wote wa maisha ya Abiya.
Ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu ase obogima bwonsi bwa Rehoboamu.

English: For your name's sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, unisamehe uovu wangu, ijapokuwa ni mwingi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ase engencho y'erieta riao onyabere ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nokonene.

English: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be added unto you. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew 6:19–21)
Kiswahili: Bali utafuteni Ufalme wa Mungu, na haya yote atawapa pia. Utajiri Wa Mbinguni (Mathayo 6:19-21)
Ekegusii: Korende rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na ebinto ebio namomenterwe inwe.

English: from the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;
Kiswahili: wa wazao wa Zatu, alikuwa Shekania mwana wa Yahazieli na wanaume 300 pamoja naye;
Ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Satu, Sekania, mosinto o Yahasieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana atato (300);

English: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
Kiswahili: Basi Shetani akatoka mbele za Bwana naye akampiga Ayubu kwa majipu mabaya tangu nyayo za miguu yake hadi utosi wa kichwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase Omonene, akageenda, akarentera Ayubu amagumba, gochakera chimbaratero goikera ase omotwe igoro.

English: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
Kiswahili: Wasibakize chochote hadi asubuhi wala wasivunje mifupa ya mwana-kondoo. Wakati wanapoadhimisha Pasaka, hawana budi kufuata masharti yote.
Ekegusii: Tabaisa gotigaria nonya n’ensinini ye chinyama echio goika rituko ria kabere, gose tabuna riuga nonya nerimo ri’emanwa eria. Narende rituko riria rinene ri’Epasaka koreng’ana nemeroberio eria yachiigetwe.

English: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
Kiswahili: Bwana atawapigania ninyi, nanyi mnatakiwa kutulia tu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene nabarwanere inwe, na inwe mokire‐kiri rioka.”

English: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, ninyi hamjasoma kamwe alivyofanya Daudi wakati yeye na wenzake walikuwa na njaa?
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,

English: “That is a lie!” they said. “Tell us now!” So Jehu answered, “He talked to me about this and that, and he said, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’”
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Hiyo siyo kweli! Tuambie.” Yehu akasema, “Haya ndiyo aliyoniambia: ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: Ninakutia mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.’ ”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaboora: “Ayio tari amaene; totebie bono.” Erio akabateebia: “Ere nigo anteebia ng’a aya nar’Omonene atebiire: Inche nagoakire amaguta obe omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”

English: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
Kiswahili: Huyapanua mapito yangu, ili miguu yangu isiteleze.
Ekegusii: Kwang'eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro ane tagotererigwa.

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his father had done. The Captivity of Jerusalem (Lamentations 1:1–22)
Kiswahili: Akafanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, kama vile baba yake alivyokuwa amefanya.
Ekegusii: Yehoyakini agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana naya onsi ise akorete.

English: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;
Kiswahili: lile alilolifanyia jeshi la Wamisri, farasi na magari yake, jinsi alivyowafurikisha na maji ya Bahari ya Shamu walipokuwa wakiwafuatilia ninyi, na jinsi Bwana alivyowaletea angamizo la kudumu juu yao.
Ekegusii: Inyora naende buna akorete ase abarwani b'esegi ba Misiri, ne'chibarasi chiabo, ne'chigari chiabo, na buna atigete amaache y'Enyancha Embariri akabamera, ekero barenge kobabwatia inwe, na buna basirete tibana kororekana goika reero iga.

English: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
Kiswahili: Yohana aliposikia akiwa gerezani mambo ambayo Kristo alikuwa akiyafanya, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake
Ekegusii: Ekero Yohana achia koigwa aaria ase echela ebitage bia Kristo, agatoma aborokigwa baye komoboria,

English: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it. The Duties of the Priests
Kiswahili: Lakini nitawaweka katika uangalizi wa Hekalu na kazi zote zile zinazotakiwa kufanyika ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende nimbabeeke babe abarendi be Hekalu, babe bagokora emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie aroro. Abakuani

English: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Waisraeli wataishi siku nyingi bila kuwa na mfalme wala mkuu, bila kuwa na dhabihu wala mawe matakatifu, bila kisibau wala sanamu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baragenderere komenya ase amatuko amange batabwati omorwoti gose omogambi, batari korua ebing'wanso, gose gosasiima amagena atenenirie, gose koba negesibao ki'obokuani, gose ebinyasae bibekire ase chinyomba.

English: Don't argue about a matter that doesn't concern you. Don't sit with sinners when they judge.
Kiswahili: Usibishane kuhusu jambo lisilokuhusu. Usiketi pamoja na wenye dhambi wanapohukumu.
Ekegusii: Tiga gwesoia ase abande n'amang'ana atakorengeti; tiga gwesoia ase eriomana ri'abanyabibe.

English: Jeroboam didn't recover strength again in the days of Abijah. Yahweh struck him, and he died.
Kiswahili: Yeroboamu hakupata nguvu tena wakati wa utawala wa Abiya. Naye Bwana akampiga Yeroboamu akafa.
Ekegusii: Yeroboamu tanyorete chinguru chi'okoirania oborwoti bwaye ase amatuko Abiya arenge kogamba, korende Omonene akamoaka erinde agakwa.

English: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Farasi huandaliwa kwa ajili ya siku ya vita, bali ushindi huwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang'e kogeenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.

English: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won't trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.
Kiswahili: Nitaangamiza mifugo yake yote wanaojilisha kando ya maji mengi, hayatavurugwa tena kwa mguu wa mwanadamu wala kwato za mnyama hazitayachafua tena.
Ekegusii: Ning'ite ching'iti chionsi chikorisia mbarabare ase amaache amaange are; amagoro ya Mwanyabaanto, gose ebitaago bie ching'iti, tibikogenderera goturubania amaache ayio biyasarie.

English: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be guardians of the ark.
Kiswahili: Berekia na Elikana walikuwa mabawabu kwa ajili ya Sanduku.
Ekegusii: Berekia na Elikana babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria y’Omonene.

English: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wamekuja kumsikiliza na kuponywa magonjwa yao. Wale waliokuwa wakiteswa na pepo wachafu akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Bagacha koigwa amang'ana aye boigo nakogwenigwa amarwaire abo, na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi'eubi bakagwenigwa.

English: Happy is he who is sheltered from it, who has not passed through its wrath, who has not drawn its yoke, and has not been bound with its bands.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule aliyejificha kutokana nayo, ambaye hakupitia ghadhabu yake, ambaye hakuvuta nira yake, wala hakufungwa kwa vifungo vyake.
Ekegusii: Mbuya ase omonto kogingwa korwa ase oromeme, n'omonto otaragamberwa n'obororo bwaye. Omonto orabogoria richoki rie'chuma ase ebigoti biaye gose, ogosibwa n'echinyororo ase amagoro aye.

English: and next to him, Amasiah son of Zichri, the volunteer for the LORD, and with him 200,000 mighty men of valor.
Kiswahili: aliyefuata ni Amasia mwana wa Zikri, ambaye alijitolea kwa ajili ya kazi ya Bwana, akiwa na askari 200,000.
Ekegusii: na oyo o gatato Amasia, mosinto o Sikiri, oyo bweruete ase ogwancha gokora emeremo y’Omonene; ere nigo abwate abarwani chituoni chilifu amagana abere (200,000).

English: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
Kiswahili: Stefano akajibu, “Ndugu zangu na baba zangu, nisikilizeni! Mungu wa utukufu alimtokea baba yetu Abrahamu, alipokuwa bado yuko Mesopotamia, kabla hajaishi Harani,
Ekegusii: Stefano akairaneria. Abaminto na abatata, ntegerere. Nyasae bw'obonene naorokerete sokoro yaito Aburaamu, ekero arenge ase Mesopotamia, ritang'ani ataramenya Harani,

English: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Ni nini kilichotokea? Niambie.” Akasema, “Watu walikimbia kutoka vitani. Wengi wao walianguka na kufa. Naye Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Amoteebie buna amang'ana agendererete aria.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakuure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakuure.”

English: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.
Kiswahili: Akawagawa wale watu 300 katika makundi matatu, akawakabidhi tarumbeta mikononi mwao wote na mitungi isiyokuwa na maji yenye mienge ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Agaatanana abanto baria baye amagana atato ase ebiombe bitato, akaa kera oyomo egetuureri, na ekeguuru amo n’ekemoreki ki’omorero kere imeo.

English: By this they are known not to be gods. Therefore don't fear them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hili wanajulikana kuwa si miungu. Kwa hivyo msiwaogope.
Ekegusii: Chinyasae echio chikaransete ase chikaru chiabo nigo chire bosa buna enyongo yategete. Amaiso abo nigo aichire ebuse eyio abanto bagwetinyia amagoro ekero bagosoa hekalu ime.

English: They are also to fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given a virgin of Israel a bad name. And she shall remain his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.
Kiswahili: Watamtoza shekeli mia moja za fedha na kupewa wazazi wa msichana, kwa sababu mwanaume huyu amempa bikira wa Kiisraeli jina baya. Ataendelea kuwa mke wake; kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Naende bamonachere aakane, chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta rigana erimo, amoe ise omoiseke oria, ekiagera osaririe erieta ri’omoiseke omwekungi bw’Abaisraeli. Erio oria agenderere koba mokaaye, na omosacha oye tabaisa komotiga nonya ng’ake ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. So he prayed to the LORD, who spoke to him and gave him a sign.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo, Hezekia akaugua, naye akawa karibu kufa. Akamwomba Bwana, ambaye alimjibu na kumpa ishara.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Agasaba Omonene, na ere akamoiraneria ase okomworokia ekemanyererio.

English: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
Kiswahili: Mtu anaweza kutiwa adabu kwa maumivu kitandani mwake, kwa dhiki za mfululizo katika mifupa yake,
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi'okomoorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.

English: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo inatubidi tumchague mtu mwingine miongoni mwa wale ambao wamekuwa pamoja nasi wakati wote Bwana Yesu alipoingia na kutoka katikati yenu,
Ekegusii: Naboigo natonyore oyomo okobwatana naitwe koba kirori ase okobokigwa kw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Ere goika abe korwa ase egati yabaanto barenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,

English: They have ears, but they don't hear. They have noses, but they don't smell.
Kiswahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, zina pua, lakini haziwezi kunusa;
Ekegusii: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.

English: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
Kiswahili: Ningetaka msiwe na masumbufu. Mwanaume ambaye hajaoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana, jinsi ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende nindigetie ng'a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang'ana 'Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:

English: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
Kiswahili: “Laiti kama ungenificha kaburini, na kunisitiri hadi hasira yako ipite! Laiti ungeniwekea wakati, na kisha ukanikumbuka!
Ekegusii: “Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakuure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong'inyora!

English: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mbingu na dunia na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake vitapiga kelele za shangwe juu ya Babeli, kwa kuwa kutoka kaskazini waharabu watamshambulia,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio igoro na ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo, mbitere nomochengo, ekero abasaria bararue sugusu gocha gosaria Babiloni. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: And the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible. Noah Sends a Raven and a Dove
Kiswahili: Maji yakaendelea kupungua hadi mwezi wa kumi, na siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi, vilele vya milima vikaonekana.
Ekegusii: Na amaache akagenderera gokea goika omotienyi o ikomi. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bikarorekana.

English: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa huko, Yesu alibadilika sura mbele yao. Uso wake ukangʼaa kama jua na nguo zake zikawa na weupe wa kuumiza macho.
Ekegusii: Akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare, obosio bwaye bokagirigenta buna erioba, ne chianga chiaye chikaraba buna omobaso.

English: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his commanders, and his officials all surrendered to the king of Babylon. So in the eighth year of his reign, the king of Babylon took him captive.
Kiswahili: Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, mama yake, wahudumu wake, wakuu na maafisa wake wote wakajisalimisha kwa Nebukadneza. Katika mwaka wa nane wa utawala wa mfalme wa Babeli, akamchukua Yehoyakini kuwa mfungwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Yehoyakini, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, akerua ase omorwoti o Babiloni, ere omonyene, na ng’ina, na abasomba baye, na abanene baria bare komokoonya, na abanene b’enyomba yaye. Ase omwaka o gatano na gatato bw’okogaamba kwaye, omorwoti o Babiloni akaira Yehoyakini akamosiba,

English: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakamwambia, “Bwana, kama amelala usingizi ataamka.”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Omonene, onye orarire, nagwene.”

English: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
Kiswahili: Wakafanya agano kumtafuta Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao kwa moyo wao wote na kwa roho yao yote.
Ekegusii: Bagakora okobwatana kw'ogotianania ng'a bamorigie Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, na emioyo yabo yonsi.

English: How can we sing Yahweh's song in a foreign land?
Kiswahili: Tutaimbaje nyimbo za Bwana, tukiwa nchi ya kigeni?
Ekegusii: Naki torakore totere ogoteera kw'Omonene ase ense engeni?

English: The leaders of Shechem set up an ambush against Abimelech on the hilltops, and they robbed all who passed by them on the road. So this was reported to Abimelech.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, kutokana na uadui juu yake watu wa Shekemu wakaweka watu wa kumvizia katika vilele vya milima. Wakawanyangʼanya watu wote waliopita karibu nao, nayo haya yakaarifiwa kwa Abimeleki.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Sekemu bakabeeka abanto ase ebitunwa igoro baboere abanto bonsi barenge goeta ase chinchera chiria na kobaura ebinto biabo. Abimeleki agateebigwa amang’ana ayio.

English: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out his battle lance toward Ai,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Inua huo mkuki ulio mkononi mwako kuuelekeza Ai, kwa kuwa nitautia huo mji mkononi mwako.” Hivyo Yoshua akauelekeza mkuki wake Ai.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Raga ne ritimo riao rire koboko kwao gochia Ai, ekiagera ninkoe omochie oyo ase amaboko ao.” Yoshua akaraga omochie ne ritimo abwate koboko kwaye.

English: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
Kiswahili: nao wageni huja wakininyenyekea, mara wanisikiapo, hunitii.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi nigo bebeegete inse y’ane, na ekero baigure chinkuma chiane, banyigwera.

English: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo nilivyowaona hao farasi na wapanda farasi katika maono yangu: Wapanda farasi walivaa dirii vifuani zenye rangi nyekundu sana kama ya moto na yakuti samawi na kiberiti. Vichwa vya hao farasi vilikuwa kama vichwa vya simba, na moto, moshi na kiberiti vilitoka vinywani mwao.
Ekegusii: Ase okorora kwane naroche chibarasi amo nabwo bachiriinete koba buna iga: Abariini nigo baare ne chingobo chi’ebioma ase ebikuba biabo chire nekieni ki’omorero, na ekemunsi, na ekemonuri. Chibarasi nigo chiarenge nemetwe enga buna eye chindo, na korwa ase emenwa yabo bikarua omorero, na erioki, na ekebiriti.

English: Joakim the high priest, who was in those days at Jerusalem, wrote to those who lived in Bethulia and Betomesthaim, which is opposite Esdraelon toward the plain that is near to Dothaim,
Kiswahili: Kuhani mkuu Yoakimu, aliyekuwa Yerusalemu siku hizo, aliwaandikia wale walioishi Bethulia na Betomesthaimu, iliyo mkabala na Esdraeloni kuelekea uwanda ulio karibu na Dothaimu,
Ekegusii: Omokuani omonene Yohakimu oyoreenge ase omochie omonene o Yerusalemu ase chingaki echio, akabariikera abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Bethulia na Betomesthaimu, ang'e ne Esdreloni ase ense omweya ere ang'e nomochie o Dothaimu.

English: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
Kiswahili: Hao malaika walipokwisha kuondoka na kwenda zao mbinguni, wale wachungaji wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Twendeni Bethlehemu tukaone mambo haya ya ajabu yaliyotukia, ambayo Bwana ametuambia habari zake.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagateebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”

English: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye busara huona hatari na kujificha, bali mjinga huendelea mbele kama kipofu nayo ikamtesa.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong'aini nigo akororera emechando korwa aare, bwebisa, korende oy'otamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio, oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.

English: For when the people were counted, none of the residents of Jabesh-gilead were there.
Kiswahili: Walipohesabu waliona hakuna mtu yeyote wa Yabeshi-Gileadi aliyekuwepo.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baare koroberigwa na goitaagwa, bakanyoora ng’a onde taacheteo nonya n’oyomo korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi,

English: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
Kiswahili: Alipomwona Yesu akipita, akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Akarigereria Yeso ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”

English: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
Kiswahili: Hili lilitokea ili ule ukatili waliotendewa hao wana sabini wa Yerub-Baali upatilizwe, na damu yao iwe juu ya Abimeleki ndugu yao aliyewaua, na pia iwe juu ya watu wa Shekemu, ambao walimsaidia kuua ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n’ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y’Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y’ abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi’ogokora ayio.

English: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God's Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupanga siku ya kuonana naye, watu wengi wakaja kuanzia asubuhi hadi jioni akawaeleza na kutangaza kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu akijaribu kuwahadithia juu ya Yesu kutoka Sheria ya Mose na kutoka Manabii.
Ekegusii: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabateebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang'ana igoro y'oborwoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobateebereria amang'ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang'ana 'amachiiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.

English: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wameshangaa na kufadhaika wakaulizana, “Ni nini maana ya mambo haya?”
Ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagaichana na koborania: “Amang'ana aya, engencho yaye ninki?”

English: So this man also died like this, leaving his death for an example of nobleness and a memorial of virtue, not only to the young but also to the great body of his nation.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo mtu huyu pia alikufa hivi, akiacha kifo chake kama mfano wa utukufu na ukumbusho wa wema, si kwa vijana tu bali pia kwa kundi kubwa la taifa lake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Eliazari agakwa. Korende ogokwa kwaye kw'oboremu gokaba gokainyorwa buna egento ki'engencho ase ense yonsi.

English: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari usijiwekee wazo hili ovu: “Mwaka wa saba, mwaka wa kufuta madeni umekaribia,” usije ukaonyesha nia mbaya kwa ndugu yako mhitaji na ukaacha kumpa chochote. Anaweza kumlalamikia Bwana dhidi yako nawe utakuwa umepatikana na hatia ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Mwerende mono, timobaisa kwanga koa omotaka oyio egento na goteeba: Omwaka bw'okwabera chisiira obeire ang'e. Timobia ebirengererio ebibe buna ebio ribaga ase chinkoro chiaino. Onye mokoba abang'iti na kwanga koa oyomino ore omotaka egento, ere narere ase Omonene, ekiagera mwamorinire eki aremeire, nainwe 'namobe n'ebibe.

English: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwanaume hakutoka kwa mwanamke, bali mwanamke alitoka kwa mwanaume.
Ekegusii: (Naki omosacha tarwete ase omokungu, korende nomokuungu orwete ase omosacha.

English: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere Omonene bw'Esabato.”

English: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
Kiswahili: Ni vizuri wakati wote kuwa na shauku kwa ajili ya kusudi zuri, si wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi tu.
Ekegusii: Korende mbuya botambe korigia omokia ase ring'ana rire rigiya, na tari ekero inde amo nainwe rioka.

English: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Micaiah daughter of Uriel; she was from Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
Kiswahili: naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu miaka mitatu. Mama yake aliitwa Maaka, binti Urieli wa Gibea. Basi kulikuwa na vita kati ya Abiya na Yeroboamu.
Ekegusii: Akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Mikaya, mosubati o Urieli, korwa Gibea. Esegi yarenge gati y’Abiya na Yeroboamu.

English: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
Kiswahili: Furahini katika Bwana, ninyi mlio wenye haki, lisifuni jina lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Nyasae, moake ng'a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

English: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,
Kiswahili: Mnasimama hapa ili kufanya Agano na Bwana Mungu wenu, Agano ambalo Mungu analifanya nanyi siku hii ya leo na kulitia muhuri kwa kiapo,
Ekegusii: Na boono ’monyaare gosoa ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agokora amo nainwe rituko ria reero,

English: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
Kiswahili: “Wale watu wanaongʼangʼana na sanamu zisizofaa hupoteza neema ile ambayo ingekuwa yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagosasiima emegwekano eyio ere bosa barabwo batigire oboigweri gocha ase ore.

English: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza meza kumi na kuziweka hekaluni, tano upande wa kusini na tano upande wa kaskazini. Pia akatengeneza mabakuli 100 ya dhahabu ya kunyunyizia.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chimesa ikomi, agachibeka ime ase Hekalu isano ensemo ya borio, na isano ensemo ya bomosi; akaroisia ne chisani rigana erimo korwa ase chitaabu.

English: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb, but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow.
Kiswahili: Lakini waweza ukatoa ngʼombe au kondoo mwenye kilema au aliyedumaa kama sadaka ya hiari, lakini hii haitakubalika kuwa sadaka ya kutimiza nadhiri.
Ekegusii: Eeri gose emaanwa y’eng’ondi ebwate ekiimo egetambe goetania ekende, gose ekieng’e mono, nabo oranyare koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogwancha, korende ase okoyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogoikerania eira kwariete, tegwancherwa nainche.

English: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
Kiswahili: Siku za maafa hawatanyauka, siku za njaa watafurahia wingi wa vitu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.

English: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
Kiswahili: Haya ni maneno ya mwisho ya Daudi: “Neno la Daudi mwana wa Yese, neno la mtu aliyeinuliwa na Aliye Juu Sana, mtu aliyepakwa mafuta na Mungu wa Yakobo, mwimbaji wa nyimbo wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang'ana y'omoerio a Daudi, mosinto o Yese, omonto oyo oimokereretigwe igoro, omoakwa amaguta o Nyasae o Yakobo, omoteri bw'amatera agwansa ase Abaisraeli:

English: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
Kiswahili: Bwana alimwapia Daudi kiapo, kiapo cha uhakika ambacho hatakitangua: “Nitamweka mmoja wa wazao wako mwenyewe katika kiti chako cha enzi,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tokonyaara gotiga eira eyio kwarierete Daudi ase ogotiana, ogateeba: “Oyomo bw'oroiboro rwao nimobeeke aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki'obogaambi.

English: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio viongozi wa jamaa pamoja na wale walioandikwa ambao walikuja pamoja nami kutoka Babeli wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Artashasta:
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babiloni, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:

English: Anna ran to him, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, “I have seen you, my child! I am ready to die.” They both wept.
Kiswahili: Anna alimkimbilia, akaanguka shingoni mwa mwanawe, akamwambia, "Nimekuona, mwanangu! Niko tayari kufa." Wote wawili walilia.
Ekegusii: Ana akaminyokera omwana oye akamoboania akamonyunyuta akamoteebia, Bono ase engencho nakororire kore moyo naende omwana one nabo ngokwa, erio akaiyeria amariga y'omogooko.

English: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

English: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings. Run Your Race to Win
Kiswahili: Nafanya haya yote kwa ajili ya Injili, ili nipate kushiriki baraka zake.
Ekegusii: Na inche nigo ngokora aya onsi ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde inyare koba oyomo obo bw’abakonyora ogosesenigwa kwaye. Omokia ogwenerete ase obobui

English: From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
Kiswahili: Tangu nyakati za zamani hakuna yeyote aliyesikia, hakuna sikio lililotambua, hakuna jicho lililomwona Mungu mwingine ila wewe, anayetenda mambo kwa ajili ya wale wamngojeao.
Ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a kare onde tana koigwa nogoto kwaye, gose korora neriso riaye, Nyasae onga buna aye ogokorera abwo bagosemeretie amaya.

English: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda shambani akiwa katika sura nyingine.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.

English: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa watu wa jumuiya watafumba macho wakati mtu huyo anapomtoa mmoja wa watoto wake kwa mungu Moleki, nao wakaacha kumuua,
Ekegusii: Onye abanto b’ense yaino bakoombia, tibaita omonto oyio orure oyomo bw’abana baye ase enyasae Moleki,

English: He roams the mountains for pasture, searching for any green thing.
Kiswahili: Huzunguka vilimani kwa ajili ya malisho na kutafuta kila kitu kibichi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.

English: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Simoni Petro akajibu, “Usininawishe miguu peke yake, Bwana, bali pamoja na mikono na kichwa pia!”
Ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”

English: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mlichukua fedha na dhahabu yangu pia mkabeba hazina zangu nzuri sana mkapeleka kwenye mahekalu yenu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitaabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chikalu chiaino.

English: The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameyakasirikia mataifa yote; ghadhabu yake ni juu ya majeshi yao yote. Atawaangamiza kabisa, atawatia mikononi mwa wachinjaji.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu enene ase ebisaku bionsi, na obeire nekeririanda ase emeganda yabo yonsi y’esegi; obanacheire ekiina gi’okobasiria, obarure baitwe.

English: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master's son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master's son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
Kiswahili: Wewe, wanao na watumishi wako mtamlimia mashamba Mefiboshethi na kumletea mavuno, ili kwamba mwana wa bwana wako apate mahitaji yake. Naye Mefiboshethi mwana wa bwana wako atakula chakula mezani pangu daima.” (Siba alikuwa na wana kumi na watano, na watumishi ishirini.)
Ekegusii: Aye, amo n'abana bao na abasomba bao 'mobe mokomoremera emegondo. Norentere omoochokoro bw'omonene oo okwama korwa mogondo, erinde anyore endagera, korende Mefiboseti omonyene, omoochokoro bw'omonene oo, nigo arabe okoragera ase emesa y'ane botambe.” Siba nigo abwate abamura ikomi na batano na abasomba emerongo ebere.

English: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
Kiswahili: Ninajua tena nimehakikishiwa sana katika Bwana Yesu kwamba hakuna kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa asili yake. Lakini kama mtu anakiona kitu kuwa ni najisi, basi kwake huyo kitu hicho ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng'a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng'a negento ekebe.

English: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
Kiswahili: Je, barafu ya Lebanoni iliwahi kutoweka kwenye miteremko yake ya mawe wakati wowote? Je, maji yake baridi yatokayo katika vyanzo vilivyo mbali yaliwahi kukoma kutiririka wakati wowote?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amagena 'embura a Lebanoni ana koruao atige ebitare bia igoro? Gose ebirooche bikorwa ase ebitare biana koborwa amaache amakendu?

English: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Thanksgiving (Philippians 1:3–11; Colossians 1:3–14)
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Shukrani
Ekegusii: Obuya na omorembe bibe ase more, ebio bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa ase Kristo

English: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
Kiswahili: Nuru ya mwenye haki hungʼaa sana, bali taa ya mwovu itazimwa.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bw'abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka n'omogooko, korende etaya y'abakori amabe nigo enga ekebeya gekorima.

English: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Mungu katika patakatifu pake, msifuni katika mbingu zake kuu.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Nyasae agwo ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, motogie agwo igoro eyio yatongetwe ase okobua kwaye!

English: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na chapeo ya shaba kichwani mwake, na alivaa dirii ya shaba kifuani mwake yenye uzito wa shekeli elfu tano.
Ekegusii: Nigo abegete ekegogwa gi'etai na egoti yaroisirie korwa ase ebioma, na oborito bw'egoti eyio nigo bwareenge koreng'ana chikiro emerongo etano, na isano na ibere (57).

English: I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.
Kiswahili: Nitakomesha furaha na macheko yake yote: sikukuu zake za mwaka, sikukuu za Miandamo ya Mwezi, siku zake za Sabato, sikukuu zake zote zilizoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie kegima omogooko oye bwonsi, na Amatuko aye Amanene ay’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato chiaye, na emeyega yaye echiikire.

English: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yuda akaja bustanini. Aliongoza kikosi cha askari wa Kirumi, na baadhi ya maafisa kutoka kwa viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo. Nao walikuwa wamechukua taa, mienge na silaha.
Ekegusii: Nabo Yudasi gaikire konyora omoganda bw’abarwani, na abarendi baruete ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, akagenda aroro ne chitaaya na ebieri, na ebinto bi’esegi.

English: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Filipo, nimekaa nanyi muda huu wote hata usinijue? Mtu yeyote aliyeniona mimi, amemwona Baba. Sasa wawezaje kusema, ‘Tuonyeshe Baba’?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Nabeire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi, na aye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, ororire na Tata; naki aye ogoteeba: Tworokie Tata?

English: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.'”
Kiswahili: Zamani, wakati Sauli alikuwa mfalme juu yetu, wewe ndiwe uliyeiongoza Israeli vitani. Naye Bwana alikuambia, ‘Wewe utawachunga watu wangu Israeli, na utakuwa mtawala wao.' ”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, ekero Saulo arenge omorwoti oito, naye kwareenge gotang'ana Abaisraeli kobakogeenda korwana esegi, naende kobakoirana. Omonene konya ogoteebirie ng'a naye orabe omorisia bw'Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na obe omogambi obo.”

English: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul's house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi alipokuwa anakaribia Bahurimu, mtu mmoja kutoka ukoo huo huo kama jamaa ya Sauli, akatoka humo, ambaye jina lake ni Shimei mwana wa Gera; akawa analaani alipokuwa akitoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Daudi aigete Bahurimu, omonto bw'eamate ya Saulo ore korokwa Simei, mosinto o Gera, agasoka korwa ase omochie. Ere kagoocha akana‐koragereria Daudi.

English: Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put served as warriors in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls; they gave you splendor.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watu wa Uajemi, Ludi na Putu walikuwa askari katika jeshi lako. Walitundika ngao zao na chapeo zao kwenye kuta zako, wakileta fahari yako.
Ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Ayemi, na Ludi na Puti, nigo barenge abarwani bao b’esegi. Nigo basungete chinguba chiabo na ebigogwa biabo bi’ebioma ase chinyasi chiao. Barabwo nigo bakorenterete obonene.

English: This also comes out from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
Kiswahili: Haya yote pia hutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, mwenye mashauri ya ajabu, na anayepita wote kwa hekima.
Ekegusii: Amorokererio ayio nigo akorwa ase Omonene bw'Emeganda; ere nigo are omosemia bw'ogokumia, na obong'aini bwaye nobonene mono.

English: He must increase; I must decrease.
Kiswahili: Yeye hana budi kuwa mkuu zaidi na mimi nizidi kuwa mdogo.” Yeye Aliyetoka Mbinguni
Ekegusii: Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee. Oyochire korwa igoro

English: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mwaminini Mungu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Mobe nokwegena ase Nyasae.

English: And Bugathan, one of the chamberlains, said to the king, “Behold, Haman has also prepared a gallows for Mordecai, who spoke concerning the king, and a fifty cubit high gallows has been set up on Haman's property.” The king said, “Let him be hanged on it!”
Kiswahili: Bugathani, mmoja wa wasimamizi wa nyumba, akamwambia mfalme, “Tazama, Hamani pia ameandaa mti wa kunyongea kwa ajili ya Mordekai, aliyesema habari za mfalme, na mti wa dhiraa hamsini umesimamishwa juu ya shamba la Hamani.” Mfalme akasema, “Na aangikwe juu yake!”
Ekegusii: Haribona, oyomo bw'abasoomba abaare gokorera omorwoti, akabora, “Rora orobambo rore rw'obotambe bw'amaboko emerongo etano, roria Hamani asimiseretie Modekai, oyo ogotooretie aye omorwoti, nao rore ang'e nenyomba ya Hamani.” Agwo omorwoti agachiika, “Gachie motonge Hamani ase orobambo roria igoro.”

English: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya unayafanya, nami nimekaa kimya, ukafikiri Mimi nami ni kama wewe. Lakini nitakukemea na kuweka mashtaka mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Kwabeire gokona‐gokora ayio, nainche nkirete‐kiri, nigo okagete ng'a inche nigo inde buna aye. Korende bono nkogotogonyera nde na kobeka ayio ase obosio bwao.

English: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn't there a prophet of Yahweh here, that we may inquire of Yahweh by him?” One of the king of Israel's servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yehoshafati akauliza, “Je, hayuko nabii wa Bwana hapa, ili tuweze kumuuliza Bwana kupitia kwake?” Afisa mmoja wa mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, “Elisha mwana wa Shafati yuko hapa. Ndiye alikuwa akimimina maji juu ya mikono ya Eliya.”
Ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti Yehosafati akabooria, “Inee! Omobani bw'Omonene tari aa toranyare kobori'Omonene goetera asare?” Omosomba oyomo bw'omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli akairaneria, “Elisha, mosinto o Safati, nao are aiga, oria oreenge omokoreri bw'Elija.”

English: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
Kiswahili: kutokana na waovu wanaonishambulia, kutokana na adui wauaji wanaonizunguka.
Ekegusii: mbise korwa ase abakori amabe, abarigetie gonsiria, korwa ase ababisa bang’etanaine bang’ite.

English: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
Kiswahili: Mtu apendaye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali aambatanaye na makahaba hutapanya mali yake.
Ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete obong’aini nigo akomogokia ise, korende oyogotaara amo nabakungu abatayayi nigo agosiria chinibo chiaye.

English: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. Then there will be equality.
Kiswahili: Kwa wakati huu, wingi wa vitu mlivyo navyo usaidie kutosheleza mahitaji yao, ili wakati wao watakapokuwa na wingi wa vitu, nao wapate kutosheleza mahitaji yenu.
Ekegusii: Ekero eke kia bono obonge bwaino bobakonye ase okoremerwa kwabo; ekero kende obonge bwabo bobakonye inwe ase okoremerwa kwaino; erio amang’ana abe areng’aine. Esemba engencho yaye omogisangio

English: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
Kiswahili: mateso na taabu, yaani mambo yote yaliyonipata huko Antiokia, Ikonio na Listra, mateso yote niliyostahimili, lakini Bwana aliniokoa katika hayo yote.
Ekegusii: na ogochaandwa kw'ane, na ogochaandeka kw'ane, okwo nanyorete ase Antiokia na Ikonio, na Listra. Nogochaandwa kore inaki naremereretie! Na korwa ase ayio onsi Omonene agantooria.

English: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa jamaa ya ukoo wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, waliokuwa wametoka katika koo za wazao wa Yosefu, walikuja na kuzungumza mbele ya Mose na viongozi, wakuu wa jamaa ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Erio abanene b’egesaku kia Gileadi mosinto o Makiri mosinto o Manase abwo barenge korwa ase chinyomba chie egesaku kia Yusufu bagaacha na gokwana ase obosio bwa Musa, boigo ase abarai amo na abateneneri b’echinyomba chia Abaisraeli.

English: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes. Triumph in Christ
Kiswahili: ili Shetani asitushinde. Kwa maana hatuachi kuzijua hila zake. Wasiwasi Wa Paulo Huko Troa
Ekegusii: Saitani tabaisa gotobua; naki intwe titokomocha komanya obong’ainereria bwaye. Okogania gwa Paulo kogenda Troasi

English: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliwafanya watu wake kuzaana sana, akawafanya kuwa wengi sana kuliko adui zao,
Ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia abanto abwo bakabucha mono, naende bakaba ne chinguru chinyinge kobua abachandi babo.

English: Then Saul ordered his servants, “Speak to David privately and tell him, ‘Behold, the king is pleased with you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore, become his son-in-law.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akawaagiza watumishi wake, akisema, “Zungumzeni na Daudi kwa siri na kumwambia, ‘Tazama, mfalme amependezwa nawe, nao watumishi wake wote wanakupenda. Basi na uwe mkwewe mfalme.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agachiika abasomba baye, akabora, “Kwana na Daudi bobisi, momoteebie ng’a inche omorwoti nigo ngokirie nere, na abasomba baane bonsi nigo bamwanchete. Ase ayio bono momoteebie ng’a inche imbe ise biara.”

English: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nilikusudia moyoni mwangu nisifanye ziara nyingine yenye kuwaumiza ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende nkarengereria ase omoyo one, ng’a tingocha seino naende ase okobaichania.

English: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
Kiswahili: na mikufu miwili ya dhahabu safi iliyosokotwa kama kamba, na uifunge mikufu hiyo kwenye vijalizo.
Ekegusii: na okore ebichanga bibere bie chitaabu chichenire, bisisire buna engori, bibwatanigwe nebikonde biria.

English: For though their princes are at Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,
Kiswahili: Ingawa wana maafisa katika Soani na wajumbe wamewasili katika Hanesi,
Ekegusii: Nonya abagaambi baino bare ase omochie o Soani, na abatomirwe baikire ase omochie o Hanesi,

English: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Solomoni akaenda Hamath-Soba na kuuteka.
Ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akagenda koira orogongo rwa Hamati na Soba,

English: The rest of the Jews who were in the kingdom assembled, and helped one another, and obtained rest from their enemies; for they destroyed fifteen thousand of them on the thirteenth day of Adar, but took no spoil.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wengine waliokuwa katika ufalme walikusanyika, wakasaidiana, wakapata raha kutoka kwa adui zao; kwa kuwa waliwaangamiza watu elfu kumi na tano kati yao siku ya kumi na tatu ya mwezi wa Adari, lakini hawakuchukua nyara.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi abarenge Susa bagasangerereka amo naende, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, omotienyi bw'Adari, bagaita abanto amagana atato aroro, korende tibakunete ebinto biabo kobisakora.

English: And Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akafanya mapatano ya amani pamoja nao kuwaacha waishi, nao viongozi wa kusanyiko wakathibitisha kwa kiapo.
Ekegusii: Yoshua agakora omorembe na kobwatana nabarabwo, akabaa ribaga babe moyo na komenyao. Abatang’ani b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli bagancherana nokobwatana okwo ase ogotiana.

English: “Therefore we said, ‘Let's now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo sababu tulisema, ‘Tujiweke tayari na tujenge madhabahu, lakini si kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa au dhabihu.'
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo twateebete: Tiga toagache egesasiimero, tari ase okoruera ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa gose ekeng'wanso kende gionsi,

English: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock.
Kiswahili: Ada akamzaa Yabali ambaye ni baba wa wale walioishi katika mahema na kufuga wanyama.
Ekegusii: Ada akaibora Yabeli; oyo nere sokoro y’abare komenya ase ebigutu na babwate ching’iti chigotugwa.

English: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Ikiwa kama taifa moja wanaozungumza lugha moja wameanza kufanya hili, basi hakuna lolote watakalopanga kufanya ambalo halitawezekana kwao.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Rora, abanto aba negesaku ekemo, na bagokwana omonwa oyomo bonsi na amang'ana abwekaine. Na bono rora, aya naro bachakire gokora, eyio ekworokia ng'a magega y'ayio tibagosinywa gento kende gionsi baraarengererie gokora.

English: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawajibu, “Chakula changu ni kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu ambaye amenituma na kuikamilisha kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Endagera yaane neye: ogokora ogwancha kwaye oyontomete na goikerania emeremo yaye.

English: “If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote anayekuja kwangu hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu kama hatanipenda mimi zaidi ya baba yake na mama yake, mke wake na watoto wake, ndugu zake na dada zake, naam, hata maisha yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kagocha ase ’nde, nere atagecheti ise na ng’ina, na mokaye, na abana baye, na abamura bamwabo, na abasubati bamwabo, ee, nonya nobogima bwaye, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.

English: Don't be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
Kiswahili: Usiwe mwenye haki kupita kiasi, wala usiwe na hekima kupita kiasi: kwa nini kujiangamiza mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omooronge goetania, gose koba omong'aini goetania. Nase ki ogwesiria aye omonyene?

English: I will destroy her vines and fig trees, which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers. So I will make them into a thicket, and the beasts of the field will devour them.
Kiswahili: Nitaiharibu mizabibu yake na mitini yake, ambayo alisema yalikuwa malipo yake kutoka kwa wapenzi wake; nitaifanya kuwa kichaka, nao wanyama pori wataila.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie emesabibu yaye, na emeko yaye, ebio akwanete igoro yabo, agateeba ng’a eyio nero eng’eria yaye abanchi baye bamoete. Inche ninsirie emete eyio ebe orosana, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiyerie.

English: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
Kiswahili: wale majemadari wakaona kwamba hakuwa mfalme wa Israeli, nao wakaacha kumfuatilia.
Ekegusii: Na ekero abateneneri be chigari baroche ng'a ere tarenge omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, bakaonchoka, bagatiga komobwatia.

English: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata hivyo watu wakaendelea kutoa dhabihu mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, lakini wakimtolea Bwana Mungu wao peke yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakagenderera korua ebing'wanso agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, korende nigo babiruete ase Omonene, Nyasae obo bweka.

English: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Wazao wengine waliobaki wa Wakohathi walipewa miji kumi kutoka koo za makabila ya Efraimu, Dani na nusu ya Manase.
Ekegusii: Na Abakohati abatigarete bakanyora emechie ikomi korwa ase chiamate chi'egesaku ki'Efraimu na ekia Dani, na ekeng'ese kia Manase, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: Don't turn your eye away from one who asks. Give no occasion to a man to curse you.
Kiswahili: Usimgeuzie macho mtu anayekuomba. Usimpe mtu nafasi ya kulaani.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwebacha kororana n'omonto omotaka, ekiagera nigo oramoe ribaga riogokoragereria.

English: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, hekaluni mwako tunatafakari upendo wako usiokoma.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y'obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

English: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
Kiswahili: Bwana anachukia sana mawe ya kupimia ya udanganyifu, nazo mizani zisizo halali hazimpendezi.
Ekegusii: Ebirengo bi'oborito bire ara kabere nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, na ekerengero kioboriania nigo kere ekebe.

English: leaving to the historian the exact handling of every particular, and again having no strength to fill in the outlines of our abridgement.
Kiswahili: kumwachia mwanahistoria jinsi ya kushughulikia kila jambo, na tena akiwa hana nguvu ya kujaza muhtasari wa muhtasari wetu.
Ekegusii: Ngotema inde mono sana tindika amang'ana amange; emeremo eyio namotigeire oria otongete ense ritangani. Inche nigo ntagete korika ase obweng'e aria akoregete.

English: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and tell Gog that this is what the Lord GOD says: On that day when My people Israel are dwelling securely, will you not take notice of this?
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, mwanadamu, tabiri na umwambie Gogu: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Katika siku ile, watu wangu Israeli watakapokuwa wanaishi salama, Je, wewe mwenyewe hutalijua hilo?
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye Mwanyabaanto, bana oteebie Gogi ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli, abanto bane, mbabe bamenyete ase obotoereru, nario oramanye amang’ana ayio.

English: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land. The Jebusites said to David: “You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.” For they thought, “David cannot get in here.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme na watu wake wakaenda Yerusalemu kuwashambulia Wayebusi walioishi humo. Wayebusi wakamwambia Daudi, “Wewe hutaingia humu, kwani hata vipofu na viwete wanaweza kukufukuza.” Walidhani, “Daudi hawezi kuingia humu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti na abanto baye bakageenda Yerusalemu, erinde barwanie Abayebusi, abanyene ense eria. Barabwo bagateebia Daudi. “Aye tokonyaara goocha aiga nonya ng’ake; emeuko na ebirema nabwo baranyare kogoseria kegima.” Abayebusi nigo barengereretie ng’a Daudi takonyaara gosoa aroro.

English: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
Kiswahili: vilevile malisho ya mifugo yenu na wanyama pori katika nchi yenu. Chochote nchi itakachozalisha kinaweza kuliwa.
Ekegusii: Boigo ching'iti chitugire, ne ching'iti chi'orosana chire ase ense eyio nachirie okwama okwo kwemeretie.

English: So is the eunuch which has done no lawless deed with his hands, nor imagined wicked things against the Lord; for a precious gift will be given to him for his faithfulness, and a delightful inheritance in the Lord's sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Ndivyo alivyo towashi ambaye hakufanya kosa lolote kwa mikono yake, wala hakufikiria mambo mabaya dhidi ya Bwana; kwa maana atapewa zawadi ya thamani kwa ajili ya uaminifu wake, na urithi mzuri katika patakatifu pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Boigo nasesenirie omosacha osaririe obosacha bwaye ekiagera ere nache kogoka onye tanya gosaria ogochika kw'Omonene. Ekiagera ere ebeete omwegenwa, nanyore ekeegwa ekiya mono ki'obogima bwa kare na kare gwetania konyora abana.

English: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.
Kiswahili: “Katika wakati huo Mikaeli, mtawala mkuu ambaye huwalinda watu wako, atainuka. Kutakuwako wakati wa taabu ambao haujatokea tangu mwanzo wa mataifa hadi wakati huo. Lakini wakati huo, watu wako, kila mmoja ambaye jina lake litakutwa limeandikwa kwenye kitabu, ataokolewa.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio Mikaeli, omogambi oria omonene naoroke, atenenere abanto bao. Erio n'ebe engaki y'emechando emenene mono, eye etana koba rinde korwa ekero egesaku kia Mwanyabaanto giachaagete kobao goika ase engaki eyio. Korende ase engaki eyio, abanto bao mbatoorigwe, kera oyomo oyio erieta riaye riranyorekane ririikire ase egetabu eria.

English: Those in Judea who had driven Judas into exile thronged to Nicanor in flocks, supposing that the misfortunes and calamities of the Jews would be successes to themselves.
