Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa Yudea waliompeleka Yuda uhamishoni walikusanyika kwa Nikanori katika makundi, wakidhani kwamba misiba na maafa ya Wayahudi yangekuwa mafanikio kwao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b'ebisaku aria Yudea, abwo konya batamire korwa ase Yuda bagacha amo bakabwatana n'abanrwani esegi ba Nikanori, bakagerete buna obobe n'emechando eyio Abayahudi banyorete nigo ekoba okonyora ase bare.

English: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God's ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Sadoki na Abiathari wakarudisha Sanduku la Mungu mpaka Yerusalemu na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Zadoki na Abiatari bakabogoria Esanduki ya Nyasae; bakayeirania Yerusalemu, nabarabwo bakabeera aroro.

English: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.
Kiswahili: Haki yangu inakaribia mbio, wokovu wangu unakuja, nao mkono wangu utaleta hukumu kwa mataifa. Visiwa vitanitegemea na kungojea mkono wangu kwa matumaini.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwane nigo bore ang'e, ogotooreka kwane ngocha kore, amaboko aane nagambie abanto bonsi ekiina kia boronge; abanto bamenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang'e nenyancha nigo bang'anyete, basemerie okoboko kwane.

English: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers' households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa jamaa miongoni mwa wazao wa Lawi hadi wakati wa Yohanani mwana wa Eliashibu waliandikishwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw'Abalawi abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo okarikwa ase Egetabu ki'amang'ana 'Ebiro goikera ase amatuko a Yohanani, mosinto bw'Eliasibu.

English: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo atafanikiwa maishani mwake, nao wazao wake watairithi nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagenderere gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.

English: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
Kiswahili: Hawakuelewa kuwa alikuwa akiwaambia juu ya Baba yake wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana ase bare aya Ise.

English: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
Kiswahili: Petro alipoona watu wamekusanyika akawaambia, “Enyi Waisraeli, kwa nini mnastaajabu kuhusu jambo hili? Mbona mnatukazia macho kwa mshangao kana kwamba ni kwa uwezo wetu au utakatifu wetu tumemfanya mtu huyu kutembea?
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero arora aya akaboria abanto: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, inki mogokumeria aya gose nase ki inwe mogotobeta amaiso, ng'a buna intwe ase chinguru chiaito abanyene, gose ase obuya bwaito, twamokora oyo ogenda?

English: Jehoiada took for himself two wives, and he had sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Yehoyada akamwoza wake wawili, akazaa watoto wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Yehoyada akamonyuomeria abakungu babere, na barabwo bakamoiborera abana, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
Kiswahili: Je, sina haki yangu kufanya kile nitakacho na mali yangu mwenyewe? Au unaona wivu kwa kuwa nimekuwa mkarimu?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene n’ebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?

English: And now, would you turn away from the LORD? If you rebel today against the LORD, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
Kiswahili: Je, sasa ndiyo mnamwacha Bwana? “ ‘Kama mkimwasi Bwana leo, kesho atalikasirikia kusanyiko lote la Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inee! Na bono inwe motagete gotiga Omonene? Onye mokwanga reero koigwera Omonene, ekeene, ankio nigo arabe nekeririanda ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli.

English: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line all the way to Shiloh, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile mtu mmoja wa kabila la Benyamini akakimbia kutoka kwenye uwanja wa vita na kwenda Shilo, nguo zake zikiwa zimeraruka na akiwa na mavumbi kichwani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’egesaku kia Benjamini agatama korwa ase esegi, akaminyoka gochia Silo, agaikao rituko erio erio, ore ne chianga chiatandoire, na obegete ebuse ase omotwe oye.

English: The waters receded steadily from the earth, and after 150 days the waters had gone down.
Kiswahili: Maji yakaendelea kupungua taratibu katika nchi. Kunako mwisho wa siku ya 150, maji yalikuwa yamepungua,
Ekegusii: na amaache akana gokeea ng’ora ng’ora korwa ase ense, na ekero amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150) aerete, amaache aria agakea.

English: One of you will say to me, “Then why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”
Kiswahili: Basi mtaniambia, “Kama ni hivyo, kwa nini basi bado Mungu anatulaumu? Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kupinga mapenzi yake?”
Ekegusii: Aande gose nonteebie, “Nase ki nonya mbono Nyasae akonyora okomocha ase Mwanyabaanto? Inaki ning’o oranyare koamereria okorigia kwaye?”

English: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.
Kiswahili: Makosa yangu yatafungiwa kwa lakiri kwenye mfuko, nawe utazifunika dhambi zangu.
Ekegusii: Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.

English: He shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
Kiswahili: Naye atauinua huo mganda mbele za Bwana ili ukubaliwe kwa niaba yenu; kuhani ataupunga siku inayofuata Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rigotunyana eri'Esabato Omokuani asungusie riboa erio ase obosio bwane, erio monyore ogwancherwa.

English: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.
Kiswahili: Makuhani: wazao wa Yedaya (kwa jamaa ya Yeshua) 973
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw'abakuani bairanete korwa obosomba: Abwo b'ororeria rwa Yedaya be chiamate chia Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);

English: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
Kiswahili: Furaha ya matoazi imekoma, kelele za wenye furaha zimekoma, shangwe za kinubi zimenyamaza.
Ekegusii: Omogoko bw’eriogi rie chinchigiri oerire, na eriogi ri’abwo bagochenga riaerire, na omogooko bw’eriogi ri’amakano oerire.

English: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa nikitazama vile viumbe hai, niliona gurudumu moja juu ya ardhi kando ya kila kiumbe kikiwa na nyuso zake nne.
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie ebitongwa biria, nkarora amagoro 'egari ane, kera okomo kore bosio bwa kera egetongwa goteneine inse.

English: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
Kiswahili: Utawakanyaga simba na nyoka wakali, simba mkubwa na nyoka utawaponda kwa miguu.
Ekegusii: Notache chindo na amarubi, notiringe chindo chinsae ne chinchoka.

English: but every man's servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.
Kiswahili: Mtumwa yeyote ambaye mmemnunua aweza kuila kama mmemtahiri,
Ekegusii: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chitaabu ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.

English: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kutokana na huyu huyu ambaye alikuwa sawa na mfu, wakazaliwa wazao wengi kama nyota za mbinguni na kama mchanga wa pwani usiohesabika.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokuure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching'enang'eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y'enyancha, otanyare kobareka.

English: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Imba, ee Binti Sayuni; paza sauti, ee Israeli! Furahi na kushangilia kwa moyo wako wote, ee Binti Yerusalemu!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, tera neriogi rinene! Inwe Abaisraeli, aka eriogi! Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, goka na gochenga ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi!

English: We were regarded by him as something worthless, and he abstains from our ways as from uncleanness. He calls the latter end of the righteous happy. He boasts that God is his father.
Kiswahili: Alituona kama kitu kisichofaa, naye hujiepusha na njia zetu kama uchafu. Anawaita mwisho wa wenye haki wenye furaha. Anajisifu kwamba Mungu ndiye baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotorora buna abanto abakorekanu na kende gionsi togokora tikeri kiya. Nigo akwerora buna Nyasae niise boigo nana kwegena buna abanyaboronge nabwo boka bagokwa bare n'omogooko.

English: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
Kiswahili: Mose alipopanda juu mlimani, wingu liliufunika huo mlima,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.

English: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.
Kiswahili: kwa wewe navunjavunja farasi na mpanda farasi, kwa wewe navunjavunja gari la vita na mwendeshaji wake,
Ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore chibarasi na abanto bachiriinete; ninsamunyore ne chigari na abagochigendia.

English: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
Kiswahili: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu, ndipo kile kitu kikavutwa tena mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.

English: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
Kiswahili: Naye Yosefu na mama yake mtoto wakastaajabu kwa yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa kumhusu huyo mtoto.
Ekegusii: Ise na ng'ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.

English: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to judge us, to go out before us, and to fight our battles.”
Kiswahili: Kisha tutakuwa kama mataifa mengine yote, tukiwa na mfalme wa kutuongoza na kwenda mbele yetu na kutupigania vita vyetu.”
Ekegusii: Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omorwoti ogotogaambera na gototang’ana, ekero togochia korwana chiseegi chiaito.”

English: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
Kiswahili: Akawaagiza akisema: “Hili ndilo mtakalomwambia bwana wangu Esau: ‘Mtumishi wako Yakobo anasema, nimekuwa nikiishi pamoja na Labani na nimekuwako huko mpaka sasa.
Ekegusii: Akabachiika bateebie Esau omonene oye iga: “Aya naro Yakobo, omosomba oo, agokwana: Nabeire nkomenya ase ense y'obogeni, ense ya Labani goika reero iga;

English: They were banished from among men, shouted down like thieves,
Kiswahili: Walifukuzwa mbali na watu wao, wakipigiwa kelele kama wevi.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa magega na kwogererwa buna abaibi.

English: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand and you take them captive,
Kiswahili: Mkienda vitani kupigana na adui zenu naye Bwana Mungu wenu akawatia adui mikononi mwenu, nanyi mkachukua mateka,
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokogeenda ase esegi korwania ababisa baino, n’Omonene Nyasae oino, ababeeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue na moboose,

English: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja aliyeonekana kurudi ili kumshukuru Mungu isipokuwa huyu mgeni?”
Ekegusii: Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”

English: When they reached the trees, the girl asked again, "Where is your firewood?" The giant answered, "Not far now!"
Kiswahili: Walipofika kwenye miti hiyo, msichana akauliza jitu tena, “Wapi kuni zako?” Jitu likajibu, “Haziko mbali sasa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase emete eria, omoiseke oria akariboria naende, “Ing’ai chinko chiao chire?” Richini riria riakamoiraneria, “Tari are korwa igaa!”

English: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
Kiswahili: Nipe ufahamu, nami nitaishika sheria yako na kuitii kwa moyo wangu wote.
Ekegusii: Imanyie amachiiko ao, erinde ’n’yabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.

English: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Nitasema sheria zako mbele za wafalme wala sitaaibishwa,
Ekegusii: Nindue oborori bwao ase amasio y'abarwoti 'ntari nobosooku.

English: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
Kiswahili: Kwa maneno haya Wayahudi waligawanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio gokaba naende ogwatananekana ase Abayahudi ase engencho y'amang'ana aya.

English: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
Kiswahili: Tegeni sikio mje kwangu, nisikieni mimi, ili nafsi zenu zipate kuishi. Nitafanya agano la milele nanyi, pendo la uaminifu nililomwahidi Daudi.
Ekegusii: “Tegerera moigwe, erio moche ase 'nde. Igwa! Erio nario moranyare koba moyo. Ninkore nainwe okobwatana kw'ogotianania gwa kare na kare, naende nimbaorokerie obwanchani bwane bwa botambe obo narierete Daudi eira.

English: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”
Kiswahili: “Mfalme bwana wangu, watu hawa wamefanya uovu kwa yote waliomtendea nabii Yeremia. Wamemtupa ndani ya kisima, mahali ambapo atakufa kwa njaa wakati ambapo hakuna chakula popote katika mji.”
Ekegusii: “Aye omorwoti, omonene one, abanto bakorire bobe mono ase amang'ana onsi bakorire ase Yeremia omobani ase okomobeka ime ase engoro eria. Bono ere nigo arakwereo ase engencho y'enchara, ekiagera emegati yonsi yaerire korwa ase omochie.”

English: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atayateketeza hayo mafuta juu ya madhabahu, lakini kidari kitakuwa cha Aroni na wanawe.
Ekegusii: Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ase egesasiimero, korende ritaana ribe eria Aroni na abamura baye.

English: who kept the law of the Most High, and was taken into covenant with him. In his flesh he established the covenant. When he was tested, he was found faithful.
Kiswahili: Aliyeishika sheria ya Aliye Juu Zaidi, akaingizwa katika agano naye. Alithibitisha agano katika mwili wake. Alipojaribiwa, alionekana kuwa mwaminifu.
Ekegusii: Akabwatia amachiiko y'Omonene, nere Omonene agakora okobwatana nere, agaikerania ase omobere oye ekemanyererio giokobwatana okwo, boigo ekero Aburamu nigo atemetwe, akarorekana ere ore omoikeranu.

English: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Gadi akamwendea Daudi akamwambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: ‘Chagua:
Ekegusii: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi akamoteebia, “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Chora erimo eri oranche.

English: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your instruction; nothing can make them stumble.
Kiswahili: Wanaopenda sheria yako wana amani tele, wala hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuwakwaza.
Ekegusii: Abwo banchete amachiiko ao nigo bare n’omorembe omonene mono, kende tikeri gekobagoocha.

English: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, Absalomu pamoja na watu wote wa Israeli wakafika Yerusalemu, naye Ahithofeli alikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Abisalomu na abanto abwo bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagaika Yerusalemu, na Ahitofeli nigo arenge amo nere.

English: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.”
Kiswahili: ninyi mnaokula nyama ya watu wangu, mnaowachuna ngozi na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; mnaowakatakata kama nyama ya kuwekwa kwenye sufuria na kama nyama ya kuwekwa kwenye chungu?”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoria abanto baane. Mwabachobora risankwa, mwabuna amauga abo, mwababutorana buna chinyama chikobekwa enyongo.

English: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram's fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
Kiswahili: Mfalme alikuwa na meli nyingi za biashara baharini zilizokuwa zikiandamana na meli za Hiramu. Kwa mara moja kila miaka mitatu zilirudi, zikiwa zimebeba dhahabu, fedha, pembe za ndovu na nyani wakubwa na wadogo.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti nabwate chimeeri chiaye chia Tarisisi chiarenge goeta chinyancha amo ne chimeeri chia Hiramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha chiarenta chitaabu ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, ne chingoge amo ne chinyoni chi'ebieni ebiya.

English: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
Kiswahili: Siku sita baada ya jambo hili, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu peke yao.
Ekegusii: Na nyuma y'amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.

English: Those who were in the citadel kept hemming Israel in around the sanctuary, and always sought to harm them and to strengthen the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa katika ngome waliendelea kuzingira Israeli kuzunguka patakatifu, na siku zote walitaka kuwadhuru na kuwaimarisha Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Ase ebiro ebio ababisa nigo barenge ase chinsinyo barenge kona kobatianera Abaisraeli ang'e nenseemo ye Hekalu. Barabwo nigo barenge kona goteema kera ekero kobaremaria Abayahudi na kobikong'ia ebisaku binde.

English: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.
Kiswahili: Alitia nakshi za makerubi, simba na miti ya mitende juu ya uso wa vishikio na juu ya papi, katika kila nafasi iliyopatikana, pamoja na mataji yaliyosokotwa kuzunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Ase ebisiirero na ase chinsingo emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na eye chindo, na ey’emekendo, amo ney’ebisicha, ekamang’wa, buna ribaga riarenge ase kera ensemo.

English: For each man will bear his own burden.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kila mtu atauchukua mzigo wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki kera omonto nebogorererie egurube yaye omonyene.

English: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, tuendelee kutenda dhambi ili neema ipate kuongezeka?
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?

English: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won't be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu Bwana Mwenyezi ananisaidia, sitatahayarika. Kwa hiyo nimekaza uso wangu kama jiwe la gumegume, nami ninajua sitaaibika.
Ekegusii: Omonene nankonye; ase ayio tinkobugwa nogochaywa; na ase ayio nakorire obosio bwane bwabeire obokong'u buna rigena, nimanyete ng'a tingosookigwa.

English: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
Kiswahili: Nyoeni nywele zenu katika kuomboleza kwa ajili ya watoto wenu mnaowafurahia; jifanyieni upara kama tai, kwa kuwa watawaacha na kwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey'echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.

English: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, kama jina lako lilivyo, sifa zako zinafika hadi miisho ya dunia, mkono wako wa kuume umejazwa na haki.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, buna koreng’ana erieta riao rikumete, naboigo nogotogigwa kwao gokumete goikera chinsinyo chi’ense. Okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo goichire noboronge.

English: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.'
Kiswahili: “Baadaye wale wanawali wengine nao wakaja, wakaita, ‘Bwana! Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!'
Ekegusii: Naende magega yaye abaiseke baria bande bagaacha, bakaboora: Omonene, toigorere!

English: And as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Call out to every kind of bird and to every beast of the field: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great feast on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ita kila aina ya ndege na wanyama wote wa mwituni, waambie: ‘Kusanyikeni mje pamoja kutoka pande zote kwa ajili ya dhabihu ninayowaandalia, dhabihu kuu katika milima ya Israeli. Huko mtakula nyama na kunywa damu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Kwana na kera egesaku gie chinyoni na egie ching’iti chi’orosana, ochiteebie: Esangererie, moche amo korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, mochiche ase omoyega omonene bw’ekeng’wanso nabaroiseirie. Oyio nigo orabe omoyega omonene bw’ekeng’wanso igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli; inwe imorie chinyama, monywe na amanyinga.

English: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia wote, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake kila siku, anifuate.
Ekegusii: Agateebia bonsi, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye kera rituko antunyane.

English: And every one of you that I do not cut off from My altar, your eyes will fail and your heart will grieve. All your descendants will die by the sword of men.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wenu ambaye sitamkatilia mbali kutoka madhabahuni pangu atabakizwa tu kupofusha macho yenu kwa machozi na kuihuzunisha mioyo yenu, nao wazao wenu wote watakufa watakapokuwa wamefikia umri wa kustawi.
Ekegusii: Tinkorusia kera oyomo oino korwa ase egesasiimero. Oyo ntarusie korwao nigo arabe okogoukoria amaiso, na goichania enkoro yao, na abanto bonsi b’enyomba yao nigo barakwe bataragota.

English: “Even today my complaint is bitter. His hand is heavy despite my groaning.
Kiswahili: “Hata leo malalamiko yangu ni chungu; mkono wake ni mzito juu yangu hata nikiugua.
Ekegusii: Nonya ngoika reero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.

English: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Haya yamewajia ili kwamba imani yenu, iliyo ya thamani kuliko dhahabu ipoteayo, ingawa hujaribiwa kwa moto, ionekane kuwa halisi na imalizie katika sifa, utukufu na heshima wakati Yesu Kristo atadhihirishwa.
Ekegusii: Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etaabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

English: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of the fact.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mkamuua aliye chanzo cha uzima, lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Sisi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Mogaita Omotongi bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.

English: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh's house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
Kiswahili: Ikawa kuhani Pashuri mwana wa Imeri, mkuu wa maafisa wa Hekalu la Bwana, alipomsikia Yeremia akitoa unabii juu ya mambo haya,
Ekegusii: Ekero Pasuri Omokuani, mosinto o Imeri, oyorenge omoteneneri omonene bw'enyomba y'Omonene, aigwete Yeremia okobana amang'ana ayio,

English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano? Nase ki otari n'obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ase ogotooreka gokorwa ase obosio bwaye.

English: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers' households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
Kiswahili: Hawa wana wote wa Yediaeli walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Kulikuwako wanaume wapiganaji 17,200 waliokuwa tayari kwenda vitani.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo ab'ororeria rwa Yediaeli. Barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, naende nigo barenge abakong'u ase esegi. Omobaro obo nechilifu ikomi na isano na ibere, na amagana abere (17,200).

English: They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
Kiswahili: Waliondolewa kabla ya wakati wao, misingi yao ikachukuliwa na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogooko okoira.

English: When they had heard all these words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, “Surely we must report all these words to the king.”
Kiswahili: Walipoyasikia maneno hayo yote, wakatazamana wao kwa wao kwa woga na kumwambia Baruku, “Lazima tutoe taarifa ya maneno haya yote kwa mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakaonchoka bakarigererania bare nobwoba, bagateebia Baruku, “Goika toteebie omorwoti amang’ana aya.”

English: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
Kiswahili: “Mkiingia katika nyumba yoyote, kwanza semeni, ‘Amani iwe kwenu.’
Ekegusii: Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.

English: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
Kiswahili: Naye Daudi aliwachunga kwa uadilifu wa moyo, kwa mikono ya ustadi aliwaongoza.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba omorisia bw'abaanto abwo ore nenkoro endonge, akaba okobaraa nokoboko kw'obong'aini.

English: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akaingia ndani, akaketi mbele za Bwana, akasema: “Mimi ni nani, Ee Bwana Mungu, na jamaa yangu ni nini, hata umenileta mpaka hapa nilipo?
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, akabora, Aye Omonene, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?

English: until the LORD has driven men far away and the land is utterly forsaken.
Kiswahili: hadi Bwana atakapokuwa amekwisha kumpeleka kila mmoja mbali sana, na nchi itakapokuwa imeachwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene ning’anyie abanto abwo korwa ase ense eyio bagende aare, na aase agwo aratigwe are bosa, nabe aange mono ase ense eyio.

English: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Pashuri: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishmaeli, Nethaneli, Yozabadi na Elasa.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Pasuri: Elioenai na Maaseya, Isumaeli na Netaneli, Yosabadi na Elasa.

English: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa mkanipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu mkaninywesha, nilikuwa mgeni mkanikaribisha,
Ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

English: “If you will not,” said Naaman, “please let me, your servant, be given as much soil as a pair of mules can carry. For your servant will never again make a burnt offering or a sacrifice to any other god but the LORD.
Kiswahili: Naamani akasema, “Ikiwa hutapokea, tafadhali mtumishi wako na apewe udongo kiasi cha mzigo wa kuweza kubebwa na punda wawili, kwa sababu mtumishi wako hatatoa tena sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu kwa mungu mwingine isipokuwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Naamani agateeba: “Onye taibo, nagosabire, tiga inche omosomba oo ’ng’eegwe amaroba aisaine chigurube ibere, chibarasi ibere chiranyare kobogoria, ekiagera korwa bono na kogenderera inche omosomba oo tinkorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase enyasae ende yonsi, otatiga nase Omonene bweka.

English: The good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a man who devises evil.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwema hupata kibali kutoka kwa Bwana, bali Bwana humhukumu mwenye hila.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akomonyoorera monto omuya ogwancherwa, korende omonachera ekiina oyogokora emeroberio y’obobe.

English: For through Yahweh's voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana itaivunjavunja Ashuru, kwa fimbo yake ya utawala atawapiga.
Ekegusii: Ase eriogi ri'Omonene, na ase ogoaka nenyimbo yaye, Abaasuri mbaondoke mono.

English: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
Kiswahili: Kwa wale wanaopotea, sisi ni harufu ya mauti iletayo mauti; lakini kwa wale wanaookolewa, sisi ni harufu nzuri iletayo uzima. Ni nani awezaye mambo hayo?
Ekegusii: ase abwo bagosira ogotioka kw'amakweri gokorenta amakweri; ase abwo bagotoorigwa ogotioka kw'obogima gokorenta obogima. Ning'o oraisane ase amang'ana aya?

English: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
Kiswahili: na kilemba cha kitani safi, tepe za kichwani za kitani, na nguo za ndani za kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,

English: Nothing was too hard for him. When he was buried, his body prophesied.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kilichokuwa kigumu kwake. Alipozikwa, mwili wake ulitabiri.
Ekegusii: Tiriarengeo ing'ana rinde rionsi riamokong'erete ere, na ekero akwete, omobere oye okarua obobani.

English: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, as well as the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and metalsmiths from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon, the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yekonia mwana wa Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda, pamoja na maafisa, mafundi stadi na wahunzi wa Yuda, kuchukuliwa kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Babeli na Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli kwenda uhamishoni huko Babeli, Bwana akanionyesha vikapu viwili vya tini vilivyowekwa mbele ya Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Magega Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, kairire Yekonia, mosinto o Yehoyakimu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oborwoti boria, na abaroisia b’ebinto, na abaturi b’ebioma, gochia Babiloni, Omonene akanyorokia okorora oko: Bosio bwe Hekalu y’Omonene nkarora ebitonga bibere biarenge namako.

English: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don't hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
Kiswahili: Kisha akapiga magoti, akalia kwa sauti kubwa akasema, “Bwana usiwahesabie dhambi hii.” Baada ya kusema hayo, akalala.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.

English: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.
Kiswahili: Hili lilitokea ili ule ukatili waliotendewa hao wana sabini wa Yerub-Baali upatilizwe, na damu yao iwe juu ya Abimeleki ndugu yao aliyewaua, na pia iwe juu ya watu wa Shekemu, ambao walimsaidia kuua ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n'ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw'ogoiterwa kw'amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y'Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y' abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi'ogokora ayio.

English: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakamsihi sana akae nao, wakisema, “Kaa hapa nasi, kwa maana sasa ni jioni na usiku unaingia.” Basi akaingia ndani kukaa nao.
Ekegusii: Bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.

English: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
Kiswahili: Walipoingia ndani ya ile nyumba, wakamwona mtoto pamoja na Maria mama yake, wakamsujudu na kumwabudu yule mtoto Yesu. Ndipo wakafungua hazina zao, wakamtolea zawadi za dhahabu, uvumba na manemane.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda bagasoa nyomba, bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima. Erio bagakuunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etaabu, na ubani, na manemane.

English: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
Kiswahili: “Tazama nitawaamsha kutoka zile sehemu mlizowauza, nami nitawalipiza juu ya vichwa vyenu kile mlichofanya.
Ekegusii: Korende bono nimbarangerie barue aase aria mwabaoonetie gochia, erinde mbairanerie inwe ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino.

English: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataandika katika orodha ya mataifa: “Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arakore omobaro bw'abaanto, nigo ararike, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”

English: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
Kiswahili: Manukato yako yananukia vizuri, jina lako ni kama manukato yaliyomiminwa. Ndiyo sababu wanawali wanakupenda!
Ekegusii: Amaguta ao akweakwa nigo are ne rimisu rigiya; erieta riao nigo ringa buna amaguta aumoirwe, ase ayio abakungu nigo bagwanchete.

English: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.
Kiswahili: Mtaigawanya hiyo nchi katika sehemu saba. Yuda atabaki katika eneo lake upande wa kusini na nyumba ya Yosefu katika nchi yake upande wa kaskazini.
Ekegusii: Ense yatananwe ase chinsemo isano na ibere. Abayuda nigo baragenderere komenya ase orogongo rwabo agwo ensemo ya Irianyi, na Abayusufu ase orwabo, ensemo ya sugusu.

English: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
Kiswahili: talanta 100 za fedha, ngano kori 100, divai bathi 100, mafuta ya zeituni bathi 100, na chumvi kiasi chochote.
Ekegusii: Momoe goikera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo (100), na engano ebitonga elifu eyemo (1,000), na edivai chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na amaguta 'amazeituni chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na momoe omonyoo otari na kerengo.

English: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.
Kiswahili: Siwaamrishi, lakini nataka kujaribu unyofu wa upendo wenu kwa kuulinganisha na bidii ya wengine.
Ekegusii: Tinkwaneti aya ase okobachiika, korende ase omokia bw’abaanto bande nteeme ekeene ki’obwanchani bwaino.

English: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Hii ndiyo sababu niliwaambia kwamba hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu isipokuwa amejaliwa na Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabateebia, ng'a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase 'nde, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”

English: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
Kiswahili: Je, mtazungumza kwa uovu kwa niaba ya Mungu? Je, mtazungumza kwa udanganyifu kwa niaba yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana oborimo? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong'ainereria?

English: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Kiswahili: Maana Mungu hakutupa roho ya woga, bali roho ya nguvu, ya upendo na ya moyo wa kiasi.
Ekegusii: ekiagera omoika twaetwe na Nyasae tari oyo bw'obwoba, korende oyo bw'echinguru na obwanchani, na omoika bw'okwerenga intwe abanyene.

English: So all the officials and all the people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their menservants and maidservants and no longer hold them in bondage. They obeyed and released them,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo maafisa wote na watu walioingia katika agano hili wakakubali kwamba watawaacha huru watumwa wao wa kiume na wa kike, na hawatawashikilia tena kama watumwa. Wakakubali na wakawaacha huru.
Ekegusii: Abaanene b’oborwoti amo nabaanto bonsi abakorete okobwatana ng’a kera omonto asibore omosomba oye, omosacha gose omokungu, bakaigwa amang’ana ayio na bakabasibora.

English: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
Kiswahili: Ukisikika mlio wa pili wa jinsi hiyo, walioko kwenye makambi ya kusini wataondoka. Mlio huo wa kujulisha hatari utakuwa ishara ya kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero morabugie etarumbeta ase eriogi ri'ogotabobora eria'kabere, abanto bare ase ebitwori bi'enseemo ya Irianyi baimoke bachaake orogeendo. Etarumbeta goika ebugigwe ase eriogi erio ase chingaki chionsi abanto barabe bakomanora gochaaka orogeendo.

English: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
Kiswahili: Yesu, akiwa amejawa na huruma, akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamororera amaabera, akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.”

English: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Nitawaficha uso wangu, nami nione mwisho wao utakuwa nini, kwa kuwa wao ni kizazi kilichopotoka, watoto ambao si waaminifu.
Ekegusii: Akabora: Nimbise obosio bwane korwa ase bare, erio ndore omoerio obo buna ogochia koba, ekiagera barabwo nekegori egesisikanu, abanto batari abeegenwa.

English: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
Kiswahili: Ingekuwa heri kama mtu huyo angefungiwa jiwe la kusagia shingoni na kutoswa baharini, kuliko kumsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo kutenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw'aba abake akore ebibe.

English: When the king would show favor to any, he would exchange many presents and give them some of this liquid.
Kiswahili: Mfalme alipoonyesha upendeleo kwa yeyote, angebadilishana zawadi nyingi na kuwapa baadhi ya kinywaji hiki.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti akanyora chitaabu chinyinge mono korwa ase aria, echio are koa monto onde bwensi anchete.

English: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
Kiswahili: Lakini alipoona upepo mkali aliingiwa na hofu, naye akaanza kuzama, huku akipiga kelele, “Bwana, niokoe!”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero achia korora omwaga bw’echinguru, akairoka, agachaaka korimera amaache ime, agaaka eriogi, agateeba, “Omonene ntooria!”

English: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I display My glory, declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wa nchi watawazika, nayo siku nitakayotukuzwa itakuwa siku ya kumbukumbu kwa ajili yao, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense eyio mbagenderere kobatindeka, na ayio abe ogotogigwa kwabo. Aya nigo arakoreke ase rituko riria ndaorokie obonene bwane. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: Whom did He consult to enlighten Him, and who taught Him the paths of justice? Who imparted knowledge to Him and showed Him the way of understanding?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ambaye Bwana ametaka shauri kwake ili kumwelimisha, naye ni nani aliyemfundisha njia iliyo sawa? Ni nani aliyemfundisha maarifa au kumwonyesha mapito ya ufahamu?
Ekegusii: Ning’Omonene akoboria amosemie amang’ana buya? Ning’o omworokereretie oboeto bw’oboronge, na komworokia okomanya, gose komworokia enchera y’okomanya?

English: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
Kiswahili: Wengi ambao wamelala kwenye mavumbi wataamka, baadhi yao kwa uzima wa milele, wengine kwa aibu na kudharauliwa milele.
Ekegusii: Abange b'abwo baraire ase riroba ime mbaboke, abande banyore obogima bwa kare na kare, na abande banyore obosooku na ogochaaywa gwa kare na kare.

English: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nitawakumbusha mambo haya siku zote, hata ingawa mnayajua na mmethibitishwa katika kweli mliyo nayo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkomocha kobainyoria amang'ana ayio botambe, nonya moyamanyete na mwabekirwe chinguru ase ekeene ekio mwanyorire.

English: But be careful that you are not enticed to turn aside to worship and bow down to other gods,
Kiswahili: Jihadharini, la sivyo mtashawishika kugeuka na kuabudu miungu mingine na kuisujudia.
Ekegusii: Mwerende mono chinkoro chiaino tichibang’aina. Timobaisa gotiga Omonene na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao, na gochisasiima.

English: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
Kiswahili: Nitamteua pia awe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza, aliyetukuka kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio inche nimokore abe omwana one omotangi, abe omorwoti ore omonene kobua abarwoti bande bonsi b’ense.

English: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe umeyajua mafundisho yangu, mwenendo, makusudi, imani, uvumilivu, upendo, ustahimilivu,
Ekegusii: Korende aye kwabwatire okworokereria kw'ane, na orogeendo rw'ane, na okorigia kw'ane ase obogima obo, na okwegena kw'ane, na oboremereria bwane, na obwanchani bwane, na okoganya kw'ane,

English: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Je, hamjasoma katika Maandiko kwamba: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni. Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni la ajabu machoni petu’?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, Timwana gosoma ase amariiko: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?

English: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Kiswahili: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi'abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.

English: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo inatubidi tumchague mtu mwingine miongoni mwa wale ambao wamekuwa pamoja nasi wakati wote Bwana Yesu alipoingia na kutoka katikati yenu,
Ekegusii: Naboigo natonyore oyomo okobwatana naitwe koba kirori ase okobokigwa kw'omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Ere goika abe korwa ase egati yabaanto barenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,

English: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
Kiswahili: Makerubi hao walikuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, wakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao walielekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakarambora chimbaaba chiabo igoro y'Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, bakabobekera ekiriri, na amasio abo agachiikana; na barabwo bakarigereria Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

English: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother's, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.
Kiswahili: Fanya vivyo hivyo ukimkuta punda wa nduguyo au joho lake au chochote alichopoteza. Usipuuze jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo orakore koranyore etigere yaye, gose eanga yaye, gose gento kende gionsi ki'oyomino gesirete; aye kogokenyora tobaisa koombia tomogekoonyera.

English: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya Aroni na iseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b'enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

English: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
Kiswahili: Wakuchao wafurahie wanaponiona, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakoirogete 'mbandore bagoke, ekiagera 'nsemeretie ring'ana riao.

English: The Jews in Susa, however, had assembled on the thirteenth and the fourteenth days of the month. So they rested on the fifteenth day, making it a day of feasting and joy.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi huko Shushani, hata hivyo, walikuwa wamekusanyika siku ya kumi na tatu na ya kumi na nne, pia siku ya kumi na tano walipumzika na kuifanya siku ya karamu na furaha.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi abarenge Susa, barabwo nigo basangererekanete ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, na eria ikomi na kane, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano bagatimoka bakarikora rikaba eri’omoyega na omogooko.

English: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
Kiswahili: nikaweka hazama puani mwako, vipuli masikioni mwako na taji nzuri sana kichwani mwako.
Ekegusii: Nkabeka ebonyi ase emioro yao, na ebigera ase amato ao, na eguutwa enseera ase omotwe oo.

English: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atachota sadaka ya nafaka mkono uliojaa kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, baada ya hayo, atamtaka huyo mwanamke anywe yale maji.
Ekegusii: Naende korwa ase okoruegwa okwo aimokie goke, goichire roe, kobe ekeinyorio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwa Omonene, na kogosambera ase egesasiimero, na magega y’ayio ae omokungu oria amaache aria anywe.

English: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
Kiswahili: Hata kama mvua ya mawe iangushe msitu na mji ubomolewe kabisa,
Ekegusii: Ekero embura y'amagena eraabe egotwa neiyerie emete ye rinani, na omochie oino noiranigwe inse mono.

English: Was not Achan son of Zerah unfaithful regarding what was set apart for destruction, bringing wrath upon the whole congregation of Israel? Yet it was not only Achan who perished because of his sin!’”
Kiswahili: Wakati Akani mwana wa Zera alipokosa uaminifu kwa vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu, je, ghadhabu haikulipata kusanyiko lote la Israeli? Hakuwa yeye peke yake aliyekufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inyora buna Akani, mosinto o Zera, amochete ase ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa; omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo onyorete egesusuro ase engencho eyio, tari omonto oria bweka osirete ase ogosaria koria.”

English: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
Kiswahili: Ulipowadia wakati wa Elizabeti kujifungua, alizaa mtoto mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Engaki yokoibora kwa Elisabeti egaika, ere akaibora omwana omoisia.

English: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren't able.”
Kiswahili: Kila mara huyo pepo mchafu ampagaapo mwanangu, humwangusha chini na kumfanya atokwe povu mdomoni na kusaga meno, kisha mwili wake hukauka. Niliwaomba wanafunzi wako wamtoe huyo pepo mchafu, lakini hawakuweza.”
Ekegusii: ekero kiamobokire nigo gekomogaragaria inse, asokia risombogoku, na koriania amaino; ase ayio chinguru chiaye chisira. Ngakwana naborokigwa bao bageserie, tibanyara.”

English: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
Kiswahili: Siku zote tunamshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu ninyi nyote, tukiwataja kwenye maombi yetu daima.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo togoakera Nyasae ng'a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino mwensi, na kobaatora ase ogosaba gwaito.

English: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nyingi Bwana akaniambia, “Nenda sasa Frati ukauchukue ule mkanda niliokuambia uufiche huko.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amange gaetire Omonene aganteebia, “Imoka ogende goika Eufarati, orusie orokini roria nagochigeete ng’a orobise aroro, ororente aa.”

English: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
Kiswahili: Mapito ya wenye haki yamenyooka. Ewe uliye Mwenye Haki, waisawazisha njia ya mtu mnyofu.
Ekegusii: Enchera y'abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.

English: in Ziklag; in Meconah and its villages;
Kiswahili: katika Siklagi, katika Mekona na makazi yake,
Ekegusii: abande bakamenya Sikilagi, na Mekona na ase ebichie biaye;

English: Of all the creatures that live in the water, you may eat anything with fins and scales,
Kiswahili: Katika viumbe hai vyote viishivyo kwenye maji, mnaweza kula yeyote aliye na mapezi na magamba.
Ekegusii: “Ase echio chionsi chire ase amaache ime ’monyaare koria chinswe chibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho.

English: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
Kiswahili: Ole wenu ninyi mnaostarehe na kuridhika katika Sayuni, na ninyi mnaojisikia salama juu ya Mlima Samaria, ninyi watu mashuhuri wa taifa lililoendelea kuliko mataifa mengine, ambao watu wa Israeli wanawategemea!
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bamenyete buya agwo Sayoni, na abwo batoererete ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, abwo bare abasike b'egesaku egetang'ani, eki Abaisraeli bagochiera.

English: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa imefunuliwa kwa kudhihirishwa kwake Mwokozi wetu, Kristo Yesu, ambaye amebatilisha mauti na kuleta uzima na kutokufa kwa njia ya Injili.
Ekegusii: bwaorokigwe bono ase okoorokigwa kw’Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso. Ere agasiria chinguru chi’amakweri, na akarenta obogima na ogotasareka goetera ase enchiri.

English: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa sitawatendea mabaki ya watu hawa kama nilivyowatenda zamani,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Korende bono tingokorera abatigari b'abaanto aba buna nakorerete ab'amatuko aria a kare. Nabo Omonene bw'Emeganda atebiire.

English: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
Kiswahili: Lakini nitakaa Efeso mpaka wakati wa Pentekoste,
Ekegusii: Bono nimenye ase Efeso goika rituko rinene ria Pentekosti;

English: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
Kiswahili: Hanieli mwana wa Efodi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu; ase egesaku kia Manase, Hanieli, mosinto o Efodi.

English: The king and his princes were pleased with this counsel; so the king did as Memucan had advised.
Kiswahili: Mfalme na wakuu wake walipendezwa na shauri hili, hivyo basi mfalme akafanya kama Memukani alivyopendekeza.
Ekegusii: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.

English: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu afanyaye sanamu ya kuchonga au mwenye kusubu sanamu, kitu ambacho ni chukizo kwa Bwana, kazi ya mikono ya fundi stadi, na kuisimamisha kwa siri.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oyoraroisie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, koyotenenia na koyosasiima bobisi, koraabe omogwekano obaachire, gose oyo bw’ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, eyere emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini. Okwo n’okogeechia ase Omonene. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
Kiswahili: Watateka utajiri wako na kuchukua nyara bidhaa zako, watazivunja kuta zako na kuzibomoa nyumba zako nzuri, watatupa baharini mawe yako, mbao zako na kifusi chako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo mbakoure obotenenku bwao bwonsi, na mbaire ebinto biao bi'oboonchoreria; mbatagore chindwaki chiao ne chinyomba chiao chingiya. Nigo baraimokie amagena, ne chibao, na amaroba, babirute ase chinyancha ime.

English: So now I have just one request of you; do not deny me.” “State your request,” she told him.
Kiswahili: Sasa ninalo ombi moja ninalokuomba. Usinikatalie.” Bathsheba akasema, “Waweza kuliomba.”
Ekegusii: Na bono nimbwate okoboria okomo ngokoboria, tonkania.” Omokungu oria akamoteebia: “Boria.”

English: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
Kiswahili: Niliota ndoto iliyoniogopesha. Nilipokuwa nimelala kitandani mwangu, njozi na maono yaliyopita mawazoni mwangu vilinitisha.
Ekegusii: Nkarota okorota kwang'ondogetie; ekero naraire borere bwane, nkarora okorora gokaba kogonchanda ase ebirengererio biane.

English: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
Kiswahili: nao watamwona uso wake na Jina lake litakuwa kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo nabamorore obosio bwaye, na erieta riaye naribe ase amasio abo igoro.

English: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
Kiswahili: Umetuacha tutafunwe kama kondoo na umetutawanya katika mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye kwarure ribaga toriegwe buna ching’ondi chikoriegwa, gwatosiareire gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku.

English: I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
Kiswahili: Ninazunguka nikiwa nimeungua, lakini si kwa jua; ninasimama katika kusanyiko nikiomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkona‐koong’anya inde nemechando ntarochi omobaso; nigo ngotenena ase omosangererekano, narera ng’a nkonywe.

English: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
Kiswahili: Tunaikumbuka daima kazi yenu ya imani mbele za Mungu aliye Baba yetu, taabu yenu katika upendo na saburi yenu ya tumaini katika Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na intwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata oito titori gotiga koinyora emeremo yaino ase okwegena, na ogwechanda kwaino ase obwanchani, na oboremereria bwaino ase okomosemeri 'Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
Kiswahili: “Sasa mimi ninakwenda kwake yeye aliyenituma, lakini hakuna hata aniulizaye, ‘Unakwenda wapi?’
Ekegusii: Korende bono nkogenda nde asare ere oyontomete; gose onde tari ase more okomboria: Ing’ai ogochia?

English: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.
Kiswahili: Tazama chini kutoka mbinguni ukaone kutoka kiti chako cha enzi kilichoinuliwa juu, kitakatifu na kitukufu. Uko wapi wivu wako na uweza wako? Umetuzuilia wema wako na huruma zako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, rigereria inse aa, korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao obochenu bore, na obonene bwao bore. Ng'ai risemi riao, ne chinguru chiao, bire? Okonyechandera kwao, na amaabera ao ase 'nde, ng'ai bire? Ekeene, biatangirwe korwa ase 'nde.

English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
Kiswahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Shalumu,
Ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Salumu;

English: And a similar plague will strike the horses and mules, camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps. All Nations Will Worship the King (Leviticus 23:33–44; Nehemiah 8:13–18)
Kiswahili: Tauni ya aina iyo hiyo itapiga farasi na nyumbu, ngamia na punda, nao wanyama wote walioko kwenye kambi za adui.
Ekegusii: Amaakwa amabe buna ayio nache boigo ase chibarasi, ne chibarasi, ne chingamia, ne chitigere, ne ching’iti chinde chionsi chire ase ebitwori biabo.

English: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah did so.
Kiswahili: Ebed-Meleki Mkushi akamwambia Yeremia, “Weka haya matambaa makuukuu na hizo nguo zilizochakaa makwapani ili kuzuia kamba.” Yeremia akafanya hivyo,
Ekegusii: Ebedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, agateebia Yeremia, “Agia chianga echio ase chintigatigi chiao, oagie ne chingori korwa inse.” Yeremia agakora bo.

English: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, in the land of Canaan. This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
Kiswahili: pango lililoko katika shamba la Makpela, karibu na Mamre huko Kanaani, ambalo Abrahamu alinunua kwa ajili ya mahali pa kuzikia kutoka kwa Efroni, Mhiti, pamoja na shamba.
Ekegusii: rikuruma eri rire ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, ase ense ya Kaanani. Oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti bobe aase ogotindeka.

English: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
Kiswahili: Binadamu wa ngazi ya chini ni pumzi tu, nao wa ngazi ya juu ni uongo tu; wakipimwa kwenye mizani, si chochote; wote kwa pamoja ni pumzi tu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Mwanyabaanto nigo bare buna omooki rioka, abanto baeire obonene nigo bare bosa; ekero bakorengwa nigo bare abagusu; bonsi nigo bare abagusu kobua omooki.

English: Then the Israelites received the report: “Behold, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar on the border of the land of Canaan, at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side.”
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wengine waliposikia kwamba Wareubeni, Wagadi na ile nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wamejenga madhabahu kwenye mpaka wa Kanaani huko Gelilothi karibu na Yordani kwenye upande wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande bakaigwa amang’ana aya agokwanwa, “Naama! Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase baagachire egesasiimero aria Geliloti, ensemo ya bosio bw’ense ya Kaanani, ang’e na Yorodani, erochie ensemo y’Abaisraeli.”

English: Then the LORD said to Solomon, “Because you have done this and have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akamwambia Solomoni, “Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo hali yako na hukushika Agano langu na sheria zangu nilizokuamuru, hakika nitaurarua ufalme kutoka kwako na kumpa mmoja wa walio chini yako.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agateebia Sulemani, “Ekiagera gwakorire ayio, na tikwabwatete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, gose amachiiko aane aya nagochiigete, goika ntandorane na ndusie oborwoti korwa asore, imboe omosomba oo.

English: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;
Kiswahili: Siku ile baada ya Waisraeli kuwaua Wafilisti kutoka Mikmashi mpaka Aiyaloni, walikuwa wamechoka.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bagaita Abafirisiti gochaakera korwa Mikimasi goikera Ayaloni. Abaisraeli bakarosa mono ase okogoya, bare n'enchara.

English: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
Kiswahili: Bwana akapendezwa kwamba Solomoni ameliomba jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Omonene akagokigwa namang'ana ayio Sulemani aboretie.

English: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaagana na makutano, akaingia nyumbani. Wanafunzi wake wakamjia wakamwambia, “Tueleze maana ya ule mfano wa magugu shambani.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw’amabanchore a mogondo.”

English: Then Noah sent out a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamtoa hua ili aone kama maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa ardhi.
Ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agatoma riruma, egere arore gose amaache akamire korwa ase ense,

English: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
Kiswahili: Kama watendakazi pamoja na Mungu, tunawasihi msipokee neema ya Mungu bure.
Ekegusii: Na intwe gatogokora emeremo amo nere, twabasoroire timonyora obuya bwa Nyasae bosa.

English: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow's borders intact.
Kiswahili: Bwana hubomoa nyumba ya mtu mwenye kiburi, bali huilinda mipaka ya mjane isiguswe.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotagora enyomba y'omonto omoenenu, korende arenda chimbebe chi'omotakaanwa.

English: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”
Kiswahili: naye akamweleza Zereshi mkewe pamoja na rafiki zake wote kila kitu ambacho kimempata. Washauri wake pamoja na Zereshi mkewe wakamwambia, “Kwa kuwa Mordekai, ambaye mbele yake umeanza kuanguka ni wa asili ya Kiyahudi, huwezi kushindana naye; kwa hakika utaanguka!”
Ekegusii: Hamani agateebia Seresi mokaye, na abasani baye bonsi, kera egento eke kiamonyorete. Erio abanto baye abanyasemi, na Seresi mokaye, bakamoteebia, “Onye Moredekai, oyio aye gwachakire koba inse yaye n'Omoyahudi are tokomonyara; amaene nere orakobue.”

English: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili, akatokea. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, na wazee.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso kagokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agaika, na omoganda ore amo nere nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka.

English: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families, registered individually by name—those twenty years of age or older who worked in the service of the house of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Lawi kwa jamaa zao. Wakuu wa jamaa kama walivyoandikwa kwa majina yao na kuhesabiwa kila mmoja, yaani, wenye uwezo wa kufanya kazi kuanzia miaka ishirini au zaidi, waliohudumu katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi ase chiamate chiabo amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiria, buna barigetwe kera oyomo ase erieta riaye. Abwo nigo barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, na nigo baisanerete gokora emeremo y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.

English: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaomchukia Bwana wangalinyenyekea mbele zake, na adhabu yao ingedumu milele.
Ekegusii: Abwo bangechete inche Omonene, nigo baare gocha gotung'ama ase 'nde bare nobwoba, na amatuko abo nagenderere kobao kare na kare.

English: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
Kiswahili: “Hivyo ninyi mnawezaje kunifariji kwa upuzi wenu? Hakuna kilichosalia cha majibu yenu isipokuwa uongo!”
Ekegusii: “Nase ki rende mokondemia namang'ana abosa? Ayatigaire ase amairanerio aino nigo are oborimo bwoka.”

English: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back,
Kiswahili: Wakati walipokuwa wameketi mezani, neno la Bwana likamjia yule nabii mzee aliyemrudisha huyo mtu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Na ekero baarenge baikaransete ase emesa, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani oria omogotu, oria omoiranetie;

English: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa migawanyo ya mabawabu waliokuwa wazao wa Kora na wa Merari.
Ekegusii: Ebi nabio biarenge ebiombe bi'abarendi b'ebiita korwa ase abanto b'ororeria rwa Kora na orwa Merari.

English: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
Kiswahili: Nitawatawanya ninyi miongoni mwa mataifa, na kuufuta upanga wangu na kuwafuatia. Nchi yenu itaharibiwa, nayo miji yenu itakuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Nimbaserebanie mogende komenya ase egati y'abanto b'ebisaku, nimbatunyanerie esegi, naende ninsarie ense yaino ebe bosa, na emechie ebe amatongo.

English: And when God commands the clouds to go over the whole world, they do as they are told.
Kiswahili: Na Mungu anapoamuru mawingu yapite juu ya ulimwengu wote, hufanya kama yanavyoambiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae agotoma omorero korwa igoro osambe ebitunwa n'echinsana, oro nigo ogokora keria otebigwa. Emegwekano tegokora binto ebi ero tegokora nonya eki kegocherera.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh, along with all his accomplishments and the sin that he committed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Manase, na yote aliyoyafanya, pamoja na dhambi alizotenda, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Manase, na aya onsi akorete, na ebibe biria akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abayuda.

English: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha's word.
Kiswahili: Wakati adui waliposhuka kumwelekea, Elisha akamwomba Bwana: “Wapige watu hawa kwa upofu.” Basi Mungu akawapiga kwa upofu, kama Elisha alivyoomba.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria bachete korwania Elisha, nere agasaba Omonene, akabora: “Nagosabire, oukorie abanto aba.” Ase ayio Omonene akabaukoria koreng'ana buna Elisha asabeete.

English: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, mimi Danieli nikaomboleza kwa majuma matatu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria inche Danieli nigo narenge nkona‐kweumia ase engaki ye chichuma isato.

English: Kibzaim, and Beth-horon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
Kiswahili: Kibsaimu na Beth-Horoni, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.
Ekegusii: na Kibusaimu, na Beti‐Horoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan, including these cities and their villages. Joshua’s Inheritance
Kiswahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Dani, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Yoshua
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani. Omwando o Yoshua

English: A grief of heart and sorrow is a woman who is jealous of another woman. Her tongue-lashing makes it known to all.
Kiswahili: Huzuni ya moyo na huzuni ni mwanamke anayemwonea wivu mwanamke mwingine. Kupiga kwake ulimi hujulisha wote.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo ere ring'ana riogoichania ekero omokungu oyomo agotwara ribero ase oyonde na gotwara oromeme rogosiarokera kera omonto.

English: Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
Kiswahili: “Je, wewe ni mtu wa kwanza kuzaliwa? Ulizaliwa kabla ya vilima?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Naye ore omonto bw’eritang’ani koiborwa? Gose naye gwatongetwe ritang’ani ebitunwa bitarabao?

English: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God. Then she shut the door and went out.
Kiswahili: Mama akampandisha na kumlaza juu ya kitanda cha yule mtu wa Mungu, kisha akafunga mlango, akatoka nje.
Ekegusii: Akamoira akamwareria ase oborere bw’omonto oria o Nyasae, agasieka egesieri akamotiga aroro, agasoka isiko.

English: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
Kiswahili: Kila mara lijapo litawachukua, asubuhi baada ya asubuhi, wakati wa mchana na wakati wa usiku, litawakumba tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.” Kuuelewa ujumbe huu utaleta hofu tupu.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng'ana emechando eyio eraabe ekona‐gocha nebanyore inwe, neebe ekona‐gocha emambia ase emambia, ee, omobaso na obotuko. Nigo eraabe emechando emebe y'okoondokia ase okoigwa amang'ana ayio atomirwe.

English: Now a word came to me secretly; my ears caught a whisper of it.
Kiswahili: “Neno lililetwa kwangu kwa siri, masikio yangu yakasikia mnongʼono wake.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ndire rianchicherete bobisi, nigo nariigwete rikomonyerera.

English: “Please, Lord,” Moses replied, “I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since You have spoken to Your servant, for I am slow of speech and tongue.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ee Bwana, kamwe sijapata kuwa msemaji kwa ufasaha wakati uliopita wala tangu ulipoanza kuzungumza na mtumishi wako. Ulimi wangu ni mzito kuzungumza.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Omonene, “Koranche, Omonene one, inche tindi Omokuani omuya, nonya nkorwa kare, gose korwa riria gwachaagete gokwana nainche, omosomba oo. Oromeme rwane nororito na nigo ingotutura.”

English: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
Kiswahili: Akajenga mji pande zote, kuanzia kwenye mito hadi kwenye ukuta kuzunguka, wakati huo huo Yoabu akajenga sehemu zingine zilizobaki za Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio akaagacha omochie goetanana onsi korwa Milo, okaba egesingo kegima; na Yoabu akaroisia omochie ase konya otagokire.

English: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni, Gadieli mwana wa Sodi,
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Gadieli, mosinto o Sodi;

English: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
Kiswahili: Hezro, Mkarmeli; Paarai, Mwarbi;
Ekegusii: Hesiro korwa Karimeli na Paarai korwa Ariba;

English: It was reported to Solomon: “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon, and he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon first swear to me not to put his servant to the sword.’”
Kiswahili: Kisha Solomoni akaambiwa, “Adoniya anamwogopa Mfalme Solomoni na ameshikilia pembe za madhabahu. Anasema, ‘Mfalme Solomoni na aniapie leo kwamba hatamuua mtumishi wake kwa upanga.’ ”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agateebigwa ng’a Adonia omoirokire na obwatire ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero, ogoteeba: “Ritang’ani tiga omorwoti Sulemani andiere eira y’ogotiana ng’a takong’ita inche, omosomba oye, n’omoro.”

English: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; wail, O ministers of the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, O ministers of my God, because the grain and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.
Kiswahili: Vaeni nguo ya gunia, enyi makuhani, muomboleze; pigeni yowe, enyi mnaohudumu madhabahuni. Njooni, vaeni nguo ya gunia usiku kucha, enyi mnaohudumu mbele za Mungu wangu; kwa kuwa sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zimezuiliwa kufika katika nyumba ya Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakuani, eboyie chigunia, morere, nainwe abakoreri b’egesasiimero, bokia amagombo! Eboyie chigunia, morere ase Hekalu ime ase obotuko bwonsi, ekiagera okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biaborire, ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari akamwambia, “Bwana, mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.
Ekegusii: Oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.

English: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
Kiswahili: Akasafisha sehemu za ndani na miguu, akaviteketeza juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Agasibia chinyama chi'enda amo nebirenge, erio akabisaambera amo n'ekengwanso ki'ogosaambwa ase egesasiimero.

English: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
Kiswahili: “Hapa ndipo penye wito wa akili pamoja na hekima. Vile vichwa saba ni vilima saba ambavyo huyo mwanamke amevikalia.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao korabe okomanya okore nobong'aini. Emetwe eria etano na ebere nebitunwa bitano na bibere, aase omokungu oria aikaransete.

English: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
Kiswahili: Lakini walikuwa hawana watoto, kwa sababu Elizabeti alikuwa tasa; nao wote wawili walikuwa wazee sana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge nomwana, ekiagera Elisabeti nigo arenge omogomba, na barabwo bonsi babere konya bagotire mono.

English: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mtumishi wako; nipe ufahamu ili niweze kuelewa sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo, ing’a okomanya, erinde ’manye oborori bwao.

English: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
Kiswahili: mmoja wenu akamwambia, “Enenda zako kwa amani, ukaote moto na kushiba,” pasipo kumpatia yale mahitaji ya mwili aliyopungukiwa, yafaa nini?
Ekegusii: na omonto onde oino amoteebie, “Genda nomorembe, bwote omorero, oigote”, korende tamoa ebiaganetie ase omobere oye, naki aramokonye?

English: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!” The Demons and the Pigs (Mark 5:1–20; Luke 8:26–39)
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakashangaa, wakisema, “Ni mtu wa namna gani huyu? Hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii!” Wawili Wenye Pepo Waponywa (Marko 5:1-20; Luka 8:26-39)
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateeba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?” Yeso okogwenia Abageraseni abwo Ebirecha biabwatete (Mar 5:1-20; Luk 8:26-39)

English: Again, it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
Kiswahili: Tena yasema, “Enyi watu wa Mataifa, furahini pamoja na watu wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Abanto b’Ebisaku, goka amo n’abanto ba n’Omonene.”

English: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka yake, naye atamchinja mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Kisha wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
Ekegusii: Ere goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’ondi eyio akorua ebe ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyeenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Aroni basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: “Separate yourselves from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.”
Kiswahili: “Jitengeni kutoka kwenye kusanyiko hili ili nipate kuwaangamiza mara moja.”
Ekegusii: “Tigera, morue ase abanto b’omoganda oyo, erinde mbasirie ara rimo.”

English: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.” “Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.
Kiswahili: Ruthu, Mmoabu, akamwambia Naomi, “Nitakwenda mashambani nikaokote mabaki ya nafaka nyuma ya yule nitakayepata kibali machoni pake.” Naomi akamwambia, “Nenda, binti yangu.”
Ekegusii: Rutu, oria Omomoabu, agateebia Naomi, “Ntige ngende gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo bw’omonto orang’e ribaga nkore bo.” Naomi akamoiraneria, “Genda, mwana one!”

English: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
Kiswahili: katika maarifa, kiasi; katika kiasi, saburi; katika saburi, utauwa;
Ekegusii: na ase chisemi obweriti, na ase obweriti oboremereria, na ase oboremereria chingencho chi’obonyasae,

English: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
Kiswahili: Wao si waaminifu kwa Bwana; wamezaa watoto haramu. Sasa sikukuu zao za Mwandamo wa Mwezi zitawaangamiza wao pamoja na mashamba yao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibabete abegenwa ase Omonene. Nigo baiborete abana batari abaye. Ase ayio, emeyega y’Omotienyi Omoyia nebasirie amo nemeganda yabo. Esegi ase egati y’Abayuda na Abaisraeli

English: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land: “There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
Kiswahili: Sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi Waisraeli, kwa sababu Bwana analo shtaka dhidi yenu ninyi mnaoishi katika nchi: “Hakuna uaminifu, hakuna upendo, hakuna kumjua Mungu katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera obeeigwe nabamenyete ase ense eye: “Obwegenwa gose obwanchani tibori aroro, na abanto b’ense eye tibamomanyeti Nyasae.

English: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
Kiswahili: Basi Mesha mfalme wa Moabu akafuga kondoo, naye akawa ampatie mfalme wa Israeli wana-kondoo 100,000 pamoja na sufu ya kondoo dume 100,000.
Ekegusii: Bono Mesha, omorwoti o Moabu, nigo arenge omotugi bwe ching'ondi, na kera omwaka nigo arenge korua ebango ase omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, chimanwa chi'eching'ondi chilifu rigana erimo (100,000), naende amarionya e chimingichi chilifu rigana erimo (100,000).
