English: Then he shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,
Kiswahili: Atayaondoa mafuta yote ya fahali huyo wa sadaka ya dhambi, mafuta yale yanayofunika sehemu za ndani au zile zinazounganika nazo,
Ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eria y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime,

English: Now I will tell you what I am about to do to My vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be consumed; I will tear down its wall, and it will be trampled.
Kiswahili: Sasa nitawaambia lile nitakalolitendea shamba langu la mizabibu: Nitaondoa uzio wake, nalo litaharibiwa, nitabomoa ukuta wake, nalo litakanyagwa.
Ekegusii: Bono nkobateebia inde eki ngochia gokora ase omogondo oyio one bw’emesabibu: Nintagore orobago rwaye, ntagore na orwaki rwaye, na omogondo oyio obe okorisigwa na gotiringwa.

English: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
Kiswahili: Wakawaendea viongozi wa makuhani na wazee na kusema, “Tumejifunga pamoja kwa kiapo kwamba hatutakula wala kunywa mpaka tuwe tumemuua Paulo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka, bakaboora: “Ntwatiananetie bokong'u ng'a titoria gento goika twaitire Paulo.

English: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ingawa katika Kristo ningeweza kuwa na ujasiri na kukuagiza yale yakupasayo kutenda,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ninde noboremu obonge buna momura omino ase Kristo kogochika eri ogwenerete okore.

English: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Yerusalemu, Yesu akaingia katika eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza humo ndani. Akazipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadilisha fedha, na pia viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa,
Ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu. Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ime, agachaaka goseria abanto abarenge koonia na kogora aroro, agaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare goonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma;

English: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don't be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
Kiswahili: “Jiandae! Simama useme chochote nitakachokuamuru. Usiwaogope, la sivyo nitakufanya uwaogope wao.
Ekegusii: Korende aye kabe omoremu, oimoke, ogende obateebie amang'ana onsi nkogochika. Tobaisa koboboa. Oise koboboa, inche nigo ndakwoboyie ase amasio abo.

English: and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
Kiswahili: Mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,
Ekegusii: Omwana oye omomura omotangi nere Abidoni; na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Nadabu,

English: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this. Who Is the Greatest?
Kiswahili: Wakaanza kuulizana wenyewe ni nani miongoni mwao angeweza kufanya jambo hilo. Mabishano Kuhusu Ukuu
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, gose ning’o ase bare orakore ring’ana eri. Obonene bw’ekeene

English: Before the day breaks and shadows flee, turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of Bether.
Kiswahili: Mpaka jua linapochomoza, na vivuli vikimbie, rudi, mpenzi wangu, na uwe kama paa, au kama ayala kijana juu ya vilima vya Betheri.
Ekegusii: Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, aye omwanchi one, onchoka gocha ase ’nde, ominyoke buna engabi, gose buna ensune ensae igoro ase egetunwa kere chinchwara.

English: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa watu wadogo kwa umri kuniliko wananidhihaki, watu ambao baba zao ningekataa kwa dharau kuwaweka pamoja na mbwa wangu wa kulinda kondoo.
Ekegusii: Korende bono abanto bare abake ase 'nde, nigo bagonsekerera, abwo abaise babo batagwenereti kende, anga ntababegete nonya nase egati ye chisese chikorenda amaicho aane.

English: You are to furnish him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. You shall give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you.
Kiswahili: Mpe kwa uhuru kutoka zizi lako la kondoo na mbuzi, kutoka sakafu yako ya kupuria nafaka na kutoka mashinikizo yako ya kukamulia divai. Mpe kama vile ambavyo Bwana Mungu wako alivyokubariki.
Ekegusii: Omoe ching’ondi kore n’omoyo omorabu, omoe n’endagera, n’edivai, koreng’ana buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, agosesenirie.

English: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.
Kiswahili: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye miiba ni mfano wa wale wanaosikia, lakini wanapoendelea husongwa na masumbufu ya maisha haya, utajiri na anasa, nao hawakui.
Ekegusii: Na echio chiagwete ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoriigwa, na barabwo kobakogenderera bamigwa nokorengereria kw'enibo, na omogooko bw'ense eye, tibakwama ase ogoikerania.

English: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
Kiswahili: naye akatawala katika Yerusalemu miaka arobaini na mmoja. Bibi yake aliitwa Maaka binti Abishalomu.
Ekegusii: Ere akaba okogaamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina Asa nigo are korokwa Maaka, mosubati bw’Abisalomu.

English: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akashuka na kujizamisha ndani ya Yordani mara saba, kama vile huyo mtu wa Mungu alivyokuwa amemwambia, nayo nyama ya mwili wake ikapona na kutakasika kama ya mwili wa mvulana mdogo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agatirimboka, agasoa ase orooche rwa Yorodani ara gatano na kabere, buna omonto oria o Nyasae amotebetie. Omobere oye okairanerana okaba buna oyo bw'omwana omoke, ere agacheneka.

English: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
Kiswahili: na Sadoki, kijana shujaa na hodari, aliyekuwa pamoja na maafisa ishirini na wawili kutoka jamaa yake.
Ekegusii: na Zadoki, omomura etuoni, amo nabaanto bamwabo abatang’ani b’esegi emerongo ebere, na babere (22).

English: How the cattle groan! The herds wander in confusion because they have no pasture. Even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
Kiswahili: Jinsi gani ngʼombe wanavyolia! Makundi ya mifugo yanahangaika kwa sababu hawana malisho; hata makundi ya kondoo yanateseka.
Ekegusii: Rigereria chitugo buna chikwana chichandegete, amaicho e chiombe achandekire, ekiagera obonyansi bwaborire chikorisia, nonya namaicho e ching’ondi achandekire.

English: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
Kiswahili: liko wapi basi tarajio langu? Ni nani awezaye kuona tarajio lolote kwa ajili yangu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ng’ai rende ogosemeria kwane kore? Ning’o oranyare gokorora?

English: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and thorns and briers will grow up. I will command the clouds that rain shall not fall on it.”
Kiswahili: Nitalifanya nchi ya ukiwa isiyokaliwa na watu, halitakatiwa matawi wala kulimwa, nayo michongoma na miiba itamea huko, nitaamuru mawingu yasinyeshe mvua juu yake.”
Ekegusii: Ninyotige ogenderere gosareka; emesabibu tegososwa gose koburugerwa; amageri na amagwa mbikineo na koyotuba; boigo ninchike amare tayotweria embura.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana na akujibu unapokuwa katika dhiki, jina la Mungu wa Yakobo na liwe kinga yako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Tiga Omonene aigwe ogosaba kwao ase engaki y'emechando. Erieta ria Nyasae o Yakobo rikorende.

English: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,' saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;
Kiswahili: maneno niliyowaamuru baba zenu nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka tanuru la kuyeyushia vyuma.' Nilisema, ‘Nitiini mimi na mfanye kila kitu ninachowaamuru, nanyi mtakuwa watu wangu, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: nachigete chisokoro chiaino, ekero nachirusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko rigosamba. Nigo nabateebeetie ng'a kobaranyigwere na bakore onsi aya nabachigete, erio nario baare gocha koba abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.

English: And it shall be the prince’s part to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings for the feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths—for all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Huu utakuwa ndio wajibu wa mkuu anayetawala kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji kwenye sikukuu, Mwezi Mwandamo na Sabato, kwenye sikukuu zote zilizoamriwa za nyumba ya Israeli. Atatoa sadaka za dhambi, sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nigo erabe emeremo y’omogaambi arue ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa, ase Amatuko Amanene, na ase emeyega y’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ase Chisabato, engencho yaye Amatuko Amanene achiikire ase Abaisraeli. Ere narue ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.” Amatuko Amanene (Okong’ 12:1-20; Abal 23:33-43)

English: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akawageukia wanafunzi wake akanena nao faraghani, akawaambia, “Heri macho yanayoona yale mambo mnayoyaona.
Ekegusii: Akaonchokera aborokigwa baye, akabateebia bobisi, “Nasesenirie amaiso aya arorire ayamwarorire inwe!

English: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
Kiswahili: katika siku ya ishirini na nne mwezi wa sita, katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akorekanete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario.

English: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.
Kiswahili: Mwili wake ulikuwa kama kito cha zabarajadi safi, uso wake kama umeme wa radi, macho yake kama mwali wa moto, mikono yake na miguu yake kama mngʼao wa shaba iliyosuguliwa sana, nayo sauti yake kama ya umati mkubwa wa watu.
Ekegusii: Omobere oye nigo orenge komeka‐meka buna berulo, rigena rie rigori rinene; obosio bwaye nigo bwarenge kororekana buna okomesa kw'embura, na amaiso aye nigo arenge gwoka buna ebieri bi'omorero. Amaboko na amagoro aye nigo arenge komeka‐meka buna etai yasenigwe. Eriogi ri'amang'ana aye nigo riarenge kwoga buna eri'emoganda y' abanto abange.

English: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”
Kiswahili: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa. Ninawaambia, hamtaniona tena mpaka wakati ule mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ere ritombe; na inche nabateebirie ng’a timokondora nonya ng’ake, goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri ’Omonene.”

English: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
Kiswahili: wakamuuliza, “Kama wewe si Kristo, wala si Eliya na wala si yule Nabii, kwa nini basi unabatiza?”
Ekegusii: Bakaboria Yohana, “Naki rende okobatisa, onye aye tori Kristo, gose Elija, gose omobani?”

English: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Matovu na matawi yote yatakuwa kitu kimoja na kile kinara cha taa, yakifuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Amamumu ayio amo ne chinsagia biroisigwe bibe egento ekemo ne ritina, bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase ribomba erimo ri'etaabu echenire esunyuntire.

English: But the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD,
Kiswahili: Watoto wakashindana tumboni mwake, akasema, “Kwa nini haya yanatokea kwangu?” Kwa hiyo akaenda kumuuliza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abana bakaba bakomigana enda yaye ime. Ere akabora: “Onye nabo iga, okoba moyo kwane ninki korangwenere?” Akagenda koboori’Omonene.

English: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?
Kiswahili: Ingekuwaje kama wengine hawakuwa na imani? Je, kutokuamini kwao kungebatilisha uaminifu wa Mungu?
Ekegusii: Inki rende onye abande tibari abegenwa? Inee! Ogotegenwa kwabo nakonyaare gokora obwegenwa bwa Nyasae bobe bosa?

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet:
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia nabii Yeremia kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia omobani, rikamoteebia,

English: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu kitasema maneno ya hekima, usemi wa moyo wangu utatoa ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Omonwa one nokwane amang'ana 'obong'aini, na ebirengererio bi'enkoro yane nigo birabe ebi'okomanya.

English: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
Kiswahili: Jitahidi kuja kwangu upesi
Ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha ase ’nde bwango.

English: But Moses replied: “It is neither the cry of victory nor the cry of defeat; I hear the sound of singing!”
Kiswahili: Mose akajibu: “Si sauti ya ushindi, wala si sauti ya kushindwa; ni sauti ya kuimba ninayosikia.”
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Eriogi eri tiriri eri’abaanto babuire esegi, gose eri’okorera kw’abaanto babuirwe, korende eriogi naigure neri’abaanto bagotera.”

English: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
Kiswahili: Magpiashi, Meshulamu, Heziri,
Ekegusii: Magipiasi, na Mesulamu, na Hesiri;

English: The Philistines stood on one hill and the Israelites stood on another, with the valley between them.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawa katika kilima kimoja na Waisraeli katika kilima kingine, hilo bonde likiwa kati yao.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagatenena ase egetunwa ekemo, na Abaisraeli ase ekende, ne rikura ndiareenge ase egati yabo.

English: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
Kiswahili: Amani na iwepo ndani ya kuta zako na usalama ndani ya ngome zako.”
Ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase chindwaki chiao ime, na ogosesenigwa kobe ase chinyomba chiao chi'oborwoti.

English: O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Israel, whom you likened to a firstborn.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uwahurumie watu walioitwa kwa jina lako, na Israeli, uliowafananisha na mzaliwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Basenyente abanene ba ababisa bao abwo bagoteeba; “Onde taiyo naende otatiga intwe abanyene!”

English: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana alipomtokea Gideoni, akamwambia, “ Bwana yu pamoja nawe, Ewe shujaa mwenye nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera agwo, akamoteebia, “Omonene nigo are amo naye, aye omonto omoremu ase okorwana esegi!”

English: He went down into the plain of Damascus in the days of wheat harvest, and set all their fields on fire, and utterly destroyed their flocks and herds, plundered their cities, laid their plains waste, and struck all their young men with the edge of the sword.
Kiswahili: Alishuka hadi uwanda wa Damasko siku za mavuno ya ngano, akawasha moto mashamba yao yote, akaharibu kabisa makundi yao ya kondoo na ng'ombe, akapora miji yao, akaharibu uwanda wao, na kuwaua vijana wao wote kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Holoferne akagenda ase ense yomweya chibebekaine omochie o Damesiki na nigo biarenge ebiro biokogesa engaano. Agasaamba endagera yonsi ase emegondo yaabo naboigo agaita abamura baabo bonsi na gosakora obotenenku bwabo nobwechinse chionsi chibebekaine anseemo eyio.

English: He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.
Kiswahili: Petro alipobisha hodi kwenye lango la nje, mtumishi wa kike jina lake Roda, akaja kumfungulia.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Petero achia gotura egesieri kia geita, omoiseke omosomba, okorokwa Roda, agaacha koigwa.

English: Yahweh, don't grant the desires of the wicked. Don't let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, usiwape waovu matakwa yao, usiache mipango yao ikafanikiwa, wasije wakajisifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, tobaisa koa abakori amabe aya baganetie; tobaisa gosesenia emeroberio yaabo emebe, baabaise gwetogia.

English: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
Kiswahili: Usiku na mchana mkono wako ulinilemea, nguvu zangu zilinyonywa kama vile katika joto la kiangazi.
Ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko okoboko kwao gokanditoera negesusuro; chinguru chiane chikaera buna amaache akoera ekero ki’egurugura.

English: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
Kiswahili: “Baba yake akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, umekuwa nami siku zote na vyote nilivyo navyo ni vyako.
Ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: Omwana one, aye amatuko onsi nigo ore amo nainche, na ebinto bionsi inde nabirobio nebiao.

English: Holofernes took great delight in her, and drank exceedingly much wine, more than he had drunk at any time in one day since he was born.
Kiswahili: Holoferne alifurahi sana naye, akakunywa divai nyingi sana, zaidi ya aliyokuwa amekunywa wakati wowote katika siku moja tangu kuzaliwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Holoferne akamogookera mono erio akanywa edivai enyinge kobua ende yonsi konya ere atanakonywa ase ekero ekemo korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye.

English: all the kings of Zimri, Elam, and Media;
Kiswahili: wafalme wote wa Zimri, Elamu na Umedi;
Ekegusii: abarwoti bonsi ba Simuri, na Elamu, na Media;

English: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima: Shamiri, Yatiri, Soko,
Ekegusii: Na ase ense y'ebitunwa nigo yarengeo: Samiri, na Yatiri, na Soko,

English: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
Kiswahili: Vaeni viatu, lakini msivae nguo ya ziada.”
Ekegusii: Korende babeeke ebikoroto, ko tibeboyia chianga ibere.

English: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
Kiswahili: Udongo ulio bondeni ni mtamu kwake; watu wote watamfuata, nao umati wa watu usiohesabika umemtangulia.
Ekegusii: Amaroba erigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa magega, na omobaro bw'abamotang'anerete tori kobareka.

English: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja hujifanya tajiri, kumbe hana chochote; mwingine hujifanya maskini, kumbe ana utajiri mwingi.
Ekegusii: Omonto nare ogwekora ng'a n'omonda are, korende nigo are omotaka, na oyonde bwekora ng'a nomotaka are, korende nigo are omonda mono.

English: But as soon as he is established, his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the authority with which he ruled, because his kingdom will be uprooted and given to others.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kujitokeza, milki yake itavunjwa na kugawanyika katika pande nne za mbinguni. Hautakwenda kwa wazao wake, wala hautakuwa na nguvu alizotumia, kwa sababu milki yake itangʼolewa na kupewa wengine.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omorwoti oyio aranyore chinguru chinene, oborwoti bwaye mbosareke bwatananeke ase chinsemo inye chi’ense, tibokoegwa abanto b’ororeria rw’aye, tibokoba nokobua buna koria ere abwate. Oborwoti bwaye mbotegorwe boegwe abanto abaao.

English: And when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, “If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us. Paul and Silas Imprisoned
Kiswahili: Basi alipokwisha kubatizwa yeye na watu wa nyumba yake, alitukaribisha nyumbani kwake akisema, “Kama mmeona kweli mimi nimemwamini Bwana, karibuni mkae nyumbani mwangu.” Naye akatushawishi. Paulo Na Sila Watiwa Gerezani
Ekegusii: Goika omokungu oria ochia kobatiswa, ere amo nab’enyomba yaye, agatosorora na gotobetereria ogoteeba: “Onye mwandorire ng’a n’omwegeni nde ase Omonene, soa nyomba mwane, moikaranse.”

English: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
Kiswahili: Hushamu alipofariki, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyeshinda Midiani katika nchi ya Moabu, akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Avithi.
Ekegusii: Husamu nere agakwa, na Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye; oyo nere obuete Abamidiani, ase ense ya Moabu na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Aviti.

English: And some years later he went down to visit Ahab in Samaria, where Ahab sacrificed many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him, and urged him to march up to Ramoth-gilead.
Kiswahili: Baada ya miaka kadhaa akashuka kumtembelea Ahabu huko Samaria. Ahabu akachinja ngʼombe na kondoo wengi kwa ajili yake na watu aliokuwa amefuatana nao. Kisha Ahabu akamshawishi Yehoshafati kukwea pamoja naye ili kuishambulia Ramoth-Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka emeke akagenda ase Ahabu agwo Samaria. Nere akanyenyera Yehosafati, amo nabaanto barenge amo nere, ching’ondi chinyinge ne chiombe; erio akamoebereria agende amo nere korwania Ramoti o Gileadi.

English: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim, and Israel was in deep distress.
Kiswahili: Waamoni nao wakavuka Yordani ili kupigana na Yuda, Benyamini na nyumba ya Efraimu, nayo nyumba ya Israeli ikawa katika taabu kubwa.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio, Abaamoni bakaamboka Yorodani gochia korwania Abayuda, n’Ababenjamini, n’Abaefraimu, goika Abaisraeli bagaachaandwa bobe mono.

English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie yale ambayo Roho ayaambia makanisa.
Ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring'ana eri Omoika ogoteebia chikanisa.

English: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
Kiswahili: Kisha weka kikombe changu kile cha fedha kwenye mdomo wa gunia la yule mdogo wa wote pamoja na fedha zake ambazo angenunulia nafaka yake.” Naye akafanya kama Yosefu alivyosema.
Ekegusii: Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y'omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chitaabu chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.

English: Do not allow what you consider good, then, to be spoken of as evil.
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu kile ambacho unakiona kuwa chema kisemwe kuwa ni kiovu.
Ekegusii: Timotiga ayare amaya ase more atorwe ng’a n’amabe.

English: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
Kiswahili: hadi Bwana atazame chini kutoka mbinguni na kuona.
Ekegusii: goika ekero Omonene ararigererie korwa igoro na arore ayio onsi.

English: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Lakini, “Yeye ajisifuye na ajisifu katika Bwana.”
Ekegusii: “Korende ere oyogwetogia tiga etogie ase Omonene.”

English: Therefore I made a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikaagiza kwamba watu wote wenye hekima wa Babeli waletwe mbele yangu kunifasiria ndoto yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkarua ogochika ng'a abanto abang'aini bonsi ba Babiloni barentwe ase obosio bwane, erinde banteebie engencho ye chindoto chiria.

English: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
Kiswahili: Hivyo semeni na kutenda kama watu watakaohukumiwa kwa sheria ile iletayo uhuru.
Ekegusii: Kwana bo, na kora boigo, buna abanto barache kogambigwa ase amachiiko obosibore.

English: And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in my father David’s place. But I am only a little child, not knowing how to go out or come in.
Kiswahili: “Sasa, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, umemfanya mtumishi wako mfalme badala ya baba yangu Daudi. Lakini mimi ni mtoto mdogo tu, wala sijui jinsi ya kutekeleza wajibu wangu.
Ekegusii: Na bono, Omonene, Nyasae one, aye gwankorire inche, omosomba oo, nabeire omorwoti ribaga ria Daudi tata, nonya inde omwana omoke. Timanyeti buna nkogamba na koraa.

English: This knowledge is beyond me. It's lofty. I can't attain it.
Kiswahili: Maarifa haya ni ya ajabu mno kwangu, ni ya juu sana kwangu kuyafikia.
Ekegusii: Okomanya okwo nigo kore okw'ogokumia ase 'nde; nigo kore okonene mono, tinkonyaara gokomanya.

English: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
Kiswahili: Maisha ni zaidi ya chakula, na mwili ni zaidi ya mavazi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obogima nobonene kobua endagera, na omobere nomonene kobua chianga.

English: But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akayatambua mawazo yao, naye akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha kando yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Yeso achia komanya ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo, akabogoria omwana, akamobeka ang’e asare,

English: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh's word.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yehoshafati pia akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, “Kwanza tafuta shauri la Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Naende Yehosafati agateebia omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, “Ritang'ani toborie Omonene igoro y'amang'ana aya.”

English: As for the priest who presents a burnt offering for anyone, the hide of that offering belongs to him.
Kiswahili: Kuhani anayetoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya mtu yeyote anaweza kuichukua ngozi ya mnyama yule aliyetolewa iwe yake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase engencho y’omonto onde, Omokuani oyio omonyene aire risankwa ri’ekeng’wanso keria ribe eriaye.

English: You know all things. You know, Lord, that it is not in insolence, nor arrogance, nor love of glory, that I have done this, to refuse to bow down to the arrogant Haman.
Kiswahili: Unajua mambo yote. Unajua, Bwana, kwamba si kwa kiburi, wala kwa majivuno, wala kwa kupenda utukufu, kwamba nimefanya hivi, kukataa kumsujudia Hamani mwenye kiburi.
Ekegusii: Ase okweinyoria emeremo emenene omomene akorete ere akagenda, agakora onsi buna Esiteri amochiigete. Omenene, Omonene, Omonguru Omworoti

English: My son, don't despise Yahweh's discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, usiidharau adhabu ya Bwana na usichukie kukaripiwa naye,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kwanga gose gochaaya okorongeyia kw'Omonene.

English: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia kwenye chombo, akavuka na kufika katika mji wa kwao.
Ekegusii: Agasoa obwato, akaamboka, agaika omochie oye.

English: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
Kiswahili: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.
Ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro ane abeire buna ay’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.

English: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
Kiswahili: Nihukumu kwa haki yako, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, sawasawa na haki yako; usiwaache wakusimange.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nacha ekiina kiane koreng’ana noboronge bwao, tobaisa gotiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane.

English: You will be fuel for the fire. Your blood will stain your own land. You will not be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.’”
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa kuni za kuwashia moto, damu yenu itamwagwa katika nchi yenu, wala hamtakumbukwa tena; kwa maana Mimi Bwana nimesema.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inwe mobe chinko chigouterwa omorero; amanyinga aino naiterwe igoro ase ense. Timokoinyorwa nonya ng’ake. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”

English: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.
Kiswahili: nitatuma moto juu ya kuta za Gaza ambao utateketeza ngome zake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Gasa; oro nosambe insirie chinyomba chinkong'u chi'aroro.

English: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo koo za Simeoni; walikuwa 22,200.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi'egesaku gia Simioni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere (22,200).

English: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Walionekana katika utukufu wakizungumza na Yesu kuhusu kifo chake ambacho kingetokea huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abwo barorekanete ase obonene, na gokwana amang'ana ay'ogokwa kwaye, aya agwenerete goikerania Yerusalemu.

English: we were careful that those who choose to read may be attracted, and that those who wish us well may find it easy to recall, and that all readers may benefit.
Kiswahili: Tulikuwa waangalifu kwamba wale wanaochagua kusoma wanaweza kuvutiwa, na kwamba wale wanaotutakia mema waweze kupata urahisi wa kukumbuka, na kwamba wasomaji wote waweze kunufaika.
Ekegusii: Bono inche natemire mono kwororobia amang'ana ase engencho y'abasomi: baria bagosoma ase okwegokia mbagoke, na baria batagete komanya igoro y'amang'ana akoregete tibakonyora mochando.

English: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.”'”
Kiswahili: Nitakuongezea miaka kumi na mitano katika maisha yako. Nami nitakuokoa wewe pamoja na mji huu mkononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru. Nitaulinda mji huu kwa ajili yangu, na kwa ajili ya mtumishi wangu Daudi!' ”
Ekegusii: Nimente emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao. Ningotoorie aye, amo nomochie oyo, korwa ase okoboko kw'omorwoti bw'Abaasuri; ning'egere omochie oyo ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”

English: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka basi ni wapi ulikoangukia! Tubu na ukafanye matendo yale ya kwanza. Kama usipotubu, nitakuja kwako na kukiondoa kinara chako cha taa kutoka mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, inyora nkorwa ase ki ogwete. Onchoka, okore ogokora kwao kw’eritang’ani! Otakoreti bo, ninchiche asore, ndusie ekebekerero kiao gie chitaaya korwa aase aye.

English: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife, and defile yourself with her.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mke wa jirani yako na kujitia naye unajisi.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara n'omokuungu bw'omosaacha onde na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nere.

English: Please go and prepare further. Investigate and watch carefully where he goes and who has seen him there, for I am told that he is extremely cunning.
Kiswahili: Nendeni mkafanye maandalizi zaidi. Mkajue mahali ambapo Daudi huenda mara kwa mara na nani amepata kumwona huko. Wananiambia yeye ni mwerevu sana.
Ekegusii: Genda morore na koenekia ase amenyete, naende ng’a ning’o omoororire oreo. Nateebigwe ng’a ere nigo are omwoge mono ase okong’ainereria.

English: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. You will die this year because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Hivi karibuni nitakuondoa kutoka juu ya uso wa dunia. Mwaka huu utakufa, kwa sababu umetangaza uasi dhidi ya Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyi’Omonene oteebire ng’a nagoite orue ase ense. Nokwe ase omwaka oyo, ekiagera gwakwanire amang’ana agerire abanto basaririe ase Omonene.”

English: And they themselves who fashioned them can never continue long. How then should the things that are fashioned by them?
Kiswahili: Na wao wenyewe walioviumba hawawezi kudumu kwa muda mrefu. Basi, vitu vilivyoumbwa nao vinapaswaje?
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga oborimo n'obosoku ase oroiboro rwabo.

English: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mngojee Bwana, uwe hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu, nawe, umngojee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Remereria oganye Omonene, kabe omoremu, tokwa omoyo; ee, remereria oganye Omonene!

English: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren't cleansed, you won't be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Sasa uchafu wako ni uasherati wako. Kwa sababu nilijaribu kukutakasa lakini haikuwezekana kutakaswa kutoka kwenye huo uchafu wako, hutatakasika tena mpaka ghadhabu yangu dhidi yako iwe imepungua.
Ekegusii: Kwabeire oyotachenegeti ase engencho y'obonyaka bwao. Nateemire kogochena, korende tochenegeti. Tokonyara gocheneka korwa ase ogotacheneka kwao goika inche ndete endamwamu y'ane igoro ase ore.

English: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.'
Kiswahili: Mfalme alipopita pale, yule nabii akamwita, “Mtumishi wako alikwenda vitani wakati vita vilipopamba moto, mtu mmoja akanijia na mateka akasema, ‘Mlinde mtu huyu. Kama akitoroka itakuwa uhai wako kwa uhai wake, ama vipande 3,000 vya fedha.'
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arenge goeta ase enchera eria, omobani oria akarera asare, akamoteebia: “Inche omosomba oo nagendete ase esegi, na rora, omorwani bw'esegi agacha akarentana omonto ase 'nde, aganteebia: Renda omonto oyo, aise gosira ase enchera ende yonsi, obogima bwao nabobe ribaga ri'obwaye, gose oakane rigori ri'etalanta eyemo y'efeta.

English: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Yakobo alipokuwa anakufa, alimbariki kila mmoja wa mtoto wa Yosefu, akamwabudu Mungu akiwa ameegemea juu ya kichwa cha fimbo yake.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yakobo, ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, agasesenia kera oyomo bw’abana ba Yusufu, agasasiima bwesiirerete enyimbo yaye.

English: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave's entrance, and set men by it to guard them;
Kiswahili: akasema, “Vingirisheni mawe makubwa kwenye mdomo wa hilo pango, tena wekeni walinzi wa kulilinda.
Ekegusii: agachiika, agateeba, “Turunkania amagena amanene, mosieke egesoero kie rikuruma, naende mobeeke abanto barende aroro.

English: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
Kiswahili: Nchi yao imejaa fedha na dhahabu, hakuna mwisho wa hazina zao. Nchi yao imejaa farasi, hakuna mwisho wa magari yao.
Ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chifeta ne chitaabu, ne chinibo chiabo tichiri nomoerio. Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chibarasi, ne chigari chiabo tichikoera.

English: For the land, where you go in to possess isn't like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;
Kiswahili: Nchi mnayoiingia kuimiliki haifanani na nchi ya Misri mlikotoka ambako mlipanda mbegu yenu na kuinywesha, kama bustani ya mboga.
Ekegusii: Ense eria mogochia gosoa moyeire teri buna ense ya Misiri agwo ase mwarwa. Aroro nigo mwarenge kobusura chimbusuro chiaino, naende mwakora emeremo y'ogosiarera amaache, buna mogosiarera amaache ase egeticha gie chinyeni.

English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie yale ambayo Roho ayaambia makanisa.”
Ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring'ana eri Omoika ogoteebia chikanisa.”

English: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Lakini msipoona vyema kumtumikia Bwana, chagueni hivi leo mtakayemtumikia, kama ni miungu ile ambayo baba zenu waliitumikia ngʼambo Frati, au miungu ya Waamori, ambao mnakaa katika nchi yao. Lakini mimi na nyumba yangu, tutamtumikia Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Kerabe timogokiri gokorera Omonene, rirorio mwechorere reero oyo mwanchete gokorera, onye ne chinyasae chiria chisokoro chiaino chiakorerete ng'umbu y'orooche rw'Eufarati, gose chinyasae chi'Abaamori, baria momenyete ase ense yabo. Korende inche amo nabaanto b'enyomba yane ntomokorere Omonene.”

English: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.
Kiswahili: “Enyi milima ya Gilboa, msipate umande wala mvua, wala mashamba yazaayo sadaka ya nafaka. Kwa maana huko ndiko ngao ya mwenye nguvu iliponajisiwa, ngao ya Sauli haitapakwa tena mafuta.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ebigoro bia Giliboa, ogotoora kwe riime tikoba igoro ase more, gose embura tetwa, gose emegondo teeba ekwama endagera ekoruegwa ase Omonene, ekiagera aroro agwo nao chinguba chie chituoni chiasareretigwe, na enguba ya Saulo etaagetwe amaguta naende.

English: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
Kiswahili: Lakini wafu wenu wataishi, nayo miili yao itafufuka. Ninyi mnaokaa katika mavumbi, amkeni mkapige kelele kwa furaha. Umande wenu ni kama umande wa asubuhi, dunia itawazaa wafu wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto baino bakwete mbabe moyo naende; emebere y'abakwete neboke. Inwe abwo moraire ase amaroba ime, boka, motere nomogooko! Riime riao nigo rire eri'oborabu; riroba ndibairanie abakwete.

English: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa Mafarisayo walipomwona akila pamoja na watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi,” wakawauliza wanafunzi wake: “Mbona Yesu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi'?”
Ekegusii: Aborokia b'amariiko na Abafarisai bagachia komoorora okoria amo n'abanyene ebibe na abarusia ebango, bagateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki akoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”

English: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice.
Kiswahili: Kufanya yaliyo sawa na haki inakubalika zaidi kwa Bwana kuliko dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing’wanso.

English: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ladani walikuwa watatu: Yehieli wa kwanza, Zethamu na Yoeli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ladani nabwo aba batato: Yehieli, omoteneneri obo, na Setamu, na Yoel.

English: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
Kiswahili: Wakati jua lilipokuwa linatua, Abramu akashikwa na usingizi mzito, giza nene na la kutisha likaja juu yake.
Ekegusii: Erioba ko riabeire ang'e kogwa, Aburamu akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito, na obwoba obonene mono bokamosoa.

English: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
Kiswahili: Uzao wake na ukatiliwe mbali, majina yao yafutike katika kizazi kifuatacho.
Ekegusii: Tiga ororeeria rwaye rosirigwe, na erieta riaye riebwe kegima ase ekiare gia kabere.

English: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.
Kiswahili: “Watu wangu wamekuwa kondoo waliopotea; wachungaji wao wamewapotosha na kuwasababisha kuzurura juu ya milima. Walitangatanga juu ya mlima na kilima, na kusahau mahali pao wenyewe pa kupumzikia.
Ekegusii: “Abanto baane babeire buna ching'ondi chinsiru. Abarisia babo baabasiririe, ekiagera babeire bakona‐kobaong'anyia ase ebitunwa. Nigo bakona‐koong'anya buna ching'ondi, bakobaetanania korwa ase ebitunwa goika ase ebigoro; ase igo abanto baane bebire obweri bwabo.

English: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza upembe kwenye kila pembe ya hizo pembe nne, ili zile pembe na madhabahu ziwe zimeungana, na ufunike madhabahu kwa shaba.
Ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi'egesasiimero oroisie emegwekano ye ching'unchara inye. Ching'unchara echio nigo chirabe egento ekemo negesasiimero; oome gionsi netai.

English: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:
Kiswahili: Mnajua yale yaliyotukia katika Uyahudi wote kuanzia Galilaya baada ya mahubiri ya Yohana Mbatizaji:
Ekegusii: Inwe momanyete, ng’a ring’ana eri riaraaretigwe ase Boyahudi yonsi, rigachaakera Galili magega y’ebatiso eria Yohana arandetie,

English: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, tukajiandaa, tukaondoka kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Magega ase amatuko ayio tokeebeka ang'e togatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: So they approached the king and asked about his royal decree: “Did you not sign a decree that for thirty days any man who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions?” The king replied, “According to the law of the Medes and Persians the order stands, and it cannot be repealed.”
Kiswahili: Basi wakaenda kwa mfalme na kusema naye kuhusu amri ya mfalme: “Je, hukutangaza amri kwamba kwa muda huu wa siku thelathini zijazo mtu yeyote ambaye atamwomba mungu au mwanadamu yeyote isipokuwa wewe, ee mfalme, angetupwa ndani ya tundu la simba?” Mfalme akajibu, “Amri ndivyo ilivyo, kulingana na sheria za Wamedi na Waajemi, ambazo haziwezi kubatilishwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakagenda ase omorwoti, bakamobooria igoro ye richiiko riria: “Aye omorwoti, Inee! Tikwabeka ekemanyererio kiao ase richiiko riria, ogateeba ng’a ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato monto onde bwensi orasasiime enyasae ende eng’ao, gose omonto onde, otatiga aye bweka aye omorwoti, oyio arutwe ase engoro ye chindo?” Omorwoti akairaneria, “Ee, richiiko erio nigo riteneine bokong’u ritaonchorwe, koreng’ana buna amachiiko y’Abamedi na Abaayemi atari koonchorwa.”

English: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
Kiswahili: Tunda la mwenye haki ni mti wa uzima, naye mwenye hekima huvuta roho za watu.
Ekegusii: Okwama kw’omonyaboronge nigo kore omote bw’obogima, nere oyokong’usa emioyo y’abanto n’omonto omong’aini.

English: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn't recognize him.
Kiswahili: Ingawa Yosefu aliwatambua ndugu zake, wao hawakumtambua.
Ekegusii: Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.

English: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to their former state. You and your daughters will also return to your former state.
Kiswahili: Nao dada zako, Sodoma na binti zake na Samaria na binti zake, watarudishwa kama vile walivyokuwa mwanzoni, nawe pamoja na binti zako mtarudishwa kama mlivyokuwa hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Aya naro arabe ase abasubati bamino: Sodomu na abaiseke baye nabairanerigwe amaya abo, babe buna barenge ritang’ani, na Samaria na abaiseke baye mbairanerigwe amaya abo, babe buna barenge ritang’ani. Naye boigo na abaiseke bao moiranerigwe amaya aino, mobe buna mwarenge ritang’ani.

English: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
Kiswahili: Ahinadabu mwana wa Ido: katika Mahanaimu;
Ekegusii: Ahinadabu, mosinto o Ido, agatenenera orogongo rwa Mahanaimu.

English: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nitasamehe uovu wao, wala sitazikumbuka dhambi zao tena!”
Ekegusii: Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”

English: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”
Kiswahili: Akawaeleza yale Mika aliyomtendea, naye akasema, “Ameniajiri nami ni kuhani wake.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Aya naro Mika ankoreire: Nigo andigete, akong'a eng'eria, na inche nigo inde Omokuani oye.”

English: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
Kiswahili: “Msishangae kusikia haya, kwa maana saa inakuja ambapo wale walio makaburini wataisikia sauti yake.
Ekegusii: Timokumia ase aya! Naki ensa ngocha ere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbeera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye,

English: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
Kiswahili: Nililiandikia kanisa, lakini Deotrefe, yeye apendaye kujifanya wa kwanza, hakubali mamlaka yetu.
Ekegusii: Nabarikerete abekanisa amang’ana, korende Dioterefe, oyobwanchete koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase bare, tatwancheti.

English: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
Kiswahili: “Ni kama vile nilivyomwambia Farao: Mungu amemwonyesha Farao jambo analokusudia kufanya karibuni.
Ekegusii: Aya naro buna nagoteebia aye Farao, ng'a Nyasae okworokirie aya agochia gokora iga bwango.

English: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitawaaibisha wakuu wa Hekalu lako, nami nitamtoa Yakobo aangamizwe, na Israeli adhihakiwe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiga abanene b’Aase Achenu bakaba abatachenegeti, nkarua abanto ba Yakobo bakaba okoragererigwa, ee, nkarua Abaisraeli ase ogochaywa.

English: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don't you know what these things mean?' Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.
Kiswahili: “Waambie nyumba hii ya kuasi, ‘Je, mnajua hii ina maana gani?' Waambie: ‘Mfalme wa Babeli alikwenda Yerusalemu na kumchukua mfalme na watu maarufu, akarudi nao na kuwaleta mpaka Babeli.
Ekegusii: “Boria egesaku eke getari koigwera: Timomanyeti engencho y'amang'ana aya? Bateebie: Rora, omorwoti o Babiloni nachete Yerusalemu, akaira omorwoti na abagaambi b'aroro goika Babiloni.

English: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
Kiswahili: kwa maana wamemrarua Yakobo na kuharibu nchi ya makao yake.
Ekegusii: Naki abanto abwo basiririe abanto b'ororeria rwa Yakobo, naende basaririe aase bamenyete.

English: For they can neither curse nor bless kings.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hawawezi kuwalaani wala kuwabariki wafalme.
Ekegusii: Tichikonyara gokorera chinse kemanyererio kende gionsi igoro ase amare; tichikonyara kobara buna risase gose omotienyi.

English: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
Kiswahili: na Reseni, iliyo kati ya Ninawi na Kala; huo ndio mji mkubwa.
Ekegusii: na Reseni, omochie omonene oyorenge egati ya Ninawi na Kala.

English: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely, but there is no further injury, he shall surely be fined as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows.
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na wakamuumiza mwanamke mjamzito, naye akazaa kabla ya wakati lakini hakuna majeraha makubwa, mhalifu atatozwa mali kiasi cha madai ya mume wa yule mwanamke, na jinsi mahakama itakavyoamua.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abasacha kobarabe bakorwana, na kogwera omokungu ore morito, na oborito bwaye bogwe, korende atabeti na bobe bonde, omonto oria omogwerete goika aakane buna omosacha bw’omokuungu oria araborie magega abagaambi kobanachire ekiina.

English: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose huko Midiani, “Rudi Misri kwa maana watu wote waliotaka kukuua wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa konya atararwa aaria Midiani, Omonene akamoteebia, “Irana gochia Misiri, ekiagera baria bonsi barigetie obogima bwao bakuure.”

English: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn't sow, and gathering where you didn't scatter.
Kiswahili: “Kisha yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta moja akaja, akasema, ‘Bwana, nilijua kwamba wewe ni mtu mgumu, unayevuna mahali usipopanda na kukusanya mahali usipotawanya mbegu.
Ekegusii: Na oria oetwe etalanta eyemo agacha, akabora: Omonene, nakomanyete ng'a nigo ore omonto omokong'u, okogesa aase otasimegete, na gosangereria aase otabusurete;

English: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ninyi ni watu wenye shingo ngumu. Kama ningefuatana nanyi hata kwa muda mfupi, ningewaangamiza. Sasa vueni mapambo yenu, nami nitaamua nitakalowatendea.' ”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa “Bateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe nabanyabigoti bikong'u. Inse kogenda amo nainwe, nonya netagika eyemo, nigo ndabasirie kegima. Gaki bono rusia ebinto biaino ebi mwechaberete, erio ndore inki ndabakorere.”

English: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yehoyakini akayavua mavazi yake ya mfungwa, na siku zote za maisha yake zilizobaki alikula mezani mwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Yehoyakini akaonchoreria chianga chiaye chi'obosibwa, na kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi akaba okoragera nomorwoti.

English: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
Kiswahili: Ee Samaria, tupilieni mbali sanamu yenu ya ndama! Hasira yangu inawaka dhidi yao. Watakuwa najisi mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Aye Samaria, omogwekano oria bw'emori ore ase egati yao yabeire okogechia ase 'nde. Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y'abanto abwo. Ngoika ririri baragenderere koba iga bataracheneka?

English: Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
Kiswahili: Wala si Adamu aliyedanganywa, bali ni mwanamke aliyedanganywa akawa mkosaji.
Ekegusii: Na Adamu tang'ainetwe, korende nomokuungu ong'ainetwe, na igo akaba omomochi.

English: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utafahamu lipi lililo kweli na haki na sawa: yaani kila njia nzuri.
Ekegusii: Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayaare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chiinchera chionsi chire chingiya,

English: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David. David’s Family Grows (1 Chronicles 14:1–7)
Kiswahili: Basi Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akawatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi, wakiwa na magogo ya mierezi, maseremala na waashi, nao wakajenga jumba la kifalme kwa ajili ya Daudi.
Ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abanto ase Daudi. Abwo bakamoirera emete y’emecharake. Boigo agatoma abaabaachi, na abaagachi, na barabwo bakamoagaachera enyomba.

English: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
Kiswahili: Siku moja baada ya kuuawa kwa siri kwa Gedalia, kabla mtu yeyote hajafahamu jambo hilo,
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Gedalia gaitirwe, na monto onde konya taramanya amang'ana ayio,

English: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to Yahweh. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”
Kiswahili: Bonde lote watupwapo maiti na majivu pia na matuta yote kutoka Bonde la Kidroni upande wa mashariki hadi pembe ya Lango la Farasi, itakuwa takatifu kwa Bwana. Kamwe mji huu hautangʼolewa tena wala kubomolewa.”
Ekegusii: Rikura rionsi rire nemebere ekwete, ne ribu, amo nemegondo yonsi ere agwo goikera akarooche ga Kidironi, na goika ekoona ekorokwa Egeita gie Chibarasi, gochia ase ensemo ya moocha; chinsemo echio nchibe chinchenu ase 'nde inche Omonene. Tichikoonchoranwa gose gosarigwa nonya ng'ake.”

English: And I will hold accountable anyone who does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote hatasikiliza maneno yangu ambayo huyo nabii atayasema kwa Jina langu, mimi mwenyewe nitamwajibisha.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amang’ana ane ayio ndachiike omobani oyio ayakwane ase erieta riane, inche bweka omonyene ning’ee omonto oyio egesusuro.

English: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.
Kiswahili: Atamnyunyizia yule mwenye ugonjwa wa kuambukiza maji hayo mara saba, na kumtangaza kuwa safi. Kisha atamwachia yule ndege aliye hai aende zake kwenye mashamba.
Ekegusii: Anyororokerie amanyinga aria ara gatano na kabere igoro ase omonto oyio ogochia gochenwa ase oborwaire bwa ukoma, ateebe ng'a omonto oria ochenekire, na atige enyoni eria ere moyo eiruruke, egende orosana.

English: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipokaribia, akawatuma watumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili kukusanya matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’amatunda yachia goika ang’e, agatoma abasomba baye ase abaremi, banyore amatunda aye.

English: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mtu mwovu akiacha dhambi zake zote alizozitenda na kushika amri zangu zote na kufanya lililo haki na sawa, hakika ataishi, hatakufa.
Ekegusii: Korende omokori amabe karatige ebibe biaye bionsi ebio akorire, na arende emeroberio y’ane yonsi echiikire, naende akore ayare amaya na amaronge, ekeene, nabe moyo, tagokwa.

English: Drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.
Kiswahili: Kunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe, maji yanayotiririka kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Kanywe amaache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.

English: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.
Kiswahili: Miji iliyoko Negebu itafungwa, wala hapatakuwa na mtu wa kuifungua. Watu wa Yuda wote watapelekwa uhamishoni, wakichukuliwa kabisa waende mbali.
Ekegusii: Emechie y'ensemo ya Irianyi yasiekirwe ebiita biaye, monto onde takobiigora. Abayuda bonsi boosirwe bairirwe ase obosomba, bairirwe kegima.

English: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, went out to him.
Kiswahili: Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia aliyekuwa msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme, Shebna aliyekuwa katibu, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu mwandishi wakamwendea.
Ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omorwoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, oyorenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha aroro.

English: I don't have money
Kiswahili: Sina pesa
Ekegusii: Naki mwarare nagi nagita mbuyare.

English: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned. The Faith of Many (Joshua–Malachi)
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, watu walivuka Bahari ya Shamu kama vile juu ya nchi kavu; lakini Wamisri walipojaribu kufanya hivyo, walitoswa ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri buna ase ense enyomo. Korende Abamisiri barabwo bagachia goteema gokora bo, bakamerwa nenyancha.

English: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
Kiswahili: Mkabidhi Bwana njia yako, mtumaini yeye, naye atatenda hili:
Ekegusii: Erue ase Omonene mosemerie ere bweka, nere naoboseemia.

English: But the King of kings stirred up the anger of Antiochus against the wicked wretch. When Lysias informed him that this man was the cause of all the evils, the king commanded to bring him to Beroea, and to put him to death in the way customary in that place.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mfalme wa wafalme alichochea hasira ya Antiochus dhidi ya yule mwovu. Lisia alipomwambia kwamba mtu huyu ndiye chanzo cha maovu yote, mfalme aliamuru apelekwe Beroya, na kuuawa kama kawaida mahali hapo.
Ekegusii: Korende omorwoti bw'abarwoti agakora Antioko akaba n'obororo ase Menelao. Lisia akaenekeria omorwoti Antioko nga omobe oyio Menelao nere oretete emechando yonsi; ase igo omorwoti akarwa ogochika Menelao airwe ense ya Beroya aitwe korengana n'ogoitwa gw'ense eria.

English: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
Kiswahili: Huyo mtu aliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewasili Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi, alimwendea na kumwomba ili aje kumponya mwanawe, aliyekuwa mgonjwa karibu ya kufa.
Ekegusii: Oyio agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ochire korwa Boyahudi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche agwenie omwana oye, ekiagera konya oisire gokwa.

English: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn't repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn't worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can't see, hear, or walk.
Kiswahili: Wanadamu waliosalia, ambao hawakuuawa katika mapigo hayo, bado walikataa kutubia kazi za mikono yao na hawakuacha kuabudu mashetani na sanamu za dhahabu, za fedha, za shaba, za mawe na za miti, ambazo haziwezi kuona, kusikia wala kutembea.
Ekegusii: Na Mwanyabaanto abatigarete bataitetwe ase amaakwa ayio tibaonchogete korwa ase emeremo eria bakorete namaboko abo, na tibatiga gosasiima ebirecha na emegwekano yakorire korwa ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na amagena, na emete, eyio etanyare korora, gose koigwa, gose kogenda.

English: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
Kiswahili: Lakini ashukuriwe Mungu, yeye atupaye ushindi kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende mbuya mono ase Nyasae, ere oyogotoa okobua goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: As for you, do not pray for these people. Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, for I will not be listening when they call out to Me in their time of disaster.
Kiswahili: “Wewe usiwaombee watu hawa wala kufanya maombezi yoyote au kunisihi kwa ajili yao, kwa sababu sitawasikiliza watakaponiita wakati wa taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye tobaisa gosabera abanto aba, gose korera ase ’nde ase engencho ya barabwo, ekiagera inche tinkobaigwa ekero barandangerie ase engencho y’emechando yabo.

English: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yavani walikuwa: Elisha, Tarshishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha, na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodani.

English: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Hephzibah.
Kiswahili: Manase alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu miaka hamsini na mitano. Mama yake aliitwa Hefsiba.
Ekegusii: Manase nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagaamba emiaka emerongo etano, na etano, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng'ina nigo arenge korokwa Hebisiba.

English: “When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.
Kiswahili: “Mtu akikualika arusini, usikae mahali pa mgeni wa heshima kwa kuwa inawezekana amealikwa mtu mheshimiwa kuliko wewe.
Ekegusii: “Gokorangerigwa nomonto ase omoyega bw’enyangi, toikaransa ase ekerogo kie ritang’ani; onye omonto bw’amasikani kobua aye orangeretigwe nere,

English: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
Kiswahili: hivyo ninachagua kujinyonga na kufa, kuliko huu mwili wangu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo nachorire ng'a ng'entwe inkwe, ekiagera amakweri namaya kobua obororo bore ase omobere one.

English: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Basi mchukueni ninyi mkamhukumu kwa kufuata sheria zenu.” Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Sisi haturuhusiwi kutoa hukumu ya kifo kwa mtu yeyote.”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momogambie ase ogochika kwaino.” Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Intwe titori ne ribaga goita omonto.”

English: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
Kiswahili: Chini ya huo ukingo, kulikuwa na mafahali kuizunguka, yaani mafahali kumi katika kila dhiraa moja. Hayo mafahali waliyasubu katika safu mbili yakiwa ya kitu kimoja na hiyo Bahari.
Ekegusii: Ase rikere ri'egetuba keria kiarenge nobogare bw'amaboko ikomi emegwekano ye chiombe iyarengeo. Emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge ase chindwaro ibere, ekabombwa ekaba egento ekemo negetuba keria.

English: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa ule upele utaenea juu ya ngozi yake baada ya yeye kujionyesha kwa kuhani na kutangazwa kuwa safi, ni lazima aende tena kwa kuhani.
Ekegusii: Korende egesambo keria gokeraabe giesiareire ase risankwa magega Omokuani karorire ng'a ochenekire, omonto oria goika airane ase Omokuani naende,

English: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.
Kiswahili: Basi Malkia Esta binti Abihaili, pamoja na Mordekai, Myahudi, waliandika kwa mamlaka yote kuthibitisha barua hii ya pili kuhusu Purimu.
Ekegusii: Erio eting'ana Esiteri, omosubati bw'Abihaili, na Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, bakarika riruube ri'ogokong'ia amang'ana e riruube riria ria kabere igoro y'okorenda Purimu.

English: “How can you say, ‘I love you,’” she asked, “when your heart is not with me? This is the third time you have mocked me and failed to reveal to me the source of your great strength!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Delila akamwambia, “Wawezaje kusema, ‘Nakupenda,’ wakati moyo wako haupo pamoja nami? Umenifanyia mzaha mara hizi tatu na hujaniambia siri ya hizi nguvu zako nyingi.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamobooria, “Naki oranyaare goteeba ng’a nonyanchete, ekero enkoro yao etari amo nainche? Gwankoreire echeche chintunda isato na toranteebia obobisi bw’echinguru chiao.”

English: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakapanda na kupiga kambi huko Yuda na kuenea huko Lehi.
Ekegusii: Erio Abafirisiti bagatiira, bagatoora ase ense ya Yuda, bakaumokera omochie o Lei.

English: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameufanya wokovu wake ujulikane na amedhihirisha haki yake kwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogotooreka kwaye komanyekane, oorokirie oboronge bwaye ase amasio 'abaanto b'ebisaku;

English: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kuzaliwa katika mji wa Bethlehemu huko Uyahudi, wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Herode, wataalamu wa mambo ya nyota kutoka mashariki walifika Yerusalemu
Ekegusii: Yeso nigo aiboretwe ase omochie o Bethlehemu ime ya Boyahudi, ase amatuko aria Herode arenge omorwoti. Matuko make igo nyuma kaiboirwe, abaringoria b'eching'enang'eni bagacha korwa moocha goika Yerusalemu.

English: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
Kiswahili: Paulo alipoweka mikono yake juu yao, Roho Mtakatifu akawashukia, nao wakanena kwa lugha mpya na kutabiri.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo abekire amaboko aye igoro ase bare, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera; bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa na kobana.

English: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn't know that poverty waits for him.
Kiswahili: Mtu mchoyo ana tamaa ya kupata utajiri, naye hana habari kuwa umaskini unamngojea.
Ekegusii: Omonto omwegimeria nigo akoayerera koba omonda, gose tari korengereria ng'a obotaka 'mbomonyooore.

English: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
Kiswahili: Humlipa mwanadamu kwa ajili ya lile alilotenda; huleta juu yake kile ambacho matendo yake yanastahili.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agoakana omonto koreng'ana buna emeremo yaye ere; nabo akoa omonto eng'eria buna orogendo rwaye rore.

English: “We will go with our young and old,” Moses replied. “We will go with our sons and daughters, and with our flocks and herds, for we must hold a feast to the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Mose akajibu, “Tutakwenda na vijana wetu na wazee, pamoja na wana wetu na binti zetu, pia pamoja na kondoo zetu, ngʼombe, mbuzi, farasi na punda kwa sababu tutaadhimisha sikukuu kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Nigo toragende twensi, abake na abagotu, na abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, ching’ondi ne chitugo chiaito chinde chionsi, ekiagera ntobwate Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”

English: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
Kiswahili: Aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, akala mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, yeye na wenzake, jambo ambalo halikuwa halali kwao kufanya, isipokuwa makuhani peke yao.
Ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, nero tiyarenge boronge asare ayerie, gose ase abwo barenge amo nere, otatiga ase abakuani boka?

English: Then you shall declare in the presence of the LORD your God, “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me. I have not transgressed or forgotten Your commandments.
Kiswahili: Kisha umwambie Bwana Mungu wako: “Nimeondoa katika nyumba yangu ile sehemu iliyowekwa wakfu na nimempa Mlawi, mgeni, yatima na mjane, kulingana na yote uliyoamuru. Sijazihalifu amri zako wala kusahau hata mojawapo.
Ekegusii: Erio okwane amang’ana aya ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, omoteebie: Inche nabirusirie korwa ase enyomba yane ebinto biatananetwe bibe ebichenu, nabieire Abalawi, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka. Nakorire buna gwanchiigete. Tinsareti gose tinyebeti ogochika konde kwao.

English: Uzziah went out to wage war against the Philistines, and he tore down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Then he built cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Alipigana vita dhidi ya Wafilisti na kubomoa kuta za Gathi, Yabne na Ashdodi. Kisha akajenga upya miji karibu na Ashdodi na mahali pengine katikati ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Usia akagenda akarwania Abafirisiti esegi; agatagora orwaki rwa Gati, na orwa Yabune, na orw’Asidodi. Akaagacha naende emechie ase orogongo rw’Asidodi na aande onsi ase egati y’Abafilisti.

English: On Wednesday I got a letter from my best friend.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Jumatano nilipokea barua kutoka kwa rafiki yangu.
Ekegusii: Etichi gatato inkanyora rirube korwa ase omosani one.

English: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nina matumaini haya, ninajua kwamba nitaendelea kuwepo na kuwa pamoja nanyi nyote, ili mpate kukua na kuwa na furaha katika imani.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inde nobomaene ase aya, namanyire ng'a nintigare na kogenderera amo nainwe mwensi, na inwe momenteke na kogoka ase okwegena,

English: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni aibu hata kutaja mambo yale ambayo wasiotii wanayafanya sirini.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nobosooku nonya nogokwana amang'ana ayio agokorwa nabarabwo bobisi.

English: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
Kiswahili: aniokoaye na adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.

English: and that then he should take half of his goods, and go in safety to his father; and the rest, said he, when my wife and I die.
Kiswahili: na kwamba achukue nusu ya mali yake, na aende kwa baba yake kwa usalama; na iliyobaki, alisema, mimi na mke wangu tukifa.
Ekegusii: Magega yechichuma ibere, aye noire ekeng'ese ki'enibo yane na koira Sara goika ase abaibori bao. Ekero inche na Edina torakwe, ekeng'ese keria kende giatigara aye nokeire. Amang'ana ayio na y'ekeene. Gochakera bono iga inche niiso na Edina 'nyoko, buna tore abaibori ba Sara!”

English: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku nyingine ya Sabato, Yesu aliingia ndani ya sinagogi na akawa anafundisha. Huko palikuwa na mtu ambaye mkono wake wa kuume ulikuwa umepooza.
Ekegusii: Esabato ende agasoa ase esinagogi, akaorokereria. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye gw'okorio kwagataete.

English: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
Kiswahili: Na azikumbuke dhabihu zako zote, na azikubali sadaka zako za kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga ainyore okorua kwao gwonsi, anche na kogokera ebing’wanso biao bionsi bi’ogosambwa.

English: And Hezekiah had asked, “What will be the sign that I will go up to the house of the LORD?”
Kiswahili: Hezekia alikuwa ameuliza, “Kutakuwa na ishara gani kwamba nitapanda kwenda Hekalu la Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Boigo Hezekia konya oboririe iga: “Nkemanyererio ki gekonyorokia ng’a ningende ase enyomba y’Omonene?”

English: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
Kiswahili: kabla hajaumba dunia wala mashamba yake au vumbi lolote la dunia.
Ekegusii: ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.

English: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na hamtafanya kazi za kawaida. Adhimisheni sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri'omotienyi o gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi, korende morende Rituko Rinene ri'Omonene ase engaki y'amatuko atano na abere.

English: “Joseph is still alive,” they said, “and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt!” But Jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia baba yao, “Yosefu angali hai! Ukweli ni kwamba yeye ndiye mtawala wa Misri yote.” Yakobo akapigwa na bumbuazi; hakuwasadiki.
Ekegusii: Agwo bakamanyia ise amang’ana ng’a Yusufu moyo are, naende nere omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Yakobo agachia koyaigwa, akagoyaana ase omoyo oye, tanyara kwegena amang’ana abo.

English: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man's mind and heart are cunning.
Kiswahili: Hufanya shauri baya la dhuluma na kusema, “Tumebuni mpango mkamilifu!” Hakika nia na moyo wa mwanadamu vina hila.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio emebe, bagoteeba, “Bono twakorire omooroberio oito omoikeranu.” Ekeene, ebirengererio bia ime bi'omonto, na enkoro yaye, nigo bisinyete.

English: Blessed is the man who is always reverent, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
Kiswahili: Amebarikiwa mtu ambaye siku zote humcha Bwana, bali yeye afanyaye moyo wake kuwa mgumu huangukia kwenye taabu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene botambe, korende oyo okong’etie enkoro yaye nanyore emechando eramosirie.

English: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
Kiswahili: “Ohola akajitia kwenye ukahaba alipokuwa bado ni wangu, akatamani sana wapenzi wake, mashujaa Waashuru,
Ekegusii: Ohola, ekero arenge oyone, nigo arenge gokora obonyaka, akaba nokogania okobe ase abanchi baye Abaasuri.

English: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
Kiswahili: “Siku ya Bwana iko karibu kwa mataifa yote. Kama ulivyofanya, nawe utafanyiwa vivyo hivyo, matendo yako yatakurudia juu ya kichwa chako.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire gochera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi. Buna mwabeire mogokora, naboigo nainwe morakorerwe. Ogokora kwaino nkobairanere inwe abanyene.

English: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia Wagadi na Wareubeni, “Je, watu wa nchi yenu watakwenda vitani wakati ninyi mmeketi hapa?
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n'abanto ba Gadi na abareubeni, akabora, “Inee! Abanto bamino nigo bakogeenda korwana esegi, nainwe mobe motigarete aase aa?

English: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya vifungo vyangu, ndugu wengi katika Bwana wametiwa moyo kuhubiri neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri zaidi na bila woga.
Ekegusii: Na abange ase abaminto abare ase Omonene Nyasae babeire n'okoremigwa ase engencho y'ogosibwa kwane, bamentekanire n'oboremu gokwana ring'ana ria Nyasae batari nobwoba.

English: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
Kiswahili: Wanena daima dhidi ya ndugu yako na kumsingizia mwana wa mama yako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoikaransa na konakogamba abanto bamino bobe; nigo okona‐kong’acha oyomino morwete enda eyemo.

English: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.
Kiswahili: Akawapanga walinzi wote kumzunguka mfalme, kila mmoja akiwa na silaha yake mkononi mwake, karibu na madhabahu na Hekalu, kuanzia upande wa kusini hadi upande wa kaskazini mwa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Akabeka abanto bonsi korenda omorwoti, kera omonto akaba obwate ebirwanero biaye koboko kwaye, bagatenena korwa ensemo ya Irianyi y'enyomba goika ensemo ya sugusu, bagaetanana egesasiimero na enyomba eria.

English: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.” The Ingrafting of the Gentiles
Kiswahili: Macho yao yatiwe giza ili wasiweze kuona, nayo migongo yao iinamishwe daima.” Matawi Yaliyopandikizwa
Ekegusii: Tiga amaiso abo abekwe omosunte tibarora. Obakumbe emegongo yabo botambe!”

English: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
Kiswahili: Nikasikia madhabahu ikiitikia, “Naam, Bwana Mungu Mwenyezi, hukumu zako ni kweli na haki.”
Ekegusii: Naende nkaigwa eriogi korwa ase egesasiimero rigoteeba, “Ee, aye Omonene Nyasae Omobui, okogamba kwao nogw'ekeene na okwa boronge!”

English: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
Kiswahili: Bwana amewaleteeni usingizi mzito: Ameziba macho yenu (ninyi manabii); amefunika vichwa vyenu (ninyi waonaji).
Ekegusii: Omonene obaitereire inwe omoika bw'okorara chitoro chindito; oukoirie amaiso 'ababani, abwo bare amaiso aino, na otubire emetwe y'abarori, abwo bare emetwe yaino.

English: Having been saved by God out of great perils, as men arrayed against a king, we thank him greatly.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tumeokolewa na Mungu kutoka katika hatari kubwa, huku watu wakijiandaa kumpinga mfalme, tunamshukuru sana.
Ekegusii: Twamwakeire Nyasae mbuya mono ase engencho atotoretie korwa ase emechando emenene agatokonya korwa ase omorwoti.

English: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
Kiswahili: Filipo akamjibu, “Hata fedha kiasi cha dinari mia mbili, hazitoshi kununua mikate ya kuwapa watu hawa ili kila mtu apate kidogo.”
Ekegusii: Filipo akamoiraneria, “Emegati ye chidinari amagana abere tekobaisana, kera oyomo anyore moke igo.”

English: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
Kiswahili: Juu ya kinara chenyewe kulikuwepo na vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.
Ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero gie chitaaya keria rikaba nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi.

English: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.'
Kiswahili: Lakini hii ni kutimiza lile neno lililoandikwa kwenye Sheria kwamba, ‘Walinichukia pasipo sababu.'
Ekegusii: Korende igo riikerane ring'ana eriarigetwe ase amachiiko abo: Nigo bangechete bosa.

English: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
Kiswahili: Ninyi ambao ni wajinga, pateni akili; ninyi mlio wapumbavu, pateni ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti amaange, egera obong'aini; na inwe abariri, egera okomanya.

English: I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples and take their gods as captives. So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there unscathed.
Kiswahili: Atachoma moto mahekalu yao ya miungu ya Misri, atachoma mahekalu yao na kuteka miungu yao. Kama vile mchungaji ajizungushiavyo vazi lake ndivyo atakavyojizungushia Misri na kuondoka mahali hapo bila kudhurika.
Ekegusii: Ere natongie chie Hekalu chi’echinyasae chiria. Ase enchera eyio nachene ense ya Misiri buna omorisia akorusia chinda chire ase eanga yaye akwambara. Nebukadinesaro gakoorire gokora ayio, nairane ase ense yaye nomorembe.

English: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Kiswahili: Yeye atembeaye na mwenye hekima atapata hekima, bali rafiki wa mpumbavu hupata madhara.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotaara n'abanto abang'aini nigo arabe omong'aini, korende oyo ogosanga nabariri nanyorwe n'amabe.

English: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
