Kiswahili: Hili ndilo pendo: si kwamba tulimpenda Mungu, bali yeye alitupenda, akamtuma Mwanawe, ili yeye awe dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu.
Ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani, tari ng’a nintwe twamwanchete Nyasae, korende nere otwanchete intwe, agatoma Omwana oye koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito.

English: The soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.
Kiswahili: Wale askari wakapanga kuwaua wale wafungwa ili kuzuia hata mmoja wao asiogelee na kutoroka.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw'abarwani nigo orenge ng'a baite abasibwa, omonto tareema abaise gotama.

English: then the man who lay with her must pay the young woman’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she must become his wife because he has violated her. He must not divorce her as long as he lives.
Kiswahili: mwanaume atamlipa baba wa msichana shekeli hamsini za fedha. Ni lazima amwoe huyo msichana, kwa maana amemfanyia jeuri. Kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: rirorio omonto oria naae ise omoiseke oria chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano, atwaare omoiseke oria abe mokaaye, ekiagera omosareirie obwekungi bwaye; takoba n’eribaga komotiga ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
Kiswahili: Yezebeli mke wake akasema, “Hivi ndivyo unavyofanya, nawe ni mfalme katika Israeli yote? Inuka na ule! Changamka. Nitakupatia shamba la mizabibu la Nabothi, Myezreeli.”
Ekegusii: Yesebeli mokaye akamoteebia: “Inee! Naye okogaambera Abaisraeli, gose tari aye? Imoka! Orie endagera, tiga enkoro yao ebe nomosasoko; ninkonyorere omogondo bw'emesabibu o Naboti Omoyesireeli.”

English: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
Kiswahili: Mpenzi wangu kwangu mimi ni kama kishada cha maua ya mhina kutoka mashamba ya mizabibu ya En-Gedi.
Ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are ase 'nde buna egesago ki'ebisicha bikorokwa hena, bire ase emegondo y'emesabibu y'Eni‐Gedi.

English: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Kiswahili: Mtafuteni Bwana maadamu anapatikana; mwiteni maadamu yu karibu.
Ekegusii: Morigie Omonene ekero akonyorekana, morangerie erinde abakoonye ekero are ang'e!

English: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Mungu wake imo moyoni mwake; nyayo zake hazitelezi.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko a Nyasae oye nigo abeerete ase enkoro y'omonto oyio; ase agoeta tari gotererigwa.

English: Even so a man fasting for his sins, and going again, and doing the same, who will listen to his prayer? What profit does he have in his humiliation?
Kiswahili: Hata mtu akifunga kwa ajili ya dhambi zake, na kurudia, na kufanya vivyo hivyo, ni nani atakayesikiliza sala yake? Ana faida gani katika aibu yake?
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo araagaacha noyonde atagore, inee natware okonyoora konde goetania goitera ebigeri?

English: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni, nifuateni nami nitawafanya mwe wavuvi wa watu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montunyane, na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b' abanto.”

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do as follows: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Waambie ndugu zako, ‘Fanyeni hivi: Pakieni wanyama wenu mrudi mpaka nchi ya Kanaani,
Ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Bateebie abamino iga: Berekia ching’iti chiaino chigurube, moimoke mogende ase ense yaino ya Kaanani,

English: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?'” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn't coming back.”
Kiswahili: Mpanda farasi akaondoka kwenda kukutana na Yehu na kusema, “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo mfalme: ‘Je, mmekuja kwa amani?' ” Yehu akamjibu, “Una nini na amani? Unga msafara nyuma yangu.” Mlinzi akatoa habari, “Mjumbe amewafikia lakini harudi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria akariina ebarasi, akagenda koumerana nere, akamoteebia: “Omorwoti nigo akoboria gose namang'ana 'omorembe obwate.” Yehu akamoiraneria: “Ninki ogokorera omorembe? Irana magega yane ontunyane!” Omorendi oria akaira amang'ana, agateeba “Omonto oria otomwa naika ase bare, korende tari koirana gocha.”

English: So Saul said to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Why have You not answered Your servant this day? If the fault is with me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim; but if the fault is with the men of Israel, respond with Thummim.” And Jonathan and Saul were selected, but the people were cleared of the charge.
Kiswahili: Kisha Sauli akamwomba Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, akisema, “Nipe jibu lililo sawa.” Yonathani na Sauli wakatolewa kwa kura, nao watu wakawa salama.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Saulo akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nase ki kwangire koiraneria omosomba oo rituko ria reero? Onye okomocha okwo nokwane, gose nokwa Yonathani, omwana one, iraneria ase enchera y’obomera bwa Urimu, onye kore okw’Abaisraeli iraneria na Tumimu.” Igo obomera bokagwera Saulo na Yonathani, na Abanto bagatooreka.

English: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa pamoja nami kwa muda wa siku tatu, na hawana chakula chochote. Nami sipendi kuwaaga wakiwa na njaa, wasije wakazimia njiani.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye bache asare, akabora, “Inche naroreire emeganda amaabera, ekiagera babeire amo nainche amatuko atato, batari nendagera; na tindigeti kobatiga bagende nenchara, baabaise kogoya inchera.”

English: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
Kiswahili: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’
Ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoborie: Naki motamwegenete rende?

English: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Tikiko atawaambia habari zangu zote. Yeye ni ndugu mpendwa, mtendakazi mwaminifu na mtumishi mwenzangu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tukiko oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa, omosomba amo nainche ase Omonene, nabamanyie amang’ana aane onsi.

English: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Basi Wamidiani wote, Waamaleki na mataifa mengine ya mashariki wakaunganisha majeshi yao, wakavuka ngʼambo ya Yordani na kupiga kambi katika Bonde la Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Abamidiani n'Abaameleki, n'abanto ba moocha bagasangererekana amo, na ekero bambokire Yorodani bagatoora ase ense ye rikura ria Yesireeli.

English: What can I say for you? To what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?
Kiswahili: Ninaweza kusema nini kwa ajili yako? Nikulinganishe na nini, ee Binti Yerusalemu? Nitakufananisha na nini, ili nipate kukufariji, ee Bikira Binti Sayuni? Jeraha lako lina kina kama bahari. Ni nani awezaye kukuponya?
Ekegusii: Aye omochie o Yerusalemu, ninki ndagoteebie? Ninki ndakoreng’anie? Mang’ana ki anga buna ayao ndagoteebie, erinde nkoremie, aye Sayoni ore buna omoiseke omwekuungi? Ogosarigwa kwao nokonene buna enyancha ere enene, ning’o oranyare gokogwenia?

English: But standing by Jesus' cross were his mother, his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo karibu na msalaba wa Yesu walikuwa wamesimama mama yake, na dada wa mamaye, na Maria mke wa Klopa, na Maria Magdalene.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abarwani bakorete. Korende ase omosalaba o Yeso ng'ina, na ng'ina moke, Mariamu moga Kiliopa, na Mariamu Magidalena bagatenenao.

English: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?
Kiswahili: Gaza atanyoa kichwa chake katika kuomboleza, Ashkeloni atanyamazishwa. Enyi mabaki kwenye tambarare, mtajikatakata wenyewe mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Gasa yatigaire bosa, Asikeloni osirire kegima. Inwe abatigari ase rikura riria, ngoika ririri moragenderere gwekeba?

English: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
Kiswahili: Farao akasema, “Ninyi ni wavivu ndiyo sababu mnasema, ‘Turuhusu twende tukamtolee Bwana dhabihu.’
Ekegusii: Farao akabairaneria, “Inwe naboro mono. Nigo mobarachete nakio gekogera mogoteeba ng’a: Toe ribaga togende toruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.

English: But the centurion, wanting to spare Paul’s life, thwarted their plan. He commanded those who could swim to jump overboard first and get to land.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari alitaka kuokoa maisha ya Paulo, basi akawazuia askari wasitekeleze mpango wao. Akaamuru wale wanaoweza kuogelea wajitupe baharini kwanza, waogelee mpaka nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akarigia gotooria Paulo, akabataanga, tibakora buna barengereretie. Agachiika baria baranyare komura berute nyancha ime, bagende ense enyomo.

English: and spoke to them as the young men had advised, saying, “Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
Kiswahili: akafuata shauri la vijana wa rika lake na kusema, “Baba yangu alifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito, mimi nitaifanya kuwa nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwachapa kwa mijeledi, mimi nitawachapa kwa nge.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateeba: “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”

English: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
Kiswahili: lakini Bwana hatawaacha mikononi mwao wala hatawaacha wahukumiwe kuwa wakosa wanaposhtakiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagotiga omonto omooronge ase okobua kw’omokori amabe, gose takomotiga abugwe ekero asoeirwe ase ekegambero.

English: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
Kiswahili: naye Mfalme Solomoni na kusanyiko lote la Israeli waliokusanyika kumzunguka walikuwa mbele ya hilo Sanduku, nao wakatoa dhabihu nyingi za kondoo na ngʼombe ambao idadi yao haikuwezekana kuandikwa au kuhesabiwa.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani amo nomoganda bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli, baria basangererekanete amo nere bagatenena bosio bw'Esanduki eria, bakaruera aroro ebing'wanso bie ching'ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono chitaare konyara kobareka.

English: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering, put them in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.
Kiswahili: “Kwa mtu aliye najisi, weka majivu ya sadaka ya utakaso wa dhambi ndani ya chombo, umimine maji safi juu yao.
Ekegusii: “Ekiagera babeire abatachenegeti, nabaimokie riibu ike ri’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, keria giasambirwe, na kobeeka amaache amaya a rooche igoro ye riibu riria.

English: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
Kiswahili: Mtu hathibitiki kutokana na uovu, bali mwenye haki hataondolewa.
Ekegusii: Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagaacha omonto na komokong’ia, korende omori bw’omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.

English: But I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt. I will again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu niliyewaleta kutoka Misri; nitawafanya mkae tena kwenye mahema, kama vile katika siku za sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Korende inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero keria mwarenge Misiri, nimbabeeke momenye ase chiema naende, buna yarenge Amatuko Amanene aria achiikire.

English: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nitalivunja lango la Dameski; nitamwangamiza mfalme aliyeko katika Bonde la Aveni, na yeye ambaye anaishika fimbo ya utawala katika Beth-Edeni. Watu wote wa Aramu watakwenda uhamishoni huko Kiri,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nimbune emekorogoto y'ebiita bia Damesiki; ninsirie abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya y'Aveni, na oyio obwate enyimbo y'omogaambi agwo Beti‐Edeni. Abanto ba Siiria mbairwe ase obosomba gochia ase ense ya Kiri.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they contended with him.
Kiswahili: Lakini wachungaji wa Gerari wakagombana na wachungaji wa Isaki wakisema, “Maji haya ni yetu!” Ndipo akakiita kile kisima Eseki, kwa sababu waligombana naye.
Ekegusii: Abarisia b’ensemo ya Gerari bakaba bakwomana nabarisia ba Isaka, bagoteeba: “Amache aya nayaito.” Ase igo, Isaka Akayeroka entuboka eria Eseki, ekiagera bamwomaneretie aroro.

English: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh's glory shall appear to you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilowaagiza mlifanye, ili utukufu wa Bwana upate kuonekana kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateeba: “Eke naki'Omonene abachiigete mokore, erio obonene bw'Omonene mbobaorokere.”

English: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady's father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.
Kiswahili: mwanaume atamlipa baba wa msichana shekeli hamsini za fedha. Ni lazima amwoe huyo msichana, kwa maana amemfanyia jeuri. Kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: rirorio omonto oria naae ise omoiseke oria chitaabu, chisekeli chi'echifeta emerongo etano, atwaare omoiseke oria abe mokaaye, ekiagera omosareirie obwekungi bwaye; takoba n'eribaga komotiga ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye Muumba wa nyota za Dubu, na Orioni, Kilimia, na makundi ya nyota za kusini.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere otongete ching’enang’eni chia igoro Edubu. Orioni, boigo neching’enang’eni chiinde chikorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo, boigo na Amakundia a Irianyi.

English: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu inampasa kutoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe na vivyo hivyo kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio yamogwenerete arue ekeng'wanso ase engencho y'ebibe biaye ere omonyene, buna are korua ase engencho y'ebibe bi'abaanto.

English: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn't understand.
Kiswahili: Mose alidhani kuwa ndugu zake wangetambua kwamba Mungu anamtumia ili kuwaokoa, lakini wao hawakuelewa.
Ekegusii: Nigo akagete ng'a abamwabo mbamanye ng'a Nyasae nabae obosibore goetera ase okoboko kwaye, korende tibamanya.

English: and said, “O LORD, God of our fathers, are You not the God who is in heaven, and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in Your hand, and no one can stand against You.
Kiswahili: akasema: “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa baba zetu, si wewe ndiwe uliye Mungu mbinguni? Si wewe ndiwe utawalaye juu ya falme zote za mataifa? Uweza na nguvu viko mkononi mwako, wala hakuna yeyote awezaye kushindana nawe.
Ekegusii: agasaba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, Inee, aye tori Nyasae ore igoro? Tari aye okogamba igoro y’amarwoti onsi ay’ebisaku? Ase okoboko kwao okobua ne chinguru mbireo, goika onde tari oranyare gokobua.

English: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akawekwa gerezani, lakini kanisa lilikuwa likimwombea kwa Mungu kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Nabo Petero arendetwe ase echela ime, abanto b’ekanisa bakamosabera ase Nyasae nomoyo bw’omokia.

English: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had uttered this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
Kiswahili: Nilitambua kwamba Mungu hakumtuma, bali alitabiri dhidi yangu kwa sababu Tobia na Sanbalati walikuwa wamemwajiri.
Ekegusii: Inche nkamanya ng’a tari Nyasae omotomete, korende Tobia na Sanibalati bamoete chitaabu akwane amang’ana arache konyora inche.

English: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaingia eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakiuza vitu humo.
Ekegusii: Agasoa Hekalu ime, agachaaka gosokia baria barenge koonia aroro,

English: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”
Kiswahili: Nitawatawanya katika mataifa ambayo wao wala baba zao hawakuwajua, nikiwafuata kwa upanga mpaka niwe nimewaangamiza kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Nimbaserie gochia ase ebisaku ebio barabwo gose chisokoro chiabo chitabimanyete, nimbatomere abasikari bare nemioro baabaite baabasirie kegima.”

English: God said to Solomon, “Since this was in your heart instead of requesting riches or wealth or glory for yourself or death for your enemies—and since you have not even requested long life but have asked for wisdom and knowledge to govern My people over whom I have made you king—
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia Solomoni, “Kwa kuwa jambo hili ndilo shauku ya moyo wako na hukuomba mali, utajiri au heshima, wala kifo kwa ajili ya adui zako, nawe kwa kuwa hukuomba maisha marefu, bali umeomba hekima na maarifa ili kuongoza watu wangu ambao nimekufanya uwe mfalme juu yao,
Ekegusii: Nyasae akairaneria Sulemani, “Ekiagera okogania okwo kore ime ase enkoro yao, naende toboreti oegwe obotenenku, gose obonda, gose ogosikwa, gose ogosirigwa kw’obogima bw’abaanto baria bakogechete, gose toboreti oegwe obogima obotambe, korende kwaboririe oegwe obong’aini ne chisemi, erinde omanye kogambera abanto baane abwo nakobekire obe omorwoti obo,

English: For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
Kiswahili: Kwa maana asema: “Wakati wangu uliokubalika nilikusikia, siku ya wokovu nilikusaidia.” Tazama, wakati uliokubalika ndio huu, siku ya wokovu ndiyo sasa. Taabu Za Paulo
Ekegusii: Naki igo agoteeba, “Ase engaki yancheire nakoiraneretie ogosaba kwao, rituko ri’ogotooreka nagokonyete.” Rora, bono nario engaki y’ogwancherwa; rora, bono nario rituko ri’ogotooreka.

English: then you must inquire, investigate, and interrogate thoroughly. And if it is established with certainty that this abomination has been committed among you,
Kiswahili: ndipo itakubidi kuuliza, kupima na kuchunguza kwa makini. Kama ni kweli, tena ikihakikishwa kwamba jambo hili lichukizalo limefanyika miongoni mwenu,
Ekegusii: Mouna‐unie mono amang’ana ayio, erio momanye buya gose nabo are. Onye okogeechia buna okwo gwakorekanire ase egati yaino,

English: and Palal son of Uzai made repairs opposite the angle and the tower that juts out from the upper palace of the king near the courtyard of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh
Kiswahili: Naye Palali, mwana wa Uzai alijenga sehemu iliyokuwa mkabala na pembe ya ukuta, mpaka kwenye mnara wa juu ambao unajitokeza kuanzia kwenye jumba la kifalme, kando ya ua wa walinzi. Baada yake, Pedaya mwana wa Paroshi,
Ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, nere Paali, mosinto o Usai; ere akaagacha ensemo yarochie Chinsanganio na omoorobiri ochongororogete korwa ase enyomba ya rogoro y’omorwoti, eyio yarenge ang’e neraaro y’echela. Oyobwatetie oyio, nere Pedaya, mosinto o Parosi.

English: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
Kiswahili: Siku moja, Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha watu Hekaluni na kuhubiri habari njema, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero Yeso arenge kworokereria abanto Hekalu ime, na korandia enchiri, abakuani abanene na aborokia b'amariiko amo nabagaaka bakamoorokera,

English: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.
Kiswahili: “Wale vibarua walioajiriwa mnamo saa kumi na moja, wakaja na kila mmoja wao akapokea dinari moja.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria barigetwe chinsa ikomi nemo baachete, bakanyora kera oyomo edinari eyemo.

English: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Israeli alimshinda kwa upanga na kuiteka ardhi yake kutoka Arnoni mpaka Yaboki, lakini ni hadi kufikia nchi ya Waamoni tu, kwa sababu mipaka yake ilikuwa imezungushwa ukuta.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagakenya abanto abange, bakaira ense ya Sihoni, korwa orooche rw'Arinoni goika orooche rwa Yaboki ase ense y'Abaamoni. Ribebe ri'Abaamoni nigo riarendire ne chinguru.

English: So I answered them, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nikawaambia, “Neno la Bwana lilinijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio nkabairaneria, nkabateebia ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene ndiacha asende, riganteebia:

English: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
Kiswahili: “Kuhusu ingilio la ua, weka pazia lenye urefu wa dhiraa ishirini la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi. Pazia hilo litashikiliwa na nguzo nne na vitako vinne.
Ekegusii: Na ase egesoero oroisie egetambaa gi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, ebe emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Egetambaa ekio gesiirwe ne chisiiro inye ne chinterekerero chiabo inye.

English: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo mtatangaza kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo, popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Rituko erio goika moraarie na mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima; timokora emeremo yaino ya kera rituko. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akawaruhusu, nao wale pepo wachafu wakatoka, wakawaingia hao nguruwe. Lile kundi lilikuwa na nguruwe wapatao 2,000, nao wote wakateremkia gengeni kwa kasi, nao wakatumbukia ziwani na kuzama.
Ekegusii: Akabia ribaga. Ebirecha biria bi'eubi bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche chiria; riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano, goika chikagwa enyancha ime. Igo chiarenge koreng'ana chilifu ibere, chikarimera nyancha ime.

English: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
Kiswahili: safu ya tatu ilikuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;

English: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? And if he cries out to Me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa vazi lake ndilo pekee alilo nalo la kumfunika mwili wake. Ni nini kingine atajifunika nacho? Atakaponililia, nitasikia, kwa kuwa nina huruma.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nakio gioka abwate akwebisia. Eke nakio abwate gekomobekera riberera ase omobere oye. Inee! Otakemoeti, inki rende araraarere? Ere karaarere ase ’nde, ekeene, nimoigwe, ekiagera inche nomonyamaabera.

English: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
Kiswahili: Kitanda ni kifupi mno kujinyoosha juu yake, nguo ya kujifunikia ni nyembamba mno mtu hawezi kujifunikia.
Ekegusii: Oborere nigo bore obweng'e omonto agosinywa kwerambora igoro ase borobwo, na ekiebisio nigo kere ekenyerere mono omonto atanyare kwebisia.

English: Ebed-melech the Cushite cried out to Jeremiah, “Put these worn-out rags and clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,
Kiswahili: Ebed-Meleki Mkushi akamwambia Yeremia, “Weka haya matambaa makuukuu na hizo nguo zilizochakaa makwapani ili kuzuia kamba.” Yeremia akafanya hivyo,
Ekegusii: Ebedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, agateebia Yeremia, “Agia chianga echio ase chintigatigi chiao, oagie ne chingori korwa inse.” Yeremia agakora bo.

English: Now if a man consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased, which is not a part of his own property,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu ameweka wakfu kwa Bwana shamba alilonunua, ambalo si sehemu ya ardhi ya jamaa yake,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaatanane ase Omonene oboremo agorete, obwo botari ensemo y’omwando oye,

English: So the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in the land of Canaan to return to their own land of Gilead, which they had acquired according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Wareubeni, Wagadi na hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase wakawaacha Waisraeli huko Shilo katika nchi ya Kanaani ili kurudi Gileadi, nchi yao wenyewe waliyoipata sawasawa na agizo la Bwana kupitia Mose.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese kiegesaku kia Manase bagatiga Abaisraeli bande agwo Silo ase ense ya Kaanani, bakairana ase ense ya Gileadi, ense eria banyorete ase okomenya, buna Omonene konya achiikire goetera ase Musa.

English: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile ya mauaji makuu, wakati minara itakapoanguka, vijito vya maji vitatiririka juu ya kila mlima mrefu na kila kilima kilichoinuka sana.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ekero ogoitwa okonene korabe, ne chindwaki chinkong'u chiraiyerigwe, chindooche nchituboke korwa ase ebitunwa ebitambe bionsi na ebigoro biimokererete igoro.

English: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atokanaye na uzao wa Aroni atashirikiana na Walawi wakati wanapopokea zaka, nao Walawi itawapasa kuleta sehemu ya kumi ya zaka katika nyumba ya Mungu wetu katika ghala za hazina.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abalawi bakorenterwa chinsemo echio chia ikomi, Omokuani, omonto bw'ororeria rwa Aroni, goika abe amo nabarabwo. Abalawi abwo mbarusie ensemo ya ikomi ye chinsemo echio chia ikomi, bayeire ase ebinyomba bi'enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;'
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa sababu watu wanakuambia, “Unawala watu na kuliondolea taifa lako watoto wake,”
Ekegusii: “Aya n'aro Omonene agoteeba: Abanto nigo bagoteeba ng'a aye ense nigo okoria abanto, naende gwaitire abana b'egesaku kiao.

English: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
Kiswahili: Kitakuwa na vipande viwili vya mabegani vilivyoshikizwa kwenye pembe zake mbili ili kufungia kisibau.
Ekegusii: Egesibao ekio ki’obokuani kebe nebitwanga bibere bi’amareko, aase gekobwateranigwa.

English: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
Kiswahili: Jua lilipokuwa linatua, watu wakamletea Yesu watu wote waliokuwa na maradhi mbalimbali, naye akaweka mikono yake juu ya kila mgonjwa, naye akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Goika erioba rigachia kogwa bakarenta asare abanto bonsi abarenge nabarwaire bare namarwaire ao ao, na ere akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase kera oyomo, akabagwenia.

English: Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland, and Balak also went on his way.
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akainuka na kurudi nyumbani kwake, naye Balaki akashika njia yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akaimoka, akairana bwoye, na Balaki nere akabwatia enchera, akageenda bwoye.

English: In addition, they distributed portions to the males registered by genealogy who were three years of age or older—to all who would enter the house of the LORD for their daily duties for service in the responsibilities of their divisions—
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hao wakawagawia wanaume wenye umri wa miaka mitatu au zaidi ambao majina yao yalikuwa kwenye orodha ya vizazi, wale wote ambao wangeingia katika Hekalu la Bwana ili kufanya kazi zao mbalimbali za kila siku kulingana na wajibu katika mgawanyo wao.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio bagaatananera abana abamura b’emiaka etato na goetania ebiegwa, abwo baabarirwe na korikwa. Naende bagaatananera abwo babegetwe gokora emeremo yaganeirie ase enyomba y’Omonene kera rituko, koreng’ana nemeroberio y’ebiombe biabo.

English: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
Kiswahili: Kumbuka siku uliyosimama mbele za Bwana Mungu wako kule Horebu, wakati aliponiambia, “Wakutanishe watu mbele yangu wasikie maneno yangu ili kwamba waweze kujifunza kuniheshimu kwa muda wote watakaoishi katika nchi, nao waweze kuwafundisha watoto wao maneno hayo.”
Ekegusii: erinde bamanye ayakoregete ase rituko riria mwatenenete ase obosio bw'Omonene Nyasae oino, agwo Horebu, ekero Omonene akwanete nainche, aganteebia: Sangereria abanto bonsi amo, na inche mbateebie amang'ana, erinde beorokererie konyiroka ase amatuko onsi barabe bare moyo ase ense, nabarabwo baborokererie abana babo boigo.

English: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Barzilai, Mgileadi, pia akashuka kutoka Rogelimu ili kuvuka Yordani pamoja na mfalme na kumsindikiza kutoka huko.
Ekegusii: Bono Barisilai Omogileadi nere konya ochire korwa Rogelimu gokooba omorwoti gochia Yorodani amboke amo nere.

English: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.
Kiswahili: “Inua macho yako na utazame pande zote: Wote wanakusanyika na kukujia, wana wako wanakuja toka mbali, nao binti zako wanabebwa mikononi.
Ekegusii: Imokia amaiso ao igoro, origererie chinsemo chionsi, abanto bonsi basangererekanire amo bagocha asore. Abamura bao mbache korwa aare na abaiseke bao mbabogorigwe namaboko, barentwe.

English: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke Msamaria akamjibu, “Wewe ni Myahudi na mimi ni Msamaria. Yawezekanaje uniombe nikupe maji ya kunywa?” (Wayahudi walikuwa hawashirikiani kabisa na Wasamaria.)
Ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria bw’Abasamaria akamobooria, “Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi ogonsaba amaache, na inche nomokuungu bw’Abasamaria?” (Abayahudi tibari gosanga n’Abasamaria).

English: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana unihurumie, kwa kuwa niko kwenye shida; macho yangu yanafifia kwa huzuni, nafsi yangu na mwili wangu kwa sikitiko.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ndorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo mbwate emechando; amaiso aane arimeire ime ase engencho y’obororo, omoyo one ogoyire, naboigo nomobere one.

English: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
Kiswahili: Aliyeponywa alipokuwa akiambatana na Petro na Yohana, watu wote walishangaa mno, wakaja wakiwakimbilia pale ukumbi wa Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Ekero are kobwata‐bwata Petero na Yohana, abanto bonsi ase ogokumia bakaminyoka na gosangererekana amo ase bare ase egesona kiare korokwa Egesona gia Sulemani.

English: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Kiswahili: Bwana asifiwe, yeye ambaye hakuruhusu turaruliwe kwa meno yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera tatoruete totaboranwe namaino y' abanto abwo.

English: When Gehazi went in and stood before his master, Elisha asked him, “Gehazi, where have you been?” “Your servant did not go anywhere,” he replied.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaingia ndani na kusimama mbele ya Elisha bwana wake. Elisha akamuuliza, “Gehazi, ulikuwa wapi?” Gehazi akajibu, “Mtumishi wako hakwenda popote.”
Ekegusii: Agasoa nyomba, agatenena ase obosio bw’omonene oye Elisha, nere akamobooria: “Gehasi, ng’ai gese kwarenge?” Ere akairaneria: “Inche omosomba oo tinagendete aande.”

English: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya wokovu huu, wale manabii waliosema kuhusu neema ambayo ingewajia ninyi, walitafuta kwa bidii na kwa uangalifu mkubwa,
Ekegusii: Igoro ase amang’ana ogotooreka okwo ababani, baria baabaanete obuya obo borache kobacheera, bakariga‐rigia na kounenkia.

English: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alisema nasi huko Horebu, “Mmekaa vya kutosha katika mlima huu.
Ekegusii: Ekero twarenge ase egetunwa gia Sinai, Omonene, Nyasae oito, agakwana naintwe, agatoteebia, “Mwabereire aiga ase egetunwa eke ase egeka geisaine.

English: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
Kiswahili: Wengi wanauliza, “Ni nani awezaye kutuonyesha jema lolote?” Ee Bwana, tuangazie nuru ya uso wako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bagokwana iga: “Naki yare koba buya onye 'ntwanyora ayare amaya.” Aye Omonene, tiga omobaso bw'obosio bwao otomorekere.

English: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded, and they climbed Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza: Wakapanda Mlima Hori mbele ya macho ya jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli.
Ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete. Barabwo bagatiira gochia igoro as egetunwa keria kia Hori, ekero omoganda bwonsi origereretie.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes:
Kiswahili: Huko Tahpanhesi neno la Bwana likamjia Yeremia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge agwo Tapenesi, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamoteebia,

English: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on his opinions.
Kiswahili: Mkaribisheni yeye ambaye imani yake ni dhaifu, lakini si kwa kugombana na kubishana juu ya mawazo yake.
Ekegusii: Moroisie ere oy’otari na nguru ase okwegena, motari koamererania.

English: After they had seen the Child, they spread the message they had received about Him.
Kiswahili: Walipomwona yule mtoto, wakawaeleza yale waliyokuwa wameambiwa kuhusu huyo mtoto.
Ekegusii: Bagachia komorora, bakaorokia ring’ana bateebetigwe igoro y’omwana oyio.

English: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
Kiswahili: Mara yule mtu aliyekuwa amepooza akasimama mbele yao wote, akachukua mkeka wake, akaenda zake nyumbani, huku akimtukuza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agatenena ase obosio bwabo, akabogoria ekeraarero kiaye arenge koraarera, akagenda bwoye, ogotogia Nyasae.

English: The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.
Kiswahili: Matendo mabaya ya mtu mwovu humnasa yeye mwenyewe; kamba za dhambi yake humkamata kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.

English: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
Kiswahili: Akasimama na kubariki kusanyiko lote la Israeli kwa sauti kubwa akisema:
Ekegusii: agatenena agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli, agakwana neriogi rinene, akabora,

English: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Elimu na kupiga kambi kando ya Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Elimu, bakageenda bagaika ang'e n'Enyancha Embariri, bagatoora aroro.

English: For a nation has invaded My land, powerful and without number; its teeth are the teeth of a lion, and its fangs are the fangs of a lioness.
Kiswahili: Taifa limevamia nchi yangu, lenye nguvu tena lisilo na idadi; lina meno ya simba, magego ya simba jike.
Ekegusii: Risaga ri’echingige chinyinge riaumokeire ense yaito, nigo rire n’echinguru chi’ogokumia na nigo rire rinene mono; amaino aye nigo agwekaine ay’Endo, na amagegu aye nigo anga buna ay’endo eaberi.

English: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.
Kiswahili: Nitakufunga kwa kamba ili usiweze kugeuka kutoka upande mmoja hadi upande mwingine, mpaka hapo utakapokuwa umetimiza siku za kuzingirwa kwako.
Ekegusii: Ningosibe ne chingori, erinde tonyara koonchoka gochia ensemo ende yonsi goika obe gwakoorire amatuko ao ay'okoyoboera.

English: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn't forget the cry of the afflicted.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye alipizaye kisasi cha damu hukumbuka, hapuuzi kilio cha wanaoonewa.
Ekegusii: Ere oyo okorusia egesiomba ase okomocha kw'ogoitera amanyinga na koinyora abaichanete, Omonene tari kweba ekerero ki'abwo bagokorerwa bobe.

English: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.” The Parable of the Good Samaritan
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, manabii wengi na wafalme walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia.” Mfano Wa Msamaria Mwema
Ekegusii: Naki nabateebirie, ababani abange na abarwoti bakarigia korora ayamwarorire inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mwaigure, tibayaigwa.” Omoreng’anio bwo’mosamaria omuya (Mat 22:34-40; Mar 12:28-31)

English: Solomon made all these articles in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze could not be determined. Completion of the Gold Furnishings (1 Kings 7:48–51)
Kiswahili: Vitu hivi vyote Mfalme Solomoni alivyotengeneza vilikuwa vingi sana hivi kwamba uzito wa shaba haungekadirika.
Ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia ebinto ebi bionsi ebinge mono; ase igo oborito bwe chitaai chiria tibwarenge konyara korengeka na komanyekana buna bong’ana.

English: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
Kiswahili: Akashuka pamoja nao, akasimama mahali penye uwanja tambarare. Hapo palikuwa na idadi kubwa ya wanafunzi wake na umati mkubwa wa watu kutoka sehemu zote za Uyahudi, kutoka Yerusalemu, na kutoka pwani ya Tiro na Sidoni.
Ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agatenena aase ateremu, amo nomoganda bw'aborokigwa baye; na omoganda bw'abaanto abaruete Boyahudi yonsi, na Yerusalemu, na engegu ya Turo na Sidoni, bagacha komoigwa na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.

English: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
Ekegusii: Bono Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

English: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mmewakatisha Waisraeli tamaa wasivuke katika nchi ambayo Bwana amewapa?
Ekegusii: Nase ki inwe mogoita Abaisraeli emioyo, erinde tibaabaisa kwamboka gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, na koira ense eri’Omonene abaeire?

English: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Taanaki mmoja mfalme wa Megido mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Taanaki, na oyo o Megido

English: Don't you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?
Kiswahili: Je, hamwelewi kwamba chochote kiingiacho kinywani huenda tumboni, na hatimaye hutolewa nje kikiwa uchafu?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng'a kende gionsi kegosoa ase omonwa nigo kegoeta enda, kiagwa kebara?

English: How long will this continue in the hearts of these prophets who prophesy falsehood, these prophets of the delusion of their own minds?
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yataendelea mpaka lini ndani ya mioyo ya hawa manabii wa uongo, ambao hutabiri maono ya uongo ya akili zao wenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ngoika ririri oborimo boragenderere koba ime ase chinkoro chi’ababani abwo bakobana obong’ainereria bwe chinkoro chiabo?

English: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo alirudi akiwa amekwisha kupokea mamlaka ya ufalme, akawaita wale watumishi wake aliokuwa amewaachia fedha, ili afahamu ni faida kiasi gani kila mmoja wao aliyopata kwa kufanya biashara.
Ekegusii: “Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oborwoti, agachiika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.

English: “Indeed,” declares the LORD, “I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies. It was not I who sent them or commanded them, and they are of no benefit at all to these people,” declares the LORD. False Prophecies
Kiswahili: Kweli, niko kinyume na hao wanaotabiri ndoto za uongo,” asema Bwana. “Wanazisimulia na kuwapotosha watu wangu kwa uongo wao bila kujali, lakini sikuwatuma wala sikuwaamuru. Hawawafaidi watu hawa hata kidogo,” asema Bwana. Maneno Ya Uongo Na Manabii Wa Uongo
Ekegusii: Naende nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bakobana chindoto chi’oborimo, naende bachiteebia abanto baane na igo baabasiria. Ase ayio tibari gokonya abanto aba nonya ng’ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.” Egurube y’Omonene

English: If you don't have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
Kiswahili: Kama ukikosa njia ya kulipa, kitanda chako kitachukuliwa ukiwa umekilalia.
Ekegusii: Nobaise kourwa oborere bwao okoraarera, ekiagera tobwati gento ogoakana.

English: And now, that my lord may not be defeated and frustrated in his purpose, and that death may fall upon them, their sin has overtaken them, wherewith they will provoke their God to anger, whenever they do wickedness.
Kiswahili: Na sasa, ili bwana wangu asishindwe na kuchanganyikiwa katika kusudi lake, na ili kifo kiwapate, dhambi yao imewapata, ambayo kwayo watamkasirisha Mungu wao, kila wanapotenda uovu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye togosiria gose gosinywa goikerania amagania ao. Ekero Abaisraeli barakore ebibe na komobeyia Nyasae obo, erio rioka nario barakwe.

English: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitawapa watu wengine wake zao, na mashamba yao kwa wamiliki wengine. Kuanzia aliye mdogo kabisa hadi aliye mkubwa kabisa, wote wana tamaa ya kupata zaidi; manabii na makuhani wanafanana, wote wanafanya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ning’ee abanto abaao abakungu babo, na emegondo yabo ninyee abanto barababue. Abanto aba bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare neribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.

English: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
Kiswahili: Utukufu ule ulionipa nimewapa wao, ili wawe na umoja kama sisi tulivyo wamoja.
Ekegusii: Na obonene boria kwang’ete nabaeire, babe abamo, buna intwe tore oyomo;

English: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya mashujaa wa Daudi: Yosheb-Bashebethi, Mtahkemoni, alikuwa kiongozi wa wale Watatu; yeye aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 800, ambao aliwaua katika pambano moja.
Ekegusii: Aya n'aro amarieta y'abarwani chituoni Daudi abwate: Yosebe‐Basebeti korwa Takemoni. Ere nigo areenge omonene bw'abwo batato, chituoni chi'abarwani. Ere agaita abanto amagana atan'atato ase engaki eyeemo, ase okona‐kong'wana‐ng'wania ne riitimo ria'ye.

English: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
Kiswahili: Akawagawa wale watu 300 katika makundi matatu, akawakabidhi tarumbeta mikononi mwao wote na mitungi isiyokuwa na maji yenye mienge ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Agaatanana abanto baria baye amagana atato ase ebiombe bitato, akaa kera oyomo egetuureri, na ekeguuru amo n'ekemoreki ki'omorero kere imeo.

English: Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, “Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?
Kiswahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akawauliza: “Mbona mnajadiliana kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate? Je, bado hamtambui wala hamwelewi? Je, mbona mioyo yenu ni migumu kiasi hicho?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabateebia, “Inaki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timokomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?

English: In his first year, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
Kiswahili: “Pamoja na hayo, katika mwaka wa kwanza wa kutawala Koreshi mfalme wa Babeli, Mfalme Koreshi alitoa amri ya kujengwa upya nyumba hii ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka bw’eritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omorwoti o Babiloni, ere Koresi naruete ogochika ng’a enyomba eye eagachwe naende.

English: You who forbid adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
Kiswahili: Wewe usemaye mtu asizini, wewe mwenyewe wazini? Wewe uchukiaye miungu ya sanamu, wafanya jambo la kumchukiza katika mahekalu?
Ekegusii: Aye ogoteeba ng’a omonto tatomana, tori gotomana aye omonyene? Aye ogechete emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, aye tori koiba korwa ase chi Hekalu?

English: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Tuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili tu.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoteebia, “Titobwati gento aiga, otatiga emegati etano ne chinswe ibere.”

English: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu aliuchomoa upanga wake na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.
Ekegusii: Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang'e akang'usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw'Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.

English: At this, the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili kuhani mkuu Anania akaamuru wale waliokuwa karibu na Paulo wampige kofi kinywani.
Ekegusii: Anania, Omokuani omonene, agachiika baria bateneine ang’e nere bamoake omonwa oye.

English: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
Kiswahili: Nami nitakushukuru mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa, nitakusifu katikati ya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Erio ninkoiranerie ng'a mbuya mono agwo ase omosangererekano omonene, ningotogie ase omoganda omonene bw'abaanto.

English: let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to hear the prayer that I, Your servant, now pray before You day and night for Your servants, the Israelites. I confess the sins that we Israelites have committed against You. Both I and my father’s house have sinned.
Kiswahili: tega masikio yako, na ufungue macho yako, ili usikie maombi ya mtumishi wako anayoomba mbele yako usiku na mchana kwa ajili ya watumishi wako, watu wa Israeli. Ninaungama dhambi zetu sisi Waisraeli, pamoja na zangu na za nyumba ya baba yangu, tulizotenda dhidi yako.
Ekegusii: Ndigererie oigwe ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo. Nigo ngosaba ase obosio bwao omobaso na obotuko, ase engencho y’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, na koorokia ebibe intwe Abaisraeli twakorire asore. Ee, ekeene, nonya ninche amo nabaanto b’eamate yane twakorire ebibe.

English: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
Kiswahili: Basi kwa yeye awezaye kutenda mambo ya ajabu yasiyopimika kuliko yote tuyaombayo au tuyawazayo, kwa kadiri ya uweza wake ule utendao kazi ndani yetu,
Ekegusii: Gaki, ase are ere oyoranyaare gokora goetania mono kobua aya togosaba gose aya tokorengereria, koreng’ana ne chinguru chigokora emeremo ime ase tore,

English: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.'
Kiswahili: “Wa kwanza akaja na kusema, ‘Bwana, kutokana na fedha uliyoniachia, nimepata faida mara kumi zaidi.'
Ekegusii: Oyo bw'eritang'ani agacha, okobora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo ikomi binde.

English: They led captive the women and the children, and seized the livestock.
Kiswahili: Wakawachukua mateka wanawake na watoto, na kuteka mifugo.
Ekegusii: akaaosa abakungu, abana ne chitugo.

English: But if the man does not want to marry his brother’s widow, she is to go to the elders at the city gate and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to preserve his brother’s name in Israel. He is not willing to perform the duty of a brother-in-law for me.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa ndugu huyo wa mume hataki kuoa huyo mke wa nduguye, mjane atawaendea wazee kwenye lango la mji na kusema, “Ndugu wa mume wangu anakataa kuendeleza jina la nduguye katika Israeli. Hataki kutimiza wajibu wa shemeji kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okwanga gotwara moka momura omwabo, rirorio omokungu oria agende ase abagaaka bare agwo ase egeita ki’omochie, akwane amang’ana aya: Omomura omwabo omosacha one bwangire goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku, erinde erieta riaye tirisira korwa ase Abaisraeli.

English: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mizoga ya watu hawa itakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na wanyama wa nchi, wala hapatakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Emebere yabo ekwete nebe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro ne ching’iti chi’orosana. Omonto tagochiseria ekero chikoria emebere eyio.

English: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”
Kiswahili: Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli akamuuliza Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, “Je, utakwenda pamoja nami kupigana dhidi ya Ramoth-Gileadi?” Yehoshafati akamjibu mfalme wa Israeli, “Mimi ni kama wewe, watu wangu ni kama watu wako, farasi wangu ni kama farasi wako. Tutakuwa pamoja nawe vitani.”
Ekegusii: Ahabu, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, agakwana na Yehosafati, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, akamobooria, “Nogende amo nainche korwania Ramoti o Gileadi?” Yehosafati akamoiraneria, “Inche nigo inde buna aye, na abanto baane nigo bare buna abanto bao. Intwe ntobe amo naye ase okorwana esegi.”

English: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
Kiswahili: “Wale wapangaji wakawakamata wale watumishi, wakampiga mmoja, wakamuua mwingine, na yule wa tatu wakampiga mawe.
Ekegusii: Abaremi bakabwata abasomba baye, oyomo bakamoaka, oyonde bakamoita, na oyonde bakamoaka amagena.

English: So Hagar gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her: “You are the God who sees me, ” for she said, “Here I have seen the One who sees me!”
Kiswahili: Hagari akampa Bwana aliyezungumza naye jina hili: “Wewe ndiwe Mungu unionaye mimi,” kwa maana alisema, “Sasa nimemwona yeye anayeniona mimi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Hagari Akaroka Omonene oyo okwanete nere Eli‐Roi, engencho yaye “Aye naye Nyasae bw’okorora”; naki akebooria: “Inee! Amaene, narorire Nyasae, na ere ontiga inde moyo magega konamororire?”

English: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakupiga kwa magonjwa ya kudhoofisha, kwa homa na kuwashwa, hari na kwa ukame, kutu na kuwa na uchungu ambavyo vitakupiga mpaka uangamie.
Ekegusii: Nabaake n’oborwaire borakoore obogima, na obw’esosera, na obw’okobimbia omobere; narente riberera ri’egurugura entindi, na oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, na obw’okorigisia chindagera chiaino. Amaakwa ayio ’nababwatie goika abasirie kegima.

English: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
Kiswahili: Wakamvalisha Yesu joho la zambarau, wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakamvika kichwani.
Ekegusii: Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang'a egutwa y'amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,

English: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, kukainuka dhoruba kali baharini hata mashua ikaanza kufunikwa na mawimbi, lakini Yesu alikuwa amelala usingizi.
Ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omonene okaimoka ase enyancha, goika obwato bogatubwa nemerindo; korende ere konya oraarire.

English: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini wewe na watu wako mfe kwa upanga, njaa na tauni, ambazo Bwana ameonya juu ya taifa lolote ambalo halitamtumikia mfalme wa Babeli?
Ekegusii: Nase ki aye amo nabaanto bao moganetie gokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro na enchara, na oborwaire? Ayio nar'Omonene atebiire arakoreke ase egesaku kende gionsi keraange gokorera omorwoti o Babiloni.

English: And the LORD heard Israel’s plea and delivered up the Canaanites. Israel devoted them and their cities to destruction; so they named the place Hormah. The Bronze Serpent
Kiswahili: Bwana akasikiliza ombi la Waisraeli, naye akawapa ushindi juu ya Wakanaani. Wakawaangamiza kabisa na miji yao; hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Horma. Nyoka Wa Shaba
Ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Abaisraeli, akabaa obobui igoro y’Abakaanani. Abaisraeli bakabasiria kegima, bagasaria emechie yabo. Ase ogokora oko, aase aria akarokwa Horima. Eng’iti y’etai

English: As for the rest of the acts of Azariah, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Azaria na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Asaria, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abayuda.

English: The hills yield him their produce, while all the beasts of the field play nearby.
Kiswahili: Vilima humletea yeye mazao yake, nao wanyama wote wa porini hucheza karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Endagera ekoria nigo ekwama ase ebitunwa igoro, agwo ase ching’iti chi’orosana chikogosoreria.

English: and commanded his soldiers to cut down without mercy those who came in their way, and to kill those who went into their houses.
Kiswahili: na akawaamuru askari wake kuwaua bila huruma wale waliowazuia, na kuwaua wale walioingia majumbani mwao.
Ekegusii: agachiika abanto baye baite kera omonto bare koumerana nchera gose onde bwensi bw'ebisete.

English: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.
Kiswahili: Sauli akaenda katika mji wa Amaleki na kuwavizia bondeni.
Ekegusii: Saulo akagenda ase omochie bw'Abaameleki, akababoera agwo ase rigoko.

English: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti kuu mbinguni, ikisema: “Sasa wokovu na uweza na Ufalme wa Mungu wetu umekuja na mamlaka ya Kristo wake. Kwa kuwa ametupwa chini mshtaki wa ndugu zetu, anayewashtaki mbele za Mungu usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene igoro rigoteeba, “Bono ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito gwachire amo ne chinguru na oborwoti bwaye, na okobua gwa Kristo oye, ekiagera omosoeri bw'abaminto orutirwe inse, ere oyorenge kobasoera ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito omobaso na obotuko.

English: Suddenly, as Jeroboam was standing beside the altar to burn incense, there came a man of God from Judah to Bethel by the word of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kwa neno la Bwana, mtu wa Mungu alifika Betheli kutoka Yuda wakati Yeroboamu alipokuwa amesimama kando ya madhabahu ili kutoa sadaka.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto o Nyasae akarua ase ense ya Yuda. Ere agacha Beteli ekero Yeroboamu ateneine ase egesasiimero gosamba ubani.

English: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,' and don't know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana unasema: ‘Mimi ni tajiri, nimejilimbikizia mali, wala sihitaji kitu chochote.' Lakini hutambui ya kwamba wewe ni mnyonge, wa kuhurumiwa, maskini, kipofu, tena uliye uchi.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo ogoteeba: Inche nomonda inde! Netenenkirie! Tindemeiri kende. Na aye tomanyeti ng'a nigo ore omonto bw'emechando, omonto ogwenerete kororerwa amabeebe, omotaka, na omouko, na ore getirianda.

English: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
Kiswahili: Zitakuwa ishara na ajabu kwako na kwa wazao wako milele.
Ekegusii: Okwo nigo koraabe ekemanyererio na ogokumia igoro ase more, na ase chinderia chiaino kogenderera botambe.

English: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyeiweka mipaka yote ya dunia, ulifanya kiangazi na masika.
Ekegusii: Naye gwachiigete aase chimbebe chionsi chi’ense chikobeera, naende ogakora chingaki chi’egura gura n’etoigo.

English: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against Yahweh, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.
Kiswahili: Akani akamjibu Yoshua, “Ni kweli! Nimetenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli. Hili ndilo nililofanya:
Ekegusii: Akani akairaneria Yoshua, “Amaene, nakoreire Omonene Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, ebibe, na aya nakorire naya:

English: Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?” The Blind Man at Bethsaida
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawauliza, “Je, bado hamwelewi?” Yesu Amponya Kipofu Huko Bethsaida
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki motaramanya?” Yeso okogwenia omonto omouko agwo Bethisaida

English: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.” Israel’s Restoration
Kiswahili: Mabaki ya Israeli hayatafanya kosa; hawatasema uongo, wala udanganyifu hautakuwa katika vinywa vyao. Watakula na kulala wala hakuna yeyote atakayewaogopesha.”
Ekegusii: Abatigari b’Abaisraeli tibagokora ayare amabe, gose tibagokwana oborimo; chinkwana chi’obong’ainereria tichikorua ase emenwa yabo. Mbabe bakoragera na korara, na onde tari araboboyie.” Ogoteera kw’omogooko

English: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile kinywa chako kitamfumbukia yeye aliyenusurika, nawe utaongea wala hutanyamaza tena. Hivyo wewe utakuwa ishara kwao, nao watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Erio omonwa oo nokunorwe ochaake gokwana nomotami oria, tokogenderera koba rimama; ase igo aye nobe ekiorokererio ase abanto abwo, na barabwo mbamanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Mara moja kwa mwaka Aroni atafanya upatanisho juu ya pembe za hayo madhabahu. Upatanisho huu wa mwaka lazima ufanywe kwa damu ya sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi kwa vizazi vijavyo. Ni takatifu sana kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ara rimo kera omwaka Aroni akore okobwatanigwa ase ching'unchara chiaye. Naboigo ara rimo kera omwaka nakorere egesasiimero okobwatanigwa namanyinga 'ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Ayio nigo arakorerwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Egesasiimero ekio nagiatananwe kebe egechenu mono ase Omonene.”

English: “You shall say to this people, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
Kiswahili: “Zaidi ya hayo, waambie watu hawa, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Tazama, naweka mbele yenu njia ya uzima, na njia ya mauti.
Ekegusii: “Otebie abanto aba ng'a aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nabekire ase amasio aino enchera y'obogima na ey'amakweri.

English: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mahali pa juu pa kuabudia hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa kafara na kufukiza uvumba huko. Yothamu akajenga upya Lango la Juu la Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agatigwa kobao; abanto bakagenderera korua ebing’wanso na gosambera ubani igoro y’aase agwo. Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki’enyomba y’Omonene.

English: Nevertheless Nicanor, hearing of the valor of those who were with Judas, and their courage in fighting for their country, shrank from bringing the matter to the decision of the sword.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Nikanori, aliposikia kuhusu ushujaa wa wale waliokuwa pamoja na Yuda, na ujasiri wao katika kupigania nchi yao, alisita kufikisha jambo hilo kwenye uamuzi wa upanga.
Ekegusii: Nonya nigo ekero Nikanori aigwete buna Yuda n'abanto baye bare korwanerera ense yabo ase oboremu n'omoyo bw'okwerwa akanacha ekiina gotiga esegi erio gokoora omochando oyio ase enchera engao.

English: Now, therefore, Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa Farao na atafute mtu mwenye akili na hekima ili amweke kuwa msimamizi wa nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio Farao, rigia omonto ore omomanyi na omong’aini, omobeke igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: for ungodly men, refusing to know you, were scourged in the strength of your arm, pursued with strange rains and hails and relentless storms, and utterly consumed with fire.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watu wasiomcha Mungu, waliokataa kukujua, walipigwa kwa nguvu ya mkono wako, wakafukuzwa kwa mvua ya ajabu na mvua ya mawe na dhoruba zisizoisha, wakateketezwa kabisa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Abanyabibe baria nigo bangete gokomanya, okabasusura n'echinguru chi'okoboko kwao. Bakairwa n'emerindo emenene, n'embura y'amagena, n'echinkoba chitari gosira na gosirigwa n'omorero.

English: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Tena akamwahidi kwa kiapo, akamwambia, “Chochote utakachoomba nitakupa, hata kama ni nusu ya ufalme wangu.”
Ekegusii: Akamoriera eira, “Kende gionsi ekio orarigie korwa ase 'nde ninkoe, nonya nekeng'ese ki'oborwoti bwane.”

English: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa Wareubeni ulikuwa ni ukingo wa Mto Yordani. Miji hii na vijiji vyake ndiyo iliyokuwa urithi wa Wareubeni ukoo kwa ukoo.

English: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
Kiswahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya yote wakati bado niko pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: “Aya nabateebirie ekero inde ase more.

English: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
Kiswahili: Au niwaache waje kwangu kwa ajili ya kupata kimbilio, wao na wafanye amani nami, naam, wafanye amani nami.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto babwaterere oborendi bwane mbarende ne chinguru chiane; tiga bakore omorembe nainche, ee, barabwo mbabe nomorembe nainche.”

English: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. But Him they did not see.”
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya wenzetu walikwenda kaburini wakalikuta kama vile wale wanawake walivyokuwa wamesema, lakini yeye hawakumwona.”

English: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”
Kiswahili: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga nafaka pamoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
Ekegusii: Abakungu babere nababe bagoseera ase orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.

English: So the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hands of King Sennacherib of Assyria and all the others, and He gave them rest on every side.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana akamwokoa Hezekia na watu wa Yerusalemu kutoka mkononi mwa Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru na kutoka mikononi mwa wengine wote. Bwana akawastarehesha kila upande.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akorete agatooria Hezekia na abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko gwa Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, na korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo bonsi. Erio akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
Kiswahili: Mimi najishuhudia mwenyewe, naye Baba aliyenituma hunishuhudia.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong'orokia.”

English: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest said to the descendants of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this breach of faith against Him. Consequently, you have delivered the Israelites from the hand of the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Naye Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari, akawaambia Wareubeni, Wagadi na Manase, “Leo tunajua kwamba Bwana yuko pamoja nasi, kwa sababu hamkukosa uaminifu kwa Bwana katika jambo hili. Sasa mmewaokoa Waisraeli na mkono wa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, agateebia Abareubeni na Abagadi amo n’Abamanase, “Bono twamanyire ng’a Omonene nigo are ase egati yaito, ekiagera timwangete koba abegenwa ase Omonene. Igo mwatooririe Abaisraeli korwa ase egesusuro ki’Omonene.”

English: Do not be excessively wicked, and do not be a fool. Why should you die before your time?
Kiswahili: Usiwe mwovu kupita kiasi, wala usiwe mpumbavu: kwa nini kufa kabla ya wakati wako?
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omobe goetania, gose tobaisa koba omoriri. Nase ki oganetie gokwa engaki yao etaraika?

English: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Kiswahili: na yeyote atakayegusa kitu chochote alichokuwa amekalia atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Yeyote atakayeinua vitu hivyo ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Omonto aise gokuna egento kende gionsi kiareenge inse y’omonto oria omorwaire nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; na onde bwensi oraimokie egento buna ekio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: The men in ambush rushed suddenly against Gibeah; they advanced and put the whole city to the sword.
Kiswahili: Wale waviziaji wakafanya haraka kuingia Gibea, wakasambaa na kuwaua watu wote wa mji kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagasooka, bakarindokera omochie oria, bagaita abanto bonsi b’omochie n’emioro.

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo, Leteni watu wengi wenye makelele dhidi yao na uwaache wapate hofu na watekwe nyara.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Nimbarentere omoganda bw’ abanto obakorere bobe na kobasakora.

English: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
Kiswahili: Lakini niliwahurumia kwa ajili ya Jina langu takatifu, ambalo nyumba ya Israeli imelitia unajisi miongoni mwa mataifa huko walikokwenda.
Ekegusii: Korende ngechandera erieta riane richenu erio Abaisraeli bagerete rigakorwa rikaba eritachenegeti ase egati y' abanto b'ebisaku ebio ase bagendete.

English: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
Kiswahili: Zitakuwa ishara na ajabu kwako na kwa wazao wako milele.
Ekegusii: Okwo nigo koraabe ekemanyererio na ogokumia igoro ase more, na ase chinderia chiaino kogenderera botambe.

English: This is what the LORD says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Nenda ukanunue gudulia la udongo kutoka kwa mfinyanzi. Wachukue baadhi ya wazee wa watu na wa makuhani
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana nainche aganteebia, Genda ogore enyongo korwa ase omokori chinyongo. Ogende nabagaaka b’abaanto, na abagaaka b’abakuani,

English: “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food,” but God will destroy them both. The body is not intended for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
Kiswahili: “Chakula ni cha tumbo, na tumbo ni la chakula”: lakini Mungu ataviangamiza vyote viwili. Mwili haukuumbwa kwa ajili ya zinaa bali kwa ajili ya Bwana na Bwana kwa ajili ya mwili.
Ekegusii: “Endagera ney’enda na enda ney’endagera”, korende Nyasae nasarie bionsi bibere, enda na endagera. Omobere tori ase obotomani, korende nase Omonene, n’Omonene ase omobere.

English: Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
Kiswahili: Je, hamjasoma Andiko hili: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni;
Ekegusii: Nonya neririiko eri timorarisoma: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

English: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
Kiswahili: Wanadamu wote wameiona; watu wanaikazia macho kwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bayerorire, ee, Mwanyabaanto mbayerigereretie korwa aare.

English: They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.
Kiswahili: Wakayaacha maagizo yote ya Bwana Mungu wao na kujitengenezea sanamu mbili, walizozisubu katika sura ya ndama na nguzo ya Ashera. Wakasujudia mianga yote ya angani, na wakamtumikia Baali.
Ekegusii: Bagatiga amachiiko onsi ay'Omonene, Nyasae obo, bakabomba emegwekano ebere ye chimori; boigo bakaroisia omote bw'Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, bagasasiima erioba na omotienyi ne ching'enang'eni, na gokorera Baali enyasae eria.

English: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
Kiswahili: mbele ya Efraimu, Benyamini na Manase. Uamshe nguvu zako, uje utuokoe.
Ekegusii: Orokia chinguru chiao ase abanto b’Efraimu, na Ababenjamini, na Abamanase, na oche ototoorie!

English: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yese akamwambia mwanawe Daudi, “Chukua hii efa ya bisi na hii mikate kumi kwa ajili ya ndugu zako uwapelekee upesi kambini mwao.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo Yese agateebia Daudi, omwana oye: “Imokia ebigara ebi bisambire, ebitonga bibere, oimokie nemegati eye ikomi ogende bwango, obiirere bamura bamino aaria ase egetwori.

Kiswahili: mtu huyo ni lazima anyolewe, isipokuwa mahali palipo na ugonjwa, naye kuhani atamtenga kwa siku nyingine saba.

English: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn't see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
Kiswahili: Naye akaamuru lile gari lisimamishwe. Wakateremka kwenye maji wote wawili, yule towashi na Filipo, naye Filipo akambatiza.

English: Joiada was the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.
Kiswahili: Yoyada alikuwa baba wa Yonathani, na Yonathani alikuwa baba wa Yadua.

Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakikimbia mbele ya Israeli kwenye barabara iteremkayo kutoka Beth-Horoni hadi Azeka, Bwana akawavumishia mawe makubwa ya mvua kutoka mbinguni, na wengi wao wakauawa na hayo mawe kuliko wale waliouawa kwa upanga wa Waisraeli.

Abwo baitetwe namagena ’embura nigo barenge abange kobua abwo baitetwe n’Abaisraeli.

English: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
Kiswahili: Nao Walawi watawasomea watu wote wa Israeli kwa sauti kubwa:
Ekegusii: Na Abalawi bakwane amang'ana aya n'eriogi rinene, erinde Abaisraeli bonsi bayaigwe.

Kiswahili: Alipotufikia akachukua mshipi wa Paulo akajifunga, akautumia kufunga mikono na miguu yake mwenyewe akasema, “Roho Mtakatifu anasema: ‘Hivi ndivyo Wayahudi wa Yerusalemu watakavyomfunga mwenye mshipi huu na kumkabidhi kwa watu wa Mataifa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Agaacha ase tore, akabogoria orokini rwa Paulo, agesibera amagoro na amaboko, akabora: “Omoika Omochenu oteebire iga: Naboigo Abayahudi ba Yerusalemu barache gosiba omonto omonyene orokini oro, na barabwo nabamobeke ase amaboko ’abaanto b’Ebisaku.”

English: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
Kiswahili: Filipo akateremkia mji mmoja wa Samaria akawahubiria habari za Kristo
Ekegusii: Filipo agatirimboka, agasoa omochie o Samaria, akabaranderia Kristo.

English: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant He had made with them at Horeb.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maneno ya Agano Bwana aliyomwagiza Mose kufanya na Waisraeli huko Moabu, kuwa nyongeza ya Agano alilofanya nao huko Horebu.
Ekegusii: Aya n’aro amang’ana y’okobwatana kw’ogotianania Omonene achiigete Musa akore n’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense ya Moabu. Okobwatana okwo nigo kwamentetwe ase kori’Omonene konya akorire amo nabarabwo aaria Horebu.

English: The month is called after its name, increasing wonderfully in its changing— an instrument of the army on high, shining in the structure of heaven,
Kiswahili: Mwezi huo unaitwa kwa jina lake, ukiongezeka kwa ajabu katika mabadiliko yake - chombo cha jeshi lililo juu, kinachong'aa katika muundo wa mbinguni,
Ekegusii: “Omotienyi” bw'amatuko yomotienyi nigo oeire erieta kobwatekana nokororekana kwaye, oro nigo ogokiina ase chinchera chi'ogokumia ase ebiro biaye; oro omonyene nekiorokererio kia abarwani ba igoro ekero okomesa ase obwaro bwaye aria igoro.

English: So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish,
Kiswahili: Wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyeokwa,
Ekegusii: Bakamoa egesamunye gi’enswe gesambire na obooke boke.

English: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake walipoona kwamba baba yao anampenda Yosefu kuliko yeyote mwingine miongoni mwao, walimchukia na hawakusema naye neno lolote jema.

English: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkawa wafuasi wetu na wa Bwana, ingawa mlipata mateso mengi, mlilipokea lile Neno kwa furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mokaba abegi baito, na ab'Omonene, na nonya mwachandegete mono, mwanyorete ring'ana amo nomogooko okorwa ase Omoika Omochenu,

English: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Nyumba zao zitapewa watu wengine, pamoja na mashamba yao na wake zao, nitakapounyoosha mkono wangu dhidi ya wale waishio katika nchi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaao mbaire chinyomba chiabo, amo nabakungu babo na emegondo yabo. Ee, nindambore okoboko kwane, ing'ee abanto b'ense eye egesusuro.

English: and they didn't know the mysteries of God, neither did they hope for wages of holiness, nor did they discern that there is a prize for blameless souls.
Kiswahili: na hawakujua siri za Mungu, wala hawakutumainia mshahara wa utakatifu, wala hawakutambua kwamba kuna zawadi kwa roho zisizo na lawama.
Ekegusii: Tibamanyeti emeroberio ya Nyasae ya bobisi barabwo tibanya gotwara okogania komenya obogima obuya botari na mamocho.

English: “Leave, you sojourner, for an honored guest is here. My brother has come to be my guest. I need my house.”
Kiswahili: "Ondoka, wewe mgeni, kwa maana mgeni mheshimiwa yuko hapa. Ndugu yangu amekuja kuwa mgeni wangu. Ninahitaji nyumba yangu."
Ekegusii: Kore omogeni genda bwoo erio omotigerere omonto bw'engencho. Momura omonto ngochare bwone aiga ninde nokogania kw'eribaga ase enyomba yane.”

English: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake na kuambatana na mkewe, nao watakuwa mwili mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ekio nakio gekogera omonto agotiga ise na ng'ina obwatana na mokaye, na abwo babere baba omobere oyomo.

English: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!
Kiswahili: Ulijigamba dhidi yangu na kusema maneno dhidi yangu bila kujizuia, nami nikayasikia.

English: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.

English: Then Abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns. So he went and took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akainua macho yake, akaona kondoo dume amenaswa pembe zake nyuma yake katika kichaka. Akaenda akamchukua huyo kondoo dume, akamtoa awe sadaka ya kuteketezwa badala ya mwanawe.
