English: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ang'e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.

English: Moreover he has given them to be in subjection to all the kingdoms that are around us, to be a reproach and a desolation among all the people around us, where the Lord has scattered them.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo amewatia chini ya falme zote zinazotuzunguka, wawe aibu na ukiwa miongoni mwa watu wote wanaotuzunguka, mahali ambapo Bwana amewatawanya.
Ekegusii: Omonene agatoserebania, agatobeka ase amaboko y'echinse chinde echio chiatoetanaine, barabwo bagatorigereria na gotochaya mono.

English: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, vumilieni hadi kuja kwake Bwana. Angalieni jinsi mkulima angojavyo ardhi itoe mavuno yake yaliyo ya thamani na jinsi anavyovumilia kwa ajili ya kupata mvua za kwanza na za mwisho.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, remereria goika Omonene achiche. Rigereria, omoremi nigo akoganya okwama kw’omogondo okore ne rigori. Igo akoremereria ase ayio, goika anyore embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.

English: If your brother does not live near you, or if you do not know who he is, you are to take the animal home to remain with you until your brother comes seeking it; then you can return it to him.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huyo ndugu haishi karibu nawe au kama hufahamu yeye ni nani, mchukue nyumbani kwako huyo mnyama umweke mpaka mwenyewe aje kumtafuta. Ndipo umrudishie.
Ekegusii: Onye tamenyeti ang’e naye gose tomomanyeti, goika oyerente bwoo ebeere aroro goika oria omino ache koyerigia, erio omoyee.

English: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo pia, sasa wapo mabaki waliochaguliwa kwa neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero kia bono ’mbare abatigari abachoorirwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

English: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn it with all their heart. They had sought Him earnestly, and He was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.
Kiswahili: Yuda wote wakafurahia kile kiapo kwa sababu walikuwa wameapa kwa moyo wao wote. Wakamtafuta Mungu kwa bidii, naye akaonekana kwao. Kwa hiyo Bwana akawastarehesha pande zote.

English: As soon as the sacrifice was consumed, then Nehemiah commanded that the rest of the liquid be poured on large stones.

Ekegusii: Na ekero ekengwanso kiaerete koyia, Nehemia agachiika amache aria atigarete aumorwe igoro ase amagena aria amanene

English: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa Waamori ulikuwa kuanzia Genge la Akrabimu, kuendelea hadi Sela na kuelekea juu.
Ekegusii: Agwo aase ensinyo ya sugusu ya Sera, orobebe rw’Abaamori rokabeekerwa ase egetirimboko gia Akirabimu.

English: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
Kiswahili: Bahari ilikuwa inazidi kuchafuka. Kwa hiyo walimuuliza, “Tukutendee nini ili kufanya bahari itulie kwa ajili yetu?”
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio chionsi enyancha nigo yagendererete gosareka mono. Erio abanto baria bakabooria Jona, “Ngento ki tokogokorera, erinde enyancha etotoerere?”

English: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
Kiswahili: Wamenifanya niwe na wivu kwa kile ambacho si mungu, na kunikasirisha kwa sanamu zao zisizokuwa na thamani. Nitawafanya wawaonee wivu wale ambao si taifa. Nitawafanya wakasirishwe na taifa lile lisilo na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Bagerire nabeire ne risemi ase engencho y’egetari Nyasae, nagechiigwe ase emegwekano yabo ere bosa, eyio bagosasiima. Ase ayio inche ninseegete abanto abachorochombu, erinde babageechie nimbatige bageechigwe ase okobarentera egesaku ekeriri.

English: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
Kiswahili: Sema wewe ni dada yangu, ili nitendewe mema kwa ajili yako, na maisha yangu yatahifadhiwa kwa sababu yako.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bagokoboria igo, obateebie ng'a aye mosubati ominto ore, erinde ebe buya ase 'nde, na ase engencho yao imbe moyo.”

English: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
Kiswahili: Ee Temani, mashujaa wako watatiwa hofu, kila mmoja katika milima ya Esau ataangushwa chini kwa kuchinjwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abatemani, abarwani baino b’esegi bare chituoni mbaondoke, na kera oyomo ore ase Egetunwa gia Esau naitwe asirigwe kegima. Ayakogera Abaedomu baegwe egesusuro

English: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
Kiswahili: Wakati mkulima alimapo ili apande, je, hulima siku zote? Je, huendelea kubomoa ardhi na kusawazisha udongo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto okorema ng'a asimeke chimbusuro nigo akogenderera kona‐korema rioka? Inee! Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona‐koboosa rioka?

English: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
Kiswahili: Wakasema tena kwa nguvu: “Haleluya! Moshi wake huyo kahaba unapanda juu milele na milele.”
Ekegusii: Eria kabere bagateeba, “Haleluya! Erioki ri'okoyia kwaye nigo rirachongororoke gochia igoro goika kare na kare.”

English: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimewaambia, lakini hamwamini. Mambo ninayoyatenda kwa jina la Baba yangu yananishuhudia.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.

English: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
Kiswahili: Daudi akachukua kichwa cha yule Mfilisti na kukileta Yerusalemu, naye akaweka silaha za huyo Mfilisti katika hema lake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaimokia omotwe bw'Omofilisti oria akayoira Yerusalemu, korende ebirwanero bia Goliato akabigacha ase eema yaye omonyene.

English: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.
Kiswahili: Hata kama mtu ataishi miaka mingi kiasi gani, na aifurahie yote. Lakini na akumbuke siku za giza, kwa maana zitakuwa nyingi. Kila kitu kitakachokuja ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Omonto karagenderere koba moyo ase engaki y'emiaka emenge, tiga agokere engaki eyio yonsi, korende goika ainyore ng'a amatuko 'omosunte nabe amange mono. Onsi aya agochi‐gocha nigo are bosa.

English: He got his people great glory, and put on a breastplate like a giant, and bound his warlike harness around him, and set battles in array, protecting the army with his sword.
Kiswahili: Aliwapatia watu wake utukufu mkubwa, akavaa kifuani kama jitu, na kujifunga silaha zake za kivita, na kupanga vita, akililinda jeshi kwa upanga wake.
Ekegusii: Yuda akamenta obonene bwa abanto baye. Buna etwoni, akeboyia egiekengero kia gekuba, akabogoria ebirwanero na koraa esegi; na ase omoro oye akarenda ekambi yaye.

English: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
Kiswahili: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake;
Ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!

English: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances. You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako anakuagiza leo kufuata amri hizi na sheria; zishike kwa bidii kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote.
Ekegusii: “Rituko ria rero Omonene, Nyasae oo, ogochiikire oigwere na kobwata amachiiko aya n’emeroberio echiikire. Ase ayio oyarende mono na koyakora n’enkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi.

English: calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.
Kiswahili: akiita wale wapitao karibu, waendao moja kwa moja kwenye njia yao.
Ekegusii: aba okorangeria abaeti bare ase orogendo rwabo,

English: “Don't let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu, mnamwamini Mungu, niaminini na mimi pia.
Ekegusii: “Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino; momwegene Nyasae, nainche monyegene.

English: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn't know what to answer him.
Kiswahili: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito. Nao hawakujua la kumwambia.
Ekegusii: Erio naende akairana gocha ase aborokigwa akabanyora bararire, ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito, gose tibamanya eri bakomoiraneria.

English: So he killed these men for having turned traitors, and immediately took possession of the two towers.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo aliwaua watu hawa kwa kuwa wasaliti, na mara moja akachukua milki ya minara hiyo miwili.
Ekegusii: Agwo agwo agaita abanto abwo erio akaboera chindwaki chiria ibere.

English: Judah is a lion's cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
Kiswahili: Ee Yuda, wewe ni mwana simba; unarudi toka mawindoni, mwanangu. Kama simba hunyemelea na kulala chini, kama simba jike: nani athubutuye kumwamsha?
Ekegusii: Yuda, aye nendo ensae. Omwana one, gokorwa gotwara, nigo oratiire, na korara, na gotimoka buna endo, buna endo eaberi, ning'o orabe noboremu kogotura?

English: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.
Kiswahili: Lolote lililopo limekwisha kupewa jina, naye mwanadamu alivyo ameshajulikana; hakuna mtu awezaye kushindana na mwenye nguvu kuliko yeye.
Ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi kereo nigo kiarogetwe erieta korwa kare, naende nigo yamanyekanete eki omonto are gocha koba. Mwanyabaanto takonyara koamererania noria ore ne chinguru komobua.

English: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.
Kiswahili: Elamu analichukua podo, pamoja na waendesha magari ya vita na farasi. Kiri anaifungua ngao.
Ekegusii: Abaelamu nigo babogoretie chinsara, bagacha amo nabariini chigari na abe chibarasi; na abanto ba Kiri bagasokia chinguba chiabo.

English: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.
Kiswahili: Kwa hofu kuu na huzuni, Yakobo akagawanya watu aliokuwa nao katika makundi mawili, pia akagawanya makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi, na vilevile ngʼombe na ngamia.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaondoka mono na koumata, agaatanana abanto baria baarenge amo nere, ne ching'ondi, ne chiombe, ne chingamia, bikaba ebiombe bibere,

English: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
Kiswahili: Basi tuma watu waende Yafa wakaulize mtu mmoja Simoni aitwaye Petro, yeye ni mgeni katika nyumba ya Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi, ambaye nyumba yake iko kando ya bahari.’
Ekegusii: Ase igo, toma abanto Yopa, orangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero; ere nomogeni are nyomba mwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao, nigo amenyete ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.

English: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years. Satan Cast into the Lake of Fire
Kiswahili: Waliobarikiwa na walio watakatifu ni wale walio na sehemu katika ufufuo wa kwanza. Hao mauti ya pili haina nguvu juu yao, bali watakuwa makuhani wa Mungu na wa Kristo, nao watatawala pamoja naye kwa muda wa miaka 1,000. Kuhukumiwa Kwa Shetani
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyore omochenu, oyore nensemo y’okobokigwa kw’eritang’ani. Igoro ase abwo amakweri a kabere tari nokobua korende nababe abakuani ba Nyasae na abakristo, na barabwo nabagambe amo nere emiaka elifu eyemo.

English: He took possession of his cities. He came to Ecbatana and took the towers, plundered its streets, and turned its beauty into shame.
Kiswahili: Alichukua miji yake, akafika Ekbatana, akateka minara, akapora mitaa yake, na akageuza uzuri wake kuwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro akayeira ense emechie yonsi yabamedi. Akayeira emechie emenene yonsi nechichiiro na koonchorana obuya bw'emechie eyio yonsi ase okoyetaagora na koyesaria.

English: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
Kiswahili: Upendo na uaminifu humweka mfalme salama, kwa njia ya upendo, kiti chake cha enzi huwa salama.
Ekegusii: Obuya na obwegenwa, nabio bikorenda omorwoti, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obogaambi nigo kegokong’igwa namaabera.

English: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
Kiswahili: Lakini huyo mwanamke kutoka Tekoa akamwambia, “Mfalme bwana wangu, lawama na iwe juu yangu na juu ya nyumba ya baba yangu, naye mfalme na kiti chake cha enzi na asiwe na hatia.”
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Aye omorwoti, omonene one, tiga inche na eamate ya tata tobogorie okomocha kw'ebibe ebio. Asore omorwoti, gose ase ekerogo kiao ki'obogaambi, komocha tikobao.”

English: according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
Kiswahili: alichaguliwa kwa kura kwa kufuata desturi za ukuhani, kuingia Hekaluni mwa Bwana ili kufukiza uvumba.
Ekegusii: kobwatekana nengencho y'obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y'Omonene asambe ubani.

English: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east, seeking the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.
Kiswahili: Wanaume watayumbayumba kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutangatanga kutoka kaskazini mpaka mashariki, wakitafuta neno la Bwana, lakini hawatalipata.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbatayaye korwa ase enyancha goika ase enyancha ende, na korwa sugusu goika moocha; mbaminyoke gochia aaria na aaria, babe bakorigia ring’ana ri’Omonene, korende tibakorinyora.

English: And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, mtu aliyeitwa Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani pamoja na waasi wengine waliokuwa wametekeleza uuaji wakati wa maasi.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabaanto abakorete eburuburu, na gokora oboiti ase eburuburu.

English: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Sauli walikuwa Yonathani, Ishvi na Malki-Shua. Jina la binti yake mkubwa lilikuwa Merabu, naye mdogo aliitwa Mikali.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Saulo nabwo aba: Yonathani, na Isivi, na Malikisua; na amarieta y'abaiseke baye babere naro aya: omoiseke omotangi Merabu, na oria omoke Mikali.

English: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.
Kiswahili: Basi akashuka mpaka kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, akafanya kila kitu mama mkwe wake alichomwambia kufanya.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu agatirimboka gochia ase ekeooreri, agakora buna ng'ina biara konya amotebirie.

English: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Dibon-Gadi na kupiga kambi huko Almon-Diblathaimu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Diboni‐Gadi, bakageenda bagaika Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagatoora aroro.

English: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;
Kiswahili: ile Bahari ya chuma na yale mafahali kumi na wawili chini yake;
Ekegusii: na egetuba ekenene ekemo amo nemegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere ekabekwa inse y’egetuba keria,

English: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn't depart from them
Kiswahili: Nao Israeli wakadumu katika dhambi zote za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, nao hawakuziacha
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe bionsi biria Yeroboamu akorete; tibeatananete korwa ase birobio.

English: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa watumwa wakasisitiza, wakisema, “Timizeni kazi mnayotakiwa kwa kila siku, kama wakati ule mlipokuwa mkipewa nyasi.”
Ekegusii: Abachandi baria bakagenderera kobabetereria, bagoteeba, “Goika moroisie kera rituko ekerengo kia amatabori buna konya mokoroisia ekero mware korenterwa chimboba.”

English: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwingine wingu lilikuwa juu ya Maskani kwa siku chache tu; kwa amri ya Bwana wangelipiga kambi na kisha kwa amri yake wangeliondoka.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amake oka. Bun’Omonene achiigete, abanto nigo baare kobeera ase egetwori, naende ekero Omonene arenge kobachiika, bachaaka kogeenda ase orogeendo rwabo.

English: If therefore any troublemakers have fled from their country to you, deliver them to Simon the high priest, that he may take vengeance on them according to their law.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo ikiwa watu wowote wakorofi wamekimbia kutoka nchi yao kuja kwenu, wakabidhini kwa Simoni kuhani mkuu, ili apate kuwalipiza kisasi kwa mujibu wa sheria yao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, bono keraabe ogwatananeka konde gwonsi kwabeire ase Yudea na gotamera ense yao, oiranie abanto abwo ase Simioni, Omokuani omonene, nere nabae egesusuro kobwatekana na amachiiko ya Abayahudi.”

English: And when he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
Kiswahili: Alipotukuta huko Aso, tulimpakia melini, tukasafiri wote mpaka Mitilene.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gotoikeera aaria Asosi, tokamosoyia ase emeeri, togaika Metilene.

English: These were in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima: Shamiri, Yatiri, Soko,
Ekegusii: Na ase ense y’ebitunwa nigo yarengeo: Samiri, na Yatiri, na Soko,

English: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
Kiswahili: Shaharaimu aliwazaa wana katika nchi ya Moabu baada ya kuwapa talaka wake zake wawili yaani, Hushimu na Baara.
Ekegusii: Saharaimu akaibora abana abamura ase ense ya Moabu ekero konya aseririe Husimu na Baara, abakungu baye.

English: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don't withhold your hand; for you don't know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.
Kiswahili: Panda mbegu yako asubuhi, nako jioni usiruhusu mikono yako ilegee, kwa maana hujui ni ipi itakayofanikiwa, kwamba ni hii au ni ile, au kwamba zote zitafanikiwa sawasawa.
Ekegusii: Busura embusuro yao mambia, nonya mogoroba totiga koyebusura, ekiagera tomanyeti eye erame, neye gose neria, gose nchionsi amo chirame buya.

English: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn't answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akauliza ushauri kwa Bwana, lakini Bwana hakumjibu kwa ndoto, wala kwa Urimu, wala kwa njia ya manabii.
Ekegusii: Saulo akabooria komanya korwa ase Omonene, korende Omonene tamoiraneretie gento kende, nonya goetera ase chindoto, gose goetera ase Urimu, gose goetera ase ababani.

English: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.
Kiswahili: Ee Binti Sayuni, adhabu yako itaisha, hatarefusha muda wako wa kukaa uhamishoni. Lakini, ee Binti Edomu, ataadhibu dhambi yako, na atafunua uovu wako.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, egesusuro ki'ebibe biaino giaikeranigwe. Omonene takogenderera gokoira ase obosomba; korende inwe abanto ba Edomu, Omonene nabae egesusuro ase engencho y'ebibe biaino, ee, naorokie ebibe biaino maiso marore.

English: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
Kiswahili: Kisha ishara nyingine ikaonekana mbinguni: Likaonekana joka kubwa jekundu lenye vichwa saba na pembe kumi na taji saba katika vichwa vyake.
Ekegusii: Egekone kende gekarorekana igoro: Enchoka enene embariri eyarenge nemetwe etano na ebere ne ching'unchara ikomi, na igoro ase emetwe yaye nigo yarenge ne chigutwa isano na ibere.

English: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
Kiswahili: Wala Herode hakumwona na kosa lolote, ndiyo sababu amemrudisha kwetu. Kama mnavyoona, mtu huyu hakufanya jambo lolote linalostahili kifo.
Ekegusii: nonya n'Herode tarochi, ekiagera omoiranirie gocha ase tore. Rora, ere takorete gento kemogwenerete akwe.

English: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
Kiswahili: Wale mitume kumi na wawili wakakusanya wanafunzi wote pamoja wakasema, “Haitakuwa vyema sisi kuacha huduma ya neno la Mungu ili kuhudumu mezani.
Ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere bakarangeria omoganda bw’aborokigwa, bagateeba: “Tetogwenereti intwe gotiga ring’ana ria Nyasae na gokora emeremo ye chimesa.

English: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people and the wickedness of their sin.
Kiswahili: Wakumbuke watumishi wako Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Usiangalie ukaidi wa watu hawa, uovu wao wala dhambi yao.
Ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao, Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo; tobaisa kobarera abanto aba ogotaigwera kwabo gose obonyaka bwabo, gose ebibe biabo.

English: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
Kiswahili: Mzabibu wako umekatwa, umechomwa moto, unapowakemea, watu wako huangamia.
Ekegusii: Abanto bayosambire nomorero na koyogecha. Osirie abanto abwo ase okobea kwao!

English: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Kiswahili: kama vile ambavyo Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.”
Ekegusii: buna Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto atachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y'abange.”

English: As Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands, shattering them at the base of the mountain.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoikaribia kambi na kuona yule ndama na ile michezo, hasira yake ikawaka, akatupa vile vibao vilivyokuwa mikononi mwake, akavipasua vipande vipande pale chini ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Musa gaikire ang’e negetwori akarora emori eria, na buna abanto baare gotenga, akaba nendamwamu enene; agaakera inse chibao chiria abwate maboko aye, chigaateka, chikaba ebisamunye ase egetunwa inse.

English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
Kiswahili: Haya yalifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba: “Mwenyewe alitwaa udhaifu wetu na alichukua magonjwa yetu.”
Ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya, ogoteeba, “Ere akaimokia oboreu bwaito, na akabogoria amarwaire aito.”

English: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
Kiswahili: Sikia sasa, ee Israeli, amri na sheria nitakazokufundisha wewe. Zifuate ili upate kuishi na uingie kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana, Mungu wa baba zako anawapa.
Ekegusii: Naende Musa agakwana, “Inwe Abaisraeli, bono igwera amachiiko na emeroberio ’nkoborokereria, moyakore, erio nario moraabe moyo, erinde mogende moire ense eria, Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, agochia kobaa.

English: “If we do go,” Saul replied, “what can we give the man? For the bread in our packs is gone, and there is no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Kama tukienda, tutampa nini huyo mtu? Chakula kimekwisha kwenye mifuko yetu. Hatuna zawadi ya kumpelekea huyo mtu wa Mungu. Je tuna nini?”
Ekegusii: Saulo akabooria omosomba oye: “Onye tokogenda ase omonto oyio, inki tobwate tokomoirera? Endagera twabwate ase ebibekerero biaito yaerire, na keegwa kende titobwati tokoirera omonto oyio o Nyasae. Ninki tobwate?”

English: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana ni nani aliyefahamu mawazo ya Bwana ili apate kumfundisha?” Lakini sisi tunayo mawazo ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: “Naki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bi’Omonene, erinde amworokererie?” Korende intwe ntore nebirengererio bia Kristo.

English: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi wapendwa, jijengeni katika imani yenu iliyo takatifu sana tena ombeni katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe, abanchani, mweagache ase okwegena kwaino kore ogochenu mono, na gosaba ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni Mfalme milele na milele, mataifa wataangamia watoke nchini mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonene n'Omorwoti o kare na kare; abanto b'Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.

English: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
Kiswahili: Je, ni kwa malaika yupi ambaye Mungu amepata kumwambia wakati wowote, “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako”?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tatebeti onde ase abamalaika baye: “Ikaransa ensemo y'okoboko kwane gw'okorio, goika mbabeeke ababisa bao babe inse y'amagoro ao”?

English: Is this man Coniah a despised and shattered pot, a jar that no one wants? Why are he and his descendants hurled out and cast into a land they do not know?
Kiswahili: Je, huyu mtu Yekonia ni chungu kilichodharauliwa, chungu kilichovunjika, chombo kisichotakiwa na mtu yeyote? Kwa nini yeye na watoto wake watupwe nje kwa nguvu, na kutupwa kwenye nchi wasioijua?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyo Konia nigo abeire buna enyongo yatekire, egekorero onde ataganeti? Nase ki rende ere amo nabana baye barutirwe gochia ase ense batamanyeti?

English: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
Kiswahili: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, wanaudhania kuwa ukuta usioweza kurukwa.
Ekegusii: Obotenenku bw'omonto omonda nigo bonga buna omochie omokong'u, naende nigo bonga orwaki orotambe gochia igoro rokomorenda.

English: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
Kiswahili: Kesheni daima na mwombe ili mweze kuokoka na yale yote yatakayotokea na kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyoore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi araache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”

English: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!’
Kiswahili: Ndipo Roho akaniinua, nikasikia sauti kubwa nyuma yangu ya ngurumo. (Utukufu wa Bwana na utukuzwe katika mahali pa makao yake!)
Ekegusii: Erio Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, nkaigwa korwa magega y’ane eriogi buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba, rigoteeba: “Obonene bw’Omonene botogigwe korwa agwo ase bore!”

English: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Kiswahili: “Mungu ametukuzwa katika nguvu zake. Ni nani aliye mwalimu kama yeye?
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amanene ase okobua kwaye. Inee! Ning'o okworokereria buna ere?

English: Now I know for sure that you will be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kwamba hakika utakuwa mfalme na ya kwamba ufalme wa Israeli utakuwa imara mikononi mwako.
Ekegusii: Bono inche namanyire ng’a naye orabe omorwoti, na oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli mbogenderere koba ase okoboko kwao.

English: In the midst of kindred he who rules them has honor. Those who fear the Lord have honor in his eyes.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayewatawala ana heshima katikati ya jamaa, na wale wanaomcha Bwana wana heshima machoni pake.
Ekegusii: Gati abamura bamwabo omomura omonene nere ogwenerete gosikwa. Baria bamoirogete Nyasae mbagwenerete amasikani bosio bwaye.

English: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo katika siku hizo, sitakuangamiza kabisa,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire, “Nonya nase amatuko ayio tinkobasiria inwe kegima.

English: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
Kiswahili: Nimechakaa kwa kulia kwa huzuni; usiku kucha nafurikisha kitanda changu kwa machozi; nimelowesha viti vyangu vya fahari kwa machozi.
Ekegusii: Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw'obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia namariga ase oborere bwane, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.

English: Then I returned, washed myself, ate my bread in heaviness,
Kiswahili: Kisha nikarudi, nikaoga, nikakula mkate wangu kwa uzito,
Ekegusii: erio nkairana ngesibia nkaria endagera eria n'okweumia.

English: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”
Kiswahili: Watu ni wenye nguvu na warefu, ni wana wa Waanaki! Mnafahamu habari zao na mmesikia inavyosemekana: “Ni nani awezaye kusimama dhidi ya Waanaki?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bakareo n'abanene, naende n'abatambe, abanto b'ororeeria rw'Anaki mwabeire mokoigwa chinkuma chiabo, bagokwanwa: Ning'o oranyaare kobua Abanaki?

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: N'Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: You heard rebuke in Sinai, and judgments of vengeance in Horeb.
Kiswahili: Ulisikia kemeo huko Sinai, na hukumu za kisasi huko Horebu.
Ekegusii: Aye kwaigwerete ogotogonya kw'Omonene aaria ase egetunwa gia Sinai, n'okoraria gw'egesusuro ase ababisa baye aaria ase egetunwa kia Orebu.

English: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Samaki katika Mto Naili wakafa, nao mto ukanuka vibaya sana kiasi kwamba Wamisri hawakuweza kunywa maji yake. Damu ilikuwa kila mahali katika nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amaache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo chakula kikaandaliwa kwa ajili yake, lakini akasema, “Sitakula mpaka niwe nimewaambia yale niliyo nayo ya kusema.” Labani akasema, “Basi tuambie.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateeba: “Inche nomosomba o Aburaamu.

English: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
Kiswahili: Katika kufedheheshwa kwake alinyimwa haki yake. Nani awezaye kueleza juu ya kizazi chake? Kwa maana maisha yake yaliondolewa kutoka duniani.”
Ekegusii: Ase ogwekeyia kwaye ekiina kiaye gekarusigwa. Ning'o oranyare gototeebia ororeria rwaye? Ekiagera obogima bwaye bwarusigwe ase ense.”

English: Furthermore, let both man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and have everyone call out earnestly to God. Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands.
Kiswahili: Bali wanadamu na wanyama wafunikwe kwa nguo za gunia. Kila mmoja afanye hima kumwomba Mungu. Waziache njia zao mbaya na udhalimu ulio mikononi mwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi pi amo n’echingiti babeke chianga chi’echigunia. Kera oyomo goika amosabe Nyasae ase ekeene naende boigo goika atige chinchera chiaye chi’obobe namakora aye y’ebibe.

English: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus' chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
Kiswahili: Petro akageuka, akamwona yule mwanafunzi aliyependwa na Yesu akiwafuata. (Huyu ndiye yule mwanafunzi aliyeegama kifuani mwa Yesu walipokula naye chakula cha mwisho na kuuliza, “Bwana, ni nani atakayekusaliti?”)
Ekegusii: Petero akeonchora, akarora omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete okobatunyana; nere oria bweegegete egekuba kiaye ekero gi'okoria endagera ya mogoroba na gokwana, “Omonene, ning'o orakorue?”

English: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nikaweka baadhi ya watu nyuma ya sehemu za chini za ukuta kwenye sehemu zilizo wazi, nikawaweka kufuatana na jamaa zao, wakiwa na panga, mikuki na pinde zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo nkabeeka abanto maate, magega y'orwaki, aase aasie; nkababeeka eamate ase eamate, bare nebirwanero biabo: emioro, na amatimo, na amata.

English: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mkate ushukao kutoka mbinguni, si kama ule mkate baba zenu waliokula nao wakafa. Lakini yeye aulaye mkate huu ataishi milele.”
Ekegusii: Oyio nomogati oigete korwa igoro, tari buna chisokoro chiaino chiariete mana, bagakwa; oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo goika kare na kare.”

English: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
Kiswahili: ‘Je, binadamu aweza kuwa mwadilifu kuliko Mungu? Je, mtu aweza kuwa safi kuliko Muumba wake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto nanyare koba omooronge kobua Nyasae? Nanyare koba oyochenegete kobua Omotongi oye?

English: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: “Basi baada ya miaka arobaini kupita, malaika wa Mungu akamtokea Mose jangwani karibu na Mlima Sinai katika kichaka kilichokuwa kinawaka moto.
Ekegusii: Ekero emiaka emerongo ene yachia koera, omomalaika akamoorokera ase ogwoka kw’omorero ase egetutu aaria erooro y’egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
Kiswahili: Nitawapiga kwa tauni na kuwaangamiza, lakini nitakufanya wewe kuwa taifa kubwa lenye nguvu kuliko wao.”
Ekegusii: Nkobaaka inde noborwaire bogoita erinde imbasirie, na aye 'ngokore obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere nokobua goetania abanto aba.”

English: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
Kiswahili: naye akawa huko nyikani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, akijaribiwa na Shetani. Alikaa na wanyama wa mwituni, nao malaika wakamhudumia. Yesu Aanza Kuhubiri
Ekegusii: Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare. Yeso okorangeria Abarubi bane (Mat 4:17; Luk 4:14-15)

English: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana Mungu wenu atawatia watu hao mikononi mwenu, akiwatia katika kuchanganyikiwa kukubwa mpaka wawe wameangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae oino, nabeeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino, erio abatantanie, nainwe goika mobasirie kegima.

English: Give them—Yahweh what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
Kiswahili: Wape, Ee Bwana, je, utawapa nini? Wape matumbo ya kuharibu mimba na matiti yaliyokauka.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bae eki ogwenerete kobaa, ogombayie chinda chiabo, ne chimbeere chiabo chiome pa.

English: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Enenda zako, mwanao yu hai.” Yule afisa akaamini yale maneno Yesu aliyomwambia, akaondoka akaenda zake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, omwana oo nabe moyo.” Omonto oria akegena ring'ana riria ateebetigwe na Yeso, akabwatia enchera yaye.

English: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu, imwagikayo kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe magega ase okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane, aitekire ase engencho yaino.]

English: So Moses took the staff from the LORD’s presence, just as he had been commanded.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akaichukua hiyo fimbo kutoka pale ilipokuwa mbele za Bwana kama alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia enyimbo eria korwa aase yarenge, agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

English: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
Kiswahili: Wala tusimjaribu Kristo, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa kwa kuumwa na nyoka.
Ekegusii: Gose titoteema Omonene, buna abande babo bakorete, bagasirigwa ne ching’iti.

English: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully. Love, Zeal, Hope, Hospitality (John 13:31–35; 1 John 3:11–24)
Kiswahili: kama ni kutia moyo na atie moyo, kama ni kuchangia kwa ajili ya mahitaji ya wengine na atoe kwa ukarimu, kama ni uongozi na aongoze kwa bidii, kama ni kuhurumia wengine na afanye hivyo kwa furaha. Alama Za Mkristo Wa Kweli
Ekegusii: oyo okoremia abe ase okoremia kwaye; oyo okorua arue ase omoyo omorabu; oyo ogotenenera atenenere ase omokia; oyo okororera amaabera arorere amaabera n’omogooko. Emeroberio y’obogima bw’obokristo

English: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
Kiswahili: Siku zote kwa moyo mmoja walikutana ndani ya ukumbi wa Hekalu, wakimega mkate nyumba kwa nyumba, wakila chakula chao kwa furaha na moyo mweupe,
Ekegusii: Kera rituko bakagenderera gosangererekana amo ase Hekalu ime, bagosamunyora emegati enyomba ase enyomba na koragerera amo ase omogooko na ase chinkoro chi’oboitongo,

English: For that man shouldn't think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mtu kama huyo asidhani ya kuwa atapata kitu chochote kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto oria takaga ng'a nanyore egento korwa ase Omonene;

English: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
Kiswahili: Wakaweka mawe ya kuabudiwa na nguzo za Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti uliotanda.
Ekegusii: Bageteneneria chisiiro chi’ogosasiima na emete y’Asera igoro ase kera ekegoro egetambe, na inse ya kera omote omobese.

English: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.
Kiswahili: Kama vile tulivyomtii Mose kikamilifu, ndivyo tutakavyokutii wewe. Bwana Mungu wako na awe pamoja nawe tu kama vile alivyokuwa pamoja na Mose.
Ekegusii: Buna tware koigwera Musa, naye natokoigwere. Omonene, Nyasae oo, abe amo naye buna abeete na Musa.

English: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
Kiswahili: Utajazwa na aibu badala ya utukufu. Sasa ni zamu yako! Kunywa na ujifunue! Kikombe kutoka kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Bwana kinakujia, na aibu itafunika utukufu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaichoirwe nobosooku ribaga ri’ogosikwa. Aye kanywe, obe omonto otarogeti! Egekombe ki’egesusuro kere ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nakegochere; na oboosoku mbotube obonene bwao.

English: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amelifunua hili nikiwa ninasikia: Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, asema: “Mpaka siku ya kufa kwenu, dhambi hii haitafanyiwa upatanisho.”
Ekegusii: Omonene bw'Emeganda nere onyorokirie amang'ana ayio na gonteebia, “Ekeene, timokwaberwa ebibe ebio nonya ng'ake.” Omonene bw'Emeganda oteebire ayio.

English: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
Kiswahili: Sababu ya mimi kukuacha huko Krete ni ili uweke utaratibu mambo yale yaliyosalia na kuwaweka wazee wa kanisa katika kila mji, kama nilivyokuagiza.
Ekegusii: Nkagotiga Kirete, erinde oroisie aria aganetie gokorwa erio ochore abagaaka ime ase kera omochie. Inyora buna nagochigeete.

English: You must use honest scales, a just ephah, and a just bath.
Kiswahili: Tumieni mizani sahihi na vipimo sahihi vya efa na bathi.
Ekegusii: “Goika motware ebirengero bi’ekeene mokorengera oborito na obonge bw’ebinto bionsi.

English: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
Kiswahili: Wakati unapowapa, wanakikusanya, unapofumbua mkono wako, wao wanashibishwa mema.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwabieire endagera, nigo bikoyesangereria; ekero kwaramboire okoboko kwao, nigo bigoisaneka n'ebinto bire ebiya.

English: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
Kiswahili: Utaniita nami nitakuitika; utakionea shauku kiumbe ambacho mikono yako ilikiumba.
Ekegusii: Aye korandangerie, na inche ningoitabere, ekiagera noganie emeremo y'amaboko ao.

English: But when the Gentiles and Jews, together with their rulers, set out to mistreat and stone them,
Kiswahili: Watu wa Mataifa na Wayahudi wakajiunga na baadhi ya viongozi, wakafanya mpango wa kuwatendea mitume mabaya na kuwapiga mawe.
Ekegusii: Ekero okong’orerwa kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku na Abayahudi amo n’abanene babo gwakoretwe igoro y’abatomwa ase okobakorera amabe na kobaaka amagena,

English: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
Kiswahili: huwaketisha pamoja na wakuu, pamoja na wakuu wa watu wake.
Ekegusii: obabeeka baikaransa amo n’abwo bare n’okobua, baria bakogambera abanto baye.

English: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
Kiswahili: Ramu alimzaa Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akamzaa Nashoni, kiongozi wa kabila la Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nahasoni, oyo orenge omotang’ani bw’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda.

English: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
Kiswahili: Tujichagulie wenyewe yaliyo sawa, nasi tujifunze pamoja yaliyo mema.
Ekegusii: Tochore ayare amaronge; intwe amo toteeme komanya ayare amaronge.

English: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akauliza, “Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na nini? Nitaufananisha na nini?
Ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo boreng’anirie naki? Ninki nkoboreng’ania?

English: A worthless man digs up evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
Kiswahili: Mtu mbaya kabisa hupanga mabaya, maneno yake ni kama moto uunguzao.
Ekegusii: Omonto otaisaini nigo akona‐gotukoria amabe, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chinga omorero okorura.

English: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamkumbuka Noa na wanyama wote wa porini na wa kufugwa waliokuwa naye ndani ya safina, akatuma upepo ukavuma katika dunia, nayo maji yakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoinyora Nuhu ne ching'iti chionsi, echi'orosana, na echiatugire, echiareenge amo nere ase obwato ime. Erio agwo Nyasae akagusia omwaga ase ense, na amaache aria agakea.

English: Then Elihu continued:
Kiswahili: Kisha Elihu akasema:
Ekegusii: Erio Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

English: They have emptied out the money that was found in Yahweh's house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”
Kiswahili: Wamelipa fedha zilizokuwa katika Hekalu la Bwana na wamewakabidhi wasimamizi na wafanyakazi.”
Ekegusii: Bairire chitaabu chionsi chianyorekanete ase enyomba y'Omonene, na bachibekire ase amaboko 'abateneneri b'emeremo amo nabakori emeremo.”

English: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
Kiswahili: Mwana-kondoo alipoivunja ile lakiri ya tatu, nikamsikia yule kiumbe wa tatu mwenye uhai akisema, “Njoo!” Nikatazama, na mbele yangu alikuwepo farasi mweusi! Yeye aliyempanda alikuwa na mizani mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatato, nkaigwa eng’iti ya gatato ere moyo ekobora, “Inchuo!” Nkarigereria, nkarora ebarasi emwamu, na ere oyoyeriinete narenge nekerengo gi’okorenga ase okoboko kwaye.

English: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
Kiswahili: Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa, kwa sababu ya watesi wako, kumnyamazisha adui na mlipiza kisasi.
Ekegusii: Ase emenwa y’abana n’eyabakogonka nigo kweagacheire eburi bosio bw’ababisa bao, erinde okoiyeria ababisa bao inse na abakorusia egesiomba.

English: You who ride white donkeys, who sit on saddle blankets, and you who travel the road, ponder
Kiswahili: “Nanyi mpandao punda weupe, mkiketi juu ya matandiko ya thamani, nanyi mtembeao barabarani, fikirini
Ekegusii: Inwe aba’mokoriina chitigere chindabu, nainwe aba’mogoikaransa ase emegeeke yaino, nainwe aba’mogotaara ase chinchera, morarie amang’ana ayio!

English: She will meet him like a mother, and receive him like a wife married in her virginity.
Kiswahili: Atakutana naye kama mama, na kumpokea kama mke aliyeolewa katika ubikira wake.
Ekegusii: Ere chisemi n'akwariganie buna omokungu omonyanyangi akoarigania omonywomi.

English: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja mavazi mapya, lakini Benyamini akampa shekeli 300 za fedha, na jozi tano za nguo.
Ekegusii: Akaa kera oyomo eanga agochia koonchoreria, korende Benjamini ere akamoa chisekeli chi'echifeta amagana atato amo ne chianga isano, echi agochia koonchoreria.

English: Don't be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don't deceive with your lips.
Kiswahili: Usishuhudie dhidi ya jirani yako bila sababu, au kutumia midomo yako kudanganya.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba kirori bosa igo mamincha y'omonto onde, na tobaisa kong'ainereria nebikoba biao.

English: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukaenda mpaka kwenye mteremko wa kaskazini wa Beth-Hogla na kujitokeza kwenye ghuba ya kaskazini ya Bahari ya Chumvi, kwenye maingilio ya Yordani upande wa kusini. Huo ulikuwa mpaka wa kusini.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rokagenderera gochia esagamo ya Beti‐Hogila, rogaika ensemo ya sugusu y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Oro narwo orobebe rwa Irianyi.

English: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Yesu Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, ambaye tulimhubiri kwenu: Mimi, Silvano na Timotheo, hakuwa “Ndiyo” na “Siyo,” bali kwake yeye siku zote ni “Ndiyo.”
Ekegusii: Naki Omwana o Nyasae, Yeso Kristo, oyo inche na Silivano, na Timotheo, twarandetie ase egati yaino tabeete “Ee” na “Yaya”, korende asare “Ee” nero ereo botambe.

English: No one is to enter the house of the LORD except the priests and those Levites who serve; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the people are to obey the requirement of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote ataingia katika Hekalu la Bwana isipokuwa makuhani na Walawi walioko kwenye zamu. Wao wanaweza kuingia kwa sababu ni watakatifu, lakini watu wengine wote itawapasa kulinda kile walichoamriwa na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi tabaisa gosoa enyomba y’Omonene otatiga abakuani na Abalawi abwo bare ab’ekerisio. Abwo mbanyare gosoa, ekiagera bachenekire, korende abanto bande goika babwate omooroberio ochikiire n’Omonene.

English: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
Kiswahili: Nimewaambia mambo ya duniani, nanyi hamkuniamini, mtaniaminije basi nitakapowaambia mambo ya mbinguni?
Ekegusii: Onye nkobateebia amang’ana ense, na inwe timokoyeegena, naki moreegene kondabateebie amang’ana a igoro?

English: Assaulting them vigorously, they took control of the positions, and kept off all who fought upon the wall, and killed those whom they encountered, killing no fewer than twenty thousand.
Kiswahili: Wakiwashambulia kwa nguvu, walichukua udhibiti wa maeneo hayo, na kuwazuia wote waliopigana ukutani, na kuwaua wale waliokutana nao, na kuwaua wasiopungua elfu ishirini.
Ekegusii: Bakarwania Abarwani baria b'esegi barendete chinyasi chi'echingongo echio erio bagaita abanto goetania 20,000.

English: You are not to do any work at all. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.
Kiswahili: Hamtafanya kazi kamwe. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Timokora emeremo ende yonsi. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more, ebiaare ase ebiaare aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
Kiswahili: Fimbo ya waovu haitadumu juu ya nchi waliopewa wenye haki, ili wenye haki wasije wakatumia mikono yao kutenda ubaya.
Ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi y’abakori amabe tekogenderera kogambera omwando bw’ abanto abaronge; abwo baabaise korambora amaboko abo ase ogokora amabe.

English: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
Kiswahili: Atawahurumia wanyonge na wahitaji na kuwaokoa wahitaji kutoka mauti.
Ekegusii: Nigo are omwororo ase omoremerwa na ase omotaka, boigo nigo agotooria emioyo y’abaremeire.

English: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
Kiswahili: Eliya alipoisikia, akafunika uso kwa vazi lake, akatoka na kusimama kwenye mdomo wa pango. Kisha ile sauti ikamwambia, “Eliya, unafanya nini hapa?”
Ekegusii: Na ekero Elija aigwete eriogi riria, agatuba obosio bwaye negetambaa kiaye gi'okwambara, agasoka isiko, agatenena ase egesoero kie rikuruma riria; na agwo eriogi rigacha asare, rigakwana, rikamoboria: “Elija, ninki ogokora aiga?”

English: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi akapeleka ujumbe huu kwa makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari, kusema: “Waulizeni wazee wa Yuda, ‘Kwa nini mwe wa mwisho kumrudisha mfalme katika jumba lake la kifalme, maadamu kile kinachosemwa katika Israeli yote kimemfikia mfalme katika makao yake?
Ekegusii: Daudi omorwoti agatoma abanto gochia ase Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, agateeba, “Kwana n'abagaaka b'Abayuda, mobamboorerie: Inaki rende mokoba abanto b'omoerio ase okong'irania inche omorwoti inka bwone, bono ekero amang'ana onsi aya Abaisraeli bakwanete aikerete nyomba mw'ane?

English: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
Kiswahili: Kama vile mvua na theluji ishukavyo kutoka mbinguni, nayo hairudi tena huko bila kunywesha dunia na kuichipusha na kuistawisha, hivyo hutoa mbegu kwa mpanzi na mkate kwa mlaji,
Ekegusii: “Buna embura na amagena ’embura bigotwa korwa igoro, na tibikoirana gochia igoro, korende nigo bikonyiyia riroba, erinde ebimeri biamera na kwama, erio ense yama chimbusuro chikobusurwa, na endagera ekoriegwa,

English: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
Kiswahili: Naye kila anayesikia haya maneno yangu wala asiyatende, ni kama mtu mjinga aliyejenga nyumba yake kwenye mchanga.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, ko tayakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto omoriri, oagachete mwaye ase amaroba;

English: Also Yahweh's word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Naende ring'ana ri'Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:

English: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Mara utakaposikia sauti ya kutembea kutoka kwenye vilele vya miti ya miforosadi, nenda haraka, kwa sababu hiyo itamaanisha kuwa Bwana ametangulia mbele yako kupiga jeshi la Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Ekero oraigwe eriogi ri'ebititiro bigoeta igoro ase emete eyio, erio bwebeeke ang'e, omanye ng'a inche Omonene nasookire, nagotang'anire kobua abarwani b'Abafilisti.”

English: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote aniaminiye mimi, kazi nizifanyazo yeye atazifanya, naam na kubwa kuliko hizi atazifanya, kwa sababu mimi ninakwenda kwa Baba.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyoranyegene inche, emeremo ngokora inche, nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.

English: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwita Loti wakisema, “Wako wapi wale watu ambao walikuja kwako jioni hii? Watoe nje kwetu ili tuweze kuwalawiti.”
Ekegusii: bakarangeria Loti, bakamobooria: “Abanto abwo bacha mwao bono botuko, ng'ai bare? Basokie isiko aa, tobakore abakungu.”

English: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
Kiswahili: Akafika kwenye mji mmoja wa Samaria uitwao Sikari, karibu na lile shamba ambalo Yakobo alimpa mwanawe Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Igo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sikari, ang'e nomogondo oria Yakobo aete Yusufu omwana oye;

English: but I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.
Kiswahili: Nitauondoa ufalme kutoka mikononi mwa mwanawe na kukupa wewe makabila kumi.
Ekegusii: Nindusie oborwoti korwa ase okoboko kw'omwana oye; aye noegwe ebisaku ikomi,

English: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don't sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
Kiswahili: “Mtu akikualika arusini, usikae mahali pa mgeni wa heshima kwa kuwa inawezekana amealikwa mtu mheshimiwa kuliko wewe.
Ekegusii: “Gokorangerigwa nomonto ase omoyega bw'enyangi, toikaransa ase ekerogo kie ritang'ani; onye omonto bw'amasikani kobua aye orangeretigwe nere,

English: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
Kiswahili: Mwenye hekima moyoni hupokea maagizo, lakini mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omong'aini ase enkoro yaye nigo anchete amachiiko, korende oyogokwana amang'ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.

English: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh's hand double for all her sins.”
Kiswahili: Sema na Yerusalemu kwa upole, umtangazie kwamba kazi yake ngumu imekamilika, kwamba dhambi yake imefanyiwa fidia, kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana maradufu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.
Ekegusii: Kwana amang'ana 'obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng'a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng'a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw'Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.

English: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers' houses.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Efraimu, mashujaa hodari 20,800, watu waliokuwa maarufu katika koo zao.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaefraimu: chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana atano na atato (20,800), abanto chituoni ase esegi bamanyekanete ase chiamate chiabo.

English: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
Kiswahili: Aliachia upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwenye mbingu na kuuongoza upepo wa kusini kwa uwezo wake.
Ekegusii: Akarenta omwaga o moocha okagusa igoro, na ase okobua kwaye akagusia omwaga korwa Irianyi.

English: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa nikiikumbuka imani yako ya kweli, waliokuwa nayo bibi yako Loisi na mama yako Eunike na ambayo mimi ninasadiki sasa wewe pia unayo.
Ekegusii: Ning'inyorete okwegena ore nakorokwo, gotari nobong'ainereria, okwo kwareenge ritang'ani ase nyagokoro Lois na ase nyoko Yunuke, na inche ninde nobomaene ng'a naye nokobwate boigo.

English: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, shattering them before your eyes.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nilichukua vibao vile viwili nikavitupa na kuvipasua vipande vipande mbele ya macho yenu.
Ekegusii: ’Nkabwata chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena ase amaboko ane, ’ngachiakera inse, ’ngachiatera agwo ase amasio aino.

English: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.
Kiswahili: Kando ya Mto Ahava, hapo nilitangaza kufunga, ili tujinyenyekeshe mbele za Mungu wetu na kumwomba kwa ajili ya kutujalia safari ya amani sisi na watoto wetu, pamoja na mali zetu zote.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo ase orooche rw'Ahawa, nkaraareria abanto, nkabateebia ng'a tweng'ate, naende twekeyie tobe abaitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito na korigia korwa asare oborendi obuya ase orogendo rwaito, intwe na abana baito, na ebinto biaito bionsi.

English: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
Kiswahili: Sasa kama mkinitii kikamilifu na kutunza Agano langu, basi ninyi mtakuwa mali yangu ya thamani kubwa miongoni mwa mataifa yote. Ijapokuwa dunia yote ni mali yangu,
Ekegusii: Bono komoranyigwere na kobwata okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, rirorio inamobe abanto baane. Naki ense yonsi neyane, korende inwe inamobe abanto baane abachore kobua abanto b’ebisaku binde.

English: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mose aliwaandikia sheria hiyo kwa sababu ya ugumu wa mioyo yenu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ase engencho y'obokong'u bwe chinkoro chiaino nakio kiagerete abariikerete ogochika oko.

English: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.
Ekegusii: Bagakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu bagachibeeka ase egesembe keria, ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.

English: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
Kiswahili: Akamuuliza, “Hivi kweli wewe ni mwanangu Esau?” Akajibu, “Mimi ndiye.”
Ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Amaene, naye omwana one Esau?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Ee, Tata ninche.”

English: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
Kiswahili: Pia alitawala Araba ya mashariki kuanzia Bahari ya Kinerethi hadi Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), hadi Beth-Yeshimothi, kisha kuelekea kusini chini ya materemko ya Pisga.
Ekegusii: Naende akaba okogamba ase rikura ria Yorodani, moocha y'enyancha ya Galili goika Beti‐Yesimoti, ensemo ya moocha y'Enyancha y'omonyoo, eyere ase orogongo rwa Araba, gochia Irianyi goika ebitirimboko bi'egetunwa gia Pisiga.

English: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways justice; and those who walk in pride he is able to abase.
Kiswahili: Basi mimi, Nebukadneza, humhimidi, na humtukuza na kumsifu Mfalme wa mbinguni, kwa sababu kila kitu afanyacho ni haki, na njia zake zote ni adili. Nao waendao kwa kiburi anaweza kuwashusha.
Ekegusii: Bono inche Nebukadinesaro nigo 'nkomotogia Omorwoti ore igoro na komobaka, ekiagera ogokora kwaye gwonsi n'okwa boronge, ne chinchera chiaye boigo, na abwo bare abaenenu nigo akobakeyia.

English: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaita ule umati wa watu, akawaambia, “Sikilizeni na mwelewe:
Ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto bache asare, akabateebia, “Igwa na manya:

English: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mmebarikiwa hata kama ikiwalazimu kuteseka kwa ajili ya haki. “Msiogope vitisho vyao, wala msiwe na wasiwasi.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye mogochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, more negesio. Timoiroka okoirokia kwabo, gose timoichana.

English: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, near the dwelling of the righteous; do not destroy his resting place.
Kiswahili: Usivizie kama haramia afanyavyo ili kuyashambulia makao ya mwenye haki, wala usiyavamie makazi yake,
Ekegusii: Aye omokori amabe, tobaisa koboera omonyene oboronge ase amenyete, tosaria aase aye agotimokera.

English: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wenzake walipoona haya yaliyotukia wakaudhika sana, nao wakaenda na kumwambia bwana wao kila kitu kilichokuwa kimetukia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasomba bande bachia korora aya akoreka, bagaichana mono, bakagenda, bagateebia omonene obo onsi ayakorekire.

English: Who has seen him, that he may describe him? Who can magnify him as he is?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyemwona, ili aweze kumsimulia? Ni nani awezaye kumtukuza kama alivyo?
Ekegusii: Ere ning'o oyio omorooche ere erio anyare korwa omogano buna ere are? Gose, ning'o oranyaare komotogia aikeranie ekerengo kemogwenerete?

English: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let's kill him and seize his inheritance.'
Kiswahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji walipomwona mwanawe, wakasemezana wao kwa wao, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Njooni tumuue, ili tuchukue urithi wake.'
Ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria, ekero bachia korora omwana oria, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye toyoire.

English: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because this will mean that God has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Mara usikiapo sauti ya kwenda juu ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi, hapo ndipo utoke upigane vita, kwa sababu hiyo itaonyesha kwamba Mungu amekutangulia ili kupiga jeshi la Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero oraigwe ebititiro bigoeta ase emete eyio igoro, erio ogende korwana esegi; omanye ng’a Nyasae ogotang’aneire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”

English: Each Israelite took his position around the camp, and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.
Kiswahili: Wakasimama kila mtu mahali pake kuizunguka kambi pande zote, Wamidiani wote wakakimbia, huku wakipiga kelele.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto agatenena aase aye goetanana ase egetwori keria; erio abarwani b’esegi abarenge imeo bagachaaka kominyoka gochia aaria na aaria, bagakuura na gotama.

English: Although the sender intended that this money was for the sacrifice of Hercules, yet on account of present circumstances it went to the construction of trireme warships.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mtumaji alikusudia kwamba pesa hizi zilikuwa kwa ajili ya kafara ya Hercules, lakini kwa sababu ya hali ya sasa zilitumika katika ujenzi wa meli za kivita za trireme.
Ekegusii: ase igo bagachira bakaroiseria chimeri chi'echisegi.

English: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akatuma watu wamwite kuhani Ahimeleki mwana wa Ahitubu, na jamaa yote ya baba yake, waliokuwa makuhani huko Nobu, nao wote wakaja kwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agatoma Abanto korangeria Ahimeleki Omokuani, mosinto bw'Ahitubu, amo n'baanto bonsi b'eamate yaye, na abakuani bonsi abaarenge agwo Nobu. Abwo bonsi bakagenda ase omorwoti.

English: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer),
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya mafuta iliyoamriwa, yaliyopimwa kwa bathi, ni sehemu ya kumi ya bathi kutoka kila kori moja (ambayo ina bathi kumi au homeri moja.)
Ekegusii: Morue amaguta ekerengo gechiikire, ebituba bibere korwa ase ekori eyemo. (Ekori eyemo nigo ereng'aine ne homeri eyemo; nigo ebwate chibati ikomi).

English: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. Therefore I am commanding you to do this.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kwamba mlikuwa watumwa katika nchi ya Misri. Ndiyo sababu ninawaamuru kufanya hili.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri; ase ayio nabachiikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.

English: if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul. The Choice of Life or Death
Kiswahili: kama ukimtii Bwana Mungu wako, na kuzishika amri zake na maagizo yake ambayo yameandikwa katika Kitabu hiki cha Sheria, na kumgeukia Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote. Uzima Na Mauti
Ekegusii: komoraigwere Omonene Nyasae oino, na mobwate amachiiko aye onsi na emeroberio echiikire, ariikire ase egetabu eke y’amachiiko, naende komoramoonchokere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.

English: At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon—
Kiswahili: Hivyo kwa wakati huo tukachukua kutoka kwa wafalme hawa wawili wa Waamori nchi ya mashariki ya Yordani, kutoka Bonde la Arnoni mpaka kufika kwenye Mlima Hermoni.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria tokaira ense y’abarwoti baria babere b’Abaamori, ense yarenge moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani, gochaakera orooche rw’Arinoni goikera egetunwa kia Herimoni.

English: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
Kiswahili: “Basi kukawa na njaa katika nchi yote ya Misri na Kanaani, ikasababisha dhiki kubwa, nao baba zetu wakawa hawana chakula.
Ekegusii: Erio enchara ekaba igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na Kaanani, na emechando emenge, ne chisokoro chiaito tichianyora endagera echiisanete.

English: Yahweh's Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Kiswahili: Roho wa Bwana akaanza kumsukuma wakati alipokuwa huko Mahane-Dani, kati ya Sora na Eshtaoli.
Ekegusii: Omoika bw'Omonene ogaachaka gokora emeremo ime yaye ekero arenge ase egetwori gia Dani, agwo gati ya Sora na Esitaoli.

English: They stood at their prescribed posts, according to the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood, which they received from the hand of the Levites.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakachukua nafasi zao za kawaida kama ilivyoelezwa katika Sheria ya Mose mtu wa Mungu. Makuhani wakanyunyiza ile damu waliyokabidhiwa na Walawi.
Ekegusii: Bagakora emeremo yabo, kera oyomo aase aye, koreng’ana namachiiko a Musa, omonto o Nyasae. Abakuani bakanyororokeria amanyinga aria banyorete korwa ase amaboko ’Abalawi.

English: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka mlimani, Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote mambo waliyoona, mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuwa amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Kabagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa akabakania tibatorera monto ayabaroche, goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto kabokire korwa ase abakuure.

English: Yahweh's sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
Kiswahili: Upanga wa Bwana umeoga katika damu, umefunikwa na mafuta ya nyama: damu ya kondoo na mbuzi, mafuta kutoka figo za kondoo dume. Kwa maana Bwana ana dhabihu huko Bosra, na machinjo makuu huko Edomu.
Ekegusii: Omoro Omonene oichoirwe namanyinga, otubirwe nebitinya, ee, oichoirwe namanyinga e chimanwa chi'eching'ondi, na aye chimbori, na otubirwe nebitinya bie chinyigo chie chimingichi. Omonene ngokora are ekeng'wanso agwo Bosira, na ogoitwa okonene nkobe ase ense y'Abaedomu.

English: Instead, you are to open your hand to him and freely loan him whatever he needs.
Kiswahili: Afadhali fungua mikono yako na umkopeshe kwa hiari chochote anachohitaji.
Ekegusii: Mobe abaya ase are, momoe singo ebinto biisaine ase oboremerwa bwaye bonde bwonsi.

English: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, naki erieta riao riakuma ense yonsi!

English: “Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda akasema, “Mwache avichukue vitu hivyo, ama sivyo tutakuwa kichekesho. Hata hivyo, nilimpelekea mwana-mbuzi, lakini hukumkuta.”
Ekegusii: Yuda akabora: “Tiga atware ebinto ebio namoete bibe intenenera, titobaisa gocha kororekana nobosooku. Rora, namotomerete emaanwa egoree, na aye tikwamonyorete.”

English: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction. And when they had made an end to the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Amoni na Moabu wakawainukia watu wa Mlima Seiri ili kuwaua na kuwaangamiza kabisa. Baada ya kumaliza kuwachinja watu wa Seiri, wakaangamizana wao kwa wao.
Ekegusii: Abaamoni na Abamoabu bakaumokera korwania abanto b’ebigoro bia Edomu, bakabasiria kegima, na ekero basiretie abanto abwo, Abaamoni na Abamoabu bagaitana, bagakoorana.

English: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.
Kiswahili: Daudi na nyumba yote ya Israeli walikuwa wanacheza mbele za Bwana kwa nguvu zao zote, kwa nyimbo, vinubi, zeze, matari, kayamba na matoazi.
Ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga na goteera ase ogotogia Omonene; bakabugia amakano, na ebibangarara, ne chindege, na ebinto binde bi'ogochengera.

English: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
Kiswahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Wayahudi wamekubaliana wakuombe umpeleke Paulo kwenye baraza lao kesho kwa kisingizio kwamba wanataka kufanya uchunguzi wa kina wa shauri lake.
Ekegusii: Akabora: “Abayahudi babwatanire kogosaba otirimbokie Paulo gochia bosio bw'ekegambero ankio, buna igo barigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua.

English: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”
Kiswahili: mbele ya rafiki zake na jeshi la Samaria, akisema, “Hawa Wayahudi wanyonge wanafanya nini? Je, wataweza kuurudishia ukuta wao? Je, watatoa dhabihu? Je, wataweza kumaliza kuujenga kwa siku moja? Je, wataweza kufufua mawe kutoka malundo ya vifusi yaliyoungua hivyo?”
Ekegusii: Agakwana ase amasio 'abaanto bamwabo na ase abasikari b'Abasamaria, agateeba, “Ngento ki eke Abayahudi aba aboro abagundo bagokora? Inee! Mbanyare kweagachera naende omochie oyio? Mbarue ebing'wanso aase aa naende? Mbanyare gokoora emeremo eyio ase rituko erimo? Gose mbanyare koremora korwa ase ebinge chi'amagena aya asambetwe bayakore abe amayia?”

English: A man who goes astray from his own marriage bed says in his heart, “Who sees me? Darkness is around me, and the walls hide me. No one sees me. Of whom am I afraid? The Most High will not remember my sins.”
Kiswahili: Mtu anayepotoka kutoka kwenye kitanda chake cha ndoa husema moyoni mwake, “Nani anionaye? Giza linanizunguka, na kuta zinanificha. Hakuna anionaye. Nimwogope nani? Aliye Juu hatakumbuka dhambi zangu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo akobuna eira yaye y'enyaangi na goteeba ase omoyo oye: “Ning'o ondooche? Omosunte nigo ong'etanaine nechinyasi nigo chimbisete! Monto taiyo ondooche, inche ninki ndoboere? Omonene takorora ebibe biane!”

English: So Abraham got up early the next morning, saddled his donkey, and took along two of his servants and his son Isaac. He split the wood for a burnt offering and set out for the place God had designated.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akaamka asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, akamtayarisha punda wake. Akawachukua watumishi wake wawili pamoja na Isaki mwanawe. Baada ya kuchanja kuni za kutosha kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akaondoka kuelekea mahali Mungu alipokuwa amemwambia.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akabeeka ebinto ase etigere yaye, akairana abamura babere amo nere, na Isaka omwana oye. Agaatia chinko agochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, akaimoka, akagenda gochia aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae.

English: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
Kiswahili: “Ole kwa ulimwengu kwa sababu ya yale mambo yanayosababisha watu kutenda dhambi! Mambo hayo lazima yawepo, lakini ole wake mtu yule ambaye huyasababisha.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobw'ense ase engencho y'amateemwa ayakorenta ebibe! Inaki amateemwa takomocha kobao, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oyio okorenta ogoteemwa!

English: And so Job died, old and full of years.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Ayubu akafa, akiwa mzee aliyekuwa ameshiba siku.
Ekegusii: Na Ayubu agakwa kabeire omogotu mono.

English: Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me, a delightful child? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore My heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: Je, Efraimu si mwanangu mpendwa, mtoto ninayependezwa naye? Ingawa mara kwa mara ninanena dhidi yake, bado ninamkumbuka. Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unamwonea shauku, nina huruma kubwa kwa ajili yake,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Efraimu tari omwana one nyanchete? Ere nere ongogetie mono. Nonya nkomotianera, nigo imorengereretie botambe. Enkoro yane nigo emwechanderete, ekeene, nimororere amaabera.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
Kiswahili: Kabila ya Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo, ilikuwa na miji mikubwa ifuatayo: Yeriko, Beth-Hogla, Emeki-Kesisi,
Ekegusii: Emechie ye chiamate chi'egesaku kia Benjamini nigo yarenge: Yeriko, na Beti‐Hogila, na Emeki‐Kesisi,

English: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Ni mmoja miongoni mwenu ninyi kumi na wawili, yule anayechovya mkate kwenye bakuli pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Noyomo bw'aba ikomi na babere, ere oyogotobeka amo nainche omogati ase esani.

English: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akachukua kile Kitabu cha Agano na kuwasomea watu. Nao wakajibu, “Tutafanya kila kitu alichosema Bwana, nasi tutatii.”
Ekegusii: Erio akaimokia egetabu gi'okobwatana kw'ogotianania agwo ase amariko a Omonene ariikire agasomera abanto bakaigwa, erio Barabwo bakaboora, “Natoigwere na gokora onsi ay'Omonene akwanire.”

English: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
Kiswahili: Kifuko hicho kilikuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, nacho kilikunjwa mara mbili.
Ekegusii: Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng’aine.

English: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
Kiswahili: Upande wa mwisho wa magharibi ulikuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini na ulikuwa na mapazia, na nguzo kumi na vitako vyake kumi, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya bosongo bakaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

English: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:
Kiswahili: Mfalme na wakuu wake walipendezwa na shauri hili, hivyo basi mfalme akafanya kama Memukani alivyopendekeza.
Ekegusii: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.

English: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Yafa hapakuwa mbali sana na Lida, wanafunzi waliposikia kwamba Petro yuko huko waliwatuma watu wawili kwake ili kumwomba, “Tafadhali njoo huku pasipo kukawia.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Lida nigo orenge ang'e na Yopa, na aborokigwa konya baigure ng'a Petero nao are aria, bagatoma abanto babere asare komosorora na komoteebia: “Koranche, totebana gocha ase tore.”

English: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
Kiswahili: Nitaangamiza uchawi wenu na hamtapiga tena ramli.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana ase more nonya ng'ake.

English: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
