Kiswahili: bali walijichanganya na mataifa na wakazikubali desturi zao.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo basang'ananete n'abanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.

English: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
Kiswahili: Hakika angewakemea kama mkiwapendelea watu kwa siri.
Ekegusii: Ekeene ere nabatogonyere Onye mogokora ogwanchereria bobisi.

English: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
Kiswahili: Leo unanifukuza kutoka nchi, nami nitafichwa mbali na uwepo wako. Nitakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga asiyetulia duniani na yeyote anionaye ataniua.”
Ekegusii: Rora, reero gwanseririe korwa ase riroba eri, nimbiseke korwa ase obosio bwao, timborora naende. Nimbe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense, na onde bwensi orang'umere nigo arang'ite.”

English: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Asafu. Ee Mungu, mbona umetukataa milele? Mbona hasira yako inatoka moshi juu ya kondoo wa malisho yako?
Ekegusii: (Ototera gw'Asafu) Aye Nyasae, nase ki gwatotigire kegima? Ninki gekogera endamwamu yao yokire igoro ye ching'ondi chi'oborisia bwao?

English: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into Yahweh's house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.
Kiswahili: “Panda uende kwa Hilkia, kuhani mkuu, umwambie ahesabu zile fedha ambazo zimeletwa katika Hekalu la Bwana, ambazo mabawabu wamekusanya kutoka kwa watu.
Ekegusii: “Genda ase Hilikia, Omokuani bw'omonene, omoboorie abare chitaabu chiarentirwe ase enyomba y'Omonene, echio abarendi b'egesieri basangereirie korwa ase abanto.

English: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
Kiswahili: Basi Mfalme Daudi akamtaka aletwe kutoka Lo-Debari, kutoka nyumbani kwa Makiri mwana wa Amieli.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agatoma abanto bagachia komwoyia korwa o Makiri, mosinto bw'Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.

English: Then the priest is to pour some of the oil into his left palm
Kiswahili: Kuhani atamiminia sehemu ya mafuta kwenye kiganja chake cha mkono wa kushoto,
Ekegusii: Omokuani ataaere amaguta ase oroe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

English: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwako Mbenyamini mmoja, mtu maarufu, ambaye aliitwa Kishi mwana wa Abieli, mwana wa Serori, mwana wa Bekorathi, mwana wa Afia wa Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Benjamini nareengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kisi, mosinto bw’Abieli, o Serori, o Bekorati bw’Afia, omonto bw’egesaku gia Benjamini. Kisi nigo areenge omonto omonda.

English: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ampendaye ndugu yake anakaa nuruni, wala hakuna kitu chochote ndani yake cha kumkwaza.
Ekegusii: na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.

English: He was caught away, lest evil should change his understanding, or guile deceive his soul.
Kiswahili: Alinyakuliwa, uovu usije ukabadilisha ufahamu wake, au hila ikamdanganya roho yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo amonganyetie erio obobe tiboonchora ebirengererio biaye gose obongainereria tibosiria omoyo oye.

English: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Mose aliondoka Misri bila kuogopa ghadhabu ya mfalme. Alivumilia kwa sababu alimwona yeye asiyeonekana kwa macho.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y'omorwoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.

English: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
Kiswahili: “Kuhusu haya mnayoyaona hapa, wakati utafika ambapo hakuna jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.” Mateso (Mathayo 24:3-14; Marko 13:3-13)
Ekegusii: “Aya morooche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mat 24:3-25; Mar 13:3-23)

English: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
Kiswahili: Hivyo watu wakachukua donge lao la unga kabla ya kutiwa chachu, wakaweka ndani ya mabakuli ya kukandia, wakayaviringisha katika vitambaa na kuyabeba mabegani mwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimokia amasie abo konya atarabekwa memera, bakaboa ebituba biabo, ebi baare oboseemiara obosie, ase ebitambaa biabo baare kwambara, bakabibogoria ase amareko abo.

English: Let's see if his words are true. Let's test what will happen at the end of his life.
Kiswahili: Hebu tuone kama maneno yake ni ya kweli. Hebu tujaribu kitakachotokea mwishoni mwa maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Bono intwe tiga torore gose amang'ana aye nayekeene, tiga torore ayaramonyore ekero arakwe.

English: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh's covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akaandika sheria hii na kuwapa makuhani, wana wa Lawi, waliochukua Sanduku la Agano la Bwana na wazee wote wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Musa akariika amachiiko ayio, erio akayaa abakuani Abalawi barenge kobogoria Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw'ogotianania kw'Omonene, boigo akayea abagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli.

English: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one. Do Not Love the World
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia ninyi akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana, kwa sababu mna nguvu, na neno la Mungu linakaa ndani yenu, nanyi mmemshinda yule mwovu. Msiupende Ulimwengu
Ekegusii: Nabarikerete inwe, abana bane, ekiagera momomanyete tata. Nabarikeire inwe aba Tata ekiagera momomanyete ere oyonge oo korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.

English: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
Kiswahili: Huko hakutakuwepo na simba, wala mnyama mkali hatapita njia hiyo, wala hawatapatikana humo. Ila waliokombolewa tu ndio watakaopita huko,
Ekegusii: Endo tekobao ase enchera eyio, gose eng'iti ende y'orosana tegochao, chirochio tichikonyorekana aroro, korende abanto baboorigwe nabwo barataare ase enchera eyio.

English: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
Kiswahili: Kuweni na nia ile ile aliyokuwa nayo Kristo Yesu:
Ekegusii: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

English: and sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
Kiswahili: Tukamtuma Timotheo ambaye ni ndugu yetu na mtumishi mwenzetu wa Mungu katika kuieneza Injili ya Kristo, aje kuwaimarisha na kuwatia moyo katika imani yenu,
Ekegusii: Togatoma Timotheo oyominto, omokori emeremo amo na Nyasae ase okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, erinde abakong'ie na kobaremia ase okwegena kwaino,

English: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.
Kiswahili: ndipo yeye aletaye sadaka yake ataiweka mbele za Bwana sadaka ya nafaka, sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta.
Ekegusii: Oyokorua ebing’wanso buna ebio ase Omonene, goika arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo,

English: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
Kiswahili: akatuma wajumbe kwenda kumwita Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ambaye alikuwa huko Pethori, karibu na Mto Frati, katika nchi yake ya kuzaliwa. Balaki akasema: “Taifa limekuja kutoka Misri, nao wamefunika uso wa nchi, nao wametua karibu nami.
Ekegusii: Ere agatoma abanto ase Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, agwo Petori ore ang'e norooche rw'Eufarati, ase ense yabo. Barabwo bakamoteebia amang'ana a Balaki. “Rigereria, abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nabarabwo nabange, batubete orogongo rwonsi, batoorire ang'e naintwe, barigereretie ense yane.

English: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa mji wakamwambia Yoashi, “Mlete mwanao hapa. Ni lazima afe, kwa sababu amebomoa madhabahu ya Baali na kukatakata nguzo ya Ashera iliyokuwa karibu nayo.”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b'omochie oria bagateebia Yoashi, “Morente omomura oyio oo aiga, ere goika aitwe, ekiagera otagoire egesasiimero gia Baali, na otagoire omote oria bw'Asera orenge ensemo yaye.”

English: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
Kiswahili: Jeuri imeinuka kuwa fimbo ya kuadhibu uovu, hakuna hata mmoja wa hao watu atakayeachwa, hata mmoja wa kundi lile, hakuna utajiri, hakuna chenye thamani.
Ekegusii: Okorega okwo gwakiinire, kwabeire enyimbo igoro y'abwo bagokora amabe. Omonto obo tagotigara nonya noyomo; obotenenku bwabo mbosirigwe amo na kende gionsi babwate, na obonene bwabo bwonsi mboere.

English: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
Kiswahili: Waamori ambao waliishi katika vilima hivyo waliinuka dhidi yenu, wakawafukuza kama kundi la nyuki wakiwapiga njia yote ya Seiri mpaka Horma.
Ekegusii: Abaamori abamenyete ase ense eria bagaacha bakabaumokera buna chinchoke. Bakabaseria goika Horima erio bakababua agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu.

English: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
Kiswahili: “Hawajui lolote, hawaelewi lolote. Wanatembea gizani; misingi yote ya dunia imetikisika.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.

English: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”
Kiswahili: Siku ile itakapowadia, mtalia kwa kutaka msaada kutokana na mfalme mliyemchagua, naye Bwana hatawajibu.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio inamobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y'omorwoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”

English: As a house that is destroyed, so is wisdom to a fool. The knowledge of an unwise man is talk without sense.
Kiswahili: Kama nyumba iliyobomolewa, ndivyo hekima ilivyo kwa mpumbavu. Maarifa ya mtu asiye na akili ni kama maneno yasiyo na maana.
Ekegusii: Ase omonto omoriri chisemi nigo chinga buna enyomba yagure; n'emeroberio y'omonto omoriri igo are amang'ana atari na moroberio.

English: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.
Kiswahili: Akapaondoa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, akazivunja sanamu, akakatakata nguzo za Ashera. Akavunja vipande vipande ile nyoka ya shaba Mose aliyotengeneza, kwa kuwa hadi siku hizo wana wa Israeli walikuwa wanaifukizia uvumba (ilikuwa ikiitwa Nehushtani).
Ekegusii: Agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na agatagora chisiiro chigosasimerwa amo nomote bw'Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu. Akabutorana ebing'ese eng'iti y'etai eria Musa aroisetie, ekiagera goika ase amatuko aria Abaisraeli igo bagendererete koyesambera ubani; bakayeroka Nehusitani.

English: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
Kiswahili: Akamchukua Petro pamoja na wale wana wawili wa Zebedayo, akaanza kuhuzunika na kufadhaika.
Ekegusii: Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

English: Wake up righteously and don't sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Kiswahili: Zindukeni mwe na akili kama iwapasavyo, wala msitende dhambi tena; kwa maana watu wengine hawamjui Mungu. Nasema mambo haya ili mwone aibu.
Ekegusii: Boka buna egwenerete ase oboronge, timokora ebibe naende. Naki abande tibamomanyeti Nyasae. Natebiire aya ase okobasookia.

English: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”
Kiswahili: “Maji yaliyoibiwa ni matamu; chakula kinacholiwa sirini ni kitamu!”
Ekegusii: “Amaache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase abobisi nigo ogwansa.”

English: She died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
Kiswahili: Sara akafa huko Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani, Abrahamu akamwombolezea na kumlilia Sara.
Ekegusii: Sara agakwera ase Kiriati‐Ariba, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani. Aburaamu akagenda komoreera Sara na okweumia okonene, na akaroberia omoyega bw’ogotindekwa kwaye.

English: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.
Kiswahili: Mkono ulinigusa, ukaninyanyua, na kuniweka nikipiga magoti na mikono yangu ikashika chini, huku nikiwa bado ninatetemeka.
Ekegusii: Nkarora okoboko kogonkuna, gokanyimokia, ngatung'ama n'amaru, ngasigamera inse nebisanyi bi'amaboko nkoiguswa.

English: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
Kiswahili: Hadadezeri akaagiza Waaramu walioletwa kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Frati, wakaenda Helamu pamoja na Shobaki jemadari wa jeshi la Hadadezeri akiwaongoza.
Ekegusii: Hadadeseri agatoma abanto barente Abasiiria abwo barenge moocha y'orooche rw'Eufarati. Barawo bagaacha Helamu, na Sobaki, omotang'ani bw'abarwani ba Hadadeseri, akabatang'ana.

English: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi Yonathani alikwenda shambani kukutana na Daudi. Alikuwa amefuatana na mvulana mdogo,
Ekegusii: Emambia ya kabere, Yonathani amo nomwana oria omomura, bakagenda mogondo, ase engaki konya bachikanire na Daudi.

English: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.
Kiswahili: Hamani akaongeza, “Si hayo tu. Mimi ndiye mtu pekee ambaye Malkia Esta amemwalika kumsindikiza mfalme kwenye karamu aliyomwandalia. Naye amenialika pamoja na mfalme kesho.
Ekegusii: Naende Hamani akabora, “Esiteri eting'ana, moka omorwoti, naroisia endagera, tarangeretie onde otatiga inche bweka amo nomorwoti. Nonya ng'ankio nagatorangeretie, inche amo nomorwoti.

English: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.
Kiswahili: Fanya hivi: Waondoe hao wafalme wote thelathini na wawili kutoka nafasi zao na uweke maafisa wengine mahali pao.
Ekegusii: Kora iga: Rusia abarwoti, kera oyomo ase emeremo yaye, na ase amabaga abo obeke abatang'ani b'abasikari.

English: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana alikuwa anawafundisha wanafunzi wake. Akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu. Nao watamuua, lakini siku tatu baada ya kuuawa atafufuka.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia ng'a, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko y' abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke magega y'amatuko atato.”

English: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
Kiswahili: Uzima huo ulidhihirishwa; nasi tumeuona na kuushuhudia, nasi twawatangazia uzima wa milele, ambao ulikuwa pamoja na Baba, nao ukadhihirishwa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabaraareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa ase tore.

English: Get up and consecrate the people, saying, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
Kiswahili: “Nenda, ukawatakase watu. Waambie, ‘Jitakaseni mjiandae kwa kesho; kwa sababu hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: Kitu kilichowekwa wakfu kipo katikati yenu, ee Israeli. Hamwezi kusimama dhidi ya adui zenu mpaka mtakapokiondoa.
Ekegusii: Bono imoka, ochene abanto! Obateebie bechene na kwebeeka ang’e goika ankio, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebiire iga: Inwe Abaisraeli imobwate ase egati yaino ebinto biatananetwe na koragererigwa, timokonyara kobua ababisa baino goika mwarusirie ebinto ebio korwa ase more.

English: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.
Kiswahili: Wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata, lakini wakaogopa umati wa watu, kwa kuwa watu walimwona Yesu kuwa ni nabii.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia korigia komobwata, bakairoka emeganda, ekiagera abanto konya banchire ng’a ere nomobani.

English: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani, hata aweze kuwa safi, au yeye aliyezaliwa na mwanamke, hata aweze kuwa mwadilifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto ninki are goika anyare koba oyochenegete? Gose ere oyio oiboire nomokuungu ng’a anyare koba omonyaboronge?

English: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.
Kiswahili: Kisha msherehekee Sikukuu ya Majuma kwa Bwana Mungu wenu kwa kutoa sadaka ya hiari kwa kadiri ya baraka ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa.
Ekegusii: Morende Amatuko Amanene ye Chichuma ase Omonene Nyasae oino, Morente ebiegwa bi'ogwancha ase Omonene Nyasae oino, mobirue buna koreng'ana abasesenirie.

English: A foolish son is his father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.
Kiswahili: Mwana mpumbavu ni maangamizi ya babaye, naye mke mgomvi ni kama kutonatona kusikoisha.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo akorentera ise amabe, na omokungu okona‐kwomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotonya.

English: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
Kiswahili: Wema wa Bwana Mungu wetu uwe juu yetu; uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu: naam, uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu.
Ekegusii: Obosiani bw'Omonene, Nyasae oito, bobe igoro yaito, na emeremo y'amaboko aito oyesesenie ase tore, ee, osesenie emeremo y'amaboko aito!

English: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule malaika akaniambia, “Kwa nini unastaajabu? Nitakufafanulia siri ya huyo mwanamke na huyo mnyama aliyempanda, mwenye vichwa saba na pembe kumi.
Ekegusii: Na omomalaika oria aganteebia, “Naki ogokumia? Ningoteebie obobisi bw’omokuungu oyio, na obw’eng’iti eyio emobogoretie ere nemetwe etano na ebere, ne ching’unchara ikomi.

English: Is Israel a slave? Was he born into slavery? Why then has he become prey?
Kiswahili: Je, Israeli ni mtumishi, yaani mtumwa kwa kuzaliwa? Kwa nini basi amekuwa mateka?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abaisraeli nabasomba bare? Gose nigo baiboretwe bare abasomba? Onye taibo, nase ki rende abeire buna oy’ogotwarwa?

English: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
Kiswahili: Kama pengine halikomboi shamba hilo, au kama ameliuza kwa mtu mwingine, kamwe haliwezi kukombolewa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria taganeti kobooria oboremo boria, korende aboonerie omonto omoao, rirorio oboremo obwo tibokoboorigwa nonya 'ng'ake.

English: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake Yesu mwanzoni hawakuelewa mambo haya, lakini Yesu alipotukuzwa, ndipo walipokumbuka kuwa mambo haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa ajili yake na alitendewa yeye.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende magega Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorere aya.

English: “How many years have you lived?” Pharaoh asked.
Kiswahili: Farao akamuuliza, “Je una umri gani?”
Ekegusii: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

English: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground. For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain.
Kiswahili: Jipandieni wenyewe haki, vuneni matunda ya upendo usio na kikomo, vunjeni ardhi yenu isiyolimwa; kwa kuwa ni wakati wa kumtafuta Bwana, mpaka atakapokuja na kuwanyeshea juu yenu haki.
Ekegusii: Ebusurere oboronge, mogese ayare ay’obwanchani, eremere chimbuna chiaino, ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okomorigia Omonene, erinde ache abatwerie oboronge buna embura egotwa.

English: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa vitu vyote vitaharibiwa namna hii, je, ninyi imewapasa kuwa watu wa namna gani? Inawapasa kuishi maisha matakatifu na ya kumcha Mungu,
Ekegusii: Naboigo, ekiagera ebinto ebi bionsi nabisire, nebagwenerete inwe mobe abanto b'orogendo oroochenu na abe chingencho chi'obonyasae.

English: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.
Kiswahili: Kila mara Mose alipoingia ndani ya hema, nguzo ya wingu ingeshuka chini na kukaa kwenye ingilio, wakati Mungu akizungumza na Mose.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki'Eema eria, n'Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.

English: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
Kiswahili: Waagize watende mema, wawe matajiri katika matendo mema, pia wawe wakarimu na walio tayari kushiriki mali zao na wengine.
Ekegusii: Obachiike naende bakore amaya, babe abanda ase ogokora okuya, babe ang'e korua chinibo chiabo, na gwatanera abaande ase emioyo emiya,

English: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa mwaminifu kwa yeye aliyemweka, kama vile Mose alivyokuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.

English: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
Kiswahili: Kama ukitii kweli kweli kile asemacho na kufanya yote nisemayo, nitakuwa adui wa adui zako, na nitawapinga wale wakupingao.
Ekegusii: Korende koramoigwere ere, na gokora ayio onsi nakwanire inche, rirorio nindwanie ababisa bao, ninchande abwo bakogochanda.

English: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtaimba kama usiku ule mnaadhimisha sikukuu takatifu. Mioyo yenu itashangilia kama vile watu wanapokwea na filimbi kwenye mlima wa Bwana, kwa Mwamba wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inwe motere ogoteera buna nokw’omoyega omochenu bw’obotuko; chinkoro chiaino nchibe nomogooko buna ekero abanto bakobugia ebiroria kobagotiira gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, ere oyore Egetare ki’Abaisraeli.

English: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini mambo haya Mungu ametufunulia kwa Roho wake. Roho huchunguza kila kitu, hata mambo ya ndani sana ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae otoyaorokeirie ase Omoika oye, naki Omoika nigo okorigia onsi, nonya nobobisi bwa Nyasae.

English: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken, and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.
Kiswahili: Atakaposimama, ufalme wake utavunjika, na kugawanywa katika pepo nne za mbinguni, lakini si kwa wazao wake, wala si kwa mamlaka yake aliyotawala nayo; kwa maana ufalme wake utang'olewa, hata kwa ajili ya wengine zaidi ya hawa.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omorwoti oyio aranyore chinguru chinene, oborwoti bwaye mbosareke bwatananeke ase chinsemo inye chi'ense, tibokoegwa abanto b'ororeria rw'aye, tibokoba nokobua buna koria ere abwate. Oborwoti bwaye mbotegorwe boegwe abanto abaao.

English: When the king’s command and edict had been proclaimed, many young women gathered at the citadel of Susa under the care of Hegai. Esther was also taken to the palace and placed under the care of Hegai, the custodian of the women.
Kiswahili: Wakati agizo na amri ya mfalme lilitangazwa, wanawali wengi waliletwa kwenye ngome ya mji wa Shushani na kuwekwa chini ya uangalizi wa Hegai. Pia Esta alipelekwa katika jumba la mfalme na akakabidhiwa Hegai, aliyekuwa mkuu wa nyumba ya wanawake.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogochika koria okoyia kw’omorwoti kwaraaretigwe, na abaiseke basangereretigwe agwo ase eburi ya Susa, bakabeekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Hegai, oyorenge omorendi bw’abakungu ase enyomba y’omorwoti; Esiteri nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo.

English: But King Ptolemy took control of the cities along the sea coast, to Selucia which is by the sea, and he devised evil plans concerning Alexander.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mfalme Ptolemy alichukua udhibiti wa miji iliyo kando ya pwani ya bahari, hadi Selukia iliyo kando ya bahari, naye akapanga mipango mibaya dhidi ya Aleksanda.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio yobong'ainereria Tolemai akenyoorera emechie yonsi engegu yenyancha goika ekiambokero gia Selukia.

English: Twenty thousand five hundred were slain, beside six hundred cavalry.
Kiswahili: Waliuawa elfu ishirini na mia tano, kando na wapanda farasi mia sita.
Ekegusii: bagaita abarwani esegi abwo bare gotara n'amagoro 20,500 na baria barinete chibarasi 600.

English: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ni kuchukia uovu; ninachukia kiburi na majivuno, tabia mbaya na mazungumzo potovu.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nokogecha obobe; nigo ’ngechete oboenenu, na obwerori, norogendo orobe, boigo namang’ana y’obong’ainereria.

English: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mimi ndimi lango la kondoo.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia naende, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ninche inde egesieri gie ching’ondi.

English: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
Kiswahili: “Kama nimeshangilia msiba wa adui yangu, au kutazama kwa furaha taabu iliyomjia,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nagokerete ogosirigwa kw'omobisa one? Gose netogetie ekero amabe amocherete?

English: And I was greatly displeased and threw all of Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.
Kiswahili: Nilikasirika sana na nikavitupa nje vyombo vyote vya Tobia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba nendamwamu enene ngatuguta ebinto bia nyomba bia Tobia korwa ase enyomba eria.

English: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Heri mtu yule ambaye Mungu humrudi; kwa hiyo usidharau adhabu yake Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae akoa egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia; ase ayio tobaisa gochaaya ogoaka, gw’okorongeyia kw’oyore Omonguru.

English: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commandments is what counts.
Kiswahili: Kutahiriwa si kitu, na kutokutahiriwa si kitu. Lakini kuzitii amri za Mungu ndilo jambo muhimu.
Ekegusii: Okwaroka tai gento, na ogotaroka tai gento, korende nokobwata amachiiko a Nyasae.

English: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
Kiswahili: Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, pamoja na wana wawili wa Mose na mkewe, wakamjia Mose huko jangwani, mahali alipokuwa amepiga kambi karibu na mlima wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo Jethiro, ise biara Musa, amo na moka Musa na abana baye babere, bagacha ase erooro aase Musa konya atoorire ase egetunwa kia Nyasae.

English: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.'
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasema kuhusu yule aliyechakazwa na uzinzi, ‘Basi wamtumie kama kahaba, kwa kuwa ndivyo alivyo.'
Ekegusii: Erio nkeboria: Inee! Abanto aba abanyaka nigo bagochia gokora obonyaka nomokuungu oyo okorire obonyaka ase engaki entambe?

English: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unapigapiga, nguvu zangu zimeniishia; hata macho yangu yametiwa giza.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, chinguru chiang'ereire; amaiso aane asoirwe orotutu, tindi korora.

English: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
Kiswahili: Baasha aliposikia jambo hili, akasimamisha kujenga Rama na kuacha kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Baasa aigwete amang'ana ayio, agatiga kogita omochie o Rama, na emeremo yaye aroro egatenena.

English: He went up from there to Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Kutoka pale akaenda Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.

English: and built around Ecbatana walls of hewn stones three cubits broad and six cubits long, and made the height of the wall seventy cubits, and its breadth fifty cubits,
Kiswahili: Wakajenga kuta kuzunguka Ekbatana kwa mawe yaliyochongwa, upana wake dhiraa tatu, na urefu wake dhiraa sita, wakauzungushia urefu wake dhiraa sabini, na upana wake dhiraa hamsini.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Arifakisadi akaywagaachera omochie bwa Ekibata enyasi ya amagena. Obotambe bw'enyasi nigo bwarenge chimita 30 na obogare bwaye chimita 22. Kera rigena rienyasi nigo riarenge no'bogare bwe chisentimita 130, n'obotaambe bwe chisentimita 260.

English: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people urged them to continue this message on the next Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Paulo na Barnaba walipokuwa wakitoka nje ya sinagogi, watu wakawaomba wazungumze tena mambo hayo Sabato iliyofuata.
Ekegusii: Kabasokire, abanto bakabasorora bache kobateebia amang’ana aya Esabato ya kabere.

English: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
Kiswahili: Nao wanafunzi wake wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia vya mikate na samaki, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.
Ekegusii: Bagasangereria ebisamunye biasamunyogete, na ebio bigaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere, naboigo nebisamunye bie chinswe.

English: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
Kiswahili: Akarudisha mali zote, na akamrudisha Loti jamaa yake na mali zake, pamoja na wanawake na watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Erio akairania enibo yonsi, na akairania boigo Loti omwabo amo nenibo yaye, na abakungu, na abanto bande abasakoretwe.

English: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wameketi naye mezani aliyeelewa kwa nini Yesu alimwambia hivyo.
Ekegusii: Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.

English: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana, akiwa amesimama upande wa kuume wa madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba, akamtokea Zekaria.
Ekegusii: Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw'Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y'egesasiimero ki'ogosambera ubani.

English: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya maadili haya yote jivikeni upendo, ambao ndio unaofunga kila kitu pamoja katika umoja mkamilifu.
Ekegusii: Kobua aya onsi, mweboyie obwanchani, nabwo egesibo gekobwatania kera egento ase oboikeranu bw’obuya.

English: So Anansi climbed slowly back down his sticky thread to the earth. He thought and he thought, and he came up with a plan. He dug a deep hole, covered it with branches and dirt so it was hidden, and he went home for supper. In the morning, sure enough, a leopard had fallen into his pit. He was furiously scratching at the side of the pit, but he couldnt get out.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo Anansi alishuka pole pole chini. Aliwaza na kuwazua kisha akapata mpango. Alichimba shimo refu, akalifunika kwa matawi na udongo ili lisionekane, kisha akaenda nyumbani. Asubuhi iliyofuata chui alikuwa ameanguka kwenye shimo. Alikuwa akikwaruza kuta za shimo kwa ghadahbu.
Ekegusii: Igo anansi agaika ng'ora ng'ora ase eusi eria yarenge konantananta gochia nse ase ense. Akarengereeria, akamanya koamua korosia omorebio oyo. Akarema engoro etaambe, akayekuneka ne chinsaginsagi chiemete nobochabu bonde erinde anyare kobisa engoro eria, akamanya kogenda nka koria endagera yamarogoba. Mambia yaye, amaene pi akanyora echui yagure engoro eria ime.

English: Now if a man loses his hair and is bald, he is still clean.
Kiswahili: “Wakati mwanaume hana nywele naye ana upaa, yeye ni safi.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto osunyokire etukia, risio riachiire magega, nigo are nyaisio, ere ochenekire,

English: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
Kiswahili: Daudi akayainua macho yake akamwona huyo malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama katikati ya mbingu na dunia, naye ameunyoosha upanga wake juu ya Yerusalemu tayari kuangamiza. Kisha Daudi na wazee, waliokuwa wamevaa nguo za gunia, wakaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chi’echigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.

English: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel son of Zuar.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Nethaneli mwana wa Suari.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.

English: And the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea, to the exiles in the vision given by the Spirit of God. After the vision had gone up from me,
Kiswahili: Roho akaniinua na kunileta mpaka kwa watu wa uhamisho huko Ukaldayo nikiwa katika yale maono niliyopewa na Roho wa Mungu. Ndipo maono niliyokuwa nimeyaona yakanitoka,
Ekegusii: Ase okorora naetwe, Omoika o Nyasae okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase ense y’Abakalidayo, ase abanto abwo boosetwe barenge. Nyuma y’ayio okorora koria narooche gokarua asende.

English: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.
Kiswahili: Mimi nimeona watumwa wamepanda farasi, wakati wakuu wakitembea kwa miguu kama watumwa.
Ekegusii: Narorire abasomba bariinete chibarasi, na abagaambi bagotaara namagoro buna abasomba.

English: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yatatembea yakiangaziwa na nuru yake na wafalme wa duniani wataleta fahari yao ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku nabataare ase omobaso oye, na abarwoti b’ense nabarente obonene bwabo imeo.

English: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
Kiswahili: Baana mwana wa Ahiludi: katika Taanaki na Megido, na katika Beth-Shani yote karibu na Sarethani chini ya Yezreeli, kuanzia Beth-Shani hadi Abel-Mehola kupita hadi Yokmeamu;
Ekegusii: Baana, mosinto bw'Ahiludi, agatenenera emechie ya Taanaki na Megido, na Beti‐Sehani yonsi, eyio eikerete Saretani, Irianyi ya Yesireeli, na korwa Beti‐Sehani goika Abeli‐Mehola, na ng'umbu ya Yoki‐Meamu.

English: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
Kiswahili: ambaye Mungu atamleta kwa wakati wake mwenyewe: yeye ahimidiwaye, aliye peke yake Mtawala, Mfalme wa wafalme, na Bwana wa mabwana,
Ekegusii: Oyosesenirie, oyore nokobua ere bweka, Omorwoti bw'abarwoti, Omonene bw'abanene, oraache gotworokia okoorokigwa okwo ase ekero kiaye.

English: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
Kiswahili: Adamu na mkewe wote wawili walikuwa uchi, wala hawakuona aibu.
Ekegusii: Omosacha na omokungu nigo baarenge getirianda, na tibaare kororerana obosooku.

English: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the sweetness of a friend is counsel to the soul.
Kiswahili: Manukato na uvumba huleta furaha moyoni, nao uzuri wa rafiki huchipuka kutoka kwenye ushauri wake wa uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato nigo bikogokia enkoro, naboigo bore obwororo bw’omosani oyo okorua ogoseemia okuya.

English: but the poor man had nothing except one small ewe lamb that he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food and drank from his cup; it slept in his arms and was like a daughter to him.
Kiswahili: lakini yule maskini hakuwa na chochote ila kondoo jike mdogo aliyekuwa amemnunua. Akamtunza kondoo huyo, akakulia kwake pamoja na watoto wake. Kondoo huyo alishiriki chakula cha bwana wake na kunywea kikombe chake hata pia huyo kondoo alilala mikononi mwa bwana wake. Kwake alikuwa kama binti yake.
Ekegusii: Korende oria omotaka tarenge na gento, otatiga abwate akamanwa agasigiti, akwo agorete ng’a atuge. Akamanwa akwo gakaba gakomenya inka amo nabana baye, gakaba gakoria endagera abwate na konywera korwa ase egekombe kiaye. Nigo kaanarete koraara ase egekuba kiaye, gakaba ase are buna omwana oye omoiseke.

English: They rested on the fourteenth of the same month, and kept it as a day of rest with joy and gladness.
Kiswahili: Walipumzika siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi huo huo, na wakaifanya kama siku ya kupumzika kwa furaha na shangwe.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bande abarenge ase chingongo chinde chi'obogambi obwo bagasangerereka amo ase okoegera obogima bwabo, ase okwenyorera obotoereru na gwetooria korwa ase ababisa babo.

English: the land of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.
Kiswahili: eneo la Wagebali; Lebanoni yote kuelekea mashariki, kuanzia Baal-Gadi chini ya Mlima Hermoni hadi Lebo-Hamathi.
Ekegusii: ense y’Abagebali amo na Lebanoni yonsi gochia moocha, na korwa Baali‐Gadi inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni goika enchera ekogenda Hamati.

English: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
Kiswahili: Bwana atawakabidhi kwenu, nanyi lazima mwatendee yale yote niliyowaamuru.
Ekegusii: Omonene nababeeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobakore koreng'ana namang'ana onsi nabachiikire.

English: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are Yahweh's. He has set the world on them.
Kiswahili: Humwinua maskini kutoka mavumbini na humwinua mhitaji kutoka lundo la majivu; huwaketisha pamoja na wakuu na kuwafanya warithi kiti cha enzi cha heshima. “Kwa kuwa misingi ya dunia ni ya Bwana; juu yake ameuweka ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka bw'ebuse, na omoremerwa korwa ase ribu, obabeeka baikaransa amo nabwo bare n'okobua, na kobaa omwando bw'ebirogo bi'obonene. Oboroso bw'ense nobwa Omonene, na igoro y'oboroso obwo oterekereire enseo.

English: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko lote wakaabudu kwa kusujudu, wakati waimbaji wakiwa wanaimba na wenye tarumbeta wakipiga tarumbeta zao. Yote haya yaliendelea mpaka walipomaliza kutoa ile dhabihu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Erio omosangererekano bwonsi ogasasiima, na abateri bagatera, na ababugia ebitureeri bakabibugia ase amariogi amanene; bakagenderera goika okoruegwa gw'ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa kogakoorwa.

English: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded. So Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years, until he turned and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli aliishambulia nchi, naye Yehoyakimu akawa mtumwa wake kwa miaka mitatu. Lakini hatimaye akabadili mawazo yake na kuasi dhidi ya Nebukadneza.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ay’okogaamba kwa Yehoyakimu, Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, agacha aroro, na Yehoyakimu akaba inse y’okogaamba kwaye ase emiaka etato, korende magega y’ayio akaanga komoigwera.

English: And I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood; so I will bring upon you the wrath of your bloodshed and jealousy.
Kiswahili: Nitakuhukumia adhabu wanayopewa wanawake wafanyao uasherati na hao wamwagao damu, nitaleta juu yenu kisasi cha damu cha ghadhabu yangu na wivu wa hasira yangu.
Ekegusii: Ninkonachere ekiina buna abakungu basaririe chiira chi’okonyuomana kwabo na buna abaiteri amanyinga bakonacherwa ekiina; amanyinga ao ninyaitere inde nendamwamu ne risemi.

English: Question a friend; for many times there is slander. Don't trust every word.
Kiswahili: Muulize rafiki; mara nyingi kuna uchongezi. Usiamini kila neno.
Ekegusii: Onye kwaigure ring'ana riibe igoro y'omosani oo, nabo oranyore tarikwaneti. Ase igo, tobaisa kwegena kera egento ekio kwaigure.

English: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for My people who seek Me.
Kiswahili: Sharoni itakuwa malisho kwa ajili ya makundi ya kondoo, na Bonde la Akori mahali pa kupumzikia kwa makundi ya ngʼombe, kwa ajili ya watu wangu wanaonitafuta.
Ekegusii: Ense omweya ya Saroni neebe oborisia bw’amaicho e ching’ondi, na Ebate y’Akori ebe aase chiombe chikorara. Aase agwo naegwe abanto baane abwo babeire bakondigia.

English: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
Kiswahili: Lile ninaloliona huniletea huzuni nafsini kwa sababu ya wanawake wote wa mji wangu.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one ase engencho y'abaiseke bonsi b'omochie one.

English: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me.”
Kiswahili: Pale utakapofia nami nitafia hapo, na papo hapo nitazikwa. Bwana na aniadhibu vikali, kama kitu kingine chochote kitanitenga nawe isipokuwa kifo.”
Ekegusii: Aase aye orakwere, nainche nao ndakwere, na ntindekwe aroro. Tiga Omonene ang’e egesusuro ekenene kegima bono na kogenderera onye gento kende kegochia konyatanana korwa asore, otatiga amakweri oka.”

English: Indeed, like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go to work foraging for food; the wasteland is food for their children.
Kiswahili: Kama punda-mwitu jangwani, maskini huzunguka katika kazi zao za kutafuta chakula; mahali palipo jangwa huwapa chakula cha watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Rora, abataka abwo babeire buna chitigere chi’orosana chire ase erooro; nigo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora ebi bakoria. Ase ekerubo ekiomo nao bakorigeria abana babo endagera.

English: So I prophesied as I had been commanded. And as I prophesied, there was suddenly a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to bone.
Kiswahili: Basi nikatabiri kama nilivyoamriwa. Wakati nilipokuwa ninatabiri, kukawa na sauti, sauti ya kugongana, nayo mifupa ikasogeleana, mfupa kwa mfupa mwenziwe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabana buna Omonene anchigete: na ekero nagendererete kobana, nkaigwa eriogi rinene riarenge negetitiro; amauga ayio agacha amo, riuga rikabwatana neriuga riamwabo.

English: But Nebuzaradan captain of the guard left behind some of the poorest of the land to tend the vineyards and fields.
Kiswahili: Lakini Nebuzaradani akawaacha mabaki ya wale watu maskini kabisa ili watunze mashamba ya mizabibu na mashamba mengine.
Ekegusii: Korende Nebusaradani oria omoteneneri bw’abarendi agatiga abanto bande barenge abataka mono b’ense eria babeere aroro. Abwo bakaba bakoroiseria emegondo y’emesabibu na gokora emeremo y’okorema.

English: Who has put wisdom in the heart or given understanding to the mind?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyeujalia moyo hekima au kuzipa akili ufahamu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o okobeeka obong’aini ase enkoro ime, gose okomanya ase omoyo ime?

English: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa pili akalimwaga bakuli lake baharini, nayo ikabadilika kuwa damu kama ya mtu aliyekufa na kila kiumbe hai kilichokuwa ndani ya bahari kikafa.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika o kabere agaitera egetaabo kiaye ase enyancha ime, na enyancha ekaonchoka ekaba amanyinga buna ay'omonto okuure, na ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase enyancha ime bigakwa.

English: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?'”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile watu wanaoishi katika pwani hii watasema, ‘Tazama lililowapata wale tuliowategemea, wale tuliowakimbilia kwa msaada na wokovu kutoka mikononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru! Tutawezaje basi kupona?' ”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bamenyete ase ense ere ang'e nenyancha mbakwane, bateebe: Rora amang'ana abanyorire abanto abwo intwe twasemeretie na kobatamera ng'a batokonye korwa ase omorwoti bw'Abaasuri! Bono, naki intwe toranyare gotooreka?”

English: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yerusalemu wa juu ni huru, nayo ndiye mama yetu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu ya igoro nomochie omosibore, noro baba oito.

English: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anasema, “Mimi ni kinyume na ninyi. Nitafunika uso wako kwa gauni lako. Nitaonyesha mataifa uchi wako na falme aibu yako.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba, Ninyee Ninawi egesusuro! Ngochobore otigare getirianda erio ngotigere ebisaku bikorore, birore obosoku bwao bwonsi.

English: How can it rest when the LORD has commanded it? He has appointed it against Ashkelon and the shore of its coastland.”
Kiswahili: Lakini upanga utatuliaje wakati Bwana ameuamuru, wakati ameuagiza kuishambulia Ashkeloni pamoja na pwani yake?”
Ekegusii: Naki omoyio orakore okire‐kiri na gotimoka, ekero Omonene ayochikiire gokora emeremo? Oyochikiire orwanie Asikeloni ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.”

English: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh's altar that was before Yahweh's porch.
Kiswahili: Asa aliposikia maneno haya na unabii wa Azaria mwana wa Odedi nabii, akajipa moyo. Akaziondoa sanamu zote zilizokuwa machukizo katika nchi yote ya Yuda na Benyamini na kutoka miji aliyoiteka ya vilima vya Efraimu. Akakarabati madhabahu ya Bwana iliyokuwa mbele ya ukumbi wa Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Asa aigwete amang'ana 'obobani bw'Odedi, akaba noboenenu, akarusia emegwekano y'ogosasimwa, okogechia koria, korwa ase ense yonsi y'Abayuda na Ababenjamini, na korwa ase emechie yonsi eria konya airire agwo ase ense y'ebitunwa y'Efraimu; naende akaroisia egesasiimero ki'Omonene agwo ang'e nenyomba yaagachetwe bosio bw'enyomba y'Omonene.

English: Men don't despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
Kiswahili: Watu hawamdharau mwizi kama akiiba kukidhi njaa yake wakati ana njaa.
Ekegusii: Abanto tibari gochaaya omoibi onye ore koiba endagera ekiagera are n'enchara.

English: (Yahweh gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamtoa mwokozi kwa ajili ya Israeli, nao wakaokoka kutoka kwenye mamlaka ya Aramu. Hivyo Waisraeli wakaishi katika nyumba zao wenyewe kama ilivyokuwa hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaa Abaisraeli omotooria, obatooretie korwa ase amaboko 'Abasiiria. Magega y'ayio Abaisraeli bakagenderera komenya ase chinka chiabo buna agwo ritang'ani.

English: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s mighty men will be like the heart of a woman in labor. Judgment on Damascus (Isaiah 17:1–14)
Kiswahili: Tazama! Tai atapaa juu angani na kuruka chini kwa ghafula, akitandaza mabawa yake juu ya Bosra. Katika siku hiyo, mioyo ya mashujaa wa Edomu itakuwa kama moyo wa mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa. Ujumbe Kuhusu Dameski
Ekegusii: Naama! Egesaku gete nkeimokerere igoro keiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y’omochie o Bosira. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi’abasikari b’Edomu bare chituoni nachiondoke, na barabwo babe buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.” Omonene okogambia Damesiki

English: Yet the fool multiplies words. No one knows what is coming, and who can tell him what will come after him?
Kiswahili: naye mpumbavu huzidisha maneno. Hakuna yeyote ajuaye linalokuja, ni nani awezaye kueleza ni jambo gani litakalotokea baada yake?
Ekegusii: Omoriri nigo are omonyamang’ana mange. Monto onde tamanyeti aya agochia koba. Ning’o oranyare komoteebia ekegochia koba korwa magega yaye.

English: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
Kiswahili: Wale wanaopotoka rohoni watapata ufahamu, nao wale wanaolalamika watayakubali mafundisho.”
Ekegusii: Erio abwo basirire ase omoika mbaegwe okomanya, na abwo bakwemurungania mbanche amorokererio.”

English: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo kuhani mkuu akawa anamuuliza Yesu kuhusu wanafunzi wake na mafundisho yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene akaboria Yeso amang'ana igoro yaborokigwa baye, na amang'ana 'okworokereria kwaye.

English: The Gourd sang a beautiful and soothing song. Khayanga recognised the voice as that of her late mother. It went like this... Khayanga, ee, Khayanga! Our child the loved one! Youre not alone, loved one! Have this gourd, loved one! Carry it everywhere you go, loved one! Let it console you loved one!
Kiswahili: Kibuyu hicho kiliimba wimbo mtamu na wa kuburudisha. Wimbo wenyewe uliimbwa hivi: Khayanga, ee, Khayanga! Mtoto wetu, mpendwa! Tuko na wewe, mpendwa! Shika kibuyu, mpendwa! Kibebe kote, mpendwa! Kikuliwaze, mpendwa! Khayanga aligundua kuwa hiyo sauti ilikuwa ya mamake. Alikihifadhi Kibuyu hicho ili kimfariji kila alipohisi huzuni na upweke.
Ekegusii: Korwa rituko erio, Khayanga akabogoria ekerandi keria kera ase arenge kogenda. Agakebeka ase arenge korara, akaba gakoboka nakio na kweyaka amaguta kageikaranserete. Baka ekaba buna kera ekero atagakebogoirie nigo arenge kogechiwa sana. Ekiagera kera ekero agakeboigirie, nigo giakamoinyorie ise na ng'ina yagera oigwa buya.

English: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God's Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, nawaambia, sitaila tena Pasaka mpaka itakapotimizwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera nabateebirie, tinkoyeria naende goika yaikeranigwe ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Coming without warning, he set fire to cities and villages. And in winning back the most important positions, putting to flight no small number of the enemies,
Kiswahili: Akija bila onyo, alichoma moto miji na vijiji. Na katika kushinda nafasi muhimu zaidi, akiwafukuza maadui wengi,
Ekegusii: Yuda akaboera emechie n'ebichie nakobisamba n'omorero. Agaseria ababisa na akaira chinsemo chinene chi'engencho mono.

English: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies' sake.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, tega sikio na ukasikie; fumbua macho yako ukaone ukiwa wa mji ule wenye Jina lako. Hatukutolei maombi yetu kwa sababu sisi tuna haki, bali kwa sababu ya rehema zako nyingi.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe, rigereria orore ogosirigwa gwaito, na omochie oyo okorokwa ase erieta ria'o. Intwe titori korenta ogosaba gwaito ase ore ng'a nabanyaboronge tore, korende nase engencho y'amaabera ao amaange.

English: My neighbors mocked me, and said, “He is no longer afraid to be put to death for this matter; and yet he fled away. Behold, he buries the dead again.”
Kiswahili: Majirani zangu walinidhihaki, na kusema, "Haogopi tena kuuawa kwa jambo hili; lakini alikimbia. Tazama, anawazika wafu tena."
Ekegusii: Korende abaamate baane bagansekerera bagoteeba “Morigererie oyo! Tari kwooboa ekiagera aya agokora naro agerete ere are korigigwa aitwe korende ere agatama, na rora ochakire amang'ana aria aria!”

English: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
Kiswahili: wengine waokoeni kwa kuwanyakua kutoka kwenye moto; nao wengine wahurumieni mkiwa na hofu, mkichukia hata vazi lenye mawaa na kutiwa unajisi na mwili.
Ekegusii: Korende motoorie abande ase okobataboria korwa ase omorero. Abande mobarorere amaabera mobe nokoiroka, mogeche nonya neanga eria ebekire riko ri'okogania okobe kw'omobere.

English: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.
Kiswahili: Tazama, mfalme atatawala kwa uadilifu na watawala watatawala kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Rora, omorwoti naoroke oragaambe ase oboronge, na abagaambi b'obogaambi mbagambe bakore ay'ekeene.

English: So Raphael went on his way, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting; so he brought forth the bags with their seals, and gave them to him.
Kiswahili: Basi Rafaeli akaenda zake, akalala kwa Gabaeli, akampa hati; akatoa mifuko hiyo pamoja na mihuri yake, akampa.
Ekegusii: Bono Rafaeli akagenda goika Rege akaraara nyomba mwa Gabaeli erio akaa Gabali riruube riria ri'okobwatana boigo akamoteebia buna Tobia omwana o Tobiti 'nkonywoma are naende omoariganirie ase omoyega. Ase obwango Gabaeri akareta emebuko yabwate chitaabu yasibire na kobekwa ekemanyererio akaa Rafaeli.

English: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.
Kiswahili: Kuzaliwa kwake hakuna maana, huondokea gizani na gizani jina lake hufunikwa.
Ekegusii: Omwana oyio okwete nigo achete egento bosa, naende nigo akogenda gochia ase omosunte, na omosunte oyio otuba erieta riaye.

English: and to levy tribute on the temple, as on the other sacred places of the nations, and to put up the high priesthood for sale every year.
Kiswahili: na kutoza ushuru hekaluni, kama ilivyo katika sehemu zingine takatifu za mataifa, na kuweka ukuhani mkuu kwa ajili ya mauzo kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: na korusia Hekalu ebango buna ase ande onsi ase abanto b'ebisaku bare gosasimera. Boigo na koonia obokuani obonene kera omwaka.

English: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh's commandments, and do them; and that you don't follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa mkivitazama vifundo hivyo ili mpate kukumbuka amri zote za Bwana, ili mpate kuzitii msije mkajitia uzinzi wenyewe kwa kuzifuata tamaa za mioyo yenu na za macho yenu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera amasugunia ayio nabe ekeinyorio ase more. Ekero mokoyarigereria monyare koinyora amachiiko ane onsi na koyabwata. Naboigo moranyare gokonywa, erinde mobe abegenwa ase 'nde na gwetanga korwa ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiaino na amaiso aino.

English: and how they were shut up in the rest of the cities of the land of Gilead, and that tomorrow they planned to encamp against the strongholds, and to take them, and to destroy all these men in one day.
Kiswahili: na jinsi walivyokuwa wamefungiwa katika miji mingine ya nchi ya Gileadi, na kwamba kesho walipanga kupiga kambi dhidi ya ngome, na kuziteka, na kuwaangamiza watu hawa wote kwa siku moja.
Ekegusii: abande nigo basibire ase emechie emeke emeke ya Gileadi. Boigo bakabateebia buna ababisa beariganetie gochigwera chimbago erio bababwate na kobasiria Abayahudi bonsi ase rituko erimo.

English: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maagizo na masharti ambayo Bwana aliwapa Waisraeli kupitia Mose katika tambarare za Moabu, karibu na Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko n’emeroberio y’Omonene Nyasae, buna biaruetwe gochia ase Abaisraeli, goteera ase Musa agwo ase ense omweya ya Moabu ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani ang’e n’omochie o Yeriko.

English: Then Holofernes' servants brought her into the tent, and she slept until midnight. Then she rose up toward the morning watch,
Kiswahili: Kisha watumishi wa Holoferne wakamleta ndani ya hema, naye akalala hadi usiku wa manane. Kisha akaamka kuelekea zamu ya asubuhi,
Ekegusii: Abakoreri baye abwo bamorendete komoira na komosoyia ase egetwori kiaye. Akaraara aroro goika mambia chuni ekero aboogete

English: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ndani ya moyo hutoka mawazo mabaya, uuaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushahidi wa uongo na masingizio.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang'ana y'oborimo, na okorama.

English: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
Kiswahili: Pete za kifuko cha kifuani zitafungwa kwenye pete zile za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, ziunganishwe na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau.
Ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chibekire ase egesembe chibwateranigwe ne chibonyi chi'egesibao neusi eburu; erio egesembe keria kebeere orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka.

English: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawagawa Walawi katika makundi kufuatana na wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana Abalawi ase ebiombe kobwatekana nabamura ba Lawi: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.

English: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn't look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.
Kiswahili: Mlijenga bwawa la maji katikati ya kuta mbili kwa ajili ya maji ya Bwawa la Zamani, lakini hamkumtazama Yule aliyelitengeneza, au kuwa na heshima kwa Yule aliyeubuni tangu zamani za kale.
Ekegusii: Mokaagacha etangi y'amaache agwo ase egati ye chindwaki chiria ibere, erinde monyore amaache akorwa ase ritibo rikoro, korende timwamorigeretie Oyio okorete ayio, gose timwamorengereretie Oyio okorete omooroberio oyio agwo kare.

English: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza masinia kumi ya shaba, kila moja likiwa na ujazo wa bathi arobaini, yakiwa na kipenyo cha dhiraa nne kila sinia moja kwa kila kimoja ya vile vitako kumi.
Ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia na ebituba ikomi bie chitaai. Obogare bwa kera egetuba nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na nigo kiare koira amaache aisaine ang’e ne chilita amagana kianda. Naboigo aroisetie ebituba ikomi, ekemo ase kera ekebekerero.

English: There is a grievous evil I have seen under the sun: wealth hoarded to the harm of its owner,
Kiswahili: Nimeshaona uovu mzito chini ya jua: Utajiri uliolimbikizwa kwa kujinyima na kuleta madhara kwa mwenye mali,
Ekegusii: Obobe mono narorire inse y’erioba nabwo obo: chinibo chinyinge chikogachwa nigo chiranyare gosiria omonto ochigachete.

English: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn't care for the sheep.
Kiswahili: Yeye hukimbia kwa sababu ameajiriwa wala hawajali kondoo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotama ekiagera nomorikwa, gose tarengerereti amang'ana e ching'ondi.

English: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
Kiswahili: mimi mwenyewe nitaweka uadui nanyi, na kuwatesa kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu mara saba zaidi.
Ekegusii: rirorio boigo nimbe mamincha yaino, erio inche omonyene imbae egesusuro ara gatano na kabere buna ebibe biaino biragwenere.

English: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
Kiswahili: Natembea katika njia ya unyofu katika mapito ya haki,
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobwatia enchera y’oboronge, naba ’ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.

English: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawahurumia na kuwagusa macho yao. Mara macho yao yakapata kuona, nao wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Yeso agasogwa namaabera, agakuna amaiso abo. Erio kegima bakarora, bakamotunyana.

English: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Kiswahili: Mkaribieni Mungu, naye atawakaribia ninyi. Itakaseni mikono yenu ninyi wenye dhambi, na kuisafisha mioyo yenu ninyi wenye nia mbili.
Ekegusii: Moike Nyasae ang’e, na ere nabaike ang’e inwe. Inwe abanyene ebibe, mochene amaboko aino; inwe abanyene emioyo ebere, mochene chinkoro chiaino.

English: I will restore My people Israel from captivity; they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
Kiswahili: Nitawarejesha tena watu wangu Israeli waliohamishwa; wataijenga tena miji iliyoachwa magofu, nao wataishi ndani mwake. Watapanda mizabibu na kunywa divai yake; watalima bustani na kula matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Ning’iranie abanto bane Abaisraeli korwa ase obosomba. Barabwo mbaagache naende emechie eyio yasiretigwe bamenyeo, mbasimeke emesabibu na konywa edivai yaye; boigo mbareme emegondo, basimeke chindagera na koria okwama kw’emegondo eyio.

English: So I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives. I will bring disaster upon them, even My fierce anger,” declares the LORD. “I will send out the sword after them until I finish them off.
Kiswahili: Nitamfadhaisha Elamu mbele ya adui zao, mbele yao wale wanaotafuta uhai wao; nitaleta maafa juu yao, naam, hasira yangu kali,” asema Bwana. “Nitawafuatia kwa upanga mpaka nitakapowamaliza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ningere abanto b’Elamu boboe ababisa babo, boigo boboe nabaanto baria bakorigia basirie obogima bwabo. Nimbarentere amabe, na endamwamu yane yoke igoro yabo. Nimbatunyanerie emioro, baitwe basirigwe kegima.

English: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between you and me.”
Kiswahili: Njoo sasa na tufanye agano, wewe na mimi, na liwe kama shahidi kati yetu.”
Ekegusii: Inchuo bono, tokore okobwatana, aye nainche, na korokwo inakobe kirori egati yao nainche.”

English: they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him. Peter Speaks in Solomon’s Colonnade (Deuteronomy 18:15–22)
Kiswahili: wakamtambua kuwa ni yule mtu aliyekuwa akiketi nje ya Hekalu penye lango liitwalo Zuri akiomba msaada, nao wakajawa na mshangao, wakastaajabu juu ya yale yaliyomtukia. Petro Anashuhudia Kuwa Yesu Anaponya
Ekegusii: Bakamomanya ng’a nere oria orenge goikaransa na gosaba ebiegwa aria ase Egesieri Ekiya gie Hekalu. Erio bagaichorwa nogokumia na ogoichana ase amang’ana aria akoregete asare.

English: When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD—the Lord of all the earth—touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.”
Kiswahili: Mara tu nyayo za makuhani walichukualo Sanduku la Bwana, Bwana wa dunia yote, zitakapokanyaga ndani ya Mto Yordani, maji hayo yatiririkayo kutoka juu yatatindika na kusimama kama chuguu.”
Ekegusii: Igo erabe ekero abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Omonene Nyasae bw’ense engima, baratache amaache a Yorodani namagoro abo, amaache akorwa rogoro ya Yorodani nanacheke, atenene buna enyasi.”

English: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Wamidiani wakamuuza Yosefu huko Misri kwa Potifa, mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, aliyekuwa mkuu wa ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Na Abamidiani baria bakamoonia aaria Misiri ase Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande.

English: yet you in your manifold mercies didn't forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn't depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu ya huruma zako kuu hukuwaacha jangwani. Wakati wa mchana ile nguzo ya wingu haikukoma kuwaongoza katika njia yao, wala nguzo ya moto haikuacha kuwamulikia usiku njia iliyowapasa kuiendea.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, ase engencho y'amaabera ao amanene tikwabatigete agwo ase erooro. Riire riria riarenge kobaraa ase omobaso tiriaruete ase bare; gose riire riria ri'omorero tiriatigete kobamorekera ase enchera barenge goeta ase obotuko.

English: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won't give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
Kiswahili: “Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye mtoto wake akimwomba samaki, atampa nyoka badala yake?
Ekegusii: Naki monto onde nare ase more oyore ise, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena? Gose karamosabe enswe, ase ribaga ri'enswe namoe eng'iti?

English: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.
Kiswahili: Kila mwaka ninyi na jamaa zenu mtapaswa kuwala mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu pale mahali atakapopachagua.
Ekegusii: Omwaka ase omwaka, inwe amo n'abanto b'echinka chiaino moriere chinyama chi'echitugo echio chintangi ase obosio bw'Omonene Nyasae oino, aase agwo arachoore.

English: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
Kiswahili: Bali wewe, udumu katika yale uliyojifunza na kuyaamini kwa uthabiti, ukitambua ya kuwa ulijifunza hayo kutoka kwa nani,
Ekegusii: Korende aye, ogenderere ase ayakworokereretigwe na koyaenekia, gokomanya ng'a nkorwa ase ng'o kweorokereretie.

English: All the women who remain in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon, and those women will say: ‘They misled you and overcame you— those trusted friends of yours. Your feet sank into the mire, and they deserted you.’
Kiswahili: Wanawake wote walioachwa katika jumba la kifalme la mfalme wa Yuda wataletwa mbele ya maafisa wa mfalme wa Babeli. Wanawake hao watakuambia: “ ‘Walikupotosha na kukushinda, wale rafiki zako uliowaamini. Miguu yako imezama matopeni; rafiki zako wamekuacha.’
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro aya: Abakungu bonsi barache gotigwa ase enyomba y’omorwoti bw’Abayuda mbairwe gochia ase abagaambi bare inse y’omorwoti o Babiloni. Nigo barabe bagokwana iga: “Abasani bao kwegenete nigo bakong’ainete, barabwo bagakobua. Bono amagoro ao arateerire ase etintira, abwo beonchoire, bagotigire.

English: My son, if sinners entice you, don't consent.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, kama wenye dhambi wakikushawishi, usikubaliane nao.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng'a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.

English: “Son of man, set your face against Gog of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy against him
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, kaza uso wako dhidi ya Gogu, katika nchi ya Magogu, mkuu wa Roshi, Mesheki na Tubali, tabiri dhidi yake
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, onchoka origererie Gogi bw’ense ya Magogi, oyore omogambi bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, obaane mamincha yaye,

English: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than that of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had purposed to thwart the good counsel of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom. Hushai’s Warning Saves David (Psalms 55:1–23)
Kiswahili: Absalomu na watu wote wa Israeli wakasema, “Shauri la Hushai, Mwariki, ni jema zaidi kuliko lile la Ahithofeli.” Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amekusudia kupinga shauri nzuri la Ahithofeli, ili kuleta maafa juu ya Absalomu.
Ekegusii: Abisalomu na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaboora, “Ogoseemia kwa Husai Omoariki nokuya kobua koria kw’Ahitofeli.” Omonene nere ochiigete ogoseemia okwo okuya kw’Ahitofeli kwangwe, erinde arentere Abisalomu emechando. Daudi ogokuurerwa atame etoorie

English: so that I may take hold of the hearts of the people of Israel. For because of their idols, they are all estranged from Me.’
Kiswahili: Nitafanya jambo hili ili kukamata tena mioyo ya watu wa Israeli, ambao wote wameniacha kwa ajili ya sanamu zao.’
Ekegusii: Erio nario ’ndanyare koirania chinkoro chi’Abaisraeli abwo baatananirwe korwa ase ’nde ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasiima gocha ase ’nde.

English: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
Kiswahili: Shikeni maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu mtembee katika njia zake na kumheshimu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio mobwate amachiiko a y’Omonene Nyasae oino, ase ogotaara ase chinchera chiaye na komoiroka.

English: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu Yoshua, “Watumwa wako waliambiwa waziwazi jinsi Bwana Mungu wenu alivyomwamuru mtumishi wake Mose kuwapa ninyi nchi hii yote na kuwaangamiza wakazi wake wote toka mbele zenu. Kwa hiyo tuliogopa mno kwa ajili ya uhai wetu kwa sababu yenu, ndiyo maana tukafanya neno hili.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria Yoshua, “Omonene, nigo twakorire aya, ekiagera twatebetigwe na koenekerigwa ng'a Omonene. Nyasae oo, nachigete Musa, omosomba oye, abae ense eye engima na gosiria bonsi abamenyete aa. Ase ayio tokaondoka, tokaba nobwoba obonene ng'a motoite; ayio akagera togakora aya.

English: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!” Peter Addresses the Crowd (Psalms 16:1–11; Joel 2:28–32)
Kiswahili: Lakini wengine wakawadhihaki wakasema, “Hawa wamelewa divai!” Petro Ahutubia Umati
Ekegusii: Abande bagasekereria, bagoteeba: “Nigo batindire nedivai enyia.” Ogokwana gwa Petero ekero gia Pentekosti

English: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.
Kiswahili: Nitawainulia nabii kama wewe kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zao; nitaweka maneno yangu kinywani mwake, naye atawaambia kila kitu nitakachomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egati y’abaamwabo nimbaimokerie omobani onga buna aye, nimbeeke amang’ana ane as’omonwa oye, nere n’abateebie ayio onsi ndamochiike.

English: The wicked borrow, and don't pay back, but the righteous give generously.
Kiswahili: Waovu hukopa na hawalipi, bali wenye haki hutoa kwa ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoira egento singo tagokeirania, korende omonto omooronge nigo are namaabera na korua ebiegwa,

English: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I have even given him control of the beasts of the field.’”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: Nitaweka nira ya chuma kwenye shingo za mataifa haya yote ili kufanya yamtumikie Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, nao watamtumikia. Nitampa kutawala hata wanyama wa mwituni.’ ”
Ekegusii: Aya naro Nyasae bw’Emeganda agoteeba nimbeke ase amagoti ’abaanto b’ebisaku bionsi rikorogoto ri’ekioma, erinde babe abasomba ba Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, nabarabwo mbamokorere, ekiagera inche Omonene namoeire ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana boigo.”

English: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sasa tunaona taswira kama kwa kioo, lakini wakati huo tutaona wazi. Sasa nafahamu kwa sehemu, wakati huo nitafahamu kikamilifu, kama vile mimi ninavyofahamika kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Naki ekero kia bono nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore buna orotutu; korende ekero keria ntorore obosio ase obosio. Ekero kia bono namanyire ase ensemo; ekero keria nimanye onsi, buna inche imanyekanete kegima.

English: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
Kiswahili: Hakika ndipo utakapojifurahisha kwa Mwenyezi, nawe utamwinulia Mungu uso wako.
Ekegusii: Rirorio nobe gokwegokia ase Omobui oria, onyare korigereria Nyasae.

English: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.
Kiswahili: Niliinua macho yangu nikaona, na tazama, mtu aliyevaa kitani, ambaye mapaja yake yamepambwa kwa dhahabu safi ya Ufazi.
Ekegusii: nkarigereria, nkarora omonto obegete eanga y'egatani, bweboeretie kenama kiaye n'orokini roroisirie korwa ase etaabu engiya ekorwa Ufasi.

English: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs a year old—together with their grain offerings—and twelve male goats for the sin offering.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya wanyama waliotolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa walikuwa fahali kumi na wawili wachanga, kondoo dume kumi na wawili na wana-kondoo dume kumi na wawili wa mwaka mmoja, pamoja na sadaka zao za nafaka. Mbuzi waume kumi na wawili walitolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi.
Ekegusii: Ching’iti chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo chiarenge chieri ikomi na ibere, chimingichi ikomi na ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo ikomi na ibere, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera gwachiikire amo, chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

English: Then the people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things you are doing mean to us?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wakaniuliza, “Je, jambo hili unalofanya linamaanisha nini kwetu?”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bakamboria, “Nonyare gototeebia engencho y’amang’ana aya, na eyagera gwakora iga?”

English: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya miji yako kuwa magofu nawe utakuwa ukiwa. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nintagore emechie yao ebe amaturi, na ebe ense esaregete kegima ere bosa; erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

English: all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon until Moses killed him and the chiefs of Midian (Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba), the princes of Sihon who lived in the land.
Kiswahili: miji yote ya uwanda wa juu na eneo lote la utawala wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, aliyetawala katika Heshboni. Mose alikuwa amemshinda Sihoni, pia watawala wakuu wa Wamidiani, ambao ni Evi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba, waliokuwa wameungana na Sihoni, ambao waliishi katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: emechie yonsi y’ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, na oborwoti bwonsi bwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio konya ogambeire Hesiboni. Musa konya omobuire ere amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamidiani: Evi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Abwo bonsi barenge kogamba inse ya Sihoni bamenyete ase ense eria.

English: No food will be offered to comfort those who mourn the dead; not even a cup of consolation will be given for the loss of a father or mother.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote atakayewapa chakula ili kuwafariji wale waombolezao kwa ajili ya wale waliokufa, hata akiwa amefiwa na baba au mama, wala hakuna yeyote atakayewapa kinywaji ili kuwafariji.
Ekegusii: Monto onde takoa oria okwereire endagera ase okomoremia; na oria okoreera ise gose ng’ina takoremigwa ase okoegwa ekenyugwa.

English: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
Kiswahili: Hanania, Elamu, Anthothiya,
Ekegusii: Hanania na Elamu, na Anitotia,

English: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiongea nami, Roho akanijia na kunisimamisha wima, nikamsikia akisema nami.
Ekegusii: Ekero akwanete nainche, Omoika ogasoa ime y’ane, ogantenenia, erio nkamotegerera oria orenge gokwana nainche.

English: then turned eastward toward Beth-dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el, and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.
Kiswahili: Tena ukageuka mashariki kuelekea Beth-Dagoni, ukagusa Zabuloni na Bonde la Ifta-Eli, ukaenda upande wa kaskazini hadi Beth-Emeki na Neyeli, ukipitia Kabul upande wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Erio rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Dagoni, rogatwomera Sabuloni na ense yo’mweremo o Ifuta‐Eli, ensemo ya sugusu, rogaika Beti‐Emeki na Neieli. Erio rokagenderera gochia sugusu goika Kabuli,

English: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
Kiswahili: Vumilianeni na kusameheana mtu akiwa na lalamiko lolote dhidi ya mwenzake. Sameheaneni kama vile Bwana alivyowasamehe ninyi.
