Ekegusii: Bogorerania inwe ase inwe, na onye omonto ore ne ring’ana igoro ase omonto onde, mwaberane: buna Omonene abaaberete inwe, nainwe mwaberane bo.

English: This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.'”
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana alivyoamuru: ‘Kila mmoja akusanye kiasi anachohitaji. Chukueni pishi moja kwa kila mtu mliye naye katika hema yenu.' ”
Ekegusii: Ring'ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang'ana ase eema yaye.”

English: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—
Kiswahili: mkufunzi wa wajinga na mwalimu wa watoto wachanga, kwa kuwa una maarifa ya kweli katika hiyo sheria,
Ekegusii: Omotebereria bw’abariri, na omworokia bw’abana abake, ekiagera kwanyorire okworokereria okuya gwe chisemi na ekeene bire ime ase amachiiko.

English: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God. David’s Army Grows at Hebron
Kiswahili: Siku baada ya siku watu walikuja kumsaidia Daudi, mpaka akawa na jeshi kubwa, kama jeshi la Mungu. Wengine Waungana Na Daudi Huko Hebroni
Ekegusii: Rituko ase rituko abanto bakagenderera gocha ase Daudi komokonya, goika agatwara abarwani abange mono, buna abasikari ba Nyasae. Omobaro bw’abarwani ba Daudi

English: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo waambie hao wanaoupaka chokaa isiyokorogwa vyema kwamba ukuta huo utaanguka. Mvua kubwa ya mafuriko itanyesha, nami nitaleta mvua ya mawe inyeshe kwa nguvu, nao upepo wa dhoruba utavuma juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio goika oteebie ababani abwo bagoaka orwaki orwo echooka eyio ng'a orwaki orwo narogwe. Embura y'omoubera netwe amo namagena amanene, na ekembugu‐mbugu biroiyerie inse.

English: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,
Kiswahili: Chochote kinachohitajika kama mafahali wachanga, kondoo dume, wana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa Mungu wa mbinguni, ngano, chumvi, divai na mafuta kama vitakavyohitajika na makuhani huko Yerusalemu, lazima wapewe kila siku pasipo kukosa,
Ekegusii: Na kende gionsi abakuani bare agwo Yerusalemu baraganie baegwe. Kera rituko nigo baraegwe chieri chinsae, ne chimingichi gose ching'ondi, chibe ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa ase Nyasae o igoro. Boigo baegwe engano, na omonyoo, na edivai, na amaguta 'amasabibu. Baegwe ebinto ebio, tibamocha kobiegwa.

English: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wapenzi wangu, zikimbieni ibada za sanamu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, abanchwa baane, tama, timobaisa gosasiima emegwekano.

English: Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out, kindle fires, and burn up the weapons—the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ndipo wale wanaoishi katika miji ya Israeli watakapotoka na kutumia hizo silaha kuwashia moto na kuziteketeza, yaani, kigao na ngao, pinde na mishale, rungu za vita na mikuki. Kwa miaka saba watavitumia kama kuni.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abamenyete ase emechie y’Abaisraeli mbagende basangererie ebirwanero; chinguba, ne ching’aya, na amata, ne chinsara, ne chisimisi, na amatimo, babikore chinko bagoutera omorero ase engaki y’emiaka etan’ebere.

English: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!
Kiswahili: Jikungʼute mavumbi yako, inuka, uketi kwenye kiti cha enzi, ee Yerusalemu. Jifungue minyororo iliyo shingoni mwako, ee Binti Sayuni uliye mateka.
Ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, esamunse korwa ase orotu, tenena na oikaranse aase ao. Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, esibore amakorogoto mwasiberetwe ase amagoti aino.

English: So now Yahweh, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?
Kiswahili: “Basi kwa kuwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, amewafukuza Waamori watoke mbele ya watu wake Israeli, wewe unayo haki gani ya kuitamalaki?
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, nere oseretie Abaamori ase engencho y' abanto baye Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye bono nigo oganetie koira ense yabo?

English: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliye na hekima, ayasikie mambo haya, na atafakari upendo mkuu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore omong'aini, tiga aigwe amang'ana aya, tiga arengererie mono amanye obwanchani bw'Omonene bogendererete botambe.

English: Concerning Naphtali he said: “Naphtali is abounding with favor, full of the blessing of the LORD; he shall take possession of the sea and the south.”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Naftali akasema: “Naftali amejaa tele upendeleo wa Bwana, naye amejaa baraka yake; atarithi magharibi na kusini.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abanafutali: “Inwe Abanafutali nigo mwanyorire ogwancherwa okonge na ogosesenigwa kw’ogoisaneka korwa ase Omonene, moire orogongo rore ase enyancha ensemo ya Irianyi,”

English: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
Kiswahili: Waliuza mali zao na vitu walivyokuwa navyo, kila mtu akagawiwa kadiri ya mahitaji yake.
Ekegusii: bakaoonia chinibo chiabo na ebinto ebibarenge nabio, na kobigabera abanto bonsi koreng'ana buna kera oyomo aremeire.

English: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
Kiswahili: Katika mkono wake wa kuume alishika nyota saba, na kinywani mwake ulitoka upanga mkali wenye makali kuwili. Uso wake ulikuwa kama jua likingʼaa kwa nguvu zake zote.
Ekegusii: Ase okoboko kwaye gw'okorio nigo abwate ching'enang'eni isano na ibere, na ase omonwa oye okaruao omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere, na obosio bwaye nigo bware kobara buna erioba rikobara ne'chinguru chiaye.

English: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo yeye anayeasi dhidi ya mamlaka inayotawala anaasi dhidi ya kile kilichowekwa na Mungu, nao wale wafanyao hivyo watajiletea hukumu juu yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naboigo oy'otari koigwera oyore n'okobua, nigo akoamererania naya Nyasae achiikire; na barabwo abakoamererania inabenyorere ekiina.

English: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
Kiswahili: na kuwatuma kwa Bwana ili kumuuliza, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”
Ekegusii: erio Yohana akarangeria babere ase aborokigwa baye, akabatoma ase Omonene komoboria, “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

English: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watu waliomjia Daudi huko Siklagi, wakati alikuwa amefukuzwa mbele ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi (walikuwa miongoni mwa mashujaa waliomsaidia Daudi vitani,
Ekegusii: Daudi nigo amenyete Sikilagi, ekero arenge kwebisa korwa ase Saulo, mosinto o Kisi. Abanto chituoni abarenge komokonya ase esegi bagacha asare.

English: Does the eagle soar at your command and make his nest on high?
Kiswahili: Je, tai hupaa juu kwa amri yako na kujenga kiota chake mahali pa juu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Naye ogochika ekeongo kiairuruka gochia igoro, kiaagacha egeswa kiaye aase a igoro mono?

English: Later she gave birth to Cain’s brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, while Cain was a tiller of the soil.
Kiswahili: Baadaye akamzaa Abeli ndugu yake. Basi Abeli akawa mfugaji, na Kaini akawa mkulima.
Ekegusii: Naende akaibora omwana onde Abeli. Abeli akaba omorisia bwe ching’ondi, na Kaini akaba omoremi bw’omogondo.

English: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
Kiswahili: Vyura wataondoka kwako na katika nyumba zako, kwa maafisa wako na kwa watu wako, ila watabakia katika Mto Naili tu.”
Ekegusii: Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”

English: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa nane kwa mwezi wa nane, alikuwa Sibekai Mhushathi wa Wazera. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na gatato, Sibekai bw'ororeria rwa Husa Omozera akaba omoteneneri bw'ekeombe ki'omotienyi o gatano na gatato. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: For the dill isn't threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
Kiswahili: Iliki haipurwi kwa nyundo, wala gurudumu la gari halivingirishwi juu ya jira; iliki hupurwa kwa fimbo, na jira kwa ufito.
Ekegusii: Dili teri koorerwa nekeoorero gi'ekioma, gose komini teri koorwa namagoro e chigari, korende bionsi bibere nigo bigosusurerwa omote.

English: He went out, and wept bitterly.
Kiswahili: Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi.
Ekegusii: Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.

English: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Watasema juu ya utukufu wa fahari ya ukuu wako, nami nitatafakari juu ya kazi zako za ajabu.
Ekegusii: Nimbe 'nkorengereria mono igoro y'obonene bwao bw'ogosikwa okonene, na igoro y'emeremo yao y'ogokumia.

English: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him critically.
Kiswahili: Mapigano yakawa makali sana kumzunguka Sauli, nao wapiga upinde wakampata na kumjeruhi vibaya.
Ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono igoro ya Saulo; abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria mono; ere akabwatwa nomoondoko omonene ase engencho ya barabwo.

English: He himself will crush them before our face; but as for you, don't be afraid of them.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe atawaponda mbele yetu; lakini nyinyi msiwaogope.
Ekegusii: Omonene omonyene nabakoore ababisa baito. “Ase igo inwe timobaisa kobairoka.”

English: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
Kiswahili: nami nitakumbuka agano langu na Yakobo, na agano langu na Isaki, na agano langu na Abrahamu, nami nitaikumbuka nchi.
Ekegusii: erio nario ndainyore okobwatana kwane k’wogotianania okwo nakorete na Yakobo, na Isaka, na Aburaamu, naende ning’inyore ense eria nabaete.

English: Nevertheless, the LORD did not turn away from the fury of His burning anger, which was kindled against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to provoke Him to anger.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Bwana hakuacha ghadhabu yake iliyowaka dhidi ya Yuda kwa sababu ya yale yote ambayo Manase alikuwa amefanya kumghadhibisha.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene taonchogete atige obotindi obonene bw’endamwamu yaye yogete igoro ase Abayuda ase engencho y’okogechia gwonsi Manase konya akorire amogechirie.

English: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and said, “O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, when one man sins, will You be angry with the whole congregation?” Moses Separates the People
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose na Aroni wakaanguka kufudifudi na kulia kwa sauti, wakasema, “Ee Mungu, Mungu wa roho za wanadamu wote, utakuwa na hasira na kusanyiko lote wakati ni mtu mmoja tu ametenda dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateeba, “Aye ’Nyasae, Nyasae okorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, Inee, omonto oyomo gakorire ebibe, naye igo okogechigwa n’omoganda oyo bwonsi?”

English: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Makiri mwana wa Manase walikwenda Gileadi, wakaiteka nchi na kuwafukuza Waamori waliokuwa huko.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, bakageenda bakaumokera ense ya Gileadi, bagaseria Abaamori bamenyeteo, erio bakaira ense eria.

English: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.'
Kiswahili: Msitumie ngazi kupandia kwenye madhabahu yangu, uchi wako usije ukadhihirika kwa chini.'
Ekegusii: Naende totiirera ebiriinero igoro, gokogenda ase egesasiimero, egetirianda kiao tikebaisa kooroka.”

English: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
Kiswahili: Mose akawachagua watu wenye uwezo kutoka Israeli yote, akawafanya kuwa viongozi wa watu, maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.
Ekegusii: Agachora abanto b’Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeeka babe abaraai b’Abaisraeli, b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

English: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, as well as Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them. Jeremiah Rewrites the Scroll
Kiswahili: Badala yake, mfalme akamwamuru Yerameeli, mwana wa mfalme, Seraya mwana wa Azrieli, na Shelemia mwana wa Abdeeli kuwakamata mwandishi Baruku na nabii Yeremia. Lakini Bwana alikuwa amewaficha.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agachiika Yerameeli, momura oye, na Seraya, mosinto bw’Asirieli, na Selemia, mosinto bw’Abudeeli, ng’a babwate Baruku omoriki amo na Yeremia omobani, korende Omonene konya obabisire. Yeremia okorika egetabu ende

English: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Watatunza samani zote za Hema la Kukutania, wakitimiza wajibu wa kuhudumia Waisraeli kwa kufanya kazi ya Maskani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbatenenere ebinto bionsi bire ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase ogokora emeremo yonsi ase Obomenyo Obochenu nigo barabe bagokorera Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: If, however, the owner decides to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.
Kiswahili: Kama mwenye mnyama atapenda kumkomboa mnyama huyo, lazima aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto omonyene oganetie kobooria eng’iti eria, rirorio aakane rigori riria ribekire, n’ameente eyemo ya isano ase rigori erio.

English: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, kama mioyo yetu haituhukumu, tunao ujasiri mbele za Mungu,
Ekegusii: Abanchani, onye chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, rirorio ntore noboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae,

English: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
Kiswahili: kama mashariki ilivyo mbali na magharibi, ndivyo Mungu alivyoziweka dhambi zetu mbali nasi.
Ekegusii: Naende koreng'ana buna moocha ere aare mono korwa bosongo, naboigo Omonene akorusia ebibe biaito korwa ase tore biabeera aare.

English: The centurion answered, “Lord, I'm not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari akamwambia, “Bwana, mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.
Ekegusii: Oria omotang'ani bw'abarwani rigana akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y'ekerama kiane; korende kwana ring'ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.

English: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo ambayo Maskani, Hema la Ushuhuda, iliposimamishwa, wingu liliifunika. Kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi wingu lililokuwa juu ya Maskani lilionekana kama moto.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Obomenyo boria Obochenu bwatenenetigwe, riire rigatuba Obomenyo obwo, engencho yaye Eema y'Oborori. Na korwa mogoroba goika mambia riire riria rikarorekana rire buna omorero.

English: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
Kiswahili: Hakuna haja yangu kuwaandikia kuhusu huduma hii itolewayo kwa ajili ya watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase amang'ana y'ogokorera abachenu, tindi nengencho y'okobariikera.

English: Her buttock is so jiggly
Kiswahili: Matako yake yanatetemeka sana
Ekegusii: Enyonga yaye ekonyegera mono

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Sasa siku ya kifo chako imekaribia. Mwite Yoshua, mkajihudhurishe katika Hema la Kukutania, mahali nitakapompa maagizo ya kazi.” Kwa hiyo Mose na Yoshua wakaja na kujihudhurisha kwenye Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Naama! Amatuko ao abereire ang’e ogochia gokwa. Rangeria Yoshua, erinde moochiche agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, erio imobeeke ase emeremo agwenerete akore.” Musa na Yoshua bakageenda agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,

English: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
Kiswahili: Alipoivunja ile lakiri ya pili, nikamsikia yule kiumbe wa pili mwenye uhai akisema, “Njoo!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Emanwa y’Eng’ondi achia gosansora ekemanyererio gia kabere, nkaigwa eng’iti ya kabere ere moyo ekobora, “Inchuo!”

English: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent the people away to their homes, joyful and glad of heart for the good things that the LORD had done for David, for Solomon, and for His people Israel. The LORD’s Response to Solomon (1 Kings 9:1–9)
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na tatu ya mwezi wa saba Solomoni akawaaga watu waende nyumbani mwao, wakishangilia na kufurahi mioyoni mwao, kwa wema mwingi Bwana Mungu aliomtendea Daudi na Solomoni na kwa ajili ya watu wake Israeli. Bwana Mungu Amtokea Solomoni (1 Wafalme 9:1-9)
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatato ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere agatiga abanto bakagenda ase chinka chiabo bare nomochengo na omogooko ase chinkoro chiabo, ase engencho y’obuya bori’Omonene aorogetie ase Daudi na ase Sulemani, na ase Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Nyasae okoorokera Sulemani naende (1 Abar 9:1)

English: He remained faithful to the LORD and did not turn from following Him; he kept the commandments that the LORD had given Moses.
Kiswahili: Alishikamana na Bwana kwa bidii wala hakuacha kumfuata; alishika amri ambazo Bwana alikuwa amempa Mose.
Ekegusii: Akaba omwegenwa ase Omonene, tatigete komoigwera, korende akabwata amachiiko onsi ari’Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: Then the Lord will disclose these things, and the glory of the Lord shall be seen with the cloud, as it was also shown to Moses, also as Solomon implored that the place might be consecrated greatly,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana atafunua mambo haya, na utukufu wa Bwana utaonekana katika wingu, kama vile ulivyoonyeshwa kwa Musa, pia kama Sulemani alivyoomba kwamba mahali hapo papaswe kutakaswa sana,
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio Omonene nabaorokerie ebinto ebio, obonene bw'Omonene n'erire riria mbirorekane, buna yabete engaki eria ya Musa, na buna Sulemani asabete Hekalu ebekwe ensemo ase obonene.

English: Then the LORD said to me, “Go show love to your wife again, though she is loved by another and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and offer raisin cakes to idols. ”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Nenda, ukaonyeshe upendo wako kwa mke wako tena, ingawa amependwa na mwingine naye ni mzinzi. Mpende kama Bwana apendavyo Waisraeli, ingawa wanageukia miungu mingine na kupenda mikate mitamu ya zabibu kavu iliyowekwa wakfu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Genda omwanche naende omokungu oyio nonya ogokora obotomani nomwanchi oye, omwanche buna Omonene anchete Abaisraeli, nonya baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao, naende babeire n’okogania kwa amasabibu amomo.”

English: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa kuweni na huruma mkaniangalie mimi. Je, ningeweza kusema uongo mbele zenu?
Ekegusii: Bono, komoranche mondigererie; ninde nobomaene kegima, tingokwana oborimo ase more.

English: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.
Kiswahili: Nitaondoka na kurudi kwa baba yangu na kumwambia: Baba, nimetenda dhambi mbele za Mungu na mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Ninyimoke, ngende ase tata, imoteebie: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao,

English: so that I come again to my father's house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,
Kiswahili: na nirudi salama nyumbani kwa baba yangu, hapo ndipo Bwana atakuwa Mungu wangu,
Ekegusii: na inche kondairane ase omochie o Tata nomorembe, eri'Omonene nabe Nyasae one;

English: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”'
Kiswahili: hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” '
Ekegusii: goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y'amagoro ao”.

English: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.
Kiswahili: Nitapaharibu mahali penu pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, nibomoe madhabahu zenu za kufukizia uvumba, na kuzilundika maiti zenu juu ya sanamu zenu zisizo na uhai, nami nitawachukia ninyi sana.
Ekegusii: Ninsarie obotunwa bwaino ase mogosasimera, nintagore ebisasiimero biaino ase mogosaambera amanukato, erio intugute emebere yaino ekwete igoro y’emegwekano yaino mogosasiima etari moyo. Inche nimbaange kegima.

English: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
Kiswahili: Naye akampa mfalme talanta 120 za dhahabu, kiasi kikubwa cha vikolezi na vito vya thamani. Haikuwahi kamwe kuletwa vikolezi vizuri kama vile Malkia wa Sheba alivyompa Mfalme Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Erio eting’ana eria ekaa omorwoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitaabu ang’e chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Ebinsari binde tibiarentetwe ekero kende gionsi bireng’aine na biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omorwoti Sulemani.

English: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
Kiswahili: “Kama nimeishi katika uongo au mguu wangu umekimbilia udanganyifu,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire ngotaara ase chinchera chi'obong'ainereria, gose amagoro aane naminyokeire ay'oborimo?

English: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Kiswahili: Wale watu mashujaa walikuwa: Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu,
Ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b'abasikari nabwo aba: Asaeli momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu.

English: Don't become an enemy instead of a friend; for an evil name will inherit shame and reproach. So it is with the sinner who has a double tongue.
Kiswahili: Usiwe adui badala ya rafiki; maana jina baya litarithi aibu na fedheha. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa mwenye dhambi mwenye ulimi maradufu.
Ekegusii: Chimbwa chimbe nigo chikoreta obosooku amo n'ogotogonyerwa, buna ayakomonyora omonto omorimo naende omonyabibe.

English: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo mtakayoyafanya: Semeni kweli kila mtu kwa mwenzake, na mtoe hukumu ya kweli na haki kwenye mahakama zenu,
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro morakore: Kera omonto akwane ekeene noyomwabo; monache ebiina bia boronge na ebi’omorembe agwo ase ebiita biaino.

English: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo hasira yangu itakapokoma na ghadhabu yangu dhidi yao itatulia, nami nitakuwa nimelipiza kisasi. Baada ya kuimaliza ghadhabu yangu juu yao, watajua kuwa mimi Bwana nimenena katika wivu wangu.
Ekegusii: “Ase enchera eyio ning'umore endamwamu y'ane, na obotindi bwane, igoro ase bare, erinde 'ng'isaneke. Ekero 'ndabe naumoire endamwamu y'ane ase bare, 'mbamanye ng'a ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio inde ne risemi.

English: Now Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
Kiswahili: Noa akawa mkulima, akawa mtu wa kwanza kupanda mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Nuhu akaba omoremi, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani gosimeka emesabibu, nero ekoroisigwa edivai.

English: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa habari yenu, enyi kundi langu, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitahukumu kati ya kondoo na kondoo, kati ya kondoo dume na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Inwe ching’ondi chiane, ninache ekiina ase egati y’eng’ondi na eng’ondi ende, na ase egati ye chimingichi ne chigoree.

English: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
Kiswahili: Alifanya bahari kuwa nchi kavu, wakapita kati ya maji kwa miguu, njooni, tumshangilie.
Ekegusii: Ere akaonchora enyancha ekaba ense enyomo, erio abanto bakambokera aroro namagoro. Aroro agwo tokagoka mono asare.

English: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”
Kiswahili: “Mchukue umtunze. Usimdhuru, lakini umfanyie chochote anachotaka.”
Ekegusii: “Ira Yeremia, omorende buya mono. Tobaisa komokorera amang'ana ande amabe, korende amang'ana aragoteebie omokorere”

English: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For Yahweh has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
Kiswahili: Pigeni kelele kwa furaha, enyi mbingu; furahi, ee dunia; pazeni sauti kwa kuimba, enyi milima! Kwa maana Bwana anawafariji watu wake, naye atakuwa na huruma kwa watu wake walioumizwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe igoro chionsi, tera nomogooko; naye ense, aka eriogo ri'omochengo; inwe ebitunwa, tera mono, ekiagera Omonene oremirie abanto baye, ororeire abachandegete baye amaabera.

English: And those who have transgressed My covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before Me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two in order to pass between its pieces.
Kiswahili: Watu waliovunja agano langu, na ambao hawakutunza masharti ya agano walilofanya mbele zangu, nitawafanya kama ndama waliyemkata vipande viwili, kisha wakatembea kati ya vile vipande vya huyo ndama.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo basaretie okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete nabarabwo, gose tibarendete amang’ana ’okobwatana koria barabwo bakorete ase obosio bwane, inche nimbakorere buna barabwo bakorete ase emori eria y’okobwatana, bayenachanete ebing’ese bibere, erio bagaeta ase egati y’ebing’ese biria.

English: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sikiliza hili, wewe uliyeteswa, uliyelewa, lakini si kwa mvinyo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye ochandegete, aye gwatindire, ko tari ase ogotinda kw’edivai, igwa amang’ana aya:

English: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
Kiswahili: nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.'
Ekegusii: ne ching'enang'eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chire igoro nachitengechigwe.

English: When they lifted up their eyes from afar, they could barely recognize Job. They began to weep aloud, and each man tore his robe and threw dust in the air over his head.
Kiswahili: Walipomwona kwa mbali, ilikuwa vigumu kumtambua. Wakaanza kulia kwa sauti kubwa, wakayararua majoho yao na kujirushia mavumbi juu ya vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Bagachia komoorora korwa aare, tibanyara komomanya gose nere. Bagachaaka goaka amariogi bakorera; bagatandora chianga chiabo, bagesiarera ebuse gochia igoro na ase emetwe yabo.

English: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers. All their kings fall; not one of them calls upon Me.
Kiswahili: Wote ni moto kama tanuru; wanawaangamiza watawala wao. Wafalme wake wote wanaanguka, wala hakuna yeyote kati yao aniitaye mimi.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagwoka buna omorero o riko, bagosiria abagaambi babo b’ebiina. Abarwoti babo bonsi bagure, na onde tari ase abwo okondangeria imokonye. Abaisraeli na abanto b’ebisaku

English: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Hii ni laana inayotoka kwenda juu ya nchi yote, kwa kuwa kufuatana na yale yaliyoandikwa katika upande mmoja, kila mwizi atafukuziwa mbali, pia kufuatana na yaliyo upande wa pili, kila aapaye kwa uongo atafukuziwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Erio aganteebia, “Okwo nokoragererigwa gwachiereire ense yonsi. Kera oyokoiba narusigwe korwa aiga, buna koreng'ana ariikire ase egetabu eyio, na kera oyogotiana narusigwe boigo korwa aiga, buna koreng'ana ariikire ase egetabu eyio.

English: They charge like mighty men; they scale the walls like men of war. Each one marches in formation, not swerving from the course.
Kiswahili: Wanashambulia kama wapiganaji wa vita; wanapanda kuta kama askari. Wote wanatembea katika safu, hawapotoshi safu zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo chikominyoka gochia korwana esegi buna abasikari chituoni; nigo chikoriina chindwaki igoro buna abasikari. Kera eyemo nigo eragenderere gochia bosio, ende teri eragobere esire enchera ebwatetie.

English: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don't let me see my wretchedness.”
Kiswahili: Kama hivi ndivyo unavyonitendea, uniue sasa hivi, yaani kama nimepata kibali machoni pako, wala usiniache nione maangamizi yangu mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Onye aye kogonkorera amang'ana buna ayio, indorere amaabera, ong'ite rimo rioka inkwe ase obosio bwao, erinde timbaisa korora obokong'u obo.

English: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
Kiswahili: Vigingi vyote vya maskani na vya ua ulioizunguka vilikuwa vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Ebirochi bionsi bi'eema y'Obomenyo na ebi'ebitambaa bi'eraaro nigo biarenge bie chitaai.

English: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Gomeri walikuwa: Ashkenazi, Rifathi na Togarma.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi, na Rifati, na Togama.

English: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
Kiswahili: Maombi ya mtu aliyechoka. Anapoteseka na kumimina malalamiko yake kwa Bwana. Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.
Ekegusii: (Omonto ochandegete okorera ase Omonene) Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane; ekerero kiane tiga geike asore.

English: If someone sins and violates any of the LORD’s commandments even though he was unaware, he is guilty and shall bear his punishment.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akifanya dhambi na kufanya yale yaliyokatazwa katika mojawapo ya amri za Bwana, hata ikiwa hajui, yeye ana hatia na anastahili adhabu.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi aise gokora gento ase amang’ana ayio inche Omonene nakaanete ng’a takorwa, nonya tamanyeti ng’a ayio akorire nokomocha, ere omochire, goika abarerwe okomocha okwo.

English: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
Kiswahili: “Wakati huo, Ufalme wa Mbinguni utakuwa kama wanawali kumi waliochukua taa zao na kwenda kumlaki bwana arusi.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio, oborwoti bwa igoro nigo boragwekanigwe n'abaiseke ikomi ababogoretie chitaaya chiabo, bagasoka gochia korotota omonywomi.

English: You will not join them in burial, since you have destroyed your land and slaughtered your own people. The offspring of the wicked will never again be mentioned.
Kiswahili: Hutajumuika nao kwenye mazishi, kwa kuwa umeharibu nchi yako na kuwaua watu wako. Mzao wa mwovu hatatajwa tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: Aye togotindekwa buna abarwoti bande, ekiagera gwasaririe ense yao, naende gwaitire abanto bao. Ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirogwatorwa nonya ng’ake.

English: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unasema kuhusu wewe, “Utafute uso wake!” Uso wako, Bwana “Nitautafuta.”
Ekegusii: Aye gwatebire: “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogoteebia: “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”

English: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale wanawake wakaondoka pale kaburini wakiwa wamejawa na hofu, bali wakiwa na furaha nyingi. Wakaenda mbio kuwaeleza wanafunzi wake habari hizo.
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa ase oboina bwango, bare nokoiroka na omogooko omonene, bakaminyoka, bakairera aborokigwa baye amang'ana.

English: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
Kiswahili: Hufunua mambo ya ndani ya gizani, na kuyaleta nuruni yale yaliyositirika sana.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoorokia obobisi ase omosunte, erio okora obobisi boria bore ase omosunte bwaba oborabu.

English: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Misri akawaita hao wakunga, akawauliza, “Kwa nini mmefanya hivi? Mbona mmeacha watoto wa kiume waishi?”
Ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?

English: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don't have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
Kiswahili: Hata kama nitasema kwa lugha za wanadamu na za malaika, kama sina upendo, nimekuwa kengele inayolialia au toazi livumalo.
Ekegusii: Ninsa gokwana ase emenwa ya Mwanyabaanto na ey'abamalaika, onye tindi nobwanchani, nabeire buna etai ekwoga gose endege ekobuga.

English: So the woman went and told her husband, “A man of God came to me. His appearance was like the angel of God, exceedingly awesome. I did not ask him where he came from, and he did not tell me his name.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akamwendea mumewe na kumweleza kuwa, “Mtu wa Mungu alinijia. Kule kuonekana kwake kulikuwa kama kwa malaika wa Mungu, wa kutisha sana. Sikumuuliza alikotoka wala hakuniambia jina lake.
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akageenda agateebia omosacha oye, “Omonto o Nyasae nachicha ase ’nde: nigo arenge kororekana buna omomalaika o Nyasae, nigo arenge bw’okoondokia mono. Tinamoboretie ase are korwa, nere tanteebeti erieta riaye.

English: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he must pronounce him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; it is a skin disease.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atakapoiona hiyo nyama mbichi, atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa najisi. Hiyo nyama mbichi ni najisi, ana ugonjwa wa kuambukiza.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omokuani ararore ng’a enyama eria embariri yasokire, rirorio ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Enyama eria embariri nigo ere eyetachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.

English: King David was told, “Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God's ark.” So David went and brought up God's ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David's city with joy.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mfalme Daudi akaambiwa, “Bwana ameibariki nyumba ya Obed-Edomu pamoja na kila alicho nacho, kwa sababu ya Sanduku la Mungu.” Basi Daudi akateremka na kulipandisha Sanduku la Mungu kutoka nyumba ya Obed-Edomu hadi Mji wa Daudi kwa shangwe.
Ekegusii: Daudi agateebigwa ng'a, ase engencho y'Esanduki eria y'Omonene osesenirie abanto b'enyomba y'Obedi‐Edomu, amo nebiinto bionsi abwate. Erio akageenda akoyia Esanduki eria korwa ase enyomba y'Obedi‐Edomu, akayerenta ase omochie oye ore n'omochengo omonene.

English: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David's throne will be established before Yahweh forever.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mfalme Solomoni atabarikiwa, na kiti cha ufalme cha Daudi kitakuwa imara mbele za Bwana milele.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche omorwoti Sulemani ninsesenigwe, na ekerogo ki'obonene gia Daudi nagekorwe kebe ne chinguru kegenderere botambe ase obosio bw'Omonene.”

English: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”
Kiswahili: Maovu haya yote hutoka ndani ya mtu, nayo ndiyo yamtiayo mtu unajisi.”
Ekegusii: Aya onsi amabe nigo akorwa ime, naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”

English: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
Kiswahili: Huyu Maria, ambaye Lazaro kaka yake alikuwa mgonjwa, ndiye yule ambaye alimpaka Bwana mafuta na kuifuta miguu yake kwa nywele zake.
Ekegusii: Mariamu nere oyo oagete Omonene amaguta na komotinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye. Bono Lazaro momura omwabo nigo arenge omorwaire.

English: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Kiswahili: Nimetia manukato kitanda changu kwa manemane, udi na mdalasini.
Ekegusii: Naboumoreire manemane, na amaguta y'omogaka, na ay'omodalasini botioke buya.

English: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
Kiswahili: Pigeni matiti yenu kwa ajili ya mashamba mazuri, kwa ajili ya mizabibu iliyozaa vizuri
Ekegusii: Moake‐ake ebikuba biaino, ekiagera emegondo yaino emiya, na emesabibu yaino ekwama mono, yasarigwe,

English: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wafalme wa nchi ambao Yoshua na Waisraeli waliwashinda upande wa magharibi mwa Yordani, kuanzia Baal-Gadi katika Bonde la Lebanoni hadi kufikia Mlima Halaki, unaoinuka ukielekea Seiri. (Yoshua alitoa nchi zao kwa makabila ya Israeli iwe urithi wao sawasawa na mgawanyiko wa makabila yao:
Ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bakabua na goita abarwoti bonsi abamenyete bosongo ya Yorodani, gochakera Baali‐Gadi ase ebate ya Lebanoni goikera egetunwa kia Halaki, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu. Yoshua agaatananera kera egesaku ki'Abaisraeli ense eria ekaba eyabo.

English: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.
Kiswahili: na kila mjenzi alijifunga upanga wake upande mmoja akiwa anafanya kazi. Lakini mtu wa kupiga baragumu alikaa pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo bw'abaagachi nigo eboeranetie omoyio oye o birende kenema kiaye ekero agendererete koagacha; na omobugia egetureeri nigo ateneine ang'e nainche.

English: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
Kiswahili: Tulisikia habari hii huko Efrathi, tulikutana nayo katika mashamba ya Yaara:
Ekegusii: Ama! Agwo Efarata tokaigwa amang'ana igoro y'Esanduki y'Okobwatana, tokayenyora aaria ase orosana rwa Yearimu.

English: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh's word.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, itabirie milima ya Israeli na useme, ‘Ee milima ya Israeli, sikieni neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bana oteebie ebitunwa bi'Abaisraeli: Inwe ebitunwa bi'Abaisraeli, igwa ring'ana ri'Omonene!

English: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?
Kiswahili: “Je, waweza kuufunga mnyororo wa Kilimia? Waweza kulegeza kamba za Orioni?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gosiberania egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo? Gose bwororobie egetuse keria gekorokwa Orioni?

English: He created her. He saw and measured her. He poured her out upon all his works.
Kiswahili: Alimuumba. Alimwona na kumpima. Alimmiminia kazi zake zote.
Ekegusii: Noyomo bweka obwate chisemi na nigo akairansete ase ekerogo kiaye kiobonene nere Omonene

English: Many will purify themselves, make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked will do wickedly. None of the wicked will understand; but those who are wise will understand.
Kiswahili: Wengi watajitakasa, watajifanya weupe, na kusafishwa; bali waovu watatenda maovu; hakuna hata mmoja waovu atakayeelewa; bali wale walio na hekima wataelewa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange mbacheneke na koraba, babe basibekire, korende abakori amabe mbagenderere gokora amabe, onde tagotooka ase abakori amabe orabe nokomanya, korende abare nobong'aini mbamanye.

English: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.” The Return to Nazareth (Luke 2:39–40)
Kiswahili: “Sauti ilisikika huko Rama, maombolezo na kilio kikubwa, Raheli akilia kwa ajili ya wanawe, akikataa kufarijiwa, kwa sababu hawako tena.” Kurudi Kutoka Misri
Ekegusii: “Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia. Raeli nkoreera are abana baye, tancheti akirigwe, ekiagera bonsi bakuure.” Okoiranigwa kw’Omwana korwa Misiri

English: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: kwa tarumbeta na mvumo wa baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume: shangilieni kwa furaha mbele za Bwana, aliye Mfalme.
Ekegusii: Moake amariogi 'omogooko ase Omonene ore omorwoti ase okobugia ebirombeta na ebitureeri.

English: He said, “How will we liken God's Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
Kiswahili: Akawaambia tena, “Tuufananishe Ufalme wa Mungu na nini? Au tutumie mfano gani ili kuueleza?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akagenderera koboora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase mobayeeno ki?

English: Then Moses said, “This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things, for it was not my own doing:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo mtakavyojua kuwa Bwana amenituma kufanya mambo haya, na kwamba halikuwa wazo langu.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Ase aya namomanye ’ng’a Omonene ontomire gokora aya onsi, naende ng’a tari inche omonyene nebegete gokora buna inyanchete.

English: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—
Kiswahili: Dhahabu, fedha, shaba, chuma, bati, risasi,
Ekegusii: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai, na ebioma ao ao,

English: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo walimuuliza, “Tuambie, ni nani anayehusika kwa kutuletea tatizo hili lote? Unafanya kazi gani? Umetoka wapi? Nchi yako ni ipi? Wewe ni kutoka taifa lipi?”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakamobooria, “Toteebie gose ning'o ogerire amabe aya atonyorire. Meremo ki ogokora aye? Ng'ai kwarure? Ense yao nereri? Ngesaku ki ore?”

English: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya watu wako Israeli kuwa watu wako wewe mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee Bwana Mungu, umekuwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.

English: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn't sin with his lips.
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Unazungumza kama vile ambavyo mwanamke mpumbavu yeyote angenena. Je, tupokee mema mikononi mwa Mungu, nasi tusipokee na udhia?” Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi katika kusema kwake.
Ekegusii: Korende Ayubu akairaneria mokaye, akamoteebia, “Aye nigo ogokwana buna omokungu onde bwensi omoriri agokwana. Onye tokonyora amaya korwa ase Nyasae, Inee, titokonyora amabe naro korwa asare?” Ase amang'ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe ase ogokwana kwaye.

English: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon. He leased it to the tenants. For its fruit, each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver.
Kiswahili: Solomoni alikuwa na shamba la mizabibu huko Baal-Hamoni; alikodisha shamba lake la mizabibu kwa wapangaji. Kila mmoja angeleta kwa ajili ya matunda yake shekeli 1,000 za fedha.
Ekegusii: Sulemani nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Baali‐Hamoni, akayotigera abarendi, na kera omorendi nigo arenge korenta chitaabu chi’echifeta elifu eyemo goakanera amatunda.

English: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
Kiswahili: “Je, mwenye kushindana na Mwenyezi aweza kumsahihisha? Mwenye kumlaumu Mungu na ajibu.”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto okona‐korigia amamocho naamereranie n'Omonguru? Aye okona‐koamererania na Nyasae, iraneria rende.”

English: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
Kiswahili: Watakusalimu na kukupa mikate miwili, ambayo utaipokea kutoka kwao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbagokwanie, bakoe emegati ebere, noyianche, oyebogorie korwa ase amaboko abo.

English: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nakwo ensoko y'obogima eragere omonto eatanane korwa ase emetego y'amakweri.

English: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu kufuata maagizo, amri na sheria ninazowapa leo.
Ekegusii: Bono morende na koigwera amachiiko, na emeroberio echiikire, mokore ayio onsi nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero.

English: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa tatu akaipiga tarumbeta yake, na nyota kubwa iliyokuwa ikiwaka kama taa ikaanguka toka angani, ikaangukia theluthi ya mito na chemchemi za maji.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatato akabugia egetureeri kiaye. Erio eng’enang’eni enene ekagwa korwa igoro, yare gwoka buna ekieri; ekagwa igoro ase ensemo ya gatato ye chindooche, na igoro ye chinsoko chi’amaache.

English: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
Kiswahili: Koo za Wakohathi zilitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa kusini wa Maskani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya Irianyi y’Obomenyo boria.

English: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),
Kiswahili: Wakati huu ulikuwa wakati wa mavuno, nao Mto Yordani ulikuwa umefurika hadi kwenye kingo zake. Ilikuwa kawaida ya Yordani kufurika nyakati zote za mavuno. Mara tu makuhani wale waliokuwa wamebeba Sanduku la Agano walipofika mtoni na nyayo zao kuzama ndani ya yale maji,
Ekegusii: Bono orooche rwa Yorodani nigo rware goichora engaki yerigesa amaache aetanana chingegu. Ekero abakuani, abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria, baigete Yorodani na batachete amaache namagoro abo,

English: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Yeye akaaye mahali pa salama pake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, atadumu katika uvuli wake Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ere oyomenyete inse y'oborendi bw'Oyore Igoro Mono, na otimogete ase ekiriri ki'oyore Omobui,

English: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye Bwana hamhesabii dhambi, na ambaye rohoni mwake hamna udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyi’Omonene atabarereti okomocha kwaye, oyo otari nobong’ainereria ase omoyo oye ime.

English: But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wewe umjaribuye mwenye haki na kupima moyo na nia, hebu nione ukilipiza kisasi juu yao, kwa maana kwako nimeliweka shauri langu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw'Emeganda, aye okorenga abanto ase oboronge, nigo omanyete chinkoro na ebirengererio. Ase ayio, nduserie egesiomba ase ababisa baane, ekiagera nabekire amang'ana aane asore.

English: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
Kiswahili: Tembeeni katika Sayuni, uzungukeni mji, hesabuni minara yake;
Ekegusii: Taara moetanane Sayoni, mobare emerobiri yaye.

English: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him turned toward Debir and fought against it.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua na Israeli wote wakageuka na kuushambulia Debiri.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Debiri, akaumokera omochie oyio.

English: But you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, or the land along the banks of the Jabbok River, or the cities of the hill country, or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden.
Kiswahili: Lakini kulingana na amri ya Bwana Mungu wetu, hamkujiingiza katika nchi yoyote ya Waamoni, wala katika sehemu yoyote iliyo kandokando ya Mto Yaboki, wala katika miji iliyoko katika vilima.
Ekegusii: Korende titwaigete ang’e ase ense y’Abaamoni, gose ase chingegu chi’orooche rwa Yaboki, na emechie y’ense y’ebitunwa, na aande onsi ase Omonene Nyasae oito, atokanetie titogeendao.

English: A good name is more desirable than great riches; favor is better than silver and gold.
Kiswahili: Heri kuchagua jina jema kuliko utajiri mwingi, kuheshimiwa ni bora kuliko fedha au dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Erieta rigiya nigo rigwenerete gochorwa kobua chinibo chinyinge, na ogwakwaneka okuya nigo kobuete efeta na etaabu.

English: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
Kiswahili: Kama nikisema, “Hakika giza litanificha na nuru inayonizunguka iwe usiku,”
Ekegusii: Ninsa goteeba, “Tiga omosunte ontube kegima, na oborabu bong’etanaine boonchoke bobe omosunte”,

English: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
Kiswahili: Huko ndipo nitakapokutana na Waisraeli, nalo Hema la Kukutania litatakaswa na utukufu wangu.
Ekegusii: Agwo ning’umerane n’Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning’akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.

English: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
Kiswahili: Waliubadilisha Utukufu wao kwa sanamu ya fahali, ambaye hula majani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaonchoreria oyorenge obonene bwabo, bakaonchokera omogwekano bw’eng’ombe ekorisia obonyansi.

English: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ifikapo jioni, mnasema, ‘Hali ya hewa itakuwa nzuri, kwa kuwa anga ni nyekundu.’
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Rikoba mogoroba, mwaboora: Reero nerakeere, ekiagera igoro abariirire.

English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, hiyo divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo yote itamwagika.
Ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria enyia nayaate ebirandi biria; edivai enyene eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke.

English: Kedemoth, and Mephaath—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
Kiswahili: Kedemothi na Mefaathi, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne;
Ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefaati, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Kiswahili: Usiwaache wafikiri, “Aha, hili ndilo tulilotaka!” Au waseme, “Tumemmeza.”
Ekegusii: Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamonyorire buna twaganetie.” Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamobuire.”

English: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which Yahweh shall choose.
Kiswahili: Lakini vichukueni vitu vyenu vilivyowekwa wakfu pamoja na vile mlivyoweka nadhiri, mwende mahali pale Bwana atakapopachagua.
Ekegusii: Ebinto biaino moraatanane bibe ebichenu amo nebi mwariete chiira ng'a 'mobirue, mobiire aase agwo Omonene arachoore.

English: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda Kaini akaleta baadhi ya mazao ya shamba kama sadaka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Engaki egaika Kaini akarenta okwama kw’omogondo oye erio kobe ekengwanso ase Omonene.

English: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
Kiswahili: Nina ufahamu zaidi kuliko wazee, kwa kuwa ninayatii mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo 'manyete amange kobua abanto abagotu, ekiagera 'mbwatete amachiiko ao.

English: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
Kiswahili: “Sauti ikasema kutoka mbinguni mara ya pili, ‘Usikiite najisi kitu chochote Mungu alichokitakasa.’
Ekegusii: Eriogi riganteebia eria kabere korwa igoro: Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.

English: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, tangu wakati wa Adamu hadi wakati wa Mose, mauti ilitawala watu wote, hata wale ambao hawakutenda dhambi kwa kuvunja amri, kama alivyofanya Adamu, ambaye alikuwa mfano wa yule atakayekuja.
Ekegusii: Korende amakweri nigo agaambete korwa Adamu goika Musa, nonya niigoro y’abwo batakorete ebibe koreng’ana nogosaria kw’Adamu, oyorenge omogwekano bw’oyio ogochi‐gocha.

English: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers to Joseph’s house.
Kiswahili: Yule Msimamizi akafanya kama Yosefu alivyomwambia na akawachukua wale watu nyumbani kwa Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie, agasoyia abanto abwo nyomba ime.

English: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaomba tena, nazo mbingu zikatoa mvua nayo ardhi ikatoa mazao yake.
Ekegusii: Agasaba naende, igoro ekarenta embura, na ense ekama okwama kwaye.

English: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
Kiswahili: Yeyote amchukiaye ndugu yake ni muuaji, nanyi mwajua ya kwamba muuaji hana uzima wa milele ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogechete oyomwabo oyio nomoiti, na inwe momanyete ng'a omoiti tari nobogima bwa kare na kare ime yaye.

English: I built reservoirs to water my groves of flourishing trees.
Kiswahili: Nikajenga mabwawa ya kukusanya maji ya kunyweshea hii miti iliyokuwa inastawi vizuri.
Ekegusii: Nkeroiseria amatibo ase nare korusia amaache nasiarera emete egokina ase rinani.

English: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
Kiswahili: Wakazika mifupa ya Sauli na ya mwanawe Yonathani katika kaburi la Kishi, babaye Sauli, huko Sela katika nchi ya Benyamini, nao wakafanya kila kitu mfalme alichoagiza. Baada ya hayo, Mungu akajibu maombi kwa ajili ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Erio bagatindeka amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, omwana oye, ase ense ya Benjamini, aaria Zela, ase embeera ya Kisi ise. Barabwo bagakora onsi aya omorwoti achiigete. Magega y'ayio Nyasae akaigwa aya basaberete ense eria.

English: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Nimechimba visima katika nchi za kigeni na kunywa maji yake. Kwa nyayo za miguu yangu nimekausha vijito vyote vya Misri.'
Ekegusii: Ngakunya, nkanyora amaache nkonywa, ngakamia chindooche chionsi chia Misiri ne chimbaratero chi'amagoro aane.

English: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
Kiswahili: Huwainua maskini kutoka mavumbini, na kuwanyanyua wahitaji kutoka kwenye jalala,
Ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obwere, na koimokia omoremerwa korwa ase ribu,

English: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
Kiswahili: mkajivike utu mpya, ulioumbwa sawasawa na mfano wa Mungu katika haki yote na utakatifu.
Ekegusii: mweboyie omonto omoyia, oyotongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae ase oboronge na obochenu bw'ekeene.

English: That proposal was good in their eyes.
Kiswahili: Pendekezo hilo lilikuwa zuri machoni pao.
Ekegusii: Okogania okwo gokagookia abanto,

English: Moreover, he recounted to them the help given from time to time in the days of their ancestors, both in the days of Sennacherib, when one hundred eighty-five thousand perished,
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, aliwasimulia msaada waliopewa mara kwa mara katika siku za baba zao, katika siku za Senakeribu, wakati watu mia moja themanini na tano elfu walipoangamia,
Ekegusii: Yuda akagenderera kobainyoria buna Nyasae akonyete chisokoro chiabo: chingaki chia Senakeribu ababisa 185,000 bagasirigwa;

English: Indeed, the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu amewabariki kwa kazi yote ya mikono yenu. Amewalinda katika safari yenu katikati ya jangwa hili kubwa. Kwa miaka hii arobaini Bwana Mungu wenu amekuwa pamoja nanyi, na hamkupungukiwa na kitu chochote.
Ekegusii: Inyora buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abasesenirie ase emeremo yaino yonsi mwabeire mogokora. Nigo abeire obarendete ase orogeendo rwaino ase erooro eye enene ase emiaka eye emerongo ene. Omonene Nyasae oino, obeire amo nainwe, na inwe timwaremeretwe na gento kende.

English: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
Kiswahili: Wakauita ule mji Dani kwa kufuata jina la baba yao aliyezaliwa na Israeli, ingawa mji huo ulikuwa ukiitwa Laishi hapo kwanza.
Ekegusii: Bakaroka omochie oyio Dani, erieta ria Dani sokoro yabo, mosinto o Israeli.

English: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God. David’s Psalms of Thanksgiving (Psalms 105:1–15)
Kiswahili: nao Benaya na Yahazieli makuhani, ndio wangepiga tarumbeta mara kwa mara mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Mungu. Zaburi Ya Daudi Ya Shukrani (Zaburi 105:1-15; 96:1-13; 106:1, 47-48)
Ekegusii: Benaya na Yahasieli, abakuani, bakaba bakobugia ebitureeri botambe agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire Okobwatana kwa Nyasae.

English: Don't listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
Kiswahili: “Msimsikilize Hezekia. Hili ndilo mfalme wa Ashuru asemalo: Fanyeni amani nami na mje kwangu. Kisha kila mmoja wenu atakula kutoka kwa mzabibu wake na mtini wake mwenyewe, na kunywa maji kutoka kisima chake mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang'ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omorwoti bw'Abaasuri agoteeba: Kora omorembe nainche, moche ase 'nde. Erio kera omonto ase more narie okwama kw'emesabibu na okw'emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amaache 'ensoko yaye omonyene,

English: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
Kiswahili: Walimwabudu Bwana, lakini pia waliitumikia miungu yao kulingana na desturi za mataifa walikotoka.
Ekegusii: Bakamoiroka Omonene, korende boigo bagakorera chinyasae chiabo abanyene, bagakora buna abanto b'ebisaku biria, ase bang'anyetigwe korwa, baarenge gokora.

English: Now in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.
Kiswahili: Katika mwezi wa saba Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania mwana wa Elishama, aliyekuwa wa uzao wa mfalme na pia alikuwa mmoja wa maafisa wa mfalme, akaja pamoja na watu kumi kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu huko Mispa. Walipokuwa wakila pamoja huko,
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere ase omwaka oria, Isumaeli mosinto o Netania, mochokoro bw'Elisama, oyorenge omonto bw'enyomba y'obogambi na omoteneneri omonene igoro ase abanene barenge gokorera omorwoti, amo nabaanto bande ikomi, bagacha ase Gedalia, mosinto bw'Ahikamu, agwo Misipa. Ekero barenge koria endagera amo bonsi agwo Misipa,

English: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.
Kiswahili: Kukawa na mianga ya umeme wa radi, ngurumo, radi na tetemeko kubwa la ardhi. Hapajawa kamwe na tetemeko la ardhi kama hilo tangu mwanadamu awepo duniani, hivyo lilikuwa tetemeko kubwa ajabu.
Ekegusii: Igo bikaba okomesa, na okogukura, ne chinkoba, na omotengecho omonene bw'ense. Na korwa ekero Mwanyabaanto bachaagete koba ase ense motengecho onde tona koba omonene buna oyio.

English: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which Yahweh will give you by this young woman.”
Kiswahili: Kupitia kwa watoto ambao Bwana atakupa kutokana na huyu mwanamwali, jamaa yako na ifanane na ya Peresi, ambaye Tamari alimzalia Yuda.”
Ekegusii: Naende enka yao ebe buna eya Peresi, oria Tamari aiborerete Yuda, goetera ase oroiboro rori'Omonene arakoe korwa ase omokungu oyio.”

English: Then the man led me out northward into the outer court, and he brought me to the group of chambers opposite the temple courtyard and the outer wall on the north side.
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mtu akaniongoza kuelekea kaskazini mpaka kwenye ua wa nje na kunileta mpaka kwenye vyumba vinavyoelekeana na ua wa Hekalu na kuelekeana na ukuta wa nje upande wa kaskazini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira ase eraaro ya isiko erochie sugusu, na akang’ira ase enyomba rirondo yanachanire ebinyomba yarenge gati y’aase atigire ataagachire na oboagacho bwa sugusu.

English: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
Kiswahili: Mwambieni Mungu, “Jinsi gani yalivyo ya kutisha matendo yako! Uwezo wako ni mkuu mno kiasi kwamba adui wananyenyekea mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Motebie Nyasae: Naki ogokora kwao kore ogw’okwoboyia! Obobui bwao nigo bore obonene mono, goika ababisa bao bekeyie asore.

English: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Binui 648
Ekegusii: aba orwa Binui: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ene, na batano na batato (648);

English: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, with a heart of integrity and uprightness, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
Kiswahili: “Kukuhusu wewe, kama ukienenda kwa unyofu wa moyo na uadilifu, kama baba yako Daudi alivyofanya na kutenda yote ninayoyaagiza kwa kutunza maagizo yangu na sheria,
Ekegusii: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, buna Daudi iso achibwatetie, ase enkoro endonge na ase obwegenwa; na onye kogokora onsi aya nagochikiire, na kobwata emeroberio yonsi echiikire;

English: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. And he did evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
Kiswahili: Yehoyakimu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu miaka kumi na mmoja. Akafanya maovu machoni pa Bwana Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Yehoyakimu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oye.

English: and that the temple which was in it was exceedingly rich, and that in it were golden shields, breastplates, and weapons which Alexander, son of Philip, the Macedonian king, who reigned first among the Greeks, left behind there.
Kiswahili: na kwamba hekalu lililokuwa ndani yake lilikuwa na utajiri mwingi sana, na kwamba ndani yake mlikuwa na ngao za dhahabu, vifua vya kifuani, na silaha ambazo Alexander, mwana wa Filipo, mfalme wa Makedonia, aliyetawala kwanza kati ya Wagiriki, aliziacha hapo.
Ekegusii: Hekalu yaye nigo yabwate obotenenku obonene, eichire chinguba chi'etaabu, abietubo biegekuba na ebirwanero biatigetwe aroro na Alekisanda omwana bw'omorwoti mosinto o Filipo omorwoti o Makedonia oyio orenge omoteneneri bw'eritang'ani bwa Abagiriki.

English: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.
Kiswahili: kipande cha andazi la tini na andazi la zabibu zilizokaushwa. Akala naye akapata nguvu, kwa kuwa hakuwa amekula chakula chochote wala kunywa maji kwa siku tatu usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: naende bakamoa amako amomo, na amabomba abere ay'amasabibu amomo, na ekero ariire, akanyora chinguru. Ase engaki y'amatuko atato konya atana koria gento, gose konywa.

English: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
Kiswahili: Nitawaongoza vipofu kwenye njia ambayo hawajaijua, kwenye mapito wasiyoyazoea nitawaongoza; nitafanya giza kuwa nuru mbele yao, na kufanya mahali palipoparuza kuwa laini. Haya ndiyo mambo nitakayofanya; mimi sitawaacha.
Ekegusii: “Nindaae abanto bare emeuko ase enchera batana komanya, nimbatang’ane ase oboeto batana komanya. Ning’onchore omosunte ore bosio bwabo obe oborabu, aase atareng’aini naaranigwe. Ayio naro ndabakorere, tingotiga goikerania amang’ana aane.

English: but you must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
Kiswahili: Lakini kamwe usinywe damu; imwage juu ya ardhi kama maji.
Ekegusii: Korende timobaisa koria amanyinga; goika moyaitere ase riroba buna amaache.

English: Then the king made Daniel great, and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon, and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme akamfanya Danieli kuwa mkuu, akampa zawadi nyingi kubwa, akamfanya kuwa mkuu wa jimbo lote la Babeli, na kuwa mkuu wa wenye hekima wote wa Babeli.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akaa Danieli amasikani amanene, na ebiegwa ebinene ebinge, naende akamobeka akaba omogambi igoro ase orogongo rwonsi rwa Babiloni na omoteneneri omonene igoro y'abang'aini bonsi ba Babiloni.

English: Yahweh said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Hakika nitakuokoa kwa kusudi jema, hakika nitawafanya adui zako wakuombe msaada nyakati za maafa na nyakati za dhiki.
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire: “Ekeene, ninkobeke chinguru, ngosesenie. Ase engaki y'emechando nimbetererie ababisa bao batung'ame ase obosio bwao.

English: You may eat any clean bird,
Kiswahili: Mnaweza kula ndege yeyote aliye safi.
Ekegusii: “Chinyoni chionsi chichenegete ’namochirie.

English: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we'll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yuda akamwambia baba yake Israeli, “Mtume kijana pamoja nami, nasi tutaondoka mara, ili sisi na wewe pamoja na watoto wetu tuweze kuishi, wala tusife.
Ekegusii: Yuda agateebia Israeli ise: “Mong'e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.

English: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest's office—
Kiswahili: pamoja na mavazi matakatifu yaliyofumwa ya kuhani Aroni, na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe wakati wanahudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani,
Ekegusii: ne chianga chingiya chinchenu chia Aroni Omokuani, na echi'abamura baye, echi barabeeke ekero bagokora emeremo y'obokuani,

English: And Jehoshaphat walked in the way of his father Asa and did not turn away from it; he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Alienenda katika njia za Asa baba yake wala hakwenda kinyume chake. Alifanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Yehosafati akabwatia chinchera chia Asa ise, taonchogete na gochitiga. Agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene.

English: He said to those who were building houses, were betrothing wives, were planting vineyards, and were fearful, that they should return, each man to his own house, according to the law.
Kiswahili: Aliwaambia wale waliokuwa wakijenga nyumba, waliokuwa wakichumbiana na wake, waliokuwa wakipanda mizabibu, na walikuwa na hofu kwamba wangerudi, kila mtu nyumbani kwake, kulingana na sheria.
Ekegusii: Erio kobwatekana ne richiiko, akabairania gochia inka oria orenge koagacha enyomba, oyo konye onywomire ase obwango obwo, oyo orenge komeria chintetere chi'emesabibu gose oria orenge omwoba.

English: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
Kiswahili: Amebarikiwa mtu yule atendaye hili, mtu yule alishikaye kwa uthabiti, yeye ashikaye Sabato bila kuinajisi, auzuiaye mkono wake usifanye uovu wowote.”
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyo ogokora ayio, Mwanyabaanto oyo okoyabwata bokong’u, oyio okorenda Esabato, tayekora ebe eyetachenegeti, omonto oyio ogotanga okoboko kwaye tigokora amabe ande onsi.”

English: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
Kiswahili: “Ufanye mti kuwa mzuri, nayo matunda yake yatakuwa mazuri. Au ufanye mti kuwa mbaya, na matunda yake yatakuwa mabaya. Kwa maana mti hutambulika kwa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: “Kora omote obe omuya, na amatunda aye abe amaya; gose kora omote obe omobe, na amatunda aye abe amabe; naki omote nigo okomanyekana ase okwama kwaye.

English: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they sighted a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, mabaharia hawakuitambua ile nchi, lakini waliona ghuba yenye ufuko wa mchanga, ambako waliamua kuipweleza meli kama ingewezekana.
Ekegusii: Kobwachia gokia, tibamanya ense eria, otatiga baroche omosomo ore nengegu, bagateebania gosoyia emeeri aroro, keranyarekane.

English: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don't know what has become of him.'
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Aroni, ‘Tufanyie miungu watakaotuongoza, kwa maana mtu huyu Mose aliyetutoa nchi ya Misri, hatujui yaliyompata.'
Ekegusii: bagateebia Aroni: Tokorere chinyasae echiranyare gototang'ana. Titomanyeti eriamonyorire Musa, oyotorusetie ase ense ya Misiri.

English: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
Kiswahili: ambaye ubaba wote wa kila jamaa za mbinguni na za duniani unatokana naye.
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abakorwa ase Tata, abare igoro na abare ase ense, nigo bakorokwa ase erieta riaye.

English: Allocate your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High and it will profit you more than gold.
Kiswahili: Gawa hazina yako kulingana na amri za Aliye Juu Zaidi na itakufaidi zaidi kuliko dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Kora emeremo ase obotenenku bwao koreng'ana n'ogochika kwa Nyasae erio naye n'onyore eng'eria ase obogima bwao kobua chitaabu.

English: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
Kiswahili: Utakula uzao wa tumbo lako, nyama ya wana wako na binti zako ambao Bwana Mungu wako amekupa, kwa sababu ya mateso yale adui zako watakayokuletea wakati wa kukuzingira.
Ekegusii: “Ekero ababisa baino barabamige na kobasiongororokana, nigo moraabe n'emechando emenene, goika morie emebere y'abana baino, bari'Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire.

English: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zake walipokwisha kuondoka kwenda kwenye Sikukuu, yeye pia alikwenda lakini kwa siri.
Ekegusii: Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotiira, nere boigo agatiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, tari maiso marore, korende ase bobisi.

English: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Zakayo akasimama na kumwambia Bwana, “Tazama, Bwana! Sasa hivi nusu ya mali yangu ninawapa maskini, nami kama nimemdhulumu mtu yeyote kitu chochote, nitamrudishia mara nne ya hicho kiwango.”
Ekegusii: Zakayo agatenena, agateebia Omonene, “Rora, Omonene, ekeng'ese ki'enibo yane ning'ee abataka; naende onye naureretie omonto egento nimoiranerie ara kane.”

English: If it spreads any further on the skin, the priest must pronounce him unclean; it is an infection.
Kiswahili: Kama unaenea kwenye ngozi, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa najisi; ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza.
Ekegusii: Onye oborwaire obwo bwesiareire ase risankwa, erio Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti, risankwa rianyorire oborwaire.

English: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
Kiswahili: Nitaweka mabegani mwake ufunguo wa nyumba ya Daudi. Kile afunguacho hakuna awezaye kufunga, na kile afungacho hakuna awezaye kufungua.
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke ekeigorero ki’enyomba ya Daudi ase amareko aye; ere nabe okoigora, na onde tari oranyare gosieka; nabe ogosieka na onde tari oranyare koigora.

English: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Kiswahili: Tunaamini na kujua kuwa wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Na intwe twegenire na komanya ng'a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasae.”

English: “Shouldn't I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn't my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Kiswahili: Je, nisiwaadhibu kwa ajili ya hili?” asema Bwana. “Je, nisijilipizie kisasi juu ya taifa kama hili?
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene okwanire iga: “Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase engencho y'ogokora okwo? Tinkweruseria egesiomba igoro ase egesaku kegokora amang'ana buna ayio?

English: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya dhahabu, mafuta ya upako, uvumba wenye harufu nzuri na pazia la ingilio la hema;
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi'etaabu, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, na egetambaa ki'egesoero ki'Eema,

English: All King Solomon’s drinking cups were gold, and all the utensils of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. There was no silver, because it was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
Kiswahili: Vikombe vyote vya Mfalme Solomoni vya kunywea vilikuwa vya dhahabu na vyombo vyote vya nyumbani katika Jumba la Kifalme la Msitu wa Lebanoni vilikuwa vya dhahabu safi. Hakukuwa na kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa fedha, kwa sababu fedha ilionekana ya thamani ndogo siku za Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omorwoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitaabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitaabu chichenire; binde tibiarenge bie chifeta. Ase amatuko a Sulemani efeta tiyabarire ng’a negento kie rigori.

English: Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful. On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures.
Kiswahili: Pia atawapa mvua kwa ajili ya mbegu mnazootesha ardhini, chakula kinachotoka ardhini kitakuwa kizuri sana, tena tele. Katika siku ile, ngʼombe wenu watalisha katika shamba pana la majani.
Ekegusii: Erio ekero morabe mogosimeka chimbusuro chiaino, Omonene nachitwerie embura, erinde chindagera chiaino chiame, nainwe monyore chindagera chinyinge chingiya. Ekero ekio chitugo chiaino nchinyore amarisio amagare.

English: But if you refuse to let them go, I will plague your whole country with frogs.
Kiswahili: Kama ukikataa kuwaruhusu kuondoka, basi nitaipiga nchi yako yote kwa kuwaletea vyura.
Ekegusii: Korende koraange kobaa ribaga bagende, rirorio inche ning’ake ense yao yonsi ase okorenta ebioto.

English: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.
Kiswahili: ngamia 435 na punda 6,720.
Ekegusii: ne chingamia amagana ane, na emerongo etato, na isano (435), ne chitigere chilifu isano nemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere (6,720).

English: lest you concede your vigor to others, and your years to one who is cruel;
Kiswahili: usije ukatoa nguvu zako nzuri kwa wengine na miaka yako kwa aliye mkatili,
Ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, nigo orae abanto abaao amasikani ao, na emiaka yao ebaise konachwa n’abanto batari n’amaabera.

English: Judith said to them, “Hear me now, my kindred, and take this head, and hang it upon the battlement of your wall.
Kiswahili: Yudithi akawaambia, “Nisikilizeni sasa, ndugu zangu, na mchukue kichwa hiki, mkitundike juu ya mnara wa ukuta wenu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuditi akabateebia, “Abamiinto, ntegerere bono,, bogoria omotwe oyo moyotonge igoro ase enyasi yomochie oino.

English: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Nitamtukuza Bwana kwa moyo wangu wote, katika baraza la wanyofu na katika kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Ning'ake ng'a mbuya mono ase Omonene n'enkoro yane yonsi, agwo ase omosangererekano bw' abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikusudia kuangusha ukuta uliomzunguka Binti Sayuni. Ameinyoosha kamba ya kupimia na hakuuzuia mkono wake usiangamize. Alifanya maboma na kuta ziomboleze, vyote vikaharibika pamoja.
Ekegusii: Omonene onachire ase ebirengererio biaye gosaria chindwaki chi'omochie o Sayoni, oramboire engori y'okorengera. Tagotanga okoboko kwaye tayosaria; otigire chiburi ne chindwaki chikweumia, chionsi amo nigo chiumatete.

English: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
Kiswahili: Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi akavitoa kwa mkono wa Mithredathi mtunza hazina, aliyevihesabu mbele ya Sheshbaza mkuu wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ebikorero ebio Koresi, omorwoti bw'Abaayemi, akabia Mitiredati, omoteneneri bwe chikungo. Mitiredati akabibara, akabirika inse erio akabia Sesibasari, omogambi bw'Abayuda.
