English: After several days, Felix returned with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa, Feliksi alikuja pamoja na Drusila mkewe, ambaye alikuwa Myahudi. Alituma aitiwe Paulo, naye akamsikiliza alipokuwa akinena juu ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atari make, Feliki agaika na Durusila mokaye, oyorenge Omoyahudi. Akarangeria Paulo, akamoigwa ogokwana amang’ana igoro y’okomwegena Kristo Yeso.

English: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?' that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh.'”
Kiswahili: Nao watakapokuuliza, ‘Kwa nini unalia kwa uchungu?' Utasema hivi, ‘Kwa sababu ya habari zinazokuja. Kila moyo utayeyuka na kila mkono utalegea, kila roho itazimia na kila goti litalegea kama maji.' Habari hizo zinakuja! Hakika zitatokea, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero barakoborie: Nase ki oichaanete iga? Obairanerie, obateebie: N'ase engencho y'amang'ana amabe agochia gocha. Ekero araache, kera omonto nairianyeke ase enkoro yaye, na amaboko y' abanto bonsi naborwe chinguru; kera omonto nakwe omoyo, na amaru y' abanto bonsi nororobe abe buna amaache. Naama! Amabe ayio ngocha are, goika aikeranigwe. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

English: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,
Kiswahili: au kama mnyama aliye juu ya nchi au ndege yeyote arukaye angani,
Ekegusii: gose omogwekano ogwekaine eng’iti ende yonsi ere ase ense, gose oyo bw’enyoni ebwate chimbaaba ekoiruruka igoro,

English: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
Kiswahili: Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
Ekegusii: Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri’Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang’e.

English: So they attacked them on the Sabbath, and they died—they, their wives, their children, and their livestock—in number a thousand souls of men.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waliwashambulia siku ya Sabato, nao wakafa—wao, wake zao, watoto wao, na mifugo yao—nafsi elfu za watu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri'Esabato, barabwo bagaita abanto 1,000, abasacha na abakungu amo na abana. Bagachisaamba chitugo boigo.

English: until your brother's anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”
Kiswahili: Wakati ndugu yako atakapokuwa hana hasira nawe tena na amesahau uliyomtendea, nitakupelekea ujumbe urudi. Kwa nini niwapoteze wote wawili kwa siku moja?”
Ekegusii: Ekero endamwamu yaye erakee, na ere ebire aya kwamokorerete, erio nintome abanto bache gokorangeria oirane korwa aroro. Nase ki ndakwerwe nainwe mwensi babere ase rituko erimo.”

English: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
Kiswahili: akimwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote habari hizi, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Rigereria, toteebia monto onde bwensi amang'ana aya; korende genda bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng'wanso egiachigetwe na Musa ase ogosibeka kwao, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”

English: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu 600 toka ukoo wa Wadani, waliojifunga silaha za vita, wakaondoka Sora na Eshtaoli.
Ekegusii: Abanto amagana atano na rimo b'egesaku gia Dani, babogoretie ebirwanero, bakaimoka korwa Sora na Esitaoli, bagatiira,

English: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akinena kwa lugha, basi waseme watu wawili au watatu si zaidi, mmoja baada ya mwingine na lazima awepo mtu wa kutafsiri.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, bakwane babere gose batato boka, korende kera omonto ase ribaga riaye, na oyomo aonchore.

English: And the dread of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
Kiswahili: Hofu ya Bwana ikawa juu ya falme zote za nchi zilizozunguka Yuda, hivyo hawakufanya vita na Yehoshafati.
Ekegusii: Omonene akoboyia amarwoti onsi ye chinse chiaetanaine Abayuda, na onde tacha korwania Yehosafati.

English: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
Kiswahili: Awe amezaliwa nyumbani mwako au amenunuliwa kwa fedha yako, ni lazima watahiriwe. Agano langu katika mwili wako litakuwa ni Agano la milele.
Ekegusii: Omobiare o inka na omogorwa chitaabu, bonsi goika barokigwe. Ase igo, ekemanyererio gi'okobwatana kwane inakebe ase emebere yaino goika kare na kare.

English: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, Amaziah executed the servants who had murdered his father the king.
Kiswahili: Baada ya ufalme kuimarika mikononi mwake, aliwaua maafisa waliomuua mfalme baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo anyorete chinguru chi’oborwoti bwaye, agaita abasomba baye baria baitete omorwoti ise.

English: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
Kiswahili: Lameki alioa wanawake wawili, mmoja aliitwa Ada, na mwingine Sila.
Ekegusii: Lameki akanyuoma abakungu babere. Omokungu oyomo nigo are korokwa Ada, n'oyonde Zila.

English: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ametuokoa kutoka ufalme wa giza na kutuingiza katika ufalme wa Mwana wake mpendwa,
Ekegusii: Nere otosiborete korwa ase okobua kw’omosunte na agatong’anyia na gotosoyia ase oborwoti bw’Omwana oye omwanchwa.

English: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
Kiswahili: siku hiyo atakapokuja kutukuzwa katika watakatifu wake na kustaajabiwa miongoni mwa wote walioamini. Ninyi pia mtakuwa miongoni mwa hawa kwa sababu mliamini ushuhuda wetu kwenu.
Ekegusii: ekero arache ase rituko riria, erinde atogigwe ase egati y'abachenu baye, na gokumigwa ase egati ya bonsi abamwegenire, ekiagera mwegenire oborori bwaito obo twabarenteire.

English: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
Kiswahili: Kisulisuli kitawafagilia mbali na dhabihu zao zitawaletea aibu.
Ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nkebaabuse ne chinguru chiaye, na barabwo mbasookigwe ase engencho y'ebing'wanso biabo.

English: And David was the youngest. The three oldest had followed Saul,
Kiswahili: Daudi ndiye alikuwa mdogo wa wote. Hao wakubwa watatu wakamfuata Sauli,
Ekegusii: Daudi nere orenge omoke ase bonsi. Abwo batato abanene bakaba bakomobwatia Saulo.

English: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
Kiswahili: Bali ninyi geukeni, mwondoke kuelekea jangwani kwa kufuata njia ya Bahari ya Shamu.”
Ekegusii: Korende inwe onchoka, mogende gochia ase erooro, gochia ase enchera ekogeenda ase omosomo bwa Akaba.

English: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept. I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
Kiswahili: Niliposikia mambo haya, niliketi, nikalia. Kwa siku kadhaa niliomboleza na kufunga na kuomba mbele za Mungu wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, ngaikaransa inse, nkarera. Ase amatuko atai make nkaba nkobokia amagombo na kweng’ata amo nogosaba ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro,

English: as well as the pig; though it has a divided hoof, it does not chew the cud. It is unclean for you. You must not eat its meat or touch its carcass.
Kiswahili: Nguruwe pia ni najisi; ingawa ana kwato zilizogawanyika, hacheui. Msile nyama yake wala kugusa mzoga wake.
Ekegusii: Timoria embeche; nebwate ebitaago biatananegete, korende teri koria eng’ang’ura. Ase ayio n’ebe ase more ey’etachenegeti. Timoria chinyama chie ching’iti echio gose timokuna emebere yabo ekero chi akuure.

English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
Kiswahili: Yeyote alaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, atakaa ndani yangu nami nitakaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nigo akomenya ime yane, na inche ime yaye.

English: Listen, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart on the right course.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza, mwanangu na uwe na hekima, weka moyo wako kwenye njia iliyo sawa.
Ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa na obe n’obong’aini, naende orende enkoro y’ao ebwatie enchera endonge.

English: Yahweh's word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia Yehu mwana wa Hanani dhidi ya Baasha, kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, rigakwana mamincha ya Baasa, rigateeba,

English: While there was war between Saul's house and David's house, Abner made himself strong in Saul's house.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa vita kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi, Abneri alikuwa anajiimarisha katika nafasi yake kwenye nyumba ya Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ekero esegi eyio yagendererete gati y'eamate ya Saulo na eya Daudi, Abineri akagenderera kwenyorera chinguru chinyinge ase egati y'eamate ya Saulo.

English: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day's journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
Kiswahili: Wao wakidhani kuwa yuko miongoni mwa wasafiri, walienda mwendo wa kutwa nzima. Ndipo wakaanza kumtafuta miongoni mwa jamaa zao na marafiki.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagakaga ng'a nigo are ase omoganda obo, bakagenda orogendo rw'omobaso oyomo, bakamorigia ase abairi babo boigo nabasani.

English: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
Kiswahili: Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema. Hao ndio wana wa Ishmaeli.
Ekegusii: Yeturi na Nafisi, na Kedema. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Isumaeli.

English: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
Kiswahili: Tunajua kwamba Mungu alisema na Mose, lakini kwa habari ya mtu huyu hatujui atokako.”
Ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo arenge gokwana na Musa, korende oyo titomanyeti aase arure.”

English: So they went back and told Jehu, who replied, “This is the word of the LORD, which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite: ‘On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour the flesh of Jezebel.
Kiswahili: Wakarudi na kumwambia Yehu, ambaye alisema, “Hili ndilo neno la Bwana alilosema kupitia kinywa cha mtumishi wake Eliya Mtishbi, kwamba: Katika kiwanja cha Yezreeli, mbwa wataikula nyama ya Yezebeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero bairanete, bagateebia Yehu amang’ana ayio, nere akabairaneria, agateeba: “Eri ne ring’ana ri’Omonene riria akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Elija Omotisibi: Agwo ase oboremo bore Yesireeli chisese nachirie omobere o Yesebeli.

English: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza pia mataruma kwa mti wa mshita: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mmoja wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Akabaacha emeriibo etano y'emekonge, eriibe chibao chie rikere erimo ri'Obomenyo,

English: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
Kiswahili: Uaibishwe ee Sidoni, nawe ee ngome la bahari, kwa kuwa bahari imesema: “Sijapata kuwa na uchungu wa kuzaa wala sijapata kuzaa, wala sijapata kulea wana wala kutunza mabinti.”
Ekegusii: Aye Sidoni, rora obosooku; enyancha ere neburi enkong'u y'enyancha yatebiire iga: “Inche tinana kobina, gose koibora, tinana korera abana abamura, gose gokinia abaiseke abekungi.”

English: And again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
Kiswahili: tena, “Bwana anajua kwamba mawazo ya wenye hekima ni ubatili.”
Ekegusii: naende, “Omonene nigo amanyete okorengereria kw’abare nobong’aini ng’a nokwa bosa.”

English: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
Kiswahili: Wale wanaofurahia hukumu yangu ya haki wapige kelele za shangwe na furaha; hebu waseme siku zote, “Bwana atukuzwe, ambaye amefurahia mafanikio ya mtumishi wake.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo banchete ng'a ng'egwe oboronge bwane, tiga baake eriogi ri'omogooko na omochengo, bagenderere goteeba: “Omonene noyo bw'obonene! Ee, nigo agokirie namaya omosomba oye akonyora!”

English: those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Benyamini walikuwa watu 35,400.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naisano, n’amagana ane (35,400).

English: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the king’s command and edict were to be executed. On this day the enemies of the Jews had hoped to overpower them, but their plan was overturned and the Jews overpowered those who hated them.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kumi na tatu ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, yaani mwezi wa Adari, amri iliyoagizwa na mfalme ilikuwa itekelezwe. Siku hii adui wa Wayahudi walikuwa wametumaini kuwashinda, lakini sasa mambo yaliwageukia na Wayahudi wakawashinda wale waliokuwa wanawachukia.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro omotienyi bw’Adari, rigaika. Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato ekero ogochika kw’omorwoti kware gocha goikeranigwa, ababisa b’Abayahudi nigo basemeretie ng’a mbaababue, korende amang’ana konya aonchokire ng’a Abayahudi mbabue ababisa babo.

English: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu itatoshelezwa kama kwa wingi wa vyakula; kwa midomo iimbayo kinywa changu kitakusifu wewe.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one oisanekire buna oyorire obonoru bw'emeseto na ebitinya, nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one ore nebikoba bire nomogooko.

English: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri, yaani farasi wote wa Farao na magari ya vita, wapanda farasi na vikosi vya askari, wakawafuatia Waisraeli, wakawakuta karibu na Pi-Hahirothi, mkabala na Baal-Sefoni walipokuwa wamepiga kambi kando ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri bakababwatia korwa magega amo ne chibarasi chionsi, ne chigari chia Farao, na abariini chibarasi chiaye, na abarwani baye bonsi, bakabanyora batoorire enyancha mbarabare, ang'e na Pi‐Hahiroti kororia Baali‐Sefoni.

English: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
Kiswahili: Tikiko, aliye ndugu mpendwa na mtumishi mwaminifu katika Bwana, atawaambia kila kitu, ili pia mpate kujua hali yangu na kile ninachofanya sasa.
Ekegusii: Erinde monyaare komanya buna inche inde, naende ninki ngokora, Tukiko, oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa ase Omonene, nabateebie amang'ana onsi.

English: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,
Kiswahili: “Wakati watu wako Israeli watakapokuwa wameshindwa na adui kwa sababu ya dhambi walizofanya dhidi yako, watakapokugeukia na kulikiri jina lako, wakiomba na kufanya dua kwako katika Hekalu hili,
Ekegusii: “Onye abanto bao Abaisraeli babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,

English: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa watu hawa wa Israeli aliwachagua baba zetu, akawafanya kustawi walipokuwa huko Misri, kwa uwezo mwingi akawaongoza na kuwatoa katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw’abaanto aba Abaisraeli agachora chisokoro chiaito, na ekero barabwo bamenyete buna abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri, akabaimokereria igoro. Ase okobua kwaye akabarusia aroro,

English: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh's house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Roho akaniinua na kunileta mpaka kwenye lango la nyumba ya Bwana linalotazama upande wa mashariki. Pale kwenye ingilio la lango kulikuwepo wanaume ishirini na watano, nami nikaona miongoni mwao Yaazania mwana wa Azuri na Pelatia mwana wa Benaya, viongozi wa watu.
Ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang'ira ase egeita ki'enyomba y'Omonene kiarochie moocha. Na rora, agwo ase egesieri ki'egeita mbarengeo abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano, na ase egati yabo nkarora Yasania, mosinto bw'Asuri, na Peletia, mosinto o Benaya, abwo barenge abagaambi b' abanto.

English: What then will we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tuseme nini basi? Kwamba watu wa Mataifa ambao hawakutafuta haki, wamepata haki ile iliyo kwa njia ya imani.
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku, abatarenge korigia oboronge ’mbanyorete oboronge boria bw’okwegena;

English: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
Kiswahili: Simoni akamjibu, “Bwana, tumefanya kazi ya kuchosha usiku kucha na hatukuvua chochote. Lakini, kwa neno lako nitazishusha nyavu.”
Ekegusii: Simioni akamoiraneria, “Omonene, nabo twakorire emeremo obotuko obogima, titonyoreti gento, korende ase ring'ana riao natoikie ebionga.”

English: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don't defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.'
Kiswahili: Nami nikawaambia, “Kila mmoja wenu aondolee mbali sanamu za chukizo ambazo mmekazia macho, nanyi msijitie unajisi kwa sanamu za Misri. Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Nkabateebia iga: Kera oyomo oino tiga atugute korwa ase are ebinto bi'okogechia ebio anchete korigereria, timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y'emegwekano eyio Abamisiri bagosasiima. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyepewa talanta tano akaenda mara moja akafanya nazo biashara akapata talanta nyingine tano zaidi.
Ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano akagenda erio kegima, agachionchoreria, akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.

English: Likewise, the one with the two talents gained two more.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyepewa talanta mbili akafanya vivyo hivyo, akapata nyingine mbili zaidi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo noria oetwe chitalanta ibere akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.

English: The Gentiles who were in Gilead gathered themselves together against the Israelites who were on their borders, to destroy them. They fled to the stronghold of Dathema,
Kiswahili: Mataifa waliokuwa Gileadi walikusanyika pamoja dhidi ya Waisraeli waliokuwa mipakani mwao, ili kuwaangamiza, nao wakakimbilia ngomeni mwa Dathema.
Ekegusii: Abanto be ebisaku bagasangererekana agwo Gileadi erio babagwere na kobasiria Abaisraeli abwo bamenyete sobo. Korende Abaisraeli bagatama goika ebiita bia Dathema,

English: So these kings came out with all their armies, a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore, along with a great number of horses and chariots.
Kiswahili: Wakaja na vikosi vyao vyote na hesabu kubwa ya farasi na magari ya kuvutwa na farasi, jeshi kubwa, kama wingi wa mchanga ulio pwani ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha nabarwani babo bonsi, omoganda bw’abaanto abange buna omokenye bw’engegu y’enyancha. Nigo barenge ne chibarasi ne chigari chinyinge mono.

English: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ ”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mwana-Kondoo aliyeko katikati ya kile kiti cha enzi atakuwa Mchungaji wao; naye atawaongoza kwenda kwenye chemchemi za maji yaliyo hai. Naye Mungu atafuta kila chozi kutoka macho yao.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Emanwa y’Eng’ondi oyore gati‐gati y’ekerogo ki’obonene nabarisie, ere nabaraae gochia ase chinsoko chi’amaache are moyo, na Nyasae natinyie amariga onsi korwa ase amaiso abo.

English: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.
Kiswahili: Usiongeze wala usipunguze chochote ninachowaamuru ninyi, ila myashike maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu ambayo nawapa.
Ekegusii: Timomenta ring’ana rinde rionsi ase aria nabachiikire, gose timorusia gento aroro. Mobwate amachiiko y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ayio inche nabaeire.

English: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
Kiswahili: Kujipamba kwenu kusiwe kwa nje tu, kama vile kusuka nywele, kuvalia vitu vilivyofanyizwa kwa dhahabu na kwa mavazi.
Ekegusii: Ogwechabera kwaino tikoba ogwa isiko ase okomina chitukia, na kobeeka ebigera bie chitaabu, gose chianga chinterere,

English: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every remaining ally. Indeed, the LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana siku imewadia kuwaangamiza Wafilisti wote na kuwakatilia mbali walionusurika wote ambao wangeweza kusaidia Tiro na Sidoni. Bwana anakaribia kuwaangamiza Wafilisti, mabaki toka pwani za Kaftori.
Ekegusii: Rituko ngocha rire ekero Abafirisiti bonsi barasirigwe, na abatigarete gokonya Turo na Sidoni basirigwe boigo. Omonene nasirie Abafirisiti, abare abatigari ase egesinka gia Kafitori.

English: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nne wa utawala wa Mfalme Hezekia, Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru akaishambulia miji yote ya Yuda yenye ngome na kuiteka.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kane bw'okogaamba kwa Hezekia omorwoti, Senakeribu, omorwoti bw'Abaasuri, akagenda korwania emechie yonsi y'Abayuda, yagiteire chindwaki, akayeira.

English: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Wakawa wanamwangalia waone kama atamponya siku ya Sabato, ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki.
Ekegusii: Agwo mbarenge oo abanto gete abwo baganetie gotega Yeso barore gose nagwenie omonto oria ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.

English: For you will not find the depth of the heart of man, and you will not perceive the things that he thinks. How will you search out God, who has made all these things, and know his mind, and comprehend his purpose? No, my kindred, don't provoke the Lord our God to anger!
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hutapata undani wa moyo wa mwanadamu, wala hutaona mambo anayoyafikiria. Mtamtafutaje Mungu, aliyeumba vitu hivi vyote, na kujua nia yake, na kuelewa kusudi lake? Hapana, ndugu zangu, msimkasirishe Bwana Mungu wetu!
Ekegusii: Inwe timokonyaara korenga chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto gose ebirengererio biabo; inaki rende moranyaare komanya chiseemi chia Nyasae ere oyotongete ebinto bionsi gose komanya ebirengererio na aria arigetie ere omonyene? Teri bo inwe abaminto! Tomobaisa komobeia Omonene oito!

English: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.
Kiswahili: “Siku ya pili yake utamtoa beberu asiye na dosari kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, nayo madhabahu itatakaswa kama ilivyotakaswa kwa yule fahali.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere orue egoree ensae, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe; na egesasiimero gechenwe buna giachenetwe nekeng'wanso ki'eeri eria.

English: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
Kiswahili: ingawa kwa kweli si Yesu mwenyewe aliyekuwa akibatiza, ila ni wanafunzi wake.
Ekegusii: (nonya Yeso omonyene tare kobatisa, otatiga aborokigwa baye),

English: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
Kiswahili: Lakini walimdanganya kwa vinywa vyao, wakisema uongo kwa ndimi zao,
Ekegusii: Korende nigo bakwanete amang'ana amansu ase okomong'aina, bagakwana oborimo nemenwa yabo.

English: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo lazima aache uovu, akatende mema; lazima aitafute amani na kuifuatilia sana.
Ekegusii: Tiga atige amabe, akore amaya, arigie omorembe na koyotunyana mono.

English: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
Kiswahili: ndipo utakapojipatia furaha yako katika Bwana, nami nitakufanya upande juu ya miinuko ya nchi na kusherehekea urithi wa Yakobo baba yako.” Kinywa cha Bwana kimenena haya.
Ekegusii: rirorio nonyore omogooko ase ’nde inche Omonene, nainche ningoetie ase ebitunwa bi’ense igoro, nkoe omwando o Yakobo, sokoro yao, oyorie.” Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio korwa ase omonwa oye.

English: “Open the east window,” said Elisha. So he opened it and Elisha said, “Shoot!” So he shot. And Elisha declared: “This is the LORD’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram, for you shall strike the Arameans in Aphek until you have put an end to them.”
Kiswahili: Elisha akasema, “Fungua dirisha la mashariki,” naye akalifungua. Elisha akasema, “Piga mshale!” Naye akapiga mshale. Elisha akasema, “Mshale wa ushindi wa Bwana, mshale wa ushindi juu ya Aramu! Utawaangamiza Waaramu kabisa huko Afeki.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Igora ekebao kerochie moocha!” Yehoasi agakeigora. Erio Elisha akamoteebia, “Rasa!” Nere akarasa. Elisha agakwana, “Omogwe bw’obobui Omonene. Omogwe bw’obobui igoro y’Abasiiria. Aye norwanie Abasiiria agwo Afeki goika obasirie kegima.”

English: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
Kiswahili: Walipoinua macho yao, hawakumwona mtu mwingine yeyote isipokuwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koimokia amaiso abo, tibarora monto otatiga Yeso bweka.

English: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtaijua kweli nayo kweli itawaweka huru.”
Ekegusii: naende namomanye ekeene, na kerokio nakebasibore.”

English: My father counts the days; and if I wait long, he will be very grieved.
Kiswahili: Baba yangu huhesabu siku; na nikingoja kwa muda mrefu, atahuzunika sana.
Ekegusii: Bono aye noroche amang'ana Ragueli arire eira goikerania nainche namigirwe mono neira eye yaye!”

English: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.
Kiswahili: Nitawafukuza mataifa mbele yako na kupanua mipaka ya nchi yako, wala hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeitamani nchi yako wakati unapokwenda mara tatu kila mwaka kuonana na Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Ninserie abanto b'ebisaku korwa asore na kogareyia orogongo rwao, onde tari orakoroure ase chingaki echi isato kera omwaka, ekero orabe kogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae oo.

English: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
Kiswahili: Bwana hufanya lolote apendalo, mbinguni na duniani, katika bahari na vilindi vyake vyote.
Ekegusii: Kende gionsi Omonene agwancha gokora nigo akogekora; gokeraabe ase ense, gose igoro, gose ase enyancha, gose ase chindiba.

English: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than that of all the men of the East, greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Hekima ya Solomoni ilikuwa kubwa kuliko hekima ya watu wote wa Mashariki na kubwa kuliko hekima yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini bwa Sulemani nigo bwabuete obw’abaanto bonsi ba Moocha na obw’Abamisiri bonsi.

English: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akaupanda mlima Nebo kutoka tambarare za Moabu mpaka kilele cha Pisga, ngʼambo ya Yeriko. Huko Bwana akamwonyesha nchi yote: kutoka Gileadi mpaka Dani,
Ekegusii: Musa akarua emieya ya Moabu, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa kia Nebo igoro ase egechuuria gia Pisiga, kororia Yeriko. Omonene akamworokia ense eria yonsi, ense ya Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Dani,

English: In every gift show a cheerful countenance, And dedicate your tithe with gladness.
Kiswahili: Katika kila zawadi onyesha uso wa furaha, Na utoe zaka yako kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Esadaka yomonto omoigweri nigo egwancherwa; nero tekwebwa kare na kare.

English: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
Kiswahili: Siku saba kuanzia sasa nitaleta mvua juu ya nchi kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana, nami nitafutilia mbali kutoka uso wa nchi kila kiumbe hai nilichokiumba.”
Ekegusii: Magega y'amatuko atano na abere nindete embura ase ense etwe amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, na kende gionsi nakorete kere moyo ase ense ningesirie kegima.”

English: It cannot be bought with gold, nor can its price be weighed out in silver.
Kiswahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi kuliko zote, wala thamani yake haiwezi kupimwa kwa fedha.
Ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitaabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.

English: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
Kiswahili: Mioyo yetu humshangilia, kwa maana tunalitumainia jina lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.

English: But of those that chew the cud or have a completely divided hoof, you are not to eat the following: the camel, the rabbit, or the rock badger. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof. They are unclean for you,
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, miongoni mwa wale wanaocheua au wale walio na kwato zilizogawanyika kamwe msile ngamia, sungura na pelele. Iwapo wanacheua, lakini hawana kwato zilizogawanyika; ni najisi kwenu kwa taratibu za kiibada.
Ekegusii: Ase ching’iti echio chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete, timoria echio: engamia, na egesusu, na egesengi. Echio nigo chikoria eng’ang’ura, korende tichibwati ebitaago biatananegete, ase ayio tichichenegeti.

English: It's me who planted that Erythrina abyssinica in the garden
Kiswahili: Ni mimi niliyepanda Erythrina abyssinica hiyo bustanini
Ekegusii: Ninche nasimegete omotembe oyu mogondo

English: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
Kiswahili: Nimetengwa pamoja na wafu, kama waliochinjwa walalao kaburini, ambao huwakumbuki tena, ambao wamekatiliwa mbali na uangalizi wako.
Ekegusii: Natigirwe inde buna oyomo bw’abakuure buna abwo baitetwe, bono bare ase chimbeera ime. Nabeire buna abwo aye otainyoreti nonya ng’ake, kwabaatananire korwa ase okoboko kwao.

English: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let's do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
Kiswahili: Nasi kwa nini tusiseme, kama wengine wanavyotusingizia kuwa tunasema, “Tutende maovu ili mema yapate kuja?” Wao wanastahili hukumu yao.
Ekegusii: Inaki rende totagokora obobe, erinde obuya boche? Buna abande bagoteeba ase ogotoitania. Okogambigwa kwabo nigo kore boronge.

English: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
Kiswahili: Jicho lako la kuume likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe ulitupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kupoteza kiungo kimoja cha mwili wako kuliko mwili wako mzima ukatupwa jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Onye eriiso riao ria borio rikogera okore ebibe, rirusie, oritugute are, ekiagera mbuya ase ore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
Kiswahili: Miguu yao ilikuwa imenyooka, nyayo za miguu yao zilikuwa kama kwato za miguu ya ndama, nazo zilimetameta kama shaba iliyosuguliwa.
Ekegusii: Amagoro abo nigo arongeete, na ebisanyi bi'amagoro abo nigo biagwekaine ebi'emori. Ebitongwa ebio nigo biarenge komeka‐meka buna etai ekomeka‐meka.

English: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli akaishi katika nchi ya Waamori.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase ense y’Abaamori.

English: Then Mephibosheth, Saul’s grandson, went down to meet the king. He had not cared for his feet or trimmed his mustache or washed his clothes from the day the king had left until the day he returned safely.
Kiswahili: Pia Mefiboshethi mwana wa Sauli akashuka kwenda kumlaki mfalme. Hakuwa amenawa miguu wala kunyoa ndevu zake wala kufua nguo zake tangu siku mfalme alipoondoka Yerusalemu mpaka siku aliporudi ile salama.
Ekegusii: Erio Mefiboseti, omoochokoro o Saulo, agatirimboka gochia korotota omorwoti. Korwa ekero keria omorwoti aruete Yerusalemu, Mefiboseti konya tana gwesibia amagoro aye, gose konacha chinderu, gose gosibia chianga chiaye, goika rituko riria omorwoti airanete nomorembe.

English: When their fathers or brothers come to us to complain, we will tell them, ‘Do us a favor by helping them, since we did not get wives for each of them in the war. Since you did not actually give them your daughters, you have no guilt.’”
Kiswahili: Baba zao au ndugu zao waume watakapotulalamikia, tutawaambia, ‘Kuweni wakarimu kwetu, nanyi mturuhusu tuwe nao kwa kuwa hatukuweza kumpa kila mtu mke tulipopigana. Lakini ninyi pia hamna hatia, kwa kuwa hamkuwapa wao binti zenu kuwa wake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Na ekero abaise, gose abamura bamwabo, baraache kobasoera ase tore, intwe nigo torabateebie: Komoranche mobaabatigere, ekiagera titwabanyorerete kera omonto omokungu ekero gi’eseegi, na ekiagera inwe abanyene timwabaabaete babe abakungu babo, timori nokomocha kw’ogosaria eira eria twatiananetie.”

English: In the one hundred seventy-fourth year, Antiochus went into the land of his fathers; and all the forces came together to him, so that there were few men with Tryphon.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa mia moja sabini na nne, Antiochus aliingia katika nchi ya baba zake; na majeshi yote yakakusanyika kwake, hivi kwamba kulikuwa na watu wachache pamoja na Trypho.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o 174, Antioko akayesagaana ense yechisokoro chiaye. Abasikari ang'e bonsi bagasangererekana na kobwatana nere; abake kegima bakabwatana na Turifo.

English: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.'
Kiswahili: “Nao mti wa miiba ukaijibu, ‘Kama kweli mnataka niwe mfalme wenu, basi njooni mpate kupumzika chini ya kivuli changu. Lakini kama sivyo, moto na utoke kwenye mti wa miiba ukateketeze mierezi ya Lebanoni!'
Ekegusii: Na egetutu ki'amagwa gekairaneria emete yonsi: Onye ekeene mwanchire gonchoora imbe omogambi oino, inchwo mokenderere inse y'ekiriri kiane, korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase chinsagia chiane chi'amagwa, osambe emecharake ya Lebanoni.

English: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
Kiswahili: Hakuna urithi katika Israeli utakaohamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila Mwisraeli atatunza ardhi ya kabila lake aliyoirithi kutoka kwa baba zake.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Naboigo kera Omoisraeli narende omwando oye omotungetie.

English: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mahali hapo Yesu aliposulubiwa palikuwa karibu na mjini, Wayahudi wengi walisoma maandishi haya yaliyokuwa yameandikwa kwa lugha za Kiebrania, Kiyunani na Kilatini.
Ekegusii: Nabo amariiko ayio abange b’Abayahudi mbayasomete, ekiagera aase aria Yeso abamberetwe nigo arenge ang’e nomochie; naro nigo arigetwe ase Ekeiberania, na Ekerumi, na Ekegiriki.

English: The king said, “What do you desire, Esther? What is your request? Ask even to the half of my kingdom, and it shall be yours.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akasema, "Unataka nini, Esta? Ombi lako ni nini? Omba hata nusu ya ufalme wangu, nayo itakuwa yako."
Ekegusii: Ekero konya aetire korwa kera egesieri gochia ekende, akenyora oteneine bosio bw'Omorwoti. Omorwoti oyio nigo aikakansete bweboyetie n'echiaanga chiaye chi'obonene, okomekameka buna amagena ya amaabera amo n'amagana aande y'engencho - akarorekana ore oyobwogokumia keegima.

English: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
Kiswahili: Juu ya hivyo vitu watatandaza kitambaa chekundu na kufunika kwa ngozi za pomboo na kuweka mipiko yake mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Baare egetambaa ekebariri igoro ase ebinto ebio, bagetube ne risankwa ri'eng'iti ya rooche, na basoyie emiaro y'okobogoreria emesa eria.

English: King Solomon gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, who had supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akampa Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro miji ishirini katika Galilaya, kwa sababu Hiramu alikuwa amempatia mierezi yote, misunobari na dhahabu yote aliyohitaji.
Ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, konya oeire Sulemani chibao chi’emecharake, na echi’emetarakwa, amo ne chitaabu ase ekerengo aganetie. Magega y’ayio omorwoti Sulemani akaa Hiramu emechie emerongo ebere yarenge ase ense ya Galili.

English: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don't take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Israeli alikuwa amewaambia maafisa wake, “Je, hamjui Ramoth-Gileadi ni mali yetu na bado hatufanyi chochote kuirudisha kwetu kutoka kwa mfalme wa Aramu?”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli agateebia abasomba baye: “Inwe momanyete ng'a Ramoti o Gileadi noyoito. Inee! Naki rende twakirire‐kiri, totarayoirania korwa ase amaboko 'omorwoti bw'Abasiiria?”

English: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be party to his death.
Kiswahili: Mrudi mwanao, kwa maana katika hiyo kuna tumaini, usiwe mshirika katika mauti yake.
Ekegusii: Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.

English: And the guards stood with weapons in hand surrounding the king by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
Kiswahili: Wale walinzi, kila mmoja akiwa na silaha yake mkononi mwake, wakajipanga kumzunguka mfalme, karibu na madhabahu na Hekalu, kuanzia upande wa kusini hadi upande wa kaskazini mwa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Na abarendi baria bagatenena korwa ensemo ya Irianyi y’enyomba goika ensemo ya sugusu, bagaetanana omorwoti ang’e negesasiimero na enyomba yonsi; kera oyomo obo obwate ebirwanero koboko kwaye.

English: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni kwamba: Yeyote apandaye kwa uchache pia atavuna kwa uchache, naye apandaye kwa ukarimu pia atavuna kwa ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Korende inyora aya, oyogosimeka ebike nigo akogesa ebike; oyogosimeka ebinge nigo akogesa ebinge.

English: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu akimpiga mwenzake kwa chuma naye mtu huyo akafa, mtu huyo ni muuaji; muuaji sharti atauawa.
Ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oakire omonto onde negento buna ekioma, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
Kiswahili: Mara nitakapomtuma Artema au Tikiko kwako, jitahidi kuja unione huko Nikopoli, kwa sababu nimeamua kukaa huko wakati wa majira ya baridi.
Ekegusii: Kondatome Artemas gose Tukiko gocha ase ore, teema buna oranyaare gocha ase ’nde aria Nikopoli bwango, inaki nindengereretie komenya aroro ekero gi’etoigo.

English: We raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned down Ziklag.”
Kiswahili: Tulivamia Negebu ya Wakerethi, na nchi ya Yuda, na Negebu ya Kalebu. Nasi tulichoma moto Siklagi.”
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo twasagana Negebu aase Abakereti bamenyete, na ensemo ere ey’Abayuda na ey’abaanto ba Kalebu. Boigo togasamba Sikilagi nomorero.”

English: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan: “As surely as the LORD lives, the man who did this deserves to die!
Kiswahili: Daudi akawakwa na hasira dhidi ya mtu huyo tajiri na kumwambia Nathani, “Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, mtu huyo aliyefanya hivyo anastahili kufa!
Ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaberorokwa n’endamwamu enene ase engencho y’omonda oria, agateebia Nathani, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, omonto oyio okorete amang’ana ayio goika akwe.

English: “Spend the night here,” Balaam replied, “and I will give you the answer that the LORD speaks to me.” So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
Kiswahili: Balaamu akawaambia, “Mlale hapa usiku huu, nami nitawaletea jibu lile Bwana atakalonipa.” Kwa hiyo wakuu wa Moabu wakakaa naye.
Ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia abanto baria, “Rara aa ase obotuko obo, nainche nimbarentere amairanerio korwa ase Omonene ankio mambia.” Ase ayio abanene baria ba Moabu bakabeera aroro amo na Baalamu.

English: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Yeroboamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, wafalme wa Israeli. Naye Zekaria mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Yeroboamu akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiarenge abarwoti b'Abaisraeli chiararete. Na Zakaria, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
Kiswahili: Umenionyesha njia za uzima, utanijaza na furaha mbele zako.’
Ekegusii: Kwanyorokereirie chinchera chi’obogima; nong’ichorie omogooko ase obosio bwao.

English: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
Kiswahili: “Uovu wao wote na uje mbele zako; uwashughulikie wao kama vile ulivyonishughulikia mimi kwa sababu ya dhambi zangu zote. Kulia kwangu kwa uchungu ni kwingi na moyo wangu umedhoofika.”
Ekegusii: “Tiga obobe bwabo bwonsi bororekane ase obosio bwao, obae egesusuro; buna kwang'ete inche ase engencho y'ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nigo ng'umatete mono, na enkoro yane yanyarekire.”

English: and hasn't brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before Yahweh's tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.
Kiswahili: badala ya kuileta kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili kuileta kama sadaka kwa Bwana mbele ya Maskani ya Bwana, mtu huyo atahesabiwa kuwa na hatia ya kumwaga damu; ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: atayerenteti agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano ebe ekeng'wanso ase 'nde, bosio bw'Obomenyo bwane, rirorio okomocha kw'ogoitera amanyinga nakobarerwe omonto oyio. Ere oiteire amanyinga, ase igo naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

English: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
Kiswahili: Lakini tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji, ‘Mungu aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Korende korwa omochakano bw'ogotongwa gw'ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.

English: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wingu likafunika Hema la Kukutania, na utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio riire rigatuba Eema y’omosangererekano, na obonene bw’Omonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.

English: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God's Kingdom?
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza tena, “Nitaufananisha Ufalme wa Mungu na nini?
Ekegusii: Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng'ania oborwoti bwa Nyasae?

English: And when the letter arrived, they took the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Hiyo barua ilipowafikia, watu hawa wakawachukua wale wana sabini wa mfalme na kuwachinja wote. Wakaweka vichwa vyao ndani ya makapu na kumpelekea Yehu huko Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero riruube riria riabaikerete, bakaimokia abana b’omorwoti emerongo etano na ebere, bakabaita nemioro. Erio bakabeeka emetwe yabo ebitonga ime, bakayetoma gochia ase Yehu agwo Yesireeli.

English: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town. Sheep among Wolves (2 Timothy 1:3–12)
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa miji ya Sodoma na Gomora kustahimili katika hukumu kuliko mji huo. Mateso Yanayokuja (Marko 13:9-13; Luka 21:12-17)
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Nebe aororo ase Sodomu na Gomora ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase omochie oria. Ogochandwa kogochia gocha

English: They preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
Kiswahili: Wakahubiri habari njema katika mji huo na kupata wanafunzi wengi. Kisha wakarudi Listra, Ikonio na Antiokia,
Ekegusii: Magega kobarandirie amang’ana amaya ase omochie oria, na kobakorire abange koba aborokigwa, bakairana goika Listra, na Ikonio, na Antiokia,

English: The Israelites, however, acted unfaithfully regarding the things devoted to destruction. Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart. So the anger of the LORD burned against the Israelites.
Kiswahili: Lakini Waisraeli hawakuwa waaminifu kuhusu vile vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu; Akani mwana wa Karmi, mwana wa Zabdi, mwana wa Zera, wa kabila la Yuda, alivichukua baadhi ya hivyo vitu. Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli tibabete abegenwa; bakaira ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa. Akani, mosinto o Karimi, o Sabidi, o Zera bw’egesaku kia Yuda, akaira ebinto binde biaragereretigwe: n’Omonene akaba nekeririanda ekenene ase Abaisraeli.

English: He does not take His eyes off the righteous, but He enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
Kiswahili: Yeye haondoi macho yake kwa wenye haki; huwaketisha penye viti vya enzi pamoja na wafalme na kuwatukuza milele.
Ekegusii: Tari gotiga korigereria abanyene oboronge, korende nigo akobabeeka amo nabarwoti ase ebirogo bi’obonene. Ee, nigo akobakinia bagenderera kobeera aroro,

English: Hurry, escape there, for I can't do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
Kiswahili: Lakini ukimbilie huko haraka, kwa sababu sitaweza kufanya lolote mpaka ufike huko.” (Ndiyo maana mji huo ukaitwa Soari.)
Ekegusii: Ayerera, bwetoorie, ekiagera tingokora ing'ana rinde rionsi goika gwasoire omochie oria ime.” Ase ayio, omochie oyio okarokwa Soari.

English: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we sailed directly to Cos, and the next day on to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
Kiswahili: Tulipokwisha kujitenga nao, tukaanza safari kwa njia ya bahari moja kwa moja mpaka Kosi. Siku ya pili yake tukafika Rodo na kutoka huko tukaenda Patara.
Ekegusii: Ekero twatananekire nabarabwo na komanora n’emeeri, tokagenda boronge goika Kosi, na ase rituko ria kabere togaika Rodo, na korwa aroro togaika Patara.

English: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Wakati huu, nitawatupa nje kwa nguvu wote waishio katika nchi hii; nitawataabisha ili waweze kutekwa.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Ase engaki eye ninserie ne chinguru abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense eye, nimbarentere ogoichana goika baigwe obororo.

English: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.'
Kiswahili: Mpatie mateso na huzuni nyingi sawa na utukufu na anasa alizojipatia. Kwa kuwa moyoni mwake hujivuna, akisema, ‘Mimi ninatawala kama malkia; mimi si mjane, wala sitaona huzuni kamwe.'
Ekegusii: Na buna ere etogirie na kwegokia atari gwetanga ase okorigia kwaye, moe obororo na ogoichana koreng'ana boigo. Nigo agoteeba ase enkoro yaye ime: Inche ning'ikaransete eting'ana, tindi omoboraka, gose tinkoba nomoichano nonya ng'ake!

English: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu wa hali ya chini mwenye mtumishi, kuliko kujifanya mtu wa hali ya juu nawe huna chakula.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoitongo ogwekorera emeremo yaye omonyene nigo are omuya kobua omonto ogwekora koba omonene, korende tabwati endagera.

English: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom might revert to the house of David.
Kiswahili: Yeroboamu akawaza moyoni mwake, “Sasa inawezekana ufalme ukarudi katika nyumba ya Daudi.
Ekegusii: Yeroboamu akarengereria ase enkoro yaye ime: “Bono oborwoti igo borabaise koirana bogende ase enyomba ya Daudi.

English: When Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
Kiswahili: Yuda, ambaye alikuwa amemsaliti Yesu, alipoona kuwa Yesu amehukumiwa, akajuta na akarudisha vile vipande thelathini vya fedha alivyopewa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi, oria omoruete achia korora ng’a onacheirwe ekiina, ageitia, akairania chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka,

English: the red kite, the falcon, any kind of kite,
Kiswahili: kengewa mwekundu, kengewa mweusi, mwewe wa aina yoyote,
Ekegusii: amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;

English: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
Kiswahili: Atendaye mabaya na aendelee kutenda mabaya, aliye mchafu na aendelee kuwa mchafu, yeye atendaye haki na aendelee kutenda haki, na yeye aliye mtakatifu na aendelee kuwa mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Oyogokora ayatari boronge, tiga agenderere gokora ayatari boronge, na oyotachenegeti, tiga agenderere koba oyotachenegeti, na oyore omoroonge, tiga agenderere gokora oboronge, na oyore omochenu agenderere gochenwa.”

English: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
Kiswahili: Watoto wakakua, naye Esau akakuwa mwindaji hodari, mtu wa mbugani, wakati Yakobo alikuwa mtu mtulivu, mwenye kukaa nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Ekero abana abwo bakinire, Esau akaba omotwari bwe ching’iti, korende Yakobo nigo areenge omonto omotoereru, ore kobeera ase chiema.

English: It smashed into pieces on the ground. The wisdom was free for everyone to share. And that is how people learned to farm, to weave cloth, to make iron tools, and all the other things that people know how to do.
Kiswahili: Chungu kilivunjika vipandevipande pale chini. Hekima zikawa za bure kwa mtu yeyote kujichukulia. Na hivyo ndivyo watu walivyojifunza kulima, kushona nguo, kuunda zana za chuma, na mambo yote mengine ambayo watu wanajua kuyafanya.
Ekegusii: Enyongo erai egaateka ebisanda ekaba ebiminyore ebinge nse yomote oria. Nabo igo bono abanto besometie okorema, ogosona chiyanga n'ebinto bionsi abanto bamanyete rero.

English: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia,

English: For their outcry echoes to the border of Moab. Their wailing reaches Eglaim; it is heard in Beer-elim.
Kiswahili: Mwangwi wa kilio chao umefika hadi mpakani mwa Moabu, kilio chao cha huzuni kimefika hadi Eglaimu, maombolezo yao hadi Beer-Elimu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’okorera kwabo riaichoire ase ense ya Moabu; ekerero ekio giaikire Egilaimu na Beeri‐Elimu.

English: “Not so, my lord,” they replied. “Your servants have come to buy food.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Sivyo bwana wangu. Watumishi wako wamekuja kununua chakula.
Ekegusii: Bakamokania: “Tari bo, Omonene, intwe abasomba bao nigo twachire kogora endagera.

English: Then Raguel blessed God, saying, “Blessed are you, O God, with all pure and holy blessing! Let your saints bless you, and all your creatures! Let all your angels and your elect bless you forever!
Kiswahili: Kisha Ragueli akamshukuru Mungu, akisema, “Umebarikiwa, Ee Mungu, kwa baraka zote safi na takatifu! Watakatifu wako na wakubariki, na viumbe vyako vyote! Malaika wako wote na wateule wako na wakubariki milele!
Ekegusii: Erio Ragueli agatogia Nyasae ogoteeba, “Obakwe kare na kare aye Nyasae one bw'obuya.

English: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku za mwisho, asema Mungu, nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya wote wenye mwili. Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri, vijana wenu wataona maono, na wazee wenu wataota ndoto.
Ekegusii: “Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio, Omonene oteebire, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inababane. Abamura baino nabarore amaroro, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto.

English: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
Kiswahili: naye atakuwa mahali patakatifu; lakini kwa nyumba zote mbili za Israeli atakuwa jiwe lile linalosababisha watu kujikwaa na mwamba wa kuwaangusha. Kwa watu wa Yerusalemu, atakuwa mtego na tanzi.
Ekegusii: Ere nabe aase aino aachenu, korende ase ebisaku ebi bibere bi'Abaisraeli nabe rigena rikogocha, na egetare gekoiyeria inse, naende abe omoeto na oboreba ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu.

English: Elisha said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
Kiswahili: Elisha akasema, “Hakika, kama Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote aishivyo ambaye ninamtumikia, kama si kuheshimu Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, nisingekutazama wala hata kukutupia jicho.
Ekegusii: Elisha akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene bw'Emeganda are moyo, oria inche ngokorera, onye ntasigeti Yehosafati, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, anga tinarenge gwancha gokorora, gose gokorigereria.

English: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mlipomwona yule Nahashi mfalme wa Waamoni anakuja dhidi yenu, mliniambia, ‘Hapana, tunataka mfalme atutawale,’ hata ingawa Bwana Mungu wenu alikuwa mfalme wenu.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero mwaroche Nahasi, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, ogocha kobarwania moganteebia: Ntorigetie omorwoti oratogambere, nony’Omonene orenge omorwoti oino.

English: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says Yahweh, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn't send them or command them. They don't profit this people at all,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kweli, niko kinyume na hao wanaotabiri ndoto za uongo,” asema Bwana. “Wanazisimulia na kuwapotosha watu wangu kwa uongo wao bila kujali, lakini sikuwatuma wala sikuwaamuru. Hawawafaidi watu hawa hata kidogo,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo inde mamincha y'ababani abwo bakobana chindoto chi'oborimo, naende bachiteebia abanto baane na igo baabasiria. Ase ayio tibari gokonya abanto aba nonya ng'ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain. His disciples went with Him, accompanied by a large crowd.
Kiswahili: Baadaye kidogo, Yesu alikwenda katika mji mmoja ulioitwa Naini. Nao wanafunzi wake na umati mkubwa wa watu walikwenda pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya akagenda omochie okorokwa Naini; aborokigwa baye bakagenda amo nere, na abanto abange.

English: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikwenda katika nchi ya Uyahudi, nao wakakaa huko kwa muda na kubatiza.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.

English: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.
Kiswahili: Nyati wataanguka pamoja nao, ndama waume na mafahali wakubwa. Nchi yao italowana kwa damu, nayo mavumbi yataloa mafuta ya nyama.
Ekegusii: Ching'era nachirochio nchiiyerigwe inse, ne chieri chinene ne chinke boigo. Ense yabo nenyiigwe namanyinga, ne riroba riabo rinore nebitinya, ekiagera

English: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Hadadi alipofariki, Samla kutoka Masreka akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Hadadi akwete, Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. You have praised the gods of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don't see, hear, or know; and you have not glorified the God in whose hand is your breath and whose are all your ways.
Kiswahili: bali umejiinua juu ya Bwana wa mbinguni; nao wameleta vyombo vya nyumba yake mbele yako, na wewe, na mabwana zako, na wake zako, na masuria wako, mmekunywa divai kutoka humo. Umeisifu miungu ya fedha, na dhahabu, na shaba, na chuma, na miti, na mawe, ambayo haioni, haisikii, wala haijui; wala hukumtukuza Mungu ambaye pumzi yako i mkononi mwake, na njia zako zote ni zake.
Ekegusii: korende kweimokereirie igoro mamincha y'Omonene ore igoro. Ebikorero bi'enyomba yaye biarentirwe ase obosio bwao; aye amo nabaanto b'oborwoti bwao, na abakungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere, babinywereire edivai. Aye kwabeire kogotogia chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na emete na amagena, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose chitamanyeti gento, korende Nyasae oria obomoyo bwao bore ase okoboko kwaye, ne chinchera chiao chionsi chire ase okobua kwaye, tomotogeti.

English: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
Kiswahili: Kama haukufaa kitu chochote ulipokuwa mzima, je, si zaidi sana sasa ambapo hauwezekani kufanyishwa chochote cha kufaa baada ya moto kuuchoma na kuuunguza?
Ekegusii: Naama! Onye ekero omosabibu oyio orenge omogima togwenerete gokorerwa moremo onde bwensi, bono ekero oyire na korurwa nomorero, 'moremo ki orakorerwe?

English: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Yeye atakuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake. Nami nitakifanya imara kiti chake cha enzi cha utawala wake katika Israeli milele.’
Ekegusii: Ere naagache enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane. Ere nabe omwana one, nainche nimbe ise, na inche ninkore ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli kebe ne chinguru goika kare na kare.

English: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh's word concerning Israel.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa mashujaa wa Daudi: wao pamoja na Israeli wote wakauimarisha ufalme wake ili kuenea katika nchi yote, kama Bwana alivyoahidi.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto abanene chituoni ba Daudi, baria bamosiirete bokong'u ase oborwoti bwaye, amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bakamobeeka akaba omorwoti, koreng'ana ne ring'ana ri'Omonene igoro y'Abaisraeli.

English: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Yohana akarora Yeso ogocha asaare, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae, oyokorusia ebibe bi’ense!

English: So then desire for wisdom promotes to a kingdom.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo basi hamu ya hekima huongezeka hadi ufalme.
Ekegusii: Ase igo erango y'okonyora obongaini nigo ekoraa omonto gochia ase oborwoti.

English: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
Kiswahili: Aha! Laiti kwamba Mungu angesema, kwamba angefungua midomo yake dhidi yako,
Ekegusii: Korende onye ndiria Nyasae are gokwana na akoorokie buna ore,

English: When the king heard this, he was angry, and gathered together all his friends, the rulers of his army, and those who were over the cavalry.
Kiswahili: Mfalme aliposikia haya, alikasirika, akawakusanya marafiki zake wote, wakuu wa jeshi lake, na wale waliokuwa juu ya wapanda farasi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti aigwete ayio, ere akabea mono. Akabasangereria abateneneri ba abarwani be esegi bonsi, abanene ba abarwani baye be esegi na baria batenenerete abarwani be chibaarasi.

English: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake waliposhuka kutoka mlimani, alikutana na umati mkubwa wa watu.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere ekero baare gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, omoganda omonene okaumerana nere.

English: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Yosefu alikuwa amechukuliwa mpaka Misri. Mmisri aliyeitwa Potifa aliyekuwa mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, mkuu wa ulinzi, akamnunua Yosefu kutoka kwa Waishmaeli waliomleta Misri.
Ekegusii: Bono Yusufu agatirimbokigwa gochia Misiri; na Potifari, omoteneneri bw'enka ya Farao na omotang'ani bw'abarendi baye bande, omonto o Misiri, akamogora korwa ase Abaisumaeli, abwo bamotirimbogetie gochia aroro.

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo, Mimi mwenyewe, niko kinyume nanyi Yerusalemu, nitawapiga kwa adhabu yangu mbele ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, inche ninche inde mamincha yaino, nimbaachere, ’mbanachere ekiina agwo ase egati yaino, ase amasio y’ abanto b’ebisaku.

English: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye mwenyewe ndiye amani yetu, aliyetufanya sisi tuliokuwa wawili, yaani, Wayahudi na watu wa Mataifa, tuwe wamoja kwa kuvunja kizuizi na kubomoa ule ukuta wa uadui uliokuwa kati yetu,
Ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nomorembe oito, otokorete intwe, Abayahudi n’Abagiliki, koba oyomo, goetera ase omobere oye agatagora etoto eria yatwatananete, engencho yaye obobisa.

English: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo, nina neno dhidi yako: Unamvumilia yule mwanamke Yezebeli ambaye anajiita nabii, lakini anawafundisha na kuwapotosha watumishi wangu ili wafanye uasherati na kula vyakula vilivyotolewa kafara kwa sanamu.
Ekegusii: Korende ninde ne ring’ana eri igoro asore: Tibwangeti omokungu oria Yesebeli ere oyokweroka omobani o Nyasae. Ere nigo akworokereria na kong’aina abasomba baane bakore obotomani, na koria ebinto bikoruegwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa.

English: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed to have nothing bad to say about us.
Kiswahili: na usemi sahihi usio na lawama, ili wanaokupinga watahayari, wakose neno lolote baya la kusema juu yetu.
Ekegusii: Ogokwana kwao kobe ogoikeranu, okwo gotanyaare gosoerwa, erinde omoengereria onde bwensi asooke, taaba ne ring’ana riibe agokwana igoro yaito.

English: Then the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
Kiswahili: Basi wakuu, wasimamizi, watawala, washauri, watunza hazina, waamuzi, mahakimu na maafisa wengine wa jimbo walikusanyika ili kuizindua sanamu ile Mfalme Nebukadneza alikuwa ameisimamisha, nao wakasimama mbele ya hiyo sanamu.
Ekegusii: Erio abagaambi baria abanene, na abagaambi be chingongo, na abagabana, na abasemia, na abagachi be chikungo, na abagaambi ebiina, na abamanyi b'amachiiko, na abanene bande bonsi b'ense eria, bagaacha gwatanana na gosesenia omogwekano oria omorwoti Nebukadinesaro konya atenenirie. Ekero bateneine bosio bw'omogwekano oria,

English: All the sinners among My people will die by the sword— all those who say, ‘Disaster will never draw near or confront us.’” A Promise of Restoration (Acts 15:5–21)
Kiswahili: Watenda dhambi wote miongoni mwa watu wangu watauawa kwa upanga, wale wote wasemao, ‘Maafa hayatatupata wala kutukuta.’ Kurejezwa Kwa Israeli
Ekegusii: Abanyabibe bonsi b’ abanto bane, abwo bagoteeba ng’a amabe takobanyora gose kobakorera kende, ’mbakenywe nemioro. Abaisraeli mbairanerigwe amaya abo ase amatuko agochi‐gocha

English: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
Kiswahili: Yeye aligeuza mito kuwa jangwa, chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo kuwa ardhi yenye kiu,
Ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chindooche chikaba erooro, ne chinsooko chikaba ense enyomo.

English: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of Yahweh's blessed and their descendants with them.
Kiswahili: Hawatajitaabisha kwa kazi bure, wala hawatazaa watoto ili wapatwe na majanga, kwa kuwa watakuwa taifa lililobarikiwa na Bwana, wao na wazao wao pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibakoba bagokora emeremo ya bosa, gose tibakoibora abana barakwe mobosokano, ekiagera bare oroiboro rw'abasesenirie n'Omonene, na abana babo boigo.

English: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
Kiswahili: Wewe mke, unajuaje kama utamwokoa mumeo? Au wewe mume unajuaje kama utamwokoa mkeo?
Ekegusii: Aye omokungu, ng'ai oramanyere gose notoorie omosacha oo? Gose aye omosacha, ng'ai oramanyere gose notoorie omokungu oo?

English: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
Kiswahili: “Ondoka sasa na uvuke Bonde la Arnoni. Tazama, nimemweka mikononi mwako Sihoni Mwamori, mfalme wa Heshboni na nchi yake. Anza kuimiliki nchi hiyo na umwingize katika vita.
Ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agateeba: Imoka, mochaake orogeendo rwaino, mwamboke orooche rw'Arinoni. Naama! Nabeekire ase amaboko aino Sihoni Omoamori, omorwoti o Hesiboni, amo n'ense yaye. Ase igo, mochaake komorwania esegi, moire ense yaye.

English: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
Kiswahili: Sasa, bibi mpendwa, si kwamba ninakuandikia amri mpya, bali ile tuliyokuwa nayo tangu mwanzo. Tupendane kila mmoja na mwenzake.
Ekegusii: Na bono, omokungu, nakoboririe ng'a twanchane intwe ase intwe. Tari ng'a nogochika okoyia ngokoriikera, korende nkoria twarenge nakorokwo korwa ritang'ani.

English: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
Kiswahili: lakini hukauka majira ya ukame, na wakati wa hari hutoweka katika mikondo yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero ki'omobaso chiasunkera chiakea; na omorakera ogocha chiasira kegima korwa aase abo.

English: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
Kiswahili: Nimempa muda ili atubu kwa ajili ya uasherati wake, lakini hataki.
Ekegusii: Inche namoeire ribaga anyare koonchoka, korende tancheti koonchoka na gotiga obotomani bwaye.

English: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
Kiswahili: Atawahurumia wanyonge na wahitaji na kuwaokoa wahitaji kutoka mauti.
Ekegusii: Nigo are omwororo ase omoremerwa na ase omotaka, boigo nigo agotooria emioyo y'abaremeire.

English: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akambusu Raheli na akaanza kulia kwa sauti.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaagata Raeli, akarera na koiyeria amariga.

English: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akawatuma Petro na Yohana, akisema, “Nendeni mkatuandalie chakula cha Pasaka ili tuweze kuila.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma Petero na Yohana, akabora, “Genda motoroiserie Epasaka, erinde toyerie.”

English: Fear the Lord and honor the priest. Give him his portion, even as it is commanded you: the first fruits, the trespass offering, the gift of the shoulders, the sacrifice of sanctification, and the first fruits of holy things.
Kiswahili: Mche Bwana na umheshimu kuhani. Mpe sehemu yake, kama ilivyoamriwa: malimbuko, sadaka ya hatia, sadaka ya mabega, dhabihu ya utakaso, na malimbuko ya vitu vitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene, na kobasika abakuani baye, Kae Nyasae ensemo yaye eyio emotungetie: rigesa riao ritang'ani.

English: And there I have provided a place for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with the children of Israel.” Solomon’s Prayer of Dedication (1 Kings 8:22–53)
Kiswahili: Nimeliweka humo Sanduku la Agano, ambamo ndani yake kuna lile Agano la Bwana alilofanya na watu wa Israeli.” Maombi Ya Solomoni Ya Kuweka Wakfu (1 Wafalme 8:22-53)
Ekegusii: na aroro agwo nabekire Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, koria akorete n’Abaisraeli.” Ogosaba gwa Sulemani (1 Abar 8:22-53)

English: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu alimuumba mtu kutoka mavumbi ya ardhi, akampulizia pumzi ya uhai puani mwake, naye mtu akawa kiumbe hai.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akaimokia amaroba korwa inse akabomba na koroisia omonto korwa ase orotu rwe riroba, akamoutera omoika bw’obogima ase chimioro chiaye, erio omonto akaba n’obomooyo.

English: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says Yahweh, “that this house will become a desolation.”'”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hutayatii maagizo haya, asema Bwana, ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu kwamba jumba hili litakuwa gofu.' ”
Ekegusii: Korende onye timokoigwera amang'ana aya, inche omonyene netianirie ng'a enyomba eye nebe bosa. Nab'Omonene atebiire.”

English: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
Kiswahili: Mungu ni Roho na wote wanaomwabudu imewapasa kumwabudu katika roho na kweli.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae n'Omoika, na abwo bakomosasiima nebagwenerete komosasiima ase omoika na ekeene.”

English: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
Kiswahili: mkabidhini mtu huyu kwa Shetani, ili mwili wake uharibiwe, ili roho yake iokolewe katika siku ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: mogwenerete koa Saitani omonto oyio, omobere oye osarigwe, erinde omoika oye oche gotoorigwa ase rituko ri’Omonene Yeso.

English: When Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer and the chief official in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
Kiswahili: Ikawa kuhani Pashuri mwana wa Imeri, mkuu wa maafisa wa Hekalu la Bwana, alipomsikia Yeremia akitoa unabii juu ya mambo haya,
Ekegusii: Ekero Pasuri Omokuani, mosinto o Imeri, oyorenge omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba y’Omonene, aigwete Yeremia okobana amang’ana ayio,

English: When they were near their village they met their uncle. He was taking his cow to the water. Thaimi called out, Run, uncle, run! Men are coming to steal our cattle and burn our village. The man shouted at his cow and made her run towards the village. Further on Thaimi saw her aunt working in the field and she called out, Run, aunt, run! Men are coming to steal our cattle and burn our village! And the woman took her hoe, picked up her sleeping baby and ran towards the village. Further on Thaimi saw her grandfather. He was limping along the road beside a donkey loaded with grain. And she called out, Run, Grandfather, run! Men are coming to steal our cattle and burn our village! Her grandfather lifted his stick and chased the donkey until it ran towards the village.
Kiswahili: Walipokaribia kijijini walikutana na mjomba wao. Alikuwa akienda kunywesha ngombe maji mtoni. Thaimi alimwita kwa sauti, “Mjomba, kimbia, kimbia! Kuna wanaume wanaokuja kuiba ngombe na kutuchomea nyumba.” Mjomba alimrudisha ngombe kijijini. Na kwa mbali, Thaimi alimwona Shangazi shambani akilima akamwita, “Shangazi, kimbia, kimbia!” Wanume wanakuja kuiba ngombe wetu na kuchoma nyumba zetu!” Shangazi alichukua jembe lake, akamchukuwa mtoto aliyekuwa akilala na kisha akatoroka kurudi kijijini. Kisha Thaimi akamwona babu yake. Alikuwa akichechemea kandokando mwa barabara akimbebesha punda nafaka. Akamwita kwa sauti, “ Babu, kimbia, kimbia, wanaume wanakuja kuiba ngombe wetu na kuchoma nyumba zetu.” Babu alipiga punda akaenda mbio kuelekea kijijini.
Ekegusii: Kobagochia goika nka sobo, bakaumerana na isemoke. Nigo arenge koira eng'ombe yaye echi konywa amache. Thaimi akamorangeria. “Minyoka tata moke minyoka! Abanto bande mbare bagocha koiba chiombe chiato nagosamba chinyomba.” Isemoke agaonchora eng'ombe eria nakoyetema gochia nka. Egeka ake korua ase barenge, Thaimi akarora ng'ina moke kagokora egasi mogondo nakomorangeria: Minyoka mama minyoka! Abanto bande mbare bagocha koiba chiombe chiato nagosamba chinyomba.” Na ng'ina moke akabogoria obokombe bwaye amo n'omwana oraire akaminyoka gochia nka. Egeka ake korua ase barenge, Thaimi akarora isekoro kagosogora para kare n'ebunda yabogoretie endagera konyora bagesire. Akamorangeria: Minyoka sokoro minyoka! Abanto bande mbare bagocha koiba chiombe chiato nagosamba chinyomba. Isekoro akabogoria ebagwacho yaye nagosenda ebunda eria kominyoka gochia nka.

English: But take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself. This is what you are to eat during the 390 days you lie on your side.
Kiswahili: “Chukua ngano na shayiri, maharagwe na dengu, mtama na mawele, uviweke na kuvihifadhi vyote kwenye gudulia la kuhifadhia, na uvitumie kujitengenezea mkate. Utaula mkate huo kwa hizo siku 390 utakazokuwa umelala kwa upande mmoja.
Ekegusii: Oimokie engano, na esairi, ne ching’ende, ne chinchorogo, na amaemba, na engano ende, erio obeke ebinto ebio ase ekebekerero ekemo, obiochoganie, obiroisie emegati. Eyio nero or’abe gokoria ase engaki eyio y’amatuko amagana atato, na emerongo kianda, or’abe koraire.

English: A tabernacle was prepared. In its first room were the lampstand, the table, and the consecrated bread. This was called the Holy Place.
Kiswahili: Hema ilitengenezwa. Katika sehemu yake ya kwanza kulikuwa na kinara cha taa, meza na mikate iliyowekwa wakfu; hii sehemu iliitwa Mahali Patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki eema eria ye ritang’ani yaroisetigwe. Ime ase eema eria mbiarengeo ekebekerero gie chitaaya, na emesa amo nemegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae. Aase aria are korokwa Aase Aachenu.

English: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. “Don't fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mmebarikiwa hata kama ikiwalazimu kuteseka kwa ajili ya haki. “Msiogope vitisho vyao, wala msiwe na wasiwasi.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye mogochandwa ase engencho y'oboronge, more negesio. Timoiroka okoirokia kwabo, gose timoichana.

English: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, “Come!”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikaangalia wakati Mwana-Kondoo akivunja ile lakiri ya kwanza miongoni mwa zile saba. Ndipo nikasikia mmoja wa wale viumbe wanne wenye uhai akisema kwa sauti kama ya radi: “Njoo!”
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ogosansora ekemanyererio ekemo kia bitano na bibere, nkaigwa eyemo ye ching’iti chiria chire moyo egokwana neriogi buna eri’enkoba, egoteeba, “Inchuo!”

English: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Kiswahili: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Mungu ninatumaini; sitaogopa. Mwanadamu apatikanaye na kufa, atanitenda nini?
Ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye, ninsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki baranyare gonkorera?

English: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Hagari: Nebayothi mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Ishmaeli, Kedari, Adbeeli, Mibsamu,
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw'ororeria rwabo. Omwana omomura omotangi o Isumaeli nere Nebayoti; na abande nabwo aba: Kedari na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu;

English: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the scaly outbreak, and if it has not spread on the skin and does not appear to be deeper than the skin, the priest is to pronounce him clean. He must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.
Kiswahili: Siku ya saba kuhani atachunguza tena ule upele; ikiwa haujaenea kwenye ngozi na hakuna shimo mahali pale, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa safi. Lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa safi.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani amorenge naende, na onye richoncho riria tiriesiarereti ase risankwa, na tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire, ase igo asibie chianga chiaye, abe oyochenegete kegima.

English: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
Kiswahili: Maana mtu mmoja kwa Roho hupewa neno la hekima na mwingine neno la maarifa kwa Roho huyo huyo.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo ase Omoika aegwa ogokwana kw'obong'aini, na oyonde ring'ana ri'okomanya ase Omoika oria oyomo.
