English: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
Kiswahili: Bibi arusi ni wa bwana arusi. Lakini rafiki yake bwana arusi anayesimama karibu naye na kusikiliza kutoka kwake, hufurahi sana aisikiapo sauti ya bwana arusi. Kwa sababu hii furaha yangu imekamilika.
Ekegusii: Oyore nomoriakari nere omonywomi, korende omong'wansi oye nigo agotenena na komoigwa, ogookera eriogi ri'omonywomi; naboigo omogooko one oikeranire bono.”

English: and sent them with this letter: The apostles and the elders, your brothers, To the brothers among the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: Greetings.
Kiswahili: Wakatumwa na barua ifuatayo: Sisi mitume na wazee, ndugu zenu, Kwa ndugu Mataifa mlioamini mlioko Antiokia, Shamu na Kilikia: Salamu.
Ekegusii: bakabaa baire riruube ririikire iga: “Ase abaminto b’Ebisaku abamore ase Antiokia, na Siiria, na Kilikia. Intwe abamino, abatomwa na abagaaka, twabakwanirie.

English: Lose your money for a brother and a friend. Don't let it rust under a stone and be lost.
Kiswahili: Poteza pesa zako kwa ajili ya ndugu na rafiki. Usiruhusu zitupe chini ya jiwe na kupotea.
Ekegusii: Korera chifeta chiao emeremo na ase ogokoonya omwana omino gose omosani oo, gose tobaisa gotiga ebesa yao eboosere abwo ase oyebisete.

English: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikulazimisha kwenda maili moja, nenda naye maili mbili.
Ekegusii: Na onye omonto ogokobetereria kogenda nere emaeli eyemo, genda nere goika chimaeli ibere.

English: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kazi yote ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania ikakamilika. Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo y’Obomenyo bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n’Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you!
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa kuwa hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Upanga wa mfalme wa Babeli utakuja dhidi yako.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Omoro bw’omorwoti o Babiloni norentwe igoro yao.

English: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
Kiswahili: Lakini kumbukeni Bwana Mungu wenu, ndiye ambaye huwapa uwezo wa kupata utajiri, na hivyo kulithibitisha Agano lake, ambalo aliwaapia baba zenu, kama ilivyo leo.
Ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, nere okobaa chinguru chi’okonyoora obotenenku, ekiagera aganetie gokong’ia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania okwo akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino buna akorire goika reero iga.

English: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahweh and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akamwambia Samweli, “Nimetenda dhambi. Nimevunja amri ya Bwana na maagizo yako. Niliwaogopa watu na kwa hiyo nikafanya walivyotaka.
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia Samweli, “Nakorire ebibe, ekiagera nasaririe ogochika kw'Omonene na amang'ana ao gwantebeetie. Nigo nairogete Abanto, nkaba nkoigwera okogania kwabo.

English: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and moored the boat.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti, wakatia nanga.
Ekegusii: Ekero bambokire bagaika ense ya Genesareti, bakabeeka ekeroochi.

English: And I will dwell among the Israelites and will not abandon My people Israel.” The Temple’s Interior (2 Chronicles 3:5–9)
Kiswahili: Nami nitakaa miongoni mwa Waisraeli, nami sitawaacha watu wangu Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ndamenye aroro ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tingotiga abanto baane Abaisraeli.” Okoroisia Hekalu ime (2 Amg 3:8-14)

English: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa filimbi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, tegea sikio maneno yangu, uangalie kupiga kite kwangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe amang'ana aane; oiraneria egekoe kiane.

English: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn't have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
Kiswahili: Niliandika hivyo kama nilivyofanya, ili nikija nisihuzunishwe na wale watu ambao wangenifanya nifurahi. Nina uhakika na ninyi nyote, kwamba wote mngeshiriki furaha yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nabaiikerete ring'ana eri, erinde ngocha ting'ichanigwa na baria bagwenerete kongokia, naki ninsemeretie igoro yaino inwe mwensi, ng'a omogooko one noro oyoino mwensi.

English: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
Kiswahili: Basi mambo haya yalitokea kama mifano ili kutuzuia tusiweke mioyo yetu katika mambo maovu kama wao walivyofanya.
Ekegusii: Ebi igo biarenge ebiorokererio bi'ogotokuurera, erinde intwe titoba abanto bakogania amabe, buna baria baganetie.

English: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akatetemeka. Akapanda chumbani juu kupitia langoni akilia. Alipokuwa akienda, akasema, “Ee mwanangu Absalomu! Mwanangu, mwanangu Absalomu! Laiti ningekufa badala yako: Ee Absalomu, mwanangu, mwanangu!”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agachaandeka mono, akariina gochia akanyomba karenge ase egeita igoro, akarera nobororo, akaba ogotaara‐taara na goteeba, “Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Omwana one! Abisalomu, 'ntare gokwa ribaga ria'o! Abisalomu, omwana one!”

English: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
Kiswahili: Yeye atafanya haki yako ingʼae kama mapambazuko, na hukumu ya shauri lako kama jua la adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: Omonene naorokie oboronge bwao buna akoorokia oborabu, na ekeene kiao buna amasase a mobaso gati.

English: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Gershoni: Libni na Shimei.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta 'abana abamura ba Gerisomu: Libini na Simei.

English: Shafts of lightning will fly with true aim. They will leap to the mark from the clouds, as from a well-drawn bow.
Kiswahili: Mishale ya umeme itaruka kwa lengo la kweli. Itaruka hadi kwenye shabaha kutoka mawinguni, kama kutoka kwa upinde uliovutwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Enkoba neche rimo rioka igoro ase amare buna chinsara korwa ase obota.

English: Besides this, the five thousand shekels of silver which they received from the uses of the sanctuary from the revenue year by year is also released, because it belongs to the priests who minister there.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, shekeli elfu tano za fedha walizopokea kutokana na matumizi ya mahali patakatifu kutoka kwa mapato ya mwaka baada ya mwaka pia huachiliwa, kwa sababu ni mali ya makuhani wanaohudumu hapo.
Ekegusii: Komenta nayio, titori gochia gotura ebing'ese biria 5,000 bi'efeta korwa ase okonyoora gwe Hekalu. Efeta eyio nigo ebatungetie abakuani baria bagokorera Hekalu.

English: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Sabato tukaenda nje ya lango la mji kando ya mto, mahali ambapo tulitarajia tungepata mahali pa kufanyia maombi. Tukaketi, tukaanza kuongea na baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wamekusanyika huko.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria Esabato togasoka isiko y'egeita ase orooche mbarabare, ase ensemo twarengereretie ng'a tonyore aase togosabera. Togaikaransa, togakwana nabakungu abasangererekanete aria.

English: After two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing beside the Nile,
Kiswahili: Baada ya miaka miwili kamili kupita, Farao aliota ndoto: Tazama alikuwa amesimama kando ya Mto Naili,
Ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka ebere koyaetire Farao akaroota chindoto ng’a oteneine engegu y’orooche rwa Naeli.

English: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
Kiswahili: Huko ndipo nitakapokutana na Waisraeli, nalo Hema la Kukutania litatakaswa na utukufu wangu.
Ekegusii: Agwo ning'umerane n'Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning'akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.

English: When all Israel saw that the king had refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!” So all the Israelites went home,
Kiswahili: Israeli wote walipoona kuwa mfalme amekataa kuwasikiliza, wakamjibu mfalme: “Tuna fungu gani kwa Daudi? Sisi hatuna urithi kwa mwana wa Yese. Nendeni kwenye mahema yenu, ee Israeli, angalia nyumba yako mwenyewe, ee Daudi!” Hivyo Waisraeli wakaenda kwenye mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omorwoti nigo angete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bagateeba, “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.

English: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
Kiswahili: Zifu, Telemu, Bealothi,
Ekegusii: na Sifu, na Telemu, na Bealoti,

English: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika mwaka wa tatu Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda akashuka kwenda kumwona mfalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o gatato Yehosafati, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, akagenda ase omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli.

English: God helped him against the Philistines, against the Arabs living in Gur-baal, and against the Meunites.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamsaidia dhidi ya Wafilisti na dhidi ya Waarabu walioishi Gur-Baali na dhidi ya Wameuni.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamokonya, erinde akabua Abafirisiti, amo n’Abaarabu abamenyete ase Guru‐Baali, na Abameuni.

English: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
Kiswahili: Mishmana wa nne, Yeremia wa tano,
Ekegusii: na Misimana oyo o kane, na Yeremia oyo o gatano,

English: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Sofa walikuwa: Sua, Harneferi, Shuali, Beri, Imra,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sofa nabwo aba: Sua, na Hareneferi, na Suali, na Beri, na Imura,

English: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
Kiswahili: Walichukua nyara zote na mateka, pamoja na watu na wanyama,
Ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa abanto, boigo bakaira chitugo chionsi.

English: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kama vile Bwana alivyoamuru, Waisraeli wakawapa Walawi miji ifuatayo pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho kutoka urithi wao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakaa Abalawi emechie gete amo namarisio arengeo korwa ase emiando yabo, koreng'ana buna Omonene achigete.

English: For the mountains will be moved from their foundations with the waters, and the rocks will melt as wax at your presence: But you are yet merciful to those who fear you.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana milima itaondolewa kwenye misingi yake kwa maji, na miamba itayeyuka kama nta mbele zako: Lakini bado una huruma kwa wale wanaokucha.
Ekegusii: Ebigoro nechinyancha nabiisa gotengecha goika amaroso abo buna amaache, ebitare nigo biranyititoke buna amachoe ase obosio bwao. Korende ase baria bakoirogete aye nobarorere amaabera.

English: These are the words of the Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Maneno ya Mhubiri, mwana wa Daudi, mfalme huko Yerusalemu:
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana ’omorandia mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti o Yerusalemu.

English: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,
Kiswahili: “Laiti maneno yangu yangewekwa kwenye kumbukumbu, laiti kwamba yangeandikwa kwenye kitabu,
Ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye amang’ana aane narikwa bono! Yare koba buya arikwe ase egetabu,

English: Then the LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika Mlima Sinai,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoteebia,

English: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.
Kiswahili: Macho ya mtu mwenye majivuno yatanyenyekezwa na kiburi cha wanadamu kitashushwa, Bwana peke yake ndiye atakayetukuzwa siku hiyo.
Ekegusii: Rituko ngocha rire ekero obomwenu bwa Mwanyabaanto borairanigwe inse, na oboenenu bwabo mbokeeigwe, na ase rituko eri'Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.

English: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”
Kiswahili: Kidogo ulichokuwa nacho kabla sijaja kimeongezeka sana, naye Bwana amekubariki popote nilipokuwa. Lakini sasa, ni lini nitashughulikia mambo ya nyumba yangu mwenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Naki enibo yao nigo yareenge enke ritang'ani ekero ntaracha aa, korende bono yamentekanire mono kegima. Omonene ogosesenirie aye, aande onsi ase nabeire nkogenda kogokorera emeremo. Ko bono, inche indi ndabe nkoroisia amang'ana abwone inche omonyene?”

English: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on Him by the people of Israel,
Kiswahili: Ndipo likatimia lile lililonenwa na nabii Yeremia, kwamba, “Walichukua vile vipande thelathini vya fedha, thamani aliyopangiwa na watu wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: Erio rigaikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia, ogoteeba, “Bakaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato, rigori riaye oria obegetwe rigori n’abanto bande b’Abaisraeli,

English: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Nawasihi Euodia na Sintike wawe na nia moja katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Namosoroire Ewodia, namosoroire na Sintike babe nomoyo oyomo ase Omonene.

English: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
Kiswahili: Yehoahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miezi mitatu. Jina la mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia kutoka Libna.
Ekegusii: Yehoahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagaamba emetienyi etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia korwa Libuna.

English: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
Kiswahili: “Watwae Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli wengine na uwatakase kwa kawaida ya ibada.
Ekegusii: “Atanana Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli na obachene.

English: to tell him, “This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or of the Ammonites.
Kiswahili: kusema: “Hili ndilo asemalo Yefta, Israeli hawakuchukua nchi ya Moabu wala ya Waamoni.
Ekegusii: bamoteebie “Oko nokoiraneria kwa Yefta: Abaisraeli tibaireti rogongo rw’Abamoabu, gose rw’Abaamoni,

English: when seven cows, well-fed and sleek, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
Kiswahili: nikawaona ngʼombe saba, wazuri na wanono, wakijitokeza kutoka mtoni wakaja kujilisha kwenye matete.
Ekegusii: Nkarora chiombe isano na ibere, chinoru chingiya mono, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka;

English: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;
Kiswahili: Msifanye kama tunavyofanya hapa leo, kila mtu anavyopenda mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria timobaisa gokora buna togokora bono aiga. Kera omonto nigo agokora buna arooche omonyene ng'a 'mboronge.

English: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn't overtake them in Gibeah.
Kiswahili: “Tangu siku za Gibea, mmetenda dhambi, ee Israeli, huko ndiko mlikobaki. Je, vita havikuwapata watenda mabaya huko Gibea?
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwagendererete gokora ebibe korwa ase amatuko aria mwarenge Gibea, na goika bono nigo mogendererete gokora bo. Inee! Esegi y'okorusia egesiomba igoro y'abakori amabe tiyababuete agwo Gibea?

English: Zebulun was a people who risked their lives; Naphtali, too, on the heights of the battlefield.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Zabuloni walihatarisha maisha yao, vilevile nao watu wa Naftali.
Ekegusii: Abasabuloni bakerua nonya ’ngoika ogokwa, n’Abanafutali boigo ase okorwana esegi ebitunwa igoro.

English: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Isaki alimbariki Yakobo na Esau kuhusu maisha yao ya baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Isaka agasesenia Yakobo na Esau ase amang’ana agochi‐gocha.

English: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nitachukua nafaka yangu wakati itakapokomaa na divai yangu mpya wakati itakapokuwa tayari. Nitamnyangʼanya sufu yangu na kitani yangu iliyokusudiwa kufunika uchi wake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ning'iranie endagera yane, na edivai yane, ekero engaki eraikerane, boigo ning'ire amarionya aane e ching'ondi, na egatani, ebio namoete atube obogetirianda bwaye.

English: Moreover Yahweh's word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in Yahweh's sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, neno la Bwana likamjia Baasha pamoja na nyumba yake kupitia kwa nabii Yehu mwana wa Hanani, kwa sababu ya maovu yote aliyokuwa ametenda machoni pa Bwana, akamkasirisha kwa mambo aliyotenda, na kuwa kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu, na pia kwa sababu aliiangamiza.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ring'ana ri'Omonene rikarentwa nomobani Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, igoro ya Baasa na abanto b'enyomba yaye, ase engencho y'amabe onsi akorete ase amaiso 'Omonene. Omonene akagechigwa goika akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y'ayio onsi Baasa akorete ase okoba buna abanto b'enyomba ya Yeroboamu; boigo ekiagera asiretie abanto abwo.

English: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa wale ambao Mungu amewaita, Wayahudi na pia Wayunani, Kristo ndiye nguvu ya Mungu na pia hekima ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase abwo barangeretigwe, Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi, Kristo nere chinguru chia Nyasae, na obong'aini bwa Nyasae.

English: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
Kiswahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, zina pua, lakini haziwezi kunusa;
Ekegusii: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.

English: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
Kiswahili: ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, naam, kila kiogeleacho katika njia za bahari.
Ekegusii: ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi'enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.

English: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
Kiswahili: Kisha Isaki akamuaga Yakobo, naye akaenda Padan-Aramu, kwa Labani mwana wa Bethueli Mwaramu, ndugu wa Rebeka, aliyekuwa mama wa Yakobo na Esau.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Isaka agateebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng'ina Yakobo na Esau.

English: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
Kiswahili: Bali kwa yeye ninyi mmepata kuwa katika Kristo Yesu, aliyefanyika kwetu hekima itokayo kwa Mungu, yaani haki, na utakatifu na ukombozi.
Ekegusii: Korende nogokora kwa Nyasae, ng’a inwe imore ime ase Kristo Yeso, oyo Nyasae akorete koba obong’aini bwaito na oboronge bwaito, naende ogochenwa gwaito na okoboorigwa gwaito.

English: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Behold, I have told you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nendeni upesi mkawaambie wanafunzi wake kwamba, ‘Amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu, naye awatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona. Sasa nimekwisha kuwaambia.' ”
Ekegusii: Na genda bwango, moteebie aborokigwa baye ng'a obokire korwa ase abakuure; na rora, obatang'aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”

English: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to Me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,
Kiswahili: Kisha Isaya mwana wa Amozi akapeleka ujumbe kwa Hezekia, akasema: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: Kwa sababu umeniomba kuhusu Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru,
Ekegusii: Erio Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, agatoma amang’ana ase Hezekia, akomoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Aye gwansabire igoro ya Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: I lifted up my prayer from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.
Kiswahili: Niliinua maombi yangu kutoka ardhini, na kuomba ukombozi kutoka kifo.
Ekegusii: Nainche nkareta ogosaba kwane ase ore, erio ngasaba ng'a ontoorie korwa ase amakweri.

English: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, O King, and will praise you, O God my Savior. I give thanks to your name,
Kiswahili: Nitakushukuru, Ee Bwana, Mfalme, nami nitakusifu, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wangu. Nitalishukuru jina lako,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, nagwakeire buya na kogotogia, omotooria one. Naribakire eriata riao.

English: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
Kiswahili: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu humtesa maskini, waovu na wanaswe katika hila wanazozitunga.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe baenenire na gokorera abaremerwa bobe. Tiga babwatwe barabwo abanyene ase emeroberio yabo y'obobe.

English: The astrologers answered the king, “No one on earth can do what the king requests! No king, however great and powerful, has ever asked anything like this of any magician, enchanter, or astrologer.
Kiswahili: Wanajimu wakamjibu mfalme, “Hakuna mtu duniani ambaye anaweza kufanya analotaka mfalme! Vilevile hakuna mfalme hata awe mkuu na mwenye uweza namna gani, aliyeuliza kitu kama hicho kwa mganga au kwa msihiri, wala kwa mnajimu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Abakalidayo baria bakairaneria omorwoti, bakamoteebia, “Monto onde tari ase ense eye oranyare koorokia ring’ana erio aye omorwoti oganetie komanya, ekiagera omorwoti onde tari, nonya ore omonene mono, gose ore nokobua kore naki, oboririe egento kenga buna ekio korwa ase abaringoria, gose abaragori, gose korwa ase Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi.

English: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
Kiswahili: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.’
Ekegusii: Akabora: Yaya, tata Aburaamu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakuure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.

English: “When all these things come upon you—the blessings and curses I have set before you—and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,
Kiswahili: Wakati baraka hizi zote pamoja na laana nilizoziweka mbele yako zitakapokujia, nawe ukazitafakari moyoni popote Bwana Mungu wako atakapokutawanya miongoni mwa mataifa,
Ekegusii: “Ekero ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa, ayio naborokereirie aria arabe gakobanyora ekero mogendererete komenya ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi ebio ase Omonene Nyasae oino, arabaseerie gochia, ’monyaare koinyora amang’ana ane.

English: Whoever flees to the temple that is at Jerusalem, and within all of its borders, whether owing money to the king, or any other matter, let them go free, along with all that they have in my kingdom.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayekimbilia hekalu lililoko Yerusalemu, na ndani ya mipaka yake yote, iwe ni deni la mfalme, au jambo lingine lolote, mwacheni aende zake huru, pamoja na vyote alivyo navyo katika ufalme wangu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oriete kende gionsi agoturwa nomorwoti gose obwate ogoturwa egento kende gionsi, ekero araabe otameire Hekalu ya Yerusalemu gose ase ensemo eyemo ende yonsi ye Hekalu eyio, goika ere aberwe na koegwa enibo yaye ere ande onsi ase oborwoti bwane.

English: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya kama walivyoambiwa, baadhi yao wakakusanya zaidi, wengine pungufu.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora bo, bagasangereria abande enyinge, na abande enke.

English: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
Kiswahili: “Mlitarajia mengi, kumbe, yametokea kidogo. Ulichokileta nyumbani nilikipeperusha. Kwa nini?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Ni kwa sababu ya nyumba yangu, inayobaki katika hali ya magofu, wakati kila mmoja wenu anajishughulisha na nyumba yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Nigo mwasemeretie monyore ebinge, korende mokanyora ebike; na ekero mwabirentete inka, nkabirurukia bikagenda. Inche Omonene bw'Emeganda nigo nkobaboria: Nase ki yabeete bo? Nekiagera enyomba yane yatigirwe egendererete koba ritombe, na kera oyomo oino nigo echanderete enyomba yaye omonyene.

English: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest's, as the meal offering.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi yoyote ya hizo alizotenda, naye atasamehewa. Sadaka iliyobaki itakuwa ya kuhani, kama ilivyokuwa ile sadaka ya nafaka.' ”
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y'ebibe akorire ase ring'ana rinde rionsi ri'ayio, na omonto oria naaberwe. Oboratigare bobe obw'Omokuani, buna obw'okoruegwa kw'endagera bokoba obwaye.”

English: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
Kiswahili: Shekeli moja itakuwa gera ishirini. Shekeli ishirini, jumlisha na shekeli ishirini na tano, jumlisha na shekeli kumi na tano zitakuwa mina moja.
Ekegusii: “Ase chitaabu, esekeli eyemo nigo ebwate chigera emerongo ebere; emina eyemo nigo ebwate chisekeli emerongo etano nomo (emerongo ebere, na emerongo ebere na isano, na ikomi na isano).

English: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia neno la Bwana yeye pamoja na wote waliokuwako nyumbani mwake.
Ekegusii: Bagakwana ring'ana ri'Omonene asare na ase abanto bonsi abarenge mwaye.

English: “They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Huweka tayari ndimi zao kama upinde, ili kurusha uongo; wamekuwa na nguvu katika nchi lakini si katika ukweli. Wanatoka dhambi moja hadi nyingine, hawanitambui mimi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagokumba chimeme chiabo buna amata; oborimo nigo bomentete koba obonge kobua ekeene ase ense yabo. Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Nigo bagendererete komenta ebibe ase ebibe binde, gose tibamanyeti inche.”

English: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Gosheni, Holoni na Gilo; miji kumi na mmoja pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Goseni, na Holoni, na Gilo, emechie ikomi nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
Kiswahili: Moyo wenye furaha ni dawa nzuri, bali roho iliyopondeka hukausha mifupa.
Ekegusii: Enkoro ere n'omogooko nigo ekogwenia buna eriogo, korende omoichano ore ase enkoro nigo okwomia emeseto y'amauga.

English: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
Kiswahili: Yakobo akasogea karibu na baba yake Isaki, ambaye alimpapasa na kusema, “Sauti ni ya Yakobo, bali mikono ni ya Esau.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda agaika ise ang'e, na ere akamotaba‐taba, akabora: “Eriogi rirorio neria Yakobo, korende amaboko naya Esau.”

English: So you are to consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa hamsini mtauweka wakfu na kutangaza uhuru katika nchi kwa wakazi wake wote. Itakuwa ni yubile kwenu; kila mmoja wenu atairudia mali ya jamaa yake, na kila mmoja kurudi kwenye ukoo wake.
Ekegusii: Mwatanane omwaka oyio bw’emerongo etano, moyochene. Morarie obosibore ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense yaino. Omwaka oyio nobe omwaka bw’Omochengo ase more. Kera omonto ore ase more airanigwe ase omwando oye, na kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.

English: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God's Kingdom. With him were the twelve,
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya Yesu alikwenda, akawa anazunguka katika miji na vijiji akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu. Wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili walikuwa pamoja naye,
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya, akaba ngoetanana are ase emechie na ebichie, okorandia na kobateebia amang'ana amaya ay'oborwoti bwa Nyasae. Na baria ikomi na babere nigo barenge amo nere,

English: Then the scouts took two chariots with horses, and the king sent them after the Aramean army, saying, “Go and see.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakachagua magari mawili ya vita pamoja na farasi wake, naye mfalme akawatuma wafuatilie jeshi la Waaramu. Akawaamuru waendeshaji akisema, “Nendeni mkaone ni nini kilichotokea.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagachora abanto babere bakariina chigari chiare kong’uswa ne chibarasi, na omorwoti akabatoma gochia koroota abasikari b’Abasiiria.”

English: Healthy sleep comes from moderate eating. He rises early, and his wits are with him. The pain of wakefulness, colic, and griping are with an insatiable man.
Kiswahili: Usingizi mzuri hutokana na kula kwa kiasi. Anaamka mapema, na akili zake ziko pamoja naye. Maumivu ya kuamka, colic, na mshiko wa moyo yanampata mtu asiyeshiba.
Ekegusii: Omonto okoragera nekerengo nigo akonyoora chitoro chingiya, ere nabooke bwango na kweigwa ore buya. Korende rinyandambe takonyoora chitoro, ere nigo akoonchoka omoyo naende na koromwa enda.

English: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions' mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”
Kiswahili: Mungu wangu alimtuma malaika wake, naye akafunga vinywa vya hawa simba. Hawajanidhuru, kwa sababu nilionekana sina hatia mbele zake. Wala kamwe sijafanya jambo lolote baya mbele yako, ee mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae one natomete omomalaika oye, agasieka emenwa ye chindo, na chirochio tichiankorerete bobe bonde, ekiagera nigo nanyorekanete ng'a tindi na komocha ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nase obosio bwao, aye omorwoti, tinkoreti komocha konde.”

English: Don't lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
Kiswahili: Moyo wako usitamani uzuri wake wala macho yake yasikuteke,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa komogania ase enkoro yao ime ase engencho y'ekieni kiaye ekiya; amaiso aye tabaisa gokong'usa.

English: From the time that Amaziah turned from following the LORD, a conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But men were sent after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia wakati ule Amazia alipogeuka na kuacha kumfuata Bwana walifanya shauri baya dhidi yake huko Yerusalemu naye akakimbilia Lakishi, lakini wakawatuma watu wamfuatilie huko Lakishi nao wakamuulia huko.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria Amasia atigete Omonene, abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora omooroberio bw’okomoita. Ere agatama gochia Lakisi, na abanto bagatomwa aroro, bakamoita.

English: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
Kiswahili: Baba wasiuawe kwa ajili ya watoto wao, wala watoto wasiuawe kwa ajili ya baba zao; kila mmoja atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Abaibori tibagoitwa ase engencho y'ebibe bi'abana babo, gose abana tibagoitwa ase engencho y'ebibe bi'abaibori babo; korende kera omonto nigo araitwe ase engencho y'ebibe biaye omonyene.

English: So they continued on their journey, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaendelea na safari, jua likachwea walipokaribia Gibea ambao ni mji wa Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Bakagenderera orogeendo rwabo, na ekero baikire ang’e na Gibea, omochie bw’Ababenjamini, konya bwairiire kegima.

English: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
Kiswahili: Watu waliokula walikuwa wapata 4,000. Akiisha kuwaaga,
Ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo barenge ang'e chilifu inye (4,000).

English: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;
Kiswahili: Kwao unatimia ule unabii wa Isaya aliposema: “ ‘Hakika mtasikiliza lakini hamtaelewa; na pia mtatazama lakini hamtaona.
Ekegusii: Ase barabwo obobani bwa Isaya bwaikeranire, obogoteeba: Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng'ake, na okorigereria namorigererie, korende timokorora nonya ng'ake.

English: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ulipizaye kisasi, Ee Mungu ulipizaye kisasi, uangaze sasa.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ogoakana egesiomba, aye Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, oorokia oborabu bwao.

English: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
Kiswahili: Kuwa pamoja nawe ni kijito cha uzima, katika nuru yako twaona nuru.
Ekegusii: Naye ore ensoko y’obogima, na ase omobaso oo nigo tokorora omobaso.

English: Then I said to you, “Don't be terrified. Don't be afraid of them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikawaambia, “Msihofu, wala msiwaogope.
Ekegusii: Korende nkabateebia: Timoiroka abanto baria.

English: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them. Edom Refuses Passage
Kiswahili: Haya yalikuwa maji ya Meriba, mahali pale ambapo Waisraeli waligombana na Bwana, naye akajionyesha mwenyewe huko kuwa mtakatifu katikati yao. Edomu Wakatalia Israeli Kupita
Ekegusii: Aya naro amaache a Meriba aase Abaisraeli baamereranetie n’Omonene, na ere akeorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase egati yabo.” Omorwoti o Edomu okwanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yaye

English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God. To the Church in Smyrna
Kiswahili: “Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie yale ambayo Roho ayaambia makanisa. Yeye ashindaye, nitampa haki ya kula matunda toka kwa mti wa uzima, ambao uko katika paradiso ya Mungu. Kwa Kanisa Lililoko Smirna
Ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogoteebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue nimoe ribaga arie amatunda y’omote bw’obogima, oyio ore ase Paradiso ya Nyasae. Amang’ana ase Sumurina

English: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them.
Kiswahili: Akamgusa mkono wake na homa ikamwacha, naye akainuka na kuanza kumhudumia.
Ekegusii: Akamokuna okoboko kwaye. Esosera ekamotiga, na ere akaimoka akamokorera.

English: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana siku zile kabla ya gharika, watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina.
Ekegusii: Inaki buna barenge ase amatuko aria etoigo etaracha, baare koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato,

English: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
Kiswahili: Balaki aliposikia kuwa Balaamu anakuja, akatoka kumlaki katika mji wa Moabu, katika mpaka wa Arnoni, ukingoni mwa nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Balaki aigwete ng'a Baalamu inchera are gocha, akageenda komoorototera agwo Ari, omochie orenge ang'e norooche rw'Arinoni, ase orobebe rwa Moabu.

English: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
Kiswahili: lakini ninaonyesha upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanipendao na kuzishika amri zangu.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko aane.

English: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
Kiswahili: Wale ndugu walipopata habari wakampeleka hadi Kaisaria, wakamsafirisha kwenda Tarso.
Ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo bachia konyora amang'ana aya, bakamoira goika Kaisaria, bakamotoma agende Tariso.

English: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
Kiswahili: Kwanza, mnapokutana kama kanisa, nasikia kwamba kuna mgawanyiko miongoni mwenu, nami kwa kiasi fulani nasadiki kuwa ndivyo ilivyo.
Ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani naigure ng’a ekero mogosangerereka ase ekanisa ogwatananekana nkore ase more. Ayande aya naigure negenire ng’a namaene.

English: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akafanya lile Mose alilomwomba. Mainzi yakaondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake, wala hakuna hata inzi aliyebakia.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa ateebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.

English: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,
Kiswahili: bundi, mumbi, bundi mkubwa,
Ekegusii: enyakweumia enke na enene, na etibibi;

English: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Njooni, watoto wangu, mnisikilize, nitawafundisha kumcha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abana baane, inchwo montegerere, mborokererie buna moramoiroke Omonene.

English: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
Kiswahili: Mngojee Bwana, na uishike njia yake. Naye atakutukuza uirithi nchi, waovu watakapokatiliwa mbali, utaliona hilo.
Ekegusii: Gany'Omonene na obwatie enchera yaye, nere nakoimokererie igoro akoe ense ebe eyao; erio norigererie orore buna abanyabibe bagosirigwa.

English: Daniel answered the king, “No wise man, enchanter, medium, or magician can explain to the king the mystery of which he inquires.
Kiswahili: Danieli akajibu, “Hakuna mwenye hekima, msihiri, mganga au mwaguzi anayeweza kumweleza mfalme siri aliyouliza,
Ekegusii: Danieli akairaneria omorwoti, akamoteebia, “Onde tari ase abanto abang’aini, gose abaragori, gose abaringoria, gose abanto bamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni oranyare koorokia obobisi obo aye omorwoti kwaboririe,

English: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.
Kiswahili: Huufunika uso wa mwezi mpevu, akitandaza mawingu juu yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo atubete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akagetuba namare aye.

English: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
Kiswahili: Siklagi, Beth-Markabothi, Hasar-Susa,
Ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susa,

English: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool displays his folly.
Kiswahili: Kila mwenye busara hutenda kwa maarifa, bali mpumbavu hudhihirisha upumbavu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo agokora emeremo yaye ne chiseemi, korende omonto omoriri nigo akoraria oboriri bwaye.

English: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
Kiswahili: wafalme wote wa Arabuni na wafalme wote wa watu wageni wanaoishi katika jangwa;
Ekegusii: abarwoti bonsi b'Arabia na ab'ebisaku ebio bisang'anaine bimenyete ase erooro;

English: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
Kiswahili: “Ee Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, uwauaye manabii na kuwapiga mawe wale waliotumwa kwako! Mara ngapi nimetamani kuwakusanya watoto wako pamoja, kama vile kuku akusanyavyo vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake, lakini hukutaka!
Ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng'ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye aase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!

English: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana alipoamka kama vile kuamka usingizini, kama vile mtu aamkavyo kutoka kwenye bumbuazi la mvinyo.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaboka buna nigo araire chitoro, na akaba buna omonto etuoni onyure edivai ogoaka eriogi;

English: The Israelites secretly did things against the LORD their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city, they built high places in all their cities.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya vitu kwa siri dhidi ya Bwana Mungu wao, ambavyo havikuwa sawa. Kuanzia kwenye mnara wa ulinzi hadi kwenye mji wenye maboma walijijengea wenyewe mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu katika miji yao yote.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora bobisi ebinto ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae obo. Bakeagachera aase aimokererete igoro ase bagosasimera, agwo aase abo onsi bamenyete, ase emerobiri y’okorenda yaagachire amo nemechie egiteire chindwaki.

English: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don't defer to anyone; for you aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
Kiswahili: Wakamjia, wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu. Wewe huyumbishwi na wanadamu, kwa kuwa huna upendeleo. Lakini wewe huifundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli. Je, ni halali kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng'a aye nigo ore omonto bw'ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto, naki torengerereti obonene bw' abanto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae. Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?

English: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”
Kiswahili: Naye akamwambia baba yake, “Naomba nifanyiwe jambo hili. Nipewe miezi miwili ili kuzunguka vilimani nikaulilie ubikira wangu, mimi na wenzangu.”
Ekegusii: Naende omoiseke oria akamoteebia, “Inkorere egento ekemo gioka! Ing'a ribaga ri'emetienyi ebere, erinde 'ngende amo nabasani bane ase ebitunwa, na aroro toetanane na korera, ekiagera ningenderere koba omwekungi.”

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa watu ukawaweke wakfu leo na kesho. Waambie wafue nguo zao
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda ase abanto aba, obachene reero na ankio, naende obateebie basibie chianga chiabo,

English: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
Kiswahili: Mimi niko katika maumivu na dhiki; Ee Mungu, wokovu wako na unihifadhi.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inde ase emechando n'obororo; aye Nyasae, ogotooreka kwao konyimokererie igoro.

English: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
Kiswahili: Mtatoa dhabihu ya Pasaka ya mnyama kwa Bwana Mungu wenu kutoka kundi lenu la mbuzi na kondoo au la ngʼombe, mahali pale ambapo Bwana atapachagua kama makao kwa ajili ya Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Morusie eng'ondi, gose embori, gose eng'ombe, korwa ase amaicho aino, mogende aase Omonene arachoore abe obomenyo bw'erieta riaye, erio morue eng'iti eria ebe ekeng'wanso gi'Epasaka ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: Jonathan left his brother Simon in the city, and went out into the country, and he went with a few men.
Kiswahili: Yonathani alimwacha nduguye Simoni mjini, akaenda mashambani, naye akaenda na watu wachache.
Ekegusii: Yonathani akamotiga momura omwabo ime yomochie, akageenda ensemo ye emegondo ase ense eyio ore nekeombe kia abanto abake igo.

English: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mtu wa amani; lakini ninaposema, wao wanataka vita.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokora omorembe, korende ekero ’ngokwana, barabwo nigo baganetie esegi.

English: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
Kiswahili: (Lakini Wadani walipata shida kulimiliki eneo lao; kwa hiyo walipanda kuishambulia Leshemu, wakaitwaa, wakawaua watu wake kwa upanga na kuukalia. Walikaa Leshemu na kuuita Dani kufuatana na jina la baba yao.)
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b'egesaku gia Dani basiretie ense yabo, bakagenda Lesemu, bakayoumokera, bakayoira na bagaita abanto b'agwo nemioro. Bagasakora chinibo chiarengeo, bakamenya omochie oyio. Erio bakaonchora erieta ri'omochie oyio Lesemu, bakayoroka Dani, erieta ria sokoro yabo Dani.

English: But now I remember the evils which I did at Jerusalem, and that I took all the vessels of silver and gold that were in it, and sent out to destroy the inhabitants of Judah without a cause.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa nakumbuka maovu niliyoyafanya huko Yerusalemu, na kwamba nilichukua vyombo vyote vya fedha na dhahabu vilivyokuwamo, nikatuma watu kuwaangamiza wakazi wa Yuda bila sababu.
Ekegusii: Erio inche nkainyora obobe nakorete Yerusalemu ase okobogoria ebibeekerero bietaabu n'efeta korwa ase Hekalu erio inche inkarigia kobasiria bosa abamenyi ba Yudea.

English: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
Kiswahili: Yeye alindaye kinywa chake na ulimi wake hujilinda na maafa.
Ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rw'aye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.

English: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don't be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyekuumba, ee Yakobo, yeye aliyekuhuluku, ee Israeli: “Usiogope kwa maana nimekukomboa, nimekuita wewe kwa jina lako, wewe u wangu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b'ororeeria rwa Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, aya nar'Omonene oria obatongete na kobabomba agoteeba; “Timoiroka, ekiagera inche nababooririe; nabarangeirie ase amarieta aino; inwe nabaane.

English: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Akawaweka makuhani kwenye wajibu wao na kuwatia moyo katika utumishi wa Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Akabeka abakuani ase emeremo yabo na akabaseegeta bakore emeremo y'enyomba y'Omonene.

English: He encamped against the sanctuary many days; and set there mounds to shoot from, and engines of war, and machines for throwing fire and stones, and weapons to throw darts, and slings.
Kiswahili: Alipiga kambi dhidi ya patakatifu kwa siku nyingi; na akaweka vilima vya kurusha huko, na mitambo ya vita, na mashine za kurusha moto na mawe, na silaha za kurusha mishale, na kombeo.
Ekegusii: Akayeetanana na kogitera Hekalu ase ebiro ebitambe. Akaroberia na koroisia ebioge biogotagora chinyasi, chitinga chi'okoruta ebioge na ebinto biokoruta omorero amagena nechinsara boigo ebiraasi bi'okorutera amagena.

English: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves and said to the people, “Going up to Jerusalem is too much for you. Here, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kutafuta shauri, mfalme akatengeneza ndama wawili wa dhahabu. Akawaambia watu, “Ni gharama kubwa kwenu kukwea kwenda Yerusalemu. Hii hapa miungu yenu, ee Israeli, iliyowapandisha kutoka Misri.”
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arengereretie amang’ana ayio, akaroisia korwa ase etaabu emegwekano ebere ye chimori, agateebia abanto: “Igo mogochandeka mono kona kogenda Yerusalemu. Inwe Abaisraeli, rora aiga chinyasae chiaino, echi chiabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua gwa Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.

English: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:
Kiswahili: (alifanya hivi ili tu kuwafundisha wazao wa Waisraeli ambao hawakuwa wamejua vita hapo awali):
Ekegusii: Nabo akorete ase okworokereria kera ekegori ki'Abaisraeli engencho y'eseegi, mono abwo konya batararwana esegi ende yonsi.

English: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, kulikuwa na watu waliomwambia Yesu habari za Wagalilaya ambao Pilato aliwaua, na damu ya hao watu akaichanganya na dhabihu yao waliyokuwa wanatoa.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio mbachete aroro abanto bamotebetie amang’ana igoro y’Abagalili, baria Pilato asang’ananetie amanyinga abo nebing’wanso biabo.

English: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa upendo na uaminifu uovu huondolewa; kwa kumcha Bwana mtu hujiepusha na ubaya.
Ekegusii: Ase amaabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y'ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene, omonto nigo agweatanana korwa ase amabe.

English: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
Kiswahili: wala si kwa ajili ya taifa hilo pekee, bali pia kwa ajili ya watoto wa Mungu waliotawanyika, ili kuwaleta pamoja na kuwafanya wawe wamoja.
Ekegusii: gose tari ase engencho y'egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya asangererie abana ba Nyasae baria baatananekire, babe abamo.

English: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaweka fito alizozibambua kwenye mabirika yote ya kunyweshea mifugo, ili ziwe mbele ya makundi walipokuja kunywa maji. Wanyama walipokuja kunywa maji, hali wakiwa wanahitaji mbegu,
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka ebite biria ase chintuba chi'amaache ase amaicho are gocha konywera. Na ekiagera ching'iti chiria chiare koa chiaberi amarieme, ekero chigocha konywa amaache,

English: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Kerosi, Siaha, Padoni,
Ekegusii: Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;

English: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said, “Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!”
Kiswahili: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa akisema hayo, mwanamke mmoja katikati ya ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti akasema, “Limebarikiwa tumbo lililokuzaa na matiti uliyonyonya!”
Ekegusii: Ekero agokwana aya, omokungu oyomo ase omoganda agaaka eriogi, akamoteebia, “Nesesenirie enda yakobogoretie, ne chimbeere kwagongete!”

English: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
Kiswahili: Amani ya Kristo na itawale mioyoni mwenu, kwa kuwa ninyi kama viungo vya mwili mmoja mmeitiwa amani. Tena kuweni watu wa shukrani.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorembe o Kristo ogambere chinkoro chiaino, noro mwarangererigwe ase omobere oyomo, na mobe abakoiraneria ng'a mbuya mono.

English: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
Kiswahili: Kuna wakati kwa ajili ya kila jambo, nayo majira kwa kila tendo chini ya mbingu:
Ekegusii: Kera egento nkere nekero kiaye, na aiga inse y'erioba kera ekegokorekana nkere nengaki yaye.

English: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote aliyeko nje mahali pa wazi agusaye mtu aliyeuawa kwa upanga au mtu aliyekufa kwa kifo cha kawaida, au mtu yeyote agusaye mfupa wa mtu aliyekufa au kaburi, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oranyore omonto okenyirwe orosana ime, gose okwete ogokwa konde gwonsi, na amokune, gose akune riuga ri'egetondo, gose oboina, omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y'amatuko atan'abere.

English: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
Kiswahili: “Tunaahidi kutowaoza binti zetu kwa watu wanaotuzunguka, wala kuwaoza wana wetu binti zao.
Ekegusii: Bagateeba, Titokorua abaiseke baito banyuomwe nabaanto b'ense eye, gose titokonyuomeria abamura baito abaiseke babo.

English: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Popote nitakapowafukuzia, mabaki wote wa kizazi hiki kiovu watatamani kufa kuliko kuishi, asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.'
Ekegusii: Abanto abaratigare b'egesaku eke ekebe, baria bare moyo ase chinsemo chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, mbaganie ogokwa kobua koba moyo. Inche Omonene bw'Emeganda nakwanire.

English: They will no longer be prey for the nations, and the beasts of the earth will not consume them. They will dwell securely, and no one will frighten them.
Kiswahili: Hawatatekwa tena nyara na mataifa, wala wanyama pori hawatawala tena. Wataishi kwa salama, wala hakuna yeyote atakayewatia hofu.
Ekegusii: Tibagotwarwa buna ching’iti naende nabaanto b’ebisaku, gose ching’iti chi’orosana tichikobaria. Mbabe bamenyete bare noborendi obuya, gose onde tari oraboboie.

English: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, naye huyo wakamuua. Akawatuma wengine wengi; baadhi yao wakawapiga, na wengine wakawaua.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria naende agatoma omosomba onde naende, na oyio bakamoita agakwa. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita bagakwa.

English: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
Kiswahili: Akiisha kusema hayo, akabaki Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Agachia gokoora kobateebia aya, agatigara Galili.

English: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
Kiswahili: Watafakari watu wasio na hatia, wachunguze watu wakamilifu, kuna mafanikio kwa mtu apendaye amani.
Ekegusii: Rigereria omonto omoikeranu, ee, origererie omonto ore nenkoro endonge, norore ng'a omonto ogokora omorembe nere orachie kare.

English: So David and his six hundred men went to the Brook of Besor, where some stayed behind
Kiswahili: Daudi pamoja na watu wake 600 wakafika kwenye Bonde la Besori, mahali ambapo wengine waliachwa nyuma,
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi amo n’baanto baye amagana atano na rimo bakagenda, bagaika ase akarooche ka Besori. Agwo abanto bande bagatigara magega.

English: For even if in the sight of men they are punished, their hope is full of immortality.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata kama mbele ya wanadamu wataadhibiwa, tumaini lao limejaa kutokufa.
Ekegusii: Nigo torakagere buna nigo banyorire egesusuro, korende nigo bare n'ogosemeria gw'ogotakwa.

English: ‘Flee! Run for your lives! Become like a juniper in the desert. ’
Kiswahili: Kimbieni! Okoeni maisha yenu, kuweni kama kichaka jangwani.
Ekegusii: Tama! Motoorie obogima bwaino, mobe buna etigere y’orosana etigarete yoka ase erooro.

English: They told the king what Jonathan had done, that they might cast blame on him; but the king kept silent.
Kiswahili: Walimwambia mfalme kile Yonathani alichofanya, ili wapate kumlaumu; lakini mfalme akakaa kimya.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakamotebia boigo amabe Yonathani akorete bare nogosemeria buna ere nabekerwe amamocho; korende takwana gento kende.

English: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
Kiswahili: Maana tulitaka kuja kwenu, hasa mimi Paulo, nilitaka kuja tena na tena, lakini Shetani akatuzuia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ntwaganetie gocha ase more (inche Paulo nonya ng’ara kabere) korende Saitani agatotanga.

English: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.
Kiswahili: Vyumba vya pembeni vilikuwa na ghorofa tatu, kimoja juu ya kingine, kila ghorofa ilikuwa na vyumba thelathini. Kulikuwa na boriti katika ukuta wote wa Hekalu ili kuimarisha vyumba vya pembeni, kwa hiyo boriti hizo hazikushikamanishwa kwenye ukuta wa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Ebinyomba ebio biaetanaine Hekalu nigo biarenge namarongo atato, kera rirongo nigo riabwate ebinyomba emerongo etato. Ebitambokero nigo biachomeranirie ase enyasi ye Hekalu, erinde emeriibo y'ebinyomba biria egatoorera aroro, tiyasoete ase enyasi eria ime.

English: No one can say, “What is this?” “Why is that?” for all things are created for their own uses.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kusema, "Hiki ni nini?" "Kwa nini?" Kwa maana vitu vyote vimeumbwa kwa matumizi yake.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobooria “Nkieke?” Gose “Eke negiaki?” Ekiagera kera egento nigo getongire ase emeremo yaye.

English: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. “With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,” she said.
Kiswahili: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mkewe Eva, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa Kaini. Eva akasema, “Kwa msaada wa Bwana nimemzaa mwanaume.”
Ekegusii: Bono Adamu akaba na mokaye Hawa, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nanyorire omwana omomura ase ogokonywa kw’Omonene.” Ase igo akamoroka Kaini.

English: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
Kiswahili: Wale waliotoka katika kila kabila la Israeli ambao walielekeza mioyo yao kumtafuta Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, wakawafuata Walawi huko Yerusalemu kumtolea Bwana dhabihu, Mungu wa baba zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi'Abaisraeli, baria baruete chinkoro chiabo komorigia Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, bagatunyana Abalawi gochia Yerusalemu, bakarua ebing'wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.

English: The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.
Kiswahili: Ndugu asiye na cheo kikubwa yampasa ajivunie hali hiyo maana ametukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Korende abakristo abare abataka bagoke, ekiagera Nyasae abaimokereirie igoro,

English: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”
Kiswahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa kwake wote ni hai.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”

English: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
Kiswahili: Basi yule jemadari aliyekuwa amesimama hapo mbele ya msalaba wa Yesu aliposikia ile sauti yake na kuona jinsi alivyokata roho, akasema, “Hakika mtu huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Na ekero omotang'ani bw'abarwani rigana ateneine amorigereretie, agachia korora ng'a otwekire mo, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: I said in my heart, ‘To what suffering I have come! How great a flood it is that I'm in, now! For I was gracious and loved in my power.'
Kiswahili: Nikasema moyoni mwangu, "Nimepitia mateso gani! Ni mafuriko makubwa kama nini niliyo nayo sasa! Kwa maana nilikuwa na neema na upendo katika nguvu zangu."
Ekegusii: Ritang'ani nigo neboretie ninki kiagerete emechaando eye ekanyoora inche agwo ase oborwoti bwane inche nabeire omuya na bwanchire na abanto bonsi!

English: For I said, “Don't let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilisema, “Usiwaache wafurahie, wala wasijitukuze juu yangu mguu wangu unapoteleza.”
Ekegusii: Nigo nkogosaba ng'a ababisa baane tibagokera emechando yane; na tibetogeria okogwa kwane.

English: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
Kiswahili: au kama kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi au samaki yeyote aliye ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: gose oyo bw'eng'iti ekwagura ase riroba, gose oyo bw'enswe ende yonsi ere ime ase amaache inse y'ense.

English: On that day a man will raise a young cow and two sheep,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, mtu atahifadhi hai ndama mmoja na kondoo wawili.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omonto nabe otugete ritororo erimo, ne ching’ondi ibere;

English: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana wa mabwana: Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene bw’abanene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.
Kiswahili: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vilikuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yaliyotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani rokaba nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo rokaba nemegwekano y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chikaba boigo.

English: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Debiri mmoja mfalme wa Gederi mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Debiri, na oyo o Gederi,

English: The cat has eaten the chicks.
Kiswahili: Paka amekula vifaranga.
Ekegusii: Ekemoni kiarire ebichuchu.

English: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”
Kiswahili: Yonathani akamuuliza baba yake, “Kwa nini auawe? Kwani amefanya nini?”
Ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamobooria, “Nase ki araitwe akwe? Ngento ki akorire?”

English: When the Israelites along the valley and those on the other side of the Jordan saw that the army of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliokuwa kandokando ya bonde na wale waliokuwa ngʼambo ya Yordani walipoona kuwa jeshi la Waisraeli limekimbia na kwamba Sauli na wanawe wamekufa, wakaacha miji yao na kukimbia. Nao Wafilisti wakaja na kukaa humo.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli abwo baarenge ensemo ende ase ense omweremo, na abwo bareenge moocha ya Yorodani baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli konya batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakuure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafirisiti bakagenda bakamenya ase emechie eyio.

English: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel's tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”'
Kiswahili: Utakapoondoka kwangu leo, utakutana na watu wawili karibu na kaburi la Raheli, huko Selsa kwenye mpaka wa Benyamini. Watakuambia, ‘Punda wale uliotoka kwenda kuwatafuta, wamekwisha kupatikana. Sasa baba yako ameacha kufikiri kuhusu punda na sasa ana hofu kukuhusu wewe. Anauliza, “Nitafanyaje kuhusu mwanangu?” '
Ekegusii: Ekero okorua aa ase 'nde reero noumerane n'abanto babere ang'e nembeera ya Raeli, ase orogongo rwa Benjamini ase Selisa. Barabwo nigo baragoteebie ng'a chitigere chiria mwagendete korigia chiatokire. Iso otigire gochichandekera, na bono naye achaandekerete, ogoteeba: Naki ndakore indore omwana one?

English: Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner—even those who are not your offspring.
Kiswahili: Kwa vizazi vijavyo, kila mwanaume miongoni mwenu mwenye siku nane ni lazima atahiriwe, pamoja na watakaozaliwa nyumbani mwako au walionunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni, wale ambao sio watoto wako.
Ekegusii: Ekiaare ase ekiaare kera omwana omoisia ore ase egati yaino goika arokigwe ekero akoorire amatuko atano na atato, omobiare o inka amo nomogorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, otari bw’ororeeria rwao.

English: On hearing this, the centurion went and reported it to the commander. “What are you going to do?” he said. “This man is a Roman citizen.”
Kiswahili: Yule kiongozi aliposikia maneno haya, alimwendea yule jemadari na kumwambia, “Unataka kufanya nini? Kwa maana huyu mtu ni raiya wa Rumi.”
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria ochia koigwa aya, akagenda akoorokia omotang’ani oria omonene, akabora: “Naki origetie gokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo n’Omorumi are.”

English: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wanamlinda Yesu wakaanza kumdhihaki na kumpiga.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria babwatete Yeso, bakamosekereria, na komoaka.

English: Now therefore don't hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa, usidhani kwamba hana hatia. Wewe ni mtu wa hekima, utajua la kumtendea. Zishushe mvi zake kaburini kwa damu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, tobaisa komobara ng'a tari na komocha, ekiagera aye nomonto omong'aini; nomanye aye omonyene eki ogwenerete gokora asare, tomotiga agende aase abakuure ore ne chimbuche, ase engencho y'okomocha kwaye kw'ogoitera amanyinga omoite akwe.”

English: “Look,” said Jacob, “it is still broad daylight; it is not yet time to gather the livestock. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Tazama, jua bado liko juu, si wakati wa kukusanya mifugo. Nywesheni kondoo na mwarudishe malishoni.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Rigereria, bono mobaso, chinsa chi’ogosangereria amaicho tichiraika, nyoinsia ching’ondi, naende mochiire korisia.”

English: When Onias had sure knowledge of this, he sharply reproved him, having withdrawn himself into a sanctuary at Daphne, that lies by Antioch.
Kiswahili: Onia alipojua jambo hili kwa hakika, alimkemea vikali, akijitenga na kukaa katika patakatifu pa Daphne, karibu na Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Onia ekero aigwete aya akagenda akaerokia ase Hekalu eyemo agwo Dafne, ange n'omochie bw'Antiokia. Agwo agachaaka komomochia Menelao maiso marore.

English: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God's word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo na Barnaba wakawajibu kwa ujasiri, wakisema, “Ilitupasa kunena nanyi neno la Mungu kwanza. Lakini kwa kuwa mmelikataa, mkajihukumu wenyewe kuwa hamstahili uzima wa milele, sasa tunawageukia watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bagakwana noboremu, bagateeba: Igo yagwenerete ng'a ring'ana ria Nyasae rikwanwe ase more ritang'ani. Korende ekiagera mwarisukeirie are mwenacheire inwe abanyene ng'a timogwenereti obogima bwa kare na kare, tweonchoreire abanto b'Ebisaku.

English: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn't go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven't you come from a journey? Why didn't you go down to your house?”
Kiswahili: Daudi alipoambiwa kwamba, “Uria hakwenda nyumbani,” Daudi akamuuliza, “Je, si ndiyo tu umefika kutoka safari ya mbali? Kwa nini hukwenda nyumbani?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagateebia Daudi ng'a Uria tageendete bwoye. Daudi akamobooria, “Inee! Tikwarwete ase orogendo? Nase ki otageendete bwoo?”

English: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Kwa vile Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli amewapa watu wake raha na amekuja kuishi Yerusalemu milele,
Ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oeire abanto baye obotoereru, na bono ere nigo amenyete Yerusalemu kare na kare.

English: “What is it, Queen Esther?” the king inquired. “What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given to you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme aliuliza, “Malkia Esta, ni nini? Ombi lako ni nini? Hata kama ni nusu ya ufalme, utapewa.”
Ekegusii: na omorwoti akamobooria, “Eting’ana Esiteri, ninki origetie? Inteebia eki oganetie; aye nokeegwe, nakeba nonya nekeng’ese ki’oborwoti bwane.”

English: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”
Kiswahili: Kisha yeye na wale watu waliokuwa pamoja naye wakala, wakanywa na kulala palepale. Walipoamka asubuhi, yule mtumishi, akasema, “Nipeni ruhusa nirudi kwa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Momura omwabo Rebeka na ng'ina bakamoteebia: “Tiga omoiseke oyo arabeere aiga koreng'ana amatuko ikomi; magega y'ayio mogende komo.”

English: He hung Nicanor's head and shoulder from the citadel, a clear sign evident to all of the help of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Alining'iniza kichwa na bega la Nikanori kutoka ngome, ishara dhahiri kwa msaada wote wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Yuda agasunga omotwe o Nikanori ase enyasi koba kirori ase kera oyomo ase obobui bw'Omonene.

English: So the men of the outpost called out to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, “Come on up, and we will teach you a lesson!” “Follow me,” Jonathan told his armor-bearer, “for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa kwenye doria wakawapigia kelele Yonathani na mbeba silaha wake, wakisema, “Njooni, pandeni kwetu nasi tutawakomesha.” Basi Yonathani akamwambia mbeba silaha wake, “Panda nyuma yangu; Bwana amewatia mikononi mwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Erio abarendi babo b’eburi bakarangeria Yonathani amo nomobogoreria bw’ebirwanero biaye, bakabateebia: “Inchuo tiira gocha aa ase tore, tobateebie ring’ana.” Yonathani agateebia omomura oria: “Mbwatie, totiire gochia aroro, ekiagera Omonene obabekire ase amaboko y’Abaisraeli.”

English: In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money. Though a man make a vow to them and doesn't keep it, they will never exact it.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, hawawezi kutoa utajiri wala pesa. Ingawa mtu ataweka nadhiri kwao na asiitimiza, hawataidai kamwe.
Ekegusii: Tichigotoria omonto korwa amakweri gose gokonya omonto otari na nguru korwa ase oria ore n'echinguru.

English: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamuuliza, “Utafanya ishara gani ya muujiza, ili tuione tukuamini? Utafanya jambo gani?
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?

English: When there is a man who has labored with wisdom, knowledge, and skill, and he must give his portion to a man who has not worked for it, this too is futile and a great evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mtu anaweza kufanya kazi yake kwa hekima, maarifa na ustadi, kisha analazimika kuacha vyote alivyo navyo kwa mtu mwingine ambaye hajavifanyia kazi. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili tena ni balaa kubwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo agokora emeremo emekong’u nobong’aini bwaye, ne chisemi, na okomanya kwaye, konyora ebinto, korende magega yaye atigera omonto omoao otabiechanderete okwegokia nabirobio. Ayio boigo mbosa, naende mbobe mono.

English: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
Kiswahili: Naye akapiga kelele kwa sauti kuu kama simba anayenguruma. Alipopiga kelele, zile radi saba zikatoa ngurumo zake.
Ekegusii: na akarera neriogi rinene ringa buna eri'endo ekoruma. Ekero achia korera chinkoba isano na ibere chigakwana neriogi riabo.

English: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.
Kiswahili: Akawaajiri pia watu 100,000 wapiganaji kutoka Israeli kwa talanta 100 za fedha.
Ekegusii: Agasaba abarwani chituoni chilifu rigana erimo (100,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli, akabaakanera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo.

English: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
Kiswahili: Badala yake, inawapasa kusema, “Kama Bwana akipenda, tutaishi na kufanya hili ama lile.”
Ekegusii: Ayamogwenerete goteeba naya, “Omonene karanche, natobe moyo, naende tokore iga gose iga”.

English: Their lineage has a long chin
Kiswahili: Ukoo wao una kidevu kirefu
Ekegusii: Ororeri rwabo robwate ekenyinyiro egetambe

English: who says of Cyrus, ‘My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire,’ who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be rebuilt,’ and of the temple, ‘Let its foundation be laid.’”
Kiswahili: nisemaye kuhusu Koreshi, ‘Yeye ni mchungaji wangu, naye atatimiza yote yanipendezayo; atauambia Yerusalemu, “Ukajengwe tena,” na kuhusu Hekalu, “Misingi yake na iwekwe.” ’
Ekegusii: Nigo ngoteeba igoro ya Koresi ng’a namobekire abe omorisia bw’abaanto baane; ere naikeranie ogwancha kwane gwonsi, na ateebe igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a oagachwe naende, naende ateebe igoro ye Hekalu ng’a oboroso bwaye bobekwe naende.”

English: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh's vengeance on Midian.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia watu, “Waandaeni baadhi ya wanaume wenu waende vitani kupigana na Wamidiani ili wawalipize kisasi cha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Babeeke ang'e abanto bare ase egati yaino, mobae ebirwanero bagende korwania Abamidiani, erinde bamoruserie Omonene egesiomba.

English: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu wapenzi, simameni imara, msitikisike, mzidi sana katika kuitenda kazi ya Bwana, kwa maana mnajua ya kuwa, kazi yenu katika Bwana si bure.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, abanchwa, mobe ne chinguru, motari gotengechigwa, momente mono gokora emeremo y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi, momanye ng’a emeremo yaino ase Omonene teri bosa.

English: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakawakusanya wafalme pamoja mahali paitwapo Armagedoni kwa Kiebrania.
Ekegusii: Na emeika eria egasangereria abarwoti amo gochia aase akorokwa ase Ekeiberania Arimagedon.

English: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Kiswahili: Kama watu wasiomcha Mungu, wamenidhihaki, wamenisagia meno.
Ekegusii: Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.

English: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: ili kuwa mhudumu wa Kristo Yesu kwa watu wa Mataifa nikiwa na huduma ya kikuhani ya kutangaza Injili ya Mungu, ili watu wa Mataifa wapate kuwa dhabihu inayokubaliwa na Mungu, iliyotakaswa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: erinde imbe omosomba o Kristo Yeso ase ogokorera abanto b’Ebisaku, emeremo y’obokuani ase okorandia enchiri ya Nyasae, erinde ekeng’wanso kiabo giancherwe, gechenwe n’Omoika Omochenu.

English: For I certify to you, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nataka mjue kwamba Injili niliyowahubiria haikutokana na wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Naki nimbamanyie inwe abaminto, ng’a enchiri eye nabaranderetie tiyarwete ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
Kiswahili: Alijulisha Mose njia zake, na wana wa Israeli matendo yake.
Ekegusii: Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.

English: From the descendants of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Pahath-Moabu: Adna, Kelali, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezaleli, Binui na Manase.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Pahati‐Moabu: Adina na Kelali, Benaya na Maaseya, Matania na Besaleli, Binui na Manase;

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana Mungu akamfanya mwanamke kutoka kwenye ule ubavu aliouchukua kutoka kwa huyo mwanaume, akamleta huyo mwanamke kwa huyo mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia omokungu korwa ase orobaru akamoirera omonto oria.

English: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
Kiswahili: Akamchukua Agagi, mfalme wa Waamaleki akiwa hai, nao watu wake wote akawaangamiza kabisa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Akabwata Agagi, omorwoti bw'Abaameleki, akamotiga ore moyo, korende abande bonsi pi akabaita n'emioro.

English: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don't harm yourself, for we are all here!”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akapiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, akasema, “Usijidhuru kwa maana sisi sote tuko hapa!”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaaka eriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tibweita, ekiagera intwe twensi nao tore aa.”

English: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.'”
Kiswahili: Lakini wao watajibu, ‘Hakuna faida. Tutaendelea na mipango yetu wenyewe, kila mmoja wetu atafuata ukaidi wa moyo wake mbaya.' ”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo mbateebe: Ayio namang'ana abosa. Ntoganetie tokore buna torengereretie, kera oyomo nigo arabwatie obomwenu bw'enkoro yaye embe.”
