English: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa ameketi kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni, wanafunzi wake wakamjia faraghani, wakamuuliza, “Tuambie, mambo haya yatatukia lini, nayo dalili ya kuja kwako na ya mwisho wa dunia ni gani?”
Ekegusii: Gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera bobisi, bakamoboria, “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Naende ninki ekemanyererio ki’ogocha kwao, na ay’omoerio bw’ense?”

English: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa katika Kristo mmetajirishwa kwa kila hali, katika kusema kwenu na katika maarifa yenu yote,
Ekegusii: Ase kera enchera mogatenenkigwa ime asare ase chinkwana chionsi, ne chisemi chionsi,

English: As for you, however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi, miili yenu itaanguka katika jangwa hili.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo morakwere aiga ase erooro, na emebere yaino esirere aiga.

English: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads. Worship of the Creator
Kiswahili: Kukizunguka hicho kiti cha enzi palikuwa na viti vingine vya enzi ishirini na vinne, na juu ya hivyo viti walikuwa wameketi wazee ishirini na wanne. Walivaa mavazi meupe, na walikuwa na taji za dhahabu vichwani mwao.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’obonene nigo giaetananire nebirogo emerongo ebere na bine bi’obonene, na ase ebirogo biria mbarengeo abagaaka emerongo ebere na baane baikaransete, babeekeire chianga chindabu. Ase emetwe yabo mbarenge ne chigutwa chi’echitaabu.

English: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, amuru uwezo wako, Ee Mungu tuonyeshe nguvu zako, kama ulivyofanya hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia okobua kwao; ee Nyasae, ayio gwatokoreire, genderera koyabeka chinguru.

English: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are'?
Kiswahili: Je, wewe hutuma umeme wa radi kwenye njia zake? Je, hutoa taarifa kwako kukuambia, ‘Sisi tuko hapa'?
Ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigoteebie: Ee, nao tore aa?

English: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.
Kiswahili: Gideoni mwana wa Yoashi akarudi kutoka vitani kwa kupitia Mwinuko wa Heresi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, airanete korwa ase esegi agaetera ebitirimboko bia Heresi,

English: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise— apply your mind to my knowledge—
Kiswahili: Tega sikio na usikie misemo ya wenye hekima, elekeza moyo wako kwenye yale nifundishayo,
Ekegusii: Tega ogoto kwao oigwe amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana, na obeke amorokererio ane ime ase enkoro yao.

English: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Naftali, Nabi mwana wa Wofsi;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Nabi, mosinto o Bofasi;

English: his workmanship will be evident, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will prove the quality of each man’s work.
Kiswahili: kazi yake itaonekana ilivyo, kwa kuwa Siku ile itaidhihirisha. Itadhihirishwa kwa moto, nao moto utapima ubora wa kazi ya kila mtu.
Ekegusii: emeremo ya kera omonto ing’a eorokigwe maiso marore. Naki Rituko erio inariyeorokie, ekiagera narioroke nomorero; na omorero oyio noteeme emeremo ya kera omonto ng’a naki ere.

English: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli waniletee sadaka. Utapokea sadaka kwa niaba yangu kutoka kwa kila mtu ambaye moyo wake wapenda kutoa.
Ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a bandetere ebiegwa; aye obisangererie korwa ase kera omonto oyoranche kobirua ase ’nde.

English: “‘This will be the sign to you,' says Yahweh, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.'
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hii itakuwa ndiyo ishara kwenu kwamba nitawaadhibu mahali hapa, asema Bwana, ili mpate kujua kuwa onyo langu la madhara dhidi yenu hakika litatimizwa.'
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire iga: Eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio ase more, ng'a nimbae egesusuro aase aiga, erinde monyare komanya ng'a amang'ana aane nabe okobarentera amabe.

English: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi yake Daudi akamwandikia Yoabu barua, akamtuma Uria kuipeleka.
Ekegusii: Bogakia mambia, Daudi akarikera Yoabu riruube, akaa Uria amoirere.

English: One courier races to meet another, and messenger follows messenger, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from end to end.
Kiswahili: Tarishi mmoja humfuata mwingine, na mjumbe humfuata mjumbe, kumtangazia mfalme wa Babeli kwamba mji wake wote umetekwa,
Ekegusii: Omominyoki oyomo naminyoke aumerane noyonde, na omotomwa oyomo naminyoke aumerane noyonde, kogenda goteebia omorwoti o Babiloni ng’a omochie obwatirwe ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi,

English: and the Horites in the area of Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is near the desert.
Kiswahili: na Wahori katika nchi ya kilima cha Seiri, hadi El-Parani karibu na jangwa.
Ekegusii: n’Abahori ase egetunwa Edomu goika Eli-Parani ore ang’e nerooro.

English: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.
Kiswahili: Gehazi alipofika kwenye kilima, akavichukua vile vitu kutoka kwa wale watumishi na kuvificha ndani ya nyumba. Akawaaga wale watu, nao wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete agwo ase ekegoro, Gehasi akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabibeeka nyomba ime. Erio agatiga abanto baria bakagenda.

English: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata wakawasili Kaisaria. Kornelio alikuwa akiwangoja pamoja na jamaa yake na marafiki zake wa karibu.
Ekegusii: Rituko rigotunya erio bagasoa Kaisaria. Na Kornelio nigo arenge obaganyete, konya osangereirie eamate yaye amo nabanchi baye.

English: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usimlaani kiziwi, wala usiweke kikwazo mbele ya kipofu, lakini umche Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koragereria omonto omotino, gose kobeeka ekegocha bosio bw’omonto omouko, korende omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: Don't listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;' for they prophesy a lie to you.
Kiswahili: Msiyasikilize maneno ya manabii wanaowaambia kwamba, ‘Hamtamtumikia mfalme wa Babeli,' kwa sababu wanawatabiria uongo.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa koigwera amang'ana 'ababani abwo bakobateebia ng'a: Timokorera omorwoti o Babiloni. Ase ogoteeba igo, obwo noborimo.

English: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”
Kiswahili: Je, ni mara ngapi zaidi wakati watu waovu wamemuua mtu asiye na hatia akiwa ndani ya nyumba yake mwenyewe na kwenye kitanda chake mwenyewe? Je, sasa nisidai damu yake mikononi mwenu na kuwaondoa duniani?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Tari bobe mono kobua, ekero abanto ababe baitire omonyaboronge karaire borere nyomba mwaye? Tinkomoruseria egesiomba na gosiria abwo bamoitire korwa ase ense?”

English: In the third year of his reign, Xerxes held a feast for all his officials and servants. The military leaders of Persia and Media were there, along with the nobles and princes of the provinces.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wake, alifanya karamu kwa ajili ya wakuu wake wote pamoja na maafisa. Akawaalika viongozi wa jeshi wa Uajemi na Umedi, wana wa wafalme na wakuu wa majimbo.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwaye agakora omoyega omonene ase abanene bonsi amo nabatang’ani abarenge ase obogambi bwaye. Akarangeria abatang’ani b’abasikari b’Abaayemi, na ab’Abamedia, na abanene amo nabagaambi be chingongo chiaye.

English: Joab and all Israel had stayed there six months, until he had killed every male in Edom.
Kiswahili: Yoabu na Waisraeli wote walikaa huko kwa miezi sita, mpaka walipomaliza kuwaangamiza wanaume wote huko Edomu.
Ekegusii: Joabu amo na Abaisraeli bonsi baarenge komo bagatigara agwo Edomu ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo, bagaita na gosiria kegima kera omosacha bw’aroro.

English: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mama yake akakataa na kusema, “Hapana! Jina lake ataitwa Yohana.”
Ekegusii: korende ng'ina akairaneria, akabora, “Taibo; nigo ararokwe Yohana.”

English: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
Kiswahili: Yule kijana aliposikia hayo, akaenda zake kwa huzuni, kwa sababu alikuwa na mali nyingi. Hatari Za Utajiri
Ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ring’ana riria, omomura oria akagenda nobororo, ekiagera arenge neniibo enyinge.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Moyo wa Farao ni mgumu, anakataa kuwaachia watu kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Farao okong’irie enkoro yaye, bwangire koa abanto aba ribaga bagende.

English: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
Kiswahili: Wakaweka mashahidi wa uongo ambao walishuhudia wakisema, “Mtu huyu kamwe haachi kusema dhidi ya mahali hapa patakatifu na dhidi ya Sheria.
Ekegusii: Bagatenenia kirori b'oborimo abaare goteeba: “Omonto oyo tatigeti gokwana bobe igoro y'aase Aa Aachenu na igoro y'amachiiko.

English: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
Kiswahili: Kama vitundu vilivyojaa ndege, nyumba zao zimejaa udanganyifu; wamekuwa matajiri na wenye nguvu,
Ekegusii: Buna koreng'ana egesera geichire ne chinyoni, naboigo ne chinyomba chiabo chiaichoire n'ebinto bisakoire; ase engencho eyio babeire ne chinguru, na abanda mono.

English: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Siku zinakuja, nitakapomwinulia Daudi Tawi lenye haki, Mfalme atakayetawala kwa hekima, na kutenda lililo haki na sawa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero ndasebokie oyomo ore Omoseboka omooronge o Daudi. Oyio nabe omorwoti, oragambe nobong'aini na konacha ebiina bi'ekeene na ebi'oboronge ase ense.

English: Then Boaz took ten of the elders of the city and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.
Kiswahili: Boazi akatwaa watu kumi miongoni mwa wazee wa mji, akawaambia, “Ketini hapa.” Nao wakaketi.
Ekegusii: Naende Boazi akarangeria abagaaka ikomi b’omochie baikaranse aroro, ase igo bagaikaransa.

English: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi kilivyo kina cha utajiri wa hekima na maarifa ya Mungu! Tazama jinsi ambavyo hukumu zake hazichunguziki, na ambavyo njia zake zisivyotafutikana!
Ekegusii: Aa! Obonge bw’obonda, na obong’aini, ne chisemi bire ase Nyasae! Tibikorengeka. Ebiina biaye tibikomanyekana ne chinchera chiaye tichikoriigeka!

English: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake. The First Four Trumpets
Kiswahili: Kisha yule malaika akachukua kile chetezo, akakijaza moto kutoka kwa yale madhabahu, akautupa juu ya dunia. Pakatokea sauti za radi, ngurumo, umeme wa radi na tetemeko la ardhi. Tarumbeta Ya Kwanza
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika akabogoria egetaabo, akageichoria omorero korwa ase egesasiimero akayoruta igoro ase ense, na agwo bikaba ogoaka gw’enkoba, na okogukura, na okomesa, na omotengecho bw’ense. Ebitureeri

English: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
Kiswahili: Uliweka kando ghadhabu yako yote na umegeuka na kuiacha hasira yako kali.
Ekegusii: Boigo ngwatigete koba nekeririanda, ngwatigete kegima kogechigwa nabarabwo.

English: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are fragrant firs.
Kiswahili: Nguzo za nyumba yetu ni mierezi, na mapao yetu ni miberoshi.
Ekegusii: Ebisigisa bi’enyomba yaito nebi’emecharake, ne chindote nechi’emetarakwa.

English: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
Kiswahili: Kisha akachukua ile mikate saba na wale samaki, naye akiisha kumshukuru Mungu, akavimega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, nao wakawapa ule umati wa watu.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano n'ebere, ne chinswe chiria. Ekero airaneirie ng'a mbuya mono, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, na barabwo bakayea emeganda eria.

English: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamleta kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Erio akarenta emingichi ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa, na Aroni amo nabamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo ase omotwe bw'emingichi eyio.

English: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
Kiswahili: Lakini hapatakuwa na unywele mmoja wa kichwa chenu utakaoangamia.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nagatukia akamo k’emetwe yaino tikagosira.

English: Without a commander, without an overseer or ruler,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye hana msimamizi, wala mwangalizi, au mtawala,
Ekegusii: Aro tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,

English: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
Kiswahili: Eneo lao lilienea toka Aroeri, iliyoko ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, likijumlisha nchi ya uwanda wa juu wote wa Medeba mpaka Diboni,
Ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,

English: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard (Exodus 38:9–20)
Kiswahili: Tengeneza madhabahu yawe na uvungu ndani yake ukitumia mbao. Utaitengeneza sawasawa na vile ulivyoonyeshwa mlimani. Ua Wa Kukutania (Kutoka 38:9-20)
Ekegusii: Egesasiimero keagachwe ne chibao, ime getigwe giasaime. Okeroisie buna kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.” Eraaro y’Obomenyo (Okong’ 38:9-20)

English: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu, hatutaki mkose kujua kuhusu wale waliolala mauti, ili msihuzunike kama watu wengine wasiokuwa na tumaini.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, titorigeti ng’a timomanya amang’ana igoro y’abwo bararire, mobaise goichanigwa buna abande abatari nogosemeria.

English: If the ox gores a son or a daughter, it shall be done to him according to the same rule.
Kiswahili: Sheria hii pia itatumika ikiwa fahali atampiga kwa pembe mwana au binti.
Ekegusii: Onye eng’ombe egoita omomura gose omoiseke ne ching’unchara chiaye, ogochika nakwo okwo okomo.

English: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Sisera alikuwa na magari ya chuma yapatayo 900, naye alikuwa amewatesa Waisraeli kwa ukatili kwa muda wa miaka ishirini, Waisraeli wakamlilia Bwana wakaomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Yabini nigo abwate chigari chi'ebioma amagana kianda. Ere agachaanda Abaisraeli mono ase obotindi obonene ase engaki y'emiaka emerongo ebere, n'Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene abakoonye.

English: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
Kiswahili: ili moyo wangu uweze kukusifu na usikae kimya. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru milele.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.

English: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume anayeomba au kutoa unabii akiwa amefunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Kera omosacha kagosaba gose gakobana, na ere nare negento atubete omotwe oye, igo tasigeti omotwe oye.

English: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
Kiswahili: Ili tusiwe tena watoto wachanga, tukitupwatupwa huku na huku na kuchukuliwa na kila upepo wa mafundisho kwa hila za watu, kwa ujanja, kwa kufuata njia zao za udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: erinde titoba naende abana ebing’werere, bagotumatumigwa aaria na aaria, na koirurukigwa ase kera embeo y’okworokereria, ase obong’ainereria bw’abaanto, ekero bakobang’aina kobwatia chiinchera chi’okobasiria.

English: Because you have said, “Yahweh has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”
Kiswahili: Mnaweza mkasema, “Bwana ameinua manabii kwa ajili yetu huku Babeli,”
Ekegusii: “Aya naro narikire, ekiagera inwe mwateebire ng'a Omonene obaeire ababani agwo ase ense ya Babiloni.

English: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
Kiswahili: Je, mmekuwa mkifikiri kwamba sisi tunajaribu kujitetea mbele yenu? Sisi tumekuwa tukinena mbele za Mungu kama wale walio katika Kristo. Na chochote tufanyacho, ndugu wapendwa, ni kwa ajili ya kuwatia nguvu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng'a iga togwekengera ase more naende? Ase obosio bwa Nyasae nigo togokwana ase Kristo. Na aya onsi akorirwe ase okobaagacha inwe abanchwa.

English: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwapa watu wake nguvu; Bwana huwabariki watu wake kwa kuwapa amani.
Ekegusii: Omonene nae abanto baye chinguru, naende abasesenie ase okobaa omorembe.

English: And God said, “Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nafasi kati ya maji igawe maji na maji.”
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga oboiko bobe egati‐gati y’amaache, erio bwatanane amaache korwa ase amaache ande.”

English: He arranged them as a great multitude is ordered for the war.
Kiswahili: Aliwapanga kadri umati mkubwa ulivyoamriwa kwa ajili ya vita.
Ekegusii: Akabaroberia ase ebika na kobabeeka ang'e ase esegi.

English: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them, yet they do not return to the LORD their God; despite all this, they do not seek Him.
Kiswahili: Kiburi cha Israeli kinashuhudia dhidi yake, lakini pamoja na haya yote harudi kwa Bwana Mungu wake wala kumtafuta.
Ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli bwababereire kirori. Nonya naboigo, tibari komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae obo, gose komorigia.

English: So the king set out with all the people following him. He stopped at the last house,
Kiswahili: Hivyo mfalme akaondoka, pamoja na watu wote wakimfuata, wakatua mahali mbali kiasi.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akageenderera gotama, na abanto bonsi bakamotunyana korwa magega; bakaratenena ake ase enyomba yarenge ensinyo.

English: Israel took for themselves only the cattle and plunder of that city, as the LORD had commanded Joshua.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli wakajichukulia mifugo na nyara za mji huu, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Yoshua.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira chitugo na ebinto binde basakorete bikaba ebiabo, buna Omonene atebeetie Yoshua.

English: And with Solomon, the king has sent Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, and they have set him on the king’s mule.
Kiswahili: Mfalme amemtuma pamoja naye kuhani Sadoki, nabii Nathani, Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada, Wakerethi na Wapelethi, nao wamempandisha juu ya nyumbu wa mfalme,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti otomire amo nere Zadoki Omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti, nabarabwo bariinirie Sulemani ase ebarasi y’omorwoti.

English: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers' households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wakazunguka katika Yuda yote na kukusanya Walawi na viongozi wa jamaa za Israeli kutoka miji yote. Walipofika Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase ense yonsi y'Abayuda, bagasangereria Abalawi korwa ase emechie yonsi y'Abayuda amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi'Abaisraeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

English: Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs, and next to him, Hananiah son of the perfumer made repairs. They fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
Kiswahili: Uzieli mwana wa Harhaya, mmoja wa masonara, alikarabati sehemu iliyofuatia, naye Hanania mmoja wa watengenezaji marashi akakarabati sehemu iliyofuatia. Walitengeneza Yerusalemu mpaka kufikia Ukuta Mpana.
Ekegusii: Oyobwatetie abwo koagacha, nere Usieli, mosinto o Harahaya, oyomo bw’abaturi be chifeta. Oyo omobwatetie koagacha nere Hanania, oyomo bw’abaroisia amaguta akweakwa, agotioka buya. Abwo bakaagacha Yerusalemu goikera aase are korokwa Orwaki Oronetu.

English: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.
Kiswahili: “Nilipoendelea kutazama, “viti vya enzi vikawekwa, naye Mzee wa Siku akaketi. Mavazi yake yalikuwa meupe kama theluji; nywele za kichwa chake zilikuwa nyeupe kama sufu. Kiti chake cha enzi kilikuwa kinawaka kwa miali ya moto, nayo magurudumu yake yote yalikuwa yanawaka moto.
Ekegusii: “Ekero narigereretie 'nkarora ebirogo bi'obonene bigoterekwa, na omonto omokoro bw'amatuko amaange agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye. Chianga chiaye nigo chiarenge chindabu se se, na etukia y'omotwe oye nigo yarenge endabu buna amarionya y'eng'ondi endabu asibirie; ekerogo kiaye ki'obonene nigo kiarenge chimeme chi'omorero ogwoka, na amagoro y'ekerogo ekio nigo arenge omorero ogwoka.

English: Their slain will be left unburied, and the stench of their corpses will rise; the mountains will flow with their blood.
Kiswahili: Waliouawa watatupwa nje, maiti zao zitatoa uvundo, milima itatota kwa damu zao.
Ekegusii: Emebere y’abanto baraitwe nigo eratugutwe isiko, na ogotioka kw’obogundo bw’ebitondo ebio nigo koratioke aande onsi; amanyinga ’emebere eyio natirimboke korwa ase ebitunwa igoro.

English: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.
Kiswahili: Watu wakamtumikia Bwana siku zote za maisha ya Yoshua, na za hao wazee walioishi baada ya Yoshua kufa, waliokuwa wameona mambo makuu ambayo Bwana alikuwa ametenda kwa ajili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakaba bakomokorera Omonene ase amatuko a Yoshua, na ase amatuko y'abagaaka abatigarete magega y'ogokwa kwaye, abwo barooche ogokora okwo okonene Nyasae abakorerete Abaisraeli.

English: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
Kiswahili: Hapakuwahi kuwepo na adhimisho lingine la Pasaka kama hilo tangu nyakati za Waamuzi walioongoza Israeli, wala katika nyakati zote za wafalme wa Israeli na wafalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri'Epasaka buna eri konya tiriana koinyorwa korwa ase amatuko 'abagaambi, baria bagamberete Abaisraeli, gose ase amatuko onsi ay'abarwoti b'Abaisraeli, gose ay'abarwoti b'Abayuda.

English: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wa wote wenye mwili. Je, kuna jambo lolote lililo gumu nisiloliweza?
Ekegusii: “Rora, inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae bw’abaanto bonsi. Inee! Egento nkere gensinyete?

English: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
Kiswahili: Nami kama Baba yangu alivyonipa ufalme, kadhalika mimi nami ninawapa ninyi,
Ekegusii: na inche nabaeire inwe oborwoti buna Tata ang’ete,

English: While they were trying to kill him, the commander of the Roman regiment received a report that all Jerusalem was in turmoil.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakitaka kumuua, habari zikamfikia jemadari wa jeshi la askari wa Kirumi kwamba mji wa Yerusalemu wote ulikuwa katika machafuko.
Ekegusii: Ekero bateemire komoita, amang’ana agaikera omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu ng’a omochie omogima o Yerusalemu osarekire.

English: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Umetimiza maneno uliyosema dhidi yetu na dhidi ya watawala wetu, kwa kuleta maafa makubwa juu yetu. Chini ya mbingu yote kamwe hapajatendeka kitu kama kile kilichotendeka kwa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Gwaikeranirie amang'ana ao, ayio gwakwanete ase tore, na ase abagaambi baria barenge gotogaambera, ase ogotorentera amaakwa amanene. Inse y'erioba ayio akorekanire ase Yerusalemu tana gokorekana aande.

English: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
Kiswahili: Mbwa mwitu ataishi pamoja na mwana-kondoo, naye chui atalala pamoja na mbuzi, ndama, mwana simba na ngʼombe wa mwaka mmoja watakaa pamoja, naye mtoto mdogo atawaongoza.
Ekegusii: Esese y'orosana nemenye amo nemaanwa y'eng'ondi, na engo neraare amo nemaanwa y'embori; emori, na endo, na eng'ombe enoru nachibe chikogosoria amo, na omwana omoke nabe ogochiraa.

English: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
Kiswahili: Umefanya maisha yangu mafupi kama pumzi; muda wangu wa kuishi ni kama hauna thamani kwako. Maisha ya kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi.
Ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko kwang’ete nameng’e mono. Engaki y’obogima bwane nigo ere buna teri gento ase obosio bwao. Amaene, kera omonto, nonya bwetenenerete bokong’u, nigo agoeta bwango buna omwaga.

English: Then the man brought me back to the gate that faces east,
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mtu akanileta kwenye lango linaloelekea upande wa mashariki,
Ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akang’ira goika ase egeita kiarochie moocha.

English: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
Kiswahili: Hunipa ngao yako ya ushindi, unajishusha chini ili kuniinua.
Ekegusii: “Aye kwang'eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.

English: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Tengeneza visu vya mawe magumu sana na uwatahiri Waisraeli tena.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Roisia emeyio emioge y'amagena ochake kwarokia Abaisraeli naende.”

English: a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and the rain.
Kiswahili: Utakuwa sitara na kivuli kutokana na joto la mchana, na kuwa mahali pa kujificha kutokana na dhoruba na mvua.
Ekegusii: Ekiriri ’nkebeo ki’ogokenderera korwa ase omobaso, naende kebe obotamero na oborendi bw’ogwekengera korwa ase embura y’omoubera.

English: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
Kiswahili: Basi, sisi ndugu zangu, ni kama Isaki, tu watoto wa ahadi.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe nigo more abana b'eira buna Isaka.

English: Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
Kiswahili: Epusha kinywa chako na ukaidi; weka mazungumzo machafu mbali na midomo yako.
Ekegusii: Tuguta chinkwana chi’obokorekanu korwa ase omonwa oo, na amang’ana y’obong’ainereria korwa ase ebikoba biao.

English: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
Kiswahili: akaona mashua mbili ukingoni mwa ziwa, zikiwa zimeachwa hapo na wavuvi waliokuwa wanaosha nyavu zao.
Ekegusii: Akarora amaato abere ateneine engegu y'enyancha, na abarubi basokire korwa aroro, ngosibia bare ebionga biabo.

English: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
Kiswahili: Inuka, lia usiku, zamu za usiku zianzapo; mimina moyo wako kama maji mbele za Bwana. Mwinulie yeye mikono yako kwa ajili ya maisha ya watoto wako, ambao wanazimia kwa njaa kwenye kila mwanzo wa barabara.
Ekegusii: Imoka, orere botuko bokie! Ekero oborendi bw'obotuko bogochaka, oumore ayare ase enkoro yao ime ase obosio bw'Omonene, buna okoumora amaache! Rambora amaboko ao asare osabere obogima bw'abana bao, abwo bagoyire nenchara ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.

English: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;
Kiswahili: “Kama vazi lolote lina maambukizo ya upele: likiwa ni vazi la sufu au kitani,
Ekegusii: “Onye ukoma bore ase eanga eroisirie korwa ase amarionya gose egatani,

English: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer's inkhorn by his side.
Kiswahili: Basi utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ukaondoka hapo juu ya makerubi, ulikokuwa umekaa, ukaenda kwenye kizingiti cha Hekalu. Ndipo Bwana akamwita yule mtu aliyevaa kitani safi aliyekuwa na vifaa vya mwandishi akiwa amevishikilia upande wake mmoja,
Ekegusii: Obonene bwa Nyasae bw'Abaiisraeli konya bwaimokereire igoro korwa ase egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, agwo ase bwarenge, bokagenda ase omoriibo o inse bw'egesieri ki'enyomba eria. Erio Nyasae akarangeria omonto oria obegete eanga y'egatani bweboeranetie ekaramu akoriikera,

English: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
Kiswahili: “Nakuambia, inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
Ekegusii: “Nagotebirie, imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”

English: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
Kiswahili: Ahazia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala katika Yerusalemu kwa mwaka mmoja. Mama yake aliitwa Athalia, mjukuu wa Omri.
Ekegusii: Ahasia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba omwaka oyomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Atalia, omochokoro bw’Omuri.

English: There is one who is hindered from sinning through lack. When he rests, he will not be troubled.
Kiswahili: Kuna mtu ambaye amezuiwa kutenda dhambi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa chakula. Anapopumzika, hatasumbuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero emebayeno ekorwa ase omonto omoriri teri gwancheranwa, ekiagera teri gokwanwa ase engaki egwenerete.

English: And Abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Abramu alikuwa tajiri sana wa mifugo, fedha na dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Nabo Aburamu areenge omotenenku mono, nigo abwate etugo enyinge, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu.

English: But as soon as they had rest, they again did evil in Your sight. So You abandoned them to the hands of their enemies, who had dominion over them. When they cried out to You again, You heard from heaven, and You delivered them many times in Your compassion.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mara walipokuwa na raha, wakafanya maovu tena machoni pako. Kisha ukawaacha mikononi mwa adui zao, nao wakawatawala. Walipokulilia tena, ukasikia kutoka mbinguni, na kwa huruma zako ukawaokoa kila mara.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya banyorire obotoereru, bagakora ebibe asore naende; aye ogatiga ababisa babo bakababua na kobagambera. Nonya naboigo, ekero barenge gokoiranera na korera asore, nigo kwarenge kobaigwa korwa agwo igoro, na ase engencho y’amaabera ao amange nigo kwabeete gokobatooria ase chingaki chinyinge.

English: It is better not to vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali usiweke nadhiri kuliko kuiweka na usiitimize.
Ekegusii: Mbuya toria eira kobua koria eira na toyeikerania.

English: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akinena kwa lugha, basi waseme watu wawili au watatu si zaidi, mmoja baada ya mwingine na lazima awepo mtu wa kutafsiri.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, bakwane babere gose batato boka, korende kera omonto ase ribaga riaye, na oyomo aonchore.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Mataifa mengi na wakazi wa miji mingi watakuja,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: Engaki ngocha ere, ekero abanto abange bararue ase emechie emenge, bache aa.

English: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
Kiswahili: “Lakini baba yake akawaambia watumishi, ‘Leteni upesi joho lililo bora sana, tieni pete kidoleni mwake na viatu miguuni mwake.
Ekegusii: Korende ise agateebia abasomba baye: Renta bwango eganchwa ere engiya, momobekere; mobekere nebonyi ase ekiara kiaye, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aye.

English: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana katika Roho mmoja wote tulibatizwa katika mwili mmoja, kama ni Wayahudi au Wayunani, kama ni watumwa au watu huru, nasi sote tulinyweshwa Roho mmoja.
Ekegusii: Naki ase Omoika oyomo intwe twensi tokabatiswa, tokaba omobere oyomo, nonya tore Abayahudi, gose tore Abagiriki, onye tore abasomba, gose tore abasibore; intwe twensi nigo twanyoisetigwe Omoika oyomo.

English: Because he has despised Yahweh's word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu amelidharau neno la Bwana na kuvunja amri zake, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali; hatia yake inabaki juu yake.' ”
Ekegusii: Oyio ochaayire ring'ana ri'Omonene, naende osaririe ogochika kwaye, takororerwa amaabera. Goika aatananwe kegima, nere abarerwe ebibe biaye.”

English: “Call out if you please, but who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
Kiswahili: “Ita kama unataka, lakini ni nani atakayekujibu? Ni yupi kati ya hao watakatifu utakayemgeukia?
Ekegusii: Bono rangeria! Inee! Onde nareo oragoitabere? Ase abwo abachenu, ning’o oraonchokere?

English: A fool is ungracious and abusive. The gift of a grudging person consumes the eyes.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hana huruma na ni mnyanyasaji. Zawadi ya mtu mwenye kinyongo humeza macho.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoriri, ere n'omoiti. Ekeegwa kiomonto omochayi, nigo kegotuba amaiso.

English: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;' however Yahweh has shown me that he will surely die.”
Kiswahili: Elisha akajibu, “Nenda ukamwambie, ‘Hakika utapona'; lakini Bwana amenifunulia kwamba kweli atakufa.”
Ekegusii: Elisha akamoiraneria, “Omonene nigo anyorokirie ng'a ere goika akwe, korende genda omoteebie ng'a ekeene nagwene.”

English: Now listen to them, but you must solemnly warn them and show them the manner of the king who will reign over them.” Samuel’s Warning
Kiswahili: Sasa wasikilize, lakini waonye kwa makini na uwafahamishe yale watakayotendewa na mfalme atakayewatawala.”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono, igwera amang’ana abo, korende obakuurere mono, obateebie aya omorwoti orache kobagaambera arabe ogokora.”

English: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atatoa mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, na mwingine kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa sababu ametenda dhambi kwa kuwepo mbele ya maiti. Siku iyo hiyo atakiweka wakfu kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arue riruma erimo ribe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na erinde eki'ogosambwa ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Omwerwa oria, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase ogoika ang'e negetondo. Ase rituko erio erio omonto oria achene omotwe oye,

English: “Blessed are they whose lawless acts are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
Kiswahili: “Wamebarikiwa wale ambao wamesamehewa makosa yao, ambao dhambi zao zimefunikwa.
Ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abaabeirwe ebibe biabo, abwo ebibe biabo biatubirwe.

English: They didn't depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.
Kiswahili: Nao hawakuziacha amri za mfalme alizoamuru makuhani au Walawi katika jambo lolote, ikiwa ni pamoja na zile za hazina.
Ekegusii: Bono emeremo yonsi Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y'Omonene, korwa okobekwa kw'oboroso goika ogoikeranigwa kw'oboagacho, ekaera. Igo enyomba y'Omonene ekaba eikeranete.

English: But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon. We demolished them as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba. ” The Defeat of Og (Deuteronomy 3:1–11)
Kiswahili: “Lakini tumewashinda; Heshboni umeharibiwa hadi Diboni. Tumebomoa hadi kufikia Nofa, ulioenea hadi Medeba.”
Ekegusii: Intwe twabarasire chinsara; Abahesiboni basiriigwe, twabaitire goika Diboni. Tokabasiria goika Nofa na korwa Nofa goika Medeba.”

English: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
Kiswahili: na useme: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi ni kinyume nawe, ee mlima Seiri, nami nitanyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yako na kukufanya ukiwa na usiyekaliwa na watu wala kulimika.
Ekegusii: ogeteebie ng'a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Aye Egetunwa gia Edomu, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro yao, ngosarie obe bosa.

English: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapita katika Galilaya yote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge kona goetanana ase ense engima ya Galili, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang'ana amaya y'oborwoti, okogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi obwarenge ase abanto.

English: That day, all Demane had managed to trap was a hive full of bees. He carried them in a thick bag slung over his shoulder. When he came to the cave, he found the door open and his sister gone. But there were ashes pointing the way into the woods. He followed the ash along the path until he saw a fire in the distance.
Kiswahili: Demane aliona jitu lililojaa nywele limeketi karibu na moto. Mfuko mkubwa ulikuwa karibu naye. Alisongea karibu na jitu hilo akijifanya anachechemea kama mtu aliyeumia mguu. “Tafadhali baba,” Demane alisema, “naomba unisaidie. Nimeumia mguu. Naomba maji ya kunywa.” Jitu likasema, “Ngoja nikuletee maji lakini usiguse mfuko wangu. Jitu lilisema huku likiweka mfuko ule vizuri ndani ya nyumba.
Ekegusii: Ang'e nomorero oria omosacha omoneene omerete etukia omobere bwensi naikaransete aroro negunia eneene kere ensemo. Demane agatara mbaka as'are kagosogora buna oria oumiete.. “Gaki tata one, nonkonye? Naumiire okogoro kwane. Inkonye amache yokonywa.” Omosacha oria akairaneria, “Nigo indakoretere amache rioka ekero orang'eneki na kong'a oboene buna togokuna gunia yane.” akagacha egunia eria buuya nyomba mwaye.

English: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
Kiswahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi,
Ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Ahimasi;

English: I ask instead, did Israel not understand? First, Moses says: “I will make you jealous by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation without understanding.”
Kiswahili: Nami nauliza tena: Je, Waisraeli hawakuelewa? Kwanza, Mose asema, “Nitawafanya mwe na wivu kwa watu wale ambao si taifa. Nitawakasirisha kwa taifa lile lisilo na ufahamu.”
Ekegusii: Naende nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Abaisraeli tibamanyete? Agwo ritang’ani Musa nigo agoteeba, “Nimbakore mobe ne ribero ase abanto batari egesaku, ase egesaku kere ekeriri nigo ndababeeyie.”

English: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
Kiswahili: Twekeni bendera juu ya mlima usio na kitu, wapazieni sauti, wapungieni mkono waingie katika malango ya wenye heshima.
Ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera igoro ase egetunwa getari na mete; aka eriogi rinene ase abasikari, basime namaboko basoe ase ebiita bi'abaanto abasike.

English: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
Kiswahili: nilikuwa mpumbavu na mjinga, nilikuwa mnyama mkatili mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabeete omoriri mono, tinamanya gento; nkaba buna eng’iti y’orosana ase obosio bwao.

English: and give you all a heart to worship him and do his will with a strong heart and a willing soul.
Kiswahili: na kuwapa nyote moyo wa kumwabudu na kufanya mapenzi yake kwa moyo imara na roho iliyo tayari.
Ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae abae okogania gw'okomosasiima na gokora okogania kwaye ase omoyo bw'okwerwa.

English: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
Kiswahili: Mwone nchi ni ya namna gani, na kama watu waishio humo wana nguvu au ni wadhaifu, iwapo ni wachache au wengi.
Ekegusii: Morigererie buna ense eria ere, naende morore gose abanto bareo 'mbare ne chinguru, gose naboro bare, gose nabake, gose nabange.

English: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: Nami bado nina tumaini hili: nitauona wema wa Bwana katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: Naenekirie ng’a nindore obuya bw’ Omonene; ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.

English: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
Kiswahili: Nami nitafanya kila juhudi kuona kwamba baada ya kuondoka kwangu mtaweza kuyakumbuka mambo haya siku zote.
Ekegusii: Na inche ninkore omokia ng'a botambe magega y'ogokwa kwane monyare koinyora amang'ana aya.

English: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
Kiswahili: Waelezeni watoto wenu, na watoto wenu wawaambie watoto wao, na watoto wao kwa kizazi kitakachofuata.
Ekegusii: Yateebie abana baino amang'ana aya, na abana baino bayateebie abana babo, na abana babo bayateebie ekegori kende.

English: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD meant when He said: ‘To those who come near Me I will show My holiness, and in the sight of all the people I will reveal My glory.’” But Aaron remained silent.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Hili ndilo alilonena Bwana wakati aliposema: “ ‘Miongoni mwa wale watakaonikaribia nitajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu; machoni pa watu wote nitaheshimiwa.’ ” Aroni akanyamaza.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Aya nar’Omonene atebiire, ng’a ere neorokie koba omochenu ase abanto abwo bakomoika ang’e, na ase amaiso b’abaanto bonsi naorokie obonene bwaye.” Aroni agakira‐kiri.

English: Now when I had come home again, and my wife Anna was restored to me, and my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared for me, and I sat down to eat.
Kiswahili: Basi niliporudi nyumbani tena, na mke wangu Ana akarudishwa kwangu, na mwanangu Tobia, katika sikukuu ya Pentekoste, ambayo ni sikukuu takatifu ya majuma saba, chakula cha jioni kizuri kiliandaliwa kwa ajili yangu, nami nikaketi kula.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero nairanete inka bwone nkaegwa omokungu one Anna n'omwana one Tobia, ngakorerwa omoyega omonene ekero rituko ria Pentekosti riaigete erio riare rituko rinene ase chichuma isano na ibere. Ekero naikaransete ase emesa nigo narooche chindagera chinyinge chibeekire ase emesa eyio.

English: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe baba zetu waliweka tumaini lao, walikutumaini nawe ukawaokoa.
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.

English: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mafarisayo walipoona hayo wakaambiana, “Mnaona, hamwezi kufanya lolote. Angalieni, ulimwengu wote unamfuata yeye!”
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mwarorire ng'a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana.”

English: Nevertheless, because by this deed you have shown utter contempt for the word of the LORD, the son born to you will surely die.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu kwa kufanya hili umefanya adui za Bwana kuonyesha dharau kabisa, mwana atakayezaliwa kwako atakufa.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera gwakorire ayio kwagerire ababisa ba Omonene bamochaaye, omwana oria oraiborwe goika akwe.”

English: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
Kiswahili: Wakawauliza, “Je, huyu ni mtoto wenu, ambaye mnasema alizaliwa kipofu? Imekuwaje basi sasa anaona?”
Ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteeba ng'a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”

English: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”
Kiswahili: Kila mara pepo wachafu walipomwona, walianguka chini mbele yake na kupiga kelele wakisema, “Wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Na abanto barenge n’ebirecha bi’eubi bagachia komoorora, bakagwa ase obosio bwaye, bakarera bagateeba, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza kifuniko cha upatanisho cha dhahabu safi, chenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie ekemumeko gi’etaabu echenire kebe Oboikaranso bwa amaabera. Obotaambe bwaye bobe ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu waliotajwa kwa majina wakawachukua wale mateka na kutoka zile nyara, wakachukua mavazi wakawavika wale wafungwa wote waliokuwa uchi. Wakawapatia nguo na viatu, chakula na cha kunywa, wakawapa matibabu, wote waliokuwa dhaifu miongoni mwao wakawapandisha juu ya punda, wakawaleta ndugu zao mpaka Yeriko, ndio Mji wa Mitende, kisha wakarudi Samaria.
Ekegusii: Abanto amarieta abo atoretwe bakaimoka, bakaboyia baria boosetwe barenge gesobono, bakababeekera chianga na ebikoroto, bakabaa nendagera na ebinyugwa, bakabaaka namaguta. Naende bakariinia ase chitigere baria batarenge ne chinguru, bakaira baria bonsi boosetwe, amo nebisakorwa bionsi gochia Yeriko, Omochie bw'Emekendo, ase abamwabo bamenyete. Magega y'ayio bakairana Samaria.

English: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
Kiswahili: Tia mundu, kwa kuwa mavuno yamekomaa. Njooni, mkanyage zabibu, kwa kuwa shinikizo la kukamua zabibu limejaa na mapipa yanafurika: kwa kuwa uovu wao ni mkubwa!”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obobe bwabo bwabeire obonene, soyia emeyio chinkuro mogondo, mobagese, ekiagera rigesa riaikire. Soa ime mobatindache, buna ekemitero gi’edivai giaichoire. Chinyongo chiaichoire na goiteka

English: down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
Kiswahili: kupitia katikati ya barabara kuu ya huo mji. Kwenye kila upande wa huo mto kulikuwa na mti wa uzima utoao matunda ya aina kumi na mbili, ukizaa matunda yake kila mwezi. Nayo majani ya mti huo ni kwa ajili ya uponyaji wa mataifa.
Ekegusii: nigo rogoeta gati‐gati y’enchera enene y’omochie. Chinsemo chionsi ibere chi’orooche roria noreo omote bw’obogima, okwama amatunda aye ara ikomi na kabere; nigo okorua amatunda kera omotienyi, na amato ’omote oyio nigo akogwenia abanto b’ebisaku.

English: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”
Kiswahili: Atazikwa maziko ya punda: ataburutwa na kutupwa nje ya malango ya Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aratindekwe buna etigere egotindekwa. Nigo arakururwe atugutwe isiko y'ebiita bia Yerusalemu.”

English: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana niliwaonea wivu wenye kujivuna nilipoona kufanikiwa kwa waovu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ne ribero ase abanto abaenenu, ekero naroche ng’a abwo ababe nigo basesenirie.

English: When Anna died, he buried her with his father. But Tobias departed with his wife and his sons to Ecbatana to Raguel his father-in-law,
Kiswahili: Ana alipokufa, alimzika pamoja na baba yake. Lakini Tobia akaenda zake, pamoja na mkewe na wanawe, hadi Ekbatana kwa Ragueli, mkwewe.
Ekegusii: Ase egeka egeke mokaye nere agakwa. Tobia akamotindeka ang'e n'omosacha oye. Erio Tobia akaimokia mokaye n'abana baye bagachaaka orogendo gochia Media. Bakagenda Goika Ekbatana bakamenya aroro ase Ragueli ise biara Tobia.

English: At once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.”
Kiswahili: Yule binti akarudi haraka kwa mfalme, akamwambia, “Nataka unipe sasa hivi kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji kwenye sinia.”
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agasoa nomoayerero ase obosio bw’omorwoti, agasaba, akabora, “Nindigetie ong’e omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi bono iga ase esani.”

English: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
Kiswahili: Nusu ya fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani lilikuwa: Kondoo 337,500
Ekegusii: Ekeng'ese egiatungetie abarwani b'esegi nigo kiarenge: Ching'ondi amo ne chimbori chilifu amagana atato na merongo etato na isano ibere, na amagana atano (337,500).

English: Harness the horses; mount the steeds; take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears; put on armor!
Kiswahili: Fungieni farasi lijamu, pandeni farasi! Shikeni nafasi zenu mkiwa mmevaa chapeo! Isugueni mikuki yenu, vaeni dirii vifuani!
Ekegusii: Inwe abariini chibarasi beka chibarasi ang’e mochiriine. Beka ebigogwa biaino bi’ebioma, mwebeke ang’e, tieria amatimo aino. Beka chigoti chiaino chi’ebioma.

English: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana upumbavu wa Mungu una hekima zaidi kuliko hekima ya wanadamu, nao udhaifu wa Mungu una nguvu kuliko nguvu ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera oboriri bwa Nyasae mbore nobong'aini kobua obongaini bwa Mwanyabaanto, na oboreu bwa Nyasae mbore ne chinguru kobua echia Mwanyabaanto.

English: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
Kiswahili: Mnatamani lakini hampati, kwa hiyo mwaua. Mwatamani kupata lakini hampati vile mnavyotaka, kwa hiyo mnajitia katika magomvi na mapigano. Mmepungukiwa kwa sababu hammwombi Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo mokogania, korende timori na gento; moita na koba ne ribero, korende timokonyora gento. Nigo mogokora esegi na korwana, korende timori na gento, ekiagera timori gosaba.

English: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe walipofika Gibea ya Sauli na kutoa taarifa juu ya masharti haya kwa watu, wote walilia kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa baria bagaika Gibea ase Saulo amenyete, bagateebia Abanto b'aroro amang'ana ayio, na Abanto bonsi bakarera mono.

English: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him. Punishments for Sexual Immorality (Proverbs 5:1–23; 1 Corinthians 5:1–8)
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu yeyote atamlaani baba yake au mama yake, lazima auawe. Amemlaani baba yake au mama yake, nayo damu yake itakuwa juu ya kichwa chake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Kera omonto okoragereria ise gose ng’ina, oyio goika akwe. Ekiagera oragereirie ise na ng’ina, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nigo koraabe okwaye.

English: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),
Kiswahili: Yosefu, Mlawi kutoka Kipro, ambaye mitume walimwita Barnaba (maana yake Mwana wa Faraja),
Ekegusii: Na Yusufu ore korokwa nabatomwa Barnaba (engencho yaye: “Omwana bw’Oboremia”), Omolawi, omonto o Kuporo,

English: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
Kiswahili: Wakati utakapojitokeza utawafanya kama tanuru ya moto. Katika ghadhabu yake Bwana atawameza, moto wake utawateketeza.
Ekegusii: Ekero orabaorokere nobakore booke buna omorero ekebemberi. Omonene nabasirie nendamwamu yaye enene; omorero nobasambe, bayie baere.

English: You multiplied their descendants like the stars of heaven and brought them to the land You had told their fathers to enter and possess.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya wana wao kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nawe ukawaleta katika nchi ambayo uliwaambia baba zao kuingia na kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: Okabaa abana abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na okabarenta ase ense eyio kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a ebe eyabo.

English: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?
Kiswahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akauliza, “Enyi wa imani haba! Mbona mnajadiliana miongoni mwenu kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate?
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabora, “Inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke, inki gekogera mokona‐koborania ng'a timori nemegati?

English: and hope doesn't disappoint us, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
Kiswahili: wala tumaini halitukatishi tamaa, kwa sababu Mungu amekwisha kumimina pendo lake mioyoni mwetu kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu ambaye ametupatia.
Ekegusii: Na ogosemeria tikori gotorentera obosooku, ekiagera obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaichorigwe ase chinkoro chiaito n'Omoika Omochenu, oyo twaetwe.

English: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don't come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.
Kiswahili: Waueni wazee, vijana wa kiume na wa kike, wanawake na watoto, lakini msimguse mtu yeyote mwenye alama. Anzieni katika mahali pangu patakatifu.” Kwa hiyo wakaanza na wale wazee waliokuwa mbele ya Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Moite mosirie kegima abagaaka, na abamura, na abaiseke, na abana, amo nabakaungu, korende timobaisa gokuna omonto obekeire ekemanyererio keria. Mochaakere Aase ane Aachenu.” Ase ayio bagachaaka goita abagaaka bateneine bosio bw'enyomba eria.

English: And they heaped over Achan a large pile of rocks that remains to this day. So the LORD turned from His burning anger. Therefore that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day.
Kiswahili: Wakakusanya lundo la mawe juu ya Akani, ambalo lipo mpaka leo. Naye Bwana akageuka kutoka hasira yake kali. Kwa hiyo mahali pale pakaitwa Bonde la Akori tangu siku hiyo.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaruta amagena igoro y’Akani goika amagena ayio akaba etui eyere aroro goika reero iga. Eri’Omonene agatiga ekeririanda kiaye kegakenda. Ase ayio aase aria akarokwa Ebate y’Akori buna akorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: But if there is a reddish-white sore on the bald head or forehead, it is an infectious disease breaking out on it.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ana kidonda chenye wekundu na weupe kwenye kichwa chake chenye upaa, au kwenye paji la uso, ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza unaojitokeza kichwani au kwenye paji lake la uso.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ase risio ri’omotwe oye, magega gose bosio, obwate egesambo kere nobobariri na oborabu, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokeire ase risio.

English: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”
Kiswahili: Pandeni mwende katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali. Lakini mimi sitakwenda pamoja nanyi, kwa sababu ninyi ni watu wenye shingo ngumu, nisije nikawaangamiza njiani.”
Ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”

English: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia mambo haya ninyi mnaoliamini Jina la Mwana wa Mungu ili mpate kujua ya kuwa mnao uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Nabarikeire inwe amang’ana aya, erinde momanye ng’a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri’Omwana o Nyasae.

English: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule, Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu akamwambia Yehoshafati, “Waache watu wangu wasafiri baharini pamoja na watu wako,” lakini Yehoshafati akakataa.
Ekegusii: Erio Ahasia, mosinto bw'Ahabu, agateebia Yehosafati: “Tiga abasomba baane bagende amo nabasomba bao ase chimeeri.” Korende Yehosafati akaanga.

English: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawatangazia leo, sina hatia ya damu ya mtu awaye yote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nabaorokeirie bonsi ase rituko ria reero, ng'a inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga a monto onde bwensi,

English: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.
Kiswahili: Kisha Eliya akamwambia, “Baki hapa, Elisha. Bwana amenituma Yeriko.” Naye akajibu, “Kwa hakika kama Bwana aishivyo na wewe uishivyo, sitakuacha.” Hivyo wakaenda Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Naende Elija agateebia Elisha: “Aye beera aiga, ekiagera Omonene ontomire ngende Yeriko.” Korende Elisha akamoiraneria: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, naende buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase ayio bakagenda Yeriko.

English: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.'”
Kiswahili: Yamkini Bwana, Mungu wako atayasikia maneno ya jemadari wa jeshi, ambaye bwana wake, mfalme wa Ashuru, amemtuma kumdhihaki Mungu aliye hai, tena kwamba atamkemea kwa maneno ambayo Bwana, Mungu wako ameyasikia. Kwa hiyo omba kwa ajili ya mabaki ambao bado wako.”
Ekegusii: Ande nabo erabe ng'a ekero omorwoti bw'Abaasuri atomete Rabi‐Sake korama Nyasae ore moyo, ere Omonene, Nyasae oino naigwete ayio. Ere nabae egesusuro ase amang'ana ayio. Ase ayio sabera abanto abwo batigarete bare moyo.”

English: “King Agrippa, I consider myself fortunate to stand before you today to defend myself against all the accusations of the Jews,
Kiswahili: “Mfalme Agripa, najiona kuwa na heri kusimama mbele yako leo ninapojitetea kuhusu mashtaka yote ya Wayahudi,
Ekegusii: “Omorwoti Agripa, nerorire omonyene ng’a ninde negesio, ekiagera ninyekengere ase obosio bwao reero, ase amang’ana aria onsi nasoerwa n’Abayahudi.

English: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, nisikilize nikuambie yale nitakayoyasema masikioni mwako na masikioni mwa watu hawa wote:
Ekegusii: Korende tegerera oigwe amang'ana aya ngokwana naye aiga ekero abanto bonsi baigwete.

English: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: The first was Isshiah.
Kiswahili: Kwa wa Rehabia, kutoka kwa wanawe: Ishia alikuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Isia, omoteneneri korwa ase ororeria rwa Rehabia;

English: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
Kiswahili: Ibneya mwana wa Yerohamu, Ela mwana wa Uzi, mwana wa Mikri; na Meshulamu mwana wa Shefatia, mwana wa Reueli, mwana wa Ibniya.
Ekegusii: naende Ibunia, mosinto o Yerohamu, na Ela, mosinto o Usi o Mikiri, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Sefatia o Reueli, o Ibunia,

English: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawauliza, “Je, mnayaona haya yote? Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata jiwe moja hapa litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.” Ishara Za Nyakati Za Mwisho (Marko 13:3-23; Luka 21:7-24)
Ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Inee! Mwarorire aya onsi? Nekeene nabateebirie: Tirigotigara rigena erimo aiga igoro ase erinde, eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mar 13:3-23; Luk 21:7-24)

English: Three sons were born to Absalom, and a daughter named Tamar, who was a beautiful woman. Absalom Reconciled to David
Kiswahili: Walizaliwa wana watatu na binti mmoja kwa Absalomu. Jina la binti yake aliitwa Tamari, naye akawa mwanamke mzuri wa sura.
Ekegusii: Abisalomu nigo aiboreretwe amo n’abamura batato, na omoiseke oyomo ore korokwa Tamari. Ere nigo areenge omoiseke omonyakieni.

English: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Kiswahili: Watu waovu huvizia wenye haki, wakitafuta kuwaua;
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotengera omonto omooronge, erio origia chinchera chi'okomoita.

English: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
Kiswahili: kwa kusudi la kuwakamilisha watakatifu kwa ajili ya kazi za huduma, ili kwamba mwili wa Kristo upate kujengwa
Ekegusii: Agakora bo ase ogoikerania abachenu ase emeremo y'obosomba, goika omobere o Kristo oagachwe.

English: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’”
Kiswahili: Nendeni mkatafute nyasi wenyewe popote mnapoweza kuzipata, lakini kazi yenu haitapunguzwa hata kidogo.’ ”
Ekegusii: Genda inwe mweka mwerigerie chimboba aande onsi morachinyore; korende goika moroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oria o botambe, kende nkeiyo nonya negeke kegokeigwa korwa ase ekerengo kie emeremo yaino ya kera rituko.”

English: “Why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini manukato haya hayakuuzwa kwa dinari 300 na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini?”
Ekegusii: “Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”

English: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
Kiswahili: Nionyeshe njia zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe mapito yako,
Ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie chinchera chiao; inyorokererie oboeto bwao.

English: Be first to stop for manners' sake. Don't be insatiable, lest you offend.
Kiswahili: Kuwa wa kwanza kuacha kwa ajili ya adabu. Usiwe na hasira, usije ukakosea.
Ekegusii: Nering'ana rigiya ase ore aye koba omotang'ani koigota, toba rinyandambe obaise kogechia abanto.

English: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu inampasa kutoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe na vivyo hivyo kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio yamogwenerete arue ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe biaye ere omonyene, buna are korua ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaanto.

English: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don't be afraid.'
Kiswahili: ‘Hili ndilo nililoagana nanyi mlipotoka katika nchi ya Misri. Pia Roho wangu anadumu katikati yenu. Msiogope.'
Ekegusii: Ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo nabarierete eira ng'a botambe nigo ndabe amo nainwe; ase ayio Omoika one nigo ogendererete komenya ase egati yaino; timoiroka.

English: When David's young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Daudi walipofika wakampa Nabali ujumbe huu kwa jina la Daudi. Kisha wakangojea.
Ekegusii: Ekero abamura abwo Daudi atomete baigete ase Nabali, bakamoteebia amang'ana onsi a Daudi. Erio bakaganya.

English: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya sadaka za kuteketezwa zilizoletwa na kusanyiko zilikuwa mafahali sabini, kondoo dume 100 na wana-kondoo dume 200. Wote hawa walikuwa kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omobaro bw'ebing'wanso biria omosangererekano orentete nigo orenge chieri emerongo etano na ebere, ne chimingichi rigana erimo, ne chimanwa chi'eching'ondi amagana abere. Echio chionsi nigo chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa ase Omonene.

English: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.
Kiswahili: Pale pawashwapo moto madhabahuni kimo chake kitakuwa dhiraa nne, na pembe nne zinazoelekeza juu kutoka pale pawashwapo moto.
Ekegusii: Aase bagoutera omorero na gosambera ebing'wanso igoro y'egesasiimero nigo arenge ay'ekerengo ki'amaboko ane gochia igoro, na korwa aroro emegwekano ene ye ching'unchara yaroisirie yarochie igoro.

English: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
Kiswahili: Kama bwana wake alimpatia mke naye akamzalia wana au binti, mwanamke pamoja na watoto wake watakuwa mali ya bwana wake na huyo mwanaume ataondoka peke yake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonene oye omonyuomeretie omokungu, na ere omoiboreire abana, abamura gose abaiseke, omokungu oria na abana baye nigo barabe enibo y’omonene oye; omosacha oria nigo ararueo ere bweka,

English: And on that day, in every place that had a thousand vines worth a thousand shekels of silver, only briers and thorns will be found.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, kila mahali palipokuwa na mizabibu elfu moja yenye thamani ya shekeli 1,000 za fedha, patakuwa na michongoma na miiba tu.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, aase arenge kwama emesabibu elifu eyemo, aisanete chisekeli chi’echifeta elifu eyemo, namere amageri na amagwa.

English: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu yako imekuwa nzito juu yangu, umenigharikisha kwa mawimbi yako yote.
Ekegusii: Egesusuro kiao nigo kere ekerito igoro yane, kwambagoreire emerindo yao yonsi yantubire kegima.

English: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ's.
Kiswahili: Hizi zilikuwa kivuli cha mambo ambayo yangekuja, lakini ile iliyo halisi imo ndani ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ayio nekiriri ki'amang'ana agochi‐gocha, korende omoikerania omonyene nere Kristo.

English: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Paulo akakaa huko kwa muda wa mwaka mmoja na nusu, akiwafundisha neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akamenya agwo omwaka oyomo na emetienyi etano nomo, akoborokereria ring'ana ria Nyasae ase egati yabo.

English: I don't write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
Kiswahili: Siwaandikii mambo haya ili kuwaaibisha, bali ili kuwaonya, kama wanangu wapendwa.
Ekegusii: Tinyarigeti aya ase okobasookia, korende nkobakuurera buna abana nyanchete.

English: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nilimwona Shetani akianguka kutoka mbinguni kama umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naroche Saitani okogwa korwa igoro buna okomesa.

English: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
Kiswahili: “Tazama mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, mpendwa wangu, ninayependezwa naye. Nitaweka Roho wangu juu yake, naye atatangaza haki kwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyo nachoorire, omwanchwa one, omoyo one ogokirie nere. Nimobekere Omoika one, nere naraarerie abanto b'Ebisaku ekiina.

English: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn't chew the cud, is unclean to you.
Kiswahili: Naye nguruwe ingawa anazo kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili, hacheui; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Naende timoria embeche, ekiagera nigo ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, korende teri koria eng'ang'ura; eyio techenegeti.

English: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mawe yake ni ya thamani kwa watumishi wako, vumbi lake lenyewe hulionea huruma.
Ekegusii: Abasomba bao nigo banchete amagena aye, na nigo bare namabeebe ase orotu rwaye.

English: “Good success be to the Romans, and to the nation of the Jews, by sea and by land forever. May the sword and the enemy be far from them.
Kiswahili: "Mafanikio mema yawe kwa Warumi, na kwa taifa la Wayahudi, baharini na nchi kavu milele. Upanga na adui viwe mbali nao."
Ekegusii: Obobui bobeo botambe ase Abaroma na egesaku kia Abayahudi, ase ense na ase enyancha! Omoro tobakuna; omobisa tabaika ang'e.

English: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, watu na watuhesabu sisi kuwa tu watumishi wa Kristo na mawakili wa siri za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonto natobare iga, ng’a nabasomba ba Kristo tore, na abarendi b’obobisi bwa Nyasae.

English: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
Kiswahili: Kisha weka safu nne za vito vya thamani juu yake. Safu ya kwanza itakuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;
Ekegusii: Obeke emeng'ororia ene y'amagena e rigori rinene ase egesembe keria. Ase omong'ororia bw'eritang'ani obeke saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;

English: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Kiswahili: Watoto wake na waachwe yatima, mke wake na awe mjane.
Ekegusii: Tiga abana baye batigwe bare chintakana, na omokungu oye atigwe ore omoboraka.

English: “Do you know why I have come to you?” he said. “I must return at once to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I have gone forth, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akasema, “Je, unajua kwa nini nimekujia? Sasa hivi nitarudi kupigana dhidi ya mkuu wa Uajemi, nami nikienda, mkuu wa Uyunani atakuja.
Ekegusii: Erio akamboria, Inee, kwamanyire ekiagera nacha aa ase ore? Bono nkoirana inde ngende korwania omogambi bw’Abaayemi, na ekero ndabe namobuire, erio agwo omogambi bw’Abagiriki nachiche.

English: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
Kiswahili: Kama wameukimbia upotovu wa dunia kwa kumjua Bwana wetu na Mwokozi Yesu Kristo, kisha wakanaswa tena humo na kushindwa, hali yao ya mwisho ni mbaya zaidi kuliko ile ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Naki baria baikire gotama ogotacheneka gw'ense ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo, korende kobakobwatwa naende na kobugwa nero, okoba kwabo kw'omoerio nkobe okobe kobua koria kw'eritang'ani.

English: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will trickle and dry up; the reeds and rushes will wither.
Kiswahili: Mifereji itanuka; vijito vya Misri vitapungua na kukauka. Mafunjo na nyasi vitanyauka,
Ekegusii: Chindooche chigochiao nigo chiragunde chitioke, na amaache ’emetaro agwo Misiri nakee aere; ebitonto na amauncho mbiome.

English: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kushi walikuwa: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama na Sabteka. Wana wa Raama walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba, na Havila, na Sabuta, na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana ba Raama nabwo aba: Seba na Dedani.

English: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people Israel, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
Kiswahili: Popote nilipotembea pamoja na Waisraeli wote, je, nimewahi kumwambia kiongozi wao yeyote niliyemwamuru kuwachunga watu wangu Israeli, “Kwa nini hujanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?” ’
Ekegusii: Aase aande onsi nabeire ’nkona‐kogeenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogaambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabeegete akaba omorisia bw’abaanto bane, nase ki otang’agaachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.

English: I looked out into the night and saw a man riding on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa usiku nilipata maono, mbele yangu alikuwepo mtu akiendesha farasi mwekundu! Alikuwa amesimama katikati ya miti ya mihadasi kwenye bonde. Nyuma yake walikuwepo farasi wekundu, wa kikahawia na weupe.
Ekegusii: Nkarora ase okorora kwa botuko omonto oriinete ebarasi embariri. Omonto oyio nigo ateneine ase egati y’emete ekorokwa emehadasi yarenge ase rigoko. Na magega yaye nchiarengeo chibarasi chinde chimbariri, na echire chincherati, ne chindabu.

English: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Samweli akarudi pamoja na Sauli, naye Sauli akamwabudu Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akairana, akabwatia Saulo, na Saulo agasasiima Omonene. Samweli ogoita Agagi, na gotigana na Saulo

English: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;
Kiswahili: Nchi imejaa wazinzi; kwa sababu ya laana, nchi imekauka na malisho yaliyoko nyikani yamekauka. Mwenendo wa manabii ni mbaya na mamlaka yao si ya haki.
Ekegusii: Ense eye nigo eichire nabatomani, nigo ekweumia ase engencho y'okoragererigwa, na amarisia 'erooro omire. Orogendo rw'abaanto nigo rore orobe, ne chinguru chiabo nigo chire ase ogokora aya atari amaronge.

English: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kifo cha Abrahamu, Mungu akambariki mwanawe Isaki, ambaye baadaye aliishi karibu na Beer-Lahai-Roi.
Ekegusii: Magega y'ogokwa kwa Aburaamu, Nyasae agasesenia Isaka, omwana oye. Na Isaka akamenya ang'e nensoko yaare korokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi.

English: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Kiswahili: katika Anathothi, Nobu na Anania,
Ekegusii: Anatoti, na Nobu, na Anania;

English: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe ataikomboa Israeli kutoka dhambi zao zote.
Ekegusii: Ere naboorie Abaisraeli korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.

English: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
Kiswahili: Wako wapi baba zako sasa? Nao manabii, je, wanaishi milele?
Ekegusii: Bono chisokoro chiaino ng'ai chire? Na ababani baino, ng'ai bare? Inee! Mbagendererete koba moyo botambe?

English: And He told them, “This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yaliyoandikwa: Kristo atateswa na siku ya tatu atafufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakuure ase rituko ria gatato;

English: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don't cover your lips, and don't eat mourner's bread.”
Kiswahili: Lia kwa uchungu kimya kimya usimwombolezee mtu aliyekufa. Jifunge kilemba chako na uvae viatu vyako miguuni mwako, usifunike sehemu ya chini ya uso wako, wala usile vyakula vya kawaida vya wakati wa matanga.”
Ekegusii: Oichane, korende oremererie torera; tobaisa koreera oria okuure. Bwetube egetambaa ase omotwe oo, obeeke ebikoroto ase amagoro ao. Tobaisa gotuba obosio bwao, gose tobaisa koria endagera y'ebirero.”

English: And when the days of feasting were over, Job would send for his children to purify them, rising early in the morning to offer burnt offerings for all of them. For Job thought, “Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts.” This was Job’s regular practice. Satan’s First Attack
Kiswahili: Wakati kipindi cha karamu kilimalizika, Ayubu angetuma waitwe na kuwafanyia utakaso. Angetoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya kila mmoja wao asubuhi na mapema, akifikiri, “Pengine wanangu wametenda dhambi na kumlaani Mungu mioyoni mwao.” Hii ilikuwa ndiyo desturi ya kawaida ya Ayubu. Jaribu La Kwanza La Ayubu
Ekegusii: Nyuma ya kera omoyega koerire, mambia chuni Ayubu nigo arenge korangeria abana baye nakobaruera ekeng’wanso ase kera oyomo ase okobachena. Nigo arenge gokora igo, ekiagera arenge korengereria, oteeba, “Ande nebe ng’a onde bw’abana baane okorire ebibe, oramire Nyasae ase enkoro yaye ime.” Naboigo Ayubu arenge gokora botambe.

English: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Apataye mke apata kitu chema naye ajipatia kibali kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto onyorire omokungu omuya, oyio onyorire ekeegwa ekiya na ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene.

English: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.
Kiswahili: “Wakati mataifa jirani waletapo bidhaa zao au nafaka kuuza siku ya Sabato, hatutazinunua kutoka kwao siku ya Sabato, wala siku nyingine yoyote takatifu. Kila mwaka wa saba, tutaacha kuilima ardhi na tutafuta madeni yote.
Ekegusii: Onye abanto b'ense eye bakorenta ebinto gose chindagera gotooneria rituko ri'Esabato, titokobigora ase Esabato gose ase rituko rinde richenu. Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere ntotige emegondo yaito etimoke teremwa, ne chisira titochiboria chiakanwe.

English: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn't know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
