Kiswahili: Aliwapa mana ya kula jangwani, kitu ambacho baba zenu hawakukijua, ili kuwanyenyekesha na kuwajaribu ninyi ili mwishoni apate kuwatendea mema.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro akabaa mana mokaria, endagera chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete, anyare kobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema, erinde ase omoerio oino abakorere amaya.

English: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
Kiswahili: Wafedheheshwe na waaibishwe wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu. Wanaofanya shauri kuniangamiza warudishwe nyuma kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, tiga babugwe na gosookigwa. Abwo bagokora emeroberio emebe y'okong'ita, tiga bairanigwe babe nobosooku.

English: As you saw the iron mixed with clay, so the peoples will mix with one another, but will not hold together any more than iron mixes with clay.
Kiswahili: Kama vile ulivyoona chuma kikiwa kimechanganyikana na udongo wa mfinyanzi uliochomwa, ndivyo watu watakavyokuwa mchanganyiko, wala hawatabaki wameungana tena, kama vile chuma kisivyoweza kuchanganyikana na udongo wa mfinyanzi.
Ekegusii: Buna kwarora ekioma keria keburukaine namaroba, naboigo abanto barasang’anane ase okonyuomerana, korende tibakonyara kobwatana amo buna koreng’ana ekioma getari kobwatana namaroba.

English: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
Kiswahili: “Nao walipokuwa wakienda kununua mafuta, bwana arusi akafika. Wale wanawali waliokuwa tayari wakaingia ndani pamoja naye kwenye karamu ya arusi na mlango ukafungwa.
Ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonywomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang'e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw'enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.

English: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
Kiswahili: Basi kulikuwepo na nabii fulani mzee aliyekuwa anaishi Betheli, ambaye wanawe walikuja kumwambia yote ambayo mtu wa Mungu alikuwa ameyafanya pale siku ile. Pia wakamwambia baba yao yale aliyomwambia mfalme.
Ekegusii: Narenge omobani omogotu oyomo omenyete agwo Beteli. Abana baye abamura bagacha, bakamoteebia amang'ana onsi omonto oria o Nyasae akorete ase rituko riria agwo Beteli, bakamoteebia na amang'ana akwanete nomorwoti.

English: Wounds and dishonor will befall him, and his reproach will never be wiped away.
Kiswahili: Mapigo na aibu ni fungu lake na aibu yake haitafutika kamwe;
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arabe n’amaakwa naende asirie amasikani onsi. Obosooku bwaye tibogotinyigwa boere.

English: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor's house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
Kiswahili: Ingiza mguu wako nyumbani kwa jirani yako mara chache, ukizidisha, atakukinai na atakuchukia.
Ekegusii: Amagoro ao tanara kona‐kogeenda ase enyomba y'omosani oo, nigo arabaise korosa naye, erinde akogeche.

English: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
Kiswahili: Alinichoma moyo wangu kwa mishale iliyotoka kwenye podo lake.
Ekegusii: Ere ondasire ne chinsara chi’egochi yaye, chiasoire ase chinyigo chiane.

English: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?
Kiswahili: “Mbona unatazama kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako, na wala huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriiso ri'oyomino, na omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao ime toyorochi?

English: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu ya Mungu imedhihirishwa kutoka mbinguni dhidi ya uasi wote na uovu wa wanadamu ambao huipinga kweli kwa uovu wao,
Ekegusii: Inaki endamwamu ya Nyasae yaorokiigwe korwa igoro, ase ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwonsi na obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto, abagotanga ekeene nobobe bwabo.

English: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
Kiswahili: Yeye ashindaye atavikwa vazi jeupe kama wao. Sitafuta jina lake kutoka kitabu cha uzima, bali nitalikiri jina lake mbele za Baba yangu na mbele za malaika wake.
Ekegusii: Ere oyorabue nabeekerwe chianga chindabu, na inche tingotinyia erieta riaye korwa ase egetabu y'obogima nonya ng'ake, naende ninyatore erieta riaye ase obosio bwa Tata one, na ase obosio bw'abamalaika baye.

English: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
Kiswahili: Lakini tunda la Roho ni upendo, furaha, amani, uvumilivu, utu wema, fadhili, uaminifu,
Ekegusii: Korende okwama kw’Omoika nobwanchani, omogooko, omorembe, oboremereria, obwororo, obuya, obwegenwa,

English: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
Kiswahili: nanyi tafuteni yale yanayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Teema mono komanya ekeragwenere Omonene.

English: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
Kiswahili: Hakuruhusu mtu yeyote awaonee; kwa ajili yao aliwakemea wafalme, akisema:
Ekegusii: Nyasae tatigete abanto bande baabachande; agatogonyera abarwoti ase engencho yabo,

English: “Yet even in those days,” declares the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo katika siku hizo, sitakuangamiza kabisa,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire, “Nonya nase amatuko ayio tinkobasiria inwe kegima.

English: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, sikia maombi yangu; nisikilize, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, igwa ogosaba kwane, tegerera onyigwe, aye Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na fahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka, na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
Ekegusii: Mochirue amo n'okoruegwa kw'endagera na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo neeri eria, na emingichi eria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng'ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng'ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

English: Don't give your soul to prostitutes, that you not lose your inheritance.
Kiswahili: Usiwape makahaba roho yako, usije ukapoteza urithi wako.
Ekegusii: Tochwara omoyo oo gochia ase omokungu omotayayi, ekiagera nigo arasirie egesaku kiao gionsi.

English: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.
Kiswahili: Eneo lote la hiyo sehemu litakuwa mraba, yaani, dhiraa 25,000 kila upande. Kama toleo maalum mtatenga sehemu takatifu, pamoja na milki ya mji.
Ekegusii: Orogongo roria rwonsi oroochenu nigo rorabe orw'ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), chinsemo chionsi nigo chirabe chireng'aine. Oro narwo orogongo oroochenu amo norw'omochie oyio.

English: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
Kiswahili: Akakana tena kwa kiapo akisema, “Mimi simjui huyo!”
Ekegusii: Agakaana naende, na gotiana, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.”

English: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kuweni wakamilifu kama Baba yenu wa mbinguni alivyo mkamilifu.
Ekegusii: Gaki inwe mobe abaikeranu buna Iso oino ore igoro are omoikeranu.

English: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
Kiswahili: Sasa inuka uingie mjini, nawe utaambiwa yakupasayo kutenda.”
Ekegusii: korende imoka osoe omochie, noteebigwe ayarakogwenere okore.”

English: For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Nimekupangia idadi ya siku kama miaka ya dhambi yao. Kwa hiyo kwa siku 390 utabeba dhambi za nyumba ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nagochikeire amatuko amagana atato, na emerongo kianda (390); amatuko ayio nigo anga buna emiaka y’egesusuro ki’obobe bwabo, eyio nero engaki orabe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abaisraeli.

English: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
Kiswahili: Uzima huo ulidhihirishwa; nasi tumeuona na kuushuhudia, nasi twawatangazia uzima wa milele, ambao ulikuwa pamoja na Baba, nao ukadhihirishwa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabaraareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa ase tore.

English: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, Daudi alipoona kwamba Bwana amemjibu kule kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Arauna Myebusi, akatoa dhabihu huko.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase engaki eria, ekero Daudi aroche ng’a Omonene oiraneirie ogosaba kwaye ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi, akarua ebing’wanso biaye aroro agwo.

English: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
Kiswahili: Lakini sanamu zao ni za fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Emegwekano abanto abwo bagosasiima nigo eroiseirie chifeta ne chitaabu, nigo ere emeremo y'amaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

English: But I have done this that I might not set the glory of man above the glory of God. I will not worship anyone except you, my Lord, and I will not do these things in arrogance.
Kiswahili: Lakini nimefanya hivi ili nisiuweke utukufu wa mwanadamu juu ya utukufu wa Mungu. Sitamwabudu yeyote isipokuwa wewe, Bwana wangu, na sitafanya mambo haya kwa kiburi.
Ekegusii: na ebikone bionsi bire inse y'erioba naye omonene bw'ense, na onde tari orakoamererie, aye omonene nigo omanyete amang'ana onsi

English: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kazi yote ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania ikakamilika. Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo y'Obomenyo bw'Eema y'Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n'Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Meanwhile, the people of Judah said: “The strength of the laborer fails, and there is so much rubble that we will never be able to rebuild the wall.”
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, watu wa Yuda wakasema, “Nguvu za wafanyakazi zinapungua, nacho kifusi ni kingi mno, kiasi kwamba hatuwezi kuujenga upya ukuta.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bagateeba, “Chinguru chi’abakobogoria chigurube chiorobire, na amaoomo namange mono ase okogokomora, goika twasinyirwe gokora emeremo y’okoagacha orwaki.”

English: Behold, isn't it from Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
Kiswahili: Je, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote hakuonyesha kwamba kazi ya wanadamu ni mafuta tu kwa ajili ya moto, na kwamba mataifa yanajichosha bure?
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo eyio erasambwe nomorero, na abanto b'ebisaku nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo ere bosa. Rora, ayio nigo arure ase Nyasae bw'Emeganda.

English: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Since he is my older brother, you might as well request the kingdom for him and for Abiathar the priest and for Joab son of Zeruiah!”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akamjibu mama yake, “Kwa nini uombe Abishagi, Mshunami, kwa ajili ya Adoniya? Ungeweza pia kuomba ufalme kwa ajili yake, kwani yeye ni ndugu yangu mkubwa: naam, kwa ajili yake, na kwa kuhani Abiathari na Yoabu mwana wa Seruya!”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akairaneria ng’ina, “Nase ki okoboria ng’a Abisagi, aegwe Adonia Moborerie aegwe noborwoti boigo, inyora nga ere momura ominto omonene; na Abiatari Omokuani, na Yoabu, omwana bw’omokuungu Seruya, babwatanire nere.”

English: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!' They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, asemalo: “Kutakuwepo maombolezo katika barabara zote na vilio vya uchungu katika njia kuu zote. Wakulima wataitwa kuja kulia, na waombolezaji waje kuomboleza.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw'Emeganda, oyore Omonene, atebiire: “Ebirero mbibe ase chiraaro chionsi chi'omochie, na ase chinchera chiaye chionsi abanto barere bakobuga: Obee! Obee! Mbarangerie abaremi bache korera, na abamanyete kobokia amagombo bache kweng'ereria.

English: For if you return to the LORD, your brothers and sons will receive mercy in the presence of their captors and will return to this land. For the LORD your God is gracious and merciful; He will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him.”
Kiswahili: Kama mkimrudia Bwana ndipo wale ndugu zenu waliotekwa pamoja na watoto wenu watakapoonewa huruma na wale waliowateka na kuwaachia warudi katika nchi hii, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu ni mwenye neema na huruma, hatageuzia uso wake mbali nanyi kama ninyi mkimrudia yeye.”
Ekegusii: Komorairane ase Omonene, abamino na abana baino barorerwe amaabera, na baria baboosete erio bairane ase ense eye, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabwate obwanchani na amaabera. Ere takobatiga ekero morairane asare.”

English: The second cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same size and shape,
Kiswahili: Kerubi wa pili alikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi pia, hivyo makerubi hao wawili walifanana kwa vipimo na kwa umbo.
Ekegusii: Omokerubi oria onde boigo nigo areenge bw’ekerengo ekio ekio. Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bonsi babere nigo baarenge bareng’aine kegima ase ekerengo na bagwekaine ase ekieni.

English: Her spirit returned, and at once she got up. And He directed that she be given something to eat.
Kiswahili: Roho yake ikamrudia, naye akainuka mara moja. Akaamuru apewe kitu cha kula.
Ekegusii: Omoika oye okairana, agatenena erio kegima Yeso akabachiika bamoe endagera arie.

English: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, Yahweh, have created it.
Kiswahili: “Enyi mbingu juu, nyesheni haki, mawingu na yaidondoshe. Dunia na ifunguke sana, wokovu na uchipuke, haki na ikue pamoja nao. Mimi, Bwana, ndiye niliyeiumba.
Ekegusii: Inwe igoro chionsi, tonyia amatoima, oboronge tiga borwe igoro, botwe buna amare agotwa embura; ense tiga emaanoke, eichorwe nogotooreka na oboronge. Ninche Omonene natongire ayio.”

English: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
Kiswahili: Enyi mataifa, msifuni Mungu wetu, sauti ya sifa yake isikike,
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b'ebisaku bionsi, motogie Nyasae oito, tiga eriogi ri'okomotogia riigweke.

English: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa bado ahadi ya kuingia rahani iko wazi, tujihadhari ili hata mmoja wenu asije akaikosa.
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye eira eria y’ogosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye ereo, tiga toiroke ng’a onde omo oino tabaisa konyorekana ng’a omochire gokonyora.

English: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
Kiswahili: Ni yupi miongoni mwa miungu yote ya nchi hizi ameweza kuokoa nchi yake mkononi mwangu? Inawezekanaje basi Bwana aiokoe Yerusalemu mkononi mwangu?”
Ekegusii: Nereri ase egati ye chinyasae chionsi chie chinse yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane? Nainwe mokorengereria ng’a Omonene natoorie Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko kwane?”

English: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya Aroni na iseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

English: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn't know Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Eli walikuwa watu wabaya kabisa, hawakumheshimu Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Eli nigo baareenge Abanto ababe bataroochi inchera. Tibaasigete Omonene,

English: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy, and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wayahudi walipoona ule umati mkubwa wa watu walijawa na wivu, wakayakanusha maneno Paulo aliyokuwa akisema.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bachia korora emeganda, bagaichorwa ne ribero, bagakaana amang’ana ayare gokwanwa na Paulo, bakamorama.

English: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
Kiswahili: Vaeni chapeo ya wokovu na mchukue upanga wa Roho, ambao ni Neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende bogoria ekegogwa gi’ekioma ki’ogotooreka, na omoro bw’Omoika, n’oro ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can't be pulled apart.
Kiswahili: Zimeunganishwa imara kila moja na nyingine; zimengʼangʼaniana pamoja wala haziwezi kutenganishwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo erinde ribwatanirie nerinde; naro nigo asoaine, takonyara gwatananwa.

English: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
Kiswahili: Wataitwa Watu Watakatifu, Waliokombolewa na Bwana; nawe utaitwa Aliyetafutwa, Mji Usioachwa Tena.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbarokwe “Abanto abachenu”, na “Ababoorigwe n’Omonene,” na aye omonyene norokwe “Omochie origigwe”, na “Omochie otatigwe.”

English: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia, “Kuleni leo, kwa sababu leo ni Sabato kwa Bwana. Hamtapata chochote juu ya nchi leo.
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Karie eye reero, ekiagera reero n'Esabato yaatananirwe ase Omonene, ekiagera reero timokoyerora isiko ase erooro.

English: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
Kiswahili: Kinyume chake, tulinena kama watu tuliokubaliwa na Mungu tukakabidhiwa Injili. Sisi hatujaribu kuwapendeza wanadamu bali kumpendeza Mungu, yeye ayachunguzaye mawazo ya ndani sana ya mioyo yetu.
Ekegusii: korende buna twancheirwe na Nyasae koba abatwegenirwe koegwa enchiri, nabo togokwana, tari ase okogwenera abanto, korende ase okogwenera Nyasae, oyokorenga chinkoro chiaito.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw'Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness, there will be wrath and anger.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa wale watafutao mambo yao wenyewe na wale wanaokataa kweli na kuzifuata njia mbaya, kutakuwa na ghadhabu na hasira ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende endamwamu na ekeririanda inabibe igoro ase baria beanchete abanyene, batari koigwera ekeene, korende bakoigwera ayatari boronge.

English: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
Kiswahili: Anapoona magari ya vita pamoja na kundi la farasi, wapanda punda au wapanda ngamia, na awe macho, awe macho kikamilifu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio kararore abariini chibarasi bagocha babere babere, na abariini chitigere, na abe chingamia, tiga ategerere mono, ee, ategerere buya kegima.”

English: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati wa hizo siku saba za sikukuu, ambayo huanza katika mwezi wa saba kwenye siku ya kumi na tano, mkuu anayetawala atatoa mahitaji yale yale kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi, sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta.
Ekegusii: “Gochaakera rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri'omotienyi o gatano na kabere, na kogenderera, ase engaki y'amatuko atano na abere Aria Amanene, omogambi oria arue ebing'wanso bi'ebibe buna biria amo nebi'ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw'endagera, na okw'amaguta.

English: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God's Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambieni ya kuwa hakuna mtu anayeongozwa na Roho wa Mungu anayeweza kusema, “Yesu na alaaniwe.” Pia hakuna mtu awezaye kusema, “Yesu ni Bwana,” isipokuwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigetie kobamanyia, ng'a monto onde tari oyogokwana ase Omoika o Nyasae ogoteeba ng'a, “Yeso oragererigwe!” Gose onde takonyara goteeba, “Yeso n'Omonene”, otatiga ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: Yes, he struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought His favor; he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there —
Kiswahili: Alishindana na malaika na kumshinda; alilia na kuomba upendeleo wake. Alimkuta huko Betheli na kuzungumza naye huko:
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo akinanete nomomalaika, akamobua; akarera, akamosorora ng’a amororere amaabera. Agwo Beteli Yakobo akaumerana na Nyasae, erio agakwana naintwe.

English: All the time Anansi's young son had been standing at the bottom of the tree watching. He said, "Wouldn't it be easier to climb if you tied the pot to your back instead?" Anansi tried tying the clay pot full of wisdom to his back, and it really was a lot easier.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo wote, mwanawe alikuwa amesimama chini ya ule mti akimtazama baba yake. Akamwambia, "Baba, si ingekuwa rahisi kupanda endapo ungekifungia chungu mgongoni?" Basi Anansi akajaribu kukifungia chungu kilichojaa hekima mgongoni mwake, na kweli ikawa rahisi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Engaki eye yonsi omwana bw’Anansi nigo akengerete korwa nse yomote oria, amorigereretie buna akorina. Akamotebia, ‘Naki yarenge koba bwororo kware korina omote oyio gosibete enyongo eyio ase omogongo oo ribaga ri’ekeuno?” Erio Anansi agatema gosiba enyongo eria yabwate obong’aini mogongo oye, akanyora buna nigo yarenge bwororo mono korina omote oria.

English: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
Kiswahili: Jangwani walitawaliwa na tamaa zao, walimjaribu Mungu nyikani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babete nobotoonu bw’okogania endagera. Bagateema Nyasae agwo ase erooro.

English: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all the peoples on the face of the earth.
Kiswahili: kwa maana ninyi ni taifa takatifu kwa Bwana Mungu wenu. Bwana amewachagua ninyi kuwa taifa la kipekee kutoka mataifa yote juu ya uso wa dunia, mwe tunu yake.
Ekegusii: ekiagera inwe n’abanto abachenu ase Omonene Nyasae oino. Ere obachoorire mobe abanto baye, mwaatananegete korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku binde bionsi bire ase ense. Ching’iti chichenegete na echitachenegeti (Abal 11:1-47)

English: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akafungua kinywa chake akasema, “Mungu hana upendeleo,
Ekegusii: Erio Petero agachaaka gokwana, akabora: “Ase ekeene naikire komanya ng’a Nyasae tari nogwanchereria,

English: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa kuwa watu wengi mno walikuwa wakija na kutoka, hata wakawa hawana nafasi ya kula, Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Twendeni peke yetu mahali pa faragha, mpate kupumzika.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo inwe mweka, togende aase abanto batari, motimoke ake.” Inaki abanto abange mbarengeo, bagocha na bakogenda; goika Yeso n’aborokigwa baye tibanyora ribaga ri’okoria.

English: Then she gave birth to another son and named him Shelah; it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.
Kiswahili: Akamzaa mwana mwingine tena, akamwita Shela. Huyu alimzalia mahali paitwapo Kezibu.
Ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Sela. Yuda nere nao areenge aria Kisibo ekero amoiborerete abana.

English: After enlisting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join forces with him, Eglon attacked and defeated Israel, taking possession of the City of Palms.
Kiswahili: Egloni akawataka Waamoni na Waamaleki waungane naye, akaja kuishambulia Israeli, nao wakatwaa Mji wa Mitende
Ekegusii: Egiloni akabwatana n’Abaamoni n’Abaameleki; barabwo bakabasangera Abaisraeli, bakababua, bakaira Omochie bw’Emekendo.

English: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
Kiswahili: Tena ikiwa Kristo hakufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, kuhubiri kwetu kumekuwa ni bure na imani yenu ni batili.
Ekegusii: Naende onye Kristo tabogetigwe, rirorio okorandia gwaito nokwa bosa, na okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa.

English: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka hiyo ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la ngʼombe, atamtoa ngʼombe dume asiye na dosari. Ni lazima amlete kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili aweze kukubalika kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onye ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa gekorwa ase amaicho chiombe, igo keraabe eki'eeri etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerente agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano, erinde inche 'mwanchere.

English: So I will cast you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’ God Will Restore Israel
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitawaondoa katika nchi hii na kuwatupa katika nchi ambayo ninyi wala baba zenu hamkuijua, nako huko mtaitumikia miungu mingine usiku na mchana, kwa maana sitawapa fadhili zangu huko.’
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nimbaserie morue ase ense eye, mogende ase ense inwe motamanyeti, gose chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete. Ase ense eyio namokorere chinyasae ching’ao omobaso na obotuko, gose tinkobarorera amaabera.” Okoirana korwa ase obosomba

English: I inclined my ear a little, and received her, and found for myself much instruction.
Kiswahili: Nilitega sikio langu kidogo, nikampokea, nikajipatia mafundisho mengi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nategete ogoto kwane ngategerera kegima erio 'nkamwaarigania chisemi, erio nainche 'nkenyoorera ogosemia okonene kegima.

English: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won't let you go unless you bless me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mtu akasema, “Niache niende, kwa kuwa ni mapambazuko.” Lakini Yakobo akajibu, “Sitakuacha uende usiponibariki.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Ntige ngende, ekiagera bwakiire.” Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Tingokoa ribaga ogende, otaransesenia.”

English: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
Kiswahili: Siku tatu baadaye, Yeroboamu na watu wote wakamrudia Rehoboamu, kama mfalme alivyokuwa amesema, “Rudini kwangu baada ya siku tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeroboamu amo nabaanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu omorwoti rituko ria gatato buna abateebeetie bakore.

English: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaita Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase,
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto b'egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng'ese ki'egesaku kia Manase,

English: Matthew and Thomas; James son of Alphaeus and Simon called the Zealot;
Kiswahili: Mathayo, Tomaso, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Simoni aliyeitwa Zelote,
Ekegusii: na Matayo na Thomas, Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Simioni oyomo bw’Abazelote,

English: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
Kiswahili: Yeye hulala akiwa tajiri, lakini ndiyo mara ya mwisho; afunguapo macho yake, yote yametoweka.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenda korara ore omonda, korende takoba bo rinde; ekero akoramokia amaiso kabokire anyore obotenenku bwaye bwasirire.

English: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
Kiswahili: Lakini nchi mnayovuka Yordani kuimiliki ni nchi ya milima na mabonde inywayo mvua kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Korende ense eria mogochia gosoa moyeire nigo ere ense y'ebitunwa n'amagoko, ense ekonyoora embura egotwa korwa igoro.

English: Then God remembered Rachel. He listened to her and opened her womb,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamkumbuka Raheli, akasikia maombi yake na akafungua tumbo lake.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamoinyora Raeli, akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na akaigora enda yaye;

English: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
Kiswahili: Waliosalia wangefika nchi kavu kwa kutumia mbao au vipande vya meli iliyovunjika, hivyo ikatimia kwamba wote wakaokoka na kufika nchi kavu salama.
Ekegusii: Abaratigare bagende, abande ase chibao, na abande ase ebinto binde bi'emeeri. Naboigo abanto bonsi bagaika ase ense enyomo buya.

English: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham crossed over with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel escorted the king. Contention over the King
Kiswahili: Mfalme alipovuka kwenda Gilgali, Kimhamu akavuka pamoja naye. Vikosi vyote vya Yuda na nusu ya vikosi vya Israeli vilimvusha mfalme.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akageenda agaika Giligali na Kimuhamu akageenda amo nere. Abayuda bonsi, na abanto ekeng’ese ki’Abaisraeli nabarabwo bakageenda amo nere.

English: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.'”
Kiswahili: Nitawatesa wazao wa Daudi kwa ajili ya hili, lakini siyo milele.' ”
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninchande abanto b'ororeeria rwa Daudi, korende tekoba igo kogenderera botambe.”

English: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man!
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu aweza kuwa mwenye hekima, endapo mtoto wa punda-mwitu atazaliwa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Onye omoriri okonyara koba omong’aini, rirorio emori y’etigere y’orosana nenyare koiborwa ebe omonto.

English: “Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you,
Kiswahili: “Sasa mimi ninaweka Agano langu nanyi, pamoja na uzao wenu baada yenu,
Ekegusii: “Rora, inche ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, amo na ororeeria rwaino roraiborwe korwa magega yaino;

English: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.
Kiswahili: Meno yako ni kama kundi la kondoo watokao kuogeshwa. Kila mmoja ana pacha lake, hakuna hata mmoja aliye peke yake.
Ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga riicho rie ching'ondi chiabeeri chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri egokwa.

English: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.
Kiswahili: Huduma hii mnayofanya si tu kwa ajili ya kukidhi mahitaji ya watakatifu, bali huzidi sana kwa shukrani nyingi apewazo Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki emeremo y’ogokora oko teri goisanera abachenu okoremerwa kwabo gwoka, korende yamentekire mono egere Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ara aange.

English: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakuu wote wa mataifa ya pwani watashuka kutoka kwenye viti vyao vya enzi na kuweka kando majoho yao na kuvua nguo zao zilizotariziwa. Wakiwa wamevikwa hofu kuu, wataketi chini ardhini, wakiwa wanatetemeka kila dakika na wakikustajabia.
Ekegusii: Erio abagaambi bonsi bare ase ense ere enyancha mbarabare mbarue ase ebirogo biabo bi'obonene, barusie emiambaro yabo, naende barusie chianga chiabo chire nebieni ao ao. Barabwo mbabe bakoiguswa, nigo baraikaranse inse ase amaroba, babe bakona‐koiguswa na goichana igoro yao.

English: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
Kiswahili: Maana ukamilifu wote wa Uungu umo ndani ya Kristo katika umbile la mwili wa kibinadamu,
Ekegusii: Naki ime yaye nao oboikeranu bwonsi bw'obonyasae bomenyete ase ekieni ki'omobere.

English: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alikimbilia katika nchi ya Aramu; Israeli alitumika ili apate mke, ili aweze kulipa kwa ajili yake alichunga kondoo.
Ekegusii: Yakobo nigo atamete gochia ase ense y'Aramu, ere Israeli agakora emeremo ase okonyora omokungu, ee, akarisia ching'ondi ase okonyora omokungu.

English: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: waliohesabiwa kwa koo zao, walikuwa 3,200.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu isato, n'amagana abere (3,200).

English: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Danieli, enenda zako, kwa sababu maneno haya yamefungwa na kutiwa muhuri mpaka wakati wa mwisho.
Ekegusii: Akairaneria aganteebia, “Aye Danieli, karue aa ogende, ekiagera amang'ana aya amumekerigwe na kobekwa ekemanyererio goika engaki y'omoerio.

English: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
Kiswahili: Gileadi ni yangu, Manase ni yangu, Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.
Ekegusii: Gileadi neyaane, na Manase neyaane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogaambi.

English: You won't escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”'
Kiswahili: Hutaweza kuepuka mkono wake, bali hakika utatekwa na kukabidhiwa kwake. Utamwona mfalme wa Babeli kwa macho yako mwenyewe, naye atazungumza nawe ana kwa ana. Nawe utakwenda Babeli.
Ekegusii: Aye togotooreka korwa ase okoboko kwaye. Goika obwatwe na kobekwa ase okoboko kwaye, erinde mororane nomorwoti o Babiloni, amaiso ase amaiso, na gokwana nere morigereranetie obosio ase obosio, aye goika oirwe Babiloni.

English: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
Kiswahili: “Uwalipize kisasi Wamidiani kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Halafu baada ya hayo, utakufa.”
Ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y'ayio abanto abwo baabakorerete, erio magega yaye nokwe, osangererekane amo n'abanto bao.”

English: Don't show yourself valiant in wine, for wine has destroyed many.
Kiswahili: Usijionyeshe kuwa shujaa katika divai, kwani divai imewaangamiza wengi.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwerorekania buna nigo ore egeata giokonywa amarwa, ekiagera edivai yaitire abange.

English: On the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month of the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the first year of the reign of Evil-merodach king of Babylon, he pardoned Jehoiachin king of Judah and released him from prison.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba tangu Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda apelekwe uhamishoni, katika mwaka ule ambao Evil-Merodaki alifanyika mfalme wa Babeli, alimwacha huru Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, na kumfungua kutoka gerezani siku ya ishirini na tano ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato netano nebere (37) korwa Yehoyakini omorwoti o Yuda airetwe obosomba ase ense ya Babiloni ase omotienyi o ikomi na kabere (12) chitariki emerongo ebere na isano (25), Omorwoti Ewili Merodaki o Babiloni ase omwaka oria achagete kogamba akarorera Yehoyakini Omorwoti o Yuda amaabera akamorusia echera.

English: That night David and Abishai came to the troops, and Saul was lying there asleep in the inner circle of the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. And Abner and the troops were lying around him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Daudi na Abishai wakaenda kwenye jeshi wakati wa usiku, tazama Sauli, alikuwa amelala ndani ya kambi na mkuki wake umekitwa ardhini karibu na kichwa chake. Abneri na askari walikuwa wamelala kumzunguka Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ase igo ase obotuko obwo Daudi na Abisai bakagenda agwo ase Abanto b’egetwori keria, bakanyora Saulo oraire aase chigari chiabekire chikengete. Saulo nigo asimisetie ritimo riaye ang’e nomotwe oye, na Abineri na abarwani bande b’esegi nigo baraire, bamoetanaine.

English: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
Kiswahili: Msijifanye mabwana juu ya wale walio chini ya uangalizi wenu, bali kuweni vielelezo kwa hilo kundi.
Ekegusii: Timoba abagwekora abanene igoro ase abwo mwaeirwe, korende mobe ekiorokererio ekiya ase riicho riria.

English: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,
Kiswahili: Ili kukomboa wazao wa kwanza 273 wa Waisraeli ambao wamezidi hesabu ya Walawi,
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli nabange bare, mbaetanetie Abalawi ase amagana abere, na emerongo etano ebere na batato (273).

English: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakati wa ufufuo, yeye atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa ’mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”

English: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akarudi akaacha kumfuata Daudi na kwenda kukabiliana na Wafilisti. Ndiyo sababu wanaiita sehemu hii Sela-Hamalekothi.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Saulo agatiga kobwatia Daudi, akairana, akagenda korwania Abafirisiti. Ase ayio aase agwo akarokwa “Egetare ki'Ogwatananeka.”

English: He redeemed my soul from going down to the Pit, and I will live to see the light.’
Kiswahili: Alinikomboa nafsi yangu nisitumbukie shimoni, nami nitaishi ili kuufurahia mwanga.’
Ekegusii: Ere obooririe omoyo one togenda ase oboina, bono obogima bwane mborore oborabu.

English: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds, and no other well-watered trees would reach them in height. For they have all been consigned to death, to the depths of the earth, among the mortals who descend to the Pit.’
Kiswahili: Kamwe hakutakuwa na miti mingine kando ya hayo maji itakayorefuka zaidi ya huo, vilele vyake vikiwa juu ya majani yote ya miti. Hakuna miti mingine, hata kama imekunywa maji vizuri namna gani, itakayofikia urefu huo. Yote mwisho wake ni kifo, na kuingia ardhini, kama vile ilivyo kwa wanadamu, pamoja na wale waendao shimoni.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke, erinde mote onde bwensi ore ase amaache tobaisa kweenenia ase obotambe bwaye, gose gwetambeyia gochia igoro ase amare; gose emete ende yonsi ekonyora amaache tekina gochia igoro yeenenie, ekiagera yonsi yachikeirwe ogokwa esoe inse ye riroba ase Mwanyabaanto bakuure basoete.

English: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
Kiswahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya kwa mafumbo. Saa yaja ambapo sitazungumza nanyi tena kwa mafumbo bali nitawaeleza waziwazi kuhusu Baba.
Ekegusii: “Aya nakwanire nainwe ase emereng’anio; engaki neche ntakwane naende ase emereng’anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang’ana a Tata.

English: He looks down on all the haughty; he is king over all the proud.”
Kiswahili: Yeye huwatazama chini wale wote wenye kujivuna; yeye ni mfalme juu ya wote wenye kiburi.”
Ekegusii: Nigo ekorigereria kera egento kere igoro mono etari gokioboa, nigo ere omorwoti bw’ebitongwa bionsi bire noboenenu.”

English: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako amekuwa maskini katikati yako, naye akajiuza kwako, usimfanye atumike kama mtumwa.
Ekegusii: “Onye oyomino omenyete bwoo obeire omotaka, ere eoonie omonyene ase ore, tobaisa komokoria emeremo buna omosomba.

English: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
Kiswahili: sembuse mtu ambaye ni funza: mwanadamu ambaye ni buu tu!”
Ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio onga buna rikonde; na Mwanyabaanto oyio onga buna enyongore.”

English: Again He said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia tena, “Ninaenda zangu, nanyi mtanitafuta, lakini mtakufa katika dhambi zenu. Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia naende, “Inche nkogenda nde, na inwe namondigie, namokwe ase ebibe biaino; aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao.”

English: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.
Kiswahili: “Niliita washirika wangu lakini walinisaliti. Makuhani wangu na wazee wangu waliangamia mjini walipokuwa wakitafuta chakula ili waweze kuishi.
Ekegusii: “Inche nkarangeria abanchi bane ng'a bankonye, korende bakang'aina; abakuani bane na abagaaka bagakwera ase omochie ime, ekero baarenge korigia endagera barie banyore chinguru chinyia.

English: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
Kiswahili: Wagadi waliishi Gileadi, huko Bashani pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka, pia katika nchi yote ya malisho ya Sharoni kote walikoenea.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakamenya agwo Gileadi na Basani, na ase emechie y’aroro na ase oborisia bwonsi bwa Saroni goikera chinsinyo chiaye.

English: Let's acknowledge Yahweh. Let's press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
Kiswahili: Tumkubali Bwana, tukaze kumkubali yeye. Kutokea kwake ni hakika kama vile kuchomoza kwa jua; atatujia kama mvua za masika, kama vile mvua za vuli ziinyweshavyo nchi.”
Ekegusii: Intwe tiga tomomanye Omonene, ee, tiga tokore omokia tomomanye. Okooroka kwaye nigo korabe ogw'ekeene buna ogosoka kw'erioba; natochere buna embura, ee, buna embura ekwamia endagera na konyiyia riroba.

English: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh's house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.
Kiswahili: Shaba iliyotokana na zile nguzo mbili, ile Bahari na wale mafahali kumi na mawili wa shaba waliokuwa chini yake, pamoja na vile vishikilio vilivyohamishika, ambavyo Mfalme Solomoni alikuwa ametengeneza kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana, ilikuwa na uzito usioweza kupimika.
Ekegusii: Oborito bwe chitaai chiaroisetie chisiiro chiria ibere, na egetuba keria ekenene mono, na emegwekano ye chieri ikomi na ebere yeroisirie korwa ase chitaai eyio yaimokereretie egetuba keria igoro, amo nebibekerero bionsi biria Sulemani omorwoti aroisetie ase enyomba y'Omonene, nigo bwaetanetie ekerengo.

English: Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Which way has he turned? We will seek him with you. The Bride
Kiswahili: Mpenzi wako amekwenda wapi, ewe mzuri kupita wanawake wote? Mpenzi wako amegeukia njia ipi, tupate kumtafuta pamoja nawe? Mpendwa
Ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, ng’ai omwanchi oo achiire? Omwanchi oyio oo, ng’ai aonchokire gochia? Togende amo naye tomorigie. (Omoriakari)

English: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.
Kiswahili: Daudi na watu wake walipofika Siklagi, wakakuta mji umeangamizwa kwa moto na wake zao pamoja na wana wao na binti zao wamechukuliwa mateka.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi na abanto baye bachete ase omochie oyio, bakanyora ng'a osambirwe, na abakungu babo amo na'bamura na abaiseke babo bairirwe ase obosomba.

English: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart. God Disciplines His Sons
Kiswahili: Mtafakarini sana yeye aliyestahimili upinzani mkuu namna hii kutoka kwa watu wenye dhambi, ili kwamba msije mkachoka na kukata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Gaki, morengererie mono ere oyoremereretie oboengereria buna obwo bokorwa ase abanyene ebibe igoro yaye ere omonyene, timocha kwebutokania na gokwa emioyo yaino.

English: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa kikosi cha kwanza kwa mwezi wa kwanza alikuwa Yashobeamu mwana wa Zabdieli. Kulikuwa na watu 24,000 katika kikosi chake.
Ekegusii: Yasobeamu, mosinto o Sabidieli, nere otenenerete ekeombe egetang’ani, ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani; ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kila kitu sawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa agakora onsi buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: If therefore they plead any more against you, we will do them justice, and fight with you on sea and on land.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo wakiendelea kukushtaki, tutawatendea haki, na tutapigana nawe baharini na nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Ekero barabe bachire ase tore na kwemurungania ase engencho yaino naende, intwe ntobabwatesie Abayahudi, ntokoranie nainwe ase amaache na ase ense enyomo.”

English: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, mtu wa Mungu, yakimbie mambo haya yote. Fuata haki, utauwa, imani, upendo, saburi na upole.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, omonto o Nyasae, tama ayio onsi, rigia oboronge, ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na oboremereria na obwororo.

English: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don't withhold.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa hutamani zaidi, lakini mnyofu hutoa pasipo kuzuia.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong'iti nigo akweganeria kera egento botambe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo akorua na tari kong'itia.

English: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn't strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
Kiswahili: Amasa hakuona upanga uliokuwa mkononi mwa Yoabu, naye Yoabu akamchoma nao tumboni, nayo matumbo yake yakamwagika chini. Pasipo kuchomwa mara ya pili, Amasa akafa. Basi Yoabu na Abishai nduguye wakamfuatia Sheba mwana wa Bikri.
Ekegusii: Amasa teritete korwa ase omoyio oria Yoabu abwate koboko kwaye. Ase igo Yoabu akamobeta omoyio oria enda, na amara akagwa inse. Erio agwo Amasa agakwa, na Yoabu tamoaka eria kabere. Magega y'ayio Yoabu na Abisai, momura omwabo, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.

English: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Ninawajua kondoo wangu nao kondoo wangu wananijua.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche omorisia omuya, na echire echiane ninchimanyete,

English: Then the king held a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his officials and servants. He proclaimed a tax holiday in the provinces and gave gifts worthy of the king’s bounty.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akafanya karamu kubwa, karamu ya Esta, kwa wakuu wake wote na maafisa. Mfalme alitangaza mapumziko katika majimbo yake yote na kugawa zawadi kwa ukarimu wa kifalme. Mordekai Afunua Hila
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agakora omoyega omonene bw’amasikani ase Esiteri, akarangeria abanene bonsi b’obogambi na abasomba baye aroro. Boigo akaraareria abanto bakeanerigwe ebango ase ense yaye, naende akarua ebiegwa ebinge buna omorwoti agwenerete akore. Moredekai ogotooria obogima bw’omorwoti

English: In the day that you end the days of your life, in the time of death, distribute your inheritance.
Kiswahili: Siku utakapomaliza siku za maisha yako, wakati wa kifo, gawanya urithi wako.
Ekegusii: Omoerio bw'obogima bwao, ase ensa yao yomoerio, gaba obonda bwao.

English: who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
Kiswahili: aliyeyakokota magari ya vita na farasi, jeshi pamoja na askari wa msaada, nao wakalala huko, wala hawatainuka tena kamwe, wakakomeshwa, na wakazimika kama utambi:
Ekegusii: akarenta aroro chigari chi’esegi ne chibarasi, na abasikari amo ne chituoni chiabo, erio akabaiyeria inse, tibatenena naende; nigo basiretigwe bakarima buna orotambe rw’etaya. Aya nar’Omonene oyio agoteeba:

English: I will make them a horror and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a disgrace and an object of scorn, ridicule, and cursing wherever I have banished them.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya kuwa chukizo kabisa na kitu cha kulaumiwa katika mataifa yote ya dunia, watakuwa aibu na kitu cha kudharauliwa, chombo cha dhihaka na kulaaniwa, popote nitakapowafukuzia.
Ekegusii: Nindete amabe amanene igoro ase bare, na abanto b’amarwoti onsi mbaichanigwe na koondoka ekero barabarore, ekiagera nimbatige bachaywe na gosekererwa, naende babe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa bobe, na abanto mbabe bakoragereria ase erieta riabo.

English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
Kiswahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na mfanyabiashara aliyekuwa akitafuta lulu safi.
Ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro mbogwekanirie nomonto omoonchoreria, okorigia chiruru chingiya.

English: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.
Kiswahili: Hiyo nyama mbichi ikigeuka na kuwa nyeupe, ni lazima amwendee kuhani.
Ekegusii: Korende onye enyama eria embariri ekoonchoka ebe endabu, erio omonto oyio agende ase Omokuani,

English: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana asemavyo: “Nchi yote itaharibiwa, ingawa sitaiangamiza kabisa.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: “Ense yonsi nesarigwe etigare bosa, korende tinkoyesiria kegima.

English: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na lango kwenye ukumbi wa ndani lililoelekea lile lango la kaskazini, kama vile ilivyokuwa ule upande wa mashariki. Akapima kutoka lango moja hadi lile lililo mkabala nalo, lilikuwa dhiraa mia moja.
Ekegusii: Kororia ase oboagacho obwo bwa geita gia sugusu, oboagacho bonde mbwarengeo bw'egeita kiare gosoerwa gochia ase eraaro ya ime. Obwo nabwo bwareng'aine noboagacho bw'egeita kiarochie moocha. Akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bonde goika ase obonde, bokaba obw'amaboko rigana erimo.

English: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Zabuloni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ororeria rwa Sabuloni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: Kemuma wore a black dress to the funeral
Kiswahili: Kemuma alivaa gauni jeusi kwenye mazishi
Ekegusii: Kemuma abegete eyanga emwamu gochia amatanga

English: “I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Niliwapelekea tauni miongoni mwenu kama nilivyofanya kule Misri. Niliwaua vijana wenu wa kiume kwa upanga, niliwachukua farasi wenu. Nilijaza pua zenu kwa uvundo kutoka kwenye kambi zenu, hata hivyo hamjanirudia mimi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Nigo nabarenterete amaakwa anga buna aria narentete Misiri; naende ngaita abamura baino nemioro; nkabaura chibarasi chiaino, nkabatiokeria oboguundo bw’ abanto baino baitetwe, agwo ase ebitwori biaino. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili ya wafalme na wale wote wenye mamlaka, ili tupate kuishi kwa amani na utulivu, katika uchaji wote wa Mungu na utakatifu.
Ekegusii: ase engencho y’abarwoti, na bonsi abaeire okobua, erinde tonyaare koba nobogima bw’oboitongo na obw’omorembe, na ase amang’ana onsi koba ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na echi’ogosikana.

English: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa Israeli wakawaambia hao Wahivi, “Lakini huenda mnakaa karibu nasi, twawezaje basi kufanya mapatano nanyi?”
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagateebia Abahivi baria, “Naki rende torakore okobwatana nainwe? Aande gose nigo momenyete ase egati yaito.”

English: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire. It consumed the great deep and devoured the land.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi alilonionyesha katika maono: Bwana Mwenyezi alikuwa akiita hukumu ya moto; nao ulikausha vilindi vikuu, ukateketeza nchi.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora Omonene ogocha korua egesusuro goetera ase omorero; omorero oyio ogasamba chindiba chinene, naende ogaachaka gosamba nense ekoremwa.

English: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
Kiswahili: Abramu akamwambia, “Mtumishi wako yuko mikononi mwako. Mtendee lolote unalofikiri ni bora zaidi.” Ndipo Sarai akamtesa Hagari, hivyo akamtoroka.
Ekegusii: Aburamu nere agateebia Sarai: “Rora, omosomba oo oyio nase amaboko ao are; moonchie buna oranche.” Erio Sarai akamochanda bobe, na ere agatama korwa asare.

English: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.
Kiswahili: maafisa wote wakamtuma Yehudi mwana wa Nethania, mwana wa Shelemia, mwana wa Kushi, kumwambia Baruku, “Leta hicho kitabu ambacho umewasomea watu, nawe mwenyewe uje.” Ndipo Baruku mwana wa Neria akawaendea akiwa na hicho kitabu mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio abanene abwo bonsi bagatoma Yehudi mosinto o Netania, omochokoro o Selemia, omocho kororia o Kusi, korangeria Baruku na komoteebia, “Imokia egetabu eyio gwasoma ase abanto bategererete, ochiche nero.” Ase ayio Baruku, mosinto o Neria, akabogoria egetabu eria, agacha ase bare,

English: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, tuendelee kutenda dhambi ili neema ipate kuongezeka?
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?

English: It must be torn down with its stones, its timbers, and all its plaster, and taken outside the city to an unclean place.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima ibomolewe: mawe yake, mbao na lipu yake, vyote vikatupwe nje ya mji mahali palipo najisi.
Ekegusii: Enyomba eria etagorwe, na amagena onsi amo nemete ne rioomo riaye rionsi biimokigwe, bionsi biirwe ase eubi egotugutwa isiko y’omochie.

English: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni kama adui; amemmeza Israeli. Amemeza majumba yake yote ya kifalme na kuangamiza ngome zake. Ameongeza huzuni na maombolezo kwa ajili ya Binti Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire buna omobisa, osiririe Abaisraeli; osiririe chinyomba chiaye chionsi chi’oborwoti, otagoire chiburi chiaye chinkong’u; naende omenteire abanto ba Yuda okorera na okweumia.

English: I will bring you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners, and I will execute judgments against you.
Kiswahili: Nitawaondoa mtoke katika mji na kuwatia mikononi mwa wageni nami nitawaadhibu.
Ekegusii: Nimbarusie ase omochie oyo, mbabeeke ase amaboko y’ abanto abaao, na ’mbanachere ekiina.

English: And for a full 180 days he displayed the glorious riches of his kingdom and the magnificent splendor of his greatness.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku zote 180 mfalme alionyesha utajiri mwingi wa ufalme wake, fahari na utukufu wa enzi yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe y’emetienyi etano nomo (6), omorwoti akaba okworokia abanto abwo obonda na obonene bw’oborwoti bwaye, obwo bw’ogosika okonene.

English: not by works, so that no one can boast.
Kiswahili: si kwa matendo, ili mtu yeyote asije akajisifu.
Ekegusii: gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde taacha gwetogia.

English: Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin and said, “Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akawakazia macho wale wajumbe wa baraza, akasema, “Ndugu zangu, nimetimiza wajibu wangu kwa Mungu kwa dhamiri safi kabisa hadi leo.”
Ekegusii: Paulo akarigereria mono abanto b’ekegambero, akabora: “Baminto, nabeireo ase obosio bwa Nyasae goika reero iga, na enkoro yane tekongambia.”

English: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia watu wake, “Tazameni, Waisraeli wamekuwa wengi mno kwa idadi kutuliko sisi.
Ekegusii: Ere agateebia abanto baye, “Rigereria, Abaisraeli aba babeire abange gotobua, naende babeire ne chinguru gotobua,

English: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
Kiswahili: Usiache mafuriko yanigharikishe au vilindi vinimeze, au shimo lifumbe kinywa chake juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Gaki totiga emerindo entube, gose chindiba chimere, gose engoro emumekerie.

English: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
Kiswahili: safu ya pili ilikuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;

English: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Walete Walawi mbele ya Hema la Kukutania na ukusanye jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Osangererie omoganda bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli na orente Abalawi agwo bosio bw'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead. Pressing on toward the Goal
Kiswahili: ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kufikia ufufuo wa wafu. Kukaza Mwendo Ili Kufikia Lengo
Ekegusii: erinde inyore ase enchera ende yonsi goikera okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure. Kominyoka goika ase Engori

English: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
Kiswahili: Kama siku hizo zisingefupishwa, hakuna hata mtu mmoja ambaye angeokoka. Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, siku hizo zitafupizwa.
Ekegusii: Naende onye amatuko ayio atanachetwe, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete; korende ase engencho y’abachore amatuko ayio nanachwe.

English: Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.
Kiswahili: Bwana akawashinda Wabenyamini mbele ya Waisraeli na siku ile Waisraeli wakawaua Wabenyamini watu waume 25,100, wote wakiwa wenye kujifunga silaha za vita.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabua Ababenjamini ase obosio bw'Abaisraeli; nabarabwo bagaita Ababenjamini chilifu emerongo ebere na isano, ne rigana erimo, ase rituko riria. Abanto abwo bonsi baitetwe nigo bamanyete korwanera emioro.

English: But as soon as they heard that his brother Simon was made high priest in his place, and ruled the country and the cities in it,
Kiswahili: Lakini mara tu waliposikia kwamba Simoni ndugu yake amefanywa kuhani mkuu badala yake, na kwamba alikuwa mtawala wa nchi na miji iliyomo,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Abasiparta baigwete buna Simioni obeire Omokuani omonene ase ribaga ria momura omwabo, naende buna nigo areenge koraa Yudea na ebichie biaye buya,

English: And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hofu ya Mungu ikazipata falme zote za nchi waliposikia jinsi Bwana alivyokuwa amepigana dhidi ya adui za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akoboyia amarwoti onsi ay’ense, ekero abanto b’aroro baigwete ng’a Omonene narwanetie ababisa b’Abaisraeli.

English: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Shekania: Shemaya na wanawe: Hatushi, Igali, Baria, Nearia na Shafati; jumla yao walikuwa sita.
Ekegusii: Omwana o Sekania nere Semaya, na abana baye abamura nabwo aba: Hatusi na Igali, Baria na Nearia, na Safati; bonsi mbatano nomo.

English: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don't have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Hakika kama Bwana Mungu wako aishivyo, sina mkate wowote, isipokuwa konzi ya unga kwenye gudulia na mafuta kidogo kwenye chupa. Ninakusanya kuni chache nipeleke nyumbani na nikapike chakula kwa ajili yangu na mwanangu, ili kwamba tule, kiishe, tukafe.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, akamoteebia, “Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, are moyo, timbwati gento kende keroisirie, otatiga mbwate obosie boisaine oroe oromo rwoka bore ekegancha, na amaguta amasinini oka are ase echuba. Bono inche nigo ngochora ebite ebi bike, erinde ndoiserie endagera ase 'nde na ase omwana one, erio torie toche tokwe.”

English: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent —Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana ataadhibu kwa upanga wake, upanga wake mkali, mkubwa na wenye nguvu, ataadhibu Lewiathani yule nyoka apitaye kwa mwendo laini, Lewiathani yule nyoka mwenye kujipinda; atamuua joka huyo mkubwa sana wa baharini.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nae Leviatani, eng’iti eria y’okwoboyia, enyango ekwemiina, egesusuro. Nayeite n’omoro oye ore omokong’u na omonene, na ore ne chinguru; boigo naite enchoka eria ere ime ase enyancha.

English: But they remained silent. Then Jesus took hold of the man, healed him, and sent him on his way.
Kiswahili: Wakakaa kimya. Hivyo Yesu akamshika yule mgonjwa mkono na kumponya, akamruhusu aende zake.
Ekegusii: Bagakira. Akamobwata, akamogwenia, akamoa ribaga agende.

English: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mlivyoungana kusaidiana nasi katika maombi, hivyo wengi watatoa shukrani kwa niaba yetu kwa ajili ya baraka za neema tulizopata kwa majibu ya maombi ya wengi.
Ekegusii: ekero inwe boigo mogotokonya amo ase ogotosabera. Ase igo, abanto abange baakere Nyasae ng'a mbuya mono ase engencho yaito, ase obuya obo twaeirwe, ekiagera abange bagotosabera.

English: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
Kiswahili: Zebadia, Meshulamu, Hizki, Heberi,
Ekegusii: Sebadia na Mesulamu, Hisiki na Heberi,

English: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God's high priest?”
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu na Paulo wakamwambia, “Je, wewe wathubutu kumtukana kuhani mkuu wa Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Baria bateneine ang'e nere bakaboora: “Inee! Naye okorama Omokuani omonene o Nyasae?”

English: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
Kiswahili: Uliwatoa watu wako Israeli kutoka Misri kwa ishara na maajabu, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na ulionyooshwa na kwa matisho makuu.
Ekegusii: Nigo kwang'anyetie abanto bao Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase enchera y'ebikone na amakumia, na okobua okonene, na okoboko koramboire kore ne chinguru, na ase okoondokia okonene,

English: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Shuka chini mara moja, kwa sababu watu wako ambao umewatoa katika nchi ya Misri wamepotoka. Wamegeukia mbali haraka kutoka lile nililowaagiza, wamejitengenezea sanamu ya kusubu.”
Ekegusii: “Eri’Omonene aganteebia: Imoka otirimboke bwango korwa aiga ase egetunwa, ekiagera abanto abwo kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri bakorire ebibe. Baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachiigete kobwatia. Beroiseirie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa onyititoire na kobombwa.

English: Wail, O gate! Cry out, O city! Melt away, all you Philistines! For a cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there are no stragglers in its ranks.
Kiswahili: Piga yowe, ee lango! Bweka, ee mji! Yeyukeni, enyi Wafilisti wote! Wingu la moshi linakuja toka kaskazini, wala hakuna atakayechelewa katika safu zake.
Ekegusii: Aye egeita, eumie! Aye omochie, rera! Inwe Abafirisiti mwensi, ichana ase obwoba! Erioki nkorwa rire sugusu, na ase egati yabo onde tari oranyorwe.

English: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
Kiswahili: na wakatengeneza vitako arobaini vya fedha vya kuweka chini ya hiyo mihimili, vitako viwili kwa kila mhimili, kimoja chini ya kila ulimi.
Ekegusii: Agakora ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao ase chintamang’o chiaye ibere.

English: When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoulizwa na Mafarisayo Ufalme wa Mungu utakuja lini, yeye akawajibu, “Ufalme wa Mungu hauji kwa kuchunguza kwa bidii,
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,

English: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mfalme aokokaye kwa ukubwa wa jeshi lake; hakuna shujaa aokokaye kwa wingi wa nguvu zake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti tari orabue nomoganda oye omonene Nyasae bw'abarwani, gose etuoni teri eratoorigwe ne chinguru chiaye chinyinge.

English: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me. Testimonies about Jesus
Kiswahili: “Mimi siwezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yangu. Ninavyosikia ndivyo ninavyohukumu, nayo hukumu yangu ni ya haki kwa kuwa sitafuti kufanya mapenzi yangu mwenyewe, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: “Inche omonyene tinkonyaara gokora kende gionsi. Buna nkoigwa nabo nkogamba, na ekiina kiane nigo kere boronge, ekiagera tindi korigia ogwancha kwane, korende nogwancha gwa Tata oyontomete.

English: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
Kiswahili: Naye mwanamke aaminiye kama ameolewa na mwanaume asiyeamini na huyo mume anakubali kuishi naye, basi huyo mwanamke asimwache.
Ekegusii: Na omokungu ore nomosaacha otegeneti, na omosacha oyo bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.

English: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband's brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ndugu wanaishi pamoja na mmoja wao akafa bila kuacha mwana, kamwe mjane wake asiolewe nje ya jamaa hiyo. Ndugu wa mumewe atamchukua, amwoe na kutimiza wajibu wa shemeji kwake.
Ekegusii: “Onye abamura babere ba ise omo bamenyete aase aamo, na oyomo akwe, nere tabwate omwana, omokungu bw'omonto oria takonyuomwa n'omonto bw'eamate eng'ao, korende omomura omwabo omosacha oye nere oratware omokungu oria abe ribaga ria momura omwabo.

English: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
Kiswahili: Atakuadhibu kwa mishale mikali ya shujaa, kwa makaa yanayowaka ya mti wa mretemu.
Ekegusii: Mobetwe chinsara chinyoge chi’omorwani etuoni, na mosambwe n’omorero bw’amakara ’omote okorokwa omoretemu.

English: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
Kiswahili: Upendo wake kwenu unaongezeka sana anapokumbuka jinsi mlivyokuwa watiifu, na kumpokea kwa hofu na kutetemeka.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bw’omoyo ase more bwamentekanire, ekero akoinyora okoigwera kwaino inwe mwensi, na buna mwamoroisetie ase okoiroka na okoiguswa.

English: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi watu wenye dharau mnaotawala watu hawa wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abachecheria aba mokogaambera abanto ba Yerusalemu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. I have sent this message to inform my master, so that I may find favor in your sight.’”
Kiswahili: Ninao ngʼombe na punda, kondoo na mbuzi, watumishi wa kiume na wa kike. Sasa ninatuma ujumbe huu kwa bwana wangu, ili nipate kibali machoni pako.’ ”
Ekegusii: nanyorire chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke. Na bono, omonene one, nigo natomire abanto nkomanyie amang’ana ayio, inyoore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.”

English: They are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watakapochukua baadhi ya hiyo damu na kuipaka kwenye vizingiti vya juu na miimo ya milango ya nyumba ambamo watakula wana-kondoo hao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo baimokie amanyinga aria, bayagindie emetobwa ebere ya gesieri na omoribo o igoro bw’emetobwa, ase kera enyomba barayeriere emanwa eria.

English: If you listen to all that I command you, walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight in order to keep My statutes and commandments as My servant David did, then I will be with you. I will build you a lasting dynasty just as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa utafanya kila nitakalokuamuru, kuenenda katika njia zangu na kufanya yaliyo sawa mbele za macho yangu kwa kuzishika amri zangu na maagizo yangu kama alivyofanya Daudi mtumishi wangu, nitakuwa pamoja nawe. Nitakujengea ufalme utakaodumu kama ule niliomjengea Daudi, nami nitakupa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Koranyigwere na okore onsi aya nagochikiire na obwatie chinchera chiane, na okore ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane ase okorenda emeroberio yane na amachiiko aane buna Daudi, omosomba one, akorete, rirorio nimbe amo naye. Naende ningotenenerie egesaku kegendererete, buna nateneneretie Daudi, ninkobeke ogambere Abaisraeli.

English: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.'”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Pia imeandikwa: ‘Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako.' ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naende neriikire Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”

English: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akatoa amri wakusanyike wageni wote waliokuwa wanaishi Israeli, na kutoka miongoni mwao akaweka waashi ili kuchonga mawe kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abamenyi abarenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli basangererigwe amo, akababeeka kobaacha amagena na koyaroisia ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
Kiswahili: Kama hutawaachia watu wangu waondoke nitakupelekea makundi ya mainzi juu yako, kwa maafisa wako, kwa watu wako na kwenye nyumba zenu. Nyumba za Wamisri zitajazwa mainzi, hata na ardhi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Onye tokoa abanto baane ribaga, rirorio nintome chingi chinyinge igoro yao na abasomba bao, na igoro y'abanto bao ne chinyomba chiao. Chinyomba chi'Abamisiri inachiichorwe ne chingi, nonya nense eyio yonsi bamenyete.

English: He brought him word how that the treasury in Jerusalem was full of untold sums of money, so that the multitude of the funds was innumerable, and that they didn't pertain to the account of the sacrifices, but that it was possible that these should fall under the king's power.
Kiswahili: Alimletea habari jinsi hazina iliyokuwa Yerusalemu ilivyokuwa imejaa kiasi kikubwa cha pesa kisichohesabika, kiasi kwamba wingi wa fedha hizo ulikuwa usiohesabika, na kwamba hazikuhusu hesabu ya dhabihu, lakini kwamba inawezekana kwamba hizi zingeanguka chini ya mamlaka ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia buna ekegancha gie Hekalu nigo kebwate enibo enyinge totanyare kobara; na ase engencho enibo eyio ataganeirie ase engencho y'ekengwanso, nabo ekoegwa omorwoti.

English: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa katika Maandiko: “Tazama, naweka katika Sayuni, jiwe la pembeni teule lenye thamani, na yeyote atakayemwamini hataaibika kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera eriikire ase amariiko, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena richore, rigena rinene ri'ekoona, naende nigo rire rie rigori rinene, na onde bwensi oyoramwegene takorora obosooku.”

English: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile ambayo Bwana aliwapeana Waamori kwa Israeli, Yoshua akanena na Bwana akiwa mbele ya Waisraeli akasema: “Wewe jua, simama juu ya Gibeoni, wewe mwezi, tulia juu ya Bonde la Aiyaloni.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riri'Omonene abegeete Abaamori ase amaboko 'Abaisraeli, Yoshua agakwana n'Omonene. Ekero Abaisraeli bategererete, akabora, “Aye erioba, tenena, okire‐kiri igoro ya Gibeoni, naye omotienyi boigo, igoro ye Rikura ri'Ayaloni!”

English: Ask and learn who I am, and the rest who help us. They say, ‘Your foot can't stand before our face; for your ancestors have been put to flight twice in their own land.'
Kiswahili: Uliza na ujifunze mimi ni nani, na wengine wanaotusaidia. Wanasema, 'Mguu wako hauwezi kusimama mbele yetu; kwa maana baba zako wamekimbia mara mbili katika nchi yao wenyewe.'
Ekegusii: Aye mbwemanyere buna inche ning'o na abasani baane mbarabi naboigo nomanye buna tokobua kende ase obosio bwaito. Baria bagotangarete aye babeire bagoitwa ase riroba riabo abanyene;

English: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
Kiswahili: Amin nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie, namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.

English: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa mara ya tatu, Pilato akawauliza, “Kwani amefanya kosa gani huyu mtu? Sikuona kwake sababu yoyote inayostahili adhabu ya kifo. Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi, na kisha nitamwachia.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring'ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”

English: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
Kiswahili: Nitazikatilia mbali pembe za waovu wote, bali pembe za wenye haki zitainuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabune kegima ching'unchara chi'abakori amabe, korende echi'abanyaboronge nachiimokererie igoro.

English: Do not cover up their iniquity or let their sin be blotted out from Your sight, for they have provoked the builders.
Kiswahili: Usiusitiri uovu wao, wala usifute dhambi zao mbele zako, kwa kuwa wamewatukana wajenzi mbele.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotuba ebibe biabo, gose kobitinyia korwa ase obosio bwao, ekiagera bagerire kwabeire nendamwamu ase tore intwe abaagachi.”

English: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
Kiswahili: Sisemi haya ili kuwahukumu, kwa kuwa nilisema mwanzo, kwamba ninyi mko mioyoni mwetu hata kwa kufa pamoja au kuishi pamoja.
Ekegusii: Tintebeti ring'ana eri erinde mbagambie inwe, ekiagera ritang'ani konya nabateebirie ng'a inwe nigo more ne ribaga ase chinkoro chiaito, ase ogokwa na okoba moyo amo.

English: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
Kiswahili: kikosi kingine kilielekea Beth-Horoni, nacho kikosi cha tatu kilielekea kwenye nchi ya mpakani ielekeayo Bonde la Seboimu linalotazamana na jangwa.
Ekegusii: na egia kabere gekagenda Beti‐Horoni, na ekende gochia ase orobebe rorochie Rikura ria Seboimu na erooro.

English: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo waliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewanyamazisha Masadukayo, Mafarisayo wakakusanyika pamoja.
Ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai, ekero bachia koigwa ng'a Yeso obakiririe Abasadukai, bagasangererekana amo.

English: And this is the interpretation of the message: MENE means that God has numbered the days of your reign and brought it to an end.
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo maana ya maneno haya: “ Mene: Mungu amezihesabu siku za utawala wako na kuukomesha.
Ekegusii: Engencho y’amang’ana ayio nero eye: MENE, engencho yaye: Nyasae obarire amatuko y’oborwoti bwao obokoorire;

English: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya mioyo ya Wamisri kuwa migumu kusudi waingie baharini wakiwafuatia. Nami nitajipatia utukufu kupitia Farao pamoja na jeshi lake lote, kupitia magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.
