Ekegusii: Rora, ninkore chinkoro chi'Abamisiri chibe chinkong'u, barabwo mbaababwatie korwa magega. Nabo inche inyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi chiaye.

English: “At the time of the end, the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.
Kiswahili: "Wakati wa mwisho, mfalme wa kusini atashindana naye; na mfalme wa kaskazini atakuja juu yake kama kisulisuli, pamoja na magari ya vita, na wapanda farasi, na meli nyingi; ataingia katika nchi hizo, na kufurika na kupita katikati."
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki y'omoerio omorwoti o Irianyi namoumokere, korende omorwoti oria o sugusu nigo aramorindokere buna ekembugu‐mbugu ore ne chigari, na abariini be chibarasi, ne chimeeri chinyinge. Nigo arasoe ase chinse ao ao nomoganda omonene, aichore aoorie goeterao.

English: Yahweh's glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
Kiswahili: nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatua juu ya Mlima Sinai. Kwa muda wa siku sita wingu lilifunika mlima, na siku ya saba Bwana akamwita Mose kutoka katikati ya lile wingu.
Ekegusii: Obonene bw'Omonene bogaacha bokabeera igoro y'egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y'amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire gati.

English: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Shufamu, ukoo wa Washufamu; kutoka kwa Hufamu, ukoo wa Wahufamu.
Ekegusii: na Abasefufamu, abarwete ase Sefufamu, na Abahufamu, abarwete ase Hufamu.

English: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana lazima Kristo atawale mpaka awe amewaweka adui zake wote chini ya miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Naki negwenerete ere agambe, goika abeeke ababisa bonsi inse ase amagoro aye.

English: With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed; with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling.
Kiswahili: “Katika upendo wako usiokoma utawaongoza watu uliowakomboa. Katika nguvu zako utawaongoza mpaka makao yako matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase chiira chiao chi’obwanchani chiria kwabarierete okaraa abanto aba kwabooretie, ase chinguru chiao okabaikia ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

English: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
Kiswahili: Busara itakuhifadhi na ufahamu utakulinda.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio y'ebirengererio ebiya nekorende, na okomanya okuya 'ngokorende boigo.

English: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
Kiswahili: Wameiacha njia iliyonyooka, wakapotoka na kuifuata njia ya Balaamu mwana wa Beori aliyependa mshahara wa uovu.
Ekegusii: Basirire ekiagera batigire enchera erambogete na kobwatia enchera ya Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, oyobwanchete eng'eria y'ogokora okobe.

English: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Yesu alipokuwa amesimama karibu na Ziwa la Genesareti, watu wengi wakiwa wanasongana kumzunguka ili wapate kusikia neno la Mungu,
Ekegusii: Ekaba abanto nkomomiga baare, erinde baigwe ring'ana ria Nyasae, agatenena ase engegu y'enyancha ya Genesareti,

English: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.” The Sign of the Sabbath (Numbers 15:32–36)
Kiswahili: pia mafuta ya upako na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri kwa ajili ya Mahali Patakatifu. Watavitengeneza sawasawa kama vile nilivyokuagiza wewe.” Sabato
Ekegusii: na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya esamberwe Aase Aachenu ime. Ase ogokora ebinto ebi bionsi goika bakore buna nagochikiire kegima.” Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka

English: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
Kiswahili: Basi Mikali akamteremsha Daudi kupitia dirishani, naye akakimbia na kuokoka.
Ekegusii: Erio Mikali agaikeria Daudi goetera ase ekebao, na Daudi agatama agetooria.

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Mose na kuhani Eleazari walipokea dhahabu kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, wakazileta katika Hema la Kukutania kama ukumbusho kwa Waisraeli mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora chitaabu chiria korwa ase abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana, bagachiira ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Abaisraeli bakainyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Now therefore, know for sure that by sword and famine and plague you will die in the place where you desire to go to reside.”
Kiswahili: Basi sasa, hakikisheni jambo hili: Mtakufa kwa upanga, njaa na tauni mahali ambapo mnataka kwenda kuishi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono manya na mobe nobomaene ng’a inwe mokwe ase ogoitwa nemioro, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita, aase agwo mwaganirie kogenda komenya buna abamenyi.”

English: Don't listen to Hezekiah.' For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;
Kiswahili: “Msimsikilize Hezekia. Hili ndilo mfalme wa Ashuru asemalo: Fanyeni amani nami na mje kwangu. Kisha kila mmoja wenu atakula kutoka kwa mzabibu wake na mtini wake mwenyewe, na kunywa maji kutoka kisima chake mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang'ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omorwoti bw'Abaasuri agoteeba: Mokore omorembe nainche, moche ase 'nde, erio kera omonto ore ase more narie okwama kw'emesabibu yaye omonyene, na kera omonto narie okwama kw'emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amaache 'ensoko yaye omonyene,

English: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, naye akawaponya huko.
Ekegusii: na emeganda emenene ekamotunyana, akabagwenia aroro.

English: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikwenda katika nchi ya Uyahudi, nao wakakaa huko kwa muda na kubatiza.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.

English: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
Kiswahili: Baada ya mambo haya, wakati wa utawala wa Artashasta mfalme wa Uajemi, Ezra mwana wa Seraya, mwana wa Azaria, mwana wa Hilkia,
Ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana aria kaerire ase engaki y’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omorwoti bw’ense y’Ayemi, narengeo omonto okorokwa Ezra, mosinto o Seraya, bw’Asaria, o Hilikia,

English: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo Baba yangu wa mbinguni atakavyomfanyia kila mmoja wenu ikiwa hatamsamehe ndugu yake kutoka moyoni mwake.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo na Tata one ore igoro arabakorere nainwe, onye timokwabera abamino ase chinkoro chiaino ime.”

English: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
Kiswahili: ambao walichukuliwa uhamishoni kutoka Yerusalemu na Mfalme Nebukadneza wa Babeli, wakiwa miongoni mwa waliochukuliwa mateka pamoja na Mfalme Yekonia wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Moredekai oyo nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria bairetwe ase obosomba chingaki chiria omorwoti Yekonia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, abwo omorwoti Nebuchadnezzar airete ase obosomba amo nabaanto bande.

English: Putting in at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
Kiswahili: Kituo chetu cha kwanza kilikuwa Sirakusa na tukakaa huko siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Togaika Sirakusa, tokamenyao amatuko atato.

English: Now prophesy, son of man, and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says concerning the Ammonites and their contempt: ‘A sword! A sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, to flash like lightning—
Kiswahili: “Nawe, mwanadamu, tabiri na useme, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo kuhusu Waamoni na matukano yao. “ ‘Upanga, upanga, umefutwa kwa ajili ya kuua, umesuguliwa ili kuangamiza na unametameta kama umeme wa radi!
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bana oteebe ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba igoro y’Abaamoni, na igoro y’okorama kwabo, oteebe: “Omoyio, ee, omoyio osomoirwe ase ogoita, otierigwe na gosenigwa, nigo okomesa buna enkoba.

English: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mwenye haki hupima majibu yake, bali kinywa cha mwovu hufoka ubaya.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonyene oboronge nigo ekorengereria aya ekoiraneria, korende emenwa y’abakori amabe nigo egoitororoka ayare amabe.

English: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
Kiswahili: Wakamfanya Mungu kuwa na wivu kwa miungu yao migeni, na kumkasirisha kwa sanamu zao za machukizo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagera Omonene akaba ne risemi, ekiagera basasiimete chinyasae chingeni, bakagera akaba n’endamwamu enene, ekiagera akorete okogeechia.

English: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu. Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa!”
Ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna amariiko agoteeba, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto arurwe nere! Nigo ere buya kobua asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”

English: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
Kiswahili: ukoo wa nyumba ya Lawi na wake zao, ukoo wa Shimei na wake zao,
Ekegusii: eamate y'enyomba ya Lawi ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo; eamate ya Simei ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo;

English: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamuuliza, “Utafanya ishara gani ya muujiza, ili tuione tukuamini? Utafanya jambo gani?
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?

English: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
Kiswahili: Adoraimu, Lakishi, Azeka,
Ekegusii: na Adoraimu, na Lakisi, na Aseka,

English: Then Yahweh's word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likaja kupitia kwa nabii Hagai:
Ekegusii: Erio ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rikaboria:

English: The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob: “I will never forget any of their deeds.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameapa kwake mwenyewe, aliye Kiburi cha Yakobo: “Kamwe sitasahau chochote ambacho wamefanya.
Ekegusii: Omonene otianire ase Oyore Obonene bw’ abanto ba Yakobo, ogoteeba, “Ekeene, tinkweba ogokora kwabo nonya ng’ake.

English: Then Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, where he died.
Kiswahili: Farao Neko akamfanya Eliakimu mwana wa Yosia kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Yosia, na kulibadilisha jina la Eliakimu kuwa Yehoyakimu. Lakini akamchukua Yehoahazi na kumpeleka Misri, naye akafia huko. Yehoyakimu Mfalme Wa Yuda (2 Nyakati 36:5-8)
Ekegusii: Farao Neko akabeeka Eliakimu, omwana omomura o Yosia, akamobeka akaba omorwoti ase ribaga ria ise, na akaonchora erieta riaye, akamoroka Yehoyakimu. Akarusia Yehoahasi agwo, akamoira Misiri, nere agakwera aroro. Yehoyakimu omorwoti bw’Abayuda (2 Amg 36:5)

English: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.'”
Kiswahili: nami nilikuambia, “Ruhusu mwanangu aondoke, ili aweze kuniabudu mimi.” Lakini ukakataa kumruhusu kwenda, basi nitaua mwana wako mzaliwa wa kwanza.' ”
Ekegusii: Inche nagotebirie: Moe omwana one ribaga agende gonsasiima korende koraange, rirorio nigo ndaite omwana oo omotangi.”

English: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Je, wewe pia unatoka Galilaya? Chunguza nawe utaona kwamba hakuna nabii atokae Galilaya!” [
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Inee! Naye boigo Galili kwarwa? Rigia, orore ng’a mobani takorwa Galili.” [

English: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akaenda akamwambia yule mtu wa Mungu, naye mtu wa Mungu akasema, “Nenda ukayauze hayo mafuta ulipe madeni yako. Wewe na wanao mnaweza kuishi kwa kile kinachosalia.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akagenda, agateebia omonto oria o Nyasae amang'ana ayio. Nere agateebia omokungu oria. “Genda, oonie amaguta ayio, oakane esira yao, na echiratigare nchigoisane aye na abana bao.”

English: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don't put him to death,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa watu wa jumuiya watafumba macho wakati mtu huyo anapomtoa mmoja wa watoto wake kwa mungu Moleki, nao wakaacha kumuua,
Ekegusii: Onye abanto b'ense yaino bakoombia, tibaita omonto oyio orure oyomo bw'abana baye ase enyasae Moleki,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yosia na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana ande onsi igoro ya Yosia, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'ogokora kw'Abarwoti b'Abayuda.

English: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?
Kiswahili: Je, naweza kuhukumu kuwa mtu mwenye mizani ya udanganyifu hana hatia, aliye na mfuko wa mawe ya kupimia ya uongo?

English: “Come,” he replied, “let us go out to the field.” So the two of them went out into the field,
Kiswahili: Yonathani akamwambia, “Njoo, twende shambani.” Basi wakaenda huko pamoja.
Ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamoteebia, “Inchuo togende ase egetii.” Bonsi babere bakagendao,

English: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mtu mwenye hekima huongoza kinywa chake, na midomo yake huchochea mafundisho.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekworokereria omonwa oye oboseemia, naende yamenta ogotegererwa kw’ebikoba biaye.

English: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoteremka kutoka Mlima Sinai akiwa na vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda mikononi mwake, hakujua kuwa uso wake ulikuwa ukingʼaa, kwa sababu alikuwa amezungumza na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, obwate ase okoboko kwaye chibao chiriikire oborori, ere tamanya ng’a risankwa ri’obosio bwaye nigo riare komeka‐meka, ekiagera konya okwanire n’Omonene.

English: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
Kiswahili: ili mtu wa Mungu awe amekamilishwa, apate kutenda kila kazi njema.
Ekegusii: erinde omonto o Nyasae abe oikeranigwe, oisanerigwe, anyare gokora kera ogokora okuya.

English: he said to them, “Take to heart all these words I testify among you today, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Yawekeni moyoni maneno yote ambayo nimewatangazia kwa makini siku hii ya leo, ili kwamba mpate kuwaagiza watoto wenu wayatii kwa bidii maneno yote ya sheria hii.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Renda na koigwera amang’ana onsi aya nabeekire abe kirori ase more ase rituko ria reero, mochiike abana baino babwate na gokora amang’ana onsi y’amachiiko ayio.

English: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
Kiswahili: Yeye achimbaye shimo aweza kutumbukia ndani yake, yeyote abomoaye ukuta anaweza kuumwa na nyoka.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokunya engoro, nere oragwe imeo, na oyo okobochora enyasi, eng'iti engenda inse nemorome.

English: But he said to me, ‘Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. Now, therefore, do not drink wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb until the day of his death.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini aliniambia, ‘Utachukua mimba na utazaa mtoto mwanaume. Basi sasa, usinywe mvinyo wala kileo kingine chochote wala usile kitu kilicho najisi, kwa kuwa huyo mtoto atakuwa Mnadhiri wa Mungu tangu tumboni mwa mama yake mpaka kufa kwake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende nigo anteebia ng’a nimbe morito na ing’ibore omwana omoisia, naende ng’a timbaisa konywa edivai, gose ebinyugwa bigotindia, na timbaisa koria endagera ende yonsi etachenegeti, ekiagera omwana oria naatananwe ase Nyasae abe Omwerwa oye korwa okoiborwa kwaye.”

English: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, yafaa nini ikiwa mtu atadai kuwa anayo imani lakini hana matendo? Je, imani kama hiyo yaweza kumwokoa?
Ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokonywa ki omonto aranyore onye ogoteeba ng'a nare nokwegena, na ere tari nogokora? Inee! Okwegena koria nkonyare komotooria?

English: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and confess Your name, praying and pleading before You in this temple,
Kiswahili: “Wakati watu wako Israeli watakapokuwa wameshindwa na adui kwa sababu ya dhambi walizofanya dhidi yako, watakapokugeukia na kulikiri jina lako, wakiomba na kufanya dua kwako katika Hekalu hili,
Ekegusii: “Onye abanto bao Abaisraeli babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,

English: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
Kiswahili: Basi wale makerubi walikuwa wamesimama upande wa kusini wa Hekalu wakati yule mtu alipoingia ndani, wingu likaujaza ule ukumbi wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo nigo bateneine ensemo ya Irianyi y'enyomba y'Omonene, ekero omonto oria asoeteo, ne riire rigaichora ase eraaro ya ime.

English: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini yeyote miongoni mwenu afikiri kwamba ni jambo lisilosadikika Mungu kufufua wafu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki motari gwancha nga Nyasae nkobabookia are abakuure?

English: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja humwambia jirani yake uongo; midomo yao ya hila huzungumza kwa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi nigo bagoteebania amang'ana 'oborimo; nigo bare okong'o nyamenwa ebere na gokwana amang'ana ay'okweansia.

English: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kisha Paulo na wenzake wakasafiri toka Pafo wakafika Perga huko Pamfilia. Lakini, Yohana Marko akawaacha huko, akarejea Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo na abamwabo bakamanora n'emeeri korwa Pafo, bagaika Perga ase Pamfulia. Yohana akabatiga, akairana Yerusalemu,

English: Beware, my child, of all fornication, and take first a wife of the seed of your fathers. Don't take a strange wife, who is not of your father's tribe; for we are the descendants of the prophets. Remember, my child, that Noah, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, our fathers of old time, all took wives of their kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed will inherit the land.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari, mwanangu, na uasherati wote, na kwanza utwae mke wa uzao wa baba zako. Usitwae mke mgeni, ambaye si wa kabila la baba yako; kwa maana sisi tu wazao wa manabii. Kumbuka, mwanangu, kwamba Nuhu, Ibrahimu, Isaka, na Yakobo, baba zetu wa zamani, wote walichukua wake wa jamaa zao, na wakabarikiwa katika watoto wao, na uzao wao utairithi nchi.
Ekegusii: “Omwana one, etange mono korwa ase obotomani goetenia onsi, nywoma omosubati korwa ase egesaku giechisokoro chiao. Tobaisa konywoma omosubati korwa ase abanto b'ebisaku ase engencho intwe negesaku ki'ababani. Inyora abagaaka buna Nuhu, Aburamu, Isaka, na Yakobo abwo bare chisokoro chiaito nigo banywomete abasubati korwa ase egesaku kiabo. Nyasae akabasesenia akabaa abana abwo bare oroiboro rwabo nabwo bagocha koira ense eria yomwando.”

English: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;
Kiswahili: Jumla ya wanyama waliotolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa walikuwa fahali kumi na wawili wachanga, kondoo dume kumi na wawili na wana-kondoo dume kumi na wawili wa mwaka mmoja, pamoja na sadaka zao za nafaka. Mbuzi waume kumi na wawili walitolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi.
Ekegusii: Ching'iti chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa nigo chiarenge chieri ikomi na ibere, chimingichi ikomi na ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo ikomi na ibere, amo n'okoruegwa kw'endagera gwachiikire amo, chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe.

English: giving him written instructions to kill Judas himself and to scatter those who were with him, and to set up Alcimus as high priest of the great temple.
Kiswahili: akimpa maagizo yaliyoandikwa ya kumuua Yuda mwenyewe na kuwatawanya wale waliokuwa pamoja naye, na kumteua Alkimo kuwa kuhani mkuu wa hekalu kubwa.
Ekegusii: aite Yuda na gosebererania abatunyani baye, na komokora Alkimo koba Omokuani omonene bwe hekalu.

English: No, a man is a Jew because he is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a man’s praise does not come from men, but from God.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu ni Myahudi alivyo ndani, nayo tohara ya kweli ni jambo la moyoni, ni la Roho, wala si la sheria iliyoandikwa. Mtu wa namna hiyo hapokei sifa kutoka kwa wanadamu bali kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ere n’Omoyahudi bw’ekeene oyore Omoyahudi o ime, na okwaroka gw’ekeene nogw’enkoro. Eye nemeremo y’Omoika, teri ey’amariiko. Ogotogigwa kwaye tikorueti ase Mwanyabaanto, korende nase Nyasae.

English: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
Kiswahili: Lile nisemalo ni kwamba wakati wote mrithi bado ni mtoto, hana tofauti na mtumwa, ingawa ndiye mmiliki wa mali yote.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo ngokwana ng'a omonyamwando, ekero are omwana, tari nogwatananeka nomosomba, nonya ore omonyene enibo yonsi.

English: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Hii ni ishara ya Agano ninalofanya kati yangu na ninyi na kila kiumbe hai kilicho pamoja nanyi, Agano kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo:
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateeba: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi'okobwatana kwane kw'ogotianania nakorire egati yane nainwe, na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo nainwe, na ase ebiaare bigochiagocha.”

English: the descendants of Pahath-moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab), 2,818;
Kiswahili: wazao wa Pahath-Moabu (wa jamaa ya Yeshua na Yoabu) 2,818
Ekegusii: aba orwa Pahati-Moabu, be chiamate chia Yesua na Yoabu: chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na batano na batato (2,818);

English: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can't go beyond Yahweh's word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says'?
Kiswahili: ‘Hata ikiwa Balaki angenipa jumba lake la kifalme likiwa limejazwa fedha na dhahabu, nisingeweza kufanya kitu chochote kwa matakwa yangu, kikiwa kizuri au kibaya, kwenda kinyume na agizo la Bwana, nami imenipasa kusema tu kile Bwana atakachosema'?
Ekegusii: Balaki naisa kong'a enyomba yaye eichire ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, tinkonyara kwanga koigwera amang'an'Omonene anchikiire, na tingokora gento kende ase ogwancha kwane, abe amabe, gose amaya. Ay'Omonene agoteeba, ayio naro ngwenerete 'nkore.

English: Hear, O nations, the word of the LORD, and proclaim it in distant coastlands: “The One who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them as a shepherd keeps his flock.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi mataifa, litangazeni katika nchi za pwani ya mbali: ‘Yeye aliyewatawanya Israeli atawakusanya na atalichunga kundi lake la kondoo kama mchungaji.’
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, morirarie ase ebisinka na ase chinse chi’aare echire ang’e ne chinyancha, motebe: Oria osiarerete Abaisraeli, nabasangererie naende, ere nabarisie buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye.

English: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Walawi walioniacha wakati Waisraeli walipopotoka wakatoka kwangu na kutangatanga kwa kufuata sanamu zao, watachukua adhabu ya dhambi zao.
Ekegusii: “Abalawi abwo baruete asende bagantiga, bakagenda gosasiima emegwekano yabo, ekero Abaisraeli bande basaretie; egesusuro ki'ogosaria kwabo nkebairanere.

English: And I heard the voice of a man calling from between the banks of the Ulai: “Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti ya mwanadamu kutoka Mto Ulai ikiita, “Gabrieli, mwambie mtu huyu maana ya maono haya.”
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi ri’omonto rikorangeria korwa gati‐gati y’orooche rwa Ulai, rigoteeba, “Aye Gabirieli, momanyie omonto oyio engencho y’okorora okwo!”

English: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”
Kiswahili: Naye akapima urefu wa sehemu takatifu ndani, nao ulikuwa dhiraa ishirini, na upana wake ulikuwa dhiraa ishirini hadi mwisho wa sehemu ya nje ya sehemu takatifu. Akaniambia, “Hapa ndipo Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Akarengia obotambe bw'akanyomba karia kaare moino ya Aase Aachenu, bokaba obw'amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye bokaba amaboko emerongo ebere boigo. Omonto oria agantebia, “Aiga nao Aase Aachenu Mono.”

English: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings (Ephesians 6:21–24; 2 Timothy 4:19–22)
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu aliye Baba yetu apewe utukufu milele na milele. Amen. Salamu Za Mwisho
Ekegusii: Bono Nyasae, Tata oito, abakwe kare na kare. Amina. Amakwania ’ogokoorera

English: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
Kiswahili: Je, wote ni mitume? Je, wote ni manabii? Je, wote ni walimu? Je, wote wanatenda miujiza?
Ekegusii: Inee! Bonsi nabatomwa? Bonsi nababani? Bonsi naborokia? Bonsi ngokora bare ebikone bie chinguru?

English: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Samsoni alienda Gaza, akamwona mwanamke kahaba, naye akaingia kwake.
Ekegusii: Samusoni akageenda Gasa, na aroro akarora omokungu omotayayi, akageenda akarara nere.

English: The well-fed hire themselves out for food, but the starving hunger no more. The barren woman gives birth to seven, but she who has many sons pines away.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa na chakula tele wamejikodisha wenyewe ili kupata chakula, lakini wale waliokuwa na njaa hawana njaa tena. Mwanamke yule aliyekuwa tasa amezaa watoto saba, lakini yule ambaye alikuwa na wana wengi amedhoofika.
Ekegusii: Abanto ababwate endagera eisaine kare bono beruure gokora emeremo, erinde banyore endagera, nabwo baareenge n’enchara, baigotire bono. Omokungu orenge omogomba oiboire abana batano na babere, korende oria konya obwate abange otigaire ore bosa.

English: And the cows that were sickly and thin devoured the seven sleek, well-fed cows. Then Pharaoh woke up,
Kiswahili: Wale ngʼombe wabaya na waliokonda wakawala wale saba wazuri na wanono. Kisha Farao akaamka.
Ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiria chingiya chinoru. Erio Farao akaboka.

English: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
Kiswahili: Mnyama yule niliyemwona alifanana na chui, lakini miguu yake ilikuwa kama ya dubu na kichwa chake kama cha simba. Lile joka likampa huyo mnyama nguvu zake, kiti chake cha enzi na mamlaka makubwa.
Ekegusii: Na eng'iti eria narooche nigo yagwekaine engo. Amagoro aye nigo arenge buna ay'edubu, na omonwa oye buna oyo bw'endo. Enchoka ekaa eng'iti eria chinguru chiaye, na ekerogo kiaye ki'obonene, na okobua okonene.

English: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya nane ikamwangukia Yeshaya, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa gatano na gatato bokagwera Yesaia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
Kiswahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu za hiari; Ee Bwana, nitalisifu jina lako kwa kuwa ni vyema.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ninkoruere ekeng’wanso inde nenkoro y’ogwancha, nimbe nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.

English: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
Kiswahili: Kama Bwana asingelinisaidia upesi, ningelikuwa ninaishi katika ukimya wa kifo.
Ekegusii: Onye Omonene atankonyete, omoyo one nigo orenge gocha kobeera ase obokiriru bw'amakweri bwango.

English: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
Kiswahili: Kama hakuna kuadibishwa (ambalo ni fungu la watoto wote), basi ninyi ni watoto wa haramu wala si watoto halali.
Ekegusii: Korende onye mokoba motari nokorongeigwa oko bonsi babwataine nakorokwo, rirorio nigo more abana ebimeru gose tari abana ba boronge.

English: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,'” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wamemzunguka kama watu walindao shamba, kwa sababu amefanya uasi dhidi yangu,' ” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Abayuda basaririe ase 'nde, ababisa babo mbaabaetanane buna abarendi b'omogondo bakoyoetanana. Omonene okwanire.

English: They will cut down her forest,” says Yahweh, “though it can't be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.
Kiswahili: Wataufyeka msitu wake,” asema Bwana, “hata kama umesongamana kiasi gani. Ni wengi kuliko nzige, hawawezi kuhesabika.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng'a mbageche rinani ri'ense eria nonya rire rinoru mono ritaetwe nonde, ekiagera abwo nigo bare abange mono kobua chingige, tibakonyara kobareka.

English: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo tutakapomshambulia popote atakapoonekana, nasi tutamwangukia kama umande unavyoshuka juu ya ardhi. Yeye mwenyewe wala watu wake hakuna atakayeachwa hai.
Ekegusii: Erio toorokere Daudi aande onsi aranyorekane, tomogwere buna riime rikogwa igoro ase riroba, gose titotiga onde bwensi abe moyo, ere gose monto onde bwensi bare komo.

English: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waonyesheni wazi hawa ndugu uthibitisho wa upendo wenu na sababu inayotufanya tujivune kwa ajili yenu, mbele ya makanisa, ili yapate kuona.
Ekegusii: Nabo moorokie ase obosio bwe chikanisa obwanchani bwaino, na ogwetogia gwaito ase engencho yaino ase bare.

English: “In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku hizo, wakati huo,” asema Bwana, “watu wa Israeli pamoja na watu wa Yuda wataenda wakilia ili kumtafuta Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli amo n'Abayuda nabache amo babe bakorera na kondigia inche, Nyasae obo.

English: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
Kiswahili: Yoeli ndiye alikuwa mkuu wao, Shafamu wa pili, na wakafuata Yanai na Shafati, huko Bashani.
Ekegusii: Yoel nere orenge omonene, na Safamu oyo o kabere, naende Yanai na Safati bakaba agwo Basani.

English: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, wala hakuna Mungu ila wewe, kama vile tulivyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

English: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn't do that which was right in Yahweh's eyes, like David his father,
Kiswahili: Ahazi alikuwa na miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala. Akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na sita. Tofauti na Daudi baba yake, hakufanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Takorete ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene buna Daudi, sokoro yaye, akorete.

English: From Kadesh, Moses sent messengers to tell the king of Edom, “This is what your brother Israel says: You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
Kiswahili: Mose akawatuma wajumbe kutoka Kadeshi kwenda kwa mfalme wa Edomu, akisema: “Hili ndilo ndugu yako Israeli asemalo: Wewe unafahamu juu ya taabu zote ambazo zimetupata.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa Kadeshi gochia ase omorwoti o Edomu bamoteebie, “Amang’ana aya naro intwe Abaisraeli bamino togoteeba: Nomanyete emechando yonsi yatonyorire,

English: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let's go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.'
Kiswahili: na wenyeji wa mji mmoja watakwenda kwenye mji mwingine na kusema, ‘Twende mara moja na tukamsihi Bwana, na kumtafuta Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. Mimi mwenyewe ninakwenda.'
Ekegusii: Abanto b'omochie oyomo mbagende bateebie ab'omochie onde: Inchuo togende bwango, torigie ogwancherwa ase obosio Omonene, ee, inchwo torigie Omonene bw'Emeganda! Nainche nkogenda inde.

English: Simeon will have one portion bordering the territory of Benjamin from east to west.
Kiswahili: “Simeoni atakuwa na sehemu moja, itakayopakana na nchi ya Benyamini kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gia Simioni keegwe orogongo rw’aye robebekane norwa Benjamini, korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.
Kiswahili: Akaenenda katika njia za wafalme wa Israeli, na pia akasubu sanamu kwa ajili ya kuabudu Mabaali.
Ekegusii: Akabwatia chinchera chi'abarwoti b'Abaisraeli, naende akaroisia emegwekano ya Baali yanyititoire na kobombwa akayesasiima.

English: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever. RESH
Kiswahili: Tangu zamani nimejifunza kutoka shuhuda zako kwamba umezithibitisha ili zidumu milele. Maombi Kwa Ajili Ya Msaada
Ekegusii: Korwa kare nimanyete korwa ase oborori bwao ng’a naye kwabobegete bobeo goika kare na kare. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogokoonywa

English: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Balaamu, “Usiende pamoja nao. Hupaswi kulaani watu hao, kwa kuwa wamebarikiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobaisa kogeenda amo nabarabwo gose gochia koragereria Abaisraeli. Barabwo nigo basesenirie.”

English: I observed and took it to heart; I looked and received instruction:
Kiswahili: Nikatafakari moyoni mwangu lile nililoliona, nami nikajifunza somo kutokana na niliyoyaona:
Ekegusii: Nkayorigereria na korengereria mono igoro y’omogondo oyio, nkanyora amorokererio aya:

English: Now when Ish-bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel was dismayed.
Kiswahili: Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli aliposikia kwamba Abneri amekufa huko Hebroni, akakosa ujasiri, nayo Israeli yote wakatiwa hofu kuu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, aigwete ng’a Abineri oitirwe agwo Heburoni, akerusia moyo, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagaichana na gokumia.

English: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kumwoa mwanamke mwingine anazini, naye mwanaume amwoaye mwanamke aliyetalikiwa anazini.
Ekegusii: “Kera oyogotiga mokaye na konyuoma oyonde otomanire, nere oyokonyuoma oyotigirwe nomosaacha oye, noyio otomanire.

English: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usimchukue dada wa mke wako kuwa mke mwenza, na kukutana naye kimwili wakati bado mke wako anaishi.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koira mokoyoo, omwabo mokao, ekero mokao are moyo; ayio nabaise korenta obobisa.

English: Wisdom exalts her sons, and takes hold of those who seek her.
Kiswahili: Hekima huwatukuza wanawe, na huwashika wale wanaomtafuta.
Ekegusii: Chisemi nigo chigotogia abana baye, na gokoonya baria bagochirigia.

English: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slave labor, because they were his men of war, his officers and captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
Kiswahili: Lakini Solomoni hakuwafanya Waisraeli watumwa kwa ajili ya kazi yake, bali walikuwa wapiganaji, majemadari, maafisa wake, majemadari wa magari yake ya vita na waendesha magari ya vita.
Ekegusii: Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli babe abasomba ase okomokorera emeremo. Barabwo nigo babete abasikari, na abanene b’oborwoti, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.

English: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”
Kiswahili: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakamjia na kumuuliza, “Je, unajua kwamba Mafarisayo walichukizwa sana waliposikia yale uliyosema?”
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Inee! Kwamanyire ng'a Abafarisai, ekero baigwete ring'ana riria, mbagechetigwe?”

English: So at that time Solomon and all Israel with him—a very great assembly of people from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt—kept the feast for seven days.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Solomoni akaiadhimisha sikukuu wakati ule kwa muda wa siku saba, na Israeli wote pamoja naye. Walikuwa kusanyiko kubwa sana, watu kutoka Lebo-Hamathi hadi Kijito cha Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Sulemani amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi mbabwate Amatuko Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Omosangererekano oyio omonene ogasangerereka gochakera korwa egesoero kia Hamati goikeera akarooche ka Misiri.

English: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
Kiswahili: Tutakuruhusu kwa sharti moja tu, kwamba mtakuwa kama sisi kwa kuwatahiri wanaume wenu wote.
Ekegusii: Natonyare gwancha okoboria kwaino ase ring'ana erimo rioka, naende nario eri: Komoranche mobe buna intwe, kera omonto omosacha ore asemore aarokigwe.

English: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
Kiswahili: Nitauelekeza uso wangu dhidi yenu ili mshindwe na adui zenu; wale wanaowachukia watawatawala, nanyi mtakimbia ingawa hakuna mtu anayewafukuza.
Ekegusii: Nimbe mamincha yaino, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Abanto baabageechete nabwo barabagambere, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Mobe mogotama nonya monto onde tari okobabwatia.

English: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
Kiswahili: Bali kama watumishi wa Mungu tuonyeshe kwa kila njia: katika saburi nyingi; katika dhiki, katika misiba, na katika shida;
Ekegusii: korende ase kera ring'ana twenyorere ogotogigwa okuya buna abasomba ba Nyasae, ase okoganya okonge, ase emechando, ase obokong'u, ase ogochandwa,

English: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.
Kiswahili: Kando ya Mto Ahava, hapo nilitangaza kufunga, ili tujinyenyekeshe mbele za Mungu wetu na kumwomba kwa ajili ya kutujalia safari ya amani sisi na watoto wetu, pamoja na mali zetu zote.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa, nkaraareria abanto, nkabateebia ng’a tweng’ate, naende twekeyie tobe abaitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito na korigia korwa asare oborendi obuya ase orogendo rwaito, intwe na abana baito, na ebinto biaito bionsi.

English: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
Kiswahili: Lile ninaloliona huniletea huzuni nafsini kwa sababu ya wanawake wote wa mji wangu.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one ase engencho y’abaiseke bonsi b’omochie one.

English: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza Yesu, “Je, unasikia hayo hawa wanayosema?” Akawajibu, “Naam; kwani hamkusoma, “ ‘Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa’?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Kwaigure abana buna bakobora?” Yeso akabateebia, Ee; timwana gosoma: Nase emenwa y’abana na ey’abakogonka kwerenteire ogotogia ogoikeranu?

English: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
Kiswahili: Tumeangamizwa kwa hasira yako na tumetishwa kwa ghadhabu yako.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo togosirigwa nendamwamu yao, twaondokigwa nekeririanda kiao.

English: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.
Kiswahili: Wakati Efraimu alipozungumza, watu walitetemeka, alikuwa ametukuzwa katika Israeli. Lakini alikuwa na hatia ya kumwabudu Baali naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaefraimu baarenge gokwana, abanto nigo baarenge koiguswa; nigo beimokereretie igoro ase egati y'Abaisraeli; korende bakarenta okomocha ase ogosasiima enyasae Baali, na ase ayio bagakwa.

English: All the birds of the air nested in its branches, and all the beasts of the field gave birth beneath its boughs; all the great nations lived in its shade.
Kiswahili: Ndege wote wa angani wakaweka viota kwenye vitawi vyake, wanyama wote wa shambani wakazaana chini ya matawi yake, mataifa makubwa yote yaliishi chini ya kivuli chake.
Ekegusii: Chinyoni chionsi chikaagacha ebiswa biabo ase chinsagia chiaye, ne ching’iti chikabiarera inse ye chinsagia chiaye; inse y’ekiriri kiaye abanto b’ebisaku bionsi ebinene bikamenyao.

English: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don't burn with indignation?
Kiswahili: Je, ni nani aliye mdhaifu, nami nisijisikie mdhaifu? Je, nani aliyekwazwa, nami nisiudhike?
Ekegusii: Ning'o ore omoreu, na inche timba omoreu? Ning'o ogerire ogwe, na inche tingechigwa?

English: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don't go from house to house.
Kiswahili: Kaeni katika nyumba hiyo, mkila na kunywa kile watakachowapa, kwa sababu kila mtendakazi anastahili malipo yake. Msihamehame kutoka nyumba hadi nyumba.
Ekegusii: Mobeere ase enyomba eyio, morie na konywa ebi bakobaa, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete aegwe eng'eria yaye. Timoetanana enyomba ase enyomba.

English: Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him.
Kiswahili: Petro na wenzake walikuwa wamelala usingizi mzito. Walipoamka, wakaona utukufu wa Yesu na wale watu wawili waliokuwa wamesimama pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Petero na baria barenge amo nere, konya babwatirwe ne chitoro, korende nigo bategesetie, bakarora obonene bwaye, na abanto baria babere bateneine amo nere.

English: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atapura kutoka matiririko ya Mto Frati hadi Kijito cha Misri, nanyi ee Waisraeli, mtakusanywa mmoja mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nabaswage inwe Abaisraeli buna chinyeke chi’endagera na kobachora oyomo oyomo. Nigo arachakere ase orooche rwa Eufarati na goikera ase akarooche ka Misiri.

English: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
Kiswahili: pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro chikobibwata chibe emerongo ebere chie chitaai, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio bie chisiiro chiria ne chinuga chiabo chibe chi’echifeta.

English: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
Kiswahili: Hurudi jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.
Ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.

English: and agreed to stay with him, and the young man became like a son to Micah.
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule Mlawi akakubali kuishi pamoja naye, naye huyo kijana akawa kwake kama mmoja wa wanawe.
Ekegusii: Omolawi oria agancha komenya amo n’omonto oria, na ere akamokora buna oyomo bw’abana baye abamura.

English: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.” The Parable of the Barren Fig Tree (Isaiah 5:1–7)
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, la hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, wote mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.” Mfano Wa Mti Usiozaa Matunda
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi, namosire boigo.” Omoreng’anio bw’omoko omogomba

English: The foreigners lifted up their eyes, and saw them coming near them.
Kiswahili: Wageni waliinua macho yao, wakawaona wakikaribia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo be ebisaku barigereretie bakarora Yuda okobaachera na abanto baye,

English: And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!”
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
Ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi naende, “Mobambe!”

English: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
Kiswahili: Enoki, mtu wa saba kuanzia Adamu alitoa unabii kuhusu watu hawa, akisema: “Tazama, Bwana anakuja pamoja na maelfu kwa maelfu ya watakatifu wake,
Ekegusii: Na Enoku, omonto o gatano na kabere korwa ase Adamu, nakwanete amang'ana obobani igoro y'abwo, ogoteeba, “Rigereria, Omonene nache nabachenu baye chilifu ne chilifu,

English: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
Kiswahili: Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni ajabu machoni petu’?”
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”

English: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
Kiswahili: Pandeni milimani mkalete miti na kujenga nyumba, ili nipate kuifurahia, na nitukuzwe,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, morente emete moagachere enyomba eye, erio nario ndagokigwe nero, naende inyeorokie ng’a inche ninde nobonene.” Nabo Omonene atebiire.

English: And the LORD answered, “It is because they have forsaken My law, which I set before them; they have not walked in it or obeyed My voice.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Ni kwa sababu wameiacha sheria yangu, niliyoiweka mbele yao: hawajaniheshimu mimi wala kufuata sheria yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoiraneria: “Aya nigo akorekanire, ekiagera batigire ogochika kwane nabaete, bangire konyigwera na kobwatia chinchera chiane.

English: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
Kiswahili: Kama sivyo nitamvua nguo zake awe uchi na kumwacha uchi kama siku ile aliyozaliwa. Nitamfanya kama jangwa, nitamgeuza awe nchi ya kiu, nami nitamuua kwa kiu.
Ekegusii: Atakoreti bo, nimochabore chianga chiaye, imotige getirianda abe bosa buna ase rituko riria aiboretwe. Nimokore abe buna erooro, na buna ense enyomo, nimotige akwe ase engencho y'erang'o.

English: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
Kiswahili: Atangʼolewa kutoka usalama wa hema lake, na kupelekwa kwa mfalme wa vitisho.
Ekegusii: Nataboranwe ne chinguru korwa ase obomenyo konya asemeretie, erio airwe ase omorwoti bw’okwoboyia okonge.

English: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
Kiswahili: Siku sita baada ya jambo hili, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu peke yao.
Ekegusii: Na nyuma y’amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.

English: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed. The Resurrection of the Dead
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kama ilikuwa mimi au wao, hili ndilo tunalohubiri, na hili ndilo mliloamini. Ufufuo Wa Wafu
Ekegusii: Gaki onye ninche, gose mbaria, naboigo tokorandia, naboigo mwegenete. Okobokigwa kw’abakuure

English: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.'”
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipowaambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asemalo: ‘Kila mmoja wenu ajifunge upanga wake kiunoni aende huku na huko kambi yote mwisho hadi mwisho mwingine, kila mmoja amuue ndugu yake, na rafiki yake na jirani yake.' ”
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oteebire iga “Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa egeita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio”.

English: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
Kiswahili: Kama ukifanya hivyo nao wakinililia, hakika nitasikia kilio chao.
Ekegusii: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.

English: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo maana yake: Vikapu vitatu ni siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Na Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Engencho y'okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinteru echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.

English: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
Kiswahili: Mpe sehemu ya mamlaka yako ili jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ipate kumtii.
Ekegusii: Omoe okobua buna okwao, erio nario omoganda bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli oramoigwere.

English: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
Kiswahili: Maono niliyoyaona yalikuwa kama maono yale niliyokuwa nimeyaona wakati Mungu alipokuja kuangamiza mji na kama maono niliyokuwa nimeyaona kando ya Mto wa Kebari, nami nikaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Obonene obwo narooche ase okorora nigo bwarenge buna boria narooche ekero nachete gosaria omochie o Yerusalemu, na buna okorora koria konya narorire agwo ase orooche rwa Kebari. Erio ngatung'ama inse nkaumama.

English: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya makao yangu miongoni mwenu, nami sitawachukia.
Ekegusii: Nimenye ase egati yaino ase Obomenyo bwane Obochenu; tinkobatiga nonya ng’ake.

English: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”
Kiswahili: Bali Yoshua alikuwa amewaagiza watu, “Msipige kelele ya vita, msipaze sauti zenu, wala kusema neno lolote mpaka siku ile nitakayowaambia mpige kelele. Ndipo mtapiga kelele!”
Ekegusii: Yoshua agachiika abanto baria, akabateebia, 'Timoaka eriogi, gose gokwana ing'ana rinde nonya ng'ake goika rituko riria ndabateebie ng'a moake eriogi. Erio nario moraake eriogi.'

English: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
Kiswahili: Habari za ukoo wa Yesu Kristo mwana wa Daudi, mwana wa Abrahamu:
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’echisokoro chia Yeso Kristo korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi, oyio orenge korwa ase ororeria rwa Aburaamu.

English: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
Kiswahili: ambayo kwa kweli si Injili kamwe, ila kwa dhahiri kuna watu wanaowachanganya na wanaotaka kuipotosha Injili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase ekeene “enchiri ende eng’ao” teiyo, korende nigo nkoyakwana aya ase engencho mbareo abanto bande bakobaotorana na korigia koonchorana enchiri ya Kristo.

English: And as she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a piece of bread.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa anakwenda kumletea, akamwita akasema, “Tafadhali niletee pia kipande cha mkate.”
Ekegusii: Ekero omokungu oria arenge kogenda korenta amaache, akamorangeria naende, akamoteebia, “Ondetere negesamunye ki’omogati.”

English: of turning away your face from a kinsman, of taking away a portion or a gift, of gazing at a woman who has a husband,
Kiswahili: ya kugeuza uso wako kutoka kwa jamaa, ya kuchukua sehemu au zawadi, ya kumtazama mwanamke aliye na mume,
Ekegusii: ase okoba omong'iti ekero ogosabwa egento, ase ogokira ekero ogokwanigwa,

English: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Hagari akamzalia Abramu mwana, naye Abramu akamwita huyo mwana Hagari aliyemzalia, Ishmaeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Hagari akaiborera Aburamu omwana omoisia; nere Akaroka omwana oria oye, Isumaeli.

English: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
Kiswahili: “Chakula ni cha tumbo, na tumbo ni la chakula”: lakini Mungu ataviangamiza vyote viwili. Mwili haukuumbwa kwa ajili ya zinaa bali kwa ajili ya Bwana na Bwana kwa ajili ya mwili.
Ekegusii: “Endagera ney'enda na enda ney'endagera”, korende Nyasae nasarie bionsi bibere, enda na endagera. Omobere tori ase obotomani, korende nase Omonene, n'Omonene ase omobere.

English: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
Kiswahili: Mliwahurumia wale waliokuwa kifungoni, mkikubali kwa furaha kunyangʼanywa mali zenu kwa maana mlijua kwamba mnayo mali iliyo bora zaidi idumuyo.
Ekegusii: Naki mwabarorerete amaabera baria barenge ase ebisibo, mogancha nomogooko kourwa chinibo chiaino, ekiagera mwamanyete ng’a inwe abanyene more nenibo eyere engiya kobua, erabeo kare na kare.

English: But if the distance is too great for you to carry that with which the LORD your God has blessed you, because the place where the LORD your God will choose to put His Name is too far away,
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mahali pale ni mbali sana nanyi mmebarikiwa na Bwana Mungu wenu na hamwezi kubeba zaka yenu (kwa sababu mahali pale Bwana atakapopachagua kuliweka Jina lake ni mbali sana),
Ekegusii: Onye aase agwo Omonene achoorire abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye are aare mono, motanyaare kobogoria ensemo ya ikomi y’eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, abasesenirie n’ero,

English: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
Kiswahili: Akaingia ndani, akaanguka miguuni pa Elisha na kusujudu hadi nchi. Kisha akamchukua mwanawe na kutoka nje.
Ekegusii: Agacha agatugama ase amagoro Elisha, akaumama, erio akaimokia omwana oye, agasoka isiko.

English: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?
Kiswahili: Akawaambia tena, “Tuufananishe Ufalme wa Mungu na nini? Au tutumie mfano gani ili kuueleza?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akagenderera koboora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase mobayeeno ki?

English: from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;
Kiswahili: wa wazao wa Shefatia, alikuwa Zebadia mwana wa Mikaeli na wanaume 80 pamoja naye;
Ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Sefatia, Sebadia, mosinto o Mikaeli, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na etato (80);

English: Don't rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
Kiswahili: Usimkemee mzee kwa ukali bali umshawishi kama vile angekuwa ni baba yako. Uwatendee vijana kama vile ndugu zako;
Ekegusii: Totogonyera omogaka, korende omosorore buna iso, abamura abake buna bamura bamino,

English: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Hor-Hagidgadi na kupiga kambi huko Yotbatha.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Hori‐Hagidigadi, bakageenda bagaika Yotibata, bagatoora aroro.

English: “Son of man, write down today’s date, for on this very day the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, weka kumbukumbu ya tarehe hii, tarehe hii hasa, kwa kuwa mfalme wa Babeli ameuzingira mji wa Yerusalemu kwa jeshi siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, riika erieta rie rituko ria reero, ekiagera rituko eri nario omorwoti o Babiloni achire korwania Yerusalemu.

English: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
Kiswahili: Ningependa nikae naye ili ashike nafasi yako ya kunisaidia wakati huu nikiwa kifungoni kwa ajili ya Injili.
Ekegusii: Naki inche nigo narenge kogania abeere aiga amo nainche ase nsibire ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde anyare gonkorera ribaga riao.

English: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni urithi wangu milele, naam ni furaha ya moyo wangu.
Ekegusii: Oborori bwao nabwo omwando one goika kare na kare, ee, nabwo enkoro yane egokerete mono.

English: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh's anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watamgeuza mwanao aache kunifuata, ili aitumikia miungu mingine, nayo hasira ya Bwana itawaka dhidi yako, naye atakuangamiza ghafula.
Ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo nigo baraonchore abana baino abamura batige gosasiima Omonene, erio bakorere chinyasae ching'ao. Eri'Omonene abaise koba n'endamwamu ase more, abasirie ara rimo rioka.

English: Let us lie down in our shame; let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our fathers; from our youth even to this day we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.”
Kiswahili: Sisi na tulale chini katika aibu yetu, na fedheha yetu itufunike. Tumetenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana Mungu wetu, sisi na mababa zetu; tangu ujana wetu hadi leo hatukumtii Bwana Mungu wetu.”
Ekegusii: Tiga toraare inse tobe nobosooku, na echayo ebe ase tore, ekiagera twasaririe ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, korwa obwana bwaito goika reero iga, intwe amo ne chisokoro chiaito. Titwamoigwerete Omonene, Nyasae Nyasae oito.

English: In every work that he began in the service of God's house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.
Kiswahili: Naye katika kila kitu alichofanya katika huduma kwenye Hekalu la Mungu na katika utii kwa sheria na amri, alimtafuta Mungu wake na kufanya kazi kwa moyo wake wote. Naye hivyo akafanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Ere agasesenigwa, ekiagera emeremo ende yonsi akorete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ase okobwata amachiiko onsi, na komorigia Nyasae oye, nigo ayakorete nenkoro yaye yonsi.

English: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
Kiswahili: Mungu, yeye ajuaye mioyo, alionyesha kwamba anawakubali kwa kuwapa Roho Mtakatifu kama vile alivyotupa sisi.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae, oyomanyete chinkoro chi'abaanto, akabanchera, akabaa Omoika Omochenu, koreng'ana buna atoete intwe,

English: They will chop down her forest, declares the LORD, dense though it may be, for they are more numerous than locusts; they cannot be counted.
Kiswahili: Wataufyeka msitu wake,” asema Bwana, “hata kama umesongamana kiasi gani. Ni wengi kuliko nzige, hawawezi kuhesabika.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng’a mbageche rinani ri’ense eria nonya rire rinoru mono ritaetwe nonde, ekiagera abwo nigo bare abange mono kobua chingige, tibakonyara kobareka.

English: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo Marko, Aristarko, Dema na Luka, watendakazi wenzangu wanakusalimu.
Ekegusii: Boigo Mariko na Aristariko, na Dema, na Luka.

English: Its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico had the same measurements as the others. Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around; it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
Kiswahili: Vyumba vyake, kuta zilizogawanya vyumba na ukumbi wake zilikuwa na vipimo sawasawa na zile nyingine. Hilo lango na baraza yake vilikuwa na madirisha pande zote. Navyo vilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa hamsini na upana wa dhiraa ishirini na tano.
Ekegusii: Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Boigo ebibao mbiarengeo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, na ase egesona. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.

English: So I became great and surpassed all in Jerusalem who had preceded me; and my wisdom remained with me.
Kiswahili: Nikawa maarufu sana kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepata kuishi Yerusalemu kabla yangu. Katika haya yote bado nikawa nina hekima.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba omonto bw’amasikani amanene, nkabua abwo bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu; boigo obong’aini bwane bogantigarera.

English: Moreover, when nations consenting together in wickedness had been confounded, wisdom knew the righteous man, and preserved him blameless to God, and kept him strong when his heart yearned toward his child.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, mataifa yalipokubaliana pamoja katika uovu yalipochanganyikiwa, hekima ilimjua mtu mwenye haki, na kumhifadhi bila lawama kwa Mungu, na kumtia nguvu moyoni mwake alipotamani mtoto wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero chinse chiaigwananete ase ogokora amabe, obongaini bogakonya omonto oyomo oyio omoirogete Nyasae n'moyo oye bwonsi. Ase obongaini omonto oyio akabwata amachiiko a Nyasae nonya ngoika komorwa omwana oye oyio anchete mono.

English: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
Kiswahili: “Nilisema, ‘Ninyi ni “miungu”; ninyi nyote ni wana wa Aliye Juu Sana.’
Ekegusii: Natebiire ng’a: “Inwe nechinyasae; inwe mwensi nabana b’Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.

English: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Nifungulie malango ya haki, nami nitaingia na kumshukuru Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inyigorere ebiita bi’oboronge, erio insoe aroro ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene.

English: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent's door.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akatokea katika Hema katika nguzo ya wingu, nalo wingu likasimama juu ya ingilio la Hema.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaoroka agwo ore ime ase riire rire buna esiiro, narirorio rigatenena agwo ase egesieri ki'Eema eria.

English: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunamjua yeye aliyesema, “Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi; nitalipiza.” Tena asema, “Bwana atawahukumu watu wake.”
Ekegusii: Naki ntomanyete ere oyokwanete, “Egesiomba nekiane, inche ning’akane,” naende, “Omonene nere oragambie abanto baye.”

English: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter, and the LORD said to Hosea, “Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.
Kiswahili: Gomeri akachukua tena mimba akamzaa binti. Kisha Bwana akamwambia Hosea, “Mwite Lo-Ruhama, kwa maana sitaonyesha tena upendo kwa nyumba ya Israeli, kwamba nisije kabisa nikawasamehe.
Ekegusii: Naende Gomeri akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoiseke. Erio Omonene agateebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ruhama, ekiagera tinkonyara kogenderera koba namaabera ase Abaisraeli, gose tinkobaabera nonya ng’ake.

English: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I beg you, please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.’ So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.” When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
Kiswahili: ‘Hili ndilo mtakalomwambia Yosefu: Ninakuomba uwasamehe ndugu zako dhambi na mabaya kwa vile walivyokutenda vibaya.’ Sasa tafadhali samehe dhambi za watumishi wa Mungu wa baba yako.” Ujumbe huu ulipomfikia, Yosefu akalia.
Ekegusii: Moteebie Yusufu iga: Nagosabire obaabere abamino amamocho abo na ebibe biabo bagokorerete. Nimanyete ng’a mbagokorerete bobe. Ase igo, bono twagosabire, otwabere ebibe biaito, naki intwe nabasomba ba Nyasae o iso.” Yusufu akarera ekero abamwabo bamoboretie amang’ana ayio.

English: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
Kiswahili: Katika mawazo yenu mtaifikiria hofu iliyopita: “Yuko wapi yule afisa mkuu? Yuko wapi yule aliyechukua ushuru? Yuko wapi afisa msimamizi wa minara?”
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino nchirengererie igoro y'obwoba boria na goteeba: “Inee! Oria orenge kobeeka ebango, ng'ai are? Oria orenge korusia ebango, ng'ai are? Oria orenge kobara emerobiri, ng'ai are?”

English: Hookworms feed on blood
Kiswahili: Minyoo hula damu
Ekegusii: Amanyinga naro endagera ye chinkegeta

English: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
Kiswahili: Heri wale wanaozishika shuhuda zake, wamtafutao kwa moyo wao wote.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abwo barendete oborori bwaye, abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,

English: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
Kiswahili: divai ya kuufurahisha moyo wa mwanadamu, mafuta kwa ajili ya kungʼarisha uso wake, na mkate wa kutia mwili nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakonywa edivai na baba nomogooko; nigo bakweaka amaguta, bagirigenta amasio abo, naende baria endagera, erinde emebere yabo yanyora chinguru.

English: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Kiswahili: yale ambayo tuliyasikia na kuyajua, yale ambayo baba zetu walituambia.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ayio twaigwete na koyamanya, ayio chisokoro chiaito chiatotebetie.

English: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka yake ni mbuzi, ataileta mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekeng'wanso ekio arue ebitinya bionsi ebire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, n'ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng'wanso kegosaambwa n'omorero ase 'nde inche Omonene.

English: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
Kiswahili: “Kimbieni kutoka Babeli; ondokeni katika nchi ya Wakaldayo tena kuweni kama mbuzi wale waongozao kundi.
Ekegusii: “Tama korwa Babiloni, morue ase ense y'Abakalidayo, mobe buna chigoree chigotang'ana bosio bwe riicho.

English: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine kumi waliposikia haya, waliwakasirikia hao ndugu wawili.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bakababea abamura baria babere.

English: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles kept the Passover.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza, waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni wakaadhimisha Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, abanto baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakarenda Epasaka.

English: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Waisraeli wote kuanzia Dani hadi Beer-Sheba na wa kutoka nchi ya Gileadi wakatoka kama mtu mmoja wakakusanyika mbele za Bwana huko Mispa.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba, amo n'ab'ense ya Gileadi bakarua chinka chiabo, bagasangererekana amo, bakabwatana, bakaba buna omonto oyomo ase obosio bw'Omonene agwo Misipa.

English: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, na uzishikamanishe sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.
Ekegusii: Naende okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibwateranie ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.

English: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
Kiswahili: Nao wakati wa kufukiza uvumba ulipowadia, wale wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika ili kuabudu walikuwa nje wakiomba.
Ekegusii: Na omoganda bwonsi bw'abaanto nigo orenge isiko gosaba ekero ki'ogosamba ubani.

English: When Your people go to war against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to You in the direction of the city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name,
Kiswahili: “Wakati watu wako watakapokwenda vitani dhidi ya adui zao, popote utakapowapeleka, wakati watakapoomba kwa Bwana kuelekea mji ambao umeuchagua, na Hekalu nililolijenga kwa ajili ya Jina lako,
Ekegusii: “Abanto bao kobaragende korwania ababisa babo ase enchera ende yonsi aye orabatome gochia, na kobaragosabe aye Omonene barigereretie omochie oyio gwachorire, na enyomba eye naagacheire erieta riao,

English: the elders of his city must send for him, bring him back, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.
Kiswahili: wazee wa mji wake watatuma ujumbe kwake, kumleta kutoka mji ule na kumkabidhi mlipiza kisasi cha damu kumuua.
Ekegusii: erio abagaaka b’omochie bw’omoiti oria batome abanto bamorusie korwa ase omochie oria atameire, bamobeeke ase okoboko kw’oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere aite omoiti oria.

English: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
Kiswahili: Mnadhani nimekuja kuleta amani duniani? La, nawaambia sivyo, nimekuja kuleta mafarakano.
Ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a nigo nachire ng’ee ense omorembe? Nabatebirie, taibo, korende nogwatanana.

English: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa ndiyo jumla ya wale wa koo za Wamerari. Mose na Aroni waliwahesabu kufuatia amri ya Bwana kupitia kwa Mose.
Ekegusii: Oyo n'oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi'Abamerari, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
Kiswahili: Jitahidi ufike huku kabla ya majira ya baridi. Eubulo anakusalimu, vivyo hivyo Pude, Lino, Klaudia na ndugu wote.
Ekegusii: Teema buna oranyaare gocha ritang’ani etoigo etaracha. Eubulu ogokwanirie, naboigo Pudente na Lino, na Klaudia, na abaminto bonsi.

English: He said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and present them before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua ndama dume kwa ajili ya sadaka yako ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, wote wawili wasiwe na dosari, nao uwalete mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende agateebia Aroni, “Chora eeri ensae na emori, chionsi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, ochirue ase Omonene. Eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe eki’ogosaambwa.

English: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.
Kiswahili: Nikayatafakari katika akili yangu, nikiwalaumu wakuu na maafisa. Nikawaambia, “Mnawaonea ndugu zenu kwa kuwatoza riba!” Basi nikaitisha mkutano mkubwa ili kuwashughulikia
Ekegusii: Nkarengereria inche omonyene gokora egento ase engencho y'ayio. Ngasoera abanto basikire na abatang'ani, nkabateebia, “Inwe nigo mokwenyorera ebitoki korwa ase abamino.” Erio nkarangeria omoganda omonene gocha kogamba igoro y'amang'ana ayio,

English: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
Kiswahili: Petro na yule mwanafunzi mwingine wakaondoka mara kuelekea kaburini.
Ekegusii: Petero agasoka, akagenda amo nomworokigwa oria onde, bakabwatia enchera kogenda oboina.

English: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo Sauli alikuwa anarudi kutoka mashambani, akiwa nyuma ya maksai wake, naye akauliza, “Watu wana nini? Mbona wanalia?” Ndipo wakamweleza jinsi watu wa Yabeshi walivyokuwa wamesema.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Saulo nigo areenge ogocha korwa mogondo ogotema chiombe chiaye, akabooria: “Inki kiaba Abanto aba bakorera iga?” Ase ayio bakamoteebia amang'ana aria Abanto ba Yabesi barentete.

English: When Jesus had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”
Kiswahili: Alipomaliza kunena, akamwambia Simoni, “Sasa peleka mashua hadi kilindini kisha mshushe nyavu zenu mkavue samaki.”
Ekegusii: Goika agachia gokoora ogokwana kwaye, agateebia Simioni, “Sukia obwato goika endiba, moikie ebionga biaino ase okoruba.”

English: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
Kiswahili: Ishmerai, Izlia na Yobabu ndio waliokuwa wana wa Elpaali.
Ekegusii: Isimerai na Isilia, na Yobabu; aba nigo barenge abana abamura b'Elipali.

English: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
Kiswahili: kwa jibini na maziwa kutoka makundi ya ngʼombe na kutoka makundi ya mbuzi, kwa mafuta ya wana-kondoo na mbuzi, kwa kondoo dume wazuri wa Bashani, na kwa ngano nzuri. Ukanywa damu ya zabibu inayotoa povu.
Ekegusii: Akabaa amanooga ye chiombe, na amabeere ye chimbori, ne chinyama chinoru chie chimanwa chi'eching'ondi, na echie chimingichi, amo ne ching'ondi ne chimbori chingiya chikorwa Basani. Mokaria engano yarenge engiya mono, na mokanywa edivai korwa ase amasabibu amonyinga.

English: Then the Assyrians called out loudly in Hebrew to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten and terrify them in order to capture the city.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakawaita kwa Kiebrania watu wa Yerusalemu waliokuwa juu ya ukuta ili kuwatisha na kuwatia hofu ili waweze kuuteka mji.
Ekegusii: Abaasuri bagaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ase abanto ba Yerusalemu abarenge igoro ase orwaki ase okobagosa na koboboyia, erinde baire omochie oria.

English: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men.
Kiswahili: Wale nzige walikuwa na umbo kama la farasi waliotayarishwa kwa ajili ya vita. Kwenye vichwa vyao kulikuwa na kitu kama taji za dhahabu na nyuso zao zilikuwa kama za binadamu.
Ekegusii: Ase ebieni biabo chingige chiria nigo chiagwekaine chibarasi chibekire ang’e ase esegi. Ase emetwe yabo nigo chiarenge n’ebinto bikororekana buna chigutwa chi’echitaabu, na amasio abo nigo agwekaine amasio a Mwanyabaanto.

English: If a man of knowledge hears a wise word, he will commend it and add to it. The wanton man hears it, and it displeases him, so he throws it away behind his back.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye maarifa akisikia neno la busara, analisifu na kuliongeza. Mtu mkorofi akisikia, na halimpendezi, basi analitupa nyuma ya mgongo wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omong'aini akoigwa ring'ana ri'echisemi nigo akoritogia na korimenta kegima. Korende omonto osirete ekero akoriigwa nigo akorisiereria, na koritugutera aare kegima.

English: This is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies. They will turn their backs and run from their enemies, because they themselves have been set apart for destruction. I will no longer be with you unless you remove from among you whatever is devoted to destruction.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu Waisraeli hawawezi kusimama dhidi ya adui zao. Wanawapa visogo na kukimbia kwa kuwa wanastahili maangamizi. Sitakuwa pamoja nanyi tena mpaka mwangamize kila kitu miongoni mwenu kilichotengwa kwa maangamizi.
Ekegusii: Nakio kiagerire Abaisraeli babuirwe na’babisa babo. Batamire korwa ase ababisa babo, ekiagera barabwo abanyene baragererigwe ase ogosirigwa. Inche tinkoba amo nainwe goika mwasaririe ebinto ebi bionsi biragereirie bire ase egati yaino.

English: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaondoka kwa mashua peke yao, wakaenda mahali pasipo na watu.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda ase obwato, aase abobisi, atari nabaanto.

English: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
Kiswahili: Lakini ulipowadia utimilifu wa wakati, Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe, ambaye alizaliwa na mwanamke, akazaliwa chini ya sheria,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Nyasae agatoma Omwana oye; ere akaiborwa nomokuungu, akaiborerwa inse y’amachiiko,

English: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
Kiswahili: yote haya kwa sababu ya wingi wa tamaa za kahaba, anayeshawishi, bibi wa mambo ya uchawi, anayewatia utumwani mataifa kwa ukahaba wake na pia jamaa za watu kwa ulozi wake.
Ekegusii: Ninawi omotomani nkoegwa are egesusuro. Akomeka meka na oichire n'ogwechabera kw'oborogi bw'ogoita, nigo aegete ebisaku na kobakora abasomba.

English: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
Kiswahili: Yeye huyafanyia makinda yake ukatili kama vile si yake; hajali kwamba taabu yake inaweza ikawa bure,
