Ekegusii: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,

English: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
Kiswahili: Katika siku za maisha ya Yesu hapa duniani, alimtolea maombi na dua pamoja na kulia sana na machozi, yeye awezaye kumwokoa na mauti, naye Mungu akamsikia kwa sababu ya kutii kwake kwa unyenyekevu.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, ekero arenge ase omobere o Mwanyabaanto, Yeso agasaba na gosorora amo nokorera okonene, na amariga, asere oyorenge nokobua gw'okomotooria korwa ase amakweri, na akaigugwa ekiagera asigete Nyasae.

English: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.'”
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Huyu mtu alisema, ‘Ninaweza kulivunja Hekalu la Mungu na kulijenga tena kwa siku tatu.' ”
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Omonto oyo nigo ateebete: Ninyare gotagora Hekalu ya Nyasae, na koyeagaacha ase amatuko atato.”

English: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father's house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.
Kiswahili: Lakini suria wake akafanya ukahaba dhidi yake, naye akamwacha akarudi nyumbani kwa baba yake huko Bethlehemu ya Yuda. Baada ya kukaa huko kwa muda wa miezi minne,
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyio tarenge omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, erio akamotiga, akairana gochia o ise, aaria Bethlehemu, akamenya aroro ase engaki y'emetienyi ene.

English: Yes, it is coming, and it will surely happen, declares the Lord GOD. This is the day of which I have spoken.
Kiswahili: Hili jambo linakuja! Hakika litatokea, asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Hii ndiyo siku ile niliyosema habari zake.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Rora, amang’ana ayio ngocha are, aikeranigwe ase rituko riria nakwanete ng’a ayio nabe.

English: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.
Kiswahili: Wakamleta yule punda na mwana-punda, nao wakatandika mavazi yao juu ya hao punda, naye Yesu akaketi juu yake.
Ekegusii: Bakamorentera etigere amo nemori yaye, bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ya chirochio, na Yeso akayeriina.

English: Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
Kiswahili: Kuhani mmoja alikuwa akipitia njia ile, alipomwona huyo mtu, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ekaba agwo Omokuani oyomo akaoroka, ogoeta ase enchera eria, akamorora, agaeta ensemo.

English: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu alifundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wao wa sheria.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, na tari buna aborokia babo b’amariiko.

English: Then he is to remove all the fat, just as it is removed from the peace offering, and the priest is to burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Atayaondoa mafuta yote, kama vile mafuta yaondolewavyo kwenye sadaka ya amani, naye kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’embori eyio buna ebitinya bi’eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ebio ase egesasiimero bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’ ”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu akamwambia, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mtu haishi kwa mkate tu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neriikire. Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka.”

English: For the bites of locusts and flies truly killed them. No healing for their life was found, because they were worthy to be punished by such things.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kuumwa na nzige na nzi kuliwaua kweli. Hakuna uponyaji wa maisha yao uliopatikana, kwa sababu walistahili kuadhibiwa kwa mambo kama hayo.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo bakwete ase okoromwa n'echingige n'echingi, na nchera ende yonsi y'okobatoria tiyarenge oo, ase engencho mbagwenerete koegwa egesusuro n'ebitongwa ebio.

English: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mwanaume kama mtu akutanaye na mwanamke; hilo ni chukizo.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomonto omosacha buna okoraara n’omokuungu; obwo nobonyaka obobe bw’okogechia.

English: Yet You, O Lord GOD, have said to me, ‘Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses, even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans!’” The LORD Answers Jeremiah
Kiswahili: Ingawa mji utatiwa mikononi mwa Wakaldayo, wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, uliniambia, ‘Nunua shamba kwa fedha, na jambo hilo lishuhudiwe.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aye Omonene nigo gwanchigeete ng’a ngore omogondo ng’akane chitaabu, naende ndigie birori, nonya omochie oyio obekirwe ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo.”

English: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”
Kiswahili: Nipe wake zangu na watoto, ambao nimetumika kuwapata, nami niende zangu. Unajua ni kazi kiasi gani ambayo nimekufanyia.”
Ekegusii: Ing'a abakungu baane na abana baane, aba namenyire nkogokorera, ontige 'ngende seito; naki nomanyete emeremo nabeire nkogokorera.”

English: She forgets that a foot may crush them, or a wild animal may trample them.
Kiswahili: bila kujali kuwa mguu waweza kuyaponda, kwamba baadhi ya wanyama wa porini wanaweza kuyakanyaga.
Ekegusii: Ero nigo ekoyeba, tekomanya ng’a naatwe namagoro, naende ng’a gose eng’iti y’orosana neyatache.

English: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
Kiswahili: Huu ni ubaya ulio katika kila kitu kinachotendeka chini ya jua: Mwisho unaofanana huwapata wote. Zaidi ya hayo, mioyo ya watu, imejaa ubaya na kuna wazimu mioyoni mwao wangali hai, hatimaye huungana na waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y'erioba, ng'a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na magega y'ayio nigo bakogeenda ase abakuure.

English: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwaka wa kumi na nne, Mfalme Kedorlaoma na wafalme waliojiunga naye walikwenda kupigana na kuwashinda Warefai katika Ashtaroth-Kanaimu, Wazuzi katika Hamu, Waemi katika Shawe-Kiriathaimu,
Ekegusii: Na omwaka o ikomi na kane Kedorilaoma na abarwoti baria babwataine nere bagacha, bakarwania na kobua Abarefai ase Asteroti‐Karinaimu, na Abasusi ase Hamu, na Abaemi ase Shawe‐Kiriataimu,

English: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza saa ambayo alianza kupata nafuu. Wakamwambia, “Jana yapata saa saba, homa ilimwacha.”
Ekegusii: Erio akababoria amang'ana ensa achaagete koba buya. Bakamoteebia, “Niigoro, chinsa isano na ibere esosera yamotigete.”

English: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
Kiswahili: Basi wakaondoka na kwenda mpaka Zifu wakimtangulia Sauli. Naye Daudi na watu wake walikuwa katika Jangwa la Maoni, katika Araba kusini mwa Yeshimoni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimoka bagatang'anera Saulo, bakagenda Sifu, korende Daudi amo n'baanto baye nao baarenge ase erooro ya Maoni, agwo ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, Irianyi ya Yesimona.

English: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu; Israeli na aseme sasa:
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Inee! Naki yare goocha koba onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito? Tiga Abaisraeli bairanerie.

English: He filled them with the knowledge of wisdom, and showed them good and evil.
Kiswahili: Aliwajaza maarifa ya hekima, na kuwaonyesha mema na mabaya.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae akabaichoria n'echisemi, abaorokererie okomanya na koigwa gati y'amaya n'amabe.

English: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
Kiswahili: “Mlinisikia nikisema, ‘Ninakwenda zangu, lakini nitarudi tena.’ Kama kweli mngelinipenda mngelifurahi kwa kuwa naenda kwa Baba, kwani Baba ni mkuu kuniliko mimi.
Ekegusii: Mwaigwete inche nkobateebia: Nkogenda nde, na ninchiche naende ase more. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, ekiagera Tata nomonene kombua.

English: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka mara, wakarudi Yerusalemu. Wakawakuta wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao, wamekusanyika
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka ensa eria eria, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakanyoora baria ikomi nomo basangererekanete, na baria abarenge amo nabarabwo,

English: If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die. But if there is no truth to their accusations against me, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
Kiswahili: Basi kama mimi nina hatia ya kutenda kosa lolote linalostahili kifo, sikatai kufa. Lakini kama mashtaka yaliyoletwa dhidi yangu na hawa Wayahudi si kweli, hakuna yeyote aliye na haki ya kunikabidhi mikononi mwao. Naomba rufaa kwa Kaisari!”
Ekegusii: Onye namochire, gose nakorire ring’ana ringwenerete ogokwa, tinyangeti ogokwa, korende onye tari ekeene ring’ana eri bansoereire, onde tari oranyare kombeka ase amaboko abo. Nindigetie ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari.”

English: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba wasio haki hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu? Msidanganyike: Waasherati, wala waabudu sanamu, wala wazinzi, wala wahanithi, wala walawiti,
Ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abatari noboronge tibakoira omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Timong’aineka; abanyaka tibakoira omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, nonya nabasasimi emegwekano, gose abatomani, gose abakwerua ase okogania kw’omobere, gose abasacha abagwesaria nabasaacha,

English: Be dismayed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.
Kiswahili: Kateni tamaa, enyi wakulima, lieni, enyi mlimao mizabibu; huzunikeni kwa ajili ya ngano na shayiri, kwa sababu mavuno ya shambani yameharibiwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe abaremi ichana na gosooka, nainwe abaroiseria b’emesabibu, rera, ekiagera engano na esairi biasirigwe amo nokwama gwonsi kw’emegondo.

English: They deliberated among themselves what they should answer: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
Kiswahili: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’
Ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoboorie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?

English: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akakutana na Balaamu, akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa chake akasema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera Baalamu, akamoteebia amang'ana arenge gochia gokwana, naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang'ana ayio ayio.

English: Blessed is the rich person who is found blameless, and who doesn't go after gold.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu tajiri ambaye haonekani kuwa hana lawama, na ambaye hafuati dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ore omotenenku otari komochigwa, omonto oria otari kominyokia obotenenku.

English: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watu wa Aramu walifanya biashara nawe kwa ajili ya wingi wa kazi za mikono yako, wakibadilishana kwa almasi, vitambaa vya rangi ya zambarau, vitambaa vilivyotariziwa, kitani safi, matumbawe na akiki nyekundu.
Ekegusii: Abasiiria bagakora oboonchoreria naye, ekiagera kwabwate ebinto ebinge bi'obotenenku; bagakorentera amagena ye rigori rinene akorokwa alimasi, na erangi emonyinga, na ebitambaa bi'ebieni ao ao, na egatani engiya, na amakorongote, na amagena akorokwa agati, bakagora ebinto biao.

English: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
Kiswahili: Wakati wasiwasi ulipokuwa mwingi ndani yangu, faraja yako ilinipa furaha nafsini mwangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane ere nogwechanda okonge, okoremia kwao okonge nigo gokogokia omoyo one.

English: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Vumilia taabu pamoja nasi kama askari mwema wa Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naye oremererie emechando buna omorwani omuya o Kristo Yeso.

English: In that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and fall, and the load upon it will be cut down.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema, “Katika siku ile, kigingi kilichogongomewa mahali imara kitaachia njia. Kitakatwa, nacho kitaanguka na mzigo ulioningʼinia juu yake utaanguka chini.” Bwana amesema.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eyio omosumari oria okong’onteretwe ase enyasi enkong’u nosimorwe korwao ogwe inse, ne chigurube chiasungireo nchigwe, chisamunyokane.” Nab’Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.

English: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn't there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven't brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza Ahimeleki, “Je, unao mkuki au upanga hapa? Sikuleta upanga wala silaha nyingine yoyote, kwa sababu shughuli ya mfalme ilikuwa ya haraka.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akabooria Ahimeleki: “Nobwate aa ritimo gose omoro? Inche tinarentanete omoro one, gose ebirwanero binde bionsi, ekiagera omoremo oyio omorwoti anchiigete gokora nigo oganetie okorwe ase obwango.”

English: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
Kiswahili: Mtu hathibitiki kutokana na uovu, bali mwenye haki hataondolewa.
Ekegusii: Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagaacha omonto na komokong'ia, korende omori bw'omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.

English: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus. The Ministry of the Twelve (Mark 6:7–13; Luke 9:1–6)
Kiswahili: Simoni Mkananayo, na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Simioni omoKaanani, na Yudasi Iskariota, ere oria omoruete. Emeremo ya baria ikomi na babere (Mar 6:7-13; Luk 9:1-6)

English: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, nyumba ya Israeli imekuwa kwangu takataka ya chuma, wote kwangu wamekuwa shaba, bati, chuma na risasi iliyoachwa kalibuni. Wao ni taka ya madini ya fedha tu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Abaisraeli babeire asende buna amabiria. Bonsi nigo banga buna etai, ne ribati, na ekioma, ne risasi, bire ase eriko ri’omorero, ee, beonchoire babeire buna amabiria ye chifeta.

English: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
Kiswahili: Huyafanya mataifa yatukuke na kuyaangamiza; hufanya mataifa kuwa makubwa, naye huyatawanya.
Ekegusii: Nigo agokinia ebisaku, naende obisiria; nigo akobikora biabucha, naende obing'anyia.

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your citadels.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi: “Adui ataizingira nchi; ataangusha chini ngome zenu na kuteka nyara maboma yenu.”
Ekegusii: Ababisa mbanaarie ense eye, baiyerie chindwaki chiaino inse, ne chinyomba chiaino chinkong’u chisakorwe.

English: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
Kiswahili: Anakemea bahari na kuikausha, anafanya mito yote kukauka. Bashani na Karmeli zinanyauka na maua ya Lebanoni hukauka.
Ekegusii: Nigo agochiika enyancha nero yakamoka! Nigo agokora chindoche chiakama. Emegondo ya Basani nigo egosusana, egetunwa gia Karimeli nigo kegoonchoka kiaba maroba, amaua a Lebanoni nigo akorachoka.

English: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wanaume walioteuliwa kutoka jumuiya, viongozi wa makabila ya baba zao. Walikuwa wakuu wa koo za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abaaanto aba nabwo barenge abateneneri ase ebisaku ebio biabo, naende abatang'ani be chiamate chi'Abaisraeli, bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda bwonsi.

English: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
Kiswahili: Saga baadhi yake kuwa unga na uweke mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, mahali ambapo nitakutana nawe. Itakuwa takatifu sana kwenu.
Ekegusii: Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amaachenu mono ase more.

English: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”
Kiswahili: Ole wangu mimi kwa ajili ya kuumia kwangu! Jeraha langu ni kubwa! Lakini nilisema, “Kweli hii ni adhabu yangu, nami sharti niistahimili.”
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twasunyuntirwe. Amaote aito tari kogwenigwa. Intwe nigo twarengereretie: Ekeene, eye nemechando, korende goika toremererie.

English: Then the city was breached; and though the Chaldeans had surrounded the city, all the men of war fled by night by way of the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden. They headed toward the Arabah,
Kiswahili: Kisha ukuta wa mji ukavunjwa, na jeshi lote likakimbia. Wakaondoka mjini usiku kupitia lango lililokuwa kati ya kuta mbili karibu na bustani ya mfalme, ingawa Wakaldayo walikuwa wameuzunguka mji. Wakakimbia kuelekea Araba.
Ekegusii: Erio chindwaki chi’omochie chikabochorwa, na abanto bonsi b’esegi bagatama botuko, bagaetera egeita kiarenge gatigati ye chindwaki ibere, ang’e nomogondo bw’omorwoti, nonya Abakalidayo banaaretie omochie chinsemo chionsi. Bakagenda gochia ase Ekerubo Ekiomo.

English: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David's city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Azaria akalala pamoja na baba zake, naye akazikwa karibu nao katika Mji wa Daudi, na Yothamu mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Asaria akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi, na Yotamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wamekonda kutokana na kupungukiwa na kwa njaa, walizurura usiku katika nchi kame iliyo ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'okoremerwa na enchara babeire ebigonkobe, nigo bakona‐kogokona namaino abo riroba eriomo pa, erio riasaregete.

English: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu,’
Ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.

English: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
Kiswahili: Leo ninaziita mbingu na nchi kama mashahidi dhidi yako kwamba nimeweka mbele yako uzima na mauti, baraka na laana. Basi sasa chagueni uzima, ili wewe na watoto wako mpate kuishi,
Ekegusii: Rituko ria reero narangeirie igoro na ense chibe birori ase more ng’a inche nabeekire ase amasio aino obogima na amakweri, ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa. Ase ayio, chora obogima, erinde inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino monyaare kogenderera koba moyo.

English: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Simeoni ni: Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Sohari na Shauli mwana wa mwanamke Mkanaani.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw'omokuungu Omokaanani.

English: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
Kiswahili: mkiwa mmetiwa nguvu kwa uwezo wote kwa kadiri ya nguvu yake yenye utukufu, ili mpate kuwa na wingi wa saburi na uvumilivu. Nanyi kwa furaha
Ekegusii: Na inwe mobekwe chinguru ase okobua gwonsi, koreng'ana ne chinguru chi'obonene bwaye ase okoganya na oboremereria bwonsi amo nomogooko,

English: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister before Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name forever.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Amramu walikuwa: Aroni na Mose. Aroni waliwekwa wakfu, yeye na wazao wake milele, wawe wakiweka wakfu vitu ambavyo ni vitakatifu mno, kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, kuhudumu mbele zake na kutamka baraka katika Jina la Bwana milele.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Amuramu nabwo Aroni na Musa. Aroni agaatananwa koba oyochenegete mono kogenderera botambe. Ere amo nabamura baye babe bagosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene na komokorera, naende babe bagosesenia ase erieta riaye botambe.

English: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
Kiswahili: Naye atawatuma malaika zake kwa sauti kuu ya tarumbeta, nao watawakusanya wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa mbingu hadi mwisho mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye na egeturi ekenene ki'egetuureri, na barabwo mbasangererie abachoore baye korwa ase chinsinyo inye, korwa ensinyo eyemo ya igoro goika eyende.

English: “You shall take the breast of Aaron's ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuchukua kidari cha huyo kondoo dume wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa Aroni, kiinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, nayo itakuwa fungu lako.
Ekegusii: “Obogorie ritaana ri'emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Aroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng'iti eyio.

English: And they went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
Kiswahili: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakatoka, wakahubiri kila mahali, naye Bwana akatenda kazi pamoja nao na kulithibitisha neno lake kwa ishara zilizofuatana nalo.]
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bakaimoka, bakarandia chinsemo chionsi. Omonene akaba ogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo, na goikerania ring’ana ase ebimanyererio bie chinguru ebiabatuny’anete. Amina.

English: I rebuked them and called down curses on them. I beat some of these men and pulled out their hair. Then I made them take an oath before God and said, “You must not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters as wives for your sons or for yourselves!
Kiswahili: Niliwakemea na kuwalaani. Niliwapiga baadhi ya watu na kungʼoa nywele zao. Niliwaapisha kwa jina la Mungu na kusema: “Msiwaoze binti zenu kwa wana wao, wala binti zao wasiolewe na wana wenu wala ninyi wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio nkomania abanto abwo, nkabaragereria; ngaaka abande abwo na gosunyora chitukia chiabo. Nkabatiania ase erieta ria Nyasae, nkabateebia, “Timobaisa gosokia abaiseke baino ase abamura b’ebisaku ebio, gose konyuomeria abamura baino abaiseke babo; gose inwe abanyene timobaisa konyuoma korwa aroro.

English: Then all the men of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat at their head, returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the LORD had made them rejoice over their enemies.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu, wakiongozwa na Yehoshafati, wakarudi Yerusalemu wakiwa na furaha kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa amewasababisha wafurahi juu ya adui zao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakairana, kera oyomo bw’Abayuda na obw’abaanto ba Yerusalemu, na Yehosafati akabatang’ana. Bakairana Yerusalemu bare nomochengo, ekiagera Omonene abaete obobui igoro ase ababisa babo.

English: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
Kiswahili: Nao Wareubeni wakajenga upya miji ya Heshboni, Eleale na Kiriathaimu,
Ekegusii: Abareubeni bakaagacha emechie ya Hesiboni, na Eleale, na Kiriataimu,

English: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Sauli alikuwa bado anazidisha vitisho vya kuua wanafunzi wa Bwana, akamwendea kuhani mkuu,
Ekegusii: Korende ase chingaki echio Saulo akamenta kobagosa na korengereria goita aborokigwa bw'Omonene. Akagenda ase Omokuani omonene,

English: Drive out the mocker, and conflict will depart; even quarreling and insults will cease.
Kiswahili: Mfukuze mwenye dhihaka, na mvutano utatoweka; ugomvi na matukano vitakoma.
Ekegusii: Seria omonyacheche, na eriomana ndiere, ee, eriomana na ogochaaya ’mbisire.

English: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.
Kiswahili: Nitakutawanya miongoni mwa mataifa na kukutapanya katika nchi mbalimbali nami nitakomesha unajisi wako.
Ekegusii: Ninsiarere abanto bao gochia ase egati y' abanto b'ebisaku, na gochia ase chinse chinde. Ninsirie ogokora okobe korwa ase ore.

English: So while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tukiwa bado katika hema hii twalia kwa uchungu na kulemewa, kwa sababu hatutaki kuvuliwa bali kuvikwa makao yetu ya mbinguni ili kwamba kile kipatikanacho na mauti kimezwe na uzima.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatore ase enyomba eye ere buna eema, nigo togwechanda, toritoerwa, tari ng’a igo torigetie korusigwa ase enyomba eye, korende ntorigetie okoboyigwa konde, erinde egekonyorekana namakweri kemerwe nobogima.

English: If you are righteous, what do you give Him, or what does He receive from your hand?
Kiswahili: Kama wewe ni mwadilifu, unampa nini, au yeye anapokea nini mkononi kwako?
Ekegusii: Onye kore omonyene oboronge, ngento ki okoa Nyasae, gose ninki akonyora korwa ase okoboko kwao?

English: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, hata Rahabu, yule kahaba, hakuhesabiwa haki kwa yale aliyotenda alipowapokea wale wapelelezi na kuwaambia waende njia nyingine?
Ekegusii: Naboigo na Rahabu, oria omotayayi, Inee, taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aroisetie baria batometwe, akabasokia isiko ase enchera ende eng’ao?

English: Jehoiada appointed the officers of Yahweh's house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in Yahweh's house, to offer the burnt offerings of Yahweh, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yehoyada akaweka uangalizi wa Hekalu la Bwana mikononi mwa makuhani, waliokuwa Walawi, ambao Mfalme Daudi alikuwa amewagawa ili wahudumu hekaluni kwa ajili ya kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa za Bwana kama ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria ya Mose, kwa kushangilia na kuimba kama Daudi alivyokuwa ameagiza.
Ekegusii: Yehoyada akabeeka abarendi ase enyomba y'Omonene, bagatenenerwa nabakuani Abalawi, baria Daudi konya achorire batenenere enyomba y'Omonene. Barabwo babe bakorua ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa ase Omonene, koreng'ana buna ariikire ase amachiiko a Musa. Naende babe bakorua ebing'wanso biria ase omogooko na amatera, buna aroberetigwe na Daudi.

English: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
Kiswahili: Tunafurahi wakati wowote sisi tunapokuwa dhaifu, lakini ninyi mkawa na nguvu. Nayo maombi yetu ni kwamba mpate kuwa wakamilifu.
Ekegusii: Naki twagokire ekero intwe tore abareu, na inwe more ne chinguru. Eri twasabire neri, ng'a moikeranigwe.

English: “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
Kiswahili: “Baba yetu alikufa jangwani. Hakuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora, ambao walifungamana pamoja dhidi ya Bwana, lakini alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe na hakuacha wana.
Ekegusii: “Tata nigo akwerete agwo ase erooro. Ere tarenge ase egati y’ekeombe keria giasangererekanete amo gekaba mamincha y’Omonene, ase abwo barenge ase ensemo ya Kora, korende ere nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene. Ekero akwete tatigete abana abamura

English: From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,
Kiswahili: Barafu inatoka tumbo la nani? Ni nani azaaye ukungu kutoka mbinguni,
Ekegusii: Nkorwa ase enda ya ng’o obokeng’entu bokorwa? Ning’o okoibora obokendu bokorwa igoro?

English: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don't know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.'
Kiswahili: “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!'
Ekegusii: Korende ere natebe: Nabatebirie, timbamanyeti aase mokorwa; karue ase 'nde, inwe mwensi abakori amabe.

English: I will make the streams dry up and sell the land to the wicked. By the hands of foreigners I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.
Kiswahili: Nitakausha vijito vya Naili na nitaiuza nchi kwa watu waovu, kwa mkono wa wageni, nitaifanya nchi ukiwa na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake. Mimi Bwana nimenena haya.
Ekegusii: Inche ninkamie chindooche chiome pa, na ng’oonie ense eyio ase amaboko’ abanto ababe. Nindete abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni basarie ense na kera egento kere imeo. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.

English: All the lawless and ungodly men of Israel came to him. Alcimus was their leader, desiring to be high priest.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waasi sheria na wasiomcha Mungu wa Israeli walimwendea. Alkimo alikuwa kiongozi wao, akitamani kuwa kuhani mkuu.
Ekegusii: Ekaba Abayahudi baria ababe na batamosigete Omonene, ase oborai bwa Alikimo oyio oganetie koba Omokuani omonene, bakamochiera Demeturio.

English: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Gaza, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu walichukua mateka jumuiya nzima na kuwauza kwa Edomu,
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y'ogosaria kw' abanto ba Gasa ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima gochia ase ense ya Edomu, bakabakora abasomba.

English: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don't go among the Gentiles, and don't enter into any city of the Samaritans.
Kiswahili: Hawa kumi na wawili, Yesu aliwatuma akawaagiza: “Msiende miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa, wala msiingie mji wowote wa Wasamaria.
Ekegusii: Aba ikomi na babere Yeso akabatoma, akabachiika, “Timogenda enchera ende yonsi y' abanto b'Ebisaku, timosoa nonya nomochie onde bwonsi bw'Abasamaria,

English: Also for you, O Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.
Kiswahili: “Pia kwa ajili yako, Yuda, mavuno yameamriwa. “Wakati wowote ningerejesha neema ya watu wangu,
Ekegusii: “Nainwe Abayuda boigo, mwarikeirwe engaki ye rigesa ri’ogokora kwaino, ekero ndasibore abooswa b’abaanto baane.

English: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu aliye Baba yetu apewe utukufu milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Bono Nyasae, Tata oito, abakwe kare na kare. Amina.

English: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded; in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials, Aaron raised the staff and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was turned to blood.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakafanya kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amewaagiza. Akainua fimbo yake machoni pa Farao na maafisa wake na kuyapiga maji ya Mto Naili, na maji yote yakabadilika kuwa damu.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Ase obosio bwa Farao na abasomba baye, Aroni akaimokia enyimbo yaye, agaaka orooche, na amaache ayare imeo akaonchoka, akaba amanyinga.

English: You unleash your mouth for evil and unharness your tongue for deceit.
Kiswahili: Unakitumia kinywa chako kwa mabaya na kuuongoza ulimi wako kwa hila.
Ekegusii: “Omonwa oo nigo ore omwango gokwana amang’ana ’obobe, na oromeme rwao nigo romanyete koroisia amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.

English: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
Kiswahili: Tufurahi, tushangilie na kumpa utukufu! Kwa maana arusi ya Mwana-Kondoo imewadia na bibi arusi wake amejiweka tayari.
Ekegusii: Togoke na gochenga, tomotogie ase obonene bwaye, ekiagera rituko ri’enyangi y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi riaikire, na omoriakari oye bwebekire ang’e.

English: winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
Kiswahili: ambaye anakonyeza kwa jicho lake, anayetoa ishara kwa miguu yake na kuashiria kwa vidole vyake,
Ekegusii: Nigo agosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye, naende nigo agosumera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio n’amaboko aye.

English: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.'”
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo alivyoagiza Bwana: ‘Chukueni pishi ya mana na kuhifadhi kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo ili vione mikate niliyowapa mle jangwani nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri.' ”
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Omonene otochikiire togache endagera eye inke ya Mana ase engencho ye chinderia chiaito, erinde banyare gocha korora endagera eye Omonene atoete torie ase erooro, ekero atorusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: But as he went, he remembered the words of Raphael, and took the ashes of the incense, and put the heart and the liver of the fish on them, and made smoke with them.
Kiswahili: Lakini alipokwenda, alikumbuka maneno ya Rafaeli, akachukua majivu ya uvumba, akaweka moyo na ini la samaki juu yake, akayatoa moshi pamoja nayo.
Ekegusii: Tobia akainyora oboseemia bwa Rafaeli erio akaigora akabuko karia ase agachete enkoro eria y'enswe ne rini akabibeeka ase ubani yare gosambwa bigachaka korwa erioki.

English: But worship was raised to a yet higher pitch, even by those who didn't know him, urged forward by the ambition of the architect;
Kiswahili: Lakini ibada ilipandishwa hadi kiwango cha juu zaidi, hata na wale ambao hawakumjua, wakichochewa na tamaa ya mbunifu;
Ekegusii: Abaroisia aba b'emegwekano nigo bare koroisia omobwekano omuya mono erio nonya mbaria batamomanyete bakogokigwa nere.

English: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers' house of the Gershonites.
Kiswahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.
Ekegusii: Eliasafu, mosinto o Laeli, nere oraabe omotang'ani bwe chiamate chi'Abagerisoni.

English: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
Kiswahili: Filipo, na Bartholomayo; Tomaso, na Mathayo mtoza ushuru; Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, na Thadayo;
Ekegusii: Filipo na Batholomayo; Thomas na Matayo, omorusia ebango; Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Tadayo;

English: He who tills his land will raise his harvest high. He who pleases great men will get pardon for iniquity.
Kiswahili: Yeye ailimaye ardhi yake ataongeza mavuno yake. Yeye awapendezaye watu wakuu atasamehewa uovu.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokwana n'echisemi, oyio mbuya are; oyore n'echisemi nigo akogokia abanto bare n'engencho.

English: Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes, with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: “Mesheki na Tubali wako humo, pamoja na makundi yao ya wajeuri wakiwa wameyazunguka makaburi yao. Wote hawakutahiriwa, wameuawa kwa upanga kwa sababu walieneza vitisho vyao katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: “Abameseki na Abatubali nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi, ne chimbeera chi’emeganda eyio nigo chibaetanaine ase chinsemo chionsi. Abwo bonsi nabaanto batarogeti, nigo baitetwe nemioro. Agwo kare nigo barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo.

English: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”
Kiswahili: Eliya akamwambia Ahabu, “Nenda, ukale na kunywa, kwa kuwa kuna sauti ya mvua kubwa.”
Ekegusii: Elija agateebia Ahabu: “Imoka, orie na onywe, ekiagera eriogi ri'embura riaigurwe rikogukura.”

English: Is there iniquity in Gilead? They will surely come to nothing. Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Indeed, their altars will be heaps of stones in the furrows of the field.
Kiswahili: Je, Gileadi si mwovu? Watu wake hawafai kitu! Je, hawatoi dhabihu za mafahali huko Gilgali? Madhabahu zao zitakuwa kama malundo ya mawe katika shamba lililolimwa.
Ekegusii: Onye ebibe bire ime ya Gileadi, abanto b’aroro goika basire. Onye abanto ba Giligali bakoruera ebing’wanso bie chieri aroro ase ebisasimero biabo, birobio mbisarigwe bibe buna obonge bwa amagena ase emetaro y’emegondo.”

English: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Tuliposikia maneno haya sisi na ndugu wengine tukamsihi Paulo asiende Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Togachia koigwa aya, intwe na abanto baria tokamosorora tabaisa gotiira gochia Yerusalemu.

English: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one; that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.
Kiswahili: na juu yao akaweka marais watatu, ambao Danieli alikuwa mmoja wao; ili magavana hawa wa mitaa watoe hesabu kwao, wala mfalme asipate hasara.
Ekegusii: Naende akabeeka abanene batato igoro ase abwo; Danieli nigo arenge oyomo obo. Abagaambi baria abanene nigo barenge koba bakorua omobaro ase abwo batato, erinde omorwoti tabaisa gosirerwa n'eniibo.

English: when the doors to the street are shut and the sound of the mill fades away, when one rises at the sound of a bird and all the daughters of song grow faint,
Kiswahili: wakati milango ya kuingia barabarani itakapofungwa na sauti ya kusaga kufifia; wakati watu wataamshwa kwa sauti ya ndege, lakini nyimbo zao zote zikififia;
Ekegusii: Ebisieri birochie ase chinchera mbisiekwe, na amariogi ay’ogosia nakee; amariogi e chinyoni natabobore omonto korwa ase chitoro, na amariogi ’abaiseke bagotera nakee.

English: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”
Kiswahili: Kisha atamwachia yule ndege aliye hai huru mashambani nje ya mji. Kwa njia hii atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nyumba ile, nayo itakuwa safi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani atige enyoni eria ere moyo eiruruke, egende orosana isiko y'omochie. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa ase enyomba eria, na ero ebe yachenekire.”

English: At that time we captured all his cities and devoted to destruction the people of every city, including women and children. We left no survivors.
Kiswahili: Kwa wakati ule tuliteka miji yake yote na kuiangamiza kabisa: wanaume, wanawake na watoto. Hatukumwacha yeyote.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria tokabwata emechie yaye yonsi, tokayesaria, togaita abasacha, n’abakuungu, na abana, titwatigaretie monto ore moyo, nonya n’oyomo.

English: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiana ase endamwamu yane ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane.

English: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
Kiswahili: naye Mfalme Solomoni na kusanyiko lote la Israeli waliokusanyika kumzunguka walikuwa mbele ya hilo Sanduku, nao wakatoa dhabihu nyingi za kondoo na ngʼombe ambao idadi yao haikuwezekana kuandikwa au kuhesabiwa.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani amo nomoganda bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli, baria basangererekanete asare, bagatenena bosio bw'Esanduki eria, bakaruera aroro ebing'wanso bie ching'ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono chitarenge konyara kobareka.

English: But if you are seeking anything beyond this, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama kuna jambo jingine lolote zaidi mnalotaka kulileta, itabidi lisuluhishwe katika kusanyiko halali.
Ekegusii: Korende onye more namang’ana ande, nigo araroisigwe nabagaambi ba botambe.

English: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
Kiswahili: Nayahesabu mateso yetu ya wakati huu kuwa si kitu kulinganisha na utukufu utakaodhihirishwa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Nabarire emechando y'ekero kia bono, ng'a teri gento onye ekoreng'anigwa nobonene boria bogocha koorokigwa ase tore.

English: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, aliloniambia: “Chukua kutoka mkononi mwangu kikombe hiki kilichojaa divai ya ghadhabu yangu, na kuyanywesha mataifa yote ambayo ninakutuma kwao.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, antebirie: “Bogoria egekombe eke ki'edivai y'endamwamu korwa ase okoboko kwane, erio oe ebisaku bionsi ase ndagotome gochia, biyenywe.

English: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
Kiswahili: Wakakodisha magari ya vita 32,000 yakiwa na waendeshaji wake, pamoja na mfalme wa Maaka na vikosi vyake, wakaja na kupiga kambi karibu na Medeba. Waamoni nao wakakusanyika toka miji yao, wakatoka ili kupigana vita.
Ekegusii: Bagasaba chigari chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000) amo nomorwoti o Maaka na abarwani baye b'esegi. Barabwo bagacha, bagatoora bosio bwa Medeba. Abaamoni bagasangererigwa korwa ase emechie yabo, bagacha korwana esegi.

English: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?' He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.' He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.'
Kiswahili: “Bwana akauliza, ‘Kwa njia gani?' “Akasema, ‘Nitakwenda na kuwa roho ya uongo katika vinywa vya manabii wake wote.' “Bwana akasema, ‘Utafanikiwa katika kumshawishi. Nenda ukafanye hivyo.'
Ekegusii: Omonene akabooria omoika oria: Nase enchera ere naki oramoebererie? Omoika oria okairaneria: Igo nkoimoka ngende, imbe omoika bw'obong'ainereria ase emenwa y'ababani bonsi b'Ahabu. Omonene akayotebia: Genda omoebererie ase enchera eyio. Nobue.

English: Because you have disheartened the righteous with your lies, even though I have caused them no grief, and because you have encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways to save their lives,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu mliwavunja moyo wenye haki kwa uongo wenu, wakati mimi sikuwaletea huzuni na kwa kuwa mliwatia moyo waovu ili wasiziache njia zao mbaya na hivyo kuokoa maisha yao,
Ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’oborimo bwaino mwagerire abanyene oboronge baichanire ase chinkoro chiabo, abwo inche ntaichanetie. Nigo mwagerire abakori amabe koba noboremu, erinde tibaonchoka batige chinchera chiabo chi’obobe, erinde batoorie obogima bwabo.

English: Yahweh gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.
Kiswahili: Bwana akampa Solomoni hekima, kama alivyomwahidi. Palikuwepo na uhusiano wa amani kati ya Hiramu na Solomoni, na wote wawili wakafanya mkataba.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani obong'aini buna amorierete eira. Omorembe okaba ase egati ya Hiramu na Sulemani, na aba babere bagakora okobwatana gw'okoigwana.

English: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob; once again He will choose Israel and settle them in their own land. The foreigner will join them and unite with the house of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Bwana atamhurumia Yakobo, atamchagua Israeli tena, na kuwakalisha katika nchi yao wenyewe. Wageni wataungana nao na kujiunga na nyumba ya Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Omonene narorere ororeeria rwa Yakobo amaabera, nachore Abaisraeli abwo naende, abarente bamenye ase ense yabo. Abanto abaao mbabwatane nab’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, bamenye amo nabarabwo.

English: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.
Kiswahili: Leteni ndama aliyenona, mkamchinje ili tuwe na karamu, tule na kufurahi.
Ekegusii: Nyerente emori eria ere enoru, moyenyenye, torie na kogoka,

English: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu aliwaacha wavunjiane heshima kwa kufuata tamaa zao za aibu. Hata wanawake wao wakabadili matumizi ya asili ya miili yao wakaitumia isivyokusudiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Nyasae akabatiga batunyane okogania kwabo kw’obosooku, goika abakungu babo bakaonchoreria okomenyana kw’omobere kwa boronge ase oko gotari kwa boronge.

English: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa pasipo kuwa na mtoto yeyote.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana.

English: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wana wa Raheli aliomzalia Yakobo; jumla yao ni kumi na wanne.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro Raeli aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na baane.

English: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.
Kiswahili: Waambie mafundi stadi wote niliowapa hekima katika shughuli hiyo wamtengenezee Aroni mavazi hayo, ili awekwe wakfu, anitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Oteebie abaroisia abang’aini, abwo naeire obong’aini ne chisemi, baroiserie Aroni chianga, erinde aatananwe abe ogonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

English: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
Kiswahili: Pia Solomoni alikuwa na watawala kumi na wawili wa wilaya katika Israeli yote, walioleta mahitaji kwa mfalme na kwa watu wa nyumbani kwa mfalme. Kila mmoja alitoa chakula kwa mwezi mmoja katika mwaka.
Ekegusii: Sulemani nachorete abanto abanene ikomi na babere abaarenge gosangereria endagera na koyerentera omorwoti amo nab'enyomba yaye. Kera oyomo ase aba ikomi na babere nigo areenge korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka.

English: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn't do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn't love his brother.
Kiswahili: Kwa jinsi hii tunaweza kujua dhahiri watoto wa Mungu na pia watoto wa ibilisi. Yeyote asiyetenda haki hatokani na Mungu, wala yeye asiyempenda ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase eri abana ba Nyasae nigo bare maiso marore, na abana ba Saitani boigo: Onde bwensi otari gokora boronge tarueti ase Nyasae, nonya noyo otancheti oyomwabo.

English: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Upande wenu wa kusini utajumuisha sehemu ya Jangwa la Sini kufuata mpaka wa Edomu. Upande wa mashariki mpaka wenu wa kusini utaanzia mwisho wa Bahari ya Chumvi,
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi, ense yaino eike ase erooro ya Sini, egenderere gochia ase orobebe rwa Edomu. Orobebe rwaino rwa Irianyi rochakere ensemo ya moocha ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo,

English: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
Kiswahili: Ninapolia na kufunga, lazima nivumilie matusi.
Ekegusii: Ekero nabete nkorera ase omoyo one na kweng'ata, ngachaywa na gokwanwa bobe.

English: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
Kiswahili: Mavazi yake yakawa na weupe wa kuzima macho, meupe kuliko ambavyo mtu yeyote duniani angaliweza kuyangʼarisha.
Ekegusii: Chianga chiaye chikameka‐meka, chikaba chindabu mono, buna omosibia onde ase ense atanyare gochisibia chibe chindabu.

English: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He also overlaid the upper area with gold. The Cherubim (1 Kings 6:23–30)
Kiswahili: Misumari ya dhahabu ilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli hamsini. Alivifunika pia vyumba vya juu kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Oborito bw’emesumari nigo bwarenge chigiramu amagana atano n’etano ebere (570) chi’echitaabu. Ebinyomba bia irongo boigo bikaoomwa netaabu.

English: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo wako na haki yako; kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nitaimba sifa.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Nintere igoro y'amaabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.

English: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana anavyoamuru kwa binti za Selofehadi: Wanaweza kuolewa na mtu yeyote wampendaye, mradi tu waolewe miongoni mwa koo za kabila za baba yao.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi, barabwo ’mbare nobosibore konywomwa na monto onde bwensi banchete, korende omonto oyio goika arue ase egesaku kiabo.

English: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama tulipokuwa adui wa Mungu tulipatanishwa naye kwa njia ya kifo cha Mwanawe, si zaidi sana tukiisha kupatanishwa, tutaokolewa kwa uzima wake.
Ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ababisa ba Nyasae, tokabwatanigwa nere ase amakweri y’Omwana oye. Kobua mono, magega gatwabwatanigwe natotoorigwe ase obogima bwaye;

English: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Juu ya madhabahu akateketeza mafuta, figo na mafuta yanayofunika ini kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya dhambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Ebitinya ne chinyigo, n’ebitinya bie riini, ebiarusetie ase ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe, akabisaambera ase egesasiimero, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
Kiswahili: Msichukue mkoba wa safari, wala kanzu mbili, wala jozi ya pili ya viatu, wala fimbo, kwa maana mtendakazi anastahili posho yake.
Ekegusii: gose esaro ase orogendo, gose chianga ibere, gose ebikoroto, nonya nenyimbo, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete endagera yaye.

English: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh's word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba, mwezi wa kwanza, siku ya kwanza, neno la Bwana likanijia, kusema:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani, omotienyi bw'eritang'ani, omwaka bw'emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, ring'ana ri'Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:

English: For the sake of Your name do not despise us; do not disgrace Your glorious throne. Remember Your covenant with us; do not break it.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya jina lako usituchukie kabisa; usikidharau kiti chako cha enzi kilichotukuka. Kumbuka agano lako nasi na usilivunje.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’erieta riao, koranche tototuguta. Totiga ekerogo kiao ki’obonene gechaywe. Inyora okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete naintwe, gose togosaria.

English: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth, with dust on their heads.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi ule ule, Waisraeli walikusanyika pamoja, wakifunga na kuvaa nguo za gunia na kujitia mavumbi vichwani mwao.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane ri’omotienyi oyio, Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangererekana amo, beng’atete na beboyetie chigunia, bageaka ebundo ase emetwe yabo.

English: After the men had eaten their fill, they lightened the ship by throwing the grain into the sea.
Kiswahili: Baada ya watu wote kula chakula cha kutosha, wakapunguza uzito wa meli kwa kutupa ngano baharini.
Ekegusii: Kobaigotire bakagusuyia emeeri ase ogotuguta engano ase enyancha ime.

English: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.
Kiswahili: Mmojawapo akasema, “Bwana wangu, mimi na mwanamke huyu tunaishi kwenye nyumba moja. Nilikuwa nimezaa alipokuwa pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agakwana, agateeba, “Aye omonene one, inche amo nomokuungu oyo nigo tomenyete ase enyomba eyemo; nkaibora omwana ekero ere areenge ase enyomba eria.

English: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.'” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.
Kiswahili: Maafisa hawa wako wote watanijia, wakisujudu mbele yangu, wakisema, ‘Ondoka, wewe pamoja na watu wako wote wanaokufuata!' Baada ya haya nitaondoka.” Kisha Mose, huku akiwa amewaka hasira, akamwacha Farao.
Ekegusii: Na abasomba aba bao bonsi nabatirimboke gocha ase 'nde na batung'ameo, bakobora: Genda, karue aa, aye na abanto bao bonsi bakobwatie. Magega y'ayio nindue aa!” Erio agwo Musa akarua o Farao ore nekeririanda ekenene.

English: He never returns to his house; his place remembers him no more.
Kiswahili: Kamwe harudi tena nyumbani mwake; wala mahali pake hapatamjua tena.
Ekegusii: Oyio takoirana gocha mwaye, na aase aye taakomonyoora naende.

English: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi na kutenda shughuli zako zote.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi.

English: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Hata mbweha hutoa matiti yao kunyonyesha watoto wao, lakini watu wangu wamekuwa wasio na huruma kama mbuni jangwani.
Ekegusii: Nonya ne chisese chi'orosana nkogonkia chire chimanwa chiabo, korende abakungu b'omochie bw'abaanto bane babeire abatindi, buna chisagero chire ase erooro.

English: I am not at ease or quiet; I have no rest, for trouble has come.”
Kiswahili: Sina amani, wala utulivu; sina pumziko, bali taabu tu.”
Ekegusii: Inche timbwati omorembe gose botoereru bonde; timbwati ogotimoka, korende emechando nigo egendererete konagocha.”

English: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mmetumainia matendo yenu na mali zenu, ninyi pia mtachukuliwa mateka, naye Kemoshi atakwenda uhamishoni, pamoja na makuhani wake na maafisa wake.
Ekegusii: “Ekiagera inwe mosemeretie emeremo yaino, na obotenenku bwaino, inamwoswe moirwe ase obosomba, na enyasae eria Kemosi neirwe ase obosomba, amo nabakuani baye na abanene b'obogambi bwaye.

English: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on His throne to be king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel enough to establish them forever, He has made you king over them to carry out justice and righteousness.”
Kiswahili: Ahimidiwe Bwana Mungu wako, ambaye amependezwa sana nawe, na akakuweka juu ya kiti chake cha ufalme utawale kwa niaba ya Bwana Mungu wako. Kwa sababu ya upendo wa Mungu wako kwa Israeli na shauku yake ya kuwadhibitisha milele, amekufanya wewe mfalme juu yao, ili kudumisha haki na uadilifu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na gokobeeka ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, obe omorwoti ase obosio bwaye, ere Omonene, Nyasae oo! Ekiagera ere anchete Abaisraeli botambe, na akabakong’ia bakaba ne chinguru kare na kare, ogokorire aye koba omorwoti igoro ase bare, erinde onyare konacha ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge.”

English: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Dani atahukumu watu wake kwa haki kama mmoja wa makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Dani nagambere abanto baye, buna egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli.

English: Put harmonious speech into my mouth before the lion, and turn his heart to hate him who fights against us, to the utter destruction of those who agree with him.
Kiswahili: Nitie maneno ya upatano kinywani mwangu mbele ya simba, na ugeuze moyo wake umchukie yeye anayepigana nasi, hata kuwaangamiza kabisa wale wanaokubaliana naye.
Ekegusii: boigo nomanyete inche nigo ngechete esiko korwa ase abanto bategeneti Nyasae, naende nigo 'nchaayete oborere bwa abanto bataarogeti, bw'omorwa isiko onde bwensi. Aye nomanyete ng'a nigo nde n'ebitango ebinge,

English: No one can say, “What is this?” “Why is that?” for at the proper time they will all be sought out. At his word, the waters stood as a heap, as did the reservoirs of water at the word of his mouth.
Kiswahili: Hakuna awezaye kusema, "Ni nini hiki?" "Kwa nini?" Kwa maana kwa wakati unaofaa yote yatatafutwa. Kwa neno lake, maji yakasimama kama chungu, kama vile mabwawa ya maji yalivyosimama kwa neno la kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koboria “Ngento kieke?” Gose, “Eke negiaki?” Ekiagera intwe inatwegere ebio bionsi ase chingaki chi'Omonene. Ase ring'ana riaye, amaache nigo agotiga goiteka yebekerania; ase ogokwana kw'omonwa oye amaache nigo amenyete ime ase ekiage kiaye.

English: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates,
Kiswahili: Yaandikeni juu ya miimo ya nyumba zenu na juu ya malango yenu,
Ekegusii: Moyariike ase emetobwa n’aase emeriibo y’ebisieri bi’echinyomba chiaino, n’aase ebiita biaino.

English: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Retirement for Levites
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, Walawi walikuja kufanya kazi yao katika Hema la Kukutania chini ya usimamizi wa Aroni na wanawe. Waliwafanyia Walawi kama vile Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Magega yayio Abalawi bakageenda ase obokoreri bwabo ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano inse y’oborendi bwa Aroni na abamura baye. Bun’Omonene konya achiikire Musa igoro y’Abalawi nabo Abaisraeli baabakorerete.

English: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliomtangulia na ule uliomfuata ukapiga kelele ukisema, “Hosana, Mwana wa Daudi!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Hosana juu mbinguni!”
Ekegusii: Emeganda eria yatang’aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro mono!”

English: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Asheri ni: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi na Beria. Dada yao alikuwa Sera. Wana wa Beria ni: Heberi na Malkieli.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura b'Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi, na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo nere Sera. Na abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi na Malikieli.

English: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
Kiswahili: Nami nikienda na kuwaandalia makao, nitarudi tena na kuwachukua mkae pamoja nami, ili mahali nilipo, nanyi mpate kuwepo.
Ekegusii: Kondagende kobaroiseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie ase 'nde, erinde ase 'nde inche, nainwe mobeo.

English: Yes, they all together, under one form of death, had corpses without number. For the living were not sufficient even to bury them, Since at a single stroke, their most cherished offspring was consumed.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo, wote kwa pamoja, chini ya aina moja ya kifo, walikuwa na maiti zisizohesabika. Kwa maana walio hai hawakutosha hata kuwazika, Kwa kuwa kwa pigo moja, watoto wao waliopendwa zaidi waliliwa.
Ekegusii: Bonsi nigo bakwete ase enchera eria eria; emebere y'abakwete ekaba emenge mono na baria barenge moyo tibaisaine koyetindeka. Ase ogoakwa okomo abana baabo abwo banchente mono bagakwa.

English: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia ndoana wakamvutia kwenye tundu na kumleta mpaka kwa mfalme wa Babeli. Wakamtia gerezani, hivyo kunguruma kwake hakukusikika tena katika milima ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Bakayegobania nekegobanio, bakayebeka ase egesaisero, bakayeira ase omorwoti o Babiloni. Aroro agwo bakayesiekera ase eburi enkong'u, ng'a eriogi riaye tiribaisa koigweka ase ebitunwa bi'Abaisraeli.

English: You bowed your loins to women, and in your body you were brought into subjection.
Kiswahili: Uliinamisha viuno vyako kwa wanawake, na katika mwili wako uliwekwa chini ya utii.
Ekegusii: Korende aye okoyorwa omobere oo ase abakungu, okaba omosomba bw'okogania kwao.

English: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
Kiswahili: Yeye akonyezaye kwa nia mbaya husababisha huzuni, naye mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera amaiso ase okogenka nigo akorenta emechando, na oyogokwana amang'ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.

English: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Inakuwaje basi kwamba Daudi, akinena kwa kuongozwa na Roho, anamwita Kristo ‘Bwana'? Kwa maana asema,
Ekegusii: Akababoria, Inki rende gekogera Daudi, akoraagwa n'Omoika, akamoroka Omonene, okobora:

English: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn't say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
Kiswahili: Ahadi zilinenwa kwa Abrahamu na kwa mzao wake. Maandiko hayasemi “kwa wazao,” likimaanisha watu wengi, bali “kwa mzao wako,” yaani mtu mmoja, ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Chiira chiria chiarieretwe Aburaamu na omoiborwa oye. Biblia teri gokwana amang'ana aya, “Ase oroiboro” buna nase abange; korende eira iga erengete ase oyomo, “Ase omoiborwa oo”, nere Kristo.

English: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Akazikwa kwenye kaburi lake katika bustani ya Uza. Naye Yosia mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Amoni agatindekwa ase embeera yaye ase omogondo o Usa; na Yosia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wakati wa usiku ninalikumbuka jina lako, nami nitatii sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkoinyora erieta riao botuko, nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao.

English: Others sold all that they had left, and at the same time implored the Lord to deliver those who had been sold as slaves by the impious Nicanor before he ever met them,
Kiswahili: Wengine waliuza yote waliyoyasalia, na wakati huohuo wakamwomba Bwana awaokoe wale waliokuwa wameuzwa kama watumwa na Nikanori mwovu kabla hajakutana nao.
Ekegusii: Korende abande bakaonia ebinto ebitigari biabo bionsi na gosaba Omonene abarore abwo Nikanori konya aonirie gochia obosomba nonya konya esegi terachaka.

English: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
Kiswahili: Mimi nilipanda mbegu, Apolo akatia maji, lakini Mungu ndiye aliikuza.
Ekegusii: Inche ngasimeka, Apolo akabeeka amaache, korende Nyasae nere ogokinia.

English: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.
Kiswahili: Basi Waisraeli wakaweka waviziao kuizunguka Gibea.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabeeka abarwani bakaboa goetanana omochie o Gibea.

English: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
Kiswahili: Acha niende nikaione hiyo nchi nzuri ngʼambo ya Yordani, ile nchi nzuri ya vilima na Lebanoni.”
Ekegusii: Nagosabire, koranche aye Omonene ong’e ribaga nyamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, indore ense eria engiya y’ebitunwa amo na Lebanoni.

English: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
Kiswahili: “Pinde za mashujaa zimevunjika, lakini wale wanaojikwaa wamevikwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Amata yabaanto chituoni abunekire, korende abakogochwa babeekirwe chinguru.

English: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
Kiswahili: Ngano ilipoota na kutoa masuke, magugu nayo yakatokea.
Ekegusii: Egachia komera ekama chinyeke, erio amabanchore naro akarorekana.

English: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akamjibu punda, “Umenifanya mjinga! Kama ningelikuwa na upanga mkononi mwangu, ningelikuua sasa hivi.”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akayeiraneria, “Nekiagera gwankoreire echeche. Onye nabwate omoro ase okoboko kwane, nanga nigo narenge kogoita.”

English: O Lord, Father and Master of my life, don't abandon me to their counsel. Don't let me fall because of them.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Baba na Bwana wa maisha yangu, usiniache nishindwe na shauri lao. Usiniache nianguke kwa sababu yao.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae Tata, n'omogaambi bw'obogima bwane, ase ogwancha kwao tintiga erio insirigwe na n'emechando yane; gose obaisa gwancha nkore amabe ase engencho yaye.

English: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimemwona mpumbavu akistawi, lakini ghafula nyumba yake ikawa imelaaniwa.
Ekegusii: Nabeire nkorora omonto omoriri okogenderera bokong'u, korende mobosokano nkaragereria enka yaye.

English: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet, who said, “Why have you sought this people’s gods, which could not deliver them from your hand?”
Kiswahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Amazia, naye akamtuma nabii kwake, ambaye alisema: “Kwa nini unauliza kwa miungu ya hawa watu, ambayo haikuweza kuwaokoa watu wake wenyewe kutoka mkononi mwako?”
Ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu asare, akamotomera omobani komoboria, “Nase ki kwarigirie chinyasae chi’abaanto, chiria chitabakonyete korwa ase okoboko kwao?”

English: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd or the flock.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie, ‘Yeyote miongoni mwenu aletapo sadaka ya mnyama kwa Bwana, alete mnyama kama sadaka yake kutoka kundi lake la ngʼombe au la kondoo na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi akorwa ase egati yabo akondeetera inche Omonene eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso, ayerusie korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori.

English: “We both had dreams,” they replied, “but there is no one to interpret them.” Then Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Sisi sote tuliota ndoto, lakini hapakuwa na mtu yeyote wa kuzifasiri.” Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia, “Je, kufasiri ndoto si kazi ya Mungu? Niambieni ndoto zenu.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarootete chindoto, na onde tari oranyare kogoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiaito.” Yusufu akabateebia: “Nigoro ya Nyasae kobateebia engencho yaye. Komoranche, mochinteebie.”

English: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”
Kiswahili: Samweli akafanya kile Bwana alichosema. Alipofika Bethlehemu, wazee wa mji wakatetemeka walipomlaki. Wakauliza, “Je, umekuja kwa amani?”
Ekegusii: Samweli agakora ayio Omonene amochiigete, akagenda Bethlehemu. Abagaaka b'omochie oria bagaacha komoorotota bakoiguswa bakamobooria: “Inee! Ngwachire namang'ana 'omorembe?”

English: From the descendants of Binnui: Shimei,
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Binui: Shimei,
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Binui: Simei

English: A Song of Ascents. When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Bwana alipowarejeza mateka Sayuni, tulikuwa kama watu walioota ndoto.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene atoiraneretie intwe Abasayoni ebisio bieito, nigo twabeete buna abakoroota!

English: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it,
Kiswahili: Mtakapokuwa mmeingia nchi ile ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi na mtakapokuwa mmeimiliki na kukaa ndani yake,
Ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwaikire ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, na komenyao,

English: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwao ambaye atakunywa damu yoyote, nitakuwa kinyume cha mtu huyo atakayekunywa damu na kumkatilia mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraarie amanyinga ande onsi, inche Omonene nimbe mamincha y'omonto oyio, na inche nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.

English: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, jihesabuni wafu katika dhambi lakini mlio hai kwa Mungu katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe mwebare ng'a mwabeire abakuure ase ebibe, korende mwabeire moyo ase Nyasae ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote! Umeuweka utukufu wako juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki riakuma iga ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.

English: “You will not surely die,” the serpent told her.
Kiswahili: Lakini nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Hakika hamtakufa.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekairaneria omokungu oria “Ayio tari bo ogokwa, timogokwa.

English: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don't let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Shuka ukamlete Aroni pamoja nawe. Lakini makuhani pamoja na watu wasije wakalazimisha kuja kwa Bwana, nisije nikawaadhibu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Tirimboka gochia inse, orente Aroni, motiire nere gocha aa. Korende abakuani na abanto tibaabaisa gotamboka orobebe gocha aa ase 'nde, mbaise kobaa egesusuro.”

English: When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass. Judgment and Restoration
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lile lililoko mioyoni mwenu kamwe halitatokea, mnaposema, “Tunataka tuwe kama mataifa mengine, kama watu wengine wa dunia, wanaotumikia miti na mawe.”
Ekegusii: Amang’ana mokorengereria tagoikeranigwa nonya ng’ake, ekiagera nigo mogoteeba: Ntoganetie tobe buna abanto b’ebisaku binde na abe chinse chinde, tosasiime emete na amagena. Nyasae okorua egesusuro na amaabera

English: Then David summoned one of the young men and said, “Go, execute him!” So the young man struck him down, and he died.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamwita mmoja wa watu wake na kumwambia, “Nenda ukamuue!” Kwa hiyo akampiga, naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria omomura oyomo, akamoteebia, “Inchuo omoite!” Omomura oria agaaka Omoameleki oria, akamoita,

English: Show new signs, and work various wonders. Glorify your hand and your right arm.
Kiswahili: Onyesha ishara mpya, na ufanye maajabu mbalimbali. Utukuze mkono wako na mkono wako wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Naende bono kora ebikone amo nebimanyererio binde;

English: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa ninajua kuwa chochote utakachomwomba Mungu, atakupa.”
Ekegusii: Korende nonya mbono namanyire ng’a kende gionsi orasabe Nyasae, Nyasae nakoe.”

English: Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha wana wa Aroni wataiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, juu ya ile sadaka ya kuteketezwa iliyoko juu ya kuni zinazowaka, kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kararue ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe ase 'nde inche Omonene, korwa ase riicho rie ching'ondi, gose chimbori, arente eng'iti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, etuoni gose eaberi.

English: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued in every province and published to all the people, so that they would be ready on that day.
Kiswahili: Nakala ya andiko la amri ilipaswa kutolewa kama sheria katika kila jimbo, na kufahamishwa kwa watu wa kila taifa ili waweze kuwa tayari kwa siku ile.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ’amarube ayio achikirwe nigo abegetwe maiso marore ase chingongo chionsi ase obogambi boria koraareria abanto bonsi bebeeke ang’e goika rituko riria riike.

English: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything to cause your brother to stumble.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali kutokula nyama wala kunywa divai au kufanya jambo lingine lolote litakalomsababisha ndugu yako ajikwae.
Ekegusii: Mbuya gotaria enyama, nonya ’nkonywa edivai, gose gokora gento kende gionsi keragoche oy’omino.

English: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own palace,
Kiswahili: Miaka ishirini ilipopita, ambayo katika hiyo Solomoni alilijenga Hekalu la Bwana na jumba lake mwenyewe la kifalme,
Ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’emiaka emerongo ebere, eria Sulemani airete ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene na enyomba yaye omonyene,

English: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.
Kiswahili: Kama vile walivyofanya tangu siku nilipowapandisha kutoka Misri mpaka siku hii ya leo; wakiniacha mimi na kutumikia miungu mingine, ndivyo wanavyokufanyia wewe.
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero keria nabarusetie Misiri goika reero iga bantigire inche, babeire bagokorera chinyasae ching'ao, na bono bagotigire aye buna bantigete inche.

English: and on the vine were three branches. As it budded, its blossoms opened and its clusters ripened into grapes.
Kiswahili: nao mzabibu ulikuwa na matawi matatu. Mara tu ulipoanza kuchipua, maua yalichanua na vishada vyake vikawa zabibu zilizoiva.
Ekegusii: na omosabibu oyio nigo orenge ne chinsagia isato; bwango ogasomoria, ogasokia ebisicha, na okaama ebisago bi’amasabibu amatobu.

English: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
Kiswahili: Mwezi hugawanya majira, na jua hutambua wakati wake wa kutua.
Ekegusii: Aye kwabekire omotienyi obeire ekemanyererio gie chingaki, na erioba nigo rimanyete boronge ekero rigwenerete kogwa.

English: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa binti wa kuhani ameolewa na mtu asiye kuhani, binti huyo haruhusiwi kula chochote cha matoleo matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’Omokuani karanyuomwe nomonto otari Omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu bikoruegwa bibe ebing’wanso.

English: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates—and there is no water to drink!”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mmetupandisha kutoka Misri mpaka mahali hapa pa kutisha? Hapa hakuna nafaka wala tini, zabibu au makomamanga. Wala hapa hakuna maji ya kunywa!”
Ekegusii: Ninki mwatorusetie Misiri gocha ense eye yamakweri? Aase aa ataka atari kwama endagera, gose amako, gose amasabibu, gose amakomomanga. Nonya namaache tokonywa tari aa.”

English: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
Kiswahili: Herode alitaka sana kumuua Yohana, lakini akaogopa watu, kwa maana walimtambua kuwa ni nabii.
Ekegusii: Goika akarigia komoita, korende akairoka abanto, ekiagera konya banchire ng’a Yohana n’omobani orenge.

English: There is nothing that can be taken in exchange for a faithful friend. His excellency is beyond price.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuchukuliwa kama mbadala wa rafiki mwaminifu. Ubora wake ni wa thamani kubwa.
Ekegusii: Omosani omwegenwa nigo are omonto bw'engencho mono kobua ebinto bionsi, n'onde taiyo oranyare korenga obuya bwaye.

English: Being encouraged by the words of Judas, which were noble and effective, and able to incite to virtue and to stir the souls of the young to manly courage, they determined not to carry on a campaign, but nobly to bear down upon the enemy, and fighting hand to hand with all courage bring the matter to a conclusion, because the city, the sanctuary, and the temple were in danger.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wametiwa moyo na maneno ya Yuda, ambayo yalikuwa ya kiungwana na yenye ufanisi, na yenye uwezo wa kuchochea wema na kuchochea roho za vijana kuwa na ujasiri wa kiume, waliamua kutoendelea na kampeni, bali kwa uungwana kuwashinda adui, na kupigana mkono kwa mkono kwa ujasiri wote kulikamilisha jambo hilo, kwa sababu mji, patakatifu, na hekalu vilikuwa hatarini.
