Ekegusii: Amang'ana ayio amaya Yuda akwanete akabeka kera omonto chinguru n'omoremu, abasae bakaba n'okogania korwana esegi goetania abanto abanene. Omochie obo, Edini yabo boigo n'Hekalu yabo nigo biare ange gosirigwa. Abayahudi tibatagete gosiria ngaki nonya ngake, barabwo bakagania korwania ababisa babo obosio ase obosio.

English: There is one who destroys his soul through bashfulness. By a foolish countenance, he will destroy it.
Kiswahili: Kuna mtu anayeiangamiza nafsi yake kwa aibu. Kwa uso wa kipumbavu, ataiangamiza.
Ekegusii: Omonto nabo agotangwa gokora ekebe ase engencho are omotaka, ase igo nigo agotimoka ekiagera tari na kende agweiteria.

English: The city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat within it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mji huu hautakuwa chungu kwa ajili yenu, wala hamtakuwa nyama ndani yake. Nitatoa hukumu dhidi yenu katika mipaka ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omochie oyo tori gochia koba buna enyang’eni ase more, na inwe timori koba chinyama ime yaye; inche nimbanachere ekiina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli.

English: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu atakutana kimwili na mke wa baba yake, hakumheshimu baba yake. Mwanaume huyo na mwanamke huyo wote wauawe; damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto okoraara n’omokuungu ore moga ise, igo orenteire ise obosooku; abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.

English: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.'
Kiswahili: Askari wake wote wanaotoroka wataanguka kwa upanga, nao watakaonusurika watatawanyika katika pande zote za dunia. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi Bwana nimesema.
Ekegusii: Abarwani baye b'esegi abaratame 'mbakenywe nemioro, na abatigari mbasiarerwe gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi'ense. Erio nario moramanye ng'a ninche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
Kiswahili: Je, mlipata mateso kiasi hicho bure? Ni kama kweli yalikuwa bure!
Ekegusii: Inee! Igo mwanarete emechando emenge enga buna eye bosa? Aande gose tiyarenge bosa.

English: and as I have done to Samaria and its idols, will I not also do to Jerusalem and her idols?”
Kiswahili: je, nisiishughulikie Yerusalemu na sanamu zake kama nilivyoshughulikia Samaria na vinyago vyake?’ ”
Ekegusii: Inee, tingokora ase Yerusalemu, na ase emegwekano yaye egosasimwa, buna nakorete ase Samaria na ase emegwekano yaye?”

English: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
Kiswahili: Utaingia kaburini ukiwa na umri wa uzee mtimilifu, kama masuke ya ngano yakusanywapo kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Nogende ase embeera kore nobogotu obuya, buna emesaima y'endagera ekorentwa ekero engaki yabo yaikire.

English: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
Kiswahili: Shekania, Rehumu, Meremothi,
Ekegusii: Sekania, na Rehumu, na Meremoti;

English: “Those of the Jews called Hasidaeans, whose leader is Judas Maccabaeus, keep up war and are seditious, not allowing the kingdom to find tranquillity.
Kiswahili: "Wale wa Wayahudi wanaoitwa Wahasidae, ambao kiongozi wao ni Yuda Makabayo, wanaendelea na vita na ni waasi, hawaruhusu ufalme kupata utulivu."
Ekegusii: “Abayahudi baria bakorokwa Abahasidi, abwo bakoragwa na Yuda Makabi, nabwo bagosegeta esegi n'obosaria, goikera nonya n'ense etatware morembe.

English: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It's Elijah the Tishbite.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Alikuwa mtu aliyekuwa na vazi la manyoya na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake.” Mfalme akasema, “Huyo alikuwa ni Eliya, Mtishbi.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Igo abegete eganchwa eroisirie korwa ase amarionya, na bweboeretie orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye.” Omorwoti akabateebia: “Ekeene, oyio n'Elija Omotisibi.”

English: when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wote wanapokuja mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu mahali atakapopachagua, utasoma sheria hii mbele yao masikioni mwao.
Ekegusii: ekero Abaisraeli bonsi bagoocha ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, aase agwo arachoore, osome amachiiko onsi, erinde Abaisraeli bonsi bayaigwe.

English: Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amri iliyo kuu ndiyo hii: ‘Sikia ee Israeli. Bwana Mungu wetu, Bwana ndiye mmoja.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Erie ritang’ani nario eri: Igwa, Abaisraeli, Omonene oito, Nyasae, Nere Omonene oyomo;

English: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Si kama mtumwa, bali bora kuliko mtumwa, kama ndugu mpendwa. Yeye ni mpendwa sana kwangu na hata kwako zaidi, yeye kama mwanadamu na kama ndugu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende ere bono tari buna omosomba, korende goetania omosomba; buna oyominto omwanchwa, ase Kristo. Asende mono, na ase ore mono kobua, buna omosomba, naende buna oyominto ase Omonene!

English: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
Kiswahili: Wewe unayeshindwa na joto katika nguo zako wakati nchi imenyamazishwa kimya bila upepo wa kusini,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete egekogera chianga chiao chigosamba ne riberera, ekero ense egotoererigwa nomwaga okogusa korwa Irianyi?

English: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn't there here a prophet of Yahweh besides, that we may inquire of him?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yehoshafati akauliza, “Je, hayuko nabii wa Bwana hapa ambaye tunaweza kumuuliza?”
Ekegusii: Korende Yehosafati akaboria, “Inee! Omobani onde bw'Omonene tari aiga, tonyare koboria goetera asare?”

English: punishing those who don't know God, and to those who don't obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
Kiswahili: Atawaadhibu wale wasiomjua Mungu na ambao hawakuitii Injili ya Bwana wetu Yesu.
Ekegusii: na kobaakana egesiomba abwo batamomanyeti Nyasae, na bataigwereti enchiri y'Omonene oito Yeso.

English: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu kisima kile kikaitwa Beer-Lahai-Roi, ambacho bado kipo huko hata leo kati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ensoko eria ekarokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi; ero nigo ere egati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “How long will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Je, mtaacha kushika maagizo na maelekezo yangu mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri morabe mokwanga ogotebereria kwane na amachiiko aane?

English: Then Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, “This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel:
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akakwea kwenda kwa Mungu, naye Bwana akamwita kutoka kwenye ule mlima akasema, “Hivi ndivyo utakavyosema na nyumba ya Yakobo na utakachowaambia watu wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro koumerana na Nyasae. Omonene akamorangeria agwo ase egetunwa, akamoteebia, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie abanto b’egesaku kia Yakobo, baria Abaisraeli:

English: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon's house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu mpaka leo makuhani wa Dagoni wala wengine waingiao katika hekalu la Dagoni huko Ashdodi hawakanyagi kizingiti.
Ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw'egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akakana tena. Baada ya muda kidogo wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo karibu na Petro wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana wewe pia ni Mgalilaya!”
Ekegusii: Agakaana naende. Magega y'egeka egeke naende, baria bateneine ang'e bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye n'oyomo obo ore, ekiagera nigo ore Omogalili.”

English: So Moses spoke all this to the Israelites just as the LORD had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana alimwagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

English: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God's finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
Kiswahili: Bwana alinipa mbao mbili za mawe zilizoandikwa kwa kidole cha Mungu. Juu ya mbao hizo kulikuwepo amri zote ambazo Bwana aliwatangazia kule mlimani kwa njia ya moto, siku ya kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Omonene akang'a chibao chiria ibere chi'amagena echio Ere Omonyene ariigete n'ekiara kiaye. Nigo chiariikire amang'ana onsi Omonene konya akwanire nainwe agwo ase egetunwa korwa ase egati‐gati y'omorero, ekero mwasangererekanete aroro.

English: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation. Hearing and Doing
Kiswahili: Kwa mapenzi yake mwenyewe alituzaa kwa neno la kweli, kusudi tuwe kama mazao ya kwanza katika viumbe vyake vyote. Kusikia Na Kutenda
Ekegusii: Ase ogwancha kwaye ere omonyene agatoibora ase ring’ana riaye ri’ekeene, erinde tobe buna ogotongorwa konde kw’ebitongwa biaye. Okoigwa ring’ana na korikora

English: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.
Kiswahili: (Watumishi wa Hiramu na wa Solomoni wakaleta dhahabu kutoka Ofiri, tena wakaleta shehena kubwa ya miti ya msandali na vito vya thamani.
Ekegusii: Abasomba ba Huramu na abasomba ba Sulemani, baria barentete chitaabu korwa Ofiri, bakarenta boigo korwa aroro chibao chi'emete ekorokwa alugumu, amo namagena e rigori rinene.

English: All the peoples of the earth are counted as nothing, and He does as He pleases with the army of heaven and the peoples of the earth. There is no one who can restrain His hand or say to Him, ‘What have You done?’”
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote ya dunia yanahesabiwa kuwa si kitu. Hufanya kama atakavyo kwa majeshi ya mbinguni, na kwa mataifa ya dunia. Hakuna anayeweza kuuzuia mkono wake au kumwambia, “Umefanya nini wewe?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense nigo baabarire ng’a nigo bare bosa. Ere nigo agokorera emeganda ya igoro buna anchete, akorera na Mwanyabaanto bare ase ense boigo. Onde tari oramotange, gose komoboria: Ngento ki ekio ogokora?”

English: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana umetetea haki yangu na msimamo wangu; umeketi kwenye kiti chako cha enzi, ukihukumu kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okonacha ekiina kiane ase oboronge; noikaransete ase ekerogo kiao ki'obonene kore omonachi ebiina omooronge.

English: Yahweh's angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana akamwambia, “Rudi kwa bibi yako ukajishushe chini yake.”
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase moibori omino, na bwekeyie asare.”

English: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
Kiswahili: Lakini kitu kichafu hakitaingia humo kamwe, wala mtu yeyote atendaye mambo ya aibu au ya udanganyifu. Bali watakaoingia humo ni wale tu ambao majina yao yameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima cha Mwana-Kondoo.
Ekegusii: Na imeo tikegosoa nonya ng’ake kende gionsi kere egetachenegeti, gose oyogokora okogechia, gose oyogoteeba oborimo, otatiga baria barikire ase egetabu y’obogima y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.

English: So Isaac left that place and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.
Kiswahili: Basi Isaki akatoka huko akajenga kambi katika Bonde la Gerari, akaishi huko.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Isaka akang’anya korwa aroro, agatoora ase ense eraire ya Gerari, akamenya aroro.

English: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.
Kiswahili: Mungu aliye pekee, mwenye hekima, ambaye kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo utukufu ni wake milele na milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: ase Nyasae, omonyene obong’aini bweka, ogotogigwa kare na kare ase Yeso Kristo! Amina.

English: Queen Vashti, however, refused to come at the king’s command brought by his eunuchs. And the king became furious, and his anger burned within him. Queen Vashti Deposed
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati watumishi walipotoa amri ya mfalme, Malkia Vashti alikataa kuja. Ndipo mfalme alighadhibika, na hasira yake ikawaka.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baria b’omorwoti bakairera Vasti amang’ana ayio, korende ere akaanga koigwera ogochika kw’omorwoti. Ayio akagera omorwoti akaba nendamwamu enene mono yarenge gwoka ime yaye buna omorero.

English: There is one who slips, and not from the heart. Who is he who hasn't sinned with his tongue?
Kiswahili: Kuna mtu anayeteleza, na si kwa moyo wake wote. Ni nani ambaye hajatenda dhambi kwa ulimi wake?
Ekegusii: Omonto nabo arakwane egetagwenereti, ekio ere omonyene ategeneti. Korende, ning'o ere otanagokora ekebe?

English: He who teaches a fool is as one who teaches a man who slumbers. In the end he will say, “What is it?”
Kiswahili: Anayemfundisha mpumbavu ni kama anayemfundisha mtu anayelala usingizi. Mwishowe atasema, “Ni nini?”
Ekegusii: Koeresa omonto omoriri egento nigo enga buna nigo okoeresa omonto oraire chitoro; ekero gwakoorire koeresa omoriri oyio naende okoboria: “Ninki buno kware goteeba?”

English: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Wao wako pamoja na Sauli na watu wote wa Israeli huko kwenye Bonde la Ela, wakipigana na Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Saulo, na bamura bamino, na Abaisraeli bonsi nao bakare ase ense omweremo ya Ela korwana n'Abafilisti.”

English: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.
Kiswahili: Zunguka mji mara moja pamoja na watu wote wenye silaha. Fanya hivi kwa siku sita.
Ekegusii: Aye amo nabarwani bao goika motaare moetanane omochie oyio ara rimo kera rituko ase engaki y'amatuko atano na rimo.

English: which I hold in reserve for times of trouble, for the day of war and battle?
Kiswahili: ambazo nimeziweka akiba kwa ajili ya wakati wa taabu, na kwa ajili ya wakati wa vita na mapigano?
Ekegusii: Amagena ayio ngachete goika ase engaki y’emechando, amatuko aria arabe ay’esegi na okorwana konde.

English: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mkiingia kwenye nyumba yoyote, kaeni humo hadi mtakapoondoka katika mji huo.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Enyomba ende yonsi ase moraroisigwe, mobeere aroro goika ekero moraimoke korwa aase aria.

English: So now in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo basi ninawaagiza mbele za Israeli yote na kusanyiko hili la Bwana naye Mungu wetu akiwa anasikia: Kuweni na bidii kuzifuata amri za Bwana Mungu wenu, ili mpate kumiliki nchi hii nzuri na kuwaachia wana wenu kuwa urithi milele.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio bono aiga ase amasio ’Abaisraeli bonsi bare omosangererekano bw’Omonene, na ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito oyotoigwete, morende mono amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae onio, na koyabwatia, erio nario moramenye ase ense eye engiya na koyetigera abana baino, ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe magega yaino.

English: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”
Kiswahili: wakamwambia, “Tutarudi pamoja na wewe nyumbani kwa watu wako.”
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Yaya, titokogotiga! Nigo torigetie kogenda amo naye ase abanto baino.”

English: And I will summon a sword against Gog on all My mountains, declares the Lord GOD, and every man’s sword will be against his brother.
Kiswahili: Nitaita upanga vita dhidi ya Gogu juu ya milima yangu yote, asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Upanga wa kila mtu utakuwa dhidi ya ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Nindete omoro orwanie Gogi agwo ase ebitunwa biane bionsi, erio kera omonto aite oyomwabo n’omoro.

English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng'a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi. Tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

English: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
Kiswahili: Habari hizi zilipofika masikioni mwa kanisa huko Yerusalemu, wakamtuma Barnaba aende Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ekanisa ya Yerusalemu bakaigwa amang'ana aya, bagatoma Barnaba agende Antiokia.

English: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
Kiswahili: Walipotuma watu kwenda kupeleleza Betheli (ambao hapo kwanza uliitwa Luzu),
Ekegusii: Bagachitoma chirooti gochia Beteli. Agwo ase amatuko akare omochie oyio nigo omanyekanete buna Lusu.

English: However the Lord didn't choose the nation for the place's sake, but the place for the nation's sake.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Bwana hakuchagua taifa kwa ajili ya mahali hapo, bali mahali hapo kwa ajili ya taifa.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene tachorete abanto baye ase engencho y'Hekalu korende nigo achorete Hekalu yaye ase engencho y'abanto baye.

English: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mtasalitiwa, ili mteswe na kuuawa, nanyi mtachukiwa na mataifa yote kwa ajili yangu.
Ekegusii: Erio inabaabarue monyare gochandwa na goitwa, na inwe inamwangwe nebisaku bionsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.

English: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Kiswahili: Bwana yu karibu na wote wamwitao, karibu na wote wamwitao kwa uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang'e ase abanto abwo bakomorangeria; abwo bonsi bakomorangeria ase ekeene.

English: The Lord created mankind out of earth, and turned them back to it again.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliumba wanadamu kutoka ardhini, na akawarudisha tena kwake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo atongete Mwanyabaanto korwa ase amaroba, naende Mwanyabaanto nairane ase riroba.

English: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakiingia mle kaburini, wakamwona kijana mmoja aliyevaa joho jeupe akiwa ameketi upande wa kuume, nao wakastaajabu.
Ekegusii: Bagasoa oboina ime, bakarora omomura oikaransete ensemo y'okorio, bweboyetie eanga endabu, bakegosa.

English: When Saul sent the messengers to seize David, Michal said, “He is ill.”
Kiswahili: Sauli alipotuma watu kumkamata Daudi, Mikali akasema, “Yeye ni mgonjwa.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abanto batometwe na Saulo kwoyia Daudi bachete, na Mikali akabateebia: “Orwarire.”

English: Do not put the shoes anywhere
Kiswahili: Usiweke viatu popote
Ekegusii: Tobeka ebikoroto ande onsi

English: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth.”
Kiswahili: nalo jiwe hili nililolisimamisha kama nguzo litakuwa nyumba ya Mungu na katika yote utakayonipa nitakutolea wewe sehemu ya kumi.”
Ekegusii: ne rigena eri natenenia aa buna esiiro nigo rirabe enyomba yao, Nyasae. Na kende gionsi orang’e inche, amaene tinkomocha gokoa ensemo ya ikomi.”

English: or finds lost property and lies about it and swears falsely, or if he commits any such sin that a man might commit—
Kiswahili: au akiokota mali iliyopotea na akadanganya, au kuapa kwa uongo, au kama akitenda dhambi yoyote ambayo watu waweza kuitenda;
Ekegusii: gose onyorire egento giasirete, naende akane na gotiana ng’a takenyorete, bibe ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora,

English: Now the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “Please take note that the place where we meet with you is too small for us.
Kiswahili: Wana wa manabii wakamwambia Elisha, “Tazama, mahali hapa tunapokutana nawe ni padogo sana kwetu.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa b’ababani bagateebia Elisha: “Rora aase aiga tomenyete inse y’oboteneneri bwao igo are aake mono ase tore.

English: Even if he does good, he does it in forgetfulness. In the end, he reveals his wickedness.
Kiswahili: Hata kama akifanya mema, anafanya kwa kusahau. Mwishowe, anafichua uovu wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero akorire egento ekiya, nigo akogekora mosiabano, ase igo bworokia buna are omoriri ere omonyene.

English: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nabii Isaya akaenda kwa Mfalme Hezekia na kumuuliza, “Watu hao walisema nini, na wametoka wapi?” Hezekia akamjibu, “Wametoka nchi ya mbali. Walikuja kwangu kutoka Babeli.”
Ekegusii: Erio omobani Isaya agacha ase Hezekia, omorwoti akamobooria: “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng'ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria: “Barabwo nigo barwa Babiloni, ense y'aare, bagacha ase 'nde.”

English: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don't go up and don't fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.'”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana aliniambia, “Waambie, ‘Msipande kupigana, kwa sababu sitakuwa pamoja nanyi. Mtashindwa na adui zenu.' ”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Bakanie, obateebie ng'a tibaabaisa kogeenda korwana esegi, ekiagera inche Omonene tindi amo nabarabwo. Kobaragende nigo bagochia kobugwa n'ababisa baabo.

English: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
Kiswahili: Mungu anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.

English: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David. This was the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Solomoni akaanza kujenga Hekalu la Bwana katika Yerusalemu juu ya Mlima Moria, pale ambapo Bwana alikuwa amemtokea Daudi baba yake. Ilikuwa katika kiwanja cha kupuria cha Arauna, Myebusi, mahali palipotolewa na Daudi.
Ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agachaaka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, igoro ase egetunwa kia Moria, agwo ase Omonene aorokerete Daudi ise, Daudi nigo achorete aase agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi kiarenge.

English: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa Mungu amewapatanisha ninyi kwa njia ya mwili wa Kristo kupitia mauti, ili awalete mbele zake mkiwa watakatifu, bila dosari wala lawama,
Ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obabwatanirie inwe amo nere omonyene ase ogokwa kw'omwana oye ase omobere oye bw'echinyama, Nyasae obakorire abasani baye erio abarente ase obosio bwaye, more abachenu, motari na komocha gose na bobe bonde,

English: Don't quench the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Msiuzime moto wa Roho Mtakatifu;
Ekegusii: Timorimia Omoika!

English: He spoke words of peace to them in subtlety, and they believed him. Then he fell upon the city suddenly, struck it very severely, and destroyed many people of Israel.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia maneno ya amani kwa hila, nao wakamwamini. Kisha akaushambulia mji ghafla, akaupiga vikali sana, na kuwaangamiza watu wengi wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase obong'ainereria omonene bwa abarwani abwo agakwana amang'ana amaansu y'omorembe korende ase okobatega. Erio kegima, akayosaagana mobasokano omochie oria na koyosaria bobe mono. Agaita omoganda bwa abanto abange.

English: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Isakari, waliofahamu majira na kujua kile ambacho Israeli inapasa kufanya, walikuwa viongozi 200, pamoja na jamaa zao wote chini ya uongozi wao.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisakaru: abanto abang'aini abamanyi ebimanyererio bie chingaki, bamanyete egento Abaisraeli bagwenerete gokora, abateneneri amagana abere (200), amo nabamwabo abarenge inse ase obochiki bwabo.

English: But together they lie down in the dust, and worms cover them both.
Kiswahili: Hao wote hulala mavumbini, nao mabuu huwafunika wote.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo bakobeekwa ase riroba bareng’anetie, bagunda, na amakonde abatuba.

English: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn't obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Kile kitu ambacho Israeli alikitafuta kwa bidii hakukipata. Lakini waliochaguliwa walikipata. Waliobaki walifanywa wagumu,
Ekegusii: Inaki rende abeire? Egento keria Abaisraeli baare korigia tibakenyorete, Baria bachoretwe, mbarabwo bakenyorete, korende abatigarete bagakorwa koba abakong'u ase chinkoro chiabo,

English: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
Kiswahili: Habari hizi za mambo aliyoyafanya Yesu zikaenea Uyahudi wote na sehemu zote za jirani.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na ense yonsi yaetanaine.

English: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
Kiswahili: “Kama ningejishuhudia mimi mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu si kweli.
Ekegusii: Inche kondeorokie omonyene, oborori bwane tibori obw’ekeene.

English: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wake, Nebukadneza aliota ndoto. Mawazo yake yakasumbuka na hakuweza kulala.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kabere bw'okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro ere akarota chindoto; ase ayio agachandeka ase ebirengererio biaye, tarara chitoro.

English: Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed. Saying 6
Kiswahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani lililowekwa na baba zako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotuumana orobebe orokoro orwo chisokoro chiao chiabeegete. 5.

English: A rich man speaks, and all keep silence. They extol what he says to the clouds. A poor man speaks, and they say, “Who is this?” If he stumbles, they will help to overthrow him.
Kiswahili: Tajiri husema, na wote hukaa kimya. Wanasifu anachowaambia mawingu. Maskini husema, na wanasema, "Huyu ni nani?" Akijikwaa, watasaidia kumwangusha.
Ekegusii: Omotenenku aise gokwana, abanto bonsi nigo bagokira kiri. Abanto nigo bagotogia enkwano yaye gochia amare igoro; tiga bono omonto omotaka akwane, abanto bonsi bana goteeba iga: “N'oyio nere ning'o?” Ekero omotaka akogochwa, abanto nigo bakomotwomerania gochi inse.

English: God presented Him as the atoning sacrifice through faith in His blood, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye Mungu alimtoa awe dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa njia ya imani katika damu yake. Alifanya hivi ili kuonyesha haki yake, kwa sababu kwa ustahimili wake aliziachilia zile dhambi zilizotangulia kufanywa.
Ekegusii: Ere Nyasae omobekire koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase amanyinga aye, erinde tomonyoore ase enchera y’okwegena. Igo Nyasae oorokirie oboronge bwaye, ekiagera ase okoremereria kwaye atigete ebibe biria biatang’anete.

English: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won't even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Katika Sheria imeandikwa kwamba: “Kupitia kwa watu wenye lugha ngʼeni na kupitia midomo ya wageni, nitasema na watu hawa, lakini hata hivyo hawatanisikiliza,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase amachiiko nigo ariikire, “Omonene oteebire: Ase abanto b'emenwa etamanyekaneti, na ase ebikoba bi'emenwa y'abageni ninkwane nabaanto aba. Nonya nabo tibakonyigwera.”

English: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Maombi. Ee Mungu, ufanye haraka kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!

English: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God's voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Kama mkisikiliza kwa bidii sauti ya Bwana Mungu wenu na kuyafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pake, kama mkiyatii maagizo yake na kuzishika amri zake zote, sitaleta juu yenu ugonjwa wowote niliowaletea Wamisri, kwa kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwaponyaye.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Oise koigwera aya inche Omonene oo ngokwana, na koyakora ayare boronge ase amaiso aane, na gotegerera amaachiko aane, na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi, rirorio inche tingokobekera amarwaire ande onsi buna aria nabeekerete Abamisiri; naki ninche Omonene oo, oyogokogwenia.”

English: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote. Lakini tukipendana, Mungu anakaa ndani yetu, na pendo lake limekamilika ndani yetu.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi. Gatoranchane intwe ase intwe, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime ase tore, na obwanchani bwaye bwaikeranigwe ime yaito.

English: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwaaga wale watu, akaenda mlimani kuomba.
Ekegusii: Magega gakorire gokwana nabarabwo, akagenda egetunwa gosaba.

English: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipolia tena kwa sauti kuu, akaitoa roho yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarera naende neriogi rinene, erio agatweka mo.

English: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near and brought accusation against the Jews.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo baadhi ya Wakaldayo walijitokeza na kuwashtaki Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Bono abanto bande b'Abakalidayo bakagenda bagasoera Abayahudi.

English: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
Kiswahili: mbuni, kiruka-njia, dudumizi, kipanga, shakwe, aina zote za kipanga,
Ekegusii: esagero, na omoyaaye, na enyakoboke, na ebisaku biamwabo;

English: And one sheep shall be given from each flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These are for the grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings, to make atonement for the people, declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: Pia kondoo mmoja atachukuliwa kutoka kwenye kila kundi la kondoo mia mbili kutoka kwenye malisho yaliyonyeshewa vizuri ya Israeli. Hivi vitatumika kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: “Korwa ase amaicho are ase amarisio y’Abaisraeli morue eng’ondi eyemo korwa ase ching’ondi amagana abere, ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase abanto. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.' So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
Kiswahili: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aitwaye Yesu alitengeneza tope, akanipaka machoni mwangu, naye akaniambia nenda ukanawe katika Bwawa la Siloamu, ndipo nikanawa nami nikapata kuona!”
Ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang'aka amaiso aane, aganteebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamuu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, nakuambia; leo, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, wewe mwenyewe utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero, ase obotuko obo, ritang'ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”

English: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
Kiswahili: Akasubu pete za shaba za kushikilia ile mipiko kwa ajili ya zile pembe nne za huo wavu wa shaba.
Ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye, agachibeka ase chikoona inye chi'egechungi ekio gi'etai, ase emiaro egosoigwa.

English: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh; but I will place a yoke on her fair neck. I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, and Jacob will break the hard ground.
Kiswahili: Efraimu ni mtamba wa ngʼombe aliyefundishwa ambaye hupenda kupura, hivyo nitamfunga nira juu ya shingo yake nzuri. Nitamwendesha Efraimu, Yuda lazima alime, naye Yakobo lazima avunjavunje mabonge ya udongo.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo baarenge buna ritororo riorokereretigwe buya, rianchete koora, inche nigo nabegete rikorogoto ase ebigoti biabo ebiya. Bono nimbeekere Abaefraimu rikorogoto, nonya n’Abayuda goika babe bakorema, na Abayakobo goika babe bakobosa.

English: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.'
Kiswahili: Mpaka leo hawajajinyenyekeza au kuonyesha heshima, wala hawajafuata sheria yangu na amri nilizoweka mbele yenu na baba zenu.
Ekegusii: Goika rituko ria reero monto onde tari bwekeeirie ase okoba omoitongo, gose koiroka na kobwata amachiiko aane, na emeroberio nabegete ase amasio aino, na ase amasio e chisokoro chiaino.

English: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
Kiswahili: Pia Ahabu akatengeneza nguzo ya Ashera na kufanya mengi ili kumkasirisha Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kuliko walivyofanya wafalme wote wa Israeli waliomtangulia.
Ekegusii: Ahabu akaroisia omote bw'Asera, enyasae enkuungu; agakora bobe mono goetania abarwoti bonsi baria bamotang'anerete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, goika akaba nendamwamu.

English: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
Kiswahili: “Yeye ashindaye nitampa haki ya kuketi pamoja nami kwenye kiti changu cha enzi, kama vile mimi nilivyoshinda na nikaketi pamoja na Baba yangu kwenye kiti chake cha enzi.
Ekegusii: Ere oyorabue, nimoe ribaga aikaranse amo nainche ase ekerogo kiane ki’obonene, buna nainche nabuete, ngaikaransa amo na Tata one ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.

English: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you, if you find my beloved, tell him I am sick with love. The Friends
Kiswahili: Enyi binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza: kama mkimpata mpenzi wangu, mtamwambia nini? Mwambieni ninazimia kwa mapenzi. Marafiki
Ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora ng’a mokonyora omwanchi one, momoteebie ng’a amaiga ’obwanchani anyaarire. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)

English: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
Kiswahili: Filipo alikuwa na binti wanne mabikira waliokuwa wanatoa unabii.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo narenge nabaiseke bane abekungi, baare kobana.

English: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;
Kiswahili: Mose alipomaliza kuisimamisha Maskani, aliitia mafuta na kuiweka wakfu pamoja na samani zake zote. Pia alitia madhabahu mafuta na kuiweka wakfu, pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Musa konya akoorire gotenenia Obomenyo Obochenu naende kaboakire amaguta na kobwatanana amo n'ebinto biaye bionsi, naende gakoorire gwatanana egesasiimero na ebikorero biaye,

English: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao walitangatanga jangwani, hawakuona njia ya kuwafikisha mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babete bakona goetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.

English: Meanwhile, Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. So Ish-bosheth questioned Abner, “Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?”
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli alikuwa amekuwa na suria, jina lake Rispa binti wa Aiya. Naye Ish-Boshethi akamwambia Abneri, “Kwa nini umekutana kimwili na suria wa baba yangu?”
Ekegusii: Saulo nabwate omokungu o sere‐sere ore korokwa Risipa, mosubati bw’Aya. Isi‐Boseti akaboria Abineri, “Nase ki mwamenyanire nomokuungu o sere‐sere o tata?”

English: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa Yuda na Yerusalemu, maafisa wa mahakama, makuhani na watu wote wa nchi waliopita kati ya vile vipande vya ndama,
Ekegusii: Barabwo amo nabanene b'oborwoti bw'Abayuda, na aba Yerusalemu, na abateneneri b'enyomba y'omorwoti, na abakuani, na abanto bonsi b'ense eye, baria baetete ase egati y'ebing'ese bi'emori eria,

English: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
Kiswahili: Yerameeli alikuwa na mke mwingine, aliyeitwa Atara, aliyekuwa mama yake Onamu.
Ekegusii: Boigo Yerameeli nabwate omokungu onde orenge korokwa Atara; nere orenge ng'ina Onamu.

English: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai's name.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mordekai aligundua hila hii na kumwambia Malkia Esta, ambaye baadaye alimwarifu mfalme, huku akimsifu Mordekai.
Ekegusii: Moredekai akamanya ayio, akayateebia Esiteri eting'ana, nere akayateebia omorwoti ribaga ria Moredekai.

English: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
Kiswahili: nayo roho yangu inamfurahia Mungu Mwokozi wangu,
Ekegusii: omoika one ogokeire Nyasae, Omotoria one,

English: You will seek me and won't find me. You can't come where I am.”
Kiswahili: Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona, nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja.”
Ekegusii: Namondigie, korende timokonyoora; na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao.”

English: like roses in the days of first fruits, like lilies by a water spring, like the shoot of the frankincense tree in summer time,
Kiswahili: kama waridi siku za matunda ya kwanza, kama yungiyungi kando ya chemchemi ya maji, kama chipukizi la mti wa ubani wakati wa kiangazi,
Ekegusii: Nigo arenge buna ogosiicha kw'eritang'ani kwa amaua yobwanchani, buna ebisiicha biamatoke a rooche, buna ogoseboka kw'emecharake igoro ase egetunwa kia Lebanoni ase chingaki chiegurugura.

English: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God'? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
Kiswahili: Je, wakati huo utasema, “Mimi ni mungu,” mbele ya wale wanaokuua? Utakuwa mwanadamu tu, wala si mungu, mikononi mwa hao wanaokuua.
Ekegusii: Ekero orabe ase amaboko abanto abwo, bakogoita, Inee, nogenderere gokwana ase amasio abo ng'a aye Nyasae ore? Aye nigo ore Mwanyabaanto, orabe ase amaboko ay'abwo bakogoita, tori Nyasae.

English: O you fire and heat, bless the Lord! Praise and exalt him above all forever!
Kiswahili: Enyi moto na joto, mhimidini Bwana! Msifuni na kumwadhimisha milele!
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene inwe obokendu n'eriberera,

English: Now the border of Manasseh went from Asher to Michmethath near Shechem, then southward to include the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
Kiswahili: Eneo la Manase lilienea kuanzia Asheri hadi Mikmeta mashariki mwa Shekemu. Mpaka ule ulielekea upande wa kusini kutoka pale kujumuisha watu walioishi En-Tapua.
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwa Manase rogaachakera Aseri, rogaika Mikemetati, moocha ya Sekemu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi ase abanto b’Eni‐Tapua.

English: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul's son, greatly delighted in David.
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mwanawe Yonathani na watumishi wake wote wamuue Daudi. Lakini Yonathani mwana wa Sauli alimpenda sana Daudi.
Ekegusii: Saulo agakwana na Yonathani, omomura oye, na abasomba baye bonsi ng'a naganetie goita Daudi, korende Yonathani nigo anchete Daudi mono.

English: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.
Kiswahili: Mordekai alipojua yote yaliyokwisha kufanyika, alirarua mavazi yake na kuvaa nguo za magunia na kujipaka majivu, akaenda mjini, akiomboleza kwa sauti na kwa uchungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Moredekai atebeetigwe amang'ana onsi akorirwe, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chigunia na kweaka ribu, akagenda ase egati y'omochie okorera neriogi rinene, ore nobororo obonge,

English: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don't forget the helpless.
Kiswahili: Inuka Bwana! Inua mkono wako, Ee Mungu. Usiwasahau wanyonge.
Ekegusii: Omonene, gaki 'nchuo! Aye Nyasae, rambora okoboko kwao, gaki tibweba bachandegete!

English: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our guilt? What is the sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
Kiswahili: “Utakapowaambia watu hawa mambo haya yote na wakakuuliza, ‘Kwa nini Bwana ameamuru maafa makubwa kama haya dhidi yetu? Tumefanya kosa gani? Tumetenda dhambi gani dhidi ya Bwana, Mungu wetu?’
Ekegusii: “Ekero orateebie abanto amang’ana aya onsi, barabwo babe bagokoboria: Nase ki Omonene arentire obobe obo obonene ase tore? Obobe bwaito mborobi? Ebibe twakorire ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mbiribi?

English: Have compassion upon the city of your sanctuary, Jerusalem, the place of your rest.
Kiswahili: Uhurumie mji wa patakatifu pako, Yerusalemu, mahali pako pa kupumzika.
Ekegusii: Bisangererie ebisaku bionsi bia Yakobo,

English: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
Kiswahili: Alipofika, akainama na kuchungulia mle kaburini, akaona vile vitambaa vya kitani mle ndani, lakini hakuingia.
Ekegusii: agatung’ama, akarora ebitambaa bireo, korende tasoa ime.

English: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo aliwaokoa kwa ajili ya jina lake, ili apate kudhihirisha uweza wake mkuu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene akabatooria ase engencho y’erieta riaye, ng’a anyare komanyekania okobua kwaye okonene.

English: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
Kiswahili: Kama mwenye mnyama atapenda kumkomboa mnyama huyo, lazima aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto omonyene oganetie kobooria eng'iti eria, rirorio aakane rigori riria ribekire, n'ameente eyemo ya isano ase rigori erio.

English: For healing comes from the Most High, and he shall receive a gift from the king.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana uponyaji hutoka kwa Aliye Juu Zaidi, naye atapokea zawadi kutoka kwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekeegwa kiaye kioborwaria nigo kerwete ase Omonene; nere nigo akonyora ekeegwa korwa ase omorwoti.

English: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, “Dunia na vyote vilivyomo ni mali ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: “Naki ense ney’Omonene, amo na bionsi ebireo.”

English: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
Kiswahili: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana tangu sasa na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

English: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh. Aaron’s Staff
Kiswahili: Mose alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na Aroni alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na mitatu walipozungumza na Farao. Fimbo Ya Aroni Yawa Nyoka
Ekegusii: Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Aroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83). Enyimbo ya Aroni

English: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo, umati mkubwa wa watu ulikusanyika tena. Kwa kuwa walikuwa hawana chakula, Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na barabwo tibarenge na gento bakoria, Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia,

English: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mtu aliyepanda mbegu nzuri katika shamba lake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oye;

English: Reprove your neighbor before you threaten him; and give place to the law of the Most High.
Kiswahili: Mkaripie jirani yako kabla hujamtishia; na uiachie nafasi sheria ya Aliye Juu Zaidi.
Ekegusii: Koraigwe kende igoro y'omwamate oo; moborie, tobaisa komogosa! Kae ebirage bia Nyasae ribaga bikore emeremo.

English: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hana akajibu, “Si hivyo bwana wangu, mimi ni mwanamke mwenye huzuni kubwa. Mimi sijanywa mvinyo wala kileo, nilikuwa ninaumimina moyo wangu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ana akamoiraneria, “Taibo, omonene one, inche nomokuungu inde nobororo ase enkoro yane. Tinyweti edivai gose ekenyugwa kende kegotindia. Nigo nabeire ngosaba na kobeeka emechando yane yonsi ase Omonene.

English: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.
Kiswahili: Kwea juu ya kilele cha Pisga uangalie magharibi, kaskazini, kusini na mashariki. Iangalie hiyo nchi kwa macho yako, kwa vile wewe hutavuka Yordani.
Ekegusii: Tiira gochia igoro ase egentunwa gia Pisiga, otenene ase egechuuria kiaye, oimokie amaiso ao, origererie gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, origererie buya ense eria orarore, ekiagera tokonyaara kwamboka ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

English: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won't abhor you.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya makao yangu miongoni mwenu, nami sitawachukia.
Ekegusii: Nimenye ase egati yaino ase Obomenyo bwane Obochenu; tinkobatiga nonya ng'ake.

English: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
Kiswahili: Bali mfalme atafurahi katika Mungu, wale wote waapao kwa jina la Mungu watamsifu, bali vinywa vya waongo vitanyamazishwa.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omorwoti nabe okogoka ase Nyasae, na abanto bonsi abagotiana asare mbabe bagwetogia, korende emenwa y'abanto bagokwana oborimo nekirigwe.

English: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wa Mfalme Belshaza, mimi Danieli, nilipata maono, baada ya maono ambayo yalikuwa yamenitokea mbeleni.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw'okogamba kwa Belisasari omorwoti, inche Danieli nkarora okorora konde magega ya koria kw'eritang'ani.

English: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”

English: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni basi maana ya ule mfano wa mpanzi:
Ekegusii: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw'omobusuri.

English: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
Kiswahili: Nayo habari njema lazima ihubiriwe kwanza kwa mataifa yote kabla ule mwisho haujawadia.
Ekegusii: Naende negwenerete enchiri erandigwe ritang'ani ase ebisaku bionsi.

English: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.
Kiswahili: Sisi tumekuwa kama wale ambao hujawatawala kamwe, kama wale ambao hawajaitwa kwa jina lako.
Ekegusii: Twabeire buna abanto aye otana kogaambera rinde, na buna abanto batari korokwa ase erieta riao.

English: Indeed, with mocking lips and foreign tongues, He will speak to this people
Kiswahili: Sawa kabisa, kwa midomo migeni na kwa lugha ngeni, Mungu atasema na watu hawa,
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene nakwane nabaanto aba goetera ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao, abwo bagokwana omonwa omogeni.

English: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kufanya yale yote yaliyoandikwa kumhusu, walimshusha kutoka msalabani na kumzika kaburini.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goikerania onsi ayariikire igoro yaye, bakamoikia korwa ase omote, bakamobeka ase oboina.

English: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wao?”
Ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b'ebisaku baraborie, “Nyasae oyio obo ng'ai are?”

English: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mipiko hiyo kwa mbao za mshita, uifunike na dhahabu, uitumie kubeba hiyo meza.
Ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeome netaabu, nero emesa erabogorerigwe.

English: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh's assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh's assembly forever,
Kiswahili: Hapatakuwa na Mwamoni au Mmoabu au yeyote wa wazao wao atakayeruhusiwa kuingia katika kusanyiko la Bwana, hata mpaka kizazi cha kumi.
Ekegusii: “Abaamoni, gose Abamoabu, gose ororeeria rwabo, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tibaabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano bw'Omonene nonya ng'ake.

English: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
Kiswahili: Sasa ninawasihi sana, jipeni moyo mkuu kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayepoteza maisha yake, ila meli itaangamia.
Ekegusii: Bono nabateebirie, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera monto tagosira, otatiga emeeri yoka.

English: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang'ana aya inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, 'ngokwana, amang'ana aya nay'ane, inche omonto oramokiigwe amaiso.

English: Don't be afraid of the words of a sinful man; for his glory will be dung and worms.
Kiswahili: Usiogope maneno ya mtu mwenye dhambi; maana utukufu wake utakuwa kama mavi na minyoo.
Ekegusii: Timoiroka okogosererigwa kwomonto omobe. Moinyore buna ere boigo nakwe na obwerori bwaye bwonsi inabosire boigo omobere oye oguunde na koriegwa na amakonde.

English: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.'”
Kiswahili: Yeye pamoja na wazao wake watakuwa na Agano la ukuhani milele, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kwa ajili ya heshima ya Mungu wake, na akafanya upatanisho kwa Waisraeli.”
Ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo kw'omorembe 'nkobe ase are ere, na ase ororeria rw'aye, okobwatana kwa botambe kw'obokuani, ekiagera abeete ne risemi ase engencho yane, inche Nyasae oye, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”

English: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children, to those who believe in his name:
Kiswahili: Bali wote waliompokea, aliwapa uwezo wa kufanyika watoto wa Mungu, ndio wale waliaminio jina lake.
Ekegusii: Korende bonsi abamoitabete na kwegena erieta riaye, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae.

English: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Eliezeri: Rehabia alikuwa wa kwanza. Eliezeri alikuwa na mwana mmoja tu, lakini wana wa Rehabia walikuwa wengi sana.
Ekegusii: Ase abana b'Eliezeri Rehabia nere orenge omoteneneri obo. Eliezeri tabwate abana abamura bande; korende abana abamura ba Rehabia nigo barenge abange mono.

English: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.
Kiswahili: Wao ni taifa lisilo na akili, hakuna busara ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli n’abanto batancheti ogosemigwa, na tibari n’obong’aini bonde bwonsi.

English: I care very little, however, if I am judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwangu mimi ni jambo dogo sana kwamba nihukumiwe na ninyi au na mahakama yoyote ya kibinadamu. Naam, hata mimi mwenyewe sijihukumu.
Ekegusii: Asende inche, tai gento ngambigwe nainwe, gose na kegambero kende gionsi kia Mwanyabaanto. Nonya ninche omonyene tinkwegambia.

English: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,
Kiswahili: Awali ya yote, nasihi kwamba dua, sala, maombezi na shukrani zifanyike kwa ajili ya watu wote:
Ekegusii: Gaaki, ritang'ani ase amang'ana onsi nabasoroire ng'a okoboria, na ogosaba, na okogaramera amo nokoiraneria Nyasae ng'a mbuya mono, bikoreke ase engencho y'abanto bonsi,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Kiswahili: Na kwa matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yehoashi, yote aliyoyafanya na mafanikio yake, pamoja na vita yake dhidi ya Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoasi, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye gw'okorwania Amasia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'ogokora kw'Abarwoti b'Abaisraeli.

English: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
Kiswahili: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.
Ekegusii: Tokonye torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokonywa kwa Mwanyabaanto mbosa.

English: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
Kiswahili: Kama hakuna kuadibishwa (ambalo ni fungu la watoto wote), basi ninyi ni watoto wa haramu wala si watoto halali.
Ekegusii: Korende onye mokoba motari nokorongeigwa oko bonsi babwataine nakorokwo, rirorio nigo more abana ebimeru gose tari abana ba boronge.

English: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.'”
Kiswahili: lakini kwa kuwa huyu mjane ananisumbuasumbua, nitahakikisha amepata haki yake ili asiendelee kunichosha kwa kunijia mara kwa mara!' ”
Ekegusii: korende ekiagera omoboraka oyo andosirie, nimogambere boronge, tacha kondosia ase ogonchichera botambe.”

English: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.
Kiswahili: Hatafurahia vijito, mito inayotiririsha asali na siagi.
Ekegusii: Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chinsoko chiichire namooke na amabeere.

English: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness You have shown Your servant. Indeed, with only my staff I came across the Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
Kiswahili: mimi sistahili fadhili na uaminifu wako wote ulionitendea mimi mtumishi wako. Nilikuwa na fimbo tu mkononi mwangu nilipovuka mto huu wa Yordani, lakini sasa ninayo makundi mawili.
Ekegusii: Inche tingwenereti nonya ng’ake obuya na obwegenwa bwonsi gwankorerete inche, omosomba oo, naki engaki naambogeete orooche rwa Yorodani nigo nabwate enyimbo yoka koboko kwane, na bono nabeire ebiombe bibere.

English: Then Asa cried out to the LORD his God: “O LORD, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this multitude. O LORD, You are our God. Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Asa akamlilia Bwana Mungu wake na kusema, “Ee Bwana, hakuna yeyote aliye kama wewe wa kuwasaidia wasio na nguvu dhidi ya wenye nguvu. Utusaidie, Ee Bwana, wewe ndiwe Mungu wetu, kwa kuwa tunakutumainia wewe, nasi kwa jina lako tumekuja dhidi ya jeshi hili kubwa. Ee Bwana, wewe ndiwe Mungu wetu, usiwaache wanadamu wakushinde wewe.”
Ekegusii: Asa akarera ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, agateeba, “Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye ase ogokonya abatari ne chinguru na abare ne chinguru. Ase ayio, aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, otokonye, ekiagera naye tosemeretie, na ase erieta riao twachire korwana nomoganda oyo omonene. Aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae oito, omonto onde tari orakobue.”

English: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,
Kiswahili: Nitakuokoa kutoka kwa watu wako na watu wa Mataifa ambao ninakutuma kwao,
Ekegusii: Ningotoorie korwa ase abanto bao, na korwa ase abanto b'Ebisaku, ase abwo ndagotome.

English: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don't serve my gods and you don't worship the golden image which I have set up?
Kiswahili: naye Nebukadneza akawauliza, “Je, ni kweli kwamba ninyi Shadraki, Meshaki na Abednego hamuitumikii miungu yangu wala kuiabudu sanamu ya dhahabu niliyoisimamisha?
Ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro akababoria, “Inwe Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, Inee, nekeene ng'a inwe timori gokorera chinyasae chiane, gose timori gosasiima omogwekano oria bw'etaabu ntenenetie?

English: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
Kiswahili: Usioane nao. Usimtoe binti yako kuolewa na mwanawe, au kumchukua binti yake aolewe na mwanao.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo; timorua abana baino abaiseke ase abamura babo, gose timonyuomeria abana baino abamura ase abaiseke babo,

English: Because they don't respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawaheshimu kazi za Bwana, na yale ambayo mikono yake imetenda, atawabomoa na kamwe hatawajenga tena.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng'a ogokora kw'Omonene, gose emeremo y'amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.

English: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
Kiswahili: mjitie katika kuwahudumia watu kama hawa na kila mmoja aingiaye kwenye kazi na kuifanya kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Nabasoroire baigwere abanto buna aba, na kera omonto oyogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo ase ogwechanda.

English: And the man answered, “The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
Kiswahili: Adamu akasema, “Huyu mwanamke uliyenipa awe pamoja nami alinipa sehemu ya tunda kutoka kwenye huo mti, nami nikala.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria: “Omokungu oyo kwang’ete ng’a abe amo nainche, nere ong’ete amatunda y’omote oyio, na inche nkaria.”

English: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
Kiswahili: Jifurahishe katika Bwana naye atakupa haja za moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene, ere nakoe okogania gw’enkoro yao.

English: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo, Mimi mwenyewe, niko kinyume nanyi Yerusalemu, nitawapiga kwa adhabu yangu mbele ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, inche ninche inde mamincha yaino, nimbaachere, 'mbanachere ekiina agwo ase egati yaino, ase amasio y' abanto b'ebisaku.

English: Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.
Kiswahili: Huko, watu wakamletea Yesu mtu mmoja kiziwi, ambaye pia alikuwa na kigugumizi, wakamwomba aweke mkono wake juu ya huyo mtu na amponye.
Ekegusii: Bakamorentera omonto ore omotiino, naende nigo are gotutura kagokwana; bagasorora Yeso abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro asare.

English: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.
Kiswahili: Mtu akusanyaye majivu ya huyo mtamba ni lazima pia afue nguo zake, kadhalika naye pia atakuwa najisi hadi jioni. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa Waisraeli na kwa wageni wanaoishi miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria orabuuche riibu riria, asibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Oko nakwo ogochika koragenderere botambe ase Abaisraeli na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo.

English: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;
Kiswahili: mapazia ya ua pamoja na nguzo na vitako vyake, pia na pazia kwa ajili ya ingilio la kwenye ua; kamba zake na vigingi vya hema kwa ajili ya ua; vyombo vyote vilivyohitajiwa kwa ajili ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania;
Ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori, na ebirochi, na ebikorero bionsi bi’obokoreri ase Obomenyo ime, ase Eema y’o mosangererekano,

English: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana si wale wanaoisikia sheria ambao ni wenye haki mbele za Mungu, bali ni wale wanaoitii sheria ndio watakaohesabiwa haki.
Ekegusii: Inaki tari abwo bakoigwa amachiiko bare abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende mbaria bagoikerania amachiiko, nabwo baraegwe oboronge.

English: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
Kiswahili: Kama sikuja na kusema nao wasingalikuwa na hatia ya dhambi. Lakini sasa hawana udhuru kwa ajili ya dhambi zao.
Ekegusii: Onye ntachete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe, korende bono tibari nogwekengera ase ebibe biabo.

English: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa imejaa uharibifu na ukatili machoni pa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ense ekaba yasarekire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, egaichorwa nobotindi na okoregana kwegeitano.

English: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
Kiswahili: Yule kiongozi aliposikia maneno haya, alimwendea yule jemadari na kumwambia, “Unataka kufanya nini? Kwa maana huyu mtu ni raiya wa Rumi.”
Ekegusii: Omotang'ani oria ochia koigwa aya, akagenda akoorokia omotang'ani oria omonene, akabora: “Naki origetie gokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo n'Omorumi are.”

English: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
Kiswahili: Mara mtakaposikia sauti ya baragumu, filimbi, marimba, zeze, kinubi, zumari na aina zote za sauti za ala za uimbaji, lazima mwanguke chini na kuabudu sanamu ya dhahabu ambayo Mfalme Nebukadneza ameisimamisha.
Ekegusii: ng’a ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amarandi, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, goika motung’ame inse, mosasiime omogwekano bw’etaabu, oria Nebukadinesaro omorwoti atenenirie.

English: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for Yahweh your God will deliver it into your hand.
Kiswahili: ninyi inawapasa mwinuke mtoke huko mafichoni na kuuteka mji. Bwana Mungu wenu atautia mkononi mwenu.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero togotama, inwe morue ase moboete, moumokere omochie, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyobeekire ase amaboko aino.

English: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?
Kiswahili: “Je, waweza kumvua Lewiathani kwa ndoano ya samaki, au kufunga ulimi wake kwa kamba?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nonyare kong’usa Leviatani, eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?

English: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye tukisafiri kupita chini ya kisiwa kidogo kiitwacho Kauda, ambapo kwa kuwa tulikuwa tumekingiwa upepo na hicho kisiwa, tuliweza kwa shida kuifunga mashua ya kuokolea watu.
Ekegusii: Togaeta togakengana ase egesinka egeke gekorokwa Kilaudia, tokanyara ase obokong'u kobogoria obwato oboke.

English: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Na ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka ya kufanya hayo?”
Ekegusii: bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokorera aya?”

English: then I will uproot Israel from the soil I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. I will make it an object of scorn and ridicule among all the peoples.
Kiswahili: ndipo nitakapoingʼoa Israeli kutoka nchi yangu niliyowapa, nami nitalikataa Hekalu hili nililolitakasa kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Nitalifanya kitu cha kudharauliwa na kitu cha kudhihakiwa miongoni mwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: rirorio nimbarusie korwa ase ense eye nabaeire; na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetugute erue ase amaiso aane, naende ebe ring’ana rigokwanwa bobe nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
Kiswahili: Unaniongoza kwa shauri lako, hatimaye utaniingiza katika utukufu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na magega y’ayio noche kong’ira onsoyie ase obonene.

English: For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana siku hizo zitakuwa za dhiki kuu ambayo haijapata kuwako tangu mwanzo, hapo Mungu alipoumba ulimwengu, mpaka leo, na wala haitakuwako tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko aria n’ebe emechando, buna etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ogotonga oko Nyasae atongete, goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.

English: The sun started to go down, and the day began to cool. Where were our clothes?
Kiswahili: Tuliangalia chini ya miti. Tuliangalia juu ya vichaka. Tuliangalia kila mahali.
Ekegusii: Togachirigia nse yemete. Tokarigia ime yobonyansi. Tokarigia kera ase.

English: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama ukileta malimbuko ya sadaka ya nafaka kwa Bwana, utatoa masuke yaliyopondwa ya nafaka mpya iliyookwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Aye gokorenta ogotongora kw'endagera ase 'nde inche Omonene, goika orente ebigara ebibese bisaambire ase omorero, bisenyentire.

English: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”
Kiswahili: Mvue Aroni mavazi yake, na umvike Eleazari mwanawe, kwa maana Aroni atakusanywa pamoja na watu wake; atakufa huko.”
Ekegusii: Orusie Aroni chianga chiaye chi'obokuani, ochibekere Eleazari, momura oye. Aroni ere 'nakwe, na asangererekane amo n'abanto baye, ekero more aaria.”

English: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no stately form or majesty to attract us, no beauty that we should desire Him.
Kiswahili: Alikua mbele yake kama mche mwororo na kama mzizi katika nchi kavu. Hakuwa na uzuri wala utukufu wa kutuvutia kwake, hakuwa na chochote katika sura yake cha kutufanya tumtamani.
Ekegusii: Omosomba oyio nigo akinete ase obosio bwaye buna ekemeri ekerere, na buna egesabo ki’omote kegokina korwa ase riroba eriomo, tabwate ekieni ekiya, gose obonene bw’omobere; ekero twamorigereretie, titwaroche buya bonde asare bogotong’usa.

English: Then the man who is lord of the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest: Leave one brother with me, take food to relieve the hunger of your households, and go.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo huyo mtu aliye bwana katika nchi hiyo alipotuambia, ‘Hivi ndivyo nitafahamu kuwa ninyi ni watu waaminifu: Mwacheni mmoja wa ndugu zenu pamoja nami hapa, kisha nendeni mpeleke chakula kwa ajili ya jamaa yenu inayoteseka kwa njaa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio, omonene bw’ense eria, agatoteebia: Ase amang’ana aya naro ndamanyere gose nabaanto abaronge more: Tiga oyomo oino aiga ase ’nde, inwe abande genda, moire endagera ase engencho y’enchara ekare inka seino.

English: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way, but the folly of fools deceives them.
Kiswahili: Hekima ya mwenye busara ni kufikiria njia zake, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu ni udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto ore n’okomanya nigo bokomokonya omanya buna chiinchera chiaye chire, korende obosooku bw’abaanto abariri nigo bokobang’aina.

English: But Yahweh's angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?
Kiswahili: Lakini malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Eliya, Mtishbi, “Panda ukakutane na wajumbe wa mfalme wa Samaria, uwaulize, ‘Je, ni kwa sababu hakuna Mungu katika Israeli ndiyo maana mnakwenda kumuuliza Baal-Zebubu, mungu wa Ekroni?'
Ekegusii: Korende omomalaika bw'Omonene agateebia Elija Omotisibi: “Imoka ogende, oumerane nabaanto baria omorwoti Ahasia atomire, obaborie: Inee! Nase ki mokogenda koboria Baali‐Sebubu, enyasae y'Ekironi? Nekiagera mokagete ng'a Nyasae tari ase Abaisraeli?

English: I have indeed built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”
Kiswahili: naam, hakika nimekujengea Hekalu zuri sana, mahali pako pa kuishi milele.” Hotuba Ya Solomoni (2 Nyakati 6:3-11)
Ekegusii: Bono nakoagacheire enyomba ebe obomenyo bwao, aase oramenye kogenderera botambe.” Sulemani ogokwana ase abanto (2 Amg 6:3-11)

English: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
Kiswahili: aniwekaye huru toka kwa adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa bane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha y’ane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.

English: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na mipiko yake na kiti cha rehema,
Ekegusii: na Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, amo nemiaro yaye, na ekerogo kia amaabera,

English: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to these gods.
Kiswahili: ambao waliwaalika kushiriki katika kutoa kafara kwa miungu yao. Watu wakala na kusujudu mbele ya miungu hii.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakarangeria Abaisraeli bagende ase emeyega y’ebing’wanso yarenge gokorerwa chinyasae chiabo, na barabwo bakabiria, naende bagasasiima chinyasae chi’Abamoabu.

English: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamtukana na kusema, “Wewe ndiwe mwanafunzi wake, Sisi ni wanafunzi wa Mose.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamorama, bakaboora, “Naye ore omworokigwa oye, korerende intwe nigo tore aborokigwa ba Musa.

English: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu, “Mataifa mawili yamo tumboni mwako, na mataifa hayo mawili kutoka ndani yako watatenganishwa. Mmoja atakuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko mwingine, na yule mkubwa atamtumikia yule mdogo.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ebisaku bibere mbire enda yao ime, abanto babere orache koibora, na barabwo mbaatananekane korwa okoiborwa kwabo; oyomo nabe ne chinguru kobua oria onde, oria omonene omosomba bw'oria omoke.”

English: and now the LORD has fulfilled it; He has done just as He said. Because you people have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed His voice, this thing has happened to you.
Kiswahili: Sasa Bwana ameyaleta haya, amefanya sawasawa na vile alivyosema angefanya. Yote haya yametokea kwa sababu ninyi mlifanya dhambi dhidi ya Bwana na hamkumtii.
Ekegusii: Omonene orentire amang’ana ayio amabe, ere okorire buna akwanete. Ekiagera mwakorete ebibe ase Omonene, gose timwamoigwerete, amang’ana aya amabe abanyorire.

English: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
Kiswahili: Utakapokuja, niletee lile joho nililoliacha kwa Karpo huko Troa na vile vitabu vyangu, hasa vile vya ngozi.
Ekegusii: Ekero orache ondentanerie egetambaa gi’okwambara, eke natigerete Karipo aria Teroa. Naboigo kogocha ondentanerie chibuku, na kobua mono chiria chi’amasankwa.

English: By these letters the king permitted the Jews in each and every city the right to assemble and defend themselves, to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the forces of any people or province hostile to them, including women and children, and to plunder their possessions.
Kiswahili: Waraka wa mfalme uliwaruhusu Wayahudi katika kila mji kuwa na haki ya kukusanyika na kujilinda wenyewe; kuharibu, kuua na kuangamiza jeshi lolote, taifa lolote au jimbo lile litakalowashambulia wao, wake zao, watoto wao na kuteka mali za adui zao.
Ekegusii: Amarube ayio nigo arenge goteeba ng’a omorwoti orure ribaga ase Abayahudi ba kera omochie bache amo, erinde beegerere abanyene. Baegwe ribaga boigo goita abarwani bande bonsi ba kera egesaku baare gocha kobarwania, baite nabana babo na abakungu babo; boigo basakore chinibo chiabo.

English: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi ninakaribia kufa, lakini Mungu atakuwa pamoja nanyi, na atawarudisha katika nchi ya baba zenu.
Ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Rora ng'ang'e inde gokwa. Nyasae nigo arabe amo nainwe, nabairanie gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiaino.

English: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
Kiswahili: Wale waliotegemea Kushi na kujivunia Misri wataogopa na kuaibika.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeretie Abamisiri na betogeretie Abaetiopia mbabe baichanete na gosooka.

English: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Toeni dhabihu zilizo haki; mtegemeeni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Karue ebing'wanso bi'oboronge, na mosemerie Omonene.

English: Then he came to the gate facing east and climbed its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate to be one rod deep.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaenda kwenye lango linaloelekea mashariki. Akapanda ngazi zake akapima kizingiti cha lango, nacho kilikuwa na kina cha huo ufito.
Ekegusii: Naende akagenda ase egeita kiarochie moocha, akariinera ebiriinero biaye. Erio akarengia obogare bw’egesona inse agwo ase oboagacho bw’egeita, bokaba emoti eyemo.

English: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn't it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini Bwana anatuleta katika nchi hii ili tufe kwa upanga? Wake zetu na watoto wetu watachukuliwa kama nyara. Je, isingekuwa bora kwetu kurudi Misri?”
Ekegusii: Ninki gekogera Omonene agotoira ase ense eria tochie goitwa ase esegi? Abakungu baito, na abana baito, nigo bagochia gwoswa n'ababisa baito. Naki yare koba buya onye 'ntwairana gochia Misiri.”

English: So Joseph went and told Pharaoh: “My father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akaenda na kumwambia Farao, “Baba yangu na ndugu zangu wamekuja kutoka nchi ya Kanaani wakiwa na makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe, pamoja na kila kitu walicho nacho, nao sasa wapo huko Gosheni.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagenda agateebia Farao: “Tata na bamura baminto bachire korwa ase ense ya Kaanani, amo ne chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio; barabwo nao bare ase ensemo ya Goseni.”

English: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
Kiswahili: Baba zako walioshuka kwenda Misri jumla yao walikuwa sabini, na sasa Bwana Mungu wako amekufanya wengi kama nyota za angani.
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaino chiria chiatirimbogete gochia Misiri nigo chiarenge abanto emerongo etano n'ebere, na b'Omonene Nyasae oino, obamentekanirie, mwabeire abange buna ching'enang'eni chia igoro.

English: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
Kiswahili: Unapoficha uso wako, wanapata hofu, unapoondoa pumzi yao, wanakufa na kurudi mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwabisire obosio bwao, nigo bikoba nobwoba obonene; na ekero okobiura omoika obo, nigo bigokwa, biairana ase amaroba ime.

English: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,'
Kiswahili: Kisha Yeremia akaiambia jamaa ya Warekabi, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Mmetii amri ya baba yenu Yonadabu, na mmefuata mafundisho yake yote na mmefanya kila kitu alichowaamuru.'
Ekegusii: Korende Yeremia agakwana nabaanto b'eamate y'Abarekabu, agateeba, “Aya nar'Omonene bw'Emeganda, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Mwaigwereire amang'ana aria Yonadabu, sokoro yaino, abachigete, na mwarendire emeroberio yaye yonsi, na gokora amang'ana onsi abachigete.

English: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
Kiswahili: Kiburi huzalisha magomvi tu, bali hekima hupatikana kwa wale wanaozingatia ushauri.
Ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogoseemigwa nigo bakoba n'obong'aini.

English: And the couriers traveled from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun; but the people scorned and mocked them.
Kiswahili: Matarishi wakaenda mji hadi mji katika Efraimu na Manase, wakafika mpaka Zabuloni, lakini watu wakawadharau na kuwadhihaki.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria abaango bairete amarube bakagenda ase kera omochie ase ense y’Efraimu na eya Manase, na goika eya Sabuloni, korende abanto bakabachecheria na kobachaya.

English: The sinner will be overpowered through his lips. By them, the insulter and the arrogant will stumble.
Kiswahili: Mwenye dhambi atashindwa kupitia midomo yake, na kwa midomo yake, mwenye kutukana na mwenye kiburi watajikwaa.
Ekegusii: Omonyabibe nigo akobwatwa ase okweimokereria na amang'ana aye omonyene.
