English: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Does disaster come upon them? Does God, in His anger, apportion destruction?
Kiswahili: “Lakini ni mara ngapi taa ya waovu huzimwa? Ni mara ngapi maafa huwajia, yale yawapatayo ambayo Mungu huwapangia katika hasira yake?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobacheera? Inee! Ara karenga Nyasae akobaa emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?

English: In those days I also saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, niliona Wayahudi waliokuwa wameoa wanawake kutoka Ashdodi, Amoni na Moabu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria boigo nkarora Abayuda bande banyuomete abakungu korwa ase chinse chi’Abaasidodi na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu.

English: and if the mark in the fabric, leather, weave, knit, or leather article is green or red, then it is contaminated with mildew and must be shown to the priest.
Kiswahili: tena kama maambukizo kwenye vazi, au ngozi, au lililofumwa au kusokotwa, au kifaa chochote cha ngozi, ni rangi ya kijani au nyekundu, huo ni upele unaoenea na ni lazima kuhani aonyeshwe.
Ekegusii: na onye ekemoa gekororekana kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, ase eanga, gose ase risankwa, gose ase egetambaa keria, gose ase egento kende keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, obwo noukoma bogwesiarera, na ebinto ebi biorokigwe ase Omokuani.

English: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.'
Kiswahili: “Nikajibu, ‘La hasha Bwana! Kitu chochote kilicho najisi hakijaingia kinywani mwangu.'
Ekegusii: Korende nkabora: Yay'Omonene, ekiagera egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi, tibiana gosoa ase omonwa one nonya ng'ake.

English: and nobly said, “I got these from heaven. For his laws' sake I treat these with contempt. From him, I hope to receive these back again.”
Kiswahili: na kwa heshima akasema, "Nilipata hizi kutoka mbinguni. Kwa ajili ya sheria zake nazidharau. Natumaini kuzipokea tena kutoka kwake."
Ekegusii: agakwana ase oboremu Nyasae nere ongete amaboko aya, korende amachiiko a Nyasae nigo are ay'engencho goetania amaboko ane, na nimanyete buna Nyasae nangiranerie amaboko aya ane.

English: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
Kiswahili: Yehoshafati mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake na akajiimarisha dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Yehosafati, omwana omomura bw'Asa, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye. Agakong'ia oborwoti bwaye ase ogwekengera ase Abaisraeli.

English: On that day the Benjamites mobilized 26,000 swordsmen from their cities, in addition to the 700 select men of Gibeah.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Wabenyamini wakakusanya watu 26,000 kutoka miji yao, waliojifunga panga, mbali na hao 700 waliochaguliwa miongoni mwa hao waliokaa Gibea.
Ekegusii: Ababenjamini abwo baroberetigwe korwa ase emechie yabo ase rituko riria nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo, abamanyete korwanera emioro. Amo n’abwo ’mbarengeo abanto amagana atan’abere, abachooretwe korwa ase omochie o Gibea.

English: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili, kuanzia juu hadi chini. Dunia ikatetemeka na miamba ikapasuka.
Ekegusii: Na rora, egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere, ense egatengecha, ebitare bigatandoka.

English: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
Kiswahili: Hakika nimeuweka moyo wangu safi bure, ni bure nimenawa mikono yangu nisiwe na hatia.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, mbosa nabeire ndendete enkoro yane ebe echenegete, mbosa nabeire ngoisaba amaboko aane ng’a timba nokomocha.

English: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
Kiswahili: Ninasikia makaripio ambayo yananivunjia heshima, nao ufahamu wangu unanisukuma kujibu.
Ekegusii: Naigure ogokuurerwa gw'okonyomania ng'a inche nomomochi, korende omoika bw'okomanya ore ime yane ogerire ing'iranerie.

English: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtiane moyo mtu na mwenzake kila siku, maadamu iitwapo Leo, ili asiwepo hata mmoja wenu mwenye kufanywa mgumu kwa udanganyifu wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Korende moremanie inwe ase inwe kera rituko, ekero gekorokwa ekia Reero, erinde ase, more onde takorwa koba omokong'u ase obong'ainereria bw'ebibe.

English: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore Yahweh has brought all this evil on them.'”
Kiswahili: Watu watajibu, ‘Kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewatoa baba zao Misri, nao wamekumbatia miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia, ndiyo sababu Bwana ameyaleta maafa haya yote juu yao.' ”
Ekegusii: Nigo barairanerie: Nekiagera barabwo batigete Omonene, Nyasae obo, oria orusetie chisokoro chiabo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, naende bakabwatana ne chinyasae ching'ao, bagachisasiima na gochikorera. Amang'ana ayio agerire Omonene orentire amabe aya onsi igoro ase bare.”

English: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events, and we have no justification to account for this commotion.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyo sasa, tuko hatarini kushtakiwa kwa kufanya ghasia kwa sababu ya tukio la leo. Kwa kuwa hakuna sababu tutakayoweza kutoa kuhalalisha msukosuko huu.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene obokong’u mbore ase tore, aande mbarigetie gotosoera ase engencho y’eburu‐buru eye ya reero. Karabe igo, rirorio titokonyaara gwekengera ase engencho y’omosangererekano oyo.”

English: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
Kiswahili: Tumesikia juu ya kiburi cha Moabu: kiburi chake cha kujivuna na udanganyifu, kiburi chake na ufidhuli wake, lakini majivuno yake si kitu.
Ekegusii: Twaigure buna Abamoabu bare abetogia, barabwo nigo bare aberori mono, na abamwenu, na abaenenu, na abanyandamwamu, korende ogwetogia kwabo nigo kore okw'obong'ainereria.

English: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden. The Descendants of Cain
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Kaini akaondoka mbele za Bwana akaenda kuishi katika nchi ya Nodi, iliyoko mashariki ya Edeni.
Ekegusii: Erio Kaini akarwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, akageenda, akamenya ase ense ekorokwa okoombogana ere moocha ya Edeni. Ororeeria rwa Kaini

English: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.
Kiswahili: Wakati walipelekewa sehemu ya chakula kutoka mezani mwa Yosefu, sehemu ya Benyamini ilikuwa mara tano zaidi ya sehemu ya wale wengine. Kwa hiyo wakanywa na kufurahi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Bakaegwa endagera korwa ase emesa ya Yusufu, korende Benjamini ere akarenterwa enyinge kobua abwo bande, ebirengo bitano. Naboigo bakanywa, bakagoka amo nere.

English: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.” Aaron’s Blessing
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hii ndiyo sheria ya Mnadhiri ambaye anaweka nadhiri kwa matoleo yake kwa Bwana kufuatana na kujitenga kwake, zaidi ya chochote kile anachoweza kupata. Ni lazima atimize nadhiri aliyoiweka kufuatana na sheria ya Mnadhiri.’ ” Baraka Ya Kikuhani
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase oyoriete eira ng’a abe Omwerwa Omonene, goika arue ase Omonene aya amorierete eira akorua ore Omwerwa oye, korende onye oriire eira arue goetania, goika ayeikeranie kegima koreng’ana nogochika gw’okwerwa. Ogosesenia Kw’Omonene Kogokwanwa N’abakuani

English: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
Kiswahili: Je, Bwana atafurahishwa na kondoo dume elfu, au mito elfu kumi ya mafuta? Je, nimtoe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza kwa ajili ya kosa langu, mtoto wangu mwenyewe kwa ajili ya dhambi ya nafsi yangu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nagokigwe ne chimingichi chilifu, gose ne chindooche chi’amaguta chilifu ikomi? Inee! Nindue omwana one omotangi ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, omwana oyio ore okwama kw’obogima bwane, abe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoyo one?”

English: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
Kiswahili: Watasema, “Iko wapi ile ahadi ya kuja kwake? Tangu baba zetu walipofariki, kila kitu kinaendelea kama kilivyokuwa tangu mwanzo wa kuumbwa.”
Ekegusii: bagoteeba, “Ng'ai bore oboikeranu bw'eira eria y'ogocha kwaye? Naki korwa agwo chisokoro chiaito chiaraarete ebinto bionsi nabo bigendererete engencho eyio eyio, buna biarenge korwa omochakano bw'ogotongwa.”

English: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
Kiswahili: Enyi uzao wa nyoka! Mnawezaje kunena mambo mema, wakati ninyi ni waovu? Kwa maana kinywa cha mtu huyanena yale yaliyoujaza moyo wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe oroiboro rwe ching'iti! Naki moranyare gokwana amaya ekero more ababe? Ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying:
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia Solomoni kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Sulemani, rikamoteebia,

English: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa akaketi akaanza kuongea, naye Yesu akamkabidhi kwa mama yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng'ina.

English: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
Kiswahili: Mose akachukua nusu ya damu ya wale wanyama na kuiweka kwenye mabakuli na nusu nyingine akainyunyiza juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Musa akabogoria ekeng'ese ki'amanyinga aya, akayabeeka egetaabo ime, na ekeng'ese kende akanyororokeria egesasiimero.

English: Surely I will conceal nothing from you. I have said, ‘It is good to conceal the secret of a king, but to reveal gloriously the works of God.'
Kiswahili: Hakika sitakuficha chochote. Nimesema, ‘Ni vizuri kuficha siri ya mfalme, bali kufichua kwa utukufu kazi za Mungu.’
Ekegusii: “Bono nkobateebia inde ekeene ntari kobabisa kende. 'Nabateebia ng'a mbuya kobisa obobisi bw'omorwoti, korende aya Nyasae goika ararigwe kera ase buna egwenerete. Tobiti!

English: They don't know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can't see, and their hearts, that they can't understand.
Kiswahili: Hawajui chochote, hawaelewi chochote, macho yao yamefungwa hata hawawezi kuona, akili zao zimefungwa hata hawawezi kufahamu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagokora ayio nabariri, tibamanyeti kende. Amaiso abo aukoire, tibakonyara korora, na ebirengererio biabo biasarigwe, tibakonyara komanya.

English: but their duty was to assist the descendants of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, being responsible for the courts and chambers, the purification of all the holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God,
Kiswahili: Wajibu wa Walawi ulikuwa kuwasaidia wazao wa Aroni kuhudumu katika Hekalu la Bwana: Kuwa wasimamizi wa nyua, vyumba vya pembeni, kutakasa vyombo vitakatifu na utendaji mwingine wowote katika nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yabo nebe ogokonya abwo b’ororeria rwa Aroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na gotenenera chiraaro na ebinyomba ebike; boigo ogosibia ebinto bichenire, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma alimjia Yesu, akamwomba akipiga magoti, akamwambia, “Ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma agacha asare, akamosorora na komotung'amera, akamoteebia, “Onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”

English: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Umetufanya kuwa mithali miongoni mwa mataifa, mataifa hutikisa vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba omorabaaro ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, twabeire togosingiserigwa emetwe nabaanto.

English: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
Kiswahili: Yeye aizuiaye fimbo yake hampendi mwanawe, bali yeye ampendaye huwa mwangalifu kumwadibisha.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oy’omwanchete tari goteebana komoorongeyia.

English: Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O LORD our God? So we put our hope in You, for You have done all these things.
Kiswahili: Je, kuna sanamu yoyote isiyofaa kitu ya mataifa iwezayo kuleta mvua? Je, anga peke yake zaweza kutoa mvua? La hasha, ni wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, Mungu wetu. Kwa hiyo tumaini letu liko kwako, kwa kuwa wewe ndiwe ufanyaye haya yote.
Ekegusii: Inee! Emegwekano y’ogosasimwa y’abanto b’ebisaku nenyare korenta embura? Gose igoro enyene enyare korenta embura? Inee! Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, tari aye tosemeretie? Nigo togosemeretie, ekiagera naye gwakorire aya onsi.

English: And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
Kiswahili: Popote nitakapowafukuzia, mabaki wote wa kizazi hiki kiovu watatamani kufa kuliko kuishi, asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.’ Dhambi Na Adhabu
Ekegusii: Abanto abaratigare b’egesaku eke ekebe, baria bare moyo ase chinsemo chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, mbaganie ogokwa kobua koba moyo. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nakwanire. Ebibe na egesusuro

English: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.
Kiswahili: Moyo wake ukawa hodari katika njia za Bwana na zaidi ya yote, akaondoa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu na nguzo za Maashera katika Yuda.
Ekegusii: Akaba omoremu ase chinchera chi'Omonene, agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na akarusia emete y'Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, korwa ase Abayuda.

English: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite's brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
Kiswahili: Katika vita vingine na Wafilisti huko Gobu, Elhanani mwana wa Yaare-Oregimu, Mbethlehemu, alimuua nduguye Goliathi, Mgiti, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na mpini kama mti wa mfumaji.
Ekegusii: Esegi ende yarenge n'Abafilisti agwo Gobu. Elihanani, mosinto o Yaare‐Oregimu korwa Bethlehemu, agaita Goliato korwa Gati. Orotanga rwe riitimo ria Goliato nigo rwareenge buna omwaro omonene.

English: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mwenye kupanda na mwenye kutia maji si kitu, bali Mungu peke yake ambaye huifanya ikue.
Ekegusii: Onye nabo, oyogosimeka tai gento, nonya noyokobeeka amaache, korende Nyasae bweka oyogokinia.

English: The rich man's wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
Kiswahili: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, bali ufukara ni maangamizi ya maskini.
Ekegusii: Obotenenku bw'omonto omonda nigo bore ase are buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, korende obotaka nabwo ogosirigwa kw'abataka.

English: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah,
Kiswahili: ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: Nitaleta maafa juu ya mahali hapa na watu wake, laana zote zilizoandikwa ndani ya hicho kitabu ambazo zimesomwa mbele ya mfalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nindete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto b’aiga okoragererigwa gwonsi korikire ase egetabu eke yasomwa ase omorwoti bw’Abayuda.

English: But no one asks, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives us songs in the night,
Kiswahili: Lakini hakuna asemaye, ‘Yuko wapi Mungu Muumba wangu, yeye anifanyaye niimbe usiku,
Ekegusii: Korende monto onde tari okobooria: Ng’ai Nyasae, oria ontongete, are, oyio okogera amatera ay’ogotogia aterwa botuko?

English: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let's rise up against her in battle.
Kiswahili: Maono ya Obadia. Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi kuhusu Edomu: Tumesikia ujumbe kutoka kwa Bwana: Mjumbe alitumwa kwa mataifa kusema, “Inukeni, twendeni tukapigane vita dhidi yake.”
Ekegusii: Oko nokorora kw'Obadia. Aya naro Omonene agoteeba igoro y'egesaku kia Edomu. ee, twaigure amang'ana korwa ase Omonene, na omotomwa otomirwe gochia ase abanto b'ebisaku, ogoteeba: “Imoka, togende korwania Abaedomu esegi!”

English: also Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah, from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and their sons, 20 men.
Kiswahili: Naye Hashabia, pamoja na Yeshaya kutoka wazao wa Merari na ndugu zake na wapwa wake wanaume ishirini.
Ekegusii: Boigo bagatoma Hasabia na Yesaia bw’ororeria rwa Merari, na abamwabo, na abana babo, bonsi nabaanto emerongo ebere.

English: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Kiswahili: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Je, wewe utakasirika milele? Wivu wako utawaka kama moto hadi lini?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nendamwamu ase tore? Inee! Ribero riao, ngoika ririri rigochia gwoka buna omorero?

English: He said to me, “Don't seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaniambia, “Usiyafunge maneno ya unabii yaliyomo katika kitabu hiki, kwa sababu wakati umekaribia.
Ekegusii: Naende aganteebia, “Tobisa amang'ana 'obobani bw'egetabu eke gose koyabeka ekemanyererio, ekiagera engaki ng'ang'e ere

English: My son, don't be busy about many matters; for if you meddle much, you will not be unpunished. If you pursue, you will not overtake, and you will not escape by fleeing.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, usiwe na shughuli nyingi; maana ukiingilia mambo mengi, hutaadhibiwa; ukifuatilia, hutakuta, wala hutatoroka kwa kukimbia.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tiga gwechandera amang'ana amaange bosa; riika riaigo, ementere emeremo erio onyare kwebachera emetego yokomochigwa bosa. Notaka kobwatia amang'ana amaange tokoyaikeria, gose tokonyara koyabogerera ase ogotama gwoka.

English: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
Kiswahili: Hili likahesabiwa kwake haki, kwa vizazi visivyo na mwisho vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng’a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.

English: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,
Kiswahili: Kusanya watu wote, wanaume, wanawake, watoto na wageni wanaoishi katika miji yenu, ili waweze kusikia na kujifunza kumcha Bwana Mungu wenu na kufuata kwa bidii maneno yote ya sheria hii.
Ekegusii: Mosangererie abanto bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, na abamenyi bamenyete ase emechie yaino, erio bonsi baigwe na kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene Nyasae oino, erinde babe abegenwa na bakore amang'ana onsi y'amachiiko aya.

English: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.
Kiswahili: Maafa baada ya maafa, nchi yote imekuwa magofu. Kwa ghafula mahema yangu yameangamizwa, makazi yangu kwa muda mfupi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nigo bokoromeng'ana obobe bonde, ense yonsi yasarigwe. Chiema chiane chiasarigwe mobosokano; ebietubo bie chiema chiane biatandoirwe.

English: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore Yahweh's anger burned against the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini Waisraeli hawakuwa waaminifu kuhusu vile vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu; Akani mwana wa Karmi, mwana wa Zabdi, mwana wa Zera, wa kabila la Yuda, alivichukua baadhi ya hivyo vitu. Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli tibabete abegenwa; bakaira ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa. Akani, mosinto o Karimi, o Sabidi, o Zera bw'egesaku kia Yuda, akaira ebinto binde biaragereretigwe: n'Omonene akaba nekeririanda ekenene ase Abaisraeli.

English: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Kiswahili: “Njooni kwangu, ninyi nyote mnaotaabika na kulemewa na mizigo, nami nitawapumzisha.
Ekegusii: Inchuo ase 'nde inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.

English: if they break my statutes, and don't keep my commandments;
Kiswahili: kama wakihalifu maagizo yangu na kutoshika amri zangu,
Ekegusii: na onye bagochia gosaria aya nachiikire. Bange kobwata amachiiko aane,

English: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
Kiswahili: Wanalisifu jina lako ambalo ni kuu na la kuogopwa: yeye ni mtakatifu!
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi tiga batogie erieta riaye rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ere nigo are omochenu.

English: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
Kiswahili: Kisha tutakuwa kama mataifa mengine yote, tukiwa na mfalme wa kutuongoza na kwenda mbele yetu na kutupigania vita vyetu.”
Ekegusii: Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omorwoti ogotogaambera na gototang'ana, ekero togochia korwana chiseegi chiaito.”

English: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,' behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama yeye atasema, ‘Mimi sipendezwi nawe,' basi mimi niko tayari; yeye na anifanye chochote aonacho chema kwake.”
Ekegusii: Korende karanteebie ng'a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya ase are.”

English: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Ramothi na Anemu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: na Ramoti, na Anemu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in the evening, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or if both will equally prosper. Enjoy Your Years
Kiswahili: Panda mbegu yako asubuhi, nako jioni usiruhusu mikono yako ilegee, kwa maana hujui ni ipi itakayofanikiwa, kwamba ni hii au ni ile, au kwamba zote zitafanikiwa sawasawa. Mkumbuke Muumba Wako Ukiwa Bado Kijana
Ekegusii: Busura embusuro yao mambia, nonya mogoroba totiga koyebusura, ekiagera tomanyeti eye erame, neye gose neria, gose nchionsi amo chirame buya.

English: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous, and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked.
Kiswahili: Mwenye haki huwachukia sana wasio waaminifu; waovu huwachukia sana wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari omooronge nigo are okogechia ase oyore omooronge, na oyore n’enkoro endonge nigo are okogechia ase omokori amabe.

English: “‘As I live,' says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, atafia huko Babeli, katika nchi ya mfalme aliyemketisha katika kiti cha enzi, ambaye alidharau kiapo chake na kuvunja mapatano yake.
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, omorwoti oyio ochaayire eira yaye atianete ase omorwoti o Babiloni, oria omobegete akaba omorwoti, na osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw'ogotianania, oyio goika akwere aaria Babiloni.

English: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh's song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hezekia akatoa amri ya kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa madhabahuni. Walipoanza kutoa sadaka, wakaanza pia kumwimbia Bwana pamoja na tarumbeta na zile ala za uimbaji za Daudi mfalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Hezekia agachiika ng'a ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa keruegwe ase egesasiimero. Ekero ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa giachaagete koruegwa, abanto bagachaaka goterera Omonene; na ababugia ebitureeri bakabibugia bakoraagwa n'ebinto bi'okobugigwa bia Daudi, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli.

English: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
Kiswahili: Kama tukimwacha aendelee hivi, kila mtu atamwamini, nao Warumi watakuja na kupaharibu mahali petu patakatifu na taifa letu.”
Ekegusii: Toise komotiga iga, abanto bonsi mbamwegene; na Abarumi mbache, batoure Aase aito Aachenu na egesaku giaito.”

English: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, baraza la wazee wa watu, yaani viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, wakakutana pamoja, naye Yesu akaletwa mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b’abaanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakoboora,

English: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.
Kiswahili: Macho yake ni kama ya hua kandokando ya vijito vya maji, aliyeogeshwa kwenye maziwa, yaliyopangwa kama vito vya thamani.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aye nigo agwekaine amaruma are ase chindooche, ee, nigo anga amaruma asibigwe namabeere, naende nigo anga amagena akomeka‐meka achokire buya.

English: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Imeri 1,052
Ekegusii: aba orwa Imeri: elifu eyemo, na emerongo etano, na babere (1,052).

English: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
Kiswahili: Wanaenda kasi kuingia mjini; wanakimbia ukutani. Wanaingia ndani ya nyumba; kwa kuingilia madirishani kama wevi.
Ekegusii: Nigo chikorindokera omochie, na kominyoka ase chindwaki igoro; nigo chikoriina ase chinyomba chisoa ime na chietera ase chitirisa buna abaibi.

English: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
Kiswahili: “Je, wajua ni wakati gani mbuzi wa mlimani wanapozaa? Je, watambua ni wakati gani kulungu jike azaapo mtoto wake?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nomanyete chingaki ekero chimbori chi'orosana chikobiara? Gose ekero chinsune chikobiara?

English: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu! Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa.” Kuanzishwa Kwa Meza Ya Bwana (Mathayo 26:26-30; Luka 22:14-20; 1 Wakorintho 11:23-25)
Ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna ariikeretwe korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria orure Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto. Nanga mbuya ase are omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.” Emesa y’Omonene

English: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
Kiswahili: Kapu lako na chombo chako cha kukandia kitalaaniwa.
Ekegusii: “Neragererigwe endagera y'ebitonga biaino amo n'ebituba biaino mogoseera obosie.

English: A diseased person must wear torn clothes and let his hair hang loose, and he must cover his mouth and cry out, ‘Unclean, unclean!’
Kiswahili: “Mtu mwenye ugonjwa kama huo wa kuambukiza ni lazima avae nguo zilizoraruka, awachilie nywele zake bila kuzichana, afunike sehemu ya chini ya uso wake, na apige kelele, ‘Najisi! Najisi!’
Ekegusii: “Omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma abeeke chianga amachanchabe, tabaisa gochanua etukia yaye, atube omonwa oye ase egekoba kia igoro, erio aake eriogi na gokuura: Inche tinchenegeti! Tinchenegeti!

English: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
Kiswahili: Fanya kila uwezalo uwasafirishe Zena yule mwanasheria na Apolo na uhakikishe kwamba wana kila kitu wanachohitaji katika safari yao.
Ekegusii: Kora omokia gokoonya Zena, omonogeri bw'amachiiko, na Apolo, ekero okobatoma ase orogeendo rw'abo, na origererie buya ng'a 'mbabwate kera ekemo keria baganetie.

English: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn't know it,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sikukuu kumalizika, wakati Yosefu na Maria mama yake walipokuwa wakirudi nyumbani, Yesu alibaki Yerusalemu lakini hawakutambua.
Ekegusii: Ekero Epasaka yaera, ekero barenge koirana, omwana Yeso agatigara magega agwo Yerusalemu, na abaibori baye tibamanya.

English: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
Kiswahili: Wabarikini wale wanaowalaani, waombeeni wale wanaowatendea mabaya.
Ekegusii: basesenie abwo bakobaragereria, basabere abwo bakobakorera bobe.

English: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba sheria ni ya kiroho, lakini mimi ni wa kimwili nikiwa nimeuzwa kwenye utumwa wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a amachiiko nay’Omoika, korende inche n’omonto bw’engencho y’ebibe; nigo naonetigwe inse ase obosomba bw’ebibe.

English: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, mwabuduni kwenye mlima wake mtakatifu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro! Inchuo mosasimere ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are omochenu.

English: She heard the evil words of the people against the governor, because they fainted for lack of water; and Judith heard all the words that Ozias spoke to them, how he swore to them that he would deliver the city to the Assyrians after five days.
Kiswahili: Alisikia maneno mabaya ya watu dhidi ya gavana, kwa sababu walizimia kwa kukosa maji; na Yudithi akasikia maneno yote ambayo Uzia aliwaambia, jinsi alivyowaapia kwamba angeukabidhi mji kwa Waashuri baada ya siku tano.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yuditi aigwete buna okobora kwa amaache karenterete abanto gochaandeka goika kwemurunganeria abaraai baabo naboigo buna Uzia abarierete eira ase okobaa amaache magega ya amatuko atano,

English: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
Kiswahili: Matawi sita yatatokeza kuanzia ule ufito wa katikati wa kinara cha taa: matawi matatu upande mmoja na matatu upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Chinsagia isano nemo chibe chigosoka korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

English: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo basi si ajabu, kama watumishi wa Shetani nao hujigeuza ili waonekane kama watumishi wa haki. Mwisho wao utakuwa sawa na matendo yao yanavyostahili.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio tari ring'ana rigeni ng'a abasomba baye nabarabwo bakweonchora bekora buna abasomba b'oboronge. Omoerio obo nobe koreng'ana nemeremo yabo.

English: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.
Kiswahili: maji hayo yaliyotiririka kutoka upande wa juu yaliacha kutiririka yakasimama kama chuguu mbali kabisa nao, kwenye mji ulioitwa Adamu kwenye eneo la Sarethani, wakati yale maji yaliyokuwa yanatiririka kuingia kwenye Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), yalitindika kabisa. Hivyo watu wakavuka kukabili Yeriko.
Ekegusii: erio amaache ayare gotirimboka korwa rogoro agatenena buna orwaki aare mono, agwo Adamu, omochie orenge ang'e na Saretani. Amache arenge gotirimboka gochia enyancha ya Araba nero enyancha y'omonyoo, akanacheka pi. Erio abanto bakaamboka kororia omochie o Yeriko.

English: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.
Kiswahili: Barua zilipelekwa na tarishi katika majimbo yote ya mfalme zikiwa na amri ya kuharibu, kuua na kuangamiza Wayahudi wote, wadogo kwa wakubwa, wanawake na watoto wadogo, siku moja, yaani siku ya kumi na tatu ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, ndio mwezi wa Adari, na pia kuteka nyara vitu vyao.
Ekegusii: Amarube aria akaegwa abanto abaango bakayaminyokia gochia ase chingongo chionsi chiare ase oborwoti boria. Nigo arenge goteeba ng'a ase rituko erimo rioka, rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri'omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro Adari, Abayahudi bonsi, abanto abake na abagotu, abakungu na abana, baitwe tibarorerwa mabeera basirigwe pi, na ebinto biabo bisakorwe.

English: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni mpitaji na mgeni miongoni mwenu. Niuzieni sehemu ya ardhi yenu ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”
Ekegusii: “Inche nomomenyi inde, imenyete ase egati yaino; komoranche mong'e aase ntindeke omokungu one onkwereire, imorusie ase obosio bwane.”

English: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
Kiswahili: Naye akaapa kwa Yule aishiye milele na milele, aliyeumba mbingu na vyote vilivyomo, dunia na vyote viijazavyo, pamoja na bahari na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, akasema, “Hakuna kungoja tena!
Ekegusii: agatiana asere oyore moyo goika kare na kare, oyotongete igoro na ebinto bireo, na ense na ebinto bireo, na enyancha na ebinto bireo, agateeba, “Engaki ende tekoba magega ase aya,

English: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.'
Kiswahili: Nikasema, ‘Nimefukuziwa mbali na uso wako, hata hivyo nitatazama tena kuelekea Hekalu lako takatifu.'
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nkarengereria ng'a natugutirwe korwa ase obosio bwao, naende ng'a tikonyara koyerora Hekalu yao Enchenu.

English: For a destroyer is coming against her— against Babylon. Her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken, for the LORD is a God of retribution; He will repay in full.
Kiswahili: Mharabu atakuja dhidi ya Babeli, mashujaa wake watakamatwa, nazo pinde zao zitavunjwa. Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu wa kisasi, yeye atalipiza kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Abagosiria bachire gosiria Babiloni; abarwani baye chituoni bairirwe, amata abo abunirwe. Inche Omonene nigo inde Nyasae bw’ogoakana egesiomba, ekeene goika ngeakane kegima.

English: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Farao akawaita Mose na Aroni na kuwaambia, “Ondokeni! Tokeni kwa watu wangu, ninyi pamoja na Waisraeli! Nendeni mkamwabudu Bwana kama mlivyoomba.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni obotuko boria, akabateebia, “Imoka, morue aa ase abanto baane, inwe na Abaisraeli bonsi! Genda mokorere Omonene buna mwabeire mokoboria!

English: For even they who receive circumcision don't keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
Kiswahili: Hata wale waliotahiriwa wenyewe hawaitii sheria, lakini wanataka ninyi mtahiriwe ili wapate kujivuna kwa habari ya miili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya mbarabwo abanyene abaarogete tibabwateti amachiiko, korende mbarigetie inwe mwarokigwe, erinde banyare gwetogeria emebere yaino.

English: “Therefore, behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
Kiswahili: “Lakini siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “nitakapoadhibu sanamu zake, na katika nchi yake yote waliojeruhiwa watalia kwa maumivu makali.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Ase engencho eyio, rora, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndanachere emegwekano egosasimwa ya Babiloni ekiina na abanto bonsi baakirwe chingoma nababe bakonakweumia ase ense eyio yonsi.

English: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children—
Kiswahili: Kisha Abrahamu akamwomba Mungu, naye Mungu akamponya Abimeleki, mke wake, na watumwa wake wa kike kwamba waweze kupata watoto tena,
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agasaba Nyasae; na Nyasae akagwenia Abimeleki amo na mokaye, na abasomba baye abakungu, na barabwo bakaibora abana.

English: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa viumbe vyote viliwekwa chini ya ubatili, si kwa chaguo lao, bali kwa mapenzi yake yeye aliyevitiisha katika tumaini,
Ekegusii: Inaki ebitongwa bionsi nigo biabegetwe inse y'engencho ya bosa, tari ase ogwancha kwabo, korende ase ogwancha kwaye ere oyobibegete ase ogosemeria,

English: Reward those who wait for you, and men will put their trust in your prophets.
Kiswahili: Uwape thawabu wale wanaokungoja, na watu watawaamini manabii wako.
Ekegusii: Obae ebiegwa biao kwaroberetie korwa omochakano na tiga ababani bao baegwe amasikani.

English: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don't say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo mtaomba kwa Jina langu. Wala sitawaambia kwamba nitamwomba Baba kwa ajili yenu,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namosabe ase erieta riane; tinkobateebia ng'a nimbasabere ase Tata,

English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
Kiswahili: Mara moja Yesu akatambua rohoni mwake kile walichokuwa wanawaza mioyoni mwao, naye akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso namanyete ase omoika oye ime buna baare korengereria ase chinkoro chiabo, akabateebia, “Inaki mokorengereria iga ase chinkoro chiaino?

English: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Itupe chini.” Mose akaitupa chini hiyo fimbo nayo ikawa nyoka, naye akaikimbia.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Yerute inse!” Na ekero Musa ayeruta inse, ekaonchoka ekaba eng'iti, na Musa agatama korwa asere.

English: He said to them, “Don't hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mtumishi akawaambia, “Msinicheleweshe, kwa kuwa Bwana amefanikisha safari yangu, nipeni ruhusa nirudi kwa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Tiga torangerie omoiseke, tomoboorie, toigwe buna agoteeba.”

English: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Atamkabidhi huyo fahali kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana. Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali na kumchinja mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Arente eeri eria ase obosio bwane agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano. Erio goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw'eeri eria, na ayenyeenyere agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: and declared: “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, for wisdom and power belong to Him.
Kiswahili: na akasema: “Lihimidiwe jina la Mungu milele na milele; hekima na uweza ni vyake.
Ekegusii: “Erieta ria Nyasae ritogigwe goika kare na kare! Obong’aini na okobua nebiaye.

English: because his only daughter, who was about twelve, was dying. As Jesus went with him, the crowds pressed around Him,
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa binti yake wa pekee, mwenye umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, alikuwa anakufa. Yesu alipokuwa akienda, umati wa watu ukamsonga sana.
Ekegusii: ekiagera narenge nomoiseke, omwana omomoima, konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere, na ere nigo arenge ang’e ogokwa. Ekero Yeso arenge kogenda abanto bakaba bakomomiga‐miga.

English: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisi tulio hai siku zote tumetolewa tufe kwa ajili ya Yesu, ili kwamba uzima wake upate kudhihirishwa katika mwili wetu upatikanao na mauti.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe ekero tore moyo, amatuko onsi nigo tokoruegwa tokwe ase engencho ya Yeso, erinde obogima bwa Yeso boorokigwe ase emebere yaito eyekonyorwa namakweri.

English: For a holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and will depart from thoughts that are without understanding, and will be ashamed when unrighteousness has come in.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana roho takatifu ya nidhamu itakimbia udanganyifu, na itaacha mawazo yasiyo na ufahamu, na kuaibika wakati uovu unapoingia.
Ekegusii: Oyore omochenu nigo agwetanga korwa ase obongainereria. Omonto oyio nigo akwerusanania korwa ase ebirengererio bi'oboriri, na nigo akoba n'obwoba ekero ekeene getari gwanchwa.

English: So he cried out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. For I am in agony in this fire.’
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule tajiri akamwita, ‘Baba Abrahamu, nihurumie na umtume Lazaro achovye ncha ya kidole chake ndani ya maji aupoze ulimi wangu, kwa sababu nina maumivu makuu kwenye moto huu.’
Ekegusii: Akarera, akabora: Tata Aburaamu, indorera amaabera, toma Lazaro atobeke ekiara kiaye mesia ase amaache, akendie oromeme rwane, ekiagera nachandekire ase omorero oyo.

English: “King Demetrius to his brother Jonathan, and to the nation of the Jews, greetings.
Kiswahili: "Mfalme Demetrio kwa ndugu yake Yonathani, na kwa taifa la Wayahudi, salamu."
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Demeturio, ase omomura omwabo Yonathani na momura omwabo amo na abanto bonsi be egesaku kia Abayahudi: Amaiga ayio!

English: I will lead them as captives to the utmost parts of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Nitawapeleka kama mateka hadi sehemu za mwisho za dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Nimbaimokie abasakore baabo na kobang'anyia gochia ase chinsinyo chi'ense.

English: So Joab sent to Tekoa to bring a wise woman from there. He told her, “Please pretend to be a mourner; put on clothes for mourning and do not anoint yourself with oil. Act like a woman who has mourned for the dead a long time.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yoabu akamtuma mtu fulani kwenda Tekoa na kumleta mwanamke mwenye hekima kutoka huko. Akamwambia huyo mwanamke, “Jifanye uko katika maombolezo. Vaa nguo za kuomboleza, nawe usitumie mafuta yoyote ya uzuri, jifanye kama mwanamke ambaye amekuwa na huzuni kwa siku nyingi kwa ajili ya kufiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo agatoma abanto bageende Tekoa kwoyia omokungu gete omong’aini korwao. Ekero achiire Yoabu akamoteebia, “Aye bwekore ng’a nigo okwereire; obeeke chianga chi’ogokwerwa, tibweaka amaguta, bwekore buna omokungu obeire okweumia amatuko amaange ekiagera akwereirwe.

English: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna mungu yeyote amepata kujaribu mwenyewe kuchukua taifa moja kutoka taifa lingine, kwa mapigo, kwa ishara za miujiza na maajabu, kwa vita, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na mkono ulionyooshwa au kwa matendo makuu ya kutisha, kama yale ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu aliyofanya kwa ajili yenu huko Misri mbele ya macho yenu?
Ekegusii: Gose enyasae ende kero kende gionsi yana korenta egesaku kende korwa ase egati y'ebisaku binde, erinde agekore kebe abanto baye omonyene, buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abakorerete inwe agwo Misiri? Ase amaiso aino nigo arentete amateemwa, na ebikone, na amakumia, na esegi, na ase okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire akarenta okoondokia okonene.

English: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.
Kiswahili: Unawapenda wale wanaokuchukia, na unawachukia wale wanaokupenda. Leo umeonyesha wazi kwamba majemadari wako na watu wao hawana maana kwako. Naona kwamba ungefurahi kama Absalomu angekuwa hai leo na sisi sote tuwe tumekufa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete abwo bakogeechete na kogeecha abwo bagwanchete. Inaki reero kworokirie maiso marore ng'a abatang'ani na abasomba bao barabwo 'mbosa bare ase ore. Reero nario namanya ng'a onye Abisalomu moyo areenge, na intwe twensi tobe twakuure, erio nanga nigo kwaigwa buya.

English: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
Kiswahili: Kama baba alivyo na huruma kwa watoto wake, ndivyo Bwana anavyowahurumia wale wanaomcha;
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namaabera ase bare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namaabera ase abwo bamoirogete.

English: One day, Nyame decided that he would give the pot of wisdom to Anansi. Every time Anansi looked in the clay pot, he learned something new. It was so exciting!
Kiswahili: Siku moja, Nyame aliamua kumpa Anansi chungu hicho cha hekima. Kila Anansi alipotazama ndani ya chungu cha udongo, alijifunza jambo jipya. Alifurahi sana!
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo, Nyame akaamua koenana enyongo eria y'obong'aini gosia ase Anansi. Kera engaki Anansi arigereretie enyongo eria, nigo arenge kweegeria egento ekeyia. Nero nigo yare komorentera omogoko omonge.

English: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
Kiswahili: Makuhani waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa 1,760. Walikuwa watu wenye uwezo, waliowajibika kuhudumu katika nyumba ya Mungu. Jamaa Za Walawi
Ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge abamwabo, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (1,760). Bonsi nigo barenge abamanyi ase ogokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Abalawi abamenyete Yerusalemu

English: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but they died in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Eri na Onani walikuwa wana wa Yuda, lakini walifia huko Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Basinto ba Yuda, Eri na Onani, bagakwera agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
Kiswahili: Hata kama sikuwa na hatia, kinywa changu kingenihukumu; kama sikuwa na kosa, kingenitangaza kuwa mwenye hatia.
Ekegusii: Nonya nare koba omonyaboronge, amang'ana ngokwana nigo are kongambia; nonya nare koba ng'a tindi na komocha, aya nigo are kombera kirori ng'a nomokori amabe inde.

English: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;
Kiswahili: Ndipo lilipotolewa tangazo Yuda yote na Yerusalemu kwa watu wote waliokuwa uhamishoni kukusanyika Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio amang'ana akararigwa ase ense yonsi y'Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu, ng'a abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba basangererekane agwo Yerusalemu.

English: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don't belong to the night, nor to darkness,
Kiswahili: Ninyi nyote ni wana wa nuru na wana wa mchana. Sisi si wana wa giza wala wa usiku.
Ekegusii: ekiagera inwe mwensi nabana b'oborabu, na abana b'omobaso. Intwe titori abobotuko, gose ab'omosunte.

English: All the people consented to ordain for Simon that he should do according to these words.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakakubali kumwagiza Simoni afanye kama alivyosema.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagaitabera amang'ana ayio ase ogwancherana ase obomo, bagaitaba komoa Simioni oboronge bwogoikerania amang'ana ayio kobwatekana nogwancherana okwo.

English: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wayahudi ambao hawakuwa wameamini wakawa na wivu, wakawakodi watu waovu kutoka sokoni, wakakutanisha umati wa watu, wakaanzisha ghasia mjini. Wakaenda mbio nyumbani kwa Yasoni wakiwatafuta Paulo na Sila ili kuwaleta nje penye ule umati wa watu.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi bakaba ne ribero, bakaira abanto ababe korwa ase abaomboganu, bagasangereria omoganda, na bagakora eburu‐buru ase omochie. Bagachiera abanto b'enyomba ya Yasoni, bakarigia koira Paulo na Sila isiko ase abanto.

English: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
Kiswahili: na kuwapa ninyi mnaoteseka raha pamoja na sisi, wakati Bwana Yesu atakapodhihirishwa kutoka mbinguni katika mwali wa moto pamoja na malaika wake wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: na kobaa inwe abamwachandirwe ogotimokigwa amo naintwe. Aya nigo arakoreke ekero Omonene Yeso agocha koorokigwa korwa igoro amo nabamalaika n'okobua kwaye ase ekebemberi ki'omorero,

English: Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari. The Gershonites (Numbers 3:21–26; Numbers 4:21–28)
Kiswahili: Daudi akawagawa Walawi katika makundi kufuatana na wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari. Wagershoni
Ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana Abalawi ase ebiombe kobwatekana nabamura ba Lawi: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.

English: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akainuka akaenda nao, naye alipowasili, wakampeleka hadi kwenye chumba cha ghorofani alipokuwa amelazwa. Wajane wengi walisimama karibu naye wakilia na kuonyesha majoho na nguo nyingine ambazo Dorkasi alikuwa amewashonea alipokuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang'e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.

English: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo miji mitano ya Misri, itazungumza lugha ya Kanaani, na kuapa kumtii Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. Mji mmojawapo utaitwa Mji wa Uharibifu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto b’emechie etano y’ense ya Misiri mbabe bagokwana omonwa bw’Abakanaani, naende babe bakobwatana n’Omonene bw’Emeganda na gotiana ase erieta riaye. Oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo orarokwe Omochie bw’Erioba.

English: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord's house?
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo tulikurudishia zile fedha kutoka nchi ya Kanaani ambazo tulizikuta kwenye midomo ya magunia yetu. Hivyo kwa nini tuibe fedha au dhahabu kutoka nyumbani kwa bwana wako?
Ekegusii: Tari bo, intwe abasomba bao titware gokora bo. Inee! Chibesa chiria twanyorete igoro y'endagera ase chigunia chiaito ime, titwagochiiraneria naende korwa ase ense ya Kaanani? Naki tware gokora toibe efeta gose etaabu korwa ase enyomba y'omonene oo?

English: After many days, he came to a village. He went to one of the houses and said to the owner, I have chased an antelope for a long time and I am very tired. I want to rest. The man said, Sit down and rest. Would you like some beer? Opio was very thirsty so he drank some. Then he went to sleep.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nyingi alijipata katika kijiji kingine. Akaingia kwa nyumba moja akamwambia mwenye nyumba, “Nimekuwa nikimfukuza paa kwa muda mrefu na sasa nimechoka. Nahitaji kupumzika.” Mwenye nyumba akamwambia, “Ebu keti upumzike. Je, ungependa pombe kidogo?” Kwa vile Opio alikuwa na kiu alikunywa pombe kidogo kisha akalala.
Ekegusii: Opio agachibwatia. Akaminyoka chinsa chinyinge. Kera engaki aigwete orosire, nigo arenge gotimoka. Erio naende ominyoka. Chisese chiria chikamosireria. Amatuko amange agaeta, agaika ekenyoro ase abanto baikaransete isiko yechinyomba chaibo. Akagenda ase enyomba eyemo nakoboria omonyene, ‘Nigo narenge koinda engabi egekaegetambe mbaka narosire. Enagania gotimoka ake.” Omonyene enyomba egateba, “Ikaransa nse igaa. Naki nonywea amaru?” Opio nigo arang'ete sana igo akanywa make. Koruoo akagenda korara.

English: And when the three hundred rams’ horns sounded, the LORD set all the men in the camp against one another with their swords. The army fled to Beth-shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.
Kiswahili: Walipozipiga zile tarumbeta 300, Bwana akafanya watu katika kambi yote kugeuziana upanga kila mmoja na mwenziwe. Jeshi likakimbia mpaka Beth-Shita kuelekea Serera hadi mpakani mwa Abel-Mehola karibu na Tabathi.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto ba Gidioni babugetie ebitureeri biria amagana atato, Omonene akaondokia Abamidiani, kera oyomo akaonchokera goita oy’omwabo n’omoro ase egetwori keria ekegima, na abarwani bonsi bagatama gochia ensemo ya Serera goikera Beti‐Hasita, na goikera Abeli‐Mehola, ang’e na Tabati.

English: In each of the provinces of King Xerxes, the Jews assembled in their cities to attack those who sought to harm them. No man could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen upon all peoples.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi walikusanyika katika miji yao, katika majimbo ya Mfalme Ahasuero kuwashambulia wale waliokuwa wanatafuta kuwaangamiza. Hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kushindana nao, kwa sababu watu wa mataifa mengine yote waliwaogopa.
Ekegusii: Bono Abayahudi bagasangererekana amo ase emechie yabo yonsi, na ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bw’omorwoti Ahaswero, erinde baite abanto baria barigetie kobasiria. Monto onde tarenge onyarete kobatanga, ekiagera obwoba ase engencho y’abwo konya bwasoire ase abanto bonsi.

English: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Hakika nimeona mateso ya watu wangu katika Misri. Nimesikia kilio chao kwa sababu ya wasimamizi wao, nami naguswa na mateso yao.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabora, “Amaene narorire emechando yabaanto baane abwo bakare Misiri; naigure buna bakweumia inse yamaboko y’Abamisiri abwo bakobachanda, na inche namanyire kegima obororo bwabo.

English: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”
Kiswahili: Solomoni akajibu, “Kama akijionyesha kuwa mtu mstahiki, hakuna unywele wake utakaoanguka juu ya ardhi, lakini kama uovu ukionekana ndani yake, atakufa.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agateeba: “Karanyorekane ore omonto bw'ekeene, nonya nagatukia akamo k'omotwe oye tigakogwa inse; korende obobe koboranyorekane asare, goika akwe.”

English: They said, “We can't, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”
Kiswahili: Walijibu, “Haiwezekani, mpaka kondoo wote wakusanyike na jiwe liwe limevingirishwa kutoka mdomo wa kisima. Ndipo tutanywesha kondoo.”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Titokonyara gokora bo goika ekero amaicho onsi arache asangererekane amo, erinde abarisia bamanye gotigeria rigena korwa ase omonwa bw'ensoko; erio tomanye konyoinsia ching'ondi.”

English: Relatives and helpers are for a time of affliction, but almsgiving rescues better than both.
Kiswahili: Jamaa na wasaidizi ni kwa ajili ya wakati wa mateso, lakini kutoa sadaka huokoa zaidi kuliko vyote viwili.
Ekegusii: Okoba na abamino na gokonyana ase chingaki chi'obokong'u negento ekiya, korende ogokonya abataka nigo kore okuya kobua.

English: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwema na mwenye kusamehe, umejaa upendo kwa wote wakuitao.
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore omuya na oyo okwabera; nigo okoorokia obwanchani obonge ase abagokorangeria obakonye.

English: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
Kiswahili: Katika fahari yeye ni kama fahali mzaliwa wa kwanza; pembe zake ni pembe za nyati, na kwa pembe hizo atapiga mataifa, hata yaliyo miisho ya dunia. Hivyo ndivyo yalivyo makumi elfu ya Efraimu; hivyo ndivyo yalivyo maelfu ya Manase.”
Ekegusii: Omotangi oye nigo are n'obonene bw'echinguru buna chieeri, ne ching'unchara chiaye nigo chire buna echi'eng'era, ase chirochio naseerie abanto goikera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi'ense. Echio nachio chilifu ikomi chi'Abaefraimu, naende echio nachio chilifu chinyinge chi'Abamanase.”

English: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
Kiswahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote na mnaweza kuwasaidia wakati wowote mnaotaka. Lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
Ekegusii: Inaki amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, na kero kende gionsi mwanchete, namonyare kobakorera amaya, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.

English: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn't felt your endless cruelty?
Kiswahili: Hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuponya jeraha lako; jeraha lako ni la kukuua. Kila anayesikia habari zako, hupiga makofi kwa kuanguka kwako, kwa kuwa ni nani ambaye hajaguswa na ukatili wako usio na mwisho?
Ekegusii: Riogo tiriyo gose, amaote ao takonyara kobwena. Bonsi abakoigwa amang'ana ao y'ogosarigwa nigo bagwaka chinkobi n'omogoko. Nareo onde bwensi otambogete obotindi bwao botakoera?

English: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kora walikuwa Asiri, Elikana na Abiasafu. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Kora.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.

English: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo kinywa chake kikafunguliwa na ulimi wake ukaachiwa, akawa anaongea akimsifu Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agasiborwa omonwa na oromeme rwaye, agakwana, ogotogia Nyasae.

English: In that day the lovely young women— the young men as well— will faint from thirst.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile “wasichana wazuri na vijana wanaume wenye nguvu watazimia kwa sababu ya kiu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni na abamura mbagoy’ane ase okoba nerang’o.

English: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Watu wenu watachinjwa katikati yenu, nanyi mtatambua Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto baraitwe mbagwe ase egati yaino, na inwe monyare komanya ng'a inche ninche Omonene.

English: Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.
Kiswahili: Wawili wa kila aina ya ndege, wa kila aina ya mnyama na wa kila aina ya kitambaacho ardhini watakuja kwako ili wahifadhiwe hai.
Ekegusii: Ase kera egesaku gie chinyoni, ne ching’iti chionsi, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, ochirente ibere ibere amo naye, erinde chibe moyo.

English: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
Kiswahili: Isaya alisema haya alipoona utukufu wa Yesu na kunena habari zake.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ayio Isaya nigo ayakwanete, ekiagera aroche obonene bwaye; agaatora amang'ana aye.

English: “Son of man, take note that the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many years from now; he prophesies about the distant future.’
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, nyumba ya Israeli inasema, ‘Maono yale anayoyaona ni kwa ajili ya miaka mingi ijayo, naye hutabiri kuhusu siku zijazo zilizo mbali.’
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Abaisraeli nigo bagoteeba iga: Okorora koria ere arorire nokw’amatuko atabe bwango; nigo akobana igoro ye chingaki chikare aare chitaracha.

English: Now as they went on their journey, they came at evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari yao, walifika jioni kwenye mto Tigri, wakalala huko.
Ekegusii: Bono Anna agatiga korera, erio Tobia akaimoka amo n'esese yaye n'omomalaika oria erio bagachaaka orogendo. Emorogoba eria y'erituko ritang'ani bagaika engegu y'oroche rwa Tigri.

English: choosing rather to die nobly than to fall into the hands of the wicked wretches, and suffer outrage unworthy of his own nobleness.
Kiswahili: akichagua kufa kwa uungwana kuliko kuanguka mikononi mwa wanyonge waovu, na kupata hasira isiyostahili utukufu wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: akarora nga mbuya akwe n'amasikani ribaga ri'okobwatwa n'abanyabibe na koorokigwa ogochaaya okwo ataganeirie.

English: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—
Kiswahili: ‘Kwa kuwa hawakunifuata kwa moyo wote, hakuna mtu yeyote mwenye miaka ishirini au zaidi ambaye alikuja kutoka Misri atakayeona nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo;
Ekegusii: Ekeene ase abanto bonsi baruete Misiri, aba bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, onde tari, nonya noyomo oranyare korora ense eria narierete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a nimbae, ekiagera abanto aba bangire koba abegenwa asende.

English: Then they brought out the king's son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”
Kiswahili: Yehoyada na wanawe wakamtoa Yoashi mwana wa mfalme nje na kumvika taji. Wakampa nakala ya agano na kumtangaza kuwa mfalme. Wakamtia mafuta na kupaza sauti, wakisema, “Mfalme aishi maisha marefu!”
Ekegusii: Erio akarenta omwana oria bw'omorwoti isiko, akamobekera egutwa ase omotwe oye, naende akamoa Egetabu ki'Oborori. Yoashi akararigwa koba omorwoti, na Yehoyada na abamura baye bakamoaka amaguta, bagateeba, “Omorwoti ochie kare!”

English: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ajibuye kabla ya kusikiliza, huo ni upumbavu wake na aibu yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria ring'ana atarariigwa buya, obwo noboriri ase are, na nigo akonyora obosooku.

English: O land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
Kiswahili: Ee nchi, nchi, nchi, sikia neno la Bwana!
Ekegusii: Aye ense, ense, ense! Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!

English: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule aonaye hekima, mtu yule apataye ufahamu,
Ekegusii: Nare n'omogooko omonto oyio onyorire obong'aini naende ore n'okomanya.

English: It is he who sends forth the light, and it goes. He called it, and it obeyed him with fear.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye anayetuma nuru, nayo inaondoka. Aliiita, nayo ikamtii kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Ching'enang'eni nigo chikobara ase abo ase omogoko, ere nigo agochirangeria na chirochio chiaitaba, “Noo tore aa”. Nigo chikobara ase omogoko gochia ase oria ochitongete.

English: Even so, I myself didn't burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
Kiswahili: Iwe iwavyo, kwa vyovyote vile mimi sikuwalemea. Lakini kwa mimi kuwa mwerevu naliwapata.
Ekegusii: Korende abe bo, inche timbaraarereti, korende ekiagera inde omong'aini nkabanyora ase obong'ainereria.

English: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
Kiswahili: Baba yangu ananipenda kwa kuwa ninautoa uhai wangu ili niupate tena.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera narure obogima bwane, erinde inyare koboirania naende.

English: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
Kiswahili: Watoto wa watumishi wako wataishi mbele zako; wazao wao wataimarishwa mbele zako.”
Ekegusii: Abana b’abasomba bao mbamenye ase oborendi obuya, ne chinderia chiabo chigenderere komenya ase obosio bwao.

English: Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not have washed in them and been cleansed?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
Kiswahili: Je, Abana na Farpari, mito ya Dameski, si bora zaidi kuliko mito yoyote ya Israeli? Je, nisingeweza kuoga ndani ya hiyo mito na kutakasika?” Basi akageuka na kuondoka kwa hasira kuu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Chindooche chia Damesiki, Abana na Faripari, tichiri chingiya kobua chindooche chi’ense y’Abaisraeli? Inee! Tinarenge gwesibia ase chirochio ncheneke?” Bono akaonchoka akagenda ore nokogechigwa.

English: For Aram, along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has plotted your ruin, saying:
Kiswahili: Aramu, Efraimu na mwana wa Remalia wamepanga shauri baya ili wakuangamize, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Abasiiria amo n’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia, bakorire emeroberio emebe igoro yao bagoteeba:

English: And indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;
Kiswahili: Wahurumieni walio na mashaka;
Ekegusii: Mobarorere amaabera abwo bagotiting’ara.

English: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
Kiswahili: Hakika siku zinakujia, ambazo adui zako watakuzingira, nao watakuzunguka pande zote na kukuzuilia ndani.
Ekegusii: Naki amatuko nagochere, ababisa bao barakoagachere orwaki bagoetanane, bagotangerane ase chinsemo chionsi,

English: The tempest comes from its chamber, and the cold from the driving north winds.
Kiswahili: Dhoruba hutoka katika chumba chake, baridi hutoka katika upepo uendao kasi.
Ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nigo kegosoka korwa ase chiero chiaye agwo Irianyi, na omwaga ore nobokendu orua sugusu oseria amare.

English: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.
Kiswahili: Samweli akamjibu Sauli, “Mimi ndiye mwonaji, panda utangulie mbele yangu mpaka mahali pa juu, kwa kuwa leo itakupasa kula pamoja nami na asubuhi nitakuruhusu uende na nitakuambia yale yote yaliyo moyoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Samweli akamoiraneria: “Ninche omoorori oyio. Genda motang'ane gochia aase agwo ebing'wanso bikoruerwa, ekiagera reero namorie endagera aroro amo nainche. Ankio ninkoe ribaga ogende, na inche ngotebie amang'ana onsi are ase ebirengererio biao.

English: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.
Kiswahili: theluthi nyingine Lango la Suri, na theluthi nyingine lango lililo nyuma ya walinzi, ambao hupeana zamu kulinda Hekalu,
Ekegusii: na ensemo ende ya isato barende ase Egeita gia Suri, na ensemo ende ya isato barende ase egeita magega y'abarendi. Naboigo mobe mokorenda ase enyomba y'omorwoti.

English: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
Kiswahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu atakayesikiliza hili, au atakayezingatia kwa makini katika wakati ujao?
Ekegusii: Ning'o ase more oranyare gotegerera amang'ana aya, erio ayarengererie na koyaigwera ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.

English: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
Kiswahili: Bwana, unaamuru amani kwa ajili yetu, yale yote tuliyoweza kuyakamilisha ni wewe uliyetenda kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, notorentere omorembe, ekiagera emeremo twabeire togokora, naye kwabeire gokoyetokorera.

English: When a woman has a discharge consisting of blood from her body, she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanamke atatokwa na damu ya kawaida ya mwezi, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba, na yeyote atakayemgusa atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: “Ekero omokungu are nomotienyi nigo arabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Onde bwensi oramokune nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
Kiswahili: Kisha mmojawapo wa wale kumi na wawili, aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, alikwenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudasi Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,

English: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again. ”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Tengeneza visu vya mawe magumu sana na uwatahiri Waisraeli tena.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Roisia emeyio emioge y’amagena ochake kwarokia Abaisraeli naende.”

English: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe huwaonyesha wafu maajabu yako? Je, wale waliokufa huinuka na kukusifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abakuure nkobakorera ore amakumia? Inee! Abwo nkoimoka bare na kogotogia?

English: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”
Kiswahili: Wakati walikuwa wakiwaua watu, nami nilikuwa nimeachwa peke yangu, nikaanguka kifudifudi, nikapiga kelele nikisema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi! Je, utaangamiza mabaki yote ya Israeli, katika kumwagwa huku kwa ghadhabu yako juu ya Yerusalemu?”
Ekegusii: Ekero abwo bagendererete goita abanto, ngatigara inche bweka. Erio ngatung'ama inse nkaumama, nkarera ase Omonene, nkamoboria, “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo ogochia gosiria Abaisraeli bonsi abwo batigaire ase okoumora endamwamu yao ase Yerusalemu?”

English: A man who is a sinner will trouble friends and sow discord among those who are at peace.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye dhambi atawasumbua marafiki na kupanda mbegu za ugomvi miongoni mwa wale walio na amani.
Ekegusii: Omonyabibe nigo agosaria obosani gati y'abanto na kobeekera obobisa ase bare

English: “Come to me, all you who desire me, and be filled with my fruits.
Kiswahili: "Njooni kwangu, nyote mnaonitamani, mjazwe na matunda yangu."
Ekegusii: Inchwo asende mwensi abwo morang'ete morie na koigota amatunda aane.

English: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn't turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh's eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
Kiswahili: Katika kila jambo alitembea katika njia za Asa baba yake wala hakwenda kinyume chake. Alifanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana. Hata hivyo mahali pa juu pa kuabudia hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa kafara na kufukiza uvumba huko.
Ekegusii: Yehosafati akabwatia chinchera chionsi chi'Asa ise, taonchogete na gochitiga; agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene. Korende nonya naboigo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tatagoretwe, na abanto bakagenderera korua ebing'wanso na gosamba ubani aroro.

English: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,'
Kiswahili: Kama nikisema, ‘Nitayasahau malalamiko yangu, nitabadili sura ya uso wangu na kutabasamu,'
Ekegusii: Inse goteeba ng'a nyebe ogwechanda kwane, na ntige omoichano one inyeremie,

English: So Amnon lay down and feigned illness. When the king came to see him, Amnon said, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of cakes in my sight, so that I may eat from her hand.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Amnoni akalala kitandani kujifanya mgonjwa. Mfalme alipokuja kumwona, Amnoni akamwambia, “Ningependa dada yangu Tamari aje na kuniandalia mikate maalum mbele yangu, ili nipate kula toka mkononi mwake.”
Ekegusii: Agwo Amunoni akaraara, agekora buna nomorwaire are. Ekero omorwoti achete korora Amunoni, nere akamoteebia, “Koranche teebia Tamari ominto ache andoiserie emagaati ebere aa ase ndoche, indie korwa ase okoboko kwaye.”

English: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
Kiswahili: Basi Hagari anawakilisha Mlima Sinai ulioko Arabuni, na unafanana na Yerusalemu ya sasa ambayo iko utumwani pamoja na watoto wake.
Ekegusii: Naki Hagari, engencho yaye egetunwa Sinai ekere Arabia, kegwekanirie na Yerusalemu ya bono, ekiagera nigo are ase obosomba amo nabana baye.

English: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Wakanawa kila walipoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au walipoikaribia madhabahu kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasiimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
Kiswahili: Ule moshi wa uvumba pamoja na yale maombi ya watakatifu, vikapanda juu mbele za Mungu, kutoka mkononi mwa huyo malaika.
Ekegusii: Na erioki ria ubani rigachongororoka gochia igoro amo nogosaba kw’abachenu korwa ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: but don't seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don't pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
Kiswahili: msitafute Betheli, msiende Gilgali, msisafiri kwenda Beer-Sheba. Kwa maana kwa hakika Gilgali itakwenda uhamishoni, na Betheli itafanywa kuwa si kitu.”
Ekegusii: Korende timogenda Beteli, gose timosoa Giligali, gose timogenda goika Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera abanto ba Giligali mbairwe ase obosomba, na Beteli nosirigwe kegima.”

English: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana himizo letu halikutokana na hila wala nia mbaya au udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Naki ogosorora gwaito tikori ogw'okobasiria, gose ogw'okobabeka ase eubi, gose ogw'okobang'aina,

English: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. That is what Joshua did, leaving nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses. Joshua Takes the Whole Land
Kiswahili: Kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose mtumishi wake, vivyo hivyo Mose alimwagiza Yoshua, naye Yoshua akafanya kama vivyo, hakukosa kufanya lolote katika yale yote Bwana aliyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achigete Musa, omosomba oye, naboigo Musa achigete Yoshua. Na Yoshua agakora ayio onsi, tatigete kende gionsi ase ayio onsi Omonene achigete Musa. Yoshua okoira ense eria

English: They killed the phylarch of Timotheus's forces, a most unholy man, and one who had done the Jews much harm.
Kiswahili: Walimuua mtawala wa majeshi ya Timotheo, mtu asiye mtakatifu sana, na mtu aliyewatendea Wayahudi mabaya mengi.
Ekegusii: Bagaita omoteneneri omonene bw'abarwani esegi ba Timotheo oyio orenge omonto omobe mono oyio orenge gochanda Abayahudi.

English: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
Kiswahili: Baba zetu waliabudu kwenye mlima huu, lakini ninyi Wayahudi mnasema ni lazima tukaabudu huko Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiarenge gosasiima ase egetunwa eke, na inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Yerusalemu nao aase atogwenerete togosasiimera.”

English: and covenant with them, that they may walk after their own laws, as before; for because of their laws which we abolished they were angered, and did all these things.”
Kiswahili: na kufanya agano nao, ili wapate kufuata sheria zao wenyewe, kama hapo awali; kwa sababu ya sheria zao tulizoziondoa walikasirika, wakafanya mambo haya yote.
Ekegusii: Tobaakere buya ase ogotunyana amachiiko na amorokererio abo buna barenge gokora omochakano. Emechaando eye yonsi nigo yachaagete ekero intwe twabachegetie Abayahudi ase okorusia na gotuguta amachiiko, amenario abo.

English: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
Kiswahili: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”
Ekegusii: Renda, saba, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”

English: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
Kiswahili: naye Eliabu mwana wa Heloni alikuwa kiongozi wa kabila la Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: na Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku gia Sabuloni.

English: Anansi spun a long thread, and climbed up his sticky thread all the way to heaven. Can I have the stories, please? he asked the Sky God. But Nyame laughed at Anansi and said, Oh, these are very expensive stories. You wouldnt be able to pay for them, little spider.
Kiswahili: Anansi alisokota utando mrefu unaonata, akautumia kupanda hadi mbinguni. “Tafadhali nipe hadithi?” Anansi alimwambia Mungu wa Mbinguni. Lakini Nyamae alimcheka Anansi akisema, “Hadithi hizi ni ghali mno. Hutaweza kuzilipia, buibui mdogo, wee.”
Ekegusii: Anansi, akarosia eusi etaambe nakorina eusi eria yarenge konanta mbaka igoro o'nyasae. “Ninyore emegano aria, gaki?” akaboria Nyasae Bwe'rioba. Rakini Nyame akamosekerera kagoteba, “ Obe, emegano eye nigo ere yerigori rinene. Tokonyara koyeakanera aye, akanyambobe aka.”

English: Since as you have kept your covenants with us, and continued in our friendship, and have not joined yourselves to our enemies, we have heard of this, and are glad.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umeyashika maagano yako nasi, na kuendelea kuwa rafiki yetu, wala hujajiunga na adui zetu, tumesikia habari hizi, nasi tunafurahi.
Ekegusii: Intwe ntore nomogooko koigwa buna mwatunyanire okobwatana gwaito. Inwe mwatigaire koba abegenwa ase tore nabo buna inwe timorabwatana na ababisa baito.

English: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.” The Parable of the Leaven (Matthew 13:33)
Kiswahili: Umefanana na punje ya haradali ambayo mtu aliichukua na kuipanda katika shamba lake. Nayo ikakua, ikawa mti nao ndege wa angani wakatengeneza viota vyao kwenye matawi yake.” Mfano Wa Chachu (Mathayo 13:33)
Ekegusii: Mboreng’anie nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye; egakina, ekaba omote. Chinyoni chia igoro chikaroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”

English: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God's house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakavileta vile vikombe vya dhahabu ambavyo vilikuwa vimechukuliwa kutoka Hekalu la Mungu huko Yerusalemu, naye mfalme na wakuu wake, wake zake na masuria wake wakavinywea.
