Ekegusii: Erio bakarenta ebikorero biria bie chitaabu na ebie chifeta, ebio biasakoretwe korwa ase Hekalu, enyomba eria ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu; omorwoti, na abanene baria, na abakungu baye, na abakungu baye ba sere‐sere, bakabinywera.

English: And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
Kiswahili: Nitawatunza huko, kwa sababu bado iko miaka mingine mitano inayokuja ya njaa. La sivyo, wewe na nyumba yako na wote ulio nao mtakuwa fukara.’
Ekegusii: Agwo inche ninkoragerie, erinde tobaisa gocha gosoa ase okoremeerwa, aye amo nabaanto bao, na bionsi ebi ore nabio, ekiagera emiaka etano y’enchara netigarete.

English: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
Kiswahili: Kufanya yaliyo sawa na haki inakubalika zaidi kwa Bwana kuliko dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing'wanso.

English: For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa matowashi washikao Sabato zangu, ambao huchagua kile kinachonipendeza na kulishika sana agano langu:
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: “Abanto abagomba abarendete Chisabato chiane, abwo bachorire gokora ogwancha kwane, naende babwatete okobwatana kwane kw'ogotianania,

English: And Joab reported to the king the total number of the troops. In Israel there were 800,000 men of valor who drew the sword, and in Judah there were 500,000. Judgment for David’s Sin (1 Chronicles 21:7–13)
Kiswahili: Yoabu akatoa hesabu ya wapiganaji kwa mfalme: Katika Israeli kulikuwako watu 800,000 wenye uwezo wa kupigana, na katika Yuda watu 500,000.
Ekegusii: Yoabu akaa omorwoti omobaro bw’abaanto abaare konyara korwana esegi nemioro. Ase Abaisraeli nigo barenge abanto chilifu amagana atan’atato (800,000), na ase Abayuda chilifu amagana atano (500,000).

English: We will fall into the hands of the Lord, and not into the hands of men; for as his majesty is, so also is his mercy.
Kiswahili: Tutaanguka mikononi mwa Bwana, na si mikononi mwa wanadamu; kwani kama utukufu wake ulivyo, ndivyo rehema zake zilivyo.
Ekegusii: Tiga twebeke ase amaboko a Nyasae na tari ase amaboko a Mwanyabaanto. Ekiagera ase obonene bw'omonto oyio, nabo borabe buna amaabera aye.

English: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
Kiswahili: Wenye kiburi wameficha mtego wa kuninasa, wametandaza kamba za wavu wao, wametega mitego kwenye njia yangu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu babeekire oboreba bobisi ase ’ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babeekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.

English: Additionally, the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akatengeneza kiti kikubwa cha kifalme kwa kutumia pembe za ndovu na kukifunika kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaroisia ekerogo ki’oborwoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu na agakeooma netaabu echenire.

English: “Pick me up,” he answered, “and cast me into the sea, so it may quiet down for you. For I know that I am to blame for this violent storm that has come upon you.”
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Niinueni mnitupe baharini, nayo itakuwa shwari. Ninajua mawimbi haya makubwa yamewatokea kwa ajili ya kosa langu.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Inyimokie, mondute ase enyancha ime; ero netoerere ase more, ekiagera namanyire ng’a ninche nagerire ekembugu‐mbugu kiabacheire.”

English: It was Simon, the son of Onias, the high priest, who in his life repaired the house, and in his days strengthened the temple.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa Simoni, mwana wa Onia, kuhani mkuu, ambaye katika maisha yake alirekebisha nyumba, na katika siku zake aliimarisha hekalu.
Ekegusii: Ere oyio orenge omonene ase abamura bamwabo na ogwetogeria kwa abanto baye, nere Simioni Omokuani omonene mosinto bwo Onia. Ase obogima bwaye akayeagaacha Hekalu boyia naboigo koyeagaachera orwaki.

English: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.
Kiswahili: Lakini jioni ikikaribia ataoga, na baada ya jua kuzama ataingia tena kambini.
Ekegusii: “Ekero kia mogoroba, esibie omobere n'amaache, na ekero bwairiire kegima asoe ase egetwori.

English: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
Kiswahili: Huinyeshea milima kutoka orofa zake, dunia inatoshelezwa kwa matunda ya kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw'emeremo yao.

English: Suddenly King Nebuchadnezzar jumped up in amazement and asked his advisers, “Did we not throw three men, firmly bound, into the fire?” “Certainly, O king,” they replied.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Nebukadneza akashangaa, akainuka kwa haraka na kuwauliza washauri wake, “Je, hawakuwa watu watatu ambao tuliwafunga na kuwatupa ndani ya moto?” Washauri wakajibu, “Hakika, ee mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Erio Nebukadinesaro omorwoti agakumia na goichana, agatenena ase obwango, akaboria abasemia baye, “Inee! Titwarutete abanto batato boka ase omorero basibire?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, aye omorwoti, ayio namaene.”

English: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.
Kiswahili: Wale waliosalia waliuawa kwa upanga uliotoka kinywani mwa yule aliyekuwa amempanda farasi nao ndege wote wakajishibisha kwa nyama yao.
Ekegusii: Na baria batigarete bagaitwa nomoyio o birende bw'oyoikaransete igoro ase ebarasi eria, omoyio o birende, oria okorua ase omonwa oye. Ne chinyoni chionsi chikaigota ase chinyama chiabo.

English: And Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.” So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Siba akamwambia mfalme, “Mtumishi wako atafanya chochote bwana wangu mfalme atakachoagiza mtumishi wake kufanya.” Basi Mefiboshethi akala chakula mezani pa Daudi kama mmoja wa wana wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio Siba akairaneria omorwoti, “Inche omosomba oo ninkore ayio onsi gwachiikire.” Ase igo Mefiboseti akaba okoragera ase emesa ya Daudi Omonene oye, akaba buna oyomo bw’abana b’omorwoti.

English: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed. ”
Kiswahili: Yeye aangukaye juu ya jiwe hili atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Oyoragwe igoro ase rigena eri nabunekane, na ere oyo rigena riria riragwere inarimosenyente.]

English: And he placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple. Since their wings were spread out, the wing of the first cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the second cherub touched the other wall, and in the middle of the room their wingtips touched.
Kiswahili: Aliwaweka makerubi hao ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu pa Hekalu, mabawa yake yakiwa yamekunjuliwa. Bawa la kerubi mmoja liligusa ukuta mmoja, wakati bawa la yule mwingine liligusa ukuta mwingine, nayo mabawa yao mengine yaligusana katikati ya chumba.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakabeekwa ase akanyomba karia bosio ime ye Hekalu. Chimbaaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire; orobaaba oromo rw’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba oyomo rogaika enyasi ensemo eyemo, na oromo rw’oyonde rogaika enyasi ensemo ende; gati‐gati y’enyomba orobaaba ronde rwa kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba rogakunana.

English: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: Mwambieni yule mtu aliyewatuma ninyi kwangu,
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabateebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, nigo agoteeba ng'a mogende ase omonto oria obatomete gocha ase 'nde, momoteebie:

English: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
Kiswahili: Nimewapa neno lako, nao ulimwengu umewachukia kwa kuwa wao si wa ulimwengu kama mimi nisivyo wa ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Inche nabaeire ring’ana riao; ense yabagechire, ekiagera barabwo tibari abanto b’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.

English: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, “Peter is standing at the gate!”
Kiswahili: Alipoitambua sauti ya Petro, alifurahi mno akarudi bila kufungua na kuwaeleza kwamba, “Petro yuko langoni!”
Ekegusii: Kamanyire eriogi ria Petero, akaba nomogooko, taigora egesieri, korende akaminyoka, agasoa nyomba, akabateebia ng’a Petero ngesieri ateneine.

English: The battle spread over the whole countryside, and that day the forest devoured more people than the sword.
Kiswahili: Vita vikaenea nchi nzima, watu wengi zaidi wakifia msituni siku hiyo kuliko waliouawa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Esegi nigo yesiarerete ase orosana rwonsi rw’aase aria, na ase rituko riria abanto abange bagakwera ase rinani ime kobua abwo baitetwe nemioro.

English: The territory of Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
Kiswahili: Nchi ya Yazeri, miji yote ya Gileadi na nusu ya nchi ya Amoni iliyoenea hadi Aroeri, karibu na Raba;
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Yaeseri na emechie yonsi ya Gileadi, na ekeng’ese gi’ense y’Abaamoni goika Aroeri, oyore moocha ya Raba,

English: These days should be remembered and celebrated by every generation, family, province, and city, so that these days of Purim should not fail to be observed among the Jews, nor should the memory of them fade from their descendants.
Kiswahili: Siku hizi zinapasa zikumbukwe na kuadhimishwa katika kila kizazi, kila jamaa na katika kila jimbo na kila jiji. Nazo siku hizi za Purimu kamwe zisikome kusherehekewa na Wayahudi, wala kumbukumbu zake zisipotee miongoni mwa wazao wake.
Ekegusii: Amatuko ayio abe akoinyorwa na kobwatwa ebiaare ase ebiaare, ase kera eamate na ase kera orogongo, na kera omochie. Amatuko ayio a Purimu tabaisa gotigwa korendwa ase egati y’Abayahudi, gose ekeinyorio ki’amatuko ayio tikemocha koba ase chinderia chiabo.

English: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
Kiswahili: Basi haya ndiyo maeneo Waisraeli waliyopokea kama urithi katika nchi ya Kanaani, ambayo kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa koo za kabila za Israeli waliwagawia.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chingongo Abaisraeli baatananeretwe ase ense ya Kaanani, chibe emiando yabo. Eleazari, Omokuani, amo na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abateneneri be chiamate chi'ebisaku bi'Abaisraeli bakabaatananera ense ase ogoaka obomera.

English: And with her last breath—for she was dying—she named him Ben-oni. But his father called him Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Hapo alipopumua pumzi yake ya mwisho, kwa maana alikuwa akifa, akamwita mwanawe Benoni. Lakini babaye akamwita Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Agwo akaba okogireka ase ogokwa; na ekero areenge ang’e ase ogokwa, Akamoroka omwana oyio Ben‐Oni, korende ise akamoroka Benjamini.

English: So Jehoash king of Israel advanced, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akakwea kuwashambulia. Yeye na Amazia mfalme wa Yuda wakakabiliana uso kwa uso huko Beth-Shemeshi katika Yuda.
Ekegusii: Yehoasi, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda, bakarigererania n’Amasia, ase okorwana esegi agwo Beti‐Semesi, omochie bw’Abayuda.

English: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo wale watatu, wakapita katikati ya safu za Wafilisti, wakachota maji kutoka kwa kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu, wakamletea Daudi. Lakini yeye akakataa kuyanywa. Badala yake, aliyamimina mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amaache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa otatiga ayaumorete akaba okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,

English: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to Yahweh from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”
Kiswahili: Alipozirudisha zile shekeli 1,100 za fedha kwa mama yake, mama yake akamwambia, “Mimi nimeiweka fedha hii wakfu kwa Bwana kwa ajili ya mwanangu kutengenezea kinyago cha kuchonga na sanamu ya kusubu. Mimi nitakurudishia wewe.”
Ekegusii: Omomura oria akairania chisekeli chiria chi'echifeta amagana ikomi na rimo ase ng'ina. Ng'ina agateeba, “Naatananire chifeta echi ase Omonene ase engencho y'omwana one. Chifeta echio 'nachibe echi'okoroisia omogwekano bw'ogosasiimwa oraabe obaachire na oomire ne chifeta. Ase ayio, omwana one, ningochiiranerie.”

English: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
Kiswahili: Dhidi yako, wewe peke yako, nimetenda dhambi na kufanya yaliyo mabaya machoni pako, ili uthibitike kuwa wa kweli unenapo, na kuwa na haki utoapo hukumu.
Ekegusii: Nagokoreire ebibe aye omonyene bweka, nakorire amabe bosio bwao. Aye omanyekane ng'a mboronge ore ekero ogokwana, na mboronge ore na nigo okonacha ekiina buya kegima.

English: A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye hekima humcha Bwana na kuepuka mabaya, bali mpumbavu hukasirika kwa hamaki na uzembe.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwoboa na kwerenda korwa ase amabe, korende omoriri nigo akoba omoremu ase ogokora amabe.

English: Absalom happened to meet David's servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.
Kiswahili: Basi ikawa Absalomu alikutana na watu wa Daudi. Yeye alikuwa amepanda nyumbu wake, naye nyumbu alipopita chini ya matawi yaliyosongana ya mwaloni mkubwa, kichwa cha Absalomu kilinaswa kwenye mti. Akaachwa akiningʼinia hewani, wakati nyumbu aliyekuwa amempanda aliendelea kwenda.
Ekegusii: Abisalomu akaumerana nabasomba ba Daudi mobosokano. Nigo ariinete ebarasi yaye, n'ero egaeta inse y'omoaruni ore ne chinsagia chinetu, na omotwe bw'Abisalomu okaaga ase omote oria igoro, nere agatigara osung'unaneteo, na ebarasi yaye egaeta akaminyoka.

English: David said to Abner, “Aren't you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Wewe si ni mtu shujaa? Ni nani aliye kama wewe katika Israeli? Kwa nini basi hukumlinda mfalme bwana wako? Mtu mmoja alikuja kumwangamiza mfalme, bwana wako.
Ekegusii: Daudi akabooria Abineri: “Aye tori omonto etuoni? Ning'o ore omoremu buna aye ase egati y'Abaisraeli? Nase ki rende otarendete omonene oo omorwoti? Omonto oyomo nacheteo goita Omunene oo omorwoti.

English: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Ateri (kupitia Hezekia) 98
Ekegusii: aba orw'Ateri b'eamate ya Hezekia: emerongo kianda, na batano na batato (98);

English: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.
Kiswahili: Kabla wala baada ya Mfalme Yosia hapakuwepo na mfalme mwingine yeyote ambaye alimpenda Bwana kwa moyo wake wote, kwa roho yake yote, na kwa nguvu zake zote, sawasawa na Sheria yote ya Mose.
Ekegusii: Morwoti onde tabeete agwo ritang'ani orenge buna Yosia, oria omobwatetie Omonene nenkoro yaye yonsi, na omoyo oye bwonsi, ne chinguru chiaye chionsi, koreng'ana n'amachiiko onsi a Musa; gose morwoti onde tanyorekanete buna ere ase abwo bamobwatetie korwa magega.

English: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, as well as the king of Maacah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba while the Ammonites came from their cities and marched out for battle.
Kiswahili: Wakakodisha magari ya vita 32,000 yakiwa na waendeshaji wake, pamoja na mfalme wa Maaka na vikosi vyake, wakaja na kupiga kambi karibu na Medeba. Waamoni nao wakakusanyika toka miji yao, wakatoka ili kupigana vita.
Ekegusii: Bagasaba chigari chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000) amo nomorwoti o Maaka na abarwani baye b’esegi. Barabwo bagacha, bagatoora bosio bwa Medeba. Abaamoni bagasangererigwa korwa ase emechie yabo, bagacha korwana esegi.

English: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father. Lights in the World (Matthew 5:13–16)
Kiswahili: na kila ulimi ukiri ya kwamba Yesu Kristo ni Bwana, kwa utukufu wa Mungu Baba. Ngʼaeni Kama Mianga Katika Ulimwengu
Ekegusii: na kera oromeme narobe kirori ng’a Yeso Kristo n’Omonene, ase obonene bwa Nyasae Tata. Okobara buna Omebaso ase Ense

English: Know and understand this: From the issuance of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem, until the Messiah, the Prince, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of distress.
Kiswahili: “Ujue na kuelewa hili: Tangu kutolewa kwa amri ya kuutengeneza na kuujenga upya Yerusalemu mpaka kuja kwa Mpakwa mafuta, aliye mtawala, kutakuwako majuma saba na majuma sitini na mawili. Barabara zitajengwa tena pamoja na mahandaki, lakini katika wakati wa taabu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, omanye na korengereria ng’a korwa engaki eria ring’ana riaruetwe igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a noagachwe naende, goika ase engaki y’ogocha kw’oyomo Omoakwa Amaguta, oyore omogambi, nachibe chichuma isano na iberegose “isano na ibere” ara emerongo etano na ebere: isano na ibere. Naende ase chichuma emerongo etano nomo, na ibere, omochie noagachwe amo ne chinchera chiaye ne chiburi chiaye, korende ase engaki y’emechando emenene.

English: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watu hawa huniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase 'nde.

English: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Unataka tukuandalie wapi?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng'ai origetie toyeroiserie?”

English: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
Kiswahili: Naye Nikodemo, yule ambaye kwanza alimwendea Yesu usiku, akaja, akaleta mchanganyiko wa manemane na manukato, yenye uzito wa zaidi ya kilo thelathini
Ekegusii: Na Nikodemo oria omochierete botuko agwo ritang'ani, nere akagenda boigo, akarenta ebinto bisang'ananirie manemane na uudi, oborito bwaye chiratili rigana erimo.

English: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,” says the LORD.
Kiswahili: Nitamwangamiza mtawala wake na kuwaua maafisa wake wote pamoja naye,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie omogambi ebiina o Moabu nabagaambi b’aroro.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Yuda.

English: So six hundred Danites departed from Zorah and Eshtaol, armed with weapons of war.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu 600 toka ukoo wa Wadani, waliojifunga silaha za vita, wakaondoka Sora na Eshtaoli.
Ekegusii: Abanto amagana atano na rimo b’egesaku gia Dani, babogoretie ebirwanero, bakaimoka korwa Sora na Esitaoli, bagatiira,

English: It spread and burned those Chaldeans whom it found around the furnace.
Kiswahili: Ilienea na kuwateketeza Wakaldayo wale iliyowakuta karibu na tanuru.
Ekegusii: Omorero oria okabucha mono goika ogasiria Abakalidayo abwo bateneine ange noro.

English: So Ahaziah died according to the word of the LORD that Elijah had spoken. And since he had no son, Jehoram succeeded him in the second year of the reign of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat over Judah.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akafa, sawasawa na lile neno la Bwana ambalo Eliya alikuwa amesema. Kwa kuwa Ahazia hakuwa na mwana, Yoramu akawa mfalme baada yake katika mwaka wa pili wa Yehoramu mwana wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Ahasia agakwa buna Omonene akwanete goetera ase Elija. Ahasia tabwate omwana omomura; ase igo Yoramu momura omwabo akaba omorwoti ase ribaga riaye, ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogaamba kwa Yehoramu mosinto o Yehosafati, omorwoti bw’Abayuda.

English: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
Kiswahili: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari wako katika majumba ya wafalme.
Ekegusii: Gose inki mwachiete korora isiko? Omonto bweboyetie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chinterere nigo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi'abarwoti.

English: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death. Solomon Anointed to Build the Temple
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Mwanangu Solomoni bado ni mdogo wa umri na hana uzoefu. Nyumba itakayojengwa kwa ajili ya Bwana inatakiwa iwe yenye uzuri mwingi na sifa na fahari mbele ya mataifa yote. Kwa hiyo nitaifanyia matayarisho.” Daudi akafanya matayarisho makubwa kabla ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Daudi nigo arengereretie ng’a Sulemani, omwana oye omoke otaramanya amange, na enyomba egochia koagachwa ase Omonene goika ebe engiya mono, naende eramanyekane ase ense yonsi ng’a nigo ere nobonene; na igo ere bweka goika abeeke ebinto bionsi ang’e. Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria ebinto ebinge ekero atarakwa.

English: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
Kiswahili: Itakuwaje kama baba yangu akinigusa? Itaonekana kwake kama niliyemfanyia ujanja na kuleta laana juu yangu badala ya baraka.”
Ekegusii: Aande, Tata nigo arantaba‐tabe, na inche imbe ase amaiso aye buna omong'ainereria, inyerentere okoragererigwa ribaga ri'ogosesenigwa.”

English: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, kwa kuwa Herode hakumpa Mungu utukufu, malaika wa Bwana akampiga, naye akaliwa na chango, akafa.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoaka ekiagera atasigete Nyasae; akariegwa namakonde, agatweka mo.

English: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
Kiswahili: mwimbieni Bwana kwa kinubi, kwa kinubi na sauti za kuimba,
Ekegusii: Terera Omonene ase okobugia amakano, ee, ase okobugia amakano tera namariogi amaya.

English: For Ahaz took away a portion out of Yahweh's house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn't help him.
Kiswahili: Ahazi akachukua baadhi ya vitu kutoka Hekalu la Bwana, jumba la kifalme na kutoka kwa wakuu wake na kumpa mfalme wa Ashuru kama ushuru, lakini hilo halikumsaidia.
Ekegusii: Ahasi akaurereria enyomba y'Omonene, na enyomba y'omorwoti, na ey'abanene barenge nere, akaa omorwoti bw'Abaasuri ebango, korende ayio tamokonyete.

English: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kwa nini unanikataa na kunificha uso wako?
Ekegusii: Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase 'nde?

English: Finally, the waters completely inundated the earth, so that all the high mountains under all the heavens were covered.
Kiswahili: Maji yakazidi kujaa juu ya nchi, yakaifunika milima yote mirefu chini ya mbingu yote.
Ekegusii: Amache ayio akagenderera komenteka mono na akaba nechinguru chinene, erio agoichora igoro ase ense goika ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe mono kegima, biareenge kera ase inse y’erioba, bikarimera amaache ime.

English: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maombi yangu: kwamba upendo wenu uongezeke zaidi na zaidi katika maarifa na ufahamu wote,
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosaba kwane, ng'a obwanchani bwaino bomenteke, bobe obonge mono ase okomanya kw'ogwatanana gwonsi,

English: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.
Kiswahili: aliuza shamba alilokuwa nalo, akaleta hizo fedha alizopata na kuziweka miguuni pa mitume.
Ekegusii: akaonia omogondo oye, akarenta chitaabu, agachibeeka ase amagoro yabatomwa.

English: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
Kiswahili: Aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua vazi lake.
Ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eyanga yaye.

English: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
Kiswahili: Alipasua mwamba, maji yakabubujika, yakatiririka jangwani kama mto.
Ekegusii: Akabochora egetare, na amaache agasoka korwao, akaminyoka ase erooro buna orooche.

English: saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Mungu apishie mbali kwamba nifanye hivi! Je kweli, niinywe damu ya watu hawa waliohatarisha maisha yao?” Kwa sababu walihatarisha maisha yao kuyaleta yale maji, Daudi hakukubali kuyanywa. Huo ndio uliokuwa ujasiri wa wale mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene ontange tiyanywa. Aya nigo anga buna nkonywa amanyinga ’abaanto bataegerete obogima bwabo ase okorenta amaache aya.” Ase ayio akaanga tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo chituoni batato bakorete.

English: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
Kiswahili: Huendelea toka nguvu hadi nguvu, hadi kila mmoja afikapo mbele za Mungu huko Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe bakomenta koba ne chinguru kogenderera botambe, mbarore Nyasae ayobuete chinyasae agwo Sayoni.

English: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
Kiswahili: Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume, akaichukua sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka juu ya ncha ya sikio la kuume la Aroni, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume na juu ya kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Boigo abamura ba Aroni bakarentwa na Musa akagindia amanyinga mesia y'amato abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi'amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi'amagoro abo a borio. Erio amanyinga aria atigarete akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
Kiswahili: Siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja akihubiri katika nyika ya Uyahudi, akisema,
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro ya Boyahudi agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba,

English: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.” The Betrayal of Jesus (Matthew 26:47–56; Mark 14:43–52; John 18:1–14)
Kiswahili: Naye akawauliza, “Mbona mmelala? Amkeni, mwombe ili msije mkaingia majaribuni.” Yesu Akamatwa (Mathayo 26:47-56; Marko 14:43-50; Yohana 18:3-11)
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mwararire? Boka, mosabe, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mat 26:47-56; Mar 14:43-50; Yoh 18:2-11)

English: Now give God thanks, because I ascend to him who sent me. Write in a book all the things which have been done.”
Kiswahili: Sasa mshukuruni Mungu, kwa sababu ninapanda kwake yeye aliyenituma. Andika katika kitabu mambo yote yaliyotendeka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bono inwe motogie na komoakera mbuya mono Omonene Nyasae. Bono inche 'nkoirana inde gochia ase oria ontomete korwa igoro. Riika amang'ana ayio onsi akoregete.

English: For the Lord Yahweh says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi: “Hapo kwanza watu wangu walishuka Misri kuishi, hatimaye, Ashuru wakawaonea.
Ekegusii: Ee, aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Abanto baane nigo bagendete Misiri agwo kare, bakaba abamenyi aroro, na Abaasuri bakabachanda engencho ende etarengeo.

English: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Mnabishana nao kuhusu nini?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”

English: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
Kiswahili: Kisha mtaniita, na mtakuja na kuniomba, nami nitawasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Erio namondangerie mochiche ase ’nde mosabe, nainche nimbaigwe.

English: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
Kiswahili: lakini huyo mkuu wa maafisa akamwambia Danieli, “Ninamwogopa bwana wangu mfalme, aliyeagizia chakula na kinywaji chenu. Kwa nini aone nyuso zenu zikiwa mbaya kuliko za vijana wengine wa rika lenu? Mfalme atakata kichwa changu kwa sababu yenu.”
Ekegusii: Omoteneneri oria agateebia Danieli, “Nairokire ng'a omonene one omorwoti, oyio obachiikerete endagera yaino, na ebinyugwa biaino, ekero arabarore ng'a amasio aino anyirire kobua ay'abamura bande b'ekegori kiaino, nigo arambutore omotwe.”

English: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.
Kiswahili: Gaza utaachwa na Ashkeloni utaachwa magofu. Wakati wa adhuhuri Ashdodi utaachwa mtupu na Ekroni utangʼolewa.
Ekegusii: Omochie o Gasa nong'anyigwe, na oyo bw'Asikeloni notigwe ore bosa; abanto b'Asidodi nabaserigwe, na omochie bw'Ekironi notagorwe.

English: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana milele!
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe kare na kare! Amina. Amina.

English: He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.
Kiswahili: Hezekia aliweka tumaini lake kwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli. Hapakuwepo na mfalme mwingine wa kufanana naye miongoni mwa wafalme wa Yuda, kabla yake au baada yake.
Ekegusii: Hezekia akaba ogosemeri'Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli. Onde tabeete buna ere ase egati y'abarwoti bonsi b'Abayuda baria bamobwatetie gose baria bamotang'anerete.

English: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
Kiswahili: Mkabidhi Bwana njia yako, mtumaini yeye, naye atatenda hili:
Ekegusii: Erue ase Omonene mosemerie ere bweka, nere naoboseemia.

English: For even if no troubling thing frighted them, yet, scared with the creeping of vermin and hissing of serpents,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata kama hakuna kitu kinachowasumbua kilichowatisha, lakini, wakiwa wameogopa wadudu na milio ya nyoka,
Ekegusii: Nonya nekero gento gi'okondokia getarenge oo, barabwo nigo barenge n'obwoba ase eriogi ri'echingiti n'ebitongwa biria biare kwagura.

English: The Lord's blessing is in the reward of the godly. He makes his blessing flourish in an hour that comes swiftly.
Kiswahili: Baraka ya Bwana iko katika thawabu ya wacha Mungu. Huifanya baraka yake istawi katika saa inayokuja haraka.
Ekegusii: Aye bwata emeremo yao erio ogote kore ase emeremo yao.

English: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
Kiswahili: Asa akamzaa Yehoshafati, Yehoshafati akamzaa Yoramu, Yoramu akamzaa Uzia,
Ekegusii: na Asa akaibora Yehosafati, na Yehosafati akaibora Yoramu, na Yoramu akaibora Usia,

English: Watch therefore, for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
Kiswahili: “Basi kesheni kwa sababu hamjui ni lini mwenye nyumba atakaporudi: iwapo ni jioni, au ni usiku wa manane, au alfajiri awikapo jogoo, au mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Renda boigo, ekiagera timomanyeti ekero omonene bw'enyomba agochi‐gocha, gose mogoroba, gose mbotuko gati, gose etuoni gekobuga, gose mambia,

English: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in Yahweh's house, and they prepared them.
Kiswahili: Hezekia akatoa agizo la kutengeneza vyumba vya ghala katika Hekalu la Bwana nalo hili likafanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio Hezekia agachiika abanto baagache ebigachero ase enyomba y'Omonene. Na ekero babiagachete,

English: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
Kiswahili: wasio na upendo, wasiopenda kupatanishwa, wasingiziaji, wasiozuia tamaa zao, wakatili, wasiopenda mema,
Ekegusii: abatancheti abanto baande, abatarigeti kobwatana, abang'aachi, abatari gwetanga ase rinde rionsi, abatiindi, abageechete ayare amaya,

English: The wise man has eyes in his head, but the fool walks in darkness. Yet I also came to realize that one fate overcomes them both.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye hekima ana macho katika kichwa chake, lakini mpumbavu anatembea gizani; lakini nikaja kuona kwamba wote wawili hatima yao inafanana.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo abwate amaiso ase omotwe oye, korende omonto omoriri nigo agotaara ase omosunte; nonya naboigo, nkarora ng’a bonsi nigo bakonyorwa negento ekemo.

English: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu ameoa karibuni, kamwe asipelekwe vitani au kupewa wajibu mwingine wowote. Kwa mwaka mmoja atakuwa huru kubaki nyumbani ili amfurahishe mke aliyemwoa.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto onyuomire omokungu tageenda ase esegi amo n'abarwani bande, gose taegwa emeremo ende yonsi akorere egesaku, korende nigo araegwe ribaga abeere 'nka bwoye ase omwaka oyomo kogokia mokaaye.

English: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
Kiswahili: Hiramu akasubu Bahari ya chuma, yenye umbo la mviringo, ya dhiraa kumi kutoka ukingo hadi ukingo na kimo cha dhiraa tano. Mzunguko wake ulikuwa dhiraa thelathini.
Ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia egetuba ekenene korwa ase etai enyititoire na kobombwa, ekaba egesingo. Ekerengo korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende nigo kiareenge eki’amaboko ikomi. Obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etato ekanyara goetanana egetuba ekio.

English: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nitakuwa kama simba kwa Efraimu, kama simba mkubwa kwa Yuda. Nitawararua vipande vipande na kuondoka; nitawachukua mbali, na hakuna wa kuwaokoa.
Ekegusii: niimbe buna endo ase Abaefraimu, na buna endo ensae ase Abayuda. Inche omonyene nimbwate eke natwarire nkeire; ee, nkeire, na onde tari oragetoorie.

English: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”
Kiswahili: Tena Isaya anasema, “Shina la Yese litachipuka, yeye atakayeinuka ili kutawala juu ya mataifa. Watu wa Mataifa watamtumaini.”
Ekegusii: Naende Isaya nigo agokwana, “Ritina ria Yese inariiche, ere naoroke kogaambera abanto b’Ebisaku; nere abanto b’Ebisaku barasemerie.”

English: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana amekuwa ngome yangu, na Mungu wangu amekuwa mwamba ninaoukimbilia.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene obeire egekengero kiane egekong’u, ee, Nyasae one negetare ngotamera.

English: Mourning for the dead lasts seven days, but for a fool and an ungodly man, it lasts all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Kuomboleza kwa ajili ya wafu hudumu kwa siku saba, lakini kwa mpumbavu na mtu asiyemcha Mungu, hudumu siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi okoganera omoriri omgano, igo enga buna gokwana n'omonto ore n'echitoro chindito.

English: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father's house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake na watu wa nyumbani mwa baba yake, “Nitapanda kwa Farao na kumwambia, ‘Ndugu zangu na watu wa nyumbani mwa baba yangu, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wamekuja kwangu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo na abanto b'enka ya ise: “Nkogenda inde ase Farao imoteebie: Abaminto na abanto b'enka ya tata, aba baarenge ase ense ya Kaanani, bachire ase 'nde.

English: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nilipojitahidi kufahamu kutofautisha hekima, wazimu na upumbavu, lakini nikatambua hata hili nalo ni kukimbiza upepo.
Ekegusii: Naende nkerua nenkoro yane komanya goatanana gati y'echisemi, n'oboriri, obong'aini na obobarimo, korende nigo nanyorete ng'a ayio onsi akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.

English: And the Lord said, “Listen to the words of the unjust judge.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni asemavyo huyu hakimu dhalimu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Igwa aya omogambi otari omooronge agoteeba.

English: the signs and works He did in Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and all his land;
Kiswahili: ishara alizozifanya na mambo aliyoyafanya katikati ya Misri, kwa Farao mfalme wa Misri na kwa nchi yake yote;
Ekegusii: na ebikone biaye, na ogokora kwaye okwo akorete agwo Misiri ase Farao omorwoti, na ase abanto b’ense yaye.

English: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
Kiswahili: Vile viumbe hai vilipokwenda, magurudumu yaliyokuwa kando yao yalisogea na wakati hivyo viumbe hai vilipoinuka kutoka ardhini magurudumu nayo yaliinuka.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge gosuka, naboigo na amagoro aria naro arenge gosuka amo nabirobio mbarabare, na ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba, naboigo na amagoro aria arenge koimokerera igoro.

English: and their mirrors, linen garments, tiaras, and shawls.
Kiswahili: vioo, mavazi ya kitani, taji na shali.
Ekegusii: na ebirore, ne chianga chi’egatani chie rigori rinene, na ebigogwa, na ebietubo.

English: “Stand in the gate of Yahweh's house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh's word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship Yahweh.'”
Kiswahili: “Simama kwenye lango la nyumba ya Bwana, na huko upige mbiu ya ujumbe huu: “ ‘Sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi watu wote wa Yuda mliokuja kupitia malango haya ili kumwabudu Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Genda agwo ase egeita ki'enyomba y'Omonene, na aroro agwo orarie ring'ana eri: Igwa ring'ana ri'Omonene, inwe abanto bonsi ba Yuda aba mogosoa ase ebiita ebio komosasiima.

English: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
Kiswahili: Yehoramu akapokea barua kutoka kwa nabii Eliya iliyosema: “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Daudi baba yako, asemalo: ‘Hukuenenda katika njia za Yehoshafati baba yako au za Asa mfalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Elija omobani agatomera Yehoramu riruube rigoteeba, “Aya nar'Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yao, agoteeba: Aye tobwateti chinchera chia Yehosafati iso, gose echi'Asa, omorwoti bw'Abayuda.

English: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
Kiswahili: Lakini kama baadhi ya matawi yalikatwa, nawe chipukizi la mzeituni mwitu ukapandikizwa mahali pao ili kushiriki unono pamoja na matawi mengine kutoka shina la mzeituni,
Ekegusii: Korende onye chinsagia chinde chiabunekire, na aye oyokwarwete ase omozeituni bw’orosana gwachomirwe ase ribaga riabo, okaba oyomo bwe ritina ri’omozeituni, na konyora obonoru bwaye,

English: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Kiswahili: Kenazi, Temani, Mibsari,
Ekegusii: Kenasi na Temani, na Mibusari,

English: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
Kiswahili: Ninaikabidhi roho yangu mikononi mwako, unikomboe Ee Bwana, uliye Mungu wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.

English: Write in my name whatever seems good to you, and seal it with my ring; for whatever is written at the command of the king, and sealed with my ring, cannot be countermanded.
Kiswahili: Andika kwa jina langu chochote unachokiona kuwa kizuri, kisha ukitie muhuri kwa pete yangu; kwa maana chochote kilichoandikwa kwa amri ya mfalme, na kutiwa muhuri kwa pete yangu, hakiwezi kubadilishwa.
Ekegusii: Gaki inwe riika riruube ase Abayahudi, moribeeke erieta riane, inche omorwoti, moriike buna morarore, moribeeke ekemanyererio ki'ebonyi yane, ekiagera riruube rinde rionsi ririikire na kobeekwa erieta ri'omorwoti amo nekemanyererio ki'ebonyi yaye, onde tari orarionchore.”

English: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
Kiswahili: Lakini katika siku zile ambazo huyo malaika wa saba atakapokaribia kuipiga hiyo tarumbeta yake, siri ya Mungu itatimizwa, kama vile alivyowatangazia watumishi wake manabii.”
Ekegusii: korende ekero omomalaika o gatano na kabere arabugie egetureeri kiaye, obobisi bwa Nyasae naboikeranigwe, buna araareretie abasomba baye ababani.”

English: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia: “Mwanadamu, ninakutuma kwa Waisraeli, kwa taifa asi ambalo limeniasi mimi, wao na baba zao wananikosea mimi hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Ere aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, nkogotoma inde gochia ase Abaisraeli, egesaku ekio getari koigwera, ekio giantigire inche. Abanto abwo amo ne chisokoro chiabo babeire bagosaria asende nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.”
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote amkaribishaye mmoja wa hawa watoto wadogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi. Naye anikaribishaye mimi, amkaribisha Baba yangu aliyenituma.” Yeyote Asiye Kinyume Nasi Yuko Upande Wetu (Luka 9:49-50)
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, tanyancheti inche, korende ere oyontomete.” Onde bwensi otari mamincha yaito nigo are naintwe (Luk 9:49-50)

English: We have never eaten the lima beans
Kiswahili: Hatujawahi kula maharagwe ya lima
Ekegusii: ntwanyakoria ching'ende chia lima

English: “Now this is the law of the guilt offering, which is most holy:
Kiswahili: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya hatia, ambayo ni takatifu sana:
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ekio n’ekengwanso egechenu mono.

English: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaacha, akarudi kwenye mashua, akavuka hadi ngʼambo.
Ekegusii: Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng'umbu.

English: On that day Moses commanded the people:
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile Mose akawaagiza watu:
Ekegusii: Musa agachiika abanto ase rituko erio erio, agakwana,

English: Yahweh's face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
Kiswahili: Uso wa Bwana uko kinyume na watendao maovu, ili kufuta kumbukumbu lao duniani.
Ekegusii: Obosio bw'Omonene nigo bore mamincha y'abwo bagokora amabe, nabasirie korwa ase ense, tibainyorwa.

English: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Huzifuata amri zangu na kuzishika sheria zangu kwa uaminifu. Huyo mtu ni mwenye haki; hakika ataishi, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio aise gokora bo, na abwatie emeroberio y'ane echiikire, na abwate amachiiko ane, na akore ayare boronge, oyio nigo are omonyaboronge; ekeene, nabe moyo. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
Kiswahili: Wasiepuke kwa vyovyote, Ee Mungu, katika hasira yako yaangushe mataifa.
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabatooreke korwa ase obobe buna obwo? Taibo. Aye Nyasae, basirie abanto abwo kegima nendamwamu yao entindi.

English: Shem and Seth were honored among men, but above every living thing in the creation was Adam.
Kiswahili: Shemu na Sethi waliheshimiwa miongoni mwa wanadamu, lakini juu ya kila kiumbe kilicho hai katika uumbaji alikuwa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Semu, Seti na Enoku nigo barenge abanto basikire kegima, n'abanto abwo, Korende Adamu nigo asikire mono kegima goetania ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase ense aye.

English: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
Kiswahili: Kama desturi yake, Paulo aliingia ndani ya sinagogi, na kwa muda wa Sabato tatu akawa anahojiana nao kutoka kwenye Maandiko,
Ekegusii: Na Paulo, buna anarete, agasoa ime aase barenge. Agwo ase Chisabato isato agakwana nabarabwo amang'ana korwa ase amariiko,

English: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
Kiswahili: Yuda, mtumwa wa Yesu Kristo na nduguye Yakobo: Kwa wale walioitwa, wapendwa katika Mungu Baba na kuhifadhiwa salama ndani ya Yesu Kristo:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Yuda, omosomba o Yeso Kristo, oyomwabo Yakobo, nkobarikera nde inwe abamwarangerigwe, abamwanchire na Nyasae Tata, na morendire na Yeso Kristo.

English: For humans are not capable of everything, because the son of man is not immortal.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wanadamu hawawezi kila kitu, kwa sababu mwana wa Adamu si wa milele.
Ekegusii: Ntwe Mwanyabaanto titokonyara gotwara kera egento keria toganetie; ekiagera intwe twensi n'ebitongire biria bigokwa.

English: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
Kiswahili: Ni ninyi ambao mlichaguliwa tangu mwanzo na Mungu Baba kulingana na alivyotangulia kuwajua, kupitia kwa kazi ya utakaso wa Roho, katika utiifu kwa Yesu Kristo na kunyunyiziwa damu yake: Neema na amani ziwe kwenu kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwachoretwe koreng'ana buna Nyasae Tata amanyete korwa kare, na mogachenwa n'Omoika, monyare koigwera Yeso Kristo, na konyororokerigwa namanyinga aye. Obuya na omorembe bimenteke ase oboikeranu bwonsi.

English: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn't right before God.
Kiswahili: Wewe huna sehemu wala fungu katika huduma hii kwa kuwa moyo wako si mnyofu mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tori negetari gose nensemo ase ring'ana eri, ekiagera enkoro yao teri boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: The children of Jambri came out of Medaba, and seized John and all that he had, and went their way with it.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Jambri walitoka Medaba, wakamkamata Yohana na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, wakaenda navyo.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto be eamate ya Yamburi korwa Medeba bakamogwera Yohana bakamobwata na koira ebinto bionsi arenge nabio.

English: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn't the son bear the iniquity of the father?' When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mnauliza, ‘Kwa nini mwana asiadhibiwe kwa uovu wa baba yake?' Kwa vile mwana ametenda yaliyo haki na sawa na amekuwa mwangalifu kuzishika amri zangu zote, hakika ataishi.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki keragere omwana atanyore emechando ase engencho y'ebibe bia ise? Nigo nkobairaneria iga: Ekero omwana akorire ayare amaya na amaronge, na obeire okorenda emeroberio y'ane echiikire na ayekore, ekeene, nabe moyo.

English: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
Kiswahili: Wakati wafalme walipounganisha nguvu, waliposonga mbele pamoja,
Ekegusii: Rora, abarwoti nigo basangererekanete, bagacha amo.

English: I heard the Lord's voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti ya Bwana ikisema, “Nimtume nani? Ni nani atakayekwenda kwa ajili yetu?” Nami nikasema, “Mimi hapa. Nitume mimi!”
Ekegusii: Magega y'ayio nkaigwa Omonene okoboria, “Ning'o ngotoma, na ning'o oranyare koba omotomwa oito?” Nkairaneria ngateeba, “Nao inde aa, ntome.”

English: Yahweh's anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn't respect the persons of the priests. They didn't favor the elders.
Kiswahili: Bwana mwenyewe amewatawanya; hawaangalii tena. Makuhani hawaonyeshwi heshima, wazee hawakubaliki.
Ekegusii: Okobea kw'Omonene kwabasiareire, takobechandera naende; abakuani tibasigetwe, na abagaaka tibaroreretwe amaabera.

English: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikuwa akijitahidi kumwona Yesu ni mtu wa namna gani. Lakini kutokana na umati mkubwa wa watu hakuweza kwa sababu alikuwa mfupi wa kimo.
Ekegusii: Akarigia korora Yeso, gose ’monto ki; ko tanyara ase engencho y’omoganda, ekiagera arenge omweng’e.

English: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
Kiswahili: Naye Maria akasema: “Moyo wangu wamwadhimisha Bwana,
Ekegusii: Mariamu agateeba, “Omoyo one otogirie Omonene,

English: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao walikuwa viongozi wa kutunza vifaa vilivyotumika katika huduma ndani ya Hekalu; walivihesabu kila vilipoingizwa ndani na kila vilipotolewa.
Ekegusii: Abalawi bande nabwo batenenerete ebikorero bi’emeremo, ekiagera nigo baganeirie kobibara ekero biarenge korentwa ime, na ekero biarenge koirwa isiko ase emeremo.

English: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
Kiswahili: Binti mkubwa akamzaa mwana, akamwita jina lake Moabu; ndio baba wa Wamoabu hata leo.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omoiseke oria omotangi akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Moabu; oyio nere sokoro bw'Abamoabu goika reero iga.

English: A modest woman is grace upon grace. There are no scales that can weigh the value of a self-controlled soul.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke mnyenyekevu ni neema juu ya neema. Hakuna mizani inayoweza kupima thamani ya nafsi yenye kujidhibiti.
Ekegusii: Omokungu ore nekerengo nigo akomenta koba omonyakieni, kerengo kierigori tikeiyo keranyaare korengerwa omokungu oyio.

English: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?
Kiswahili: Je, hii ndiyo njia ya kumlipa Bwana, enyi watu wajinga na wasio na busara? Je, yeye siye Baba yenu, Muumba wenu, aliyewafanya ninyi na kuwaumba?
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto abariri motari nobong’aini, Inee, eye nero enchera mogoakanera Omonene? Inee, ere tari iso, oria obatongete, na obakorire mwabeire ne chinguru?

English: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
Kiswahili: akamsihi akisema, “Binti yangu mdogo ni mgonjwa mahututi. Tafadhali nakusihi, njoo uweke mikono yako juu yake ili apate kupona, naye atakuwa hai.”
Ekegusii: akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”

English: and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She was also a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
Kiswahili: jina la mke wa Amramu ni Yokebedi, naye pia alikuwa mzao wa Lawi, ambaye alizaliwa kwa Walawi nchini Misri. Alimzalia Amramu: Aroni, Mose na dada yao Miriamu.
Ekegusii: Moka Amuramu nigo arenge korokwa Yokebedi, mosubati o Lawi, oria oiboreretwe Lawi agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Omokungu oria akamoiborera Amuramu abana aba: Aroni, na Musa, na Miriamu, omoiseke omwabo.

English: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
Kiswahili: “Ole wake yeye ajengaye milki yake kwa mapato ya udhalimu, awekaye kiota chake juu, ili kukimbia makucha ya uharibifu!
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria okonyora ebitoki bi’obobe na kobirenta ase enyomba yaye, erinde bweagachera egeswa kiaye aase aimokererete igoro ng’a abe noborendi korwa ase okobua kw’amabe.

English: But your many foes will be like fine dust, the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff. Then suddenly, in an instant,
Kiswahili: Lakini adui zako wengi watakuwa kama vumbi laini, kundi la wakatili watakuwa kama makapi yapeperushwayo. Naam, ghafula, mara moja,
Ekegusii: Korende ababisa bao bare omoganda omonene mbairurukigwe buna orotu; na omoganda bw’abare abatindi noirurukigwe buna omoiriro gochia aare. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe mobosokano, ee, nigo arabe mobosokano mono.

English: Therefore you shall keep this statute at the appointed time year after year.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima uishike amri hii kwa wakati uliopangwa mwaka baada ya mwaka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ogochika oko goika korende omwaka ase omwaka ase engaki eyio echiikire.” Abana abatangi ne ching’iti chintangi

English: They brought the priests' garments, the first fruits, and the tithes. They stirred up the Nazarites, who had accomplished their days.
Kiswahili: Walileta mavazi ya makuhani, malimbuko ya kwanza, na zaka. Walichochea Wanadhiri, ambao walikuwa wametimiza siku zao.
Ekegusii: Bakarenta emiambaro ya abakuhani, okorua kwe rigesa riogotongora na ensemo ya ikomi. Naende bakarenta baria batakeire bagaikerania ogotakerwa kwabo.

English: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alikuwa huko tena pamoja na wanafunzi wake wawili.
Ekegusii: Naende rituko riare kobwatia Yohana nigo arenge oteneine amo na babere baborokigwa baye.

English: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
Kiswahili: Basi ile tamaa mbaya ikishachukua mimba, huzaa dhambi, nayo ile dhambi ikikomaa, huzaa mauti.
Ekegusii: Na okogania koria okobe gokwabogoirie oborito kwaibora ebibe, na ebibe biria kobiakiinire, biarenta amakweri.

English: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?'
Kiswahili: Mnamo saa kumi na moja akatoka tena akawakuta wengine bado wamesimama bila kazi. Akawauliza, ‘Kwa nini mmesimama hapa kutwa nzima pasipo kufanya kazi?'
Ekegusii: Goika chinsa ikomi nemo agasoka, akarora abande bateneine, akababoria nabarabwo: Ninki mwatenenera aa bwaira, motari nameremo?

English: You are to speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.
Kiswahili: Utasema kila kitu nitakachokuagiza, naye Aroni ndugu yako atamwambia Farao awaachie Waisraeli watoke katika nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Aye oteebie oyomino Aroni ayio onsi nagochikiire, na ere akwane na Farao, amoteebie ng’a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.

English: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zetu mpendwao na Mungu, kwa kuwa tunajua kwamba Mungu amewachagua,
Ekegusii: Naki abaminto, abamwanchire na Nyasae, twamanyire ng’a ere obachorire.

English: Jesus also told them a parable: “Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
Kiswahili: Pia akawapa mfano akasema, “Je, kipofu aweza kumwongoza kipofu? Je, wote wawili hawatatumbukia shimoni?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, “Inee! Omouko nonyare koraa omouko onde? Tibakogwa bonsi babere ase engoro?

English: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.'
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Bwana, tumekumbuka kwamba yule mdanganyifu wakati alikuwa bado hai alisema, ‘Baada ya siku tatu nitafufuka.'
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Omonene, twainyoire ng'a omong'ainereria oria nateebete ekero arenge moyo: Magega ase amatuko atato nimboke.

English: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God, saying, “O LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akamsihi Bwana Mungu wake, akasema, “Ee Bwana, kwa nini hasira yako iwake dhidi ya watu wako, wale uliowatoa Misri kwa uweza mkuu na mkono wenye nguvu?
Ekegusii: Korende Musa agasorora Omonene, Nyasae oye, akabora, “Gaaki Omonene nase ki’endamwamu yao ekoberorokera abanto bao, abakwang’anyetie korwa Misiri ase okobua okonene, na ase okoboko kwao gwe chinguru?

English: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
Kiswahili: kama vile yalivyokabidhiwa kwetu na wale waliokuwa mashahidi walioyaona na watumishi wa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Nigo barigete buna intwe twatebetigwe nabwo barenge abarori korwa omochakano na abakori emeremo be ring'ana batorenteire.

English: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
Kiswahili: Nilisikia, lakini sikuelewa. Kwa hiyo nikauliza, “Bwana wangu, matokeo ya haya yote yatakuwa nini?”
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa amang’ana aria, korende tinamanya engencho yaye. Ase ayio nkaboria, “Aye Omonene one, omoerio bw’amang’ana aya, naki or’abe?”

English: Micaiah replied, “You will soon see, on that day when you go and hide in an inner room.”
Kiswahili: Mikaya akajibu, “Utagundua siku hiyo utakapokwenda kujificha kwenye chumba cha ndani.”
Ekegusii: Mikaya akamoiraneria: “Aye norore rituko riria oratame na gosoa ase ekenunchi bwebisa.”

English: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
Kiswahili: Sitatimiza hasira yangu kali, wala sitageuka na kumharibu Efraimu. Kwa kuwa mimi ndimi Mungu, wala si mwanadamu, Aliye Mtakatifu miongoni mwenu. Sitakuja kwa ghadhabu.
Ekegusii: Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo 'nde Nyasae, tindi Mwanyabaanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha ase more inde nekeririanda.

English: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
Kiswahili: Tazameni jinsi huzuni hii ya kimungu ilivyoleta faida ndani yenu: bidii mliyo nayo, juhudi mliyofanya kujitetea, uchungu wenu, hofu yenu, upendo wenu, shauku yenu na jinsi mlivyokuwa tayari kutoa adhabu inayostahili. Kwa kila njia mmejithibitisha kuwa safi katika jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Rora buna ogoichanigwa okwo kore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae kwabarenteire omokia, na ogwekengera, na okobea, okoiroka na amaiga amange, ogwetigana na egesiomba! Ase kera enchera mweorokererie koba motari na komocha ase ring'ana erio.

English: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
Kiswahili: Wabenyamini wengine na baadhi ya watu kutoka Yuda pia walikuja kwa Daudi katika ngome yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Benjamini, na ekia Yuda, bagacha ase eburi agwo ase Daudi arenge.

English: Just as the LORD was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon and make his throne even greater than that of my lord King David.”
Kiswahili: Kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa na bwana wangu mfalme, vivyo hivyo na awe na Solomoni kukifanya kiti chake cha utawala kuwa kikuu kuliko kile cha bwana wangu Mfalme Daudi!”
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’an’Omonene abeire amo naye, omonene one, naboigo abe amo na Sulemani, erio akore ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kebe ekenene goetania ekerogo kiao aye omorwoti Daudi, omonene one.”

English: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,
Kiswahili: Usimkemee mzee kwa ukali bali umshawishi kama vile angekuwa ni baba yako. Uwatendee vijana kama vile ndugu zako;
Ekegusii: Totogonyera omogaka, korende omosorore buna iso, abamura abake buna bamura bamino,

English: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can't serve both God and Mammon.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali.
Ekegusii: “Onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.

English: The priests made a prayer while the sacrifice was being consumed—both the priests and all the others. Jonathan led and the rest responded, as Nehemiah did.
Kiswahili: Makuhani walisali wakati dhabihu ilipokuwa ikiteketezwa—makuhani na wengine wote. Yonathani aliongoza na wengine wote waliitikia, kama Nehemia alivyofanya.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorero oria ogendererete gosamba ekengwanso keria, Yonathani, Omokuani omonene agachaaka gosaba erio n'abanto bande bonsi bakamoitaberia bakoragwa na Nehemia.

English: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Walawi siku zote wana haki ya kukomboa nyumba zao katika miji ya Walawi wanayoimiliki.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi mbare ne ribaga kobooria chinyomba chi’emechie ere emiando yabo engaki ende yonsi.

English: Then God said to Noah, “The end of all living creatures has come before Me, because through them the earth is full of violence. Now behold, I will destroy both them and the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Nitawaangamiza watu wote, kwa kuwa dunia imejaa ukatili kwa sababu yao. Hakika mimi nitaangamiza watu pamoja na dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Narorire ng’a ninsirie Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera baichoirie obotindi na oboregani ense, ase igo nimbasirie amo nense yonsi.

English: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father's wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
Kiswahili: Zifuatazo ni habari za Yakobo. Yosefu, kijana wa miaka kumi na saba, alikuwa akichunga makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi pamoja na ndugu zake wa mama wengine, yaani wana wa Bilha na wana wa Zilpa wake za baba yake, naye akawa akimletea baba yake taarifa mbaya kuhusu hao ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano bw'ororeeria rwa Yakobo. Yusufu, ekero aikire emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, nigo areenge korisia amaicho amo na bamura bamwabo. Omosae oyio akaba ore amo nabamura bamwabo, abana ba Bilia na Silpa, abakungu ba ise. Yusufu akaba okorentera ise amang'ana igoro y'ogokora kwabo okobe.

English: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtumishi si mkuu kuliko bwana wake, wala aliyetumwa si mkuu kuliko yule aliyemtuma.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye, gose omotomwa tari omonene kobua ere oyomotomete.

English: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
Kiswahili: Chochote ambacho Mungu wa mbinguni ameagiza, kifanyike kwa ukamilifu kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Mungu wa mbinguni. Kwa nini pawepo ghadhabu dhidi ya utawala wa mfalme na wanawe?
Ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi Nyasae o igoro arachike ng'a gekorwe, ekio gekorwe boronge ase engencho y'enyomba ya Nyasae o igoro, erinde endamwamu ya Nyasae tebaisa koba igoro y'oborwoti bwane, na abamura baane.

English: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwanza itampasa kuteseka katika mambo mengi na kukataliwa na kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Korende ritang'ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.

English: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”
Kiswahili: na miteremko ya mabonde inayofika hadi mji wa Ari na huelekea mpakani mwa Moabu.”
Ekegusii: na egetirimboko ki'amakura, aase omochie bw'Ari ore, na gochia orobebe rwa Moabu.”

English: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh's glory has risen on you!
Kiswahili: “Ondoka, angaza, kwa kuwa nuru yako imekuja na utukufu wa Bwana umezuka juu yako.
Ekegusii: Imoka obare, ekiagera omobaso oo ochire, na obonene bw'Omonene bwakobareire.

English: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na maagizo ya mwisho ya Daudi, Walawi waliohesabiwa ni wale wa kuanzia umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko omoerio o Daudi, Abalawi bonsi bakarikwa, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania.

English: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Asheri, Sethuri mwana wa Mikaeli;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi'Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;

English: The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
Kiswahili: Bwana huchukia sana njia ya waovu, bali huwapenda wale wafuatao haki.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omokori amabe nigo ere okogechia ase Omonene, korende nigo anchete oy’okobwatia oboronge.

English: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear Yahweh's word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.
Kiswahili: Waambie watu wa Negebu: ‘Sikieni neno la Bwana. Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ninakaribia kukutia moto, nao utateketeza miti yako yote, mibichi na iliyokauka. Miali ya moto haitaweza kuzimwa na kila uso kutoka kusini mpaka kaskazini utakaushwa kwa moto huo.
Ekegusii: Oteebie rinani ria Negebu iga: Igwa ring'ana ri'Omonene. Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nintongie omorero ime yao, n'oro nosambe osirie emete emebese, na emiomo yonsi. Omorero oyio ekebemberi tokorimigwa, na amasio y' abanto bonsi korwa Irianyi goika sugusu nasambwe n'oro.

English: Then Samuel set out from Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin. And Saul numbered the troops who were with him, about six hundred men. Israel without Weapons
Kiswahili: Kisha Samweli akaondoka Gilgali, akapanda Gibea ya Benyamini, naye Sauli akawahesabu watu aliokuwa nao. Jumla yao walikuwa watu 600. Israeli Bila Silaha
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimoka, akarua Giligali, akagenda Gibea ase orogongo rwa Benjamini. Na Saulo akabara Abanto abatigarete amo nere, na barabwo nigo baarenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo.

English: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
Kiswahili: kwake yeye Mungu pekee Mwokozi wetu, kwa Yesu Kristo Bwana wetu, utukufu, ukuu, uweza na mamlaka ni vyake tangu milele, sasa na hata milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: ere oyore Nyasae bweka, Omotooria oito goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito, asare ere ogotogigwa, na obonene, n’echinguru, na okobua, korwa kare na kare, na bono, na goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: If, however, he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold it to another man, it may no longer be redeemed.
Kiswahili: Kama pengine halikomboi shamba hilo, au kama ameliuza kwa mtu mwingine, kamwe haliwezi kukombolewa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria taganeti kobooria oboremo boria, korende aboonerie omonto omoao, rirorio oboremo obwo tibokoboorigwa nonya ’ng’ake.

English: “Where is he?” replied the king. And Ziba said, “Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Yuko wapi?” Siba akajibu, “Yuko nyumbani kwa Makiri mwana wa Amieli huko Lo-Debari.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Ng’ai akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Nigo akare o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.”

English: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Abiya, pamoja na mambo aliyofanya na aliyosema, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha maelezo cha nabii Ido.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ande onsi igoro y'Abiya ne chinchera chiaye, ne chinkwana chiaye, nigo ariikire ase omogano bw'omobani Ido.

English: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
Kiswahili: Yaredi aliishi jumla ya miaka 962, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (962), erio agakwa.

English: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utapata kibali na jina zuri mbele za Mungu na mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igo nario oranyore ogwancherwa na okomanya okuya ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ ‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
Kiswahili: “ Bwana akauliza, ‘Kwa njia gani?’ “Akasema, ‘Nitakwenda na kuwa roho ya uongo katika vinywa vya manabii wake wote.’ “ Bwana akasema, ‘Utafanikiwa katika kumshawishi. Nenda ukafanye hivyo.’
Ekegusii: Omonene akabooria omoika oria: Nase enchera ere naki oramoebererie? Omoika oria okairaneria: Igo nkoimoka ngende, imbe omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi b’Ahabu. Omonene akayotebia: Genda omoebererie ase enchera eyio. Nobue.

English: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.
Kiswahili: Kwa uwezo wangu wote nimetenga mali kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Mungu wangu: dhahabu kwa kazi za dhahabu, fedha kwa ajili ya fedha, shaba kwa kazi za shaba, chuma kwa kazi za chuma na miti kwa kazi za miti, vivyo hivyo vito vya shohamu kwa ajili ya kutia kwenye vijalizo, almasi, mawe ya rangi mbalimbali, aina zote za vito vya thamani na marmar; yote haya kwa wingi mno.
Ekegusii: Inche ase ogokora aya narenge konyara, nabekire ebinto ang’e ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae one: chitaabu ase ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta, ne chitaai ase ebinto bie chitaai, na ebioma ase ebinto bi’ebioma, ne chibao ase ebinto bi’echibao. Amo n’ebinto ebio narure amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande ay’ogosata, ayare nebieni ao ao, akomeka‐meka, amo namagena ande amange amarabu akomeka‐meka.

English: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ilivyo, Mungu ameweka viungo katika mwili, kila kimoja kama alivyopenda.
Ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obekire ebiimo, kera ekemo ase omobere buna arigetie.

English: Then you will do as I have done: You will not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtafanya kama nilivyofanya. Hamtafunika sehemu ya chini ya nyuso zenu wala hamtakula vyakula vya kawaida vya waombolezaji.
Ekegusii: Nainwe nabo morakore buna inche nakorire. Timobaisa gotuba chinderu na emenwa, gose timoria endagera y’ebirero.

English: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David's house.
Kiswahili: Huko viti vya enzi vya hukumu hukaa, viti vya enzi vya nyumba ya Daudi.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao ebirogo bi'abanachi ebiina bire, ebirogo bi'obonene bi'enyomba ya Daudi.

English: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
Kiswahili: “Lakini umesema nikiwa ninakusikia, nami nilisikia maneno yenyewe:
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, gwakwanire ase ntegererete, na inche naigure amang'ana ao.

English: along with all of Joseph’s household, and his brothers, and his father’s household. Only their children and flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
Kiswahili: Hawa ni mbali na watu wote wa nyumbani kwa Yosefu, na ndugu zake, na wale wote wa nyumbani mwa baba yake. Ni watoto wao, makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe tu waliobakia katika nchi ya Gosheni.
Ekegusii: na bonsi ab’enka ya Yusufu, amo nabamwabo, na ab’enka ya ise. Abana babo boka bagatigara Goseni amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiabo.

English: If you own something, he will live with you. He will drain your resources and will not be sorry.
Kiswahili: Ukiwa na kitu, ataishi nawe. Atakupotezea rasilimali zako na hatajuta.
Ekegusii: Omotenenku oyio akorore kore n'egento nigo agokoberera ang'e, na onagosakora ebinto biao ng'ora-ng'ora goika obikoora kegima. Atari n'amaabera.

English: When Noah awoke from his drunkenness and learned what his youngest son had done to him,
Kiswahili: Noa alipolevuka kutoka kwenye mvinyo wake na kujua lile ambalo mwanawe mdogo kuliko wote alilokuwa amemtendea,
Ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu atindokire korwa ase okonywa kwaye kw’edivai, akamanya eke omwana oye omoke amokoreire,

English: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: Hii ni hesabu ya jamaa ya Aroni na Mose kwa wakati ambao Bwana alizungumza na Mose katika Mlima Sinai.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b'ororeria rwa Aroni, na orwa Musa, ase engaki eri'Omonene akwanete na Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wale wanaoishi kwa kuufuata mwili huziweka nia zao katika vitu vya mwili, lakini wale wanaoishi kwa kufuata Roho, huziweka nia zao katika mambo ya Roho.
Ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi’Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’Omoika.

English: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.
Kiswahili: “Ee mfalme, ulitazama, na mbele yako ilisimama sanamu kubwa, kubwa mno kupita kiasi, sanamu iliyongʼaa na kutisha kwa kuonekana kwake.
Ekegusii: “Aye omorwoti, ase okorora kwao okarora omogwekano omonene mono, oteneine ase obosio bwao. Omogwekano oyio nigo orenge omotambe, okomeka‐meka noborabu obonene, na okororekana kwaye nigo kwarenge gw'okoondokia.

English: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
Kiswahili: Vinywa vyao huweka madai hata kwa mbingu, nazo ndimi zao humiliki duniani.
Ekegusii: Emenwa yabo nigo egokwana amang'ana amabe are mamincha ya igoro; ne chimeme chiabo chiasokia ayakogenda ase ense engima.

English: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu aliporudi nyumbani, umati wa watu ukakusanyika tena, kiasi kwamba yeye na wanafunzi wake hawakuweza kula chakula.
Ekegusii: Na omoganda ogasangerereka naende; barabwo abanyene tibanyara nonya nokoria.

English: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hukumu bila huruma itatolewa kwa mtu yeyote asiyekuwa na huruma. Huruma huishinda hukumu.
Ekegusii: Naki ekiina tikeri namaabera asere oyotari namaabera. Amaabera nigo agochenga igoro y'ekina.

English: Jeroboam did not again recover his power during the days of Abijah, and the LORD struck him down and he died.
Kiswahili: Yeroboamu hakupata nguvu tena wakati wa utawala wa Abiya. Naye Bwana akampiga Yeroboamu akafa.
Ekegusii: Yeroboamu tanyorete chinguru chi’okoirania oborwoti bwaye ase amatuko Abiya arenge kogamba, korende Omonene akamoaka erinde agakwa.

English: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn't remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke anapokuwa na utungu wa kuzaa huwa na maumivu kwa sababu saa yake imewadia. Lakini mtoto akiisha kuzaliwa, yule mwanamke husahau maumivu hayo kwa sababu ya furaha ya kuzaliwa mtoto ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y'omogooko bw'okoiborwa kw'omonto ase ense.

English: To those without the law I became like one without the law (though I am not outside the law of God but am under the law of Christ), to win those without the law.
Kiswahili: Kwa watu wasio na sheria nilikuwa kama asiye na sheria (ingawa siko huru mbali na sheria ya Mungu, bali niko chini ya sheria ya Kristo), ili niweze kuwapata wale wasio na sheria.
Ekegusii: Ase baria batari namachiiko nkaba buna oyo otari namachiiko (tari buna tindi namachiiko ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende nigo inde inse y’amachiiko a Kristo) erinde mbarente baria batari namachiiko.

English: Didn't the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
Kiswahili: Je, haikumpasa Kristokuteswa kwa njia hiyo na kisha aingie katika utukufu wake?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang'ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”

English: for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu walimwacha na kutumikia Baali na Maashtorethi.
Ekegusii: Bakamotiga Omonene na bagachaaka gochikorera chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti.

English: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo nitawatia mikononi mwa watu wa mashariki mkawe mali yao. Watapiga kambi zao katikati yenu na kufanya makazi miongoni mwenu, watakula matunda yenu na kunywa maziwa yenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimbarue mbabeeke ase amaboko y' abanto ba moocha, mobe ababo. Barabwo mbabeeke chiema chiabo ase egati yaino, naende mbaagache obomenyo bwabo aroro; mbarie okwama kwaino na banywe amabeere aino.

English: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
Kiswahili: Hata misunobari na mierezi ya Lebanoni inashangilia mbele yako na kusema, “Basi kwa sababu umeangushwa chini, hakuna mkata miti atakayekuja kutukata.”
