Ekegusii: Nonya nemetarakwa nigo egokerete okobugwa kwao, na emecharake ya Lebanoni nigo egoteeba: Gese gwakaiyeretigwe inse, omotemi emete onde tana gotochera.

English: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
Kiswahili: Mose aliposikia maneno haya, alikimbilia huko Midiani alikokaa kama mgeni, naye akapata watoto wawili wa kiume.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'amang'ana aya Musa agatama gochia ase ense ya Midiani, akamenya aroro buna omomenyi. Akaiborera abana babere abamura aroro.

English: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule, Mfalme Ahazi akatuma wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Ashuru kuomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Ahasi omorwoti agatoma amang'ana ase omorwoti bw'Abaasuri, akamobooria amokonye.

English: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh’s officials and by the people.
Kiswahili: ( Bwana akawafanya Wamisri wawe na moyo wa ukarimu kwa Waisraeli, naye Mose mwenyewe akaheshimiwa sana na maafisa wa Farao na watu wote katika nchi ya Misri.)
Ekegusii: Omonene akaa abanto baye ogwancherwa ase amasio y’Abamisiri; kobua ayio Musa nigo arenge omonto omonene mono ase ense ya Misiri ase amasio ’abasomba ba Farao, na ase abanto baye.

English: I said to myself, “Come now, I will test you with pleasure; enjoy what is good!” But it proved to be futile.
Kiswahili: Nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Haya basi, nitakujaribu kwa anasa nione ni lipi lililo jema.” Lakini hilo nalo likaonekana ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Ngakwana nenkoro yane, ngateba, “Bono ninteeme ndore naki omogooko ore, imbe nkwegokia omonyene.” Korende nonya nayio onsi nigo arenge bosa.

English: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”
Kiswahili: Basi ni dhahiri kwamba hakuna mtu anayehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu kwa kushikilia sheria, kwa maana, “Mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani.”
Ekegusii: Bono nigo are maiso marore, ng’a onde tari oranyore oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase amachiiko; ekiagera nigo ariikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”

English: Zebulun didn't drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo Zabuloni hawakuwafukuza Wakanaani walioishi huko Kitroni, wala walioishi Nahaloli, ambao walibaki miongoni mwao; bali waliwatia katika kazi ya kulazimishwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'egesaku gia Sabuloni tibaabang'anyetie abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Kitironi na Nahalali. Ase ayio Abakaanani baria bakagenderera komenya agwo ase egati yabo, korende bakabetererigwa kobakorera emeremo emekong'u.

English: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda wa siku saba isionekane chachu yoyote katika nyumba zenu. Yeyote alaye chochote chenye chachu ndani yake, lazima akatiliwe mbali kutoka jumuiya ya Israeli, akiwa ni mgeni au mzawa.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y'amatuko atano na abere ememera terorekana ase chinyomba chiaino nonya ng'ake; naki onde bwensi orarie egento kebekire ememera naatananwe korwa ase omoganda bw'Abaisraeli, onye ore omomenyi gose omobiare.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli hivi: ‘Mmejionea wenyewe kwamba nimesema nanyi kutoka mbinguni:
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe abanyene mwarorire ng’a nigo nakwanire nainwe korwa igoro.

English: But when they could not find them, they dragged Jason and some other brothers before the city officials, shouting, “These men who have turned the world upside down have now come here,
Kiswahili: Lakini walipowakosa wakamburuta Yasoni na ndugu wengine mbele ya maafisa wa mji, wakipiga kelele: “Watu hawa ni wale walioupindua ulimwengu wamekuja huku,
Ekegusii: Ekero batabanyora, bagakurura Yasoni na abande baminto gochia ase abanene b’omochie, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba abaonchoranire ense baikire nonya naa,

English: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akapaita mahali pale Mungu alipozungumza naye Betheli.
Ekegusii: Igo Yakobo akaaroka aase aria Nyasae akwanerete amo nere Beteli.

English: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.'
Kiswahili: “Mwalimu, Mose alisema, ‘Kama mtu akifa bila kuwa na watoto, ndugu yake inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili ampatie watoto huyo nduguye aliyekufa.'
Ekegusii: bakobora, “Omworokia, Musa nateebete: Omonto karakwe, na ere tari n'abana, momura omwabo atware omoboraka oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.

English: the mighty man and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the soothsayer and the elder,
Kiswahili: shujaa na mtu wa vita, mwamuzi na nabii, mwaguzi na mzee,
Ekegusii: Narusie korwao abanto bare chituoni na abarwani bande b’esegi, na abagaambi ebiina, na ababani, na abaringoria, na abagaaka,

English: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
Kiswahili: Naye Baba mwenyewe ameshuhudia juu yangu. Hamjapata kamwe kuisikia sauti yake wala kuona umbo lake,
Ekegusii: Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori ase ’nde. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora

English: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
Kiswahili: naye anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumwa wenu:
Ekegusii: na oyorarigie koba omotang'ani ase more, goika abe omosomba oino,

English: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and defeated the Philistines his adversaries. He broke their horn in pieces to this day.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa aliwaangamiza adui pande zote, na kuwashinda Wafilisti adui zake, akavunja pembe zao vipande vipande hata leo.
Ekegusii: Akabaabusera are ababisa baye korwa chinsinyo chionsi na kobakiria Abafilisiti; agachitagora chisiiro chiabo goika reero iga.

English: Keep my commandments and live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
Kiswahili: Shika amri zangu nawe utaishi; linda mafundisho yangu kama mboni ya jicho lako.
Ekegusii: Bwata amachiiko ane, erinde obe moyo; orende amorokererio ane buna orendete endorero y’eriiso ria’o.

English: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Obothi, wakapiga kambi huko Iye-Abarimu, mipakani mwa Moabu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, bagatoora aroro ase orobebe rwa Moabu.

English: Instead, I devoted myself to the construction of the wall, and all my servants were gathered there for the work; we did not acquire any land.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, nilijitoa kwa bidii katika kazi ya ukuta huu. Watu wangu wote walikutanika pale kwa ajili ya kazi. Hatukujipatia shamba lolote.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nakorete omokia, nkagenderera koagacha orwaki, gose titwagorete oboremo bonde, na abasomba baane nigo babete amo nainche ase ogokora emeremo eria.

English: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh's sight, to provoke him to anger.
Kiswahili: Akamtoa kafara mwanawe mwenyewe katika moto, akafanya uchawi na uaguzi, na akataka shauri kwa wapiga ramli na kwa mizimu. Akafanya maovu mengi sana machoni mwa Bwana na kumghadhibisha.
Ekegusii: Agasamba omwana oye omomura akamokora ekeng'wanso; akaba ogokora oborogi na oboragori, na akabooria ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y'abanto bakwete, na akenaria oborogi bonde. Agakora amabe amange ase obosio bw'Omonene, akamogechia goika akaba nendamwamu.

English: If she doesn't please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
Kiswahili: Kama hakumpendeza bwana wake aliyemchagua, huyo bwana atamwacha akombolewe. Hatakuwa na haki ya kumuuza kwa wageni, kwa sababu huyo bwana atakuwa amekosa uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Onye omoiseke oyio tagwenereti omonene oye, oyorengereretie komokora abe mokaye, rirorio nigo araboorigwe airane. Omonene oye takoba ne ribaga komoonia ase egesaku ekegeni, ekiagera among'ainete.

English: The hand of the diligent will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.
Kiswahili: Mikono yenye bidii itatawala, bali uvivu huishia katika kazi za utumwa.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto omonyamokia ’nkogambe, korende oyore omworo nabetererigwe akore emeremo y’obosomba.

English: For Yahweh says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana analoniambia: “Kama vile simba angurumavyo, simba mkubwa juu ya mawindo yake: hata ingawa kundi lote la wachunga mifugo huitwa pamoja dhidi yake, hatiwi hofu na kelele zao wala kusumbuliwa na ghasia zao; ndivyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakavyoshuka kufanya vita juu ya Mlima Sayuni na juu ya vilele vyake.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene antebetie; “Buna koreng'ana endo ensae ekoronya ase eng'iti yaitire, na teri kogoswa namariogi 'omoganda bw'abarisia, gose teri kwoboa egeturi kiabo, naboigo inche Omonene bw'Emeganda ndache korwana ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase ekegoro kiaye.

English: Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?” And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
Kiswahili: Yule binti akatoka nje, akaenda kumuuliza mama yake, “Niombe nini?” Mama yake akamjibu, “Omba kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji.”
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oria agasoka, akaboria ng’ina, “Inki ’ndasabe?” Ng’ina akamoiraneria, “Omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi.”

English: For your incorruptible spirit is in all things.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana roho yako isiyoharibika iko katika mambo yote.
Ekegusii: Omoika oo oyio otari gokwa nigo ore ase ebinto bionsi.

English: Do good to a godly man, and you will find a reward— if not from him, then from the Most High.
Kiswahili: Mtendee mema mtu mcha Mungu, nawe utapata thawabu - kama si kutoka kwake, basi kutoka kwa Aliye Juu Zaidi.
Ekegusii: Kora amaya ase omonto omoirogete Nyasae naye n'osesenigwe; naye n'otogigwe n'omonto oyio, gose n'Omonene.

English: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
Kiswahili: “Kwea katika mapangano ya Mlima Abarimu hadi kilima cha Nebo kilichoko Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yeriko, na uitazame Kanaani, nchi ninayowapa Waisraeli kama milki yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa bi'Abarimu, ase egetunwa kia Nebo, kere ase ense ya Moabu, kororia Yeriko, erio origererie ense ya Kaanani eyio ingochia koa Abaisraeli ebe eyabo.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose:
Ekegusii: Na Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: and the LORD did as Moses requested. He removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not one fly remained.
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akafanya lile Mose alilomwomba. Mainzi yakaondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake, wala hakuna hata inzi aliyebakia.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa ateebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.

English: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.
Kiswahili: Kisha akalisogeza mbele kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo, nao ukoo wa Matri ukachaguliwa. Mwishoni Sauli mwana wa Kishi akachaguliwa. Lakini walipomtafuta, hakuonekana.
Ekegusii: Ekero arentire egesaku gia Benjamini ang'e, obomera bokagwera eamate ya Matiri, na ase eamate ya Matiri obomera bokagwera Saulo, omomura o Kisi, korende Abanto bagachia komorigia tibamonyora.

English: So she set out and went to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her at a distance, he said to his servant Gehazi, “Look, there is the Shunammite woman.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaenda na kumfikia huyo mtu wa Mungu katika Mlima Karmeli. Alipomwona kwa mbali, huyo mtu wa Mungu akamwambia mtumishi wake Gehazi, “Tazama, yule Mshunami!
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agachaaka orogendo, agaika ase omonto oria o Nyasae, agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli. Ekero omonto oria o Nyasae aroche omokungu oria ogocha, agateebia Gehasi, omosomba oye “Rigereria gochia aaria, Omosunemu oria ogocha!

English: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh's house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh's house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Wakaldayo walivunja vipande zile nguzo za shaba, vile vishikilio vya shaba vilivyohamishika, na ile Bahari ya shaba, ambavyo vyote vilikuwa katika Hekalu la Bwana. Hivyo wakaichukua hiyo shaba na kuipeleka Babeli.
Ekegusii: Abakalidayo bakabuna chisiiro chi'etai chiria chiarenge ime ase enyomba y'Omonene, na ebibekerero bi'ebituba, na egetuba keria ekenene keroisirie korwa ase etai, ebiarenge ase enyomba y'Omonene, Kobabibunire, bikaba ebing'ese, bakaira chitaai chiria chionsi Babiloni.

English: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
Kiswahili: Nyamazeni mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi, kwa maana siku ya Bwana iko karibu. Bwana ameandaa dhabihu, amewaweka wakfu wale aliowaalika.
Ekegusii: Tegerera okire‐kiri ase obosio Omonene! Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e; Omonene bwariganirie ekeng’wanso, bwatananire abwo arangeirie ase ekegeni kiaye na abasesenie.

English: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
Kiswahili: Ninaomba pia kwamba macho ya mioyo yenu yatiwe nuru ili mpate kujua tumaini mliloitiwa, utajiri wa urithi wa utukufu wake kwa watakatifu
Ekegusii: naende ng'a amaiso ye chinkoro chiaino abekwe omobaso, erinde momanye ogosemeria koria abarangereretie monyore, na komanya obonda bw'obonene bw'omwando oye buna bore, obo abachenu baeirwe.

English: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Noa waliotoka ndani ya safina ni: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi. (Hamu ndiye alikuwa baba wa Kanaani.)
Ekegusii: Abana ba Nuhu abarwete ase obwato nabwo aba: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Hamu nere ise Kaanani.

English: “This is what the LORD says: If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time,
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Ikiwa mtaweza kuvunja agano langu kuhusu usiku na mchana, ili usiku na mchana visiwepo kwa nyakati zake,
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Nakorete okobwatana kwane igoro y’omobaso na obotuko, erinde bibe bikororekana ase chingaki chiabo chichikiire, na okobwatana okwo tikogosareka.

English: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akamwambia Akishi, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni pako, unipe sehemu katika mojawapo ya miji katika nchi nikae huko. Kwa nini mtumwa wako akae pamoja nawe katika mji huu wa kifalme?”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Akisi: “Onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche ong'e aase nkomenya ase omochie ore isiko korwa ase omochie oo. Tari buya ase 'nde, omosomba oo, ngenderere komenya ase omochie omonene bw'oborwoti amo naye?”

English: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Pia Bwana atakuletea kila aina ya ugonjwa na maafa ambayo hayakuandikwa humu katika kitabu hiki cha sheria, mpaka utakapokuwa umeangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabarentere amarwaire ao ao, na emechando eyio etariikiri ase egetabu eke y’amachiiko, goika inwe mosirigwe kegima.

English: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi watapiga mahema yao kuzunguka Maskani ya Ushuhuda ili ghadhabu isiipate jumuiya ya Waisraeli. Walawi watawajibika kwa utunzaji wa Maskani ya Ushuhuda.”
Ekegusii: Korende Abalawi nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chietanane Obomenyo obwo bore noborori, na komenyao, erinde endamwamu yane etangwe tebaisa kogwera omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli. Abalawi barende Obomenyo obwo bore noborori.”

English: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”
Kiswahili: Atafia huko mahali walipompeleka kuwa mateka; hataiona tena nchi hii.”
Ekegusii: korende aase airetwe obosomba, nao arakwere, gose takoirana gocha aa ase ense ayerore naende.”

English: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia emesa ye chibao chi'emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw'ekerengo ki'amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng'ese.

English: “Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”
Kiswahili: “Tuulizie sasa kwa Bwana, kwa sababu Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli anatushambulia. Labda Bwana atatenda maajabu kwa ajili yetu kama nyakati zilizopita, ili Nebukadneza atuondokee.”
Ekegusii: “Gaki kwana n'Omonene ribaga riaito, ekiagera Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, ngocha are gotorwania esegi; ande Omonene nabo arabaise gotokorera amakumia aye, erinde omorwoti oyio atotige tatorwania.”

English: Let those who dwell near Zion come and remember the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting has brought upon them.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaoishi karibu na Sayuni waje wakumbuke utumwa wa wana na binti zangu, ambao Mwenyezi-Mungu wa Milele amewaletea.
Ekegusii: Inwe abaamate ba Siyoni inchuo morore buna Nyasae o kare na kare atomire abana bane gochia obosomba.

English: Don't you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
Kiswahili: Hamjui kwamba tutawahukumu malaika? Je, si zaidi mambo ya maisha haya?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng'a ntogambie abamalaika? Tari kobua mono amang'ana 'obogima obo?

English: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house, will go into captivity. You will go to Babylon, and there you will die and be buried—you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied these lies.’” Jeremiah’s Complaint
Kiswahili: Nawe Pashuri pamoja na wote waishio katika nyumba yako mtakwenda uhamishoni Babeli. Mtafia humo na kuzikwa, wewe na rafiki zako wote ambao umewatabiria uongo.’ ” Malalamiko Ya Yeremia
Ekegusii: Aye Pasuri, na abanto bonsi bamenyete ase enka yao, namwoswe, moirwe ase obosomba. Aye noirwe Babiloni, nokwereo na otindekweo, aye amo nabasani bao bonsi, abwo kwabeire gokobaanera amang’ana ’oborimo.” Yeremia okwemurungania ase Omonene

English: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe hungekuwa na mamlaka yoyote juu yangu kama hungepewa kutoka juu. Kwa hiyo yeye aliyenitia mikononi mwako ana hatia ya dhambi iliyo kubwa zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”

English: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, tuokoe kutoka mkononi mwake, ili falme zote duniani zipate kujua kwamba wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, ndiwe Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie, nagosoroire totoorie korwa ase okoboko kwaye, erio amarwoti onsi ay'ense amanye ng'a aye Omonene, naye bweka ore Nyasae.”

English: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph son of Deuel.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli.

English: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don't see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Nimekuja ulimwenguni humu kwa ajili ya kuhukumu, ili wale walio vipofu wapate kuona, nao wale wanaoona, wawe vipofu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekiina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”

English: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD, the God of Hosts, has declared: “I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels, so I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenyezi ameapa kwa nafsi yake mwenyewe: Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema: “Nachukia kiburi cha Yakobo, nachukia ngome zake; nitautoa mji wao na kila kitu kilichomo ndani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteeba iga: “Inche Omonene netianirie ngoteeba: Nigo ngechirie noboenenu bw’ abanto ba Yakobo, na nigo ngechete chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u. Ase ayio nintige omochie osirigwe amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo.”

English: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo umesimikwa katika kiti cha enzi kama Uliye Mtakatifu; wewe ni sifa ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omochenu; obonene nobwao, naye ogotogigwa n'Abaisraeli.

English: Righteous lips are a king’s delight, and he who speaks honestly is beloved.
Kiswahili: Wafalme hufurahia midomo ya uaminifu; humthamini mtu asemaye kweli.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana amaronge agokwanwa nigo akogokia omorwoti, nere nigo abanchete abwo bagokwana oboronge.

English: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.
Kiswahili: Kichwa chake ni dhahabu safi kuliko zote, nywele zake ni za mawimbi na ni nyeusi kama kunguru.
Ekegusii: Omotwe oye nigo ore omuya onga etaabu echenire, etukia yaye nigo ere omosamugoku bw'obwari; nigo ere emwamu ti buna amarionya 'ekegonkoru.

English: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
Kiswahili: Napenda mfahamu kwamba kichwa cha kila mwanaume ni Kristo, na kichwa cha mwanamke ni mwanaume, nacho kichwa cha Kristo ni Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende nindigetie momanye ng'a Kristo nere omotwe o kera omosacha; na omosacha nere omotwe bw'omokuungu; na Nyasae nere omotwe o Kristo.

English: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
Kiswahili: Mji huu pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake utawekwa wakfu kwa Bwana. Ila Rahabu tu, yule kahaba na wote ambao wako pamoja naye nyumbani mwake ndio watakaosalimishwa, kwa sababu aliwaficha wale wapelelezi tuliowatuma.
Ekegusii: Omochie oyo oragererigwe, na ebinto bionsi ebire imeo biatananirwe ase Omonene. Rahabu bweka, omokungu oria omotayayi, amo nabaanto bare nyomba mwaye nabwo baratigare bare moyo, ekiagera ere abisete abanto baria twatomete koroota ense.

English: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa kaskazini, wekeni alama kuanzia Bahari ya Kati hadi mlima Hori,
Ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu 'ndochakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rogenderere gochia ase egetunwa kia Hori.

English: They shall observe these days in the month Adar, on the fourteenth and on the fifteenth day of the month, with an assembly, joy, and gladness before God, throughout the generations forever among his people Israel.
Kiswahili: Wataadhimisha siku hizi katika mwezi wa Adari, siku ya kumi na nne na siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi, pamoja na kusanyiko, furaha na shangwe mbele za Mungu, kwa vizazi vyote milele miongoni mwa watu wake Israeli.
Ekegusii: na ase bare amatuko aya, rituko ria ikomi na kane n'eria ikomi na gatano ase omotienyi bwa Adari, nigo are amatuko y'omosangerekano, y'omogoko n'omochengo ase Nyasae, goetera ase ebisaku bionsi na goika kare na kare ase abanto baye Israeli.

English: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ikiwa tumeungana naye katika mauti yake, bila shaka tutaungana naye katika ufufuo wake.
Ekegusii: Inaki onye twabwatanire nere ase amakweri buna ayaye, naboigo torabwatane nere ase okobokigwa buna ok'waye.

English: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.
Kiswahili: Nyama zao zitakuwa chakula chenu, kama ilivyokuwa kidari cha kuinuliwa na paja la mguu wa kulia.
Ekegusii: Korende chinyama chiabo amo ne ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama kia borio, echio nachio echiao.

English: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
Kiswahili: Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote, ipaze sauti kwa nyimbo za shangwe na vinanda;
Ekegusii: Aye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Omonene, tera ogoteera kw’omogooko na motogie ase amariogi amanene.

English: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
Kiswahili: Utatuhurumia tena, utazikanyaga dhambi zetu chini ya nyayo zako, na kutupa maovu yetu yote katika vilindi vya bahari.
Ekegusii: Aye notoiranere, otororere amaabera naende; notiringere ebibe biaito inse y’amagoro ao, nobitugute bionsi ime ase chindiba chi’enyancha.

English: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Amramu walikuwa: Aroni na Mose. Aroni waliwekwa wakfu, yeye na wazao wake milele, wawe wakiweka wakfu vitu ambavyo ni vitakatifu mno, kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, kuhudumu mbele zake na kutamka baraka katika Jina la Bwana milele.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b'Amuramu nabwo Aroni na Musa. Aroni agaatananwa koba oyochenegete mono kogenderera botambe. Ere amo nabamura baye babe bagosamba ubani ase obosio bw'Omonene na komokorera, naende babe bagosesenia ase erieta riaye botambe.

English: Indeed, the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, delivered from the day of wrath.
Kiswahili: kwamba mtu mwovu huepushwa kutoka siku ya maafa, kwamba huokolewa kutoka siku ya ghadhabu?
Ekegusii: ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?

English: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, hekaluni mwako tunatafakari upendo wako usiokoma.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

English: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
Kiswahili: Vinywa vyetu vilijaa kicheko, ndimi zetu zilijaa nyimbo za shangwe. Ndipo iliposemwa miongoni mwa mataifa, “Bwana amewatendea mambo makuu.”
Ekegusii: Erio emenwa yaito egaichorwa namaseko, ne chimeme chiaito chigatera as'omogooko. Erio abanto b'ebisaku bagateebania, “Omonene okoreire abanto abwo amang'ana amanene.”

English: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that Yahweh's ark had come into the camp.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti waliposikia makelele wakauliza, “Ni nini makelele haya yote katika kambi ya Waebrania?” Walipofahamu kuwa Sanduku la Bwana limekuja kambini,
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagachia koigwa amariogi aria agoakwa bakaboorania: “Ninki engencho y'ogoakwa kw'amariogi ayio amanene ase egetwori ki'Abaiberania?” Ekero banyorete amang'ana ng'a n'Esanduki y'Omonene yarentirwe ase egetwori,

English: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
Kiswahili: avue nguo alizokuwa amevaa alipotekwa. Baada ya kuishi nyumbani mwako na kumwombolezea baba yake na mama yake kwa mwezi mzima, ndipo utakapoweza kumwendea na kuwa mume wake naye atakuwa mke wako.
Ekegusii: Aonchoorerie chianga chiria abegete ekero oosetwe, na agenderere kobeera agwo enka y'omonto oyio, abe okoreera ise na ng'ina ase engaki y'omotienyi omogima. Magega yaye omonto oria amotware abe mokaaye.

English: Hadadezer sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates, and they came to Helam with Shobach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
Kiswahili: Hadadezeri akaagiza Waaramu walioletwa kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Frati, wakaenda Helamu pamoja na Shobaki jemadari wa jeshi la Hadadezeri akiwaongoza.
Ekegusii: Hadadeseri agatoma abanto barente Abasiiria abwo barenge moocha y’orooche rw’Eufarati. Barawo bagaacha Helamu, na Sobaki, omotang’ani bw’abarwani ba Hadadeseri, akabatang’ana.

English: Next he brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and there I saw the water trickling out from the south side.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akanitoa nje kupitia lango la kaskazini na kunizungusha mpaka kwenye lango la nje linaloelekea mashariki, nayo maji yalikuwa yakitiririka kutoka upande wa kusini.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agansokia isiko akang’eteria ase egeita gia isiko kiarochie sugusu, akang’etanania gochia ase egeita kiarochie moocha; aroro agwo ’nkarora amaache akorwa ensemo ya Irianyi y’egeita.

English: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
Kiswahili: “Nendeni, mkasimame Hekaluni mkawaambie watu maneno yote ya uzima huu mpya.”
Ekegusii: “Genda, motenene ase Hekalu ime, moteebie abanto bonsi amang'ana onsi igoro y'Obogima obo oboyia.”

English: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku zote 180 mfalme alionyesha utajiri mwingi wa ufalme wake, fahari na utukufu wa enzi yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe y'emetienyi etano nomo (6), omorwoti akaba okworokia abanto abwo obonda na obonene bw'oborwoti bwaye, obwo bw'ogosika okonene.

English: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
Kiswahili: niliwasikiliza kwa makini. Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyethibitisha kwamba Ayubu amekosa; hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyeweza kujibu hoja zake.
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo nabategererete mono, korende onde tarenge ase more obuete Ayubu, gose onde tanyarete koiraneria amang'ana aye.

English: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God. And all the people who saw this gave praise to God.
Kiswahili: Akapata kuona saa ile ile, akamfuata Yesu, huku akimsifu Mungu. Watu wote walipoona mambo hayo, nao wakamsifu Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, akamotunyana, okomotogia Nyasae; na abanto bonsi bagachia korora aya, bakamotogia Nyasae.

English: For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana mwenyewe ndiye aliifanya mioyo yao iwe migumu, ili kupigana vita dhidi ya Israeli ili apate kuwafutilia mbali pasipo huruma, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okong'etie chinkoro chiabo ng'a barwanie Abaisraeli, erinde barabwo abanyene basirigwe kegima batari kororerwa amaabera. Nab'Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.
Kiswahili: Hii itakuwa ni sehemu takatifu kwa ajili ya makuhani. Itakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa 25,000 upande wa kaskazini, upana wa dhiraa 10,000 upande wa magharibi, dhiraa 10,000 upande wa mashariki na urefu wa dhiraa 25,000 upande wa kusini. Katikati yake patakuwa mahali patakatifu pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abakuani mbanyore orogongo rwabo korwa ase orwo oroochenu. Orogongo rwabo nigo rorabe nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000) korwa moocha goika bosongo, na korwa sugusu goika Irianyi robe chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Aase aachenu a Omonene nigo arabe gati‐gati y'oboremo obwo.

English: You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.
Kiswahili: Utanunua ardhi kwa mzawa wa nchi yako kwa misingi ya hesabu ya miaka baada ya Yubile. Naye ataiuza kwako kwa misingi ya hesabu ya miaka iliyobaki kwa kuvuna mavuno.
Ekegusii: Koragore omogondo korwa ase omonto onde oakane omonto oria koreng’ana n’emiaka eyio etigarete aragese ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo otaraika.

English: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.'
Kiswahili: “Nami sasa nimekuja kusema hili kwa bwana wangu mfalme kwa sababu watu wameniogopesha. Mtumishi wako alifikiri, ‘Nitanena na mfalme, labda mfalme atamfanyia mtumishi wake kile anachoomba.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo naacha gokwana aya ase ore, aye omonene one, ekiagera abanto banyoboirie. Ase igo inche omokungu, omosomba oo, 'nkarengereria ng'a 'nkwane naye omorwoti. Ande aye nonkorere aya inche, omosomba oo, 'nkoboria.

English: as well as Gomer with all its troops, and Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.
Kiswahili: pia Gomeri pamoja na vikosi vyake vyote, na Beth-Togarma kutoka kaskazini ya mbali pamoja na vikosi vyake vyote, mataifa mengi wakiwa pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Gomeri amo n’omoganda oye bwonsi bw’eseegi, na egesaku gia Togarima kemenyete aare, ensemo ya sugusu, amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ee, abanto abange mbache amo naye.

English: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
Kiswahili: Wale sabini na wawili wakarudi kwa furaha, na kusema, “Bwana, hata pepo wachafu wanatutii kwa jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Baria emerongo etano na ebere na babere (72) bakairana nomogooko, bagateeba, “Omonene, nonya nebirecha biatoigwereire ase erieta riao.”

English: and you eat the food of the land, you shall lift up an offering to the LORD.
Kiswahili: nanyi mkala chakula cha nchi hiyo, toeni sehemu ya chakula hicho kama sadaka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: na mokoria endagera y’ense eria, morente okoruegwa kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.

English: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule na ushikwe na giza kuu; usihesabiwe katika siku za mwaka, wala usihesabiwe katika siku za mwezi wowote.
Ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima otube obotuko boria, tibobaisa kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay'omwaka, gose kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay'emetienyi.

English: They set loaves upon the table, hung up the curtains, and finished all the work which they had done.
Kiswahili: Wakaweka mikate mezani, wakatundika mapazia, na kumaliza kazi yote waliyoifanya.
Ekegusii: Bakabeka emegati emesa igoro, bakabeeka ebitamba biogotuba na gokora emeremo yonsi barabwo baroberetie gokora.

English: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
Kiswahili: Utalaaniwa uingiapo na utokapo.
Ekegusii: “Imoragererigwe ekero mogosoa inka, na ekero mokogeenda isiko.

English: So David did as the LORD had commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, naye akawaangusha Wafilisti njia yote kuanzia Geba hadi Gezeri.
Ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Omonene amoteebetie, agaita Abafirisiti korwa Geba goika Geseri.

English: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na ushindi uliompa, utukufu wake ni mkubwa, umeweka juu yake fahari na utukufu.
Ekegusii: Amasikani ’omorwoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.

English: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.'
Kiswahili: “Kisha miti ikauambia mtini, ‘Njoo na uwe mfalme wetu!'
Ekegusii: Erio emete egateebia omoko: Inchuo aye otogambere!

English: Moreover you haven't brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won't come up.”
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, hujatuingiza katika nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali, wala hujatupa urithi wa mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu. Je, utayangʼoa macho ya watu hawa? Hapana, sisi hatuji!”
Ekegusii: Naende nonya naboigo, aye totorenteti ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, gose totoeti emiando y'amaremo na emegondo y'emesabibu. Inee! Nigo otagete kobaukoria abanto aba bonsi? Intwe titogocha.”

English: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
Kiswahili: Kila Andiko limevuviwa na Mungu na lafaa kwa mafundisho, kwa kuwaonya watu makosa yao, kwa kuwaongoza na kwa kuwafundisha katika haki,
Ekegusii: Kera ririiko riutire n’Omoika o Nyasae, nario riranyare gotworokereria, na gotokuurera, na gotorongeyia, na gototang’ana ase oboronge,

English: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa wenye kiburi wanabarikiwa. Hakika watenda mabaya wanastawi, pia hata wale wanaoshindana na Mungu ndio wanaosalimika.’ ”
Ekegusii: Bono nigo tokoroka abwo bare abaenenu ng’a mbasesenirie. Abakori amabe nabwo bagendererete konyora amaya; tari ayio oka, korende nonya nekero bagoteema Nyasae nigo bagokonywa.”

English: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
Kiswahili: Tumejitolea kwa Misri na Ashuru tupate chakula cha kutosha.
Ekegusii: Twaramboreire Abamisiri na Abaasuri amaboko batoe endagera egotoisana.

English: Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana atakatilia mbali kutoka Israeli kichwa na mkia, tawi la mtende na tete katika siku moja.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ase rituko erimo rioka Omonene nanache omotwe bw'Abaisraeli na ekemincha, boigo nanache orosagia rw'omokendo na esaka.

English: Better is a poor man who is healthy and fit, than a rich man who is afflicted in his body.
Kiswahili: Afadhali maskini mwenye afya njema na mwili mzuri, kuliko tajiri mwenye shida mwilini mwake.
Ekegusii: Mbuya koba omotaka, korende kore n'obuya bw'omobere n'echinguru, kobua koba omotenenku korende ochandegete n'amarwaire ase omobere oye.

English: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Sodoma, mfalme wa Gomora, mfalme wa Adma, mfalme wa Seboimu, na mfalme wa Bela (yaani Soari) wakatoka kupanga majeshi yao kwenye Bonde la Sidimu
Ekegusii: Agwo omorwoti o Sodomu, na oyo o Gomora, na oyo bw'Adima, na oyo o Seboimu, na oyo o Bela, noro Soari, bakageenda, bakabwatarena korwana esegi ase ense omweya ya Sidimu,

English: If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without blemish as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta amefanya dhambi na kuwaletea watu hatia, lazima alete kwa Bwana fahali mchanga asiye na dosari, kuwa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya dhambi aliyotenda.
Ekegusii: “Onye Omokuani oyoakire amaguta ogokora ebibe, na igo arentere abanto bonsi okomocha, goika arue eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire, ayerue ase ’nde ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.

English: And Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, “Why do you come out and array yourselves for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not servants of Saul? Choose one of your men and have him come down against me.
Kiswahili: Goliathi alisimama na kuwapigia kelele majeshi ya Israeli, akisema, “Kwa nini mmetoka kupanga vita? Je, mimi si Mfilisti, na ninyi ni watumishi wa Sauli? Chagueni mtu na anishukie mimi.
Ekegusii: Goliato agacha bosio, agaaka eriogi ase abarwani b’Abaisraeli, akabora: “Nase ki mwachire na korobera ase okorwana esegi? Inee! Inche tindi Omofilisti, nainwe nabasomba ba Saulo? Chora omonto oyomo oino ache aa ase ’nde.

English: I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. Their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
Kiswahili: nitawatia mikononi mwa adui zao wanaotafuta uhai wao. Maiti zao zitakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na wanyama wa nchi.
Ekegusii: nimbabeeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo na ase amaboko ’abaanto bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo. Nabaitwe bakwe, na emebere yabo ebe endagera ye chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana.

English: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.
Kiswahili: Ole ya pili imekwisha kupita, tazama ole ya tatu inakuja upesi.
Ekegusii: Obobe bwa kabere bwaetire, rora, obobe bwa gatato ngocha bore bwango.

English: For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyeumba mbingu, ndiye Mungu; yeye aliyeifanya dunia na kuiumba, yeye ndiye aliiwekea misingi imara, hakuiumba ili iwe tupu, bali aliiumba ikaliwe na viumbe vyake. Anasema: “Mimi ndimi Bwana, wala hakuna mwingine.
Ekegusii: Omonene oyio otongete igoro chionsi, nere Nyasae, nere otongete ense akayebeeka oboroso obokong’u. Tayetongete ng’a ebe bosa, nigo ayetongete emenywe. Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Inche ninche Omonene, nyasae ende teiyo.

English: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni, enyi watu wangu, nami nitasema, ee Israeli, nami nitashuhudia dhidi yenu: Mimi ndimi Mungu, Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, tegerera moigwe, inche nkwane! Inwe Abaisraeli, inche nimbe nkorua oborori bore mamincha yaino. Inche Nyasae inde Nyasae oino.

English: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.'
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kutoka Yerusalemu watakuja mabaki, na kutoka Mlima Sayuni kundi la walionusurika. Wivu wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ndio utatimiza jambo hili.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa Yerusalemu, na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, ekeombe ki'abaanto baratooreke. Risemi ri'Omonene bw'Emeganda ndiikeranie amang'ana ayio.

English: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
Kiswahili: Chukueni fedha mara mbili, kwa kuwa mtazirudisha zile fedha zilizowekwa midomoni mwa magunia yenu. Labda ziliwekwa kwa makosa.
Ekegusii: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y'endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.

English: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
Kiswahili: Adamu alipokuwa ameishi miaka 130, alikuwa na mwana aliyekuwa na sura yake, mwenye kufanana naye. Akamwita Sethi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Adamu konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etato (130), akaba ise bw’omwana omomura omobwekaine, ore ekieni kiaye ere omonyene, akamoroka Seti.

English: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
Kiswahili: Hakuna askari yeyote ambaye akiwa vitani hujishughulisha na mambo ya kawaida ya maisha haya kwa sababu nia yake ni kumpendeza yule aliyemwandika awe askari.
Ekegusii: Morwani onde tari, oyokogeenda ase esegi, orebeke ase amang'ana ande onsi y'ense eye, erinde amogwenere ere oyomoriigete.

English: So the king prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. And the Aramean raiders did not come into the land of Israel again. The Siege and Famine of Samaria
Kiswahili: Basi akawaandalia karamu kubwa, na baada ya kula na kunywa, akawaaga nao wakarudi kwa bwana wao. Hivyo, vikosi kutoka Aramu vikakoma kuvamia nchi ya Israeli. Njaa Katika Samaria Iliyozingirwa
Ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti akabaroiseria omoyega omonene, na ekero bakoorire koria na konywa, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda ase omonene obo. Abasiiria baria tibairanete naende nebiombe biabo korwania Abaisraeli. Okonaarigwa gwa Samaria

English: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliye Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Mbele ya macho yako na katika siku zako, nitakomesha sauti zote za shangwe na za furaha, na pia sauti za bibi arusi na bwana arusi mahali hapa.’
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Ase engaki yaino ekero morigereretie ninsirie eriogi ri’omogooko, na erie chigosori, na eri’omonywomi, na eri’omoriakari.

English: and she put it in her bag of food. They both went out together to prayer, according to their custom. They passed through the camp, circled around that valley, and went up to the mountain of Bethulia, and came to its gates.
Kiswahili: Akaiweka kwenye mfuko wake wa chakula. Wote wawili walitoka pamoja kusali, kama ilivyokuwa desturi yao. Walipita kambini, wakazunguka bonde hilo, wakapanda mlima wa Bethulia, wakafika kwenye malango yake.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oria akayobeeka ime ye egunia yendagera. Erio Yuditi na omoiseke oria bagasoka, buna yarenge engencho yaabo kogenda gosaba. Bagaetera ase enchera yegetwori kia Abaashuru, bagaeta ime yerikura na koriina egetunwa goika ang'e negesieri kiegesieri kiomochie o Bethulia.

English: Blessed are you in the firmament of heaven, to be praised and glorified forever!
Kiswahili: Umebarikiwa katika anga la mbinguni, upate kusifiwa na kutukuzwa milele!
Ekegusii: Mosesenie Nyasae Omonene inwe ebitongwa bi'Omonene: motogie na komoa obonene bwao kare na kare.

English: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
Kiswahili: Wakati huyo mtu Elikana alipanda pamoja na jamaa yake yote kutoa dhabihu ya mwaka kwa Bwana na kutimiza nadhiri yake,
Ekegusii: Elikana amo na'baanto b'enka yaye bakagenda naende koruera Omonene ekeng'wanso gia kera omwaka na goikerania eira bariete.

English: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini mwaonaje? Mtu mmoja alikuwa na wana wawili. Akamwendea yule wa kwanza akamwambia, ‘Mwanangu, nenda ukafanye kazi kwenye shamba la mizabibu leo.’
Ekegusii: “Inaki morooche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: Omwana one, genda reero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

English: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
Kiswahili: Nimemwona Daudi, mtumishi wangu, na nimemtia mafuta yangu matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nanyorire Daudi, omosomba one, namoakire amaguta aane amaachenu ase okomwatanana ase ’nde.

English: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Israel, to give blessing to the Lord with his lips, and to glory in his name.
Kiswahili: Kisha akashuka, akainua mikono yake juu ya mkutano wote wa wana wa Israeli, kumshukuru Bwana kwa midomo yake, na kulitukuza jina lake.
Ekegusii: Sioni akarua aroro, akaimokereria amaboko aye igoro ase omosangererekano bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli, erio koraria ogosesenigwa kw'Omonene korwa ase omonwa oye omonyene, na korimokereria erieta riaye igoro.

English: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Esau (ambaye ni Edomu) aliishi katika nchi ya kilima huko Seiri.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Esau, oyokorokwa naende Edomu, akaba okomenya ase ense y'ebitunwa bia Edomu.

English: Still having breath within him, and being inflamed with anger, he rose up, and though his blood gushed out in streams and his wounds were grievous, he ran through the crowds, and standing upon a steep rock,
Kiswahili: Akiwa bado ana pumzi ndani yake, na akiwa amewaka hasira, aliinuka, na ingawa damu yake ilimwagika kwenye vijito na majeraha yake yalikuwa mabaya, alikimbia katikati ya umati wa watu, na kusimama juu ya mwamba mkali,
Ekegusii: Ekero konya atarakwa are n'obororo, Razi akaimoka ore n'amanyinga ayio arenge goiteka korwa ase aria ebetete omoro, akaminyoka gati gati y'abanto akariina egetare ekenene igoro agatenena.

English: From there they moved on and camped on the other side of the Arnon, in the wilderness that extends into the Amorite territory. Now the Arnon is the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Wakasafiri kutoka hapo na kupiga kambi kando ya Mto Arnoni, ambao uko katika jangwa lililoenea hadi nchi ya Waamori. Arnoni ni mpaka wa Moabu, kati ya Moabu na Waamori.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakageenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.

English: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.
Kiswahili: Mataifa mtakayowafukuza husikiliza wale wafanyao ulozi na uaguzi. Lakini kwenu ninyi, Bwana Mungu wenu hajawaruhusu kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Naende Musa agateeba, “Abanto b'ebisaku ebio mogochia goseeria nigo bakoigwera abarogi na abariori, korende inwe Omonene Nyasae oino, obakaanirie ng'a timobaisa gokora ebinto ebio.

English: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
Kiswahili: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

English: Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead, including the territories of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. There was also one governor in the land of Judah. Solomon’s Prosperity
Kiswahili: Geberi mwana wa Uri: katika Gileadi (nchi ya Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori na nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani). Naye alikuwa ndiye mtawala pekee katika eneo hilo. Mahitaji Ya Solomoni Ya Kila Siku
Ekegusii: Geberi, mosinto bwa Uri, agatenenera ense ya Gileadi yareenge kogamberwa na Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Nigo areenge omoteneneri oyomo bweka ase ense eyio yonsi. Obogaambi bwa Sulemani bogosesenigwa

English: As you don't know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don't know the work of God who does all.
Kiswahili: Kama vile usivyofahamu njia ya upepo, au jinsi mwili uumbwavyo ndani ya tumbo la mama, vivyo hivyo huwezi kufahamu kazi ya Mungu, Muumba wa vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: Buna otamanyeti ase embeo ekogusa gochia, gose buna amauga 'omwana ore ase enda ya ng'ina agokina, naboigo tokonyara komanya emeremo ya Nyasae oyio ogokora amang'ana onsi.

English: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
Kiswahili: Furahini na kushangilia kwa maana thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo walivyowatesa manabii waliokuwa kabla yenu.
Ekegusii: Goka na gochenga, ekiagera eng'eria yaino n'enene igoro. Inaki naboigo bachaandete ababani abarengeo ritang'ani konya motarabao.

English: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.
Kiswahili: Muda zaidi kidogo ya mwaka mmoja, ninyi mnaojisikia salama mtatetemeka, mavuno ya zabibu yatakoma na mavuno ya matunda hayatakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, ekero amatuko aetanetie omwaka aerire mobe mogochandeka, ekiagera emesabibu tekwama, ne rigesa rie chindagera tirikoba.

English: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
Kiswahili: wakawaambia Mose na Aroni, “Bwana na awaangalie awahukumu ninyi! Mmetufanya tunuke kwa Farao na maafisa wake, nanyi mmeweka upanga mikononi mwao ili kutuua sisi.”
Ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekiina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba chindoso ase obosio bwa Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwabaeire engencho yogotoita.”

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers and with all your detestable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa kuwa umemwaga tamaa zako na kuonyesha uchi wako katika uzinzi wako kwa wapenzi wako na kwa sababu ya sanamu zako zote za machukizo na kwa sababu uliwapa damu ya watoto wako,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Obosooku bwao bwaorokigwe isiko, na obogetirianda bwao tibotubiri ekero ogokora obonyaka nabanchi bao. Naende nigo gwasasimete emegwekano yao y’okogechia na okarua abana bao bakaba ekeng’wanso ase emegwekano eyio.

English: Josiah, however, did not turn away from him; instead, in order to engage him in battle, he disguised himself. He did not listen to Neco’s words from the mouth of God, but went to fight him on the Plain of Megiddo.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata hivyo, Yosia hakukubali kumwacha, bali alijibadilisha ili kupigana naye vita. Hakusikiliza yale Neko aliyokuwa amemwambia kwa agizo la Mungu bali alikwenda kupigana naye katika tambarare ya Megido.
Ekegusii: Korende Yosia tanchete koonchoka korwa ase Neko. Agekona ase ogwetuba ng’a tamanyekana, akagenda korwana na Neko agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido, taigwete amang’ana aye ayaruete ase Nyasae.

English: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
Kiswahili: Naam, ninyi ndio fahari yetu na furaha yetu.
Ekegusii: Ee, inwe nobonene bwaito, na omogooko oito.

English: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, watu waliondoka Haserothi, wakapiga kambi katika Jangwa la Parani.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio abanto bakaimoka kogeenda korwa ase Haseroti, bagaika ase erooro ya Parani, bagatoora aroro.

English: “I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.”
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wavulana wawe maafisa wao, watoto ndio watakaowatawala.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabeeke abasae babe abanene babo, na abana abake baabagambere.

English: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the city will be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.
Kiswahili: “Siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “wakati mji huu utajengwa upya kwa ajili yangu, kuanzia mnara wa Hananeli hadi Lango la Pembeni.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero omochie oria oraagachwe naende ase 'nde, gochakera ase Omorobiri o Hananeli goikera ase Egeita gi'Ekoona.

English: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha tano kwa mwezi wa tano alikuwa Shamhuthi Mwizrahi. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw'ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw'ekeombe ki'omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: Catch for us the foxes— the little foxes that ruin the vineyards— for our vineyards are in bloom. The Bride
Kiswahili: Tukamatie mbweha, mbweha wale wadogo wanaoharibu mashamba ya mizabibu, mashamba yetu ya mizabibu yaliyochanua. Mpendwa
Ekegusii: Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete. (Omoriakari)

English: Solomon made 70,000 of them porters, 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors.
Kiswahili: Akawaweka watu 70,000 miongoni mwao kuwa wachukuzi wa mizigo, na 80,000 kuwa wachonga mawe vilimani, na 3,600 wakiwa wasimamizi juu yao ili wawahimize watu kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Akabeka abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bakaba bakobogoria chigurube, ne chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) bakaba bakobaacha amagena ase ebitunwa, ne chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600) bakaba bagotebereria abanto bakore emeremo.

English: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametukuka, kwa kuwa anakaa mahali palipoinuka, ataijaza Sayuni kwa haki na uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aimokererete igoro, ekiagera nigo amenyete igoro mono; naichorie Sayoni nekeene na oboronge.

English: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
Kiswahili: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Intoorie n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya ’nkogosaba.

English: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu nyingine kwa Mungu, naye Aroni pamoja na wazee wote wa Israeli wakaja kula chakula pamoja na baba mkwe wa Mose mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio Jethiro ise biara Musa akamoruera Nyasae ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa na ebing'wanso binde bi'okonyenywa. Aroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo nere, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: But when our time there had ended, we set out on our journey. All the disciples, with their wives and children, accompanied us out of the city and knelt down on the beach to pray with us.
Kiswahili: Lakini muda wetu ulipokwisha, tukaondoka tukaendelea na safari yetu. Wale wanafunzi pamoja na wake zao na watoto wakatusindikiza hadi nje ya mji. Wote tukapiga magoti pale pwani tukaomba.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aito achia koera, tokaimoka, tokagenda ase orogendo rwaito; na abwo bonsi, na abakungu babo, na abana, bagatokooba goika isiko y’omochie; togatung’ama ase engegu y’enyancha, togasaba.

English: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
Kiswahili: Matendo yenu mabaya yamezuia haya yote, dhambi zenu zimewazuia msipate mema.
Ekegusii: Na bono amamocho aino abatangire timonyora ebinto ebio, na ebibe biaino biatangire ebinto ebiya mwarenge gocha koegwa.

English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife. It is your father's nakedness.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mke wa baba yako; hiyo itamvunjia heshima baba yako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na nyoko moke, moga iso. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku.

English: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.
Kiswahili: pamoja na baraka nzuri mno za ardhi na ukamilifu wake, na upendeleo wake yeye aliyeishi kwenye kichaka kilichokuwa kinawaka moto. Hivi vyote na vikae juu ya kichwa cha Yosefu, juu ya paji la uso la aliye mkuu miongoni mwa ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Abae ebinto ebiya korwa ase riroba, na ebiichire ime yaye, amo n’ogwancherwa gokorwa ase are ere oyobweorokereretie ase egetutu keria. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe igoro y’Abayusufu, ekiagera Yusufu nigo achooretwe akaba omogambi ase egati y’abaamwabo.

English: And the ten horns are ten kings who will rise from this kingdom. After them another king, different from the earlier ones, will rise and subdue three kings.
Kiswahili: Zile pembe kumi ni wafalme kumi watakaotokana na ufalme huu. Baada yao mfalme mwingine atainuka, ambaye atakuwa tofauti na wale waliotangulia, naye atawaangusha wafalme watatu.
Ekegusii: Ching’unchara chiria ikomi, abwo nabarwoti ikomi baraoroke, na magega yabo omorwoti onde naoroke. Ere nigo arabe nogwatananekana korwa ase abwo bamotang’anerete, nabue abarwoti batato.

English: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
Kiswahili: “Mimi, naam mimi, ndimi nizifutaye dhambi zako, kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, wala sizikumbuki dhambi zako tena.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche bweka ngotinyia ogosaria kwao, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na tinkoinyora ebibe biao.

English: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”
Kiswahili: Yonathani akajibu, “La hasha! Hutakufa! Tazama, baba yangu hafanyi kitu chochote, kikubwa au kidogo, bila kuniambia mimi. Kwa nini anifiche hili? Sivyo ilivyo!”
Ekegusii: Yonathani akamoiraneria, “Taibo, togokwa. Tata tari gokora gento kende gionsi, ekenene gose egeke, atantebeti. Nase ki tata arambise ring'ana erio, tamanyia? Ayio takoba bo.”

English: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
Kiswahili: Rehoboamu akaenda Shekemu, kwa kuwa Waisraeli wote walikuwa wamekwenda huko kumfanya yeye kuwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Rehoboamu akagenda Sekemu, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi konya bachiire aroro komobeka abe omorwoti.

English: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
Kiswahili: Wale wanenao kwa ajili yao wenyewe hufanya hivyo kwa kutaka utukufu wao wenyewe. Lakini yeye atafutaye utukufu wa yule aliyemtuma ni wa kweli, wala hakuna uongo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw'oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw'ekeene, na asare obong'ainereria tiboiyo.

English: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umeniokoa toka kwenye mauti na miguu yangu kwenye kujikwaa, ili niweze kuenenda mbele za Mungu katika nuru ya uzima.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.

English: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani wa Wayahudi wakapinga, wakamwambia Pilato, “Usiandike ‘Mfalme wa Wayahudi,’ bali andika kwamba mtu huyu alisema yeye ni mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagateebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomorwoti bw’Abayahudi.”

English: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.'”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wametenda uovu machoni pangu na kunighadhibisha tangu siku baba zao walipotoka Misri mpaka siku ya leo.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera bakorire ayare amabe ase obosio bwane, na botambe nigo kongechiagwa nabeire nendamwamu, korwa ase amatuko aria chisokoro chiabo chiarwete Misiri goika reero iga.”

English: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
Kiswahili: Ardhi iko aje? Ina rutuba au la? Je, kuna miti ndani yake au la? Jitahidini kadiri mwezavyo kuleta baadhi ya matunda ya nchi.” (Ulikuwa msimu wa kuiva zabibu za kwanza.)
Ekegusii: Morigererie gose riroba ndire nobotobu gose neritaka, naende gose emete nereo, gose teiyo. Mobe abaremu, morentane okwama kw’amatunda gw’ense eria.” (Engaki eria nigo yarenge ekero emesabibu konya yamire ase ogotongorwa.)

English: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
Kiswahili: wa jamaa ya Harimu, Adna; wa jamaa ya Meremothi, Helkai;
Ekegusii: Adina ase eamate ya Harimu, na Helikai ase eamate ya Merayoti;

English: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
Kiswahili: Uliumba kaskazini na kusini; Tabori na Hermoni wanaliimbia jina lako kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Naye gwatongete sugusu na Irianyi; egetunwa gia Tabori, na ekia Herimoni, nigo bigotogia erieta riao nomogooko.

English: Then he turned around, looked at them, and called down a curse on them in the name of the LORD. Suddenly two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.
Kiswahili: Akageuka, akawatazama na kuwalaani kwa Jina la Bwana. Kisha dubu wawili wa kike wakatokea mwituni na kuwararua vijana arobaini na wawili miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Elisha akeonchora, na ekero abaroche, akabaragereria ase erieta ri’Omonene; ne chidubu ibere chiaberi chikarwa ase rinani, chigatandora abana baria abamura emerongo ene, na babere.

English: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa ni wenye kunungʼunika na wenye kutafuta makosa; wao hufuata tamaa zao mbaya, hujisifu kwa maneno makuu kuhusu wao wenyewe na kuwasifu mno watu wenye vyeo kwa ajili ya kujipatia faida.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare abemurungania na abereri, kobagotunyana okogania kwabo okobe, na emenwa yabo ekwana amang'ana 'oboenenu amanene mono, bagotogia abanto ase engencho y'okwenyorera.

English: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
Kiswahili: “Kama siku zile mlipotoka Misri, nitawaonyesha maajabu yangu.”
Ekegusii: “Nimborokie amakumia buna nakorete ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: Meanwhile, many people continued to testify that they had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwepo wakati Yesu alipomwita Lazaro kutoka kaburini na kumfufua kutoka kwa wafu, waliendelea kushuhudia.
Ekegusii: Nabo omoganda bw’abaanto abwo barenge amo nere ekero arangeretie Lazaro korwa ase embeera ime, na komobokia, bakaba bakomoorokia.

English: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye anayeamini anao uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ere oyonyegenete inche nare nobogima bwa kare na kare.

English: On that day the number of those killed in the citadel of Susa was reported to the king,
Kiswahili: Mfalme aliarifiwa siku iyo hiyo hesabu ya waliouawa katika ngome ya Shushani.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio omorwoti akarenterwa omobaro bw’abaitetwe aria Susa, omochie omonene,

English: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.
Kiswahili: Shimei akamjibu mfalme, “Ulilolisema ni jema. Mtumishi wako atatenda kama bwana wangu mfalme alivyosema.” Naye Shimei akakaa Yerusalemu kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Simei agateebia omorwoti: “Egento gwateebire nekiya; buna aye omonene one omorwoti gwateebire, naboigo inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Ase ayio, Simei akamenya ase Yerusalemu amatuko amange.

English: Your nakedness will be uncovered and your shame will be exposed. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one.”
Kiswahili: Uchi wako utafunuliwa na aibu yako itaonekana. Nitalipa kisasi; sitamhurumia hata mmoja.”
Ekegusii: Obogetirianda bwao tibogotubwa, na obosooku bwao mbororekane. Nindusie egesiomba na tinkororera nonya noyomo amaabera.”

English: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
Kiswahili: Chukueni fedha mara mbili, kwa kuwa mtazirudisha zile fedha zilizowekwa midomoni mwa magunia yenu. Labda ziliwekwa kwa makosa.
Ekegusii: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.

English: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
Kiswahili: kwa maana ufalme ni wa Bwana naye hutawala juu ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omogambi Omonene, nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku bionsi.

English: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
Kiswahili: Siku ile watu wakaingia mjini kimya kama vile waingiavyo kwa aibu watu waliokimbia kutoka vitani.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria abanto bakaba bagochoba gosoa ase omochie ime buna abanto bagotama korwa ase esegi bare nobosooku ase engencho y'ayio.

English: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn't find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu katika ule umati wakapiga kelele, hawa wakisema hili na wengine lile. Yule jemadari alipoona kuwa hawezi kupata hakika ya habari kwa sababu ya zile kelele, akaamuru Paulo apelekwe katika ngome ya jeshi.
Ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagaaka eriogi bagoteeba iga, na abande iga. Ekero atanyarete komanya oboronge bw'amang'ana aria ase engencho y'egeturi keria, agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba y'abarwani.

English: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
Kiswahili: Aliwaambia, “Je, mnamjua Labani, mjukuu wa Nahori?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, tunamfahamu.”
Ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Inee! Momanyete Labani, mochokoro o Nahori?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Ee, ntomomanyete.”

English: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
Kiswahili: Basi Pilato akawaita pamoja viongozi wa makuhani, viongozi wengine na watu,
Ekegusii: Pilato akarangeria amo abakuani abanene, na abagaambi, na abanto,

English: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
Kiswahili: “Lakini wewe, Bethlehemu Efrathi, ingawa u mdogo miongoni mwa koo za Yuda, kutoka kwako atatokea kwa ajili yangu yeye atakayekuwa mtawala katika Israeli, ambaye asili yake ni kutoka zamani, kutoka milele.”
Ekegusii: “Korende aye Bethlehemu Efarata, aye ore omoke ase egati ye chiamate chi'egesaku ki'Abayuda, korwa asore nang'orokere oyomo orabe omogambi bw'Abaisraeli. Oyio nao arenge korwa agwo kare, ee, korwa kare na kare.”

English: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”
Kiswahili: Sasa tafadhali isikilize sauti ya mtumishi wako, uniruhusu nikupatie chakula kidogo ule ili uwe na nguvu za kurejea ulikotoka.”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono koranche inyigwe inche omosomba oo omokungu, tiga nkorentere endagera orie, erinde onyore chinguru, ogenderere norogendo rwao.”

English: Whoever doesn't bear his own cross and come after me, can't be my disciple.
Kiswahili: Yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Naende monto onde bwensi otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.

English: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.
Kiswahili: Basi yule nabii mzee akachukua maiti ya mtu wa Mungu, akailaza juu ya punda na akairudisha katika mji wake, ili amwombolezee na kumzika.
Ekegusii: Omobani oria akaimokia omobere oria bw'omonto o Nyasae, akayobeeka ase etigere igoro, erio akayoirania gochia ase omochie oye omonyene, akamoreera na akamotindeka.

English: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Hosts:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Isaya akamwambia Hezekia, “Sikia neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote:
Ekegusii: Erio Isaya agateebia Hezekia: “Bono igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda:

English: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
Kiswahili: Akafunika wale makerubi kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bonsi babere bakaoomwa netaabu.

English: he attacked the Jamnites at night, and set fire to the harbor together with the fleet, so that the glare of the light was seen at Jerusalem, two hundred forty furlongs distant.
Kiswahili: Aliwashambulia Wajamni usiku, na kuwasha moto bandari pamoja na meli, hivi kwamba mwangaza wa nuru ulionekana Yerusalemu, umbali wa maili mia mbili na arobaini.
Ekegusii: akaboera abanto ba Yamnia botuko, agasamba ekiambokero ebieri bi'omorero bikarorekana korwa Yerusalemu oboare bw'echikilomita 50.

English: This had been accomplished when the day was just dawning, because of the Lord's protection that gave Judas help.
Kiswahili: Hili lilitimizwa wakati siku ilipokuwa ikipambazuka tu, kwa sababu ya ulinzi wa Bwana uliompa Yuda msaada.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete magega botarakiamoka, na onsi nigo anyarekanete ase engencho Nyasae Omobui abarendete.

English: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Makuhani lazima washike maagizo yangu ili wasiwe na hatia, wakafa kwa kuyadharau. Mimi ndimi Bwana ninayewafanya watakatifu.
Ekegusii: “Abakuani bonsi goika barende amang'ana aya nachiikire. Batayabwateti, nababe abakori ebibe ase ayio, na barabwo mbakwe, ekiagera bagosaria aya nachiikire. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.

English: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,
Kiswahili: Kisha Esta alituma jibu hili kwa Mordekai:
Ekegusii: Naende Esiteri akabatoma ase Moredekai bamoiranerie,

English: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you dwell near us. How can we make a treaty with you?”
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa Israeli wakawaambia hao Wahivi, “Lakini huenda mnakaa karibu nasi, twawezaje basi kufanya mapatano nanyi?”
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagateebia Abahivi baria, “Naki rende torakore okobwatana nainwe? Aande gose nigo momenyete ase egati yaito.”

English: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
Kiswahili: Mabaki ya Israeli hayatafanya kosa; hawatasema uongo, wala udanganyifu hautakuwa katika vinywa vyao. Watakula na kulala wala hakuna yeyote atakayewaogopesha.”
Ekegusii: Abatigari b'Abaisraeli tibagokora ayare amabe, gose tibagokwana oborimo; chinkwana chi'obong'ainereria tichikorua ase emenwa yabo. Mbabe bakoragera na korara, na onde tari araboboyie.”

English: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
Kiswahili: Mungu alitoka Temani, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu kutoka Mlima Parani. Utukufu wake ulifunika mbingu, na sifa zake zikaifunika dunia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ngocha are korwa Temani ee, Ere oyore Omochenu ngocha are korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani. Obonene bwaye mbotube igoro chionsi, na ense neichorwe nogotogigwa kwaye.

English: You will therefore do well to send messengers to them and give them the right hand of friendship, that they, knowing our mind, may be of good heart, and gladly occupy themselves with the conduct of their own affairs.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo utafanya vyema ukiwatumia wajumbe na kuwapa mkono wa kuume wa urafiki, ili, wakijua akili zetu, wawe na moyo mwema, na kwa furaha wajishughulishe na mambo yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo narora nga mbuya mbamanyie igoro y'amang'ana aya, na kobaenekeria buna nimbe omosani obo, erio banyare kogendereria amang'ana abo ase omorembe, batabwati bwoba bonde.”

English: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.' So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nikawaambia, ‘Yeyote aliye na kito chochote cha dhahabu avue.' Kisha wakanipa hiyo dhahabu, nami nikaitupa motoni, akatokea huyu ndama!”
Ekegusii: Inche: nkabateebia: Onde bwensi obwate etaabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching'a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”

English: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
Kiswahili: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Mungu amesahau, huficha uso wake na haoni kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Igo ase enkoro yaye ime orengereria iga: “Nyasae tagwechandera kende, obisire obosio bwaye tayarora nonya ng’ake.”

English: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, lolote mfanyalo, kama ni kula au kunywa, fanyeni yote kwa utukufu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Gaki komokoria, gose mokonywa gose mogokora ing’ana rinde rionsi, kora onsi ase obonene bwa Nyasae.

English: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
Kiswahili: Mara yule msichana akasimama, akaanza kutembea (alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili). Walipoona haya, wakastaajabu sana.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka akagenda, ere konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere. Erio bagakumia ogokumia okonene.

English: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn't come to Corinth.
Kiswahili: Mungu ni shahidi wangu kwamba ilikuwa ni kwa ajili ya kuwahurumia ninyi sikurudi Korintho.
