Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkorigia Nyasae ambere kirori, ng'a ase okobarorera inwe amaabera tindagenda Korinto.

English: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndugu zake Yesu wakamwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende Uyahudi ili wanafunzi Wako wapate kuona miujiza unayofanya.
Ekegusii: Bamura bamwabo bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.

English: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa upendo na uaminifu uovu huondolewa; kwa kumcha Bwana mtu hujiepusha na ubaya.
Ekegusii: Ase amaabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y’ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene, omonto nigo agweatanana korwa ase amabe.

English: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakasikia watu wakinongʼona mambo kama hayo kuhusu Yesu, ndipo wao pamoja na viongozi wa makuhani wakatuma walinzi wa Hekalu waende kumkamata.
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakaigwa omoganda okwemurungania igoro yaye. Erio abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate.

English: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and no one can stop his hand, or ask him, “What are you doing?”
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote ya dunia yanahesabiwa kuwa si kitu. Hufanya kama atakavyo kwa majeshi ya mbinguni, na kwa mataifa ya dunia. Hakuna anayeweza kuuzuia mkono wake au kumwambia, “Umefanya nini wewe?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense nigo baabarire ng'a nigo bare bosa. Ere nigo agokorera emeganda ya igoro buna anchete, akorera na Mwanyabaanto bare ase ense boigo. Onde tari oramotange, gose komoboria: Ngento ki ekio ogokora?”

English: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye amekuwa akiiba, asiibe tena, lakini lazima ajishughulishe, afanye kitu kifaacho kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na kitu cha kuwagawia wahitaji.
Ekegusii: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.

English: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: Then David conferred with all his leaders, the commanders of hundreds and of thousands.
Kiswahili: Daudi alishauriana na kila afisa wake, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogosemania nabanene bonsi abarenge abatang’ani b’abarwani elifu eyemo (1,000) na abe rigana erimo (100).

English: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
Kiswahili: Sisi ni wageni na wapitaji machoni pako, kama walivyokuwa baba zetu wote. Siku zetu duniani ni kama kivuli, bila tumaini.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore ase ense y’obogeni, naende nigo tore abaeti ase obosio bwao, buna chisokoro chiaito chionsi chiarenge; amatuko aito ay’okomenya ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari, na ogosemeria konde tikoiyo.

English: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,
Kiswahili: “Mtu anapomkosea jirani yake na akatakiwa kuapa, akija na kuapa mbele ya madhabahu yako ndani ya Hekalu hili,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw’egesasiimero kiao ase enyomba eye,

English: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya Hekalu lako Yerusalemu wafalme watakuletea zawadi.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti nigo bagokorentera ebiegwa ime ase Hekalu yao ere agwo Yerusalemu.

English: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on that day must be put to death.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita, mtafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba itakuwa takatifu kwenu, Sabato ya kupumzika kwa Bwana. Yeyote atakayefanya kazi yoyote siku hiyo ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Mokore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nigo rirabe richenu ase more, rituko ri’Esabato, riogotimoka ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.

English: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
Kiswahili: ambaye hatalipwa mara mia katika ulimwengu huu: nyumba, ndugu wa kiume na wa kike, mama na baba na watoto, mashamba pamoja na mateso, kisha uzima wa milele katika ulimwengu ujao.
Ekegusii: ere naegwe ebinge ase chingaki echi chia bono, na ase ense egochi-gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo unanijua mimi, Ee Bwana; unaniona na kuyachunguza mawazo yangu kukuhusu wewe. Wakokote kama kondoo wanaokwenda kuchinjwa! Watenge kwa ajili ya siku ya kuchinjwa!
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nomanyete inche, nigo ondoche, na nigo ogoteema ebirengererio biane gose mbire asore. Barusieo abwo ababe buna ching’ondi chigochia konyenywa, obabeeke ensemo baganye rituko bagochia konyenywa.

English: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule niliwaambia, “Ninyi mmekuwa mzigo mzito sana kwangu kuwachukua peke yangu.
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n'abanto, Ase engaki eria twarenge egetunwa gia Sinai nigo nabateebetie ng'a inche bweka tinkonyaara kobaraa.

English: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,
Kiswahili: Basi, watu walipovunja kambi ili kuvuka Yordani, makuhani wakiwa wamebeba Sanduku la Agano waliwatangulia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baimogete korwa ase chiema chiabo erinde bamboke Yorodani, abakuani bakabatang'ana, babogoretie Esanduki eria y'Okobwatana.

English: And the king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Misri akamwondoa madarakani huko Yerusalemu na akatoza Yuda kodi ya talanta 100 za fedha na talanta moja ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri agacha Yerusalemu akarusia Yehoahasi ase oborwoti, erio akabeekera abanto b’ense eria ebango ye chitalanta rigana erimo chi’echifeta, na etalanta eyemo y’etaabu.

English: For God will show your splendor everywhere under heaven.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu ataonyesha utukufu wako kila mahali chini ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae naorokie obonene bwao gochia ase chinse chionsi.

English: he must order that the contaminated stones be pulled out and thrown into an unclean place outside the city.
Kiswahili: ataagiza kwamba mawe yote yaliyoambukizwa yaondolewe na kutupwa katika eneo lililo najisi nje ya mji.
Ekegusii: achike ng’a amagena aria asoirwe na ukoma atagorwe, atugutwe ase eubi egotugutwa, isiko y’omochie.

English: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
Kiswahili: Uangalie mateso na shida zangu na uniondolee dhambi zangu zote.
Ekegusii: ndigererie orore obororo bwane na ogochandwa kwane, na onyabere ebibe biane bionsi.

English: This is to be done for each bull, ram, lamb, or goat.
Kiswahili: Kila fahali au kondoo dume, kila mwana-kondoo au mbuzi mchanga, atatayarishwa kwa njia hii.
Ekegusii: “Ebinto ebi nabio biraruegwe amo na kera eeri, gose emingichi, gose kera emanwa y’eng’ondi gose ey’embori.

English: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ninyi basi mlio waovu mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri, si zaidi sana Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa vitu vizuri wale wamwombao?
Ekegusii: Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa amaya abwo bakomosaba?

English: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kutoa mifano hii, akaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire emebayeeno eyio, akarua aroro, akagenda aase aande.

English: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
Kiswahili: Mtwike Bwana fadhaa zako, naye atakutegemeza, hatamwacha kamwe mwenye haki wake aanguke.
Ekegusii: Motweke Omonene chigurube chiao, nere nakobwate nokoboko kwaye akorende; ere tagotiga omonyaboronge abugwe namabe.

English: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
Kiswahili: Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu aliwatesa Israeli wakati wote wa utawala wa Yehoahazi.
Ekegusii: Hasaeli, omorwoti bw'Abasiiria, akaba ogochanda Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi ay'okogaamba kwa Yehoahasi.

English: but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked. Jesus before the Sanhedrin (Matthew 26:57–68; Luke 22:66–71; John 18:19–24)
Kiswahili: alikimbia uchi, akaliacha vazi lake. Yesu Mbele Ya Baraza La Wayahudi (Mathayo 26:57-68; Luka 22:54-71; Yohana 18:13-24)
Ekegusii: korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki’egatani, agatama ore getirianda. Yeso bosio bw’abakuani (Mat 26:57-68; Luk 22:54-55,63-71; Yoh 18:12-14,19-24)

English: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
Kiswahili: Lakini msaidizi wako, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, ataingia. Mtie moyo, kwa sababu atawaongoza Waisraeli kuirithi hiyo nchi.
Ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omokonyi oo, nere orasoe aroro. Mobeeke chinguru, omoremie, ekiagera nere oraraae Abaisraeli bagende koira ense eria.

English: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
Kiswahili: Ninakula majivu kama chakula changu na nimechanganya kinywaji changu na machozi
Ekegusii: Nigo nkoria ribu buna nkoria endagera, na ekenyugwa kiane nigo ngokeburukania namariga,

English: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Mwezi Mpya hata mwingine, na kutoka Sabato hadi nyingine, wanadamu wote watakuja na kusujudu mbele zangu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Korwa omoyega bw'Omotienyi Omoyia goika oyo bw'Omotienyi onde Omoyia, na korwa Esabato goika Esabato ende, abanto bonsi mbache gosasiima ase obosio bwane.

English: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can't be compared to it.
Kiswahili: kwa maana hekima ina thamani kuliko marijani na hakuna chochote unachohitaji kinacholingana naye.
Ekegusii: “Obong'aini nigo bore obuya kobua amagena akomeka‐meka aye rigori rinene, tibokoreng'anigwa n'ebinto bionsi bire ebiya biganeirie.

English: I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.
Kiswahili: Ninaujua ujeuri wake, lakini ni bure,” asema Bwana, “nako kujisifu kwake hakumsaidii chochote.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo imanyete ribero riabo. Ogwetogia kwabo nigo kore okw'obong'ainereria, naboigo nogokora kwabo kore.

English: “King Alexander to his brother Jonathan, greetings.
Kiswahili: "Mfalme Aleksanda kwa ndugu yake Yonathani, salamu."
Ekegusii: “Omorwoti Alekisanda ase omosaani oye Yonathani, amakwania ayio!

English: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
Kiswahili: Basi kulikuwako na njaa katika nchi, naye Abramu akashuka kwenda Misri kukaa huko kwa muda, kwa maana njaa ilikuwa kali.
Ekegusii: Bono enchara egasoa ase ense eria, na ase engencho enchara eria yareenge enene mono, ekagera Aburamu agatirimboka gochia Misiri achi kobeera aroro

English: Don't boast about the clothes you wear, and don't exalt yourself in the day of honor; for the Lord's works are wonderful, and his works are hidden among men.
Kiswahili: Usijisifu kwa mavazi yako, wala usijisifu katika siku ya heshima; kwa maana kazi za Bwana ni za ajabu, na kazi zake zimefichwa miongoni mwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Tibwetogia ekiagera obegete eanga amaritati, kogunkwara ekero kwairwe amasikani. Oise kogunkwara, Nyasae ngokora are ebikone bi'ogokumia.

English: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
Kiswahili: Kazi zote zinazofanywa kwa bidii huleta faida, bali mazungumzo matupu huelekea umaskini tu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi egokorwa nigo ekorenta ebitoki, korende amang'ana amasa agokwanwa nigo gokorenta obotaka.

English: By the wrath of the LORD of Hosts the land is scorched, and the people are fuel for the fire. No man even spares his brother.
Kiswahili: Kwa hasira ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote nchi itachomwa kwa moto, nao watu watakuwa kuni za kuchochea moto. Hakuna mtu atakayemhurumia ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene bw’Emeganda yasambire ense; abanto nigo banga buna chinko chigwokia omorero, na monto onde takororera oyomwabo amaabera.

English: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
Kiswahili: Anakuja pamoja na Onesimo, ndugu yetu mpendwa na mwaminifu, ambaye ni mmoja wenu. Watawaambia mambo yote yanayotendeka hapa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Amo nere natomire Onesimo, oyominto omwegenwa, omwanchwa, oyore oyomo oino. Barabwo nabaabamanyie onsi ayare aiga ase tore.

English: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Bwana lilibakia huko Kiriath-Yearimu kwa muda mrefu, yaani jumla ya miaka ishirini, nao watu wa Israeli wakaomboleza na kumtafuta Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio Esanduki eria y'Omonene ekabeera agwo Kiriati-Yearimu ase engaki entaambe, emiaka emerongo ebere. Ase engaki eyio yonsi, Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakorera ase Omonene ng'a abakoonye.

English: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana huvunja mierezi; Bwana huvunja vipande vipande mierezi ya Lebanoni.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikobuna emete emecharake, ee, nigo rikobuna emecharake ya Lebanoni.

English: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mwishoni mwa hiyo miaka arobaini, nitawakusanya Wamisri kutoka mataifa walikotawanywa.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ekero emiaka emerongo ene yaerire, ninsangererie Abamisiri, mbarusie korwa ase egati y' abanto abwo ase basiareretwe gochia.

English: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nyingi kupita, Wayahudi wakafanya shauri kumuua Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko amange aetire, Abayahudi bakamogamba, erinde banyare komoita,

English: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Mlawi mmoja naye alipofika mahali pale, alimwona, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani
Ekegusii: Na Omolawi boigo agachia goika aase aria, akamorora; nere agaeta ensemo.

English: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akawatuma kutoka Jangwa la Parani. Wote walikuwa viongozi wa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Parani, buna Omonene amochiigete. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo barenge abatang'ani ase Abaisraeli.

English: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh. They anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh's word by Samuel.
Kiswahili: Wazee wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wamewasili kwa Mfalme Daudi huko Hebroni, alifanya mapatano nao huko Hebroni mbele za Bwana, nao wakamtia Daudi mafuta awe mfalme wa Israeli, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoahidi kupitia kwa Samweli.
Ekegusii: Nabo abagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli bagacha ase omorwoti agwo Heburoni; na aroro Daudi agakora okobwatana kw'ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw'Omonene, na barabwo bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, koreng'ana ne ring'ana riri'Omonene akwanete goetera ase Samweli.

English: One of Joab’s young men stood near Amasa and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa watu wa Yoabu akasimama kando ya Amasa, akasema, “Yeyote ampendaye Yoabu na yeyote aliye upande wa Daudi, na amfuate Yoabu!”
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Yoabu agatenena ang’e nomobere bw’Amasa akabora, “Oyo omwanchete Yoabu na oyore oyo’Daudi, tiga atuny’ane Yoabu.”

English: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away. The Sadducees and the Resurrection (Mark 12:18–27; Luke 20:27–40)
Kiswahili: Waliposikia hili, wakashangaa. Hivyo wakamwacha, wakaenda zao. Ndoa Na Ufufuo (Marko 12:18-27; Luka 20:27-40)
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa ring’ana riria, bagakumia; bakamotiga, bakagenda. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mar 12:18-27; Luk 20:27-40)

English: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni furaha yangu, nazo ni washauri wangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo 'ngokerete oborori bwao, ekiagera nabwo bogonseemia.

English: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
Kiswahili: hivyo aliondoka chakulani, akavua vazi lake la nje, akajifunga kitambaa kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.

English: the countries of India, Media, and Lydia. They took them from him, and gave them to King Eumenes.
Kiswahili: nchi za India, Media, na Lydia. Wakavichukua kutoka kwake, wakampa Mfalme Eumenes.
Ekegusii: Buna ense ya India, Media na Lidia. Bakaira chinsemo echio na komoa omorwoti Eumene.

English: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.
Kiswahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu.
Ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.

English: He answered and declared to them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of the children of Asshur, and all the great words that Holofernes had spoken against the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Akajibu na kuwaeleza maneno ya baraza la Holoferne, na maneno yote aliyokuwa ameyasema katikati ya wakuu wa wana wa Ashuru, na maneno yote makubwa aliyokuwa ameyasema Holoferne dhidi ya nyumba ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Akioro akabaorokeria kera ring'ana rikwanetwe ase omosangererekano bwa Holoferne igoro yeseegi. Akabateebia aria ere omonyene akwanete ase omosangererekano oyio bwo Holoferne na abarai ba Abaashuru na buna Holoferne etogetie ase aria are gochia kobakorera Abaisraeli.

English: Then David asked Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Je, nani atakayeniambia kama baba yako atakujibu kwa ukali?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria, “Iso karakoiranerie amang’ana amakong’u, Inee, ning’o orache gonteebia ayio?”

English: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
Kiswahili: Bwana arusi alipokawia kuja wale wanawali wote wakasinzia na kulala.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonywomi atebana gocha, bagasundoka bonsi, bakarara.

English: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
Kiswahili: Wakaenda mpaka Kapernaumu. Ilipofika siku ya Sabato, mara Yesu akaingia sinagogi, akaanza kufundisha.
Ekegusii: Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.

English: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”
Kiswahili: Chukua mikate kumi, maandazi kadhaa na gudulia la asali na umwendee. Atakuambia kitakachotokea kwa kijana.”
Ekegusii: Oire amo naye emegati ikomi, na amaandasi, na obooke egetono ekemo, ogende asare; ere nagoteebie egento kegochia gokororekana ase omwana.”

English: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in Yahweh's house:
Kiswahili: Pia akatengeneza masinia, masepetu na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia. Kwa hiyo Huramu akakamilisha kazi zote katika Hekalu la Bwana kama vile Mfalme Solomoni alikuwa amemwagiza, yaani:
Ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia ebituba, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Naboigo agakoora emeremo yonsi eyaetwe na Sulemani ng'a akore ase enyomba y'Omonene.

English: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
Kiswahili: Shangilieni mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu mahali atakapopachagua kama makao ya Jina lake, ninyi, wana wenu na binti zenu, watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, Walawi walio katika miji yenu, na wageni, yatima na wajane waishio miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Agwo aase Omonene arachoore abe obomenyo bw'erieta riaye, nao morageende na mogooke ase obosio bwaye, inwe n'abana baino, abamura n'abaiseke, n'abasomba baino, abamura n'abaiseke, n'Abalawi bamenyete ase emechie yaino, n'abamenyi, ne'chintakana, n'ababoraka bare ase egati yaino.

English: Seventy weeks are decreed for your people and your holy city to stop their transgression, to put an end to sin, to make atonement for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
Kiswahili: “Majuma sabini yameamriwa kwa ajili ya watu wako na kwa ajili ya mji wako mtakatifu, ili kumaliza makosa, kukomesha dhambi, kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya uovu, kuleta haki ya milele, kutia muhuri maono na unabii, na pia kumtia mafuta yeye aliye mtakatifu sana.
Ekegusii: “Chichuma emerongo etano na ebere” gose “isano na ibere” ara emerongo etano na ebere, emerongo etano na ebere nachio chiachiikirwe ase abanto bao, na ase omochie oo omochenu, gokoora ogosaria na gosiria ebibe, na gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe, naende korenta oboronge bwa kare na kare na kobeeka okorora koria na obobani boria ekemanyererio, boigo goaka Aase Aachenu Mono amaguta na koachena.

English: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo sasa Bwana ameweka roho ya kudanganya ndani ya vinywa vya hawa manabii wako wote. Bwana ameamuru maafa kwa ajili yako.”
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio rora bono, Omonene obaeire omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase emenwa y’ababani aba bao bonsi, ekiagera ochikiire ng’a nonyore egesio ekebe.”

English: Joshua said to them, “Don't be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for Yahweh will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia, “Msiogope, wala msivunjike moyo. Kuweni hodari na wenye ushujaa. Hili ndilo Bwana atakalowatendea adui zenu wote mnaokwenda kupigana nao.”
Ekegusii: Naende Yoshua agateebia abatang'ani baria b'abarwani, “Timoiroka, timokwa emioyo; mobe noboremu na gotenena bokong'u, ekiagera naboigo Omonene arakore ababisa bonsi morarwanie.”

English: Yet because the wicked do not fear God, it will not go well with them, and their days will not lengthen like a shadow. God’s Ways Are Mysterious
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu waovu hawamwogopi Mungu, hawatafanikiwa, maisha yao hayatarefuka kama kivuli.
Ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe tibakonyora amaya ayio, gose obogima bwabo tibokoba obotambe. Nigo banga buna omorengari ogoeta, ekiagera tibamoirogete Nyasae.

English: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants sail with your servants,” but Jehoshaphat refused.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule, Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu akamwambia Yehoshafati, “Waache watu wangu wasafiri baharini pamoja na watu wako,” lakini Yehoshafati akakataa.
Ekegusii: Erio Ahasia, mosinto bw’Ahabu, agateebia Yehosafati: “Tiga abasomba baane bagende amo nabasomba bao ase chimeeri.” Korende Yehosafati akaanga.

English: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
Kiswahili: Je, ikiwa sisi tulipanda mbegu ya kiroho miongoni mwenu, itakuwa ni jambo kubwa iwapo tutavuna vitu vya mwili kutoka kwenu?
Ekegusii: Onye intwe twabasimekeire ebinto bi'omoika, Inee, nering'ana rinene gatoragese ebinto biaino bi'ogokonya ase obogima bw'ense eye?

English: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh's angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Malaika aliponyoosha mkono wake ili kuangamiza Yerusalemu, Bwana akahuzunika kwa sababu ya maafa, akamwambia yule malaika aliyekuwa anawadhuru watu, “Yatosha! Rudisha mkono wako.” Wakati huo malaika wa Bwana alikuwa kwenye sakafu ya kupuria ya Arauna, Myebusi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika aramborete okoboko kwaye asirie Yerusalemu, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye ase amabe ayio, agateebia omomalaika oria orenge gosiria abanto, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao.” Omomalaika konya oikire ang'e nekeooreri ki'Arauna Omoyebusi.

English: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Tirsa mmoja wafalme jumla yao ilikuwa thelathini na mmoja.
Ekegusii: na oyo o Tirisa. Abarwoti abwo bonsi nigo barenge emerongo etato nomo (31).

English: Let your soul love a wise servant. Don't defraud him of liberty.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yako impende mtumishi mwenye busara. Usimnyang'anye uhuru.
Ekegusii: Mwanche omokori emeremo oo.

English: And this will be a sign to you, O Hezekiah: This year you will eat what grows on its own, and in the second year what springs from the same. But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo itakuwa ishara kwako, ee Hezekia: “Mwaka huu utakula kile kiotacho chenyewe, na mwaka wa pili utakula kutoka machipukizi yake. Lakini katika mwaka wa tatu, panda na uvune, panda mashamba ya mizabibu na ule matunda yake.
Ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore aye Hezekia: Omwaka oyo inamorie endagera ekwemeria yoka enyene, na omwaka o kabere boigo. Erio omwaka o gatato mobusure na kogesa, mosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na morie okwama kwabo.

English: Then Esther summoned Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs appointed to her, and she dispatched him to Mordecai to learn what was troubling him and why.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Esta akamwita Hathaki, mmojawapo wa matowashi wa mfalme ambaye alikuwa amewekwa kumhudumia Esta, akamwagiza kutafuta ni nini kilikuwa kikimtaabisha Mordekai na ni kwa nini.
Ekegusii: Erio Esiteri akarangeria Hataki, oyo omorwoti achorete koba omokoreri bw’Esiteri, akamotoma agende ase Moredekai amoborerie engencho y’amang’ana ayio, naende ninki kiagerire achandegete igo.

English: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake because the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasikia harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, naye akasema moyoni mwake, “Kamwe sitailaani tena ardhi kwa sababu ya mwanadamu, hata ingawa kila mwelekeo wa moyo wake ni mbaya tangu ujana. Kamwe sitaangamiza tena viumbe hai vyote kama nilivyofanya.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene aigwete rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera, agateeba ase omoyo oye ime: “Tinkoragereria ense naende nonya ng'ake ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, naki ebirengererio bie chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nebibe korwa obwana bwabo; nonya nebitongwa bionsi bire moyo tingocha kobisiria naende buna nakorete.

English: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him, because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. On that day he must consecrate his head again.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atatoa mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, na mwingine kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa sababu ametenda dhambi kwa kuwepo mbele ya maiti. Siku iyo hiyo atakiweka wakfu kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arue riruma erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Omwerwa oria, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase ogoika ang’e negetondo. Ase rituko erio erio omonto oria achene omotwe oye,

English: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
Kiswahili: “Nami nitamiminia nyumba ya Daudi na wakazi wa Yerusalemu roho ya neema na maombi. Watanitazama mimi, yule waliyemchoma. Nao watamwombolezea kama mtu anayemwombolezea mwanawe wa pekee na kusikitika kwa uchungu kama anayemsikitikia mzaliwa wake wa kwanza wa kiume.
Ekegusii: “Ning’umorere abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, omoika bw’amaabera na ogosaba. Ekero barandigererie mbarore oyo babetete babe bakondeera, buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima; mbandeere bare nobororo buna obw’omonto okoreera omwana oye omotangi.

English: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
Kiswahili: jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino, mkono kwa mkono, mguu kwa mguu,
Ekegusii: eriso ase eriso, na erino ase erino, okoboko ase okoboko, na okogoro ase okogoro,

English: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, and said, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, in keeping with the command of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Wakamwendea kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi, wakasema: “ Bwana alimwagiza Mose atupatie urithi miongoni mwa ndugu zetu.” Kwa hiyo Yoshua akawapa urithi pamoja na ndugu wa baba yao, kufuatana na agizo la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abatang’ani abanene, bakaboora, “Omonene nachigete Musa ng’a intwe toegwe orogongo ororabe omwando oito ase egati y’abaminto.” Ase ayio bakaegwa omwando ase egati y’abamwabo ise, buna Omonene achigete.

English: And now we have sinned before you, and you have delivered us into the hands of our enemies,
Kiswahili: Na sasa tumetenda dhambi mbele zako, nawe umetutia mikononi mwa adui zetu,
Ekegusii: naboigo gwatoereirie gochia ase ababisa baito erio korwa esiko gochia ase chinyasae chiabo, Nyasae Omobui, aye n'omoronge ore. Korende barabwo tibaisanegeti

English: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.'
Kiswahili: Wale wapumbavu wakawaambia wale wenye busara, ‘Tupatieni mafuta yenu kidogo; taa zetu zinazimika.'
Ekegusii: Baria abariri bagateebia baria abang'aini: Twatanere amaguta aino, ekiagera chitaaya chiaito chiarimire.

English: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
Kiswahili: wakainuka dhidi ya Mose. Pamoja nao walikuwepo wanaume wa Kiisraeli 250, watu waliojulikana, viongozi wa jumuiya waliokuwa wameteuliwa kuwa wakuu wa kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: bakabwatana, bakaanga koigwera Musa. Amo nabwo 'mbarengeo abanto bande b'Abaisraeli, amagana abere, namerongo etano. Abwo barenge abaraai bachorire korwa ase omosangererekano, bamanyekanete, naende basikire.

English: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, Christ died for nothing.
Kiswahili: Siibatilishi neema ya Mungu, kwa maana kama haki ingeweza kupatikana kwa njia ya sheria, basi Kristo alikufa bure!”
Ekegusii: Tinkwanga obuya bwa Nyasae, ekiagera onye oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko, rirorio Kristo nigo akwete bosa.

English: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.
Kiswahili: Itakupasa kufanya vivyo hivyo katika siku ya saba ya mwezi huo kwa ajili ya mtu yeyote ambaye hutenda dhambi bila kukusudia au bila kujua, hivyo utafanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Okore boigo ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri'omotienyi, ase engencho y'omonto onde bwensi okorire ebibe atancheti, gose ayakorete ase oboriri bwaye. Ase enchera eyio mokore okobwatanigwa ase Hekalu.

English: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.
Kiswahili: Elisha akamwambia, “Nenda kwa amani.” Baada ya Naamani kusafiri umbali fulani,
Ekegusii: Elisha akamoteebia: “Genda nomorembe.” Korende ekero Naamani arure asare, agendire egeka egeke korwa aroro,

English: They set the city on fire, and seized many spoils that day, and saved the king.
Kiswahili: Waliuchoma moto mji, wakachukua nyara nyingi siku hiyo, wakamwokoa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamotooria omorwoti korende bakoyosakora koyobeka omochie oyio omorero.

English: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
Kiswahili: Wakati nchi inapoangukia mikononi mwa waovu, yeye huwafunga macho mahakimu wake. Kama si yeye, basi ni nani?
Ekegusii: Ense nigo ebeekire inse y'amaboko 'abakori amabe, Nyasae otubire amasio 'abagaambi ebiina. Onye tari ere, ning'o rende okorire ayio?

English: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
Kiswahili: Baba yenu Abrahamu alishangilia kwamba angaliiona siku yangu, naye akaiona na akafurahi.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”

English: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakastaajabia mafundisho yake wakasema, “Mtu huyu amepataje kujua mambo haya bila kufundishwa?”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bagakumia ase aya, bakaboora, “Naki amanyete chisemi, na ere tasometigwe?”

English: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
Kiswahili: Usijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote kilicho juu mbinguni au duniani chini au ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw'ogosasiimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose ase ense, gose ime ase amaache inse y'ense.

English: At that instant she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
Kiswahili: Saa ile ile akaanguka chini miguuni mwake na kufa. Nao wale vijana wakaingia, wakamkuta amekufa, wakamchukua wakamzika kando ya mumewe.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima akagwa ase amagoro aye, agakwa. Abamura baria bagasoa, bakamonyora okuure. Erio bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka ase omosacha oye ensemo.

English: The congregation of wicked men is as a bundle of tow with a flame of fire at the end of them.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko la watu waovu ni kama mzigo wa kamba uliofunikwa na mwali wa moto mwishoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Omosangererekano bw'abakori amabe, nigo onga buna engori egwoka agwo ase baraumerane kw'omorero ekerage okobumbucha.

English: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda wa miaka arobaini alivumilia matendo yao walipokuwa jangwani.
Ekegusii: na koreng'ana engaki y'emiaka emerongo ene akaremereria nabarabwo ase erooro.

English: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening. The Cleansing of Women
Kiswahili: Yeyote agusaye vitu hivyo atakuwa najisi; ni lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Na onde bwensi orakune ebinto ebio nabe oyotachenegeti; ere asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh's law, which he commanded to Israel;
Kiswahili: ili kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa Bwana kwenye madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa mara kwa mara, asubuhi na jioni, sawasawa na kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika sheria ya Bwana ambayo alikuwa amempa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge Hemani na Yedutuni, na abanto baria bachoretwe na korikwa amarieta abo ase okoiraneri'Omonene ng'a mbuya mono ase engencho y'obwanchani bwaye obwo bogendererete kare na kare.

English: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don't refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
Kiswahili: Basi kama mimi nina hatia ya kutenda kosa lolote linalostahili kifo, sikatai kufa. Lakini kama mashtaka yaliyoletwa dhidi yangu na hawa Wayahudi si kweli, hakuna yeyote aliye na haki ya kunikabidhi mikononi mwao. Naomba rufaa kwa Kaisari!”
Ekegusii: Onye namochire, gose nakorire ring'ana ringwenerete ogokwa, tinyangeti ogokwa, korende onye tari ekeene ring'ana eri bansoereire, onde tari oranyare kombeka ase amaboko abo. Nindigetie ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari.”

English: But if I do them, though you don't believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
Kiswahili: lakini ikiwa nazifanya kazi za Mungu, hata kama hamniamini mimi ziaminini hizo kazi, ili mpate kujua na kuelewa kwamba Baba yu ndani yangu, nami ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Korende konda yekore, nonya timonyegeneti inche, egene emeremo eria, monyare komanya na kwegena ng'a Tata nigo are ime yane, na inche ime ase Tata.”

English: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
Kiswahili: Nguruwe mwitu wanauharibu na wanyama wa kondeni hujilisha humo.
Ekegusii: Chimbeche chie rinani nigo chigosaria omosabibu oyio, ne ching'iti chi'orosana nigo chikoyotakuna.

English: Before I realized it, my desire had set me among the royal chariots of my people. The Friends
Kiswahili: Kabla sijangʼamua, shauku yangu iliniweka katikati ya magari ya kifalme ya kukokotwa na farasi ya watu wangu. Marafiki
Ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaramanya, omoyo one okang’ira, okambeka ase egari y’omogambi bw’abaanto baane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)

English: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.” He said to her, “If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Delila akamwambia Samsoni, “Mpaka sasa, umenifanyia mzaha na kuniambia uongo. Nieleze ni jinsi gani utakavyoweza kufungwa.” Samsoni akamwambia, “Kama ukivisuka hivi vishungi saba vya nywele za kichwa changu katika mtande wa nguo na kukaza kwa msumari, ndipo nitakuwa dhaifu kama mtu mwingine yeyote.” Hivyo Samsoni alipokuwa amelala, Delila akachukua vile vishungi saba vya nywele za kichwa chake na kuvifunga kwenye mtande wa nguo,
Ekegusii: Naende Delila agateebia Samusoni, “Goika bono gwankoreire echeche, na gonteebia oborimo. Nteebie buna oranyaare gosibwa.” Samusoni akamoiraneria, “Korasiberanie ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi'etukia yane ase egetambaa keria okoroisia na kobisiba bokong'u nekegobanio, tibikorusigwao, erio nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.” Ekero Samusoni araarete, Delila akabwata ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi'etukia yaye,

English: and they occupied beforehand all the tops of the high mountains, fortified the villages that were in them, and stored supplies for the provision of war, for their fields were newly reaped.
Kiswahili: Wakamiliki vilele vyote vya milima mirefu hapo awali, wakaimarisha vijiji vilivyokuwa ndani yake, wakaweka akiba ya mahitaji ya vita; kwa maana mashamba yao yalikuwa yamevunwa mara tu.
Ekegusii: Bakayebwata ase obwango chinsinyo chi'ebitunwa, bakaagacha oborendi ase ebitunwa ebio erio kobeeka ebigancha biabo aaroro na kwearigania ase esegi. Bakaba nebisio ebiya ase engencho erio nario konya baruure ase okogesa chindagera chiabo.

English: Then Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh, and called it “Yahweh is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Gideoni akamjengea Bwana madhabahu mahali pale na kupaita, Yehova-Shalom. Mpaka leo ingalipo imesimama huko Ofra ya Waabiezeri.
Ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro agwo, agakeroka Salomu Egesasiimero ekio nigo geteneine agwo omochie bw'eamate y'Abieseri okorokwa Ofura, nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Ninakaribia kuutia mji huu mikononi mwa Wakaldayo, na mwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli ambaye atauteka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Rora nkobeeka nde omochie oyo ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, ee, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, goika ayoire.

English: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your iniquities endless?
Kiswahili: Je, uovu wako si mkuu? Dhambi zako si hazina mwisho?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amabe gwakorire tari amanene? Ekeene, ebibe biao tibiri nomoerio.

English: not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
Kiswahili: asiwe mlevi, wala mkali bali awe mpole, asiwe mgomvi wala mpenda fedha.
Ekegusii: tari omonto onarete edivai, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, abe omonto omoremereria, otari gwancha eriomana, gose otari omwegimeria.

English: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
Kiswahili: lakini mwacheni hai kwa ajili yenu kila msichana ambaye kamwe hajawahi kuzini na mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Korende abaiseke bonsi abekungi timobaisa kobaita, mobaire babe abaino.

English: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusanyiko la Sinagogi kutawanyika, wengi wa Wayahudi na waongofu wa dini ya Kiyahudi wakawafuata Paulo na Barnaba, wakazungumza nao na kuwahimiza wadumu katika neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omosangererekano bw'esinagogi oera, Abayahudi abange na abegeni b'ebisaku binde abaonchogete bakabwatana na Paulo na Barnaba, abakwanete nabarabwo, na kobaremia bagenderere ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

English: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia katika eneo la Hekalu na kuwafukuza wote waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza vitu Hekaluni. Akazipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadilisha fedha, na pia viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, akabasokia isiko bonsi abarenge koonia na kogora ime ase Hekalu, akaonchorana chimesa chi'abaare koonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi'abaare koonia amaruma.

English: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
Kiswahili: Salmoni, Mwahohi; Maharai, Mnetofathi;
Ekegusii: Salimoni korwa Ahohi, na Maharai korwa Netofa;

English: Saul answered, “The troops brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God, but the rest we devoted to destruction.”
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “Askari wamewaleta kutoka kwa Waamaleki, waliwaacha wale kondoo na ngʼombe wazuri ili kuwatoa dhabihu kwa Bwana, Mungu wako, lakini tuliwaangamiza kabisa wengine wote.”
Ekegusii: Saulo akamoiraneria, “Abanto mbarenta ching’ondi ne chiombe korwa ase Abaameleki; nigo batiga echio chingiya mono chire moyo, erinde bachirue chibe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, korende echinde chionsi nigo twachisiria kegima.”

English: For they did not practice My ordinances, but they rejected My statutes and profaned My Sabbaths, fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu hawakutii sheria zangu lakini walikuwa wamekataa amri zangu na kuzinajisi Sabato zangu, nayo macho yao yakatamani sanamu za baba zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo nakorete bo, ekiagera tibabwatete amachiiko ane na tibayakorerete, korende nigo baangete koigwera emeroberio y’ane echiikire, na bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti, na amaiso abo nigo arigereretie emegwekano eyio chisokoro chiabo chiarenge gosasiima.

English: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
Kiswahili: Alameleki, Amadi na Mishali. Upande wa magharibi mpaka uligusa Karmeli na Shihor-Libnathi.
Ekegusii: na Alameleki, na Amadi, na Misali. Ensemo ya bosongo orobebe rwabo rogatwomera Karimeli na Sihori‐Libinati.

English: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
Kiswahili: “Umebarikiwa Ufalme unaokuja wa baba yetu Daudi!” “Hosana kwake yeye aliye juu!”
Ekegusii: Mbosesenirie oborwoti bogocha, oborwoti bwa sokoro yaito Daudi! Hosana aye ore igoro!”

English: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.
Kiswahili: “Sasa wewe mwenyewe unafahamu lile Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alilonitendea, lile alilofanya kwa majemadari wawili wa majeshi ya Israeli, Abneri mwana wa Neri, na Amasa mwana wa Yetheri. Aliwaua, akimwaga damu yao wakati wa amani kama vile ni kwenye vita, tena akaipaka damu ile kwenye mkanda uliokuwa kiunoni mwake na viatu alivyovaa miguuni mwake.
Ekegusii: “Aye nomanyete eki Yoabu, omwana bw'omokuungu Seruya, akorete ase 'nde, ase ogoita abachiki baria babere b'abasikari b'Abaisraeli: Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Amasa, mosinto o Yeteri. Noinyorete buna abaitete ase engaki y'omorembe ase ogwakana egesiomba ase ogoita bakorete ase engaki ch'esegi. Agaita abanto batari na komocha na bono agantigera egesiomba ase aya akorete na nigo nanyorire egesusuro.

English: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
Kiswahili: Mtachukua sehemu ya yale matoleo matakatifu sana ambayo hayateketezwi kwa moto. Kutoka kwa matoleo yote wanayoniletea kama sadaka takatifu sana, ziwe za nafaka, au za dhambi, au za makosa, sehemu ile itakuwa yako na wanao.
Ekegusii: Ase ebinto bire ebichenu mono, ebiratigare, bitari gosambwa nomorero, ebiraabe ebiao, nabio ebi: Kera okoruegwa kw'endagera, na kera ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na ekeng'wanso gi'okorongeyia okomocha. Ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakorua ase 'nde, nabibe ebichenu mono ase ore, na ase abamura bao.

English: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against Yahweh, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Hamna ruhusa kuwaleta hao wafungwa hapa, ama sivyo tutakuwa na hatia mbele za Bwana. Je, mnataka kuongezea dhambi yetu na hatia yetu? Kwa sababu hatia yetu tayari ni kubwa, nayo hasira kali ya Bwana iko juu ya Israeli.”
Ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Timobaisa korenta aa abanto abwo mwosete; moise gokora bo, nigo morabaise kogera tobe nokomocha ase Omonene komenta amo nebibe na okomocha tore nakwo bono. Okomocha tobwate nigo kore okonene, na endamwamu entindi ya Nyasae nigo ere igoro ase Abaisraeli.”

English: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part. New Life in Christ (Colossians 3:1–17)
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwake, mwili wote ukiwa umeungamanishwa na kushikamanishwa pamoja kwa msaada wa kila kiungo, hukua na kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo, wakati kila kiungo kinafanya kazi yake. Maisha Ya Zamani Na Maisha Mapya
Ekegusii: Ase are ere omobere bwonsi onyare gokiina ogokiina kw’omobere na kweagaacha omonyene ase obwanchani, korasang’ananigwe na kobwatanigwa ase ogokoonywa gwa kera ekiimo koreng’ana n’emeremo ya kera ensemo. Obogima obokoro na boria oboyia

English: But the king added, “He may return to his house, but he must not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, but he did not see the king.
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme akasema, “Lazima Absalomu aende kwenye nyumba yake mwenyewe; kamwe asiuone uso wangu.” Kwa hiyo Absalomu akaenda kwenye nyumba yake na hakuuona uso wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: na omorwoti agateeba, “Tiga amenye ao ase enka yaye omonyene; tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane.” Ase igo Abisalomu akamenya bwoye oka, taba okororana n’omorwoti. Abisalomu Ok’obwatanigwa na Daudi

English: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
Kiswahili: Uzi akamzaa Zerahia, Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi,
Ekegusii: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

English: Therefore from the beginning I was convinced, and I thought it through and left it in writing:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tangu mwanzo nilikuwa na uhakika, na nilifikiria vizuri na kuiacha kwa maandishi:
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire nobomaene igoro ya ayio onsi korwa omochakano; nayarengereirie na koyaitona ase okoyariika.

English: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya shida yangu nitakuita, kwa maana wewe utanijibu.
Ekegusii: Ekero inde nemechando nigo ngokorangeria, ekiagera aye nigo okonyigwa na kong'iraneria.

English: at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.
Kiswahili: wakati ule Bwana alisema kwa kinywa cha Isaya mwana wa Amozi. Akamwambia, “Vua nguo ya gunia kutoka mwilini mwako na viatu kutoka miguuni mwako.” Naye akafanya hivyo, akatembea huku na huko uchi, bila viatu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene agakwana na Isaya, mosinto bw'Amosi, akamoteebia: “Genda orusie egunia obegete ase omobere oo, na ebikoroto obegete ase amagoro ao.” Isaya agakora bo, akaba ogotaara getirianda, na tabegete ebikoroto.

English: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akapata mimba akampelekea Daudi ujumbe, kusema, “Mimi ni mjamzito.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaba morito; agatoma amang'ana ase Daudi, akabora, “Nabeire morito.”

English: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
Kiswahili: Niambieni, je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”
Ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete igoro, gose nase Mwanyabaanto? Ng'iranerie.”

English: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana jua kali lenye kuchoma huchomoza na kuliunguza, likayakausha majani, na ua lake likapukutika, nao uzuri wake huharibika. Vivyo hivyo tajiri naye atanyauka akiwa anaendelea na shughuli zake. Kujaribiwa
Ekegusii: Naki erioba korikooroka nomobaso omoororo, nigo rigosamba na kwomia obonyansi. Egesicha ki’obonyansi kiaroroka, na obuya bw’ekieni kiaye bwasira. Naboigo nomonda nere arasire kagendererete kwerigeria. Gotema na gotemwa

English: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
Kiswahili: Kutakuwa na mitetemeko mikubwa ya ardhi, na njaa kali, na magonjwa ya kuambukiza katika sehemu mbalimbali. Pia kutakuwa na matukio ya kutisha na ishara kuu kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana y’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.

English: Then Gideon said to God, “Do not be angry with me; let me speak one more time. Please allow me one more test with the fleece. This time let it be dry, and the ground covered with dew.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Gideoni akamwambia Bwana, “Usinikasirikie. Ninaomba nifanye ombi moja lingine. Niruhusu nifanye jaribio jingine moja kwa ngozi hii. Wakati huu uifanye ngozi hii kavu na ardhi yote ifunikwe na umande.”
Ekegusii: Gidioni agakwana na Nyasae, akamoteebia, “Nyasae, totiga endamwamu yao yoke ase ’nde, korende ing’a ribaga ’nkwane naye rimo naende. Tiga nteeme rimo naende ne risankwa eri. Na bono ekero eke kora iga ’ng’a risankwa ribe eriomo, korende obotooru bobe inse ase riroba rionsi.”

English: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Yane na Yambre walivyopingana na Mose, vivyo hivyo watu hawa hupingana na ile kweli. Hawa ni watu wenye akili zilizopotoka, ambao wamekataliwa kwa mambo ya imani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo buna Yane na Yambare baengereranetie na Musa, na aba nabo bakoengererania nekeene. Ebirengererio biabo biasarekire, na okwegena kwabo kwangirwe,

English: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y'emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong'u bwabo.

English: The people quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!
Kiswahili: Watu wakagombana na Mose, na kusema, “Laiti tungelikufa wakati ndugu zetu walipoanguka na kufa mbele za Bwana!
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakaamerererania na Musa, bagakwana, “Nanga nigo yabeete buya kobua onye naintwe ’ntwakwete ekero abaminto baitetwe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: When you enter, you will come to an unsuspecting people and a spacious land, for God has delivered it into your hand. It is a place where nothing on earth is lacking.”
Kiswahili: Mtakapokwenda huko mtakuta watu waliotulia walio salama, nayo nchi hiyo ni kubwa na Mungu ameitia mikononi mwenu, nayo ni nchi ambayo haikupungukiwa na kitu chochote kilicho duniani.”
Ekegusii: Ekero moragende aroro nigo moranyore abanto tibebegeti ang’e korwana, na ense eria n’engare. Ee, Nyasae obeekire ense eria ase amaboko aino. Ense eria teremeiri gento kende gionsi gekorwa ase riroba.”

English: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo sitanyamaza; nitanena kutokana na maumivu makuu ya roho yangu, nitalalama kwa uchungu wa nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkonyara gokira tinkwana, nimbe ngokwana emechando y'omoyo one na kwemurungania nobororo ase omoyo one.

English: But since it is a dispute about words and names and your own law, settle it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of such things.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa linahusu maneno, majina na sheria yenu, amueni ninyi wenyewe. Mimi sitakuwa mwamuzi wa mambo haya.”
Ekegusii: korende onye nokoboria igoro ase amang’ana, na amarieta, na amachiiko aino, yarigererie inwe abanyene. Inche tindigeti koba omotorania bw’amang’ana ayio.”

English: Then he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through knee-deep water. Again he measured a thousand cubits and led me through waist-deep water.
Kiswahili: Akapima dhiraa 1,000 nyingine na kunipitisha kwenye hayo maji ambayo yalifika magotini. Akapima dhiraa nyingine 1,000 na kunipitisha kwenye hayo maji ambayo yalifika kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Naende akabwatia orooche roria, akarengia obotambe bw’amaboko ande elifu eyemo, akanyambokia ase amaache aria, naro akang’ika ase amaru. Naende akarengia amaboko elifu eyemo ende, akanyambokia ase amaache, naro akang’ika ase ekenema.

English: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
Kiswahili: Huko kuwa na mashtaka miongoni mwenu ina maana kwamba tayari ni kushindwa kabisa. Kwa nini msikubali kutendewa mabaya? Kwa nini msikubali kunyangʼanywa?
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya ng'a ngosoerana more inwe ase inwe nigo are ase okobugwa kwaino. Inki motanchereti gokorerwa bobe? Inki motanchereti kourwa ebi mobwate?

English: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, neno la mfalme likawa na nguvu juu ya Yoabu; kwa hiyo Yoabu akaondoka na kuzunguka Israeli yote kisha akarudi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Korende ring'ana ri'omorwoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akaimoka akagenda ase Abaisraeli bonsi, erio akairana gocha Yerusalemu.

English: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery. ”
Kiswahili: Mimi nawaambia, yeyote amwachaye mkewe isipokuwa kwa sababu ya uasherati naye akaoa mke mwingine, anazini. Naye amwoaye yule mwanamke aliyeachwa pia anazini.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, oyoratige mok’aye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, na konyuoma oyonde, oyio otomanire; naende oy’oranyuome omokungu oyotigirwe, otomanire.”

English: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
Kiswahili: Tulipofika Rumi, Paulo aliruhusiwa kuishi peke yake akiwa na askari wa kumlinda.
Ekegusii: Ekero twasoa Rumi, Paulo akaegwa ribaga komenya ere bweka, amo nomorendi ore komorenda.

English: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akatengeneza madhabahu ya shaba yenye urefu wa dhiraa ishirini, upana wa dhiraa ishirini na kimo chake dhiraa kumi.
Ekegusii: Sulemani akaagacha egesasiimero gi'etai. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw'amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko ikomi.

English: you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.
Kiswahili: kusanya shekeli tano kwa kila mmoja, kufuatana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, ambayo ina uzito wa gera ishirini.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio oboorie kera oyomo obo ne chitaabu chie chisekeli isano, koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere).

English: They said, “Don't deal with us according to our wickednesses, but according to your mercy.”
Kiswahili: Walisema, “Usitutendee sawasawa na maovu yetu, bali sawasawa na rehema zako.”
Ekegusii: bagoteeba: “Otwabere gaki, totokorera buna etogwenerete intwe!”

English: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: “Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, aliloniambia: “Chukua kutoka mkononi mwangu kikombe hiki kilichojaa divai ya ghadhabu yangu, na kuyanywesha mataifa yote ambayo ninakutuma kwao.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, antebirie: “Bogoria egekombe eke ki’edivai y’endamwamu korwa ase okoboko kwane, erio oe ebisaku bionsi ase ndagotome gochia, biyenywe.

English: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi walipewa, Ramothi katika Gileadi (mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa ajili ya mauaji), Mahanaimu,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti o Gileadi, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Mahanaimu,

English: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo uwaache watoto wao waone njaa; uwaache wauawe kwa makali ya upanga. Wake zao wasiwe na watoto, na wawe wajane; waume wao wauawe, nao vijana wao waume wachinjwe kwa upanga vitani.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, oite abana babo nenchara, orue abwo abanyene babugwe nababisa babo na baitwe nemioro; tiga abakungu babo bakwerwe nabana babo amo nabasaacha babo, batigwe babe ababoraka. Abanto babo abasacha baitwe namarwaire, na abamura babo baitwe nemioro ase esegi.

English: and didn't know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakukutana kimwili mpaka Maria alipojifungua mwanawe kifungua mimba akamwita Jina lake Yesu.
Ekegusii: Korende konya tibaramanyana kemobere nyuma ataraibora omwana oye omoisia. Naende Yusufu akamoroka erieta riaye Yeso.

English: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
Kiswahili: Basi, “Ikiwa ni vigumu kwa mwenye haki kuokoka, itakuwaje kwa mtu asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Na, buna eriikire, “Onye ekoba aakong’u omonyene oboronge gotooreka, oria otamoirogeti Nyasae na omonyene ebibe, naki rende kerabe asare?”

English: Onias answered and said, “This is the lover of the kindred, he who prays much for the people and the holy city: Jeremiah the prophet of God.
Kiswahili: Onia akajibu, akasema, Huyu ndiye mpenzi wa jamaa, yeye anayewaombea sana watu na mji mtakatifu: Yeremia, nabii wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Onia agateba: “Oyo Yeremia n'omobani o Nyasae, omobani oyio bwanchete Abayahudi bamwabo, ere nigo agendererete gotosabera intwe boigo na Yerusalemu omochie omochenu.”

English: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
Kiswahili: Mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana, pumzi ya uhai wetu hasa, alinaswa katika mitego yao. Tulifikiri kwamba chini ya kivuli chake tungeliweza kuishi miongoni mwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omoakwa amaguta Omonene, oyio orenge omoika bw'obogima bwaito, akabwatwa ne chiirima chiabo, oyio nere twateebete ng'a ase ekiriri kiaye nao toramenye ase egati y'ebisaku.

English: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
Kiswahili: Walilazimika kuishi katika mikondo ya vijito vilivyokauka, kwenye majabali na mahandaki.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y'ense, na ase ebitare.

English: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.
Kiswahili: na kwa sababu ya jambo hili Waasheri wakaishi miongoni mwa Wakanaani, wenyeji wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Nabo Abaaseri bagendererete komenya ase egati y’Abakaanani, ababiare b’ense eria, ekiagera barabwo tibang’anyetigwe korwao.

English: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
Kiswahili: Kama vile moto uteketezavyo vijiti na kusababisha maji kuchemka, shuka ukafanye jina lako lijulikane kwa adui zako, na kusababisha mataifa yatetemeke mbele zako!
Ekegusii: Nigo yarenge koba buna omorero ogosamba chinsagia chi'emete, naende buna omorero okoberia amaache, na igo ogere erieta riao rimanyekane ase ababisa bao, na abanto b'ebisaku batengechigwe ase obosio bwao.

English: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
Kiswahili: Nao wakazini naye. Kama vile watu wazinivyo na kahaba, ndiyo hivyo walivyozini na hao wanawake waasherati, Ohola na Oholiba.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagosoa ase omokungu oyio buna abasacha bagosoa ase omokungu omotayayi. Ase igo abasacha abwo bagasoa ase Ohola na Oholiba bagakora obonyaka.

English: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.
Kiswahili: Usishuhudie dhidi ya jirani yako bila sababu, au kutumia midomo yako kudanganya.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba kirori bosa igo mamincha y’omonto onde, na tobaisa kong’ainereria nebikoba biao.

English: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza sinia la shaba lenye kitako cha shaba kutoka kwa vioo vya shaba vilivyotolewa na wanawake waliohudumu pale ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye korwa ase ebirore bie chitaai bi'abakuungu baare gokorera ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mose kushuka kutoka mlimani akawaendea watu na kuwaweka wakfu, wakafua nguo zao.
Ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gochia ase abanto, akabachena, na barabwo bagasibia chianga chiabo.

English: Then Elisha sent him a messenger, who said, “Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored, and you will be clean.”
Kiswahili: Elisha akamtuma mjumbe kumwambia, “Nenda uoge katika Yordani mara saba, na nyama ya mwili wako itapona, nawe utatakasika.”
Ekegusii: Elisha agatoma omonto asare, akamoteebia “Genda bwesibie ase orooche rwa Yorodani ara gatano na kabere, na omobere oo noirane obe buna orenge ritang’ani, naye nocheneke.”

English: Then the LORD came and stood there, calling as before, “Samuel! Samuel!” And Samuel answered, “Speak, for Your servant is listening.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaja akasimama hapo, akiita kama mara zile nyingine, “Samweli! Samweli!” Kisha Samweli akasema, “Nena Bwana, kwa kuwa mtumishi wako anasikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agacha, agatenena aria, akarangeria buna agwo magega: “Samweli! Samweli!” Samweli agaitaba: “Kwana. Inche, omosomba oo, ninyigwete.”

English: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Tena nawaambia, ikiwa wawili wenu watakubaliana duniani kuhusu jambo lolote watakaloomba, watafanyiwa na Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: “Naende nabateebirie: Onye babere ase more bagwancherana ase ense igoro yering’ana rinde rionsi barasabe, inabakorerwe rirorio na Tata one ore igoro.

English: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika Mlima Sayuni kutakuwepo na wale watakaookoka; nao utakuwa mtakatifu, nayo nyumba ya Yakobo itamiliki urithi wake.
Ekegusii: “Korende ase egetunwa gia Sayoni mbabe aroro abaratooreke na aase agwo nabe aachenu. Abanto b'enyomba ya Yakobo nabairanerigwe ense yabo.

English: Then David reviewed his troops and appointed over them commanders of hundreds and of thousands.
Kiswahili: Daudi akakusanya watu aliokuwa nao na kuweka majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi akaroberia abanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bi’elifu elifu, na ebie rigana, akababeekera abatang’ani

English: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akauambia umati wa watu pamoja na wanafunzi wake:
Ekegusii: Naende Yeso agateebia emeganda na aborokigwa baye,

English: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni kama mtu aliyejenga nyumba, akachimba chini sana, na kuweka msingi kwenye mwamba. Mafuriko yalipokuja, maji ya ghafula yaliipiga ile nyumba, lakini haikutikisika, kwa sababu ilikuwa imejengwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba, agakunya gochia inse mono, akabeeka oboroso bwaye igoro ase egetare. Ekero etoigo yachia gocha, eooro egaaka enyomba eria ne chinguru, tiyanyara koyenyegeria, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.

English: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Yaredi, Mahalaleli aliishi miaka 830, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Yaredi, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato (830), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, tuwaandikie kwamba wajiepushe na vyakula vilivyonajisiwa kwa kutolewa sanamu, wajiepushe na uasherati, au kula mnyama aliyenyongwa, na damu.
Ekegusii: korende tobarikere riruube ng'a beatanane korwa ase ebinto bitachenegeti bi'emegwekano y'ogosaasimwa, na obotomani, na enyama ende yonsi y'eng'iti eng'entire, na korwa ase amanyinga.

English: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote wafurahi na kuimba kwa shangwe, kwa kuwa unatawala watu kwa haki na kuongoza mataifa ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b'ebisaku bagoke na oteera nomochengo; ekiagera aye nigo okonachera abanto ebiina ase oboronge. Aye naye okoraa ebisaku bire ase ense.

English: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.
Kiswahili: Vikosi vyote vya Yoabu vikaja na kumhusuru Sheba mwana wa Bikri huko Abel-Beth-Maaka. Wakauzingira mji kwa kuweka vikosi vya askari, ili kukabiliana na ngome ya mji. Walipokuwa wanagongagonga ukuta ili kuubomoa na kuuangusha chini,
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abareenge na Yoabu bagaacha Abeli Beti‐Maaka, bakamonaria, bakaagacha eburi bosio bw'omochie kororia orwaki, na abanto bagachaaka gotagora orwaki ng'a baroiyerie inse.

English: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors. DALETH
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni furaha yangu, nazo ni washauri wangu. Kuamua Kuitii Sheria Ya Bwana
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ngokerete oborori bwao, ekiagera nabwo bogonseemia. Okogania gw’okoigwera amachiiko Omonene

English: for whether he was a farmer, or a shepherd, or a laborer whose toils were in the wilderness, he was overtaken, and endured that inescapable sentence; for they were all bound with one chain of darkness.
Kiswahili: kwani iwe alikuwa mkulima, au mchungaji, au mfanyakazi ambaye kazi yake ilikuwa nyikani, alikamatwa, na kuvumilia hukumu hiyo isiyoepukika; kwani wote walikuwa wamefungwa kwa mnyororo mmoja wa giza.
Ekegusii: Abaremi, abarisia n'abakori emeremo abwo bare gokora emeremo ase ebitunwa bonsi nigo basoetwe n'emechando eyio eyio batare konyara gwetanga, ekiagera bonsi nigo basibetwe chinyororo chiria chi'omosunte.

English: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa amefanya vivyo hivyo kwa wazao wa Esau, ambao waliishi Seiri, wakati alipowaangamiza Wahori watoke mbele yao. Waliwafukuza na wao wakaishi mahali pao mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akorerete abanto b'ororeeria rw'Esau, baria bamenyete ase ense y'ebitunwa ya Edomu. Agaita Abahori, na Abaesau bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo, nao bamenyete goika reero iga.

English: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
Kiswahili: Bado akamtuma na mwingine wa tatu, huyu pia wakamjeruhi na kumtupa nje ya shamba.
Ekegusii: Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.

English: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akiwashutumu rafiki zake ili apate ujira, macho ya watoto wake yatashindwa kuona.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogosigaana abasani ase okwenyorera chinibo chiabo, amaiso abana babo nigo araukore.

English: There is a futility that is done on the earth: There are righteous men who get what the actions of the wicked deserve, and there are wicked men who get what the actions of the righteous deserve. I say that this too is futile.
Kiswahili: Kuna kitu kingine ambacho ni ubatili kinachotokea duniani: Watu waadilifu kupata yale yanayowastahili waovu, nao waovu kupata yale yanayowastahili waadilifu. Hili nalo pia, nasema ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Nare amang’ana abosa kegima agokorekana aiga ase ense; mbareo abanto abanyaboronge bakonyorwa negesusuro ki’ogokora kw’abanyabibe, na boigo abanyabibe banyora obuya bw’ogokora kw’abanyaboronge. Ase ayio ngateeba, “Ayio boigo mbosa.”

English: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.
Kiswahili: Lakini, Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wewe uhukumuye kwa haki, nawe uchunguzaye moyo na akili, wacha nione ukiwalipiza wao kisasi, kwa maana kwako nimeweka shauri langu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene bw'Emeganda okonacha ebiina ase oboronge; aye okoriga‐rigia ebirengererio bi'enkoro, tiga ndore gokorusia egesiomba ase bare, ekiagera nabekire amang'ana aane asore.”

English: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Utatazama tu kwa macho yako na kuona adhabu ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Norigererie namaiso ao, orore buna abakori amabe bakoegwa egesusuro.

English: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and into the perseverance of Christ.
Kiswahili: Bwana aiongoze mioyo yenu katika upendo wa Mungu na katika saburi ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Omonene atang'ane chinkoro chiaino, erinde momanye obwanchani bwa Nyasae, na oboremereria bwa Kristo.

English: However, in the third year, Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to visit the king of Israel,
Kiswahili: Lakini katika mwaka wa tatu Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda akashuka kwenda kumwona mfalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o gatato Yehosafati, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, akagenda ase omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
Kiswahili: Walinzi wako ni kama nzige, maafisa wako ni kama makundi ya nzige watuao kwenye kuta wakati wa siku ya baridi: lakini wakati jua linapotokea wanaruka kwenda zao, na hakuna ajuaye waendako.
Ekegusii: Abanene bao nigo banga buna risaga ri'echingige echio chigotigara ase chinyasi ase rituko ri'obokendu. Korende ekero risase rigosoka, chirochio chiairuruka, na onde taiyo okomanya ase chikogenda!

English: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ndani ya Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa hakuleti tofauti, bali lililo muhimu ni imani itendayo kazi kwa njia ya upendo.
Ekegusii: Naki ase Kristo Yeso okwaroka tikogokonyorera kende, gose ogotaroka, korende okwegena okwo nakwo kogokora emeremo ase obwanchani.

English: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Kiswahili: Vijito vya machozi vinatiririka kutoka machoni mwangu, kwa sababu watu wangu wameangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo agoitera amariga amange buna amaache a rooche, ase engencho y'ogosirigwa kw'omochie bw'abaanto bane.

English: So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nimetoka nje kukulaki; nimekutafuta na nimekupata!
Ekegusii: Ayio naro agera naacha gokorotota, nigo nakorigirie n’omokia ng’a ’nkorore, na bono nakonyorire.

English: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Katika siku hiyo kilio kitapanda juu kutoka lango la Samaki, maombolezo kutoka mtaa wa pili, na mshindo mkubwa kutoka vilimani.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio eriogi ri'okorera ndigugwe korwa ase Egeita gie Chinswe, na okweumia nkoigugwe korwa ase ensemo enyia y'omochie, na endumo enene korwa ase ebigoro.

English: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
Kiswahili: Nitasema kumhusu Bwana, “Yeye ndiye kimbilio langu na ngome yangu, Mungu wangu, ambaye ninamtumaini.”
Ekegusii: oyio nigo aranyare goteeba, “Omonene nere obotamero bwane, na orwaki rwane, nere Nyasae one oyo nsemeretie.”

English: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kwetu sisi, Bwana ndiye Mungu wetu, wala hatujamwacha. Makuhani wanaomtumikia Bwana ni wana wa Aroni, nao Walawi wakiwasaidia.
Ekegusii: “Korende ase tore intwe, Omonene nere Nyasae oito, na intwe titomotigeti. Intwe ntobwate abakuani bagokorera Omonene, baria bare b’ororeria rwa Aroni na Abalawi abare gokora emeremo yabo.

English: Surely I am the most ignorant of men, and I lack the understanding of a man.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni mjinga kuliko wanadamu wote; sina ufahamu wa kibinadamu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo inde omoriri otagwenereti korokwa omonto, gose timbwati obomanyi bwa Mwanyabaanto.

English: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwokozi wangu, uje upesi kunisaidia.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogotooreka kwane, ayerera onkonye!

English: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakachagua magari mawili ya vita pamoja na farasi wake, naye mfalme akawatuma wafuatilie jeshi la Waaramu. Akawaamuru waendeshaji akisema, “Nendeni mkaone ni nini kilichotokea.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagachora abanto babere bakariina chigari chiare kong'uswa ne chibarasi, na omorwoti akabatoma gochia koroota abasikari b'Abasiiria.”

English: My conscience is clear, but that does not vindicate me. It is the Lord who judges me.
Kiswahili: Dhamiri yangu ni safi, lakini hilo halinihesabii kuwa asiye na hatia. Bwana ndiye anihukumuye.
Ekegusii: Naki timanyeti engencho y’ogwesoera inche omonyene, korende timbareiri oboronge ase engencho y’ayio. Omonene nere orangambie.

English: And he said to the kinsman-redeemer, “Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.
