Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa, “Naomi, aliyerudi hapa kutoka nchi ya Moabu, anauza sehemu ya ardhi iliyokuwa mali ya ndugu yetu Elimeleki.
Ekegusii: Erio Boazi agateebia omonyamwando oria, “Naomi, oria oirana korwa ense y’Abamoabu, nkoonia are oboremo boria bwarenge omwando bw’Elimeleki ominto.

English: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Kiswahili: Upande wa magharibi kutakuwepo na kambi ya makundi ya Efraimu chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Efraimu ni Elishama mwana wa Amihudi.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya bosongo n'Abaefraimu, inse y'ebendera y'ekeombe kiabo. Elisama, mosinto bw'Amihudi, nere oraabe omotang'ani obo,

English: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don't know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kosa lako mwenyewe utaupoteza urithi niliokupa. Nitakufanya mtumwa wa adui zako katika nchi usiyoijua, kwa kuwa umeiwasha hasira yangu, nayo itawaka milele.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio namotige omwando oyo nabaete, na inche mbatige mokorere ababisa baino ase ense inwe motamanyeti, ekiagera endamwamu yane nigo ere buna omorero outire, nosambe kogenderera botambe.”

English: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.
Kiswahili: Nitampa mwanawe kabila moja ili kwamba Daudi mtumishi wangu awe na taa mbele zangu daima katika Yerusalemu, mji ambao nimeuchagua kuweka Jina langu.
Ekegusii: korende omwana oye nimoe egesaku ekemo, erio Daudi, omosomba one, botambe atware etaya ekomoreka ase obosio bwane agwo Yerusalemu, omochie nachorire mbeeke erieta riane aroro.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, along with all his might and how he constructed the pool and the tunnel to bring water into the city, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Hezekia, mafanikio yake yote, na jinsi alivyotengeneza bwawa na mfereji ambao ulileta maji katika mji, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Hezekia, na okobua kwaye gwonsi, na buna aroisetie ritibo na omotaro ase okorenta amaache ase omochie ime, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abayuda.

English: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
Kiswahili: Jueni kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu. Yeye ndiye alituumba, sisi tu mali yake; sisi tu watu wake, kondoo wa malisho yake.
Ekegusii: Manya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae. Nere ototongete, na intwe nabaye tore; nigo tore abanto baye, ne ching’ondi chie riicho riaye.

English: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me, and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever. For his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation.
Kiswahili: Mwishoni mwa siku hizo, mimi, Nebukadneza, niliinua macho yangu kuelekea mbinguni, na ufahamu wangu ukarudi kwangu, nikamtukuza Aliye Juu Zaidi, nikamsifu na kumheshimu Yeye aishiye milele; kwa maana mamlaka yake ni mamlaka ya milele, na ufalme wake ni wa kizazi baada ya kizazi.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio obong'aini bwane bokang'iranera, na obonene bw'oborwoti bwane, na obw'amasikani ane, bikang'iranera boigo. Abasemia bane, na abanto bane abanene bagaacha kondigia, na inche nkairanerigwa oborwoti bwane, na nkamenterwa okobua okonene goetania.

English: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
Kiswahili: Kufuata maelekezo haya, yule mkuu wa gereza akawaweka katika chumba cha ndani sana mle gerezani, na akawafunga miguu yao kwa minyororo.
Ekegusii: Ere ekero anyorire ogochika oko akabaruta ase akanyomba ka ime, agasoyia amagoro abo ase amakorogoto.

English: For surely we will die and be like water poured out on the ground, which cannot be recovered. Yet God does not take away a life; but He devises ways that the banished one may not be cast out from Him.
Kiswahili: Kama vile maji yaliyomwagika ardhini, yasivyoweza kuzoleka tena, hivyo sisi kufa ni lazima. Lakini Mungu haondoi uhai, badala yake, yeye hufanya njia ili kwamba aliyefukuzwa asibaki akiwa amefarikishwa naye.
Ekegusii: Intwe twensi goika tokwe; nigo tore buna amaache aitekire inse atanyaare kobuuchwa naende. Nyasae tari gosiria obogima. Nigo akoroberia ng’a oria otamete taseerigwa na gwatananwa korwa ase are.

English: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,' then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,' then all the flock bore streaked.
Kiswahili: Kama alisema, ‘Wenye madoadoa watakuwa ujira wako,' basi makundi yote yalizaa wenye madoadoa, kama alisema, ‘Wenye mistari watakuwa ujira wako,' basi makundi yote yalizaa wenye mistari.
Ekegusii: Onye otebeete: ‘Echire nebisembe echio nachio chirabe eng'eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire nebisembe, na ekero atebeete.' Echire namagwari nachio echio chirabe eng'eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire namagwari.

English: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for Yahweh the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Tangazo likatolewa katika Yuda na Yerusalemu kwamba inapasa wamletee Bwana kodi ile ambayo Mose, mtumishi wa Bwana alikuwa amewaagiza Israeli huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bakaraarerigwa barente ase Omonene ebango eria Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, abeekerete Abaisraeli agwo ase erooro.

English: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
Kiswahili: Yeye aupandaye uovu huvuna taabu, nayo fimbo ya ghadhabu yake itaangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Oy'ogosimeka obobe, nagese ogosareka, na enyimbo y'endamwamu yaye nigo erasire bosa.

English: When therefore they had come together here, I didn't delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.
Kiswahili: Hivyo walipokutana hapa, sikukawia, kesho yake niliitisha baraza, nikaketi penye kiti changu cha hukumu, nikaagiza huyo mtu aletwe.
Ekegusii: Ase igo ekero basangererekanete aiga, tintebaaneti, korende rituko ria kabere ngaikaransa ase ekerogo kiane gi'ekegambero, ngachiika omonto oyo arentwe.

English: This land will be his possession in Israel. And My princes will no longer oppress My people, but will give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
Kiswahili: Nchi hii itakuwa milki yake katika Israeli. Nao wakuu wangu hawataonea tena watu wangu bali watairuhusu nyumba ya Israeli kuimiliki nchi kulingana na makabila yao.
Ekegusii: Ensemo eyio nebe ey’omogaambi agwo ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Abagaambi bane tibaabaisa kogenderera gochanda abanto bane, korende batige kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli kemenye ase orogongo rw’aye. Emeroberio ase omogambi

English: They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone's hand.”
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Hujatudanganya wala kutuonea. Hujapokea chochote kutoka kwenye mkono wa mtu awaye yote.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bakairaneria: “Aye tigwatoriananetie kende, gose tigwatokorerete bobe, gose tikwairete gento ki'omonto onde bwensi.”

English: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Basi watoeni hao watu waovu kabisa walioko Gibea, ili tupate kuwaua na kuondoa uovu katika Israeli.” Lakini Wabenyamini hawakuwasikia ndugu zao, Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Bono barente abanto baria abanyaka ba Gibea, erinde tobaite, torusie obobe obo borue ase Abaisraeli.” Ababenjamini tibaigwerete Abaisraeli bamwabo,

English: But because his heart was proud, Hezekiah did not repay the favor shown to him. Therefore wrath came upon him and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Lakini moyo wa Hezekia ukajaa majivuno na hakuonyesha itikio kwa wema aliotendewa, kwa hiyo ghadhabu ya Bwana ikawa juu yake na juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera Hezekia arenge omonto omoenenu ase enkoro yaye tairaneretie ng’a mbuya mono ase amaya akoreretwe, Ase engencho eyio endamwanu y’Omonene egacha igoro asare, na ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu.

English: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have seized you.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa umelemewa na hukumu kwa ajili ya uovu; hukumu na haki vimekukamata.
Ekegusii: Korende bono aye nigo okonacherwa ekiina buna eki’abakori amabe, ekiina na ayare ay’ekeene mbikonyore.

English: You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
Kiswahili: Unaona jinsi ambavyo imani yake na matendo yake vilikuwa vinatenda kazi pamoja, nayo imani yake ikakamilishwa na kile alichotenda.
Ekegusii: Kwarorire ng’a okwegena kwaye amo nogokora mbiakorete emeremo, na okwegena koria kogaikeranigwa ase ogokora.

English: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
Kiswahili: Walivunjavunja milango yote iliyonakshiwa kwa mashoka na vishoka vyao.
Ekegusii: Nigo baimogetie chinyundo na ebisire, bakabuna ebinto bionsi bie Hekalu biabachetwe korwa ase emete.

English: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?
Kiswahili: Ulizeni na mkaone: Je, mwanaume aweza kuzaa watoto? Kwa nini basi ninaona kila mwanaume mwenye nguvu ameweka mikono yake tumboni kama mwanamke aliye na utungu wa kuzaa, kila uso ukigeuka rangi kabisa?
Ekegusii: Boria momanye; Inee, omosacha nabe morito aibore omwana? Nase ki rende narorire kera omosacha abwatete enda namaboko aye buna omokungu okobina aibore? Nase ki kera omonto aonchokire obosio bwaye?

English: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
Kiswahili: Siku ya pili yake, walipokuwa wameukaribia mji, wakati wa adhuhuri, Petro alipanda juu ya nyumba kuomba.

English: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hiyo, ametukirimia ahadi zake kuu na za thamani kupitia mambo haya, ili kupitia hayo mpate kuwa washiriki wa asili ya uungu, na kuokoka kutoka upotovu ulioko duniani unaosababishwa na tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Ase ebinto ebio otoeire chiira chinene mono, echie rigori rinene, erinde ase echio monyare koba ababwatani be chingencho chia Nyasae, na gotama ogosaria gw’okogania okobe kore ase ense eye.

English: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
Kiswahili: Jiepushe na maneno mabaya, yasiyo na maana, yasiyo ya utauwa, kwa maana hayo huzidi kuwatosa watu katika kukosa heshima kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase amang'ana atari y'obonyasae, na atari nengeencho. Inaki ase ayio abanto nigo barageenderere komenteka ase chingeencho chitari chi'obonyasae.

English: The LORD said to Moses, “Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebellious, so that you may put an end to their grumbling against Me, lest they die.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Rudisha fimbo ya Aroni mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, ili ihifadhiwe kama alama kwa waasi. Hili litakomesha manungʼuniko yao dhidi yangu, ili kwamba wasife.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, Irania enyimbo ya Aroni ebeere agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere noborori, erinde egachwe ebe ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera abanto batari koigwera. Nabo okirie okwemurungania kwabo ase ’nde, timbaisa koigwa amang’ana buna ayio, mbaise kobaita bakwe.

English: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill made low; the uneven ground will become smooth, and the rugged land a plain.
Kiswahili: Kila bonde litainuliwa, kila mlima na kilima kitashushwa; penye mabonde patanyooshwa, napo palipoparuza patasawazishwa.
Ekegusii: Kera rigoko nditichwe rimokerere igoro, na kera egetunwa na ekegoro nabiiranigwe inse, aase atareng’aini nareng’anigwe, na aase are ebitunwa‐tunwa naaranigwe.

English: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants' standard.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akakubali masharti ya Efroni, akampimia ile fedha aliyotaja masikioni mwa Wahiti: Shekeli 400 za fedha kulingana na viwango vya uzito vilivyokuwa vikitumika wakati huo na wafanyabiashara.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu bagaancherana na Efuroni; na Aburaamu akarengera Efuroni chifeta chiria ateebete Abahiti kobaigwete, chisekeli chi'echifeta amagana ane, koreng'ana nekerengo giancheranire nabaonchoreria.

English: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa makuhani wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata mara moja, kwa sababu walifahamu kwamba amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao. Lakini waliwaogopa watu.
Ekegusii: Aborokia b'amariiko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng'a omoreng'anio oria nabwo akobayeena, korende bakairoka abanto.

English: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
Kiswahili: Kwenye vichaka walilia kama punda, na walijisongasonga pamoja kwenye vichaka.
Ekegusii: Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y'amase akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.

English: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na milango miwili iliyoweza kukunjuka iliyotengenezwa kwa mbao za msunobari na kila mmoja ulikuwa na bawaba ambazo zingeuwezesha kujikunja kila kipande juu ya kingine.
Ekegusii: na ebisieri bibere bi'emetarakwa; kera egesieri nigo kiareenge ebing'ese bibere biare konyara koigorwa biaringanigwa.

English: So the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, along with some of the people, settled in their own towns; and the rest of the Israelites settled in their towns.
Kiswahili: Makuhani, Walawi, waimbaji, mabawabu, na watumishi wa Hekalu waliishi katika miji yao wenyewe, pamoja na baadhi ya watu wengine, nao Waisraeli waliosalia waliishi katika miji yao.
Ekegusii: Abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande, bakaba bakomenya ime ya Yerusalemu na emechie eyoetanaine. Abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, nabarabwo bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo yaetanaine omochie o Yerusalemu, na Abaisraeli bonsi bakamenya ase emechie ase chisokoro chiabo chiamenyete.

English: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me.
Kiswahili: Nitawatakasa dhambi zote walizofanya dhidi yangu, na nitawasamehe dhambi zote za uasi dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Nimbachene korwa ase okomocha kwabo, na korwa ase ebibe bionsi bakorire ase 'nde; nimbaabere ebibe biabo bionsi na ogosaria bakorire ase 'nde.

English: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa muth-labeni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nitakutukuza kwa moyo wangu wote, nitayasimulia matendo yako yote ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ningoakere mbuya mono kegima n'enkoro yane yonsi. Nindarie emeremo yao yonsi y'ogokumia.

English: All other flying insects that have four legs are detestable to you.
Kiswahili: Lakini viumbe wengine wote wenye mabawa na wenye miguu minne ni machukizo kwenu. Wanyama Ambao Ni Najisi
Ekegusii: Korende ebinde bionsi ase ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia ase more.

English: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
Kiswahili: Nyara zilizobaki kutoka mateka ambayo askari walichukua ni kondoo 675,000,
Ekegusii: Ebisakorwa ebiatigarete ase abarwani b'esegi, ebi barentete ekero babuete, nabio ebi: ching'ondi, amo ne chimbori, chilifu amagana atano nomo na merongo etano na ebere na isano (675,000),

English: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. But if I am a father, where is My honor? And if I am a master, where is your fear of Me?” says the LORD of Hosts to you priests who despise My name. “But you ask, ‘How have we despised Your name?’
Kiswahili: “Mwana humheshimu baba yake, naye mtumishi humheshimu bwana wake. Kama mimi ni baba, iko wapi heshima ninayostahili? Kama mimi ni bwana, iko wapi heshima ninayostahili?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Ni ninyi, enyi makuhani, mnaolidharau Jina langu. “Lakini mnauliza, ‘Tumelidharau Jina lako kwa namna gani?’
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Omwana nigo asigete ise, na omosomba nairogete omonene oye. Onye inche inde iso oino, amasikani aino ase ’nde, ng’ai are? Na onye inde omonene, okonyiroka kwaino, ng’ai kore? Inwe abakuani nigo mochaayete erieta riane, naende nigo mokoboria: Nase enchera ki tochaayete erieta riao?

English: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.
Kiswahili: Nami nikaomba: “Ee Mungu wangu, natahayari na kuona aibu kukuinulia uso wangu Mungu wangu, kwa sababu dhambi zetu zimejikusanya hata kupita juu ya vichwa vyetu na hatia yetu imefika mbinguni.
Ekegusii: ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae one, nabeire nobosooku, na obosio bwane bwabeire nomoichano; tinkonyara gokorigereria aye Nyasae one. Ebibe biaito biabuchire gotoetania goika igoro, na okomocha gwaito gwaikire agwo igoro.

English: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
Kiswahili: maafa na yawapate ghafula: wavu walionifichia na uwatege wenyewe, na waanguke katika shimo hilo, kwa maangamizo yao.
Ekegusii: Ogosirigwa tiga kobanyore mobosokano; oboreba obwo bantegeire tiga bobabwate barabwo abanyene, tiga bagwe imeo abanyene na gosirigwa.

English: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
Kiswahili: Makutano makubwa ya watu yakawa yanamjia kutoka Galilaya, Dekapoli, Yerusalemu, Uyahudi na kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamotunyana korwa Galili, na Dekapoli, na Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi, na ng'umbu ya Yorodani.

English: Solomon’s provisions for a single day were thirty cors of fine flour, sixty cors of meal,
Kiswahili: Mahitaji ya Solomoni ya kila siku yalikuwa kori thelathini za unga laini, kori sitini za unga wa kawaida.
Ekegusii: Endagera Sulemani arenge korenterwa ase rituko erimo nigo yareenge: obosie obonuke, ebitonga amagana atato, na obosie bonde, ebitonga amagana atano na rimo,

English: Truly we went astray from the way of truth. The light of righteousness didn't shine for us. The sun didn't rise for us.
Kiswahili: Hakika tulipotoka kutoka katika njia ya kweli. Nuru ya haki haikutuangazia. Jua halikutuangazia.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe twangete chinchera chia boronge! Titwamenyete ase oborabu bw'ekeene, gose borabu bwaye tibwatobarerete.

English: For their tongue is polished by the workman, and they themselves are overlaid with gold and with silver; yet they are only fake, and can't speak.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ulimi wao umeng'arishwa na fundi, nao wenyewe wamefunikwa kwa dhahabu na fedha; lakini ni bandia tu, hawawezi kusema.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroisia chigutwa chi'echitaabu erio babekera chinyasae echio ase emetwe yabo, buna korengana bakobekera omoiseke bwanchete gwechabera.

English: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika yule aliyekuwa akizungumza nami akasema, “Tangaza neno hili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: ‘Nina wivu sana kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu na Sayuni,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omomalaika oria aganteebia, “Raria, otebe ng'a aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: Nigo inde ne risemi rinene ase engencho ya Yerusalemu na Sayoni.

English: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
Kiswahili: kila mara nilipotaka kumponya Israeli, dhambi za Efraimu zinafichuliwa na maovu ya Samaria yanafunuliwa. Wanafanya udanganyifu, wevi huvunja nyumba, maharamia hunyangʼanya barabarani,
Ekegusii: “Ekero nganetie kogwenia Abaisraeli, ogosaria kw'Abaefraimu na ogokora okobe kw'Abasamaria nigo gokororekana maiso marore. Barabwo nigo bagokora ay'obong'ainereria; abaibi nigo bagotagora chinyomba basoa ime, na ebiombe bi'abauri nigo bikourereria isiko.

English: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children's children—
Kiswahili: Mwe waangalifu, na makini ili msije mkasahau mambo ambayo mliyaona kwa macho yenu, wala kuyaacha yaondoke moyoni mwenu siku zote za uhai wenu. Mwafundishe hayo watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao.
Ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba ayamwarorire n'amaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abaachokoro baino,

English: For he didn't leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.
Kiswahili: Hapakubaki kitu chochote katika jeshi la Yehoahazi isipokuwa wapanda farasi hamsini, magari kumi ya vita na askari wa miguu elfu kumi, kwa kuwa mfalme wa Aramu alikuwa amewaangamiza hao wengine na kuwafanya kama mavumbi wakati wa kupura nafaka.
Ekegusii: Yehoahasi tatigareretigwe abasikari otatiga abariini chibarasi emerongo etano, ne chigari ikomi, na abanto baarenge gotaara namagoro chilifu ikomi, ekiagera omorwoti bw'Abasiiria aitete abanto bonsi bakaba buna orotu rw'ekeooreri rogotiringwa.

English: For this man, when he succeeded to the kingdom, appointed one Lysias to be chancellor and supreme governor of Coelesyria and Phoenicia.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu huyu, aliporithi ufalme, alimteua mmoja Lisia kuwa chansela na gavana mkuu wa Coelesyria na Foinike.
Ekegusii: Ekero Antioko Eupatori abete omorwoti, agachora omonto oyomo orenge korokwa Lisia abe omogabana omonene ase amang'ana yense boigo abe gabana omonene ase ense ya Siria enene na Foiniki,

English: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
Kiswahili: Fanyeni mambo yote bila kunungʼunika wala kushindana,
Ekegusii: Mokore amang'ana onsi motari nokwemurungania na okoborania,

English: Now when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he was furious and filled with indignation. He ridiculed the Jews
Kiswahili: Sanbalati aliposikia kwamba tulikuwa tunajenga ukuta upya, alikasirika na akawa na uchungu sana. Aliwadhihaki Wayahudi
Ekegusii: Ekero Sanibalati aigwete ng’a intwe Abayahudi konya twachakire koagacha orwaki rw’omochie naende, akaba nekeririanda ekenene, agachaaka gotochecheria.

English: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: As for you and your wives, you have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands your words: ‘We will surely perform our vows that we have made to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.’ Go ahead, then, do what you have promised! Keep your vows!
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: Ninyi na wake zenu mmeonyesha kwa matendo yenu kile mlichoahidi mliposema, ‘Hakika tutatimiza nadhiri tulizoziweka za kumfukizia uvumba na kummiminia sadaka za kinywaji Malkia wa Mbinguni.’ “Endeleeni basi, fanyeni yale mliyoahidi! Timizeni nadhiri zenu!
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Inwe amo nabakungu baino mwakorire na goikerania namaboko aino ayio mwakwanete nemenwa yaino, mogateba: Goika tokore buna twariete eira gokora; tosambe ubani ase Eting’ana ya Igoro, naende toumore okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa asere. Bono inwe kora bo, moikeranie chiira chiaino!

English: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
Kiswahili: Wote waliomsikia walistaajabishwa na uwezo wake mkubwa wa kuelewa, na majibu aliyoyatoa.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia ase okomanya kwaye na okoiraneria kwaye.

English: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’ ”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nawe, Bethlehemu, katika nchi ya Yuda, wewe si mdogo miongoni mwa watawala wa Yuda; kwa maana kutoka kwako atakuja mtawala atakayekuwa mchungaji wa watu wangu Israeli.’ ”
Ekegusii: ’Bethlehemu ase ense ya Yuda, ase enchera ende yonsi aye tori moke ase egati y’emechie emenene ya Yuda; ekiagera korwa ime yao nache omorai oyio orarae abanto baane ba Israeli.

English: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.
Kiswahili: Nyimbo za kushukuru zitatoka kwao na sauti ya furaha. Nitaiongeza idadi yao wala hawatapungua, nitawapa heshima na hawatadharauliwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nabatere amatera ay'ogoaka ng'a mbuya mono, mbaake amariogi 'omochengo. Nimbamentekanie babuche, na omobaro obo tokoba omoke. Ningere basikwe na tibakobarwa ng'a tibaisaini gento.

English: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme alimnyooshea Esta fimbo yake ya utawala ya dhahabu naye aliinuka na kusimama mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaimokia enyimbo eria y'etaabu, akayiorotera Esiteri. Esiteri akaimoka, agatenena ase obosio bw'omorwoti,

English: because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.” (Thus all foods are clean.)
Kiswahili: Mtu akila kitu hakiingii moyoni mwake bali tumboni, na baadaye hutolewa nje ya mwili wake.” (Kwa kusema hivi, Yesu alivihalalisha vyakula vyote kuwa ni “safi.”)
Ekegusii: ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebara?” (Ase ogoteeba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)

English: If a man loves righteousness, the fruits of wisdom's labor are virtues, for she teaches soberness, understanding, righteousness, and courage. There is nothing in life more profitable for people than these.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu anapenda haki, matunda ya kazi ya hekima ni fadhila, kwani inafundisha kiasi, uelewa, haki, na ujasiri. Hakuna kitu maishani chenye faida zaidi kwa watu kuliko hawa.
Ekegusii: Inee, aye mbwanchete ekeene? Bono engeria y'emeremo yobongaini nokoba nembwa engiya, koba nobomanyi boke, ekeene noboremu. Ase obogima kende tikeri kiya goetania ebi.

English: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
Kiswahili: Fahari na enzi viko mbele yake; nguvu na utukufu vimo patakatifu pake.
Ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na omogooko nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye.

English: And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us. So we have not drunk wine all our lives—neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Tumetii kila kitu ambacho baba yetu Yonadabu mwana wa Rekabu alituamuru. Sisi wenyewe wala wake zetu wala wana wetu na binti zetu kamwe hatujanywa divai
Ekegusii: Ase ayio intwe na abakungu baito, na abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, twabeire toigwerete Yonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, sokoro yaito, ase amang’ana onsi atochigeete ng’a titobaisa konywa edivai ase amatuko aito onsi.

English: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
Kiswahili: Umelikuza taifa, na kuzidisha furaha yao, wanafurahia mbele zako, kama watu wanavyofurahia wakati wa mavuno, kama watu wafurahivyo wagawanyapo nyara.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogooko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.

English: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Zabuloni, askari wenye uzoefu mkubwa walioandaliwa tayari kwa vita wakiwa na silaha za kila aina, ili kumsaidia Daudi kwa uaminifu thabiti, walikuwa 50,000.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abasabuloni: abarwani abakong’u baare nomoyo oyomo, baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, babwate ebirwanero biisaine, abanto chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).

English: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Reero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Aburaamu.

English: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?'
Kiswahili: Ingawa Hekalu hili linavutia sana sasa, wote watakaolipita watashangaa na kusema, ‘Kwa nini Bwana amefanya kitu kama hiki katika nchi hii na kwa Hekalu hili?'
Ekegusii: “Enyomba eye ere nogosikwa na obonene, korende ekero ekio kera omonto orabe ogoeta naichanigwe na gokumia, naende aborie: Nase ki Omonene akorire aya ase ense eye, na ase enyomba eye?

English: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaenda kwenye lango linaloelekea mashariki. Akapanda ngazi zake akapima kizingiti cha lango, nacho kilikuwa na kina cha huo ufito.
Ekegusii: Naende akagenda ase egeita kiarochie moocha, akariinera ebiriinero biaye. Erio akarengia obogare bw'egesona inse agwo ase oboagacho bw'egeita, bokaba emoti eyemo.

English: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes the flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Amelaaniwa yeye amtegemeaye mwanadamu, ategemeaye mwenye mwili kwa ajili ya nguvu zake, ambaye moyo wake umemwacha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Oragererigwe omonto oyo osemeretie Mwanyabaanto na kwegena chinguru chia Mwanyabaanto, oyio okoonchoka ase enkoro yaye ontiga inche Omonene.

English: “Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: “Sikia maneno ya agano hili, nawe uwaambie watu wa Yuda na wale waishio Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: riganteebia: “Igwa amang’ana ’okobwatana kw’ogotianania, kwana n’Abayuda na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu,

English: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
Kiswahili: Walifanya kama watu wanaotumia mashoka kukata kichaka cha miti.
Ekegusii: Nigo yarorekanete buna nabaanto bakogecha emete, bakaimokia ebisire kogecha rinani rinoru.

English: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,' because she was taken out of Man.”
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanaume akasema, “Huyu sasa ni mfupa wa mifupa yangu na nyama ya nyama yangu, ataitwa ‘mwanamke,' kwa kuwa alitolewa katika mwanaume.”
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agateeba, “Omoerio oyombwekaine oyo aa Oyo neriuga korwa ase amauga aane, ne chinyama korwa ase chinyama chiane. Oyo nigo ararokwe omokungu, ekiagera oyo nigo arusigwe ase omosacha.”

English: On the third day, Esther put on her royal attire and stood in the inner court of the palace across from the king’s quarters. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the royal courtroom, facing the entrance.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu, Esta alivaa mavazi yake ya kimalkia, naye akasimama katika ua wa ndani wa jumba la mfalme, mbele ya ukumbi wa mfalme. Naye mfalme alikuwa akiketi katika kiti chake cha kifalme katika ukumbi, akielekea langoni.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Esiteri akabeeka chianga chiaye chi’oboting’ana, akagenda agatenena ase egoora ya ime, ase enyomba y’omorwoti erochie enyomba enene y’omorwoti. Omorwoti nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kerochie gesieri ki’enyomba yaye.

English: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh's name.
Kiswahili: Naye Sethi akamzaa mwana, akamwita Enoshi. Wakati huo watu wakaanza kuliitia jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Seti nere akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Enosu. Erio agwo abanto bagachaaka korangeria erieta ri'Omonene ase okomosasiima.

English: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Abrahamu akaharakisha akaingia hemani kwa Sara, akamwambia, “Chukua vipimo vitatu vya unga laini haraka, ukande na uoke mikate.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Aburaamu akaayerera, agasoa eema ime agwo ase Sara arenge, akamoteebia: “Renta bwango obosie, ebirengo bitato, obokonye, oroisie emegati.”

English: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kulia kwangu kwa uchungu kwanijia badala ya chakula; kusononeka kwangu kunamwagika kama maji.
Ekegusii: Obororo bw'emechando yane bwabeire buna endagera nkoria, na ebirero biane nigo bigoiteka buna amaache.

English: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, but Lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
Kiswahili: Abramu akaishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakati Loti aliishi miongoni mwa miji ya lile bonde na kupiga mahema yake karibu na Sodoma.
Ekegusii: Aburamu akamenya ase ense ya Kaanani, na Loti nere akamenya egati y’emechie agwo ase ense eria y’omweya, akang’anyia eema yaye gochia Sodomu.

English: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”
Kiswahili: Niache, ili nipate kuwaangamiza na kufuta jina lao kutoka chini ya mbingu. Nami nitakufanya kuwa taifa lenye nguvu zaidi na kuwa wengi kuliko wao.”
Ekegusii: Tobaisa goteema gontanga, ’ntige imbasirie naende intinyie amarieta abo, nimbakore beebwe kegima, tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase ense, erio ’ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere ne chinguru kobabua.

English: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
Kiswahili: Heri wale watumishi ambao bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wakiwa wanakesha. Amin, nawaambia, atajifunga mkanda wake na kuwaketisha ili wale, naye atakuja na kuwahudumia.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abasomba baria ekero omonene obo agocha abanyore barendete. Ekeene nabateebirie: Neboyie, abaikaransie ase endagera, ache abakorere.

English: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni lile neno nililowaambia, ‘Hakuna mtumishi aliye mkuu kuliko bwana wake.’ Kama wamenitesa mimi, nanyi pia watawatesa. Kama wamelishika neno langu, watalishika na neno lenu pia.
Ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riria nabateebeetie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye. Onye banchandete inche, nabaabachande nainwe; onye babwatete ring’ana riane nabwate neriaino.

English: The next day the people of Shechem went out into the fields, and this was reported to Abimelech.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake watu wa Shekemu wakatoka wakaenda mashambani, Abimeleki akaambiwa juu ya jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bagasoka ase egetii aarabu, n’Abimeleki agateebigwa amang’ana ayio.

English: saying, ‘Please let me go, because our clan is holding a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has told me to be there. So now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go and see my brothers.’ That is why he did not come to the king’s table.” Saul Seeks to Kill Jonathan
Kiswahili: Alisema, ‘Niruhusu niende, kwa sababu jamaa yetu wana dhabihu mjini, na ndugu yangu ameniagiza niwepo huko. Kama nimepata kibali mbele yako, niruhusu niende kuona ndugu zangu.’ Hii ndiyo sababu hakuja mezani pa mfalme.”
Ekegusii: agateeba: Abanto b’eamate yane ngochia bare korua ekeng’wanso agwo ase omochie, na momura ominto onchikiire ng’a imbeo. Ase ayio, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa asore, ing’a ribaga ngende korora abaminto. Aya naro agera atachicha ase endagera yao, aye omorwoti.”

English: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'
Kiswahili: “Yule mwana akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nimekosa mbele za Mungu na mbele yako. Sistahili kuitwa mwanao tena.'
Ekegusii: Omwana oria akamoteebia: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao, tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo.

English: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for the LORD has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kamwe mfalme asijipatie hesabu kubwa ya farasi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, au kuwafanya watu warudi Misri ili kupata farasi zaidi, kwa maana Bwana amekuambia, “Hamtairudia njia ile tena.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oyio takwementera chibarasi chinyinge, gose tabaisa gotoma abanto bairane Misiri ase ogochia korigia chibarasi chinyinge, ekiagera Omonene obateebirie ng’a timokonyaara koirana gochia ase enchera eria naende.

English: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.
Kiswahili: Inampasa Mfalme ajue kwamba tulikwenda katika eneo la Yuda, kwenye Hekalu la Mungu mkuu. Watu wanalijenga kwa mawe makubwa na kuweka mbao kwenye kuta. Kazi inafanyika kwa bidii na inaendelea kwa haraka chini ya uongozi wao.
Ekegusii: “Nigo togokomanyia aye omorwoti ng'a intwe ntwagenda ase orogongo orwo rw'Abayuda, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oyore omonene. Nigo egendererete koagacherwa amagena amanene mono, ne chibao chibekire ase chinyasi. Ekeene, emeremo eye nigo egokorwa ase okwerwa okonene, na nigo esesenirie ase amaboko abo.

English: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
Kiswahili: Mungu anatawala juu ya mataifa, Mungu ameketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki'obonene kere egechenu.

English: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ahadi hii ni kwa ajili yenu na watoto wenu, na kwa wote walio mbali, na kila mtu ambaye Bwana Mungu wetu atamwita amjie.”
Ekegusii: Naki eira eye nigo ere ase more na ase abana baino, na ase abanto bonsi abare aare, na bonsi abarangerigwe n'Omonene nyasae oito.”

English: But God understands its way, and He knows its place.
Kiswahili: Mungu anaifahamu njia ya kuiendea hekima na ndiye peke yake anayefahamu inakokaa,
Ekegusii: “Nyasae bweka namanyete enchera y’obong’aini, namanyete aase aye.

English: For truly it was neither herb nor poultice that cured them, but your word, O Lord, which heals all people.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kweli haikuwa mimea wala dawa ya kuua iliyowaponya, bali neno lako, Ee Bwana, linalowaponya watu wote.
Ekegusii: Riogo rinde tiriyo riabagwenetie, korende goetera ase ring'ana riao rioka, aye Omonene abanto bao bakagwena.

English: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Bali kueni katika neema na katika kumjua Bwana na Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo. Utukufu una yeye sasa na milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: Korende mokine ase obuya na ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo. Obonene nobwaye bono na goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: he sent messengers to capture him. But when they saw the group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel leading them, the Spirit of God came upon them, and Saul’s messengers also began to prophesy.
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli akatuma watu kumkamata Daudi, lakini walipoona kundi la manabii wakitoa unabii, wakiwa pamoja na Samweli akiwa amesimama hapo kama kiongozi wao, Roho wa Mungu akaja juu ya watu wa Sauli, nao pia wakatoa unabii.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo agatoma Abanto boyie Daudi. Korende ekero Abanto aba baigeteo, bakarora ekeombe ki’ababani bakobaboka ase okobana, na Samweli oteneineo buna omotang’ani obo. Omoika o Nyasae ogaika igoro ase bare, nabarabwo boigo bagaachaka kobana.

English: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, umeona wanayoyafanya wazee wa nyumba ya Israeli gizani, kila mmoja kwenye sehemu yake mwenyewe ya kufanyia ibada za sanamu yake? Wao husema, ‘ Bwana hatuoni, Bwana ameiacha nchi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwarorire egento abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagokora ase omosunte, kera oyomo ase akanunchi ka’ye k’emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa? Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: Omonene tatorochi. Ere otigire ense eye.”

English: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
Kiswahili: Eleazari akafa bila ya kuwa na wana: alikuwa na binti tu. Binamu zao, wana wa Kishi, wakawaoa.
Ekegusii: Eleazari nigo akwete atabwati abana abamura, korende nabwate abana abaiseke. Abanto bamwabo, abana abamura ba Kisi, bakanyuoma abaiseke baria.

English: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, sheria ilikuwa kiongozi kutufikisha kwa Kristo, ili tupate kuhesabiwa haki kwa imani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko abeire omotebereria oito agotoira goika ase Kristo, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okwegena.

English: This is the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel. Thus declares the LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, who forms the spirit of man within him:
Kiswahili: Hili ni neno la Bwana kuhusu Israeli. Bwana, yeye azitandaye mbingu, awekaye misingi ya dunia na aiumbaye roho ya mwanadamu ndani yake, asema:
Ekegusii: Eri n’ering’ana rikong’u ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba, oyio oramborete igoro chionsi na akabeeka oboroso bw’ense, oyio otongete omoika ime ase omonto:

English: Nehemiah and those who were with him called this thing “Nephthar”, which is by interpretation, “Cleansing”; but most men call it Nephthai.
Kiswahili: Nehemia na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye walikiita kitu hiki “Nefthari,” ambacho kwa tafsiri yake ni “Utakaso”; lakini watu wengi hukiita Nefthai.
Ekegusii: Nehemia n'abasani baye bakaroka amache ayio “nafthari”, engencho yaye ogochenwa; korende ange abanto bonsi nigo bakoroka amache ayio 'naftha.

English: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akageuka, akawaona wakimfuata akawauliza, “Mnataka nini?” Wakamwambia, “Rabi,” (maana yake Mwalimu), “Unaishi wapi?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamoteebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga'i omenyete?”

English: When he makes his prayer concerning goods and his marriage and children, he is not ashamed to speak to that which has no life.
Kiswahili: Anapoomba kwa ajili ya mali na ndoa yake na watoto, haoni haya kusema na kile kisicho na uhai.
Ekegusii: Korende ere tari koba n'obosoku ekero agochaka gosasiima omobwekano oyo otari na bomoyo ochaka koyoteebia igoro y'enywomo yaye boigo n'abana baye.

English: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
Kiswahili: Lakini wafu wenu wataishi, nayo miili yao itafufuka. Ninyi mnaokaa katika mavumbi, amkeni mkapige kelele kwa furaha. Umande wenu ni kama umande wa asubuhi, dunia itawazaa wafu wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto baino bakwete mbabe moyo naende; emebere y’abakwete neboke. Inwe abwo moraire ase amaroba ime, boka, motere nomogooko! Riime riao nigo rire eri’oborabu; riroba ndibairanie abakwete. Ekiina na ogokorwa oboyia

English: With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles.” So the people were strengthened by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah. Sennacherib Threatens Jerusalem (2 Kings 18:17–37; Isaiah 36:1–22)
Kiswahili: Kwake uko mkono wa mwili tu, bali kwetu yuko Bwana Mungu wetu kutusaidia na kutupigania vita vyetu.” Nao watu wakatiwa moyo kutokana na maneno aliyowaambia Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oria nigo are ne chinguru chia Mwanyabaanto, korende Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are amo naintwe ase ogotokonya na gotorwanisia.” Abanto bakaba abaremu ase engencho y’amang’ana a Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda.

English: For while they were disbelieving all things by reason of the enchantments, upon the destruction of the firstborn they confessed the people to be God's children.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana walipokuwa wakikataa vitu vyote kwa sababu ya uchawi, walipowaangamiza wazaliwa wa kwanza, walikiri watu kuwa watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibaigwerete ogokuurerwa nigo begenete oborogi bwabo. Korende ekero abana babo abatangi basiretigwe, bakamanya nga ekeene abanto abwo na ba Nyasae.

English: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
Kiswahili: Nazo ishara hizi zitafuatana na wanaoamini: Kwa Jina langu watatoa pepo wachafu; watasema kwa lugha mpya;
Ekegusii: Na ebimanyererio ebi bie chinguru nabibatunyane abwo begenire: Ase erieta riane nabaserie ebirecha, nabakwane ase emenwa emeyia,

English: The donkey saw Yahweh's angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
Kiswahili: Wakati punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama barabarani akiwa na upanga uliofutwa mkononi mwake, punda akageukia upande kuelekea shambani. Balaamu akampiga ili amrudishe barabarani.
Ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria obwate omoyio o birende koboko kwaye, ekagobera gochia enchera ensemo, ekageenda ase omogondo. Baalamu agaaka etigere eria koyeirania ase enchera.

English: This is our God. No other can be compared to him.
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye Mungu wetu, hakuna mwingine anayeweza kulinganishwa naye.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere omanyete enchera ekogenda ase okomanya na akaa abasomba baye Abaisraeli abwo anchete obong'aini

English: I was exalted like a palm tree on the sea shore, like rose bushes in Jericho, and like a fair olive tree in the plain. I was exalted like a plane tree.
Kiswahili: Niliinuliwa kama mtende kwenye ufuo wa bahari, kama vichaka vya waridi huko Yeriko, na kama mzeituni mzuri katika uwanda. Niliinuliwa kama mti wa mwaloni.
Ekegusii: Ngatambea buna emekendo ya Engedi, buna amaua yobwanchani a Yeriko, buna emesabibu ekogokia erandete ase omogondo, buna emete ye chindeege emerete rooche mbarabare.

English: Afterward, Joshua read aloud all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—according to all that is written in the Book of the Law.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, Yoshua akasoma maneno yote ya sheria, yaani baraka na laana, kama vile ilivyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Sheria.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akabasomera amang’ana onsi ay’amachiiko, ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa, buna ariikire ase Egetabu ki’Amachiko.

English: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
Kiswahili: Daudi alimwimbia Bwana maneno ya wimbo huu wakati Bwana alipomwokoa mikononi mwa adui zake wote, na pia mkononi mwa Sauli.
Ekegusii: Oko nogoteera Daudi atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baye na aya Saulo.

English: The child's mother said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.
Kiswahili: Lakini mama mtoto akasema, “Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo na wewe uishivyo, sitakuacha.” Kwa hiyo Elisha akainuka, akafuatana naye.
Ekegusii: Ng'ina omwana oria agateeba: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase ayio Elisha akaimoka akamotunyana.

English: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Mtakapovuka Mto Yordani, makabila haya yatasimama juu ya Mlima Gerizimu kubariki watu: Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari, Yosefu na Benyamini.
Ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwambokire gochia ng'umbu ya Yorodani, Abasimeoni, na Abalawi, na Abayuda, na Abaisakaru, na Abayusufu, na Ababenjamini, batenene igoro ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu, basesenie abanto.

English: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wengine wakamtuma Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari katika nchi ya Gileadi, kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw'Eleazari, Omokuani, gochia ase abanto b'egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng'ese ki'egesaku kia Manase, ase ense ya Gileadi.

English: And Holofernes said to her, “But if the things that are with you should run out, from where will we be able to give you more like it? For there is none of your race with us.”
Kiswahili: Holoferne akamwambia, "Lakini kama vitu vilivyomo vitaisha, tutaweza kukupa wapi vingine kama hivyo? Kwa maana hakuna mtu wa kabila lako aliye pamoja nasi."
Ekegusii: Erio Holoferne akamoboori, “Ninki torakore ekero endagera amo ne edivai kwabogoretie egochia gokoerera? Inaki toranyore endaagera ogochia koria? Rora intwe titori na Abaisraeli bamenyete naintwe ase chiema chiaito.”

English: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
Kiswahili: Bwana ameapa, naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
Ekegusii: Omonene otianire, takoonchora ebirengererio biaye: “Aye nigo ore Omokuani goika kare na kare, koreng'ana buna Melkizedeki.”

English: Just then the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
Kiswahili: Lakini malaika wa Bwana akamwita kutoka mbinguni, akamwambia, “Abrahamu! Abrahamu!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Korende omomalaika Omonene akamorangeria korwa igoro, akabora: “Aburaamu, Aburaamu!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

English: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
Kiswahili: Malango ya mto yamefunguliwa wazi, na jumba la kifalme limeanguka.
Ekegusii: Ebiita bire ange na roche biaigoirwe n'echinguru; enka y'omorwoti yaichoirwe nomoondoko.

English: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
Kiswahili: “Hakika hatakuwa na raha katika kutamani kwake sana; hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe kwa hazina zake.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ribero ri'omonto oyio riagerire taba n'obotoereru, takonyara kogaacha gento kende gekomogokia.

English: The weight of gold that came to Solomon each year was 666 talents,
Kiswahili: Uzito wa dhahabu ambayo Solomoni alipokea kwa mwaka ulikuwa talanta 666,
Ekegusii: Etaabu yaare korentwa ase Sulemani kera omwaka nigo yarenge goetania chikiro chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000).

English: When the morning came, they lifted up their eyes and saw many people who couldn't be counted, bearing ladders and engines of war, to take the stronghold; and they were fighting against them.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi ilipofika, waliinua macho yao na kuona watu wengi ambao hawakuweza kuhesabiwa, wakiwa wamebeba ngazi na mitambo ya vita, ili kuiteka ngome; nao walikuwa wakipigana nao.
Ekegusii: Mambia chuni, Yuda amo na abanto baye bakarora abarwani esegi abange batanyaare kobareka babogoretie chingazi na ebirwanero, baganetie koira ense na kobagwera Abayahudi.

English: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
Kiswahili: Sheshani akamwoza huyu mtumishi wake Yarha binti yake, akamzalia mwana jina lake Atai.
Ekegusii: Sesani akaa Yara, omosomba oye, omoiseke oye akaba mokaye; ere akaibora omomura orenge korokwa Atai.

English: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
Kiswahili: (Basi Mose alikuwa mtu mnyenyekevu sana, mnyenyekevu kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote katika uso wa dunia.)
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio Musa nigo arenge omoitongo mono kobua abanto bonsi barenge ase ense.

English: But Jesus replied, “A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa anaandaa karamu kubwa, akaalika watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto oyomo okorete omoyega omonene; akarangeria abanto abange.

English: Thus the Israelites were subdued at that time, and the men of Judah prevailed because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli walitiishwa katika tukio lile, nao watu wa Yuda wakawa washindi kwa sababu walimtegemea Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao.
Ekegusii: Igo Abaisraeli bakabugwa bakabeekwa inse y’obogambi bw’Abayuda, na Abayuda nigo babuete ekiagera basemeretie Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.

English: They tilled their land in peace, and the land gave her increase, and the trees of the plains gave their fruit.
Kiswahili: Walilima ardhi yao kwa amani, nayo nchi ikatoa mavuno yake, na miti ya nchi tambarare ikazaa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakarema ase emegondo yaabo ase omorembe, ense ekarua okwama kwaye na amatunda akaama ase obonge.

English: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Katika Sheria imeandikwa kwamba: “Kupitia kwa watu wenye lugha ngʼeni na kupitia midomo ya wageni, nitasema na watu hawa, lakini hata hivyo hawatanisikiliza,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase amachiiko nigo ariikire, “Omonene oteebire: Ase abanto b’emenwa etamanyekaneti, na ase ebikoba bi’emenwa y’abageni ninkwane nabaanto aba. Nonya nabo tibakonyigwera.”

English: “Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you during the reign of Josiah until today.
Kiswahili: “Chukua kitabu uandike ndani yake maneno yote niliyonena nawe kuhusu Israeli, Yuda na mataifa mengine yote, tangu nilipoanza kunena nawe wakati wa utawala wa Yosia hadi sasa.
Ekegusii: “Imokia egetabu, orike ime yaye amang’ana onsi nakwanete naye igoro y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda, na igoro y’ebisaku bionsi. Orike kera egento gochakera rituko riria nakwanete naye, ekero Yosia arenge kogamba, goika rituko ria reero.

English: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, usiniache, hata niwapo mzee wa mvi, mpaka nitangaze uwezo wako kwa kizazi kijacho, nguvu zako kwa wote watakaokuja baadaye.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, namerire chimbuche chiarabire se, goika imbe narareirie abanto b’ebiaare bigochi-gocha chinguru chiao, na okobua kwao.

English: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn't it put on a stand?
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Je, taa huwashwa na kufunikwa chini ya kikapu au mvunguni mwa kitanda? Je, haiwashwi na kuwekwa juu ya kinara chake?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Etaya nigo ekorentwa erinde yamumekwa negetonga gose yabekwa nyaro y'oborere? Teri kobekwa igoro ase ekebekerero?

English: then exchange it for money, take the money in your hand, and go to the place the LORD your God will choose.
Kiswahili: basi badilisheni zaka yenu kuwa fedha, mkaichukue hiyo fedha mwende nayo mahali Bwana Mungu wenu atakapopachagua.
Ekegusii: rirorio moonchorerie ebinto ebio ase chitaabu, erinde mochiire aase agwo Omonene oino achoorire.

English: Many will commend his understanding. So long as the world endures, it won't be blotted out. His memory won't depart. His name will live from generation to generation.
Kiswahili: Wengi watasifu uelewa wake. Maadamu ulimwengu utaendelea kuwepo, hautafutwa. Kumbukumbu lake halitaondoka. Jina lake litadumu kizazi baada ya kizazi.
Ekegusii: Obomanyi bwaye inabotogigwe nabaanto abange, naborobwo obwo tibokwebwa nonya ng'ake. Chinkuma chiaye tichigosira, nerieta riaye inarinyorwe ase ebiare bionsi.

English: Is there any help within me now that success is driven from me?
Kiswahili: Je, ninao uwezo wowote wa kujisaidia mimi mwenyewe, wakati ambapo mafanikio yamefukuziwa mbali nami?
Ekegusii: Ekeene gokonywa konde gwonsi tikori ime yane, amagenderero nabwate naurirwe.

English: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamchukua, wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.
Ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita.

English: And just as you saw a stone being cut out of the mountain without human hands, and it shattered the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold, so the great God has told the king what will happen in the future. The dream is true, and its interpretation is trustworthy.” Nebuchadnezzar Promotes Daniel
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo maana ya maono ya jiwe lililochongwa kutoka mlimani, lakini si kwa mikono ya mwanadamu, lile jiwe ambalo lilivunja chuma, shaba, udongo wa mfinyanzi, fedha na dhahabu vipande vipande. “Mungu Mkuu amemwonyesha mfalme kile kitakachotokea wakati ujao. Ndoto hii ni ya kweli na tafsiri yake ni ya kuaminika.”
Ekegusii: buna koreng’ana kwarooche rigena rigotegoka rinyene korwa ase egetunwa, ritategoiri namaboko ya Mwanyabaanto, ne rigena riria rigaaka na gosamunyora ekioma, na etai, na amaroba, na efeta, na etaabu. Nyasae ore omonene okomanyirie aye omorwoti amang’ana agochi‐gocha. Chindoto chiao nechi’ekeene, na engencho yaye nagotebirie ney’ekeene.” Omorwoti okoa Danieli obonene

English: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo pia niliwaambia watu, “Kila mtu na msaidizi wake wakae ndani ya Yerusalemu wakati wa usiku, ili waweze kutumika kama walinzi wakati wa usiku, na kufanya kazi wakati wa mchana.”
Ekegusii: Boigo ngateebia abanto ng'a kera omonto amo nomosomba oye babeere aiga Yerusalemu, babe bakorenda botuko, na mobaso babe bagokora emeremo y'okoagacha.

English: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn't come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,
Kiswahili: Samweli akamuuliza, “Umefanya nini?” Sauli akajibu, “Nilipoona kwamba watu wanatawanyika, na kwamba hukuja wakati uliopangwa na kwamba Wafilisti walikuwa wakikusanyika huko Mikmashi,
Ekegusii: Samweli akamobooria: “Inki eke gwakorire?” Saulo akamoiraneria: “Nigo narora ng'a Abanto ngotama bare korwa ase 'nde, naende naye gwateebana, tocheti ase engaki eria gwateebete ng'a nochiche. Boigo Abafirisiti konya basangererekanire agwo Mikimasi.

English: Dont treat me like a fool, he shouted, and stormed into the hut. He closed the door and opened the bag himself. The angry bees swarmed out and stung his head, his nose, his eyes. Blinded, he jumped about, howling with pain.
Kiswahili: Jitu lilikimbia kuelekea kwenye bwawa la maji. Lilichopeka kichwa kwenye matope likakwama huko. Liligeuka na kuwa kisiki cha mti uliokatwa. Nyuki walijenga nyumba yao kwenye kisiki hicho. Baadaye, Demane na Demazane walifurahia asali tamu kutoka kwa mzinga huo wa nyuki.
Ekegusii: Akaminyoka na kogwa nomotwe ime yamache, omotwe oye okananta ase esike. Agaonchokera omote orenge ang'e naende akanyora nekonu yechinchoke. Korwa abuo ase engaki etambe, Demane na Demazane bakaria oboke obwansu korwa ase ekonu eria.

English: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
Kiswahili: Watu wakasimama hapo wakimwangalia, nao viongozi wa Wayahudi wakamdhihaki wakisema, “Aliokoa wengine! Ajiokoe mwenyewe basi, kama yeye ndiye Kristo wa Mungu, Mteule wake.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagatenena, bakarigereria. Na barabwo abanyene bakamokorera echeche, bakaboora, “Natooretie abande, tiga etoorie ere omonyene, onye oyo nere Kristo o Nyasae, Omochore oye.”

English: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Maneno ya Mhubiri, mwana wa Daudi, mfalme huko Yerusalemu:
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang'ana 'omorandia mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti o Yerusalemu.

English: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary among them forever.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya nao Agano la amani, litakuwa Agano la milele. Nitawafanya imara na kuongeza idadi yao, nami nitaweka mahali patakatifu pangu miongoni mwao milele.
Ekegusii: Ninkore okobwatana kw’omorembe amo nabarabwo; okwo nigo korabe ogwa kare na kare. Nimbabeeke aroro, mbamentekanie. Nimbeke Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.

English: Begging will be sweet in the mouth of the shameless, but it kindles a fire in his belly.
Kiswahili: Kuombaomba kutakuwa kutamu kinywani mwa asiye na haya, lakini huwasha moto tumboni mwake.
Ekegusii: Ase omonto otari negesookero, ogosaberera nigo kore asere ogwansu, korende ime yaye nigo oreo omorero okomosaamba.

English: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
Kiswahili: Kama mataifa Bwana aliyoyaangamiza mbele yenu, ndivyo ninyi mtakavyoangamizwa kwa kutokumtii Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Buna ebisaku biria, Omonene arasirie korwa ase amasio aino, naboigo nainwe morasirigwe, ekiagera motaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oino.”

English: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I'm not lying.
Kiswahili: Nawahakikishia mbele za Mungu kuwa ninayowaandikia si uongo.
Ekegusii: Ayio nkobariikera, nekeene. Nyasae namanyete buna tindi kongainereria!

English: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don't know about.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Mimi ninacho chakula ambacho ninyi hamkifahamu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”

English: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Efraimu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 32,500. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi'egesaku gia Efraimu. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato na ibere, na amagana atano (32,500). Aba nabwo barenge abana ba Yusufu ne chiamate chiabo.

English: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akasema, “Bwana, naamini.” Naye akamwabudu.
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Omonene, negenire”; akamosasiima.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah:
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likamjia, kusema,
Ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija rikamoteebia,

English: While he was speaking these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and became speechless.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akinielezea haya, nilisujudu uso wangu ukiwa umeelekea chini, nikawa bubu.
Ekegusii: Ekero akoorete gokwana nainche amang’ana aya, ngetureka gochia inse, nkaba rimansu.

English: say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ For they have turned their backs to Me and not their faces, yet in the time of trouble they beg, ‘Rise up and save us!’
Kiswahili: Wanaiambia miti, ‘Wewe ndiwe baba yangu,’ nalo jiwe, ‘Wewe ndiwe uliyenizaa.’ Wamenipa visogo vyao wala hawakunigeuzia nyuso zao; lakini wakiwa katika taabu, wanasema, ‘Njoo utuokoe!’
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamogoteeba ng’a, omote noro iso, ne rigena nario nyoko, nigo morasookigwe. Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera mwantigire na kong’a amagega; timong’onchorereti amasio aino. Korende ekero more nemechando mwabora: Inchuo ototoorie.

English: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote. Lakini nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na utoe sadaka aliyoamuru Mose, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Rigereria, toteebia monto onde ing'ana; korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng'wanso egiachigetwe na Musa, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”

English: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Enyi wanafiki! Je, kila mmoja wenu hamfungulii ngʼombe wake au punda wake kutoka zizini akampeleka kumnywesha maji siku ya Sabato?
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inwe abang'ainereria, Inee, kera oyomo oino tari gosibora eng'ombe yaye gose etigere yaye korwa bweri ase rituko ri'Esabato, ogenda nero koyenyoisia?

English: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”
Kiswahili: Yohana akawaambia, “Aliye na kanzu mbili amgawie asiye nayo, naye aliye na chakula na afanye vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Oyore ne chianga ibere ae ere oyotari nero; na oyore nendagera akore boigo.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagoteebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”

English: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ndugu yangu, natamani nipate faida kwako katika Bwana, uuburudishe moyo wangu katika Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ee, oyominto, ninganetie obokonyi bokorwa ase ore, ekiagera noyo bw'Omonene ore. Buna oyominto ase Kristo, ong'e omoyo!

English: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
Kiswahili: aliyetenda ishara zote zile za miujiza na maajabu ambayo Bwana alimtuma kuyatenda huko Misri, yaani kwa Farao na maafisa wake wote na nchi yake yote.
Ekegusii: Onde tana gotooka okorete ebikone buna ebi Omonene atomete Musa kobikora ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Farao amo n'abasomba baye, na ense yaye yonsi.

English: In the fourth year of Hezekiah’s reign, which was the seventh year of the reign of Hoshea son of Elah over Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and besieged it.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa nne wa Mfalme Hezekia, ambao ulikuwa mwaka wa saba wa Hoshea mwana wa Ela kutawala Israeli, Shalmanesa mfalme wa Ashuru alikwenda kuishambulia Samaria na kuuzunguka kwa majeshi.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kane bw’okogaamba kwa Hezekia omorwoti, noro omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogaamba kwa Hosea, mosinto o Ela, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, Salimaneseri, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda korwania Samaria, akayoboera.

English: Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers. Jacob and Esau (Malachi 1:1–5; Romans 9:6–29)
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Ishmaeli waliishi kuanzia nchi ya Havila hadi Shuri, karibu na mpaka wa Misri, unapoelekea Ashuru. Hao waliishi kwa uhasama na ndugu zao wote. Yakobo Na Esau
Ekegusii: Abana ba Isumaeli nigo baamenyete bagachaakera Havila, bagaika Suri moocha ya Misiri, ase enchera ekogenda Asuri; bakamenya babebekaine n’abamwabo bonsi. Okoiborwa gwa Esau na Yakobo

English: Even from your own number, men will rise up and distort the truth to draw away disciples after them.
Kiswahili: Hata kutoka miongoni mwenu watainuka watu na kuupotosha ukweli ili wawavute wanafunzi wawafuate.
Ekegusii: naende korwa ase egati yaino abanto mbaimoke bagokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria, bang’use aborokigwa babatunyane.

English: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the LORD has brought her grief because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.
Kiswahili: Adui zake wamekuwa mabwana zake, watesi wake wana raha. Bwana amemletea huzuni kwa sababu ya dhambi zake nyingi. Watoto wake wamekwenda uhamishoni, mateka mbele ya adui.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baye babeire abanene baye, ee, ababisa baye nigo bagendererete goseseneka. Omonene oyotomeire emechando ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaye okonge, na ababisa baye bairire abana baye ase obosomba.

English: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu. Kwa hivyo wakawa wanamwangalia sana ili waone kama ataponya katika siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Aborokia b'amariiko na Abafarisai bakamotega korora gose namogwenie ase rituko ri'Esabato, banyare komosoera.

English: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
Kiswahili: Watabeba mapazia ya maskani. Hema la Kukutania, kifuniko chake na kifuniko cha nje cha ngozi za pomboo, mapazia ya maingilio ya Hema la Kukutania,
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbabogorie ebitambaa bi’Obomenyo Obochenu amo nebitubo bi’Eema eria, ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche rikobituba, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema eria,

English: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana taabu zisizo na hesabu zimenizunguka, dhambi zangu zimenikamata, hata nisiweze kuona. Zimekuwa nyingi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, nao moyo unazimia ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Amabe amange atari kobareka nigo ang'etanaine. Ebibe biane biambuire, goika tinkonyara korora; biabeire ebinge kobua etukia y'omotwe one, goika nerusirie moyo.

English: Yahweh says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Kama sijathibitisha agano langu na usiku na mchana, na kuziweka wakfu sheria za mbingu na nchi,
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Inche nakorete okobwatana igoro y'omobaso na obotuko, na emeroberio echikeire igoro na ense. Onye ntakong'etie okobwatana okwo,

English: Hailstones full of wrath will be hurled as from a catapult. The water of the sea will be angered against them. Rivers will sternly overwhelm them.
Kiswahili: Mvua ya mawe iliyojaa ghadhabu itarushwa kama kutoka kwa manati. Maji ya bahari yatawakasirikia, mito itawafurika kwa ukali.
Ekegusii: Embura y'amagena nebachere buna chinsara n'eritimo; amacha anyancha nache ase obororo ase engencho yabo, nechindoche nchibasiri chitari n'mabera.

English: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikuwa mcha Mungu pamoja na wote wa nyumbani mwake. Aliwapa watu sadaka nyingi na kumwomba Mungu daima.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, nere amo n’abanto b’enyomba yaye bonsi nigo bamoirogete Nyasae. Nigo are koa abanto ebiegwa ebinge n’omoyo oyomo na kogenderera gosaba Nyasae botambe.

English: So Daniel was brought before the king, who asked him, “Are you Daniel, one of the exiles my father the king brought from Judah?
Kiswahili: Hivyo Danieli akaletwa mbele ya mfalme, naye mfalme akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiwe Danieli, mmoja wa watu wa uhamisho walioletwa na mfalme baba yangu kutoka Yuda?
Ekegusii: Erio Danieli akarentwa ase obosio bw’omorwoti, na omorwoti akamobooria: “Inee! Naye Danieli oria, oyomo bw’ abanto baria boosetwe korwa ase ense y’Abayuda, oria omorwoti tata arentete korwa ase ense eria?

English: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
Kiswahili: Laiti ungelipasua mbingu na kushuka chini, ili milima ingelitetemeka mbele zako!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki otari gotandora igoro oike gocha inse aa, erinde ebitunwa bitengechigwe ase obosio bwao?

English: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi alivyokuwa mkuu: Hata Abrahamu, baba yetu mkuu, alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya nyara zake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, rigereria buna omonto oyo arenge omonene! Aburaamu, omogaka oito o kare, akamoa ensemo ya ikomi y'ebinto asakorete korwa ase esegi.

English: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, “They have brought the heads of the sons of the king.” And Jehu ordered, “Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning.”
Kiswahili: Mjumbe alipofika, akamwambia Yehu, “Wameleta vichwa vya wana wa mfalme.” Ndipo Yehu akaagiza, “Viwekeni malundo mawili katika ingilio la lango la mji mpaka asubuhi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto arentete amang’ana ng’a emetwe y’abana b’omorwoti yarentirwe, Yehu agateeba: “Yebeke amo ase chitui ibere agwo ase egesoero ki’egeita, ebeereo goika mambia.”

Kiswahili: Petro alipobisha hodi kwenye lango la nje, mtumishi wa kike jina lake Roda, akaja kumfungulia.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Petero achia gotura egesieri kia geita, omoiseke omosomba, okorokwa Roda, agaacha koigwa.

English: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
Kiswahili: Mnategemea panga zenu, mnafanya mambo ya machukizo na kila mmoja wenu humtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake. Je, mtaimiliki nchi?’
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwegenete emioro yaino; nigo mogokora ay’okogechia, kera oyomo oino nigo agotomana nomokuungu bw’omonto onde. Inee! Naki moranyare koira ense eye ebe eyaino?

English: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
Kiswahili: Paulo alipotokea, wale Wayahudi waliokuwa wameteremka toka Yerusalemu wakasimama wakiwa wamemzunguka, wakileta mashtaka mengi mazito dhidi yake ambayo hawakuweza kuyathibitisha.
Ekegusii: Ekero Paulo achire, Abayahudi abarwete Yerusalemu bagatenena, bakamoetanana, bakarenta amasoero amange amarito igoro yaye, ayabatanyare koorokia oboene ng'a mboronge are.

English: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa ndoto, nasi sasa tutamfasiria mfalme.
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorota kwarotete, na bono intwe ntogoteebie aye omorwoti engencho yaye.

English: And you yourself will relinquish the inheritance that I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land that you do not know, for you have kindled My anger; it will burn forever.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kosa lako mwenyewe utaupoteza urithi niliokupa. Nitakufanya mtumwa wa adui zako katika nchi usiyoijua, kwa kuwa umeiwasha hasira yangu, nayo itawaka milele.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio namotige omwando oyo nabaete, na inche mbatige mokorere ababisa baino ase ense inwe motamanyeti, ekiagera endamwamu yane nigo ere buna omorero outire, nosambe kogenderera botambe.” Amang’ana ao ao ay’Omonene

English: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.
Kiswahili: Sadaka ya kinywaji itakayotolewa pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo ni robo ya hini ya kinywaji kilichochachuka. Mimina sadaka ya kinywaji kwa Bwana mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Orue okoruegwa gw'ekenyugwa egetuba ekemo, amo nemingichi eria entang'ani. Ekenyugwa eke egetindi keraumorwe agwo Aase Aachenu, ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: The meat of the sacrifice of his peace offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day he offers it; none of it may be left until morning.
Kiswahili: Nyama ya sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya shukrani lazima iliwe siku iyo hiyo inapotolewa; hutabakiza kitu chochote mpaka asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono chiriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa; tichibaisa gotigara nonya ne chinsinini goika rituko ria kabere.

English: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.
Kiswahili: Bakbukia na Uni, wenzao, walisimama mkabala nao wakati wa ibada.
Ekegusii: Bakibukia na Uno, abamwabo, bagatenena kororia ase bare, ekero barenge gokora emeremo yabo ase Hekalu.

English: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to Yahweh, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
Kiswahili: Basi Yuda wakageuka na kuona kwamba wanashambuliwa mbele na nyuma. Ndipo wakamlilia Bwana. Makuhani wakapiga tarumbeta zao,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abayuda barigereretie bakarora ng'a esegi nigo yarenge bosio bwabo na magega abo, na igo bakarera ase Omonene, na abakuani bakabugia ebitureeri biria.

English: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
Kiswahili: Baada yake, Abdoni mwana wa Hileli, Mpirathoni, akawa mwamuzi wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Magega ya Eloni, Abidoni, mosinto o Hileli, Omopiratori, akagaambera Abaisraeli.

English: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Greetings from Paul’s Fellow Workers (Colossians 4:7–14)
Kiswahili: Mungu wa amani atamponda Shetani chini ya miguu yenu upesi. Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe namionogorere Saitani inse y’amagoro aino bwango. Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

English: The children of slave-girls pierced them through, and wounded them as fugitives' children. They perished by the army of my Lord.
Kiswahili: Watoto wa watumwa wa kike waliwachoma, na kuwajeruhi kama watoto wa wakimbizi. Waliangamia na jeshi la Bwana wangu.
