Ekegusii: Abana ba abasomba abaiseke bakabasaamba; bakabaaka chingoma buna abana ba ababisa; bagasirigwa na abarwani ba Omonene oito.

English: for as a man has destroyed his enemy, so you have destroyed the friendship of your neighbor.
Kiswahili: kwani kama vile mtu alivyomwangamiza adui yake, ndivyo ulivyoharibu urafiki wa jirani yako.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera buna omonto agosiria omobisa, naye boigo gwasaririe obosaani nomoamate oo.

English: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Kiswahili: Haloheshi, Pilha, Shobeki,
Ekegusii: Halohesi, na Pila, na Sobeki;

English: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Ana alikuwa: Dishoni. Nao wana wa Dishoni walikuwa: Hemdani, Eshbani, Ithrani na Kerani.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura bw'Ana nere Dishoni. Abana ba Dishoni nabwo aba: Hamurani na Esibani, Itirani na Kerani.

English: He follows My statutes and faithfully keeps My ordinances. That man is righteous; surely he will live, declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: Huzifuata amri zangu na kuzishika sheria zangu kwa uaminifu. Huyo mtu ni mwenye haki; hakika ataishi, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio aise gokora bo, na abwatie emeroberio y’ane echiikire, na abwate amachiiko ane, na akore ayare boronge, oyio nigo are omonyaboronge; ekeene, nabe moyo. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: as when a hungry man dreams he is eating, then awakens still hungry; as when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking, then awakens faint and parched. So will it be for all the many nations who go to battle against Mount Zion.
Kiswahili: kama vile mtu aliye na njaa aotavyo kuwa anakula, lakini huamka, bado njaa yake ingalipo, kama vile mtu mwenye kiu aotavyo kuwa anakunywa maji, lakini huamka akiwa anazimia, akiwa bado angali ana kiu. Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa makundi yote ya mataifa yanayopigana dhidi ya Mlima Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo bakorwania Egetunwa gia Sayoni, nigo barabe buna omonto ore nenchara akorota ng’a nkoragera are, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nenchara, gose buna oyore nerang’o akorota ng’a nkonywa are amaache, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nerang’o. Ogokuurerwa gwachayetwe

English: and said, “Behold, I will make known to you what will happen in the latter time of wrath, because it concerns the appointed time of the end.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Nitakuambia yale yatakayotokea baadaye wakati wa ghadhabu, kwa sababu maono haya yanahusu wakati wa mwisho ulioamriwa.
Ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio aganteebia, “Rora, ningoteebie aya agochia koba ase omoerio bw’endamwamu y’Omonene, ekiagera okorora okwo nigo gokworokia igoro y’engaki y’omoerio.

English: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Efraimu, Hoshea mwana wa Nuni;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Efraimu, Hosea, mosinto o Nuni;

English: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamletea mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na alikuwa kipofu na bubu. Yesu akamponya, hata akaweza kusema na kuona.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio akarenterwa omonto obwatire nekerecha; ere nomouko orenge, naende nigo arenge rimama. Akamogwenia, goika oria orenge omouko ne rimama agakwana na korora.

English: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
Kiswahili: Bwana atafungua mbingu, ghala zake za baraka, kukupa mvua kwa majira yake na kubariki kazi zako zote za mikono yako. Utakopesha mataifa mengi lakini hutakopa kwa yeyote.
Ekegusii: Nabakunorere emonga yaye engiya ere igoro, na abatwerie embura ase ense yaino ase chingaki chiganeirie. Nasesenie emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora, erinde monyaare koa abanto b'ebisaku ebinge ebinto singo. Korende inwe timokoremerwa, erinde mochie gosaba singo.

English: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa upendo wa Kristo unatutia nguvu, kwa sababu tunasadiki kuwa mmoja alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, kwa hiyo wote walikufa.
Ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwa Kristo nigo bogotobetereria, ekiagera twamanyire ekeene ng’a onye oyomo okuure ase engencho ya bonsi, nabo bonsi bakuure.

English: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God's Son may be glorified by it.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akasema, “Ugonjwa huu hautaleta mauti bali umetokea ili kudhihirisha utukufu wa Mungu, ili Mwana wa Mungu apate kutukuzwa kutokana na ugonjwa huu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oborwaire obwo tari obw'amakweri, korende ase okoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae, erinde Omwana o Nyasae abakwe ase obwo.”

English: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn't have many children, and all their family didn't multiply like the children of Judah.
Kiswahili: Shimei alikuwa na wana kumi na sita, na binti sita, lakini ndugu zake hawakuwa na watoto wengi, hivyo ukoo wao wote haukuwa na watu wengi kama ukoo wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Simei nigo abwate abana abamura ikomi na batano nomo (16), na abaiseke batano nomo (6); korende abamura bamwabo tibabwate abana abange, gose chiamate chiabo chionsi tichiamentekanete buna echia Yuda.

English: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
Kiswahili: Shida za moyo wangu zimeongezeka, niokoe katika dhiki yangu.
Ekegusii: Omoichano nigo oichire ase enkoro yane, ndusie ase obokong’u bwane,

English: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
Kiswahili: Lakini mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.
Ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Omobani? Ee, nabateebirie: Oyore omonene kobua omobani,

English: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.
Kiswahili: nikatazama juu, na mbele yangu alikuwepo mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kitani na mshipi wa dhahabu safi kutoka ufazi kiunoni mwake.
Ekegusii: nkarigereria, nkarora omonto obegete eanga y'egatani, bweboeretie kenama kiaye n'orokini roroisirie korwa ase etaabu engiya ekorwa Ufasi.

English: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren't enough for them.
Kiswahili: Basi Wabenyamini wakarudi nyumbani mwao, wakapewa wale wanawali wa Yabeshi-Gileadi waliowaponya. Lakini hawakuwatosha wanaume wote.
Ekegusii: Ababenjamini bakairana ase engaki eria, n'Abaisraeli bakaa abaiseke baria korwa Yabesi o Gileadi, bataitetwe babe abakungu babo; korende abwo tibaabaisanete abasacha b'Ababenjamini.

English: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”'
Kiswahili: Nitafanya jambo hili ili kukamata tena mioyo ya watu wa Israeli, ambao wote wameniacha kwa ajili ya sanamu zao.'
Ekegusii: Erio nario 'ndanyare koirania chinkoro chi'Abaisraeli abwo baatananirwe korwa ase 'nde ase engencho y'emegwekano yabo bagosasiima gocha ase 'nde.

English: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amri iliyo kuu ndiyo hii: ‘Sikia ee Israeli. Bwana Mungu wetu, Bwana ndiye mmoja.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Erie ritang'ani nario eri: Igwa, Abaisraeli, Omonene oito, Nyasae, Nere Omonene oyomo;

English: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu alijua mawazo yao, hivyo akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Inuka usimame mbele ya watu wote.” Hivyo yule mtu akainuka, akasimama mbele yao wote.
Ekegusii: Korende akamanya ebirengererio biabo, agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Imoka, otenene gati aa!” Akaimoka agatenena.

English: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia baba mkwe wake kuhusu kila kitu Bwana alichomfanyia Farao na Wamisri kwa ajili ya Israeli, na pia kuhusu shida zote walizokutana nazo njiani na jinsi Bwana alivyowaokoa.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia ise biara aya onsi Omonene akorerete Farao amo n'Abamisiri ase engencho y'Abaisraeli, na obokong'u bwonsi obwo banyorete inchera, naende buna Omonene abatooretie.

English: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
Kiswahili: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyewakopesha watu wawili fedha: Mmoja alidaiwa dinari 500na mwingine dinari hamsini.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo omorua singo orenge nabasira babere; oyomo omoriete esira ye chidinari amagana atano (500), na oyo o kabere emerongo etano (50).

English: They remembered his words,
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakayakumbuka maneno ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakainyora amang'ana aye.

English: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.
Kiswahili: Atanena maneno kinyume cha Yeye Aliye Juu Sana na kuwaonea watakatifu wake, huku akijaribu kubadili majira na sheria. Watakatifu watatiwa chini ya mamlaka yake kwa wakati, nyakati mbili, na nusu wakati.
Ekegusii: Ere nakwane amang'ana are mamincha y'Oyore Igoro Mono, naende narosie abachenu b'Oyore Igoro Mono na kobachanda; narengererie koonchora ebiro, na amachiiko. Abachenu mbabekwe ase okoboko kwaye ase ekero ekemo, na ebiro bibere, na ekeng'ese gi'ekero.

English: And now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here shall be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, wanao wawili waliozaliwa kwako huku Misri kabla sijaja hapa kwako watahesabiwa kuwa ni wangu; Efraimu na Manase watakuwa wangu, kama vile Reubeni na Simeoni walivyo wangu.
Ekegusii: “Bono abana bao abamura babere kwaiborerete ase ense ya Misiri ritang’ani ntaracha aa, barabwo nabaane bararokwe. Efraimu na Manase nigo barabe abaane, buna Rubeni na Simioni bare abaane.

English: The six hundred Danites stood at the entrance of the gate, armed with their weapons of war.
Kiswahili: Wale Wadani 600, waliovaa silaha za vita, wakasimama penye ingilio la lango.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria amagana atano na rimo, Abadani, babogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, bebegete ang’e, bagatenena ase egeita.

English: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atawainua hao wana-kondoo wawili mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, pamoja na mkate wa malimbuko. Ni sadaka takatifu kwa Bwana kwa ajili ya kuhani.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani asungusie omogati bw'ogotongora amo ne chimanwa chi'eching'ondi echio ibere ase obosio bw'Omonene. Ebinto ebio biatananwe bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, bibe endagera y'Omokuani.

English: Therefore Yahweh's anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hasira ya Bwana inawaka dhidi ya watu wake, mkono wake umeinuliwa na anawapiga. Milima inatetemeka, maiti ni kama takataka kwenye barabara. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y'Omonene yokire ase abanto baye, na ere oramboire okoboko kwaye ase bare obaakire. Ebitunwa biatengechigwe, na emebere y'abanto bakwete nebe buna eubi ase chinchera. Nonya ayio onsi agochia koba igo, endamwamu yaye tekoera; okoboko kwaye nigo koragenderere korua egesururo.

English: I urge those who read this book to not be discouraged because of the calamities, but recognize that these punishments were not for the destruction, but for the chastening of our race.
Kiswahili: Ninawasihi wale wanaosoma kitabu hiki wasikatishwe tamaa na majanga, lakini watambue kwamba adhabu hizi hazikuwa kwa ajili ya uharibifu, bali kwa ajili ya kuadhibu jamii yetu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkobasorora timokwa omoyo ekero mogosoma igoro y'amang'ana y'ogokumia ayio akoregete, korende momanye nga egesusuro eke nigo giancheretwe tari ase ogosiria, korende korongeyia abanto ba Omonene.

English: Yahweh says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Ingawa wana muungano nao ni wengi sana, watakatiliwa mbali na kuangamia. Ingawa nimekutesa wewe, ee Yuda, sitakutesa tena.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba ase abanto baye Abaisraeli: “Nonya Abasiria bare abakong'u naende abange ina baitwe nagosirigwa. Abanto bane 'nabakorete mogachandeka, korende inche tinkoirorera gokora ayio naende.

English: And the king provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life.
Kiswahili: Siku kwa siku mfalme alimpa Yehoyakini posho siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoa endagera yaye, na kera egento kiaganeirie ase kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: Before the lamp of God had gone out, Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was located.
Kiswahili: Taa ya Mungu bado ilikuwa haijazimika, na Samweli alikuwa amelala Hekaluni mwa Bwana, ambapo Sanduku la Mungu lilikuwako.
Ekegusii: na Samweli nigo areenge oraire ime ase Obomenyo Obochenu aase Esanduki y’Omonene yareenge. Ritang’ani chitaaya chia Nyasae chitararima,

English: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
Kiswahili: Macho ya Bwana yako kila mahali, yakiwaangalia waovu na wema.
Ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie kera ase, nigo arooche ababe amo n’abaya.

English: Won't you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
Kiswahili: Je, hutatuhuisha tena, ili watu wako wakufurahie?
Ekegusii: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?

English: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
Kiswahili: Ulimi uletao uponyaji ni mti wa uzima, bali ulimi udanganyao huponda roho.
Ekegusii: Oromeme rokoiraneria n'obokanyeku nigo rokogwenia, korende orokorubania nigo rogotandora enkoro.

English: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
Kiswahili: Wote hawa walikuwa wana wa Hemani mwonaji wa mfalme. Aliwapata wana hawa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu ili kumwinua. Mungu alimpa Hemani wana kumi na wanne na binti watatu.
Ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Hemani, omoorori bw'omorwoti. Nyasae amorierete eira y'okomokong'ia; ase ayio akamoa abana abamura ikomi na baane, na abaiseke batato.

English: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, “You must not reduce your daily quota of bricks.”
Kiswahili: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli walitambua kuwa wako taabani walipoambiwa, “Hamtakiwi kupunguza idadi ya matofali mliotakiwa kutengeneza kila siku.”
Ekegusii: Abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakarora ng’a basoire ase obokong’u ekiagera bateebetigwe ng’a, “Goika moikeranie kera rituko ekerengo keria kia amatabori.”

English: O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mkumbuke Daudi na taabu zote alizozistahimili.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oinyore Daudi, ase engencho y’obokong’u bwonsi bwamonyoorete.

English: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo patakuwepo madhabahu ya Bwana katikati ya Misri na mnara wa kumbukumbu kwa Bwana kwenye mpaka wa Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio egesasiimero nkeagacherwe Omonene agwo ase egatigati ya Misiri, boigo rigena rire buna esiiro nditenenerigwe Omonene agwo ase ribebe ri'ense eyio.

English: Ahinadab son of Iddo in Mahanaim;
Kiswahili: Ahinadabu mwana wa Ido: katika Mahanaimu;
Ekegusii: Ahinadabu, mosinto o Ido, agatenenera orogongo rwa Mahanaimu.

English: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod's palace.
Kiswahili: alisema, “Nitasikiliza shauri lako washtaki wako watakapofika hapa.” Kisha akaamuru Paulo awekwe chini ya ulinzi kwenye jumba la kifalme la Herode.
Ekegusii: “Ninche nyigwe amang'ana ao ekero abagosoeri bao barache.” Agachiika arendwe ase enyomba y'ekegambero kia Herode.

English: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
Kiswahili: kwa wazinzi na wahanithi, kwa wale wauzao watu, na kwa waongo na waapao kwa uongo, na kwa chochote kingine kilicho kinyume na mafundisho ya kweli,
Ekegusii: ase abatomani, na abasacha abagwesaria ase abasacha, ase abakoiba abanto na kobaonia, ase abanyaborimo, na abakoria chimuma chi’oborimo. Na korir’abe ing’ana rinde rionsi ritabwataini nokworokereria kw’obogima,

English: The remaining Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted these cities: From the tribe of Ephraim
Kiswahili: Koo nyingine za Wakohathi, ambao pia ni Walawi, walipewa miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu:
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi, bakaegwa emechie korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: When John’s disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb. The Feeding of the Five Thousand (Matthew 14:13–21; Luke 9:10–17; John 6:1–15)
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana walipopata habari hizi, wakaja na kuuchukua mwili wake, wakauzika kaburini. Yesu Awalisha Wanaume 5,000 (Mathayo 14:13-21; Luka 9:10-17; Yohana 6:1-14)
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa ba Yohana baigwete amang’ana aya, bakagenda bakabogoria egetondo, bakagetindeka. Yeso okorageria abanto chilifu isano (Mat 14:13-14; Luk 9:10; Mat 14:15-21; Luk 9:11-17; Yoh 6:1-13)

English: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
Kiswahili: Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa amekuwa mwema kwangu.
Ekegusii: Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.

English: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.
Kiswahili: aletewe joho la kifalme ambalo mfalme ameshalivaa na farasi ambaye mfalme alishampanda, ambaye amevikwa taji ya kifalme kichwani mwake.
Ekegusii: goika arenterwe eanga y'oborwoti, eyio omorwoti abeekire, na ebarasi eyio omorwoti anarete koriina ebekeire egutwa y'oborwoti ase omotwe oye.

English: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamwambia Itai, Mgiti, “Kwa nini ufuatane na sisi? Rudi ukakae pamoja na Mfalme Absalomu. Wewe ni mgeni, mkimbizi kutoka nchini mwako.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaboria Itai Omogiti, “Nase ki naye okogeenda amo naintwe? Irana obeere nomorwoti oyio omoyia; aye nomomenyi ore, naende nigo gwaserigwa korwa seino.

English: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from Yahweh's house. The priests, Yahweh's ministers, mourn.
Kiswahili: Sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zimekatiliwa mbali kutoka nyumba ya Bwana. Makuhani wanaomboleza, wale wanaohudumu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okoruegwa kw'endagera na ogw'ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba y'Omonene. Abakuani abare abakoreri b'Omonene nigo bakorera.

English: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu,'
Ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng'ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase 'nde biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.

English: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote ninapotanda mawingu juu ya dunia na upinde wa mvua ukijitokeza mawinguni,
Ekegusii: Ekero nkwara amare igoro y'ense, na omokubinyongo nobe okororekana ase amare.

English: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
Kiswahili: Hivyo niliwaambia, lakini hamkutaka kusikia. Mliasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana, na katika kiburi chenu mlienda katika nchi ya vilima.
Ekegusii: ’Nkabateebia amang’ana ayi’Omonene akwanete, korende mokaanga koigwera, mogasaria amang’ana Omonene abachiigete, mokageenda n’obomwenu ase ense eria y’ebitunwa.

English: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn't go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Yehoshafati akaunda merikebu nyingi za biashara ili kwenda Ofiri kuchukua dhahabu, lakini kamwe hazikusafiri, kwa maana zilivunjika huko Esion-Geberi.
Ekegusii: Yehosafati akaroisia chimeeri chia Tarisisi, chiarenge kogenda Ofiri korenta chitaabu, korende tichiagendete, ekiagera chiasarekerete agwo Esioni‐Geberi.

English: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
Kiswahili: Kisha mtanajisi sanamu zenu zilizofunikwa kwa fedha, na vinyago vyenu vilivyofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Mtazitupilia mbali kama vitambaa vya wakati wa hedhi na kuziambia, “Haya, tokeni hapa!”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio moimokie emegwekano yaino mogosasiima, eyio ebachire na koomwa ne chifeta, na eyende ebombire na koomwa netaabu, moyetugute buna ebinto bitachenegeti, moyetebie: “Karue aa ase tore!”

English: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitailinda nyumba yangu dhidi ya majeshi ya wanyangʼanyi. Kamwe mdhalimu hatashambulia watu wangu tena, kwa maana sasa ninawachunga.
Ekegusii: Erio inche Omonene nindende enyomba yane, erinde abarwani b'esegi tibaabaisa goeterao gose koiranerao; na abachandi b'abaanto baane tibaabaisa gochao, ekiagera bono inche ninyerigererie namaiso aane.

English: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”
Kiswahili: Esau aliposikia maneno haya ya baba yake, akalia sauti kubwa na ya uchungu, na kumwambia baba yake, “Nibariki mimi, mimi pia, baba yangu!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koigwa amang'ana aya korwa ase ise, agakuura na korera ekerero ekenene mono ki'obororo, akamoteebia: “Nsesenie nainche boigo, Tata!”

English: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain far away, a great space being between them;
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akavuka upande mwingine na kusimama juu ya kilima mahali palipokuwa na nafasi pana kati yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaamboka gochia eng'umbu ende, agatenena aare ase ekegoro keria, bokaba oboare botari boke ase egati yabo.

English: Then King Nebuchadnezzar sent word to assemble the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates, and all the other officials of the provinces to attend the dedication of the statue he had set up.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akaita wakuu, wasimamizi, watawala, washauri, watunza hazina, waamuzi, mahakimu na maafisa wengine wote wa jimbo kuja kuizindua sanamu ambayo Mfalme Nebukadneza alikuwa ameisimamisha.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Nebukadinesaro agatoma abanto basangererie amo abagaambi abanene b’oborwoti bwaye, na abagaambi be chingongo chiaye, na abagabana, na abasemia, na abagachi be chikungo, na abagaambi ebiina, na abamanyi b’amachiiko, na abanene bande bonsi b’oborwoti bwaye. Abwo bonsi nigo barangereretigwe ase ogwatanana na gosesenia omogwekano oria Nebukadinesaro omorwoti konya atenenirie.

English: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don't know who put our money in our sacks.”
Kiswahili: Pia tumeleta fedha nyingine kwa ajili ya kununulia chakula. Hatujui ni nani aliziweka fedha hizo katika magunia yetu.”
Ekegusii: Naende ntwarentana chitaabu chinde, echi togocha kogora endagera. Titomanyeti gose ning'o ochibegete ase chigunia chiaito ime.”

English: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and a wicked mouth swallows iniquity.
Kiswahili: Shahidi mla rushwa hudhihaki hukumu na kinywa cha mtu mwovu humeza ubaya kwa upesi.
Ekegusii: Kirori omobe nigo agochecheria oboronge, na omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogworerete ebibe.

English: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, and their sacrifices will not please Him, but will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat will be defiled. For their bread will be for themselves; it will not enter the house of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hawatammiminia Bwana sadaka ya divai wala dhabihu zao hazitampendeza. Dhabihu kama hizo zitakuwa kwao kama mkate wa waombolezaji; nao wote wazilao watakuwa najisi. Chakula hiki kitakuwa kwa ajili yao wenyewe; kisije katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tibakorua okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gi’edivai ase Omonene, ere takogokera ebing’wanso bararue asare. Okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera bararue asare nigo korabe buna endagera y’ebirero; na omonto onde bwensi orayerie nigo arabe oyo otachenegeti, ekiagera endagera eyio erabe egoisanekia oyore nenchara rioka, tekorentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.

English: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
Kiswahili: naye akakamatwa. Akapelekwa kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi, mahali ambapo alimtangazia hukumu.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabwata omorwoti oria, bakamoira ase omorwoti o Babiloni agwo ase omochie o Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, na ere akamonachera ekiina.

English: Then the servant told Isaac all that he had done.
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mtumishi akamweleza Isaki mambo yote aliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agateebia Isaka amang’ana onsi, buna akorete.

English: Mordecai wrote in the name of King Xerxes and sealed it with the royal signet ring. He sent the documents by mounted couriers riding on swift horses bred from the royal mares.
Kiswahili: Mordekai aliandika nyaraka kwa jina la Mfalme Ahasuero, akazitia muhuri kwa pete ya mfalme na kuzipeleka kwa njia ya matarishi, ambao waliendesha farasi waendao kasi waliozalishwa maalum kwa ajili ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo arigetwe na kobeekwa erieta ri’omorwoti Ahaswero, na akabeekwa ekemanyererio ki’ebonyi yaye. Erio amarube ayio akairwa nabariini be chibarasi chi’omorwoti echio chiare kominyoka bwango.

English: The eyes of men are his terror. He doesn't know that the eyes of the Lord are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, seeing all the ways of men, and looking into secret places.
Kiswahili: Macho ya wanadamu ndiyo hofu yake. Hajui kwamba macho ya Bwana yana angavu mara elfu kumi kuliko jua, yanaona njia zote za wanadamu, na yanachungulia mahali pa siri.
Ekegusii: Obwoba bw'omonto oyio nase abanto boka. Ere tamanyeti buna amaiso y'Omonene nigo aramogetie ara chilifu ikomi kobua risase. Amaiso ayio nigo arigereretie chinchera chionsi chia Mwanyabaanto, goika nonya nchiria chionsi chibisegete.

English: “What was the outcome?” David asked. “Please tell me.” “The troops fled from the battle,” he replied. “Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Ni nini kilichotokea? Niambie.” Akasema, “Watu walikimbia kutoka vitani. Wengi wao walianguka na kufa. Naye Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Amoteebie buna amang’ana agendererete aria.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakuure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakuure.”

English: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don't think to yourself that you will escape in the king's house any more than all the Jews.
Kiswahili: Mordekai alirudisha jibu hili: “Usifikiri kwamba kwa sababu uko katika nyumba ya mfalme wewe pekee katika Wayahudi wote utapona.
Ekegusii: akamotomera abanto nokoiraneria oko: “Tokaga ng'a ekiagera ore ase enyomba y'omorwoti aye notooreke kobua Abayahudi bande.

English: On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile viziwi watasikia maneno ya kitabu, na katika utusitusi na giza macho ya kipofu yataona.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emetino neebe ekoigwa amang’ana ariikire ase egetabu, na emeuko yarenge ekorora buna rikongori na omosunte, nerore buya namaiso abo.

English: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua (through Kadmiel, through the line of Hodevah ), 74.
Kiswahili: Walawi: wazao wa Yeshua (kupitia Kadmieli kupitia jamaa ya Hodavia) 74
Ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Abe chiamate chia Yesua o Kadimieli, ab’ororeria rwa Hodawia: emerongo etano na ebere, na baane (74).

English: And the LORD also speaks concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
Kiswahili: “Pia kwa habari ya Yezebeli Bwana anasema, ‘Mbwa watamla Yezebeli karibu na ukuta wa Yezreeli.’
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire boigo igoro ya Yesebeli; Chisese inachiriere Yesebeli agwo ase oboremo bwa Yesireeli.

English: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
Kiswahili: Alijenga patakatifu pake kama vilele, kama dunia ambayo aliimarisha milele.
Ekegusii: Aroro akaagacha obomenyo bwaye obochenu bobere igoro mono, nabobe obokong'u buna ense ekong'irie kogenderera botambe.

English: Then Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. So Saul blew the ram’s horn throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”
Kiswahili: Yonathani akashambulia ngome ya Wafilisti huko Geba, nao Wafilisti wakapata habari hizo. Kisha Sauli akaamuru tarumbeta ipigwe nchi yote na kusema, “Waebrania na wasikie!”
Ekegusii: Yonathani agaita omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’Abafilisti agwo Gibea, na Abafirisiti bakaigwa amang’ana ayio. Saulo akabugia egetureeri ase ense eria yonsi, agateeba, “Tiga Abaiberania baigwe.”

English: and sent to Holofernes, saying, “Let my lord now command that they allow your servant to go out to pray.”
Kiswahili: na akatuma ujumbe kwa Holofernes, akisema, “Sasa bwana wangu na aamuru wamruhusu mtumishi wako kwenda kuomba.”
Ekegusii: erio agatoma amang'ana gochia ase Holoferne ng'a aegwe ribaga kogenda goika ase rikura gosasiima ase ogosaba.

English: Now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest I go in and die, even as those before me. For a demon loves her, which harms no man, but those which come to her. Now I fear lest I die, and bring my father's and my mother's life to the grave with sorrow because of me. They have no other son to bury them.”
Kiswahili: Sasa mimi ndiye mwana pekee wa baba yangu, nami naogopa, nisije nikaingia na kufa, kama wale walionitangulia. Kwa maana pepo humpenda, ambaye hamdhuru mtu yeyote, ila wale wanaomjia. Sasa naogopa nisije nikafa, na kuyaleta maisha ya baba yangu na mama yangu kaburini kwa huzuni kwa sababu yangu. Hawana mwana mwingine wa kuwazika.
Ekegusii: Naende naigure ng'a nigo bare goitwa nekerecha. Ekerecha keria nigo giachandete Sara na goita kera omosacha oyio oganetie konywoma Sara. Nigo nairoka ekerecha eke mono. Inyora inche bweka omwana omomoima bw'abaibori baane, 'ng'ise gokwa, abaibori baane nigo barakwe ase engencho y'obororo bw'ogokwa kwane. Barabwo tibabwati mwana onde naende orabatindeke.”

English: A temporary resident or hired hand shall not eat the Passover.
Kiswahili: lakini kibarua yeyote au msafiri haruhusiwi kula.
Ekegusii: Omogeni omenyete ase more, gose omonto orikire tibayeria Epasaka eyio.

English: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo katika sinagogi lao palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto obwatire nekerecha ki'eubi agacha ase esinagogi, ere agaaka eriogi,

English: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Kiswahili: Heri walio na moyo safi, maana hao watamwona Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare abachenu ase chinkoro, ekiagera barabwo 'nabarore Nyasae.

English: What has been will be again, and what has been done will be done again; there is nothing new under the sun.
Kiswahili: Kile kilichokuwepo kitakuwepo tena, kile kilichofanyika kitafanyika tena, hakuna kilicho kipya chini ya jua.
Ekegusii: Aya arengeo kare, naro agochia kobao naende. Aya akoregete kare, naro agochia gokoreka naende. Ande tari are amayia inse y’erioba.

English: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn't despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
Kiswahili: “Mungu ni mwenye nguvu, lakini hamdharau mwanadamu; ni mwenye nguvu, naye ni thabiti katika shauri lake.
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are Omonguru, ere tachayeti onde; nigo are nokobua ase chinguru na obong'aini.

English: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
Kiswahili: Hekima, kama ulivyo urithi, ni kitu chema na huwafaidia wale walionalo jua.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini nigo bore obuya buna omwando, na nigo bogokonya abwo baroche erioba.

English: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh was God.
Kiswahili: Naye alipomwomba, Bwana akaguswa na kule kusihi kwake na akasikiliza kilio chake, kwa hiyo akamrudisha Yerusalemu na kwenye ufalme wake. Ndipo Manase akatambua kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero asabeete igo, Nyasae aganchera ogosorora kwaye, akaigwa okoboria kwaye kw'oboitongo, na akamoirania Yerusalemu naende ase oborwoti bwaye. Erio Manase akamanya ng'a Omonene nere Nyasae.

English: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwanza itampasa kuteseka katika mambo mengi na kukataliwa na kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa naende, akamoteebia,

English: Have you not just called to Me, ‘My Father, You are my friend from youth.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe hujaniita hivi punde tu: ‘Baba yangu, rafiki yangu tangu ujana wangu,
Ekegusii: “Na bono iga mwachakire kondangeria mogoteeba: Aye tata, aye naye gwatwanchete korwa obwana bwaito.

English: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God's altar that is before his tabernacle!”
Kiswahili: “Hili jambo la kumwasi Bwana na kumwacha siku hii ya leo kwa kujenga madhabahu kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na dhabihu, zaidi ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wetu iliyo mbele ya maskani yake na liwe mbali nasi.”
Ekegusii: Taibo! Ayio abe aare naintwe ng'a ntorigetie kwanga koigwera Omonene Nyasae, gose komotiga bono, ase okoagacha egesasiimero ki'ogosambera ekeng'wanso, gose korua okoruegwa kw'endagera, gose ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe, egesasiimero kere ao na keria kere bosio bw'Obomenyo bwaye.”

English: As soon as Amasa’s body was removed from the road, all the men went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bichri.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Amasa kuondolewa kutoka barabarani, watu wote walienda pamoja na Yoabu kumfuatia Sheba mwana wa Bikri.
Ekegusii: Ekero arusetigwe inchera, abanto bonsi bagaeta, bagatunyana Yoabu, erinde babwatie Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.

English: After him a wise son rose up, who because of him lived in security.
Kiswahili: Baada yake akatokea mwana mwenye hekima, ambaye kwa ajili yake aliishi kwa usalama.
Ekegusii: Magega ya Daudi, omwana oye omong'aini akamenya nomorembe ase engencho yaye.

English: And Solomon loved the LORD and walked in the statutes of his father David, except that he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akaonyesha upendo wake kwa Bwana kwa kuenenda sawasawa na amri za Daudi baba yake, ila yeye alitoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba huko mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Sulemani nigo anchete Omonene, akabwatia emeroberio Daudi achiigete, korende nigo aruete ebing’wanso na gosamba ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro.

English: Nevertheless, the people of each nation continued to make their own gods in the cities where they had settled, and they set them up in the shrines that the people of Samaria had made on the high places.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kila kikundi cha taifa lililoletwa Samaria kilitengeneza miungu yao wenyewe katika miji kadhaa mahali walipoishi, nao wakaiweka mahali pa ibada za miungu ambapo watu wa Samaria walikuwa wametengeneza katika mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo abanto ba kera egesaku bakaroisia chinyasae chiabo abanyene, bagachibeeka ase chinyomba chi’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, echio abanto ba Samaria baagachete; abanto ba kera egesaku bagakora igo ase emechie eria bamenyete.

English: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
Kiswahili: Watu wa magharibi watashangaa yaliyompata; watu wa mashariki watapatwa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete bosongo mbakumie igoro ye rituko ri'ogosirigwa kwaye, na abamenyete moocha mbaondokigwe namang'ana ayio.

English: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
Kiswahili: Adui zetu wote waliposikia kuhusu hili, mataifa yote yaliyotuzunguka yakaogopa na kupoteza ujasiri, kwa sababu yalitambua kuwa kazi hii imefanyika kwa msaada wa Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baito bonsi baigwete ayio, na abanto b'ebisaku bionsi biatoetanaine bayaroche, bakaba nobwoba obonene, bagechaya na gwesookera abanyene, ekiagera nigo bamanyete ng'a emeremo eyio nigo yakoretwe na goikeranigwa ase ogokonywa kwa Nyasae oito.

English: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya haya yote, twaeni ngao ya imani, ambayo kwa hiyo mtaweza kuizima mishale yote yenye moto ya yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Kobua onsi bogoria enguba y'okwegena, ase eyio namonyaare korimia emegwe yonsi y'omorero y'oria omobe.

English: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.
Kiswahili: ambaye mama yake alikuwa mjane kutoka kabila la Naftali na baba yake alikuwa mtu wa Tiro tena fundi wa shaba. Hiramu alikuwa na ustadi wa hali ya juu na mzoefu katika aina zote za kazi ya shaba. Alikuja kwa Mfalme Solomoni na kufanya kazi zake zote alizopangiwa.
Ekegusii: Hiramu nigo areenge omwana bw’omokuungu omoboraka bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, na ise nigo areenge omonto o Turo, omoturi bwe chitaai. Hiramu omonyene nigo areenge nobong’aini obonge amo ne chisemi, omanyete gotura ebinto binde bionsi bie chitaai. Ere agacha ase Sulemani, akamokorera emeremo yaye yonsi. Chisiiro ibere chi’etai (2 Amg 3:15-17)

English: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaweka askari walinzi katika ufalme wa Waaramu huko Dameski. Basi Waaramu wakawa watumwa wa Daudi, na kumlipa ushuru. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kote alipokwenda.
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abasikari ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.

English: He who is lacking in understanding thinks about these things. An unwise and erring man thinks foolishly.
Kiswahili: Yeye asiye na ufahamu huyafikiria mambo haya. Mtu asiye na hekima na mkosefu huyafikiria upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase omonto okorengereria ime yaye; omonto omoriri osiriigwe nabo akorengereria ase oboriri bwaye.

English: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.
Kiswahili: Mwana-kondoo alipoivunja ile lakiri ya tano, nikaona chini ya madhabahu, roho za wale waliochinjwa kwa ajili ya neno la Mungu na kwa ajili ya ushuhuda walioutunza.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatano, nkarora inse y'egesasiimero emeika y'abwo baitetwe ekiagera barenge koraria ring'ana ria Nyasae, na koba abegenwa ase oborori bwabo.

English: Weep for the dead, for he lacks light. Weep for a fool, for he lacks understanding. Weep more sweetly for the dead, because he has found rest, but the life of the fool is worse than death.
Kiswahili: Mlilie wafu, kwa maana hana mwanga. Mlilie mpumbavu, kwa maana hana ufahamu. Mlilie wafu kwa utamu zaidi, kwa sababu amepata raha, lakini maisha ya mpumbavu ni mabaya kuliko kifo.
Ekegusii: Oyo kworokereria omonto omoriri, oyio nigo anga buna omonto ogosangereria ebigonkorio, gose buna oy'otura omonto ore n'echitoro erinde amosabe singo.

English: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu mkuu, mfalme mkuu juu ya miungu yote.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene nere Nyasae ore omonene, nere Omorwoti omonene obuete chinyasae chionsi.

English: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaanza kwa kuwaambia, “Leo Andiko hili limetimia mkiwa mnasikia.”
Ekegusii: Agachaaka kobateebia, “Reero ririiko eri riaikeranigwe ase more buna mwarigwa rigosomwa.”

English: The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice, and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him.
Kiswahili: Baba wa mwenye haki ana furaha kubwa, naye aliye na mwana mwenye hekima humfurahia.
Ekegusii: Ise bw’omonto ore omonyene oboronge nigo akoba nomogooko omonene. Ere oyoiboire omwana omomura omong’aini nagookigwe nere.

English: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu Waisraeli ni watumishi wangu niliowaleta kutoka nchi ya Misri, kamwe wasiuzwe kama watumwa.
Ekegusii: Abwo nabaanto bagonkorera, ninche nabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri. Abwo tibakoonigwa buna abasomba.

English: Because you didn't obey Yahweh's voice, and didn't execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu wewe hukumtii Bwana, wala hukumtimizia ghadhabu yake kali juu ya Waamaleki, Bwana amekutendea mambo haya leo.
Ekegusii: Tikwaigwerete eriogi ri'Omonene, gose goikerania egesusuro ki'endamwamu yaye entindi igoro y'Abaameleki. Ekio nakio kiagera Omonene akorire amang'ana ayio asore reero iga.

English: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not the battle in Gibeah overtake the sons of iniquity?
Kiswahili: “Tangu siku za Gibea, mmetenda dhambi, ee Israeli, huko ndiko mlikobaki. Je, vita havikuwapata watenda mabaya huko Gibea?
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwagendererete gokora ebibe korwa ase amatuko aria mwarenge Gibea, na goika bono nigo mogendererete gokora bo. Inee! Esegi y’okorusia egesiomba igoro y’abakori amabe tiyababuete agwo Gibea?

English: Take off the garment of your mourning and affliction, O Jerusalem, and put on forever the beauty of the glory from God.
Kiswahili: Vua vazi lako la huzuni na mateso, Ee Yerusalemu, na ujivike milele uzuri wa utukufu kutoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu eaborie chianga chiria kwabegete ase engaki y'emechando n'okweumia, eboyie botambe obuya n'obonene bwa Nyasae.

English: the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. And although there was famine in every country, there was food throughout the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: nayo miaka ile saba ya njaa ikaanza, sawasawa na alivyosema Yosefu. Kulikuwa na njaa katika nchi nyingine zote, bali katika nchi yote ya Misri kulikuwa na chakula.
Ekegusii: na emiaka eria etano na ebere y’enchara egachaka gocha, buna Yusufu abaanete. Enchara egacha ase chinse chionsi, korende ase ense yonsi ya Misiri endagera n’yareengeo.

English: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliye Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: Nenda ukawaambie watu wa Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu, ‘Je, hamwezi kujifunza kutoka kwa wana wa Rekabu, na kuyatii maneno yangu?' asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar'Omonene bw'Emeganda, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Genda okwane n'Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, obaborie: Inee! Timori gwancha amorokererio na koigwera amang'ana aane inche Omonene?

English: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it. The Parable of the Net
Kiswahili: Alipoipata lulu moja ya thamani kubwa, alikwenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo akainunua.” Mfano Wa Wavu
Ekegusii: Ere agachia korora eruru eyemo ye rigori rinene, akaimoka akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akayegora.

English: Don't withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
Kiswahili: Usimnyime mtoto adhabu, ukimwadhibu kwa fimbo, hatakufa.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga korongeyia omwana oo; koramoake ekeranya, tagochia gokwa.

English: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success.
Kiswahili: Pasipo kusema neno, yule mtumishi akamtazama kwa makini aone kama Bwana ameifanikisha safari yake, au la.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akamobeta amaiso, akaba okirete kiri, erinde amanye gose Omonene osesesenirie orogendo rwaye, gose taibo.

English: “My covenant with him was one of life and peace, which I gave to him; it called for reverence, and he revered Me and stood in awe of My name.
Kiswahili: “Agano langu lilikuwa pamoja naye, agano la uhai na amani, nami nilimpa yote, ili aniche na kuniheshimu, naye akaniheshimu na kusimama akilicha Jina langu.
Ekegusii: “Okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete nere nokw’obogima na omorembe. Okwo nigo namoete, erinde anyiroke. Ere akanyiroka, akaba okoiguswa ase engencho y’erieta riane.

English: Give to him who asks you, and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
Kiswahili: Mpe yeye akuombaye, wala usimgeuzie kisogo yeye atakaye kukukopa.
Ekegusii: Oyokogosaba, moe; na oyorigetie singo, tomorina.

English: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
Kiswahili: Ninamwambia Mungu Mwamba wangu, “Kwa nini umenisahau? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?”
Ekegusii: Nigo ngotebia Nyasae ore egetare kiane, “Nase ki aye kwanyebire? Nase ki ngendererete korera ngochandwa nababisa baane?”

English: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo mbele yake palikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye ugonjwa wa kuvimba mwili.
Ekegusii: Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.

English: Take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.
Kiswahili: Chukua fedha na dhahabu utengeneze taji, nawe uiweke kichwani mwa kuhani mkuu Yoshua, mwana wa Yehosadaki.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwaeirwe chifeta ne chitaabu oroisie egutwa korwa ase ebinto ebio, oyebeke ase omotwe o Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.

English: Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, delivered the message of the LORD to the people: “I am with you,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kisha Hagai, mjumbe wa Bwana, akawapa watu ujumbe huu wa Bwana: “Mimi niko pamoja nanyi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Hagai, omotomwa bw’ Omonene, agakwana nabaanto amang’ana ’Omonene, akabateebia, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Inche nigo inde amo nainwe.”

English: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
Kiswahili: Kutoka Negebu, akapita mahali hadi mahali, hadi akafika Betheli, mahali hapo ambapo mwanzoni alipiga hema lake kati ya Betheli na Ai
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akageenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang'ani kegima, gati ya Beteli na Ai,

English: Thus they were cast down and not exalted, because we sinned against the Lord our God in not listening to his voice.
Kiswahili: Hivyo walianguka chini na hawakuinuliwa, kwa sababu tulimtendea dhambi Bwana Mungu wetu kwa kutosikiliza sauti yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo twakorete ebibe mamincha y'Omonene Nyasae oito na tokanga komoigwera. Ase igo ense yaito ekabugwa ribaga yarenge ense yobobui.

English: Samson said to them, “If you behave like this, surely I will take revenge on you, and after that I will cease.”
Kiswahili: Samsoni akawaambia, “Kwa kuwa mmetenda hivyo, hakika sitatulia mpaka niwe nimelipiza kisasi juu yenu.”
Ekegusii: Samusoni agateebia Abafirisiti, “Onye mogokora amang'ana anga buna aya, natianire ng'a tingotimoka goika inyeruserie egesiomba igoro yaino.”

English: And Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mikaya kuwaambia kila kitu ambacho alikuwa amesikia Baruku akiwasomea watu kutoka kwenye kile kitabu,
Ekegusii: Mikaya akabateebia amang’ana onsi aigwete ekero Baruku asomete egetabu eria ase abanto bategererete.

English: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
Kiswahili: Mtafuteni Bwana na nguvu zake; utafuteni uso wake siku zote.
Ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie mobe ase obosio bwaye botambe.

English: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
Kiswahili: Nasi tunamtuma pamoja naye ndugu ambaye anasifiwa na makanisa yote kwa huduma yake ya kuhubiri Injili.
Ekegusii: Amo nere twatomire oyominto oria omanyekanete ase chikanisa chionsi ase okorandia kwaye kw'amang'ana amaya.

English: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
Kiswahili: Basi, ndugu zangu, nataka mjue kwamba mambo yale yaliyonipata kwa kweli yamesaidia sana kueneza Injili.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, nimbamanyie ng’a amang’ana aria onsi anyorete, abeire ase okogendereria gw’enchiri.

English: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaotaka kuonekana wazuri kwa mambo ya mwili wanataka wawalazimishe kutahiriwa. Sababu pekee ya kufanya hivyo ni kuepuka kuteswa kwa ajili ya msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Bonsi abwo barigetie kororekana buya ase emebere yabo, abwo nabwo bakobabetereria ng’a mwarokigwe, erinde tibachandwa ase engencho y’omosalaba o Kristo.

English: But if you can show me that Bel devours them, then Daniel shall die; for he has spoken blasphemy against Bel.” Daniel said to the king, “Let it be according to your word.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ukiweza kunionyesha kwamba Beli anawameza, basi Danieli atakufa; kwa maana amesema maneno ya kufuru dhidi ya Beli. Danieli akamwambia mfalme, “Na iwe kama ulivyosema.”
Ekegusii: Danieli akamoiraneria: “Tiga ebe igo buna aye omorwoti gwateebire.”

English: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
Kiswahili: kwamba atatuokoa kutoka kwa adui zetu, na kutoka mikononi mwao wote watuchukiao:
Ekegusii: ng’a natotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko abo bonsi abatogechete,

English: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa jioni ya ile siku ya kwanza ya juma, wanafunzi wake walikuwa pamoja, milango ikiwa imefungwa kwa kuwaogopa Wayahudi. Naye Yesu aliwatokea, akasimama katikati yao, akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi!”
Ekegusii: Ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang'ani ri'echuma, na ebisieri kobiasiekirwe aase agwo aborokigwa barenge, ekiagera bairogete Abayahudi, Yeso agacha, agatenena gati‐gati akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

English: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn't strengthen him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Tiglath-Pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru akaja kumtesa badala ya kumsaidia.
Ekegusii: Erio Tiligati‐Pileseri, omorwoti bw'Abaasuri, akagenda akamorwania na komochanda ribaga ri'okomokonya.

English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng'a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

English: Moses wrote all Yahweh's words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akaandika kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amesema. Akaamka kesho yake asubuhi na mapema na kujenga madhabahu chini ya mlima na kusimamisha nguzo kumi na mbili za mawe kuwakilisha makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akariika amachiiko onsi ay'Omonene omoete. Erio akaimoka maambia chuni, akaagacha egesasiimero inse ye getunwa, agatenenia amagena ikomi na abere koreng'ana nebisaku ikomi na bibere bi'Abaisraeli.

English: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa ndiyo dhambi ya nyumba ya Yeroboamu ambayo iliisababishia kuanguka na kuangamia kwake hadi kutoweka kwenye uso wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ayio nigo abeete ebibe ase enyomba ya Yeroboamu, na akagera ekanachwa na egasirigwa kegima korwa ase ense.

English: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
Kiswahili: Maovu yangu yamenifunika kama mzigo usiochukulika.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biane biantubire nonya nomotwe bwonsi, bianditoeire na kombua.

English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnasafisha kikombe na sahani kwa nje, lakini ndani mmejaa unyangʼanyi na kutokuwa na kiasi.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime biaichoire nobouri na okogania gotari nekerengo.

English: and as soon as he had finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded him to say, the priests and prophets and all the people seized him, shouting, “You must surely die!
Kiswahili: Lakini mara tu Yeremia alipomaliza kuwaambia watu kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru kukisema, basi makuhani, manabii na watu wote walimkamata wakisema, “Ni lazima ufe!
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeremia akoorete gokwana amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigeete akwane ase abanto bonsi, erio abakuani, na ababani, na abanto bonsi bakamobwata, bagateeba, “Aye goika oitwe okwe!”

English: But the commanders of the Philistines were angry with Achish and told him, “Send that man back and let him return to the place you assigned him. He must not go down with us into battle only to become our adversary during the war. What better way for him to regain the favor of his master than with the heads of our men?
Kiswahili: Lakini majemadari wa Wafilisti wakamkasirikia na kusema, “Mrudishe mtu huyu, apate kurudi mahali pale ulipompangia. Haimpasi kufuatana pamoja nasi vitani, asije akageuka, akawa kinyume chetu vitani. Ni kwa njia ipi bora zaidi angeweza kujipatia tena kibali kwa bwana wake, isipokuwa kwa vichwa vya watu wetu wenyewe?
Ekegusii: Korende abanene b’Abafilisti bakaba nendamwamu enene ase Akisi, bakamoteebia: “Irania omonto oyo agende aase kwamobegete amenye. Ere takogenda amo naintwe korwana esegi. Karaikeo nabo arabaise gotoonchokera, abe omobisa oito. Naki arakore anyore ogwancherwa ase omonene oye otatiga ase ogoita Abanto baito.

English: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
Kiswahili: Mcheni Bwana enyi watakatifu wake, kwa maana wale wamchao hawapungukiwi na chochote.
Ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene, inwe abachenu baye, naki abwo bamoirogete tibakoremerwa kende.

English: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can't redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuja, kwa nini hakuwepo hata mmoja? Nilipoita, kwa nini hakuwepo hata mmoja wa kujibu? Je, mkono wangu ni mfupi mno hata nisiweze kuwakomboa? Je, mimi sina nguvu za kukuokoa? Kwa kukemea tu naikausha bahari, naigeuza mito ya maji kuwa jangwa; samaki wake wanaoza kwa kukosa maji na kufa kwa ajili ya kiu.
Ekegusii: “Nase ki ntanyorete nonya nomonto oyomo ekero nachete? Nase ki nonya nomonto oyomo atanyitaberete ekero narangeretie? Inee! Okoboko kwane nigo kweng'eire gotanyare kobooria? Gose inche nigo naborirwe chinguru chi'ogotooria? Naama! Ekero ngotogonyera enyancha, amaache nigo agosira; nigo ngokora chindooche chiaba erooro; chinswe chireo nigo chikoborwa amaache, chiakwa chiagunda.

English: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
Kiswahili: “Wakati huo, nitakuwa Mungu wa koo zote za Israeli nao watakuwa watu wangu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase engaki egocha, inche nimbe Nyasae bw'ebisaku bionsi bi'Abaisraeli, na barabwo nababe abanto baane.”

English: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,
Kiswahili: Petro akamwambia, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo anakuponya, inuka utandike kitanda chako.” Mara Ainea akainuka.
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia: “Ainea, Yeso Kristo okogwenirie; imoka bware oborere bwao!” Erio kegima akaimoka.

English: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Kuna mikate mingapi? Nendeni mkaangalie.” Walipokwisha kujua wakarudi, wakamwambia, “Kuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakaboora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”

English: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
Kiswahili: ili kumgeuza mtu kutoka kwenye kutenda mabaya na kumwepusha na kiburi,
Ekegusii: ng'a anyare koonchora omonto atige ogokora kwaye okobe, na atange oboenenu bw'omonto.

English: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, nitaumba mbingu mpya na dunia mpya. Mambo ya zamani hayatakumbukwa, wala hayatakuja akilini.
Ekegusii: “Rigereria, nintonge igoro chinyia, na ense enyia. Amang'ana e ritang'ani takoinyorwa gose takorengererigwa.

English: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo ninawaambia, Ufalme wa Mungu utaondolewa kwenu na kupewa watu wengine wawezao kuzaa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eye nabateebirie, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae naborusigwe ase more, boegwe egesaku egekwama amatunda aye. [

English: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”
Kiswahili: Je, tulazimike sasa kusikia kwamba ninyi pia mmefanya uovu huu mkubwa na kutokuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu wetu kwa kuoa wanawake wa kigeni?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo toragenderere koigwera amang'ana aino na tokore ebibe ebinene, naende tobe abatari abegenwa ase Nyasae oito, ase okonyuoma abakungu b'ebisaku ebiao?”

English: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
Kiswahili: ‘Ninyi wenyewe mmeona nililofanya huko Misri, jinsi nilivyowabeba kwenye mbawa za tai na kuwaleta kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwarorire aya nakoreire Abamisiri, na buna nababogoretie inwe buna ekeongo ekobogoria amage aye ase chimbaaba chiaye, nabarentire aiga ase ’nde.

English: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
Kiswahili: Lakini mara kwa mara Yesu alijitenga nao ili kwenda mahali pa faragha kuomba.
Ekegusii: Korende ere akerusanania, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasaba.

English: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.
Kiswahili: Msiwachokoze kwa vita kwa maana sitawapa ninyi sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao, hata sehemu ya kutosha kuweka wayo wenu juu yake. Nimempa Esau nchi ya vilima ya Seiri kama yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: timobaisa korwana nabarabwo, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe ense yabo nonya n’enseemo enke eisaine egesanyi gi’okogoro, ekiagera naeire abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu ebe eyaabo.

English: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.'
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, watu wanaoishi katika magofu hayo katika nchi ya Israeli wanasema hivi, ‘Abrahamu alikuwa mtu mmoja tu, hata hivyo akaimiliki nchi. Lakini sisi ni wengi, hakika tumepewa nchi kuwa milki yetu.'
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto abwo bamenyete ase amaturi aaria ase ense y'Abaisraeli, nigo bagokwana, bateeba: Aburaamu nigo arenge omonto oyomo, na ere akanyora ense eye ekaba eyaye; korende intwe nigo tore abange, ekeene, ense eye nero twaeirwe ebe eyaito.

English: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akaleta zile fimbo zote kwa Waisraeli wote kutoka mbele za Bwana. Wakaziangalia, na kila mtu akaichukua fimbo yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agachisokia isiko chinyimbo chiria chionsi korwa ase obosio bw'Omonene, agachirenta ase Abaisraeli bonsi. Abwo bagachirigereria, na kera omonto akabogoria enyimbo yaye.

English: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
Kiswahili: Misri ilifurahi walipoondoka, kwa sababu hofu ya Israeli ilikuwa imewaangukia.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo babete nomogooko ekero Abaisraeli bang'anyete, ekiagera obwoba konya bwabagwereire ase engencho y'Abaisraeli.

English: If He comes along to imprison you, or convenes a court, who can stop Him?
Kiswahili: “Kama akija na kukufunga gerezani, na kuitisha mahakama, ni nani awezaye kumpinga?
Ekegusii: Karaete asibe abanto, gose kobagambia, ning’o oramotange?

English: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Kiswahili: Bali wanyenyekevu watairithi nchi na wafurahie amani tele.
Ekegusii: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe omwando obo, na barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw'omorembe.

English: With him they sent ten chiefs—one family leader from each tribe of Israel, each the head of a family among the clans of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wakatuma pamoja naye watu kumi ambao ni viongozi, mmoja kwa kila kabila la Israeli, kila mmoja aliyekuwa kiongozi katika mgawanyiko wa jamaa miongoni mwa koo za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang’ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’eamate ase egesaku kiaye.

English: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akipita, akamwona mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.

English: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa became diseased in his feet, and his malady became increasingly severe. Yet even in his illness he did not seek the LORD, but only the physicians.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na tisa wa utawala wake, Asa alipatwa na ugonjwa kwenye miguu yake. Ingawa ugonjwa wake ulimzidia sana, hata katika kuugua kwake hakutafuta msaada kutoka kwa Bwana bali kwa matabibu tu.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato na kianda bw’okogamba kwaye, Asa akanyora oborwaire ase amagoro aye, na oborwaire obo bokaba obonene; korende nonya obete omorwaire, tarigetie Omonene, korende akarigia ogokonywa korwa ase abarwaria.

English: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute's house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia wale watu wawili waliokuwa wameipeleleza nchi, “Nendeni nyumbani kwa yule kahaba, mleteni pamoja na wote waliomo nyumbani mwake, kulingana na kiapo chenu kwake.”
Ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto baria, babere batometwe koroota ense eria, “Soa nyomba mw'omotayayi oria, momosokie amo nabaanto baye bonsi, buna mwamorierete eira na gotiana.”

English: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
Kiswahili: “Yule bwana akamsifu yule msimamizi dhalimu kwa jinsi alivyotumia ujanja. Kwa maana watu wa dunia hii wana ujanja zaidi wanapojishughulisha na mambo ya dunia kuliko watu wa nuru.
Ekegusii: Omonene oria agatogia omorendi otarenge omooronge, ekiagera akorete ase obong’aini. Naki abana b’ense eye nabang’aini kobua abana b’omobaso, ase ekegori kiabo abanyene. Enchera engiya y’ogokorera enibo emeremo

English: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
Kiswahili: Unapenda kila neno lenye kudhuru, ewe ulimi wenye hila!
Ekegusii: Aye ore noromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo bwanchete gokwana amang’ana agosaria.

English: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
Kiswahili: Mimi, naam mimi, ndimi Bwana, zaidi yangu hakuna mwokozi.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, ninche bweka inde Omotooria, naende onde tari.

English: “‘When you err, and don't observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi kama pasipo kukusudia umeshindwa kushika mojawapo katika amri hizi ambazo Bwana alimpa Mose,
Ekegusii: “Korende nenyare koba ng'a mwamochire kobwatia amachiiko ande onsi Omonene achiikire Musa,

English: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
Kiswahili: Hayo mnayoyajua mimi pia ninayajua; mimi si mtu duni kuliko ninyi.
Ekegusii: Aya momanyete, nainche ninyamanyete; inwe timombueti kende.

English: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Spiritual Blessings (Romans 8:28–34)
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Baraka Za Kiroho Katika Kristo Yesu
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa kw’omoika ase Kristo

English: The men sampled their provisions, and didn't ask counsel from Yahweh's mouth.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa Israeli wakavikagua vyakula vyao bila kupata shauri kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagancha koigwa endagera yabo, korende tibarigia ogosemia korwa ase Omonene.

English: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say, ‘Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?’
Kiswahili: ninyi mnaoshangilia kushindwa kwa Lo-Debari na kusema, “Je, hatukuteka Karnaimu kwa nguvu zetu wenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogokera egento kere bosa, mogoteeba, “Inee! Titwenyorerete ching’unchara goetera ase chinguru chiaito abanyene?”

English: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ishara kwa watu wa Ninawi, ndivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakavyokuwa ishara kwa kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Naki buna Yona abeete ekemanyererio ase abanto ba Ninawi, naboigo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto arache koba ase ekegori eke.

English: He put them all together into custody for three days.
Kiswahili: Akawaweka wote chini ya ulinzi kwa siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Erio agasiekera bonsi amo echela ime ase amatuko atato.

English: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametuma ujumbe dhidi ya Yakobo, utamwangukia Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene otomire ring'ana kogambia ororeeria rwa Yakobo, narirorio ndibaikere Abaisraeli.

English: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
Kiswahili: Lango la Yeshana lilikarabatiwa na Yoyada mwana wa Pasea, na Meshulamu mwana wa Besodeya. Waliweka boriti zake, na wakaweka milango, makomeo na nondo.
Ekegusii: Yehoyada, mosinto o Pasea, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Besodeya, bakaagacha Egeita Egekoro, bagakebekera emetobwa, na ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.

English: And between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.
Kiswahili: Masonara na wafanyabiashara walifanya ukarabati kutoka chumba kilichoko juu ya pembe hadi Lango la Kondoo.
Ekegusii: Ase egati y’akanyomba ka irongo agwo ase Ekoona na Egeita gie Ching’ondi, abaturi be chifeta na abaonchoreria bakaagacha aroro.

English: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
Kiswahili: milima ilikuona ikatetemeka. Mafuriko ya maji yakapita huko; vilindi vilinguruma na kuinua mawimbi yake juu.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo biakorooche, bikanyegerigwa, amaache e chiooro agaeta; chindiba chigaaka amariogi, chikaimokia amaboko abo gochia igoro.

English: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.
Kiswahili: Mkate huu wetu ulikuwa wa moto tulipoufunga siku tulipoanza safari kuja kwenu, lakini sasa angalia jinsi ulivyokauka na kuota ukungu.
Ekegusii: Rigereria emegaatiyaito! Nigo yarenge morero korwa riko, ekero twayerusetie chinyomba chiaito na gochaka orogendo rwaito, na rora bono buna yomire naende yamerire amatosi.

English: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana mimi niko pamoja nawe, wala hakuna mtu atakayeweza kukushambulia ili kukudhuru, kwa kuwa ninao watu wengi katika mji huu ambao ni watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye, nonya monto onde tari oragoochere, erinde agokore bobe. Naki inche nigo inde n'abanto abange ase omochie oyo.”

English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
Ekegusii: Mochirue amo n'okoruegwa kw'endagera na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria koreng'ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng'ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

English: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’ The House on the Rock (Luke 6:46–49)
Kiswahili: Ndipo nitakapowaambia wazi, ‘Sikuwajua kamwe. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!’ Msikiaji Na Mtendaji (Luka 6:47-49)
Ekegusii: Erio nainche nimbateebie maiso marore abanto baria: Timbamanyeti inwe nonya ng’ake; karue ase ’nde, inwe abakori amabe! Abaagachi Enyomba babere (Luk 6:47-49; Mar 1:22)

English: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe umemkataa, umemdharau, umemkasirikia sana mpakwa mafuta wako.
Ekegusii: Korende bono, aye Omonene kwangire omoakwa amaguta oo, kwabeire nendamwamu enene asare.

English: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”
Kiswahili: “Usiingie katika nyumba ambayo kuna karamu, na kuketi humo ili kula na kunywa.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosoa enyomba y'abanto bagokora omoyega na goikaransa agwo ase okoria na konywa amo nabarabwo.

English: I will put My Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it, declares the LORD.’” One Nation with One King
Kiswahili: Nitatia Roho yangu ndani yenu nanyi mtaishi, nami nitawakalisha katika nchi yenu wenyewe. Ndipo mtakapojua kwamba Mimi Bwana nimenena, nami nitalitenda, asema Bwana!’ ” Taifa Moja Chini Ya Mfalme Mmoja
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Nimbeke omoika one ime yaino, na inwe mobe moyo. Nimbarente, mbabeeke ase ense yaino. Erio momanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, boigo nayakorire.” Abayuda na Abaisraeli mbabe ab’oborwoti obomo

English: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo kuhani mkuu akawa anamuuliza Yesu kuhusu wanafunzi wake na mafundisho yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene akaboria Yeso amang’ana igoro yaborokigwa baye, na amang’ana ’okworokereria kwaye.

English: “Are you not like the Cushites to Me, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD. “Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir?
Kiswahili: “Je, Waisraeli, ninyi si sawa kwangu kama Wakushi?” asema Bwana. “Je, sikuleta Israeli kutoka Misri, Wafilisti kutoka Kaftori, na Washamu kutoka Kiri?
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, timonga buna Abaetiopia asende? Inee! Tinabarusetie inwe Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na Abafirisiti korwa ase ense ya Kafitori, na Abaasuri korwa Kiri?” Nab’Omonene ateebire.

English: I have not departed from the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread.
Kiswahili: Sijaziacha amri zilizotoka midomoni mwake; nimeyathamini maneno ya kinywa chake kuliko chakula changu cha kila siku.
Ekegusii: Tinana gotiga kobwata amachiiko akwanete; nimbwatetie amang’ana ere akwanete, gose tari aya naroberetie inche omonyene.

English: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
Kiswahili: Huvizia kama simba aliye mawindoni; huvizia kumkamata mnyonge, huwakamata wanyonge na kuwaburuza katika wavu wake.
Ekegusii: bw’ebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboerete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; obabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.

English: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Nebo 52
Ekegusii: abanto ba Nebo: emerongo etano, na babere (52);

English: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
Kiswahili: Mapito ya wenye haki yamenyooka. Ewe uliye Mwenye Haki, waisawazisha njia ya mtu mnyofu.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.

English: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
Kiswahili: Mwe waangalifu, na makini ili msije mkasahau mambo ambayo mliyaona kwa macho yenu, wala kuyaacha yaondoke moyoni mwenu siku zote za uhai wenu. Mwafundishe hayo watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao.
Ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba ayamwarorire n’amaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abaachokoro baino,

English: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.
Kiswahili: Kushi akamzaa Nimrodi, ambaye alikua akawa mtu shujaa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bw'eritang'ani orenge egiata ase ense.

English: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
Kiswahili: Kisha Waisraeli wakapanda kupigana na Wabenyamini katika siku ya tatu na kujiweka kwenye nafasi zao dhidi ya Gibea kama walivyokuwa wamefanya hapo kwanza.
Ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria gatato bakageenda korwania Ababenjamini, bakeroberia ase okorwana agwo Gibea, buna chingaki chiria chi'eritang'ani.

English: As they began emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his bag of silver! And when they and their father saw the bags of silver, they were dismayed.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamimina nafaka kutoka kwenye magunia yao, ndani ya gunia la kila mtu kulikuwa na mfuko wa fedha! Wakati wao na baba yao walipoona mifuko ya fedha, wakaogopa.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chitaabu chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise barooche chisaro chi’echitaabu chiabo, bakaondoka.

English: He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
Kiswahili: Huchunga kundi lake kama mchungaji wa mifugo: Hukusanya wana-kondoo katika mikono yake na kuwachukua karibu na moyo wake, huwaongoza taratibu wale wanyonyeshao.
Ekegusii: Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chi’eching’ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora. Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tari koreng’anigwa na onde

English: Where no hedge is, the property will be plundered. He who has no wife will mourn as he wanders.
Kiswahili: Pale ambapo hakuna ua, mali itaporwa. Asiye na mke ataomboleza anapotangatanga.
Ekegusii: Oria obwate obongo bw'ebirengererio ebibe nigo akorenta omoichano korende ere oria onarete obogima goika amoakane buna egwenerete.

English: They decorated the front of the temple with crowns of gold and small shields. They dedicated the gates and the priests' chambers, and made doors for them.
Kiswahili: Walipamba sehemu ya mbele ya hekalu kwa taji za dhahabu na ngao ndogo. Waliweka wakfu malango na vyumba vya makuhani, na kutengeneza milango kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Bagachabera chinyasi chiamotwe chie Hekalu ne egutwa ye etaabu ne chinguba chinke chinke; bakaroisia ebisieri bie Hekalu; bakaagacha chinyomba chi'abakuani boyia na gochibeka ebisieri.

English: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”
Kiswahili: Sasa naomba uwe radhi kuibariki nyumba ya mtumishi wako, ili idumu mbele zako milele, kwa maana wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, umesema, na kwa baraka zako nyumba ya mtumishi wako itaendelea kubarikiwa milele.”
Ekegusii: Gaki boono, koranche osesenie enyomba y'ane, inche omosomba oo, erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene, kwariete eira eyio. Ase igo enyomba y'ane, inche omosomba oo, esesenigwe kare na kare nogosesenigwa kwao.”

English: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn't it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
