Kiswahili: (Mfalme Ogu wa Bashani ndiye peke yake aliyesalia miongoni mwa mabaki ya Warefai. Kitanda chake kilikuwa cha chuma chenye urefu wa dhiraa tisa na upana wa dhiraa nne. Mpaka sasa kinaweza kuonekana katika mji wa Waamoni wa Raba.)
Ekegusii: (Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, nere orenge oyobwomoerio ase Abarefai. Esanduki yaye y'ogotindekerwa eyaroiseirie ebioma, nigo yarenge chimita inye ase obotambe boigo n'echimita ibere ase obogare koreng'ana nokorenga kwa boronge. Nao ere agwo Raba, omochie bw'Abaamoni.)

English: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
Kiswahili: Magdieli na Iramu. Hao ndio wakuu wa makabila ya Edomu.
Ekegusii: Magadieli na Iramu. Abwo nabwo barenge abagaambi b’ebisaku bia Edomu.

English: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika kila taifa, kila mtu amchaye na kutenda yaliyo haki hukubaliwa naye.
Ekegusii: korende ase kera egesaku omonto omoirogete na gokora oboronge nigo agwancherwa nere.

English: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
Kiswahili: Simba anaweza kuangamia kwa kukosa mawindo, nao wana wa simba jike hutawanyika.
Ekegusii: Endo engotu nekwe ase okoborwa chinyama ekoria. Ne chimanwa chi'endo eaberi nigo chigosererebekana.

English: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akageuka, akawaacha waabudu jeshi lote la mbinguni, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Manabii: “ ‘Je, mliniletea dhabihu na sadaka kwa miaka arobaini kule jangwani, ee nyumba ya Israeli?
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akeonchora korwa ase bare, akabatiga basasiime erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chia igoro, buna ariikire ase egetabu y’ababani: Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, eyio mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?

English: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Nao Walawi wakalichukua Sanduku la Mungu mabegani mwao wakitumia mipiko, kama vile Mose alivyoamuru sawasawa na neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abalawi bakabogoria Esanduki eria ya Nyasae nemiaro igoro ase amareko abo, buna Musa abachigete koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: each man's work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man's work is.
Kiswahili: kazi yake itaonekana ilivyo, kwa kuwa Siku ile itaidhihirisha. Itadhihirishwa kwa moto, nao moto utapima ubora wa kazi ya kila mtu.
Ekegusii: emeremo ya kera omonto ing'a eorokigwe maiso marore. Naki Rituko erio inariyeorokie, ekiagera narioroke nomorero; na omorero oyio noteeme emeremo ya kera omonto ng'a naki ere.

English: As for the descendants of Levi, the family heads up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa jamaa miongoni mwa wazao wa Lawi hadi wakati wa Yohanani mwana wa Eliashibu waliandikishwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’Abalawi abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo okarikwa ase Egetabu ki’amang’ana ’Ebiro goikera ase amatuko a Yohanani, mosinto bw’Eliasibu. Ogwatananwa kw’emeremo ye Hekalu

English: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Funika nyuso zao kwa aibu ili watu walitafute jina lako, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kora amasio abo abe nobosooku obonene, erinde babe bakorigia erieta riao.

English: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
Kiswahili: Mungu alimtukuza, akamweka mkono wake wa kuume kuwa Kiongozi na Mwokozi ili awape Israeli toba na msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna Omoraai na Omotooria, erinde abae abanto ba Israeli ribaga riokoonchoka erinde banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.

English: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y'emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong'u bwabo.

English: Their bows will dash young men to pieces; they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb; they will not look with pity on the children.
Kiswahili: Mishale yao itawaangusha vijana, hawatakuwa na huruma kwa watoto wachanga wala hawataangalia watoto kwa huruma.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbaite abamura b’abwo ase okobabeta chinsara, tibakororera abana bare inda, gose abana bande, amaabera.

English: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliye Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Mbele ya macho yako na katika siku zako, nitakomesha sauti zote za shangwe na za furaha, na pia sauti za bibi arusi na bwana arusi mahali hapa.'
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene bw'Emeganda, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Ase engaki yaino ekero morigereretie ninsirie eriogi ri'omogooko, na erie chigosori, na eri'omonywomi, na eri'omoriakari.

English: if you are pure and upright, even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate.
Kiswahili: ikiwa wewe ni safi na mnyofu, hata sasa atainuka mwenyewe kwa niaba yako, na kukurudisha katika mahali pako pa haki.
Ekegusii: korabe oyochenegete na ore nenkoro endonge, ekeene, rirorio ere nagochandekere, nakoroiserie obomenyo, na oboronge bogenderere kobao.

English: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses' law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Pale, mbele ya Waisraeli Yoshua akanakili juu ya hayo mawe sheria ya Mose, aliyokuwa ameiandika.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli kobarigereretie, Yoshua akarika ase amagena amachiiko aria aria Musa konya ariikire.

English: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!'
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasikia sauti ikiniambia, ‘Petro, ondoka uchinje na ule.'
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Petero, imoka, onyenye orie!

English: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian's camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yerub-Baali (yaani Gideoni) na lile jeshi lililokuwa pamoja naye, wakaondoka asubuhi na mapema na kupiga kambi kando ya chemchemi ya Harodi. Kambi ya Wamidiani ilikuwa kaskazini yao katika bonde karibu na kilima cha More.
Ekegusii: Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amo n'abanto abarenge komo bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatoora ang'e n'ensoko ya Harodi. Abamidiani nigo batoorete ase ense omweya sugusu yabo, ang'e n'egetunwa kia More.

English: All the rulers of the children of Esau, all the leaders of the people of Moab, and the captains of the sea coast came to him and said,
Kiswahili: Wakuu wote wa wana wa Esau, wakuu wote wa watu wa Moabu, na wakuu wa pwani wakamwendea, wakasema,
Ekegusii: Erio abamenyi ba Bani Esau, na abarai bonsi ba abanto ba Moabu na abarai b'ense mbarabare yenyancha ya Mediterania bakamochira Holoferne bakamoteebia,

English: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?'”
Kiswahili: Hazaeli akaenda kumlaki Elisha, akiwa amechukua zawadi ya kila kitu kizuri kilichopatikana Dameski, mizigo iliyobebwa na ngamia arobaini. Akaingia ndani na kusimama mbele yake, akasema, “Mwanao Ben-Hadadi mfalme wa Aramu amenituma niulize, ‘Je, nitapona ugonjwa huu?' ”
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hasaeli akagenda korotota Elisha, akamoirera ebiegwa, ebinto ebiya mono bia Damesiki, ebinto biisaine kobogorigwa ne chingamia emerongo ene. Ekero aigete asare, agatenena ase obosio bwaye, agateeba: “Omwana oo Beni‐Hadadi, omorwoti bw'Abasiiria, ontomire gocha asore gokoboria gose nagwene korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.”

English: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli kama wangekuwa wanafikiri kuhusu nchi waliyoiacha, wangalipata nafasi ya kurudi huko.
Ekegusii: Onye barabwo mbainyorete ense eria ase baruete, anga mbanyorete ribaga koirana aroro.

English: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana manabii wote na Sheria walitabiri mpaka wakati wa Yohana.
Ekegusii: Inaki ababani bonsi mbaabanete, na amachiiko boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana.

English: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to patrol the earth.”
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mtu aliyesimama katikati ya miti ya mihadasi akaeleza, “Ni wale ambao Bwana amewatuma waende duniani kote.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria akang’iraneria, aganteebia, “Chibarasi echio nachio Omonene atomire chietanane ase ense yonsi.”

English: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
Kiswahili: Yosia akawaleta makuhani wote wa Bwana kutoka miji yote ya Yuda, na kunajisi mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, kuanzia Geba hadi Beer-Sheba, mahali pote ambapo hao makuhani wa miungu walifukiza uvumba. Akabomoa mahali pa kuwekea vitu vya ibada za miungu palipokuwa katika malango, kwenye ingilio la Lango la Yoshua, mtawala wa mji, lililoko upande wa kushoto wa lango la mji.
Ekegusii: Akarenta abakuani bonsi korwa ase emechie y'Abayuda, na ase ense yonsi korwa Geba goika Beeri‐Seba agakora aase onsi aimokererete igoro agwo ase abakuani baarenge gosambera ubani akaba aatachenegeti. Na ebisasimero bi'aase aimokererete igoro arenge agwo ase ebiita bi'omochie, keria kiarenge ase egesoero ki'Egeita kia Yoshua, omogabana bw'omochie, na keria kiarenge ensemo y'okobee y'oyo ogosoera omochie, omorwoti akabitagora akabiyeria inse.

English: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
Kiswahili: Lakini Waisraeli wakapita baharini mahali pakavu, ukiwepo ukuta wa maji upande wao wa kuume na upande wao wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y'enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amaache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi ase bare.

English: “I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a holy watcher came down from the sky.
Kiswahili: “Katika maono niliyoyaona nikiwa nimelala kitandani mwangu, nilitazama, na mbele yangu alikuwepo mlinzi, aliye mtakatifu, akishuka kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: “Ekero naraire borere bwane, nkarora ase okorora kwane omorendi omochenu ogoika korwa igoro.

English: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
Kiswahili: Tazama watesi wako wanafanya fujo, jinsi adui zako wanavyoinua vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora rirorooche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.

English: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo Yesu akatoka nje ya nyumba, akaketi kando ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria Yeso akarua nyomba agaikaransa ase enyancha mbarabare.

English: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwamba nimekwisha kutayarisha mambo yangu, ninajua mimi nitahesabiwa kuwa na haki.
Ekegusii: Rora, naroisirie amang'ana aane, namanyire ng'a nimbarerwe oboronge.

English: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
Kiswahili: Baraza yake ilielekeana na ukumbi wa nje, miimo yake ilinakshiwa miti ya mitende pande zote, kulikuwa na ngazi nane za kupandia huko.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y'emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiria chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge n'ebitangora bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.

English: Manasseh will have one portion bordering the territory of Naphtali from east to west.
Kiswahili: “Manase atakuwa na sehemu moja, itapakana na nchi ya Naftali kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Manase keegwe orogongo rw’aye robebekane norwa Nafutali korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
Kiswahili: Methusela aliishi jumla ya miaka 969, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Metusela nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na kianda (969), erio agakwa.

English: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
Kiswahili: Ombeni pia ili tupate kuokolewa kutokana na watu waovu na wabaya, kwa maana si wote wanaoamini.
Ekegusii: ng’a totoorigwe korwa ase abanto batari abaronge, na abare ababe, ekiagera tai bonsi bare nokwegena.

English: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akaenda katika Mlima wa Mizeituni.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akagenda ase egetunwa ki'Emezeituni.

English: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe!” And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him. The Death of Jesus (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:45–56; Luke 23:44–49; John 19:28–30)
Kiswahili: Basi huyu Kristo, huyu Mfalme wa Israeli, ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, ili tupate kuona na kuamini.” Wale waliosulubiwa pamoja naye pia wakamtukana. Kifo Cha Yesu Msalabani (Mathayo 27:45-56; Luka 23:44-49; Yohana 19:28-30)
Ekegusii: Tiga Kristo, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, tonyare korora na kwegena!” Na barabwo abaabambetwe amo nere bakamoraama. Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Luk 23:44-49; Yoh 19:28-30)

English: So Hanun took David's servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
Kiswahili: Basi Hanuni akawakamata watu wa Daudi, akawanyoa kila mmoja ndevu zake nusu, akakata mavazi yao nyuma katikati kwenye matako, akawaacha waende zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba abwo ba Daudi, akagingira chinderu chiabo ensemo eyemo, na akanacha chianga chiabo agachiikia ebinema, akabaseria bagende.

English: Indeed, the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too small to wrap around you.
Kiswahili: Kitanda ni kifupi mno kujinyoosha juu yake, nguo ya kujifunikia ni nyembamba mno mtu hawezi kujifunikia.
Ekegusii: Oborere nigo bore obweng’e omonto agosinywa kwerambora igoro ase borobwo, na ekiebisio nigo kere ekenyerere mono omonto atanyare kwebisia.

English: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
Kiswahili: roho hizo ambazo zamani hazikutii, wakati ule uvumilivu wa Mungu ulipokuwa ukingoja katika siku za Noa, wakati wa kujenga safina, ambamo watu wachache tu, yaani watu wanane, waliokolewa ili wasiangamie kwa gharika.
Ekegusii: Emeika eyio ney’abwo bataigwerete agwo kare, ekero Nyasae aganyete ase oboremereria ase amatuko aria Nuhu are koroisia obwato. Ime ase abwo abanto abake, engencho yaye abanto batano na batato, batooregete goetera ase amache.

English: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
Kiswahili: Tena, “Nitaweka tumaini langu kwake.” Tena anasema, “Niko hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Nimosemerie Nyasae.” Naende oteeba, “Rora, inche nao inde aiga amo nabana baria naetwe na Nyasae.”

English: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
Kiswahili: Kama kondoo, wamewekewa kwenda kaburini, nacho kifo kitawala. Wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi, maumbile yao yataozea kaburini, mbali na majumba yao makubwa ya fahari.
Ekegusii: Buna riicho rie ching'ondi nigo bakoirwa gochia aase abakuure amakweri naro arabe omorisia obo. Abwo bare abaronge mbaabagambere kobogokiamoka, na ebieni biabo mbisirere agwo aase abakuure aase are obomenyo bwabo.

English: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Je, dhambi ya Peori haikutosha? Hata ingawa kulikuja tauni juu ya kusanyiko la Bwana, mpaka leo hii hatujatakasika kutokana na dhambi hiyo!
Ekegusii: Inee! Ebibe biria twakorete ase ogosasiima Peori tibiatoisanete? Korwa ase ebibe biria titwana gochenwa nonya ngoika reero iga, na egesusuro gekanyora omoganda bwonsi bw'Omonene.

English: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana lilimjia Mika, Mmoreshethi, wakati wa utawala wa Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda; ufunuo aliouona kuhusu Samaria na Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Mika, oyo omenyete agwo Moreseti, ekero Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, barenge abarwoti b’Abayuda. Omonene akamomaanorera Mika ayare gochia koba igoro ya Samaria na Yerusalemu. Okweumia igoro ya Samaria na Yerusalemu

English: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
Kiswahili: nao wakamvuta juu kwa kamba na kumtoa katika kisima. Yeremia akakaa katika ua wa walinzi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakang'usa Yeremia ne chingori chiria korwa ase engoro eria, bakamorusiao. Na Yeremia akagenderera kobeera ase egoora y'abarendi.

English: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don't speak to Jacob either good or bad.'
Kiswahili: Nina uwezo wa kukudhuru, lakini usiku uliopita Mungu wa baba yako alisema nami, akaniambia, ‘Jihadhari, usiseme neno lolote kwa Yakobo liwe zuri au baya.'
Ekegusii: Ninde nokobua gw'okogokorera amabe, korende Nyasae o iso nakwanete nainche ase obotuko bwaetete, agankurera aganteebia: Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.

English: And Adam named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all the living. The Expulsion from Paradise
Kiswahili: Adamu akamwita mkewe Eva, kwa kuwa atakuwa mama wa wote walio hai.
Ekegusii: Adamu akaaroka mokaye Hawa, ekiagera ere nere ng’ina bw’abare moyo bonsi.

English: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Sedekia akamwambia Yeremia, “Ninawaogopa Wayahudi ambao wamekimbilia kwa Wakaldayo, kwa kuwa Wakaldayo wanaweza kunitia mikononi mwao, nao wakanitenda vibaya.”
Ekegusii: Zedekia omorwoti akairaneria Yeremia, akamoteebia, “Noboire Abayahudi baria batamete bakabwatana n'Abakalidayo. Inse kwerua, nigo ndabaise gochia kobekwa ase amaboko abo, na barabwo banchecherie ase ogonchanda.”

English: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa mkanipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu mkaninywesha, nilikuwa mgeni mkanikaribisha,
Ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang'a endagera; inarenge nerang'o, mokang'a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

English: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Njoo hapa mbele ya watu wote.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Tenena gati aa!”

English: If I summoned Him and He answered me, I do not believe He would listen to my voice.
Kiswahili: Hata kama ningemwita kwenye shauri, naye akakubali, siamini kama angenisikiliza.
Ekegusii: Onye narenge komorangeria, na ere ang’itabere, rirorio tinarenge kwegena ng’a nategererete eriogi riane.

English: Because of this, all my brothers have perished for Israel's sake, and I am left alone.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, ndugu zangu wote wameangamia kwa ajili ya Israeli, nami nimebaki peke yangu.
Ekegusii: Bamura baminto bonsi baitirwe ase okorwanerera amachiiko, Hekalu negesaku kia Abaisraeli; niche bweka ntigarete.

English: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
Kiswahili: Manase alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu miaka hamsini na mitano. Mama yake aliitwa Hefsiba.
Ekegusii: Manase nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagaamba emiaka emerongo etano, na etano, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hebisiba.

English: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
Kiswahili: Ninajua tena nimehakikishiwa sana katika Bwana Yesu kwamba hakuna kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa asili yake. Lakini kama mtu anakiona kitu kuwa ni najisi, basi kwake huyo kitu hicho ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng’a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng’a negento ekebe.

English: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;
Kiswahili: Dedani, Tema, Buzi na wote walio maeneo ya mbali;
Ekegusii: emechie ya Dedani, na Tema, na Busi, na abanto bonsi abwo bakonacha chitukia chiabo;

English: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
Kiswahili: na wote wakanywa kile kile kinywaji cha roho, kwa maana walikunywa kutoka ule mwamba wa roho uliofuatana nao, nao ule mwamba ulikuwa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bakanywa ekenyugwa keria keria ki'omoika, ekiagera banywete korwa ase egetare ki'omoika kiabatunyanete; na egetare keria nakio Kristo.

English: Then I will send a boy and say, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ Now, if I expressly say to him, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them,’ then come, because as surely as the LORD lives, it is safe for you and there is no danger.
Kiswahili: Kisha nitamtuma mvulana na kumwambia, ‘Nenda ukaitafute mishale.’ Kama nikimwambia, ‘Tazama mishale iko upande huu wako! Uilete hapa,’ basi uje, kwa sababu hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, wewe ni salama, hakuna hatari.
Ekegusii: Erio nintome omosomba one arigie emegwe eria. Kondateebie omosomba oria: Rigereia, emegwe nigo ere magega ao, gocha ensemo yane, genda oyerente, rirorio aye Daudi ochiche, obe nomorembe. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, togokorerwa bobe bonde.

English: The flowers have appeared in the countryside; the season of singing has come, and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land.
Kiswahili: Maua yanatokea juu ya nchi; majira ya kuimba yamewadia, sauti za njiwa zinasikika katika nchi yetu.
Ekegusii: Ebisicha biasichire ase ense, engaki y’amatera yaikire, ee, eriogi ri’amatera ’amaruma riaigurwe ase ense yaito.

English: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ninyi watu msipoona ishara na miujiza kamwe hamtaamini.”
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamoteebia, “Motarochi ebikone na amakumia, timori kwegena nonya ng’ake.”

English: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother's wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda akamwambia Onani, “Kutana kimwili na mke wa ndugu yako, na utimize wajibu wako kwake kama mke wa ndugu yako, ili umpatie ndugu yako uzao.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Onani: “Motware moka momura omino, erinde omotenenerie egesaku.”

English: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn't receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
Kiswahili: na kila aina ya uovu kwa wale wanaoangamia kwa sababu walikataa kuipenda kweli wapate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: na ase obong'ainereria bwonsi bw'ogotaba boronge ase abwo bagosira, ekiagera bangete konyora ekeene, na kogiancha erinde banyare gotoorigwa.

English: Each man left his place and departed into his own land.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu aliacha mahali pake na kwenda nchi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: kera omonto agatiga emeremo yaye na koirana gochia sobo.

English: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kila mmoja ambaye ni mzawa ni lazima afanye vitu hivi kwa njia hii hapo aletapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi ababiare nabwo barabwatie omooroberio oyio, ekero bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kobe risimu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

English: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
Kiswahili: mwanamke asiyependwa aolewapo, naye mtumishi wa kike achukuapo nafasi ya bibi yake.
Ekegusii: na ekero omoiseke otanchiri akonyuomwa, na omoiseke omosomba akoira ribaga ri'omokuungu oria agokorera emeremo.

English: He stood before Yahweh's altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands
Kiswahili: Kisha Solomoni akasimama mbele ya madhabahu ya Bwana machoni pa kusanyiko lote la Israeli, naye akakunjua mikono yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw'egesasiimero ki'Omonene ase obosio bw'omosangererekano bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye.

English: Now Sennacherib had been warned about Tirhakah king of Cush: “Look, he has set out to fight against you.” So Sennacherib again sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
Kiswahili: Basi Senakeribu akapata taarifa kwamba Tirhaka, Mkushi mfalme wa Misri, alikuwa anaenda kupigana naye. Basi akatuma tena wajumbe kwa Hezekia na neno hili:
Ekegusii: Na ekero omorwoti bw’Abaasuri aigwete amang’ana ng’a Tirihaka, omorwoti bw’Abaetiopia, ochire korwana esegi nere, agatoma abanto ase Hezekia naende, akabateebia,

English: And a proclamation was issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they were to bring to the LORD the tax imposed by Moses the servant of God on Israel in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Tangazo likatolewa katika Yuda na Yerusalemu kwamba inapasa wamletee Bwana kodi ile ambayo Mose, mtumishi wa Bwana alikuwa amewaagiza Israeli huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bakaraarerigwa barente ase Omonene ebango eria Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, abeekerete Abaisraeli agwo ase erooro.

English: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
Kiswahili: Mapazia yote yalitoshana kwa ukubwa: kila moja lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa dhiraa nne
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa nigo bwarenge obw'ekerengo ki'amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane; bionsi nigo biarenge bi'ekerengo ekemo.

English: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yote yaliwapata wao ili yawe mifano kwa wengine, nayo yaliandikwa ili yatuonye sisi ambao mwisho wa nyakati umetufikia.
Ekegusii: Aya agakoreka ase bare buna ekiorokererio, akarikwa ase ogotokuurera intwe abatogocherwa nomoerio bw'ense.

English: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
Kiswahili: Nawaambieni, vivyo hivyo kutakuwa na furaha zaidi mbinguni kwa sababu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye, kuliko kwa wenye haki tisini na tisa ambao hawana haja ya kutubu.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabateebirie, nobe omogooko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka.

English: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
Kiswahili: wana wa Hashemu Mgiloni, Yonathani mwana wa Shagee Mharari,
Ekegusii: basinto ba Hasemu korwa Gisoni na Yonathani, mosinto o Sagee, korwa Harari;

English: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipokuwa jangwani, mtu mmoja alikutwa akikusanya kuni siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri'Esabato.

English: Then I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She replied, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.’ So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.
Kiswahili: “Nikamuuliza, ‘Wewe ni binti wa nani?’ “Akasema, ‘Mimi ni binti wa Bethueli, mwana wa Nahori, Milka aliyemzalia.’ “Ndipo nilipotia pete puani mwake na bangili mikononi mwake,
Ekegusii: Erio namobooria: “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore?” Ere ong’iraneria: “Inche nomoiseke o Betueli oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori.” Agwo namobekera ekegera chimioro chiaye, na ebitange ase amaboko aye.

English: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
Kiswahili: Unakitumia kinywa chako kwa mabaya na kuuongoza ulimi wako kwa hila.
Ekegusii: “Omonwa oo nigo ore omwango gokwana amang'ana 'obobe, na oromeme rwao nigo romanyete koroisia amang'ana 'obong'ainereria.

English: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamwambia Mungu, “Nimetenda dhambi kubwa kwa kufanya jambo hili. Sasa, ninakusihi, ondoa hatia ya mtumishi wako. Nimefanya jambo la kipumbavu sana.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire. Korende bono nagosabire, onyabere inche, omosomba oo, ogosaria kwane, naki nigo nakorire egento ki'oboriri obonene.”

English: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and tell them, ‘Any man of the house of Israel or any foreign resident who presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Aroni na wanawe, na Waisraeli wote uwaambie: ‘Ikiwa mmoja wenu, aliye Mwisraeli au mgeni anayeishi katika nchi ya Israeli, atatoa matoleo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa Bwana, iwe kutimiza nadhiri au kuwa sadaka ya hiari,
Ekegusii: “Teebia Aroni na abamura baye, na Abaisraeli bonsi, ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, aganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, keraabe nase engencho y’eira, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye,

English: From the first flower to the ripening grape my heart delighted in her. My foot walked in uprightness. From my youth I followed her steps.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia ua la kwanza hadi zabibu zilizoiva, moyo wangu ulifurahishwa naye. Mguu wangu ulitembea kwa unyofu. Tangu ujana wangu nilifuata nyayo zake.
Ekegusii: Korwa okoiborwa kwane goika obogotu nche naamogokerete kegima ase omoyo one ime. Amagoro aane akabwatia enchera enyorooro; korwa obwana bwane akabwatia enchera yaye.

English: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers'?
Kiswahili: Je, watu hawa wote mimi ndiye niliyewatungisha mimba? Je, ni mimi niliyewazaa? Kwa nini unaniambia niwachukue mikononi mwangu, kama vile mlezi abebavyo mtoto mchanga, hadi kwenye nchi uliyowaahidi baba zao?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ninche naiborete abanto aba bonsi? Gose ninche nabatongete? Naki rende ogonteebia ng'a 'mbabogorie na kobarera ase egekuba kiane, buna omoreri akobogoria omwana ekeng'werere okogonka, goika imbaikie ase ense eria kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng'a nobayee?”

English: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won't have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.
Kiswahili: basi agano langu na Daudi mtumishi wangu, na agano langu na Walawi ambao ni makuhani wanaohudumu mbele zangu, linaweza kuvunjwa, na Daudi hatakuwa tena na mzao wa kutawala katika kiti chake cha enzi.
Ekegusii: Boigo okobwatana kwane nakorete na Daudi, omosomba one, ngotenene. Omonto takobora ase ororeria rwaye oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki'oborwoti. Boigo nokobwatana kwane nabakuani b'ororeria rwa Lawi ngotenene.

English: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
Kiswahili: “Ombeni nanyi mtapewa; tafuteni nanyi mtapata; bisheni nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.
Ekegusii: “Saba, 'namoegwe; rigia, 'namonyore; tura, 'namoigorerwe egesieri.

English: Then he took the calf they had made, burned it in the fire, ground it to powder, and scattered the powder over the face of the water. Then he forced the Israelites to drink it.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamchukua yule ndama waliokuwa wamemtengeneza na kumchoma kwenye moto, kisha akamsaga kuwa unga, akanyunyiza kwenye maji na kuwafanya Waisraeli wanywe.
Ekegusii: Erio akabwata emori eria bakorete, akayesamba na koyesegenya goika ekaba orotu, akaroitera ase amaache ime, na akaa Abaisraeli amaache ayio, na barabwo bakanywa.

English: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
Kiswahili: lakini macho yao yakazuiliwa ili wasimtambue.
Ekegusii: Amaiso abo agatubwa, tibanyara komomanya.

English: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer. The Second Seal: War
Kiswahili: Nikatazama, na hapo mbele yangu alikuwepo farasi mweupe! Yeye aliyempanda alikuwa na upinde, naye akapewa taji, akampanda akatoka akiwa kama mshindi aelekeaye katika kushinda.
Ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora ebarasi endabu, na ere oyoyeriinete narenge nobota; akaegwa egutwa, agasoka buna oyokobua, naende buna oyorabue.

English: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.
Kiswahili: Basi akaenda, akaokota mabaki ya nafaka mashambani nyuma ya wavunaji. Ikatokea kwamba alijikuta anafanya kazi kwenye shamba lililokuwa mali ya Boazi, ambaye alitoka kwenye ukoo wa Elimeleki.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu akagenda ase omogondo gete, akaba ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y’abagesi. Na bono egatoka ng’a omogondo oyio nigo orenge oyo o Boazi, omonto oria bw’eamate y’Elimeleki.

English: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
Kiswahili: lakini umande ulitokeza kutoka ardhini na kunyesha uso wote wa nchi:
Ekegusii: Korende obotooru nigo bware gotiira korwa inse na konyiyia riroba ri’ense yonsi.

English: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uturehemu, tunakutamani. Uwe nguvu yetu kila asubuhi na wokovu wetu wakati wa taabu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tororere amaabera; twabeire togosemeretie. Kabe chinguru chiaito kera rituko, na ototoorie ase engaki y'emechando.

English: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor,
Kiswahili: Sisera alipoambiwa kuwa Baraka mwana wa Abinoamu alikuwa amepanda Mlima Tabori,
Ekegusii: Sisera agateebigwa ng’a Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, otiirire gochia ase Egetunwa gia Tabori.

English: in every city and province where the ordinance was published. Wherever the proclamation took place, the Jews had joy and gladness, feasting and mirth. Many of the Gentiles were circumcised and became Jews for fear of the Jews.
Kiswahili: katika kila mji na jimbo ambapo amri hiyo ilitangazwa. Popote tangazo hilo lilipofanyika, Wayahudi walikuwa na furaha na shangwe, karamu na furaha. Watu wengi wa Mataifa walitahiriwa na kuwa Wayahudi kwa kuwaogopa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: okorengereria okoronge kw'abarai kwamerirwe n'okorengeria okobe.

English: and carried away all the plunder and spoils, both people and animals.
Kiswahili: Walichukua nyara zote na mateka, pamoja na watu na wanyama,
Ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa abanto, boigo bakaira chitugo chionsi.

English: David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akawaita makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari, pamoja na Walawi Urieli, Asaya, Yoeli, Shemaya, Elieli na Aminadabu.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria abakuani Zadoki na Abiatari, naende Abalawi: Urieli na Asaia, Yoel na Semaya, Elieli na Aminadabu,

English: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alisulubiwa katika udhaifu, lakini anaishi kwa nguvu za Mungu. Vivyo hivyo, sisi tu dhaifu kupitia kwake, lakini katika kuwashughulikia ninyi tutaishi pamoja naye kwa nguvu za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki igo abambetwe ase oboreu, korende moyo are ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Naki intwe nigo tore abareu asare; korende natobe moyo amo nere ase okobua kwa Nyasae gocha ase more.

English: All go to one place; all come from dust, and all return to dust.
Kiswahili: Wote huenda mahali panapofanana; wote hutoka mavumbini, mavumbini wote hurudi.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda aase ching’iti chikogenda; Mwanyabaanto nigo baruete ase amaroba, ne ching’iti naboigo; nigo bakoirana ase amaroba, naboigo na chirochio.

English: And if at another time I announce that I will build up and establish a nation or kingdom,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa wakati mwingine nitatangaza kuwa taifa ama utawala ujengwe na kuwekwa wakfu,
Ekegusii: Na engaki ende yonsi inche ndakwane igoro y’okoagacha na gokinia abanto b’egesaku gose oborwoti,

English: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
Kiswahili: Hakika, ni vigumu mtu yeyote kufa kwa ajili ya mwenye haki, ingawa inawezekana mtu akathubutu kufa kwa ajili ya mtu mwema.
Ekegusii: Inaki naakong’u omonto gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omonyene oboronge, korende nenyarekane omonto koremereria gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omuya.

English: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God's Kingdom,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yohana kukamatwa na kutiwa gerezani, Yesu aliingia Galilaya akaanza kuhubiri habari njema ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Magega Yohana kabekirwe echela ime, Yeso akagenda Galili, akarandia enchiri ya Nyasae,

English: Yahweh's word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana lililomjia Hosea mwana wa Beeri wakati wa utawala wa Uzia, Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda, na wakati wa utawala wa Yeroboamu mwana wa Yehoashi, mfalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Eri nario ring'ana ri'Omonene riacherete Hosea, mosinto o Beeri, ase amatuko aria Usia, na Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, baarenge abarwoti b'Abayuda, na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi, arenge omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli.

English: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa huvizia kumwaga damu yao wenyewe; hujivizia tu wenyewe!
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoboera goitera amanyinga abo abanyene, na koumokera obogima bwabo abanyene.

English: Shudder, you ladies of leisure; tremble, you daughters of complacency. Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists.
Kiswahili: Tetemekeni, enyi wanawake wenye kuridhika, tetemekeni kwa hofu, enyi binti mnaojisikia salama! Vueni nguo zenu, vaeni nguo ya gunia viunoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, iguswa, mwechabore chianga chiaino mobe getirianda, erio mweboyie chigunia.

English: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant; so he will do damage and return to his own land.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Kaskazini atarudi katika nchi yake na utajiri mwingi, lakini atakuwa ameukaza moyo wake kinyume na agano takatifu. Atachukua hatua dhidi ya hilo agano, kisha atarudi nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oria o sugusu nairane gochia ase ense yaye, aire ebinto ebinge asakoire, na enkoro yaye neroberie mamincha y’okobwatana koria ogochenu, na ekero arabe oikeranirie ayio, nairane gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.

English: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkasema, “Bwana Mungu wetu ametuonyesha utukufu na enzi yake, nasi tumesikia sauti yake kutoka kwenye moto. Leo tumeona kwamba mwanadamu anaweza kuishi hata kama Mungu akizungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Mokabora: Naama, Omonene Nyasae oito, otworokirie obonene bwaye na obonguru bwaye, naintwe twaiguure eriogi riaye korwa ase egati‐gati y'omorero. Rituko ria reero twarorire Nyasae ogokwana na Mwanyabaanto, na Mwanyabaanto oyio ogendererete koba moyo.

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Disaster! An unprecedented disaster — behold, it is coming!
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Maafa! Maafa ambayo hayajasikiwa yanakuja.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, obobe ngoocha bore, obobe borabe bogoetania bonde bwonsi.

English: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don't know.'
Kiswahili: ‘Niite nami nitakuitika na kukuambia mambo makuu na yasiyochunguzika, usiyoyajua.'
Ekegusii: Ndangerie, nainche ninkoiranerie, ninkoorokerie amang'ana amanene abisekanete, ayio aye otana komanya.

English: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mtumishi akatoa vitu vilivyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu na kwa fedha pamoja na mavazi, akampa Rebeka, pia akawapa zawadi za thamani kubwa nduguye na mamaye.
Ekegusii: Ere na abanto baria baarenge komo bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakaraara aroro. Mambia kobwachia gokia akabateebia: “Ing'a ribaga ng'irane ase omonene one.”

English: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
Kiswahili: Hakika utaita mataifa usiyoyajua, nayo mataifa yale yasiyokujua yataharakisha kukujia, kwa sababu ya Bwana Mungu wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, kwa maana amekutukuza.”
Ekegusii: Naama! Aye norangerie abanto b’ebisaku otamanyeti, na abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti mbaminyoke gocha asore, ase engencho y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera okoeire obonene.”

English: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.'
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kila mtu atumiaye maneno ya mithali hii, atayatumia juu yako: “Alivyo mama, ndivyo alivyo bintiye.”
Ekegusii: “Rora, omonto onde bwensi oganetie gokwana omoreng'anio, nigo arakwane igoro yao, atebe: Buna ng'ina omosubati are, nabo nomosubati oye are.

English: But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
Kiswahili: Lakini huyu mwanao ambaye ametapanya mali yako kwa makahaba aliporudi nyumbani, wewe umemchinjia ndama aliyenona!’
Ekegusii: Korende ochia gocha omwana oo oyo, oriire ebinto biao nabakuungu abatayayi, kwamonyenyeire emori enoru.

English: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the LORD said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu yenu Bwana alinikasirikia na hakutaka kunisikiliza. Bwana aliniambia, “Hilo latosha; usiseme nami jambo hili tena.
Ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho yaino inwe Omonene akaba n’endamwamu ase ’nde tanchete koigwa okoboria kwane. Korende aganteebia: Ayio aisanire! Tobaisa gokwana nainche gento kende igoro ye ring’ana erio.

English: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wana wa Seiri, Mhori, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ile: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana,
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Edomu Omohori, ababiare b’ense eria: Lotani, na Sobali, na Sibeoni, na Ana,

English: and Abram (that is, Abraham). The Descendants of Abraham (Genesis 25:12–18)
Kiswahili: Tera akamzaa Abramu (yaani, Abrahamu). Jamaa Ya Abrahamu
Ekegusii: na Aburamu nere Aburaamu. Ororeria rwa Isumaeli (Omoch 25:12-16)

English: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore Yahweh will return your wickedness on your own head.
Kiswahili: Pia mfalme akamwambia Shimei, “Unajua katika moyo wako makosa uliyomtendea baba yangu Daudi. Sasa Bwana atakulipiza kwa ajili ya mabaya yako uliyotenda.
Ekegusii: Boigo omorwoti agateebia Simei, “Nomanyete aye omonyene ase enkoro yao ime obobe bwonsi boria gwakorete ase Daudi tata Omonene nakoiranerie obobe bwao.

English: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni fungu langu, nimeahidi kuyatii maneno yako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye negetare kiane; nariire eira koigwera amang'ana ao.

English: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
Kiswahili: Wala hii si ajabu, kwa kuwa hata Shetani mwenyewe hujigeuza aonekane kama malaika wa nuru.
Ekegusii: Nabo tari ogokumia, ekiagera Saitani omonyene nigo akweonchora bwekora buna omomalaika bw'omobaso.

English: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
Kiswahili: Ndugu, msineneane mabaya ninyi kwa ninyi. Mtu yeyote anayesema mabaya dhidi ya ndugu yake au kumhukumu anasema dhidi ya sheria na kuihukumu. Unapoihukumu sheria, basi huishiki sheria bali umekuwa hakimu wa kuihukumu hiyo sheria.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, timong’achana. Oyokong’acha oyomwabo, gose komogambia nigo akong’acha amachiiko na koyagambia, korende onye gokogambia amachiiko, rirorio tori omokori amachiiko, korende omogambia amachiiko.

English: Solomon accumulated 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akakusanya magari ya vita na farasi. Alikuwa na magari 1,400 na farasi 12,000, ambayo aliyaweka katika miji ya magari na mengine akawa nayo huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane (1,400) ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, ne chinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu ang’e ase omorwoti amenyete.

English: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo kwa desturi mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa, wanafunzi wa Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”
Ekegusii: Goika rituko rie ritang'ani ri'Emegati etabekiri memera, ekero gi'okonyenya emanwa y'eng'ondi y'Epasaka, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Ng'ai origetie togende tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”

English: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
Kiswahili: Tazama kuume kwangu na uone, hakuna hata mmoja anayejihusisha nami. Sina kimbilio, hakuna anayejali maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero 'nkorigereria ase ensemo yane y'okorio, tindi korora monto aroro ogonkonya; gose tindi korora aase 'ndatamere, monto onde tari okonyechaandera.

English: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
Kiswahili: Epafra, aliye mfungwa mwenzangu katika Kristo Yesu, anakusalimu.
Ekegusii: Epafara, oyosibire amo nainche ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, ogokwanirie.

English: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don't be a willing party to his death.
Kiswahili: Mrudi mwanao, kwa maana katika hiyo kuna tumaini, usiwe mshirika katika mauti yake.
Ekegusii: Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.

English: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
Kiswahili: Kwa jinsi ambavyo mimi nimechunguza, wale walimao ubaya na wale hupanda uovu, huvuna hayo hayo hayo.
Ekegusii: Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.

English: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”
Kiswahili: Nililia kama mbayuwayu au korongo, niliomboleza kama hua aombolezaye. Macho yangu yalififia nilipotazama mbinguni. Ee Bwana, ninataabika, njoo unisaidie!”
Ekegusii: Nigo nkorera buna egesingororo gose ebarara; nigo nkweumia buna riruma. Amaiso aane arosire ase okorigereria gochia igoro. Aye Omonene, nigo inde nemechando emenene, indwanerere!”

English: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu najua ya kwamba hivi karibuni nitaliweka kando, kama vile Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo alivyoliweka wazi kwangu.
Ekegusii: Nimanyete ng'a amatuko ng'ang'e are ndarue ase obomenyo obo. Aya naro Omonene oito Yeso Kristo anyorogetie.

English: After this, Joash intended to restore Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Yoashi akaamua kukarabati Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Magega y'ayio Yoashi akagania koroisia enyomba y'Omonene.

English: And when he prayed to Him, the LORD received his plea and heard his petition; so He brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD is God.
Kiswahili: Naye alipomwomba, Bwana akaguswa na kule kusihi kwake na akasikiliza kilio chake, kwa hiyo akamrudisha Yerusalemu na kwenye ufalme wake. Ndipo Manase akatambua kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero asabeete igo, Nyasae aganchera ogosorora kwaye, akaigwa okoboria kwaye kw’oboitongo, na akamoirania Yerusalemu naende ase oborwoti bwaye. Erio Manase akamanya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae.

English: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Baba yangu anafanya kazi yake daima hata siku hii ya leo, nami pia ninafanya kazi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tata ngokora are emeremo nonya ngoika bono, na inche ngokora nde emeremo.”

English: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
Kiswahili: Nimesahaulika miongoni mwao kama mtu aliyekufa, nimekuwa kama chombo cha mfinyanzi kilichovunjika.
Ekegusii: Abanto banyebire buna bakweba omonto okuure; nabeire buna enyongo yatekire.

English: Wherever they went out, Yahweh's hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.
Kiswahili: Popote Israeli walipotoka kwenda kupigana, mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa kinyume nao ili kuwashinda, kama vile alivyokuwa amewaapia. Nao wakawa katika taabu kubwa.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki barenge kogeenda ase esegi, Omonene nigo arenge kobabeera mamincha na obarentera amabe, buna konya abateebirie na gotiana. Barabwo nigo barenge n'emechando emenene kegima.

English: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa kikosi kwa mwezi wa pili alikuwa Dodai Mwahohi. Miklothi ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa kikosi chake. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Dodadi bw’ororeria rw’Ahohi nere otenenerete ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Mikiloti nere orenge omokonyi oye.

English: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wa mwenye haki ni fedha iliyo bora, bali moyo wa mwovu una thamani ndogo.
Ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonyene oboronge nigo ronga buna efeta echenire korende ebirengererio bi’omokori amabe tibiri na igori rinde.

English: Let that day be darkness. Don't let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
Kiswahili: Siku ile na iwe giza; Mungu juu na asiiangalie; nayo nuru isiiangazie.
Ekegusii: Tiga rituko riria ribe omosunte; Nyasae ore igoro tabaisa koriechandera, gose omobaso tobaisa koribarera.

English: Now therefore don't give your daughters to their sons. Don't take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.'
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, msiwaoze binti zenu kwa wana wao wala binti zao kwa wana wenu. Msitafute mkataba wa urafiki nao kwa wakati wowote. Ndipo mtakapofanikiwa na kula mema ya nchi na kuwaachia watoto wenu nchi hiyo kama urithi wao wa milele.'
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timobaisa gosokia abaiseke baino ase abamura babo, gose timobaisa kobarigeria omorembe gose ogosesenigwa. Mobe abakong'u na morie amaya ay'ense eye na moyetigere abana baino ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe.

English: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote anayemkosoa mwenye mzaha hukaribisha matukano; yeyote anayekemea mtu mwovu hupatwa na matusi.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokuurera omonyacheche, nigo akwenyorera obororo; na oyogotogonyera omonto omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera ogochaaywa.

English: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;
Kiswahili: uzito wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza ya mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, uzito wa fedha kwa ajili ya meza ya fedha;
Ekegusii: na oborito bwe chitaabu chia kera emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na obwe chifeta chikoroiserigwa chimesa chi’echifeta.

English: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.
Kiswahili: Bwana anachukua nafasi yake mahakamani, anasimama kuhukumu watu.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire ang'e korenta ekiina, otenenire konachera ebisaku ekiina.

English: Don't commit a sin twice, for even in one you will not be unpunished.
Kiswahili: Usifanye dhambi mara mbili, kwani hata katika moja hutaadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwaberwa korwa ase ekebe ara kabere, ekiagera noegwe egesusuro nonya ase rimocho erimo rioka.

English: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
Kiswahili: Eneo lao lilijumuisha: Helkathi, Hali, Beteni, Akishafu,
Ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Helikati, na Hali, na Beteni, na Akisafu,

English: So Manasseh led the people of Judah and Jerusalem astray, so that they did greater evil than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites. Manasseh’s Repentance and Restoration (2 Kings 21:10–18)
Kiswahili: Lakini Manase akawaongoza Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu katika upotovu, kiasi kwamba walifanya maovu mengi kuliko mataifa ambayo Bwana aliwaangamiza mbele ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Manase akaebereria Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora amabe goetania aria abanto b’ebisaku bakorete, bari’Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli. Manase okoonchoka na gweitia

English: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Kiswahili: Huwatimizia wamchao matakwa yao, husikia kilio chao na kuwaokoa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoikeraneria abamoirogete okogania kwabo; boigo nigo akoigwa ekerero kiabo na kobatooria.

English: As He entered one of the villages, He was met by ten lepers. They stood at a distance
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiingia kwenye kijiji kimoja, watu kumi waliokuwa na ukoma wakakutana naye. Wakasimama mbali,
Ekegusii: Ekero are gosoa omochie oyomo, akaumerana nabaanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, bateneine are;

English: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni alikuwa hakufai, lakini sasa anakufaa sana wewe na mimi pia.
Ekegusii: Agwo kare tarenge taisainegento kende ase ore, korende bono obeire oyo bw’engeencho mono ase ore nainche boigo.

English: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.” The Cost of Discipleship (Luke 9:57–62; Luke 14:25–33; John 6:59–66)
Kiswahili: Haya yalifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba: “Mwenyewe alitwaa udhaifu wetu na alichukua magonjwa yetu.” Gharama Ya Kumfuata Yesu (Luka 9:57-62)
Ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya, ogoteeba, “Ere akaimokia oboreu bwaito, na akabogoria amarwaire aito.” Amateemwa ase abwo barigetie koba aborokigwa (Luk 9:57-62)

English: Then I asked the angel, “What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikamuuliza yule malaika, “Hii mizeituni miwili iliyoko upande wa kuume na wa kushoto wa kinara cha taa ni nini?”
Ekegusii: Naende nkaboria omomalaika oria, “Emezeituni eye ebere, oyomo ore ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee y’ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya, neya ki?”

English: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nakuambia kwamba, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Sodoma kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu kuliko wewe.”
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe ng'a n'ebe aororo ase ense ya Sodomu ase rituko ri'ekiina kobua ase ore.”

English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.
Kiswahili: “Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie yale ambayo Roho ayaambia makanisa. Yeye ashindaye nitampa baadhi ya ile mana iliyofichwa. Nitampa pia jiwe jeupe ambalo juu yake limeandikwa jina jipya asilolijua mtu, isipokuwa yule anayelipokea.
Ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring'ana eri Omoika ogoteebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue nimoe ensemo ya mana ebisire, naende nimoe rigena rirabu, na ase rigena erio ndirikireo erieta riyia, eritamanywe na monto onde otatiga ere oyo orariegwe.

English: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:
Kiswahili: “Siku zinakuja, nitakapowaadhibu wale wote ambao wametahiriwa kimwili tu, asema Bwana,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, inche ndabae egesusuro abanto baria bonsi baarogete, ko nonya nabo nigo bare buna abatarogeti.

English: After these days, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. She declared,
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda usio mrefu, Elizabeti mkewe akapata mimba, naye akajitenga kwa miezi mitano.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko aria mokaye Elisabeti akaba morito, akebisa emetienyi etano, ogoteeba,

English: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.
Kiswahili: Basi Herode Agripa alikuwa amekasirishwa sana na watu wa Tiro na Sidoni. Hivyo watu wa miji hiyo miwili wakaungana pamoja wakatafuta kukutana naye. Wakiisha kuungwa mkono na Blasto, mtumishi maalum wa Mfalme Herode Agripa aliyeaminika, wakaomba mapatano ya amani maana nchi zao zilitegemea nchi ya huyo mfalme kwa mahitaji yao ya chakula.
Ekegusii: Herode nigo abeete mono abanto ba Turo na Sidoni. Korende barabwo bakamochiera ase obomo, na ekero baebereirie Blasto, oyorenge korenda enyomba y’omorwoti, bakarigia omorembe, ekiagera ense yabo nigo yare konyora endagera korwa ase ense y’omorwoti.

English: But a man of God came to him and said, “O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel—not with any of the Ephraimites.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu wa Mungu akamjia na kumwambia, “Ee mfalme, haya majeshi kutoka Israeli kamwe usiyaruhusu yaende pamoja na wewe kwa kuwa Bwana hayuko pamoja na Israeli, wala hayupo pamoja na yeyote wa watu wa Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto oyomo o Nyasae agacha asare, akamoteebia, “Aye omorwoti, tobaisa gotiga Abaisraeli, Abaefraimu aba, bagende amo naye, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nabarabwo.

English: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
Kiswahili: Ponyeni wagonjwa, fufueni wafu, takaseni wenye ukoma, toeni pepo wachafu. Mmepata bure, toeni bure.
Ekegusii: Abarwaire bagwenie, abakuure babokie, abare noborwaire bwa ukoma basibie, na ebirecha birusie. Mwaeirwe bosa, nainwe karue bosa.

English: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
Kiswahili: Basi ujue kwamba Bwana Mungu wako ndiye Mungu; ni Mungu mwaminifu, anayetunza Agano la upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanaompenda na kuzishika amri zake.
Ekegusii: Gaki manya ng'a Omonene Nyasae oino, nere bweka Nyasae bw'ekeene, naende Nyasae bw'obwegenwa, oyokorenda okobwatana kwaye kw'ogotianania, na koorokia obwanchani bwaye botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu ase baria bamwanchete na babwatete amachiiko aye.

English: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.
Kiswahili: Watatokea manabii wengi wa uongo, nao watawadanganya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: na ababani b’oborimo abange mbaimoke, baraae abange na kobasiria.

English: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
Kiswahili: Heri wale wanaozishika shuhuda zake, wamtafutao kwa moyo wao wote.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abwo barendete oborori bwaye, abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,

English: Now these were members of the Thirty: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa wale Thelathini walikuwepo: Asaheli ndugu wa Yoabu; Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu;
Ekegusii: Abande ba baria emerongo etato nabwo aba: Asaeli, momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu;

English: He sent others to Gazara to do away with John. To the captains of thousands, he sent letters to come to him, that he might give them silver, gold, and gifts.
Kiswahili: Aliwatuma wengine Gazara ili wamuue Yohana. Kwa makapteni wa maelfu, alituma barua ili waje kwake, ili awape fedha, dhahabu, na zawadi.
Ekegusii: Akabariikera abanene be esegi na kobaarigania ase chiira chi'okobaakana eng'eria ye chifeta, etaabu nebiegwa ebinge. Erio akabatoma abande ase egati ya abanto baye bagende Gazara komoita Yohana,

English: Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you. He feeds on grass like an ox.
Kiswahili: “Mwangalie mnyama aitwaye Behemothi, niliyemuumba kama nilivyokuumba wewe, anayekula majani kama ngʼombe.
Ekegusii: “Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.

English: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kuna Mungu mmoja na mpatanishi mmoja kati ya Mungu na wanadamu, yaani mwanadamu Kristo Yesu,
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae noyoomo, na omobwatania gati ya Nyasae na Mwanyabaanto noyoomo, omonto oria Kristo Yeso

English: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Mwamini Bwana Yesu Kristo, nawe utaokoka, pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwako.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Mwegene Omonene Yeso, na aye notooreke amo nab’enyomba yao.”

English: The king consented, and wrote letters to Jonathan concerning all these things as follows:
Kiswahili: Mfalme akakubali, akamwandikia Yonathani barua kuhusu mambo haya yote kama ifuatavyo:
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agaitaba na komoriikera Yonathani riruube riogoikerania eira eyio buna ekobwatia:

English: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: ili niweze kutembea mbele za Bwana, katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosio Omonene, ’nde ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.

English: And all the prophets were prophesying the same, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and prosper, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.” Micaiah Prophesies against Ahab (2 Chronicles 18:12–27)
Kiswahili: Manabii wengine wote walikuwa wanatabiri kitu hicho hicho wakisema, “Ishambulie Ramoth-Gileadi na uwe mshindi. Kwa kuwa Bwana ataitia mkononi mwa mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Abaabani baria bonsi bakabana amang’ana ayio ayio, bagateeba, “Genda Ramoti o Gileadi, noyobue. Omonene nayobeke ase okoboko kwao aye omorwoti.”

English: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.'”
Kiswahili: nao watakuchukua mikononi mwao, usije ukajikwaa mguu wako katika jiwe.' ”
Ekegusii: naende: Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

English: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
Kiswahili: Nilisikia na moyo wangu ukagonga kwa nguvu, midomo yangu ikatetemeka kwa hofu niliposikia sauti; uchakavu ukanyemelea mifupa yangu, na miguu yangu ikatetemeka. Hata hivyo nitasubiri kwa uvumilivu siku ya maafa kuyajilia mataifa yaliyotuvamia.
Ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang'ana ayio, enda yane egatengechigwa, ebikoba biane bikaiguswa ekero naigwete okoeera okwo, amauga 'omobere one akarwara na kogunda, ngatengechigwa aase nateneine. Nimbe ndemereretie ase rituko riria ri'emechando, ekero omobisa arache korwania egesaku giaito.

English: the Jezerite clan from Jezer, and the Shillemite clan from Shillem.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Yeseri, ukoo wa Wayeseri; kutoka kwa Shilemu, ukoo wa Washilemu.
Ekegusii: na Abayeseri, abarwete ase Yeseri, na Abasilemu, abarwete ase Silemu.

English: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaanza kufundisha tena kando ya bahari. Umati wa watu uliokuwa umekusanyika kumzunguka ulikuwa mkubwa, kiasi kwamba ilimbidi Yesu aingie kwenye mashua iliyokuwa baharini na kuketi humo, nao watu wote walikuwa ufuoni mwa bahari.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka kworokereria naende ase enyancha mbarabare, na omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato, agaikaransa imeo igoro y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi nao orenge ase ense enyomo enyancha mbarabare.

English: And the LORD said to Satan: “The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you! Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “ Bwana akukemee Shetani! Bwana, ambaye ameichagua Yerusalemu, akukemee! Je, mtu huyu siyo kijinga kinachowaka kilichonyakuliwa kwenye moto?”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Saitani, “Aye Saitani, inche Omonene ningotogonyere! Ee, inche Omonene nachorire Yerusalemu, ningotogonyere! Inee! Omonto oyo tari ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa ase omorero ime?”

English: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema: “Tazama ninafanya Agano mbele ya watu wako wote. Mbele ya watu wako wote nitafanya maajabu ambayo hayajafanyika katika taifa lolote katika ulimwengu wote. Watu wale mnaoishi miongoni mwao wataona jinsi ilivyo ya kushangaza ile kazi nitakayowafanyia mimi Bwana wenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Rora, bono ngokora inde nainwe okobwatana kw'ogotianania. Ase amasio 'abaanto bao bonsi ninkore ebikone ebio bitana gokoreka ase ense yonsi, gose ase egesaku kende gionsi. Na abanto bonsi abagoetanaine inabarore ogokora kw'Omonene, naki ayio ndagokorere namang'ana ay'okoondokia.

English: She lived under Deborah's palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
Kiswahili: Debora alikuwa akiketi chini ya Mtende wa Debora uliokuwa kati ya Rama na Betheli katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, nao Waisraeli wakaja kwake ili awaamue.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo anarete goikaransa inse y'omote orenge korokwa Omokendo o Debora, egati ya Rama na Beteli, ase ense y'ebitunwa ya Efraimu na Abaisraeli nigo baanarete goocha ase are abagaayane.

English: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
Kiswahili: Nitadumisha upendo wangu kwake milele, na agano langu naye litakuwa imara.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane botari koera nimoborendere kare na kare, na okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nkorete nere ngotenene bokong’u.

English: Now, therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. See that no one is missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing will not live.” But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
Kiswahili: Sasa waiteni manabii wote wa Baali, watumishi wake wote na makuhani wake wote. Hakikisheni kwamba hakuna hata mmoja atakayekosekana, kwa sababu ninakwenda kutoa kafara kubwa sana kwa Baali. Yeyote atakayeshindwa kuja hataendelea kuishi.” Lakini Yehu alifanya hivyo kwa hila ili apate kuwaangamiza watumishi wote wa Baali.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, ndangereria ababani bonsi ba Baali, na abakoreri baye bonsi, na abakuani baye bonsi; onde tabaisa gotigara otache, ekiagera inche ngochia nde korua ekeng’wanso ekenene ase Baali. Omonto onde bwensi oramoche, tachicha, takoba moyo.” Korende Yehu nigo akorete ayio ase obong’ainereria, erinde aite na gosiria abakoreri ba Baali.

English: And from that day forward Saul kept a jealous eye on David.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia wakati ule na kuendelea Sauli akawa na jicho la wivu juu ya Daudi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase rituko riria na kogenderera Saulo akarorera Daudi ribero.

English: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
Kiswahili: Yeye atawalipa kwa ajili ya dhambi zao na atawaangamiza kwa ajili ya maovu yao; Bwana Mungu wetu atawaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Ere nabae egesusuro ase engencho y'ebibe biabo, na abasirie ase engencho y'ogosaria kwabo; ee, Omonene, Nyasae oito, nabasirie kegima.

English: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikatengeneza Sanduku kwa mti wa mshita, nikachonga pia vibao vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, kisha nikakwea mlimani nikiwa na vibao viwili mikononi mwangu.
Ekegusii: “Erio 'nkaroisia Esanduki ye'chibao chi'omokonge, na 'nkabaacha chibao chi'amagena ibere chiagwekaine chiria chi'eritang'ani; nkabogoria chibao chiria ibere ase okoboko kwane, ngatiira gochia ase egetunwa igoro.

English: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili mweze kushindana siku ya uovu itakapokuja nanyi mkiisha kufanya yote, simameni imara.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bogoria ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare koamererania ase rituko ri’obobe, na komwaikeranirie onsi, motenene.

English: For you love all things that are, and abhor none of the things which you made; For you never would have formed anything if you hated it.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana unapenda vitu vyote vilivyopo, wala huchukii chochote ulichokiumba; Kwa maana usingefanya chochote kama ungekichukia.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete ebinto bionsi bire ase ense, gose tibwangeti kende ase ebio gwatongete. Anga tigwatongete kende onye ndiria okiangete.

English: You know the way to the place where I am going. ” The Way, the Truth, and the Life
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajua njia ya kufika ninakokwenda.” Yesu Ndiye Njia Ya Kwenda Kwa Baba
Ekegusii: Nase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”

English: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.'
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, ndugu zako, ndugu zako ambao ni wa uhusiano wa damu na nyumba yote ya Israeli, ndio wale ambao watu wa Yerusalemu wamesema, ‘Wako mbali na Bwana; nchi hii tulipewa sisi kuwa milki yetu.'
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo bagokwana igoro y' abanto bamino b'egesaku kiao, ee, igoro y'Abaisraeli bonsi, bagoteeba: Barabwo nigo bare aare korwa ase Omonene, ense eye nintwe twaeirwe ebe eyaito.

English: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
Kiswahili: Yeye awafanyaye watu kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na hao ambao hufanywa watakatifu, wote hutoka katika jamaa moja. Hivyo Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo babwate ise oyomo. Nakio gekogera Yeso atari korora obosoku kobaroka abamwabo.

English: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akamwambia Hobabu mwana wa Reueli, Mmidiani, mkwewe Mose, “Tunaondoka kwenda mahali ambapo Bwana amesema ‘Nitawapa ninyi mahali hapo.’ Twende pamoja nasi tutakutendea mema, kwa maana Bwana ameahidi mambo mema kwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana na Hobabu, mosinto o Reueli Omomidiani, akamoteebia, “Intwe ’nkogeenda tore aase aaria ase Omonene atotebetie ng’a n’atoe. Inchuo ogende amo naintwe, na intwe ’natogokorere amaya, ekiagera Omonene orire eira ng’a nasesenie Abaisraeli.”

English: He took 600 of the best chariots, and all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.
Kiswahili: Akachukua magari bora mia sita, pamoja na magari mengine yote ya Misri, pamoja na maafisa wa magari hayo yote.
Ekegusii: Naende akaira chigari amagana atano na rimo, echi achorete, amo ne chigari chinde chionsi, na abariini chituoni bachiriinete.

English: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Naye Elizabeti aliposikia salamu ya Maria, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake akaruka. Elizabeti akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n'Omoika Omochenu,

English: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.
Kiswahili: Wakati madhabahu yalitiwa mafuta, viongozi walileta sadaka zao kwa ajili ya kule kuwekwa wakfu kwake na kuziweka mbele ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria egesasiimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta, abatang'ani bakarenta okoruegwa kwabo bosio bw'egesasiimero.

English: The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion; whoever provokes him forfeits his own life.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama ngurumo ya simba; yeye amkasirishaye hupoteza uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Okogosa kw’omorwoti nigo konga buna okoruma kw’endo, na oyo okomogechia oba n’endamwamu, oyio nigo akogera obogima bwaye bosirigwe.

English: For when the prince had come there, with an army that seemed irresistible, they were cut to pieces in the temple of Nanaea by the treachery of Nanaea's priests.
Kiswahili: Kwani mkuu alipofika huko, akiwa na jeshi ambalo lilionekana kuwa lisilozuilika, walikatwa vipande vipande katika hekalu la Nanaea kwa usaliti wa makuhani wa Nanaea.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Antioko ekero aigete Persia na omoganda omonene bw'abarwani oyio orenge kororekana otabweke, abarwani abwo b'esegi nigo banachanetwe ebingese ebingese aria ase hekalu ya Nanea ase engencho y'echiira chiria abakuani b'enyasae eria ekuungu yare korokwa Nanea bariete

English: You will drink it and drain it; you will dash it to pieces, and tear your breasts. For I have spoken,’ declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: Utakinywa chote na kukimaliza; utakivunja vipande vipande na kuyararua matiti yako. Nimenena haya, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Nigo orabetererigwe onywe okoore ekenyugwa ekio gionsi, ee, goika omene ebisamunye biaye kogiatekire, naende oarie chimbeere chiao nabirobio. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.

English: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.'
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, sio wewe utakayenijengea Hekalu, bali mwanao, ambaye ni nyama yako na damu yako mwenyewe, yeye ndiye atakayejenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina langu.'
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba eyio otatiga omwana oo, omomura oria oraiborwe korwa ase enda yao, nere oraagachere erieta riane enyomba.

English: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mimi ndimi mkate wa uzima. Yeye ajaye kwangu, hataona njaa kamwe na yeye aniaminiye, hataona kiu kamwe.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inche nomogati bw’obogima; ere oyogocha ase ’nde takoigwa enchara nonya ng’ake, na ere oyoranyegene takorang’a nonya ng’ake.

English: He paneled the main room with cypress, which he overlaid with fine gold and decorated with palm trees and chains.
Kiswahili: Akaufunika ukumbi mkuu kwa mbao za miberoshi na kufunikwa kwa dhahabu safi na kuupamba kwa miti ya mitende na kuifanyizia kwa minyororo.
Ekegusii: Chinyasi chia ime chie Hekalu enyene agachituba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa, naende agachiooma ne chitaabu chingiya, agachichabera nemegwekano y’emekendo na ey’ebinyuri.

English: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu ameshuhudia mema kuhusu Demetrio, vivyo hivyo hata na hiyo kweli yenyewe. Sisi pia twashuhudia mema juu yake, nanyi mwajua kwamba ushuhuda wetu ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Demeturio obereirwe kirori nabaanto bonsi, naende nekeene ekenyene, ng'a nomuya are. Na intwe boigo twarorire, na aye kwamanyire ng'a oborori bwaito nobw'ekeene.

English: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajua kwamba watu wa nyumbani mwa Stefana ndio waliokuwa wa kwanza kuamini katika Akaya, nao wamejitoa kwa ajili ya kuwahudumia watakatifu. Ndugu nawasihi,
