Ekegusii: Bono baminto, mwamanyire ng'a abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana nigo barenge ab'eritang'ani koonchoka agwo Akaya; na barabwo bebekire ase emeremo y'ogokorera abachenu.

English: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Baba anavyonijua mimi, nami ninavyomjua Baba, nami nautoa uhai wangu kwa ajili ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: buna Tata amanyete inche, na inche nimomanyete Tata, na obogima bwane naborure ase engencho ye ching'ondi.

English: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn't turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.
Kiswahili: Asaheli akamfukuza Abneri, pasipo kugeuka kulia wala kushoto wakati akimfuata.
Ekegusii: Ere agachaaka kobwatia Abineri, na ekero arenge komobwatia taonchogete gochia aande, ensemo ya borio gose eya bomosi.

English: “Edom will become an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
Kiswahili: “Edomu atakuwa kitu cha kuogofya; wote wapitao karibu watashangaa na kuzomea kwa sababu ya majeraha yake yote.
Ekegusii: “Edomu nosarigwe obe ekiorokererio gi’okoondokia. Kera omonto oraetere aase agwo naondoke na goichanigwa ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.

English: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn't believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn't even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Yohana alikuja kwenu kuwaonyesha njia ya haki, lakini hamkumsadiki, lakini watoza ushuru na makahaba wakamsadiki. Nanyi hata mlipoona hayo, baadaye hamkutubu na kumsadiki.
Ekegusii: Inaki Yohana nigo achete ase more ase enchera y'oboronge, timwamwegena; korende abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi bakamwegena; na inwe nonya nekero mwaroche ayio, timwaonchoka na komwegena.

English: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
Kiswahili: Idadi ya nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wengi sana, Wakakaa kuanzia Bashani hadi Baal-Hermoni, yaani mpaka Seniri na mlima Hermoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakamenya ense eria; bakamentekana mono, bakamenya korwa orobebe rwa Basani goika Baali‐Herimoni, na Seniri, na egetunwa kia Herimoni.

English: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
Kiswahili: Je, atafanya agano nawe ili umtwae awe mtumishi wako maisha yake yote?
Ekegusii: Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng'a ebe omosomba oo kogenderera botambe?

English: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kushindana kwetu si juu ya nyama na damu, bali dhidi ya falme, mamlaka, dhidi ya wakuu wa giza na majeshi ya pepo wabaya katika ulimwengu wa roho.
Ekegusii: Inaki okoamererania gwaito tikori ase abare n’amanyinga ne chinyama, korende igoro y’abagaambi na abare nokobua, igoro y’abanene b’omosuunte bw’ense eye, na igoro y’emegaanda y’ebirecha ebibe bire igoro.

English: So Bathsheba went to see the king in his bedroom. Since the king was very old, Abishag the Shunammite was serving him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bathsheba akaenda kumwona mfalme chumbani mwake mahali ambapo Abishagi, Mshunami, alikuwa akimhudumia, naye mfalme alikuwa mzee sana.
Ekegusii: Batiseba akagenda ase omorwoti, agasoa akanyomba k’omorwoti. (Bono omorwoti konya obeire omogotu mono, na Abisagi, Omosunemu, nere orenge omokoreri oye.)

English: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ikiwa Abrahamu alihesabiwa haki kwa matendo, basi, anacho kitu cha kujivunia, lakini si mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera onye Aburaamu oetwe oboronge ase engencho y'ogokora kwaye, nare neki agwetogeria, korende tari ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Naye aliwaua wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti abaakumete, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: is like the light of the morning at sunrise of a cloudless dawn, the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth.’
Kiswahili: yeye ni kama mwanga wa asubuhi jua lichomozapo asubuhi isiyo na mawingu, kama mwanga baada ya mvua uchipuzao majani kutoka ardhini.’
Ekegusii: nigo anga buna omobaso o mambia ase bare, buna erioba rikobara emambia etari namare. Nigo anga buna obonyansi bogokiina magega embura koyatuure.”

English: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
Kiswahili: Wameshuhudia kuhusu upendo wako mbele ya kanisa. Utafanya vyema ukiwasafirisha kama inavyostahili kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo babeire kirori ase ekanisa igoro y’obwanchani bwao. Nokore buya korabakonye ase orogendo rwabo, buna egwenerete ase okomokorera Nyasae.

English: and with him Lysias his guardian and chancellor, each having a Greek force of one hundred ten thousand infantry, five thousand three hundred cavalry, twenty-two elephants, and three hundred chariots armed with scythes.
Kiswahili: na pamoja naye Lisia, mlinzi wake na kansela wake, kila mmoja akiwa na jeshi la Wayunani la watembea kwa miguu 110,000, wapanda farasi 5,300, tembo 22, na magari 300 yenye mikuki.
Ekegusii: na buna Lisia omorendi oria omonene bw'eserekari nao arenge amo na Antioko. Kera oyomo nigo arenge amo na abarwani esegi Abagiriki 110,000 bagotara n'amagoro, na 10,000 abarini chibarasi, na 5,300 abarini chibarasi bande chinchogu 22, amo n'echigari 300 echio chiabwate emeyio emioge.

English: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya nne, ndani ya nyumba ya Mungu wetu, tulipima fedha, dhahabu na vyombo vilivyowekwa wakfu, tukakabidhi mikononi mwa kuhani Meremothi mwana wa Uria. Eleazari mwana wa Finehasi alikuwa pamoja naye, pia walikuwako Walawi wawili, Yozabadi mwana wa Yeshua na Noadia mwana wa Binui.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane togasoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito; erio chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebikorero biria, bikarengwa bikabekwa ase amaboko a Meremoti Omokuani, mosinto o Uria, oyorenge amo na Eleazari, mosinto o Finehasi, na ase Abalawi aba: Yosabadi, mosinto o Yesua, na Nuhudia, mosinto o Binui.

English: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu alihesabu kuwa Mungu angaliweza kumfufua Isaki kutoka kwa wafu. Na kwa kusema kwa mfano, alimpata tena Isaki kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Akarengereria ng'a Nyasae nanyare komobokia korwa ase abakuure. Ase ayio akamonyora agwo agwo, buna omogwekano.

English: Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.
Kiswahili: Tazama, nitawachochea Wamedi dhidi yao, ambao hawajali fedha wala hawafurahii dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche Omonene ninseegete Abamedi abwo batabare chifeta ne chitaabu koba nengencho enene.

English: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa ameyafunga matumbo ya wote katika nyumba ya Abimeleki kwa sababu ya Sara, mke wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene konya okorire abakungu b'enka y'Abimeleki koba abagomba, erio tibaibora, ase engencho ya Sara moka Aburaamu.

English: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nilisema, “Geukia mbali nami, niache nilie kwa uchungu. Usijaribu kunifariji juu ya maangamizi ya watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche ngateeba: “Tobaisa kondigereria, ntige ndere nobororo ing’iyerie amariga; tobaisa gwechanda kondemia ase engencho y’ogosarigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto baane.”

English: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
Kiswahili: Akawauliza tena, “Mnamtafuta nani?” Nao wakamjibu, “Yesu wa Nazareti.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria eria kabere, “Ning’o mokorigia?” Bakaboora, “Yeso Omonazareti.”

English: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
Kiswahili: nimekuwa kama mtu asiyesikia, ambaye kinywa chake hakiwezi kutoa jibu.
Ekegusii: Ee, inche nabeire buna omonto otari koigwa, buna oyo omonwa oye otabwati amang’ana okoiraneria.

English: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites. Introduction to the Law
Kiswahili: Miji hiyo ilikuwa: Bezeri katika tambarare ya jangwa kwa ajili ya Wareubeni; Ramothi katika nchi ya Gileadi kwa ajili ya Wagadi; nao mji wa Golani katika nchi ya Bashani kwa ajili ya Wamanase. Utangulizi Wa Sheria
Ekegusii: Beseri ase erooro, ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro, nigo orenge omochie bw’obotamero ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na Ramoti ase ense ya Gileadi ase abanto ba Gadi, na Golani ase ense ya Basani ase abanto ba Manase. Okoruegwa kw’amachiiko a Nyasae

English: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
Kiswahili: “Sasa una nini dhidi yangu, ee Tiro na Sidoni, nanyi nchi zote za Ufilisti? Je, mnanilipiza kwa yale niliyoyafanya? Kama mnalipa, mimi nitalipiza juu ya vichwa vyenu kwa kasi na kwa haraka yale mliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: “Inwe Turo na Sidoni, ne chingongo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, ngento ki mogonkorera? Inee! Nigo moganetie kong’iraneria egento? Moise korusia egesiomba igoro yane, nimbairanerie ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino bwango mono.

English: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
Kiswahili: Baada yake, alitokea Yuda Mgalilaya wakati wa kuorodhesha watu, naye akaongoza kundi la watu kuasi. Yeye pia aliuawa, nao wafuasi wake wakatawanyika.
Ekegusii: Magega yaye, Yudasi Omogalili nere akaimoka ase amatuko aria ekero abanto baare koriikwa, akang'usa abanto abange bamotunyane. Nere boigo agasira, na bonsi abamotunyanete bagaserebekana.

English: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila mmoja anajishughulisha zaidi na mambo yake mwenyewe wala si yale ya Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi nigo bakorigia ebinto biabo abanyene, gose tari ebia Kristo Yeso.

English: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kwamba hakuna kitu bora kwa wanadamu kuliko kuwa na furaha na kutenda mema wakati wanapoishi.
Ekegusii: Namanyire ng'a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya kerabagwenere otatiga babe nomogooko, naende bakore ayare amaya ekero bare moyo.

English: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
Kiswahili: Msilipe ovu kwa ovu, au jeuri kwa jeuri, bali barikini, kwa maana hili ndilo mliloitiwa ili mpate kurithi baraka.
Ekegusii: Timoakanana amabe ase amabe, gose okorama ase okorama, korende ribaga ri'ayio mobe abamogosesenania, ekiagera ayio naro mwarangererigwe, ng'a monyore omwando bw'ogosesenigwa.

English: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn't hate him in time past—
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo kanuni kuhusu mtu amuuaye mwingine na kukimbilia humo kuokoa maisha yake, yaani, yeye amuuaye jirani yake bila kukusudia, wala hakumchukia kabla ya hapo.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraite oyonde mosiabano, atabwati obobisa nere, nanyaare gotamera oyomo bw'emechie eyio, na gotooria obogima bwaye.

English: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo alinyunyizia damu hiyo kwenye ile hema pamoja na kila kifaa kilichotumika ndani yake kwa taratibu za ibada.
Ekegusii: Eema amo n'ebinto bionsi biare gokorerwa ase ogosasiima naboigo are kobinyororokereria amanyinga.

English: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching. The Greatest Commandment (Deuteronomy 6:1–19; Mark 12:28–34)
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliposikia hayo, ulishangaa sana kwa mafundisho yake. Amri Kuu Kuliko Zote (Marko 12:28-34; Luka 10:25-28)
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia koigwa aya, ogakumia ase okworokereria kwaye. Ogochika kore okonene kobua ayande (Mar 12:28-34)

English: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.
Kiswahili: Huchagua sufu na kitani naye hufanya kazi kwa mikono yenye bidii.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akorigia amarionya e ching’ondi ne chiusi chi’egatani, okora emeremo namaboko aye ore n’omoyo omuya.

English: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.'
Kiswahili: “Njoo, ee Sayuni! Kimbia, wewe ukaaye ndani ya Binti Babeli!”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, inwe abamomenyete amo nabaanto ba Babiloni, imoka motame, mwetoorie!”

English: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
Kiswahili: Wote walio wa Kristo Yesu wameusulubisha mwili na shauku zake pamoja na tamaa zake.
Ekegusii: Abwo bare abakristo Yeso baabambire chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe amo nokogania okobe na okorengereria kwabo.

English: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
Kiswahili: uliyeumba milima kwa uwezo wako, ukiwa umejivika nguvu,
Ekegusii: Aye gwakong’irie ebitunwa ne chinguru chiao, ekiagera aye nigo bweboetie okobua.

English: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha saba kwa mwezi wa saba alikuwa Helesi Mpeloni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na kabere, Helesi, Omopeloni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister. She is your father's near kinswoman.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na dada wa baba yako; ni ndugu wa karibu wa baba yako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke omwabo iso; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo iso.

English: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
Kiswahili: lakini kamwe usile matunda ya mti wa kujua mema na mabaya, kwa maana siku utakapokula matunda yake, hakika utakufa.”
Ekegusii: gotatiga amatunda y’omote bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe toyaria, ekiagera rituko riria orayarie goika okwe.”

English: For she knows all things and understands, and she will guide me prudently in my actions. She will guard me in her glory.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana anajua mambo yote na anaelewa, naye ataniongoza kwa busara katika matendo yangu. Atanilinda katika utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obongaini mbomanyete amang'ana onsi, borobwo mbondae buya ase ogokora kwane; na omochenu bwaye mbondende.

English: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, Mungu ni dhalimu? La, hasha!
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo atebeetie Musa, “Nimororere amaabera ere oyo ndarorere amaabera, na nimororere amabeebe ere oyo 'ndarorere amabeebe.”

English: For the conduct of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to despise their husbands and say, ‘King Xerxes ordered Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she did not come.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tendo hili la malkia litajulikana kwa wanawake wote, kwa hiyo watawadharau waume zao na kusema, ‘Mfalme Ahasuero aliagiza Malkia Vashti aletwe mbele yake, lakini alikataa.’
Ekegusii: Ogokora oko eting’ana yakorire goise komanyekana ase abakungu bonsi, nigo koragere abakungu bande bachaye abasacha babo, bateebe: Omorwoti Ahaswero nachika abasomba baye barente Vasti eting’ana asare, korende Vasti akaanga, tacha ase omorwoti.

English: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people's bodies and souls.
Kiswahili: bidhaa za mdalasini, vikolezi, za uvumba, manemane, na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, za divai, na mafuta ya zeituni, za unga mzuri na ngano; ngʼombe na kondoo; farasi na magari; na miili na roho za wanadamu.
Ekegusii: omodalasini, na ekarafuu, na manemane, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani na edivai, na amaguta, na obosie obonuke, na engano, ne chiombe, ne ching'ondi, ne chibarasi, ne chigari, na emebere ya Mwanyabaanto na emioyo yabo.

English: Antiochus encamped against Dor, and with him one hundred twenty thousand men of war and eight thousand cavalry.
Kiswahili: Antiochus alipiga kambi dhidi ya Dori, na pamoja naye watu wa vita mia moja na ishirini elfu na wapanda farasi elfu nane.
Ekegusii: Antioko akayoonchokana omochie o Dori ore na abasikari bachorire 120,000 amo na abechibaarasi 8,000.

English: Therefore snares surround you, and sudden peril terrifies you;
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu mitego imekuzunguka pande zote, hatari ya ghafula inakutia hofu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio emeeto yagoetananire, na obwoba bwa mobosokano nkogochanda bore.

English: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.
Kiswahili: Wakauweka mji wakfu kwa Bwana, na kila chenye uhai ndani yake walikiangamiza kwa upanga, wanaume kwa wanawake, vijana kwa wazee, ngʼombe, kondoo na punda.
Ekegusii: Bagaita abanto bonsi b'omochie, abasacha na abakungu, abasae na abagotu, nemioro, bagaita boigo chiombe, ne ching'ondi, ne chitigere.

English: Some came from Ephraim, with their roots in Amalek; Benjamin came with your people after you. The commanders came down from Machir, the bearers of the marshal’s staff from Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Efraimu wakaja watu, ambao chimbuko lao ni Amaleki; Benyamini akiwa miongoni mwa watu waliokufuata. Kutoka Makiri wakashuka viongozi, na kutoka Zabuloni wale washikao fimbo ya jemadari.
Ekegusii: Abwo ritina riabo riarenge ase ense y’Abaameleki, bagatirimboka korwa ase Efraimu, abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini bagakobwatia. Abatang’ani b’abarwani b’esegi bagatirimboka korwa Makiri, na abarenge abariiki ase esegi korwa Sabuloni.

English: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Danieli akamwambia mlinzi aliyeteuliwa na huyo mkuu wa maafisa kuwasimamia Danieli, Hanania, Mishaeli na Azaria,
Ekegusii: Erio Danieli agakwana n'omorendi oria obegetwe koba omoteneneri omonene bw'abasomba b'omorwoti erio arende Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria, akamoteebia;

English: He took them, and ate in front of them.
Kiswahili: naye akakichukua na kukila mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Akabibogoria, akabiria ase amaiso abo.

English: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!
Kiswahili: “Twekeni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni tarumbeta katikati ya mataifa! Andaeni mataifa kwa ajili ya vita dhidi yake, iteni falme hizi dhidi yake: Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi. Wekeni jemadari dhidi yake, pelekeni farasi wengi kama kundi la nzige.
Ekegusii: “Tenenia ebendera y'esegi igoro ase ense! Bugia egetureeri ase egati y'ebisaku! Beka ebisaku ang'e birwanie Babiloni. Rangeria amarwoti ayorwanie, ee, rangeria Ararati, na Mini, na Asikenasi. Chora abatang'ani b'esegi bayoumokere. Renta chibarasi chinyinge buna chingige chikogosa.

English: The priest shall then burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all its frankincense, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atateketeza ile sehemu ya kumbukumbu kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya nafaka iliyopondwa kwa mafuta, pamoja na uvumba wote, kama sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Omokuani asaambe ebigara bike bia biria bisenyentire, amo namaguta; abisaambe amo n’ekoroso yonsi bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.

English: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme aliuliza, “Malkia Esta, ni nini? Ombi lako ni nini? Hata kama ni nusu ya ufalme, utapewa.”
Ekegusii: na omorwoti akamobooria, “Eting'ana Esiteri, ninki origetie? Inteebia eki oganetie; aye nokeegwe, nakeba nonya nekeng'ese ki'oborwoti bwane.”

English: warning them not to make Him known.
Kiswahili: akiwakataza wasiseme yeye ni nani.
Ekegusii: Akabachika tibatebia abande igoro yaye.

English: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
Kiswahili: Sikia, ee Israeli, nawe uwe mwangalifu kutii ili upate kufanikiwa na kuongezeka sana katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, kama Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaahidi ninyi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe, monyaare koyarenda; erio nario er'abe buya ase more, naende 'momentekane mono ase ense eria entenenku ere n'amabeere n'amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw'echisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira.

English: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawauliza, “Ni sadaka gani ya hatia tutakayompelekea?” Wakajibu, “Majipu matano ya dhahabu na panya wa dhahabu watano, kulingana na idadi ya watawala wa Wafilisti, kwa sababu tauni iyo hiyo imewaua ninyi na watawala wenu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakabooria, “Inee! Okoruegwa okwo gw'okomocha nkoroki torairanie ase Omonene?” Barabwo bakabairaneria, “Emegwekano etano y'amagumba, na etano ye chimbeba, yonsi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu. Moire emegwekano koreng'ana nomobaro bwe chinyasae chia Abafirisiti, ekiagera amaakwa ayio nigo abeete igoro ase more mwensi, na igoro ase abanene baino boigo.

English: He who gathers by denying himself gathers for others. Others will revel in his goods.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayekusanya kwa kujikana mwenyewe hukusanya kwa ajili ya wengine. Wengine watafurahia mali zake.
Ekegusii: Onye akwerina, igo ere nigo akonibera abanto bande? Erio abwo bakoira omwando nigo bagosiakeria enibo eyio ase okwegokia.

English: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
Kiswahili: Amechora mstari wa upeo juu ya uso wa maji, ameweka mpaka wa nuru na giza.
Ekegusii: Ong'ororirie ekeringerera kere orobebe rw'amaache ase ogwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.

English: She/he said that they should buy her/his red pen
Kiswahili: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kumnunulia kalamu yake nyekundu
Ekegusii: atebete bamogorere ekeramu yaye embariri

English: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
Kiswahili: Mara tu Yezebeli aliposikia kwamba Nabothi amepigwa mawe na amekufa, akamwambia Ahabu, “Amka na uchukue lile shamba la mizabibu la Nabothi, Myezreeli, ambalo alikataa kukuuzia. Hayuko hai tena, bali amekufa.”
Ekegusii: Ase obwango ekero Yesebeli aigwete ng'a Naboti oakirwe amagena okuure agateebia Ahabu: “Imoka, oire omogondo bw'emesabibu o Naboti, Omoyesireeli, oria angete gokoa omoe chitaabu, ekiagera bono tari moyo, okuure.”

English: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini walipewa Gibeoni, Geba, Alemethi na Anathothi, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho. Miji hii kumi na mitatu iligawanywa miongoni mwa koo za Wakohathi.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Geba na Alemeti, na Anatoti, emechie eyio yonsi amo namarisio aetanaineo. Emechie yabo yonsi ase chiamate chiabo nigo yarenge ikomi na etato.

English: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.
Kiswahili: Akawaacha, akatoka nje ya mji, akaenda hadi Bethania, akalala huko.
Ekegusii: Akabatiga, agasoka korwa ase omochie, akagenda Bethania, akarara aroro.

English: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
Kiswahili: Aliona kushutumiwa kwa ajili ya Kristo ni utajiri mkubwa zaidi kuliko hazina za Misri, maana alikuwa anatazamia kupata thawabu baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abarete ogochaaywa ase engencho ya Kristo ng'a nobonda kobua chiniibo chia Misiri, ekiagera arigereretie eng'eria ere bosio.

English: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
Kiswahili: Wote walio wangu ni wako na walio wako ni wangu, nami nimetukuzwa ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abare abaane nabao, na abare abao nabaane, na inche nabakirwe ime yabo.

English: Her husband sent her away after polio disabled their son
Kiswahili: Mumewe alimtuma nyumbani baada ya mtoto wao kujeruhiwa na polio
Ekegusii: omogaka oye amosereti ekero porio yaremaria omwana obo omomura

English: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Isaki alimbariki Yakobo na Esau kuhusu maisha yao ya baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Isaka agasesenia Yakobo na Esau ase amang'ana agochi‐gocha.

English: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
Kiswahili: basi mkono wangu na unyofoke toka begani mwangu, nao na uvunjike kutoka kiungio chake.
Ekegusii: rirorio tiga amareko aane ongoke agwe inse, ne chinengo chi'amaboko aane chisomoke.

English: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
Kiswahili: Nitatawanya nyama yako juu ya milima na kujaza mabonde kwa mabaki yako.
Ekegusii: Nintugute chinyama chi'omobere oo ase ebitunwa igoro, na oboguundo bwao boichore ase amagoko.

English: Yahweh sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akawatuma Yerub-Baali, Baraka, Yefta na Samweli, naye akawaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zenu kila upande, ili ninyi mpate kukaa salama.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agatoma Yeruba‐Baali, na Baraki, na Yefita, na inche Samweli, akabatooria korwa ase amaboko yababisa baino baabaetanaine, nainwe mokaba mokomenya ase obotoereru.

English: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
Kiswahili: Aliposikia jambo hili, Danieli akamwendea mfalme, akamwomba ampe muda ili aweze kumfasiria ile ndoto.
Ekegusii: Danieli akagenda ase obosio bw'omorwoti, akamosaba amoe engaki achiche komoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiria.

English: But to Hannah he would give a double portion, for he loved her even though the LORD had closed her womb.
Kiswahili: Lakini alimpa Hana fungu maradufu kwa sababu alimpenda, ingawa Bwana alikuwa amemfunga tumbo.
Ekegusii: Korende ase Ana nigo areenge komoa ebitari bibere, ekiagera nigo amwanchete nony’Omonene osiegete oroiboro rwaye.

English: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
Kiswahili: Basi, ndugu, kwa habari ya nyakati na majira hatuna haja ya kuwaandikia,
Ekegusii: Ase amang'ana ebiro ne chingaki, baminto, tari nengencho ase more ng'a mbariikere.

English: And the Israelites and Judahites who lived in the cities of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things consecrated to the LORD their God, and they laid them in large heaps.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli na Yuda walioishi katika miji ya Yuda wakaleta pia fungu la kumi la makundi yao ya ngʼombe na makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi pia na fungu la kumi la vitu vitakatifu vilivyowekwa wakfu kwa ajili ya Bwana Mungu wao na kuvikusanya katika malundo.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli na Abayuda, baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda, bakarenta ensemo ya ikomi ye chiombe na eye ching’ondi, ebinto baatananete ase Omonene, Nyasae obo; ebio bakabibeka amo, bikaba ebinge.

English: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
Kiswahili: Nchi yote ya Kanaani, unakoishi sasa kama mgeni, nitakupa kuwa milki yako milele, na uzao wako, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninkoe aye, na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ense eye omenyete bono buna omomenyi, ense yonsi ya Kaanani, ebe eyaino kare na kare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.”

English: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo mikono yangu haijafanya jeuri, na maombi yangu ni safi.
Ekegusii: nonya tindakora bobe bonde namaboko aane, na ogosaba kwane kore ogoikeranu.

English: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa maafisa wake wakuu: Kuhani: Azaria mwana wa Sadoki;
Ekegusii: na abanene abaarenge komokoonya nabwo aba. Asaria, mosinto o Zadoki, nere orenge Omokuani.

English: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
Kiswahili: Aroni akawajibu, “Vueni vipuli vya dhahabu ambavyo wake zenu, wana wenu na binti zenu wamevaa, mkaniletee.”
Ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitaabu bire ase amato 'abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”

English: Then he brought them into his home and set a meal before them. So he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God. An Official Apology
Kiswahili: Akawapandisha nyumbani mwake akawaandalia chakula, yeye pamoja na nyumba yake yote wakafurahi sana kwa kuwa sasa walikuwa wamemwamini Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akabaira mwaye, akabarageria, akagoka mono amo na bonsi b’enyomba yaye, ekiagera konya bamwegenire Nyasae.

English: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”
Kiswahili: Baruku akajibu, “Ndiyo, maneno haya yote yalitoka kinywani mwa Yeremia, nami nikayaandika kwa wino katika hiki kitabu.”
Ekegusii: Baruku akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Ee, ekero Yeremia agendererete gokwana amang'ana aya, inche nario nagendererete koyarika newino ase egetabu eke.”

English: Though he humbles himself and walks bowed down, still be careful and beware of him. You will be to him as one who has wiped a mirror, to be sure it doesn't completely tarnish.
Kiswahili: Ingawa anajinyenyekeza na kutembea kwa kuinama, bado kuwa mwangalifu na kujihadhari naye. Utakuwa kwake kama mtu aliyefuta kioo, ili kuhakikisha hakichafui kabisa.
Ekegusii: Nonya noria ogwekeeyia na gotugama bosio bwao, erende ase amabe aye. Omonto buna oyio nigo anga buna ekerore kiabosiire onye tikeri kogenderera kona gosibigwa.

English: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!' and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?'
Kiswahili: Walimwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi! Huyo Mwenyezi aweza kutufanyia nini?'
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateebeetie Nyasae: Karue ase tore! Naende bakaboora: Inee! Ngento ki Omobui oyio aratokorere?

English: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
Kiswahili: (Kutokana na hawa mataifa ya Pwani yalienea katika nchi zao, kwa koo zao katika mataifa yao, kila moja kwa lugha yake.)
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo chisokoro chi'abaanto abwo bamenyete mbarabare ye nyancha na as'ebisinka. Barabwo nororeeria rwa Yebita abwo bamenyete kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye, ne chingongo chiabo na kera oyomo ase omonwa oye areenge gokwana.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Naftali walikuwa watu 53,400.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano naisato, n'amagana ane (53,400).

English: On the tenth day of this seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you shall humble yourselves; you must not do any work.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwenye siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu. Mtajikana wenyewe na msifanye kazi.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyio o gatan’akabere, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Mobe mokweng’ata na gweitia. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi.

English: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the project. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls, and 530 priestly garments.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya viongozi wa jamaa walichangia kazi ya ujenzi. Mtawala alikabidhi kwenye hazina darkoni 1,000 za dhahabu, mabakuli 50, na mavazi 530 kwa ajili ya makuhani.
Ekegusii: Abateneneri bande be chiamate chiabo mbaruete ebiegwa ase ogokorera emeremo. Omogabana akabeeka ase ekungo ebisamunye bie chitaabu bikorokwa chidariki, elifu eyemo (1,000), ne chisani emerongo etano (50), ne chianga chi’abakuani, amagana atano, na emerongo etato (530).

English: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
Kiswahili: Kwanza wakampeleka kwa Anasi, mkwewe Kayafa, aliyekuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka ule.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamoira ritang'ani ase Anasi oyorenge ise biara Kayafa, oria orenge Omokuani omonene omwaka oria.

English: When the LORD your God expands your territory as He has promised, and you crave meat and say, “I want to eat meat,” you may eat it whenever you want.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atakapokuwa ameongeza nchi yenu kama alivyowaahidi, nanyi mkitamani nyama na mkisema, “Ningependa nyama,” hapo unaweza kula nyingi upendavyo.
Ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, arabagareerie orogongo rwaino buna abarierete eira, nainwe mokwane: ’Natorie chinyama, ekiagera more abatoonu b’okogania chinyama, nabo morarie chinyama, morie chinyinge buna moraganie.

English: And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city.
Kiswahili: Basi utukufu wa Bwana ukapaa juu kutoka mji, ukatua juu ya mlima ulio upande wa mashariki ya mji.
Ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro korwa ase omochie oria, bokagenda bogatenena igoro ase egetunwa kere moocha y’omochie.

English: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.
Kiswahili: Basi Gaali mwana wa Ebedi alikuwa ametoka nje akawa amesimama katika ingilio la mji wakati ule ule ambao Abimeleki na watu wake walipokuwa wanatoka sehemu zao za maficho.
Ekegusii: Gaali agasoka, agatenena ase egeita ki'omochie, na erio agwo Abimeleki amo n'abanto baye bakaimoka korwa ase baaboete.

English: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
Kiswahili: kutoka Isakari, ni Nethaneli mwana wa Suari;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.

English: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akawaita watu na kuwapanga huko Telaimu, askari wa miguu 200,000 pamoja na watu 10,000 kutoka Yuda.
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo akarangeria Abanto, akabaroberia agwo Telaimu. Abarwani b'esegi abaarenge gotaara namagoro nigo baare chilifu amagana abere (200,000), amo nabwo korwa ase Abayuda chilifu ikomi (10,000).

English: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
Kiswahili: Naye akianzia na Sheria ya Mose na Manabii wote, akawafafanulia jinsi Maandiko yalivyosema kumhusu yeye.
Ekegusii: Agachaakera korwa Musa na ababani bonsi akabateebereria korwa ase amariiko onsi amang'ana ariikire igoro yaye.

English: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wetu, ndiwe uliyewajibu, kwa Israeli ulikuwa Mungu mwenye kusamehe, ingawa uliadhibu matendo yao mabaya.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo kwaigwete abanto baria, nigo kwarenge Nyasae, kwarenge kobaabera, nonya naboigo nigo kwarenge kobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.

English: “What guilt offering should we send back to Him?” asked the Philistines. “Five gold tumors and five gold rats,” they said, “according to the number of rulers of the Philistines, since the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawauliza, “Ni sadaka gani ya hatia tutakayompelekea?” Wakajibu, “Majipu matano ya dhahabu na panya wa dhahabu watano, kulingana na idadi ya watawala wa Wafilisti, kwa sababu tauni iyo hiyo imewaua ninyi na watawala wenu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakabooria, “Inee! Okoruegwa okwo gw’okomocha nkoroki torairanie ase Omonene?” Barabwo bakabairaneria, “Emegwekano etano y’amagumba, na etano ye chimbeba, yonsi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu. Moire emegwekano koreng’ana nomobaro bwe chinyasae chia Abafirisiti, ekiagera amaakwa ayio nigo abeete igoro ase more mwensi, na igoro ase abanene baino boigo.

English: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya Waepikureo na Wastoiko wenye falsafa wakakutana naye. Baadhi yao wakasema, “Je, huyu mpayukaji anajaribu kusema nini?” Wengine wakasema, “Inaonekana anasema habari za miungu ya kigeni.” Walisema haya kwa sababu Paulo alikuwa anahubiri habari njema kuhusu Yesu na ufufuo wa wafu.
Ekegusii: Abande abanyasemi b'Abaepikurio na Abastoiki bakaamererania nere. Abande bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nomonyamang'ana mange, inki arigetie goteeba?” Na abande: “Ororekanire ng'a nigo are buna omorandia bw'amang'ana e chinyasae chingeni”, ekiagera nigo arenge korandia amang'ana a Yeso na okobokigwa kw'abakuure.

English: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
Kiswahili: Katika uadilifu wangu unanitegemeza na kuniweka kwenye uwepo wako milele.
Ekegusii: Aye gwankonyire, ekiagera tindi na komocha, kwambekire gotenena ase obosio bwao kogenderera botambe.

English: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king's face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”'”
Kiswahili: Absalomu akamwambia Yoabu, “Tazama, nilikutumia ujumbe na kusema, ‘Njoo ili niweze kukutuma kwa mfalme kuuliza, “Kwa nini nimekuja kutoka Geshuri? Ingekuwa bora zaidi kwangu kama ningebaki huko!” ' Sasa basi, nataka kuuona uso wa mfalme, na ikiwa nina hatia ya jambo lolote, basi na aniue.”
Ekegusii: Abisalomu akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, 'ngatoma abanto ase ore ng'a oche ogeende ase omorwoti, omoteebie amang'ana ane. Inki rende narwerete Gesuri? Nanga mbuya nare komenya aroro goika reero iga. Bono ninganetie korora omorwoti. Onye obobe bore ase 'nde ang'ite.”

English: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “La hasha Bwana! Sijawahi kamwe kula kitu chochote kilicho najisi.”
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akabora: “Yay'Omonene, ekiagera tinana koria nonya ng'ake egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi.”

English: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God's army.
Kiswahili: Siku baada ya siku watu walikuja kumsaidia Daudi, mpaka akawa na jeshi kubwa, kama jeshi la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Rituko ase rituko abanto bakagenderera gocha ase Daudi komokonya, goika agatwara abarwani abange mono, buna abasikari ba Nyasae.

English: “Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
Kiswahili: “Bila shaka ninyi ndio watu, nayo hekima itakoma mtakapokufa!
Ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe ninwe abanto bori, ekero morakwe, obong’aini nigo borasire.

English: After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a still, small voice.
Kiswahili: Baada ya tetemeko la nchi ukaja moto, lakini Bwana hakuwamo katika ule moto. Baada ya moto ikaja sauti ya utulivu ya kunongʼona.
Ekegusii: Na ekero omotengecho oerire, omorero ogoka, korende Omonene tarenge ime ase omorero oria, na magega y’ayio eriogi rike ri’obotoereru rigacha.

English: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
Kiswahili: Ni ipi njia iendayo mahali umeme wa radi unapotawanyiwa, au mahali upepo wa mashariki unaposambaziwa juu ya dunia?
Ekegusii: Inchera ki ekogenda aase oborabu bokoruerwa, gose ekogenda aase omwaga okorwa moocha bwesiarera ense yonsi?

English: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
Kiswahili: Waandaa meza mbele yangu machoni pa adui zangu. Umenipaka mafuta kichwani pangu, kikombe changu kinafurika.
Ekegusii: Kwambekeire endagera ase amasio 'ababisa baane; kwang'akire amaguta omotwe one ase okonyarigania, gwaichoirie egekombe kiane, ngoiteka kere.

English: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
Kiswahili: (Basi Yesu mwenyewe alikuwa amesema kwamba nabii hapati heshima katika nchi yake mwenyewe.)
Ekegusii: Naki Yeso omonyene aorogetie ng’a omobani tari gosikwa ase ense yaye omonyene.

English: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.
Kiswahili: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni na usamehe dhambi ya watumishi wako, watu wako Israeli. Wafundishe njia sahihi ya kuishi na ukanyeshe mvua juu ya nchi uliyowapa watu wako kuwa urithi.
Ekegusii: rirorio aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi'abasomba bao Abaisraeli, oborokererie enchera engiya bagwenerete kobwatia. Naende orente embura igoro ase ense yao, eye kwaeire abanto bao yabeire omwando obo.

English: But Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, “Unless these men remain with the ship, you cannot be saved.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwambia yule jemadari na askari, “Hawa watu wasipobaki katika meli, hamtaweza kuokoka.”
Ekegusii: Paulo agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, na abarwani: “Aba bataikaranseti ase emeeri ime timokonyara gotooreka.”

English: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo watu wote watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni kwa nguvu nyingi na utukufu.
Ekegusii: Erio nario bararore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase amare ime amo ne chinguru chinyinge na obonene.

English: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
Kiswahili: Tena, sisi sote tunao baba wa kimwili, waliotuadibisha nasi tukawaheshimu kwa ajili ya hilo. Je, si inatupasa kujinyenyekeza zaidi kwa Baba wa roho zetu ili tuishi?
Ekegusii: Amo nayio ntwarenge nabatata baito b’ense eye, baare gotorongeyia, na barabwo ntwabasigete. Inee! Tari buya mono kobua kwebeka inse ya Tata bw’emeika yaito, na koba moyo?

English: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Bali katika mwaka wa tano mnaweza kula matunda ya mti huo. Kwa njia hii mavuno yenu yataongezewa. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o gatano inamorie amatunda 'emete eyio. Komorakore igo, emete inayame amatunda amange ase more. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtaniondolea huyu tena na akapatwa na madhara, mtashusha kichwa changu chenye mvi kaburini nikiwa mwenye huzuni.’
Ekegusii: Onye mokoirana oyo nere korwa ase ’nde, na amabe achie komonyoora, rirorio nigo moragere inkwe ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane, inde nomoichano.

English: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, named Jesus!”
Kiswahili: naye Yasoni amewakaribisha nyumbani mwake. Hawa wote wanaasi amri za Kaisari wakisema yuko mfalme mwingine aitwaye Yesu.”
Ekegusii: na Yasoni akabaroisia. Barabwo bonsi nigo bagokora chingencho chire mamincha ya Kaisari, bagoteeba ng’a omorwoti onde nareo, okorokwa Yeso.”

English: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin's gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king's wine presses.
Kiswahili: Nchi yote kuanzia Geba, kaskazini mwa Yuda, hadi Rimoni, kusini mwa Yerusalemu, itakuwa kama Araba. Lakini Yerusalemu utainuliwa juu na kubaki mahali pake, toka Lango la Benyamini hadi mahali pa Lango la Kwanza, mpaka kwenye Lango la Pembeni na kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli hadi kwenye mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio ense eye yonsi neonchorwe ebe ense omweya korwa Geba goika Rimoni, Irianyi ya Yerusalemu. Korende Yerusalemu oro nogenderere kobeera igoro agwo aase aye, korwa ase Egeita kia Benjamini goika ase Egeita kie Ritang'ani, na goika ase Egeita gi'Ekoona, na korwa ase Omorobiri bwa Hananeli goika ase ebimitero bi'edivai bi'omorwoti.

English: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
Kiswahili: Basi Isaki akawaandalia karamu, nao wakala na kunywa.
Ekegusii: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

English: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar's tents, like Solomon's curtains.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mweusi, lakini napendeza, enyi binti za Yerusalemu, mweusi kama mahema ya Kedari, kama mapazia ya hema la Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, inche nigo inde omomwamu ti, noyo bw'okogokia. Nigo inga buna chiema chia Kedari, naende buna ebitambaa bi'ogosungwa bia Sulemani.

English: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
Kiswahili: Tauni ilimtangulia; maradhi ya kuambukiza yalifuata nyayo zake.
Ekegusii: Amarwaire agoita nigo atang'aine bosio bwaye, na amaakwa nigo akobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.

English: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?
Kiswahili: nitafanya nini Mungu atakaponikabili? Nitamjibu nini nitakapoitwa kutoa hesabu?
Ekegusii: ninki ndakore ekero Nyasae aranyimokere? Ninki ndamoiranerie ekero arabe okorua egesusuro ki'ebibe biane?

English: The fifth time, Sanballat sent me this same message by his young servant, who had in his hand an unsealed letter
Kiswahili: Basi, mara ya tano, Sanbalati akamtuma msaidizi wake kwangu akiwa na ujumbe wa aina ile ile, naye alikuwa amechukua mkononi mwake barua isiyofungwa,
Ekegusii: Naende ase entunda ya gatano, Sanibalati agatoma omosomba oye ase ’nde obwate riruube ritamumekeirie

English: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
Kiswahili: Simoni Mkananayo, na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Simioni omoKaanani, na Yudasi Iskariota, ere oria omoruete.

English: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mmekwisha kuwa safi kwa sababu ya lile neno nililonena nanyi.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu ase engencho ye ring'ana nabateebirie.

English: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu, akaondoka akamchukua mtoto na mama yake wakaenda mpaka nchi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng’ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.

English: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana; hilo ndilo Jina langu! Sitampa mwingine utukufu wangu wala sanamu sifa zangu.
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, erio nario erieta riane; tindi koa omonto onde obonene bwane; tinkoa emegwekano egosasimwa ogotogigwa kwane.

English: Isn't my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won't he make it grow?
Kiswahili: “Je, si hivyo ilivyo nyumba yangu mbele za Mungu? Je, hajafanya Agano la milele nami, lililopangwa na kuimarishwa kila sehemu? Je, hatanifanya niufurahie wokovu wangu na kunijalia matakwa yangu yote?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ororeria rw'ane tirori boronge ase Nyasae? Takorete nainche okobwatana gwa kare na kare, okwo korobeirie gotari koonchoka? Inee! Nyasae tagonsesenia na gontooria, naende ang'e aya 'nganetie?

English: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Wewe ndiwe Mungu utendaye miujiza, umeonyesha uwezo wako katikati ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

English: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn't you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”
Kiswahili: Yoabu akamwambia huyo mtu, “Nini! Ulimwona Absalomu? Kwa nini hukumpiga papo hapo mpaka chini? Ndipo ningekupa shekeli kumi za fedha na mkanda wa askari shujaa.”
Ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Onye kwamorora, ninki kiaba tikwamoita erio kegima? Inche anga 'naaba nomogooko inkoe chitaabu chisekeli chi'echifeta ikomi, amo norokini.”

English: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
Kiswahili: Mwenzangu hushambulia rafiki zake, naye huvunja agano lake.
Ekegusii: Oyorenge omosani one nigo aramborete okoboko kwaye, akore bobe ase abakorete omorembe nere, osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw'ogotianania.

English: As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu mimi, nimejazwa nguvu, nimejazwa Roho wa Bwana, haki na uweza, kumtangazia Yakobo kosa lake, na Israeli dhambi yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ase inde inche, Omonene nigo akongichoria n’Omoika oye n’echinguru, naende ong’a inche eki’orokererio ki’oboronge nabo igo oboremu bw’ogotebia abanto ba Israeli keria kere ebibe biabo.

English: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.
Kiswahili: Wale maafisa vijana majemadari wa majimbo wakatoka nje ya mji jeshi likiwa nyuma yao,
Ekegusii: Korende abasomba baria abamura b'abagaambi be chingongo amo nomoganda bw'esegi okobabwatia bakarua ase omochie, bakagenda,

English: So Hiram sent him ships captained by his servants, along with crews of experienced sailors. They went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and acquired from there 450 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
Kiswahili: Naye Hiramu alimpelekea meli zilizoongozwa na maafisa wake mwenyewe, watu waliokuwa na ujuzi wa baharini. Hawa watu pamoja na wale wa Solomoni wakasafiri kwa bahari mpaka Ofiri, wakaleta kutoka huko talanta 450 za dhahabu, ambazo walimkabidhi Mfalme Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Huramu akamotomera chimeeri chiarenge kogendigwa nabagendia baye, amo nabaanto bande bamanyete emeremo y’enyancha. Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri amo nabasomba ba Sulemani, bakarenta korwa aroro chitaabu chitalanta amagana ane, na emerongo etano, bakayeirera Sulemani omorwoti.

English: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
Kiswahili: Lile ninalowaambia ninyi, nawaambia watu wote: ‘Kesheni!’ ”
Ekegusii: Na erio nabateebirie inwe, nabateebirie bonsi: Renda!”

English: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn't see their father's nakedness.
Kiswahili: Lakini Shemu na Yafethi wakachukua nguo wakaitanda mabegani mwao wote wawili, kisha wakaenda kinyumenyume, wakaufunika uchi wa baba yao. Nyuso zao zilielekea upande mwingine ili wasiuone uchi wa baba yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Shemu na Yafeti bakabogoria engobo, bakayebeeka amareko abo igoro, bakagenda kemagega‐magega, bakabisia ise obogetirianda bwaye. Amaiso abo nigo arigereretie aase bakorwa, na tibarora obogetirianda bwa ise.

English: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
Kiswahili: Hata lini, waovu, Ee Bwana, hata lini waovu watashangilia?
Ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri abanyabibe baragenderere gwetogia? Ngoika ririri?

English: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
Kiswahili: Amka kwa hasira yako, Ee Bwana, inuka dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu. Amka, Mungu wangu, uamue haki.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka kore nendamwamu yao, imokerera igoro orwanie ekeririanda ki'ababisa baane! Inchuo onkonye! Aye gwachikiire ekiina.

English: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
Kiswahili: Kama vile kuonekana kwa upinde wa mvua mawinguni siku ya mvua, ndivyo ulivyokuwa ule mngʼao uliomzunguka. Hivi ndivyo ilivyokuwa kuonekana kwa utukufu wa Bwana. Nilipouona, nikaanguka kifudifudi, nikasikia sauti ya mtu anaongea.
Ekegusii: Oborabu boria bwarenge komoreka chinsemo chiaye chionsi, nigo bwagwekaine nomokubinyongo ase engaki y’embura. Okororekana okwo nakw’obonene bw’Omonene. Nyasae okorangeria Ezekieli abe omobani Ekero narooche ayio ngatung’ama inse maumama; erio nkaigwa eriogi ri’oyomo ogokwana.

English: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mipiko itaingizwa kwenye zile pete ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu inapobebwa.
Ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi’egesasiimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.

English: Then Mordecai returned to the king’s gate. But Haman rushed home, with his head covered in grief.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Mordekai akarudi kwenye lango la mfalme. Lakini Hamani akakimbia nyumbani, akiwa amejaa huzuni,
Ekegusii: Moredekai akairana geita ki’omorwoti, korende Hamani akaayerera gochia bwoye, oichanete na korera, bwetubete omotwe oye.

English: And he was buried in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier that was full of spices and various blended perfumes; then they made a great fire in his honor.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamzika katika kaburi lile alilokuwa amejichongea mwenyewe katika Mji wa Daudi. Wakamzika kwa jeneza lililowekwa vikolezi na mchanganyiko wa manukato ya aina mbalimbali yaliyotengenezwa kwa utaalamu wa mtengeneza marashi, nao wakawasha moto mkubwa kwa heshima yake.
Ekegusii: Erio agatindekwa ase oboina eroiseretie ere omonyene, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi. Bakamwareria ase ekeraarero giaichoretigwe ebinsari na amarembo ao ao, ebinto bigotioka buya, biaroisetigwe nabaroisia abang’aini. Abanto bagauta omorero omonene ase okworokia amasikani ase engencho ya Asa.

English: “Who is in the court?” the king asked. Now Haman had just entered the outer court of the palace to ask the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows he had prepared for him.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akasema, “Ni nani yuko uani?” Wakati huo huo Hamani alikuwa ameingia ua wa nje wa jumba la mfalme kusema na mfalme kuhusu kumwangika Mordekai katika mahali pa kuangikia watu alipokuwa amepajenga kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaboria, “Ning’o oyio ore ase egoora?” Ekaba ng’a Hamani nere orenge gosoa ase egoora isiko y’enyomba y’omorwoti, akwane nomorwoti, erinde achie gotonga Moredekai ase orobambo roria amosimiseretie.

English: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
Kiswahili: Kwa Waisraeli utukufu wa Bwana ulionekana kama moto uteketezao juu ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Ase Abaisraeli obonene bw’Omonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.

English: If they are indeed prophets and the word of the LORD is with them, let them now plead with the LORD of Hosts that the articles remaining in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, not be taken to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Kama wao ni manabii na wanalo neno la Bwana, basi na wamsihi Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ili vyombo vilivyobaki katika nyumba ya Bwana na katika jumba la kifalme la mfalme wa Yuda na katika Yerusalemu visipelekwe Babeli.
Ekegusii: Onye barabwo bare ababani b’ekeene, na onye ring’ana ri’Omonene rire ase bare, tiga basorore Omonene bw’Emeganda ng’a ebikorero ebio bitigarete ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba y’Omorwoti bw’Abayuda agwo Yerusalemu bitigwe tibiirwa Babiloni.

English: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”
Kiswahili: Isaki akamjibu Esau, “Nimemfanya yeye kuwa bwana juu yako, pia nimewafanya ndugu zako wote kuwa watumishi wake, nimemtegemeza kwa nafaka na divai mpya. Sasa nitaweza kukufanyia nini, mwanangu?”
Ekegusii: Isaka akamoiraneria: “Rora, bono naikire komokora obeire omonene oo, na abamwabo bonsi babe abasomba baye, naende namoeire endagera y'omogondo na edivai. Inki rende bono nkogokorera aye, omwana one?”

English: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa tano wa utawala wa Mfalme Rehoboamu, Shishaki mfalme wa Misri akashambulia Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano bw'okogaamba kwa Rehoboamu, Sisaki, omorwoti o Misiri, agacha, akarwania Yerusalemu.

English: who long for death that does not come, and search for it like hidden treasure,
Kiswahili: wale wanaotamani kifo ambacho hakiji, wale watafutao kufa zaidi ya kutafuta hazina iliyofichwa,
Ekegusii: Abwo baganyete amakweri, korende tibari koyanyora; nigo bakoyarigia kobua korigia chinibo chibisire.

English: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Enoshi, Sethi aliishi miaka 807, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enosu, Seti akamenya naende emiaka ende amagana atano na atato, na etano na ebere (807), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa mtu mwenye hekima, kama ilivyo kwa mpumbavu, hatakumbukwa kwa muda mrefu, katika siku zijazo wote watasahaulika. Kama vile ilivyo kwa mpumbavu, mtu mwenye hekima pia lazima atakufa!
Ekegusii: Buna ere ase omonto omong'aini, naboigo ere nase omoriri, onde takogenderera koinyorwa; bonsi nigo barabe bebirwe kegima ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Inee! Omonto omong'aini tagokwa buna oria omoriri agokwa?

English: “Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo sasa nitamshawishi; nitamwongoza hadi jangwani na kuzungumza naye kwa upole.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nimoebererie, imoire ase erooro, erinde nkwane nere amang’ana y’obwanchani.

English: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
Kiswahili: Kamwe asijitie unajisi mwenyewe kutokana na wale watu ambao anahusiana nao kwa kuoana, na hivyo kujitia unajisi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Omokuani are omotang'ani ase abanto baye, tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.

English: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Resini, Nekoda, Gazamu,
Ekegusii: Resini, na Nekoda, na Gasamu;

English: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ilitupasa tuwe na Kuhani Mkuu wa namna hii, yaani, aliye mtakatifu, asiye na lawama, asiye na dosari, aliyetengwa na wenye dhambi na kuinuliwa juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n’Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.

English: When he came to his village, the villagers were afraid. "What disease have you brought to us, Opio?" they asked. "What is this dark thing following you?" Opio said, "My friends, this dark thing is called night. Now you are afraid and I was afraid, too."
Kiswahili: Alipofika kijijini kwao, wanakijiji waliogopa. “Opio, ni ugonjwa gani huu uliotuletea?” walimwuliza. “Ni nini hiki cheusi kinachokufuata nyuma yako?” Opio akawaeleza, “Ndugu zangu kitu cheusi kinachonifuata kinaitwa usiku. Mnavyoogopa ndivyo nilivyoogopa pia.”
Ekegusii: Akanya gosuka ang’e n’ekenyoro kiaye. Ake ake agachaka korora ekenyoro kiaye nabasani baye.Opio akaigwa obororo. Agatebia abanyakenyoro tibabaisa kooboa. Akabatebia, “Obotuko tibori bobe. Koru bono ntonyare gotwara obotuko nomogaso. Goika ing’irane naende inchie kwoyia obotuko naende.”

English: Thanksgiving will proceed from them, a sound of celebration. I will multiply them, and they will not be decreased; I will honor them, and they will not be belittled.
Kiswahili: Nyimbo za kushukuru zitatoka kwao na sauti ya furaha. Nitaiongeza idadi yao wala hawatapungua, nitawapa heshima na hawatadharauliwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nabatere amatera ay’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, mbaake amariogi ’omochengo. Nimbamentekanie babuche, na omobaro obo tokoba omoke. Ningere basikwe na tibakobarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento.

English: But the Rabshakeh replied, “Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari wa jeshi akajibu, “Je, bwana wangu amenituma kutoa ujumbe huu kwa bwana wenu na kwenu tu? Je, hakunituma pia kwa watu walioketi ukutani, ambao, kama ninyi, itawabidi kula mavi yao na kunywa mikojo yao wenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Omochiki oria omonene akabairaneria, “Inee! Omonene one nantoma nkwane amang’ana aya ase omonene oo na asore aye? Tantomete ase inwe mweka, korende nase abanto baikaransete ase orwaki igoro; abwo banacheirwe ekiina amo nainwe bagochia koria obonyira bwabo na konywa amaache abo bagoitera.”

English: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
Kiswahili: “Umeniokoa kutokana na mashambulizi ya watu wangu; umenihifadhi mimi kama kiongozi wa mataifa. Watu ambao sikuwajua wananitumikia,
Ekegusii: “Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania n’abanto bane, kwandendire nabeire omogambi bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba bane.

English: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote akinionea aibu mimi na maneno yangu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na katika utukufu wa Baba, pamoja na malaika watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki kera omonto orandorere obosooku inche na amang’ana aane, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha ase obonene bwaye, namororere obosooku ase Ise na ase abamalaika abachenu.

English: Now, therefore, swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. Show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that I have shown to you.”
Kiswahili: Sasa niapie hapa mbele za Mungu kwamba hutanitenda hila mimi, watoto wangu wala wazao wangu. Nitendee mimi na nchi ambayo unaishi kama mgeni wema ule ule ambao nimekutendea.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono karie eira na gotiana ase Nyasae ng’a togonkorera obong’ainereria inche, na abana baane, na abachokoro baane, korende koreng’ana buna inche nagokorerete aye, obwanchani obo naye onkorere nainche boigo, amo nense eye aye omenyete ime.”

English: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.
Kiswahili: Atakuwa kama kichaka cha jangwani; hataona mafanikio yatakapokuja. Ataishi katika sehemu zisizo na maji, katika nchi ya chumvi ambapo hakuna yeyote aishiye humo.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo anga buna egetutu ki'erooro kiomire, takorora amang'ana ande onsi amaya akomocheera. Namenye aase aomo agwo ase erooro, ase ense ere nomonyoo etamenyiri na onde.

English: the nation of the Jews shall help them as allies, as the occasion shall indicate to them, with all their heart.
Kiswahili: taifa la Wayahudi litawasaidia kama washirika, kama tukio litakavyowaonyesha, kwa moyo wao wote.
Ekegusii: egesaku kia Abayahudi nkerue ogokoonya gwokwerwa ne chinibo koreng'ana nokogania korabeo.

English: Then the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and wail at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her.
Kiswahili: “Wafalme wa dunia waliozini naye na kushiriki anasa zake watakapoona moshi wa kuungua kwake, watamlilia na kumwombolezea.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense, abwo babwatanire nere ase obotomani na okogania okobe nabamoreere na komweumeria ekero bararore erioki ri’okoyia kwaye.

English: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
Kiswahili: Lakini Abiathari, mwana wa Ahimeleki, mwana wa Ahitubu, akatoroka, akakimbia na kujiunga na Daudi.
Ekegusii: Korende Abiatari bweka ase basinto b'Ahimeleki bw'Ahitubu, ere agatooreka, agatama gochia ase Daudi.

English: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?”
Kiswahili: Yule mtumishi akamuuliza, “Je, kama huyo mwanamke atakataa kuja nami katika nchi hii? Je, nimpeleke mwanao katika hiyo nchi uliyotoka?”
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Aande, omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche goika ase ense eye; Inee, nigo ndaire omwana oo goika ase ense eria kwarwete?”

English: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers' households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers' house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Mwandishi Shemaya mwana wa Nethaneli, Mlawi, aliorodhesha majina yao mbele ya Mfalme Daudi na maafisa: Kuhani Sadoki, Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari, na viongozi wa jamaa za makuhani na za Walawi: jamaa moja ikitoka upande wa Eleazari na nyingine upande wa Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Semaya, mosinto o Netaneli Omolawi, akarika amarieta abo agwo ekero omorwoti na abanene abarenge komokonya, na Zadoki Omokuani, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw'Abiatari, na abateneneri be chiamate chi'abakuani, na echi'Abalawi barigereretie. Chiamate chigachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera, eyemo korwa ase ororeria rw'Eleazari, na eyende korwa ase orwa Itamari.

English: One day when she visited, she received a gift. It was a very special Gourd which appeared from her parents graves.
Kiswahili: Siku moja wakati alipotembea makaburini, alipewa zawadi. Na zawadi yenyewe ilikuwa kibuyu cha kipekee kilichotoka kwenye makaburi ya wazazi wake.
Ekegusii: Ekerandi keria nigo kiarenge gotera iga... Khayanga, ee, Khayanga! Khayanga, ee, Khayanga! Omwana oito omwanchwa! Manya ng'a tori aye bweka, omwanchwa oito! Ee ekerandi eke iga, omwanchwa oito! Kebogorie nagotara nakerokio kera ase!

English: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Mahalaleli aliishi jumla ya miaka 895, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo kianda, na etano (895), erio agakwa.

English: They won't take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hakuna jiwe litakalochukuliwa kutoka kwako kwa ajili ya kufanywa jiwe la pembeni, wala jiwe lolote kwa ajili ya msingi, kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Igena rinde tirikorusigwa asore ribe eri'ekoona, gose kobekwa ase oboroso, korende aye nosarigwe ogenderere koba ritongo kogenderera botambe.” Nab'Omonene atebiire.

English: So the LORD brought against them the military commanders of the king of Assyria, who captured Manasseh, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana akaleta juu yao majemadari wa jeshi la mfalme wa Ashuru, ambao walimchukua Manase kwenda kifungoni, wakaweka ndoana katika pua yake, wakamfunga kwa pingu za shaba na kumpeleka Babeli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarenta abatang’ani b’abasikari b’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri igoro yabo; barabwo bakabwata Manase nekegobanio, bakamosiba ne chingataare chi’etai, bakamoira Babiloni.

English: When all this had ended, the Israelites in attendance went out to the cities of Judah and broke up the sacred pillars, chopped down the Asherah poles, and tore down the high places and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the Israelites returned to their cities, each to his own property.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mambo haya yote kumalizika, Waisraeli ambao walikuwako huko wakaenda kwenye miji ya Yuda, wakayavunja yale mawe ya kuabudia na kuzikatakata zile nguzo za Ashera.
