English: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuja na ngurumo, tetemeko la ardhi, na kwa sauti kuu, atakuja na dhoruba, tufani na miali ya moto iteketezayo.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw'Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw'ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria 'omorero ogosamba.

English: There is one who does wickedly, who hangs down his head with mourning; but inwardly he is full of deceit,
Kiswahili: Kuna mtu atendaye maovu, huinama kichwa chake kwa maombolezo; lakini ndani yake amejaa udanganyifu,
Ekegusii: Mbareo abanto bande abwo bagotirigoya, bagwetakoria ng'a mbare n'obororo, korende ime yabo nigo baichoirwe n'oborimo bwoka.

English: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn't confess it, so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue,
Kiswahili: Lakini wengi miongoni mwa viongozi wa Wayahudi walimwamini, lakini kwa sababu ya Mafarisayo hawakukiri waziwazi kwa maana waliogopa kufukuzwa katika masinagogi.
Ekegusii: Korende abange nonya nabanene bakamwegena, korende ase engencho y'Abafarisai tibamoorogetie, tibacha korusigwa ase esinagogi,

English: and go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. Proclaim there the words I speak to you,
Kiswahili: na mtoke mwende mpaka kwenye Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, karibu na ingilio la Lango la Vigae. Huko tangaza maneno ninayokuambia,
Ekegusii: goika ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu rire ase Egeita gie Chindogio, na aroro agwo orarie amang’ana inche ndagoteebie,

English: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God's house be built in its place.'
Kiswahili: naye akamwambia, ‘Chukua vyombo hivi uende ukaviweke ndani ya Hekalu huko Yerusalemu. Nawe uijenge upya nyumba ya Mungu mahali pake.'
Ekegusii: akamoteebia ng'a arente ebikorero ebio, abibeke ime ase Hekalu ere aiga Yerusalemu, naende atige enyomba ya Nyasae eagachwe aase yarenge.

English: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuna mambo mengine mengi ambayo Yesu alifanya. Kama yote yangeliandikwa, nadhani hata ulimwengu wote usingekuwa na nafasi ya kutosha kuweka vitabu vyote ambavyo vingeandikwa. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nare naende ayande amange aya Yeso akorete; naro kararikwe erimo erimo, nigo ngokaga ng'a nonya nense yonsi tegoisana chibuku echiranyare korikwa chibekwe.

English: Listen to the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory is in ruins. Listen to the roaring of the young lions, for the thickets of the Jordan are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza yowe la wachungaji; malisho yao manono yameangamizwa! Sikia ngurumo za simba; kichaka kilichostawi sana cha Yordani kimeharibiwa! Wachungaji Wawili Wa Kondoo
Ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe buna abarisia bakorera bono ekero obonene na obuya bwabo bwasirigwe! Tegerera moigwe buna chindo chinsae chikoruma bono ekero rinani rinoru ria Yorodani riasirigwe! Abarisia babere

English: When he saw that he didn't prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained as he wrestled.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu alipoona kuwa hawezi kumshinda, aligusa kiungio cha nyonga ya Yakobo kwa hiyo nyonga yake ikateguka wakati alipokuwa akishikana mweleka na yule mtu.
Ekegusii: Nere omonto oria, ekero arora ng'a tari kobua Yakobo, akamokuna enengo y'ebachwa, akamoteng'eria, kobagendererete gokinana.

English: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”
Kiswahili: chagua yule aliye bora wa kundi la kondoo. Panga kuni chini ya sufuria kwa ajili ya mifupa; chochea mpaka ichemke na uitokose hiyo mifupa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ebitari ebio obirusie korwa ase eng'ondi enchore ere ase riicho ria'o; otumbe chinko chinyinge inse y'enyongo, oute omorero obiyeke buya, oiyekeranie amauga amo.

English: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini mnaleta mashtaka dhidi yangu? Ninyi nyote mmeniasi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nakwanire iga: Nase ki mokwemurungania ase 'nde? Inwe mwensi mwasaririe ase 'nde.

English: The fear and the dread of them fell upon all the people, for they said, “There is neither truth nor justice in them; for they have broken the covenant and the oath which they swore.”
Kiswahili: Hofu na woga wao ukawaangukia watu wote, maana walisema, "Hakuna kweli wala haki ndani yao; kwa maana wamevunja agano na kiapo walichoapa."
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakaboboa Bakide na Alikimo bagoteeba: “Barabwo tibamanyeti engencho ye ekeene na oboronge. Nigo batianete ase chiira na barabwo bakabuna chiira chiabo barabwo abanyene!”

English: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa atakuwa mkuu mbele za Bwana, kamwe hataonja mvinyo wala kinywaji chochote cha kulevya, naye atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu hata kabla ya kuzaliwa kwake.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nabe omonene ase obosio bw’Omonene. Takonywa edivai gose ekenyugwa kegotindia; ere naichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu, nonya nkorwa enda ya ng’ina.

English: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
Kiswahili: Nashukuru kwamba sikumbatiza mtu yeyote isipokuwa Krispo na Gayo.
Ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng'a mbuya mono, ase engencho ntabatisete monto onde, ase more otatiga Krispo na Gayo,

English: During those seven years, Joseph collected all the excess food in the land of Egypt and stored it in the cities. In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akakusanya chakula chote kilichozalishwa katika ile miaka saba ya neema nchini Misri, akakihifadhi katika ghala za miji. Katika kila mji kulihifadhiwa chakula kilichozalishwa katika mashamba yaliyouzunguka mji huo.
Ekegusii: na Yusufu agasangereria endagera yonsi ase emiaka eria etano na ebere, ase ense ya Misiri, akayegacha ase emechie. Ase kera omochie akagacha endagera yonsi y’emegondo eria yayoetanaine.

English: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa kwanza kurudi kukaa kwenye milki zao katika miji yao walikuwa baadhi ya Waisraeli, makuhani, Walawi na watumishi wa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Abanto batang’anete koirana na komenya sobo ase emechie yabo n’Abaisraeli bande, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu.

English: which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir—
Kiswahili: (Wasidoni huuita mlima huo Sirioni, nao Waamori huuita Seniri.)
Ekegusii: (Abanto ba Sidoni nigo bakoroka egetunwa kia Herimoni Sirioni, na Abaamori nigo bagokeroka Seniri.)

English: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni nguvu ya watu wake, ngome ya wokovu kwa mpakwa mafuta wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw'ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.

English: If the God whom we serve exists, then He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand, O king.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa tutatupwa ndani ya tanuru iwakayo moto, Mungu tunayemtumikia anaweza kutuokoa na moto, naye atatuokoa kutoka mkononi mwako, ee mfalme.
Ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, Nyasae oito, oria togokorera, nanyare gototooria korwa ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi, na korwa ase amaboko ao.

English: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
Kiswahili: “Msidhani kwamba nimekuja kuleta amani duniani. Sikuja kuleta amani bali upanga.
Ekegusii: “Timokaga ng’a nigo naachire korenta omorembe ase ense; tincheti korenta omorembe, korende omoro bw’eseegi.

English: Good is prayer with fasting, alms, and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold.
Kiswahili: Sala pamoja na kufunga, sadaka, na haki ni njema. Kidogo pamoja na haki ni bora kuliko vingi pamoja na uovu. Ni bora kutoa sadaka kuliko kuweka akiba ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Mbuya gosasiima Nyasae ase enkoro y'ekeene na gokoonya abataka, kobua koba omonda otari omwegenwa. Mbuya gokoonya abataka kobua kwegachera chitaabu.

English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
Ekegusii: Mochirue amo n'okoruegwa kw'endagera, na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng'ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng'ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

English: and saw the Lord saying to me, ‘Hurry! Leave Jerusalem quickly, because the people here will not accept your testimony about Me.’
Kiswahili: nikamwona Bwana akiniambia, ‘Harakisha utoke Yerusalemu upesi, maana hawataukubali ushuhuda wako kunihusu mimi.’
Ekegusii: nkarora Omonene aroro, ogonteebia: Ayerera, karue Yerusalemu bwango, ekiagera tibagwancha oborori bwao igoro yane.

English: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
Kiswahili: Basi, ikiwa Demetrio na mafundi wenzake wana jambo zito dhidi ya mtu yeyote, mahakama ziko wazi na wasaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala. Wanaweza kufungua mashtaka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, onye Demeturio na ababaachi abare amo nere bare ne ring'ana igoro ase omonto, amatuko 'yokogambigwa nare, na abagaambi mbareo, tiga basoerane.

English: And when Abram heard that his relative had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men born in his household, and they set out in pursuit as far as Dan.
Kiswahili: Abramu alipopata habari kwamba jamaa yake amechukuliwa mateka, akawaita watu 318 wa nyumbani mwake waliokuwa wamefunzwa kupigana vita, wakawafuatilia hadi Dani.
Ekegusii: Aburamu agachia koigwa ng’a oyomwabo osakoirwe na gwoswa, agatoma abamura baye abakong’u, abaiboire bwoye, abamanyire korwana esegi, babwatie ababisa goika Dani. Abarwani aba nigo baarenge amagana atato, na ikomi na batano na batato.

English: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
Kiswahili: Wote huenda mahali panapofanana; wote hutoka mavumbini, mavumbini wote hurudi.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda aase ching'iti chikogenda; Mwanyabaanto nigo baruete ase amaroba, ne ching'iti naboigo; nigo bakoirana ase amaroba, naboigo na chirochio.

English: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo akaenda Sarepta. Alipofika kwenye lango la mji, mjane alikuwa huko akiokota kuni. Akamwita na kumwambia, “Naomba uniletee maji kidogo kwenye gudulia ili niweze kunywa.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, akaimoka, akagenda Sarefata. Ekero aigete ang'e negeita ki'omochie, akarora omokungu omoboraka narengeo ogochora chinko. Elija akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Koranche ndetere amaache make negetoono, inywe.”

English: Better an open rebuke than love that is concealed.
Kiswahili: Afadhali karipio la wazi kuliko upendo uliofichika.
Ekegusii: Ogotogonyera kwa maiso marore nigo kore okuya kobua obwanchani bobisegete.

English: along with a thousand men of Benjamin, as well as Ziba the steward of the house of Saul and his fifteen sons and twenty servants. They rushed down to the Jordan before the king
Kiswahili: Pamoja naye walikuwepo Wabenyamini elfu moja wakiwa wamefuatana na Siba, msimamizi wa nyumba ya Sauli, pia wanawe kumi na watano, na watumishi ishirini. Wakaharakisha kwenda Yordani, mahali mfalme alipokuwa.
Ekegusii: Simei nigo arenge amo n’abanto elifu eyemo b’egesaku gia Benjamini. Na Siba, omosomba o Saulo, na abamura baye ikomi na batano, na abasomba baye emerongo ebere, bakaayerera gochia ase Yorodani, bagaikao omorwoti ataraika.

English: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?
Kiswahili: na kuyashika maagizo ya Bwana na amri zake ninazokupa leo kwa mafanikio yako mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Mobwate amachiiko aye, n’emeroberio yaye echiikire, eyio nkobaa ase rituko ria reero, erinde ebe buya ase more.

English: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn't see him.”
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya wenzetu walikwenda kaburini wakalikuta kama vile wale wanawake walivyokuwa wamesema, lakini yeye hawakumwona.”
Ekegusii: Naende abande abarenge amo naintwe bakagenda ase oboina, bakarora buna abakungu bateebete, korende ere tibamorora.”

English: So he, standing in the midst of them, said, “Are you all such fools, you sons of Israel, that without examination or knowledge of the truth you have condemned a daughter of Israel?
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, akisimama katikati yao, akasema, “Je, ninyi nyote ni wapumbavu kiasi hiki, enyi wana wa Israeli, hata bila uchunguzi au ujuzi wa ukweli mmemhukumu binti wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Daniel agatenena ase bare agateba, “Inwe Abaisraeli mboriri ki obo mobwate? Nigo motagete goita omokungu oyo omoisraeli motabwati bomaene.?

English: After all this, O LORD, will You restrain Yourself? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, baada ya haya yote, utajizuia? Je, utanyamaza kimya na kutuadhibu kupita kiasi?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo ogochia gwetanga torora amang’ana aya? Inee! Nigo ogochia gokira‐kiri na gotochanda mono?

English: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Hezekia aliposikia haya, akararua nguo zake na kuvaa nguo ya gunia, naye akaenda katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Hezekia aigwete amang'ana ayio, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chianga chi'echigunia, erio agasoa ase enyomba y'Omonene.

English: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
Kiswahili: Isaya anapiga kelele kuhusu Israeli: “Ingawa idadi ya wana wa Israeli ni wengi kama mchanga wa pwani, ni mabaki yao tu watakaookolewa.
Ekegusii: inaki Omonene n'ache ase ense agaambe ekiina, akenache na kogekoora.”

English: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliokuwepo wakaadhimisha Pasaka wakati huo na Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli abarenge aroro bakarenda Epasaka ase engaki eria, naende bakagenderera korenda Rituko Rinene ri'Emegati etabekiri memera, ase engaki y'amatuko atano na abere.

English: Mordecai recorded these events and sent letters to all the Jews in all the provinces of King Xerxes, both near and far,
Kiswahili: Mordekai aliandika matukio haya, naye akapeleka barua kwa Wayahudi wote walioko katika majimbo ya Mfalme Ahasuero, majimbo yaliyo mbali na karibu,
Ekegusii: Moredekai akariika amang’ana ayio, na agatoma amarube ase Abayahudi bonsi abarenge ang’e na aare ase chingongo chionsi chi’oborwoti bw’Ahaswero,

English: Her vessels of glory are carried away into captivity. Her infants are slain in her streets. Her young men are slain with the enemy's sword.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vyake vya fahari vimechukuliwa mateka, watoto wake wachanga wameuawa katika mitaa yake, na vijana wake wameuawa kwa upanga wa adui.
Ekegusii: Ebibekerero biaye bie erigori biasakoirwe na gosombwa. Abana baye ebing'werere baiteirwe ase chinchera, abasae baye banyenyirwe n'omoro bwa ababisa.

English: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father's concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”
Kiswahili: Ahithofeli akamjibu, “Kutana kimwili na masuria wa baba yako aliowaacha kutunza jumba la kifalme. Ndipo Israeli yote itakaposikia kwamba umejifanya chukizo kwa baba yako, nayo mikono ya kila mmoja aliye pamoja nawe itatiwa nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Ahitofeli akairaneria Abisalomu, “Soa nyomba, momeny'ane nabakungu ba sere‐sere abwo iso atiga bakorenda enyomba. Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakoigwa ng'a kwagechiigwe na iso, na abwo bonsi bagokobwatia nigo barabeekwe chinguru.”

English: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
Kiswahili: Nanyi wakati wa asubuhi mnasema, ‘Leo kutakuwa na dhoruba, kwa sababu anga ni nyekundu na mawingu yametanda.’ Mnajua jinsi ya kupambanua kule kuonekana kwa anga, lakini hamwezi kupambanua dalili za nyakati.
Ekegusii: Na mambia mwaboora: Reero netwe ey’omwaga, ekiagera igoro yababariirire na gosung’unana. Inwe imomanyete korora obosio bwa igoro, korende timomanyeti ebimanyererio bi’ebiro.

English: Then even the most valiant soldier with the heart of a lion will melt with fear, because all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man who has valiant men with him.
Kiswahili: Basi hata yule askari hodari kuliko wengine wote, ambaye moyo wake ni kama wa simba, atayeyuka kwa hofu, kwa maana Israeli yote wanajua kwamba baba yako ni mpiganaji na kwamba wale walio pamoja naye ni watu hodari.
Ekegusii: Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi ’mbamanyete ng’a iso nigo are etuoni y’eseegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.

English: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
Kiswahili: Aliona mmoja wao akidhulumiwa na Mmisri, akamtetea yule aliyeonewa, akampiga yule Mmisri akamuua kulipiza kisasi.
Ekegusii: Akarora oyomo obo ogokorerwa bobe n'Omomisiri, akamokonya; agaakanera oria orenge gochandwa egesiomba, agaaka Omomisiri oria akamoita.

English: Samuel listened to all the words of the people and repeated them in the hearing of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Samweli aliposikia yote watu waliyosema, akarudia kuyasema mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Samweli aigwete amang’ana aya Abanto bakwanire, akayaira ase Omonene.

English: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
Kiswahili: Nitauweka mkono wake juu ya bahari, mkono wake wa kuume juu ya mito.
Ekegusii: Nimbeke enyancha inse y'okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y'okoboko kwaye gw'okorio.

English: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Kiswahili: Helesi, Mpalti; Ira mwana wa Ikeshi kutoka Tekoa;
Ekegusii: Helesi korwa Peleti, na Ira, mosinto o Ikesi, korwa Tekoa;

English: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akamuuliza Yehoshafati, “Je, utakwenda pamoja nami kupigana dhidi ya Ramoth-Gileadi?” Yehoshafati akamjibu mfalme wa Israeli, “Mimi ni kama wewe, watu wangu ni kama watu wako, farasi wangu ni kama farasi wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio akabooria Yehosafati: “Nogende amo nainche, torwanie Ramoti o Gileadi?” Yehosafati akamoiraneria: “Ee, ningende amo naye, na abanto baane amo nabaanto bao, ne chibarasi chiane amo ne chibarasi chiao.”

English: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni mwa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda, neno hili lilimjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ekero Zedekia omorwoti, mosinto o Yosia, achagete kogambera Abayuda, ring'ana rigacha ase 'nde inche Yeremia korwa ase Omonene

English: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
Kiswahili: (kwa kuwa mpaka wakati huo walikuwa bado hawajaelewa kutoka Maandiko kwamba ilikuwa lazima Yesu afufuke kutoka kwa wafu).
Ekegusii: Naki konya tibaramanya ririiko, ng'a nemogwenerete koboka korwa ase abakuure.

English: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.
Kiswahili: Madirisha yake yaliwekwa juu kwa safu tatu, yakielekeana.
Ekegusii: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.

English: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
Kiswahili: Bwana na akulipe kwa yale uliyoyatenda. Ubarikiwe kwa wingi na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye umekimbilia mabawani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaaba chiaye.”

English: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
Kiswahili: Bwana amenilipa sawasawa na uadilifu wangu, sawasawa na usafi wangu machoni pake.
Ekegusii: Omonene ong'akanire, ekiagera 'ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera arooche ng'a nomochenu inde.

English: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Asheri, Sethuri mwana wa Mikaeli;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;
